Perfect to grab and go, or stash in your desk. Not just for kids, these buggers are a great way for grown-ups to get calcium and good-for-you nutrients, and a much better choice than grabbing a soda. I find that these can work as an on the fly breakfast or snack, and they kill a cookie/candy craving like a superhero. If I had kids, I'm sure they'd be fighting me for them! Great for handing out to your cranky hungry cubiclemates, too. They tend to be surprised how tasty they are, since they store so well outside of the fridge. Highly recommend - so much that I subscribe and save!
these were delicious and great for the grandsons for school, they lasted quite an long time and were just the right size

I am enjoying this milk tremendously, it tastes really great, it does not have a pink color (like other strawberry flavored milks do), that means no artificial color added. I signed up for Amazon Subscribe & Save program and will probably keep this for regular delivery. Always looking forward to drink this in the morning.
I tried many flavor of milk, like vanila, chocolate, banana... but my son loves strawberry best and my two-yesr old son even calls it as 'really tasty milk', not strawberry milk.

I bought OV because it has less sugar than Horizon, though not by much (hence the 4 stars). On sale with Amazon, OV was comparable in price to Horizon in the grocery store, @ <$1/box. Convenient for lunchboxes and day-tripping.
LOVE this strawberry milk! Not too sweet and just the right amount of strawberry flavor.Low sugar, low fat, organic-what can be better?

We like the vanilla and chocolate and usually like strawberry milk we purchase at the supermarket but this had too strange a flavor. I find Organic Valley's "competitor" on Amazon has a little better flavors in their brand.  This being said...we do like the chocolate flavor the best in Organic Valley.

First and last time I order this milk, it is disgusting. The strawberry flavoring gives it a sour smell and a barf inducing flavor. If there is an opposite of good strawberry milk it is this vile concoction. IMHO.

I purchased this product because I usually buy Horizon Organic lowfat milk for my children's lunch boxes and wanted to try a lower fat product.  The Organic Valley had good reviews and said that it was less sweet and it is 1% milkfat vs. 2% in the Horizon.  I purchased 2 cases and tried a couple of the milk boxes from each case ( I always try a product before giving it to my children).  The milk had such an off chemical taste, it was disgusting.  I had 4 of my children each take a sip to see if it was my taste buds and they all agreed with me.  I will never buy this product again and will stick with Horizon Organic milk products.  I am giving this product 1 star only because I have to rate it, I don't think it even deserves 1 star.

Ordered this in June of 2012 and the expiration date on the package was for November of 2011. Just like to know what I am getting before I order things. Especially when the total cost for a single pack of biscuit mix ended up being $6.78...ouch! Some may say "why not return it?" Honestly, then that would be putting the liability on me, now wouldn't it? It is the seller's responsibility to make sure their products are of quality; are what they describe; and are not out-of-date. I do not feel like going through the big long hassle of returning this product...so, just warning all of you to make sure you ask about the expiration dates before buying products of this nature.

column9: Thinner and not as strong as I expected
column10: These are not bully sticks. They are much thinner and lighter. Our dog ate them very fast and it didn't take much chewing. At least they don't smell bad like some brands of bully sticks. What you pay is what you get...
These beefy sticks were not what I wanted and not what they were said to be.  Definitely not thick.  More like a treat than a bully stick.

I should have read the reviews on these!  About half of the chews in the bag were the thickness of a pencil.  It took my dog no more than 2 minutes to chew through one of these.  These sticks are probably cheaper at Petco.  The only reason I ordered them was to bring my Amazon order over $25 so I could get free shipping.  What a waste of money!

column9: beefy sticks- not good for tough chewers
column10: My dog loved these, but chewed them up in what seemed like seconds. They are not hard enough for tough chewers. I would recommend these for small dogs and dogs that aren't hard chewers.

column9: Clean, No Smell, Dogs Love 'Em as Much as Flossies
column10: Flossies are the all time favorite of my Aussie and Corgi, but Flossies are expensive. Bully sticks can be foul smelling and dirty. My dogs love these just as much and there's  no stink or mess in the house. I buy them when there's a 4 for price of 3 deal and stock up. If your dogs have been spoiled by Flossies, try these.These are made in USA.

column9: Great if you want your dog to have horrible breath and indigestion
column10: I decided to give these a try after looking at the other reviews, and sadly disappointed with these treats. My dogs breath is horrible and she is having severe digestion problems after eating a few of these. I'm going back to the petrodex dental chews.

These have been great for my puppy (small breed) and I'm surprised how long they last (but I could see how a big dog or a heavy chewer would go through them quickly.)  The bag has a slight smell but I can't smell the individual bully sticks when she's chewing it or when she's done.  Would buy again.
My dogs enjoyed these chews very much. The only thing that would make them better is if they lasted a bit longer. They are a good chew though and my dogs definitely enjoyed them.

Not only are they a tasty treat, I don't have to worry about choking because they are sized just right for my dogs which are a large breed.  My dogs are able to chew these thoroughly without swallowing a large chunk toward the end of the chew.
These treats are perfect for my little dog.  They are thin enough to not intimidate him, but they last for a long while.  He loves these things and they keep him busy for hours!

column9: These are not bully sticks, nor do they last long
column10: The other reviews are correct that say these "beefy sticks" aren't to be confused with "bully sticks".  While this Smokehouse product has similar pricing to bully sticks, they simply aren't bully sticks.  They aren't long lasting at all.  Because of the high price of these beefy sticks and they're more of a quickly consumed treat rather than a long lasting chew, I took 2 stars off the rating.My 30 lbs sheltie girl ate hers in less than 3 minutes and she's a lady-like eater, not a gulper.  But both shelties of mine do enjoy these beefy sticks greatly, so it gets 3 stars for what it is, a treat or a very quick chew.  I just won't buy them again.  True bully sticks are the way to go if you want something that will occupy your furry chewer's time.  A really thick bully (I buy the full 36" bully canes, otherwise known as "walking sticks") will take my kids nearly 2 hours of steady chewing to get a few inches off of it.In short, if you're looking for a quick chew that's rather expensive, these Smokehouse beefy sticks are just that.

These are a great healthy, bully sticks for small to medium dogs.They are wide enough to make them work at it awhile and the 6.5" length is great for my small (9#) bichon to handle. I give her one when I'm leaving in the morning for work and she doesn't suffer from separation anxiety, because that bully stick is all she cares about.
product was very disappointing, flimsy,much smaller than pictured (too expensive for what you get)!-returned to Amazon.

I didn't realize these bones were so thin. I had assumed they were chew bones, but instead were actually a treat. If you are looking for something to occupy your dog for an hour, these aren't it. My 11 week old puppy chainsawed through one in no time. I really needed something to keep him chewing for a while, something that wasn't my couch or shoes. I'll keep looking...
These were the most exciting treats my dogs have had in awhile.  One of them kept trying to steal the bag...
Great product.  It doesn't have the strong smell like the bully stick and my pom loves it like the bully sticks.  It's long lasting for the little dogs.

My dogs love Smokehouse Pizzle Sticks!  I have ordered them numerous times, always getting 4-6 packs at a time.  They always go quickly because I have 5 Chihuahuas.Would highly recommend these treats!

At least, I assume they're tasty, based on how our pup goes nuts about them. I haven't tried them myself, honestly. I mean, I like (nay, LOVE) jerky, but eating a pizzle stick is probably crossing a line, even for me.But for Margot? They're magic treats from heaven. We didn't want her chewing rawhide, because it can get caught in their throat or digestive tract, and these are a fantastic alternative. They've really helped in her pen training - she no longer whines like crazy when its time for quiet and she can't sit next to Mom and Dad. Now she gnaws on this and eventually falls asleep. We still watch her while she's eating them (she doesn't get them when we leave the house) because we're paranoid first-time parents like that, but they seem to be a lot safer than rawhide.The only real issue is how fast she goes through them - Amazon, you need to make these a Subscribe and Save option ASAP!

As other reviewers have said, these are not thick and dense like real bully sticks. they're sort of hollow. Not a total waste, as the pup still loves them, but WAY too expensive for what you get.NOT recommended, except maybe at 1/2 the price I paid.
my cavalier king charles has loved these since he was 3 months old and he is 1 yr and 2 months now. But they are so expensive!!! They are cheaper on wal mart 6.81 for 6.

column9: My dog loves these bully sticks.
column10: My 10 lb. Maltipoo loves these sticks.  I would have given 5 stars if they were thicker.  My dog goes through them fast so for that reason they are an expensive treat. But they aren't smelly which I appreciate.

column9: Why are these so yummy but so expensive?
column10: My 35 pound toller lOVES these things, and they don't stink, and they used to last about 20 minutes a piece when she was a pup. But now that she is full grown, they last about 5 minutes. So sad. I would buy them bigger if they made them. They are too expensive to be used as an every day 5 minute treat, but I do buy them occasionally now, and trying to find something else to replace them! She hates everything else!

column9: Not as strong as regular bully sticks
column10: I bought these for my pitbull puppy since he feels the need to chew everything in sight. These are not as thick/strong as regular bully sticks so he can go through one in about 5 minutes. On the plus side they dont smell awful so I guess its kind of a trade off. Not bad for the price.

I am not sure of the dog size of the others who have reviewed.  I know many state their dog eats right through them and fast!  That is not the case for my 14 week, 10 lb Cocker Spaniel mix.  Bodhi loves them and they last days for him!  Days! They have been great to help with the constant puppy chewing.  Yes, when I found these I was look for "Bully Sticks."  These are lighter in weight.  But you know what.  I ran out the other day and went to the pet store to buy a couple bully sticks.  He hates them.  Hates!  He won't even chew on the bully sticks.  So I would say if you have a bigger dog like a lab these may not be for you.  But for smaller dogs they are perfect!  And they don't stink either!

column9: Very small, not a good value
column10: I decided to try a different brand of Beefy Sticks because the cost was a little less. Although my dogs love these just like the "other" brands, the width of these is barely pencil size and doesn't save me any $$. Very disappointing; I will be sticking with the "other" brand on Amazon. The are stickered MADE IN THE U.S.A, so I'm not sure what the review stating they were made in China is about?? Also, the package is labeled PIZZLE STIX, not Beefy Sticks.
You just can't go wrong with bully sticks! My dog loves them and this is a perfect size for a special treat.

column9: not good for fat sensitive digestive tracts
column10: My dogs usually get 100% organic bully sticks -- I thought I would try this brand as the usual was out of stock... mistake, at least for my pups.  After eating one had soft stool & the other full blown nastiness!  The dog that got it the worst has a delicate stomach & is on a low fat diet for this reason... I think they might be OK for dogs with tougher tummies.

These are beef tendons, not beef pizzle sticks or bully sticks.  Don't get them if you're looking for a distraction for your dog.  My 55 pound mix gobbles them up in about 3 mintues.  She LOVES them and they are natural and good for her so I don't mind paying a little more than I would for some other treats.  She's picky and turns her nose up at a lot of biscuits and other treats. I like these treats for my dog, but they are just a treat, not a bone or "steer stick".

column9: My Akita loves these beefy sticks!
column10: My 7 month old Akita loves these special treats!  And, they are just that..treats.  Not bully sticks or rawhide bones.  And, they are healthy for her which I like.5/4/2012 Update, I am still buying these beef sticks for my now 90 lb Akita.  She loves these special treats and they help keep her teeth clean.  When the package arrives from Amazon she can smell them through the box and can hardly wait for me to open the box.  We even share them with the neighbor's dog and he loves them too!These beef sticks are safe as they are easily chewable and I don't fear her choking on large gummy pieces like rawhide bones.  We highly recommend!
These are basically a treat, not a chew stick.  My lab went through it in a matter seconds.
I don't know about you but I will not feed my dog 'food' from China.  Smokehouse products ARE made in China so buyer beware.
These are great chews.  My small dogs and my larger dogs all love them.  All 5 of my dogs (Bichon, Cockapoo and 3 Great Pyrenees) give them 5 Stars.

Order was timely.  My dog loves these and I couldn't find them at the local pet stores anymore.  They are a bit spendy, but my dog leaves the funiture alone and doesn't chew on anything around the house.
Ughh,  My daughter-in-law gave me some for my dachshund, smelled horrible!!  Come to find out these are a Bulls male anatomy...  Look up the word "pizzle" .......C.S.

When I searched Amazon for dog bully sticks this product came up in the search.  They are not what I expected when they arrived the dogs chewed them up in about 10 minutes.  They are more like those pig ears, kind of fried and crispy.  Way too expensive for a dog treat.
My dogs like these and they at least last awhile. I have a huge dog and it takes him some time to chew. :)
I have 2 small dogs and have tried EVERY bone.They will chew on nothing besides these bones,not even from specialties stores,forget the larger chain stores.
dogs can be finicky. My pup has a yen for chicken treats. Maybe yours prefers beef?

If you just really have to have an ESE machine and want good espresso you can't go wrong will illy.  But if you don't care about having a true espresso machine with a yucky portafilter that you have to keep clean then you should just go for the iPerespresso pods and machine instead.  I have compared these literally side-by-side and the complexity, intensity, and body of the iPerespresso shot just totally blows away the ESE shot, not to mention there is ZERO cleanup, but you are stuck with the pier pods, but who cares.  for 10 cents more a cup you get a truly perfect shot every single time of great illy espresso.
This coffee is great because its one of the darkest roasts you can find with a really low acidity.  Its even better if you can get it in whole bean to grind yourself.  It smells and tastes wonderful.
This is a good product to snack on, the package is small. Companies are always resizing their products these days and the prices keep going up.

This is a very good package of carmel corn.  I do not like Carmel Corn with a lot of peanuts included.  "Crunch 'n Munch" has a small amount of peanuts so I am able to enjoy the carmel corn which is really what I am after.The 4 once sized package seemed small at first look but it is just enough for a quick snack while watching TV.I will purchase more in the future.Regards3589
Fast delivery and the product were fresh with plenty of nuts. Nice after school treat.
Our family of 4 loves this product.  This is my second bulk purchase of crunch-n-munch.  Good value for the money too.

I paid $5.46 for this and bc of this am happy with the purchase. It's quality and tasty product but the 12 boxes definitely are smaller than I normally buy at the store. Good deal, for that price, but I wouldn't purchase again.
Flavor is awesome,the best,i love it.I get a 12 boxes package for a little price in Amazon,it's worth more the money i spent,i love it,love it.Caramel,crunchy,gorgeous!

First I want to say that we absolutely love this product. We found this in Germany and fell in love with it. So we were pleasantly surprised to find it on Amazon.  However, we ordered it and it never came . I also found that this product is definitely over priced. We ended up cancelling our order because it never came according to the time that was promised. I was actually very patient and waited for a good 4 weeks and it still didn't come. I tried to contact the seller through amazon, but never even got a response. So after cancelling, I found a nearby German deli and it was less than $5. Don't waste your time in ordering this.
This product is made of good french cheeses and I know my son like them! So I chose it because in CA wher he lives, he'll appreciate!

column9: A great way to start the day.
column10: I never knew how good oatmeal was until I tried Mornflake. I have it for breakfast every day. It took a little try and error to get it just like I like it. I put the water and oats in the pan and let it set for about 10 min before cooking then put the lid on and let it set for another 5 min. I then add a little cane syrup and milk. I hope a lot of people buy this so Amazon will keep carrying it.

Mornflake Jumbo Porridge Oats, 26-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)  Where in West Los Angeles can I purchase this superior,creamy and most flavorful breakfast cereal?  I find Mornflake Oats by far surpass all its competitors and I have tried every one of them I can find. These oats are full of life force unlike other oats which turn grey upon cooking. Mornflake oats become slightly golden are ultra creamy and tasty.  Please pack this treasure in sturdier boxes and cartons they tend to arrive slightly crushed and sometimes open.  I have noticed this when buying Mornflake oats through amazon.com and at Whole Foods market. Lamentably, Whole Foods no longer carries  this product in L.A., nor does anyone else whom I can find. They are really "missing the boat" by failing to stock this item. Even amazon.com had only one case left the last time I ordered! HELP!!!
I love this oatmeal & used to buy it at local market.  Then they discontinued it & I was so glad to find on Amazon.  Fast shipping too.

I got tired of looking for Mornflakes at the store, (only found them once & was hooked). I couldn't believe I was actually buying a case of oatmeal, but I did! Made lots of Christmas oatmeal cookies for friends. I cook up enough for 3 days at a time & leave it in bowls in the refrig then add milk & fruit, microwave it & enjoy.  It is consistently good & I love the large oats that are never tough or mushy. Am very grateful I found them & now have enough to last a LONG TIME!

Mornflake Jumbo Porridge Oats is an outstanding product, available until recently here in the US in the 26-ounce box shown here.  However, there's been an apparent change in the marketing, and the product is available in the UK, at least, in 26-ounce bags. If you visit the Mornflake website ([...]) you can find out more about the porridge and other interesting products, along with a history of the company.Please, Amazon, it's probably a small group of us who is seeking out this product, but it's worth the search to find it here. Can you continue to supply Mornflake Jumbo Porridge Oats in its new identity and packaging? There's no oatmeal of its kind - Irish, American, or English - I have tried that can hold a candle to it. There are good steel-cut oats from small Irish mills, but that's another category of the grain. These oats make great breakfast cereal, but they also are great ingredients for super meatloaf and fabulous oatmeal raisin cookies. Highly recommended!

This is a wonderful product.  Like one of the other commenters I've tried every brand of oatmeal on the market & this is simply the best.  Really, it's so good that all it needs is the tiniest amount of sweetener & it cooks up quickly & evenly as well.  Love this stuff.  It's available at some Stop & Shop markets in Massachusetts.  Will definately be buying more of this!

The product that I ordered was the wrong item.  When I called to find out how to return it, the person on the phone was really great, said to keep the item as a gift and refunded my money promptly.  We then took all of the boxes of oatmeal to a church who feed the needy. As far as the shipping, it was wonderful and the people on the phone were GREAT.

I first bought this brand of oats in a small local grocery store while visiting family out of state.  First thing I was impressed with was how little packaging this product uses.  Just the box, that's all.  No liner, no additional layers to have to cut and tear through.But it was the taste and texture that was SO much better than any oatmeal I've ever had that when I returned home, I had my family buy it and mail it to me!!  Then I thought to check Amazon, and not only did they carry it, it is one of their Subscribe and Save items.  I immediately signed up.The oatmeal has the perfect blend of creaminess as well as texture, and wonderful taste.  I make it in the microwave, and what I've found the best technique to get it really creamy is to add more water than needed, and then at the end, boil it for a minute or two (in the microwave, with the pot's lid off) till it gets to the right consistency.  (Be sure to do this in a LARGE pot .. twice the size you need or more .. and watch it constantly so it doesn't boil over!!)

column9: ...Just like being back in England, but with better weather....
column10: This oats are exactly what I was looking for. When I first came to the States I was looking for some Porridge (that's how we call it in UK). Tried different ones and, eventhough some looked just like this oats, I just could not find anything that would get creeeemy like the porridge I use to have on a bleak morning in England (every morning...). I then found this at my local Giant, but they don't always have them.I love you Amazon for stocking this wonderful product. The price it's great too, the only weird thing is getting 12 packs at the time. I never use to buy grocery in a bulk!The product is outstanding; I use a ratio of 2 and 1/2 amount of liquid (I use 2/3 water and 1/3 milk) to 1 unit of oats, bring it to boil and then let it simmer for 15-20 minutes while I shower. It gets so creamy, you hardly need anything else...maybe just a tad of sugar!! Healthy and delicious way to start the day!!

I've been making wine from packaged wine kits now for several years and when I saw the Chateau Classico kits on Amazon for $85 I had to try one.  First of all, $85 for a 16 litre red wine kit is a great deal and it comes complete with labels, real corks, and foil caps.  Add that to the free shipping and no sales tax and it's a no-brainer.  The wine is great. I've completed 17 of these Chateau Classico kits now of various types and they are all good.

Honestly I was attracted by the great price and free shipping on an 16+ liter kit. If you have ever done a kit before this was no different then all of the rest. Ingredients are clearly marked and the directions are adequate. My kit has been in the bottle now for 6 months and the wine is light bodied and very approachable.Planning on starting another one of these kits in the next month.

I just bottled this wine. It stated it was a full 6 gallons. In order to get 6 gallons, I needed to top off with better than a gallon of water. I thought that would dilute the wine too much, so I racked it into a 5 gallon carboy and proceeded from there. I did add oak chips during the fermenting process.The end result, this wine is great. When I asked my wife what she thought, she said this wine is way better than the wine she buys today. I'd defintely do another one of these.Since I didn't get the full six gallons - therefore 4 stars. I did a similar report on the Malbac.

column9: I have been looking for these for forever!
column10: I loved these candy bars as a kid and then suddenly I couldn't find them anywhere. I may have anticipated them more than I thought, because they seemed not as good as they used to be. Still great but not awsome, that is the reason for only four stars. The candy arrived very quickly and in perfect condition. The AERO BARS were very fresh and yummy. I may have to order more now that I am thinking of them again. Mmmmm!
I love Aero bars. The problem is that they are difficult to find locally. I personally like to put them in the freezer prior to eating them. The product arrived in good condition.

The bars I received were crumbled on one end & light tan in color, which indicates OLD chocolate. That end of the bar tasted awful. I have seen that a million times & I recognize what it means. The other end of the bars had melted & reset, but still tasted OK & were the correct color for fresh chocolate. A second set was sent to me at no charge, however, the same was true of those. Also appeared that the company was not too happy with my complaint, as the second set arrived in a small, smashed box with a tiny piece of bubble wrap floating around loose in the box & had not been secured to the bars with tape to protect them.

I bought chocolate through the mail in August in New Mexico.  I didn't even think about the fact that it would need to be insulated/refrigerated.  When it arrived, it was melted.  I do however remember the chocolate bar being delicious the last time I had it...alas....not this time.
I had gotten them for the wife, and She said the bars with all these bubbles in them makes the Chocolate taste explode out in your mouth, "Like sex in your mouth" she said with a smile.

This is a bold blend that has a great taste. The flavor comes bursting through. I usually brew & drink Organic Sumatra Mandeling from BJ's. I use this blend exclusively, so to get a cup that rivals the complex flavor from my Tassimo brewer is fantastic. Come on Amazon add it to the subscription service.

We've tried many Tassimo flavors.  This is by far our favorite.  Our normal cup of coffee is Starbuck's house blend out of a Cuisinart pot but one or two days a week we use our Tassimo.  This coffee is rich but not too stong.  I don't understand the current price over $20 for 14 disks and hope that it will be lowered on Amazon.  For now, we'll buy elsewhere.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: This is one of the best choices, in my opinion.  I also adore Amazon, but they need to negotiate a better price for their Tassimo Disks.  These are available at BedBath & Beyond for $10. and I always get 20% off which brings it down to $8.00 --- they were $7.50 (before the 20% off readily available coupons) until about 3 months ago.  Again, this is an excellent blend with full flavor - not bitter - I think it's my favorite.

I have tried about 75% of the available T-Discs, and the Kona Blend is one of the best regular/unflavored coffees for Tassimo. It has a nice smooth flavor that is not overpowering, and has a pleasant aroma. Personally, I would enjoy it more if it were stronger/bolder. However, being a bit mild, it goes well with breakfast and/or (gluten-free) baked goodies. I find it mildly perplexing that this product is not available from tassimodirect, nor is a subscription service available. Originally found this at (Dead Bats from) Beyond, used a 20% coupon, and was happy with the final price.

column9: Note: Rating both coffee and seller
column10: This coffee is good but, for me, it's nothing special. I will buy it again because it's a nice, mellow blend, and my favorite daily coffee, Nabob, must now be shipped from Canada. However, on my first order to the Canadian company, it's taking a long time to be delivered (still haven't gotten it).The reason for only three stars is not about the quality of the coffee but the fact that the description of the product does not mention the fact that this "Kona coffee" is actually only 15% Kona. If you look very carefully at the photo of the disc, you can see that information, and there's a legal disclaimer saying that the product may not match exactly with the description. So it's my fault for not reading more carefully, but I was happy to see what I thought was 100% Kona and wasn't careful. I've bought the 15% Kona before in a local store and did know that there was such a product in the Tassimo discs, but I just read the product title and ordered.As I said, the coffee tastes good, the amount of coffee is the usual amount, neither the small cups of some European coffees or the extra large size, and I would recommend the coffee. Just be aware that this is blended coffee with only 15% Kona. And don't expect it to come in a flash, as it did when Amazon Prime delivered it.
Of all the coffee's available for Tassimo this Kona has the richest flavor and fantastic aroma byfar my favorite.
Instructions were clear, the juice is excellent. Everything has gone as planned so far - 4 weeks into the process. I expect some very drinkable wine when all is said and done.

I received the bananaramas right on time.  And it was great.  My kids like eating them just for fun.  But I also used them for filling up little baby bottles as a monkey themed baby shower favor.  I loved it!

After trying Chimes in the smaller store bought bags, I found a new treat I love.The Mango pairs nicely with the Ginger in these chewy little candies. The sweetness smooths the spicy side of the ginger leaving me with a happy mouth. (And nice breath as an added bonus). I usually enjoy one or two a day as I tend to suck on them not chew them, thus they last quite a while. The 5 pound box drops the price in half, making the price for 5 oz about $1.80. (Fortunately for easier storage, the chews come in one larger bag not individual 5 oz bags.)I have found if I have one when I get 'hungry' after dinner, it fills the dessert void and helps keep me out of the fridge and pantry. I just tuck in the side of my mouth and the flavor keeps my mind and mouth busy enough to keep my no eating after 8pm rule in check. At 4 carbs, Zero fat and 16 calories, I can keep myself on track.

These are really exciting.  I got the ginger chews at the local market, and love them, but when I saw the mango-ginger combo, I knew I had to try them.  There's quite a bit of heat in these, and the taste lingers long after the candy is gone.  For the guy who wrote he only eats one or two a day--HOW?  These are delicious.  The 5 lb box will be gone in no time.Thank you Amazon for carrying them.  Thank you Chimes people for a great candy.

I was thrilled to find these delicious and healthy candies on line in bulk.  We love them and they are very expensive to buy individually packaged.  Buying them in bulk brought the cost down dramatically.  Everything was as advertised and arrived very quickly.  Great deal.

After having unexplained sharp, burning pain in my stomach and doctors prescribing medication for me that did not offer any relief, I decided to buy some of these ginger chews.  I found them in a local store and then couldn't find them again until I searched Amazon!  Happily, I was able to order this large quantity which lasts me about 2 months (I eat about 10 chews throughout the day).  If you are unsure about ginger and its benefits, you may wish to some research but I have been very happy with the quality (and quantity) of this product and its positive impact in my life!

An absolutely indispensable staple item for any ship's stores.  Though not personally prone to mal-de-mer or the technicolour yawn, these Mango Ginger Chews will henceforth be available to crew and guest alike on my sailboat.  I'd almost go so far as to suggest a stocking formula ... 1 ounce per foot (LOD).

These ginger chews are a very "satisfying" candy and really wake up your mouth.  i had purchased small packets of both the orange ginger and mango ginger chews at a local store, and when I discovered how fabulous they are, I searched for a source and bought the 5-pound box from amazon at a far cheaper price than buying the small packets.  Both flavors are great but we preferred the mango a bit more so purchased that one.  We are not "tired" of them, even having purchased the 5-pound quantity.  Only negative is that the wrappers can be a bit difficult to open--you have to find just the right spot to pull them open. So if you have arthritic fingers (I'm just thinking of my mom) these candies could be a problem to open.

I've tried the Orange and the Mango - prefer the Mango.  Not many people around here have ever tried these before, so they make a nice conversation item.  I give samples away all the time, to waiters (oh, I mean "servers"), co-workers, etc.  Besides the risk of pulling out a filling (cavity filling), these might be too spicy for some folks ... but that's what makes 'em so good!!!!

Besides the fact that they taste amazing...hot and sweet, they are good for motion sickness. They stick to your teeth in a way that the flavor can be savored for awhile. Yummy! Probably the best "candy" I've ever had!
Yum yum.  The sweetness of the mango is such a nice addition to the stinging heat of the ginger. Easy to carry a few in my pocket and share with friends and folks.The 5 lb box is a value buy.

According to ginger loving friends, this flavor is the best. It seems to please everyone. The mango gives it a great flavor and it seems a bit smoother than some of the others. The warmth of the ginger and the fruity mango make a unique and irresistible combination.Addictive! As with other ginger chews, great for sea sickness, etc. Buy the tins and use this 5 pound bag to refill.

I had a friend find these Chimes Ginger Chews at a local discount store.  When I went to buy them, they were gone and not going to be replaced.  So off to Amazon another friend and I went and found them with no problem.  These candies are wonderful for the nausea us cancer patients experience.  I have recommended them to others and they too have ordered them.  I hope this product stays around for a long time.  Great price for a huge amount of candy.

column9: Delicious and useful in so many situations
column10: These candies are the bomb!!GREAT FOR-freshening up that breath anytime!-poppin one or 2 to stay awake in class!-making new friends by offering strangers a cool new candy they're probably never tried! *don't seem creepy though.-calming your stomach when you feel queasy after losing your self control at a Chinese buffetI love these, I could easily eat like 8 in one sitting.

must say i was pretty much addicted to the Gin Gin ginger candy, well what can you say it is that damn good. I saw this as a recommendation while buying Gin Gins from Amazon and I am truly surprised at how delicious this is. My parents who were visiting decided that they would take a bulk of the candy with them to share with the family in the sub continent, my friends at work were impressed, and now I cannot have enough of this.I keep some on me wherever i go It is indeed genius to combine the best of the ginger and mango chew, getting the best of both worlds, highly recommended to all those who love Gin Gins
We love these mango ginger chews.  We've tried the orange and original flavors too and love them all.  Spicy and sweet.
These mango ginger chews are my favorite candy!  They are chewy and sweet, but a tad hot because of the ginger.  I highly recommend them!

I love this stuff.  We started off eating the regular flavor, which is also awesome.  It's great for when you're under the weather, when you want something light and sweet, when you're feeling a light sea-sickness, for hangovers, and even for those times when you've eaten too much and have some light indigestion.  The local stores sells 5 ounces for $5, which makes this 5 lb box a GREAT deal.  We have it on the "subscribe and save" for auto delivery, which makes this an even better deal.

column9: very good, not as good as straight ginger
column10: I love Chimes' ginger chews, and I love mangos (the fruit), so I thought I would love these.  For me, the mango flavor detracted from the ginger a bit, rather than deepening it.  I like these, and I like the ginger even better!
I got these to use as wedding favors but I can't stop eating them! Please help, they are too good!

My mango ginger chews are fresh-tasting and very slightly sweet with a zing from the ginger ingredient. They remind me of chewing gum or taffy, but are "stiffer" than either. Chewing and swallowing 5-6 of them helps relieve nausea, but they do take a few minutes to work. The effect is not strong so you may need to chew more, after you have given the first chews a chance to work, if you are still nauseated.

Love these little chews.  Great for morning sickness or just a sweet treat.  The 5 lb box is a great value and will last a long time.  I ordered them one afternoon from Amazon (with 2 day shipping) and it was on my doorstep the next morning, amazing Amazon!

column9: My favorite flavor of these chews!
column10: These were the flavor that introduced me to ginger chews and my favorite with the orange a close 2nd, peanut and apple (cinnamon really) tied for third and the origional ginger close behind. The coffee was a disappointment, don't bother.

I love coffee from Red Buffalo.  The flavors are fabulous!!  For health reasons, I only drink decaff and this company, thankfully, offers lucsious flavors in decaff, which other coffee vendors do not.  Red Buffalo will be my ONLY SOURCE for coffee I love.  In addition to their wonderful product, their customer service is top flight.connie, lakesdie, arizona
These are pretty tiny, I would have prefered them a little bigger, they tasted good, you could do sweet or savory fillings in them.  I did sweet and people loved them.

column9: Good basic kit. Do some tinkering to really make it shine.
column10: I have been making Chateau Classico kits for about a year now. The initial batches were as directed using included ingredients. The results were drinkable, decent wine. But adding Medium plus toast American Oak chips, really pushed these kits over the top for me. The result of putting this kit (and a Dolcetto) on oak for a week was a fuller bodied, immensely drinkable wine.The kit does not include any kind of oak like some others. I may try adding some oak powder when I pitch the yeast in the next batch to see how the wine changes.So far, I cannot complain about this brand of kit. I subscribe and save $15 per kit, which brings this kit in at almost half the price of some of the better known manufacturer's kits. With a little experimentation, you can get excellent results with this kit.

I have been making wine for just under a year. This is my fourth kit. I tried the other cheaper cabernet merlot 4 week kit sold on Amazon and was not very happy. So I decided to spend a little more money and see if there was a big difference. The directions were a little off but I've done this enough times now including making wine from fruit that I had a pretty good idea of the order of things. I did the full six weeks. I did not filter. I racked once at about 5 weeks and 2 times before bottling. It made 29 bottles plus enough to fill 2/3 of one. I put the 2/3 full bottle in a bottle I had with a screw top and kept it on the stove for the past 2 weeks thinking I might use it to cook. I poured myself a glass last night and neither my husband nor I could believe it! It was SO SMOOTH! It had great body. It was perfectly CABERNET like I was looking for all along! If I had filtered it might have a little better clarity than it does, but it really doesn't seem to be affecting the taste. I am so impressed with this brand I setting it up for automatic delivery. I also am going to try their Pinot Noir next and hope for the same results. If you like dry and smooth, this is the wine for you to make!

Thus far I have made it the fermentation process and I have intentions of, upon completion of this kit, to put the kit into my 5 gallon barrel and let it bulk age for awhile.  I must say I am pretty impressed with this one.  I've added very little water, I'd say about 2.5 gallons over the fermentation/racking process.  There has been little to no sediment and it tastes bold, like a Cabernet should.  There is however no oak powder or chips included in this kit, thus explaining why I have the awaiting barrel.  Of course the addition of the labels and the shrink caps and the corks make this kit very worth while.  If you have purchased one of the cheaper kits on Amazon, good job its a good way to start.  Now spend a little extra and get something much better.  I'll wite up more at 6 months after bottling as this one will keep for a couple of years or longer in the bottle.

This is the third of these kits that I have made to fill the rack while the other homebrews finish.  I am impressed.  I made this one and cut it back a bit, about 5 gallons.  It was easy, fun, and it turned out just fine. Color is deep and pretty, no filtering, and it is a great little something to pull off the rack for that spur of the moment grill out, or for that evening glass. The taste is a bit lighter than a $15 bottle of wine, but for the price it is truely drinkable. I would put it between a cab and merlot in finish.  I let mine age a bit in the carboy before bottle, and it just got better.  For the novice, and for a good cheapie to grab out when you need it, perfect!  For the price, it's a pretty good deal.

There are so many good things to say about this matcha as well as this company.  Let's start with how awesome Red Leaf Tea is.The customer service is prompt and friendly.  They listen to your suggestions and opinions and take action to please their customers.  It's a sad world when decent customer service is a novelty, but Red Leaf Tea brings some joy back into a bleak world with their courtesy.  Thank you, Red Leaf Tea!Now, this matcha...it's great for beginners!  The price is perfect and you get a good amount of tea so you can experiment with  how you like to drink it.  The basic flavors here are sweet, green and minerally.  THe texture is pretty smooth with only a hint of a powdery texture.  It's a pleasing beverage hot, prepared in the traditional way.  Yes, the quality isn't the best, but it is definitely a good introduction.  It is not bitter at all and completely inoffensive.  I used to be scared of preparing my own matcha because the one time I did it before Red Leaf, it was with a horrible matcha that was extremely bitter.  Now I make myself matcha drinks all the time!After trying this tea the traditional way to fully appreciate the flavors you're working with, you can use the powder to add flavor and healthiness to pretty much anything!  Like the Starbucks green tea latte?  Now you can make your own at a fraction of the cost!  Breakfast smoothie need a healthy caffeine kick?  BAM! Starter Matcha to the rescue!  Want some green tea cookies to go with your green tea latte?  You know where I'm going with this.  :)My favorite way to have this matcha right now is to add it to my Almond milk, banana smoothie.  It was also awesome in my amaretti cookies.  :)Conclusion?  Highly recommended!

Mom Made Foods Cheese Pizza Munchie, 5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8)Amazon service is top notch.Occasionally, a Seller slips in a pathetic excuse for a product.The advertised pictures of the product have no resemblence to the product delivered.The taste and texture of this expensive snack size frozen pizza is much like pulverized cardboard.I splurged financially on this item hoping for an exceptional eating experience, to treat myself.It was and is HORRIBLE.I cannot return the 7 unopened boxes as it is too difficult to safely package and deliver frozen foods.Even the ingredients listing are false.Try this product at Amazon.You will find every statement I have said is True.I have found every other product so far acceptable and fair for the price.I just didn't want other good Amazon customers to be ripped off by MOM MADE PIZZA.  Chris Smith

These cheese pizza pockets are great (for kids and adults)!  When I make them for kids I always make one or two for me as well.  They are quick, hot, nutritious snacks or meals.  Can't beat it.  I have tried a few other Mom Made foods and I'm sold on the stuff.  Try the Mac&Cheese!!!  It's awesome!

I was actually pretty disappointed with these, which really is inconvenient now that I have an entire case of them! A bunch of them were all but broken when I opened the boxes, and my kids aren't big fans of them either. They are picky, but pizza or anything even remotely pizza usually never fails... no such luck here. That and plan on having to bake them to warm them (which takes 25 plus minutes), otherwise they come out a bit soggy from the microwave...

column9: My very picky toddler loves these
column10: My son refuses all kinds of foods that toddlers normally love, he even WIPES HIS TONGUE after tasting macaroni and cheese.  Needless to say, I am always scrounging for healthy ways to get him to eat more things.  He adores these, and I am thrilled because they managed to squeeze in a whole load of veggies that I couldn't arm wrestle him into eating.  They are virtually impossible to find in the mega-sized city where I live, even in Whole Foods stores and the like.  My Target store attempts to stock them and can't even keep them in stock, as apparently other kids like them as much as mine. I'm so excited to stock the freezer so that I will have these on hand for every time I can't get him to eat more than a tiny fistful of goldfish crackers!
I had two for lunch at work, and they were perfect - healthy, tasty, and filling.

I eat Mom Made Munchies mid afternoon when I get starving, and don't have time to break from the computer.  The calories are so low (under 150), and these fill me up way more than a cereal bar does!  Mom Made shouldn't just market these for kids, 'cause I think more adults would love them too!

I try to buy food for my family that contains indgredients that I recognize and Mom Made fits the bill.  My son (age 7) loves these and I do too b/c I don't have to feel bad about feeding him all sorts of processed junk!!  So easy to cook and nutrious to boot.  Try some for yourself, you won't be disappointed.

The Hormel Compleats that contain sauce always contain a lot more of it than the picture on the packaging suggests.  This variety is no exception.  The picture is very misleading and suggests a much more solid meal than you get.The ravioli are thin and underfilled.  The marinara sauce has an unusually strong flavor, one which may or may not be to your personal liking.  I disliked it mostly because I found it distinctly sweet (the ingredients include sugar and high fructose corn syrup).  As it also contains vinegar, the taste is reminiscent of a Chinese sweet and sour sauce.If you are looking for a convenient, very light snack with a strong and unusual taste, you might give this a try, but I would want less sugar in the sauce and more filling in the ravioli before I tried it again.
A little spice to the sauce and GREAT TASTE. I love to take this for my meal breaks at work.

A little disappointed.  The ravioli taste OK, but too few of them.  Product has a lot of liquid; and although it has a pretty good flavor, there is a lot more of it than is needed for the amount of pasta.  Best if combined with vegetable to absorb all the excess sauce.  I use sweet potato, mashed.

column9: Compleats cheese & spinach ravioli - horrible taste
column10: I can't believe this item was even approved by FDA. Maybe it was just this one packet - but it tasted like I was eating chemicals or something. I couldn't even have a second bite!...I would have definitely vomitted had I had a second bite. I hope not all their items are as bad. I am definitely not buying from Compleats anymore!

Most of these meals have too much salt. This one could use just a bit more salt, and a bit less spice.The trick with this one is to let it sit a bit out of the microwave so the heat spreads more evenly, or you'll burn your mouth on the hot spots.This is a decent dish. Add a little salt and some grated cheese and it's even better.

I was VERY disappointed in the Chai Tea Latte.  I was very excited to try it and after brewing my first cup the smell was of a wonderful creamy pumpkin pie.  But after my first sip I knew there was something horribly wrong.  Sure enough I realized I should have looked at the ingredients before spending $9.  The chai tea disk contains Splenda (sucralose) which to those of us who can't stand the stuff, and can detect it in any food no matter how subtle the metallic aftertaste, was a HUGE disappointment.  It makes no sense to me why the makers would use Splenda to sweeten the chai tea when the latte creamer includes sugar already.  So if you like or don't mind Splenda you will probably really enjoy this.  On the other hand if you are sensitive to it your first cup may also be your last, as mine was.  :(

This drink should get ZERO stars.My husband and I recently purchased the Tassimo Suprema machine.  We mainly drink cappuccinos, but we were excited about some of the other drink options.  To add variety to our selection, we tried the Twinings Chai Latte T discs.  I was the first one to taste the chai latte.  I looked at my husband immediately and remarked, "It tastes like it has Splenda in it!" We were both incredulous at first, but then he tasted it as well.  It did taste like it had Splenda.  I took the packaging out of the garbage and read the ingredients of the Twinings Chai Latte.  To our very severe disappointment, the very last ingredient was sucralose.  My husband and I detest Splenda - it has an awful aftertaste and it gives us headaches.  We are extremely disappointed that Tassimo/Twinings decided to put Splenda in the Chai Latte recipe. We did not purchase our Tassimo system because we wanted low calorie drinks - and if the product contains Splenda IT SHOULD CLEARLY SAY SO ON THE PACKAGE. Furthermore, we are perplexed why, if this one product contains Splenda, there is no other Chai latte option.  Why in the world would someone want to spoil the wonderful taste of Chai with a manufactured sugar substitute like Splenda?  If customers ASK for a low calorie substitute, it should definitely be made available.  But why make your only version "low calorie?"We cannot bring ourselves to finish the rest of the package that we purchased - it tastes so awful. We're very disappointed that the money we spent on the package of Chai Latte T discs was wasted.  If we had seen on the packaging that it contained Splenda we would not have purchased it - we automatically assume that the sweetener is not artificial unless the label indicates otherwise - all customers do.Of course, if you don't mind the taste of Splenda then you might really enjoy this drink.  Otherwise, spend your money on something else - and make sure you read the ingredients before you buy it!

column9: It's definitely NOT a Starbucks or CoffeeBean Chai Tea Latte!
column10: I am a BIG fan of Starbucks and CoffeeBean's Chai Tea Latte.  And was so excited to buy this product hoping that it would replace my $4 habit.  But I was dissapointed.  Another reviewer that gave it a good rating stated that "it smells wonderful...tasting like a liquid pumpkin pie...Sweet, creamy and somewhat spicy".  Well, it is sweet and creamy but not spicy like my favorite Chai Tea Latte.  It just doesn't even come close to that taste...but I have convinced myself that even though I'm giving up on the taste, I'm saving at least $3 per cup if not more.  And, yes, you can taste the splenda...and I can say that because I am a splenda fan.  Overall, I only gave it a three star because it's not a bad tasting item, but just not what I expected it to taste.  Maybe the wonderful aroma alone could satisfy you...

column9: Best Chai Latte you can make at home!
column10: Delicious and invigorating. For those who want something more than a regular cup of coffee. Yes, this is made with a bit of splenda. I, personally, prefer this and, as far as the sweetness goes, it is made with very little splenda - it is not overly sweet (for those of us that don't like sweet things), but sugar/sweetener can be added for those who do like it. Chai tea is a delicious drink and the tassimo chai latte is definitely the best chai you could make at home in 30 seconds. Far better tasting and far better for you than the boxed or powder versions!
the best tassimo tea i have tried them all...very smooth chai tea..very flavorful and the best part it is only 90 calories with latte included..a must for people like me on a diet

I really like the Twinings Chai tea, whether I drink it hot or iced, pretty good. If you ice it, brew,pour in glass,put in fridge until chilled, then add the ice. I make a double batch,chill and keep extra on hand. If you ice it hot,the ice melts and dilutes the tea too much. Also, do not use fridge ice, yuk; I always use clear ice I buy at our local convenience store, makes the tea taste so much cleaner. I say buy and enjoy, hope you all agree.

column9: One of my new favorite tassimo's
column10: Bought the Tassimo for the wife mainly since I'm not a huge coffee drinker unless it's sweetened/creamed beyond recognition.  I've had chai before and jumped at them when I saw them at Bed,Bath&Beyond this past weekend. Makes a fantastic chai latte and I'm glad now I can order online since up til now I hadn't seen Chai available yet.
What bonehead decided to put sucralose in otherwise good Chia Tea?  It is sickly sweet with an enormous aftertaste.  Terrible.

First off, the Amazon descriptions make it sound like you're getting 16 servings in a pack, and tho veterans know a package is only really 8 servings, newbies may not. Then they sell it as a "Pack of 2." Does that mean you get two packages with 8 servings (1 tea plus 1 milk) each?Then the chai itself...It's the worst-tasting chai I've ever had, and I've had some doozies. If they're selling other Starbucks stuff, why not Tazo Chai? It's too sweet, too, but the spices are vivid enough to overcome the sweetness. The Twinings stuff is just too weak. And why can't they just leave the sweetener out of the tea part altogether? Avoid the Splenda issue completely.I thought that going with the Tassimo would give me stronger coffee than the Keurig makes. Didn't realize there'd only be one chai choice and it would suck. Fool me once, shame on me.

One of the reasons that I bought the Tassimo system was so that I would be able to get the Chai Tea Latte taste at home without paying 4 bucks a cup.  I am a big fan of the Tazo liquid Chai mixes that I have used in the past.  I was a little bit nervous about the Twinings Chai, but since it was well reviewed I thought I was pretty safe.OK, so, I was wrong.  It appears that this product appears to be in the "love it or hate it" category.  I'm in the latter category.  The taste, and to a lesser extent smell of this product just isn't right.  Some of it may have to do with the Splenda, it clearly has an odd aftertaste that I don't associate with Chai.  I have had Chai in coffe shops large and small, but this is a taste I'm never quite experienced.  I'm not sure why or what the funkiness is, but I don't like it.  I'm probably going to have to throw out the second box: this is that objectionable.  I'm hoping that Tazo or Starbucks comes in and gives it a go, because not having Chai Tea Latte with my Tassimo is a large bummer.  In the mean time I'll go back to using the liquid Tazo mix, when I can find it.

Love the Chai tea taste. Love the ease of use of my Tassimo unit. But read the fine print closely. For every chai tea disc you get you are also receiving (and paying for) a disc of milk/creamer/watered down blegggh. A package of 16 actually means: 8 teas and 8 creamers. It would be worth the money for 16 tea discs alone-- and let you add your own creamer. But Tassimos' creamers are watered-down throw-aways. I have a cabinet full of unused Tassimo creamers (that come with their teas/lattes/cappucinos). It's almost enough to make me stow away my Tassimo coffeemaker. Instead, I order ONLY the coffees that do not come with the nasty milk/foam/creamer. Now... what to do with 11 boxes (times 4 per box) of this... stuff?
Great product. It is now a staple in our house. I don't notice the splenda taste that everyone is talking about, tastes like a chai latte from any coffee stand to me...and I am picky!
Good if you are looking for a Chai Tee Latte - but has a bitter after taste.  Wil not but again.  Hopefully they will come out wiht a better taste.

column9: NOT THE BEST BUT IT'S GOOD!
column10: It's a nice cup of chai...is it the best or does it taste like what you get from Starbucks or other coffee/tea houses, No... but if you are looking for decent "copy-cat", than this is it! Yes, there is an artificial sweetner that is used in it, so if you are sensitive to that or just don't like the taste (I would say it mimicks the taste of Equal more than Splenda) of the fake sweetners than this tea is NOT for you. The spices are on point and the addition of either the milk disc or your own half and half makes it even more delicious! I use the fat-free milk discs that come with the Skinny Cappuccinos and it is perfect! If I want something a little richer, than I use a regualr milk disc or add my own half and half.

A very tasty Chai Latte...a nice treat and diversion from the other coffee options. Not too sweet and not too bland...just right with the flavor! The latte smells incredible when it's brewing...MMmmmm....Amazon had this product for an AMAZING price! So, you can't go wrong.
I started drinking this in the late summer and found it okay at that time.  But as the autumn temperatures have dropped, this product has gotten better.

column9: I was a fan but now? Not so much...
column10: I used to love drinking this chai tea. I thought it was a good blend of sweet and spice to create the great chai taste. However lately when I have drank it, it tastes too artificial to me. Perhaps its the Splenda in it which once warmed up makes it taste this way. I'm not too sure but the fact it uses Splenda now is a big turn-off to begin with.I wish the taste had never changed since I was a loyal drinker of it. Now? Not so much and not at this price!

If you don't send water through the same tea disc a 2nd time, and don't add sugar, you will taste too much nutmeg over a cheap assam or green tea (which tastes like dirt). I also squirted some light whip cream in it and over it. After trying the undrinkable Gevalia cappaccino, I was relieved to find something I liked. The creamer isn't bad in this one. I don't know if it's a different kind or if it is a good combination of seasoning. I gave it 3 stars because for this price, Twinings should have used a better grade of tea. It tastes pretty good now, but there is still that lingering aftertaste of earthy tea. With the milk, it fills my insulated glass 3/4 of the way full. One other feature, it smells wonderful brewing! It IS Thanksgiving in a cup (thermal glass, I mean.) As a price comparison, using the 20% coupon at Bed, Bath, & Beyond, who sells it for $10.99, regularly, for the 16 disc (8 servings) pkg. and with their free standard shipping, it comes to $1.09 per serving before tax.

First off, the Twinings Chai Latte's are probably the best drink that the Tassimo can make IMHO.  I typically pick them up at the local BB&B ($10.99 for 8 servings about $1.37/cup, and just now found out that they have free shipping :))My issue here is with this specific item.  It lists "Includes 2 packs of 16 servings each!" which would make the price of $32.99 a decent deal for 32 servings ($1.03 per cup).  I guess thats the benefit of buying in bulk.But then, the package arrived this morning.  In the package is two 8 serving packs.  Now, it is important to note that with any Tassimo Lattes, there are two T-Disks needed for each serving.  1 is the milk and the other is the espresso or tea.  So there are 16 T-Disks in each package but only 8 servings.  Everywhere else on the planet, it will cost you between $1.00 and $1.37 per serving.  Here, it will cost you twice that much.  Total false advertising and complete ripoff.  Guess I'm going to find out how Amazon's return policy works.

The product description says, "Includes 2 packs of 16 servings each!" but this is absolutely not true.  You get 2 packs of 8 servings each.  I would not have bought this version of the product if it had been labeled correctly, because it costs significantly more than the truthfully labeled 2 packs of 8 servings each.  I am going to ask Amazon to make up the price difference, or allow me to return it for no charge.

I was so excited to try the chai tea after all it smells so good. I don't mind the taste of splenda ~but the tea,which smells like a creamy pumpkin pie, was watered down to me. I don't know if it was the creamer I added( baised on another review of the watered down creamer) ,because I didn't taste the tea pre creamer...the experiance was very dissapointing. I may try it again with out the creamer~ hopefully I will get the bold and spicy flavor the delightful smell would lead you to believe is there.

I'd never had a Chai Tea Latte before, and bought this primarily for my boyfriend, until I tried it. This is delicious! I don't usually care for the taste of sucralose, but this is just right. Sweet, but not too sweet with a lovely flavor of honey and spices.

Let me say first that I use and like Splenda so I am not unhappy that it is in this chai latte drink. And I drink a lot of chai teas at coffee shops as I'm a non coffee drinker married to a coffee fiend. I found the Twinings Chai Latte for the Tassimo to be excellent and now have one every morning. It is sweet, so beware of that. Unfortunately, my teenage son and his pals recently tried the chai lattes and now they, too, are fans. So, I am hiding my stash.  The per cup cost is high, but still cheaper than what I pay at Starbucks. It's also not easy to find as my local Target carries coffee products for the Tassimo, but not the chai tea, requiring that I either drive to Bed, Bath and Beyond or order online.

column9: Blecch.  Too sweet even for someone who likes Splenda
column10: Both my husband and I hated this one.  I hated it because I can't stand the taste and aftertaste of Splenda; I didn't realize it was an ingredient or I wouldn't have bought the drink.  My husband doesn't mind Splenda, but found the chai excessively sweet, overpowering any spicy flavor.  I don't understand why they'd pre-sweeten the drink anyway -- unlike milk it's not like it's hard to store sugar or Splenda or whatever, and allow people to doctor their own drinks to their chosen sweetness.  The chai does smell nice.

column9: Splenda? My boyfriend loves it anyway.
column10: Whoah.  I had NO IDEA there was Splenda in this!  Maybe that's why I don't particularly care for it.I mean, it's good, and drinkable, but... not my cup of tea... (you see what I did there??)The initial smell is awesome, but I do prefer the Wawa or Strabucks Chai Tea..However, my boyfriend LOVES this stuff.  He drinks it in a huge cafe mug, 2 (well 4 counting all that cream) discs at a time!  And then thinks about going back for more!Hey, Tassimo sells Starbucks products, maybe they will eventually get a Starbuck's Chai Tea Disc set for us to enjoy!?

To be fair, I've only had a chai tea latte from a coffee shop one other time, so the comparison of this chair tea latte to a coffee shop variety isn't comparable as I obviously have no clue. But with that said, it's absolutely delicious. My whole family enjoys these Chai Tea Lattes, they are delicious, sweet, and creamy. I don't notice a Splenda aftertaste, but I am a fan of Splenda anyway, so that could be why.
My favorite tea of those offered by Tassimo.  Delicious, creamy chai flavor, that satisfies my urge for something sweet.  May be a bit too sweet for some.

For the real chai, that is.  Which is not latte (i.e. not foamed).  I much prefer my own homemade chai, but this is a very good substitute for a quick cuppa.  I detest the chai powders which are disgustingly sweet.  The only manufactured chai that I like was the Tazo chai concentrate (Starbucks uses Tazo), but they changed their formula last year and I don't like the new stuff.  When I bought the Tassimo, one of the requirements was that it HAD to make chai latte.  The Twinings Chai Latte is pretty durned good for a quick brew cuppa.  Yes, it is a bit sweet, but so are all the other chai's out there.  Tazo is sweet too.  This chai latte is actually finitely tuned so that you can actually taste the tea in it.  The creamer is not overpowering.  My only complaint is that when I drink chai, I like a grande.  Not the 10 oz mug you get with these disks.  So I often find myself brewing 2 cups (4 disks total including creamers) to satisfy my craving.  If Tazo were to go back to its old formula, I would probably prefer it because of strong ginger flavour.  However, at the moment, this is the closest second, to my own home brew, that I can get.
As good as anything you would get at any coffee shop.  I love it.
My husband and I thought it was great! Great flavor, great smell; I tried adding a dash of nutmeg and cinnamon to it, which really upped the spice factor.
bought the t-discs without ever trying chai tea so my opinion is probably not the best but i LOVE it...sweet enough without having to add anything. nice treat.
Tried a few different discs(Starbucks,Seattle's best). this has become the one i and my brother drink the most. it's fast becoming a regular purchase item.

Well I give this a two star only because I read its sweetened with Splenda, so shock might not really be an issue. But unless you really like eating out of the sugar bowl this is not for you. (this coming from a person who could drink 3 cups of the tassimo hot chocolate a day) Smells wonderful, looks wonderful but my Daughter (19) and I couldnt even finish a third of a cup and she ended up with a headache. Why it has to be so sickening sweet is beyond me. By the way, I ADORE the other Twinings tea.
This Chai Tea tastes so identical to Starbucks made by the bartista. I will continue to buy this for my Tassimo as it tastes the same to me as the Starbucks version

I ordered the Chai Tea along with the purchase of our Bosch Tassimo machine, as well as Starbuck's coffee, Maxwell House decaf, and the hot chocolate. We have been very pleased. We love the taste of the Chai Tea Latte. It is a perfect blend of the tea and spices and the Latte adds that special touch. We don't notice the aftertaste of the Splenda at all. But then, we use Splenda in all of our coffee and tea beverages. Yes, the Chai Tea Latte is cheaper than buying it at Starbucks and it's nice to be able to have it at home. If we can find it in bulk, we'll buy it ! It's delicious.
Of all the T-Discs available for Tassimo, this is my favorite!! Spicy and a little sweet.

column9: I love this chai latte if I use 2 tea T-Discs for every 1 latte T-Disc
column10: I think the Twinings Chai Latte is excellent -- the mixture of teas and spices is very tasty and full-bodied, with just the right hint of sweetness, if I use 2 of the tea T-Discs mixed with just 1 latte T-Disc.  For me, just 1 tea T-Disc combined with 1 latte T-Disc is just not flavorful enough, while 2 makes for the perfect Chai Latte.
This product is great!  I don't notice any funny taste.  I really enjoy the taste, unlike some yogurts or other soda that contain aspartame.  Now that is some icky tasting stuff! :)
I bought this for when the college kids come home, and they really love it!  Has a cinnamony tang to it!

I would agree with the comment on the splenda. This chai tea was very disappointing. I am a huge drinker of Starbucks Chai Latte so was looking forward to not spending $4 per day. But this chai has a very distinctive artificial sweetener taste to it. Overpowered the chai. So much so that I couldn't drink it.
I love the Chai Tea Latte, but found it far less expensive when I ordered the same product directly from Tassimo.

column9: O-Ring Failure!!  Great taste but tea leaves don't stay in the disc
column10: I've purchased this product several time before, and never had this problem.I currently am working on my first batch of a 2 pack shipment, so I'm hoping this problem doesn't continue.The first 3 discs were ok, but the last 2 cups have had the tea leaves come out of the disc and into my cup.The first time it happened I figured it out by getting a mouthful of them.  The second time, I watched the machine closely, and examined the disc afterward.  Seems like there is a production problem with the discs.The disc gets very bloated, and the inside seal that keeps the contents inside, seems to fail.I made some regular coffee immediately afterward, and didn't have any grounds seep out, so I think the problem is unique to these discs.  These are too expensive to have this happen even on one or two.The product tastes WONDERFUL, but this problem is too serious too risk continued purchase of these.

I read all the other reviews and have not seen anybody else experiencing the problem that I am having.Overall the tea is very good, but sometimes when I make it, the crushed up tea leaves end up in my cup.  I don't have this problem with any of the other products and the machine is always cleaned after every use.So I would not buy this product again, because of the problem I am having with it.
I love my Tassimo teas.  The Chi Tea is very good. We are coffee and tea drinkers and this works well for both without having your tea taste like coffee.
I'm hooked on the stuff!  Only wish they had a non-lactose milk available.  A MUST TRY!!

column9: I love Amazon, but this item is far too expensive considering . . .
column10: This will probably be deleted by Amazon, as it probably should be.  I am addicted to Tassimo Chai Tea Latte.  I buy mine at Coffeecow.  I get 5 packages for 49.95/month and that is without tax or S & H.  They resend it the same time every month.  It is so easy.  Sorry Amazon, but your prices are just too high..
The Chai Latte is delicious! Add an espresso to it and it tastes just like the Pumpkin Spice Lattee at Starbucks.

I wish I had read the reviews before I wasted my money buying this product.  I agree with other reviewers that this has a VERY artificial sweetner taste to it. I love chai lattes from coffee places and was hoping that this could replace those, but definitely NOT.  If you don't like the taste of splenda, don't buy this product!!!

i had pretty high hopes for this, i really like chai when i make it or at starbucks or something.this one, the spices taste ok, not sure if they are completely natural or not, i would suspecta mix of natural and artificial ingredients, but i'm not sure.what i am sure of, is that it is very very sweet for my taste, and has that sickly too-sweet splenda taste to it.i understand that splenda is better than aspartame but i'm not a fan

Like others I found this way too sweet with a nasty aftertaste presumably due to the sucralose -- initially I didn't know it was in there but it was immediately obvious from the first taste. I gave this two stars instead of one because I think the other flavors are basically pretty good but it's almost impossible to tolerate the aftertaste. To make it more drinkable I run a lot of extra water through (the spices hold up). But it's still basically nasty. There seems to be plenty of space in the disc, I think they could fit more real sugar in if needed. I don't expect to buy this again unless they change the recipe.

I had high hopes for this product, but they were dashed when the after taste hit.  Splenda.  The spices and flavor of the Chai itself are really satisfying but the lingering residue of the Splenda takes away any benefit from the blend.

I was quite excited when I ordered this product because chai is one of my favourite hot drinks.  However, upon my first sip almost all I could taste was the Sucralose.  It was like licking a metal pipe with spices sprinkled on it.  I hadn't paid attention to the ingredients prior to that point but the use of Sucralose was obvious.  If you're sensitive to artificial sweeteners, like Sucralose, you probably won't like this product.  Otherwise, it seems like it has potential.  I might have liked it if it didn't use artificial sweeteners but as it is I won't buy this product again.

I love Demetris regular and extra horseradsih, but the Chipotle is really hot. I like hot food, wings etc but this was just too hot alone.  Now I use the extra horseradish mix and put a dash of this in too kick it up. But be warned, this is really hot
Demitri's Bloody Mary Seasoning is some of the best I have tried. The Chipotle Habanero has great spice and flavor.

If you want to find a way to help that young family, older friends or community member; send them a surprise of Kibbles 'n Bits. The recipients are ever grateful, and so are their human owners.Really do something grand, and send a few each month to your local rescue shelter.
