column9: The REAL THING! Hello Bertie Bassett
column10: Honest to goodness Allsorts in a lovely gifty tin.Other than the label on the box, how do you know if what you're buying are genuine Allsorts?The answer is Bertie Bassett the little blue guy is in the mix.If there's no Bertie's in your candy then you're NOT enjoying the most delicious genuine Allsorts.My personal favorite way to eat them is to eat the candy beads off of the blue and pink buttons first and then the licorice candy inside - the little sandwich squares are best when you eat one layer at a time.Yep, there's an art to getting the most out of these sweets.
This candy (liquourice allsorts) has stood the test of time.It has beena favourite  for generations and enjoyed both for taste & contentfrom childhood to adulthood & Bassets continues the tradition.

column4: Mairyann "I listen to a book or two each mont...
column10: received this tin fast. came in time to give as xmas gift.  and the recipient loved them said they were very tasty and just what he recalled having as a child.  would recommend this seller.

I bought a 16-ounce bag of Bob's Red Mill Organic Golden Flaxseed Meal a few months ago and have been using it ever since. I have heard that you shouldn't keep it that long once you open it, but I haven't noticed any problems. The bag says "keeps best refrigerated or frozen," and I keep it in the refrigerator. I add about a tablespoon of the flaxseed meal to a ~16-ounce smoothie I blend fresh every morning, and I love it for that purpose! It doesn't really add any flavor that I've noticed, but I do believe it makes my pumpkin smoothies taste more like pumpkin PIE smoothies (I guess the flaxseed meal taste and texture reminds me of a pie crust being crumbled into the mix). I used more flaxseed meal in my smoothies a few times when the bag tipped out more than I was expecting, and it just made the smoothie thicker than I intended (not a big deal). The blender I use is a cheap single-serve blender, so it doesn't grind the meal up very much more than the original product straight out of the bag, but the texture doesn't bother me. The texture is not a fine powder like flour, nor is it sand-like as with cornmeal...it's flaky. I do have to wash my cup out within a few hours of finishing my smoothie, or the meal flakes will stick to the sides and make handwashing difficult.I have used it once as an egg substitute in a box cake recipe (for each egg, use 1 tablespoon flaxseed meal and 3 tablespoons of water; stir and let sit for about five minutes to get a bit gummy). Though the cake turned out okay, I'd probably not use it that way again. The cake density was a bit off, and my husband didn't like finding little flakes of flaxseed meal in his cake. He is fine with it in his smoothies, though.

These are the real deal. Pepper Companie has made these black jacks the same way since the 1800s. They are all hand pulled and delightfully irregular in size. The flavor is really strong of molasses. DELISH! They have a fabulous texture similar to a candy cane. Not super dense like a jolly rancher, they're more airy so you can bite them and chomp them down if you want.. (and trust me, you WILL want to) All of the pepper candy companie products are fabulous but these are my absolute favorite. I always stock up when I'm in Salem.
I discovered this candy in Salem, MA this summer.  My daughter and I love it.

column9: Yummy sweet treat NOTHING like pumpkin!
column10: I first had this sweet my first trip to India, visiting a friends family I was offered a tray of sweets - and these translucent nuggets called to me.  They are unique and just beyond words how incredibly tasty they are!  One of the few 'treats' I give myself (type 2 diabetes).

Love this tea. First bought it when I was in England. The disappointing thing about my purchase is the expiration date on the tea box expired last year. When you pay that amount for "imported tea" I expect it to be fresh. It still taste ok but you never know, it was great when I first got it in England. Doesn't quite taste the same..Will not buy from this supplier again. Will have my daughter's friend ship it to me first!

I've been drinking this tea for about a decade now, buying it first at a Russian specialty store in Washington Heights, NYC.  It's similar to Earl Grey in that it's a Bergamot tea, but it has a distinct flavor of its own.  I generally drink it unsweetened, but it also takes sugar and milk well.  The packaging is old school without the excess of packaging each individual bag, but I've found the flavor to stay constant through the last bag from the box.  My personal favorite above many teas I keep in the house, definitely recommended.

My wife and I love this as a morning tea and have been drinking it for years. I saw it on Amazon and the price was OK.Problem is I was charged $10 for shipping. The 2 100 bag boxes only came to $10 so shipping doubled the price.We will continue to drink this but we won't buy it from Amazon again!

I've been quitting coffee for a while and moving over to tea,  I started with Ahmad teas when I got a gift box of 4 teas for my birthday (English breakfest, Earl Grey, English Tea #1, and darjeling)  This was my personal favorite out of the box and I love having a nice cup of it waiting at work for me every morning. (Its nice to not have to drink the nasty office coffee and my coworkers cant steal it like they do with my lunch)  Its smooth and not to bitter, just right for a good cup of tea without sweeteners like I take it.  Also no coffee breath!!

There's a time when you simply don't want to drink a tea with any flavor in it at all. For the past few months I've been drinking all sorts of flavored tea: Earl Grey, Earl Grey with vanilla, tea with berry, tea with mango. Then I got tired of drinking flavored tea and decided to try this.This was actually a gift. I didn't want to open it at first because the packaging was kind of dowdy. But I wanted to try a tea without any extraneous flavors at all and decided to try it anyway.The result surprised me. This was a very full bodied tea with a very strong taste. It was very good and just what I needed after drinking all that flavored tea; finally a strong tea without any berries or anything.So, if a very strong tasting tea is what you want, I highly recommend this.
I purchased this one to try because I generally like darker flavors and love their English Tea #1.  Try it, it's wonderful.

The bad first:The tea bags were not individually wrapped.  I've bought a box of 100 tea bags before and they were individually wrapped within the box, but these were not.  Also, while most of the tea bags are consistent in potency, there are some outliers. So far, i've probably consumed 25 tea bags, but i would say that at least 1 or 2 of them were flukes (meaning they were weirdly not as potent as usual) and i had to remake my tea.The good:Despite the little issues mentioned above, i continue to love this tea.  I used to drink English breakfast tea but now i just drink this one, which is not as harsh and more fragrant.  I discovered them about 5 years ago and Ahmed's English Tea #1 is still my favorite, and i am an avid tea drinker.  True, loose leaf teas are generally more aromatic and strong, but when you don't have a lot of time in the morning, this is my go-to tea.  So glad i found them online b/c i no longer live near the store where i used to purchase them.

Received a sample box of Ahmad English Tea in a Christmas gift basket.  When it was gone, ordered a box of 100 tea bags.  This is a nice dark and hearty tea.  And it's from England. Excellent either in the morning or for late afternoon on a winter day. Though with the shipping fee it's a bit expensive, it is worth it.  Now one of my favorite teas.  Will order again.

column9: Great tea at a Great Price
column10: Ahmad English Tea is a standard in our house- fair price, great service from the vendor and a consistently good dark tea. . .Get some!

This Ahmad English Tea #1 is the perfect way to start the day.  The tea has a pure clean consistency. It steeps nicely in a large teacup.  I always drink my tea in a large handled glass mug and this tea easily tastes good all the way through.  No bitter ends.  I gave up on all the ceramic mugs because they give the tea a different flavor.  I know that the glass mugs are pure and have never had coffee in them.  I will definitely order this item again.  (...)
Ahmad English Tea tastes great, considering it comes from teabags. The flavor and color of the tea are dark and strong. Great to have in the mornings. My parents really enjoyed these.

I really like the flavor of this tea.  I first tried it in a gift basket - and really liked it - then I went online to find it.  I bought the 100/box.  Almost a cross between English Breakfast and Earl Grey.

column9: Ahmad Earl Grey Tea, 100TB ~ The Most Exquisite Earl Grey I've Ever Tasted
column10: I first came across Ahmad Earl Grey Tea a number of years ago, while I was visiting a friend who lives out in Seaford, Long Island (NY). I was waiting for her to meet me in a mall, there, & I just happened into a Mideastern grocery-deli to browse and look at the great variety of exotic foods & spices they had for sale.By & by, I started getting thirsty & asked the shopkeeper whether he had cups of hot tea for sale. He showed me the varieties of tea they had & I chose Ahmad Earl Grey Tea, since Earl Grey has been my favorite ever since I was introduced to it back in the late '70s by an English friend of mine, who would prepare it with milk or cream & sugar or honey.Well, I had had excellent cups of Earl Grey tea in the past -- Twinings, Bigelow, Island-Rose & others -- but nothing I had previously tasted had fully prepared me for the sublimely fragrant, yet delicate & nuanced bouquet of aroma & flavor that literally "took me by surprise" upon my first sip of Ahmad Earl Grey Tea... aroma & flavor that was not just a simple one-dimensional taste but one that seemed to unfold as you drank it, revealing delightfully unexpected subtleties, layers & shades of enchantingly fragrant aromas & flavors.Surprisingly, the high quality of the tea leaves & the bergamot used to impart the flavor were clearly distinguishable to me in the tea's unmistakably delightful yet delicate aroma, not only when opening the box of 100 tea bags, or the individual envelopes containing the bags of tea... but quite detectable, in the tea bag itself, even after having made a cup of tea or two, making me wonder whether they might have discovered some very effective, secret manner of infusing the bergamot aroma into the tea leaves, or the tea bag, such that the aroma didn't dissipate after having made a cup of tea, or even while standing on the shelf of the grocery, as I've noticed sometimes happens with lesser grades of Earl Grey tea.In any event, after such an incomparable experience with Ahmad Earl Grey Tea, it is the only Earl Grey tea that I choose to drink, unless I happen to be out somewhere where it is, unfortunately, not available.It is at such times that I am so appreciative to have come across Ahmad Earl Grey Tea.Though I often purchase it at Mideastern food markets, for instance in Astoria, Queens, where it is readily available at rock-bottom prices & fresh from the importers, nevertheless, for those of you who are too far away to do so, the fact that it is available here on Amazon.com is already quite a boon, especially if you order a number of packages of it to lessen the impact of the shipping charges.If you do order Ahmad Earl Grey Tea & try it, I'm quite sure that you'll find that it soon becomes for you, as it has for me, "a most exquisite delight, definitely not to be missed!"

column9: Astringent aftertaste, no foil or paper packaging
column10: I really enjoy Ahmad English tea #1, so I tried thier Earl Grey. It has an astringent aftertaste, is too strong, and this particular box has no individual packaging to seal the flavor in. I prefer not to use foil wrapped products for environmental reasons but these packets need to be in an airtight container so as not to loose thier flavor. I really cannot taste much bergamot which is what I enjoy about an Earl Grey. Also, it smells too perfumey for me. I'll stick to Twinings Earl Grey.

column9: whole grain rice chips coated with chocolate  from Shibolim
column10: Sounds strange? Don't  you believe it! These little dandies are totally awesome. They arrived at my door on Purim...and what a treat! I am so glad to learn they will soon be available from Amazon. I expected a soggy rice cake with fake chocolate...WRONG. They are crunchy with a light coating (on one side) of the real thing. I am a Type 2 diabetic so they are a great find for me. Thank you, Shibolim.
This product arrived quickly and is well-packaged. I use it almost daily and would purchase it again. It's a large quantity at an excellent price.

column9: really great spices and herbs and much more affordable then the supper markets

Jack Daniel's Honey Smokehouse Barbecue Sauce ended my search for the perfect sauce for pulled pork. This is a deep, rich sauce. It is sweet without being cloying and spicy without being hot. It really has a very complex flavor and compliments the flavor of the meat. Highly recommended!

The rose hip/hibiscus mix does not jive well. Hibiscus tea can be bitter already (which I nornally don't mind) but the rose hips do nothing for the taste but make it more bitter and less enjoyable. These Marcona almonds are delish!  I am a big almond fan and these, without skin, are so yummy.  Can't eat any others!
These are the best almonds that I have ever had in my life!  I just can't get enough of them!

column4: P. D. Wilson "artist & designer and general c...

After eating a few, the salt begins to overpower the truffle essence. However, they still have great flavor and texture. I would probably buy this product again.

column9: They don't work when you drink the whole bottle...
column10: Okay, these things are horrible...when you drink the entire bottle. I wondered why sometimes they worked wonders and other times they nearly killed me (by nausea).Unlike other energy drinks, these are harsh. You must eat something before you drink it and you MUST NOT drink the entire bottle in one sitting. If you do, you may feel tired and sick! You can however, drink the whole bottle in a day, just wait a couple hours before you drink the second serving and you will be good to go.These things also taste great (at least to me). They are tart and have a refreshing kick (the triple berry flavor).Easy steps for maximum effect:-Eat a mid-sized snack or meal-Drink only HALF the bottle-Enjoy the highI HIGHLY recommend these to anyone suffering from the devastating effects of accounting classes!!

Need energy?  This is it.  Red Bull has nothing on this stuff.One word of warning, READ THE LABEL... I'M NOT JOKING!!! I can't stress this enough.  I made the mistake of drinking a whole bottle at once... big mistake.  Anyone with a heart condition, or a nervous condition stay away.  If you're healthy and need a boost... this is great stuff.

column9: The ONLY energy drink that works.
column10: I discovered Redline by accident and am glad to this day that i did discover it. I have tried every energy drink on the planet and non work, I'am able to drink 5 Redbulls and still feel nothing. Redline on the other hand WORKS! It has a great taste, tastes super sweet when its warm. If you ever need a quick energy rush Redline is for you, sip it over time to get an intermediate energy hype or slam the bottle and in about 20 minutes you will be bouncing off the walls and will not be able to stop. The only problem is if you do slam it after about 2 hours you'll crash pretty hard, but to counter that drink a lot of water and eat spoon fulls of peanut butter (not joking). All in all Redline works unbelievable wanders for those in need of amazing amount of energy, this stuff should be sold illegally in alley ways its so powerful. What could it hurt to just try it?

I've tried quite a few different energy drinks and Redline is the one that works best for me. The only thing I would change is to remove the Yohimbine because it causes jitteriness in larger amounts. That can be mostly avoided though by sipping small amounts over a longer period of time rather than drinking a lot at once. That also minimizes any energy crash effect. The taste is quite good as well.

Redline helps me get more from my workout. I drink 1/3 of a bottle before I get on the treadmill and it helps me last longer. It also gives me a nice jump start to my day. NEVER drink the whole bottle at once.

column9: Great product--make sure to read the label!
column10: I love this drink--I work full-time and go to school, and sometimes it's the only thing that keeps me on task.  It's also great right before a workout.  The taste is acceptable; I think it's a little lighter and sweeter than Red Bull, without the fizz.Warning: This is NOT just a variation of Red Bull or Monster--it's many times more potent.  The label lists it as a dietary supplement, not an energy drink.  I recommend starting with 1/4 bottle or less on a full stomach, to see how you tolerate it.  I rarely drink more than 1/2 bottle per day.I've seen a lot of "reviews" that say that Redline is dangerous, because they had a bad experience; read further and they invariably say they didn't read the label before using it.  If you ignore the label (and the cap warning you to read the label) and drink a full bottle on an empty stomach, you will probably go to the hospital.  You might even die.  Of course, you could say the same thing about Motrin.  You have to use it responsibly.As for the 24-pack, I like it--I was going through a 4-pack every week or so, and they ran me $10 or more.  The 24-pack will save you a lot if you use the product regularly.

I've tried many energy drinks. This one is like no other.I bought mine at a convenience store. I was looking for something strong to finish up my paper after a pretty long night out.On the label they said '2 servings per bottle'. I have to admit I smiled and downed the whole damn thing.I could not believe how jacked up I was. That thing is *wild*. I don't know what they put in it, but let me tell you folks this is the absolute sh@t.The only problem is (1) sleep disruption --- got to work your tolerance up --- (2) potential crash after the effects have expired (3) a bit expensive.Overall, 5 stars, totally worth it, one the sickest pick-me-ups out there.
A great source of energy booster. You should have it before you hit the Gym and you will how quickly the energy booster kicks in.

column9: gives you incentive to work out after 20 min. of drinking
column10: when people say "read the directions", you must. you aren't supposed to ingest the whole bottle. it's meant for 2 servings for 2 separate days. i like going to the gym, but i stress staying on the elliptical, unless i drink only half of this small bottle. i do 60 minutes on elliptical and sweat like crazy. after that, i literally can run on the treadmill for another hour. i did this several times, and i got bad knees and shouldn't be running. this tells you how much stamina you have once drinking half. if you want to lose weight while working out, but can't get yourself to stay in the gym long because of procrastination, lazyness or lack of energy, this is your product. just beware by not becoming addicted to this harsh, liquid drug. i can't have a normal workout without it.

one of the best energy drinks I ever had. Actually gets me going, motivated to work out. When its all said and done, I'm tired out because of an good work out not the after effects of the drink.Other energy drinks so far gets me going for the first couple hours, and instantly my body crashes.It also tastes great!
I love the burst of energy that I get and I only need to drink half a bottle to get me thru the day. The best part is that I dont crash later in the day.

column9: Death Bottled Me Some of Its Blood... And I Love It!
column10: The title says it all, really. It works. Though its effects are different on different people (for instance, I don't get the "shiver feeling"), it wakes you up and keeps you awake. I haven't tried taking more than 1 bottle a day and I strongly advise against it, as it has enough caffeine to permanently damage your body, but really, one bottle is more than enough. I'll take a little sip in the morning, another in the afternoon, and one on my hour-long drive home in traffic (Love L.A., Hate the Traffic). This usually leaves me with half a bottle to 2/3s of a bottle left.Its taste is kind of strong, and you can tell it's a bunch of chemicals altogether, so if you can't stand it, I suggest pouring half a bottle of this into a 20oz cup of Sprite or another tangy, citrus soda. If you don't like soda, maybe some fruit juice or something. You really only need a little bit to wake yourself up and stay awake for a while and I'm not sure that much caffeine all at once is good for you anyways. Then again, we're talking about blood from the God of Death here, so if you really value your health over everything else, I don't suggest taking this at all. Not that I'm suicidal or anything, but I've got work to do. 14 hours worth. 6 days a week.I've been encountering this more and more at gas stations, so please, before you buy a whopping 24 bottles' worth here (VERY GOOD DEAL), try one first. See how you do with it. And please don't try it on an empty stomach. (I have, with no weird effects, but that's just me. I don't recommend anyone else try.)

column10: I bought one of these to try after reading something online about how it works great and has no crash.  Cautiously, I drank a small sip from a bottle. column9: Nice alternative to aspartame sugar free jell-o and fits into atkins
column10: This gelatin tastes great and is very simple to make. I usually make it (at the last minute) and put it in the freezer for about 90 minutes and it is ready to go. column9: Better Bowls Sugar Free Strawberry Gelatin

(not available everywhere but here in Florida Publix carries it) or make your own topping.YUMMMM!

column9: delicious and makes me feel good to eat it
column10: I always loved to have sugar-free Jell-O as a dessert with my lunch but lately I have become concerned about artificial colors and couldn't bear to eat something that clearly has that much Red 40 in it. I went several weeks without any tasty low-cal desserts when... enter Better Bowls! The strawberry flavor is delicious and it is something you can feel good about eating. The vanilla pudding is excellent as well, particularly with a few mini chocolate chips sprinkled on top.
Very good sugar free 'jello', good full strawberry flavor, and love the fact that it has 5 grams of fiber and 2 grams of protein-with only 20 calories!

I liked the single-serving bowls, but understand this is more 'green' because it requires less packaging. My only complaint is if you don't eat it quickly enough it gets rubber-y. But I LOVE that it has the fiber in it for so few calories!!

This jello is easy to make and absolutely delicious. My daughter has been asking for jello, but I did not want to make the stuff with aspartame and Red#40. Not only is it delicious, but it is high in Vitamin C. and Fiber and Gluten free!

This is a great tasting jello that does not contain Red 40, which is why my family eats it. We buy from Amazon because we haven't found any product like this in our grocery store. Most everything contains dyes these days, so it is nice to know we can still get products like this one to use.

I can't add much to the other reviews. This is a very good product. I was going to add a list of ingredients, but I see Amazon has added this since I bought it. About the only thing I can add is that the quick set method works just fine. This stuff dissolves almost instantly in only 1C of boiling water. Then just add 1C of ice cubes and water and stir until the ice melts. This will set much faster in the fridge. You can also use 4 small juice glasses instead of a bowl, which will help it set even faster and helps with portion control. I don't know about others, but if I make this in a bowl, it usually only makes 2 servings (or maybe only one). But if I have 4 small servings already separated, they usually last for 4 servings, which does save money as this is a bit expensive, but well worth the cost.

column9: True European Taste-Wonderful Cocoa, but Pricey
column10: This cocoa is a wonderful, rich tasting, not overly sweet, decadent product. Made with milk, it is delicious and one can adjust it to their liking with more or less cocoa and/or milk. That said, since it is already pre-mixed with sugar, this is an extremely expensive product. Green and Black recommends 4 teaspons per cup, which means this little canister will only make a few cups.I grew up in Britain and cannot drink Swiss Miss or Nestle cocoas as they have no cocoa flavor at all, and are ridiculously sweet. This is a wonderful product, but if buying Green and Black's cocoa, I prefer the straight cocoa powder with which I can mix my own sugar. I can then afford to have good cocoa (hot chocolate) without breaking my piggy bank ;)

column9: Green & Black's organic hot chocolate drink has a nice light bittersweet taste that many people will love ...
column10: If you enjoy the strong, hearty taste of old-fashioned cocoa right off the stove, Green & Black's might not be what you are searching for.  It is, as it says, a "drink."  The taste is light and delicate, but can be adjusted to suit your taste buds.  For example, it calls for four teaspoons per cup, but I prefer to add more to get the bittersweet taste their chocolate bars offer.  If you enjoy Green & Black's dark, 70% cocoa organic chocolate bars, you probably would enjoy this hot chocolate drink as well.  I'll give a quick basic overview of the drink.NOTE:  It is manufactured in a factory that processes nut and milk products.INGREDIENTS:Organic raw can sugar, organic fat-reduced cocoa powder, organic dark chocolate powder,organic chocolate liquor, organic raw cane sugar, organic cocoa butter, soy lecithin (emulsifier), and dairy ingredients.  There is a minimum of 16.5% organic dark chocolate and 60% cocoa.NUTRITION FACTS:This is based on a 4 teaspoon servingCalories - 80Total Fat - 2gSaturated Fat - 1gTrans Fat 0gCholesterol - 0mgSodium 0 mgTotal Carbohydrate - 15gDietary Fiber - 2gSugars 12gProtein - 2gGreen & Black's organic hot chocolate drink has a nice light bittersweet taste that many people will love.  The price is a bit higher than I've paid on the store shelves, but all things considered, not by much.  I've had to make sure that I watch the expiration dates on this one because when it gets outdated it tends to taste more like Ovaltine than a premium beverage.  Green & Black's claims it is "suitable for vegetarians" and one item of note it that a single serving contains 8% iron.  FYI, you can hold a 5.3 ounce can in the palm of your hand so we're not looking at large containers.  The taste is wonderful and well worth the premium price it commands.

When made with milk (I have not, and will not, make it with water) this creates a very rich hot cocoa.  It is not overly sweet and has a great flavor.  It blends easily and has minimal settling of chocolate particles in the bottom.

Great organic hot cocoa, with a very rich taste (especially made with 2% milk!). I used this product in a gift basket I made for a silent auction in support of a children's charity. The event was held at a very nice country club, and the elegant packaging Green & Black's organic hot chocolate really helped to pull the basket together.

Walnut oil certainly has that - a wonderful, nutty flavor that lends a solid undertone to salad dressings and vegetable dishes.It has other uses in the kitchen, though. Artists sometimes use walnut oil instead of linseed oil, since it's one of the few vegetable oils that hardens to a tough film when exposed to air without just going rancid. As a result, it's my choice for treating wooden spoons, cutting boards, and the like. Unlike most oil finishes, it's completely edible. Unlike mineral oil, it hardens inside the wood's grain. When new wooden tools appear in your kitchen, oil them, let them sit overnight, and wipe away any excess in the morning. Repeat daily for a week, weekly for a month, and every few months after that. Although toasted oils have a richer flavor, I prefer the untoasted for my woodenware.-- wiredweirdPS: Although you can still get walnut oil as a painting medium, you should use only food-grade oil on your woodenware.

column9: Fits in Our Diabetic Diet if I Tweak the Recipe
column10: Both my husband and I come from a strong family history of type 2 diabetes. He was diagnosed 10 years ago and I was diagnosed a little over a month ago.When I made this pudding mix with skim milk, it spiked my husband's blood sugar so for a long time, we haven't had it. My husband has quite the sweet tooth and since he is very active and a normal weight, I decided to try making it with heavy cream instead. Skim milk has approximately 11.9 grams of carbs per cup and you need 2 cups to make this recipe. That's just too many carbs for us. Plus I know my husband and there's just no way he's going to limit himself to a half cup serving.The heavy cream I buy has no carbs. Instead of 2 cups of milk I replace it with half heavy whipping cream and half water and cook as directed on the package. It sets up just fine. My husband loves it and even when he eats half of it at a time, it doesn't spike his blood sugar. It hasn't affected his weight or his cholesterol levels either. I make it about twice a week or so.The downside: Adding heavy cream adds LOTS of calories to this pudding so if you are someone who has to watch fat/calories then this wouldn't work for you. I don't eat it because I only just got my blood sugar down to normal levels and I have more weight to lose so for now I'm leaving it out of my diet plan.

Very yummy, a must to have on hand for a great G/F snack on the go. I have this every night as my bed time snack.
I just tried this and absolutely love it!  It is very crunchy and flavorful.  I will be getting more of this soon. Can't wait to try it in a cookie recipe!

I so love this it is great, i have many food allergies and this is so good. I have it with some almond milk and i add raisins or dried blueberries and it is sooo good. Very filling too. i also add it to oatmeal cookies when i make them yumm.

I love to add this to apples, cinnamon, aguava syrup, vanilla and a little butter. Everyone at my work gets so jealous when I microwave it at work. I remind them of all the things that have gluten in it that I cant eat.I love this stuff with just hemp/rice milk too.

column9: Love this Granola and so do my kids!
column10: I tried this Enjoy Life and the Udi's granola and preferred this one, not as difficult to chew. Great flavor and my three and four year old love it! Highly recommend to anyone.

I agree that this granola is not as yummy when eaten like cereal BUT this granola has become a staple in my yogurt eating :).  I have used it in regular yogurt or coconut milk yogurt and it gives it crunch and extra flavor.  I love crunch in my yogurt and this doesn't get soggy fast.  I also really like the chewy raisins.  I am not a big fan of raisins but the raisins in this mix are drier and chewier than regular raisins and I really like them.

Enjoy Life Cinnamon Crunch Granola is pretty good.  It did have a strong cinnamon taste though.I don't like raisins, so I didn't really care for them being in this granola.  It's a bit hard to chew,but it's pretty good considering that it is gluten free and free from common allergens.  Yummy!

column9: Wish it were without the raisans!
column10: The raisans are hard and yucky, but pick them out and add fresh bananas and milk, and it's a great cereal!

column9: Great granola! Incorrection nutrition information on Amazon
column10: This is a great gluten-free granola. I enjoy it with yogurt and fruit and with soy milk and fruit. I am excited to try making a gluten-free fruit crisp with it. I was dissapointed that the nutrition information on Amazon's site was inaccurate. There is less fiber and more sugar in the product than listed. However, I will still continue to purchase this delicious granola. My husband and son who don't have to follow a restrictive diet also enjoy it.

Whoever gave this a bad review must have been eating something else!  This is the BEST g-free cereal I have had to date!  It tastes JUST like regular granola, and it's crunchy and cinnamon-y and delicious!  I just had a bowl, cold, with soy milk and it was fantastic.  The granola did not get soggy, and I liked the chewy texture with the raisins.  I actually had to go and re-check the bag to make sure I wasn't eating something with gluten!  There is NO way the bad reviews on here were trying the same thing.  I am VERY picky about my foods.  This stuff is fantastic.  I bought my bag recently at a King Soopers while on vacation.  I just came on Amazon to see if they sold it, and they do!  I am so excited, I will definitely be purchasing this regularly.

We just got some sample packets of this cereal in another product.  We put it in a bowl with some Rice Dream on it and let it sit after taking the initial taste.  First bite before soaking was OK.  Good taste but a little too hard.  After soaking it was great!  I grew up on Quaker 100% natural, but have been on a celiac diet for the past ten years.  Aside from one other cereal that I really like, I think this one is a real winner.Other great things about it are the fact that it contains no corn.  The reason I like this is that I believe corn to be a major allergen that typically flies under the radar.  Kudos to "Enjoy Life" products!

I love the cinnamon crunch cereal; I eat it out of hand, with coconut milk and with Greek Yogurt for meals; I toss a half cup with a scant quarter cup of GF chocolate chips and have trail mix on the go. I don't care for berries in general, so I've not tried that flavor - but I buy this by the case.It is quite crunchy to me - not at all crisp, though, or wimpy - it's a harder, heavier crunch than many cereals advertised as crunchy; and I was taken by surprise the first time I had some, but was immediately won over.
This cereal is pretty good.  It is a little too crunchy, needs to soak a bit before it can be eaten.  Considering gluten-free products are often quite nasty this is great.
Great tasting granola.  Much better than Apple Cinammon flavor.  Goes well with yogurt for breakfast.  Excellent for gluten-free diets.

Obviously opinions vary on this, but I eat Enjoy life granola daily.  I don't understand the comments about it not being crunchy, unless perhaps people have had outdated bags. I appreciate Enjoy Life being dairy, soy and corn free as well as gluten free, as I can't have any of these.  The Cranapple flavor is the best--I mix it with Erehwon Gluten-free brown rice cereal and use vanilla rice milk.  Since opinions differ so on this product, if you're on a gluten-free diet you should try it.

Your satisfaction with this product will depend on how you eat it. This is not the kind of cereal you pour into a bowl, add milk and eat immediately. Unfortunately, the cereal is very hard; I would not call it crunchy, it's just plain hard.There are two ways around this. I customarily pour this cereal on top of plain yogurt, add milk and let it sit in the fridge overnight. By morning, the cereal is soft but not soggy. Of course it's not crunchy/crispy either but when you eat gluten-free you tolerate a lot. Alternatively, you can add milk or water to the cereal and heat it in the microwave. It's actually good this way, like a form of oatmeal.I don't mind the flavor, but again, I've been eating gluten-free for 3 years and know not to expect too much. I do like the fact that a serving provides 5 grams of fiber (more challenging to get on a gluten-free diet) and is fortified with vitamins and minerals.

Out of all the boxed gluten-free cereals that I have tried, this cereal is by far the best in both taste and texture.  I found the very-berry flavor however to be much too potent in flavor.  I would recommend this cereal to any person who is gluten-free.
I have been eating gluten free for 24 years.  I have tried many different produts and this by far is the worst cereal that I have been forced to ingest.

column9: Too bad I can't give it zero
column10: This is HORRIBLE! My husband grabbed it from the pantry and said "what's this"..I said no don't taste it, it is cardboard...he TOTALLY agreed...this does taste like cardboard and is so hard it could break a tooth...unfortunately it went right in the garbage.

column9: It's great that it's allergen-free, but...
column10: I really appreciate what Enjoy Life is doing by creating products specifically free of allergens. But this just doesn't taste very good, and the texture is slightly off-putting as well. Try their Cran-Apple Crunch or (my favorite) Very Berry crunch for a great-tasting allegen-free granola cereal.

column9: It's Sugar Free Fat Free Yumminess
column10: If you want Godiva white chocolate to fall out of the box, then you should just go buy chocolate at the grocery store and consume all the fat and calories.But if you want a yummy dessert that's easy to make, guilt free and good when accepted on its own terms, try this! It's especially tasty with some fat free cool whip. (Again: if you want rich and decadent, go and buy a pint of cream at the store and whip up your own topping).

Jello's sugar free instant white chocolate pudding is very delicious when combined with other ingredients when making a sugar free ambrosia. Its getting more hard to find until I found it at Amazon .com. I was thinking I had to give up a very delicious recipe that nobody ever knew was sugar free!!

Call it "white chocolate" or "green chocolate" or whatever you want...but call me when you're serving it!  This is the best pudding I've ever tasted and it's really hard to find!  It's sinfully good and extremely popular at our house.  Get your own 'cause I'm not sharing!  Love it!

I really like this flavor of the wonderful Jell-O sugar free instant puddings, the dieters delight.  It really doesn't taste muchlike chocolate, but has its own distinct flavor.  If you are looking for a chocolate fix, this won't do it.  But it's a nice treatserved with fresh or frozen berries.  We sometimes add extra milk and make a sort of milk shake with it.  It's a flavor our localstores often don't stock, so we order it by the 24-pack so it's always on hand.

Jell-O "Sugar-Free Instant Pudding" is a great snack! Since becoming a Type 2 diabetic last year, I am always looking for good tasting, low carb snacks. The White Chocolate is not quite as good as some of the other flavors, but it is still yummy!The Jell-O instant puddings are easy to make and taste so good that it is hard to tell it is a "diet" snack.Recommended!

column9: Does not taste like white chocolate
column10: First off, it does have the right texture of instant pudding. The pudding is super straightforward to make. You just whisk it into a couple cups of milk, less if you like thicker pudding. In 2 minutes it starts to set up into pudding.For sugar free, this one was okay. But the fake sugar taste was very easily detected, and it did not taste remotely like white chocolate! It had a very odd flavor that tasted exactly like some other food item I've had before.Stick to other flavors. This one is just not good tasting at all.

column9: Pudding may be good but I'll never buy from Amazon
column10: This pudding may be good but I'll never buy it from Amazon.  I don't need TWENTY FOUR boxes at a time.  If I made that flavor of pudding every other week, this quantity would last me nearly a year.  C'mon, Amazon, sell this and other items in allotments customers can handle.  Even the warehouse stores have smaller allotments.  A pack of TWO or FOUR would be great.

Pluses - 1) it does contain the organic ingredients I was looking for, and 2) it's gentle on the stomach.Minuses - 1) the taste isn't great. I had to use honey, which I prefer not to do. 2) the loose leaf ingredient particles are tiny, so they're small enough to leak out of my infuser. Cheesecloth baggie works much better.
Although this vanilla powder is not as powerful flavor-wise as I'd expected, I can't complain. It's great for those times when extract isn't practical.

I use a ton (okay ... exaggerated) of this vanilla powder.  Lattes, tea, coffee, baking, oatmeal, cold cereal ... anywhere you want that sweet floral goodness that is vanilla.  Plus it doesn't have the alcohol AND it doesn't drip.  Perfection!  I even keep it in a shaker bottle right next to the salt and pepper 'cause I use it so much.Highly recommended!Bourbon Madagascar Vanilla Powder 16 oz.

I've made risotto with many different brands of arborio rice, but the very best is Vigo. Other brands can be drier or the grains smaller, but this is perfect every time. I even make faux-risotto in the oven: 1 cup rice, 2 1/2 cups chicken broth, 2 TB melted butter, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper. Combine all in greased 13 x 9 baking dish, seal tightly with foil. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes. Afterwards you can add shredded chicken, steamed veggies, shredded Parmesan, crumbled goat cheese or blue cheese - it's always delicious.

This is a really great tasting snack with the right amount of kick.  I bought a 24OZ bag from my local Waldbaums for $6.49.  There was a buy one get one free sale, so I actually got 48OZs for $6.49.  Totally worth it.
This snack mix is fresh w/ just the right amount of heat!  Really good stuff w/ great ingredients.

column9: Good Stuff, where'd the big bags go?
column10: I got "hooked" on this product when my local grocery (Food City) was selling 32oz bags of it for $5 or so. Now it suddenly disappeared! $20 seems a bit high for 72 oz.

Jack Daniels Old No7 is a Tennesee Whiskey - bourbon, basically. It has smooth caramel/toffee undernotes and a hint of woodsmoke. However, to my (rather untutored) palate, the dominant and most distinctive flavour is one of over-ripe bananas. The flavour is very familiar but I just couldn't put my finger on it for a long time, but when I did it was almost shocking. Nearly rotten bananas, but without the cloying sweetness.JD is, therefore, very much like a good single malt - the tastes and aromas can be almost overpowering and are very much an acquired taste. Whereas a single malt benefits from a dash of water, however, JD really needs ice to temper the strength of the sensations it leaves on the tongue (although I prefer to drink it neat, like any halfway decent whiskey).Anyone who mixes this with Coke should be taken out and shot.
I thought this meant I was getting 6 bags of this food.  I only received 1 bag... 3.5lbs.  What does 6 Pack mean?  My cats don't like it either.
If you like "Prince" Pasta this is a good substitute....it tastes almost exactly like it....the only difference is it smells a little like rice....But it is very good!

I've tried all seven of these flavors and LOVE them.  This assortment is full of surprises for me.Surprise #1:  I didn't care for the bacon.  I love all things bacon, but this one just didn't quite do it for me.Surprises #2 & #3:  The Chipotle and Thai Chili are indescribably delicious.  They both had wonderful savory flavors.  They had a little heat to them, but not painful at all.  They were just simply delicious.Surprise #4:  The Habenero is also very flavorful.  I tried one by itself at first, because I wasn't sure what I was getting myself into.  It had a good flavor and a nice kick.  It wasn't as extreme as I'd feared.  Just be careful though, because jelly beans naturally stick to your teeth and gums.  These beans are too hot to loiter in your mouth like that.  You're much better off chewing, swallowing, and then cleaning them out of your teeth.  As far as the heat goes though, I ate a handful of five of these and they were pretty comfortable.  I wouldn't want to eat more than that, because that's not a good way to enjoy them.The Wasabi is also really good.  I really like the taste of wasabi, so this was a great treat.  It's not too hot, just a good flavor.  If it's too extreme for you, then eat two or three and add another flavor like Himalayan Sea Salt.I also love ginger, so this flavor was a great one for me too.This assortment really surprised me.  I expected these flavors to be too extreme to enjoy, almost to the point of being more of a gag gift.  Not true.  These are very tasty and they make a great snack.  Just keep your hands off my Chipotle beans, because I called dibs on 'em.

David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans are by far the best jelly beans I have ever eaten.  They are noticeably fresher and slightly softer in texture in comparison to other tiny jelly beans.  However, it is definitely the taste that really sets them apart.  It is not possible to absent-mindedly eat these while reading or watching television because the intense, natural flavors demand your full attention.  Think of them as flavor delivery vehicles.I was fortunate to receive a sampler pack that included the all twenty different flavors currently available.  However, I was most looking forward to the spicy hot ones that are included only in the Man Mix and they didn't let me down:  they are a treat.The habanero beans have a clean, fresh habanero flavor, not a generic pepper taste, with the expected amount of heat and just a little fruitiness.The chipotle jelly beans have a beautiful reddish color and that lingering smoky taste that is found only in chipotle peppers, with a moderate heat.The Thai chili has a similar level of spiciness and a flavor true to the small whole chilies served as a condiment in Thai restaurants.The unique wasabi flavor really develops as the jelly bean is chewed until your tongue is so happy it won't sit still.  If you like to munch on wasabi peas, try these.Then there are three flavors included in the Man Mix that are also included in the David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Flavor Sampler.The Himalayan sea salt jelly bean is instantly recognizable because of the distinctive mineral flavor.  I was impressed that they are not unpleasantly salty.  How did they do that?  It must have been difficult to get this one right but I like the results.  These are also good as a palate cleanser after some of the more intense flavors or with the pepper-flavored ones.The bacon jelly bean reminds me more of cured country ham than bacon, with roughly equal notes of pork, salt, smoke, and sweet.  I don't eat much meat and at first I didn't particularly care for their intensity, similar to ham base, but when I started combining them with half of a pepper- or wasabi-flavored bean, I enjoyed them much more and was very sorry when they were all gone.  They are also good with half of a black cherry jelly bean.The ginger ones have a very explosive flavor much like crystallized ginger but without the chewy fibers.  These are also good in a triple combination with the bacon and wasabi flavors.This is not just a novelty selection of candy with unique savory flavors, these are really great jelly beans.  I am keeping my fingers crossed that David's Signature Beyond Gourmet will come up with other distinctive flavors such as bhut jolokia and rocoto peppers, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, black peppercorn, dill pickle, crab spice, and curry!

column9: You just think you want it
column10: The quality of this product is great, but after about 3 of each flavor the novelty is gone and you're out of friends to torture with this mix. Choose another one of their really good mixes, this is one to skip.

My baby is almost 8 months old and she's showing an interest for finger foods. She hasn't learned the pincher grasp with her fingers yet so she can't feed herself cheerios but she sure loves to hold sticks of food in her hands. I try everything my baby eats and when I first tasted these, they reminded me of Cheetos. The cheddar flavor is very evident. Some pieces are small -- some even too short for her to hold -- looks like sizes vary slightly. She hasn't had any choking issues with these since they melt in your mouth fairly quickly. Sodium value is also fairly decent. I have noticed though that if opened (with lid on) for more than 1 week, it starts to become less crunchy and more on the chewy side.Nutrition Facts from label:Calories 35, Serving Size 18 pieces, Servings per container 6, Sodium 50mg% Daily Value for infants 0-1:Protein 0%, Vitamin A 0%, Vitamin C 0%, Calcium 6%, Iron 10%, Vitamin E 20%, Zinc 15%

These will be great for my daughter when she's over a year old or so, but at 11 months, she is not quite ready for something this large and crunchy.  They don't dissolve easily like the Gerber lil crunchies or puffs and I had to dig a whole wagon wheel out of her mouth so she wouldn't choke because she put the whole thing in there and it just sat there without dissolving, even using her teeth and gums to try to mash them.  They are about the size of a quarter so I tried cutting them up into cheerio size pieces but they still just sit on her tongue and don't dissolve and she has a hard time swallowing even the smaller pieces.  I bought a bunch in bulk so I will save them for when she's a little older.  I just wanted other parents to be careful what ages these wagon wheels are fed to.
My toddler loves these. Once open you have to finish them within a week or so or they absorb moisture and loose their freshness.

My 11 month old daughter loves these. Not only is the taste great, the texture is really soothing to her gums. She does prefer the Garden Tomato flavor over this one, but she'd rather have these than other teething biscuits. Would definitely recommend both flavors.

I like the veggie dip and the garden tomato flavors best but I think my little one would eat any of them.  He loved the puffs and now the crunchies.  They are a perfect size for getting him to feed himself but they can get messy.  Even when they get stale, he loves them.  It's a good snack for him and definitely a little overpriced, but Amazon has them cheaper than any store in my area. And I'm as a first time mom, I'm a sucker for any baby related foods that seem healthier than what my nephews are eating.

I started him off on the Puffs, since I was a little afraid of the Crunchies because they looked so big. But he actually has a lot easier time with these. They seem to dissolve a little better than the Puffs, and since they are bigger he can manipulate them better. He either holds them while he noms on one end (they dissolve fast), or he's able to push it around in his mouth well enough that he doesn't gag. The Puffs tend to go to the back of his tongue and he often coughs and gags on them. They are nutritious, and there may be better snacks out there but for right now these are awesome.

We attribute our son's new-found interest in eating finger foods to these little cheese sticks.  He first discovered them on a visit to grandma's.  They're perfect - long enough that he can hold them in his hand and still bite off the ends, and he appears to think they're quite delicious.  He's start being interested in other finger foods now that he has mastered these, but they are by far his favorites.  Would definitely recommend!

column9: Great product but I don't like the packaging
column10: I love these and my 8 month old loves them but I don't think the product canister does a good job of keeping them fresh.  It seems like they go stale VERY fast.  I don't think the baby cares but since I eat them with her it bothers me.

Gerber has an amazing line of products for babies and toddlers, but this product is a miss.  The Wagon Wheels are extremely hard.  They do not dissolve at all in the mouth.  I had hoped they would be similar to the puffs Gerber makes (only larger), but they are nothing like them.  We had to toss these.  I was scared my child would hurt her teeth or choke.

I wish I knew how to make these with a bit less salt. ALL my kids want to eat them from the 13 y.o. down to the toddler, but we try to save them for travel or a special snack because they cost so much per pound!They do taste very good. They are more spicy (not hot, just spice) than I had anticipated, but my toddler likes that. If yours doesn't like spice or you don't want them to eat a snack with a higher salt content (for toddlers) I'd skip buying this.I did buy these earlier, but then waited to feed my son until he was old enough to handle the spice.

My 14-month-old cannot get enough of these things!  If I would let him, he'd probably eat the whole container!  He whines and complains until he gets another one.  For those of you who have to be concerned about this, I was very happy to find out that this snack is gluten-free!  It's a great snack for little hands to hold on to!

I got these for my 8 month old twins, who at the moment are very big on self-feeding (and not on spoon feeding haha).  These are nice because they are bigger than the puffs and easier for them to hold on to.  They are pretty good, basically just a healthier version of cheese curls though.  My mother-in-law bought them the cinnamon maple flavor, and they are wonderful!  I wish they had a variety 6 pack on Amazon so that we could try all the flavors!

My 10 month old loves these. I've tried the Veggie Dip as well as the Garden Tomato. Actually, my hubby loves them too so I find myself running out pretty quickly!I love the fact that these are tasty, healthy, provide teething relief since they are crunchy, yet soft enough for our (as yet) toothless baby to "chew", melt in her mouth pretty quickly so there's no choking hazard, and are easy for baby to pick up with her own hand. Sometimes when my daughter is in a fussy mood and wont eat anything else, I put some of these in front of her and while she's concentrating on feeding herself, I sneak in a few spoonfuls of food. Very satisfied with this product and would definitely recommend.
it's very soft and easy to swallow BUT little salty for toddlers. I love its tasts too!!! i already ate half of the cans and try not to eat more... this is more ADULTS' snack than toddlers'

column9: Excellent snack for baby and toddlers
column10: My son loves to feed himself and prefers salty snacks to sweet ones. These were an instant hit with him as not only are they great tasting but healthy and safe for babies as they melt away in the mouth. My 3 year old also likes to share it with him and takes some to her pre-school. Its convenient on the go and reasonably priced. I recently got some Gerber Graduate coupons and combined it with sales and got some great deals.
It's hard to keep him off of these - I have to literally hide the canister and control his intake LOL

column9: Great Puff alternative to the "Fruity-yogurt" kinds
column10: Our daughter loves these!  She had a lot of trouble transitioning to solid foods, and we had to take her to a specialist. The specialist mentioned that if your child has trouble with solids and with chewing motions... you should use foods that are longer and thinner to encourage chewing on the sides of the mouth. These were perfect.  THey can be easily cut into rounds using a serated knife, and to encourage chewing, they are long enough for you to hold them to the one side of the mouth.Also, since our daughter loved puffs of all kinds... we wanted to at least introduce a variety of flavors. The garden tomato ones were a hit right from the get go and we continue to use them in "mixes" with other easy to pick up foods (goldfish, veggie crisps, etc.)Would recommend, will buy again!

I bought these for my almost 9 month old twins. I was totally shocked by how hard these wagon wheels were. I bought them thinking they would be like there other products, soft and safe to eat. While I can break them up into little pieces to eat that defeats the purpose I could just give Cheerios for a fraction of the price. I have to say i dont feel comfortable giving them a whole one to eat, they put in there months and they take forever to dissolve. Big miss on Gerbers part for these items.

My baby loves them and so do I!!  Tried them 4 years ago with my first and now with my 9 month old and they're still a great snack!!  Only complaint is that once the canister is opened, the product gets soft pretty fast.

column9: Great product, but look for a better price elsewhere
column10: My 10-month old loves these! They are helpful to teach him how to eat and relieve pain from teething, too. Look around for a better price: I was able to find a great deal at my local BJ's club: a mixed 6-pack for $9.99. At the supermarket, they are $2/can.Whenever we go out and run errands, I make a snack container for him. I mix a bunch of different snacks together and let him choose what he wants when fussiness ensues. He always chooses these or the Dr. Sears yogurt melts.

MY DD has trouble with solid foods but loves the puffs. I ordered this to get some variety from the standard gerber puffs/ sticks.  Unfortunately I ordered a pack of six thinking that these would have a similar texture to the other snacks.  These snacks are hard for ME to chew and actually cut the roof of my husbands mouth when he tried them. At first we thought it was just a bad canister, but when we opened the next canister... same issue.IF your child is to the point where they can chew these... they certainly are not in a stage where they need puffs anymore!Would not recommend.

My son, age 2, loves this line of products from Gerber. The only bad thing about this particular product is that he REEKS of maple syrup the day after having these for snack (no more than 1/2 cup size serving). It is a 3 feet away and can smell maple syrup type of odor - even after wash hands, face, and taking a bath.

My daughter loves these!  I used to be so super worried about her choking on anything; I even used to cut those Gerber star puffs in half.  Then one day she just chewed it up.  So I then tried the Gerber crunchies and she loves those too.  The cheese are her favorite, but she doesn't like the cinnamon maple ones.  Then I tried the Gerber Wheels and she loves them.  She holds them with one hand and then bits a piece off and chews it.  They are harder than the rest of the snacks but they still dissolve.  She did stick the whole thing in her mouth one time and I told her no, and out it came.  She hasn't stuck the whole thing back in her mouth since.  I would defiantly recommend these, just watch your child while she is eating them.

My toddler loves these little things, has since he was 10 months old. Although he can eat an entire can in one day now that he's 3...doctor told me that as a snack/filler this is not a bad thing to feed kids at young ages, has some good ingredients and isn't fried or full of fat.  Do try to eat the contents within a week, so they stay fresh and crisp.
I snack on these myself.  I and well beyond childhood!  Yummy!  I recommend these for the "young  'uns"  and more importanly for yourself.  Enjoy in copious quantity!
My baby's more than one year old. he don't like its taste, though i hope he can eats them, for i bought 4 cans. maybe it just eats like popcorns and has no other chedder taste.

column9: My 9 month old is crazy for these
column10: They're easy for her to pick up and she loves them over any other finger food I've tried so far. They're also not messy, which is nice for me.

I bought these for myself when I was pregnant because I wanted a low sodium snack. I love all of the Lil' Crunchies, but the Veggie Dip flavor is the best. It is mild but addicting. My son is now 9 months old, so when he's ready to try them, I'll have to buy enough for both of us ;)
My son loves these, but like any cheese puff-type thing, they leave crumbs and such everywhere.  My brother has banned these for his daughter, because the resulting poop is quite terrible.

My daughter loves these snacks!  I love them because they are so easy to take on little trips, and they don't mash into her clothes like other snacks.  (They do leave crumbs, but are easy to wipe off.)  Amazon has a much better deal on these than what I can find in the stores, plus free shipping with prime!

These have been my son's favorite snacks since I had first bought them almost 1 year ago. They're great for tiny fingers and for little ones learning to self feed. They fit perfectly into a diaper bag/purse so you can have one on you at all times. They're great with little one's meals or just a simple snack. The ONLY downfall is that they're a bit messy. After eating them I always have to find that I'm cleaning my son's hands of crumbs, but that's with everything. HIGHLY recommended.

column9: Better buy a few extra cans...
column10: My child, in a word, literally inhales these things! They smell & taste great and i would expect them to have a higher sugar content but they're actually a pretty good snack alternative, esp in comparison with fish crackers, cheetos, etc... You may find yourself sneaking a few :)

column9: My toddler LOVES these!  I wish they made these for adults as well.
column10: These may not be the #1 healthiest snack for toddlers, but they are very good.  The flavor is perfect.  It's not too strong, nor too bland.  They have a touch of salt, but it's not nearly as salty as many alternatives.  They are just the right size for little hands.  They're crunchy, yet dissolve easily.  In fact, these were my toddler's first finger food.  I often like to go with store brands to save money, but I've found that the taste of these is quite superior.As my toddler is getting older, I'm not buying these as often as I used to since they are expensive.  However, when she was still in the early stages of eating table foods, these were awesome.  I'm actually a little bummed that I'm not going to be getting them all that often anymore.

My toddler loves these and she has since she first tried them. She would eat an entire can in one sitting if I would let her. They are also great for teething, which is not something I anticipated. They are not the healthiest snack out there but they work great at pacifying an angry toddler stuck in her car seat.
My little girl loves this product.  She has these snacks on the go and at home.  They have a mild cheese flavor and are not too hard for her gums.  Love the ease of taking these on car rides too!
Son really likes these. He eats them for snack all the time. However now that he is 1 he doesnt like them as much

I bought these for my son after trying the cheese flavor.  He liked the cheese flavor so much I thought these would have to be good as well.  I wasn't disappointed.  The veggie dip is quite tasty.  My son loves them, and gets really excited when he sees the canister!  The only problem is they are SO good that my 7 year old is constantly sneaking them!

column9: great snack for baby and adult
column10: My baby started to eat this snack when she was 6 month old. It is her favorite all the time. Myself even eat it sometimes. It's such a low calories snack with great taste.
My 21 month old has loved this for at least 6 months. I've sampled them myself and I also find them to be tasty!  At least not quite as junky as chips, cheese puffs, etc.
My grandchildren love these. Their faces just about light up when I pull out one of these cans. I do have to split it up though or they struggle, both want the can and all the wheels.

We have 4 kids, ages 11 months, twins 3 1/2 years and 10 and ALL of them LOVE these.  They are always munching on these and especially the Cheddar ones.  They actually prefer these to other chips which is awesome since they're way healthier.
My 10 month old baby absolutly loves the lil crunchies snacks.  He has no problem eating them, they disolve quickly with minimal mess.

I bought these for my son to try, and he absolutely loves them! He's also tried the maple flavored crunchies, but prefers the veggie dip. His breath smells a little like garlic after he eats, them, but I'm not a vampire, so I don't mind. Ha ha! I call them baby cheetos, although they are very soft for toddlers learning to self-feed. I signed up for Amazon's subscribe and save program to get a pack of 6 of these every 2 months. I love the program and hope they keep adding more items to it. It's an easy way to keep those constantly used items in the house. I know as he gets older, we'll stop the subscribe and save, but for now, he loves them and eats them like crazy so I'm glad I don't have to worry about running out!

this case was reasonably priced and came in handy.  i was able to stash some at grandma's, home, and babysitters.  my munchkin loves these because she can bite into them, I love them because the dissolve and dont pose a great choke risk.

My toddler loves this stuff! She would eat the whole can if I let her but I only give her a handful as a special snack. The cheesy taste is not as strong as goldfish snacks but its cheesy/salty enough to excite young taste buds.
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!

column9: Must have but when on sale
column10: I got them when on sale so better price than the off-brands. Toddlers love them!A must have snack for toddlers. I wouldn't get unless on sale cuz you can get the off-brand which is exactly the same thing such as up and up at target for less.
Our little one just loves these in every flavor. They are very portable and keep fresh in the can. They have less sodium, fat and calories than the adult version of cheese puffs and extra viatmins.

I have twin girls and they can't get enough of these.  They eat them slowly.  Mostly they just suck on them until they get mushy then they break apart into pieces they can chew.  I actually like that they are bigger and easier for my babies to hold.  The puffs were too small and were harder for them to pick up and get into their mouths.
My 15 month olds love these and I have to admit that I think they are pretty tasty myself. They are like a healthier Cheeto. They melt in the mouth, so I think they are a good snack for toddlers.

My son is 22 months old and has been eating these veggie crunchies for over a year now. I never thought to look on Amazon for food items and I'm so glad a did!They are a fantastic price, very fresh and were delivered quickly.I will continue to purchase these here!
These were my babies first food she could self feed and she still loves them.  I think she started eating them around six months or so.

column9: Taste good but I wonder if it,s healthy for kids to eat
column10: I tried it myself. The taste is good  in my opinion. But It contains garlic powder so it stinks the breath after eating. And it is not all natural. Amazon price is good though.

column9: too much salt and WAY too much garlic
column10: First of all, I have major issues with children's snacks that are so full of sodium.I have to admit, my son loves these. What is not so great is the two or three days of garlic breath I have to endure afterwards. Was it so necessary to add garlic salt to a toddler snack?

My son is now 9 months old, he has been eating finger foods for a few months now. We first purchased the Gerber Graduates Mild Cheddar & he loves them! They do just melt in the mouth, perfect because he only had 5 teeth at the time. The only negative I have for these is some of the puffs are fairly large! If I give my son a handful of them, he stuffs them in his mouth, so the larger ones make me nervous. I ususally cut them in half. My new find would be the Target Up & Up brand - they are fairly cheaper & they are all the same size (perfectly smaller) So from now on, I will be saving a few bucks, and using those!
I haven't given this to my current baby yet as she's too young but my first LOVED them!!  They're very portable and yummy (yes, I tried them).  :)

Great in theory...healthy, organic, etc. ... however, this product does not dissolve in babies mouth NOR in Mommy's mouth.  My child, 7 months old, put one in his mouth, he has two teeth, tried to bite it, it did not break...he then sucked one for about 2 minutes then ... just like a kid...placed another in his mouth.  Reminding you, the reader, I was right there when this happened...he began to choke!  I lifted him out of his highchair, turned him around, did the Heimlich maneuver on him...he blew one out and then I pulled the first apple wagon out of his mouth.  On a lighter note, he's fine, prefers the puffs and whole grain cereal...but the dog couldn't even chew these!!!  We do, however, have friends, with a baby girl...same age...and she loves these!!!Happy Baby Gluten-Free Organic Puffs, Sweet Potato Puffs, 2.1-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6)
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!

column9: Must have for kids but go for on sale
column10: I got these when they had a sale on amazon. So I got them for even less than the off-brands.They are a must have for toddlers. I would get the off-brand if no sale though. They are exactly the same thing just not as pretty of a can.

These are without a doubt my daughter's favorite snack.  She has been eating them since about 10 months and they remain her favorite still at 17 months.  The other flavors they offer have not fared as well but these are still going strong.

Bought these for my 15 month old and he LOVES them.  It's nice having a savory snack as most of them tend to be on the sweeter side.He goes NUTS for them and I know it's not as empty as junk food since it has the tomato and cheese in it.The only thing is you have to use it quickly or it can go soft in the can if left for too long.It's also a bit messy so not so good for special clothes.Other than that ... OMG it tastes great!!  The Veggie Dip and Mild Cheddar are also great.

column9: Because our kids aren't obese enough
column10: Thank you Gerber, for helping us get our kids off to the right start!  Why should we parents take the time to prepare healthy snacks for our children and teach them to like REAL food, when you have Baby Cheetos in a can for them to enjoy?  One-third of America's children being overweight or obese simply isn't enough -- we need to strive for more.  America's kids need to learn to fill up on empty calories and eat for boredom, not hunger, starting at a year old or younger!  And thank goodness this product "tastes good" -- because that's all that matters, right?

I love cherries and I hate half the options you can get at the store because they are so often covered in corn syrup. These are great natural cherries that are delicious. They are a little smaller then some others I've found.

column9: Not a complete discripton of product given
column10: I have never purchased tart cherries before. I was elated to find them on the Internet.  However, when I opened the package I discovered that the package contains not only tart cherries, but also sunflower oil, which I must avoid.  Had I known this from the discription, I would not have purchased them.

I had been looking online for dried, non-sugared cherries and found them at last.  Cherryland from Door County, Wi, have the best!  They are great in baking and make a nice tart contrast to raisins in a trail mix.
I was disappointed because these cherries are so dry there are tough. I buy a mixture from qvc that is so moist therefore I am disappointed in these cherries/
My master (rolo) is very picky and he makes me get these for him. He loves them. He says woof woof wum wum.
Scored this via WH deals and they were unusual in that they weren't yet past their BB date. Not too bad and nice and citrusy; last a decent amount of time and no odd textures or aftertastes

my dog ( a toy poodle) whos likes people food better than dog food, loves this stuff.... it has no corn products....which is a plus. And she has more energy now too which is great..... i ushually avoid stuff by purina but they have the formula right with this one.....i recomend it
The recipient said that these flowers lasted longer than any others she received. They were colorful and fresh.
Last time I ordered the same flowers and the bouquet was really good and lasted a while.This time the size was smaller and it lasted half the time.Not happy with the inconsistency.

column9: Rush put his stink on these
column10: The smell from your Rush is gonna cost a lot of goodwill. My God - I never knew that I was paying for Rush when I bought your flowers! Good luck selling anything on Mother's Day,but I guess somebody always needs flowers for Hitler's grave.

My dog is used to MilkBones... she clearly likes these way better. They must even smell great, because she is not usually entirely attentive for the "sit" to get her treat, and I had her full attention with these from the get go.OTOH, she always likes anything "new", so the real test will be whether she likes them in a few months. But they are a big hit right now!

I haven't used them long enough to see a visible difference but my 4 Chihuahuas seem to like them. This is the perfect size for a dog 5-10lbs.The mini bones are not too hard or too soft so it keeps them occupied for a while as they go to work. My dogs are spoiled and they eat these.

To see if the claims were true I decided to do a taste test with the Hartz Crunch 'N Clean bone-shaped biscuits and chop-shaped treats from another national brand.Not having been snubbed before with the chops, I was somewhat surprised to see my pups choose the Crunch 'N Clean biscuits first.  These dogs have never been known to be choosy eaters, and all the biscuits were eventually consumed, but it was apparent they they liked the flavor of the Crunch 'N Clean treats.The biscuits have a texture similar to whole wheat Danish crisp-bread just not as tasty or savory (yes, I tried one, too).  They also break into pieces with uneven edges to help scrape off gunk from tooth enamel.So all in all the dogs like the flavor of the biscuits, the treats are crunchy, and the texture helps keep their teeth clean.Pretty good.

My little Maltese liked these a LOT.  They're really hard, so I'm sure they're good scrubbers on his teeth.  Although they call these small, I wish they were a bit smaller (they are about 2 inches long by about 1 inch at the wide part of the bone).  Generally I would break a biscuit this size in half for him (but he's only 7 lbs, so for a "normal" dog they would be fine).

column9: Crunchy, Smelled Good, Large, Heavy on Wheat
column10: Our Ridgebacks and Dobermans all scarfed these up immediately. Opening the box the treats smelled fresh, there was no greasy feel to them when I handled them and they did not have that icky odor that some of the chemical coated red colored, cheap biscuits have. I also liked that each biscuit was really large and thick. Even the elderly dogs liked them and the 16 year old Doberman with very few teeth left had little trouble eating this biscuit. These are hard, crunchy biscuits, but they do break apart with a little effort so they can be managed for an older dog. Our whole pack seemed to like the flavor and texture and there were no crumbs left on the floor afterward.Two days is too soon to tell if the Crunch 'n Clean biscuits will actually help with bad breath or tartar on their teeth or not. Honestly, no dog biscuit or treat or food is going to eliminate tartar on your dog's teeth - only annual cleaning by the vet will do that. (Proper nutrition will certainly help keep the problem in line)The reason for the four stars instead of five is simply due to the primary ingredients. We have Rhodesian Ridgebacks and they are prone to food allergies with regard to wheat and corn. The high wheat content in these biscuits means I cannot give them to the majority of my dogs. Many other breeds out there have the same allergen issues as well - if you are feeding an organic or wheat/corn/soy free diet for an allergy prone dog then you'll need to stay away from the Hartz treats.

My dog is actually a bit picky when it comes to treats. When you give her something new, it takes her 2 or 3 tries before she decides to try it. So I was pleasantly surprised when she immediately decided these dog biscuits were acceptable. She chowed down pretty quickly and was looking for another one. This is the highest praise I can give a dog treat product. I don't know how effective these biscuits are at tartar control, because (a) my dog is still pretty young, and (b) it takes a long time to see a difference in doggie dental hygiene. But as far as taste is concerned, Stella votes yes. I would definitely buy these again!

My Pug likes these biscuits more than the usual peanut butter ones we give him, but the jury is still out on whether they really do clean his teeth.  I notice some improvement, in particular in the realm of doggie bad breath; but he's a young dog and tartar isn't a big problem for him yet so it's difficult to determine how well these are working.  However, the dog likes them, his breath IS improved, and so I'd consider buying these again!

I have a Rottweiler puppy and he really loves these. He loves to gnaw on them for a few minutes before actually eating them. The medium size is just about right for his since he just a puppy. They biscuits are mostly protein with a few percent of fat. I have purchased other biscuits and he just refuses to eat them. He will sniff them and just ignore them. He didn't even hesitate with these. I had these on the counter and his nose was right up there trying to figure out if that box was for him. These biscuits are loose in the box. They are not sealed in a bag and in the box. I threw these in a plastic container to seal the scent and to keep them fresh. Although, I don't think dogs really care about freshness. I will be purchasing these again.

LILY, my Ridgeback rescue and MIKE, my Wheaten terrier poodle rescue both give these medium size biscuits five stars. I don't know if they really help with tartar but it seems to me that their DOGGIE BREATH is a lot less offensive and that is a big plus.The biscuits take longer to chew than one would expect for their size which is a good thing, No little bits are left on the floor, they really enjoy these. The list of ingredients is long and sugar and salt are both near the top - for that I took away 1 STAR. I would purchase these again and might try the large size as both dogs are strong chewers.

column9: Very pleased with these biscuits & will buy more.
column10: I am reviewing the "small" size Hartz Crunch 'n Clean dog biscuits.I believe I've finally found a biscuit to help with the tartar problem I've got with both my dogs -- a dachsund and mini-pin.  When the box arrived, my dachsund became so excited he was shaking from the smell!  Now, he eats anything and everything, but he was especially anxious to gobble up these biscuits....and even started a fight with my other dog over the shipping box!  Even my mini-pin ate 2 of the biscuits right away, and he is a very picky eater.  Of course, I didn't taste the biscuits, but the smell was similar to that of seasoned "curly fries."
