The coupons are the same as taking another $1.60 or so off the price.With that said, I'd still rather get one larger bag than these three 12 ounce bags.  The bulk price should be cheaper, and there would be less waste.Peet's Coffee & Tea is another very predictable coffee company, and Caffe Ibis is tops for organic and fair trade coffee.
This coffee is Good.  BUT, I can buy in at Walmart for less than online. Also Walmart has a good selection of Starbuck and other brands.

column9: Starbucks is better when you buy at the store
column10: I buy the best pre-ground on the spot coffee from my Starbucks, we have 3 locations in a town with 200,000 people.  The coffee that is on Amazon is SOOOOO expensive.  I pay around $11.00 for this coffee and have it ground in the store.  Why is this so expensive here on Amazon?

column9: Package Left in High Rise Public Entrance
column10: I love Starbucks coffee.  This coffee has great flavor and body.  It' great to wake up to the smell of freshly ground, freshly brewed Starbucks French Roast Extra Bold Coffee.  What a way to start my day!Unfortunately, I did not know that I would have to go to the public entrance and carry my package to my apartment.Ship Carrier:  EnsendaStatus:  DeliveredLocation:  Front doorSigned for by:  Released by Delivery AgentMy package was not left at my front door.  It was left in the PUBLIC ENTRANCE.  I live in a high rise building and I'm totally disabled.  The Delivery Agent stood in the public entrance, and rang my bell.  When I answered, he stated, "Your package is here."  Since all of our packages are delivered to our apartment doors, I pressed the unlock public entrance button and waited for my package to be delivered to my apartment.  After a few minutes, I went downstairs and luckily found my package still sitting in the public entrance.  Anyone could have picked up my package and left.  Since I was unable to carry my package to my apartment, my neighbor had to carry it to my apartment.  THIS IS NOT PACKAGE DELIVERY!  UPS has Ebou deliver our packages to our apartment doors.  Even USPS delivers our packages to our apartment doors.  I'm really disappointed that Amazon has chosen such a poor delivery service.  I've been ordering from Amazon for years and never had this problem.  Please fire Ensenda for not actually delivering the package to my front door and misrepresenting exactly where my package was left.

When I opened the bag of beans, couldn't believe the smell!  Smells like dirty diapers.  Thought the beans must be contaminated, but ground and brewed a cup, taste was good, not the greatest brewed coffee aroma, but not disgusting like the beans and grounds.  Too cheap to throw out the bag of beans, so will hold my nose and continue using and hope for no health side effects.

I wouldn't mind paying the price if the coffee was any good. The beans smell like burnt coffee, unlike any other French Roast I have picked up. This leads to a very bitter and burnt taste throughout. There is simply nothing special about this expensive coffee.

I have been drinking Starbucks French roast for about 15 years now. The coffee would get five stars except Amazon Subscribe & Save service sucks. I never used this service before, but decided to take advantage of it for the first time, since I drink so much coffee. Signed up for a once a month shipment on this item and Amazon canceled after my first shipment, WTF! Very dissapointed Amazon.
The caramel ones tastes great with just hot water!I haven't tried it yet...it may even be better with hot milk...
A cup of this with a dollop of whipped cream is heaven on a cold, damp or snowy, winter evening.  Heaven!

column4: Venus Starlee "Mom of 1 and a bun"
column10: I've gotten the Land O Lakes mint hot chocolate in the variety packs before and this is my favorite flavor, so I thought why not just drink the one I like best.  Actually, I mentioned it to my best friend and she ordered me a case last year for Christmas and I LOVED it!!!

We've had the Land-O-Lakes Supreme, French Vanilla and Graham and all have been excellent.  With numerous others as comparison (Swiss Miss, Nestle, Ghiradelli etc) Land-O-Lakes is the best I've had to date.

This is great hot cocoa!  The cinnamon is probably my favorite, but all the LOL hot cocoa flavors are good.  You can't beat the Amazon price either.  I can buy these at my local grocery store but they're .59 per packet.  Ouch.  A box of 72 lasts quite a while...unless you share, of course :)

column9: Tastes great, wish it were healthier!
column10: "Corn Syrup Solids, Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil, Polysorbate 60"It's really good cocoa, and I make it every morning for my husband (he won't drink coffee); we even bring it along on vacation so he can have it. I just wish that list of poisons above weren't included.  I've suggested to Land-o-Lakes that they make a ... "Sweet Nothings" version or whatever they want to call it:  a *totally* unsweetened version, so we can add whatever sweetener we wish to add.The corn syrup is unhealthy in the extreme; the 'partially hydrogenated' means trans fats (and soy is *not* healthy, contrary to the "common" "wisdom"), and the polysorbate has been shown in cosmetics to cause problems (and why is a cosmetics ingredient in a food item?!).That said (er... written), until someone comes up with a healthy product that tastes as good as this stuff does, he's gonna keep drinking these poisons every morning. {sigh}

column9: Supreme Chocolate Makes My Heart Sing!
column10: Instead of creamer and sugar, I add a packet of this to my eight ounces of freshly ground coffee each morning! For a mere 140 calories, I enter bliss! Comparable, both in yummy-ness and nutritionally, to a whole milk Starbucks Mocha Frappuccino®, this Supreme Chocolate mix comes in at 3 grams of saturated fat (30 calories, 14% DV, from hydrogenated soybean oil and coconut oil), 0 trans fat, and 24 grams of sugars (sugar and corn syrup solids). As for price, since I live three hours from the nearest Wal-Mart, the shipped price is actually a little better than I would pay locally, and it arrives practically overnight. The entire box of 72 packets is only 7"x7"x18", and consists of six smaller display type boxes of twelve packets each. These 6"x7"x3.5" display boxes will tuck neatly into the smallest kitchen upper cabinets, and will maintain the individually wrapped single serving packets in a neat upright position. All in all, this is a big luxury for a little price, which is something that makes my heart sing!
Walmart sells these at $0.47 each and these are priced at nearly $0.62 each. Enough said.

column9: This product really calls for 10 stars
column10: This the best hot chocolate I have ever had.  I love this flavor.  I introduced it my niece and she now loves it as well.
I love this flavor, It is the same price as Walmart, but this is easier, plus you get 72, hard to find 72 at walmart all one flavor

column9: An Excellent Cup of Hot Chocolate!!
column10: Being a hot cocoa lover as I am, it's hard to believe I've never tried Land O Lakes Supreme Hot Chocolate until I received it as part of a gift basket. I must say, it was one of the best cups of hot chocolate I've had in a long time.I've tried soooo many different brands....from the most expensive to the least expensive. This ranks up in my top 3...which is a hard place to get to in my eyes (or taste buds?).At approximately $0.40 a serving, this is a great deal.You'll find this hot cocoa rich in taste and quite creamy as well...even though it's simply made with hot water.Make sure you follow the instructions on the packet....6 oz. of water per packet.Go ahead...try it...you won't be disappointed!

On cold winter evening my husband and I enjoy drinking hot chocolate while sitting in front of the fire watching a good movie. This is the best hot cocoa mix we have tried yet ... it is delicious! Of course we also like to add a bit of Bailey's Irish Cream, which makes it even better. YUM!
This french vanilla delight is warm and soothing on a cold winter day, or even a not so cold day.  I first received a few packs as a Christmas gift and was delighted to see it available from Amazon.
i ordered mint chocolate and got supreme. i am very unhappy, becouse you cant return it..

This cocoa is rich and flavorful, nicely chocolately! I only wish I could get the flavors in individual boxes. I love most flavors offered, but would love to be able to get my favorites on their own! I like to give packets as Christmas gifts to people I work with done up with a cute package and winter poem. Everyone seems to love it!

I never get tired of mint chocolate cocoa! Can be pricey, try to catch when on sale or shop around Amazon's vendors for the lowest price. Quick turnaround when ordering, never been disappointed and I order ALOT!

I'm not a huge hot chocolate fan. They all seem to taste alike to me no matter the brand. I happened to get this kind in a mug as a gift. I tried it one night and I love it, love it, love it! It is ssooo good. I have never heard a bad thing about it!

This is the best hot chocolate I've ever had.  It's all my family drinks.  I give packets to people all the time to try and they always LOVE it.  BUT you have to mix it with milk to get the full deliciousness.  I'm never without a stash of this hot chocolate.  I buy it in volume because we drink so much.
Love this hot chocolate and I feel it I got this product at a very good price.People should try it it is delicious and so great to have on a cold winter day or anytime is a good time.

This cocoa dissolves in a nice way without a lot of chocolate clumps at the bottom of the mug. The cinnamon flavor has a 'cozy' aroma/taste. There are several other delicious Land O Lakes cocoa flavors including French Vanilla, Supreme, and Caramel. It's yummo in my tummo ( I find myself saying this a lot when I'm drinking it!). Several months a year the elementary school fundraising company called Market Day features a large box of Land O Lakes cocoa (assortment of flavors) for a much lower cost than in most grocery stores.
I was given these as a gift and immediately went to the net to find the other flavors available.  It's some of the best hot chocolate I've tried.

column9: Time to buy hot chocolate again
column10: And you might as well buy this. It is creamy and chocolaty, kind of like what one reviewer said before, like drinking a chocolate bar.
It may be a small packet, but it packs a powerful punch. I usually add a little extra water to make it not so strong.

column9: seriously? over a dollar a packet?
column10: I cannot believe how expensive these are!  Even at the local grocery store they are only $.69 per packet, full price.  When you add in shipping, you are paying over a dollar a packet. Outrageous!

column9: Stubb's Spicy Bar-B-Que Beef Brisket Strips
column10: I was looking for some beef jerky as a snack on a road trip to California. I found my first bag at a gas station in Nevada. I was very happy with the flavor and tenderness, and my bag was soon gone. Worse, I couldn't find it on the road back home or in my local stores. I did however find it on Amazon, much to my relief. They shipped it ASAP and it was as good as I remembered. I would advise anyone looking for some very tasty and softer jerky to try the Stubb's Spicy Bar-B-Que Beef Brisket Strips, it's way better than the hard jerky and very tasty.

Maybe it's because I've never had brisket strip "jerky" before, or maybe it was just the batch that I got, but these seemed much greasier than the usual products of this type.  I had to tear bits of fat from each strip before I ate and I could still feel my mouth coated with grease as I chewed.And again, this may have been related to my particular batch, but calling these "spicy" is laughable as I wasn't able to get a even a hint of a kick from any of the three bags I ordered.  If I'd known that these were about as spicy as ketchup, I would not have ordered tham and will likely not order them again because I prefer my jerky to have at least a little heat.Those complaints aside, this stuff is very tender and has a good and strong BBQ flavor (spicy or no).  I've never eaten Stubb's BBQ, but if this is a reasonable approximation of what goes on in his restaurants, then I wouldn't hesitate in stopping and eating there.  I'd just bring my own Tabasco.

I purchase Stubb's products all the time. This snack is really very good. If you haven't had time to slow-cook some brisket or other meat in your smoker lately... this will get you a little bit of that flavor til you can get to it. I highly recommend Stubbs sauces and rubs too. Texas BBQ is the best. God bless.

A SPICY JERKY THAT IS GOOD. I HIT A FEW HOT SPOTS BUT NOT SO HOT I COULDN'T EAT IT. LOVE THIS PRODUCT. A GOOD SNACK FOR WHEN YOU JUST WANT TO GNAW ON SOMETHING AND ITS NOT SO FATTENING AS A DISH OF ICE CREAM OR SOMETHING LIKE THAT. NOT TO SALTY. A GOOD BUY
The rice is as advertised and good for the dish that I purchased itfor.  The rice was shipped in a timely fashon.

I first bought this tea from a local farm which sold UK goods on the side. When they stopped selling the UK goods, I almost panicked, but Amazon came to my rescue! I am now able to enjoy this mellow dark tea at any time for years to come. It tastes great with breakfast, but I like to drink it late at night, extra sweet.

Yorkshire gold is the pinnacle of English tea.Rich, full-bodied, savory, aromatic, and relaxing. The perfect balance of flavors to suit even the most discerning tastes.Add a few teaspoons of sugar (I've found 2 to work perfectly), brew about 2-3 minutes, add a splash of skim milk and you have a proper cup of English tea.

I read an interesting fiction who-dun-it book and all they talked about was tea! I'm thinking, "What the heck, I never knew that there was so much to tea. Thus, I began my quest to learn about and discover different teas & even researching the history of tea. There's lots to learn :) My search began with black teas on AMAZON.com. My first purchase was four different teas by Taylor & Harrogate est 1886, I believe. I got the Yorshire Gold, Assam, Scottish Breakfast tea and Lapsang Souchong.My favorite is the Yorkshire Gold. To me it's a perfect "cuppa"!
I appreciate how i can smell the freshness and strength of this tea just by taking the plastic off the box. The aroma is amazing and it taste like luxury...

column9: A Family Favorite for Many Years!!!
column10: I've loved this soup since I was a kid, and now my daughters love it, too!  It's a "light" soup, great for upset stomachs that can't handle eating much; unlike canned soups it doesn't have that "greasy" component to it that can make canned soups too heavy for an upset tummy.  Plenty of flavor on it's own, but not an overpowering taste so it's great to pair with a sandwich or something else to make a great light meal or snack.  My daughters ask me to fix this for them all the time.  Only bad thing is that Amazon seems to be the only place to get it these days, so I have to time my purchases right to have this on hand.  But I've never had problems with getting it promptly from Amazon.  Getting ready to order another case of it!

column4: R. Santos "Mom of 7 yr and 4 yr old"
column10: My daughter loves these - bought the store brand versions and she can tell them apart from just the smell.Light soup and not heavy in which for certain days that is what I would like for lunch.
Wish I didn't purchase so much before trying it first. May be good for a sore throat in small amounts, I suppose, but I would rather have a progresso soup before this again.
Get alot out of each package so this last us forever and is great for a quick fix or a cold winter day.

This soup is my favorite. I love the tiny ring noodles and there is no other soup like it. My mom used to make it for me and it makes me think of her. When I am sick it is the only thing that makes me feel better. It is my comfort food and goes great with cream cheese and crackers, egg salad sandwich, etc. I make this for my kids and they love it as well. There is no equal. They stopped selling it in stores so now I order it online. I have to have it.
My kids love this soup.  We haven't been able to get this soup near where we live, so I was ecstatic when I found it on Amazon.com ~~ and, for a great price!

My whole family loves this soup.  I am sooo thankful that Amazon offers it because it is so hard to find.  My daughter has been eating it since she was 1 and is 11 now and still loves it.Please Amazon, don't ever stop carrying this.

Lipton Ringo Noodle soup is the best packaged soup on the market for children and grown-ups alike! My granddaughters ask for it whenever they visit me. It doesn't irritate their throats like some packaged chicken noodle soups do. I will continue to purchase it as long as it remains available.
Save your money and buy Ramen noodles instead.  These have lots of noodles and broth but hardly any flavor.

column9: Very good, but not as hot as I expected.
column10: These are very good chips.  Not really corn chips (like Fritos)...they are tortilla chips.  Good quality chip - nice flavor & texture, fresh & crunchy, just the right thickness.  Very good flavor.  I could do without the vinegar solids added though.  Not extremely hot.

These walnuts were "SO GROSS", they tasted rancid. I threw them in the garbage, honest I really did.They were not worth me paying the S&H to return.  What a waste of my hard earned money. "NEVER AGAIN"

I really love this k-cup.  It is my second favorite regular coffee K-cup (at this time), second only to the Barista Prima House Blend.  I agree with their text that states a more complex flavor.  The claim is that this is a premium line for those who expect a premium coffee more like a coffee shop.  I tend to agree, except you just don't get as much per cup.  I love the colombian blend flavor as variety to mix in between the house blend, which I absolutely love most.  The house blend is a very blended flavor without one note overpowering the others.  For a change, I like the stronger note that the colombia blend offers.  Both match my preference for medium or medium-dark house blend roasts from coffee shops, but not the very dark roast of Starbucks.  I really feel this is a complex blend that has well more than one note, but a slightly stronger note associate with colombia blends.  Most importantly, it doesn't taste burnt like a dark french roast.I have tried so many K-cup flavors, most of which I liked at varied degrees with a few exceptions, but this one is currently my second favorite (second to the Barista Prima House Blend in the same variety).  What is nice about K-cups is you can easy switch blends per cup or over time without having to exhaust a whole bag of beans or grounds before moving on.  And preferences change as you have the same day in and day out.  So I can say that at present, I love it over previous favorites (of non-flavored) which in descending order of current preference are: Wolfgang Puck Chef's Reserve Colombian, Coffee People Donut Shop Medium Roast, Green Mountain Dark Magic, Emeril's Big Easy Bold, Caribou, and a number of other decent ones.  I am just saying I prefer this over those right now.  But I will still have the others for variety.  Within this variety, I really like the house blend best.  But I prefer variety and usually have House Blend in the morning, and a Colombia blend in the afternoon.  On more rare occasions, I'll have the Barista Prima Italian Roast when I feel like a dark french roast with very strong flavor.The Barista Prima tends to be more expensive, and depending on the sale price, can be only a little more expensive than other varieties.  For a little bit more, it is worth it to me.  For a lot more, maybe not.  Paying about 12% more yields about 30% more in value in flavor to me.  But paying 50% more is costly when there other flavors are plenty good too.

I'm not sure what everyone else uses this product for, buy I have a problem with acidic ph, and this product helps with that problem. Specifically, if I have eaten or drank things that make me too acidic, then I tend to get loose stools or diarrhea, and after taking half a teaspoon of this in water, within about 30 minutes, the problem is resolved. I highly recommend it.

I react the to binders and fillers in supplements and have used this product for years as a calcium supplement.  It works great and I have been very happy with it.  It's great to get a supplement in a pure powder form.

While this kheer does not have a strong flavor, it was very good.  It comes with loose rice and 2 packets, one with sugar and one with spices and nuts.  The packet of sugar seemed quite large to me so I only used 1/2. I figured that I can always add more sugar if it needed it but it did not.  My family is trying to limit our sugar consumption.  In my view, 1/2 the sugar seems to allow the flavor of the spices and milk to come out more.  Bottom line, the flavor is good and you can adjust the sugar as it comes separate in a package.  I would buy again.  Directions say to add 4 cups milk and cook for 40 minutes.  Ingredients: rice, sugar, almonds, pistachios, raisins, spices

For those with a lactose intolerance it is impossible to find these in any restaurant.  I have to take them with me wherever I go for this very reason. They don't need refrigeration so that makes them easy to have in your handbag.The only issue is that the expiration date should be much later than the ones I purchased.  Since they are for personal use I had to use them more quickly than I would have liked to.The postage is much too high for the item but there isn't any other place to find the liquid singles that are NOT flavored.  Amazon Verified Purchase
I tried these for my office and it worked out great. The price was okay, but I found a better deal right here on Amazon. I'm learning to keep looking and the deals are there.

This product is getting hard to find and I was so happy that Amazon found it for me.  It is the only product that doesn't come right back up from my fussy felines.  I have been using it for the last three years and am so happy to have been able to locate it on Amazon.

column9: Delicious! Similar texture to oat granola!
column10: I purchased this product in the last week from a local store and was so suprised at 1.) How good it tastes and 2.) How much the texture is like real oat granola.  I had seen the GF granola before but did not get it because I thought the flakes would make it more like flake cereal.  I was definitely mistaken.  Not only does it satisfy my texture cravings, it has some great ingredients like flax seeds and dried fruit.  It actually had a good ratio of fruit to nuts and other contents, rather than having one or 2 pieces of fruit in the whole bag like some other manufacturers like to do.  In all, I totally loved this product and now that I see buying in bulk from Amazon will save me $2/bag, I will be sure to buy it here next time!

This is the second flavor of this granola I have purchased. I loved the cranberry flavor so much I decided to try this one as well! I was not disappointed! This granola is as good, if not better,than regular granola. I would not have taken the chance to buy this, if not  for the great reviews it received.

It's a toss-up whether I prefer Bakery On Main's GF Apple Raisin Walnut or the Cranberry Maple. Both are delicious. Have good crunch factor and none of the aftertaste that some GF products have. The cereal is good with milk (I use almond milk) or by itself as a snack.
Great taste. I pack a bag when I travel so I can add it to yogurt for a quick meal.

This is the best gluten free granola on the market!  I have tried all five flavors and haven't found one I didn't like.  The portions are small but calories are high.  It is the only kind I buy.  To try it is to love it.
For 2-1/2 years, since I was diagnosed with celiac disease, I searched for a good tasting and healthy gluten free cereal.  This is one that I really like.  Crunchy and tasty.  Try it, you'll like it.

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: The texture of this gluten-free granola is so similar to real oat granola, you won't be able to tell the difference.

Finally a GF/CF granola! This stuff is amazing!  I got it for my husband and daughter (2) who are GF/CF, but I love this stuff too!  And I am truly not a nuts and seed person, but I can't stop eating it!  I'm so happy to be able to give my daughter a snack that has such great protein in it and is so easy to eat! My husband is just going to keep a bag in his car to snack on.
I totally love this crunchy snack! I have to portion it out so I don't eat the whole bag at once. So much better than some other brands I've tried.
This was the second flavor I tried and was not disappointed. The Cinnamon kicks each super bite up a notch. Looking forward to trying the other products!
This cereal is soooo good. I love the big pieces of walnuts. The grains are whole and intact. It is by far the best gluten free cereal I've tried.

I recently purchased this at Sprouts. This is so good and it tastes just like the real thing! I choose to eat gluten free products for health reasons but really, this flavor and this company is great! Plenty of raisins and goodies inside too!

column9: Must Buy if you love Granola
column10: This cereal is absolutely one of my favourites, It is one fo first gluten free granola cereals I tried and I was hooked. I love the flavour and the fruit and nuts are just delicious. I just cannot believe that is gluten free, a real treat for people who want a nice cereal or something to add to a yogurt.I like also to add some nuts to this cereal, but the ingredients are of the highest quality and the packaging is really good at keeeping the granola frsh, a must buy.

This one is really good too! I don't really care for the little apple pieces. They are kind of weird. I love the cinnamon and the walnuts flavor combination. I never normally like raisins but in this mix it's very good. Enjoy it!
For those who can't do yogurt and other dairy, just add this product to other cereals on make your own granola bars.
This is very crunchy and deliciousThe flavor and the ingredients make this very filling and it also makes a good snack for after games or during work breaks
This product is so delicious and although a little high on calories it is so worth it.  I mix mine with low fat popcorn.  It is a wonderful snack.

Bakery on Main's Extreme Fruit & Nut Granola holds first place on my favorite cereal list, but this one is a close second. The cereal is very crunchy and flavorful, with a great mix of textures. The pieces of walnut are big enough that when you get one in your spoonful, you get a burst of walnut flavor.One of my favorite ways to eat this is on top of a "sort-of-Waldorf salad" - I cut up some apple and grapes, stir them into vanilla yogurt, and sprinkle a handful of Bakery on Main Apple Raisin Walnut Granola on top... YUM!Setting up the auto-ship order of 6 bags at a time through Amazon brings the price down significantly lower than I can get this in my local grocery stores!Thank you, Bakery on Main, for bringing the crunch back to my gluten-free breakfasts!
My husband has been eating this product consistently for years. He says it's the best gluten free granola out there!

column9: Yummy even if your not gluten free !
column10: My husband is gluten free and this is my favorite granola including no gluten free cereals.Not super sweet, healthy & crunchy!

I like it so much I wake up happy every morning just thinking of my bowl... yum! I like pretty much all the flavors - except that some of them's fruits can be a little tough (especially the banana bites on the rainforest flavor - i usually take them away)

Being a gluten free girl I must share that this is my all time favorite gluten free cereal/granola and I've tried them ALL.  Great with milk, over greek yoghurt with fruit, sprinkled over ice cream, or a topping on a fruit crumble.  LOVE IT!

column9: Best cereal out there- gluten-free or not!
column10: This is my all-time favorite cereal. I can't do without it, and so since Giant Food store has discontinued it, I'm switching my patronage to Wegman's even though I've been a customer of Giant's ever since I moved out on my own in 1971. That's how much I like this cereal. Giant substituted Udi's granola for this, and Udi's can't compare.

I love this granola!  So many great ingredients in it.  I usualy put this in yogurt or with milk.  If you can't have milk, try the Almond Milk at the grocery.  This adds great taste and fiber.  Will certainly buy again!

column9: So delicious I forget it is Gluten Free!
column10: This cereal is delicious and crunchy.  I easily forget that it is Gluten Free and never feel deprived of regular granola when I can have this instead!  It is also good over vanilla ice cream!
Seriously yummy, I eat a bag a week! It's so good and really goes great on top of some chobani greek yogurt! Definitely a great item!

I spent over an hour trying to decide which of these GF Bakery On Main Granola mixes to order next.  I tried the Apple Raisin Walnut, and LOVED it.  I wish you could mix and match a case so I could have some of each!  In the end I have still not decided, but based on other reviews and how much I liked the Apple Raisin Walnut, I probably can't go wrong with ANY of the flavors!!!  Well, I guess I better get back to making a decision here.........

I had purchased Bakery on Main GF Granola from Whole Foods and was very impressed.  I was never a big granola fan, but since becoming GF, getting to add something different to my breakfast food list was worth a try.  And I loved it.  I usually have the granola with yogurt and some added fruit, like a banana or blueberries and mix it all together.  It's filling, but light -  Wonderful for breakfast or a quick snack.  Purchasing thru Amazon, in bulk, allows me to save too.  Purchasing separately, I would be spending approx. $1.50 or more, per bag.  Tho I get to mix and match at another market, the overall savings is worth it.  Gotta save every which way I can these days.
This product tastes fabulous. A little sweet for the morning, so I only have it every other day. It also helps get the bowels moving!!
You'll feel as though you have made a trip to the bakery when you munch on these. Good as a snack or as a cearal with milk. Crunchy, flavorful, and fresh.

I bought this by accident attempting to get the toroni sugar free chocolate. I am pleasantly surprised. There is nothing fake tasting about this sugar free product. I use it in coffee to make a sort of home made mocha. espresso from our areopress coffee maker with a little of this and some milk has eliminated my expensive coffee shop habit.

Maybe I'm getting used to sugar free stuff but this syrup is great.  I needed something to punch up the Mocafe sugar free frappe mix and this syrup did the trick.  The frappe was smoother, blended well with the ice and really improved the chocolate flavor.  I'm glad I bought three bottles - I love it!

column9: Great Taste for any Chocolate lover!
column10: I discovered the Monin Sugar Free Dark Chocolate sauce at a local frozen yogurt place.  I am currently on a weight loss diet and have a No Sugar Added / Non-Fat yogurt occasionally.  This Sugar Free syrup really makes the usual Vanilla Frozen yogurt a real gourmet treat.I purchased it and found that it works great in turning plain coffees into yummy mocha's. Add it to your milk and heat it slightly, then whip it to make a really tasty mocha latte.I gave it only 4 stars because it is sweetened with Maltitol, a "sugar alcohol" which can upset your stomach if you're sensitive, but I haven't had the problem, but I think if you use enough it can force frequent trips to the bathroom, if you know what I mean.  If it was sweetened with sucralose (Splenda) then it would get 5 stars from me.I look forward to trying their other flavors as this was a winner... I have since re-ordered in the "6-pack."  It is also available in a larger size bottle that you can use a hand pump to dispense.I recommend it for any chocolate lover who is looking to top ice cream, yogurt, even coffee drinks!
This is the best tasting sugar free chocolate syrup I have ever tasted. You definitely can't go wrong adding it to anything that needs a touch of dark chocolate - ice cream - smoothies etc.
Love this product works great for making mocha's as it is sugar free I like this better thenthe sugar free syrups as they have a funny taste.

I absolutely love Matouk's West Indian hot sauce. It's got the spice AND the flavor, a great combination all around. I use it in everything I eat. However, amazon is tripping with the price! It went from $9 and change to $14 and change for a 26oz, and that is ridiculous! I'm going to have my local market order some with the guarantee that i'll purchase. If you like spice, get this!!!

I purchased this hoping it would be as good as the bulk chili powder I used to buy.  Wow!  It is and I really like it.  My wife, too, thinks that it is really good and we will not be searching any more for chili powder since this is better than the brand we used to buy.  I have won the neighborhood chili contest with it and will continue to use it.  Great flavor.

I like this seasoning even better than McCormick's Buffalo Wing seasoning. Now I'm not saying it even comes close to real, honest-to-goodness barbecue because it absolutely is NOTHING like that, however it does taste really good- kind of a spicy bbq taste - and it's easy to use. You just coat the chicken pieces with it and throw it in your preheated oven.I put the pieces on a foil covered cookie sheet, spray the foil with a non-stick spray and clean up is super easy as well. I've used this with boneless chicken tenders, wings and legs and always had good results. However, as with McCormick's Buffalo Wing mix, this also tends to brown/burn easily if you try to use your broiler or your outdoor grill.Bottom line: This tastes good and is a great mix to use when you're in a hurry or don't feel like taking alot of time in the kitchen. You can do it in the oven which I think takes about 25 minutes or so (less with boneless)so you aren't having to hover over the stove or grill.

column9: Great! One of my favorite flavored coffees!
column10: If you like other Green Mountain flavored coffees, especially if you like the other seasonal light-roast flavors, you will probably like this one.  I really liked the Green Mountain Blue-Berry and thought I would try this and am very pleased.  It seems like a great fit for the fall.  The flavor and aroma seem a bit stronger than in the blue-berry.  Like the blue-berry, this is a light roast.  At first I thought light would mean weak, but it seems like the perfect match for the flavor so that it is still coffee and nicely flavored without either over-powering the other.  It is nothing like a starbucks.  So if you want a strong coffee taste above all, then this isn't one for you, but if you want a nice flavored light coffee, I think it is great.Like other flavored coffees, you should only brew this on the normal default coffee cup size (6oz) on the Keurig brewer or you will water it down if you use the mug size or larger.

BUT, I'm on a very restrictive diet that doesn't allow for the usual autumny, spicy, baked goods - one of the many reasons fall is my favorite time of year.  I was highly skeptical of the quality of this, since most flavored coffees are irritatingly perfumy with no real increase in flavor.  To top that off, I don't even LIKE light coffees and have always been a bold girl.  This coffee was purchased purely on whim one night when I was craving something with pumpkin spice.  Much to my surprise, this coffee has turned out to be a hit.  It's not a five-star, knock my socks off coffee, but pretty darn close!  The pumpkin and spice with the coffee aroma and flavor are perfectly balanced.  Not perfumy at all and neither one is overpowering the other.  It also holds up decently well to my usual heavy cream.  Drinking this is just like having a piece of pumpkin spice cake with a good ol' cuppa joe.  I'm thoroughly impressed.

column9: Yum! Add some whipped cream and its like Starbucks!
column10: One squirt of whipped cream is absolutely like a Starbucks coffee.  If brewing too large a size like most of the flavored coffees you can make it too weak so be careful in adding milk or cream not to add too much until you taste test it.  Tastes like pumpkin pie.  The wonderful holiday aroma hits your nose as you lift your mug and the taste doesn't disappoint.

column9: Trust me, buy this brand and NOT the Timothy's brand.  You will be happy you purchased the Green Mountain Pumpking Spice brand.
column10: Best Pumpkin Spice coffee I have purchased for the Keurig coffee maker.  Just make it on the middle setting to not water your coffee down.This one blows away the watered down, lack of flavor Timothy's brand that I purchased on sale.Its worth the few extra bucks to get the Green Mountain brand.This comes from a Keurig Kcup veteran !!!Enjoy !!!John

I ordered this based on my enjoyment of the starbucks pumpkin spice latte.  The flavor is very light, I made mine light, over ice, with some half and half and equal sweetener.  The pumpkin taste is lighter and the spices are not over powering. I really enjoyed the drink.  It is like the starbucks drink but without all of the heavy cream and overly sweetened taste. I wouldn't use this as my everyday coffee, but I am going to enjoy this seasonally. I would recommend this to a friend.

column9: Pumpkin-y, spicy, no weird after taste, scrumptious!
column10: I live for the time of year when Starbucks brings back pumpkin spice lattes, thick and creamy and oh so pumpkin-y. I am not normally a huge fan of flavored coffees so it was with scepticism and a bit of desperation and fear for my waistline that I tried Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice. I needed to conquer my cravings for a daily pumpkin latte (or two). The Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice has the same flavor! Of course it doesn't have the creamy thick lusciousness of a latte , but it doesn't have the calories either. Pumpkin, like coconut flavor is hard to pin down but Green Mountain does a great job with this flavor and I heartily recommend it. I do still get my lattes on Sunday mornings but this gets me through the week.
My favorite pumpkin spice cup hands down- great flavor, not overpowering. Green Mountain is the best in the cup buisness I think. Im stocking up for winter!

column9: Amazon Green Mountain Pumpking Spice Keurig K cups
column10: Soooo delicious it is hard to have just one cup ~~ the taste is superb and yes I would certainly recommend this to a friend

Generally, I love k-cups- so easy to make! I'm not usually a coffee drinker, so I don't even know how to work a regular coffee pot, and using the Keurig is even easy for me.Specifically, I love the Green Mountain pumpkin K-cups! The flavor is rich, very pumpkin-y, and sweet enough that with some cream and sugar, I (again, not really a coffee person) drink it every day. Pumpkin coffee is definitely now one of my favorite things about fall.

Purchased my brewer this past summer , was looking forward to the spiced pumpkin flavor coffee Now that it's here I am very disappointed, doesn't taste anything like spiced , very weak on flavor.I recently had a cup of spiced coffee at a local facility, GM, but packaged differently. That one was quite flavorful. Green Mountain, what are you doing to us? I got first and last box of GM spiced coffee (and I'd planned to stock up!).  Now awaiting the arrival of Gloria Jean's SP!

I just tried this coffee in the Keurig edition while waiting for my car to be repaired and, being the pumpkin coffee junkie that I am, well, temptation just provided me with a new favorite!  This coffee has just the right amount of spice - not too heavy or too light, and just makes the perfect cup.  Don't try Millstone's - yuck!  Had SO much troule just choking that one down.  This one, hands down, is my favorite flavored coffee of all time now.  I just ordered 3 bags of the ground on Green Mountain's website since Amazon didn't have it.  If you call Green Mountain, you'll find out that this is their NUMBER 1 selling flavored coffee.  Highly, highly, highly recommend!
Yum Yum Yum! These arrived really quickly and taste delicious. I'm actually pretty sure my roommate keeps stealing them because they are sooo good!

I had bought this coffee for my husband a couple years ago from another retail store, and you could only purchase it through the Holiday time.Pumpkin Spice cups are awesome, and as long as Amazon continues to carry this coffee, I will continue to purchase it from them. When you get this coffee it comes in several different amounts.. My husbands face lights up everytime I surprise him with it..Try it, you will like it and the price is good, if you buy a couple boxes at one time even shipping is free....

column9: A treat anytime of the year!!
column10: [[ASIN:B007PA32L2 Green Mountain Coffee, Pumpkin Spice K-Cup packs for Keurig Brewers, 50 count] Great flavor.  Thought I would only drink tnis during cold winter months, wrong.  It's great anytime.

Good seasonal and anytime coffee. In my opinion, the best of all the seasonals I've tried. Try it, if available, it's good. Remember, if you don't like it, as we all have different palettes, it can be returned.
Item was delivered as described. Would purchase again, but only during the fall months as it is a seasonal item.

column9: excellent product!!  delicious  thank you AMAZON!!!
column10: I ordered the pumpkins spice to check out the flavor and was so pleasantly surprised...it was delicious.  I actually wish I had ordered more while the special was on.  Believe me the box went way too fast.  Everyone wanted to try it and all loved it.  Smooth flavor and just perfect amount of pumpkin spice!!!  Green Mountain has never disappointed.  I always try many different flavors, but Green Mountain especially Pumpkin Spice is one of my favorites.Respectfully,Barbara CondreyWish I had a cup NOW!!!  lol
The coffee was the perfect roast. It had that great pumpkin spice taste with just the perfect amount of cinnamon. I would order again.

My husband and I have each tried drinking this coffee a few times and it tastes bad, a real chemical/artificial taste.  Do not recommend it.  We are throwing away the rest of it, which I don't like to do, but I wouldn't try to pass it off on a friend.
I loved the flavor of this coffee! I usually don't like flavored coffees, but this one is excellent. I could see myself serving this after Thanksgiving dinner.

I ordered this product with careful consideration of other reviews. I got the 18 pack, the smallest I could find with free shipping. I have to agree with other reviewers that this is all spice and no pumpkin flavor, which is a big disappointment for me since I have a pumpkin obsession. When I made the coffee, I could smell the pumpkin and I was excited, but that's where it stopped. I could not detect any pumpkin flavor in this coffee at all. For me, the spice was overly strong when I tried the coffee plain. However, when creamer was added, it was tamed down quite a bit and perfectly fine. I would not buy this again though. I'm hoping to find some pumpkin creamer to get through the 17 k-cups I have left.

When I bought this product I was hoping it would make it easier to create a pumpkin spice latte. I learned that this is not the case. The product is exactly what it says, "Pumpkin Spice Coffee". Adding milk does not make it taste like a latte. The pumpkin flavor is nice and the coffee flavour is strong. If this is what you are looking for than the product is perfect. The product itself is great it is just not was I was personally looking for.
I love this pumpkin coffee, it tastes and smells great.  Not too much flavor, and it doesn't taste too artificially flavored
Pumpkin Spice was too weak in the spice flavors for me.  I brewed a second cup and used less water and it wasn't much better.  Will not buy it again.

This is, hands down, my absolute favorite flavored coffee of all time, and the really weird thing is that I don't like the taste of pumpkin in anything else.  Still, coffee spiced with pumpkin is a major guilty pleasure!!!

I get this coffee from my elderly aunt who has a Keurig Brewer, and loves the brewer. She like a variety of coffees and teas. She really loves this Pumpkin Spice coffee. She says it's yummy. She likes it at night or really anytime.
This coffee has the nicest blend of flavor and spice without "bite". blends well with a shot of Bailey's also!

We were so sad when work discontinued everyone's favorite K-Cup flavor, Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice.  All the stores had stopped carrying it as well.  It is a seasonal favorite only.  I was determined to find someone who carried it, so I googled it and ordered it through Amazon.com.  Hurray!!  I am going to attempt to order it again in the hopes it has not been used up by other consumers.  It's too good to keep for the holidays only.  Thanks Amazon.

column9: Gives Starbucks Pumpkin Spice Latte a run for their money
column10: I have had the tarrismo coffee maker but was frustrated about my limited options so I bought the Tarrismo.  The Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice Limited Edition Coffee was worth making the switch.  I really enjoy the Starbucks Pumpkin Spice Latte and would drink it year round if I could.  The Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice is not as good as the Starbucks version but it does give it a run for the money at half the price (I brew two cups as K-Cups really give you ¾ of a cup of coffee).  I find you just need a hint of milk to get the best taste.  Best of all the smell of the coffee brewing fills the whole house with a smell that is simply delicious.  All in all if I were never to try any other flavors but the Pumpkin Spice I would still be happy with making the switch to Keurig.

These K Cups are beyond the ordinary humdrum ones NORMALLY available; just look at all the features! They're overclocked to perform at previously unheard-of coffee levels! Precision mounted copper heatpipes rapidly dissipate heat for a more enjoyable coffee-drinking experience! The color is optimized for any event of your day, from the Standard days to Scenic, Nighttime, at the Game, even out at the Theater!How you haven't clicked the 'Buy Now' button is beyond normal human understanding!
I love this coffee. It has been hard to find since it is a Holiday coffee.  Pumpkin Spice.  Thanks for  having it in stock.  It was delivered fast and was a good price.

These K-cups are a wonderful taste of pumpkin spice!  Excellent coffee choice for the Fall and Winter months.  I've kept myself in stock with them throughout.  Sometimes k-cups don't really taste the way the flavor is to be but these really ring true.  Very worth a try.

This is a GREAT coffee!  It is light, refreshing, and very enjoyable!  I would recommend it to everyone!  I get mine at B.., B..., and B..... for about $10 for an 18 count.  Stock up for the winter!  You'll be glad you did!
I had a friend give me a few of these and I liked them so much I had to order some. Nice pumpkin taste not too strong, very smooth. Good for fall get togethers.

If you're just interested in a cup of good coffee, this is fine.  If you really want the taste of pumpkin spice, I would not select this particular brand. I couldn't really taste the pumpkin spice, and that's why I am disappointed. I was torn between giving it a one star or a two star.  I give it a 2 star for decent coffee, but a 1 star for the lack of pumpkin spice flavor.  I based my purchase on other reviews, and am surprised that others really liked it.  I've had pumpkin spice coffee at other places, and this doesn't compare at all. Perhaps I got a bad batch.  Big disappointment!!
Very good seasonal coffee, I just started drinking coffee after 31 years and i enjoy drinking this in the morning.
Love this coffee...but it's much cheaper at K---- retail store and other online stores. Highly recommended!!!! I'm stocking up on these babies!

This is an extremely good product, the smooth taste of the pumpkin and spices pleases every palate, wish it was available all year long instead of just the holiday seasons, they need to sell it every month

This coffee is an absolute treat anytime of day.  I thought it would be too overpowering and it totally isn't.  If you are a flavored coffee drinker, it's excellent!  If you aren't, it's worth it just for the smell!
I am a huge fan of Pumpkin Spice coffee, however, it just didn't come up to the depth and flavor of  Dunkin's.  Having said that I am, however, a big fan of Green Mountain coffee and drink it daily.
I love pumpkin spice coffee, but this is not nearly as good as the Gloria Jean pumpkin spice flavor.  I wish GJ's pumpkin spice were available in K-cups.

This is a bold blend that has a great taste. The flavor comes bursting through. I usually brew & drink Organic Sumatra Mandeling from BJ's. I use this blend exclusively, so to get a cup that rivals the complex flavor from my Tassimo brewer is fantastic. Come on Amazon add it to the subscription service.

We've tried many Tassimo flavors.  This is by far our favorite.  Our normal cup of coffee is Starbuck's house blend out of a Cuisinart pot but one or two days a week we use our Tassimo.  This coffee is rich but not too stong.  I don't understand the current price over $20 for 14 disks and hope that it will be lowered on Amazon.  For now, we'll buy elsewhere.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: This is one of the best choices, in my opinion.  I also adore Amazon, but they need to negotiate a better price for their Tassimo Disks.  These are available at BedBath & Beyond for $10. and I always get 20% off which brings it down to $8.00 --- they were $7.50 (before the 20% off readily available coupons) until about 3 months ago.  Again, this is an excellent blend with full flavor - not bitter - I think it's my favorite.

I have tried about 75% of the available T-Discs, and the Kona Blend is one of the best regular/unflavored coffees for Tassimo. It has a nice smooth flavor that is not overpowering, and has a pleasant aroma. Personally, I would enjoy it more if it were stronger/bolder. However, being a bit mild, it goes well with breakfast and/or (gluten-free) baked goodies. I find it mildly perplexing that this product is not available from tassimodirect, nor is a subscription service available. Originally found this at (Dead Bats from) Beyond, used a 20% coupon, and was happy with the final price.

column9: Note: Rating both coffee and seller
column10: This coffee is good but, for me, it's nothing special. I will buy it again because it's a nice, mellow blend, and my favorite daily coffee, Nabob, must now be shipped from Canada. However, on my first order to the Canadian company, it's taking a long time to be delivered (still haven't gotten it).The reason for only three stars is not about the quality of the coffee but the fact that the description of the product does not mention the fact that this "Kona coffee" is actually only 15% Kona. If you look very carefully at the photo of the disc, you can see that information, and there's a legal disclaimer saying that the product may not match exactly with the description. So it's my fault for not reading more carefully, but I was happy to see what I thought was 100% Kona and wasn't careful. I've bought the 15% Kona before in a local store and did know that there was such a product in the Tassimo discs, but I just read the product title and ordered.As I said, the coffee tastes good, the amount of coffee is the usual amount, neither the small cups of some European coffees or the extra large size, and I would recommend the coffee. Just be aware that this is blended coffee with only 15% Kona. And don't expect it to come in a flash, as it did when Amazon Prime delivered it.
Of all the coffee's available for Tassimo this Kona has the richest flavor and fantastic aroma byfar my favorite.

column9: I burn through this stuff faster than I would have thought
column10: This is the best boullion I have ever used.  Knorr is a great company.  Their Onion soup mix is to die for.  I use this in all kinds of cooking when stock is not available and in special recipies.

These biscuits are the greatest of all possible biscuits. They have jam, they have icing, they have coconut that makes you cough a bit sometimes because you inhale too quick. My only regret is that they are difficult to find in the USA.Rest assured though, I have not forgotten them.I love you... Iced... Vovo...

I got Crunchy N Yummy Organic Freeze Dried Fruit Papaya (Pack of 6) for my pre-school and he refused to eat it. The texture is terrible, I do not mind crunchy but these pieces are actually sharp! I opened several bags and they're all the same. Maybe this what sweetened glass shard tastes like.
this is the so far the most terrible taste of drie frut i had ever tryed it in my life !!!it does not even close taste like a papaya !! nada !!  the others review they lie !!

column9: Good for people with food allergies
column10: My son has numerous food allergies and we have to be careful about any packaged/processed food as it may have been made on shared equipment with common allergens. This company has been excellent about responding to all of my questions and concerns. They only process fruit in their facility so all of their products are free of the top allergens. Hooray!My toddler son loved the papayas and they are definitely the softest of the varieties that we tried (pineapple, mango and papaya). The pineapple were too hard and crunchy for him but they were very sweet and I enjoyed them. They would be fantastic on an ice cream sundae. The mango were also a little too crunchy for him initially, and yes some bits were even a little sharp. But then I discovered that after about a week of carrying the opened package in a sealed ziploc bag they became softer but not mushy or sticky at all, just about the perfect texture for my son to enjoy. I was impressed that they maintained a decent texture after being opened for that length of time. The Brothers brand freeze dried fruit kind of turns to styrofoam if it's open for more than 24 hours.I also love that this product is organic. I will definitely be purchasing the papaya for my son again.

It's tough to get reliably good fresh papayas so I tried these. I was not disappointed. They're sweet, delicious and healthy. I like to eat a handful of them whenever I'm craving something sweet. It satisfies my sweet tooth and gives me a boost of healthy vitamin C.

Crunchy N Yummy freeze dried papaya is one of those things I wish I'd discovered a long time ago. Each bag is only 55 calories for the whole thing! Okay, so it feels a bit expensive--but how much would you pay for fresh papaya at the grocery store? Probably just about the same price.Things to know:-It's not as sweet as a lot of freeze-dried fruits- the mango, for example, is much sweeter. But the mango also has twice the calories.-Papayas are ridiculously healthy fruits, so you're getting a ton of things like Vitamin C and antioxidents, and they have a decent amount of fiber in each cup-This isn't papaya cut neatly into little cubes...it's almost like papaya flakes in some cases. So if you like your fruit perfectly cubed, this is not for you.My kids and I love all the Crunchy N Yummy freeze dried fruit varieties, but I have to hide this and the mango from them so they don't eat it all, they love it so much. Great product- wish this was eligible for Subscribe and Save.

column9: Should have listened to the bad reviews
column10: This product has an appalling taste.  It has the texture of cardboard  and is otherwise bland and vile.I think if there is no added sugar,  the freeze dried form of this fruit is not so appealing.  It's as though all the flavor of the papaya was removed during the drying process.Your first feeling when you put it in your mouth is an overwhelming desire to spit it out.  It's as dry as a potato chip,  but gathers some moisture in your mouth, whereupon the taste hits you,  dirty sock.  Yes it's like stuffing a sock in your mouth.As an experiment I dropped several chips into my dogs bowl.  She wagged her tail eagerly at first, presuming she was getting a treat.  One sniff however disabused her of that notion and she turned away disgusted.  Yup it's that bad,  my dog wouldn't eat it!You get all this for $16?  No thanks.

I have tried so many brands of freeze dried fruits, and crunchy y yummy is by far the most delicious one. its is really crunchy and tastes like the real fruit.On top of that, its healthy and super practical to carry around for an anytime snack. I highly recommend!!!

This is my new favorite snack food for whenever I have a craving for sweets!  There is so much fruit for so little calories.  I love to eat it at night when watching TV and I even bring it to the movies to eat instead of popcorn.  I get all the crunch I love from chips, all the sweetness I love from candy and none of the guilt!  And my kids love it too - win, win, win!
I've thoroughly enjoyed this tea while elevating my leg and icing my knee due to Osteoarthris!  Also, this tea is soothing after doing P.T. exercises at the gym or at home. Thanks.
I am very happy with this product and I will purchase from this vendor again.
I like this product I had used it before but could not find it locally.  I was glad to find it on amazon. I use it a lot for baking. I no longer have to discard the yolks of eggs.
Received product quickly.This is an excellent alternative in all recipes I've incorporated for real eggs.Highly recommend it.
I have used this product before. I like not having to go seek it out but have the product come to me. It is a savings to use Just Whites and not to have to figure on how to use the yolks.
This Jerky is DELICIOUS! FULL of flavor and moist! One of the BEST tasting Jerky I've ever put in my mouth! two thumbs up!
If you enjoy a softer style jerky this one is for you. Consistent month after month. Sweet to hot is spot on.Every person I have shared with loved it...Buy ! Buy,

I have tryed a lot of Beef Jerky but, I must say this is the "greatest" I have eaten..Just try it you will say the same...finger licking good! and it does'nt chew like a piece of leather either...  Bettie In Ohio

column9: Good taste by a lot of FAT
column10: The tast is good but it's the beef jerky that has the most fat in it I have ever tasted.
It's a good bargain for $14 dollars a pound! But it's just your regular old jerky. No taste or anything, just your regular meat--regular jerky, you just get more bang for your buck!

its really no better than that crap jack links. a lot of the pieces are to tough to chew and i eat real jerky all the time. this is only slightly better than jacks link. the only pro is its cheap. ill take quality over this next time. half of it is just dog food because of its poor quality. its not real beef jerky, its very moist and tough. i like real dry jerky. i had to spit some pieces out because they were to tough on my teeth... first time that has happen with beef jerky.

Bought this along with a lot of other jerky to test out and after about two weeks it went moldy.No, it's not salt. It's fuzzy and green and hairy.Tasted fine while it lasted. Pretty standard pepper jerky. Didn't try it after it went moldy...

I've tried a couple of other flavors of this brand and they were great, however, this pepper flavor was over the top. Way too much pepper for my taste. So much so that I couldn't eat more than a couple of pieces and I don't plan on eating any more of it.

I bought 3 lbs on sale for about half off. The thickness and dryness was nearly perfect for how I like my jerky.  The flavor was good however it is loaded with garlic.  I don't mind the flavor of garlic in moderation, but this has so much it sticks with you all day.  I went through one bag and gave away the other two.  If I was a big fan of garlic I would have given it a 4-5 star rating, but since the type was labeled "original" and not "garlic" it was an un-welcomed surprise.

column9: Make sure you refrigerate it after opening.
column10: Overall, pretty good jerky.  I had a bag open for about a week, and didnt know I had to refrigerate, and it started to get funky.
The reviews I read said this stuff was great, I thought it was OK.  Nothing special, and I don't like the fact that you have to keep it in the refrigerator.

The flavor was very good for this product but the texture is far too soft. I had read that and was looking for a softer, easier to chew jerky but this is not a jerky texture at all.It was more like cooked steak strips thank jerky.

Probably one of the worst jerky products I've ever tasted. It was almost gelatinous in texture and waxy. I think this is the result of being over tenderized. Perhaps this is a good product for those with dental problems or dentures, but for others, you may want to stick to another jerky brand.

If you are one of the beef jerky lovers who really enjoys the soft tangyness of beef jerky that is most resembled in terriaki flavored beef jerky, you should know that it is extremely hard to find such kinds. Sometimes it's just sheer luck that you get a bag of the same texture you want. To me, I felt that this beef jerky wasn't as good as some of them but definitely better than a lot of the main brands out there. This bag, has a LOT of beef jerky, and it is somewhat soft. However, it isn't like chewy/tangy and is still a little dry. Some people like it, but to me the texture is not great. The flavor profile though is delicious.

Bought a bag of the hickory smoked flavor, and this stuff was salty enough that you could throw it on the driveway to melt ice.  Great price if that's how you like it, but I've had just about every type of Jerky commonly available along with a few that aren't, and this is by far the saltiest of any I've tried.

whenever Amazon sells Jerky under $1 per ounce, I always like to sample it.  I recall seeing this brand at my local Target over $1.50 per ounce (BTW - Target's $1/oz house brand Pepper Jerky is great).  I tried Wild Ride's Peppered and Hickory, since sweeter flavored Jerky are rarely done right.  Peppered is always a safe flavor to try since few makers can screw that up, and this one did not disappoint - very nice balance of pepper and smoke without downing it in salt.  the Hickory tasted like pickled meat with a strong dill and parsley aftertaste, while being way too salty and moist.  both had about the same gristle percentage than that cheap import Amazon sells from World Kitchens Jerky.  If you like your Jerky drier, just leave it in the fridge in an open bag for a few days.  I'd call the Pepper a 3 star jerky, and the Hickory 2 star jerky, that both earn a bonus star as long as it's available under $1/oz.  One annoying thing about the package - the ingredients list is microscopic - sort of makes you wonder what they are hiding...

column9: Could be great, but fell short!
column10: The flavor of this jerky was good-very sweet which my husband likes. However, the texture varied greatly from melt in your mouth to shoe leather that was almost not chewable. I like a little chewiness, so both textures bothered me.

column9: Tender jerky in some bags not others
column10: I really like the size of the pieces and the tenderness of the jerky I've had so far. I've only had one of the 4 packages that come in an order. I am not thrilled with the Teriyaki flavor but it's ok, not too salty. The sweet hot is really hot so beware. This brand is the first jerky I am willing to re-order, which says a lot. Usually I get grossed out by the amount of sinew in packaged jerky but I have not found much in this brand yet.Updating after opening all 4 bags that came in an order: 3 bags were good but the 4th bag was all gristle and fat. There was not one piece that was edible in it. So they definitely have a quality control problem. Pity, because the good pieces are quite good, though the teriyaki flavor is a bit chemical for me. Still better than most other jerky brands
This is a good tasting beef jerky but a little too salty and some pieces were too oily.

While I read here the original flavor was natural, there was no list of ingredients available. And to my disappointment when this arrived it does indeed contain nitrites. The taste is alright, but I really would like to find jerky WITHOUT Nitrites or Nitrates. I've kept it in the fridge now for several months (i haven't had any mold issues) since I truly try to consume nitrites as little as possible, it will take a very long time to eat this or I'll end up trashing it. Please REVISE the description to be accurate! This brand DOES from my understanding have a truly natural version, that I cannot seem to find on Amazon.

Compared to Pacific Gold beef jerky, this beef jerky is way too salty! You have to drink a glass of water for every piece of jerky you eat.  It's also a littler drier and less tender than other beef jerky.  I would recommend trying other brands of beef jerky and staying away from this unless you want to develop early high blood pressure.

column9: Too much grissle in this jerky
column10: This is really tasty jerky and the price is right, but ~20-30% of the jerky strips in the bags I purchased contained some sort of "gum-like" inedible grissle that I end up spitting out.  I've bought 2 bags of this product approximately 30 days apart and both were like this.  I'll try one more bag for the reasons I cite above, but if the next one is like the 1st two, I'm going to stop buying this product.  It's a shame, because as I said, it really is tasty.UPDATE FEB 2010OK ... I've kept my monthly subscription to this Jerky ...  What can I say ... Every 2nd or 3rd piece from the bags I've been delivered turns into a gum ball that I'm not willing to swallow, but it is just so darn tasty.  Dunno how long I'll stay with this, but for now ... I sort of look forward to the monthly delivery.

Really liked the taste.  Did not have any "tough/stringy" pieces in any of the my 4 packages.Tried this on a special deal, so price was very good (always want more for less ;^).  Normal prices seem competative w/Costco/Sams Club items.
While tasting of hickory, the flavor was abit overdone. And some portions (oddly since this is dried) tasted rather greasy.

column9: Great taste, but pot luck with texture.
column10: Like others I ordered this on a lightning deal and it's great value.I gave four stars for flavor and freshness, it IS some of the best jerky I've tasted.I was a little disappointed however, the first bag and first few pieces were moist, soft and really good, then the next couple of pieces were like rawhide, with some obvious jerked gristle, which took some serious chewing, and detracted from the quality of the rest in the bag.I thought this was a one off, but the second and third bag have been the same, mostly soft and satisfying, but about 25% smokey boot leather.I don't know whether it's quality control, but it seems like "pot luck" with what's in the bag.All that said, I haven't had the jaw ache I get from the popular brands so it's still good..........just not perfect.

Some of the jerkey is chewey and hard to eat. I am a big fan of jack links beef jerkey. I wouldnt buy again because so many pieces are hard to eat being chewy or vainy. Ah well have 3 more packs to give a try. The price was good but still I personally couldn't eat 1 out of 3 pieces. Could be just spoiled with others i guess.

This jerky tastes okay, but it seems like this isn't made from the best quality meat.  I don't know if I got a bad batch, but all the jerky I ate had hard veins running through them. All in all, I would give 2.5 stars, but since I can't, and I don't like rounding up, I have to go with 2.PROS:The Jerky is tender, but not overly tender.  It is a good consistancy (except for the occassional tough fiber running through them).CONS:The quality of the meat was sub par, which says a lot, since you don't need the best cuts to make jerky (its basically dried ground meat).  As the other reviewers pointed out, the package says the beef could be from USA or from a variety of other countries.  I'm pretty certain mine didn't come from the US.NEUTRAL:The flavor was okay.  It wasn't bad, but it wasn't anything special either.  There are many other jerkys out there that have outstanding flavor.

While "Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips" do have a good Hickory taste and are very tender (per treated), they are also fairly salty and leave a lot of "gristle" in your mouth. I also like that it doesn't have MSG (I'm alergic) but am disapointed that meat likely comes from outside the USA.On taste alone, my family is split on this jerky with 2 of us liking it (me and my son) and two of us not (my wife and daughter). We all like Wild Bill's Hickory Smoked Jerky, 6.5-Ounce Package (Pack of 4).I will not likely buy this brand again, even if it is on sale.
I was kinda skeptic about these, i ordered them, they smelled a bit funny but i ate them anyways, i'm not a big fan of hickory but these were alright for the price...
Not as good as some of the other beef jerky brands. The taste is a little to bland. Not enough flavor.

This Jerky is close, but not quite as good as good as other pre-packaged bags you can get at the gas station.  It's tender and substantial, so points there.  The flavor though is mediocre at best; poor would be a fair description.Also, if you open the bag it will grow mold in a few days.  Maybe this is a problem with other brands of jerky too.  I wouldn't know because this is the first time I have opened a bag and not eaten it relatively quickly (see above's flavor comments).All in all, this isn't very good jerky.
like others i read the "great" reviews and this is not very good tasting jerky, i had a few people try it and nobody liked it but its not a total loss. My Dog Loves it!!

I have bought from this seller before and had no problems.  This last order I opened before I went on vacation for two weeks.  The texture of the beef jerky was different in this order than the ones that I had bought before.  After returning from vacation, when I opened the package, there was a very non-pleasant odor.  Upon inspecting the jerky, I found that several pieces contained mold on them.  What I have now is over a half pound of very expensive dog treats. While I would be willing to try this product again, as I have bought it before and this is the first problem I have had, there is no easy way of contacting the seller. The product is also listed as non-returnable, so while my dog is extremely happy - I am not.

This is really good jerky. The pieces are nice and thick and have just enough gristle in it to leave you with something to chew for a while. That's half the reason I like jerky. This actually helps the bag last longer since you don't rush right onto the next piece! It has a barbeque coating with a good flavor and a semi-spicy after bite. The pieces are thick enough that they don't disintegrate in the bag so that the last half of the bag isn't smaller "crumbs". I'd buy this again and as a matter of fact I think I will right now!

column9: Worst Beef Jerky I've EVER Had
column10: The following is just my opinion so take it for what it's worth.  I suppose some reviewers actually liked this, but I have to say without any doubt whatsoever, this is absolutely the WORST jerky I've ever tried.  I've grown up on the stuff, and I like a real cowboy beef jerky.  This stuff is soft, kind of falls apart in your mouth, and I'm sorry just plain TERRIBLE.  If you like a good jerky that you can chew on a while, this isn't it.

The flavor of the sweet & hot is the best spicy jerky I have yet to find. It is also very tender. The only issue I have is sometimes you get quite a few pieces in a row that have alot of grisel in them.

column9: MOLD MOLD MOLD MOLDY MOLDY MOLDY MOLDY! DONT BUY!
column10: First off, it was disgustingly difficult to tear the jerky with my teeth, unlike the other flavor, sweet and hot.Then after LITERALLY 1 after week there was fuzzies on the jerky. You buy a 1 lb. bag so it lasts, right? I didn't realize what it was so I ate a little bit anyways. Then another week goes by - I'm talking about with the bag sealed completely up - and there is a crap ton of white and green mold all over the jerky.They had it on sale because it expired 10 years ago.OH AND YOU CAN'T GET A REFUND :P

There was a sale on Wild Ride Beef Jerky, so I decided to try it out. They did not have the flavors I wanted, but the original was good. Large strips of meat that actually looked like pieces of meat and not reformed into synthetic looking ones. Overall, I would buy from them again.

I bought this beef jerky and received it a couple of days after on 1/6/11. Less than a month later, there was a lot of mold inside the unopened bag. The bag was still sealed, with an expiration date of 5/29/12. Needless to say: stay away from this product!!!!!!!

column9: Yummy!  Wild Ride Hickory is my favorite!
column10: I'm hesitant to give this too good of a review, because I don't want the whole world buying it and then the price goes up.  BUT, this jerky is truly the best.  I've found that all the Wild Ride Jerky is fresh and easy to chew...it is very tender.  Hickory is by far the best Wild Ride flavor and I would eat it over Jack Links everyday!  Don't listen to the idiots giving this bad reviews, saying that it was stale or moldy.  This is what happens when you leave any kind of jerky out for 2+ weeks people!  Any way, just thought I'd chime in with an honest review.  Hope you dig this jerky (and price) as much as I do!

The price is cheap for a reason. This is some of the toughest jerky that i've ever had, and I've been eating jerky for over 35 years. Too much dried fat to be able to pull the stuff apart with your teeth. Flavor was good on about 50% of the pieces. The others had little or none. I think this stuff would be much better suited as a dog treat for a small breed. For me, it's pretty awful.I also got a bag of the peppered type. That review is pending.
This jerky is not as good as Jack Links. The texture is good but the flavor is not good at all. I would not buy it again.

bought two bags and at the time the details did not include the ingredients. says "naturally" not once but twice on the bag. am allergic to monosodium glutamate so this stuff might as well be guano. better-half ate half a bag and EVERY piece of it eaten was full of silverskin.
These are excellent cuts of meat, soft and chewy.  Bold pepper taste but not overpowering.  I get a bag once a month on the subscribe and save offer.

column9: Great Flavor great price, great gift
column10: Got this for my husband for Christmas and he LOVES it! Im finding myself sneaking some and we both look forward to trying the next bag since I signed him up for monthly shippings! Altho I havent figured out how to change the flavors, Im sure its with Amazon and not the Wild Ride company. Wouldnt bother either of us to get the same but would love to try all the flavors. Got a great deal and very happy with the quality and amount! Very tender, great flavor and filling as a snack! Husband is looking forward to baseball season to finally have some great jerky to snack on during the games! Recommend to all and makes a great gift that keeps giving!

I'm not too sure about some of the negative reviews.  This is a good, basic, beef jerky.  Thicker than some, but good tender strips of meat.  Not hard to chew at all, good taste and an overall solid value.  Definitely beats some of the brands available at your local grocery.

Definitely a moister, kippered-style jerky.  Not the ultra dry kind that makes your teeth hurt.  I can see why some might find it too "oily", as I have found brands like that before.But it definitely works here, at least with the Sweet and Hot.  I haven't tried the other flavors.And it's not too sweet or too hot.  Kinda like a Chinese spare rib, without the bone.  I'd buy more.
Good jerky overall. Maybe people earlier got a bad batch. A little salty but not too overwhelming. BBQ flavor tastes good. Jerky is soft and chewy and cut into big pieces. Cant beat the price. 4/5
I don't like my jerky too tender so this is right for me, except for one problem: TOO SALTY. I can barely taste the meat's flavor for all that salt. It's like eating salt with meat flavor.

Store-bought jerky tends to be an excellent source of jaw exercise, but this jerky reminds me much more of the products available at our local farmer's markets.  Excellent flavor (purchased the hickory, trying original next), and an awesome price for such large qauntity. I ordered the 16oz Cowboy Strips Original, the product arrived promptly, and this is some of the best jerky I've had. It's not that chopped and formed stuff, and it is really tasty.All in all, for the price, I haven't found any better...

column9: Tougher than the back end of a shootin' gallery!
column10: I'm a self-proclaimed connoisseur of beef jerky, I have probably eaten a wheelbarrow full of different brands. This "Wild Ride" is the toughest cut I have ever come across. You have to chew, chew, chew, and chew! Couple pieces and your jaw is too sore to complain much. No date on the bag, contacted manufacturer by email, thought maybe I got some old stock...no reply. Great taste, but too tough!

I ordered this along with other Beef Jerky for my neice for Chirstmas.  She loves the stuff.  Well when she opened this package it was moldy. It's to much of a hassel to return it so I had her to just trash it.  I'll buy food stuffs from a store and not online next time.

It's chewy, not tough chewy but chewy like chicken chewy.  Didn't come on site to write a review but to contact the seller about a refund/return but since I don't think I can, thought I'd warn you so you aren't disappointed like me :(
The Hickory was very salty, so much so that I ended up throwing it away. The regular, Barbaque, sweet and hot were all very good. I will be reordering them soon again.
nothing about this jerky stands out.  might as well buy a pack at the gas station rather than have a 4 pack of this.

I am so disappointed. I also had the mold issue a lot of reviews were talking about. Since I paid for it I found a piece that wasn't touching the mold and tried it. I'm daring I know. The beef jerky was very tender. I know some might like that, but I like it a little rough. That's how beef jerky is supposed to be. The flavor was also really bad, but that is probably from the mold. column9: not something I will purchase again

WILD RIDE WAS A LOT BETTER WHEN I STARTED EATING IT A FEW YEARS BACK. THE NEW PURCHASE OF SEVERAL BAGS (ATE TWO SO FAR) HAS BEEN DISAPPOINTING. FLAVOR PROFILE HAS CHANGED AND PRODUCT IS TOUGH AND DRY. GOING TO LOOK FOR A NEW REPLACEMENT BRAND. TOO BAD. PROBABLY GOT TOOK FOR A WILD RIDE (CRASHING) WITH THIS PURCHASE.

I was excited to try this jerkey and ripped the box open as soon as it arrived. Sadly, the flavor is just so-so. More critically, the meat is extremely tough. Not tough the way jerky should be, but tough the way a hamburger that gets left on the BBQ for a couple hours is.Very disappointed I couldn't return this because of Amazon policy.
