I've tried all the flavors at least once.  Original and Teriyaki multiple times.  First batch of Original and Teriyaki was great, 2nd and 3rd batches too over-flavored.  Pepper was too peppery (and I love pepper).  Hickory was too strong/salty.  Just not consistent.  Not going to waste more money on this product.

column9: Product is below par, very hard to chew
column10: I ordered the product a few weeks ago, and the beef jerky is very hard to tear and chew.  Some of them were like rubber, and it just took forever.  I would not buy it again.  Kind of disappointed at it.

column9: Tender as promised, but more salt and gristle than bargained for
column10: By now I've eaten half the bag so I know what's in here. Sure, their beef jerky is pretty tender. But for some reason they decided to throw in an insane amount of salt. I've had store-bought beef jerky and I've had quality Amazon beef jerky and this is definitely the saltiest by at least double. The first time I ate this, I could only handle 2 strips before I had to put it down again. My friend made a disgusted face and refused to have another bite. Luckily I am a salt lover so I can at least tolerate the extreme saltiness. But it's still too salty.Next up is the gristle. Sometimes amidst the generally tender bites there will be a mat of unchewable mass that I pretty much have to spit out or swallow whole. It happens more often than other brands and definitely more than I care for. Secondly, I don't know if it's the salt playing tricks on me, but the texture and taste is a bit worse than other brands, like they use lower quality jerky.Overall I believe that Wild Ride is less quality than most other brands, even when you factor in the low price. There are similarly priced brands that are of higher quality and lower sodium content. I don't know why they sell so well. Personally my next bulk order beef jerky will be with someone else.

column9: thick, moist, chewy pieces of something
column10: Not a bad taste, maybe too sweet.  The pieces are fairly thick, it felt like chewing on a piece of thick slightly undercooked bacon.  Meat quality seemed good when you did not find a stringy things.  Needs to be cooked longer.

I got a couple bags of Wild Ride Original and I now cannot believe the 5-star reviews. The positive is that it is moist and not dry, which is what I like, but I had to throw out at least half the package because so many pieces were unchewable. It was worth a try, but a mistake I won't make again.

column9: Tastes good but NOT all natural
column10: I ordered this product because it was described as "all-natural with no chemical preservatives" and the gold box price price was good.  It arrived quickly, as usual for Amazon, and it tastes good.  But, it's not "all-natural with no chemical preservatives" unless you consider sodium nitrite and partially hydrogenated vegetable oil to fall under that description.  I would consider ordering it again if it weren't for the artificial ingredients.How do they get away with suggesting that there are no artificial preservatives (sodium nitrite) in this stuff?  Sodium nitrite has been linked to migraines and colon cancer and has been used as a poison in larger quantities.

When I first encountered these Cowboy Strips I as a bit confused. Were they in fact made of beef or cowboy? Since cannibalism hasn't generally been in practice for quite some time (and even when it was, only by savages of the worst sort), I felt it was quite likely that the 'beef' mentioned in the title was the meat source, but it wasn't out of the realm of possibility to believe these to be beef flavored COWBOY strips made from real life cowboys. That thought caused my stomach to turn, and because I take great pride in leading a cannibalism free lifestyle, I decided it might be wise to contact the manufacturers of WILD RIDE just to double check--similarly I once contacted the makers of the very confusingly named 'chicken of the sea' brand tuna fish to see if it was chicken or fish; quite an important distinction! Better safe than sorry over having broken my nearly 30 year streak of cannibalism avoidance in one fell swoop, I gave WILD RIDE a call!Thankfully, WILD RIDE confirmed that this was in fact BEEF jerky, and that the Cowboy reference in the title was just an adjective explaining the sort of jerky it is: long, thin strips that are chewable, soft, and very, very tasty. I suggested that they rename it "Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips (NOT MADE FROM COWBOYS. NO COWBOYS INJURED IN THE MAKING OF THIS JERKY)" and they agreed such a change could potentially be useful. Much obliged for their assistance in understanding their product and their intentions (after all if they WERE selling COWBOY jerky, it might call into question what sort of operation they run, and if they are in-fact a Zombie enterprise!) I was able to enjoy all four bags of this jerky in about 30 minutes. Wishing I had more, I took a stroll to the outhouse because I suddenly wasn't feeling that well, and the next thirty minutes I spent thinking about what a great movie you could make about a Zombie owned corporation selling COWBOY JERKY to the unknowing public. I couldn't decide if I'd prefer to have Chuck Norris or Steven Seagal play the protagonist (or possibly pair them up!) or if the ending would involve a nuclear warhead wiping out the zombies or just let Chuck and Stev-o whack them apart with machetes, but at least these unanswered questions successfully distracted me from the 3.1 magnitude earthquake that was shaking the entire outhouse.So put your mind at ease: these are BEEF strips made in the cowboy fashion, and they're very, very tasty!

column9: Tastes great, but has MSG and partially hydrogenated vegetable oil.
column10: Tastes great, but has MSG and partially hydrogenated vegetable oil.  It's my fault for forgetting to check ingredients before ordering--but seriously, it should be unthinkable and illegal to use such chemicals in our food.

Please understand, that when I take the time and write a review, I am very truthful and sincere.  I am not in a contest to see how many reviews that I canwrite.  However,  I am trying to help the people not to waste their money on a product.  This peppered beef jerky, is without a shadow, the nastiest jerkythat I have ever tasted.  I know about jerky.  I make jerky myself sometimes.  This jerky is like chewing on a piece of "Fat Back", you have to wipethe grease off your chin and hands after trying to eat it. I don't believe that is 97% fat free. Take heed people, if you want and like jerky, DO NOT buy whatever this stuff is............

column9: Almost one-quarter of this jerky is sugar.
column10: It's great-tasting jerky, but if you're trying to avoid sweets, you might want to steer clear of this.  A one-ounce serving has seven grams of sugar.  Seven grams is almost a quarter of an ounce.  So a quarter of this product's weight comes from sugar.  Not exactly what you'd expect from a dried beef snack, but not much different from several other brands.  In fact, most popular brands have 5 or more grams of sugar per ounce.  If you don't mind the sugar, go for it!
I ordered 2 packages of the 1 LB Jerky and I had to return it because it was too salty to be eaten. This is the worst beef jerky I ever ate! Please save your mouth and taste buds and skip this jerky.
I bought this on a crazy deal i think for like $8.00 and it was horrible.  I ended up throwing it away!
It has MSG.  That was not mentioned on any of the description nor on the manufacture's web-site.  Other than that, it tasted okay and the texture was average.

The hickory flavor is repulsive.  I wound up throwing away 5.75 bags worth from my 6 bag order because not even the vultures at my office would eat this crap.  The texture of the beef is dry and mealy with almost a powdery quality to it.  Not moist, not tender, not flavorful, just disgusting.

column9: The worst I have ever had
column10: This is the worst beef jerky I have ever tasted. It was not dried as expected and very mushy an tasted nothing like teryaki flavor that I purchased. I recommend staying away from this product.

The Jerky had a nice, seasoned flavor to it, but I did not really enjoy the consistency and texture of it.  Rather than being chewy like other jerky I eat, it was much more crumbly.  Another reviewer mentioned it, but I thought that I would try it myself because I enjoy trying new things.  Not sure that I would recommend it to another jerky aficionado, but I have 3 more bags to eat and the flavor of the meat is good.

column9: probably not from the Texas Ranch ...
column10: Jim Davis may have been a Texas Rancher but the beef is sourced from "USA or Uruguay or New Zealand or Australia and further processed in USA" the flavor is overpowering, which I guess I should have expected from "hickory" but it doesn't taste like hickory smoke to me, it tastes like corn syrup (or maybe that's the hydrolyzed soy protein?) it's got enough hydrogenated this-and-that to fuel the Hindenburg. It's also loaded with sodium, which most jerky is, but it really *tastes* salty too. The meat is tender because it was tenderized with papain which is an enzyme in papayas (thanks Wikipedia) there does seem to be a good amount of gristly threads running through it. That doesn't really bother me so much, but it's definitely not "naturally tender" meat. This stuff is marginally edible but I wouldn't buy it again. column9: Beef jerky as it ought to be
column10: This is real beef jerky that tastes like meat, has good texture and is fun to snack on. column9: If you like spicy food, this is for you
column10: I loved it during my early pregnancy, and it is really a life saver as a great snack!My hubby loved it, too!

Honestly and simply, this product was not a good one. Certainly not good based on my personal experience.The beef jerky was so extremely tough and difficult to chew. (Many pieces were so tough that they were literally inedible.)  Additionally, I ordered the teriyaki jerky and it had a very weak or light flavor.
This jerky was very inconsistent. The first piece I ate was extremely tough and flavorless. The second was soft and almost mushy. Maybe a tenth of the bag was good jerky, the rest was just awful.

I bought this jerkey for the first time and really disappointed about its taste. It is too salty and tasted very old. I can't believe that they shipped to me a very old jerky. The shipment was delay too. I'll not buy it again from this company

I have tried many many many beef jerky products but this WILD RIDE beef jerky is the best tasting product I have ever eaten.  It is both flavorful and moist and gave me the protein boost that I look for in my beef jerky snack.  I also liked the price, very affordable.  The shipping was quick.  I will order this product again and again...

I have tried many many many beef jerky products but this WILD RIDE beef jerky is the best tasting product I have ever eaten.  It is both flavorful and moist and gave me the protein boost that I look for in my beef jerky snack.  I also liked the price, very affordable.  The shipping was quick.  I will order this product again and again...

column9: Be Careful this stuff is addictive, but at these prices you won't care!
column10: Altho I did get a bite or two, I have to admit that hubby and son got most of what I ordered.  Hubby commented that the jerky wasn't too chewy and delicious.  Son loved it--said it was the best he's tried--I guess that means that it wins out over mine?

I bought this out of curiosity and out of the fact that I was just craving some jerky. The original flavor has a mild peppery taste to it and it's really tasty. It's mostly tender, but there are some strips of meat that have beef tendons, making the strips really hard to chew. Yes, there does seem to be some sort of "grit" in the beef jerky, but I'm not really too bothered by it. The other thing I don't like about this is that there are sometimes (just sometimes) strips of meat that have no flavor. But overall, I think this was a pretty good buy. I might buy it again, but only after I try some other brands.

Wild Ride Jerky is definitely my favorite jerky on the market right now. This jerky is great because it is not only a healthier alternative to many other beef jerkies on the market but the taste is far superior.  I'll never go back to the other brands!

this is a wonderful, tasty beef jerky.  i buy it for my son in new york because he loves beef jerky and he said this wild ride beef jerky was the best.  i am very pleased with this purchase and will continue to buy.,

I really wanted to like this product but sadly, I hated it.The texture was weird. Some pieces were almost "pre-chewed" in texture while others were so tough and full of gristle you couldn't eat them.The smell was just foul. I ordered the Teriyaki flavor and have never smelled anything like this before. It smelled rotten, rancid. The smell clung to your hands.There was a thick grease on each piece. I've never had jerky that was so greasy.I am feeding the strips I didn't eat, that would be almost the whole bag, to my dog. She likes them and hasn't gotten sick, yet.I've never left a harsh review before but this product was so beyond bad I had to be brutally honest. I'm sure there are people who love this product but I am not one of them.

This is the best jeky I've had. It's so good that I've setup an automatic shipment every two months. I ran into this product in Barstow, CA at a T/A stop. I decided to give it a try since the clerk stated that it was the best jerky she had ever tasted. She was right, it was excellent and made for a delicious snack enroute to Las Vegas. The jerky isn't hard, but not really soft either. Just a nice balance of texture. The heat comes on slow and takes a few pieces to really be felt, but the sweetness of the jerky is just right, so TASTY! Give this jerky a try, it's wonderful that these come in 1lb bags. Anything smaller and I think I would end up eating a bag a day.

I gotta say..... I enjoyed this bag of jerky. I ordered the sweet and hot and it was just as good as any other beef jerky brand I have ever had. Was it greasy? Yeah, a bit. Not any more or less than others. It was moist and tender more than greasy. Did it have fat on it? Yeah. A few pieces, but honestly, those taste the best to me. I guess I like all kinds of beef jerky except for the dried out, harder than leather kinds. I don't mind having to chew, but I can't stand the type that is almost too hard to eat. This was not like that. It was moist, tender and juicy with some good flavor. I am getting it again. Might not be the best that is out there, but it is pretty good.
wild ride jerky is very very good,and its a real deal,fast service and i will be back for more. i have not heard of it before but am a fan now
Best jerky I've had hands down. Better than Pemmican and Jack Links. Tender, flavorful and nice and thick. Excellent product, will keep on purchasing!

This is true jerky not the kind that looks stamped or processed. This being said because of the natural variances of beef some pieces are smaller or contain a trace of fat or may be grisly but this is not a common occurrence. I purchase 4 pkgs of this per month and have been for 8 months. In my opinion, this is the best out there for the price. Its consistent in quality and you get 16oz. I have tried all the flavors and my favorites are Hickory, Peppered and BBQ so this review will apply to these flavors.

I ordered the pepper one and sent it to my son in Afghanistan. He loved it. He doesn't ask for much when he's deployed but does love jerkey. I bought this because it came in a 1 lb package. He told me this was the best he's ever had and not to buy the Jack Link's any more. Must be really good for him to like it that well.

column9: Lots of sweet n spicy jerky for a great price!
column10: Wow, when I bought this the first time I was impressed. For the price, it's a great tasting snack. It's a huge bag (about 4x the amount you'd get for the same price at the grocery store). It's fresh and well-made, not fatty. I highly recommend!
This stuff is excellent.  I usually only buy Jack's Links so this was taking a risk and it was definitely worth it.  Especially considering the great price.  Highly recommended.

This was the second time I ordered this product. I loved it the first time and for the two pieces I was able to get to before my dog did, I love it also. Very good!! I would recommend to anyone who like sweet and spicy flavors in one snack.

My four teenage boys wiped out the whole pound in one day. I heard no complaints. The few pieces that I tried had good flavor and not too dry. The peppered flavor was spicy as expected. I would order again and hide from the boys. Lol

The sweet & hot has an excellent balance of spice, if you want something moderately hot but not extreme.  The jerky is ok, not great; it has a higher proportion of fatty pieces than most brands I've tried.  But it's an excellent value with good flavor, so I can't complain too much.  I'd give it 3.5 stars if I could.
taste great! i normally eat the point in the less than a week! i like the sweat and hot !

Seriously delicious. Not sure where the bad reviews are coming from but this stuff is one of the better tasting jerkys I have ever had. The balance of the spice and sweetness is spot on. It seemed rather fresh. This stuff is just plain good. My only complaint is that it wasn't in bigger pieces and that I wish it didn't have so many scrap/small pieces. Not enough to deduct stars because the taste is there.

Tastes just like jerky should. The strips aren't too big or too small - and there isn't an absurd amount of pepper. A whole pound for TWELVE DOLLARS? you betcha. Priced right, unlike j*ck l*nks.. if you like simple, tasty beef jerky - this is for you.

I used to get this at a local major sporting goods store. They stopped carrying it. Thought it was gone forever until I decided to shop the web and here it was. I am a regular customer now getting it thru Amazon.

I have to tell you.I'm a contractor working over-seas in Afghanistan. I have been doing this for over 2 years now, and we have stores called "The PX" where we can buy American goodies... right, the beef jerky. They have a huge selection of beef jerky but by the time it gets here 70% of the time its tough and no longer good. But we buy it anyway.I received a care package from a friend full of this "Wild Ride beef jerky" in it and let me tell you, It was soft, tasty delicious, not too salty, not to over flavored, and just plane old amazing! Now I'm addicted! My friends and I can now relax after a hard day of work open a bag and remember the green grass, the mountain air, and the lovely beaches of the old red, white and blue.Sounds to good to be true, but its amazing beef jerky.Thanks Wild Ride.

column9: Very tasty, but goes moldy quickly.
column10: The teriyaki jerky was very flavorful, not too sweet or salty; and pleasantly chewy too, as opposed to the dry/stringy stuff I've tried elsewhere. The price was reasonable. My main problem is that several bags went moldy within weeks. Several other buyers have the same complaint. The first time I thought it came that way and it slipped by me. I checked as the other bags arrived, and saw them quickly turn fuzzy. I realized I'd have to eat it all within a week or two or throw it out once it starts to go bad. It may be moot, since it's been discontinued as of March 2011. I don't mind the additives so much, but would  appreciate if (assuming they bring it back) the stuff could keep a bit longer.

This stuff is great. It is not hard like a lot of the Jerky you would find on store shelves, and has a great taste.  I have ordered two bags so far. The first one me and my GF went through quick. The second one our dogs got to before we could finish it. They approve too!

Length:: 1:19 MinsWild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips, Pepper, 16-Ounce BagHaving a little fun today, did this review of the Wild Ride Jerky.After searching through lots of Jerky brands I found this to be one of the best around.ONE POUND bags are the way to go, my grocery store keeps putting less and less in larger bags.As with any beef Jerky it is really best to keep it sealed in your refrigerator.Funny to see how many reviews say jerky became moldy!  good jerky that is not over seasoned with preservatives will not last long in open air or heat....This is top quality US meat and seasoned lightly and marinated in a special formula to make it tender.I hope this is entertaining and helpful.
I really like the wild ride jerky.  Very good bang for the buck, but this bbq is not good.  Would not recommend even trying it.  Tastes like dried up bbq sauce.

The product was cheap, so I bought a pack to try. Wasn't the greatest beef jerky but not the worst for massed produced jerky.Beef jerky is cut too thick for my liking, flavor wasn't really sweet or spicy.
I'm not picky at all when it comes to food but this beef jerky was some of the blandest jerky I've ever had. Not much flavor at all. I got the Teriyaki flavored. Maybe other flavors are better.

This jerky was decent.  The softness of the pieces were in general pretty good, a little on the hard time sometimes but overall soft enough to chew comfortably.  They do vary a little bit within the bag so some pieces may be a bit too hard, but usually they don't get too soft.  The Sweet and Hot flavor tasted pretty good; so did the Teriyaki.  I'd recommend both!

Do not buy Wild Ride Beef Jerky. I purchased two bags of this jerky and they both ended up in the trash. I know Beef Jerky is supposed to be somewhat jerky but Wild Ride takes it to another level. Half the pieces are not edible. Maybe they should advertise this as bubble gum instead of jerky? The taste is OK, average at best. I think the only good thing about this product is the price. It is cheaper than most of the other brands out there. However, if price is what you're going for, go chew on some spare tires that are in the junkyard. What is sad is that rubber tires are probably more chewable than Wild Ridge Beef Jerky. Seriously, don't buy this brand.

The good: the beef is cut thickly and has a steak-y taste.The bad: the jerky is extremely salty to the point that it made me feel ill if I ate more than a few pieces.About me: I am a rabid jerk-o-phile, and I regularly consume mass quantities of the stuff.

It is tender like the other guys have said, I like mine crunchy and harder, but it's not terrible.  For the price/product you get a pretty good deal considering how much jerky sells for at gas stations and stores.  I recommend it.Hickory:  I just tested this flavor out.  The original is much much better I think.
Overall the taste is good, but some pieces are tender, while others are hard to chew and can't be swallowed (50/50).

One pound goes a long way.  The flavor is very addicting; like doritios or something.  you get a whole pound in the pack so it lasts a while.  It is dry and stringy but that is what I like.  The price is very economical.I recommend a smaller pack first, to make sure you like it.  Then if you do,  you can buy this bulk pack.

column9: Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips Barbeque
column10: The price is great. The product is very good. I liked the barbeque flavor one the best so far. I don't know if everyone out there would like this type of jerky or not. But the pieces were soft and chewy and I liked it.
perfect high protein, low fat snack.  very tender, so if you like to chew- this aint for you.

the flavor is excellent.  Most of the pieces in each bag are nice and tender, however a few are pretty tough.  Overall an excellent value.  Price is less than half what my grocery store charges for beef jerky.

column9: Awesome price!  Great jerky!!  I love this stuff!
column10: Some of the best tasting jerky and at a terrific price!  You can't stop eating this jerky, it's soo good.  I have regular shipments coming to me and because of that I also get free shipping and another price discount.  Amazon and Wild Ride Beef Jerky paired together ... brilliant!

This is by far the best jerky available on Amazon.  All of the pieces are tender and thick.  No jerky crumbs, no itty bitty pieces.  All thick strips.  Very flavorful.  Even my wife who normally dislikes jerky can eat these.  I ordered the Spicy flavor.  It has a nice blend of spice and sweetness.  Nothing overpowering.  Thumbs up for any Jerky lovers out there.  Definately better than the common store-brands.
I used to buy Beef Jerky from the local store. But this is heaven woow that is it. Recomend this product to anyone.

I receiced the order quickly of both the Hickory and the Sweet & Hot.  Have not opened the S&H yet but only the Hickory beef jerky.  The cut is very thick and meaty and not chewy at all.  I think it is too salty plus the fact that the packaging contains a large amount of crumbs (tiny bits of meats) as if they was loaded in the bag to make it one pound.  After mixing some grounded black pepper and sprinkled some sugar, the jerky tastes a lot better.
My whole family loves this jerky. It is tender and has a wonderful flavor. I am planning on keeping several bags on hand for last minute gifts.

i ordered this on a whim because i love jerky, i love bbq, and Pounds of Jerky are usually around 20-25 bucks and I figured 2 bags of this brand of Jerky was a pretty sweet deal. I got barbecue and teriyaki.Taste is great, it was very fresh and flavorful, and the jerky was the perfect tenderness.I highly recommend this product. Well, the barbecue. Now the Teriyaki, that's another story. Very bland flavor, tasted like regular beef jerky that was thrown in some teriyaki sauce for a few minutes before packaging, definitely nowhere near the quality of the bbq. Same great tenderness though. I can't wait to try the other flavors. :D
These bags don't last long in our house.  Ordered 4 bags twice last month for my husband and son.  Best jerky, they love it.  Convienent to carry to work and school.  We will continue to purchase.

column9: Best internet jerky I've ever had!
column10: Wonderful jerky that is full of flavor and is not overly dry like the jerky you get at gas stations. I would recommend this to anyone who loves jerky.
I purchased this item out of curiosity......It's pretty good!  Chewy like jerky should be with delicious flavor.

I like to say all of you that I got this item today and I really like the strip were thick and they weren't dry or hard.  I actually like the teriyaki flavor one the most, I also like the original. I really recommenced this product. If you like meat then you will like this.  I SAY BUY IT BUY IT BUY IT lol. I know I'm not an expert on food but i do like meat so this is just my opinion.
Most pieces were perfect, but about 1/4 of the bag had really chewy (fatty) meat.

This was not the best jerky I've had, but it was good, and was certainly worth the discounted price I got it for at Amazon (from my experience, under $1/oz is a good price).  The pieces were reasonably thick, flavorful, and most importantly, not too chewy.  I was not familiar with this brand until my recent purchase, but I'll definitely consider buying it again in the future.

I ordered this on a lightning deal so I got a great price. This jerky is tender and delicious. I believe it is one of the best I've had. The flavor is bold but not overpowering. It is mildly spicy and of course it's salty. I really enjoyed this product and plan to order it again. If you like jerky and are not worried about where the meat comes from or nitrates as other folks stated then you will probably love this stuff.

True, it's not the healthiest beef jerky. But it's healthier than most kinds you buy in the store. It taste amazing, much better than Jack's Link's or whatever you find in the store. I bought the 4 bags for 13 dollars. And if it goes on sale again, I'll buy it again and again. However, if I get the hankiering for beef jerky again, this will certainly be the brand I'm after.

This is great jerky! Tender, but still chewy and satisfying (not like shoe leather!); the slightly thicker slice on the meat is great. I really appreciate the salty/sweet taste of the Hickory marinade, with its nice hint of black pepper. I think they got it just right. There is enough spice to satisfy adult taste buds, and I don't think the heat will overwhelm older children, but for the little ones, the Teriyaki flavor is sweeter and less spicy. This is definitely a product the whole family will enjoy. Now, if they would just include a small packet of dental floss in each bag, it would be perfect!

column9: Excellent jerky! Great flavor & texture. My South Beach Phase 2 snack of choice!!
column10: Solid strips of flavorful beef, slightly tenderized with natural papaya enzymes, gives this jerky a nice bite without stressing out your jaw muscles. Pleasant natural smoke and pepper flavor doesn't overwhelm like so many other brands - the beef flavor comes through. Very low fat (0.5 g) and carb (1 g)per 1 oz serving make this jerky my South Beach Phase 2 snack of choice. Great for an on-the-go protein fix. BTW - 1 oz is a substantial portion to snack on!!!

column9: Where did the Beef Jerky go?
column10: This is the best Beef Jerky I've ever had. My son said the same thing when I asked him "Where did the Beef Jerky go?"
I eat alot of Beef Jerky and Wild Ride Cowboy Strips Original is one of the best beef jerky products that I have ever had.  Great Price, Great Taste....  MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM

I guess there's no accounting for people's tastes. After reading the glowing reviews, I was ready for a taste treat. Not what I got.I've had many different jerkies, and made my own several times. In the old days, jerky was made to keep without refrigeration, and to have a handy food to carry along on the trail. Also to cover the taste of what was probably less than fresh beef.I like a spicy flavor, with just a little bite to it, sometimes a little sweet, sometimes with a teriyaki flavor.This product (at least the original flavor) is none of these things. It tastes like a piece of steak was partially cooked and partially dried with no added spices or flavors. Just a dull piece of meat. Gone also is the leathery texture of the jerky I'm used to. It is slightly chewy, but not the texture of real jerky that takes time to chew and allows you to enjoy it for awhile.So if that bland tasteless type of jerky is your cup of tea, this may be for you. It just doesn't ring my bell.Somewhat of a disappointing purchase.

column9: My Opinion on Wild Ride Cowboy Strips
column10: Wild Ride Cowboy strips are great.  The flavor is great and the taste fantastic without chemicals.  Far better than any other brand that I have ever eaten.Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips Teriyaki, 16 Ounce Bag

This is the worst beef jerky I have ever had. It is uneatable. It is impossible to chew -- even my dogs gagged on it! Stick with quality U.S. products and not this cheap South American imported junk. The seller, Wild Bill, doesn't even put any contact information on the packaging to complain to. Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips, Original, 16-Ounce Bag. This product is a total waste of money.

column9: White Mold and Amazon Doesn't Take Food Returns! Robbed
column10: There's finely fuzzy white mold all over this stuff, and Amazon's return policy of food: You're SOL.  DISGUSTING!  Looks I've learned that grocery shopping on Amazon is not a particularly good idea.  Since I bought three different 1lb bags of this stuff in different flavors I'm out some cash.  Granted this one was the only one with mold, but the other two were complete inedible as they were made from cartilage scrap cuts - the stuff that either gets thrown away or fed to the pigs.  This flavor probably was, too, but since it has mold on it I'm not about to find out.
I love my jerky and this stuff is bad. I cant find anyone that will eat it.Just gave it to my dog. I have never wrote a review before but just to on this stuff.

I try to stay away from buying any meats that contain nitrites and I specifically read carefully through the description of the Wild Ride jerky, and here's a direct quote: "Wild Ride is made with all-natural ingredients with no preservatives, no MSG, and no nitrites."We haven't tasted it yet, so I can't attest to that, but I was very disappointed to read in the ingredients list that it contains: "Curing Salt (Salt, Sodium Nitrite)."No worries if your not concerned about nitrites, but if you are, just know this product DOES contain nitrites.

I LOVE this beef jerky!  I am the Excutive Director for an organization called The Women's Wilderness Institute, Boulder, Colorado - we now have Wild Ride beef jerky on all our courses!Our participants love the taste, texture...and it the perfect protein snack.  I like offering girls and women a low-carb, healthy option.I recommend this to anyone with an active life-style and who likes to have a healthy snack and correct fueling for any outdoor activity.
The description for the item is wrong.It does contain MSG - Monosodium Glutamate.It also contains preservatives.This item should not be called "All Natural"
Upon receiving this product after my son had consumed some it was discovered that the bag was full of green mold!!  I wouldn't even give it one star but I had to if I wanted to be able to post this.
Loved the flavor and soft and chewyness of this Beef jerky. Spicey and great to every peice.Not a bad price for where other jerky is more than $23 for barely 1lb and this one is steal with it

I'm not a Jerky expert or anything like some of the reviews here. But I've had a few different brands, some the national brands and some smaller ones. I'd have to say this is a bit below average. It was slightly spicy but not terribly tasty and the texture wasn't that good. I didn't get the feeling I was eating quality meat.So why 1 star? Easy. Within 48 hours of opening it I was greeted with bluish white mold covering about 5 or 6 pieces. I'm sure by tomorrow it will be more but it's now in the trash. I don't even know how that happens

about 1 in 10 pieces actually taste like teriyaki and several pieces were VERY SPICY HOT. not tender and not a good value.i got the 16 ounce bag for a little over 8 bucks so its fairly cheap but if the product is no good, getting a great price doesnt matter.

This is really good stuff, they are a bit soft but I got a number of pieces that gave my jaw an exercise ;p The flavor cannot be beat! (sweet and hot). I also bought the bbq flavored one but I'll finish this one first :)
The product seemed fresh on arrival but is sort of 'gummy' in texture. Didn't taste very good so I just threw it away.

column9: Worst beef jerkey I've ever "tried" to eat
column10: Absolutely horrible beef jerkey. It is really almost inedible. I threw most of this away. The taste is really off. The texture was way too soft. Almost fell apart in your mouth. I noticed that the "beef" did not come from USA per the package. Makes me wonder what kind of "beef" they are shipping in to dry. Is it old and rotten? Is it even beef? Sure doesn't tast like any beef jerkey I'm used to. Yuck.

I just got my order and it's (one of) the worst things I have ever put in my mouth! Something went horribly wrong when they made this batch. I think they spilled sodium nitrate or something all over this batch! It had white powder all over it and my even my dog turned his nose up at it! I give it one star because I've received two other orders that were so-so tasting but cancelled my subscription right after I got this... Buyer Beware!
The meat is really hard to chew on.  My teeth and jaw are now painful for just eating 3 pieces.  Teriyaki flavor is bland. It's not tasty at all.

I got the hickory smoked version and it's packed with salt. I know jerky tends to have a high salt content, but this is the first time it has ever bothered me while eating it. It's usually an after effect like being thirsty. I really regret buying this and would much rather go back to Jack Link's X stick which are less nutritious and taste more like meat flavored than real meat.Salty taste aside, the pieces are thick and are of medium toughness (i.e., prepare to use some mouth muscles), which are good. Unfortunately, I sometime run into overly chewy pieces.

column9: It's great! And I'm beef jerky picky!
column10: I love my beef jerky and this is the style I like at a great price, especially if subscribed. At $11 for a pound shipped, how can anyone complain? Since preferences differ, I'd class myself as disliking the moist style beef jerky that have become popular in recent years, I would say this is similar jack links, a bit more dehydrated. My favorite used to be a bone dry japanese brand I cant seem to find anymore. It's not quite that dry, and they do tenderize it it in some manner. However, not over processed so you'll some across vein and fat as some reviewer complained of, but it give it a very natural texture. I give it 5 stars although its not perfect in consideration of the absolutely low cost as 4 1/2 isn't an option.

column9: Must be your first time trying jerky if you left good review
column10: Let me say this first:  our family of 6 keeps a high protein, low carb diet, and we eat a lot of jerky each month ( avg 30 lbs).  We have tried a vast majority of jerky out there, and can tell a good jerky from bad.  I have no idea how can anyone leave this jerky a positive, not to mention gleaming review.  Must be the first time trying jerky.  FIRST:  there is NOTHING natural about this jerky.  Few noticed, but their packaging used to say "all natural", but NO MORE, because they know it is not.  Now it says " naturally hickory smoked", or the like.  WHO CARES.  your jerky has so much cr_p in it that naturally smoking it makes no difference.  This jerky is full of salt.  this jerky is packed with MSG - and i mean PACKED!!!  This jerky is quite greasy. NOTE:  Bulk packaging ( 1 lb bags) are a bit better than smaller bags, and meat type in bulk bags is different.  YES< this company has absolutely zero consistency.  If you take 20 chunks out of a bulk bag, you will see that there are 4-5 different kinds of meats there.  some wil be moist and chewy, others will be nothing but rubber, some with thick tendons running through, and some are quite marbled.  Just when you find a piece to your liking - you are back searching for a lucky chunk again.  smaller bags, especially teriyaki is very greasy and has so much coating that you taste all the chemicals way before you get to meat flavor ( if you can call it that).i'd give this jerky a 2 if there was meat consistency, but its a total crap shoot.  you can find LOTS of other - better tasting jerky in the same price range, here on amazon.  even the middle of the road obertos is much better than this stuff.  WILD RIDE JERKY IS A JOKE and IS GROSS.  Buy at your own risk, but know that you are buying a truly chemically processed and preserved jerky - full of MSG and 0ther additives.OH, and those 1 lb cowboy stips bags?  Well,  there was exactly 10 oz of strips in a bag - rest was jerky shavings and bitsNpieces - similar to what oberto sells as bulk packages salad topper shavings of jerky - NO STRIPS!!!  we tried every flavor in their bulk=-packaged variety and this holds true for every single package.

I did not like the taste or texture of Wild Ride Original but decided to give the company one more chance as this flavor was on sale.  While the flavor is better, unfortunately the meat is of such poor quality that it's difficult to recommend.  I uploaded three images as examples of what you will find in a typical bag.  You'll see that about 10-15% of the pieces are marbled in a high amount of fat which is odd because meat was originally smoked not only to add flavor but to get rid of fat so it would last longer.  I'm not sure what's happening here.  Some pieces have hardened grease settling on them, most likely due to the meat being smoked on something similar to a conveyor belt as opposed to hanging in a smoker.  Finally, the pieces that don't have any apparent fat or grease may still contain gristle as another reviewer mentioned.  It's not horrible, but it is of low quality to match its low price.  I wouldn't recommend it to any serious jerky lovers but you can check the at the top of the page and decide for yourself.

I bought two bags (original) which were delivered to me on November 16th...The first bag was good. It had soft pieces of jerky mixed with annoying hard pieces of jerky. The meat has a nice fat to meat ratio, you know when you bite down on a fatty piece of meat. However, the hard pieces had tendon or sinew. On some pieces I could pull the silver sinew out and use it to floss my teeth. Not palatable at all. Generally the jerky is somewhat grainy due to the spices but is palatable. A strong peppery taste permeated the jerky. I felt like some of the pieces were not mixed properly, some pieces of meat were more salty than others.The taste is quite enjoyable. (I'm known to eat anything... & can acquire taste) If you don't mind fishing out the bad parts...However, my second bag developed some kind of mold. I started on the second bag without knowing that this bag contained a mold ball right in the middle of the bag. About half way through I found the moldy meat. I had read of this occurring in some people's product but I dismissed it as a freak chance.The mold is white, it reminds me of bread fluff. The mold is very bitter. I just reached into the bag for a piece of jerky & bit down on a moldy piece. I promptly spat it out and saw the middle part of the bag was fully rotten. IMHO.Would I buy this product again?No. a 50% chance of getting moldy meat... Well I don't wanna chance it.

column9: No Better Taste, Worse Nutrition Than Local Brands, Higher Price
column10: It gets one star for the price, fat and salt content and because it's 3.65 oz. rather than the 4 oz. in brands available in local groceries.  The pieces were thick and flat, which is more attractive than the wrinkly stuff.  But the fat content is 13% compared to a more typical 2% and delivers 35 fat calories per 1 oz serving compared to a typical 5 calories from fat in a 1 oz. serving from the three different brands our local Kroger Grocery carries.  All that fat didn't make it more tender or less chewy.  And that fat is displacing protein in a 1 oz serving, so 1 0z. delivers 90 calories instead of 70.  And there was 520 mg salt compared to 470 from the store brands.Unless this just hits your palate in some incredible way, can't understand why anyone would buy this product.
We also found this to be great tasting. Flavorful, not weird tasting at all.the negative review des not sound like this product at all.  Good value.

I'm writing this to offset the overly negative review that someone else posted earlier. I've used a variety of methods for mixing coffee (drip-brew and espresso) with flavoring (both syrups and/or flavored creamer) and never liked the result. So now I just don't use flavoring syrups unless I'm adding other ingredients like milk or ice or any of the myriad of barista's secret elements. I use coffee syrups for all kinds of flavored espresso varieties (hot and cold) and White Chocolate flavoring is just another tool to make a semi-exotic (but certainly customized) beverages. It should be safe to assume that if you don't like a White Chocolate drink from a coffee shop, you won't like white chocolate syrup either.Disclaimer - I've used some of Da Vinci's other syrups, but not white chocolate syrup. The local coffee shop sells a different brand, for less than Amazon's shipped price, and it's so easy for me to stop in for more or new flavors. While it is certainly possible that Da Vinci's White Chocolate Syrup is a total failure and doesn't represent 'white chocolate flavor' well, the other scathing review seemed to be based on a limited use of coffee flavorings in general. Your mileage will, of course, vary.

I got this to mix into my coffee.  It was the most disgusting product I have ever mixed in.  Needless to say, it was a waste of money and poured down the drain.  At least I got some use by recycling the bottle that causes for a higher shipping rate than the price of the product.

My dog cannot have any food with grains that include corn, wheat, barley, oats, rice (brown and white). The only meat he can tolerate is lamb. He gets severe digestive distress with only a small amount of any aggravating food. This is the only treat I can give him and he loves it.

I bought McCann's Instant Irish Oatmeal (Maple & Brown Sugar) based on many other good reviews and found them all to be true. The product truly lives up to what other reviewers have said. My wife and I have both enjoyed every pack of the 60 included in the product. I'll definitely purchase it again.

column9: McCann's Irish Oatmeal in instant packets
column10: McCANN'S Instant Irish Oatmeal, Maple & Brown Sugar, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)This is, by far, the best-tasting instant oatmeal available with a firmer texture (not as mushy) than others. The flavors are clean and not too sweet. I've been buying this product for years; it's the only oatmeal my kids will eat. Most markets no longer stock this product.
McCanns instant irish oatmeal maple and brown sugar is the best cereal ever.  great iron and good for dieters.  You can lose weight with this cereal.

I purchased this after finishing a 52 packet box of Quaker oatmeal. As you can probably surmise, I like oatmeal a lot. The McCann's oatmeal is the best instant I've ever tried. The texture is creamy and hearty. I've yet to find a stray piece of husk (shell?), which I used to find all of the time in the Quaker packets. The best part is the flavor-- not overly sweet, no chemical-y aftertaste. It's great to find a product that is both so wholesome and so delicious!

We tried McCanns oatmeal about a year ago, ordering the variety pack. It was delicious and healthy. So I decided to order one of the favorite flavors, Maple & Brown Sugar. It was still delicious and healthy, but I don't remember having so many "hulls" in the oatmeal. I'm assuming these little hard bits are part of the outer layer of the oat, harmless but not really edible. My daughter won't eat it now because of it, so I'm stuck with too much oatmeal. At least it keeps well, but I'd hesitate to order again.

I've never been a big fan of oatmeal but I love this stuff! I eat two packets every day before work because it is fast, easy and it fills me up.  I used to think Quaker Oats was pretty good but after trying McCann's, I can't go back.
Great oatmeal.  Had been getting this at Trader Joes but they don't seem to have it any more.  Glad to find it on Amazon.

column9: McCann's Instant Oatmeal - Maple & Brown Sugar
column10: This oatmeal is great.  I eat it almost every morning.  The brands in the stores I was buying had changed the texture and I did not like them anymore.  I coould not find an oatmeal I liked so I stopped eating oatmeal..... until I found out about McCann's. The cost is the same as in the store and with free shipping from Amazon, I don't lose out at all.

I eat oatmeal every morning and have tried so many different brands. This is the best oatmeal I have ever eaten. Smooth, tasty, creamy, hearty and yummy! Will now switch to this brand for my daily oatmeal meal. So good!

I bought this via Subscribe & Save 6 months ago.  I was ready to place another order but I've noticed that the price has increased more than 20%.  The product is a decent item that I could make my standard oatmeal choice, but I'm not interested in paying 20% more.
I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of this oatmeal  I would recommend that anyone purchasing this oatmeal will agree that it is the best

Had I known that oatmeal could be so tasty, I would have been making McCANNS's for breakfast instead of the other brand.  No need to compare: throw out the other stuff and try Mc'CANNS Irish.  You'll never go back.

I eat this oatmeal 4 days a week for breakfast and it lasts until mid-afternoon. I eat 2 portions at a time, with a dash of soy milk and maybe a half a handful of raisins. 1 minute 40 seconds is perfect, but it will differ for each microwave. Definitely high in sugar, but I don't eat much other sugar laden foods otherwise. Goes great with a strong cup of fresh ground joe.

What more could I want at breakfast?  This oatmeal isn't too sweet, but it doesn't sit in the bowl like a lump of paste, either.  It has body and enough sweetener in it to give it some taste.  With a banana and some cold juice, I have a good breakfast; and my doctor kids me that I can start eating Big Macs any time.  (He can't believe how low my cholesterol is.  I certainly don't attribute the level to this product, but eating sensibly doesn't hurt.)By the way, as a "controlled" epileptic, I appreciate a breakfast food that can be fixed extremely easily.  Basically I just watch the kettle until it steams, then add the water to the cereal and stir.  What a deal!

I purchased this product looking for something of higher quality than what I could find at my local grocery store. This product did not disappoint. For starters, it tasted fresher. This may be due to the fact that each serving is sealed in a foil packet instead of a standard paper one. I also found the flavor came through a lot more than my Quaker oats brand. I could really taste the maple goodness. Finally, I am not sure if these are called something, but when I had Quaker oats, I would often find myself biting into something that was hard, maybe the consistency of heavy paper. So far, I haven't had this issue with McCann's. If you like oatmeal but want something that tastes better than your standard store brands, I recommend this.

I tried this oatmeal because all of the other oatmeals on the market tasted funny when I came back from a trip to England. This reminds me of what I ate in England. It is also not as sweet as other boxed, instant oatmeals. I also like their Cinnamon and Apples variety too. McCanns is a good product and I was glad that I found it here.

column9: Good For You, Easy to Make, and the Kids love it!
column10: Good for you and easy to make..what more could you want?  I was thrilled to find this on Amazon as I had been purchasing for years at Trader Joe's and missed my access to it in our new home.  I highly recommend it.

I absolutely LOVE this oatmeal!!!  It tastes much fresher (not stale) than any other oatmeal I've tasted.  The brown sugar is soft, the texter is creamier, but you still get your fiber.  I like to eat healthy but taste comes first!  This is a breakfast food I enjoy and don't have to feel the least bit guilty about eating.

I am happy to say that I have found an oatmeal that I enjoy eating every morning for breakfast! This oatmeal has a wonderful consistency and texture--- is also great mixed with a little yogurt or applesauce for flavoring : ) I will be buying this oatmeal again.

Met my expectations, excellent oatmeal. My family really enjoyed this oatmeal, it's much better than other oatmeals I have purchased. The price was great compared to purchasing it at our local food store.
Quick and easy to fix. Great taste. I have been ordering this product from amazon for 7 years and will continue to do so.

This is some of the best tasting oatmeal I've tried.  It isn't overly-sweet, and has a delicious buttery-rich taste (sans the butter).  The thickness can vary depending on how much water you add, or how long you microwave it.  I tend to prefer it a little thin and creamy as opposed to thick and pasty, and it comes out just fine the way I like it.

McCann's Instant Irish Oatmeal used to be available in our local supermarket, but this flavor disappeared from the shelves; I found it on Amazon, and we've had it on auto delivery ever since. It's has a sound flavor and great texture. My husband often adds Craisins and bananas to jazz it up. Tastes great either way, and I've added dried apricots to mine for an outstanding flavor boost. My husband has tried other brands; this is, by far, his favorite. Mine, too.McCANN'S Instant Irish Oatmeal, Maple & Brown Sugar, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
Started using this oatmeal when in ARkansas this winter and could not find it locally.  Great product with great taste and texture.  Thank you amazon for making it possible for me to purchase

We have been a fan of this brand ever since we discovered it 3 months ago! We eat this every single morning and very happy knowing that we are doing our bodies good by eating healthy and lowering our cholesterol! I have my Dr's appt this coming week and I cant wait to get lab work done and see how much my Cholesterol has lowered because 3 months ago the Dr wanted me to start taking pills to lower it. Instead, I hid the pills in a drawer and started eating this oatmeal every morning and my sister did the same and in just one month when she had eaten this her DR was amazed she dropped her cholesterol by 40 points!!! column9: McCaan's Irish Oatmeal Maple and BownSugar flavour
column10: You can't beat it for taste or price. It's easy for anyone to cook, it's healthy, it's real Irish and it tastes great. If you find some real VermontMaple Syrup (Not Canadain or New Hampshire), it makes a great addition to the taste, but trust me lads, ya don't really need it

These I actually like better than the Quaker Oats Maple and Brown Sugar that I have been eating for years. This one is NOT as sweet and leaves me feeling lighter and not weigh heavy on me in the morning. It is a great start and picker upper for your day.  ;-)YUMMY!

McCanns Irish Oatmeal is rich in flavor, hearty for a good breakfast.  It has fairly high sodium, however, which might be balanced by combining the brown sugar variety with regular unflavored McCanns Irish Oatmeal.
This is the best instant oatmeal I have tasted so far.  It is hearty and rib sticking. I like it a lot.

I have purchased many of McCann's oatmeals.  Both the plain slow cooking variety and the instant flavors. I discovered this brand while reading a Celiac blog somewhere.  As I recall, McCann's does not let anyone into their plants to test for Gluten (they are persnickety) but I tried the product anyway since it was suggested to try oat products from the UK.  In the past 3 years I have never had any issues with the McCann line of oatmeals. The brown sugar flavor is my favorite, I make 2 packets at a time.  The unflavored slow cook kind makes great oatmeal raisin cookies too!!!

I was delighted to see that it was available on Amazon after lamenting that it had fallen off Trader Joe's stock.All other brands of instant oatmeal packets taste like over sweetened cardboard flakes. McCann's gets a very nice texture and it allows me to eat it without milk. It's hearty and warm and well flavored.If you've been disappointed with other grocery store makers of oatmeal, it's worth a try.
My kids love this oatmeal and so do I. I don't think it is too sweet.  I love that it is convenient to make in the morning and a nice hot breakfast.
Simple...oatmeal is great.  A little water or soymilk and some fresh fruit...you've got a winner.
When our local stores stopped carrying this oatmeal, my 93 yr old father-in-law was upset. Thank goodness, I can order it here. He can make this himself and has it every day.

If you've never tried this oatmeal, do it soon!  If you really like oatmeal, you'll never want to eat another brand.  We used to get at Trader Joe's but they discontinued it.  McCann's Instant Oatmeal is so fluffy and soft with the right body and texture plus it's so easy to prepare.  We have only tried this flavor which is outstanding (not too sweet) but sure the others flavors will be just as good.
McCANN'S Instant Irish Oatmeal, Maple & Brown Sugar, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)This oatmeal is really, really good....Heartier texture and flavor than other brands..Highly recommend McCann's oatmeal.

Can't be beaten for a quick, healthy family breakfast that everyone actually looks forward to eating.  Great value here too!
McCANN'S Instant Irish Oatmeal, Maple & Brown Sugar, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)I have this for breakfast almost every morning.  Great taste and a very healthy breakfast for you
Unlike some other name brands, this oatmeal is smooth and creamy and the only thing missing is artificial anything! Highly recommend this product!

Our favorite oatmeal -- perfect on a chilly autumn morning.  Can't beat the price at Amazon.com!

I never knew I could purchase food on Amazon! It was very exciting to not only find what I need, but to save so much money on it!  Now I don't have to sweat it when my son wants to eat 2 packets at time.  Thanks Amazon!

McCann's is the only instant cereal I can even choose to eat and this is a wonderful fast breakfast

This oatmeal is wonderful.  When I have it for breakfast I don't get hungry until it is time for lunch.  And it is the best oatmeal I have ever eaten.  Love it.

If it wasn't for the Amazing Amazon, I would never have found them.  Thanks Amazon you guys are the greatest.
I have been trying to get off of non-nutritional drinks and the Switch brands are wonderful!  Sweet, bubbly, and tasty and 100% juice and sparkling water.

The Switch Lemon Lime is Amazing!  It tastes somewhere between a lemon lime soda and a lemonade.  Very clean, refreshing taste.  I originally bought it for my son because he gets it at school, but now my husband and I are drinking it all!  So much better than soda!

I don't enjoy drinking all "The Switch" products (flavor is too strong, making most of them understandably sour), but Lemon Lime is very tolerable.  It doesn't taste at all like either Lemonade or Sprite/7up, but it's pretty good.
One problem with chocolate imported from Europe is that it is stale by the time you buy it.I'm happy to say that is not the case with the Reber chocolates. They were fresh and delicious.
This tamari soy sauce tastes better than any other I've ever tried. It has a mellow, rich, deep flavor.Its expensive relative to the others but worth it to me since I use soy sauce a lot.
I love this stuff.  Much better than soy sauce.  I seem to need ten more words in order to be published, but I can only repeat -- it's wonderful.

This syrup is JUST what I expected from Monin! Not too sweet, it's got a wonderful natural taste to it that's not unlike a fresh orange. Perfect for adding a drizzle to make orange pancakes or adding a bit of flavor to a good dark roast coffee.Delicious!
I love Jason's Deli fruit dip, and used this item to make an imitation of it.  It works great.  Would buy it again.
A lovely addition to it's already beloved sibling! TING is a refreshing drink that should be more readily available!!

Sierra Nevada fits perfectly between quality and price, delicious and crisp, without being ridiculously overpriced. This is the best gluten free, peanut free, and tree nut free,dairy free soy based butter on earth.  It tastes awesome and is safe for schools,  requires no fridgeration and is a healthy substitute to peanut butter.  I buy this all the time & it is available in creamy, chocolate and un-sweetened varities.  I LOVE this & so does my family;  we never buy anything else due to allergies of peanuts & gluten.  Nutritional facts are;  calories 190 for 2 tbsp, total fat 14 grams, sodium 100 mg, zero cholesterol, zero trans fats, protein 7 grams, fiber 4 grams and sugar 4 grams.  Its delicious with a honey taste so yummy you can eat this straight with a spoon from the jar.  This is identical to the creamy variety except it's crunchy with specks of roasted soy nuts for texture.  It is made from NON GMO roasted soybeans and has no trans fats.  5 stars on this brand !

My son has a peanut allergy so we had to find a substitute for peanut butter.  This product tastes pretty close to the real thing, and I think it's actually slightly healthier. I'm really glad that Amazon now sells this by the case, because my local grocery store was charging way too much for this product and my son was consuming it like crazy.  It was getting very expensive to feed him and very inconvenient running to the grocery store constantly.  Amazon has now solved both problems.

This is the best soy nut butter because it is crunchy and feels like you are eating peanut butter. Oil sometimes goes to top when you initially open it but doesn't bother me.  Buy this if you are allergic to peanut butter.

column9: more than a peanut butter substitute
column10: i love peanut butter, but my wife is highly allergic. of coarse i can eat as much as i like but then it's decontamination time for me and the kitchen. now we have two children and they can spread p.b & j from here to timbuktu. i first saw "i.m. healthy" soy nut butter (maybe 10 yrs ago) at a natural foods store and brought it home for my wife to try. she loved it and has been eating it almost daily. the kids, we were afraid, might have the same peanut allergy so we started them out with the soy nut butter. in time we discovered they are not allergic to peanut butter at all but are allergic to tree nuts. (weird huh?) so they've been eating the soy nut butter too, they like it much more than peanut butter. i myself have been gradually changing over to the soy nut butter and eat it all the time! it's better than peanut butter on things like apples and celery.btw~ the containers are great for odds and ends like nuts and bolts, loose change or even other food. (wash by hand though they warp in the dish washer)

Due to my daughter having a peanut allergy we made the switch to soy nut butter.  What I like about this brand is that the oil doesn't rise to the top as in some other brands.  You don't have to stir and stir and stir and make a mess before you use it.  The price on Amazon.com allows me to purchase five jars and get the sixth free, so that is roughly $1 off a jar from what I pay at the store.  Yes, I go through a lot of soy nut butter!  The taste is very good, too! I would recommend it.

i'm allergic to peanut butter, but I'm a runner and am always looking for something healthier and more filling than butter or cream cheese to put on my bagels and bread for breakfast -- I LOVE this stuff. i've been eating it for years. Since I can't eat peanut butter I can't make a comparison to that, but I highly recommend this product in its own right.

column9: My favorite brand of soy nut butter
column10: This is by far my favorite brand of soynut butter.  It tastes yummy and most important the oil doesn't separate out from the nut butter, so when I open the jar the oil doesn't drip all over; doesn't require stirring up; it's just ready to eat!

column9: awesome substitute for peanut butter allergy!
column10: We purchased this item as a substitute for our daughter who has a peanut allergy. It even smells like peanut butter! The whole family loves this! Will definately purchase again! We are careful to tell our daughter this is SOY nut butter and NOT peanut butter~

My son was recently diagnosed with peanut allergy.  I have always liked soy and got this to try.  He eats it out of the jar with a spoon!  I have some everyday.  Very tasty and good balance of protein to good fats.  LOVE the price here, nothing local can come close, even when on super sale.  I am waiting patiently for the chocolate to come on line and will get that too.  Just wish you could subscribe this one, would make it so much easier.

This is a very good substitute for peanut butter. It has a roasted flavor and crunchy pieces. It is still a bit sweeter than I would like, but it tastes much better than the other soy nut butters we have tried.

I am not a peanut butter lover, so this tastes close enough to peanut butter for me.  My husband loves peanut butter and is happy with this as a substitute.  That being said, two of my children love it!  The other child does not, but he has a life-threatening allergy to peanuts and tree nuts, so I suspect his dislike stems from that.This brand soy butter is a great replacement in cookies, etc for peanut butter.  It is much thicker than the Wal-Mart brand creamy style.  We have been using this product for a few years and there can be quite a bit of variation in thickness of the soy butter from jar to jar.Overall, this is a great product and this 6 pack was a great price!

column9: My Alternative to Chunky Peanut Butter
column10: I am always looking for healthier ways to eat. Soy products have had great reviews with nutrition. I also like that generally this product is lower in calories and saturated fat per serving compared to peanut butter. To me, this is just as good as peanut butter.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Not entirely like the real thing, but still pretty tasty!
column10: If you're like me, you are probably considering purchasing this because you are allergic to nuts. (Or maybe you are just a fan of soy products.) Whatever your reasons are for not being able to eat regular peanut butter, I feel your pain. Until I was diagnosed with an allergy of the bad sort, I loved eating peanut butter straight out of the package & I almost immediately started looking for a replacement. This one was the first one I purchased.This product contains no peanuts or not products, so if you have a terrible allergy then you will have no problem with this- assuming you don't have a soy allergy. The taste isn't bad. It doesn't exactly taste like peanut butter but it's fairly close. It's just got that slight taste of soy that most soy products tend to have. In fact, the taste is pretty darn good. The texture is where I had a problem. The crunchy bits of it were fantastic, but after a moment of having the spread in your mouth the texture becomes slightly grainy. It's not an alltogether unpleasant feeling, but it's different from the texture of peanut butter.Overall though, I really liked this product. It tastes enough like peanut butter to satisfy my cravings & is pretty yummy. The texture is a bit strange, but I will probably get used to it after a while. (The switch from eating nuts to choosing soy products just happened recently.) Besides, slap on a little jam or marshmallow fluff & it's faboo. I heartily recommend this to anyone looking for a nice nutritious & nut-free peanut butter. (Now if they'd only make a Nutella version of this...)

Yes, my family jokingly calls them "people treats" because of the size and shape. These little sausage bites have the same bite-able casing and mouthfeel of a Slim Jim, but are a little more meaty. Alas, I am no longer allowed to consume them without adult supervision, lest I look down and find the bag empty.

I admit, I was skeptical that this would really taste like coffee. I love coffee and couldn't imagine liking this as much.  My daughter gave me a sample and it was weeks before I actually "made" myself try it.  I loved it!  I love almond flavor so the almond is my favorite but they make all different flavors (natural, of course, not artificial) even one that just tastes like plain coffee.  I should add that the flavors in the flavored ones are subtle, it still tastes mostly like plain coffee with just a hint of almond or whatever flavor you choose.  They smell great too!

If you want a hot drink with a coffee-like flavor (and a great aroma) but not the acid and caffeine, this is a great alternative.  I loved to drink coffee but I didn't love the way my body reacted to it.  Now I can have all the enjoyment with none of the negative effects.  I have been drinking this for a couple of weeks and actually prefer it to coffee now.  This is by far the best coffee alternative that I have found so far.

column9: Very smooth and delicious!!!!  Great alternative for coffee!
column10: We love this product in all flavors and this is a delicious COFFEE alternative weather the doctor said avoid it due to caffeine or you are trying to be less toxic!  It tastes great with just a little pure cane or honey as it has a sweet flavor naturally!
One of my favorite flavors of Teeccino. I would recommend this to anyone. I drink about four cups a day, and it helps me stay hydrated.

This is the best coffee substitute I have ever tasted. Not only does it have a great flavor, but it has great body,too, which is missing in most ersatz coffees. I make this in my espresso machine, And it comes out perfectly, with a beautiful crema. The chicory flavor is a bit strong for my taste, which is why I gave it four stars.

column9: Wow.  This is really a life saver.
column10: I tried this when I started seeing a holistic doctor who said I had to stop drinking coffee (I was up to 4-5 cups per day and loved it).  I was down to one cup of coffee per day but missing the warmth of coffee in the cold weather.  I was sure I'd never get down to zero cups, but I got some Teeccino and it is really awesome.  Warms me up like coffee and tastes very much like coffee.  AND, it doesn't make me shake or give me acid indigestion.  I've only tried original and this flavor - they're both good.

column9: The best of the Teeccino flavors!
column10: In an effort to wean myself from coffee, I turned to various coffee substitutes. Postum was actually pretty good, but they don't make it anymore. I tried some other instants without finding what I was looking for. Then I tried Teeccino products. This is absolutely my favorite flavor, especially if I add a tablespoon of carob powder to the almond amaretto in a 4-cup coffeemaker. It's good on its own, too, but the carob adds another layer of pleasure. Excellent price at Amazon (it was like getting one free!) and great service.
This stuff shouldn't be compared with coffee and never be considered a coffee substitute. It is delicious in its own right. No caff-kick, of course; more for indulging in a peaceful cup of 'yummy.'

column9: Too much of a good thing?
column10: Hmm; well, I should've read the description more carefully. I didn't realise this is a natural alternative. All-the-same, the flavor, to me, was most overwhelming. Next time, well, after actually reading the directions, LOL (I just brewed like my usual coffeee which I LOVE, btw) I'll blend to dial down the flavor several notches. I am not much of a fan of Amaretto.  I followed the advice from other reviewers (purchased the variety pack and tried them all).  The Amaretto and Vanilla flavors are my favorites.  I normally don't drink flavored coffee but that is about to change.  I am so glad to have found this caffeine free option so that I can continue to enjoy a cup or two in the morning.  I really suggest you order the variety pack first and find out what suits your taste.

This has the closest flavor we've yet found to real coffee, and makes a wonderful after-dinner substitute. It also blends well with real coffee for a less-caffein beverage. Between Teeccino and decaf (even "Swiss water process" decaf), I'll take Teeccino any day! And Teeccino's Almond Amaretto is in my opinion the most satisfying flavor.

The title says it all.This coffee is not just any flavored coffee.  It is a very special flavored, with flavor you can really taste and distinguish the flavor.  i have tried two different flavors of this coffee, and both were excellent.  You will get AROMA and FLAVOR beyond your expectations.

I recommend that you try this product before you order a 3 pack on Amazon that you cannot return.  I found the flavor to be very strong on the amaretto.  It is a flavor that I like, but i dont want every cup that i brew to taste like i'm drinking liquor in my coffee.  I would like to try the non-flavored varieties...I should have started with those.

Of course, as will all Teeccino products I've tried, you get double the value in every package because you use half the amount of grounds that you use for regular ground coffee.
Has a lot of flavor. A great substitute for coffee. I will surely be buying more

Our local market used to carry this product, but then they closed.  I was sooooo happy to see it on Amazon.  I use it every morning when I brew my coffee.  I use 1/2 coffee and 1/2 teeccino;  this cuts down on the acidity of the coffee.  Now I can drink as much coffee as I like and not worry about my stomach getting upset.  I've tried all the flavors and this one is my favorite!
This is an excellent teeccino choice. The flavor is wonderful, very satisfying. The Amaretto is pretty distinguishable, which is not the case with all flavors!
excellent product, price and service.  we love Teeccino.  I buy the 3 pak and it's cheaper than buying it in the stores.

column9: Tastes more like coffee than I could have ever expected
column10: This tastes great.  Its smooth, no weird off tastes, no aftertastes, no stomach problems that coffee usually gives me. This goes great with dessert like materials as the sweetness is complimented by anything else sweet you may encounter.  Though for a 'first thing in the morning' cup, I need something with less sweetness like their original java flavor or their insanely delicious chocolate mint.  Overall, this actually tastes like coffee with almond amaretto sweetener and I would highly recommend it. I've only made it through 4 of them so far but I expect great things from the other 8.

column9: Malta India Soda Review | Specialty Sodas
column10: Length:: 6:08 MinsThis drink is very dark, looks thick and syrupy, has the froth on top, and has no other visible carbonation throughout the beverage. It has a strong and very distinctive aroma that is heavy and sweet. The smell is reminiscent of herbal tea and is a bit vegetal and earthy. Upon my first drink, the feel is very full and creamy, a bit milky, and almost no carbonated feel to it. The taste is sweet, earthy, grassy, and herbal. It is somewhat bitter, but not so much since the sweetness has more of an effect on the taste. There is a slight milky and tea like feel on your mouth after you finish drinking it, and it is very sweet. I am not sure what it pairs well with but if anyone has any ideas, I would love to hear. Overall, it is a great tasting and sweet drink, but I personally wouldn't be able to drink the whole bottle due to the sweetness and the earthy/herbal taste. It is a nice drink to try at least once.

column9: I had to throw out all the Dogswell products I purchased
column10: I purchase almost daily from Amazon and recommend Amazon to my friends constantly. I think that makes me a very good customer.I have a very serious concern. I am so appalled at this finding as my dog has been taking these treats for 8 years, now this explains to me why my dog became so ill back in October 2011 and still no diagnosis as doctors kept pumping me for money and told me all tests were negative. I read previous reviews and had also noticed the chicken and apple treat became a quarter size with a very black chicken wrap and me like a dummy gave it to him anyway. 6 months later of my dog vomiting, bloody diarrhea extreme weight loss we started prednizone as it was the last resort, either that or they wanted to operate saying it was a thickening intestinal wall that was stopping food from passing but couldn't guarantee this would work. I so now in my heart believe is was due to Dogswell products. I started ordering them again just 2 months ago, noticed the treats were back to normal looking like they used to look, thought nothing strange of it and starting giving it to him again but being still on prednizone it's hard to say if any further damage was now done. I am stopping the purchase of these treats and throwing the rest away. I wanna thank the public for your reviews and it has helped me so much understand maybe what has been going on with my baby. Sure enough after reading everything and did a google search I ran downstairs to check my bags and sure enough it said made in CHINA, I nearly passed out, This is a huge eye opener for me and from now on I will be buying only homemade dog treats made from people I know and my treats from stores like "THREE DOG BAKERY" here in Las Vegas, Nevada were I now will know what my dog is getting. This country has purely gone to shit and this sickens me that my baby suffered due to greed once again. Let's fight back and NEVER EVER buy anything with the label "MADE IN CHINA" I don't care what it is or how great a deal it is, this must be stopped some how as it seems everything is being made in China, please help the fight, you and your dogs life depends on it. Thanks again for the reviews and concerns of the caring people out there.

I'm allergic to gluten, and although I can tolerate some now and then, eating it regularly causes all manner of immune system annoyance. When I finally figured this out and laid off the gluten, my physical condition improved immensely.But I'm a total spaghetti maniac. I was raised among Italian families, my nose teased by sauces that brewed all day, and then when dinner came, delighted by superb pasta dishes of many kinds, quite often spaghetti. Getting the news about my gluten allergy was like being slapped across the face. With a brick.So I've been on a search that lasted years, hunting for a gluten-free spaghetti that had the right texture, went well with the same things that regular spaghetti does, and tasted good, if not exactly like the traditional wheat-based spaghetti does.That search, let me tell you, has been a trail of tears. One rice-based product after another deliquesced in the pot, even before it could be served, much less eaten. Those that made it to the plate still looking vaguely like spaghetti inevitably tasted like something pulled from a dumpster. No, really - it's not hyperbole. Wheat based pasta has a unique taste, and trying to replicate both taste and texture appears to be a complete dead end.But Tinkyada has hit a (perhaps "the") sweet spot: They got the texture exactly right (based on cooking time, you can get any kind of pasta-like texture you would expect), and they've created a lovely flavor that, while not that of spaghetti, is *excellent*, and also, very importantly, has gone well with everything I think of as going well with standard pasta: Shrimp, garlic, parmesan, tomato sauces, salt, pepper, clams, sausage, meat or meatballs, olive oil... the whole nine yards, as it were. Wine and salad both contribute just as they do with the real thing. You can feed it to visitors as a specialty pasta, mentioning the spinach rather than the gluten free (unless someone asks, of course), and it goes over quite well.This is the one to try. Initially, when you boil it, stay with it rather than using a timer. Check it regularly so you can take it off the heat and drain it at just the right consistency. At my altitude, at least (approx 2300 feet ASL) it goes through the various stages of stiff, al dente and soft at a faster rate than the regular stuff, so you do need to keep a closer eye on it. Once you're familiar with the correct cooking time for your preferences, just set a timer and you're good to go. It cooks consistently from package to package, so once you get it all figured out, there's nothing to it.My highest complements to Tinkyada. Great job. Thank you so much for a really, really excellent product.Now if someone would just manage to come up with a good bread, or a flour that can be used to make bread, I'd be all set. But that search is still ongoing; after hundreds of flours and finished bread products, I'm still looking.
