I bought these for a friend for her birthday, and she said they were very good; fine quality chocolates. I guess I shouldn't do a review based on something I haven't tried myself, but I'm sure she'd be truthful with me about them. They are very tiny, but quality over quantity; I always say.
I got a box of these cat tongues for each of my boys and they loved them. I will order them agin in the future.
These remind me of my childhood and are so delicious.  Better then I remember in fact.  Everyone I shared them with enjoyed them!
As wonderful as I remember as a kid, many many years ago!  Brought backmany memories of when my brother (who is deceased) and I would go to thestore and fill a bag up of these for a nickel.

column9: Yum!!!! Thanks Luv it haven't had these in years!!!! Great
column10: Luved these as a kid can't find them in Texas, So happy & fast shipping great price too!!!will be back for more in the future..Thhanks so much

This isn't something to fill your belly, but it is a fun treat. What it is, is a saucer shaped wafer , which contains a sweet and sour powder on the inside. It tastes good, particularly if you like the combination of sweet and sour, and if you don't want a treat too heavy. I must note though that the different colors do not change the taste. They pretty much taste all the same. The wafer, if I must compare, tastes like a wafer you'd find on a plain ice cream cone, except a bit softer, and chewier.

These "flying saucer" candies take me back to my childhood.  One of my all-time favorites.  They taste just as good as I remember and the best thing is they are shipped automatically to my house!  My kids love them too!  They are very hard to find in retail stores - especially at this price.  Keep them coming!  An added bonus - a whole bag is relatively low in calories, so us dieters can have a treat without feeling guilty!

This tequila is so smooth and perfect. Other sweet liquors as Grand Marniers and Southern Comfort to name a couple are overwhelmingly sweet. This is so smooth and goes down so easy. A friend of mine was instantly wanting to purchase his own bottle after 2 shots of this Tequila.

I've been pleased with all of the Davidson's offerings I've tried up until this point.  This one just wasn't that good for me.  And as a newly converted tea drinker, it's got to be good if it's going to keep me out of the soda aisle.The flavor was very very weak in this tea.  Which rather surprised me considering the ingredients in it.  I prepared it like all others, letting it steep for awhile in boiling hot water, but it didn't even give off the nice scent that most of Davidson's teas do at this point.  Sipping it I could taste the bitter aftertaste of the tea, but none of the other flavors were present and it just tasted like hot water.  I'd like to think that maybe it was just an old teabag, but it was freshly purchased and that didn't seem to be the case.The ingredients, like all Davidson's teas, were very good at least.  Organic Rooibos, peppermint, cinnamon, orange peel, lemon peel and natural flavors were the entire list.  And I am pleased that they attempted to use some organic products.  But as said before, with all the other flavors, it really surprised me that this tea was so weak.  I've had the rooibos tea in other mixtures and liked it, so I know it wasn't that I just didn't like this type of tea.Not my favorite for sure.  I will continue to enjoy my other Davidson's teas, but not this particular flavor.  The rest are being taken to work and tossed in the shared food pile in the hopes that someone else will like it more.Review by M. Reynard 2012
My dogs really love these but more important I love them too - great ingredients/great size for treats!  So happy I found them on Amazon.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: A nice thick flake of  rolled oats for a hearty breakfast!
column10: We like the taste and texture of these Mother's "thick" rolled oats - and they come in a smaller box, which is very convenient - in the cupboard or in the freezer. We buy the case regularly and freeze most of it. It cooks right up frozen and stays perfectly fresh in the freezer for a year or so. These oats cook up flakey or creamy, depending on how you cook them. More water, or milk, makes them creamier. Great for chewy oatmeal cookies, too! My folks call these oats "REAL old-fashioned oats!" They sure are a treat if you've never had them. Recommended!

column9: BEST OATS YOU EVER TASTED!! You gotta try them!
column10: Mother's Rolled Oats are thicker cut, premium oats for those who REALLY LOVE OATS! Finest quality, cook up loose and flakey, or creamy and smooth, if you prefer. You just can't find better rolled oats! Makes awesome cookies, too, and grind up in your food processor (or blender) for meatloaf or baking!
Nothing but goodnes - especially accompanied by honey, raising, some other dried fruits, etc. Yum!

column9: IMO not as good as Country Choice
column10: I bought these because someone said they were better than Country Choice.  To me they are not as tasty and have less texture.  But the price seems better.  I don't think I will ever finish them even though I eat oatmeal almost every day.

Shipped 1 April, arrived 9 April in perfect condition and perfectly delicious, but went to reorder it and all the entrees from this company have disappeared off Amazon Gourmet, including their pita bread, with was also fabulous: fresh, great texture, wonderful flavor.  No reply to emails to the company asking to reorder, and no explanation.  So try this if you ever can folks --- maybe we just imagined how good it was!

I am glad to have Amazon around,  My kids and i were about to fly to see Grandma, None of the grocery stores have small RTU SOY formula available.  My daughter has to use ready made formula for a medical condition so powder was not an option, and when you are in the confined space of an airplane you really don't want/ need a huge can of open formula around.

My son only drinks soy and after I stopped breastfeeding him, it sucked having to adjust to waking up in the middle of the night to make him a bottle. But these things, you just pop them open, put on the nipple and voila! Ready to drink.

column9: very convenient to have if you're on the road.
column10: I really liked how convenient they were. What I didn't like is how concentrated it was, but maybe it was just me. My baby would get very constipated. That is the only reason I didn't like it too much. I only used it if it was an emergency.

I needed a bunch of Annatto for a recipe and this deal was just waaay too good to pass up.  But it is 4 lbs of Annatto seed.  The upside is I could only buy it in the 16g cube before for $3.  This basically makes 3.5 lbs of it free.
Our little dog has a very sensitive stomach.  This is the only treat that does not bother him.  He loves it and so does his tummy.  Thanks!

My son has been using Prilosec for at least a decade (42).Couple months of eating this rock salt (keeps a dish of itby his recliner) has apparently cured the mineral deficiencythat was causing his acid reflux.  Now reordering and tellingfriends.  I ordered Himalayan sea salt because of it's highmineral content and because I read on the internet that a mineral deficiency caused acid reflux, but I didn't expect thesemiraculous results.

First time trying Himalayan Pink Salt and I love it! The product itself deserves a five star but knocked a star off for the shipping price. Seems a little high for a small item like this. If you have a Trader Joe's near you its much cheaper to just get it there but if you don't like me then you have no choice but to get it here and pay five bucks for the shipping. I've never been much of a regular salt user but was having electrolyte issues so started using this in place of table salt and liking it so much I'll never go back to regular table salt.

I've never seen my cats take to food like this stuff!  They demolish an entire serving of this in mere minutes.  This is quite a contrast to our previous food which they would often leave some remaining over the course of a day.

column9: completely bland, flavorles, tasteless "jumbo" lump crab
column10: For the first time, I'm going to look into returning a purchase to Amazon, sorry.  I expected jumbo lump crab, but got some totally wet, soggy, tasteless lumps of white pieces of crab.  I've had jumbo lump crab in the past, this is not it.  For some reason, it's packed in some sort of liquid and then the can is lined with some sort of paper substance.  I've used this companies products for many years, this is not up to their usual standards.  The pieces are quit small, like they came from a small crabs and they are saturated with liquid.  Lump crab that I have bought previously in the pouch has almost no  liquid run off and consequently the crab is tasty and solid.  Krab tastes better to me.  I thought it was a good deal as the price per pound computed to be about half what I usually pay, but a bad bargain to say the least.

column9: chicken of the sea lump crab meat
column10: The lump crab from a can is as good as it can be.  It is better than the imitation crab you can purchase.  As always the price is very good on Amazon.

This favorite from Lancaster County, PA, has a corn taste which is unique because it has been dried. It makes a great side dish or it can be the principal ingredient in a rich casserole which adds milk, eggs, cracker crumbs, etc. We always have this at Thanksgiving.

THis dressing is so much more than dressing.  It is tangy, sweet, and sour all at once.  I love to use this instead of catsup.  I've even put it on sandwiches.  I've ordered this dressing before and was specifically looking for it.

This dressing is private-labeled for fruit orchards around the US.  I was happy to locate it on Amazon.The dressing is a thick, sweet and flavorful.  For a salad, a little goes a long way. The good news it is 0 fat.  Not many dressings that make that claim taste this good.  I also use it as a spread on a sandwich (lightly with some other spread like mayo).  It gives a nice flavor boost.I highly recommend.  All of my friends and family that try it, love it.

I got some of this blend thinking that it would be a little different on steamed vegetables or greens, but when I tried it on eggs, I was astounded!  Used sparingly, it really makes plain old scrambled eggs into a taste treat.The key  with all of these spice blends is to USE SPARINGLY!  I've used most of the other blends as well - a little goes a long way towards creating subtle overtones in your dishes.  Another good one is "Are You Game?"  Mostly I use that for meat dishes, but it's really good in lasagne and spaghetti sauce too.

column9: Nice flavor, No Gluten, cooks FASTER than some other McDougall instant soups, thinner than other split pea one
column10: I had previously ordered and enjoyed the Split Pea with Barley  by Dr. McD. I ordered this one this time because I saw it was lighter in sodium.It cooked up fine in two minutes of steeping in the hot water. It had a nice texture and flavor, but it was thinner than the Split Pea with Barley, which is why I liked the other one better.This cup of soup has 200 calories , 1 gram of fat, 13 grams of protein, 9 grams of fiber, and 360 mg of sodium. It boasts 30% of recommended daily value of Vit A and 12% of iron. The entire cup is considered one serving (which I specify as some McD cup products specify two servings per container.) For those who have issues with gluten, this has NO GLUTEN.For those who want a more healthful option in convenience foods/instant soups, this is a nice choice. Solid pea flavor, easy to fix, no animal products. A nice little soup. (But I do give a higher thumbs up to the one with barley).

column9: Very Good Taste, Great For You, Excellent Price On Amazon
column10: I love soup cups because they are quick, easy and don't create a lot of mess to clean up. Most soup cups, especially in grocery stores are way too high in sodium to be even remotely healthy. These Dr McDougall's soups address all of these issues. They are Vegan, and even if you are not, you will find them tasty and good for you. Plus, if you have allergies, the odds are with vegan foods, that what you are allergic to isn't in here.Not all of the nutrition information is shown, so here goes: 200 calories, NO FAT, NO CHOLESTEROL, Sodium 360mg [a lot lower than I've seen in any other brand of soup cup], Carbs 35 grams, Fiber 9 grams, PROTEIN 13 GRAMS. It's a good source of Vitamin A and Iron. If you are a veggie person, you know that you have to pay attention to make sure you get enough protein. This is a great source, especially for a 200 calorie serving. The cup, by the way, is larger than most. It's a very satisfying serving.Other than the dehydrated peas, the other ingredients are in a foil pouch inside the cup. I can only assume it keeps the ingredients fresher. Let it sit for three or four minutes and it gets nicely thick.If you are not participating in Amazon Subscribe and Save, consider it. If you set up a regular delivery schedule, anywhere from one to six months, you get a 15% discount plus free shipping without the $25 requirement. This soup is hard to find in stores and when you do, it's more expensive than it is on Amazon. Plus, you can order early or cancel an order if you need to.I'm not trying to pimp for Amazon, it's just that I've found it to be the best deal.

Except for decently high sodium (like every soup) this is really good for you. Very high in fibre and protein. It also has a really nice smokey flavour. It reminds me of French Canadian split pea soup but with green peas and no ham.

I found the soup a bit too gritty and the flavor was not my cup of tea. It was a bit too smoke flavored for my taste also. My brother seems to like it so I would conclude "different strokes for different folks".

column9: Should be called Split Pea Puree but tasty
column10: Super thin and not what I remember as a child but still pretty good.  I sort of remember split pea soup being chunkier.  I will experiment with the amount of water that I add and that might make it thicker.

Super filling and tastey and I love the tecture! Yes, it's probably reminiscent of baby food but, it's split pea soup! It should be! I hate how most split pea soup has bacon in it...Yuck! Peas are delicious so why ruin in with yucky bacon? Love this!

This product is a great way to have a nutritious meal at work when you don't have a lot of time. It is very tasty; just make sure you follow the directions and stir it thoroughly before you microwave.

I'm the mom of a 3 year old, work and volunteer. This is a great way to keep something at the office I can prep for those times I can't pack a lunch.  It does take a while for the soup to "cook" in the hot water, but I think the end result is better than instant.  You can sip it from the cup in the car if need be! I like the California Highway split pea soup and this is smooth like that, but a more complex or adult taste.  Probably thyme. Overall, it is fabulous for the health/price/taste/convenience ratio.

low low fat, vegan and tastes greathonestly, not many food products in the entire world like thiswish i had found out about it lot lot soonerno animal products - how awesome!!!great for health, convenient, delicious - need i say more!
This soup is so flavorful and full of protein, 13g for the cup! It rehydrates quickly and its thick and creamy without crazy amounts of sodium or any added oil. A must have for us vegans!

column9: Best split pea soup in a cup I've ever had
column10: This soup is convenient (I keep a bunch in my desk at the office) and makes a great lunch or snack.  It has a smoky flavor and is smooth.  The soup tastes great and is very satisfying.  I can't even tell it's light sodium.  I love it!

column9: Tasty, Easy, Quick lunch or snack,  BUT...
column10: I'm still disappointed with the "lower sodium" label.  Of course you will get less sodium if you decrease the amount in the cup by 50%!  The large Mc Dougall soup cups contain two servings typically - have you tried to share one or keep it for another day?My solution is to use about 3/4 of the "seasoning packet" (assuming that the sodium is there and not in the dried flakes).  The flavor and texture are still good.  I wish their advertising was more transparent - it would make me trust the company a little more.

I like this Dr. McDougall's Split Pea Soup.  It mixes easily and is nice and thick.  Has a fresh taste too, not like the usual instant soup mixes in a cup.  I have so many dietary restrictions, it's such a rare treat to have a convenience food that I can have.

This is great to take on the go and I add crumbled firm tofu or TVP to give it a meaty texture. It was awesome. If you follow the directions, the soup will be smooth. If anything the texture is like apple sauce. I will definitely buy this product again and add it to my lunch rotation.

ehhh this is barely edible to me. It has a very strong 'smoked' flavor to it that is overwhelming to me... it taste like I imagine slightly burnt split pea soup would taste like. That said the first time I made it the aroma was good... not that it matters when all the other flavors are ruined by the smokiness.
At work, this a quick meal.  I love the texture and that the container is BPA free. I love having this product available in case I need a fast meal in a hurry. Oh by the way it tastes very good.

column9: You have to REALLY like Split Pea soup, and even if you do, be CAUTIOUS
column10: This soup made me physically ill. Not a pleasant texture or taste. Actually, it was so bad that I haven't been able to look at split pea soup the same way ever since. I'm not using hyperbole, I don't think I'll ever be able to eat split pea soup again.

My husband and I both like this soup.  Although it is lower sodium, it is not bland.  It is a thick soup.  The suggested microwave time in our oven caused boiling over.Reducing that by 15 seconds worked fine.  Other microwaves might vary the other way. I often order McDougall Vegan soups from Amazon so that I can keep three or four varieties in stock.

I absolutely love these soups! The taste is phenomenal as a healthier alternative to soup cups. It's very tough to find a suitable, quick, and yummy grab for a vegan lunch and I'm so grateful to have a cabinet stocked with all types.

This is instant soup, not fine dining  That said, these have great flavor for instant.  Vegetarian.  Healthy.  Yum!  Been buying it for years, repeatedly.  And Amazon is cheaper than the local Publix.

Arrived within a week, just as planned, and these soups taste awesome.  They are extremely easy to store and prepare, and are also composed of quality ingredients.  Highly recommended for travel, camping, or even for a lunch break at school or work.  All that is needed is water, a heating source, and a spoon.

column9: Not bad, quick and easy to fix
column10: I could eat this Vegan Split Pea Soup and be fairly well satisfied. It's tasty enough and easy to prepare. Of course it doesn't come close to my homemade pea soup but when there's no time to cook up a batch of the regular soup, then this is nice to keep on hand. It has a good texture and is filling.

This is the best instant pea soup I have tried!  It's not like the tried and true soup you get when you make it the old fashioned way, but it is definitely the best instant soup I've tried, and I've tried quite a few epic fails!  Great quick soup to have on hand; I will order some of these again.

I am a health-conscious freshman college student and I absolutely hate my meal plan! I was frustrated with the lack of healthy food the cafeteria was serving so I decided to order Dr. Mcdougall's split pea soup along with the lentil cous cous soup. One word describes both of these products: AMAZING! I only have a water heater in my tiny little two person dorm room and that is all I need to make a meal! Not only is this product low cal but also low sodium and it doesn't even taste bland! It is super filling and I always look forward to eating this soup, especially on a cold winter day!

This is the first time I have tried this brand of soup.  It is perfect "desk food" for those who work in the office.  I just added hot water, stirred it up, and it was ready in 2 minutes.  The price was pretty good, it tasted great, and filled me up.

This soup is just delicious and not salty. Easy to prepare and good for you too!! Really hard to find soup or other products these days without alot of undesirable additives and wayyy too much salt (no names given). Try this product for a tasty treat.
ALL OF THE SOUPS ARE FANTASTIC.  LOW SODIUM, BUT FULL OF FLAVOR.  INGREDIENTS ARE WONDERFUL, WITH NO JUNK.  EASY TO STORE, AND PREPARE TO SERVE.  THANK YOU FOR CARRYING.
This is a great tasting soup for people on a low sodium diet - even my husband (who over-salts everything) was able to enjoy this soup without adding salt.

I really enjoy this soup. It's just the right consistency, not too salty or spicy, just real comfort food. It also dissolves better than the grocery store brands when you add the hot water. Just stir a few times after you add the water, while letting it "sit". I appreciate the fact that there is no msg or artificial additives.
I only go for the Light Sodium flavors as I think the others have too much salt. This one is delicious - thick and tasty. Just the right amount for me for one serving.
Very tasty and nutritious, especially if soup is left to thicken after adding boiling water.  Great to have in a pinch.  No guilt because it's got 0 fat but lots of good stuff.

I think this is the second best tasting McDougall's product, the first being Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Black Bean & Lime Soup, 3.4-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6) I've found that all Dr. McDougall's soups benefit from preparing them according the instructions on one of the other soup's I didn't like so well. After the initial heat-up, stir thoroughly and Microwave for an addt'l 5 mins @ 20% power, yes that is twenty percent power. This helps to thicken it up, soften any noodles and meld the flavours a lot more.I prefer my Split Pea kind of chunky so I found adding 2 heaping T of Quaker Oats Old Fashioned Oatmeal, 18-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6) helps a lot without adding too many calories plus more fiber to the 9 grams already in this soup.Hope that helps ya'all

Bake a couple of potatoes; cook some fresh kale (or collards) and some frozen corn; split and mash the baked potato; pour the pea soup over the potato (maybe a little over the greens & corn) and voila a delicious nourishing meal for 2!  Subscribe to this soup with prime shipping (free instant movies also) and get each soup delivered for about $1.00 per container.  While eating your delicious dinner, check out the John McDougall Wellness website, [...], (note free newsletters on left side of screen) and enjoy your meal while you are learning to get healthy.While you're about it, check out [...], learn, and get healthy.  You will be amazed!By the way, all this stuff works in one week.  See for yourself.  Nothing to lose.A disclaimer:  I am totally unconnected from either website above.  I did do this stuff; however, lost 40 pounds, blood pressure went to 120/70 and cholesterol to less than 150.  All aches and pains are gone, I love my body and I am happy.If you prefer to read while you eat your meal, consider McDougall's, The Starch Solution released May 8, 2012 (in my opinion the only book you need to read to get healthy) or The China Study, by T. Collin Campbell, which started me on this journey.And to think, this review was originally only intended to share one of my favorite meals with you...
Soup is very tasty and for the most part, healthy. If the sodium content could be lowered even more, it would be five star.

There is nothing solid in this soup.  It is just a thicker liquid like tomato soup.You could call that my fault for not knowing what split pea soup is except thepackaging shows a spoonful with chunks of what looks like peas and carrots...I assumed the dried variety like you find in a cup o soup.Overall the soup is palatable, I mean I'll finish the rest, but will not be leavingon the subscribe and save to send me another batch.

column9: Not nearly as good as the other soups
column10: I thought this soup would compare to the regular Split Pea and Barley soup...which is delicious. This soup is more gritty and doesn't have any substantial pea pieces in it. I would suggest ordering the full sodium split pea and barley.

Nothing really wrong with it, and it certainly appears to be healthy.  Maybe I was expecting too much from a powdered soup mix, although I have purchased tastier split pea soups here on Amazon.  Don't know much about vegans (and don't really care to).  Maybe they like and expect their food to be bland.  But if you'd like some substantial taste, look elsewhere.
I will never buy this stuff again tasted so bad i could even it eat a whole bowel dont buy

column9: I heard this stuff was the best
column10: I figured I'd try this for dipping cake pops. And it does seem to produce a thinner, smother coating than almond bark. It melts in the microwave better than almond bark and is easier to work with.
Reasonably good red wine vinegar with a nice strong edge. I use it all the time for salads and also to perk up things like soups and marinades. Good to spike a steaming liquid too.

I received my case of Izze Grapefruit Sparkling Juice on a Tuesday, and it was gone by Friday.  My wife and I sampled one can together, and immediately put the whole case in the fridge, pushing aside other juice beverages to make room.  For the next two and a half days, my wife and I eye-balled each other every time we went to the fridge, keeping tabs on how many cans were left.  And on Saturday, the day after the last can was gone, we felt like Izze addicts, jonesing for another can.  Just one more...If you are a Fresca fan, you will more than likely love this beverage.  It has a snappy, zingy body, light and refreshing, perfect with ice.  This would make an outstanding summer drink in a tall glass with ice, out on the deck, reading a book in the sun.  I dare say it wouldn't be a bad mixer, either, if you wanted to spike it  ;^)The nutritional content of the drink is what you make of it.  With 70% juice and 30% sparkling water, it's 8.4 ounces are going to have some calories (90 in a can).  It's also going to have vitamin c and niacin.  I've noticed some reviewers say that you'd be better off taking a multivitamin, but if you're drinking it strictly to get vitamins, I think I'd have to look at you with my head tilted slightly to one side and make a Scooby-Doo noise at you.  :^)  No one should get all of their daily recommended vitamins from a drink like this; what Izze is going to do for you is be a tasty, refreshing drink that's a much, much better option for a health-conscious person than a diet soda or most other drinks that you enjoy as a treat.If you're ever in a convenience store and notice an Izze drink in the cooler door, pick one up and try it.  Don't buy a case because it might not be your thing... but do try it.  I loved the Grapefruit version, and I will certainly try the other flavors as well.

column9: A Healthier Choice than Regular Soda
column10: I was a little skeptical at first when I got these for my kids, but I came away impressed.  They loved the taste of the grapefruit, apple, & pomegranate flavors, and I felt good that with fruit juice and added vitamins Izze is healthier than regular soda.  Downsides: they are still concentrated simple carbs, there are some health concerns regarding the health effects of carbonated beverages, and the premium price.

IZZE Grapefruit is great for those who think regular grapefruit juice is too acidic or overpowering. This blend is just perfect -- a bit of sparkling water with the grapefruit juice and not much else. This allows for a refreshing taste, but make sure it is cold. Given that I'm not much of a carbonated soda drinker, this isn't a replacement for a can of Sprite. Rather, it's just another beverage in my arsenal to replace my other daily juices if I don't want to go crazy on the calories.
not too sweet, not as many calories as the same amount of straight juice, smaller volume, so less likely to waste it.

column4: Learning All The Time "It's Never Too Late to...
column10: I love this juice (grapefruit).  Not too sweet, not too tart, just the right amount of flavor and fizz.I will say that it tastes better if I pour it into a glass - it eliminates the sort of metallic pretaste that I get when I breath right before I take a sip, which, apparently I do quite a bit.But honestly, half the time I am too lazy to get a glass and this beverage still tastes great.  I also love the 8 oz size, that is pretty much the amount I like to drink at any given time.I'll be ordering this again!  And what a luscious range of flavors, I can't wait to try some of the others.

column9: Seems like a healthy choice. . . but, it's really not.
column10: This review is for the grapefruit flavor, but I've tried clementine and pomegranate, too.I'm continually surprised at what passes for "healthy".  I received this product to review but was already familiar with Izze sodas, as they're available at most Starbucks and now at grocery stores, as well.These are 8.4 oz cans and each can is 90 calories.  Since nutritional data isn't included in the item description, I'll include them here.Each 8.4 oz serving has 10 mg sodium, 20 gm carbohydrates, and 20 grams of sugar.So, for those who believe this is a "healthy" alternative to sodas, I would disagree.  An 8-oz serving of Caffeine-free Coca Cola Classic has 97 calories, 27 grams of carbohydrates, 33 gm sodium, 24 grams of sugar.So, really, having an Izze isn't such a healthy alternative to having a coke.  You aren't reducing your sugar intake with an Izze nor will you reduce your carb intake.  Yes, it's juice and "natural" but your body responds to sugar and carbs quite the same whether the sugar comes from juice or another source.The sugars that come from juice is fructose-- and your body responds to fructose the same way it responds to table sugar.  They both cause your insulin levels to increase.  Each 8 oz glass of juice has about 8 full teaspoons of sugar.  So, if this 8.4 oz can of Izze soda is made up of 70% juice, you are still consuming 5.8 teaspoons of sugar.Whole fruit is much healthier than juice since the fiber has not been stripped away.  Fiber moderates the release of the sugar in your bloodstream and moderates the insulin release.Sorry for the nutrition lesson.Izze sodas TASTE good-- and even this Grapefruit (and I don't care for grapefruit) tastes good.  As long as one understands they aren't having something "healthy" when they have this sparkling juice, great-- if it's just taste you are looking for, give this a try.  Sometimes, though, a pretty label and a spot on a shelf in the Organic Food store causes people to believe that what they are consuming is healthy when, in fact, it's just not.I received a case of 24 cans.  My family enjoys Izze sparkling juices because they taste good and, because we have them, I don't mind them drinking them.  Even though I will occasionally purchase Izze juices for my children when we're out and hit Starbucks, I never buy sugary drinks at the store.  I consider these sparkling juices to be empty calories. When this supply is through, we won't buy them again to keep at home.4 stars for taste.

column9: Good stuff ... fruit drink that may taste like chalk! ...
column10: Yeah, chalk ... or a semi-neuvo, lightly carbonated fruit drink.I purchased some of this recently at Target, in Pomegranate, Raspberry and Grapefruit. I was happily satisfied, pleased and invigorated like one of those exploding or overactive guys on one of those Mountain Dew commercials.While the taste isn't too overpowering it's also not something that makes you go: "Hmmmm? What am I drinking?", much like some of those other energy drinks like Red Bull, or other juice based energy drinks that seem to be made of something indescribable that's close to: "wow, chemically ...".Good stuff though, gotta love it. Might be popular with the rave crowds once they start mixing it with Vodka, Tequila or God knows what else. I don't think the acquisition of this company by Pepsi will effect the product like some of the earlier internet reports had believed. They do know to leave well enough alone when they want to.I must say that after reading that Niacin was an ingredient, my concern regarding the 10% of your daily allowance in 8.4 fluid ounces, could equate to it being quite a bit or too much. This may cause contraindications with folks who have had a stroke (myocardial infarction) or Liver disease as even mediocre doses of Niacin have been problematic.
This is a delicious alternative to soda.  All-natural, lightly carbonated, and a delicious grapefruit taste.  Highly recommended!

My whole family has turned into Izze addicts. My teenaged daughter loves apple and clementine, I love grapefruit, and my husband is torn between pomegranate and blackberry. Now Izze lives in our refrigerator beside our trusty Diet Coke and bottles of water.Why do we like it so much? It's not too sweet, not too carbonated, with a rich fruit flavor. It's never bitter or harsh.I only wish it was available in more places. Only a few grocery stores carry Izze. But I guess that's what we have Amazon for!

I love grapefruit juice and consider myself a purist when it comes to juices, so I was a bit apprehensive about taking a great taste and adding a sparkling water fizz.  I had some expectations that this wasn't going to be a hit with me.  Izze Fortified All Natural Sparkling Juice was a pleasant surprise and a kick in the pants.  I love it.  I still get the pure taste of grapefruit juice and the sparkling water doesn't overpower the taste.  In fact, it enhances the experience.  I thought by ordering grapefruit (which I'm the only one in the family that likes it), I'd be safe, but the kids have discovered it and I find empties every morning where they can't help but have a can.  It doesn't have a can taste like some juices in a can either.  Overall, I'll buy this product whenever I see it.  It tastes great, has a special kick which doesn't take away from the pure fruit flavor and is an all round great compromise between a fruit juice and a fortified energy drink.  Bravo!

I thought this would be a bit more sparkling than it ended up being, but it is still very good and natural tasting.  Although not a health drink, still better than soda and the can size, 8.4 ounces, is really the perfect amount for my family when we want a flavored drink.  I've had both the grapefruit and orange and recommend them for what they are ... a tasty and good alternative to soda.

Izze's 8.4 ounce, canned 'Sparkling Grapefruit,' juice is nothing short of delicious and immensely refreshing to boot.  I've tried several other varieties in their sparkling juice line and without hesitation can say that Grapefruit is the definite standout out of the bunch.  This particular flavor has all of the vibrant citrus intensity you'd expect from a fresh grapefruit with just a hint of added sweetness (no refined sugars are added FYI) to perfectly balance the natural tartness.  Couple that with the effervescence of the sparkling water base and you have a well balanced canned beverage that quenches and dazzles the palette immediately.As an added tip - The Sparkling Grapefruit drink makes for an awesome component to cocktails.  Mix the juice from 1 can with 3 shots of high quality vodka, then pour over some crushed ice and serve in your favorite cocktail glasses.  Guaranteed party hit right there!

I love grapefruit juice, but so often it is of poor quality and bitter to taste. Or, to the other extreme, it is so loaded with sugars to mask the bitterness it becomes like drinking syrup. A few years ago, you could buy grapefruit drink from Swan's that was excellent, but then they quite making it. Go figure.I thought I'd never find a grapefruit drink I liked as well as the Swan's, but this is it! In fact, being lightly carbonated, this is even better! I love this stuff, and at only 20 carbs, it doesn't have an adverse effect on my diabetes as long as I limit myself.I can't wait to try the other flavors.

I was a bit skeptical about this product before trying it, as I am not a soda drinker by any stretch of the imagination. However, I decided to give it a go. Not only was I not disappointed, I absolutely LOVED it!The Izze Fortified All-Natural Juice (I tried the Grapefruit version) is light and refreshing and JUST sweet enough (not cloying the way sodas can be). Its crisp taste and gentle bubbles remind me a great deal of Orangina, which I always liked. The cans are smaller than regular soda, which I also view as a good thing, as I can never finish a whole can on those occasions when I do drink it. The fact that this drink is also fortified with vitamins is an added bonus (though I've gotta say that the fortification is a bit weak; nothing terribly exciting there).I look forward to trying the other flavors, but I am totally sold on IZZE and can, with a clear conscience, recommend it most highly!

column9: Tasty product in a small can
column10: This is a very tasty, not too sugary mix of juices (including white grape and apple), with greapefruit juice (no pulp) and carbonated water addes in.  I found it to be a very refreshing alterantive to Coke or Pepsi.  It has pretty much the same amount of sugar, but at least it comes in a can about 2/3s the standard size Coke or Pepsi can.  I find that it takes a while to drink one of these cans, so you do get fewer calories than standard soft drinks.  There is no refined sugar, caffeine, or preservatives, so is a better alternative to soda. I find that this is a great drink to have after some time outside on a warm day and really look forward to trying some of the other flavors.Highly recommended!
I love IZZE, this is a delicious and healthy alternative to soda.  It's great for kids and adults.  This is a good price too, and if you buy 2 cases you get FREE shipping from Amazon!

As a recovering soda junkie, I crave carbonation and sweetness.  Izze offers this in fruit form.  One of my favorite sodas was Squirt, and I have found that Izze grapefruit sparkling juice is a great replacement.  I have drank Izze out of bottles and cans, and while I prefer it in the bottle, the cans offer a smaller portion and are easier to pack (and ship, obviously).  Subscribe and save is the way to go on these, as they can be quite expensive in the store, and home delivery with a great price is hard to beat.

I don't even like grapefruit juice usually and I LOVE this! So addicting, I got this because it was the only flavor left at Chipotle and I wanted a not so sugary drink, it's so refreshing.  Great mixer with Vodka too:)

column9: This is my favorite flavor of IZZY!
column10: If you enjoy sodas like Squirt then this is as close as you are going to get in a natural soda. We enjoy all the IZZY flavors but this one is my favorite.

column9: Great drink with a little less guilt
column10: I LOVE the IZZE sodas in the glass bottles but this is almost as good with fewer calories and some vitamins to boot. I can drink these with a little less guilt than a regular can of pop plus they taste yummy!

This, and the Clementine flavor of Izze soda are my absolute favorites. When the price on Amazon goes down to 17 bucks per shipment it's cheaper than at the grocery store and very well worth my while. I'm glad I found it here.

I buy IZZE when it's on sale on Amazon. It's 70% fruit juice and 30% water - that's it. No added ingredients that you can't pronounce, none of that corn syrup stuff that everyone is scared about and no added sugar. It's a great healthy alternative to sodas. This Grapefruit flavor is my favorite of the 5 IZZE can varieties. I love grapefruits in general so this is a great match for me. It's not overly sweet and has a nice tart taste. It's very refreshing. If you like grapefruits you will love this.

column9: This soda tastes good, but it's not SCD-legal
column10: I bought Izze Soda's based on a recommendation from a person on the Specific Carbohydrate Diet. The soda is tasty, good and sweet. It actually tastes like grapefruit too, with a strong dry fruity flavor.It's great over ice, but it is NOT SCD LEGAL, at least not the grapefruit flavor, because of the gum acacia. Heartbreaking. The gum is a polysaccharide, a complex sugar which cannot be digested by SCD'ers. I know better now.

LOVE, LOVE, Love this product!! The picture is a little misleading as it is on 8 ounces, but, it's not loaded with a bunch of sugar, and it's a nice departure from the coke and pepsi.It's only 90 calories, so I don't feel guilty when I have one with my lunch.

The IZZE Grapefruit sparkling juice is my favorite amongst the blackberry and the green apple.It is NOT a healthy drink but a HEALTHIER drink than the sodas.It is NOT for those seeking a low calorie alternative to their diets.The sugar in this product is of the faster converting carb so it won't help you much in your waist-line.With that said, it IS a healthier drink if one prefers to have some sparkling drinks with their meals, which I do.I drink water throughout the day but when I eat, I like to pair my food with drinks. I am not a big wine drinker nor am I a big soda drinker. On those days that I am not in the mood for wine, this drink enhances my eating experience.unless they are inconsistant with each batch (it IS hard to gauge fruit juice, but because it IS mixed with other juices, I suspect they taste it before they can it), the grapefruit soda is just the right balance. Not too sweet and leaves a nice after taste in your mouth.Pairs good with chicken and seafood dishes. ( I like the blackberry for steak and stews and have used the blackberry for substitute when some recipes calls for coke)It IS expensive though for the amount and size. I would not give this to children thinking it is good for them.Moderation with everything is the key. We shouldn't neglect and abstain from things that we love, just eat and drink with moderation and we can eat just about anything without giving it up completely (OK, this last sentence is a bit self-serving...now I'll serve me up one of them grapefruit sparklies!!)
This is my favorite Izze product by far.  I like the taste and the sparkling effect.  It definitely has a grapefruit flavor, again, my favorite of the Izze products.
Mild grapefruit flavor with just the right amount of sparkle.  It is a very refreshing drink.

This is a great drink and the calorie intake is great! I had been pondering purchasing this for a while and I am glad that I did.  I also bought the blackberry and it is actually my favorite.  You will not be disappointed with either of these purchases.

I was looking for this drink in a bunch of stores. I finally found them but for a 4 pack they wanted about $5.00 I thought that was a bit much then i check on amazon and I was shocked that they had them. This is the first time I used the subscription system. I got a discount for using it also. I never have to think about running out since I get a 24 pack mailed to my house every month. Its a great drink and even better for the health conscious. If you want to try something other than soda give Izze's a try.

The Izze natural sparkling Juice was a great addition to our family,we enjoyed it very much and intend on buying more..We discovered it at one of our favorite places to eat and fell in love with it.. My grandson who is eight years old really enjoys a can during afternoon snacks and at the same time it is good for him instead of sodas...Might of fact we drink it instead of sodas. My daughter takes it to work with her everyday. I myself enjoy it during lunch and dinner.. A great can of Juice.

I must confess to being completely taken by this juice.  I adore the packaging, the name, and even the story behind its birth.The taste is delightfully refreshing and different.  And while it does nothing in aiding the diet or lowering your sugar intake, it does make you feel better about drinking it since it is not a soft drink per say.My husband who hates all things that could potentially be healthy would allow me to put this into his lunch.  It was a huge deal that he liked these.  Again, it's better than the Mountain Dew he constantly drinks otherwise.Fun, fruity, and unique... we do buy this juice occasionally.  However, it too is hard to find and expensive when we do to carry it as a regular grocery staple.
One of the best flavored water products I've ever tasted.  Very grapefruity, not overly sweetened and not bitter in the least.  A great beverage alternative.

I was recently given the opportunity to try Izze Sparkling Grapefruit Juice, and I am very glad I did!  With none of the added sugars contained in similar products, Izze relies on its own taste to draw the consumer in, and the addition of the sparkling water enhances the flavor rather nicely.  If you are a consumer who enjoys all natural flavor with a little pizzazz to it, then Izze is definitely the product for you!
Wonderful product. The grapefruit flavor is very refreshing; great on a hot day. Not overly carbonated either, and the serving size is just right!

I quit drinking sodas years ago, given that they're basically filled with heaps of sugar and empty calories.  And -- let's be honest -- drinking Izze's or even pure fruit juice isn't exactly great for you:  it's sugar and some vitamins / nutrients but without the fiber and such.So with the up-front admission that Izze's is hardly health food, let me express why I think this is still a worthwhile treat to have around the house:- Not as sweet as pure fruit juice, and that IMHO is a good thing.- Fewer calories and far less junk than sodas.- Will satisfy a soda craving even, I think, in the most soda'est of junkies.- Perfect balance of sweet vs. tart.- Just the right amount of carbonation.- And (kiddies, shield your eyes) it's tasty when mixed with alcohol (say, rum or vodka :-).

I really enjoy the Izze Sparkling Grapefruit Juice. What's really nice about the 8.4 oz size is that its not so overwhelmingly big. I mean, very few people want to chug down a gallon of Grapefruit juice, but this small size is perfect. And its easy to throw one in your gym bag, grab one on the way out the door, or just reach in and grab a quick drink.The juice itself is refreshing and clean, giving you a good dose of vitamins and all that good stuff. The taste is exceptionally good.I also used this to make a smoothie and it provided a good juice base.

I have given up regular soda almost all together for a few years. I just don't think that it's worth all the calories and sugar to drink an 8OZ soda with quarter of which being pure corn syrup. The IZZE beverage, however, is a welcoming sea change in the carbonated beverages market. It has pure fruit juice, with no extra sugar added, and fortified with vitamins your body needs anyway. Each can has around 90 calories, which is easily manageable with most diet plans. Taste wise, IZZE also met all my expectations: delicious, refreshing, with no strange flavors and aftertastes. Recommended.

column9: Not bad -- not bad at all
column10: The only Izze drink I've had the chance to try is the "sparkling grapefruit," and I have to say that - while I'm not much of a grapefruit fan - this stuff is pretty dark drinkable.  It has a slightly punchy aftertaste, but I'm guessing that's pretty much a universal grapefruit thing.  Each Izze can holds only 8.4 fluid ounces, which sounds a mite puny for those of us used to chugging down several 20 oz bottles of Dr. Pepper and Sun Drop a day, but it's actually a pretty good size.  This isn't the kind of drink I could pour down my throat in large quantities, not without getting sick of it pretty fast, anyway.  I can only take so much fruity goodness a day.While this is a "naturally flavored juice beverage" fortified with vitamins, containing no caffeine and very low sodium, don't expect a can a day to take care of your suggested daily intake of vitamins or anything else - all you're looking at is 10% of your daily recommended amount of Vitamin C, Vitamin B6, and Niacin.  Along with that, you're ingesting 20 grams of sugar (albeit not refined sugar) per can, and the whole concoction weighs in at 90 calories.If you have to deal with acid reflux, you might be reluctant to try this drink.  Acidic fruit can be quite unkind to those of us with this condition, as can the bubbly goodness of carbonated water (or, if you want to be all fancy-schmancy about it, "sparkling water").  All I can tell you is that I haven't had any problems - but I've never had more than one of these Izze drinks in a single day and I do take medicine daily to combat my own acid reflux.  If heartburn pays you a visit more than once a week and you aren't fighting back with Prilosec or some similar medication, I suspect that you and Izze may not get along too well together.Finally, I would be remiss if I didn't mention the cost of these things.  Even if you think the ancient gods' ambrosia couldn't hold a candle to Izze, you have to consider the fact that these things cost the better part of a buck apiece - and remember, we're only talking about 8.4 fluid ounces per can.  That's a might steep where I come from.  If at all possible, I would recommend you try one of these drinks out for yourself before ordering two dozen of them.

column9: great as far as juice beverages go...
column10: I will be honest - not a huge fan of sparkling juice beverages. However I was surprised by how refreshing this drink was. I would bet that if it were made out of a sweeter fruit, it would be impossible but grapefruit Izze is lovely. It was basically like drinking a grapefruit fresh from the fridge in the morning. It is fortified with a bit of niacin, B1 and B6. No sugar added. 90 cals in a can. Doesn't hold the spark over a pretty short period of time. Overall, I would buy it again, as it's not as high in calories as juice itself, and is definitely more healthy than many other choices in carbonated sodas.

All natural and delicious, what more could you ask for?  Well, a little more per serving might be nice.  I can easily go through 2-3 cans of this healthy nectar in one go.  Perhaps if the portion size were slightly larger I would be less tempted to crack open another can.That niggle aside though, I really love this stuff.It is refreshing and tart and not too sweet.  No high-fructose corn syrup here.You get a does of vitamins (B, C & Niacin) as well, show me a regular soda that has that!My family and co-workers tried it and really like Izze as well.It is a great size to pop in a bag to bring with you.The scent is almost like aromatherapy.The manufacturer is a small company I can get behind.At the end of the day, for ultimate healthiness, you are probably better off eating some real fruit and drinking water.  But if you have a soda craving, this will get you over the hump.  I can't wait to try the other flavors as well!

Now this is good!  How often do you come across a beverage that really seems different from all the rest?  IZZE Sparkling Juice meets that criteria for me, an all-natural blend of pure fruit juice and sparkling water.  Did I say natural?  There is none of the added caffeine, fructose and artificial ingredients that you'll find in cola-this or dew-that. Using only the fruit juice only for sweetening, it won't leave your taste buds feeling syrupy or hungry for another sugar fix.  That all conspires a little with the calories, since it packs 90 of them into a little 8.4 oz can.My favorite is the Sparkling Grapefruit.  It's light and I love the flavor of grapefruit anyway.As I mentioned, the size of the can is small, which makes it great for taking it on the go.  And while I haven't tried it as a mixture with vodka, I somehow think that just might make a most refreshing imbibe while sitting out on the deck enjoying a warm summer's evening.

column9: Great grapefruit taste that is not too sweet.
column10: I really enjoyed the grapefruit flavored IZZE.  At first it was a little strong, but the flavor efinitely grew on me.  I am not one who likes grapefruit, but I normally enjoy grapefruit flavored sodas like Squirt.  Unlike Squirt, IZZE tastes like real grapefruit juice, just carbonated.  It is not overly sweet and is quite refreshing.  It reminds me of the sports drink "Super Socco" from the mid-80's.I would definitely endorse this flavor for anyone who enjoys a tart drink.

column9: Just another form of liquid sugar, but I like controlled portion size...
column10: Izze's grapefruit flavored sparkling juice is, for all practical purposes, just another formulation of liquid sugar, albeit from grape, pear, and other fruits.  Nutritionally, it really is no different from any other sugar-based drink, whether orange juice or sugar soda.  What makes it acceptable is both its taste (more below) and its controlled portion size (8.4-ounces).  That 8.4 ounces is a far cry from the normal 12, the increasingly common 20, and those other large portions that "fool" the consumer with the nutritional note that there are "only" 110 calories per serving but there are 2.5 or more portions!I conducted a taste test of this grapefruit flavored Izze with two teenagers, two registered nurses, one registered dietitian, and two adult athletes.  They all were impressed with the flavor, and thought the "gentle" carbonation added to the enjoyment.  One teen mentioned that the smaller size encouraged sipping rather than chugging.  It is much better cold than at room temperature.The aluminum container is recyclable (encouraged).  I've seen this particular brand and size sold at cafes for about a buck fifty a can.Enjoyable!  I hope this comes out in a calorie-free version as well.

I ordered the grapefruit flavor expecting something akin to Fresca and was pleasantly surprised by the actual grapefruit flavor. While not as harsh as grapefruit juice there is the unmistakable fruit flavor with an added sparkle of carbonation.I find the flavor refreshing and a perfect touch for a hot day. I have also found that it makes for an excellent sparkling Greyhound if you add a little vodka.P-)

column9: The Grapefruit Flavor is Light and Fruity
column10: The grapefruit flavor is a huge hit at my house.  Everyone loves the taste -- not too sweet, not too bitter, and very grapefruity despite the dominance of other juice concentrates in the ingredient list.  My only real quibble with it is that the cans are too tall to fit in the soft drink can tray in my refrigerator, the kind that many new refrigerators have hanging from one of the shelves as a convenient space-saving measure.  These cans are made more for stacking flat on shelves, not for rolling out of soft-drink trays.  Oh yeah -- and then there are the 20 grams of sugar per serving, but it still beats sugary soft drinks sweetened with high-fructose corn syrup by a mile and tastes a heck of a lot better.

I've had other sparkling grapefruit-flavored drinks that I thought tasted artificial or too sweet -- by comparison, Izze is far and away the best I've tasted. It's a fruit juice blend, from concentrate, so it's not substitute for real, freshly squeezed juice -- but it's certainly a wise alternative to sodas. I've held the line at four stars because I prefer glass to aluminum when it comes to beverage packaging.

I am not a huge grapefruit van and was concerned this would be too bitter for my taste.  I was very pleasantly surprised and find the flavor delightful.  The primary ingredients are grape and apple.  The beverage is light, very refreshing and excellent even when not ice cold.  I would certainly look for this in stores.  Enjoy!!

It has a nice taste: I've always liked Squirt as a kid.The idea that it has vitamins as well is nice.One can leaves me with a full feeling.I tried my first one while it was still warmafter it arrived and it tasted good that way too.I've tried mixing it with orange juice and that gives a refreshing drink as well.I think it might make a good mixer with vodka.It is a good drink for a hot day

I loved this 8.4 fluid ounce- refreshening carbonated citrus drink ala grapefruit taste.90 caories with a spriteful taste that is perfect to go with lunches or road travel etc.It's 20 g's of natural sugarsThe sugars are natural,and what a good alternative drinkthe label is cute and tasteful and it's 70 percent fruit juice.I honestly love this beverage!!
We did a taste test at home and it was a hit. I really enjoyed it over ice - refreshing, healthy and great for the summer.

In a slim can, it's just enough for me before it loses its fizz (straight from the can), but then again my stomach has shrunk since college.It's actually a mixture of different juices, including grape, apple, grapefruit, lemon, and red radish juice. The taste is not too sweet, another plus for me, and lets me drink it without ice, unlike, say, Pepsi or Coke. Tast: airy, light, with a tart bite at the end of the swig. That it's uncaffeinated and has vitamins ... I don't know how healthy it is, but at least it sounds good, right?

It's like Fresca, only with calories and tinier bubbles. Actually Izze Sparkling Grapefruit it tastes better than Fresca, at least 90 calories better, and that's a fair trade in my book. Izze Sparkling Grapefruit (it's mostly not grapefruit, fourth among the five fruit juice concentrates in the list of ingredients, after white grape, apple and orange) has a friendly, refreshing taste. A great pick-me-up for the 1:00 office drone doldrums. I drank it straight from the slim, 5 1/4 inch tall can--like one of those tiny airline juice cans on steroids--so can't comment on it's hue. Label readers, you won't find any red dye number two here: Izze uses red radish juice (for color). I think I'll serve my next can of Izze Sparkling Grapefuit on the rocks--yes, there'll be another can--and maybe bam it up with a shot or two of Absolut.

Is this a soda or a sparkling juice?  Whatever it is it is delicious. Pours pink/red and fizzy. Aroma is of fresh citrus grapefruit. The flavor is crisp and clean and very much like grapefruit; sweet, tart, and tangy.  Product goes down smooth and with no lingering soda chemical aftertaste.  Very thirst quenching.This is a wonderfully tasting product. Very much tastes like fresh fruit because it is made with real fruit juice.  Definitely yummy!

column9: Sparkling ruby red grapefruit flavor in a smaller size can
column10: I have enjoyed Izze's sodas in bottles before and while its not quite as crisp as the glass bottled the 8 oz on the go can version is still super refreshing and flavorful.  The grapefuit flavor while prevelant isn't too sour or too sweet, the sparkling water element is truly fresh tasting and from a scan of the ingredients you can see you aren't downing a can of liquid toxins.  A terrific mixer for those who engage in the imbibing of spirits Izzes seems to go with every lunch food I have tried it with and is a terrific helper to throw in my sons lunch (he also loves it).  Good stuff for the citrus soda lover or the just plain thirsty.

column9: Metal Taste From Cans! Manufactured by PEPSI
column10: This was a split in the family - my husband and son did not notice a metal taste - but my daughter and I could taste it overwhelmingly! I drink Poland Spring Seltzer lemon flavor etc... from cans so that isn't the issue.  I've had this same soda in bottles and love the taste - especially the grapefruit!  This has much less sugar than regular soda and is organic.  But, did you know it is made by PEPSI??  I didn't until I wrote to the company online to tell them about the metal taste and received an email back from PEPSI. It is a tad deceiving for the IZZE company to claim to be its own entity when it is owned and operated by PEPSI.  Maybe it is like many of these organic companies who were bought out by the big giants - unable to make it on their own...But, the metal taste was so bad we were unable to drink ANY of them!

Izzie Fortified Graprefuit Juice is a refreshing, fruity delight. I truly enjoyed the nutrition of the real juice component and the sparkling water addition. I especially enjoyed it chilled from the refrigerator, however, I poured it into a cup, placing it into the freezer and it made for a nice, frozen treat, that adults and children could adult. Izze Sparkling Grapefruit would also be a nice addition to summer, adult beverages.I highly recommend this product to juice and sparkling water lovers.Angelia Menchan

column9: The next best thing to homemade.
column10: When I'm at home and properly prepared, I mix organic juice concentrates with Gerholsteiner naturally carbonated mineral water. The next best choice is  Izze, (not just this flavor, they're all excellent). While they sometimes use 'filler' juice like grape, Izze also comes up with mixes that enhance the primary flavor.

The product itself has been reviewed sufficiently already - it's tasty enough and a bit healthier than soda. It also lacks those nasty preservatives.The problem with buying this product from Amazon is the way Amazon delivers it. My 24 pack was delivered in a regular cardboard box. The Izze packaging is just a flimsy cardboard tray with plastic wrap covering the cans. The wrap doesn't cover the cans very well and isn't particularly snug. Since Amazon does pack this into a regular cardboard box for you, you won't need to worry about losing any of the cans in transit - but they will be clanking around in the box when it arrives on your doorstep. Open them slowly. If the Amazon box was smaller, this wouldn't happen.

The side of the can sums up: "Izze fortified is naturally sweet with no refined sugars, no caffeine, no preservatives..."Nice light refreshing taste.  While great all by itself, it also makes a nice mixer (Mixed it with Mango flavored vodka and a squeeze of lime)

column9: Better Than Soda Pop, Not as Great as Water
column10: These little cans of Izze sparkling grapefruit juices went into a big ice chest for a recent party, and I was stunned to see how popular they were among the tween-aged kids. Parents had no objections to the caffeine- and processed-sugar-free drinks, and they taste refreshing and crisp.That said, nothing beats water if you really want to have the perfect health drink. And I was frustrated to have chosen grapefruit flavor, which I had forgotten was off-limits to a family member because of medication restrictions. For those who want soda or energy drink, this won't be a replacement, in spite of those who would call it a healthy soda.Overall, however, these sparkling juices are a great summer choice. Refreshing, relatively healthy and super popular from kids to adults -- we'll be adding them to our future shopping lists for sure.

The Izze Sparkling Grapefruit is a refreshing, albeit sugar-loaded, soft drink that comes in a slender 8.4 ounce can.  Made with 70 percent fruit juice, no refined sugar, no caffeine, and no preservatives, this drink has a wonderfully tangy grapefruit scent and taste, although don't be fooled:  the juices (from concentrate) listed are, in order, white grape, apple, orange, and, finally, grapefruit.  The taste is more Orangina Sparkling Citrus Beverage with Pulp - 4 Glass Bottles than Orange Crush -- in grapefruit form.  The carbonation is light, as is the flavor.  For those who want more nutrition than is usually found in soft drinks, the Izze fortifies its drink with Niacin, B6, and vitamin C, providing 10 percent RDA of each.The sugar content is only slightly lower than Coke , although the smaller size limits your intake, unless you're so thirsty that you need to drink two cans.  Oddly, though, it doesn't taste that sweet, perhaps because it is naturally sweet.  Each 8.4 ounce serving has 20 grams of sugar.This drink can be easily mimicked by adding seltzer water to grapefruit juice.  You'll get more vitamin C that way, although the convenience of chilled can with a pre-measured portion will appeal to many.

We've walked by the bottled Izze products in our grocery store every week. They look good, but they were a little more expensive than a jug of 100% juice and some fizzy water (our soda alternative). Here comes Izze with 8.4 ounce cans and they package 24 for less than $22. So that's, what? Ninety cents a pop? (he he). We gave the grapefruit a try...WOW! It's like Squirt (my favorite soda before we foreswore the fizzy stuff to avoid high fructose corn syrup and artificial sweeteners--one gives ya liver cancer + makes you fat & the other gives you brain cancer + keeps you thin, you choose!) Yes, like Squirt only all natural. AND it's got Vitamin C, B6 & Niacin...all for only 90 calories.It IS only 8.4 ounces and there's more apple juice in it than grapefruit juice...thus the four stars...but we do really like this product and this price. A good treat that's pretty good for you! (Strange fact, right now their website lists the ingredients including carrot juice, but on the back of my can it says radish juice--I never thought I like something with a radish in it!)We also tried the Green Apple variety. More grape than apple juice, but it tastes like those apple twist "malt beverages." The apple kind of wore out it's welcome more quickly than the grapefruit...but we are definitley looking forward to trying the other flavours!
I used to mix seltzer and grapefruit juice after snapple discontinued their original (excelllent) clear citrus sodas in the 1980s.

This soup is amazing!! So good we used it, along with the French Market 18 Bean Soup by Purely American, at our wedding! We had a soup and sandwich lunch, everyone loved it!Purely American French Market 18 Bean Soup Mix, 15-Ounces Packages (Pack of 6)
I take a few of these with me whenever traveling.  They are very tasty and filling.  Great for a small breakfast or snack when there are no gluten free options available.

The main virtue these bars have is that they are useful snacks that don't tempt me to eat them up when I don't need them.  Bites with dried cranberries (maybe 3 to a bar) in them taste good enough - otherwise they taste like puffed rice drowned in syrup, which is pretty much what they are.  I prefer almost any of the other gluten-free bars I've tried - Gluten-Free Cafe lemon sesame bars, Larabars (all of them - especially apple pie), Kind fruit and nut bars, etc.  But these aren't terrible - and unlike the other bars named, they don't tempt me to snack on them when I'm at home and other food is available, which means I have them available for road trips when I need them.

We love Bakery on Main gluten free products. Can't wait to try more of there products. I do wish it was sold in most stores though. I have to drive a good distance to get it, but it is worth the drive.
For somebody that struggles because of diet restrictions, these bars are wonderful! Easy to take where ever I go, and the texture doesn't taste like it's "GF" at all!

I love taking these when we go hiking. They provide a great pick me up and I don't have to worry about my kids being drained by eating a crappy snack. We all love these ones but I tend to sneak one as a late night snack as well. By far the best in my opinion.
I love these! I keep them in my desk at work so I can have a quick snack when I need it. Sometimes they work for breakfast too when I'm in a hurry in the morning. Great product!!!
Thanks Bakery on Main for making Gluten Free snacks! This is a tasty one!  I usually snack on one around 3pm.  Perfect!  Wish it didn't have soy though.

When I first tried these, I could not stop eating them! I had to get more, they were so good!! I never knew GF or granola could taste so amazing! You will not regret ordering these delicious bars! So much flavour and just the right amount of sweet!
These are a great snack and the whole family loves them. I keep some in my purse for the kids when they get hungry and they are make for a healthy yummy treat!!

column9: Better than the peanut butter chocolate chip bars
column10: I liked the trail mix bar better than the PB chocolate chip bars that Bakery on Main makes but they still have the problem of being too sweet.  Is it possible to make a bar that doesn't cause your blood sugar to sky rocket (and crash)?  All of this being said, I still enjoyed my bars.
Everything Bakery on Main makes is delicious and this in no exception! Tastes healthy and delicious! Just the right amount of nuts, dried fruit, and seeds!
I love these bars because they are nice and crunchy.  I have had other brands that are made with mostly dates and they just do not have that crunch that I like when eating granola bars.
This is the perfect snack when driving.  It really helps you keep cool in heavey traffic.  I like the fact it is healthy and tasty ready to enjoy.
These bars hold together better and are loaded with healthy ingredients,very filling.  They are a better texture than some of the other granola bar flavors, but I could do without the "syrupy" taste.

The Bakery On Main Extreme Trail Mix Gluten Free Granola Bar is made with certified gluten free oats, amaranth & quinoa. They are full of fruit & seeds, and nuts. They are a little sticky and sweeter than I might really enjoy, but they are filling and great for on the go. (Also, usually the really natural bars (especially ones with nuts) cause break-outs on my face. I was just waiting for it to happen- and it DIDN'T.)
these little bars are packed with lots of nuts! my main criticism is that more of them should come in one box!
This is my fav granola bar produced by bakery on main. It's even better than it's granola couterpart (and I think that's awesome too).  Love it!

I agree with the other poster who said they're syrupy, but filling. I thought these bars were a bit too sweet and sticky for the flavor they were going for, but they're still very good. Maybe instead of so much sugar they could add more fruit pieces or something that would balance the sweetness out. They are still a great on the go or after the gym snack.

column9: Great for quick, on the go breakfast
column10: My 8 1/2 and 13 1/2 year old children don't often get gluten free pancakes nor gluten free cereal when we are on the road, vacationing, and the Extreme Trail Mix is a great quick, filling, on the go breakfast!  It is a little sweet, but tasty, and they love the flavor!  I love the great, healthy ingredients -- sunflower seds, flax seeds, sesame seeds, coconut, raisins, cranberries almonds, and other nuts.  It fills them up and keeps them going until the next meal!

OK...are you really serious gitalongs? 7 bucks for 1 box? Even if they are theatre size as your ad states you have to be out of your minds to list them for 7 bucks.....guess what, they are at the dollar store in ther exact same size for, yep, a buck.

It is so easy to bake and delicious. I baked 2 loaves on Friday and it was gone by Sunday. I added 1 cup of golden raisins in addition to nuts. But it is overpriced here because I bought the 2-loaf kit for only $5 at Walmart.

Great! I made the crumble topping suggegested. I had used my own recipe for pumpkin bread for years. This is easier and just as good. You will also save money than buying all the ingreadients, unless you have them all on hand. Love this product.

I usually buy this at my membership warehouse during the holiday season.  It comes as a box that makes 4 loafs which is the same box pictured in the photo shown here on amazon.  This leads you to believe that that you get 2 packs of 4 loaf each kits for a total of 8 loafs.  That is not what you get.  They send you two 2 loaf packs for a total of 4 loafs.  You get 8 loafs for the same price by purchasing it at costco or sams club when the holidays are here.  I will definitly stock up next year.  But if you love it (it is awesome) and run out, guess you gotta pay.

This pumpkin bread mix is very easy to use.  Simple directions and ingredients to be added.  I baked mine in a bundt pan, but they list plenty of options to suit anyone.  Various size muffin pans and bread loaf pans can be accommodated.  The taste of this pumpkin bread is wonderful.  It is moist and flavorful.  The pumpkin aroma while baking is sublime and the taste afterward is mild but distinctly pumpkin.  I almost never bake with a mix, this is one excellent exception.
The package came in a timely manner. This is great pumkin bread. The only problem is it makes a lot. I made 7 mini loaves with nuts and raisins, I still had too much for the loaf pans. A fine product

column9: This is fantastic! I'm eating it right now!
column10: This is the best thing I've bumped into in a long time.  We've been making pumpkin bread apart of our Thanksgiving - New Years celebrations for the past 4 years.  It is the best! Makes you feel like a real baker! lol.  But do NOT buy this from Amazon! I get the box for $5.  They are charging you $20 extra for only 1 extra serving.  Do NOT buy this here.  Take a trip to Walmart and get 2!
I OREDERED ONE PKG WHICH COST 10.00 AND YOU OFFER ANOTHER PKG FOR 20.00 THINKING IT WILL BE DOUBLE AND RECIEVED TODAY AND BOTH ARE THE SAME SIZE .  DON'T OREDER THE ONE THAT SAYS GIFT PACK.

I've made cupcakes and a 9 x 13 cake from this mix and received rave reveiws from those who sampled them. The amount and type of spices in the mix couldn't be better. Plus, the mix is all natural and is such a time saver.  Truthfully, I was surprised as to how good this product tasted. These kits can be purchased in various places.

This pumpkin bread was the most favorite of all the tasty treats sent to my son during his time in a military academy.  All his friends would line up to get in his room on the weeks this bread was sent.  Easy to make and traveled well.

column9: I hate to admit it, but this is better than my homemade recipe.
column10: I am well known in my family for my home made breads and baked goods (sorry I had to toot my own horn there). I used to think from-scratch was ALWAYS best. But even I can't top how delicious the pumpkin bread comes out when made with this kit. I took the sliced loaves of pumpkin bread to a school picnic and people were going back for seconds and thirds.Your kit basically has the can of pumpkin, the dry mix and the icing packet. Add your own (4)eggs, oil and water to the pumpkin, blend, then add in the dry mix and stir just until moistened. Pour in tins and bake. Easier and faster than measuring the dry mix ingredients out one by one in a scratch recipe.Hint1: use olive oil. It mades for a moist and dense bread and definitely smells better than anything made with corn oil.Hint2: butter the loaf tins generously. I think butter does the job better than nonstick spray...just a personal preference.Hint3: stir in the dry mix JUST until moistened. Overstirring toughens anything made with wheat flour. Do not try to "work the lumps out". They work out on their own in the baking process.This recipe made one 8X4 loaf plus three "mini" 5X3 loaves. You can get a bundt cake out of this or make other sized loaf combinations if you like. Probably even makes great muffins ( I don't have the back of the box to check on this right now).
Love anything with pumpkin in it.  Very easy preparation.  Very moist.  Absolutely the best pumpkin breat rescipe I have ever tasted.

OMG !!!!!!!! Last year I purchase 36 boxes of this mix. Think I'm nuts ?  This has got to be the worlds greatest. I make them for church, gifts and of course for me. My 3 year old great grandson is crazy about his pumpkin bread, & I don't blame him. My secret is that I use Mayonaise instead of oil and they come out so moist and YUMMY. Unfortunately this year they are hard to obtain as there was a flood in last years pumpkin fields. So now I will need to be using my scratch recipe for all my pumpkin baking as I could only obtain 2 boxes. Enjoy what you can get.

I just found this kit at my local grocery store yesterday and being the pumpkin lover that I am I snatched one up. It was delicious! I tastes just like pumpkin pie but it's bread of course. You must try it! Even my picky husband and toddler loved it which says a lot for our family.I made sure to grease the pans well so I did not have any issues getting them out. I used half a batch to make muffins and the other half for a loaf. I cooked them separately because of the cook time and they both can out perfect. I will definitely be purchasing these again.

I actually get six full size loaves out of this box and they slide nicely into a cellophane bag as a gift. I tried to go online and find the Libby's Pumpkin Bread recipe so I could stop buying the kit but could not find one. I know it exists. It's in a box in my garage somewhere! Until then, I have to go with the kit because while they were out of stock I tried a few other brands and recipes and none compared to the flavor of this recipe. Good stuff!

I tried this over the holidays, and was so surprised that I keep buying it for everyday.  Each package makes 2 loaves of great bread.  My whole family likes it.  I love the frosting that comes with it, it adds just the right touch.  If they ever get more in, I will definitely buy it over & over again.  It also keeps well, and you can use it all week.

column9: super moist so yummy & easy to make
column10: We chose not to use the iceing. It was great. One word of warning do not skimp on the nonstick spray
It's easy enough for a child to learn to bake, tastes great and makes a healthy breakfast, snack or dessert.  Freezes well. Can be made as a bread or muffins.

The Libby Pumpkin Bread Kits are only available in stores during the Thanksgiving and Xmas season, which is really too bad! It is by far the most delicious recipe I have ever made, so moist and simply just good.  At Xmas time, I gave some loaves away, took some as hostess gifts and served some for our house guests and received so many compliments, everyone just loved it!  I was completely out of kits, tried to find more in the stores (all gone), but I was thrilled to find the kits on Amazon, so I ordered enough to get by until they are available in the stores next holiday season!  Love it!!
I used a lot of this mix adding all sorts of things and made in 6 small cakes for each batch.  It made wonderful gifts.  I had bought it locally and so pleased to find it on Amazon.

column9: Nothing special.  In between great and awful.
column10: Mmmm, it's the time of year when I remember how yummy pumpkin tastes.  So when I saw this Pumpkin Bread kit on sale I decided to give it a shot.  The recipe was super easy.  Add a few eggs, oil, and water to the canned pumpkin and then add their prepackaged dry ingredients.  I baked mine in a bundt pan (baking directions are on the package.)  The mixture provided too much batter for the bundt pan.  And even taking some out made for an overflowed baked product.  The final product tasted fine.  The texture was a bit chewier than expected.  And the spice level was a little muted.  I'm sure you could do better if you made it from scratch.  But do you really want to do that?The box shows you can also make muffins, so I'll try that next time.  I bet you can spruce these up with a little spice, and maybe jazz up the icing with some cream cheese.

My daughter had to quit smoking cold turkey and we realized that something had to take the place of a cigarette for her to hold and put in her mouth.
