Although it does not cause the gas "problem" with excess consumption, I will stay with the Honey Tree. Note: I have used Honey Tree instead of Karo syrup to make almond-crusted pecan pies. It produces a pronounced gas effect, as I always eat large slices of pecan pie. I intend to make a pecan pie with this product and if I believe it is better than the Honey Tree pies, I will report back.
Was very surprized with this product.  Blends well, used in tea, baking and on toast.  Just like honey.  Consistency just a titch gelatin-like but overall excellent product.

First, the transaction and deliver went very smoothly and the package was well-packed.  I just tasted it and it tastes delicious.  I will not hesitate to do do business with this Company and product in the future.

I didn't think this resembled honey in any way shape or form. Its more like thin, runny corn syrup. BUT, its not horrible and I think it will work out perfect for certain recipes. I'm going to use mine to make some sugar free / low carb BBQ sauce.

This product is sugar free and really tastes like honey, I cannot tell the difference.  Who needs the calories and insulin spike of real honey when you can use this product.  I even make a honey dijon dressing with it!
Thought this might be worth a try to replace honey because of diabetes.  It would do in a pinch, pretty thin and watery.  Just didn't do anything for taste.
Received in a timely manner. Great sugar free, honey product. Pleased to have purchased this product.
I enjoy honey on Greek yogurt but since being diagnosed with diabetes I thought that was over.  Now I can enjoy it again and it tastes the same.

Finding good and hot Cayenne has been challenging for me - until now.I've bought Cayenne pepper at grocery stores, specialty stores, mail order, and at fairs.Sometimes they've been OK, sometimes pretty bad.  This Cayenne pepper is Outstanding!Be aware, this is not the wimpy Cayenne you would buy at the grocery store.  This stuff is really hot - and that is exactly what I have been looking for.  I have a very high tolerance for heat.  I literally use Tabasco sauce for salad dressing.  I cannot taste any heat with typical crushed red pepper or store bought Cayenne.  But I get a good kick from this stuff!

I've recently gone on a health kick.  One of my new regimens is taking cayenne pepper on a daily basis.  I knew the small grocery store containers wouldn't be very economical for my purpose and had also read that the hotter the pepper the better so I went straight to Amazon.  Of all of the different offerings I found, this one seemed to be the best deal.  I wasn't sure what to expect when I ordered it but was pleasantly surprised when it arrived.  It came in two separate mylar bags of 1lb. each.  The bags aren't resealable so I had to put it into another container. I found that one bag fits perfectly into a 1 quart Mason jar.  I will say that taking cayenne pepper all by itself is not an easy thing to do, but I'm getting used to it.  It helps that this pepper has an excellent flavor.  It's not all heat.  So, whether you are using it in a recipe, making your own hot sauce or taking it as a daily supplement, I think you will be satisfied with the flavor and heat of Frontier's ground chili peppers.  And the price is hard to beat.For those of you who are new to taking cayenne pepper as a daily supplement or are considering it, here's my experience:  The first time I tried it I used 1tsp. in 8oz. of warm water as a sort of tea as I had read on several different natural health forums.  I found that it was way too hot for me and 8oz. of it was a lot more than I could make myself drink.  My next attempt was 1tsp. dumped on the back of my tongue and washed down with plenty of cold water.. around 16oz.  I found that this was bearable, but that a full teaspoon was a lot to swallow. Much of it fell to the side between my cheek and gums... not pleasant.  I have since reduced the amount to 1/2tsp and found this to be optimum for me.  Surprisingly, there were no ill affects such as heartburn or reflux for me and have read that it will cure stomach ulcers.  My only warning is not to take it on an empty stomach.  My wife did that the first time she tried it and I'm not sure if I'll ever get her to try it again.

If you are looking for cayenne pepper that really packs a punch, this is it.  I have been taking cayenne to try and improve blood circulation to my hands and feet.  I have Type 1 diabetes and am concerned about the long term effects of this disease.  Honestly I hate taking this stuff, but I definitely feel the benefits I am looking for, not sure if it is improved blood circulation or the anti-inflammatory properties of cayenne....or if these 2 properties go hand in hand, but my hands, feet and overall body condition feels consistently better (except for the discomfort of the first 20 minutes) when I take my daily morning dose.Here is what I do.  I put about an inch of warm water in a glass, add about a teaspoon of honey, then I add about 1 teaspoon of lemon juice, then add about 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne (90K SHU), stir and....gulp!I only use a little bit of water so that I can gulp it down.  The honey and the lemon juice mask some of the power of the pepper.  I have heard that you build up a tolerance to this stuff...I have been taking this for about a month now, daily, and I have not been able to move beyond a 1/4 teaspoon without painful consequences.Good luck in your pursuit of health!

I'm pretty new to taking Cayenne Pepper on a daily basis. I just graduated from the McCormick grocery store Cayenne Pepper. Although this pepper is not nearly as hot as I expected it to be, it definitely has a lot of kick and a great taste. Also, the shipment arrived much earlier than expected.

I haven't ordered this 16 ounce bag, so can't vouch for that, but will say I think one should be careful when opening it, because this pepper is HOT! Try not to breathe... I've had a jar that I just finished of this pepper, and had it for 10 years and it was HOT HOT HOT until the very end. I can't even believe I had it that long, but you only need a little bit, and I have a high tolerance for spicy hot foods. Seriously, why bother with any other brand. Desperate for more cayenne, I recently purchased the only brand they had at a near by supermarket, and need to return it. It's not hot at all. Frontier is awesomely great!!!

I'm probably one of those weirdos who can tolerate a LOT of heat, so, this review is coming from someone who loves her hot stuff.Anyhoo, this is definitely HOT but not anything near scorching hot where you can't appreciate the flavor of the pepper itself. This cayenne has a nice sweet fruitiness coupled with the heat which I really dig.For those of you who are not used to a lot of heat, go easy on yourself at first and gradually work up to more or you might be visiting the toilet in a tumultuous rush.My only disappointment is that this is not organic. Why is it that all of the super hot cayenne is non-organic? Is it because the peppers are so hot that they repel bugs naturally and are already 'organic' by proxy of their natural repellent factor? LOL

column9: Extremely Hot Stuff; a little to Spicy for me.
column10: Extremely Hot Stuff; a little to Spicy for me. If you like burning hot then this is for you. :)Good product!

This cayenne pepper is GREAT!  This has real spice to it.  All the other cayenne peppers I've used have had sort of a dirty flavor with not much heat, but this one is clean and HOT.  You only have to use a little bit to get that kick in your food.  Which makes it great for seasoning and very economical.  I recommend this to anyone.

This "level" of Cayenne gives a big punch to my food. Whether I sprinkle it on certain foods or when I use it as an ingredient in cooking, it does the job. For the amount and price, you ger your monies worth.I just love this stuff !
I bought this to discourage wildlife from munching on my garden. It's REALLY potent. I've never seen so much cayenne pepper in one place before. Great price compared to the supermarket.
I sprinkle cayenne on my oatmeal every morning for breakfast,it seems to purify my body and gives me the kick to get started.PS. use some raisins to complement the heat.

I put Cayenne pepper on bird seed to keep squirrels away from the feeders.  (Use a mask and gloves to sprinkle the Cayenne over the seeds and mix well; add to feeder.)  The birds have different  glands than  mammals (squirrels are mammals!).  The birds are NOT affected by the hot at all; they don't taste it.  Main problem is that when it rains some of the cayenne is washed off and then you'll see a squirrel occasionally until you refill the feeder .... but this has sure saved on my sunflower seed expenditures!!  I only use about a tablespoon or so to a feeder-full of seed.
Ground Cayenne Pepper 90,000 heat units, is a lot more powerful than the one you buy at the super market. I'm very please.

After reading about the benefits of chili peppers I decided to give it a try. So, I did what most people do, I did a search and I came across this company and this product. I couldn't pass up the price, It comes in 2 big bags, but even more impressive than the price was the delivery. I got home a few days after my order and to my surprise I had received my package. It was extremely fast delivery - that is always a plus.The pepper itself, I never leave reviews, but I couldn't pass up the opportunity, this stuff is HOT, I have had other chili pepper, but this stuff packs a serious punch. If you are looking for a little zest and looking to add this to your diet, meals, or life, don't pass this up because I love hot stuff and even this is passing up my expectations.In fact, I just had some veggies with this on it. The other night I was eating and put a good amount on my soup. I started to sweat. So, I have to say if you are going back and forth on this, you should go ahead and order, you won't be disappointed, I know I'm not.Hope this helps.

column9: Exactly what I wanted, you wont find this at your local mart
column10: First off I thought I ordered 2 bags that equaled out to 1lb but was pleasantly surprised that it was actually 2 1LB bags for a total of 2LBs of surprisingly hot and flavorful cayenne. The stuff in the grocery store is reportedly 30,000 SKU or less and this powder knocks what I have bought in the past, out of the park.I bought this mainly for cayenne's rich health benefits and am making a tincture with it as well as eating 3tsps a day. Cayenne pepper especially at 90,000 SKU can really help lower your blood pressure, improve circulation, stop profuse bleeding, gives energy, increases metabolism, can stop a heart attack in its tracks, and many other benefits. Google it if you don't believe it, some see it as one of the most beneficial foods to cook with and have in your house. Anyways enough homeopathic babble.....Bottom line is this stuff has GREAT flavor much better than other store bought kinds I have purchased and really packs the heat! I put half a table spoon in my chicken noodle soup as I have done in the past with store bought brands and boy did I regret it haha if you don't have a heat tolerance and are taking this as a daily supplement I would suggest starting with 1/8 of a tea spoon in 8ozs of warm water and working your way up to 1 tsp 3 times daily for max effects. In comparison to fresh pepper heat I would rather nibble down a habanero or Thai dragon chili both ranking around 100,000 SKU than a table spoon of this stuff like I did in my soup, not to say its bad cayenne but just that a little powder goes a long ways and that's what makes this such a GREAT deal!If you are looking to spice up dishes, watch out for your health, or use it for any number of other uses then this is the cayenne for you. This stuff is HOTTTT and you will not be disappointed or find a hotter cayenne pepper powder for this price on Amazon!

I added this strength to my bird feeeders & IT WORKS GREAT!!!!For years I fought the battle & used the "little packets" for bird feeders BUT saw this in a review for this item & what a savings I have now on bird seed!NO IT DOES NOT harm birds as they have no saliva glands~~aren't we lucky?NO you do not need on safflower feeder or thistle as squirrels do not like bitter taste.Look it up on Google & you will see where it is not harmful to them.If a squirrel gets on feeder give him 5 minutes & you will not see him on it again that day-amen.Well worth the price & add accordingly.Mix in well with a big tool/spoon & a plastic bag on arm & keep your face away from mixing...glasses on if any doubt.Wash hands well after...enjoy keeping your feeders squirrel free~~hooray...chipmunks too.Happy Feeding!

Hot.  Hothothot.  Lots of it, 2 bags full.  I'm using it sprinkled on the grass to deter dogs.  I'll also keep a bit back for the kitchen, but this stuff is HOT.  You'll love it.BTW - Packing was sturdy and delivery was VERY fast.

I thought I knew what heat was until I put a couple teaspoons of this into a can of beans. Wow. Respect. And after doing a little research on the benefits that cayenne pepper has on the body, I now use this product everyday in a tea or mix with water and drink it down(Fire water-lol). I give this product 5 stars for sure.
Good quality stuff...a little goes a long way!  Great deal too, this is enough cayenne to last me for years.

column9: Very good, fresh and hot pepper
column10: The Frontier Chili Peppers come well ground, in 2 tightly sealed 1 lb plastic bags. The pepper is very hot, and my only problem was obtaining a container to hold the pepper after opening the bag. We use it as part of our buffalo wing recipe, and this is by far the best pepper we've had for the task. This is very finely ground almost to the point of being a powder.
This cayenne has a nice taste and plenty of heat. I would have appreciated a resealable package, however.  This comes in a bag that needs to be cut open and is not resealable.

Sprinkle on potato plants where beetles are feasting and the feast is over.  The beetles scatter and nolonger find the plant quite so attractive.  It has also been effective against other bugs on other plants, but not useful where you intend to eat the leaves.

I bought this for the health benefits but it's hard to tell the benefits since I'm healthy anyway! The taste is great though. I can put about 3/4 tsp in my breakfast yogurt with 3/4 tsp cinnamon and some organic, non-alkali cocoa, stevia, and I've got most of my bases covered. The price is great too.

Great deal on this cayenne pepper. Way more powder than I expected. Very hot, and very fresh. I will buy more from this seller when I run out (which could be quite a while). I bring this to work to put on all my food, since it's supposed to be good for your heart. Great packaging and quick shipping.

column9: O M G this is HOTTTTTTT but I LOVE it!
column10: I use habanero pepper in a lot of my dishes but boyyy, this cayenne pepper is HOT! I am known for loving hot and spicy stuff! I used it for the first time last night and I think I underestimated the "90,000 HU." I poured in close to 1/4 of a cup (did not measure the amount) to what I was cooking and I can barely eat it without having to drink water and chew on crackers. It was as hot as "blazing" wings from Buffalo wild wings. And this might be TMI but whenever I ate this dish I cooked and I did a #1, I felt the tingling sensation as if the pepper in my mouth. So my conclusion is I think a little goes a long way.
This is good pepper, I'm taking it to increase my circulation, it is hot but tolerable, I will purchase again, oh, and it came super fast.

This frontier ground cayenne is not for the faint of heart. It is 90 000 heat units, where as most grocery store cayennes are somewhere in the 30 000 to 45 000 range. When you get past the heat, this cayenne has a wonderful rich peppery aroma, a vibrant red-orange color and a smooth underlying sweetness. It is an excellent quality cayenne.
It's on the hot side, but it still has good flavor. It came fresh, and when I opened the package and breathed it in I could get that wicked flavor. Respectable price and mass.
this is great pepper at the high end of the heat range. very hot but not harsh. mix with chipote and mayo for a great sauce.

I purchased this for two purposes.  First, to cook with....and a little goes a long way.  Secondly, to mix in with sunflower seed/bird feed to deter squirrels and chipmunks.  They stay away now, but it was funny watching them first discover the heat!  And no, we're not completely heartless....we have put out whole corn for those little bushy-tailed theives!

We are people who love very hot food and can tolerate hot peppers as fresh cayenne peppers easily. This is definitely hotter than normal cayenne peppers. We feel our mouths are burning in several seconds after eating dishes made with these powder.(I just add one tea spoon to one quart steamed vegetables and Seafood mixture.)

I use this ground pepper to make some real good spicey beef jerky.  I get a lot of request for a spicey smoke flavor and this what I use to please my customers.  At 90,000 Hu, I measure carefully and keep my hands away from my eyes after handling this stuff.  It comes in sealed bags and it really is fresh.  I bought four pounds, and in two weeks I will order four pounds again.  MK

This stuff is good. Forget the usual store-bought cayenne, this is in a league of its own.A clean taste, and a lot of heat. I eat a lot of very spicy foods, and I constantly have to remind myself when cooking with this cayenne that quantities I used to use would render the food I'm making inedible.

column9: This ground chili works fine in my garden
column10: I know this is people food and I'll use some in cooking but I bought this for repelling some insects in my organic garden.  Cayenne works fine for this and I've never seen it at a better price.  I've mixed it with diatomaceous earth and sprinkled it on the soil.  I've also made a pepper tea with a drop of dish soap to help it stick.  Cooled and strained I've used it as a spray.

column9: The Best Cayenne I have ever used!
column10: After thorough research, I decided to purchase this Cayenne and this is the best product I have ever used to aid in losing weight and slimming my tummy after birth. I have used it for about 8 months now and still have it in stock. I have recommended it to a number of friends who were wondering how I keep fit. I don't do extreme extreme workouts and don't like them and so Cayenne has really helped me along with  minimal home workouts.Okay this is my story. I had a baby a few years ago. My initial weight was 149 lbs and by the time I was going into the delivery room, I was 226 lbs. After a couple of weeks after having my son, I was stuck at 203lbs. I decided enough was enough and started digging. I used weight loss pills, etc but nothing really worked out. I came to Amazon and started doing my search, going through reviews and researching the internet about several products offered and finally came across this particular Cayenne and this is the best thing that ever happened to my weight loss journey.I started with a quarter of a teaspoon because it was just too hot and I am now using half in food. I use it on my lunch and dinner (I sprinkle a half teaspoon on every meal after cooking (in my plate after serving)).I also drink it twice a day in the morning and in the evening. I take a cup of cold water, squeeze half a lemon in it, then add a teaspoon of cayenne powder in it, stir it and quickly gulp it down.I also work out for about 30 minutes a day, 3 or 4 times a week doing cardio on my treadmill. I also try to eat healthy as much as I can. Eating foods with high fiber, fruits, vegetables, lean meat, etc.Long story short, I am now weighing 140lbs and have stuck to this routine. I would recommend it to anyone especially if you want to lose some pounds and don't like taking pills, or working out too much.

I purchased this item to use in my bird feeder, it works great and is very hot.  I put black oil sunflower seed in a small bag add Frontier Chili Pepper an a spray of Spam cooking oil and shake. Repels Squirrels will not hurt birds.
Yes, this is a lot of cayenne. I was surprised to see the amount when it came in. The quality is good and it is well packed.
its much hotter than typical cayenne pepper and the hotness lingers longer to....the price from amazon.com is great and shipping was fast as usual,these 2 bags will last me a while!

I eat cayenne with practically everything so I go through it pretty quickly.  The 2-pack deal is great... one for me and the other one for the squirrels.  Unfortunately, the squirrels are enjoying the spice as much as I am.  It has not deterred them one bit.  They are feasting on the peppered birdseeds and in my flower garden as I type.  I'll continue eating the cayenne, but will need to find something stronger for the unwanted furry visitors.

column9: Great Taste, but not crazy hot :(
column10: It's great quality pepper with a nice flavor. However, I didn't find it as hot as I would've liked it. Maybe a bad batch, but still worthy of 5 Stars in my opinion.

column9: What are your using this for?
column10: I'm using this to make a cayenne tincture to lower blood pressure and as a vasodilator. I'm using Everclear to extract the essential ingredients over a 30 day period then I dilute to 50%.  The effects are supposed to lower blood pressure (hypertension) due to vasicular dilation and increased blood flow.  I'm also taking lecithin (1 TBS/day) in combination as that provides the maximum effect.

column9: Best GF chocolate chip cookie you will find
column10: I've tried them all, believe me.  Most are just too gritty. But Kinnikinnick's GF Montana chocolate chip cookies taste good. They have that real brown sugar flavor.  Crisp but not gritty at all.  No weird aftertaste.  These are my #1 top choice to buy when I can find them. I am glad Amazon has decided to carry them.  Wild Oats GF mini-chocolate chip cookies are good too, but not AS good as these.
WOW!!  I had no idea that Gluten Free food could be THIS GOOD!!!  Our kids loved them so much they beg for more.  Great product.

column9: Just as good as Chips Ahoy!
column10: I've been eating gluten-free for nearly 3 years and have occasionally missed the little junk food splurge here and there. I saw these cookies on Amazon and decided that, since I've never been disappointed by anything Kinnikinnick put out, I would try them. They are just as wonderful as I hoped they would be. I keep mine in the freezer, as the chocolate chips seem to melt quickly, and just take a few out as I want them.These are truly excellent cookies! I gave the rest of my gluten eating family one cookie each and they could hardly tell the difference between Kinnikinnick and Chips Ahoy.
These cookies taste so good.  I have been diagnosed for about a year now and these cookies are the best I've had. Not too sweet and they have such a great taste and plenty of chocolate chips!!

The only GF cookies that my son will eat. I tried 'em all: cheap, expensive, ordered on the internet, bought from local specialty stores, bought Pamela's etc, etc. All other gluten free cookies pale in comparison. Most others are actually gross. However, these gems are the kind of cookies that you are sitting in front of the tv in the old recliner and its really hard to stop eating them, just like the old (forbidden) Chips Ahoy. This company has a lifelong customer here. Most all of Kinnikinnick's products are the best gluten free that money can buy. Heck, I can't even make them from scratch that taste this good. Happy healthy eating everybody! :)

Those cookies are delicious. I think they could fool anyone that is not on a gluten free diet... They are crispy and light with just the right amount of chocolate chips. If you like gooey or soft chocolate chips cookies those are not for you. But if you like a good crunch you won't be disappointed, they have a great texture and are not gritty like some GF cookies sometimes are.They do not contain soy or dairy which is an added bonus for our family with multiple allergies.My only problem with them is that they're expensive... :-(

These are very addictive. I can't believe that I can't tell they are wheat-free! They are super delicious and do not taste fake or odd in any way. The chocolate chips are divine. I have eaten entirely too many this week after discovering them because I was waiting for them to have a strange after taste or make my tummy funny, but no, these cookies are just perfect. The calories aren't too bad either. It's something like 36 calories per cookie. This cookie gives much joy because eating gluten free is a bit of a hassle and this makes me feel like I am not missing out on anything! Thank you very much Kinnikinnick!!

column9: Best tasting GF cookie, which sucks as I can't stop eating them
column10: They are also sold at Wholefoods.  I have been trying so many brands of cookies and many of them have this dry powdery taste.. Yuck.  However, this cookie sis deliciously crunchy.  I know I should move away from expectations now that I am on a gluten free diet, but as a newbie I am still having a hard time 'cheating' as I miss the old gestures.  Finally, I can indulge on some naughty food wihtout compromising my health or taste.. Yeah!

column9: best GF cookie I have found.....
column10: As you can see from the other reviews, these cookies are exceptional. I have Celiac and most GF cookies I have tried simply taste bad, or have no taste at all.  When you cannot eat gluten, most, if not all of your previous "deserts" cannot be eaten. So it was refreshing to find something that replaced all the previous gluten cookies and deserts. I never thought I would crave "sweets" until I could not eat them.....Kinnikinnick's Montana chocolate chip cookies help fill the void.I just ordered some of these from Amazon as my local store has been out for two weeks....got to have that cookie!

column9: So good my husband eats them!
column10: I have to say that these cookies are so good that when I bought them for my son, my husband and I kept stealing them until they were all gone! I like that they taste like a cookie - not gritty, just the right amount of crunch and a great chocolate taste.

These cookies are very close to the Archway molasses cookies.  They have a very sharp bite of ginger to them, followed by a mellow molasses taste. These are the first GF cookies I have found where I can not tell they are GF. This company makes a chocolate chip Kinnikinnick Foods Gluten-Free Cookies, Montana's Chocolate Chip, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6) that taste like inexpensive store bought choc-chip cookies, not my preference, but not bad at all.  Theses run about $4 each in the store at best, making this a great deal, but the expiration date is not to far out so be aware.

These cookies are hard and crunchy and definitely resemble the store-bought cookies made in mass production bakeries. The taste was good, and the texture similar to somthing from Keebler or another large food processor and baker. I expected these cookies to be more like the gluten-free chocolate chip (or chunk) cookies from Pamela's. Pamela's I would rate with five stars. Overall the Kinnikinnick brand would be fine for kids who want a snack, but gourmet they are not.

I ordered a fairly large quantity of this because my son is allergic to gluten and this type of cookies are hard to come by.  I wasn't sure how he'd take to these cookies but I thought I'd risk it anyway.I was pleasantly surprised to see that he was hooked after his first cookie.  Since that first cookie, I constantly hear "chocolate chip cookie, please?" at home.Good stuff.  Will be ordering more very soon.

column9: I HAVE TO REMEMBER I DIDNT BUY THEM FOR ME !!!
column10: Kinnikinnick Foods Gluten-Free Cookies, Montana's Chocolate Chip, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)  = These cookies are so good, that I have to keep reminding myself that I bought them for my son who is GF/CF, and for me to stop eating them!!!!  Great prices here too.

My spouse is Wheat free and eats a lot of GF food. Kinnikinnick brand ingeneral is great. The cookies are what a chocalate chip cookie shouldtaste like with out the downside of other GF brands. As another reviewer said,these don't have that wierd grainy texture that GF cookies usuallyhave.  They also don't taste like baking powder-another feature of many GFbaked goods.

I love these cookies! I've been GF for about 4 months now so I tend to be a little picky...But I really do love these cookies! They are so amazing! I would recommend these to anyone even if they didn't have Cealiac or a Wheat allergy.

My son is on the autism spectrum and has some sensory issues.  These are the only gluten-free chocolate chip cookies he'll eat.  They do not have that chalky feeling in your mouth that some GF foods have.
Once the package is opened, it's gone.  Hard and dunkable, tasty and GF, AND no hoarding necessary, there are more than enough cookies to share in this package.

column9: Kinnikinnick Gluten-Free Montana's Chocolate Chip Cookies
column10: This product was delivered in perfect condition.  Not one cookie was broken.  It also arrived in a very timely matter after I placed the order.  And these cookies are delicious!

they are VERY crumbly and fragile. They are more solid if you keep them in the freezer and eat them that way. Not your typical tough ginger snap texture at all, which could be a good thing.  At least half didn't survive amazon packaging and came smashed to bits.  Definitely worth trying, but maybe bought from a store, not from amazon.
I really enjoy these cookies. As a celiac with no tolerance for gluten in any form it is nice to finally find something that I truly enjoy (that doesn't taste like cardboard).
I did like these cookies but I didn't love them. They don't have a weird aftertaste or crumbly texture, but the flavor just wasn't perfect for me. I'm still looking for my "chips ahoy"!

column9: Low fat, high taste Ginger Snaps
column10: My son loves these cookies, so I buy them in bulk and store in the freezer. They have a great taste, are low in fat....something he needs with his Crohn's disease...and very tasty. I am so glad to have a cookie that is gluten free and yummy. They are a bit fragile compared to regular ginger snaps (that could be used to open locked doors!!), but any crumbled ones are good in parfaits with yogurt or pudding, or as pie crust.
These were delicious.. My daughter is allergic to wheat, so they were for her.  She had trouble getting enough for herself since everyone thought they tasted great.
Cookies look good, taste is almost non-existent. I vote for PAmela's Chocolate chunk cookies over these. Unfortunately, Pamela's cookies include only NINE in a package. Pricey.

I bought these for someone else on a gluten free diet.I have only good things to say aboutthese cookies. Personally i like these 'hard' type cookiesbetter than the soft ones. If the price were lower Imight buy them more often and give i them a 5 star rating.
My 10 year old son loves these!  Not as good as regular chocolate chip cookies, but great for gluten free!
Disappointment...these cookies have a stale taste unlike when I buy them from the Health Food Store.

I thought Prime Shipping was not just free but when they say it should get here in 2 days it should. Well my item was ordered on the 2nd and it shows still intransit till the 5th so call me crazy but that is 4 days not 2... hum! So have questions about Prime service! Yes! I did pick the right shipping option!

I saw this on sale at a local store and decided to try it. I was hooked, most stores  that carry this price it around $3 or more plus tax. With an Amazon subscription I pay $2.74 per box for it.I enjoy that this cereal is all natural with real cinnamon & sugar. So I don't mind paying a little extra for real ingredients. All I eat is this and Special K.

column9: When I eat this cereal it feels like there is a party in my tummy.
column10: This cereal is really good.  I used to really like cinnamon toast crunch, and I still do.  I tried this stuff, and was surprised how good it really was.  When you see a "healthy" version of something in the grocery store it usually doesn't taste near as good, but this is a pleasant surprise.Not a whole lot to say really.  It is just good cereal, and if you like cinnamon toast crunch or similar cereal it is definitely worth a try.
My 2 kids aged 5.5 and 3 love this cereal. I love that it isn't as sugary as other cinnamon toast cereals. My husband has the occasional bowl as well and loves it. LOVE this cereal!

I usually eat special k protein plus, which I love but its nice to have another healthy cereal option-and this is it. I love this cereal,it tastes just like cinnamon toast crunch but this is healthy, whole grain, and not too sweet.it also has fiber and is only 110 cal per serving. I bought two boxes of this cereal from Big Lots for 4 bucks(great deal!) I highly recommend this cereal

The cinnamon crunch is really yummy, albeit a tad on the sweet side. I really like this with unsweetened almond milk & a sliced banana. Once & awhile, these go on-sale here (or in-store) ... that's when I buy them.Another good product from Cascade Farm.

An organic cereal that actually tastes good.  This is the only organic cereal I can get my 7 year old to eat.  It tastes like cinnamon toast crunch but does not have the sugar content and unhealthy additives.

column9: loved by both Big and Little
column10: It's almost embarrassing how fast my family went through 4 boxes of this cereal.  Both my husband (48) and my son (7) absolutely loved it!!  They had it for breakfast, snacks, I think my son even crushed it up on ice cream.  We got it on an amazon sale for $8.  I am sooooooo sorry I didn't buy more at the time.  Now the price is around $18.  Unfortunately, although the cereal is delicious, healthy, low sugar, etc., I would never pay more than a couple of dollars per box.  And this is only a 10.3 oz box!!  Waiting for the next sale, but if I see it less expensive elsewhere, I will stock up and recommend you do the same!!

column9: Fantastic healthy cereal with real flavour.
column10: We are going through so many boxes of this cereal in our house right now, I only wish it came in bigger boxes.My boys love this cereal, I hardly get a look in.  It is deliciously crunchy with lots of real cinnamon taste, and enough sugar without being overloaded.  The best part is it is made with natural ingredients, whole grains, real sugar and no artificial nasties.I would highly recommend this product.

I absolutely love this stuff! I bought it for my boyfriend because he used to like Cinnamon Toast Crunch, which I absolutely abhor. However, this stuff takes CTC and kicks it in the gut and sends it to the curb. This cereal tastes like real ingredients--it's sweet (but not too sweet! The calories and sugar content are not too high, although I don't remember the exact numbers), tastes like cinnamon, and that's about it. Not a ton of artificial crap and preservatives. I actually have only eaten it in a bowl with almond milk twice--I usually just eat it out of the box dry. It's like crack! We went through a period were the local supermarket had it on sale for $2 a box, and we ate at least 5 boxes a week for multiple weeks. That's scary! But it was so worth it, and so good. I'm waiting for the supermarket to put it on sale super cheap again. I'm telling you, this is the best cereal made. Period.

column9: Great taste, decent amount of fiber, not too sweet.
column10: Pleasantly surprised by this healthier version of Cinnamon Crunch Toast.  It's actually got a texture & taste more like Golden Grahams, just with cinnamon.  Holds up well in milk.  Good find.

My kids and I love this stuff.  I will say up front- "yes, it has a lot of sugar."  Now that I've said that, let's talk taste.  My kids and I loved Cinnamon toast Crunch- which we cannot eat anymore, because we found out we are allergic to GMO corn.  This stuff doesn't have any of that, so we can eat it, and it's fantastic!  I take it dry, in baggies, for desserts for lunch- and eat it like cookies.  My kids eat it like normal cereal, with milk, and they eat so much of it we are on our second order in a month.  I had been buying it at Whole Foods, but that was a long drive, and it was more expensive.  I love you Amazon.

I picked up this cereal when I was preparing for a hurricane.We didn't get hit that bad, so I didn't have to use it.But when the mood did strike me to have some cereal,I was hoping that it would be a bit nostalgic and taste like Cinnamon Toast Crunch.Well...it did.I have to say that Cascadian Farm has some of the best organic products I have come across more than ane other brand.While a lot of other brands sometimes tend to taste like cardboard, theirs don't.Another win for Cascadian Farm :D

column9: Wasn't as good as i'd hoped
column10: I love Cinnamon Toast Crunch and was hoping this would be more like it. My kids like it, but it just doesn't sit that well with me. Tastes GREAT without milk, but once I add the milk to it I am not as happy with it.

column9: Healthier alternative to the non organic brand sugar cereal
column10: I try to feed my family the most organic food that I can.  I also try to feed them the least amount of processed food.  However, this cereal lives happily on our shelf - the kids love it - I use it as a dessert sometimes.

column9: Excellent Cereal; no HFCS but still lots of sugar
column10: We don't normally eat cereal because it is generally junk food. I'm not going to claim this is a healthy cereal--it has a decent amount of sugar in it (8g sugar, 22g carbs for each 1 cup serving)--but it IS organic and as far as junk food goes, this is one of the least junky out there because the ingredients are at least natural and organic, not chemical and artificial.So, on the RARE occasion that I buy cereal for my first grader, this is what I get.I bought it at a salvage grocery for $1/box...very good deal, obviously. But I'd say it is worth the $4+ a box, too. It tastes great and I like knowing that what my son is eating isn't a bouquet of artificial colors and ingredients.

This is a fantastic cereal. Both kids and adults love the taste. There is enough flavor and sweetness to qualify as a "sugary" cereal in our house...without all the sugar, dyes, artificial flavorings, etc. I keep hoping amazon will bring it's price down though. At Target it is $3.50 a box ($14 for 4)...significantly cheaper, even without a coupon.

I found this cereal about a month ago and it has become one of my favorite snacks! If you are counting calories or familiar with Weight Watchers it has 2 points for a cup, which is incredible for cereal, let alone one that tastes this great! Yum- I love it for snacks and in a bowl with almond milk- it rocks!
Has soy in it yes not teh totally bad soy but soy lecithen so yeah sucks tastes good though very cinnamony

This coffee is bitter, has a nasty bite! It doesn't brew up very strong, either (I use a coffee press). I'm used to Sumatra roasted dark. This is medium roasted. I gave it 2 stars instead of 1 star because of the organic/ fair trade/ shade grown and also...well, at least the beans didn't taste burned.

One bag per cup gives you a mild flavor, two bags per cup gives you more berry flavor (my preference) without being overpowering, but the best part is that the flavor is never bitter and never artificial tasting no matter how many I use.  This tea is much better tasting than any of the national bottled tea brands.While many other cold brew teas are designed to make 2 quarts or a gallon per batch, with Twinings each tea bag is individually wrapped and designed for an 8 oz. cup, as with hot teas.  This makes it easy to travel with them and also easy to make small batches (I use 6 bags to 4 cups in a small pitcher.)The only minor issue I had at first was sweetening this tea.  While it would be great for those who prefer unsweetened, I do like mine slightly sweet but do not use artificial sweeteners.  Really, no one should use those in a good tea because they can alter the flavor. This is tricky when cold brewing since sugar doesn't dissolve easily, but there is a simple solution. I like to use a small amount of real sugar and dissolve it with a few tablespoons of very hot water, then I add my cold water & brew.  At home I make my own batch of simple syrup (same concept - 1/2c sugar to 1/2c hot water) to have some liquid sweetener on hand.I look forward to trying more Twinings products, I'm very impressed.

though i did not purchase this through amazon, i did get this recently from thw grocery store, and have to admit im really disappointed.  i followed the instructions the first evening EXACTLY as instructed with the included paper, and no results.  the second day, i brewed just a little longer, still no luck, (basing this off some other comments from other users here on amazon) then today i only did 6oz, not 12 as the paper instructs, and even brewed this for 6 minutes.  still nothing.i really wanted this to work for me like it has for others, i had heard good things and was so excited, but still no luck.  i guess im one of those people this doesnt affect. ill keep trying it daily till i run out, but looks like ill have to try something else.as for taste, its not bad. just tastes like tea leaves, not deliciously fantastic, but not nose-pinchingly undrinkable. good luck to anyone else. hope you have more success with this than i did

i got this tea hoping it would be better than my dieters delight china slim tea but it isnt. it does make you use the bathroom but not enough for you to feel cleansed for that particular day...i have no choice but to finish thus package but i will be going back to my regular tea afterwards
This tea is ok but it's not nearly as potent as the original product that was available 5-10? Years ago.

I have no idea what all these reviews for this brand of dieters tea are talking about. I followed the directions nothing happened. Brewed a stronger cup-still nothing.Even measured out the water to 6oz and let the tea bag seep for five minutes-nothing just stronger tasting tea. On the box it tells you not to drink more than 1 cup in a 24 hour period- I drank three the other day not even thinking about it and nothing happened! Just tasted like cranberry tea and nothing else. Strange.

I bought this product based off reviews saying it tastes great and I was extremely disappointed. As soon as I started steeping it this smell filled my kitchen (my daughter even asked what the horrible smell was). Sadly, it was this tea. I tried it and it tastes like sweaty socks also. It is so gross. I have tried adding honey, drinking it cold, drinking it hot, etc and they all taste horrible. As far as a diet aid, I don't think so. I guess if you had a lot of excrement in you, possibly. I even doubled the suggested amount and I still did not anything happen (and no, I was not on the toilet a lot either). All in all, this product was a big thumbs down to me.
I was very happy with my order.  It arrived on time and as described.  Thank you!!

I am a tea drinker....don't like coffee. I was given some of this for Christmas. Yummy!!!! I used to drink English breakfast tea which I loved but it would bother my stomach sometimes. This Christmas tea never ever bothers my stomach. It is delicious. After getting the gift I came to Amazon and ordered more for myself.

I've been a serious black tea drinker my whole life, thanks to a British mom. She bought this tea for me as a christmas present last year. I have since ordered more online. It's seasonal around December but you can still find it here on Amazon or on other websites. I now have a few tins in stock. This is a lovely spiced black tea mix that does very well with some honey and milk or on it's own (it's not too bitter).A lovely tea for a cold morning or after a long day of work.love it. will continue to buy more.

I am a Mother to 3 kids and a wife as well.  All of my family agrees that this Malt-O-Meal cereal blows coco puffs away.  General Mills has changed the recipe that we all loved so much and made them odd shaped and much harder. These "Coco Roos" are firm and crunchy yet light and airy.  They are DELICIOUS, much better than the brand name and any other immitation out there.  I love these single serving bowls as well, PERFECT!  The price cannot be beat.  Thank you Amazon, I have not seen these single servings anywhere else and I am THRILLED to be able to purchase these little bowls of Malt-O-Meal cereal.

Very dissatisfied with the product. All "chocolate" flavor comes off in the milk and the bites are not crunchy, they turn soggy immediately. Spend the extra to get the quality name-brand Coco Puffs. Coco Roos are not a good substitute.

My order arrived earlier than expected. I ordered the 25lbs unsalted pistachios and they are yummy. The meats are nice and green and the quality is excellent. I will definitely order more from Fiddyment Farms.

I have been purchasing Pistachio nuts in the market from another vendor for years, but these nuts are much better. The nuts from Fiddyment seem bigger and more tasty. I am glad that Amazon exists so that I could buy these nuts.

column9: Much more satisfying than a chip!
column10: I tried the product once at home when a friend brought some to share. The taste is amazing and the texture is really surprising. I can't believe is now available through Amazon. I'll be buying often! A much tastier and healthier alternative to other fried, fatty and salty chips.
They're great! It's like a crisp though made of fruit! Very happy with them and ordering my second lot right now!!
This snack is perfect for on the go. It's delicious, crunchy, flavorable. I can not wait to taste all the flavors, so far my favorite is Pineapple. I recommend to  all *** Frinee
The flavor is incomparable!It tastes just like a fruit of a tropical country and with ice cream is even better!Thank you!

LOOOOOOOOOOOVE IT!!!!!!!!!!!!! The most delicious and healthiest snack. It should be sold everywhere!I am not a huge fan of pineapple, but this crispy fruit snack was sensacional. I cant wait to try the other flavors.

I highly recommend this line of products, not only has great taste, it's also very healthy!!!!!!!! I haven't found anything  like this in the market. I eat it as a snack, and my kids really like when I put it in their lunch boxes, great way for them to eat fruit. Definitely hooked!

Out of the three flavors I received, the apple was my favorite. The mango and pineapple were really good too, but the pineapple was extremely crunchy. The mango was great, if you love sweet and delicious things. The best way to improve this product would be to make more variety of fruit flavors! I can't wait to get more! Eating this product was as much fun as it was looking at and feeling the different shapes. This is all natural, and all good.

I "love" this mousse!  I'm hooked!  It's my new "chocolate fix" and it's low calorie compared to typical "fixes", but doesn't taste like it!  I began to love mousse after trying the yogurt mousses on the market.  I try to make everything from scratch, but the homemade stuff is like 18 points (on Weight Watchers points Plus)!!  THIS box is only 3 to 4 Points Plus per serving!!  Yay!! And the texture & flavor are perfect!! I've made several mousse recipes, w/ the egg whites & w/out... and none of them are as good as this.  THIS is what I really was craving.I'm not sure whether we're actually gonna' get the 12/box, like it says though.... according to some other reviews.I know in Calif- there's only ONE store that carries mousse mix, and surprisingly it's in my small-town grocery store of all places.  ;-)If someone could verify whether they'd actually recieved a 12pk, we'd appreciate that, as well, as to how many servings per packet, please.  Thanks!

column9: best mousse in the world from a box
column10: This mousse is very good and quick and easy to make. I recommend using this for anything from formal dinner parties to casual get togethers.  Also makes a great mouse pie used in an ready make shortbread pie crust.  try it, you will love it.

column9: Instead of Frosting and Gluten Free
column10: My family is gluten free because we have to be. I've used this product several times with great success. Last night I wanted to make a cake but didn't have any frosting mix and the butter was hard and I didn't want to wait for it to soften. So I made the mousse and chilled it, then used it as frosting on the cake and jam for between the layers. This cake won't survive breakfast even!

I used to buy Inspired Cuisine Mousse Mix, Milk Chocolate, 2.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8) at the grocery store but it was too expensive. I decided to give this brand a try since it is cheaper, to me it tastes the same! Love this mousse, will try the dark chocolate next!

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: Despite my dairy allergy, I'm miraculously able to eat cheese without any truly dire side effects. While a friend and I were out the other day, the bizarre appearance of this cheese made it stand out from the others. That it contained porter was an interesting side note. Being the adventurous sort when it comes to cheese, I gave it a chance.It's freaking amazing. I'd use stronger language to emphasize this, but Amazon standards y'know.The cheddar has a wonderful sharp taste to it that is really well emphasized by the bitter porter flavor. It's pretty much heaven in a mouthful and stands incredibly well on its own. You don't have to pair this with anything to enjoy it, although I'm planning on trying it out with a variety of things to see how it does. I really loved letting the porter around the cheese melt in my mouth, then devour the cheddar. I don't want to sound like a pretentious cheese snob because I'm nothing of the sort, but this really was a great experience.A bit of a warning, though. This cheese can crumble (not that this is a bad thing) so you'll want to exercise a little caution to ensure that all of the morsels end up in your mouth and not on your shirt. I found that out the hard way.
This cheese is wonderful.  Great with fruit and wine - This is a very distinct cheese and definitely worth trying. The marbling and color only adds to the interest!

The presentation can sometimes scare a few people away, especially when they are only used to orange cheese.  However, once the daring few take a taste, everyone is convinced that this cheese is delicious!

A few years ago, my cats and I relocated to Germany. And while my four-pawed trio generally took the move in stride and quickly adapted to their new home in a manner that filled me with new love and admiration for them, there is one item now, several years later, still sorely lacking in their lives: Pounce Tuna Treats! For as long as we've been together (and in the case of the two females, that means their entire life), there has never been a better way to reward them or just show them my affection than by giving them some of these - my cats loved them, and I knew that due to the treats' many healthy ingredients I was actually doing something good for my kitties in addition to making them happy. But Pounce is nowhere to be found on the shelves of German stores! My cats are not overly picky in their food choices; they willingly accept almost everything appearing in their food bowls. But they have made it quite clear to me that a decent substitute for Pounce is yet to be discovered. In the meantime, what's a poor cat owner to do???
This is the only treat my cat Gompurrs likes!  Why was it discontinued at the supermarket?  So happy it's still available.

My cat loves these treats. If ever I can't find her in the house, I just pop the top and she bolts out of wherever she was hiding to come get a treat. She doesn't like crunchy treats much, so these are perfect for her. I've given her all three flavors and she seems to like them all equally. They do tend to dry out by the time I near the end of the bottle, however. The flip-top lid is very handy. Very nice, inexpensive kitty treats.

This is one great whisky for the money.  Excellent balance it combines gentle classic Speyside elements with a touch of smoke and a hint of age due to the Solera processing method.  This is by far Glenfiddich's best selection for the money. I buy this expression by the case and leave them at the houses of family and friends so I know I will always have a nice dram waiting when I visit. Highly recommended.

When I first started to buy VitaGravy, my dogs loved it. After a few weeks, they don't seem to care too much for it anymore. They still get it in their kibble every day, and will eventually eat it when they are hungry, but they don't consider it to be a treat anymore. I still buy it because of its beneficial nutritional value and decent price compared to a pill vitamin supplement. One big negative I have noticed about it is that their face is getting dirty from it. They are white dogs and this product tends to cause increased tear and around-the-mouth stains. I used to buy all different flavors of VitaGravy, buy my groomer told me the chicken flavor is best as the beef and pork based flavors can cause an even worse increase in face staining.

After having been diagnosed with dry mouth syndrome, my dentist recommended that I start using Xylitol in the form of gum and mints. And after finding out that Trident had the Xylitol, I started chewing the gum, which is very flavorful and seems to last a long time. However, after having a few stomach upsets after chewing the gum, I decided to read all the ingredients and to my dismay saw that they still use the dreaded aspartame in this product. This is a turn off, and my question is, if they are using Xylitol for a sweetener, why would they use aspartame as well.
Grear tasting gum to have on hand when you have breath. I chew it when I'm craving something sweet. I prefer this gum to Extra and Stride.

The picture shows a 12 pack box of Scrabble Cheezits. I ordered 3 of these for a school function because you can't find these anywhere in stores. The Scrabble Cheezits are always packaged with other snacks, which I didn't want. It was approximately $10 per box and I ordered 3, thinking I would get 36 snack packs for a class. They sent me 3 regular-size boxes for approximately $40.00! They need to change the picture so people know they're selling regular size boxes of Cheezits. If they were substituting a product for one that they ran out of, a regular-size box costs nowhere near $10. It then cost me more money to return the item. What a stinkin' rip off! I will never order from this distributor again. Once and done!

column9: Not what I thought it was...
column10: I was so excited to find affordable bulk organic flours, but when the package arrived I was very disappointed to realize that my oatmeal flour was nothing but wheat flour with oat flakes in it.  This should be more clear on the product page so that people looking for gluten-free alternatives can get what they pay for.

This is a hearty flour.  The oats are huge.  I have the best success using traditional yeast that I dissolve in 110 degree water for 10 or more minutes before adding to my bread machine.  Instant yeast has not worked for me, especially in SW Florida.

It's very good tomato paste. It combines three virtues: It's cheap. It tastes strongly of fresh tomatoes. It's low in salt.Sadly, DeLallo isn't always available, but if you see it in stock, give it a try.

I bought two of these cable cars to give as gifts. They came quick, and were well packaged. I found their entire customer service to be perfect. They look so cool, and I know the recipients will love them! Overall, I am happy with my purchase. The only downfall is that some of the wheels on one of them came off, but I just quickly glued them back on, so it will still be a perfect gift. But that is why I'm giving this product 4 stars, instead of 5.

column9: NEVER ORDER THIS DURING THE SUMMER!
column10: The Flaxseed Oil needs to be refrigerated.  They shipped it with a cold pack, but by the time it got to me, the cold pack was hot.  Amazon has great prices for this item, but I would recommend that you order this during the colder months.  NOT during the summer, like I did.

Quite simply a wonderful flax seed oil. One is often drawn to the product with the most reviews, but I have known the reputation of Spectrum products and for me a filtered oil I use for my daily needs was very important when deciding on a brand due to my auto-immune condition. I like the proportion of Omega-3s in this product. Flax seed oil is best used within two months of opening and I always keep it refrigerated. I have purchased smaller containers in the past from Whole Foods - this seemed like a frugal option. Very happy with the product which was sent with protection from the heat and it arrived promptly because of storage requirements.
During my supplement search I came accross this brand and I am very happy with it.Organic makes a difference when it comes to supplements, at least thats what I think :-)

This product is great for weight loss. I workout daily and was losing about a lb a day/ I started using this product for good fat daily intake and started seeing the weight melt away!! It's a little pricey here but definitely a great product!!
I purchased this flax oil product and it has a fishy taste! What gives? The irony is that one of my main purposes in trying it is that I hate the taste of fish oils.

column9: Flax Oil - Organic Ultra Enriched with Lignans by Spectrum Essentials 24 oz
column10: It is an excellent product.
the intensity of these tomatoes is mind-blowing. Got them at my co-op-yummy!wish they were available here in  bulk.

I've been thrilled with several different styles of Caffe D'arte. My favorite so far is the Gourmet Special Blend (http://www.amazon.com/Caffe-Darte-Gourmet-Special-5-Pound/dp/B0013T73DE/ref=sr_1_23?s=grocery&ie=UTF8&qid=1294674431&sr=1-23).This particular roast, Gourmet Meaning of Life, is also very, very good. It's full bodied for a mild roast.So far, none of the different roasts that I've tried have that "burnt" aftertaste you can get from many of the Starbucks roasts.

I was slightly disappionted to see its artifically flavored.  Maybe all teaberry flavoring is artificial.  Its a mild falvor, I thought the price was good.  Good for a handout or a stocking stuffer, or just to chew after a meal.

Wow, tastes exactly as I remember it.  My brothers my sister and I grew up with this, costing 5 cents per package we could each have a stick with one left over.  A true "blast from the past".  If you remember this from your youth you will enjoy it.
This was a gum my grandmother chewed, I never thought I would find it again. It taste like a mix of cinnamon and mint, flavor last a long time, and I find it very refreshing.

I bought this gum because I recently quit smoking and when I got it I realized that I paid over 12 dollars for gum that should of only cost me 5 dollars. what a rip off. however the gum arrived in a timely manner which was convenient for me.
Great gum to chew if your having ear problems..Used to chew this when I was a kid.Arrived in a timely manner.
Love the flavor.  It doesn't last a long time like Black Jack, but it still very enjoyable.

column9: $20.00 for enough sugar to make one cake...
column10: I'm giving this 2 stars instead of 1 because I should have paid more attention to the amount before I purchased it. These cans are tiny, 3 3/4 inch tall by 2 1/2 inches across. Each can holds about a cup of sugar. They recommend it for spice cake and sponge cakes which typically take 2 cups of sugar. Twenty dollars for the sugar for one cake is way too expensive. You can make your own at home by putting a chunk of fresh ginger in a decent size jar of raw brown sugar. I make vanilla sugar by putting a vanilla bean or two in a jar of white sugar. As far as the Terre Exotique sugar, it tastes good but not good enough to pay $10.00 per cup.

column9: GF HEAVEN!  WOW  A+++++++ Love this! one negative though...
column10: RAW, Gluten-free GOODNESS! AND it has cocoa in it!  MmmmmmmmmJust discovered this a week ago and already we are on our second bag.I wish I could order in bulk because I see us going through this fast.Update: after the fourth bag since reviewing I've discovered that at least half the bag is made up of raisins.... :(  I can buy organic raisins for far less in bulk.  They will need to reduce the raisins and increase the valuable ingredients if they want my business at $8 a bag.

column9: Love it, except for the raisins
column10: This cereal is perfect for me -- not too sweet, the buckwheat has a great texture, the little bit of sea salt adds a lot to the flavor, and CHOCOLATE -- but the raisins are rock hard, and when I finally get to where I can sort of chew them, they stick to my teeth like hard caramel and they don't add anything to the taste of this cereal for me. I would absolutely LOVE it if Kaia would make a raisin-free version of this.

I ordered these on a whim.  I typically don't like the taste of raw food granola, but these were terrific.  Normally when I try sprouted products they have an unusual taste to me, but the Cocoa Bliss has a terrific flavor.  What I like the most about it is the versatility.  It could be used as a cereal, snack, or better yet even a desert because there is enough cocoa in it to satisfy a chocolate craving. I have been searching a long time for an easily digestible raw food snack that does not taste weird and is not too hard on the budget. I am happy to have found this product.  This will be a staple at our house.

column9: could be better, but still amazing!
column10: Chocolate and granola are soooo tasty and what's even better is to know that a product like this combines both chocolate and granola AND STILL IS NUTRIOUS FOR YOU! Amazing :)  I would give it a 4-star or a 5-star.

column9: Tasty, but a little hard to eat
column10: The chunks of this granola are huge, which is fine if you want to eat it like a granola bar. But I want to eat as cereal, and these pieces are just way too big and hard. I emptied the bag onto a cutting board and chopped them into smaller pieces, which helped tremendously, but what a messy job! Pieces flying everywhere because they are so hard. These taste very good though, so if you don't mind the size and density, then you'll like these.

column9: Coco puffs/krispies for Raw Food aficionados
column10: As a kid i was very fond of coco puffs and cocoa krispies. As an adult mostly eating raw i find this granola very satisfying both as a breakfast cereal and as a snack (with nut milk on the side). Found this cereal in AZ but have not been able to buy locally so am trying another brand, but will request the local health food store to stock KAIA COCOA GRANOLA as it is the best. If you're a chocolate fan, try their COCOA MOLE sprouted sunflower seeds, an excellent snack that has a little kick of chili with the chocolate!

This is a great way to start the day.  Not too sweet, but turns my almond milk into chocolate goodness. It's has a very crunchy, pleasing texture that holds up in milk.  I really liked this granola and plan to get it again.  It's a great snack as well.
One of the best raw granola products around.  Forget the fact that it's raw -- it's just damn tasty.

I absolutely love this granola.  It is delicious and the perfect solution when you want something rich and chocolatey, but don't want sugar.  It is really difficult to find granola not made with sugar and this one tastes fantastic.  I can't wait to try the other flavors.

I bought Spicy World Citric Acid for use in homemade bath products; however, the product appears to be fully food grade.  The product was fresh, but the bag design leaves a little to be desired.  Although the bag is resealable once opened, all of the bags in our pack have openings around the resealable zipper ends.  The result is that once opened the citric acid can clump as it absorbs moisture from the air.Overall I would say that I like the Spicy World Citric Acid product and I will purchase it again.
I bought this citric acid so I could make mozzarella cheese. It performed well for this. The package is resealable, but the seal is not airtight.
This product is great as an addition to green tea. We really enjoy it. Delivery on this product was quick and it arrived in excellent shape.

I used this to get the deposits off our dishwasher. Just filled the dispenser and ran a long hot wash. It got a great deal of the scaling off. Tried it in the clothes washer too but don't know how well that worked if at all. Works good with less water. I'm sure it would do the job for whatever you want to use it for. Nice price.

If you like Caramels, this is the only PERFECT Caramel IN THE WORLD. Nothing else comes close to comparing. The most expensive and worth every penny.Anything else is a PRACTICAL JOKE - This is Caramel the way it should be. the balance between sweet and salty - hard and soft - is just... simply... PERFECT. It really does not get any better than that - Tasted the original Caramel from Turin, Italy - not even close to the French's Caramel. If you want the best - THIS IS IT !

I usually rely on Amazon to find the lowest prices on almost every item I need to buy.  However, your best price on K-cups tend to run around .60 cents a cup......I can find lower prices then this on other websites as well as department store sales.  Come on, Amazon......you can do better.

I bought these kcups and I was not able to use them,they were blowing up one after the other when brewing them and I was getting a cup full of grounds and having to clean my keurig coffee machine,I was afraid that they were going to end up damaging my brewer,and I decided to throw them all.I will stay away from Green Mountain from now on.
Nice, mild flavor.  The Hazelnut could be a bit more obvious for my personal liking, but for the average coffee consumer, it is a nice coffee.

I have purchased hundreds of k-cups over the past four years and had never experienced any failures of the design.  This particular batch of k-cups had a defect in the top seal which causes coffee/water to flow out in an unintended way.  Thus essentially making these k-cup unusable and therefore a waste of money.
This is my wife's favorite flavor and 1st choice over other vendors of hazelnut flavored coffee.  Being in the k-cup format makes it easy in the morning to get her coffee before heading out the door.

column9: Green Mountain Coffee Hazelnut; 12-Count K-Cups; Amazon.com
column10: Nice flavor for use when one wantas a change from regular coffee. As always, my order arrived in a timely fashion.

column4: S. Goldstein "toys for big boys junky"
column9: Not as Satisfying as Green Mountain's Dark Roast Hazelnut
column10: I ordered this from Amazon believing that it was the same Hazelnut flavored K-Cup that I got in an assortment from Green Mountain Coffee when I had purchased my Keurig brewer from them.  It was not.  The K-Cups that I got in the Green Mountain assortment were Dark Roast.  These from Amazon are not.  And, these are disappointing, by comparison.  These do not offer a full-bodied coffee taste, and are somewhat harsh.  The Dark Roast Hazelnut K-Cups were much richer and more mellow to the taste.  I went to the Green Mountain web site and could no longer find the Dark Roast Hazelnut K-Cups.  What a shame!  I cannot fault Amazon, but I wish that Green Mountain would bring back the Dark Roast version.
no complaints, awsome, cheap, can not find it for better price anywhere else. highly recommended, its like hazelnut, work well with k cup machine.
The "Millstone FogLifter" K Cups are a great value, as this is all I drink and enjoy. Excellent method of purchasing the K Cups in quantity.

All I can say is this coffee rocks! Love Starbucks and is by far our favorite dark coffee- well, we only buy the dark blends, but this one is great! A little pricey though- come on Amazon- give us a better deal :)
The seasoning was weak and missing the great flavor of the pho mix I have used Ian the past. I had to spice it up to make the pho I know and love.

This seems like a pretty good deal for 30 spice packs.  I also like HAPPY PHO - Zesty Ginger, GLUTEN FREE Vietnamese Brown Rice Pho Noodle Soup, 4.5 oz, 2 SERVINGS Per Box (Pack of 6) and posted a favorable review of it. But, with that one you only get 6 spice packs and are paying mostly for the flat rice noodles to go with it. Rice noodles are somewhat expensive any route you take (compared to say, wheat spaghetti, which if used, you may not have real Pho soup anymore). Still, look around and you may be able to find the thinner rice stick vermicelli at a good price. If so, the VV spices may be a nice low-cost alternative, without sacrificing flavor.Eventually, I may try the VV soup base, as well, but thus far have just been preparing the stock from about 10 cups of water with bouillon cubes (4 chicken and 2 beef last time). I have been opening the spice packet and pouring it in the stock, though it may be intended you filter the spice like a tea bag. This method didn't seem to make it too strong in the end, perhaps due to my stock being a bit watered down. I'll keep experimenting with the bouillon proportions, but my latest result was possibly the closest I've come to my favorite restaurant Pho (that's no longer nearby).Besides the water, bouillon, and VV spice, my recipe currently includes the following:  8 medium beef meatballs, 5 beef cold cuts, 1 cup chopped cilantro, 2 chopped green onions, 1/2 teaspoon ginger, 4 ounces rice noodles. Makes 2 or 3 large bowls full. Serve with fresh spinach leaves, bean sprouts, and chopped up serrano peppers (not the pickled kind) on the side. Plenty of sriracha sauce added to the soup is a must for me, along with a smaller amount of hoisin.  There's also a somewhat more involved recipe on the box you can try - mine is actually a variation on the Happy Pho preparation instructions, just using more broth, the VV spices, beef instead of chicken, and thin rice vermicelli.

Quick & easy spice packet to flavor your Pho broth with! When I ordered, I thought I was getting 10 packs but there are actually 3 packs in each box so you will receive 30 spice packets total. Happy slurping! :)
This is one of my favorites. Very fresh and thick. Comes with a separate heat pack to add additional kick. The best stuff to use on fresh beef tamales.

column9: I fell in love with the Bartender...that's ME!
column10: I thought I was a pro after mixing the packet with the liquor and shaking.  You really can't go wrong with this! Great for gift bags.

The appletini mix is easy and is very good. It is a little expenseve, however if you buy in larger quantities you will save.  I bought a case (72 drinks)  That will last for quite some time....I could not find the appletini mix in any store.  Only amazon has it.

I have always bought Whisky Sour Mix by the case from Brady Enterprises.  You can't go wrong with any of the mixes.  We also use the Appletini and Cosmopolitan with rave reviews.  Ice, liquor(s), packet & shake.. that's it!  I also make Whisky Sours with vodka (so I guess that's a vodka sour) and a 1/2 shot of Cointreau.  For those who like to cut the sour (tartness), use a dribble of marashino cherry juice & a cherry.  These mixes have been used by my father-in-law, uncle, & aunt since the days of Johnny Carson.  Enjoy!  Slainte!  Cheers! Kampai! Salute! Gsundheit!  Whatever!
This is very good tasting herbal coffee with no caffeine..It is very easy to fix,just brew like tea..I add almond milk to mine and it makes it creamy tasting..

I was looking for a beverage to replace coffee and tea, due to acid reflux issues. This was recommended to me and I thnk it's a good hot drink for cold mornings and won't make my acid act up. It's complex flavors help making it seem coffee-like and with a little soy creamer and honey, it's a wonderful treat.

Great "coffee" experience with a lot more flavor and no stimulants.  Enjoy drinking it in the mornings. You don't have to be concerned that you will be awake all night if you drink it in the evening too. Gives me a lift but no jitters.  Much better than coffee.

The IAU does not sell naming rights nor does it authorize any other company or organization to do so. The IAU cautions consumers that products and services marketed by ISR and other companies have no formal or official validity whatsoever. In fact with a few exceptions of ancient or Arabic names, nearly all stars are designated by catalog numbers rather than names.[8]The IAU has called the ISR's star-naming business far from dangerous "charlatanry" and their products and marketing have been criticised for "seem[ing] official."[9][10] The company clarifies the products it sells on its frequently asked questions page stating:Astronomers will not recognize your name because your name is published only in our Star catalog.[4]

The taste is amazing and can be used for most anything...from pancakes to ice cream, or just to cook with. Delivered very quickly and securely.
Very refreshing. I use this tea to make iced tea. I enjoy the flavor very much.

column9: Much Hotter than expected -- JR sent a milder variety no charge
column10: I bought these because I ran out of the fragrant, fruity green peppercorns that I bought a couple of years back at Zabar's in NYC, and because at least one of the reviews made them sound similar.  The batch I got, however, are hot like a capsicum pepper (hot red pepper.)I wrote a note to JR customer service, and they sent me some pink peppercorns at no charge.

column9: Green peppercorns... great pepper taste without a harsh "bite"
column10: If you are like me and you tend to limit the pepper on your food because you don't like the "bite" of black pepper... try out green peppercorns. They have an awesome flavor that really adds to your plate and yet it doesn't have that bitter edge to it.  That being said, I've ordered green peppercorns from a couple of different spice companies and you can't beat the price of these!  They have excellent value and quality, and I can't recommend them more!Green peppercorns are especially good on fish, eggs, pasta and other light-bodied foods.  I will NEVER go back to black peppercorns again!

column9: Exactly what I was looking for...
column10: I have only one complaint, I would have ordered 10 lbs if they sold them in 10 lb bags that is...  Ok, time to be serious, this is exactly what I wanted and they arrived the same week I ordered them.  I highly recommend to you green peppercorn fans.  Now I just need to perfect my green peppercorn steak sauce...  (any advice will be greatly appreciated.)

I'm on a diet, eat right for your blood type and needed some green peppercorns, These peppercorns are of good quality and worked out great, I'm sold on these.They were a decent price, and this is where I'll buy them in the future.
Great product - super secure packaging.  Would purchase from this seller again.  Peppercorns price was less than other sites I visited.  I am very satisfied. Thank You very much!  Abby
Great flavor. What I needed in the kitchenThe packaging is HORRIBLE!! plastic bag ripped open in the box. I picked them out for 30min.but worth it....
Peppercorns are find, but the package is bad. Unable to open neatly and then it rips open and your berries are all over the floor.

Great peppercorns, fragrant and fresh! I use them in some of the recipes in "Nourishing Traditions", such as fruit chutney. Expensive, so I bought something that was the best value for the dollar and just give them to friends as little gifts. Sent some to a friend who is also interested in NT recipes.
My friends that received these as presents were delighted with getting an unusual but innovative and useful gift. They are good and adventuresome cooks.

These peppers have good color, aroma, and taste. I ordered a pound and am quite pleased with the amount of product per dollar. We use green peppers for many things: poaching salmon, flavoring corned beef, ground in salads, etc. So far I've found the peppers competitive with any other green peppers I've bought and they are less expensive to boot.
Spoon the syrup over pancakes, hot biscuits, or in tea.  My family enjoys it best with overnight oatmeal.  Its buttery sweet flavor can't be beat.
This syrup was a mainstay when I was growing up.  It was great to find it online.  It is the most unique syrup that you will ever find.  Excellent for cooking.

These olives are absolutely the best olives we have ever eaten.  We slice them and put them on our salads and use them in bloody marys.  The combination of jalapeno and garlic are perfect with the large firm olives.  We usually buy them by the case at our regional craft fair, but we are out and I was really happy to find them on Amazon.

I purchased these olives as a Christmas gift. To be kind, the recipient stated, "I just don't know about those olives. Something's just not right. I think they might be bad." When I finally was able to taste one I immediately spit it out as I was gagging on the rotten taste and smell. These olives (not the garlic, not the peppers) were ROTTEN!! Now, I understand that things happen and there are bad lots of produce. That is the reason I emailed the company (Leonard Mountain) and explained the issue, asking for a resolution. I received no reply. At that point, I emailed again stating I would take the issue up with Amazon, offering yet another chance for Leonard Mountion to rectify the rotten olives. No reply.Thank you, Amazon for the refund. I wish the manufacturer could have resolved this issue in another manner.

Mommy buys this treat for my sisters and me.  We love it.  She tells me it is made in the US so we don't have to worry about possible problems with radiation treatment.  We go thru bags and bags!  Yummy!
