Good on its own without dairy/non-dairy milk as a snack.
This cereal is delicious - I actually eat it more as a snack than for breakfast.  It's very healthy, as it's low in sugar and high in fiber.

Wheat free does not equal gluten free. Placing an item of this description in this category can be extremely dangerous for those of us who are very sensitive to gluten. I would not want to take responsibility for this error.

These baking bits are excellent for adding to cookies, pies and scones! They give your baking a burst of flavor unlike anything else I've ever tried. I purchased 10 packages of raspberry and 5 packages of blueberry. I live in Alaska where fruit is extremely expensive and hard to get during the winter months. These baking bits give us a robust fruit flavor at a fraction of the cost of fresh fruit or preserves. I highly recomend this product!

Life got better when I discovered A1 steak sauce as a kid.  It made bad beef palatable.  Sadly, Mom bought half a steer once or twice a year and over-cooked it all.  Seems a well intended but misinformed home economics teacher scared her into cooking everything well beyond well.  Subsequent to that I discovered good beef and that it was silly and unnecessary to to use any kind of a sauce on a lovingly prepared steak.  Sadly life is not one long serving of a grilled medium rare porterhouse with a side of fresh horseradish. You may have your own take on this but you get it.  There are so-so burgers, average steaks at average steak houses and cheap cuts of beef purchased for big BBQ's.  That's where Ring of fire Original Steak Sauce comes in.  I smuggle this stuff into Outback when my family insists on eating there.  It's makes a burger barbeque something special.  Slathered on smoked tri-tip it's the shchizznit.It is only with this sauce that I can eat a burger from a fast food restaurant.  In fact, I marvel at how the #7 Angus Swiss Mushroom Burger at McDonalds tastes better than average with this steak sauce slathered all over it.  Hold the mayo and add extra mushrooms (yes, they will do that for you).  There is subtle and real chemistry at play here.  Mushrooms make beef more savory and juicy.  The heat and complex spices of Ring of Fire Steak Sauce are the salvation of this bland industrial item.  It's good on every burger but especially good when mushrooms are involved.  I'm not sure why.  In fact, I use it on Portobellos I grill and it's enough to make me think I could be a vegan for a day.So here's the bottom-line: this is the best steak sauce ever made.  I've had fancy, gourmet small batch sauce, sauce homemade by grilling gods and just about every other commercial steak sauce in the western world (my sauce spicy sauce collection approaches 100 bottles) and this stuff simply rules.  There's still a place for A1 in my world.  Sometimes you need a sauce with papaya. Sometimes you need something infused with chipotle.  Other times you need something fancy with you've got a special cheese or some other mystery ingredient with your beef.  But this is my go to Steak Sauce and I only wish they sold it in quart sizes.The folks at Ring of Fire also have the best habanero hot sauce ([...] in the entire world so it's no surprise they'd figure out steak sauce so well.  I haven't researched this but everything they sell has some crazy flavors that work and work well.  Hats off to them.
This steak sauce is the best I've ever had. Delicious taste with just enough kick. Kind of expensive, but worth every penny. I've tried many others but always come back to Ring of Fire!

They recently changed their recipe to use corn syrup as a sweetener for this. Being gluten intolerant, corn (and corn syrup) is a no-no for me.Its a shame that companies keep cheapening the quality of their products just to make a few cents!

column9: Not Bad, Yummy, But Hard & Dry
column10: While the wasabi flavor of these peas was strong, and they were hot and sweet both at the same time, the peas were super hard, many were so dry they just disintegrated when they were bitten into. Also, the majority of the peas were not whole--they were broken pieces, half of a pea, chunks of dried peas, but not whole, round, pretty peas. I realize wasabi peas are dried--I love wasabi peas and I eat them all the time--but these were super hard and super dry, like dusty inside when bitten into.Also, no nutritional label or ingredients information was provided with the peas... and the packaging was ordinary, normal plastic bags, with no information, labels, printing, anything on them to say what they were. I would imagine the bags are filled from larger bulk bags, but some sort of ingredients or nutritional labeling should have come with the product.So while the flavor was good, the texture and the size and the consistency of the product was poor. They were okay, and I did eat them, but I honestly probably wouldn't order them again from this seller. I've ordered others from Amazon.com sellers that were much better, and I would likely go back to them before ordering from here again.

These... are truly delicious. They are much hotter and spicier than the ones made by Happi, or I'm crazy. I will be placing recurring orders of these because they are just so delicious. My goodness, I didn't know so much goodness could be packed into a moderately healthy snack. Buy these!

We love to make Pad Thai at home quite often.  We found these noodles to be sticky, making them difficult to work with.  In the end we were left with a clot of broken noodles that did indeed taste great but looked poor.
This cereal is so good.  Where I live, I can't find it for less than $5 a box.  On subscribe & save, it's about $3 a box.  Great deal, and way better than other cereals that claim to be "healthy."

I didn't think I would like this. But bought it anyway as an effort to eat better this year. I tasted it out of the box and was pleasantly surprised. It's good on its own, and with yogart & fresh fruit. Nice to have great taste with the good for you. Yeah pumkin flax granola!

column9: Great cereal, but it has its flaws
column10: this is a very delicious cereal. it was all the things they said it was, the two issues about it for me is that calorie/fat content. 260 cal./10 grams of fat per serving seems a bit high, even for a granola based cereal. and the next problem is the flaxseed, they didn't grind them. like many of you know, when you don't grind flaxseed, it will pass strait through your digestive system. now at first i thought, "well im eating the cereal, a good chewing should do the job just fine", but thats not the case. not to be gross, but i saw  flaxseed in my stool, the seeds in whole. you probably only effectively breaking down about 2/5 of the seeds. so you're obviously not getting nearly as much nutritional value from it compared to if they would just pre-grind it.but other than that its a great cereal, the taste is an unmistakable 10, nice fiber content and organic. i will still buy in the future, just not as often as i would've liked though

I got my first box of this cereal at Target. it was on sale, 3 dollars and 4 cents. I'm kind of a health food freak, I saw "flax plus" and the USDA organic symbol and tossed it in the cart along with my recycled toilet paper and organic zBars.Did I know I was carrying around a slice of heaven? Had I known, I would have bought all the boxes in my local Target. But I didn't find this out until the next morning.Every morning I slid out of bed at 6 am and go get my breakfast. Warm oatmeal with bananas usually perks me up a bit, but that day I decided to try my new cereal. I added vanilla almond milk and sliced banana. I took one bite and I danced. It was so good. It is so good. I eat handfuls of it and then cry for the beauty of the moment and the taste of the cereal. it's just so good! How do they do it? It's just so good. Now in the mornings I jump out of bed and fly down the stairs so I can eat Organic Flax Plus Granola. It's just that good.Are you an on-the-fencer, unsure if you want to bound through the lush meadow that is this granola? Do it. You won't regret it.It makes me dance.
we love this granola, lots of crunch and healthy ingredients.  its good with yogurt.  watch the calories though!

column9: The most awesome granola ever! EVER!
column10: I admit it - I am a 60's flower child. I have been eating (and making my own) granola since the summer of love. While my home-made granola is superb, there are times when I just don't have the time now that I am a senior and also running my own business. After trying many, I discovered this product and fell in love - deeply in love. The flavor, the health, can only be beat by my own home made. There are a lot of granolas on the market and not all are good for you. I especially like the texture - it is lightly crunchy without destroying my dental work. The flavor is wonderful - not overly sweet. I love this particular variety blend with the pumpkin seeds and flax as both are so healthy for you on a regular basis. Enjoy!

column9: good source of omega-3s and tastes good too
column10: Love this cereal! I'm taking a nutrition class and have been on the hunt for ways to get more omega-3s into my diet. (Most Americans are deficient...) This is a great solution...healthy and tastes good too! Not like other low-fat granola cereals that are chewy and tasteless. I sprinkle it on my cereal or on yogurt for breakfast or snacks...a couple tablespoonfuls on a container of light-n-fit/low-sugar yogurts goes a lot further for me than a 100-cal pack of some unfulfilling carb snack. Adding proteins to my snacks really fills me up. And what woman can't use more calcium? I highly recommend it!

column9: Best tasting cerial in the world!
column10: Out of all the cereals I have ever tasted this is the best tasting and feels great to be eating something healthy. The ingredients are all organic and there is some amazingly healthy stuff packed into this box. I actually look forward to a healthy breakfast with this. I get the boxes shipped to work and keep them under my desk. A quick and healthy breakfast that tastes amazing!

First introduced to this granola by a friend who planned the food for a 9 day river trip. I wondered if it was just the great outdoors that made it taste so good, but after buying it at home, I realized not. It has great crunch, great flavor, and great nutrition. Too bad there isn't more in each box.

This is the absolute best granola, however the vendor sent me 6 boxes of cereal as ordered, which are due to expire in June.  Would have liked to see longer outdates on a product being purchased in a larger volume.

column9: Really good, but a tad sweet
column10: For something that is supposed to be healthy for you, this is a great tasting cereal.  The same as with most granola, it is a very dense food.  A serving size of this is going to be smaller than a serving size of a flake based cereal, so watch how much you pour into your bowl.  I'm a fairly big guy who likes a big breakfast and I find I can get about three to four servings from a box.The cereal has great texture, and you can really taste the flax and pumpkin seed.  These flavors are very nutty and earthy - which might not be for everyone, but if you are used to these kinds of foods, then the taste is pleasant.  The texture is mildly crunchy, but softer and a bit less dense than most traditional granola.My one sole complaint with this cereal is that it is a tad high on the sugar.  I feel like this was done intentionally to make the cereal sweeter and more palatable to a wider demographic.  However for those looking for low glycemic foods, it's less than ideal.  In my opinion, it could lose a little of the sweetness and be just about perfect.I can also pick these up at my local Kroger for $3.00-$3.30, which is less than the price here so shop around.

I discovered the product in the grocery store, for what ever reason they stopped stocking it. I searched on line and found your site.I found a better price and restocking is very efficient. One year later i'm still ordering on line. The grocery store just started restocking the product last week...it's too late..they lost me as a customer...they did me a favor.

My whole family loves this stuff... tastes great and has a great texture also.  The granola has a "puffed" texture so it's not as hard as some other granolas.  The pumpkin seeds give it a great flavor and it's good both with cold milk or warmed as a hot cereal.

I consider myself something of a cereal snob, and this is one of my favorites.  It is not too sweet, but doesn't need any sweetener to be perfect.  It accepts fruit well, but doesn't require any to give it a wonderful flavor.

I love this cereal.  I am always on the lookout for grocery items without corn & soy (allergens for me), and this cereal tastes great.  I am pleased with the wholesome ingredients. Also, this 6 pack is a great deal as I pay about $5 per box in my local grocery store.

column9: By far the best granola!  And, I've tasted them all!
column10: Ok folks.  This is a real review, unlike many of the "glowing" reviews for some of the small volume granolas you find on Amazon.  I have eaten virtually all of the top reviewed granolas on Amazon, because I am an Amazon junkie AND am also addicted to Natures Path granola (hemp seed and pumpkin seed, they're both great).  I was re-ordering my pack of six Natures Path when I decided to try other highly rated granolas.  I got some through Amazon and others locally.  None of them came remotely close.  The worst was Dr. Flynn's.  See my review of that one if you like.  You cannot go wrong with Nature's Path granola.  It's soooo good.

column9: Finally, I found a granola I like!
column10: I have been looking for a granola cereal that I like for 30 years, and I finally found it! Other granolas are WAY too sweet for me, they taste like sticky syrup, and the raw unsweetened granolas are too expensive, and have very little flavor at all.Then I stumbled upon this one on a clearance table at Ralphs, and yowza! I have finally found it.This cereal is not too sweet, but just sweet enough, and the flavor is fantastic. The price is good for a healthy organic cereal. It does have 260 calories per 3/4 cup, so I can't eat half the box for breakfast like I'd like to!Thanks Nature's Path for making this, and showing me that I can enjoy Granola. :-)

This is the greatest cereal ever and it's very healthy.  I actually sometimes crave it as a snack.  I have never liked cold cereal but this stuff is great.  Wife mixes it with fruit and yogart.  Low sodium, low anything bad... You have to try it.The problem is this price is way to high - comes out about 41.8 cents per ounce.  I can get it at one of the big box stores for 23 cents an ounce.  Starts with a C and ends with an O.  Almost half price.Either way, you must try these cereal at least once.  It taste great and its good for you on top of that.

This cereal is one of my favorites. It is fantastic to add blueberries and/or bananas to. SOOO YUMMY!!! You can find it in grocery stores, but buying bulk ended up being pretty less expensive. RECOMMEND FOR SURE!

I've been eating this cereal for over a year now and it's by far my favorite.  I usually mix it with plain Greek yogurt and wild blueberries but sometimes I'll eat it with soy milk.  I even have a bag in my office desk drawer for snacking.  BUY IT.

The wife had me buy it for her..it actually tastes good with nothing more than a little 2% on it..not real hard like some of the cereals that make your mouth hurt from chewing it up..
Great cereal or topping on your frozen yogurt. The boxes are small but the contents are incredible. Nature's Path is a great company and you can't go wrong with any of their organic options.

column9: Just 'cause it tastes good doesn't mean it's not good for you
column10: This cereal is filling, tasty, and good for you, with all kinds of things that other people haven't thought of -- and last but not least, has no preservatives!  I buy, I kid you not, multiple boxes at a time, the large ones they sell at Costco.Try using it, not only as a terrific breakfast component, but as a yoghurt topping, or a cookie ingredient, or even as part of some really rockin' Krispie treats.  And it's a first-class snack, all on its own.Kudos, Nature's Path!

Friend came over one day and wanted some cereal. I gave her some of this. She was like "uhh organic granola...?" She takes a bite and follows with "this is better than like... normal cereal!"Tasty. Crunchy and doesn't get soggy. Healthy. Filling. What more can you ask for? This is definitely one of my favorite cereals.

Love, love, love this cereal.  It's the best-tasting granola I've ever eaten.  The pumpkin seeds are a brilliantaddition.  As others noted, it's a bit high in calories compared to other healthy and natural cereals but most granola is that way. For a treat for breakfast every now and then it's worth it. And you can sprinkle it on plain yogurt and fruit for added crunch.  I found I needed to keep it wrapped up tight or it gets "soggy" as do most cereals. Happy crunching!

This is the best granola.  Used to get it at Sam's Club, but then they stopped carrying it.  So I found it here and ordered it.  I mix it with Dannon Oikos Key  Lime yogurt and it is the best breakfast ever.  Thanks, Amazon, for carrying this product.

It's sweet and dense but tastes less fatty than store-bought granola I've eaten in the past. The flax and pumpkin seeds are tasty. It's pretty high calorie (260 per 3/4 C serving, and 10g fat) but also very filling and satisfying.

SO I am not wasting gas money or time, either.Thanks, Amazon!
I love this cereal! It isn't too sweet and it has a wonderful flavor. I like to mix this with the Flax Plus Multigrain cereal and Almond milk.

column9: Best cereal we have ever tasted.
column10: I think it's partly the pumpkin seeds that make it so tasty. It is, by far, our favorite cereal - tastiest, just crunchy enough, not as overly sweet as some. We started getting it at Costco and now do the Subscribe and Save on Amazon. Six boxes each delivery. Now, that's cereal love.

column9: We eat this for morning and/or for dinner
column10: My husband got this the first time from Costco's....Oh sure get us addicted to this cereal than they stopped selling it. So I tracked it down at the local healthy grocery stores. This past month I cannot find this stuff anywhere! I am not sure why. So now I will be buying it off of Amazon...well why not I order everything else from Amazon. I think it is cheaper on here too. I haven't found many cereals that taste great but this one is it! Of course I am also a pumpkin lover but it isn't overly pumkin-y (okay I made that word up). Just try it!

We are on a special diet and this is the only commercial granola that does not have ingredients that are bad for us. It is wheat and corn free.I am sincerely hoping that they don't change their formula and start using canola oil and/or safflower oil and/or palm kernel oil like Cascadian farms did.This is GOOD stuff!  Occasionally I eat it "straight" with our homemade soy/almond milk, but usually we use it for "sprinkles" on top of organic yogurt mixed with fruit.  That makes a really good breakfast or lunch with very few grains.  Sometimes my husband uses it as a topping for the rice and millet cereal flakes we buy.No matter how you use it -- it's great!  I try to buy the 26 oz.eco friendly economy packs when I can find them at a sale price.

column9: Whole Foods Market has it for cheaper
column10: My local WFM sells the 11.5 oz box for $2.99, cheaper than even the Subscribe price here and you don't have to buy a bunch each time.I like that it is not overly sweet and is organic.

Love the taste and texture of this granola, not to mention the healthier appeal than commercial cereals. The green pumpkin seeds are a weird color which wins my boys over to trying it ( and liking). Hope you all enjoy as much as I do.
I buy this at costco , it comes in a double bag box.. i eat it with yogurt and i really do love it . its is one of the best granola type cereals i have had .

I first tried this cereal from Costco and was hooked. My 93 year young father and my sister also love it.I eat it dry as a snack sometimes and my doctor was happy to see something healthy on my menu. I now LOVEthe convenience of having it delivered from Amazon. DO keep the unopened boxes in freezer or fridge.
I recommend this unique tasting cereal.  The Pumpkin seeds make this cereal very good.
My flax and pumpkin seed granola is yummy. i eat it about four times a week and enjoy it. Am glad it came in a bundle of six boxes because it tastes so good!Thank you! the price was right as well!
This is my favorite granola - it tastes great and is healthy.  Hard to beat Amazon's subscribe & save price on this product.
I have been a fan of Nature's Path for several years, but their prices are so high and their boxes have gotten so small that I am giving up.  The cereal itself is good for what you get.
I buy this cereal from Amazon on a regular basis. this is my favorite granola Amazon sells.
Delicious ,crunchy granola that is loaded with pumpkin seeds and flax. Great mixed with yogurt and berries for a nutritious breakfast. Good buy .

column10: If you like a healthey breakfast this is the one.mix it with the milk and banana you don't  need anything till lunch,it is so good that sometimes I used it for lunch it is very healthey full of Fiber and fills you up.and the best is you buy it with Amazon Price and back up.
Ignore any negative comments.  I have never given this to anyone who did not love it.

column9: Great-Tasting Cereal (even without a fruit topping)
column10: it's very filling, satisfying and has an excellent taste. I've put apples and mangoes on top and that's delicious!  Glad to see that it's offered at organic supermarkets, warehouses and Amazon.

This cereal is great tasting, but a little seems to go a long way.  I dumped out my usual amount of cereal and could hardly finish it, I was so full!  I think it would also be great as a snack right out of the box and on yogurt with some fresh fruit.  The Amazon price is great, especially if you take advantage of the auto delivery option.  As an added benefit, it is loaded with fiber and helps keep you regular ;)

column9: Natures Path Flax plus Granola w/Pumpkin Seeds
column10: This is an excellent substitute for Kashi Go-Lean Crunch!  It has less carbs, sugar, & fat and more protein and fiber AND it TASTES GREAT!!!  Actually, we have switched to this from Kashi.  Pricing is competative, too.  Try this one... you won't be disappointed!

I second the problem mentioned by other reviewers regarding the indigestible whole flax seeds. Two more things I am not thrilled to find out after reading the label (should have done it before placing the order)* The "organic evaporated cane juice" is the 2nd most significant ingredient by weight. It is a fancy name but sugar is sugar. There are two more sweeteners down the list.* The 3rd ingredient by weight is "organic soy oil". Organic is good, but it is still fat.
Nature's Path Organic Flax Plus Pumpkin Granola Cereal, 11.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)This stuff tastes great!Flax, pumpkin seeds, oats, molasses and brown rice flour.

column9: Maybe not the best choice for health
column10: I bought this cereal because of the omega 3 content.  It is a bit on the sweet side but otherwise tastes good.My problem with the cereal is the high quantity of omega 6.The cereal has 450 milligram of omega-3 acids and 1500 milligram of omega-6 acidsThe dietary ratio of omega 3 to omega 6 should be 1 to 1, not 1 to 3 (though this is an improvement from the 1 to 15 in the very unhealthy standard American diet).People who are trying not to gain wait should also beware of the high calorie content.

column9: The best cereal ever, but loaded with sugar
column10: The crunchiness, the texture, the nutty flavor and the pumpkin seeds; it's all put together in this beautiful combination, delivering nothing short of an avalanche of flavor.However, it has a fatal flaw, for all of its goodness it's shadowed by its heavy sugar payload. I've got a tip though, and although it sounds a bit OCD, it works. I just rinse it in water for 30 - 60 seconds with a strainer, it seems to take most of the sugar off.I really don't like sugar that much, I've grown accustomed throughout the years to have my food without sugar, and that's the only annoying bit. Other than that, I haven't found any other cereal as addictive as this one; I've been eating it for years (I hope they don't find anything wrong with it or I'm dead).

The taste is decent, but there are two big problems:The box is tiny, and on top of that, the actual contents inside only fill HALF of the box... Rip-off.The flax seeds are not crushed, so they go right through your digestive system unassimilated.There are plenty of better choices out there.

You might not think, from reading ingredients, that this cereal has gluten in it, but it does.  While the cereal tastes yummy and has decent nutritional content, if you are gluten-sensitive, stay away.  I tried it twice and both times spent hours doubled over in agony.  I suspect the gluten source has to do with how the oats are processed.  I wish food producers would realize that celiac disease is no joke and be very careful about product labeling.  Are you listening, Nature's Path?

column9: Nature's Path Organic Flax Plus Granola Cereal with Pumpkin Seeds
column10: Tastes OK.  I believe it is good for me so I eat it but it does not satisfy like other cereals that have not nutritional value.  Good for breakfast but not a very good late night munchy.
It's sweet, packed with seeds that get stuck in your throat, doesn't taste at all of pumpkin, and filling after a couple teaspoons. Wouldn't buy again.

column10: This cereal is absolutely fantastic, and with all of the great reviews of the subscription service, I decided to sign up. Ten days after the cereal was shipped, it's still listed as 'in transit' with FedEx SmartPost, and there's no customer service number to call about the shipment. I submitted an online query 5 days ago with SmartPost, and there's been no response. I've cancelled the subscription (obviously) and suspect that I'll never see the package or a refund. I love this cereal, and have bought it a lot from the grocery store.  This whole case, however is rancid.  I need to find out how to return it!

If you're looking for something that reminds you with every bite how healthy it is, this is for you.  If you are looking for something that tastes good -- steer clear. Maybe the box would taste better...

I have used this salt on everything because the smoked smell and flavor is just wonderful.On fish,pork,steaks potatoes,soups salads and don't forget the rim of a shot of tequila.I recommend it not because it benefits me in anyway, only because it's great and Iam ordering my second jar right now.try it you will love it too.
If you like ginger tea than you'll love Ginger drink. It has a little bit of a bite, but that's what makes this drink good.

I tasted the Ginger Drink in the form of tea on a recent trip to visit a son and daughter-in-law in Ljubljana.  It seemed very restorative and I was pleased to order some from the website he furnished and get it so quickly. If I happened to have an upset stomach or a cold, it would be even better.  Very bracing!

This product is delicious. I simply enjoy the taste of the subtle honey that is already infused in the sachet. Being a mom on the go the individual sachets work well. The seller Nature and Herbs are great and professional. They were expedient and were quick to respond to any questions. I will definitely use them again.
This tea is very strong. I add raw honey and it tastes wonderful. If you don't like it that strong, you might try only using half a packet per cup.

one of my co-worker suffered with a bad cold with the normal symptoms that followed for weeks...I recommended the ginger tea and how it worked so well for my daughter...so I gave her a few packets to try....before the afternoon the cough and mucous started breaking up she was able to breath better and her taste bits came back she was able to eat lunch...and purchased her own....so whether home or in the office and you're sick and discomforted this is the product I recommend.
wonderful ginger tea..best on the market in my opinion..just be careful of the shipping costs.
Love the product.  Too expensive to ship. Probably won't get it again because of the added cost.

column9: Solid yeast that produces some amazing aromas
column10: I wanted a beer similar to the Weihenstephaner Hefeweissbier -- a bananay, clovey, tart, crisp hefeweizen. It produces. This is a profoundly top cropping yeast that produces some amazing aromas. I used a very simple extract base. Little more than a few pounds of wheat DME and an ounce of whole leaf Hallertau hops. Fermentation started about 68 and rose to 74 before settling down at about 68. The yeast remains in suspension for a long time, but the suspended yeast and soft flavors from it are expected in the style.This is fast turnaround beer. I started with a 1.044 gravity and finished at 1.011 10 days later. Maybe a week in bottles and its ready to roll. Very nice flavors. Wyeast recommends slightly underpitching or fermenting at the warmer side of the temp range to accentuate the banana aromas. Go at the cool end and pitch normally to accentuate clove. In the future, I would cold crash it over night at least to clear up the beer just a bit. Its not going to be clear as water, nor would I want it to be, but its just a bit murky for me. I didn't cold condition it at all.A few things. You will need a starter unless the pack was fresh. They have a 6 month life on them. Mine was 5 months old. I hit the activator pack, let it swell, and then did 1L simple starter (shaking with oxygenation at outset) for about 18-24 hours. I don't think you can expect to just pitch one pack if the yeast is near the end of its 6 months.Two, this yeast seems to produce copious sulfur smells later in fermentation. I thought my sewer backed up. That will clear, but it takes a few days for the gas to percolate out. You will likely need a blowoff tube. Leave about a gallon of headspace in your fermenter and use a blowoff tube until the krausen settles or there will be a mess.This is kind of a cool yeast in that you can easily harvest from the krausen, rinse it, and reuse it a second or third time because it is so profoundly top cropping. I have read that there are some genetic changes in subsequent generations of this yeast that cause it to lose the banana and clove production characteristics. However, it would seem that so long as you avoided any unwanted organisms in your yeast drippings, you might be able to continue using it for an american style wheat to get that clean, tart flavor without a lot of the banana notes. Just something to think about.These are living organisms so you might want to think about ordering this during the winter instead of the summer heat unless the seller is including an ice pack. I think you will pay a price in viability if you don't heed this advice.

Because of this, I've upgraded this review from 3 stars to 4 stars.  I'd like to give this jerky a higher score, but getting those occasional rubbery pieces makes me think 4 out of 5 is a fair score.

column9: Last minute disaster--NOT GLUTEN FREE!!! BEWARE!!

He would have been SO sick....and it would have been my fault.PULL THIS FROM GLUTEN FREE PRODUCTS!NOT TO MENTION...I MAKE MY OWN WHEAT LADEN GRAHAM CRACKER CRUSTS....not happy...not happy at all.

I think it's doing its job. They are having fun with it and getting the idea of finding out who did what, with what, and at what time. These pickles are pickled in acetic acid even though the label in English reads brine in large print implying that they are pickled in brine. The can's small print (which is NOT visible in the picture) does report the truth. The use of brine instead of vinegar as a pickling agent results in a tremendous difference in taste. I'm stuck with 12 cans of pickles in vinegar (acetic acid). Vinegar pickles I can get anywhere, and besides I hate the taste of vinegar pickles.I bought these on the strength of the large printed brine on the can. Do NOT buy this brand if you want brined pickles. As vinegar pickles go these are no worse than others of their type.

column9: Square shaped pieces of meat not agreeable with all cats!
column10: I purchased 'Natural Balance 3-Ounce Platefuls Indoor Mackerel and Sardine Formula in Gravy Entree for Cats', but no where was it advertised that the food comes in large square shaped pieces of meat.  I don't know if all their cat food varieties comes in this large square shape or not, but my cats prefer to eat ground meat or meat that comes as a 'pate'.  The Squares of mackerel & sardines are very big and all my cats do is to lick out all the gravy and leave behind most of these squares of food. When you purchase fancy feast cat food, they pretty much tell you what the form of the food is like inside of the can.  So does 9-lives, but unfortunately, 'Natural Balance' did not say this at all.  I recall purchasing mackerel by 'Merrick' as they put in their food actual pieces of 'mackerel' as they come off the fish itself just as 'Petite Cuisine' has flakes of fish in them also.  This my cat loves! But this is not the case with Natural Balance.  It's like the consistency of the meat that you eat when you're eating a 'Gyro'.  I guess my cats are too lazy to chew them, and so I'm stuck with them, as I purchased a case of 24.  I have 3 cats that are indoor cats and one cat that I feed only outdoors because he's feral.Not even my feral cat and his buddy will eat it.  They too just lick out the gravy!Natural Balance is not sold in my neighborhood.  If they were I would have tried out a packet first.  I'm sure that they are a very healthy food, and this food also has a few bits of vegetables in them which my cat did eat since the vegetables appear very small in size.  I was so sure that they were going to be a hit! I'm afraid that I'm a bit disappointed.

My cat turns 19 tomorrow and she has been eating Natural Balance her entire life.  She had her checkup last month and the vet swore she was 5 years old.  She has great teeth, shiny fur and no joint issues.  Prices at Amazon are the best for this product and if you sign up for Prime you get free 2 day shipping.

My kitty eats all the flavors of Natural Balance Platefulls on rotation, and loves all of them equally. He gets dry food in the morning, and a pouch for dinner every night. His coat is GORGEOUSLY soft and shiny, and these pouches don't give him nasty gas or rowdy bad breath like some other canned/pouch foods. When I first opened a pouch, I saw that it had peas and carrots in it, and I figured those would be left behind in the bowl. Cats just...don't eat vegetables. To my surprise, the bowl was licked clean! And after 3 months, he still licks the bowl clean every night!

column9: Chocolate Heresy! Not the same Hershey Cocoa it used to be
column10: I have been buying and using Hershey unsweetened powdered cocoa for over 30 years now.  It was pretty good stuff for the price, and always reliable.  Alas, imagine my dismay to bite into a chocolaty-looking brownie made with the same recipe I've used for years, and taste -- blah.  Blah?  From a BROWNIE?  Gasp!  What was this?  No rich, dark, pungent, distinctly chocolate flavor?  Brown, yes.  Chocolate, barely.  If you'd put a blindfold on me, I'd have been hard put to figure out what I was eating.You know the difference between REAL chocolate and those cheap, waxy brown little fake foil-wrapped abominations you can buy at the discount store to placate the neighborhood trolls every October?  Well, that's the difference between good old reliable Hershey cocoa of yore, and the stuff they're trying to pass off as cocoa now.I was aware that Hershey had removed cocoa butter and other quality ingredients from all their ready-to-eat chocolate products a couple of years ago and replaced them with vegetable shortenings, soy, emulsifiers, and God-knows-what-else.  But I naively thought Hershey cocoa powder had escaped a similar flavor hijacking, chemically-enhanced adulteration.  I was so, so wrong.  The ingredient list says, "COCOA."  Trust me, this is NOT the same cocoa it used to be.  And it's so, so wrong what Hershey has done to it.It's sad when an American tradition falls to the greed of a big corporation cutting corners.

Dutch-processed cocoa is treated with an alkali to neutralize the acid. This jar was tinted dark brown to resemble a dark Manuka honey in the picture, but inside the jar is a plain floral honey which is $5 in value, not a $32.68 per 2 jars as they charge. They took the expensive honey home and selling this one. I also was surprised that they put UMF 5+ (Unique Manuka Factor)-usually no such a low UMF. I felt being cheated! Do not buy this honey!
NO LABEL and I FEEL CHEATED TOO!! I NEED TO LODGE A SERIOUS COMPLAIN and LET my credit cards company to cancel this transaction.DONT TRUST this retailer
This is definately not comvita band , do not choose this item. Although this looks like manuka , but not comvita.
this manuka honey is help me alot for my system, clear out my cought, and my allergy, also my hold family take it, it also help my child for eat

This company is basically selling ordinary honey from bees that may get some of their nectar from the wild-growing manuka plant but that does not make it "Manuka Honey".  "Bio-Active" is not UMF.  A rating of 5 means it's useless anyway. Amazon should refuse to sell this.

Twice in a row I supposed to buy Comvita Manuka Honey, UMF 5+, 2.2-pound Jar, what I got were Manuka Honey Bio Active 5+, 2.2-pound jar, which is cheaper than the UMF 5+, so I don't understand???? Although I bought the UMF 5+ with discount, the end result was I bought the Bio Active 5+ with regular price.The Bio Active 5+ seems still serve the purpose that I want, but I just hate being cheated one way or another!

This excellent product did not last too long around this house. It was used in breads, fudge, cakes, cookies, jam and as a snack. The taste is great and the chunks are sweet and solid. A few sprinkled into oatmeal livens up the breakfast and chopped up make a wonderful sprinkle over ice cream (with hot chocolate sauce). In addition, the self life is superb. I am planning to get some more and have also decided to add it to my emergency supplies. Will recommend this product highly to all who like pineapple or just something sweet.

column9: Probably not authentic, but totally yummy.
column10: My favorite coffe shop uses this brand for their chais that they sell. I used to be able to get Pacific Chai at my grocery store, but they stopped carrying it. Luckily, Amazon to the rescue! I know it's not nutritious but it can warm you up and it is totally delicious. My daughter and I prefer the vanilla flavor, and if you heat up some Silk brand soy milk & blend it with the mix ( instead of the water the label calls for) it is really amazing! Plus, we women need to get our iso-flavanoids, and this is a really yummy way. I've used regular milk too, but believe me, for some reason the soy is so much better. I've even got my totally soya-phobic co-workers drinking it that way, and the owner of the coffe shop actually put soy milk on the menu as an option with the chai. Like my title states, it's probably not authentic chai but it is still super tasty and the spices ( cinnamon, ginger, cloves) are very warming. It's the perfect drink on a cold day or if you have the chills and can't seem to get warm. The label says you can serve it cold but I haven't tried that yet; to me it just seems like a hot drink.The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because the ingredients really do suck- non-dairy creamer w/coconut oil & corn syrup solids. Black tea is waaaay down on the list. But, I just take it for what it is; an occasional indulgence when I crave something hot & sweet & spicy ( of the non-masculine variety! ) to warm me up.

My sister introduced me to vanilla chai several years ago, our favorite being Dunkin Donuts vanilla chai which is no longer available.  We, then, went on a quest to find another "favorite vanilla chai".  We definitely found it in Pacific Vanilla Chai.  While I liked it best when it was available in the striped bags rather than in the canisters (don't know why), it is excellent.  I recommend this beverage to anyone who enjoys tea.  As their slogan says, it really is "the taste of peace and quiet".  Enjoy!

This is the best tea that I have ever had.  The creamy spicy taste is not only FANTASTIC but it smells soooooo good.  It's so hard to find in my city so I order it online.  I just wish that I could get the large canisters but it's no big deal.  I'll take it any way that I can  get it.  I LOVE IT!!!

I've tried other chai's, but this ranks at the top.  My local coffee shop carries this brand, and makes the best drinks from this mix.  If you don't have to worry about calories, it's great with a little milk, ice and ice creme blended with whipped topping on top. In the winter it's my comfort drink with lowfat milk, if I'm having a bad day, this soothes me.  With the 6 canister's it's great to be able to give away 2 or 3 canister's as gifts.

I've been using this product for years - you could say I'm addicted to it! Local stores used to carry it but no more so I'm thrilled Amazon has it. Now if we could just get the 3lb size I'd be in heaven!
Good stuff.  Comparable to Dunkin Donuts, not as frothy, but much cheaper.  Walmart and Market Basket don't always carry it.  This is a great source - Lori.

I have always been a fan of Dunkin Donuts Vanilla Chai Latte. I found Pacific Chai Latte in my super market several years ago and actually like it better than the Dunkin Donuts version. Much to my chagrin, it is no longer available in stores, so when I found it online I was ecstatic. Make a cup with milk and you'll be in heaven.

I have always enjoyed Pacific Chai Latte. Liking my Keurig, I decided to try Cafe Escapes Chai Latte when I saw it. To begin with, I found the Pacific Chai was much creamier than the more watery Cafe Escapes Chai. The amount of spice in the CE Chai was overwhelming in taste, whereas the Pacific Chai spices lent a nice balance to the flavor of the drink. Lastly, I like the granularized honey in the Pacific Chai much more than the Sucralose in the CE Chai, which left a bad aftertaste in my mouth after each sip and required food or brushing teeth to get rid of.Personally, I wouldn't buy or recommend the CE Chai again and highly recommend the Pacific Chai!!

This is the best testing Vanilla chai latte on the market.  I used to love Dunkin Donuts Vanilla chai and stopped drinking it for a long time, because it cost so much to buy a cup everyday and I've tried to find one that was more convenient, where I could make it from home and have a more reasonable price per cup and this is it.  Thank you Amazon for carrying this and at the stellar price you do!

I have trouble sleeping and needed to develope a ritual that helped get me heading in that direction. Pacific Chai Vanilla Latte says it is "the taste of peace and quiet," and that's exactly what it is. It's how I wind down every night. Take a deep breath, have this tea, and everything is right with the world.

After searching for a healthy alternative to grocery store creamers, I settled for the corn syrup solids in the Pacific Chai dry mix found here. The taste is great, and requires a smaller amount of mix to produce a high level taste. The six containers that came in this package were perfect for shipping overseas to a peace Corps volunteer family member in need of a taste from home. Recommended for a better taste in dry mixes than grocery store options commonly found on shelves.

I bought this at my local grocery store hoping it would have the strong chai flavor like the Cafe Escapes Chai Latte K-cups, but it just doesn't. This is good though. I am definitely going to try it with soy milk like one reviewer recommended. Maybe it will have a stronger flavor? Until I can invest in a Keurig, I will still be drinking the Chai Latte K-cups when I am visiting my parents.

column9: Once you try this chai, no other will be good enough
column10: I'm a sucker for chai tea. I saw this drink at my grocery store and bought it just to try it out, I'd never heard of it before. I bought both the Vanilla and the Spice Chai. I went home, made myself a cup, and was absolutely blown away at the amazing flavor. I went back and bought more so I could have some at work, some at home, and some on my motorcycle. I even sent some to my boyfriend in California in a care package (he's in the military and going through training) and now he's hooked on it, too. I love arriving at home, making myself a cup, and relaxing after a day's work. Several months after discovering this treasure, I was out to lunch and realized I wanted some chai tea. I didn't have anymore drink mix with me, so I stopped at my local coffee shop and picked up an iced chai. I've been ruined! I didn't care for the taste of the chai from my coffee shop anymore! I even tried starbucks iced chai and found myself very disappointed in how fake it tasted. Bottom line: nothing compares to the flavor of this chai drink mix. On top of that, there's 13 servings of chai per 10 oz container, which costs about $3.50... I usually pay $3.50 for one small chai from my coffee shop. This drink mix costs about 25 cents per serving. It tastes better and is way more affordable. What more could you ask for?

DH and I both love this chai.  We're used to going to the coffee shop and paying around $8.00 for 2 of them, so this is a bargain.  The flavor is amazing.  We like to add a spoon full of sugar free hot cocoa mix to the mug.  Yum!!  Fortunately, my local store carries this for less than the subscribe and save price, but if they stop selling it, I'll be here buying it with everyone else.

This is by far, one of the best chai lattes I have ever had! It is so delicious, and comforting...like a hug in a cup! It's so good that I would buy it out at the grocery store and finally realized it would be smarter to order it in bulk online!  It's my meditation down-time go-to every night.

This is my favorite chai. It's good and doesn't have cardamom, which can be a bit much. When I add the hot water, I also add some milk so I can drink it faster, which makes it even tastier.It can be expensive in the grocery store. If you get it here, it's more than a dollar saved per canister!

My daughter is away at college and had mentioned that she missed having her Chai tea because she can't store milk at the dorm. Ran across this at the grocery store and figured I would send it. She loved it and wants more. It was perfect for storing because it was dry and with an electric tea pot she can have a nice warm cup of chai anytime she wants. When I found the six pack here on Amazon much cheaper then at the grocery store I knew that this was the item to stock up on. We have tried it at home and it is a nice change from tea.
I have had a lot of chai teas but this is the one the coffee shop at my college uses and it is hands down the best one. mix it with 1/3 hot water and add 2/3 foamed milk on top to get the best taste.

I love the Chi Latte with a little vanilla that I get from Biggby here in Michigan.  The problem is the price.  Duncan Doughnuts makes a good one too.  I read the reviews and decided to try this one.  It's good!  I haven't made it with just water, always with 2%.  It's a good sub, and much cheaper!  Worth the try!

The Pacific Chai Latte mixes, Pacific Chai Vanilla Chai Latte Mix, 10-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6), are delicious and mix easily in hot water.  I have a large cup in the morning and a decaffeinated cup in the afternoon.  It's next to impossible to find in the supermarkets, and when I do find it it is much more expensive than the Amazon price.  I like the variety of flavors, but I usually choose the vanilla chai latte.  I highly recommend it for a comforting warm drink without too much caffeine.

Pacific Chai, particularly the Vanilla Chai Latte, is really the best instant chai I have ever tasted.  I have tried other makes with other flavors when I couldn't find Pacific but they did not match up to the flavor of Pacific.  To enhance a cup of hot chai, I sometimes put some whipped cream on top.  This gives the chai an added creamy smoothness. Yum!

I absolutely love this Chai Latte and I look forward to having my two cups of it every morning. I am on weight watchers and it is only 2 points per cup. The taste is so smooth and soothing and its a great taste to start my day. The price is about average with other same products and well worth paying it.
I bought this for my wife and kids to have in the mornings while we camped this summer. It was great everyone enjoyed it and the easy small tote containers were wonderful for compact packing.
I find the powdered chai tea more convenient than the liquid variety that has to be mixed with milk. This is the best brand thatr I have found to date.

This tea is by far the best vanilla chai latte that I've tasted.  Ordering here saves a substantial amount of money over buying at my grocery store.  Also, some places that do carry it are always out of stock.
This is a great product to try. It's like hot chocolate with a mixture of chai tea and spices. I highly recommend it!
This stuff is hard to find in the "real world," so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon, and with free shipping, too! It is delicious!
I used to be able to purchase this at our local supermarkets, but none of them carry it anymore.My husband loves this chai and I'm glad I'm able to purchase it for him at Amazon.

column9: My favorite energy drink bar none
column10: This stuff is straight up delicious. It has no syrupy feel or taste like most energy drinks. It tastes largely of lemonade with strong hints of black tea. Perfect start to the day, I usually drink one about an hour into my work shift. Very low calorie but full of taste.As of writing all the Amazon sellers are asking absurd prices. Try to find this at a local convenience store. The main brand of gas station around me sells it 2/$3.50. This particular listing is the best price since it has Amazon Prime/Super Saver shipping but it is still a fair bit more expensive than finding it in a store.

It's non-carbonated so its easier to drink and it tastes great. It goes great with almost any type of meal unlike red bull or most carbonated drinks which taste terrible. I use the 23 ounce can for a 12 hour shift night shift and it definitely helps. On my non work days I like to mix it with my orange juice in the morning. This is the only energy drink I really like.

I don't live in the middle od nowhere, but you can see it from here. So having an Anazoon Partner deliver a product on a regular schedule is nice. The cans come well packed, on time, and cheaper thanbif I had to fetch them in town. Well done.
This tea is delicious, I loved it, my friends came to my house and also loved ... the experience is refreshing and tulle tea bags are beautiful ... Marcelo's wife...

column9: Good for if you're in a bind...
column10: This is a good product to buy if you're in a bind and need a Mexican sugar skull shipped to your door very quickly (which for some weird reason I did). It arrived within 2 days and was well packed and nothing on it was broken. The product description picture is essentially what you get, I was hoping that the one that I got would have been a little more creatively designed, but it wasn't. It's just a sugar skull with a few random squirts of colored icing squirted all over the top of its head.
It is crafted just like it is in Mexico. But how big is it? It has scribly icing on its head. I mean come on put a little crafts work into it. And that much money for something that small.

This is great for better blood circulation and very healthy in my opinion,great taste,it makes me wish they were at least 6 ounces! My guests look at me strange seeing it and ask joking, if I had done something bad.I explain to them it is not for drugs or products that are sold for that but to help clean toxins and help ciculation as I am a diebetic and hope to improve my health in every way possible,they smile and so Oh.lol.Electrolytes,dandelion root and grape seed extract,great mixture!

column9: Great Italian dressing, also a great marinade
column10: We've been using Ken's dressings for some time now, expanding to try new ones as they become available in our area.  check around locally as shipping costs can make these heavy items often more expensive to ship, I love it when Amazon picks them up and fulfills them directly.This is one of my favorite dressings, especially for use as a marinade.  I put my chicken or steak in a marinade container, cover it with this dressing, sprinkle on some Monterey Steak Seasoning and let it sit for a day or two in the Fridge.  When we BBQ the meat, it's really tender and tastes great.  This is a very tasty dressing, you'll like it.5 stars, great tasting and a wonderful marinade.

column9: Cheaper just to go to Wegman's or something.
column10: If you have a nostalgia store (or other shop that might have nostalgia candy), go there. For $18, you don't get a whole lot of candy. Yeah, some of it is really fantastic and delicious, but it seems to have just been repackaged from recent productions of the candy. The box is also somewhat small and contains that crinkle paper confetti stuff for effect (I guess?), but it takes up a lot of space in the box.In all: I wish there was enough candy to justify paying $18 for it, but there really wasn't.

I received my first shipment of a monthly subscription order of the Whole Grain Hot Cereal.  These are absolutely wonderful!  When cooked, they have the consistency of grits, and well, they are! Whole grain grits (cereal)!  The cooking instructions call for salt to taste, but I also suggest a bit of butter or margarine.  Maybe some fresh fruit slices and you got a yummy breakfast!HIGHLY Recommended!  I'm keeping my monthly subscription for sure!

Received this in good time, personally haven't gotten to try it yet due to diet but hubby has and really likes it.  He can't eat oatmeal and this is a great breakfast replacement for him.  Large package is perfect for us living in a very rural area and all we have to do is put it into smaller containers for keeping it fresh.  Want to try their other flours and mixes soon.  We started their 'auto' program to have this sent every few months so we will never run out.  The company has good communications also.
It is wonderful to be able to find organic sunflower seeds that are raw as most are roasted in oil ad heavily salted.

Veja-Links taste like real weiners. They are a little softer than a real weiner, but not as soft as Loma Linda Big Franks. Also, they nor real weiners have the savory flavor of Big Franks to me. Some people don't like their veggie dogs soft. For those who want their veggie dog to taste exactly like the real thing, I would reccomend another product from this same company - Morning Star Farms veggie dogs. They're in the frozen breakfast section of your local grocery store. They are firm just like real weiners and they have the exact same taste. However, I prefer Big Franks to both of these veggie dogs.

column9: If you're jonesin' for a hot dog
column10: These vegetarian "hot dogs" are really good. They have the right texture, which most tofu dogs and the like don't have at all. The seasoning is very good too. They stay firm boiled or grilled, although you cook them less than a product containing meat. They only have 50 calories each, and 3 grams of fat, only 0.5 grams of that is saturated. They have 0 cholesterol and 0 trans fats. They only have 180 mg of sodium. If you're doing Dr. Fuhrman's "Eat to Live" and you're just going nuts for some meat, try grilling one of these babies and slap it on a whole wheat pita bread. It will kill those cravings and keep you from doing something you'll regret.

Vegi-Links are a delicious subtitute for meat hotdogs.  They are the best flavored and textured of any products I have used.  Grill, fry or microwave, put on a bun with your favorite condiments and you are sure to enjoy.  Kids of all ages love them also.

I've been an ethical vegetarian for 35 years, but I still "like" the taste of meat. These hot dogs are the best vegetarian dogs I have tasted - on a warm bun, with good mustard and whatever else - they are delicious!

My husband was adament that he wouldn't like this "fake" meat.  He LOVED it.  I love it.  Of couse it tastes nothing like real meat but it is delicious and is a great source of protein.  If you want to reduce your fat intake and animal protein you will really love this product.  I could sit and eat this product right out of the can.

I ordered these when I found out the Morningstar Farms veggie dogs are no longer available.  After reading about 100 reviews, I decided to try this variety.  We have been vegetarian for 12 years, so I am used to the faux meats.  Some I like, some I don't.  I LOVED Morningstar Veggie dogs, they were my absolute favorite.  Most veggie dogs in the refrigerated section of the grocery store have a ton of onion in them!  These Veja-dogs are OK on taste, but I do not like the texture.  It is A LOT like that of a hard boiled egg white.  When I first got one out of the can I did not want to even try one.  It was squishy and had tiny dark brown spots.  The syrupy stuff they are stored in really grossed me out too.  I have eaten about 5 now and am still not crazy about them.  My son however LOVES them.  He says they are his favorite.  I will try another Worthington veggie dog (Super Links or linkettes) before giving up on the "canned" dogs all together.  I hate onions, but I prefer the texture of the tofu dogs found in the grocery store.

I was very happy with my product. It was shipped very quickly and packed well.  I saved a lot of money on this product too because the canned vegetarian products are only sold at one store within a 40 mile radius of my house and they rape you on the price!!  (around 7-8 dollars per can)

We discovered Veja-links while we were doing a 6 weeks camping trip from MI to CA and as many national parks we could hit in that time.  V_L saved our dinner problems many times--like when we got into the park after dark and needed to eat and get the tents up.  We ate them cold mixed with vegetarian beans (no pork).  They are a great quickie meal when we are doing a 70 hour work week, great on a bun with sourkraut, or toppings and pickles, or just the kiddie standard of ketchup.  Grilled in the summer is good too for a different taste.  We buy by the case, they don't last long around here.  Enjoy!Diane Kalata

Veja-Links are a soy "hot dog" that is a nice alternative to the real thing.  I really like to use them to make a spread.  Boiled eggs, onion, relish and ground up Veja-links makes a good sandwich spread.  You can grill them or make pigs-in-a-blanket just like you would with real hot dogs.  The one thing that is different is no animal "by products" whatever that means.

Veja-Links are great as are most of the Worthington products.  There was a time when it was difficult to find these products but then Kellogg bought the company along with Morningstar Farms and the products were available. Then Amazon started selling them but something happened.Although Amazon lists 20 Worthington brands, at present they offer only two.  You might want to search for 7th Day Adventist bookstores which also sell Worthington.

Our family loves all of the Worthington/Loma Linda products, but I was concerned about meatless hot dogs since I think most of them remind me of  Play Doh.  Fortunately, the Veja Links are very tasty and they are nice and firm like real hot dogs.  Buying these cases from Amazon Grocery is a nice deal, too.  I hope they continue to carry them!

For a vegetatian "hot dog" these are the best in taste. Some others have a very unpleasant taste, however good for you they are, my only hope is that Amazon continues to carry these and other Worthingtn and Loma Linda products. These are great because you need not freeze or refigerate them. You only need to open the can that will store for a long time on the shelf.

These were really awful. After reading the great reviews on the worthing vegetarian hot dogs and meat I was real hopeful, but they were just gross. We do love the morning star veggie dogs though. They taste a lot closer to the real thing. These veggie dogs were very mushy and just broke in half when I tried to take them out of the can. Very disappointing. We are a vegetarian family of 6 and no one would eat them.

column9: One of the best veggie hot dogs out there
column10: Worthington Leanies are the best veggies hot dog IMHO.  But they aren't widely available. Veja-Links is the next best choice.  Pleasant hot dog taste with the right texture.  They grill up nice and will get that crusty outside.  There are 10 in a can and they are only about 5 inches long so I often use one and a half in bun.  Only 50 calories a link.  We buy a case at the beginning of summer and eat all them summer long.
By way if the Worthinton web site I found vega links on Amazon.  Eureka!!  I never knew.I wish I didn't have to order a case, but very happy with a childhood favorite

I have been eating veja-links for over 12 years. I have ate them since I was about 7. They are great, I can no longer eat real hot dogs because they taste gross now. Veja-links have totally ruined them for me and that I am glad! Pop open the can and eat them cold or warm them up (boil, microwave, grill, etc.) I love them on a hot dog bun with ketchup and real mayonaise. It will not disappoint!

column9: Makes your mouth Blue but really Yummy!
column10: This is a good syrup with excellent flavor! Worth the tinting of blue left on your mouth:O)

I have been a huge fan of Jelly Bellys since I was a kid, which was about 25 years ago.  I have always had a favorite.  At first it was peach, then banana.  Juicy pear came along and that was my favorite for about ten years.  I thought nothing would top it, ever.  Then I tried red apple.  It is sweet and tart and really delicious, my new favorite flavor.  A ten pound box is surprisingly tempting and I am sorry they are currently all sold out.

column9: A Surprising Blend of Bean and Apple
column10: I wasn't sure what to expect from this Jelly Belly flavor. I have eaten "red apples" before but they were usually in a fruit. This was a candied bean with "red apple" flavors put inside. Despite the obvious witchcrafts, I tried this confection because I am not afraid of the unknown like so many people in the RELIGIOUS RIGHT (WRONG). I was surprised to find that this "red apple" had a delicious apple-like flavor and a chew not unlike a finely prepared hamsteak. Would I eat more of these? Yes, I would. I would also recommend this "red apple" to anybody who is adventurous and wants to experience a new and exciting way to feel the best parts of the fruit eating process. RED APPLE JELLY BEANS, THEY DO TASTE LIKE APPLES KIND OF BUT NOT COMPLETELY. STILL PRETTY GOOD.

column9: beware of hot weather with this product
column10: I recently purchased this product (not here but at walmart where it is $6 a box not $10) for a cake I was making for a friend.  I usually do cakes in butter cream and fondant but she wanted whipped icing.  Anyway,  I did a test batch a week before and it was really good.  The icing came out fluffy and stiff enough for icing and piping. It held up really well in the fridge for several days.  However the day of the cake it was a very hot day and not having air conditioning, my kitchen was very warm.  The icing completely collapsed despite several tries with several batches, freezing the bowl and mixer whisk, ice applied to the bowl, and extended whipping,  I could not get it to stiffen.  It was a soft, runny mess and did not make for nice icing.  I was unable to pipe with it at all. So if you purchase this just keep that in mind.  I still prefer buttercream but the taste is creamy and less sweet that buttercream if that is what you prefer.

My dogs love these treats. Most bones they are able to soften and swallow which leads to them choking, but these break off nicely so they can eat the bone little bits at a time. The "chips" kept them busy for hours and they didn't hurt their stomach which is always a plus. You also get a good amount of bones for the price. I will definitely be buying these again!
I like many of the Dr. McDougall soups, but this has a strange, slightly chemical nasty flavor.

column9: Low Sodium just means smaller portion
column10: ALL of Dr. McDougall's "low sodium" versions are just smaller containers and portions...I've been a big supporter of their products over the years and this tactic really disappoints me.

column9: I like this soup, and it's the perfect size
column10: First, about the size.  This smaller cup is the perfect portion size for soup.  When I first bought Dr McDougalls years ago, all the choices were in this size, I believe.  Anyway, I THINK it says light sodium because they reduced how much sodium they used to put in it, or because compared to other brands it is pretty light.Second, I really like the taste of this soup, and don't find it horrid at all.  I realize that different folks have different tastes--which is why they make so many choices.  I can't stomach the Pad Thai, for instance, but I truly like this soup.  I usually steam some stir fry veggies in the microwave and eat them along with this soup.  Love it.  I am aware that the soup contains miso powder, which may not be everyone's cup of tea. Look at the ingredients and decide for yourself.If you aren't sure, you could always go to Whole Foods or someplace where they sell these products one at a time to find your faves.

This is not chicken noodle soup. It has no chicken flavor because its not supposed to taste anything like chicken... its CHINESE noodle soup.  Chinese. Asian.  Says so right on the page.  Goodness people, if you want Dr. McDougall's (vegan)CHICKEN noodle soup go get that instead..

This is the third soup Ive tried from Dr.Mcdougall's line and I really enjoyed it. It has great flavor, and fills me up. I love these products, you feel better eating these than Ramen or Instant noodle cups that are so bad for you and have so many strange ingredients. I will be trying others and more of these as well. I'd rather pay a little extra then pay extra down the line on my waist line.
The doctors put me on a low sodium diet and this soup fits into the bounds of my diet.  I like the taste and convience.  I do however, put everything into a microsafe container to stop any boilover.

These are good.. takes getting used to if you aren't used to healthy vegan food..  I don't like it as much as some other products I've used that this company has.....  I will have to try some of the other ones to remember which were the beat...

I've tried several of Dr. McDougall's Vegan soups.  My husband and I both like this one. The suggested microwave and standing times worked.  (For many of the soups these required some trial and error.)

To say these are great as soups would be an exaggeration but for instant cups-of-soup, very nice. As a vegetarian I hugely appreciate having access to the same sorts of lunchbox extras and quickie-meals that meat eaters seem to have in spades, but for me, without the meat. Thank you thank you thank you.

Okay first, I'll admit, I have no idea what I thought this "should" taste like. I guess like chicken, only not, but then I don't even really remember what real chicken soup tastes like anymore since I haven't eaten chicken in 5+ years now.But anyway, I tried this and thought it was just nasty. column9: Low Sodium means smaller portion size

column9: G R E A T.....H E R R I N G......B U T.....I ....P R E F E R.....M I N E.....I N....S O U R.....C R E A M
column10: When I was growing up, medium-sized bottles of herring in sour cream were a staple.  I was was aware of herring in wine sauce....but my parents never bought it.  I have searched for herring in sour cream here on Amazon, to no success as yet.  However, I DID find these BAR HARBOR WILD HERRING FILLETS IN CABERNET WINE SAUCE here on Amazon, and decided to try them.I never knew that herring was such a dry fish!  The wine sauce inside the can is plentiful -- but it still doesn't take away all of the dryness.  There is a goodly amount of wine sauce -- but not so much that it will spill out of the can when opened.  If you are careful opening the can, spilling of the wine sauce IS preventable.  (It's a little difficult for me, at least, to open the can by the pull-tab.  So far, I have had four of the twelve cans in the shipment -- and had to use a can-opener to open each one.)The good news about the sauce, aside from it's delicious taste, is that it has enough time, in the the can, to permeate the fish, with some of the sauce still left over.  As I have mentioned, the sauce doesn't take away ALL the dryness -- but it does take a bit away, and so the over-abundance of wine sauce IS a good idea.  A doubly-good idea, I think, is to DRAIN the sauce which has not permeated the fish, (before eating the fish), into a small container, and keep it in the refrigerator.  Then, you can use it for various other things -- such as adding it to tuna fish, as I have done.  Then, the tuna becomes tastier, and you can leave out the mayonnaise, (which is mostly oil anyway), and get a richer tuna flavour, possibly with fewer calories!These "Bar Harbor Herring Filets in Cabernet Wine Sauce" have the OU stamp of approval from the Orthodox (Jewish) Union, so preumably the cabernet wine, (listed in the next-to-the-last position in the ingredients), is KOSHER caberbet wine -- although the word "kosher" is not found in front of this ingredient.This product is "sustainably harvested from the clear cold waters of the Gulf of Maine".  It is also stated that it is a "Product of Canada". On the back of the cardboard sleeve encasing each tin, it is stated: "Produced in Canada, for Bar Harbor Foods, Whiting Maine, 04691 USA....."  This may confuse some people, (it confuses me a lot)...but I prefer to consider it a happy product, jointly produced by two of the greatest countries in the world!  Whatever you may think of my opinion, you must admit that it's nice to find a product produced ANYWHERE else than in China, these days!Eating four cans of these herring fillets, (6.7 ounces, 190 grams each), in two days,says I like them -- and I do.  They even have aslight, very tasty smoky flavour -- without any liquid smoke listed amongst the ingredients!  (As liquid smoke -- along with, (darn!), so many other things that taste SO good -- is rumoured to be cancer-causing, this is certainly a good thing!)  But the fish is, as I have said, semi-dry....in spite of the wine sauce in which the fish comes, and in which it is saturated.  These fillets in cabernet wine sauce ARE delicious -- but I do wish I could also find herring fillets in sour cream, that I grew up with.  A different flavour, and not, perhaps to everyone's taste -- but at least herring fillets in sour cream are NOT at all dry.

column9: Best HOT Chinese Mustard ever made!!!!!
column10: If you love "HOT" chinese mustard, you will love this stuff.  I was paying almost $6 a container in the stores until they stopped making it.  The powder goes a long way for the price and its the only true Chinese Mustard that I've been able to find!Thank you S&B!

He is simply wild over this stuff.  Uses to make homemade hot mustard chex mix...on popcorn...not even counting all the other random uses he finds.Too hot for me (but I am a wimp when it comes to "hot" foods....but if you like the heat, you will love it.
I just love my Laffy Taffy and in all flavors but strawberrys just keeps my mouth watering for more...can't wait till I order cherry next time..

I have always had a sweet tooth and this is some of the best taffy I've tried.  Any candy this delicious and fresh is a sure hit with those that can enjoy it. My package didn't stand a chance of lasting very long. Highly recommended to any taffy enthusiast!
It was like a desert in my mouth, each piece greedily siphoning moisture through the process of osmosis. Would not buy again.
I got an expired pack which tasted sour, but Amazon was nice enough to have them replaced for me. I have had more than 20 packs of this brand, and love the peppered taste.

There is no fat in any of the pieces. If you are an extremely picky person, you will find flaws in ANYTHING! Nothing is perfect, but this is close.

This beef jerky is not bad for the price. It's pretty tasty and tender.I like the peppered flavor and have re-ordered this item several times.

column10: Our "kids", one American and one Bristish cocker spaniel love these.  We referred to them as toothbrushes and they get one every morning as per our vets advice. Hi,  I am a HUGE Root Beer Fanatic.  I have always loved the Natural, micro brew, old fashioned root beers.  But for some reason the root beer I liked the best was Boylan's Root beer which ironically is an artificial root beer.  Then one day I was strolling throught the soda section of my local health food store looing for some natural root beers when I stumbled upon Boylan's "The Natural Kind" Root Beer.  I almost fainted right there in the aisle!  It was my favorite root beer only better! it was made micro-brew style with REAL ingredients.  Then for about 2 months I was constantly in and out of the store getting that root beer.  I was just like the Boylan's root beer that I had come to love only it was, as I said above, better!  First of all, the second you taste the root beer you can tell the quality of craftsman-ship that went into making the root beer.  The root beer is creamy and velvetly smoothe.  It just slides down your throat.  The amazing thing is that you then notice that it is definitley the signature Boylan's cane sugar root beer flavor.  The flavor is deep and complex but mild.  I know this sounds contradictory but you'll understand when you taste it for yourself.  Then something terrible happened.  I was going into the store to get my weekly bottle only to find that the store had discontinued the root beer.  I was so upset I seriously almost cried.  But then I have discoverd that Amazon.com sells it.  I can't stress to you enough how much I like this root beer.  -Desty

Since January this year I've been taste-testing a number of different root beers and related beverages (birch beers, sarsaparillas, even a spruce beer--ick!) Some are available here at Amazon, others not.But Bolyan's Natural has beaten them all for the top spot in my reorder list.Saranac, with its unique chocolate notes (also available through Amazon), comes in a close second. And I'm very fond of Barrel Bros, Capt'n Eli's, and Jackson Hole (normal root beers); also of Rhode Island Molasses (more of an earthy, smoky tasting sarsaparilla) and Bundaberg (basically their unique ginger beer modified into a sarsaparilla). I'll be reordering some of these again, too.But Boylan's, with its careful approach of combining birch oils (not nearly as overpowering as their straight-up birch beer), sassafras, vanilla, and basically everything else on which various root beer variants are based, has formulated a root beer that incorporates a little of everything in just the right amounts to be tasted without anything overwhelming anything else.Well done Boylan. Expensive, but well done. {g}

Frankly, I could care less if you don't like this review.  This natural root beer is delicious.  Smooth taste and low carbonation. Glides across the tongue and down the throat.  And, on its way down to your stomach you can taste every molecule of this natural root beer soda. Pop the top and pour this amazing root beer into a freezing cold mug over ice. Life is good with Boylan's Natural Root Beer.
