I used to LOVE the cappuccino coolers, and when they were discontinued I was upset. When I first tried the new iced latte, I added a little vanilla milk to make it taste more like the original. Now I am used to the taste and love these! I'd still buy the cappuccino, though, if I could. =D

This is probably the best iced coffee you will ever find (if you like tasty coffee, and not bitter black coffee). However... this place is kind of high, you can get it at Walmart online for $1.78. At the store I think it's about the same. But you can also get two boxes for I think $2.30. So I don't think I'll be buying this from Amazon... unless Walmart doesn't have any.

The item was what i expected. It came as a reasonable price and came within in the time period that was stated. I would truely recommend this its cheaper then buying a latte a your local cafe, starbucks, and dunkin donuts. You save a bunch of money.

Hi! If you have a Walmart, they have these for $1.80 a box. Please don't buy such a cheap item such as this and pay double price or more plus crazy amount for shipping. That is unless you live three hours away from the nearest grocery store, then go ahead.This iced coffee is surprisingly good and can be addictive. It is a little sweet and mild coffee flavor. It's nice to have for days when you don't want to go to the drive through for an iced coffee. Highly recommended. Great flavor.

I bought this item 2 weeks ago...first I am 48 yrs old..never had puffiness till about 6 months ago. I thought it was allergies... NOPE! I have bought several different items...from several manufacturers. Most have not worked. I read the reviews for this product and thought why not..it is a good price.Yes there is a smell to it but I did not even notice the "coffee smell" until about the 3rd time of using it. It does not bother me and I feel it does not last "that" long. I am however a disappointed in my results. Yes it did reduce the puffiness "some" but not as much as I was hoping for. I know it will never go away totally but was hoping for better results. It is a wonderful moisturizer !! I do notice a little greasiness but just cut down on your amount you are using.
This eye cream smells great and I believe it freshens up the face providing moisture and energy. Use it every morning and night and it's a great way to start my day.

When I first bought this my eye bags were pretty bad.  After about 1 week of use I saw a noticible difference.  If I could get more sleep, I'm sure I would see a bigger difference.  I will purchase again.  You won't be unhappy if you try this product.
Been using this item for about a year now, and I am happy with the outcome.  Great for under eye and crows feet due to aging.  Goes on smoothly.

column9: Although I haven't seen too many results yet, it's still a great moisturizer
column10: I've been using this stuff for around 3 or 4 weeks now.  I haven't seen any visible improvements in the dark circles under my eyes.  I don't really have crows feet or bags under my eyes (with or without cream) so I can't say how it would work with firming the skin.  As far as minimizing the appearance of fine lines - it accomplishes that as well as any moisturizer I have tried.That being said, it is a wonderful light weight cream.  It has a delicate scent that isn't overwhelming.  It doesn't contain any perfumes, but I think it smells a bit like milk chocolate.  I also like the fact that it is a natural product and I'm not risking my health when using it.

I've used Pure Caffeine Eye Cream for a little over a year now and I love it.  I wake up with some slight bagginess under my eyes, but I apply this when I step out of the shower and the bagginess disappears.  I also have some lines and wrinkles at the corners of my eyes (I laugh a lot) and they are not as pronounced.

I love this stuff. I have really dry skin around my eyes. I use this and then Clinique All About Eyes gel-cream over it. The Caffeine Eye Cream absorbs very well, is not sticky and de-puffs right away.

column9: Good product at a good price
column10: This scrumptious smelling eye cream really perks up my under-eye area in the mornings. I also apply it at night before I go to bed. It works well under makeup as well. I agree with the other reviews about the pump expelling too much lotion at a time. I just twist off the top and get the lotion off the pump; a little goes a long way.

I just got this product the other day..while I know I should probably wait a week or so to write a review on this, I can't help but note that so far this product feels great!  I had really puffy allergy eyes; this product makes the skin around my eyes SUPER soft and fine lines don't look as noticeable.  I like the hint of coffee smell. Its not overpowering at all. Even if you don't like the smell of coffee, I don't foresee it being an issue with this product.  I've used it both at night and during the day.  I woke up in the morning with less puffy eyes; I didn't feel an immediate "tightening" feeling like i have with other products such as the garnier nutritioniste anti-puff eye roller..but I also found I needed to reapply that throughout the day. So far the "anti-puff" effect of this product lasts through the majority of my work day.  Also, this is a great product for applying concealer.  I use Bare Escentuals (powder makeup) and this product allowed for a primer-like base for applying the powder concealer.  All in all I would recommend this product.  I only gave it 4 stars because I don't think I waited long enough to write a review.

I bought this product, not sure what to expect.  I quickly found that it caused irretation and sat on top of the skin.  I had to stop using it, and didn't mind because I didn't like that it felt oily on my skin.  As an alternative, I opted for the olay eye roller.  Maybe I am an isolated case and this doesn't bother other people, but for me, this product was no good (but it did smell nice).

I received this product so quickly, just a few days after I placed my order.  And I even got free samples too.  Cool.  I was anxious to test it out.  Even though I have only been using it a few days, I love it.  I just use a little dab under my eyes and they feel refreshed.  It was all-natural, inexpensive, and I really like the scent too. I would recommend this product.

I really like this product, it goes on really nice & I love the smell.  I find it soothing using it.  I use it all over my face not just under my eyes.  Wish it came in a larger size.  On my third tube:)

Hello guys...I recently bought this item. I have a deep dark circles on my face  which are like really dark. I am most likely to buy natural and organic products. So I ran into this item while googling. After reading all the reviews I have decided to buy it. I am using this item since a month. I can't really see any change instead it leaves my eyes reddish in color. May be it doesn't suits for me. Even if it works for anyone else. But it's not worth the given price

I've just started using this, so it is too early to say if it is firming under my eyes.However, I do really dislike the pump mechanism for this...it spits out 3 days worth of product, no matter how careful you are.  They need a pump that puts out far less or at least lets you control the output better.

I have to admit, I don't track the results, so who knows if it's working, but I have no complaints.  It also smells amazing and the consistency is good. My only issue is that the pump is stiff, so you either end up getting nothing, or spilling out far more than you could ever use on two eyes in just one pump.  I feel like i put more energy into dispensing it than anything else.  Otherwise though, no complaints.

Wrapables was very helpful and thorough in responding to my concerns! After I had some difficulties with the Coffee Bean Caffeine Eye Cream from 100% Pure, I sought to return the product and was frustrated when I could not return it. The company immediately contacted me and indicated that they would reimburse me due to my special circumstances (specifically, my skin reaction to the product). They credited my account quickly and were very helpful in this process!

I bought this as it came in a pack with the mascara and as it turned out I liked it more than the mascara. It is great stuff. It smells to me like baking cookies. Every time I put it on my husband asks me if I am baking something. It has such a yummy smell. It is so smooth and goes on great. I recommend this product for anyone looking for a good face cream.

column9: for price, this is a top facial moisurizer
column10: Pure products as a whole are five stars, and for an eye cream, this is good, just not sure I would order it again.  If you use this as an all-over face moisturizer, I find this to be great!  This might be end up in my top favorite facial moisturisers but not specifically for my eye area.  I would rotate this product with other products depending on how my skin is on certain days.For the price, this is a very good product and good for days where you want to go natural.  I would only recommend using it as a total-face moisturizer rather than just and eye area because it absorbs well, and has a better effect on the entire face as it does not cause breakouts, helps fine lines, and is not overly oily (I have combination-oily skin.)I don't like the coffee smell (and I love coffee) but as with all Pure products, the ingredients are wonderful and I would take that any day over an artificial fragrance or modified ingredient.This is a good alternating facial cream, I don't use it everyday, but when I do, I have good results with no irritation or negative effects, and that is saying a lot for me because my skin breaks out easily with pretty much any facial cream.If you go to the Pure website, they give a lot of free products away on orders, so if you are ordering more than one item, I recommend buying direct.
Does not have any effect on puffiness or dark circles.  Used it twice a day for thirty days.  Not worth the time and the smell really bothered me.

It doesn't smell like coffee, it doesn't smell like vanilla , it doesn't smell like cookies.  The smell is disgusting.  I could be more desciptive but I realize I am with polite company. And on top of that , it does not do anything for my bags under my eyes.  Don't waste your money!

I really do swear by this stuff.  I use it as my daytime moisturizer under makeup.  It is silky smooth, highly emollient, absorbs easily, and actually takes away puffiness and visibly reduces lines almost instantly.  I'm not a coffee lover, but the scent is very light and actually reminds me more of chocolate than it does coffee. A little goes a long way, but don't worry if you use a bit too much as its equally effective on those fine lines across the bridge of the nose and around the lips. Don't waste it.  I don't use it for night as I'm not worried how puffy or wrinkled I look once I've washed off my makeup and would rather save it for daytime. So for those asking "Does this stuff really work?", I can honestly say YES!

Some reviewers said this product smelled too much like coffee but I don't find it overwhelming at all. I really like the way this feels and I have noticed my skin looks better around my eyes since I started using it. I also just saw on Dr. Oz that eye cream with caffeine is the way to go so I'm glad I chose this product. I would definitely buy it again and the fact that it is all organic and natural is awesome. Highly recommend.

I have horrible, huge bags and dark circles under my eyes and have all my life (I'm 59 years old).  I've toyed with the idea of plastic surgery and then decided to give this a try.  Within two or three days I saw a HUGE difference.  I use it not only under my eyes but above on the eyelid.  It does smell a bit different but it's so creamy and absorbs quickly. You only need a tiny bit!  I use it in the morning and at night and highly recommend this product.  What a find!!!!!

Puffiness under your eyes:  not desirable, even embarassing.  This puffiness is caused by a genetic condition or more likely fluid retention due to environmental factors, i.e., sun, pollution, or lifestyle such as too much sodium in the diet, not enough sleep, stress, ageing.... Skin around the eyes is delicate and should be treated with respect.  Better than tea bags and cucumber slices, Coffee Bean Eye Cream smooths on gently, and is Organic with no harsh chemicals or Parabins to be absorbed through the skin.I tried several products with poor results and thought I would always be plagued by this.  However this product works even when I have too much salt or not enough sleep.  I use it daily and am completely satisfied with it.  Perfect!

I usually hate cream. I hate putting creams and oily junk on my face. I dont ever put sun screen on my face. Im latin and we dont need extra oil. But as I get older Im starting to see more crows by my eyes and smile lines. So Im trying to break my bad habit of not using creams. If youre like me me when it comes to creams and lotions, then this is the product for you. I really like this product. The smell is a little weird but its not bad. I dont drink coffee and think the smell can be overwhelming some times but it doesnt smell like coffee. Its mild and goes away within a few minutes. It feels good and Ive noticed a difference around my eyes. Really good product and a even better price!!Update: after a few months of using this product I realized why I wasnt sleeping very well. Its coffee, Duh! I dont drink coffee or do caffeine. Its also started burning a bit in my eyes area. If you dont have issues with caffeine, this is great- but if you do, might want to stay away from this product.

column9: A little goes a long way
column10: I purchased this from the 100% pure website directly.  They offer free shipping on orders over $50 and free samples with all orders.  I decided to purchase from this company since many of their products are organically certified (the only certification available in the world of cosmetics), so I trusted their composition.This eye creme is a little thick, as the previous reviewer noted.  However, when you pump it, it comes out in a needle -thin string of creme that is easy to apply!  It blends in very well.  You don't need much at all.  I don't even use a full pump for both eyes!  Any excess, I just rub on my hand since it's silky smooth.  The only thing that I'm not crazy about is the smell.  It's not quite coffee; it reminds me of a cookie.  It smells good, but it's not something that I enjoy smelling every morning.  But it's much better than having fragrances added to the product!  (That's my reason for 5-stars instead of 4-stars.)I don't use the creme at night, so I don't have the same problem as the other reviewer.  However, it is always a good idea to keep ALL cosmetics out of the eye!  Any cosmetic/creme (natural or not) is not healthy for the eye, and the reaction will naturally be adverse since the eye is trying to 'fight the invader.'

This really works!! Within a week I noticed a huge difference in my under eye circles. I work night shift and I usually do not get enough sleep. I bought a very expensive La Mer The Eye Concentrate and used it twice a day for 4 months with no improvement. In fact they were getting worse!!! Out of desperation I searched Amazon and based on the reviews bought 100% Pure. I am sold for life. My little wrinkles are also becoming less noticeable. The smell is fine, honestly it could smell like a sewer and I would still put it on because it works. It is so refreshing to buy a product that delivers on their claims. Thank you :-)

I've been using this product for about a month and do see some improvement in the dark circles and puffiness under my eyes. I have chronically 'clogged' sinuses, so I was happy to find something that seems to alleviate the resulting darkess/swelling I get from this. Hopefully as I continue to use this product, I'll see even more improvement. It is also very gentle--some products have caused redness and irritaion around my eyes. And I like the scent--reminds me of cocoa butter.

column9: Reduced my puffy eyes in minutes
column10: Cream goes on thick and rich and in a matter of minutes did reduce the puffiness under my eyes.It does smell a little like cookies but if it helps my puffy eyes I don't mind at all. My eyes are usually puffy due to allergies/sinus so I will probably be using it pretty often.

I fortunately bought the MINI version of this off their website and am so glad I did! I will probably ONLY buy it in this form as it is super easy to push out of the tube. (I only note this as reading other reviews regarding the pump) The product smells exactly like their Tahiti line of body products; which makes me happy every time I use it. (sort of like vanilla coffee) I have noticed a huge difference in my eyes and am really thankful for this product. My small lines seem to disappear and the product sinks right into my under eye area. I even put it on the eyelids. I swear my under eyes look brighter and I don't even need to use my concealer! I had been using Origins similar product to no avail and decided to try this. SUPER GLAD I DID! I would recommend it in the small version (cheaper too!) to try it out. I love 100% Pure and all their products!

column9: 100% Pure Cosmetics - Organic Coffee Bean Eye Cream
column10: Organic Coffee Bean Eye Cream - is a complete waste of money. I have used this product for 3 (three) weeks, no change in the puffiness.

I keep mine in the fridge to last long and am happy to say that I have used this product for about three years. It really lightens the dark circles under my eyes and is a essential part to my daily beauty regime. You only need to use a little bit per application so it really lasts you a long time before you have to buy another one.

Not a huge fan of this eye cream. It takes forever to dry so its not as practical in the morning when I am in a hurry and don't have so much time to wait. Putting on makeup when its still wet is not pretty under the eyes, which defeats the point of using the cream. It works better as a nite treatment. Haven't noticed any dramatic improvements so far in reducing puffiness and dark circles. Its also quite oily. One pump delivers way too much cream also. Would not purchase again.

I am extremely disappointed in this product.  It didn't come with directions, when I first tried to get any of this out of the tube the right way, the bottom of the plastic tube broke open, so I could never use this properly, and the bags under my eyes are just as big as before.  I would never recommend this to anyone, and I wonder if it worked for other women who bought it because of The Dr Oz show.

I love this product.  It smells sooooooo good.  It goes on very easily and the texture is very smooth.  It absorbs into the skin quickly and my eye make-up stays on as usual.  What is even more interesting, is that my skin feels so smooth where I have applied this cream.  Unusually smooth.  I think it provides more than adequate hydration to my eye area and a little bit goes a long way.  I am very happy with this product and will purchase more when I run out.  I hope that they come up with a SPF formula to go along with this product.
Don't see much improvement in waking up my eye area.  Also, the pump doesn't work.  I have to take the pump off and squeeze the tube.

I've been using this product for about 2 years.  The smell of it is wonderful, very strong coffee scent.  And I swear it reduces those pesky under-eye circles.  Believe me, I've been looking for a product that lightens my circles for several years.  I like to keep mine in the refridgerator because the coolness of the cream reduces my bags and also shrinks the blood vessles quicker.  Use every day to see the results for yourself.  It will also last a long time, the price is well worth it.

column9: It's an ok moisturizer but that's it
column10: This is a very over priced natural ineffective product. Maybe people give it good reviews because of the natural ingredients and the coffee smell. But for me, this eye cream never lightened my dark circles, never diminished my lines and never changed my puffy eyes. I used it at night only and would either waste or put it on heavy because the bottle dispenses too much product for both eyes. On more than one occasion my eye duct would get clogged and my eye would ache like someone punched me. It would go away if I didn't use any cream for a few days. This is the only eye cream that ever did that to me. I will never buy or recommend this product. A waste of $20.

I can't find anything that isn't absolutely perfect about this eye cream...(except perhaps the pump which when I'm half the way through clogs up and I have to take the top off and scrape it out).  Small price to pay for this really inexpensive product.The scent is vanilla/coffee (and I really don't care for either scent), but it smells different than most artificially scented beauty items because it truly is 100 percent pure.  The vanilla/coffee disappears very quickly.It has the perfect consistency for both upper and lower lids, and the perfect slip for makeup (the makeup goes on right over it...perfect)  I don't get the reviewer who had it in her eyes for days, but maybe her eyes are shaped differently.  I don't use very much, but when I do get a little too much out I put some on my cheeks (makes a really good anything cream).  I also always put some over my upper lip as I do with any eye cream to help with a few vertical lines.  I was using a very high end product which I really liked (never thought I'd use anything else), and then I gave this a try, and I just can't go back.Just had to write this review because I'm purchasing my fourth bottle.Update:040612-After trying the new packaging with the pump, I wish I could take off a star.  The product is still remarkable (even better, acually), but the new pump...well...it broke off at the top (and I'm very easy on my things), and I nowhave to squeeze it out.  I'm going to have to buy the smaller version.  I will never be able to get it all out.

This is my first time to try it and I have noticed a visible difference in the dark circles and puffiness. It is light and does not cake up under the eyes. I've tried lots of different and much more expensive creams but this one is definitely the best for me and it is very affordable!

column9: Does nothing but make my eyes burn
column10: This cream seems to have no effect but to make my eyes burn. It is ok as a moisturizer but no better than anything else I've tried. And no effect on fine lines and dark circles.

column9: Nice lotion but does nothing for my circles
column10: I read the reviews before purchasing this product and purchased it anyway because I know every person is different. Unfortunately this did nothing for my dark circles. It is a great lotion: it isn't too heavy, lasts all day and isn't sticky like some eye creams. I do not find the smell overpowering nor do I mind it; I really don't know how to describe it but "cookies" seems to fit. I use it daily but basically all it is at this point is a lotion I'm trying to use up. I won't purchase it again.

column9: Nice feeling cream but didn't work for me
column10: This is a nice feeling cream, smells good and I like that it's organic.  Sorry to say it didn't work for my problem.  I have allergies though, and my eyes are constantly swelling.  I've tried many other products, so maybe nothing else would work either.
The smell is fine but i have not noticed any difference with my dark circles under my eyes.Use it a.m. and p.m. no improvement just as dark as before using this product.

I love this product. You can't beat the cost from Amazon! And yes it has a small scent of coffee, but I'm a coffee drinker right from the south and drink plenty every day.So the smell is nothing compared to what this product can do for you. When I wake up in the morning the first thing I do is put my contacts in and reach for my Coffee Bean Eye Cream. I put it under my eyes and above my lips and then I get my morning coffee. Then I'm ready to put my other creams on my face over my eye cream and by then the bags and some of the wrinkles are taken care of. Awesome product!

I've used this product over the past few days and it has had no effects on my eyes.  I visited my doctor a few months back because I have a bag under one eye that only shows when I smile.  My doctor says that it didn't form because of premature aging but b/c of the way I sleep.  I thought that this cream would work resolve the issue but it hasn't had any effect on my undereye bag.

I have never used an eye cream that took away puffiness or circles.  I'm kind of an insomniac and don't get much sleep.  Therefore I usually have circles under my eyes.  This cream was amazing.  It took away most of the puffiness and dark circles under my eyes.  The process is almost immediate.  I put on the cream, then my makeup and by the time I'm ready to go out the door, my eyes are improved by 80%.  The smell that others complain about is minimal and lasts only a couple seconds.  It is worth giving this product a try.  I use it everyday now that I'm awar of it and will continue to do so!  I love this product.  The product can last you a long time as another person said.  One whole squirt is a little much.  I use about 1/2 a squirt.  One whole squirt is a lot of cream for under two eye areas.

I've used this product for two years now. I orignally bought it from a TV shopping network. I accidentaly removed the autoship. I went to the 100% website to re-order. It was cheaper here. Same product and better dispensing system than the original glass bottle. It keeps my puffiness at bay and I no longer have dark circles under my eyes. The orbits around my eyes are always hydrated and smooth. It smells fabulous! Best of all, it's organic!

I was not disappointed with this product. Since caffeine works by contracting blood vessels, it really helps with hiding dark circles. I use this nearly every morning. it's really creamy and blends in well. I don't even use a whole pump for both eyes.The only problem I've noted with this product is it takes awhile to absorb fully into the skin, so sometimes I'll rub my eye and the product bothers it. It burns abit, but nothing major. so only a very minor bother.There's not really any smell that I noted either, Unless I sniff it as soon as it comes out of the tube, I never noticed it having any smell while wearing it.

So far I am very pleased with the product.  I ordered it when I saw it advertised and demonstrated on Dr. Oz (highly respected program with good recommendations).  The product appears to work very well.  Definitely love the smell... has the smell of fresh coffee.
I really love this product. It is creamy smooth, and rich. Helps that undereye area stay firm.  It does reduce the puffyness.  The coffee aroma is not unpleasant.

column9: Don't think it did much of anything
column10: I have used this for a month and don't think it made much of a change in my circles under my eyes. it is an ok moisturizing cream but does not do much else. It has a faint smell of coffee that goes away after a while, which I didn't mind. Overall, I think nothing can change dark circles or baggy eyes!

column9: Don't get too close to eyelids...
column10: I've tried the product a few times and for some reason I really don't see much of a difference in my puffiness.It also tends to irritate my eyes... so I keep it away from my eyelids and eyelashes.

column9: Great product, but I hate the container.
column10: This eye cream is exactly what I was looking for. It's natural, vegan, silky, and really helps with my dark circles. It's not a miracle by any means, but it helps as much as I feel it should with what it advertizes. I would not use this if you wanted to treat something like wrinkles, but it's very hydrating so it's great for preventative measures. I use it twice a day in addition to massage to relieve my dark circles and it seems to work great. My only complaint is that the bottle can be really stubborn and I have to give it several pumps before any product will come out, but other than that it's a great product. I highly recommend it.
I like this product.It goes on nice and light and really does bring down the puffiness under my eyes in the morning.You only need a little dab.The price is good too.
I was optimistic about this product. I used it every day but didn't find that it helped at all with puffy eyelids. It does have a nice smell and works well as a light moisturizer.

I used this product, previously, when it was called Organic Coffee Bean Eye Cream -- and the ingredients listed green tea as the first ingredient...Now the packaging has changed, but the name of the product hasn't, nor has the description claiming it has green tea...but if you read the ingredients -- the first ingredient listed (which means it is the largest ingredient) shows that it's aloe vera -- and no where is "green tea" mentioned as an ingredient!  Misleading and deceptive.  I'm not so sure it's as effective as the one I previously bought from the same company. Makes me very suspicious and possibly not worth the money.  If I wanted Aloe Vera for my eyes, I can just buy that.
I used this product for about 2 1/2 weeks.  I didn't see any results to reducing my puffy eyes or dark circles.

column9: No Mind-Blowing Results but Still Worth a Try
column10: I bought Pure Cosmetics Coffee Bean Eye Cream back in May 2011, took a month's break from it in Sept, but have gone back to it. The results weren't mind-blowing when I was using it daily from May through mid-September, but I used it anyway because it's better than nothing. To be honest, I like how it moisturizes better than other eye creams and gels that I've used. I apply it under concealer for hydration and protection from whatever stressful effects cosmetics and living/working in NYC has had on my dry-to-sensitive skin. I used it without make-up for most of the summer to give my skin a break, but I saw no firming or brightening effects... just moisturized/hydrated. As I stated before, it's better than nothing.The "coffee bean" scent is indescribably NOT coffee, cookie, or cocoa... maybe a light version of a box of soggy waffle cones? I highly recommend you smell this at a store before you buy it. It's a super soft and creamy scent, yes, but still distinct and unappealing to me. It's basically become a general and accepted reflex to hold my breath for the few seconds I dab this on. I'm still using it because its moisturizing ways are worth it. Plus, I love the pump... it's a welcome relief from jars and tubes.I don't expect results from this, now that I've gone back to using it, but it feels good under my eyes: no irritation, whatsoever (i.e. my eyes don't water or itch when I dab it on my skin); moisturizing/hydrating; and very light and smooth.Basically: It's better than what I've previously used. However, no life-changing results... but better than nothing.

column9: It reduced puffy eyes for me!
column10: I really like this eye cream. I used department store brands for years, but have been trying to reduce the amount of chemicals I put on my skin, and so turned to 100% Pure. This creams works very well. I use this in the morning first thing and it truly reduces puffy morning eyes. I like to do it right after I wash my face, but before I do my eye make up, so it can soak in. It smells a bit like coffee, but I figure that is better than artificial fragrance. All synthetic fragrances do is mask chemical odors anyway. I have used this eye cream for months and see an improvement in the appearance of the skin around my eyes. Even better, it has not created any of the little white bumps that result from clogged pores that I have experienced with well-known department store brands. I will continue buying this one!

If this stuff gets near your eyes you will look through a haze for days (for example, you put it on away from your eyes but as you sleep it gets on the pillow then on your eyelids).  It takes forever to sink in your skin.  Smells nice, though...if you are a coffee lover.  The pump was broken on mine when I got it so I had to take the lid off to use.  It is very thick, almost like cream cheese, so it's difficult to get out of the jar (I figure that's why the pump wouldn't work).  I used (nightly) almost the whole bottle with no results in face condition.  It sits on top of the skin so I generally had to wash it off in the morning before applying make-up.

column9: Nothing outstanding or remarkable, but it gets the job done
column10: I've been using this for about two months (always at least once a day), and while I definitely can say, "Sure, this is okay," I wouldn't go out of my way to suggest or recommend it.I like that there are no super crazy or funky ingredients.  I can put this all over my eyes with zero irritation and no itching, and I have to admit I really love the smell (yum!)--it seems a lot stronger when you first start using it, but it disappears pretty quickly.THE PRODUCT: The cream is a white, thin lotion that spreads easily.  It's not the kind of lotion that instantly absorbs into your skin, and a little goes a long way!  There is going to be a moist film left behind for a while, so if you're an instant-absorption sort of person, this might catch you off-guard. However, I like that it doesn't instantly dry because my eyes feel more hydrated.THE PACKAGING: There are several comments talking about how crappy the pump is and how it 'breaks' easily.  I haven't experienced it directly breaking, but I can see how people might have problems.  The pump doesn't pull lotion from very deep inside the bottle, so it leaves behind a gap in the lotion eventually each time you pump because it doesn't "settle" to fill the spot after use.  If you squeeze from the bottom of the bottle a little bit before using or unscrew the top and jostle the bottle a bit, you'll be able to "fill" that hole created over time through using the pump.RESULTS:  I'm in my early 20s and have been blessed with pretty good genes, so wrinkles and puffy under-eyes really aren't a huge issue for me.  However, I really love how moisturizing and hydrating this cream is.  The smell is pleasant, and I'm probably about halfway through the tube in two months, so I'd say it's a decent bang for my buck.Give it a shot!  If wrinkles and puffiness are a concern for you, this might not be your holy grail product, but it's also inexpensive enough that I think it's worth trying out without feeling awful if it doesn't work.One tiny note - I don't know if this is relevant, but I have noticed since using this product I seem to have gained a small cluster of freckles around my eyes in places I've never had freckles before.  I don't know if it's from this product, but it certainly struck me as unusual.

This eye cream smells really good. I'm not sure it really delivers your eyes from looking tired. It's supposed to lift the skin around the eyes. I don't see much of this happening but it does lighten the dark circles you get from not enough sleep or from being tired. I use with other eye products and it seems to work better then on its own. Not sure if I will buy it again?

I have puffiness under my eyes. Maybe you can even call them bags because they rarely disappear. I have had insomnia for decades and that is likely the cause. I tried this product. It smells like capuccino, yummy. But, after using it a few times, my puffiness has not improved one bit. Perhaps it is because the puffiness is fat and not water retention. I am 45 years old and maybe these bags are here to stay.

column9: Is there any eye cream that works?
column10: I ordered this product without reading reviews because I saw it on Dr. Oz. Well I have had it for a few weeks and so far I don't see any difference. I know these things take time, however, frankly I have not found an eye cream for under eye puffiness that works. I have tried cheap and expensive creams. Nada!

This product works GREAT! You see results almost instantly! The only downfall to this product is that it leaves your eye area greasy all day long. I have used serums which soak right into the skin and there is no residue, but I have not found a serum that works as well as this product. I will definitely buy again because it works so well.

Ok.  I'm not going to say this stuff has produced miracles, but I do think it has helped to make my under eye darkness somewhat lighter.  I try to use it each day.  Also, it smells good...like coffee with cream and sugar.

column9: Nice Eye Cream, great for the price!

column9: Not as good as I'd hoped...

Being a mid to late 20's girl, I really just wanted something to help with my dark circles and hold up the aging process a little bit via fine lines starting to form around my eyes. I haven't noticed an improvement at all.  I've been using it for 3 weeks now, so something should've shown by now.I do have to say, that the ingredients are listed right on the bottle, and it doesn't get any better than organic everything, pretty much.  Just wished it worked better for me!

I followed their directions and mailed it all back to them with a copy of the e-mail. I did not hear from them, and weekly e-mails were not returned for 3 months! Not only did they not honor the original promise to refund my money after returning the products, they said I could call in for a credit instead. So here I am with no products, and a "credit" for more of what made me miserable. There are better natural cosmetic companies out there. Stay away.

Upon opening the package, I noticed the cream was in a pump tube, which is a plus, but it limits the control on the amount I can squeeze out at a time. Trust me you will only need about 2/3 or less of the cream that comes out of each pump. In that regard I feel that it is a bit of a waste, but I suppose I can deal with it because it is an all natural product. With that said, the smell is awful. I know that all noses are different, and that each of us like different smells, but even for me this was too much. If you want to avoid smelling the product while applying, hold your breath and apply away from the nose as far up to the eye area as possible. I would not use it as a moisturizer because of the smell. It has a very emollient texture and it is a bit oily at first. I have oily to normal skin, so I do not use moisturizers (even though I should)(it does absorb well though in given time). I rather not take the risk of using this as a moisturizer because it is not diluted enough. As an eye cream it is a good product. I am excited to see the results within the next few weeks and will edit this review regarding the effects of the product. I am very please it is all natural. Delicious product. I enjoy it exclusively. I have purchased several of these containers and am going to be re ordering again soon.

We used these hash browns camping on a wilderness camping and fishing trip. They tasted as good as if they where fresh grated from potatoes. I recommend for home as well as any camping trip. So easy to make. Hydrated with boiling water for twelve minutes in the existing container, then fried up with a bit of oil. WOW, very great product.

These are so good its silly...and easy to make.  Fill the box with boiling water, wait 12 minutes...1 pound of fresh potatoes ready to cook.  I cut down on fat by mixing 1 Tablespoon olive oil and some seasoning with potato, and cooking in a good hot non stick skillet

Here's a product that is easy to prepare and produces hash browns as good as you'll find in any restaurant.  Just follow the very clear instructions, salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy.You start by adding hot tap water to the package and letting the contents re-hydrate for 12 minutes.  For an alternative taste treat, add a few drops of Tabasco or a similar hot sauce to water before pouring it into the package.  I'm sure that other spicing (onion powder, etc.) would be good too.  After 12 minutes, drain off excess water and add potatoes to a non-stick skillet preheated with 2 tablespoons of oil--I use olive oil. Cook uncovered on medium high heat, and don't let your spouse tell you it's too hot--it not! In about 4-5 minutes it's ready to serve.Hmmmm!
I love having these hashbrowns in my pantry.  Easy to use and they brown nicely.  Would recommend to anyone who likes to keep staples on hand to avoid frequent trips to the grocery store.
These hashbrowns are great, best ever.  They're made by Basic American Foods out of Walnut Creek, CA and private labeled to Hungry Jack.  Super product!  BUY THEM!
I bought these a few months ago and now they are twice the price.  So, unfortunately I won't pay that, even though they are good.  I'll make them from scratch.

column9: So easy to use and store!

Whip out a carton, hydrate the shreds and you are off and running!  I actually and tickled at how great they taste and are actually much easier than peeling and shredding fresh potatoes.  I do not detect any off flavors and no one has asked if they were dry potatoes, on the contrary everyone raves about the dishes I serve with them in it.  I have not served them solo, they are usually part of a recipe, but I think they would taste fine as intended too.
These Hash Browns are the most delicious I've ever eaten and so easy to fix. Our local grocery stores stopped carrying this product, so I ordered them thru Amazon.

column9: Best ever for hashbrowns at home
column10: These appear to be the same product which used to be sold at Costco under the Golden Grill brand in same size packaging and they could not keep the pallets full. The Golden Grill suddenly disappeared from Costco and Hungry Jack appeared at the local grocery chains.  Both are made by Basic American Foods. I like to put a small amount of frozen chopped onions on top while pan-grilling and then flip over after 4 minutes for a minute or so to complete the process. The lowest price I have found thus far is at Walmart for $1.25 per package and their shelf is sometimes empty. I would give 6 stars if available. These are one of the best dehydrated foods on the market. Takes a litlle time but not much just pour in hot water and wait about 15 min.  Then just a dab of oil and fry them there just as good as home made.

column9: Very easy to make and quite tasty

They are great. There is no work to it. Just add water and wait 20 - 30 minutes and they are ready to cook.  They crisp up on the outside and are great on the inside.  They are just like the potatoes in the restaurants. I will buy this product again when I run out.

Two months ago my two cats ages 6 and 15 went from a flesh diet (tuna, chicken, salmon and salad with nutritional yeast) to a lacto-vegetarian diet with Evolution moist and dry food and they have never looked back. I do have to combine this moist food with Seven Stars plain yogurt and then they eat it all enthusiastically. I also add some veggies to the mix. when we were kids my dad would pick us up on the weekends. he'd stop at a store somewhere in haminton, n.j. and pick-up these cookies. after lunch on sunday, before he took us home we'd have a few margherite cookies and milk. dad would dunk his in coffee. we didn't have much time with our dad so there is not allot of memories but whenever i miss him, i go to the store and buy these cookies and hes there again. i eat allot of these cookies.

My squirrels...I should say, nature's squirrels who visit me love these Squirrelogs.  Fun to watch them eating...most always upside-down.  When their companions try to feed from the same log, the one in possession will hold the tree with rear feet and the whole log with front feet and continue to munch...so cute.  Healthy food, no messes to clean up like with corn cobs, deters squirrels from eating expensive bird food and provides entertainment and great photos. I personally eat about half a bag with butter and fish for breakfast at 9 and feel satisfied until 2 in the afternoon.  The only downside is splitting the contents in half.  You can break it apart but some of the dry noodles fall out so do it over the sink or outside.
