Easy to throw into the diaper bag, this is a great product for travel.  Too expensive to use just at home, but I like using these when running around town.
These single serve formula packets are so easy to use, especially on road trips.  I always keep a stash in the diaper bag just in case!  Each packet makes a 4 oz bottle, just add water!

Aside from the obvious convenience for stashing in the diaper bag, these are actually more economical for the breastfeeding moms who supplement--the canisters must be used within a month of being opened, so if you make up a few bottles a week, these are a better price.

Our daughter started out on the Enfamil Newborn and has now moved on to the Infant formula. She's certainly thriving on them.This looks like a very convenient product - I just bought a bunch to use on vacation at a local Big*Box store since we're leaving tomorrow.I did notice that this price is pretty high. It's available for much less both at retailers and even here on Amazon.

Whoever came up with this is a genius and a lifesaver. I too only use formula when I'm on the go or need to supplement if I don't have enough breast milk, so the can is a waste since I won't finish it in a month. The packets are so convenient. I carry a bottle or two of 4oz water and a couple of packets in my purse at all times for emergencies. Paid $10.69 for a box of 16 at Target.Only 4 out of 5 stars because you can only make 4 oz or 8 oz.  So if your baby is currently eating more than 4oz but less than 8oz you either hope he is satisfied with 4oz or make 8oz and waste some.

Always kept few packets in the diaper bag. It is great for traveling. Regular formula box needs to be consumed within a month of opening - I felt bad about throwing away formula when my kid was not 100% on formula. Single serve turned out to be a cheaper option.

I love these packets for travel and to keep handy in the diaper bag. The pricing from this particular seller is outrageous. $3.44/packet??? Should be more like $.60. Plus they want nearly $25 for shipping? Ummm, I guess they're in the business of not selling product.

I was buying Enfamil Premium Lipil Single Serve Powder Packets 17.4 g Sticks, 16-Count Boxes (Pack of 2), they will make 4oz of formula and are in packages just like sports drinks...HOWEVER the packaging SUCKS. Baby formula does not pour well and can get caught in the tinest of wrinkle and then come rushing out when it makes it way past. It's very light and fluffy so spills go everywhere. The single serve sticks are also larger, longer in length and can take up space in your diaper bag, you can't fold them up it's just awkward all around, especially to pour them in the car or at the mall, etc. Not to mention EXPENSIVE. Really EXPENSIVE, 8 packs for $12-$16. Meaning 8 bottles for that, when a whole formula case is $25. MAKE YOUR OWN SINGLE SERVE SOLUTIONS! I really can't express to you how awful the packaging is on these, they spill every single time, I'm no butterfingers so I know it's not me. The tear wrong, the formula comes gushing out after you try to coax it down when it gets stuck no matter how hard you try to flatten it out before you open. All in all, this is a great idea in theory, it just fails in design.Here are two cheaper and more efficient solutions: Most moms have and use either the Munchkin Powdered Formula Dispenser Combo Pack, Colors Vary or a variant of it ( hear its not as good as this one and I believe it). We got a Philips AVENT Formula BPA-Free Dispenser/Snack Cupand I think it's excellent quality and wonderful, the dividers do not "leak" into each other at all since it's one piece mold, and you can just take it out if you want to use for snacks, it's a must have. That said, its so big in my diaper bag. I like to have as much room in my bag as I can, and every inch counts.So I got These plastic bags make it possible. Plus if I have sports powdered mixes, etc I can use these as well for myself.  Why not make your own single serve pouches? I looked into a few kinds and these 500 Poly Bag Clear Zipper Shipping Bags 3" X 4" were the best economically, (bags for cost) I can pack 3 or 4 bottles worth in the same space that a pack of altoids would take up, less actually. About 2 or 3 on top of each other is the thickness of my iphone 4. I can fit about 8 bags inside the avent formula dispenser. This is way better than the size more conventional formula dispensers hold. The best way to pour it into your cup or baby bottle ( from experience ) is to pinch it at the ziplock seam, open it so that the left corner is touching the right corner, and pour it out. Never spill a drop, no mess all over the place, love it.That said I would NEVER Give up the avent formula dispenser, I actually bought another because I love using them at home. I sit these out on the counter and I don't have to clutter up the kitchen, plus when a baby sitter comes over I just tell her pour one compartment into the bottle and shake. I also fill up bottles of water and have them waiting at the ready so I practically have to  nothing to make a bottle when I am tired or relying on others. These are a must have. If you don't want to fuss with the baggies, I would say this is the best compact formula dispenser for your money and on the market, hands down it sweeps the competition. Don't buy the cheaper ones, their dividers SUCK and the lid is iffy. This is the one that works best. Also, the best way to pout it out and get it all out quick and fast is to line up the hole with the bottle and SHAKE SIDE TO SIDE Rapidly. Back and forth, left to right, three or four times and it's all out! Don't worry, you wont spill and the formula wont get mixed up in the compartments.These options are the best value for your money. You have a new baby, you have PLENTY of other things to spend your money on, the list never ends babies suck you dry, so don't waste the money on these if you don't have to. Hope this helps.

column9: Crisco is the best thing since sliced bread
column10: I just have to say how much I love Crisco. I slap some on my Foreman Grill so things won't stick and it works like a charm. I love eggs fried in Crisco. And sometimes I'll throw a dab of Crisco in my hair to keep it slicked back just right. Rock on, Crisco!

I started using Crisco on my skin about six months ago, and the product has signigicantly reduced signs of aging on my face. It does not make me look oily or aggravate my acne. I also use is a preshampoo treatment, as I wash my hair frequently. It relaxes the curls in my hair.

While it could be a great shortening, it is frustrating, that the ingredients were not properly listed by Amazon.  This product contains soy. As far as the packaging - is was poorly packed and the jar came badly bent.
Theses candys hardly have any fillings. I am so disapointed i order it expecting they will be full of filling like some other ones that i tried before.
After consuming this product, it left a very unpleasant "aftertaste" and "film" on my tongue.  I enjoy hard candy with fruit fillings but definitely would not recommend this one!!

column9: On the verge of being good, but something's missing
column10: I ordered this for my birthday. I got birthday money from family, and I ordered a couple of goodies, perfume, and this cocoa.  I love hot chocolate, and I'm always looking for new ones to try.  Based on the first review I decided to go ahead and order.  I will probably not reorder.  Mixed by itself into hot water it seems to lack thickness.  It also has too much of an artificial raspberry taste.  I like Hershey's Bliss Raspberry Chocolate much better.  I've been adding one spoonful of the Cobblestone Kitchen to my regular cocoa to give it a raspberry boost.  But, by itself, it does not stand up to the test. I plan on finishing the three remaining cans over time by using it as a stir in additive to other cocoa.

column9: There is good and then there is wonderful
column10: Cobblestone Kitchen's Irish Creme Hot Cocoa mix has got to be the most luxurious tasting cocoa on the market.  We originally bought this cocoa to use as a base for Frappuccinnos but quickly decided it was way to good to waste in a mix.  The flavor is rich and smooth.  We have made it a part of our winding down for bed time procedure - a couple of cups together and just relax.Cobblestone Kitchen refers to the cocoas as "Delicious and Decadent"  and they are being extremely modest.

I use the Oreo pie crusts to make a frozen Milk Chocolate Pie that everyone loves. This is a favorite summertime recipe as I don't have to bake anything and the pie tastes cool and delicious. A perfect dessert. The recipe can be found in a Taste of Home publication, and perhaps you can find it at the TOH of website; if anyone would like to search for the recipe.Best of all the price is right at Amazon. Much cheaper than the pie crusts sold at my local grocery store.Recommend.
I can't find these in the grocery store any more, so I was happy when I found them on line.  I have a special Williams-Sonoma chocolate pie recipe that calls for this oreo crust and it is amazing!
A great pie crust for cream pies (espeically chocolate).  Good price as they sell for $2.69 on the military base.

This pie filling is "filling" but tastes terrible.  The cherries are tough, so they may have been picked "green", but with all the added "enhancers", no one could even tell they are eating "cherry" pie.  Very disappointing.I now prefer to pay more and buy Comstock or another American brand that will make pie baking rewarding because the taste will be what is expected.Don't buy this China product. Nasty.Oh, and with the very first piece of pie, a PIT!  I wonder how many more will show up in the pie with this first can of "cherries"?

I was hoping to reduce the cost of making cherry pies by ordering this filling.  First, it is a product of China.  Second, it does not have the rich flavor of the usual brands produced in the United States.  I will be paying more for what tastes better, consistently.

I think any product on sale to our American consumers should have the point of origin clearly published PRIOR to sale.  Point in question is a Polar product offering cherry pie filling (made in China).  I would not have known except for the reviews.  Just my opinion

Let me start by saying that I can't stand hot chocolate mixes that you add water to .. for me, it must be made with fresh milk!  I recently read some online reviews on hot chocolate and this brand received rave reviews.  I've tried both the organic and the old world and both are fabulous.  The organic is a powder mix and the old world is chocolate shavings. I guess I'd say the old world is more intense and rich, but you can control the strength by how much you add to your hot milk. Both are definately worth the extra money and makes a nice holiday gift (with a couple festive mugs).  You can also find this brand at Whole Foods Market.

I like hot chocolate and I drink a lot of it.  Naturally, I have experimented with many different hot chocolate mixes, including the big national brands.  Lake Champlain hot chocolate is my favorite. The Organic and the Old World are very good, but Traditional is my absolute favorite and I used to make special trips to out of the way stores just to get it. The Aztec is an interesting spicy change of pace. Sometimes when supplies run out I have had to make do with other brands and you can just tell the difference if like a really chocolaty taste. I am glad that Amazon is finally stocking it.  Try it and compare.  Try it for baking your favorite chocolate desserts.  Their chocolate bars are very good as well.Lake Champlain Hot Chocolate Mixes

I was very lucky to receive a gift package of Lake Champlain hot cocoa mixes. Very lucky. The three varieties included were: Traditional, Mocha, and Aztec. Three wonderfully chunky one pound cans of hot cocoa mix. Oh, boy! This is an all-natural product without additives or preservatives. The Lake Champlain company has been reverentially producing chocolate goodness from its factory in Vermont for over 25 years. They offer a variety of chocolate indulgences, including gift baskets and gift samplers. In addition to the addictive hot cocoas, they also tempt you with truffles, caramels, chocolate bars and other items of divine decadence. The hot cocoa mixes are rich and satisfying, made with milk and soothing to the soul and the senses. The flavors of the mixes are so full-bodied that I even added spoonfuls of the hot cocoa mix into the batter for brownies, cookies, cakes and etc. I also made my own gourmet mocha madness mixes by combining the hot cocoa dry mix with instant coffee granules and powdered creamer. I had my own private stash at work, and the scent of my cocoa-powered coffee creations had others asking what I was drinking. I was benevolent and shared some of the mix. I think I started something ; )
I really liked them, reminds me of days gone by.I need to order some more in the future.Thank you

I love tea, especially hot teas.  Normally, I purchase my teas from Teavana; however, they have been out of my favorite strawberry white tea.  Thinking this may be a good substitute,I purchased this tea.  It turns bitter.  It cannot be brewed longer than one minute, and goes bitter once it cools.  This tea is the worst, and is money down the drain.  It is so bad that I will not donate it to the food pantry.  This is going to the landfill.

I've bought a couple of these for my Airedale puppy who constantly wants to chew.  These things are amazing in that they have bone, tendon, meat, and knuckles still attached.  She dives in and tears it apart - she would work on it non-stop if I didn't periodically take it away from her.  The meat and tendons are harmless enough - obviously they have fat and protein so they have to be tied into diet considerations, and the bone appears to hold onto the flavor long after it's stripped (she still licks and gnaws on a bone that's a few weeks bare).  The knuckles, once they get torn off, should probably be thrown away after a few minutes because they are small enough to be swallowed and/or choked on.  The only downside to this product is when she comes up to me and the whiskers around her mouth are a little discolored and she smells like roasted meat.  But, well worth it if you want to give your dog a treat that they can't get enough of.

I got this for a big American Bulldog.  He LOVES it.  He gobbled up the meat and tendons in no time.  I may have to take it away if he starts breaking chunks off.  So far it's fine and he's never been so happy.  These things are major bones.  I'd only recommend it for a very large tough dog though.

I have two extremely aggressive chewers, a Lab and a Dalmatian....and this bone keeps them busy for DAYS.  You do have to watch when the smaller top bones separate from the rest of the bone as they are chewed, they could be a choking hazard.  The Sarge keeps both of my dogs interested, even when the marrow and tendons have long since been eaten.  Great value for the price, considering they last so long.  If you want a bone that stimulates and satisfies, this is it!
The dogs are still playing with the first bones I purchased over a year ago.  They cleaned it up pretty quick, but all three are still gnawing on the original bones.

column9: Dog loved it...smells like a dead animal
column10: Yes, my dog loved this thing for the day we let him have it. However, the smell of dead animal that wafted from my dogs breath and the bone was absolutely putrid. He was a wee bit sad when I threw that smelly bone in the garbage. Love most of Merrick's products that I tried so far. Go for the Texas Taffy, and the bones that are hollow.
I have the sweetest Golden Retriever ever, I have never heard him growl except when someone tried to get near his mouth when he was chewing this bone! It has kept him happy for days.

This product contains two sweeteners: xylitol and stevia. They are natural but many people, including me,don't react well to sweeteners, artificial or not.The list of contents should be more visible in its label because most people won't even notice the informationabout sweeteners  as it is in such a minuscule writing. Besides, most sites don't give a complete list of  the contents ofNature's Answer Platinum Green Tea...I used several products from Nature's Answer and I think they are one of the best companies in the market.It was disappointing to find out about the almost hidden  extra contents of this green tea...  Really silly this idea of makingeverything sweet, especially considering that this is a health product.  I didn't expect this silliness from Nature's Answer.
Used to buy these in a discount store.  Then store stopped carrying the product.Really glad to see Amazon carries all the varieties that we like.Buying by the case makes sense.
I buy the ginger flavor and also the lemon/honey. They are sweet & long lasting. Make nice gifts as well.  Very useful for a substitute after the meal dessert - few calories.

If you've ever had pickled okra and they were too hot or too salty or too 'whatever'. These are the 'snackers' for you.  I started eating these long ago in Texas and now I can't believe that I've found them again!  This is the brand and this is the size jar we always had in the fridge. We all love them!!
If hot or spicy is not your thing ,then you will need to try ths item!Myself and my Son just Love hot and spicy products we also enjoyed this item and hope you will also!

don't believe the bad reviews.  i have purchased over 4 large jars of this pickled okra.  it is deliciousand a great side for sandwiches, even brown beans and cornbread.  it's around $4.88 for the 64oz jar andworth every penny for those who love pickles, olives, peppers, etc.
I SENT THIS ITEM TO MY BROTHER IN FLORIDA BECAUSE THEY COULD'NT FINE IT THERE. WAS EASY TO FIND AT AMAZON.  THANKS BOB SEVERANCE  MARSHALL, TEXAS
Okra is very mushy not like I usually get which is very crispwon't buy again waste of my money.

Every so often I stumble upon an product that surpasses the advertising. I urge everyone to have a tube of Wound Honey on hand.  I apply this the minute I have either a burn or cut and the next day you can see the difference.  It is a little hard to apply and I recommend covering the injury because its sticky, your pets would love to lick it off, but the product is wonderful and guess what, no side effects.

I had a necrotic wound after abdominal surgery, nothing helped! I was grasping at straws and I read good things about wound honey so I gave it a go. It paid off, the wound stopped with the spreading of dead tissue and began to heal. I just ordered it again for a surgery in November.

:) Well my honey recommended this for help in healing a freshly stitched up chainsaw induced wound. Well how sweet it is... it not only accelerated the process but helped take some of the sting out of the experience. I did not apply directly into the wound at first....just around the edges. I did this at night, covering up the sticky stuff with a large bandage tapped securely in place & left it on as i slept. After the wound closed i lightly applied it directly on it about every other day for a week.My recovery was quick....so quick i did not need to use allot. Now i am in the next phase of my recovery, scar reduction & physical therapy & doing great. Proper wound management care is essential from day 1 until fully recovered as the better job you do the better your chances of a quick & complete recovery. So if you have your antennas out looking for something above & beeyond your standard remedy i recommend trying this sweet stuff & sticking to it :)

Pay no attention to one of the bad reviews above. This person has not clue how to cook buckwheat properly. If they burnt the pot, what does it have to do with the buckwheat? It is not the buckwheat that burnt it, but people that know nothing of cooking it properly. Great buckwheat, cook it (2:1 water/groats) for about 45 mins at the lowest setting of your burner, don't open the lid. Don't let it boil too hard as the water eveporates quickly and it will burn.It should barely simmer.

Absolutely the Best buckwheat available. Quality and taste incomparable to the other brands, Wolff's Whole Kasha comes second. Arrowhead Buckwheat groats and Bob's Red Mill Organic whole grain buckwheat, both do not count. Have tried both and would never buy them again.

It takes really great but so pity i can't say the same about the look. I was surprised when i discovered that the minute it started boiling it was already broken and becoming saggy. maybe it's not roasted enough?

2 cups water or chicken broth,1 tsp sea salt,1/2 tsp cracked pepper...bring to a boil,let simmer about 12-16 minutes...and let cool about 30 minutes....that's it!.....Kasha is divine,in the Ukraine or West Hollywood CA....adapt and be well,follow this recipe with sauted onions and eat well....I personally don't care if you hail from Moscow,Mars,or Morocco...kasha will make you healthy for your American journey...and adapt,be well, and may your children be thoroughly Americanized.and assimilated....Like they would never be in Europe......

I bought this buckwheat months ago. I had bad experience from this one. As a relative to Russian people, this is really not close to being good buckwheat. It burns fast even when you add a lot of water: much more than 2 volume of water to 1 volume of buckwheat. The bottom of the pot burned each time I cooked the buckwheat. The smell is really bad not the typical for buckwheat. We cooked 5 of the 9 bags, hardly could eat them and tossed the rest.

column9: Shhhh....don't tell the kids I sneak their fruit roll ups
column10: We love these! So much so we are on our 3rd order in 3 months. With 5 kids and being the neighborhood hot spot we go through a lot of treats, these are one of our best go to treats. We have a dye free home and finding delicious and affordable dye free snacks can be a challenge. These arrive super fast, within 2-3 days of ordering, packaged 10 roll ups to a box x 7 boxes. Great price of auto delivery makes these comparable to the regular fruit roll ups. I don't mind buying them as an occasional treat since they are relatively healthy and they taste great, I have taste tested several after the kids have gone to bed.
My son loves these and I do too. Why would anyone buy the fruit roll-ups with added sugar when these taste so good?

column9: Very tasty, and mostly all natural.
column10: Fruit Roll-Ups Simply Fruit rolls are a convenient, tasty snack, that is made with mostly natural ingredients.  The main ingredients are pear, apple, strawberry, and blackberry juice concentrates and purees.  Less than 2% of the product is made using preservatives or additives.The rolls are sweet but also a bit tangy.  They are a smooth, flexible consistency and aren't sticky to the touch, even when they get hot.The sugar content is a bit high at 10 grams per roll, but they contain only 50 calories each.All in all... a quick, healthy, and tasty snack.

I saw these when looking at fruit snacks and decided to try them. They are 90% fruit, which is better than not, but when you get down to it, they are a sticky sugary snack that's going to stick to your teeth. Still, I figure that they are better for you than the other ones.As far as taste goes, they are sweet, I had one any thought they were pretty good. My kids love them and think of them as any other fruit snack or candy. I expected the texture to be grainy, and it might be a little, but barely noticable.Also, they don't have any shape cutouts (which are always impossible to remove anyway).
All three of my kids love these. I have tried them as well and they don't seem to have the syntetic taste that other brands have. IT really tastes like dried fruit.
Yummy is all I can really say. My husband and I enjoy this snack. It doesn't stick to your teeth like other fruit roll-ups.

column9: Healthy easy to grab and eat snack
column10: I love these, strawberry good too. I tried the fruit strips from Target, but they were SOOOPER GOOEY STICKY and it was thick and gelatiny, it just wasn't very good in my opinion. These fruit roll ups are fantastic though, similar to the original fruit roll ups, but a little granier, and tears more easily. The taste is pretty amazing, but beware for those who are allergic to citrus, because it has lemon juice in it despite it being wildberry or strawberry. Overall I recommend it for those who need an easy snack and aren't allergic to citrus or any other ingredients it contains.

I love this product!  I am a diabetic who needed to find a portable, complex-sugar product that I can carry in my purse for those times when my blood sugars were dropping. This is it!  No simple sugars, like corn syrup/dextrose/sugar, added.  And it tastes great.  My kids love them too.  Thank you General Mills.
This ite is healthy and tastes great.  Sure it's sticky, but it is not as sticky as the super sugary regular fruit roll-ups.  I enjoy them for lunch and they are an excellent snack.
I first found these in Maine and loved them.  They are really light and lemony.  Great tasting.

I can't keep these in my house because I can't stop eating them... better than any other store bought cookie I've ever had in my life... YUM.  These will now be given as gifts for ANY and ALL occasions.... simply to die for!!!

Although these cookies have 9 grams of sugar per serving (8 cookies), the tart lemon flavor is predominant. They are much lower in calories than other sweets. My only complaint is that it takes some will power to have just 8 of these little pieces of heaven!

I found these at the Chicago candy convention, and have been hooked ever since!!!  Not only do they taste amazing, but they are all natural.  Which makes them perfect for the kids.  0 Trans fats, no artifical flavors, and no preservatives.  Real juice used in the fruit ones!!If you have never tasted these, you are missing out.  Seriously!

The Zwieback toast had a good taste.  I compare it to the Old Nabisco zwieback and it doesn't quite measure up.  I also did not like the size of the product.  It was small in comparison to other zwieback products.  It was o.k. but I would not order again.

Very light slightly sweet crunchy biscuit bread. Tastes great just with butter but you can put anything on it. It's so light that it's also great for upset stomachs etc. I eat it for breakfast every morning. I like "Brandt" the best.
My sister-in-law had been looking all over for these, and we finally found them through Amazon. They are fantastic for teething children!

Brandt Zwieback is something for everyone and every generation...I like the whole grain one best, soaked in milk, but the original one is good, too. In Germany there is a wide variety of these guys by Brandt...with chocolate, coconut...- try them all, if you canAlso recommended during pregnancy when your tummy is not excited about eating anything....

Hello,very happy,that I found them at Amazon.com.The Brandt Zwieback can be used as a snack,for soups and little kids(adults)love them,with little butter and jam,ham or turkey.Yummy........I'll buy it again,when my box is finish.Thank you very much.

After searching in stores locally and not being able to find any zwieback (it seems like the only brand available in Cincinnati is Baby Mum Mum -made in China)I was happy to find these Brandt Zwieback.  Although my daughter loves her "toast" and goes through it relatively quickly, I still like that they are packaged in separate sleeves so they won't go stale.  I think we have a supply to last her until she's two as there are ten boxes sold in a pack.  Taste is good too, my picky 10 year old nephew eats them!
great for breakfast--just BRIEFLY dunk them in tea or coffee (not too long or they'll get too soggy) and enjoy! (Mom will even get them good & soggy then put them on raisen bread--also delish!)

column9: yummy but shipping not so great
column10: Brandt Zwieback is a fast and healthy way to eat any time, dunk it in coffee or cocoa or top the slices with fruit, jam, or whatever you like.  I am not sure what the name "Rusk" means? My problem was with the shipping, at least 7 of the boxes had broken pieces, which didn't change the taste but it was not easy to eat as I described. The crumbs and tiny little chunks ended up in a pan topped with pudding (not so healthy but still edible).

Well packed, received quickly. My favorite cheesecake recipe calls for Zwieback as the main ingredient in the crust and I was amazed that Nabisco had discontinued it. I was very happy to find this item, and am looking forward to trying it. Thank you!
I had these growing up in Germany. So glad to be able to buy them here. They are fresh, crisp, delicious. My whole family got hooked. Nice snack with tea or coffee. Thanks for making them available.

column9: The last sauce you will ever buy (by the case!).
column10: Head's Red is a great multi-purpose sauce that goes great on all your grilled or BBQ favorites.Be it pork, beef, chicken, Head's Red has got the right combo of sweet and bite to add the enhancement a good sauce should in any region of the country . . .
One of my favorite sauces on pulled pork and ribs. The molasses gives it a nice deep note.

column9: Unsweetened gum! No sorbitol, no xylitol, no sugar!
column10: I have dry mouth, and gum chewing really helps.  Sugar-free sweeteners bother my innards, so I've been looking for a gum that doesn't have any sorbitol or xylitol.  Voila!  (Or the Turkish equivalent.)This gum is good quality and lightly flavored.  The individual pieces are a generous size. (What looks like a stick of gum in the picture is actually a pack of 5 pieces.) I understand that this gum has a 25% market share in Turkey.I disagree with a previous reviewer who says that it's like chewing tar.  Some pieces started out kind of chewy, but most didn't, and they all ended up a good consistency in a short time.The shipping bumps up the price considerably when you buy it alone, but the pack I bought will last me for several months and I'm glad it's available.

column9: Only if you like to chew tar...
column10: I liked the idea of no sweeteners but this gum is extremely hard to chew.  My jaw gets too tired too fast.

This is my favorite brand of the new honey-whiskey craze. It almost has as much alcohol as regular whiskey but the honey takes a lot of the edge off, so you don't taste it as much. I usually have it as a dessert. I like to keep it in freezer to make it nice and thick. It would probably be really good with ice cream.

I bought this selection to take to work for lunch.  I wanted something easy, tasty and warm versus a sandwich everyday.  This selection fits the need.This includes mashed potatoes, gravy and about 8 small pieces of beef. The potatoes are injected into the container...and have a hocky puck like appearance when you open it.  The mashed potatoes are tasty, but could not be confused as "homemade".  They are thick and have a good consistency though.  The beef is good...but I always want more than the 7 or 8 small pieces they give you.  The gravy is plentiful...you will have enough to cover each bite of potato and meat.The meaty flavor is very good.  Health conscious people should know that the calories are low (about 350 calories for this entry) but there is a salty taste to this product...I didn't check the sodium content but I am going to guess it is pretty high.Easy to heat, easy to eat.  I recommend.

column9: Tasty, but skimpy amount of meat and barely any mushrooms
column10: This little bowl is pretty good tasting and has a nice beefy aroma. I just wish there was more meat to it. The amount of beef and mushrooms in here is not even close to what the photo suggests. It's mostly mashed potatoes in here, with what I would call sprinkles of meat. I found maybe 2 specks of mushrooms. They were not whole slices.Like all the other Compleats, the mashed potato is one dense block of material at the bottom of the bowl. There are about 6 or 7 small pieces of beef in here, the biggest being about the size of a thumb. The others were much smaller.Sodium content is modest at 25% of your daily value. Some of the other Compleats trays are as much as 40%. Recommended if you're hungry and in a hurry, but you should disregard the "created for a healthy lifestyle" wording on the packaging. While convenient (only takes 90 seconds to microwave up and does not need refrigeration), eating highly processed high sodium food is not healthy. For under $12, this is a good deal. I got mine at the local drugstore on sale for $2 a bowl.
This one was not too bad. The mashed potatoes were a little hard though. There was enough meat to make the meal satisfying. I wish it had more mushrooms though, but that's just my preference :)
i am not picky but this is really bad food...I don't know how you can make gravy this awful.It get a 2 star for the cheap price.

It was very nice to find these on Amazon.  I eat them for lunch everyday but can't always find the ones I like each time I shop.  This one is especially good with some mushrooms added to the meat and potatoes.  These lunches are nice in not needing to be refrigerated and only needing 90 seconds to cook, so for eating them at work it's perfect: keep them in a desk drawer and don't create a line waiting for the microwave to finish.

What can I say , there were a few pieces of beef strips floating in gravy , with mashed potatoes . Except the Mashed Potatoes were so hard they had to be cut into sections before you could attempt to eat them . Other than that there's not much else to say about them .

You can't fool me. I own a dog and I can tell you the quality of the beef in this product is most definitely dogfood. The smell and texture is distinctly that of canned wet dogfood. The taste is like that of nothing I've ever tasted in the "beef" category. Only God knows what I actually ate. I will no longer buy my dog that canned stuff ever again, now that I know what it tastes like. Thanks, Hormel.

I purchased 2 packages (6 loaves) of this bread based upon a diabetic nutritionists recommendation. Yes it is expensive, but it is difficult to find locally so I figured I would buy a couple in order to freeze some so I wouldn't have to re-order. The order arrived on time as promised (I ordered 1 day shipping to ensure freshness)When I opened the box I found that the top loaf had been reduced to a bag of crumbs because apparently there is a shortage of packing material in California. When I tasted the bread I was very disappointed. I was not expecting a blast of flavor but I did expect, based on previous reviews, at least SOME flavor. Instead what I got was the DRYEST, most bland taste one can imagine. I might as well have been eating the cardboard box it arrived in. To be fair, it did taste somewhat better toasted with butter on it, but not very much (and that defeats the purpose).Bottom line is that the bread tastes horrible, and that is only if you can find a piece of it that doesn't crumble in your fingers.

I bought this product because of the good reviews. However, on arrival the bread fell completely apart. So there goes using it as sandwich bread. I have used it as low carb bread crumbs but I wouldn't be in a hurry to buy it ever again.

column9: Health Express All Natural 1 Net Carb Flax Seed Bread (pack of 3 loaves)
column10: That Flax seed bread is very good.  It is the best I have tasted yet, of all the bread that I have ordered.  It is very good toasted, with margarine, peanut butter and Agave!  I will be ordering more of it, next time!!  All the information about the bread was given and my decision to buy it, was made on that!

column9: Great Tasting Healthy carb free Bread
column10: This Bread really IS the greatest thing since sliced Bread.  For a diabetic it is a must product, it has helped lower my blood sugar 50 points since I stated eating this bread instead of regular bread.  You might say just don't eat bread, that is impossible when you are addicted to bread.  Now if they made pasta with zero net cards my other addiction would be solved.  If they made frozen dough using the same recipe I could have pizza with near zero carbs also.  They need to franchise this product and recipe on the East Coast by this baker.
I mix the powder in with sugar in a jar.  I put a little of the mixture in water, and enjoy drinking it throughout the day. (sometimes I have a hard time drinking plain water.

Kool-Aid seems to be the only brand of unsweetened soft drink mix. I prefer this kind of product because I want to choose what sweetener (white/brown sugar, Splenda, honey, etc.) I'd use and the amount of sweetness. Plus, there are some drinks that are too sweet, so I love the option to tone down the sweet, increase the tart.My only complaint is the price ($0.23/packet). Although I've seen a packet up to $0.35 in local stores, during many sales a packet goes for $0.10. Generally, I'd expect when buying in bulk like this, there'd be a better discount.I guess when there's no competition, there's no motivation to offer better discounts. Five stars for the product, 1 star for the price = 3 stars.

My gf and I did a taste test of this, Kool-Aid Twists Ice Blue Raspberry Lemonade Unsweetened Soft Drink Mix (Kool-Aid Twists Ice Blue Raspberry Lemonade Unsweetened Soft Drink Mix, 0.22-Ounce Packets (Pack of 96)), and Minute Maid 15 cal/cup Lemonade that we buy at the store.We did not like this at all at first. We liked the Kool-Aid Twists Ice Blue Raspberry Lemonade much better. Even better than both, the Minute Maid was much better by far.We use the Splenda packets so there are hardly any calories (Splenda has 3.5 calories per packet but it can be labeled as 0 calories since it is under 5). Splenda tastes just like sugar with no bad aftertaste. We have changed to using slightly less than 8 cups of water to make the taste richer. We have also increased the Splenda to 12 packets to make it sweeter.Addendum: After many taste tests now, I am increasing the rating to a 4. The problem was that this flavor really needs more sweetener. We increased the Splenda to 1 cup.
Got this do to reviewers saying it cleans out the dishwasher... nope. Do not believe it! Maybe OK for drinking (didn't try it...), but to clean your dishwasher? No way!

My first introduction to Doctor Kracker was through a random review on Amazon about eight years ago, dormant but not forgotten the review resurfaced when I finally saw a box of the flatbreads at my local Zabar's (perk of living in New York). While shopping I spotted them so of course my curiosity escalated and I took a box home, I love pumpkin and cheese, so these were totally up my alley, a few years later and I'm a still huge fan, in fact I'm munching on the now, watching Japanese Iron Chef on TV now, figuring I should review something that I'm so wild for.These offer a major crunch, you almost have to chew these like a Viking with gusto but they are oh so good, the cheddar is quietly baked into to the batter with a few extra sprinkles on top and it provides a lightly salty and crispy background for the nutty pumpkin seeds which are sprinkled throughout each large slab, you can barely taste the cheese, just the salty residue really as these are nice and healthy, each packs 4 grams of fiber and 5 grams of protein per 100 calories ( 8 per box). This is a great treat to enjoy with beer if you want to go hang out with friends, or a nice piece under some creamy French Bree or nice slice of cured meat, even turkey and apples can become a lunch time snack with this flatbread under as it's sturdy enough to be a part of a meal. For me these make for a yummy bite, I can never get enough and I finish a box in no time, these are subtle but so refined that they beckon for me to keep coming back, anytime I'm at that store I have to get these because it's impossible to resists what awaits inside. These do not taste like junk food, they are very basic yet complex, at first they hardly taste like anything but the more you eat them the more you want, so keep some on hand once you start them.- Kasia S.
There are only two places in Pittsburgh where I can find this product.  I am glad it's available through Amazon.comI don't want anyone else to purchase this product.  Leave them all for me, thanks

These are excellent crackers for someone on a low carb diet who also wants a tasty satisfying cracker.They are very hard, and are great with peanut butter or even plain. I especially like them with cream cheese.Net carbs for one cracker is about 7 grams depending upon your choice of flavor.  They are also large, about thesize of a small postcard, and about 100 calories per cracker.  One cracker is very satisfying due to itstaste, size, crunch, texture, and ability to hold whatever  other non carb stuff you choose to pile on it.

Doctor Kracker makes terrific crackers.  They are in a box wrapped in foil and so stay fresh.  I store boxes in the freezer in a freezer bag too and they stay fresh for a long time.  Guests who have never tried them rave so much I have to give them a box to take home!  All the flavors are great and you feel like you are eating healthy with the various flavors and seeds, etc.

In fact, I want to have your babies.  Why?  These are the best crackers evah!  I've turned to the low carb way of life because of diabetes which means no bread, no crackers, etc.  I have really missed that crunch!  I use to be a popcorn fanatic but had to change all that due to the diabetes.  I just bought the six boxes from Amazon a few days ago based solely on the reviews here.  To my great surprise, I found them in the all natural section of my Publix.  My husband broke open the box for me in the car and handed me a small piece.  WOW!  I was in heaven!!  So crunchy and great tasting.  That night, I had one with a salad.  Put cream cheese on one.  Oh boy!  Then, as a snack, had another one later on with cream cheese again.  Just had one for lunch with tuna on it.  *sigh* I luvs you Doctor Kracker!!  I probably should only eat two a day to watch the carbs but they don't seem to spike my blood sugar at all.  Also, these are not little crackers.  They are about the size of a Poptart!  I can't wait to get my six boxes!

column9: If You Want Wholegrain and a Strong Crunch, This is it!
column10: I like to keep crackers next to my chair and bed to try to help settle my tummy. A restaurant my hubby and I used to go to had this great seeded cracker that they called flatbread, but they don't carry it anymore. I decided to give Seedlander a try and it was very yummy and kept that great crunch, the next logical step was to try 2 things I love together, pumpkin and cheddar. The cheddar is baked onto the cracker along with the pumpkin seeds, which have this wonderful toasted flavor. In fact I like to break some off sometimes to really enjoy the flavor. I have been looking for lots of ways to use this wonderful cracker, as it is really wonderful as a snack but also to replace bread and make a sandwich. One of my favs is to take some albacore tuna, a bit of Smart Balance Omega Mayo and sweet pickle relish to pile onto this cracker. Wow!

I am not a bread person but I LOVE to eat the Pumpkin Seed Cheddar crackers with a salad or soup!  I love the crunch (some say they are TOO hard but not me) and the cheese and pumpkin seed mixture is great!  I get these on a regular basis.  In fact, I hate being out of them!
I ate these crackers at Jasons Deli and loved them. So ordered 6 boxes. Very low carbs so good for us diabetics.
Dr. Kracker makes great products and we think that this cheesy flatbread is the best.
These  organic pumpkin seed, cheddar Crispbreads are baked and totally delicious.  They make a great snack containing protein, whole grain fiber and no sugar.  I'm addicted.

column9: Mmmmm Good! These Things Are Great!
column10: We have a nearby Fresh and Easy store and I enjoy  shopping there. It's an English company that has invaded the American scene, I like them for a variety of reasons but one is that they carry  a number of exotic items that I've just never seen anywhere else and I enjoy trying them. One such item is "Doctor Kracker Pumpkin Seed Cheddar Crispbreads. Eight 3" by 4" come cellophane-wrapped in a 7-ounce box. These are great. They're about the crispest cracker I've ever eaten and the flavor is mild but excellent. Plus, they're a whole grain cracker with a lot of fiber and no sugar so they're low on calories. Mmmmm, good! These things are great! I can hardly wait to try  the other varieties.Gary Peterson
I would buy some in a store first.  I could imagine someone not liking these like my wife but I love them.  Great snack and healthy too.

I am on a very strict low carb diet and these crackers are not only low carb (approx. 7 grams of NET carbs), they are delicious.  I am also post operative so going out to purchase them wasn't an option and I was really missing them.  Very nutritious, high in fiber, and easy to digest.The shipment came on time and I was very pleased.  When I factor in what I would have spent on gas versus the free shipping, I broke even and it was extremely convenient.  Ordering more. I have had their other flavors and they are just as delicious.  Yum.

column9: great healthy and yummy i love love love
column10: these crackers are delicious . i absolutely love them. my dr is a runner ,very healthy man. i took some in and gave him a box and he loved them. he also told me they were very healty. im a diabetic and they are low in carbs and very healthy-just a yummy treat
Crackers were fresh. Packaging was lacking though. After receiving 2 separate shipments, both shipments had broken crackers in each package.

column9: Doctor Cracker Pumpkin Seed Cheddar Organic Crispbreads
column10: Great product.  Low calorie.  The dogs and I eat a box every night.  Absolutely love them.  I usually buy them by the case, and Wal-Mart also sells them.

column9: Organic Flatbread from Dr. Cracker review
column10: Doctor Kracker Organic and Artisan-Baked Flatbread, Pumpkin Seed Cheddar, 7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)  I have eaten this product at Jason's Deli and loved it.  However, when I found it online, the price was quite high, but since we liked it so much, I ordered it anyway.  It was delivered quickly, just a matter of a couple days, because it is made not 10 miles from our office.  BUT IT TASTED STALE.  That was a real disappointment and I will not order any more.  It's much too expensive to be stale in less than 3 days of my order.  Both my husband and I had it again at Jason's Deli yesterday and it tasted fresh and wonderful.  Our experience was not a happy one.  I tried to find a retailer who sells it in the area, since it is made right here, but could not find one, so I guess we will just have to find something else.
I ordered six boxes but one box was empty.  I tried to contact someone to get another box but was not successful.

I first found these crackers at a Jason's Deli restaurant, and have been searching for them online.  They are wonderful tasting crackers.  I signed up for the subscribe and save and look forward to receiving them every other month.

Even though the dates on the boxes were a year away, and the shipment arrived in two days because of my Amazon Prime, the crackers were still stale in the worst way imaginable.  Contacted Amazon via chat and got a refund.  Ew.

We love these flatbreads and the store where we purchased them quit selling them so I was so glad to see that Amazon had them. Promptly ordered them and when they arrived each one was broken in at least 4 pieces. Imagine sending a box of crackers  through the mail with no padding and what you get is six boxes of broken pieces!! Very disappointed

When I was a little kid my sister gave me a dollar to eatone our dog's biscuits.  I was brought back to that moment intime today when I ate one of these Doctor Kracker Pumpkin Cheddar Flatbreads.I'm not proud of what I did to receive that dollar when I was a little kid.But you should save your dollars and buy something that tastes good.
It's great that I can order groceries through amazon. The 100% juice Capri Suns were exactly as described and ordered... granted I would love to find some Ecto Cooler somewhere.
These are simply dry roasted peanuts - no additives, no flavoring, no salt.  They come in neat reclose-able packages.  the nuts are fresh and good.
I bought these to make homemade peanut butter.  It turned out wonderfully.  My 15 month old daughter loves it on her waffles.

Good product, peanuts taste fresh, delicious, and natural. But the price has jumped $10 since I ordered them two months ago (its currently listed at $35 from Amazon).I don't know why its getting harder and harder to find dry-roasted, unsalted peanuts. A few months ago I found a great deal on Planters 16 oz. jars from Amazon--then the price skyrocketed. I went with these, and wasn't disappointed, but I'm not sure this is the best price to beat anymore.

I like Azar peanuts, pecans, macadamia, walnut products.  I buy them online because I can get free shipping and better prices than my local big box store.  Freshness has never been an issue with those I have received. Thank you Azar!
DO NOT HESITATE PURCHASING THESE WONDERFUL NUTS ... THEY ARE VERY FRESH, WITH OUTSTANDING FLAVOR AND CONSISTENCY ... I HAVE TRIED MANY OTHERS THAT JUST COULD NOT MEASURE UP TO THESE ...

They look as great as they taste!  The milk chocolate was very smooth and silky!  They melted in your mouth and K&K was great to work with!  They made sure I received the chocolates in perfect time and condition for my wedding!
This is one of the best chocolate i have eaten in a long time... I would recommend this to anyone.

disclaimer first: lindt is the chocolate brand i like, not milka. in theory.in practice, i love 2 milka products.no 1 is this chocolate: i am CRAZY about it!caramel is actually liquid and although this is not exactly "FILLED chocolate", they weren't goin cheap on just how much caramel filling they spritzed in it.to make a long story short, if you love caramel, you will LOVE this chocolate.

column9: Chocolate gods have called upon this chocolate
column10: This is by far the best tasting chocolate out there. AND to top it off it is filled with delightful caramel! I'd say it worth your time and money to at least give it a try.
The size was much smaller than I had anticipated and the chocolates themselves seemed old.  This product when fresh is PHENOMINAL, but what I received was less than delicious.

column9: what do we get mom for her birthday?i know CHOCOLATE
column10: AS ARE MOMS GET OLDER IT BECOMES HARDER TO SHOP FOR HER BIRTHDAY GIFT.SHOULD WE GUESS WHAT SIZE SWEATER SHE WEARS.I MEAN WE GET HER SWEATERS EVERY YEAR AND SHE ALWAYS SEEMS TO WEAR THEM ON THE ONE DAY OF THE YEAR WE VISIT HER.ON THAT DAY SHE BRINGS OUT CHOCOLATE FOR THE KIDS.YES MOMS LIKE CHOCOLATE AND THIS YEAR I GOT HER GHIRDELLI MASTERPIECE BOXED CHOCOLATE.MOM LIKED THIS GHIRARDELI CHOCOLATE SO MUCH THAT SHE CALLED ME TO SAY THANK YOU.THIS SAVED ME THE PHONE CALL TO WISH HER A HAPPY BIRTHDAY.SO FOR NOW ON MOM WILL GET A BOX OF GHIRARDELI CHOCOLATE MASTERPIECE BOXED CHOCOLATES.I COULD TELL MOM REALLY ENJOYED HER BOX OF CHOCOLATE EVERY PIECE PACKED A DIFFERENT FLAVOR.AMAZON PACKED THIS CHOCOLATE AND WHEN MY MOM RECIVED HER PACKAGE OF CHOCOLATES THEY WERE DELIVERED CHILLED AND COLD.AMAZON WAS ABLE TO DO THIS DURING THE HOT SUMMER.I WOULD LIKE TO THANK AMAZON FOR GOING BEYOND JUST DELIVERING A PACKAGE.AGAIN AMAZON CAN DELIVER COLD CHOCOLATE ANYTIME OF THE YEAR.THIS ITEM CAN BE GIVEN TO ANYBODY AT ANY TIME.I WILL BE SENDING THIS ITEM AGAIN SO SHOULD YOU.

My dogs always look forward to this treat. Most dogs like chicken. You don't have to worry about storage since they are freeze dried. It's cheaper and easier than buying chicken at the store, cooking it and storing it. This is not a food, it's a treat. You can also grind up the smaller pieces and spread it on top of their regular dog food.

We were sent a 1.4 ounce bag of the chicken Prime Bites treats by a friend. My dogs loved it!!! And how simple - there's only ONE ingredient, which is freeze-dried chicken. The treats were just dry and crumbled but my dogs went crazy. You don't get very much in a bag, and by looking at Amazon's prices, they're a bit expensive. But for a once-in-a-while splurge, this is the way to go!

This is the best training treat I've come across.  I have pomeranian puppies and they have trained so nicely with this treat.  I cut the treat into smaller bite size pieces for them.  When I say, "come", they run as fast as they can to me!  It's also nice because you can hide a few pieces of it in their kong toy with food a mealtime.  That keeps them entertained while you eat!  It doesn't smell bad and keeps easily.  They just love it.

All I have to do is say "chicken" and my cat rushes to her food bowl.  She loves, loves, loves, these things.  And I like it because it is made in USA, a good protein source for little obligate carnivore, easy to give to her, and there's no messy residue to clean up.  I'd say that most of the bag is large to medium sized chicken chunks, and the rest is "chicken crumbs".  Even "chicken crumbs" are easily mixed with a bit of warm water to make a treat she goes gaga over.  If you are using these as dog training rewards, the crumbs might be a bit a of a waste, but you can always sprinkle it on your dog's food.  I will definitely buy this again from Amazon, as my local pet food store stopped carrying it.
I can't believe how she enjoys these treats. She is a very fussy dog. She's a ten year old Boston Terrier.
My dog loves these.  I am on auto ship for these.  Good buy for the money. Product is made in the USA (YEAH) and is all natural.

column9: FINALLY a good freeze-dried chicken treat that isn't rancid!
column10: RE: CATS LOVE THIS!!I'm thrilled to have discovered Prime Taste Treats freeze dried dog treats made from 100% chicken breast! AND MADE IN THE USA!!! My cats love this product!!Pet owners should all know by now to check all food to ensure it's not coming from China OR irradiated! (another brand of freeze-dried chicken treats (Beefeaters) is both from China and  irradiated! OMG! (the Beefeater's salmon is USA-made and not irradiated; they are ok and my cats love those...)I spent hundreds of dollars on numerous pouches of the chicken PureBites only to find rancid, slimy pieces in 3 of every 4 pouches I purchased, so much money wasted tossing those pouches out, OR PureBites will refund, using the excuse that "all fat can't be removed from the chicken, so it's normal to find rancid pieces"  but that puts it on the customer to send the bag back to them for a refund. Too much work so I gave up - until I found Prime Taste Treats today!These Prime Taste Treats have a large window on the front so you can see the actual pieces inside; pieces of nice white chicken chunks that easily crumble down to "cat-size" with my fingers without encountering greasy slime like I did far too often with PureBites....This product proves that it IS possible to eliminate all the fat IF one uses a good processing plant!I will continue to feed this to my cats as a daily treat. Cats are obligate carnivores so pure protein is a great treat or supplement for them! (but not to be used to replace a meal because it lacks taurine which is essential for all cat food. This is a "treat", so make sure you are feeding a complete cat food along with these..)

I really wanted to like these treats as all the puppy training manuals say to use freeze dried liver treats when training counts.  I gave my puppy (a 16 week old, 25lb. German Shorthaired Pointer) 3 of these treats, broken into small pieces, during a training session.  He projectile vomited within 5 minutes of receiving these treats.  Another reviewer posted the same issue under a different listing (both his dogs vomited immediately) of this product and the manufacturer replied stating it was lack of water or a beef allergy.  Not the case with my dog, who has access to fresh water all day, and has had plenty of exposure to beef.  He only gets premium, all natural wet and dry food and treats (Nature's Variety Instinct and Nature's Variety Prairie).  All his treats are natural and holistic and are fed in limited quantities as well.  I see nothing on the label stating a puppy should not receive these.  I was going to try to give them to him again in a few days, but the other reviewer with the same issue did that, only to have his 2 dogs vomit again.

column9: My dog will do anything for this!
column10: I have a 3 1/2 month old German shepherd/lab and his trainer introduced these treats when training him in chaotic envrionments such as in the store and outside. One whiff under the nose he sits and makes direct eye contact with me. The trainer calls it "puppy crack". He LOVES it! I only use these in certain circumstances, otherwise at home he gets a cheaper treat. You can break up the liver ones into quite a few pieces. My trainer said not to get the chicken ones because they break into powder. Overall,the liver will last much longer (since they are quite pricey) and I highly recommend!
I break the pieces in half and my diabetic cats love their high protein treat!
This frappe mix is yummy.  It is positively loaded with little java chips.  I buy several Mocafe flavors; this is my favorite.

On the directions it states 2 scoops of the powdered mix per 4 fl oz. milk and 14 fl oz. of ice. However there is one thing missing....the scoop! How does one know exactly how much mix is contained in one scoop? My guess is about 1 1/2 tablespoons per scoop based on my taste tests. There isn't as many java chips in this mix as the starbucks drink, but it tastes good especially if you doctor it up. I added about a tablespoon of nutella to my drink and that made it perfect! 5 stars for taste but i am deducting 1 star for the missing scoop.

this is my new favorite version of you-know-who's frappacino.  the java chips are teeny tiny until you mix the drink, then they puff up.  this is, i think, less  sweet than some of the other mocafe varieties, which is a real plus in my book.  in fact, just signed up to get this auto-delivered.  i just blend it with ice and water and whatever else i have around in terms of adding additional flavors, ie vanilla, irish cream non-alcholic syrup.  yum!

Real chips in it! And not overly done coffee taste.... I drink it almost every morning! VERY TASTY!I blend it up for about 1 minute with the 2 scoops, ice and milk and it's perfect... I like having little chips! yummy
Packaging was great and arrived on time. I thought it was a little Pricey but the part that ruined it for me was how sweet it was. It tastes more like a milk shake than coffee.
Product just as described! I add instant espresso powder to replicate adding hot shots of espresso. No more expensive coffee shops. Couldn't be better!
This a delicious and easy way to make a frappe that rivals those made at Starbucks.  Not only is it convenient is much less expensive. My son likes to add caramel syrup to his.

Just tried my first taste of the Java Chip Frappe this morning. Java Chip Frappe is a delicious blended iced coffee. I was a little skeptical at first because I'm a huge fan of Starbuck's Java Chip and hadn't yet found a mix that was as good as their's. This mix is by far the best I have tried. It's loaded with chocolate chip pieces and the coffee flavor itself is delicious. A definitely recommend to anyone who loves the java chip flavor or blended coffee in general. The 3 pound bag is more than enough to satisfy a frappe lovers thirst for a long time!!Bye bye Starbucks!!

These little curled lamb treats can make decent treats for most dogs. They soften up quickly, unlike rawhide, yet can be enjoyed longer than a biscuit because of their consistency. My only caveat would be to watch the aggressive type eaters carefully, (especially large breeds), as they may try to wolf these down whole or barely damp only to end up gagging. Fortunately they usually gag right up. They also lack the corners of hard rawhide strips which saves the esophagus on the way down (and back up), should they try and swallow it whole. I think they are best for small and medium dogs who do not try this but rather attempt to gnaw, dampen and enjoy the treat more normally.Overall, for healthy normal eaters, they are a nice treat and a good change of pace.
Growing up in NY, these were one of my favorite things to eat.  These are the real deal and if you buy them, you will not be disappointed.

column9: Unique flavor and fabulous--my new favorite!
column10: My friends describe me as a chocoholic. I describe myself as a dark chocolate-snob. I like seeking out single varietals and interesting flavors. I prefer straight chocolate over chocolate with "stuff" in it but I really like this flavor. A lot.I first had it at a food and wine pairing and the chef brought it for us to try. I had to get a wrapper and seek it out for myself.My mother who is also hard to please (food and flavor-wise) really likes it too. I tend to buy it by the dozen and share with friends because I can't find this flavor at stores near by that carry other Theo's products.I'm delighted to see it here!

I loved these ricecakes.  They were a little crumbly, but the flavor was good and just the right amount of salt.  I will definitely be buying these again.  I eat a package of ricecakes a day, so I know my ricecakes!

I like onions quite a bit.  I enjoy putting dry chives in the dishes that I prepare.  I find they are a very good way to flavor my dishes without the worry of fresh chives and the labor of preparing them for cooking.  Excellent in Roman Noodle Soups. I would recommend this product for those who enjoy chives.

not sure what i was expecting, but i know I was hoping for a bit more than what i got, which was NOTHING...!i LOVE chives, but i guess there is a significant loss of flavor during the air-drying process...because this product arrived flavorless and odorless...even when reconstituted in a recipe...the only advantage is they add some color, but i could have gotten the same effect with dried cilantro or parsley at a MUCH lower cost...very disappointed.
It has the consistency and taste of a pizza sauce or tomato paste. It doesn't have many chunks in it at all and "Chunky" is in the title.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: These are HOT green chiles, NOT the usual BLAND Ortega Green Chile!
column10: Got these once thinking I was buying the usual mild green chiles from Ortega, but got a surprise -they're HOT! I expected the product to be good like other plum organic products. But this stinks and smells burnt food. My baby threw up once i fed her a spoon. I did taste and "eek" terrible. I thought the problem was with specific pack.. but no.. the product is bad..

I love arbequina olive oils for their delicacy and ability to marry with other flavors.  This Zoe oil has a more pronounced woody flavor than some others I've had but is completely delicious with that light, piney, green appley fruit I always love in arbequina oils.  I'm thinking of pouring it into a glass bottle.  Not sure if the thin plastic it comes in is the best thing to be rubbing up against my oil.  Great for fish and bright dishes.  Carries the flavor of garlic like a dream.

column9: Delicious!! The Best Olive Oil I've Ever Had!
column10: I've tried many oils, and this is the first one that actually floored me with it's delicious taste. The flavor is perfectly balanced--not too heavy, not too light. Superb for cooking, salads, garlic and fresh herb dipping oils. Carries flavors wonderfully without losing it's own deliciousness! What is a great price for such a quality EVOO. I can't imagine using anything else now and will certainly buy again. My only minor complaint is the plastic bottle, but I transferred it to a dark glass bottle upon opening.

I really appreciated the packaging of this oil because the edge of the bottle opening is slightly curved in such a way that there's no drip (for me at least) after pouring oil out of the bottle, which has been a constant problem for me with other brands of olive oil I've bought from the supermarket because I don't transfer the oil to another container (like you see on cooking shows) - I keep things simple and just pour it out of the original container. Now I don't have to worry about oily surfaces and sticky bottle sides. It's just a little thing, but it makes things so much more worth it in considering whether I want to go for this brand or another.Taste was good as any olive oil I've had. Upon opening the bottle, I had a bit by itself and I was extremely happy with the quality. Better than what's in the grocery aisles. It's not that much more expensive than bigger brands, so I'd definitely recommend trying this brand out at least once. I don't think you'll be disappointed.

I have purchased the Zoe evoo in cans (regular and organic) many times in the past and been very satisfied.  I like this Zoe 100% arbequina evoo even better, as far as taste goes.  It is very flavorful, somewhat grassy with no bitter taste, and has a smooth, silky texture.  It is more of a rich yellow color than green.  It is a great all purpose oil that holds up to sauteeing, drizzling over cooked pasta, for use in salad dressings and for bread dipping.  It is also pretty economical to use for all kitchen uses, especially when purchased on subscription basis. This comes in a clear bottle, not my preference for storage of olive oils, so I have wrapped the bottles with foil to minimize light exposure and slow degradation.  Oils can also be stored in the refrigerator or freezer to maintain quality.

Outstanding value.  This oil is very herby.  I mean, I know it's just olives in there, but it almost tastes as if herbs are delicately waved past your nose as you taste it.  Very interesting tasty stuff.  I'll probably stick to this for a while.
This olive oil has a fruity taste and aroma, and is something that you won't find in grocery store extra virgin olive oils.

lovely aroma and fruity flavor with the tiniest hint of a peppery finish is making me think that the best olives are grown in spain rather than italy.ever since the scandal broke in the New Yorker magazine (august 13, 2007 - Slippery Business by Tom Mueller.  google it.) about the fraudulent practices of italian olive oil merchants i have been looking for ways to identify good sources of untainted olive oil.  recent reviews in Cooks Illustrated confirm that the truest and most consistent flavors found in the EVOO market today are coming from spain.  at a price.this Zoe Arbequina varietal brings both flavor and value back to us, the amazon consumers.  priced to compete with the italian junk in the grocery store, this line of oils meets my unfairly high standards.  (i hate to be a snob, but a bad oil can ruin a meal.)yes, this is a plastic bottle.  so what.thanks to Tom Mueller, the New Yorker, Cooks Illustrated, Amazon, and Zoe.  great oil.  tonight it gets drizzled on baby creamer potatoes, with sel gris and fresh dill.  bon appetit.five stars
Just received 2 bottle set and noticed the olive oil was bottled in 2000 - their website says olive oil can stay fresh for 2 years after bottling.  hmmmm...

column9: Tasty product...has a hint of spice
column10: This is a good product, and has a bit of spice. It's not an over the top fabulous like some of the reviews stated, but it's good.  I don't see spending nearly $20 a liter at regular price.  But at the sale price of 2 liters for under $20 it's a bargain.  I am so glad it's back in stock and on sale

Its just cooking oil. Its has not strong smell like the other olive oils that I have tried.Pretty decent taste as well.

column9: An excellent olive oil at a reasonable price
column10: I am particularly fond of arbequina olive oil and have had this brand of olive oil on subscription for several years. This oil has the buttery, fruity flavor typical of arbequina olive oil. It does not have a big robust flavor typical of some other olive oils. Rather, it has a more subtle olive flavor that I prefer.I use this oil for most of my food preparation except for high temperature frying. I've even used it to make an olive oil cake that turned out beautifully. All in all, I have been very pleased with this brand of arbequina olive oil. I do recommend it.

column9: Zoe Diva Select Olive Oil is great
column10: I really like the Zoe Diva olive oils.  It has a mild flavor, and we use it in just about everything.  The price was good and delivered to my door, how can you beat that.
This olive oil is lovely. It is reasonable price. Nice fragrant and taste. I use it on my caprese salad and it is awesome. This would be a stable in our pantry
This olive oil was excellent and you get a lot for the price. It's also a great alternative oil when cooking because it's healthier than other oils. This oil has a real refreshing flavor.

column9: Great oil but PACKING/SHIPPING WAS NOT GOOD on 12 bottle buy

The twelve plastic liter bottles were shipped loose in one of Amazon's light-duty boxes with two of those small plastic air-bags. I was quite pleased with what I received mainly because I wasn't sure what to expect.  I still had a little bit of the olive oil from my old bottle left so I was able to taste the two and the Zoe Diva one was far superior in my opinion.  To think I paid about 9 dollars for a smaller sized bottle of the other stuff made me laugh as Amazon did it again helping me save some more money on an item I need quite often.The packaging it arrived in was pretty good and the outside plastic that held the two bottles together looked to have a lot of traces of oil on it and it did, but neither of my bottles were leaking at all.  I guess maybe it was just residual oil from when it was being packaged or maybe another set leaked.Still its in my S&S to be shipped every 6 months and looks like it will stay that way.
I dont know a lot about olive oil, but I love this stuffthe price is pretty good and it seems much smoother thanother olive oils I have used before. Tasty!

I'm addicted to this light tasty olive oil, for cooking, to substitute for butter/margarine, and to make my hair silky - yep, it's the best leave-in conditioner I've ever used, doesn't get rank and smelly, doesn't stain my bedding (obviously, I don't use a lot, just enough to hold moisture in my usually-frizzy curls). The plastic's very fine, doesn't hold the scent, recycles, ultra-light.

column10: I was very disappointed to receive what I thought wouldbe a quality olive oil in a glass bottle, instead it is in a Plasticbottle.
