These are almost verging on too sweet; a bold statement from me, since I have a big sweet tooth.  The lighter-colored snacks have a much more subtle and less sugary taste, and they do actually taste like white grapes.For those who have never tried Annie's Fruit Snacks before, you'll notice they are called "snacks," rather than "chews."  True to the name, there is no chewiness that you typically find in these kinds of treats.  Annie's are soft and separable with just one bite.One pack has only 70 calories, and as you'd expect, you don't get a whole lot for that small amount; there are about 14 fruit bunnies in each pack.  But while it may not be enough to satisfy if I'm very hungry, it does satisfy my sugar cravings.A tip for those who would like a bit more chew to these snacks:  I've recently started putting them in the freezer for about 5-10 minutes before eating a pack.  I love them like this - you get more of the firm "chewy" texture.Ingredients: organic tapioca syrup, organic cane sugar, organic tapioca syrup solids, organic white grape juice concentrate, pectin, citric acid, ascorbic acid, organic color, grape and other natural flavors, sodium citrate, organic sunflower oil, carnauba wax.

I found this product living in Florida and I can say that it brings out the flavor in chicken tremendously! I have not fully marinated with it. I usually rub down my chicken and then pop in the oven at 400 and bake for an hour. It comes out so juicy and flavorful that I can not even go back to cooking chicken any other way.I have yet to use it on other meats, but with the chicken I can say...do not hesitate to give it a try! Beyond AWESOME!!!!
Ive been using this product for years and glad to have found it here on Amazon. truly authentic Jamaican taste, the real deal.

I have killed entire families using this marinade, but by nature jerk stylewas never intended to be "mild."I'm not exaggerating the heat level of this stuff, its probably more thanmost can tolerate. But, being a front line chilihead from way back, the heatblends perfectly with the other spices to make either your chicken, fish, orpork come alive.The directions say to use 1 Tsp per pound of meat, but I use considerably morethan that, and let marinate for an hour. Actually you will get better results ifyou go for 24 hours in a ziplock bag in the fridge. You don't need to use saltand pepper, this has all the spice you need, and its all natural. Maybe the bestthing about this wondermous stuff is that its available locally almost everywherefor under $4. If you follow the directions you shouldn't offend anyone with theheat, but double the amount used and marinate longer than recommended and youmay get a complaint or two, just not from me. Grace does make a "Hot" version ofthis seasoning that is identical except for the heat levels.BTW, the other commercially available jerk seasoning comes from Walkerswood. Theyare both fantastic, the Walkerswood is a little saltier however so if you have anysensitivity to sodium then this is just the trick for you. But with the Grace seasoning,your finished product will have a green color, if you've used the grill you probablywont notice... the oven is another story.

A year or two ago, this product was available at a local wholesale club in a large plastic jug kind of a container that must have held the equivalent of 4 to 6 of these little jars. I started using it then, and found it to be very tasty, easy to fix, and healthful. When cooked with some canned chicken broth, it is unbeatable for flavor and cooking ease. The tidbits of carrots and other vegetables are a delicious blend with the rice products. I only wish the local wholesale club still carried it. These little 16 oz. jars don't last long enough.

This is a great product if you are looking for something that is low-cal, low-salt and tastes great. It's basically rice and dried vegetables and does not contain any added salt. I use either home made or low-salt store bought broth (all varieties work I've found) for a extra flavor. This blend is so good that some nights it is my main course with vegetables on the side.
If you like dried pears, these are worth the money.  They're excellent - tender, moist, whole halves.

I love pears, but I can never keep fresh fruit in my house (it always spoils before I get to it).  These are great tasting and can easily travel when necessary.  Love 'em, wish they had "Subscribe & Save" for these.

column9: Quality chocolate for a cheap price....
column10: We call these "ferrero rocher" patties. They taste 100% like ferroro rochers and for the cheap price they are totally worth it. Premium chocolate for a cheap price. I have been buying these for the past 5 years and my family loves it.
Seems that something old fashioned seems to still be the best.By the way the seller was great to.

I have used the Nutiva brand in the past that tasted and smelled like coconut. Heavenly in my opinion. This oil doesn't taste or smell like coconut oil. I have a feeling it will be great for cooking foods that you don't want a coconut flavor in. It's just that I wanted the coconut taste. I add a small teaspoon full to my coffee in the morning along with my almond milk to make it creamier and of course for the health benefit. I bake with it and fry pancakes in it. I even use it to cook meals that a coconut flavor would compliment.

column9: tree of life organic coconut oil
column10: I have been using tree of life organic coconut oil for the past year and find it very easy to use in baking or frying - I would like to know how long of a shelf life it has - I do not see an expiration date on the jar or label.  Is there some way I can find out about this?  I cannot find the website directly related to the manufacturer.Organic Coconut Oil 14 Ounces

I was very happy to find this product for several reasons. I have 3 spaniels, a cocker and 2 cavaliers, and they love having a chew in the evening. It's been getting very expensive when 3 dogs have 1 chew item every evening, so I was looking for something that lasts. My newest adopted dog likes cow ears (the other 2 dogs wouldn't touch them), and since he likes them the other dogs decided they would chew on them also. But the dogs still preferred smoked tendons I've been buying. So I was excited to find smoked cow ears, I've never seen these in TN where I live. I ordered them and they are a hit! The dogs can chew on them all evening and you can hardly tell. I will alternate these with other chews but it's so nice to have this option. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is the shipping cost, shipping costs double the cost of the order. (I don't know why I am labeled as living in Atlanta, GA--I live in Chattanooga, TN)

column9: Smoked? What Next? Steamed W/ Cat Flavor?
column10: I can't beleive what some manufacturers will go through just to get you to buy their product. I do not care what flavor these are or what you pour, cook, or smear on these MY DOGS KNOW THEY ARE UN-NATURAL! They will not get near them even if they were starving they would not eat them. I wasted my money in the hopes that maybe the unflavored supposedly all natural white ones just needing spicing up a bit. I was wrong! The dogs know what they are and will never let me forget it.

I thought I would love these based on the glowing reviews.  They are simply okay.  I doubt I'll buy them again.  I love that they are gluten free but that comes at a price.  The cookie part is always in pieces.  I pick up a cookie to take the first bite & never make it to my lips before half the cookie ends up on my lap or the floor.  What remains in my hands is also crumbling.  It seems the mere act of picking up the cookie causes it to have structural failure.  The inner part of the cookie stays true.  The addition of gelatin might have something to do with this.The taste is okay.  What flavor they have is tasty but there's not a lot of it.  The best thing about them is they come packaged 2 in a pack.  This makes them very convenient to take on the go & you don't have to worry about an open box going stale.  The box states that the packaging is non toxic aka green.  Not a lot of companies can make that claim.Even though I am not thrilled with these, I plan on trying the chocolate creme filled & the vanilla creme filled either when I find them at the store or when amazon offers them with the super saver shipping.On a final note, just for the heck of it, I put them in the toaster oven to have a breakfast treat with my tea.  They taste a bit better this way, but still fall completely apart - except for the gelatin filling which needs more figs.

I've been looking for fig cookies since I was diagnosed with Celiac Disease almost 7 years ago.  I missed fig newtons so much!  These cookies are probably far better than fig newtons.  They are so delicious.  They come in snack sized wrappings inside of the box, for easy portability.  These are worth every penny!

column9: Best fig cookie ever and gluten free!
column10: This is the best fig cookie I have tasted and it is gluten free!  The fig filling is so fresh.  Forget fig newtons!  I loved those as a kid, but these blow those away!

column4: K. Caster "Mom of child with ASD"
column9: Name Brand Fig Newton Lover WON OVER!
column10: Woooo Hoooo! Worth the wait, worth the money! We can feel safe eating a Gluten Free fig cookie with the SAME GREAT TASTE.We were horrified that after being diagnosed with Celiac Disease, and family members suffering Gluten Intolerance,that we would not be able to find compatible cookies like the Fig Newton!Fig Newton Lovers, there is HOPE! Jovial gets the job done! We are very happy with this cookie!

I tried these @ Health Expo West this past winter and have been dreaming about them since... counting the days until i could finally buy them somewhere... amazing tasting, great texture and best of all gluten free!!!

I was looking at Amazon.com to see if there were any gluten free cookies available that looked appealing to me.  I came across these fig cookies, and I really wanted to order them but was a little hesitant since a lot of gluten free food just simply doesn't taste that great.  I have celiac disease and cannot have any gluten, period.  So, these cookies are the first gluten-free fig cookies I have ever seen.  I was so excited and decided to give it a try.  I hoped that I hadn't wasted almost $17 on something I wouldn't want to eat.  Well, when I got home from work today, I saw the package and opened it immediately and tore right into one of the 2-pack plastic wrapped cookies.  They were INCREDIBLE!!!!  Oh my, they are just so good.  I haven't had a fig newton cookie for 2 1/2 years, since my diagnosis. They used to be one of my all time favorite cookies, and it's been a little sad to not have them.  But these are a great alternative to fig newtons when you live in a gluten free world.  I read some of the reviews that complained about the cookies crumbling in your hand.  They did not crumble in my hand.  They crumbled some in my mouth as I took a bite, but who cares?  I'm going to be chewing them anyway.  And they were not dry and did not leave a bad taste in my mouth.  They made my mouth water cause they were so good.  I opened another 2-pack and decided that I needed to "test" them a little more before I made my final decision on taste.  They are worth every single penny I paid.  I wish that I could pay a reasonable price for good gluten free food, but due to the more expensive ingredients, that just isn't going to happen.  I highly recommend these cookies, and I don't give out compliments to gluten free food products very often.  You should not be disappointed if you try them.  I'm so glad I did :)

I have been reading these reviews and had to write my own. Yes, they are a bit crumbly, but I have noticed (I buy them at my local store) that if they are a little bit old, they are not very good. My son (almost 3) loves them and I didn't think he would. He doesn't like things that crumble too much. I don't carry them around in his bag because they break easily if something is on them. I make sure to put two little packs a day for him. I am trying to have him gain weight so I don't mind the sugar or how many he eats.  I like that he loves them and that they aren't hard as a rock like some gluten-free cookies.

I have been a celiac for 10 years and these cookies are behind the times.  I stopped buying gf specialty foods about 4 years ago - I gave up due to lack of flavor/odd tastes (beany) and grainy textures.I have just started eating it again in the last 6-8 months because of the advances in popularity and therefore, flavor.These are so very dry.  The taste is odd, the texture is awful.  This is the type of gf specialty product that drove me away years ago.
Excellent "fig-newton" option for gluten free.  Authentic ingredients and not too sweet.  Really enjoy them!  However, you can buy them much cheaper on the jovial website.

I love these cookies...definitely better than the gluten form Fig Newtons...These are delicious gluten free cookies but I just saw they went up too much on here $$$$  bring them back to the $16.00.  If it keeps up this price I will just order them from Jovial's site which has it cheaper!

Too few cookies for too many $$. I don't understand why some GF companies use soy flour. Soy is a known allergen and if you're gluten intolerant, chances are also good that you're soy intolerant. There are other alternative flours.

column9: GF taste of days gone by...
column10: The cookies remind me of the GF quality available like 6 years ago. Very dry, crumbly, odd crust.The fig was way too sweet.  So far, it's still #1 for Paul Newmans f GF fig cookies. Ridiculous price for  the quantity also.

These are the best organic GF cookies I have ever eaten.  These Jovial fig cookies are every bit as good as Newman's. The small packs of cookies travel well.  Only thing that could make this better is a more reasonable price.  If Jovial ever stops making these, I think I will cry. Thanks to Amazon for making this available for prime shipping.

I absolutely love these cookies. They are a little crumbly but I don't even care. I actually think these taste better than Fig Newton's...I also gave some packs to people who don't have to follow a gluten free diet and they liked them as well.

I sure do miss Fig Newtons since being diagnosed with celiac disease. These truly are the closest thing!! Yes, they do crumble and they are harder than a regular Fig Newton but they are the closest I have found!! Yummy!!

I ordered a box of these directly through Jovial to try before I placed a bulk order and really enjoyed them.  The cookie and fig parts were both soft and moist.  I read one review that said the cookie part was crumbly but I did not find this to be the case at all.  I will be ordering more (and in bulk this time)!

My kids and I love these as much as the Fig Newtons we ate before our gluten intolerances came to light! I've only had one box that was a little dry but my kids didn't mind at all. The filling is always nice and moist.

These are fantastic "fig neutons". Better than the original. Not very crumbly at all - just delicious. They are individually packaged in twos also, so great for on the go. You must have these if you love fig cookies

I loved the idea of buying a gluten-free fig bar. The flavor of the filling is great, but the cookie crumbles when bit into. You lose a lot of the cookie crust at first bite unless you save it on a plate or in your hand. Wish they could figure out how to keep the crust from crumbling.

I purchased these mostly out of curiosity--I  never purchase cookies of any kind, and especially not the gluten-free variety (taste, texture, ingredients, price...just not worth it).  Before I review the cookies themselves I should explain that I almost never purchase processed food.  (I grind my own flours, make my own crackers, granola, salad dressings, etc.  So my three young daughters were SO excited to try something out of a box...whatever!  The grass is always greener on the other side!)  Anyway, I had seen these a few times at my local health food store and thought I'd give them a try.  If you're looking for gourmet, keep looking, these aren't your cookies.  However, for a boxed, gluten-free cookie they aren't too bad.  The fig flavor is more honest than a fig newton (haven't had in years but never liked), and they aren't as overly sweet as some.  That said, the fig flavor isn't quite strong enough to mask the typical gluten-free flavor of the cookie itself, and as other reviewers have noted they are very crumbly.  I ate the two in my little package and two of my three daughters ate theirs.  (One thought they were okay-good, the other said they were okay.)  The two year old tossed hers over the side of her carseat.  No one asked for more.Honestly, in a pinch I still would not buy them again, but if you like fig newtons and don't want to make your own AND you must buy gluten-free...well, these aren't too bad.

column9: For Some Reason, I Keep Coming Back For More...
column10: The first time I tried these, they were absolutely amazing. The fig-center was slightly gooey, and the cookie was soft. It brought back memories of the gluten-filled fig newtons I had given up 3 years before. I bought a box a few months later, and was sorely disappointed. The fig-center was more like a gelatin rather than gooey and the cookie crumbled with the slightest touch. The only thing I can figure is that the first batch I tried must've been incredibly fresh. I've bought a couple of boxes since then hoping for one that tasted as fresh, but I haven't had any as good as the first one.I like that they're packaged in twos for easy grab-and-go snacks and for portion control. I just have to be careful not to squish the packs in my bag...crumbled cookies! I also like the sweetness of the fig-center, but the oustide cookie part really doesn't have much flavor.
These are delicious. I eat them with a cup of lemon-ginger tea after the kids go to bed. :) It's the perfect treat for my alone time.
You just don't know chocolate until you have had flake.  Not as sweet as american chocolate and messy to eat (thus the name) but oh so delicious!  This package was fresh and wonderful.

column9: Most Excellent organic real fruit snack for all ages. My 9 yr old calls this his banana sauce. Also makes great baby food.
column10: This is a cool organic fruit snack great for all ages not just kids.  I was looking for an organic fruit snack for my sons lunch box and this  is prefect.  Great prepackaged, keeps well, no refrigeration required. Great for  on the go, lunch boxes, camping, picnics, anytime.  I can keep organic fruit on the shelf now ready anytime.We are never put off by labels like for tots or babies ,unfortunately  most of the organic snacks seem to be geared toward them.  My son loves bananas and apple sauce, so we thought we would try this.  So he calls this his  banana sauce.  He even wanted to freeze it . So we popped it in freezer and then cut off the bottom for a banana sorbet. He loved it.Also he loves the caps and is collecting  them to make something. They have holes so could be strung together.

I tried this product because it was a "Friday Special" and it caught my eye it being 100% fruit and 100% organic.  I don't have any children, but this looked interesting to try because I've been trying to eat healthier and sometimes it's hard to get my recommended amount of fruit servings a day.  I buy fruit but it always seems to go bad before I can eat it all.  I bought the peach mish mash also, and really like it, too.  I like to add it to my oatmeal, or spread it on top of my peanut butter toast, or just by itself!  To clarify the ingredients- it has 3 different fruits, not just peach and not just banana.  Obviously, I'm ok with this...just wanted to throw that out there.  There are multiple things I love about this product.  Here goes.. and not in any particular order...1) Easy to open, convenient, resealable pouch2) It tastes great!3) All natural, 100% fruit...no nasty preservatives or chemicals4) 100% organic5) Great for everyone, not just babies.6) The price is good compared with other similar products, and I love the free shipping!

My 9 month old absolutely LOVES these.  They are so convenient.  We are an on the go family going from practices and sporting events none stop. These are amazing, convenient and delicious, what more could you ask for?  I guess a lower price.  But, aside from the price, these are a great item to feed your baby.

column9: Perfect for beginner eaters and toddlers too!
column10: I purchased these when my infant son decided he hated being spoon-fed and wouldn't eat any jarred baby food. I saw these on Amazon and decided to give them a try. I loved the packaging and the fact that they're organic fruit.  Well, he loves them! He can hold them himself and suck the contents through the hole on top. No mess, happy kid. My 4 year old daughter loves them too...I just toss a bunch in my bag when we're heading out so I always have a simple, tasty, healthy snack on hand for both of them. Ok, fine, I'll admit it: I have several in my desk at work and I eat them too.  The fruits are all really good! It's like a little smoothie. This flavor (banana) happens to be my favorite.

Short and sweet, these are a God send!Might suggest instead of purchasing online, having your child try it at the store first. Our child likes one and then grows out of it, moving on to the next flavor. The price here is WAY more than we pay at Babies R Us (Usually on sale 10 for $10) or Target ($1.29) but we LOVE giving organic food and it seems to be a big hit!

column9: Great for traveling or throwing in your diaper bag
column10: My son loves these and they are great to put in your diaper bag when you are out and about or on a trip.  It is all fruit so that makes me feel better about giving them to my son.  He is 1 and a lot of times we can't find fruit that he can eat when we are out so these really help in those instances.  He drinks it right from the pouch.

I've been buying plum organics fruit pouches since my son was 6 months old. He loves their fruit pouches!it makes me feel good knowing that i'm giving my son organic fruits. it's convienent to take with you where ever you go and easy to give.i would highly reccomend this product.

Personally I thought they smelled a bit too much like overripe bananas, but my husband who I bought them for loves them! He has to have lots of potassium everyday and sometimes the store is out of bananas (our preferred easy source of on the go potassium naturally), so this was the perfect alternative! He loves them, they're organic, so I highly recommend them!

column9: Smaller version of the Plum purees.
column10: I know this says it's for toddlers but our toddler was eating these well before his 12mo birthday. The MishMash is essentially just a slightly more textured puree for slightly older kids. The smaller size of these (3.17oz vs the 4+oz ones) make them a great on-the-go snack or squeeze half of this into a plain yogurt or oatmeal for a little extra taste. Our kid loves these...can't recommend Plum products highly enough. He also gets to feed himself which is perfect since he think he's Mr. Independent.
My 8 month old loves this & has no problem holding it & sucking the food out.  This is great for on the go!

Our almost 12 month old twins love these. They do not quite know how to squeeze it themselves yet, but they seem to really like the taste. I love that it is organic, no added sugar, and minimal packaging.Great product and comes on bulk which is nice.
My grandkids love this!  It is easy to take for a snack for them and is not messy all!  Easy to take along.
I was not sure if my picky eater would like these, but he LOVES them!  Even after I tasted it I was not sure if he would eat them...he hate it in about a second!

I like these new pouches - easy travel. My non-fruit/veggie loving son even likes these - though I bought them for my 9 month old daughter. It's nice because it is blended with three fruits - all mild, go with everything. No complaints! Everything seems fresher and better coloring than jars.

I bought these for my 10-month-old, and my 2-year-old. I opened one up for each of them when we received them, and my 2-year-old daughter inhaled the entire thing in one breath. My youngest slurped hers up in less than 1 minute (while it usually takes her 15 minutes to eat a 4 oz jar of food). They love these so much. My eldest is constantly begging me for them now.I did try one for myself, and thought it tasted a little funny, but that's my adult taste buds. There couldn't be anything better than these according to the little ones. =) I'll definitely buy these again. It's such a great treat, and so easy to grab when on the go. Great for breakfast, snacks, lunch, or any time!

column9: Great Baby Food and Kid Snack!!
column10: My 10 month old has been eating this since he was 6 months- he loves to suck it out himself, no spoon or bowl needed! The flavors are so great that my 5 yr old eats them too. Extremely handy to have out and about or for a healthy snack anytime.

I love anything made by Plum Organics.  I tried almost every organic baby food product out there, especially baby frozen food and my baby will not eat anything else but Plum.  I only wished that Amazon carried their frozen baby food line.

This product makes my mouth water. Amazing taste, goes well on lemons, limes and tomatoes.After eating too much your tongue might hurt but its so worth it!Only issue I see here is the pricing on the product w/shipping.
I tried this product a few years ago and really enjoyed it, just wish it was sold I my area. Great for Coronas, Cheers!

column9: Probably the best GF pancakes you'll get from a mix
column10: Excellent GF pancakes - taste very close to the regular kind without that weird dusty taste you get from some of the other mixes. I highly recommend this product for GF pancakes.

This toy holds up pretty well to the antics of my extremely chewy "destructo dog" Luna.  She's a lab-pit mix and she can destroy nearly every toy, even the ones that are marked as super tough or indestructible.  She is on her second of these and it's looking pretty worn, but it lasted for several months.  With her, that is pretty much miraculous.  Plus a high energy dog gets a lot of joy out of a frisbee.  My girl loves to chase it and carry it around for as long as you have the energy to play.

column9: same ole frisbee same ole quality
column10: I would just like to say that this frisbee has always been my favorite and my dog max's as well(when you first get it you should wet it down with water because it's a little light)but after a little time it will break in and fly perfect, you just need to know what direction the wind is blowing when playing with it(these will normally last my german shepherd four-six months,using it one hour per day every day)with an aggressive playing dog.This is not a chew toy,it's used for excersising(so to all the people that let their dogs chew it,wrestle with it and use it for hanging from in the air)don't complain about how long it lasts(just complain about the lack of common sense your using playing with it)If you have a less aggressive dog this frisbee will last a very long time and please your dog every time you play.If you expect more from this product you'll have to take care of it.cleaning it with water,keeping it away from the dog untill play time(so they don't chew it to bits)just use common sense so you and your dog can have fun and enjoy it.Final thought,even if this frisbee starts to show age and have a couple of holes here and there you can always get a needle and thread to repair the damage and save on buying another one.I bought three of these from (little family members) for like $12.50 each, they not only arrived on time but those guys provided a five star service.when I need more of these frisbees in the future I will not hesitate to buy again from both the seller(little family members or the product booda).

The Booda Soft Bite Floppy Disc is heaven-made according to my border collie/American eskimo mix. It competes with hard plastic frisbees for distance and catching the breeze, but is kind to a dog's mouth.

column9: Great dog toy -- but recommend the 12-inch Soft Bite
column10: Great product -- My German Shepherd loves this toy and we get a lot of use out of it.  Would recommend the 12-inch version for larger and/or athletic dogs because the disc carries farther and makes for some  spectacular catches.  You can find a better price for the 12-inch version by shopping around! Booda Floppy Disc, 10-Inch
I love it because it flys so easily and doesn't hurt the dog if it hits her nor when she catches it.  However, she prefers the plastic glow in the dark disc I bought.
This is not the first Booda Floppy Disc we have had.  They are great fun for the dog and weorder a new one when the old one has been well used.  Good product.

I recently purchased the Booda Soft Bite Floppy Disc.  It is our dog, DIVAS' favorite.  The price was so great I ordered three.  One of her favorite things to do with it is put it under, or behind things, then come and find us to get it out!  My husband straightened out a wire hanger to retrieve.  She is quite good at catching it!  Diva is a Black Standard Schnauzer,soon to be 7yrs.  She has many toys, balls, etc. the  Favorite is her (Frisby).  Thank you Booda, and Thank you AMAZON for your great prices.Mary Robinson
This floppy disc is the best frisbee we've ever had!  It's easy to throw and easy for our dog to catch.  We love it!

I found out about this frisbee from my neighbor. I have a 7 month old doberman and I thought for sure she'd tear this apart. This frisbee is durable and flys well and floats. I will definitely get another one of these as a back up just in case. She's had it for a few months and is in the same condition.
I have a 90 lb lab and he loves it. Usually he will destroy all toysWithin a week. This has lasted over a month and no damages other than dirt.I will buy another one when this one dies.

column9: My Dog's Favorite Frisbee by far
column10: My golden retriever/ yellow lab cross loves frisbee and as long as we have the booda soft bite all other frisbees are rejected.  It doesn't hurt her mouth and she enojoys shaking it.  It flies well even when I throw it.  light weight and high visibility in the tall grass.  It lasts a long time considering that she plays with it daily.  There are others that last longer but that is also because she won't play with them as much.  I don't leave her unattended with the frisbee because she tends to destory it and the grass in the process.
I love this soft frisbee.  My Jack Russell loves them also,  he catches in the air and shakes it around then brings it to me for more fun.  Best frisbee for us!!

I got my dog this thing because his old one has about had it. The old one is still in use but is weathering away after almost 2 years of daily use. It never tore and still flies good just not as far. The new one I got showed me how weathered the old one was. It is the same great frisbee as the old style and I can throw it straight about 35 yards. I really think this is a great performing frisbee and will not ever chip or break my dogs teeth. Will last for a good while if you put it away from your dog after your done and do not let the dog keep it. It is made for catching and not tug of war or a chew toy.

This is a great product.  I have one from 10 or 12 years ago and is bleached out from the sun and rain while laying around in the yard.  Still works great.  Just enough lettering left to know what name to look for and have ordered several new ones.  My dog loves them and can not distroy one in week, a month or even years. Most other toys are gone in a few weeks. The stitching around the edge is the only occasional failure point but it is due to my Border Collie using it as a tug toy and chew toy as well as a fly and catch toy. I think it is probably the best toy I have found for my very active 50 lb dog.

Our miniature Australian shepherd loves his dog disc time. The construction is easy on the dog's mouth, but doesn't hold up to tugging. Our dog also likes to sometimes "kill" the disc before handing it over. He grabs it and violently shakes it. Again, a plastic disc would do better, but this is the best. We try to have two or three on hand. The expense is a bit high, but I do find it less expensive online than in brand name pet stores.

We have been buying these floppy discs for our Australian Shepard since he was 6 months old. He is now 8 years old and going strong. Our only complaints are the price. Very expensive for a toy that doesn't hold up to normal dog use. I buy them by the half-dozen and have to replace them every year since he gets daily Floppy Disc time. Soft Bite Floppy Disc Dog Toy

column9: How to use Sugar Cure to make Canadian Bacon at home.
column10: You can use this old fashioned product to make your own "knock your socks off" Canadian style Bacon. It's really simple, even though it takes 6 days and a little room in you fridge.  First requirement is, you must have a smoker/grill.  I use a large Big Green Egg. The recipe and instructions follow: For each one pound of Pork Loin (boneless) 1 tbs of Morton Sugar Cure,  1 tsp of white granulated sugar,  1 tsp of Dark Brown Sugar.  Add sugars to a small bowl and mix well by hand. Don't use the smoke flavored cure as it can be awfully tricky to get it right. The regular cure is a great product and easy to use.Prep the Pork loin: most pork loins average 9-10 lbs, this is good size to use.  I like to cut them into thirds, approximately 3 lbs or so each as this size fits perfectly into 1 gallon freezer bags.  Cut, rinse under running water, then pat dry using paper towles and place one pc in a bag.Back to cure mix, I like to mix the sugars for 3 lbs each in smaLL bowls and mix, this way I'm sure I get the right amount on each pc of meat.  Pour the cure mix into the bags, then using one hand reach into each bag and knead the mix into and all over the meat. When finished mixing the bags, wash hands and fold over top of bag squeezing out all air, then zip close.  Place bags flat on a shelf in your fridge. Once every 24 hoursflip the bags ( keeping closure folded over the top)The cure will draw moisture and create a brine (this is good, do not drain)  Do the flip routine for 5 days. On the 6th day remove from fidge, rinse off, then place the meat in a bowl of clean cool water and let soak for an hour to remove part of the salt. Will be too salty if you don't do this.  Dry meat put meat back into fridge, covered to chill down while you prep your smoker/grill.  Get your smoker to 225-250 degrees, steady,throw in a pc of hickory wood, then place the 3 pcs of cured loin into your smoker with a temp. probe in one pc.  Slow cook until the temp. of the meat reaches 160-165, then remove immedialtely.  Any higher will dry out the meat (160 is best).  Let meat cool down, then wrap and put in fridge over night.  Remove next day, slice about 1/8" thick and enjoy the best darn Canadian Bacon you ever eaten.  Canadian bacon in the stores is $8-$10 a lb and nowhere near this good.If you enjoy grilling/smoking, you'll enjoy this.  A little time consuming but by no means is it hard to do.  This Morton's Sugar Cure is a great product that makes it all easy.

Will have to buy myself a bag one of these days, instead of getting tiny amounts at arts festivals and in gourmet stores...

It is completely understandable why Talisker would be Ian Flemming's scotch of choice for the James Bond character (in the books anyway). The spirit of Talisker is like no other single malt. Never subtle and always delicious.The 25 is the most refined, IMHO, and my favorite from this great and uncompromising distillery. Sweet peat, smokey, pepper and ginger spices, rich and fruity, (a touch of spring water brings out some of the floral character), a buttery smooth mouth feel and a long warming finish make this a must try for all single malt enthusiasts. The 25 year old changes a bit in character from year to year but not enough to worry about so seek out any year you can. Because this distillery tends to be overlooked by the masses, the 25 YO is a great value. It is a muscular whisky of great craftsmanship. An real gem of a whisky. Careful though, it is not a starter malt and doesn't take kindly to strangers who rush in. Approach it carefully, introduce yourself slowly and give it a little time to breath or it may bite back! Highly recommended.

I have purchased sugar free frenchvanilla cappuccino in the past tho not from this site...and it was way better than this. Extremely disappointed - not sweet enough - not enough creamer - not creamy at all -

Fail: after adding non calarie sweetner plus no calarie Carmel flavor to this product ... the resulting flavor was POOR. I prefer my regularly brewed mocha flavored coffee with Coffeemate non sugar Carmel French Vanilla creamer 10 times better than this uninspiring product. If you must use it in circumstances such as in a motel, then it would barely pass as a POOR choice.

I was so excited to find these, as our local Whole Foods stopped carrying the frozen ones.  At the time, individual cans weren't available, so I ordered the "case."  I was really disappointed to discover on opening the first can that these beans are not peeled.  The remaining cans have been sitting in my pantry.  Last night I decided to bite the bullet and spent 30 minutes peeling to make fava hummus, which ended up tasting terrific.  But who does Progresso think they are kidding, the skins are inedible.  Will definitely try a different brand next time!
Too bad these beans are hard to find in stores. I used them for an Egyptian dish. Arrived in about a week well packed.
These are a great chewy for my two little dogs.  They don't upset tummies and they keep them busy for long enough to have a quiet dinner.

column9: Great product for my baby at a great price!
column10: Instead of cow's milk, my 1 year old is drinking goats milk as it is easier on his stomach to digest.  The price on the powder from Amazon costs $1.50 to $3.50 less than what I found in the health food stores in my area. The only issue I've had with the powder is that it can clump up sometimes if you don't use water that is warm enough or don't shake vigorously and/or stir immediately.  Otherwise, we love it!
These are excellent and healthy training high value treats.  My dogs love them.  They are good to handle after hydrating.  I like they come in various versions.
I have used this seasoning for years and to me it beats everything out there. The best BBQ I have ever done started with this. Try it and you won't be sorry.

This is a very high quality hisbiscus team made with good size petals. Much cleaner than any hibiscus (kerkede) tea I have got from Sudan or Uganda. The beautiful reusable cans are a bonus! Highly recommended.

This Bag is tough, big and easy to use for brining the largest turkeys.  I give the bag 5 stars, however the brining mix this company sells gets a fat 0 as following directions to the tee gives you a very salty bird that is borderline not edible.

column9: Awful - zip top is too weak
column10: I've used brining bags before so when I saw a good price on this 6 pack I thought I was doing myself a favor. I was dead wrong. Thanksgiving eve I went to turn my turkey over and the top opened up completely from the slightest movement. I had turkey brine spilling out into the fridge and all over the floor. Not something I needed to deal with when I was trying to get my pies baked and the table set.If I weren't a pregnant working mom of a toddler I would return these, but I think I will pass them on to some frenemies instead.

I love these bags. Used one for the first time this year. It held my 13 lb turkey with all the brine very well with room to spare. The ziplock part was super easy to use and close so you don't accidentally lose brine and icky turkey juices all over the floor. It is thick and easy to manhandle. I'm back to buy more for upcoming years!  Happy Thanksgiving to you all!
These bags are amazing! Have brined everything turkey, chicken pork ribs!they come in handy for very large left overs like form thanksgiving etc.They DO NOT LEAK!!!!!

These are the best rice cakes I've tried. They actually have taste and a light crisp texture. They do tend to be a bit crumbly, but overall really good. I go through a package of them in a couple of days and I have not had any problem with them going stale before I can eat them up.

I think these are good. I've losing weight so I eat a couple of these ( plain/w coffee ) for breakfast to keep the weight loss effect going. I find myself thinking about eating them at other times, but I normally don't. A glass of water and 2 of these will work wonders if you can't resist the urge to eat something. These are good plain or you can put something on them. I've got quite a few broken ones because of the shipping, but not a problem for me.

column9: The BEST brand of rice cakes
column10: Lundberg makes the absolutely best rice cakes out there. They are substantial, crunchy, and have a wonderful rice flavor. If you've ever tried the other brand's product, you know that the other rice cakes taste and feel like styrofoam. Not these! They're so good that my kids ask for them. Plus they are 100% gluten free for those who need to be concerned about that. Amazon ships these in a sturdy box. All of the sleeves came intact. What an easy way to shop.
These rice cakes are tasty and substantial, not like the average super-market variety that is overly puffed with air. My kids have mild allergies to wheat and these fit the bill nicely.

column9: Lundberg tastes moreike the real thing
column10: Lundberg rice cakes are not as processed as other brands and with my grandchildren, never go stale. We love all flavors but the brown rice and popcorn ones are our all time favorites. We have to keep gluten free foods in stock. These are great.

column9: Light And Crispy. Fresh and Tasty.
column10: I used to regularly eat rice cakes and then I got out of the habit and haven't even seen them for years. Suddenly I spotted some Lundberg Eco-Farmed Brown Rice Cakes at my nearby grocery store and had to have them. They're made of whole-grain brown rice and are very lightly salted. They're nice and fresh and crispy and good tasting. I like to have them for breakfast with spreads ranging from peanut butter, Nutella, and a variety of fruit spreads. And they're only 60 calories a cake. Excellent.Gary Peterson

Lundberg sets the bar when it comes to rice cakes. This is truly the perfect staple and when you need something healthy while traveling, rice cakes are the ideal solution.  I've even been known to carry them in my purse into a restaurant so I have an option to the potato or rice that the chef smothers in butter or some other sauce full of fat.  Lightness in the belly that shows up on the bathroom scale.

These are absolutely the best rice cakes in the world! I buy them by the case. They have a wonderful whole grain flavor and the texture is chewy and addicting! These are on a whole different level far above traditional white rice cakes you get in the store. I highly recommend and love them love them love them!!!

column9: Very stale, can't give them away
column10: I took a chance on these, aware that a lot of food sellers on Amazon sell very stale product, and I lost my wager. These rice cakes were extremely stale. Good at first, but you'll get tired quickly of these so don't buy a bunch.

I first bought a box of these LICK 'N CRUNCH! dog cookies as a Christmas gift for my Dad's little rat terrier, Buddy. column9: Great pump and less tingling feeling!
column10: Over the past two years, i have been working out 5 days a week. I have tried a ton of different pre-workout supplements. I am little older now and so I wanted something that would make me have enough energy to finish and complete my entire workout.I not only try and change my workouts every 6 months or when I feel like I have hit a plateau in my workout, but I often try different supplements to see if i can see any difference.Labrada Super Charge is freaking awesome. I can take one scoop and within about 15 minutes, I can feel it working. I don't get the weird tingling like you do with Jack 3d and other products, but you can just feel it. This stuff doesn't make your heart go crazy or cause any other strange side affects.On certain days, in my case Leg days, I take about a scoop and half, because I seem to always be weaker and lazier on leg days, because they are my weakest muscle group. But this stuff lets me kick into a higher gear and complete my workout.For the money, it is currently my favorite. Supplements can get expensive, so i always try and be selective in where i spend money.

The best prework out mix I have ever had!!!!!  My muscles get fuller and rock hard for a pump that is out of this world.  I am more focused and my workouts are much more intense.  I also am not as sore as i normally am after an intense workout.  If there were a six star I would give it five just isnt enough!!! I do prefer the Punch to the grape but grape isnt that bad.. FYI  It does clump up in the heat so keep it at room temp and out of ur gym bag in the car!
Wakes me up and I can sleep after drinking a red bull. This is cheap for the amount of servings you get. I think this helped me to focus too when I was studying after using this once.
This is one of the greatset products to hit the market. It does what promises to do. Anyone who needs an extra "umph" in their workut will benefit.

This is a must have prior to any workout! Tastes great, mixes smoothly, and delivers everything you need to complete an intense workout! I'm sold!!! Will never use another pre-workout drink again! This one really packs a punch!!!

Supercharge tastes great, mixes well, and works!  The pumps you get are awesome and no jitters or upset stomach like I get with many others on the market.  I also use this and it really keeps me from getting sore.Hica-max

240mg of caffeine, creatine, and aminos gives me just what I need to power through every workout.  It lasts just long enough and I never feel the 'I'd rather be not here now' feeling when in the gym.  One scoop is sufficient for most.  If it takes two, I'd worry about the effects on your body.  This has allowed me to push my limits and has lead to an increase in strength and size over the past 6 months.  It's no anabolic, but does give you the kick in the pants you need to have a consistently good workout routine.  **** Don't take this before you do any intense cardio, your heart will notice it. :-)

I would definetly buy this again and would reccomend it to anyone that needs that extra kick to get your work-outs into hi gear.

This power really gets me ready to workout without making me jittery. I do find that I can workout a little harder, longer without feeling exhausted. Love the taste, too.

I actually like this better than NoXplode. Its less harmful to the body and doesn't get me all jittery. this is for healthy people who know how to use supplements, just like any other supplement.

We recently decided to change our lifestyle before we have kids so we can be there for them and do the things parents need to do.Over the years i've tried many different products and this is the best tasting pre-workout mix that actually works. My pumps are harder and i can go longer. I've gained a lot of weight and i need to get back in shape - so for the past 3 weeks i've used this as a pre-work out mix before my workouts and muscle milk light after my workouts. I've been using this, muscle milk light and amazing grass (vegetable/fruit drink mix) as breakfast. 3.5oz of steak or chicken for lunch and a normal dinner (usually before 6). I've used other Labrada products and liked them so decided to try this, and after nearly a year I'm still liking it. I usually use it at half strength. I won't make any ridiculous unfounded claims, but for myself I feel it's great before and during intense cardio and helps my endurance. I've taken it on mountaineering expeditions for the ascent, and found it works great for that as well. YMMV.

I took a chance on this one, since it isn't being advertised out the wazu like all the others.  I did do a little research, and there are a lot of good comments out there.  I liked it very much.  I started with black powder and it was a little crazy for me, then lost it's effectiveness very quickly, but even in the beginning after about an hour there was a big crash.I've been using superpump 250 and jacked 3d, alternating it with this.  I love it.  I feel a great pump, energy, and no crash later.  It does last a little more than an hour, but after you ease off, and if you're in the gym two hours like me, by the end I feel like normal.  But no crash where I'm dragging my feet.  I would definitely buy this again when it runs out.I am not a big fan or supplements, I drink a protein shake after the gym, and really like this stuff to give me a pick me up when I go.  Cause it's sure tough on your own at 5am or 5 pm after a long day of work.In others words, "Great Stuff!"  And you can quote me on that ;)

This product works for me. I take it about 30 minutes before a workout at Gold's Gym, and have more than enough energy. I'm steadily handling heavier weights too. One major factor is the 200 mg of caffeine it contains. Lambrada also makes a grape flavor, which I didn't like. Fruit punch is fine with me. This product, coupled with protein supplements, allows me to lose body fat (especially around the waist) while increasing muscle mass.

Its simply not worth the money. I have been trying NOX products for some time now and find that most of them are a waste of money. Im 38 years old and a gym veteran at this point in very good shape and believe me. nothing substitutes for simple food. I try these products to 'boost' my moodin the morning workouts. Sorry Labrada two thumbs down for this one.

Great product cures inflammation ,headaches stomach upset and tastes great:)))thank you chimes:) If u love Ginger get this:) must have a parties:)

Great buy.  These are hard to find in store.  When you do find them they come in little packs that finish too soon:)
bought these for my friend who loves peppermint candy, he absolutely loves them, his wife says they are too strong for her, so more for him, having a ginger candy is also healthier then plain candy

I used these chocolates to make chocolate covered pretzels for a party, They were a huge hit and tasted amazing

These "Logo Tubes" contain large chocolate chips.  If you are old enough you may remember the candy Ghirardelli sold in small cardboard tubes called "Flicks".  They don't sell Flicks anymore but they do sell these.  Same candy, different packaging.  The good thing about these is that you can take 3 or 4 chips, put the package back in the cupboard and have a quick treat without having to eat a whole bar.  If I use a little self control, one of these packages can last a couple of months.  Sometimes they also have a mint flavored version available.  Those are good also.
It is an excellent product and though more expensive than Wilton's it was worth it. I would buy it again and again.
I think this makes a good chili. It's a little more expensive than just using chili mix and canned tomatoes. But it really is good.

These are great.  We are on our second batch of these candy drops.  The quality of the product is so much better than we expected.  The eating experience can be described as a consistent cinnamon flavor while you eat them, not too strong.

column9: This is the BEST flavor of the whole line
column10: We found these pink lemonade fruit snacks at a local Earth Fare store and we were THRILLED with how good they are. My three year-old loves them. Unfortunately I have never seen the pink lemonade in the stores around here, other than Earth Fare (where we don't go all that often). Amazon is so much less expensive than Babies R Us or Toys R Us for these fruit snacks so we just get them via subscribe and save. These fruit snacks (and the other flavors) have been favorite treats of my daughter's for a long time now & we're happy to give them to her since they're organic & all natural.

column9: Great Fruit Snacks, but try some other flavors.
column10: I absolutely love Annie's gummies, they healthy and yummy with an awesome texture. Texture is really important to me when it comes to fruit snacks, and these have an awesome soft texture. They aren't hard and you don't have to sit there chewing forever; but if you want you can suck not them and they won't just disintegrate or stick to the roof of you mouth. They are perfect! The only reason I gave this particular flavor a 4 instead of 5 stars, is it just doesn't taste as good to me as any of the other Annie's flavors. This particular flavor in my opinion was okay, but no where near as good as some other Annie's flavors. I recommend trying the Summer Strawberry and the Berry Patch flavors as well!!Another great fruit snack to try if you like this texture is Ocean Spray brand. They are not organic, but they are less than half the price of these. Mott's Medley's all natural fruit snacks are yummy as well and are made with both fruit and vegetable juices! The Mott's ones are also not organic, and not quite as soft as the Ocean Spray or Annie's, but again, much less expensive.
Love all of Annie's fruit snacks, but this flavor - Pink Lemonade - is the most pleasing flavor for me. Will definitely buy again.
My grade school aged kids love fruity snacks, so I am happy that Annie's makes ones that I feel okay about sending in the lunch box. Service and simplicity of ordering cannot be beat.

Disclaimer: I have not yet met an Annie's Bunnies product I did not like.  I don't know what it is, but I go wild for cheddar bunnies, sour cream bunnies, bunny crackers, etc.  While grocery shopping one day, my boyfriend mentioned wanting fruit snacks.  We looked in the bulk section and he didn't like the ingredients.  We looked on the shelves and found not one but two brands of organic gummy "fruit snacks."  We bought one box of each brand at about $6 per box.  This was a splurge for us. He liked the other brand the best but I liked the bunnies the best.  I then went online and discovered that they come in all sorts of other flavors.  I chose these pink lemonade ones and enjoy them a lot.  After a meal or in between meals, I often will take a package and have a few.  That is usually all I want.  I suck on them and enjoy the flavor, which is tart, sweet, and fruity.  The flavor and bunnies last a long time.  Sometimes I chew them.  I never finish a packet, even though they are tiny. I paperclip it shut and save it for later.  So because one packet lasts me several periods, in my mind, the price goes down.  They are also a very low calorie snack.  When discussing whether or not to buy more in the future, I noted the nutrition facts and the vitamin C content and now view them as a chewable vitamin for child-at-heart me.  When I get them, I get the enjoyment of having some bunnies with only a few calories and some bonus vitamin C.
This is by far my favorite coffee, but only cause I am used to it and grew up with it.  You cannot find it easily in US (at least not in CA).  Add some ice and enjoy!

column9: Nescafe Classic Instant Greek Coffee 200 gram can
column10: I fell in love with this amazing product while in the Greek Isles recently. I was heart broken to leave for many reasons, one being this wonderful coffee several times each day. After arriving home a friend I had spoken with about it suggested I look on [...] and I knew immediately it would be there. column9: Who Would Have Thought an Instant Could Be Great
column10: I love Greek and Turkish Coffee. The problem is that I do not love looking for my Ybrki and standing over the stove waiting while it boils-up twice. One slightly rounded teaspoon of this stuff in a demi-tasse or two if you prefer a standard size coffee cup, sugar to taste, fill with boiling water and voila - really authentic tasting Greek, or if you prefer Turkish, Coffee. Even a hint of "Crema" on the top of the brew. There are no Directions on the can in English so you may have to make adjustments to your liking. The receipes above work fine. You can also put the instant in a cocktail shaker with the same proportions of instant coffee, sugar and water, shake vigorously and pour out a frothy coffee shake over ice. This is must for greek 'frappe' drinkers.  Different than the regular instant Nescafe found in grocery stores. Pour over tall glass of ice, add more water to the remnants in your shaker and pour the rest in your glass.  You are now good to go.  The greek version of this product is the only way to go for true Greek frappe.

column9: Greek Instant Coffee That You Can't Get (easily) in US Grocery Stores!
column10: I really enjoyed the Nescafe that we got in the supermarket this summer on our trip to Greece.  Unfortunately, the "Classico" (note the "o" at the end) in US stores doesn't taste anything like this (yuk!). So, I just buy in bulk.Also really enjoyed the Eurocrem (a hazelnut/vanilla based spread) that is used on crepes in some shops in Greece and Yugoslavia.

To the person who wrote on June 25, 2011: NesCafe sells different coffees in different parts of the world. To make frappe, you cannot use American or Israeli NesCafe. It must be Greek NesCafe or, as Americans would say it, Greek instant coffee. So... while you are technically correct, the description of this item, to an American, is not wrong. I just served some at a party yesterday, and I have emails from Americans, Russians and a Vietnamese woman asking me about "Greek instant coffee..." This is how they interpret it here!

I fell in love with Nescafe frappes when I was in Greece a few years ago and was craving one again recently.  With this powder, it's super easy to make them just like I had in Greece.  The American version you can find in stores here is not the same - won't foam up properly - so go for this one.  Add some sugar and milk and shake in a cocktail shaker or throw in the blender, and you have a delicious, creamy treat just like they serve at the cafes in Greece.  Perfect for a hot summer afternoon.
I used to drink this coffee all the time, due to my ex being from Greece....  after we split up it took me a tad to find it.  but this stuff is amazing!!  you will never want to run out!
Love this coffee!! I was so happy to find Nescafe Classic Insant! I first had this coffee while vacationing in Greece. Brings back great memories of that summer with every sip I take!

This product is very difficult to get in the US so we were very excited to find it on AMAZON.  He makes his "Iced Greek Coffee" every morning.  A bit strong for my taste but he loves it and reminds him of the village he grew up in Greece.

I'm from Greece and there's no such thing as "instant greek coffee". There seems to be a confusion among reviewers between "frappe" and "greek aka turkish coffee", we are talking about two completely different kinds of coffee. To make frappe,which is cold coffee, you can use ANY KIND of instant coffee, add cold water, milk (if you want), and ice cubes,shake and serve in a tall glass. To make traditional greek aka turkish coffee (the one served in a small cup like espresso) you need a DIFFERENT TYPE OF COFFEE (eg Loumidis papagalos greek coffee). This kind of coffee is made by adding coffee, sugar (if you want) and water in a tiny boiling pan (called ibrik) and slowly bring it to a boil until the coffee rises. Nescafe classico is a very nice coffee, but it's totally different than the traditional greek/turkish coffee.It can only be used for cold frappe or hot instant, NOT traditional greek coffee.

column9: Hard to stomach but it has its uses
column10: When I lived in Greece in the Seventies, I insisted on drinking what the old people drank, namely Turkish coffee ("emeis to leme elleniko" - "we call it Greek" said a blurb on the package). However, Greek youth frequently spurned such stuff and drank instead the "frappes" made from the product you see here. To each their own. However, I've found a different use for it these latter days: I carry it on camping, and, especially, backpacking trips. Since it doesn't need, really, to be heated, there's no messing about with stoves and cleaning. How does it taste? Well, you can't have everything. But if you're addicted to coffee, and heat is unavailable or inconvenient, here's a product that might serve your purpose. Or perhaps prove that you're not the old-fashioned sort of Greek.

column9: This cheese contains corn flour as a filler
column10: It was very disappointing to read the ingredients and find that this cheese contains CORN FLOUR, which is a filler. Even grated cheese in supermarkets like Kraft label clearly "No Fillers". So does the Safeway brand. The thought of an Italian cheese having corn flour in it as a filler is repugnant to me, and is a rip off. Grated cheese should be 100% grated cheese. The label says that the corn flour is used to prevent caking. This is not true. Cellulose is used as an anti caking ingredient. Corn flour is a filler. This cheese tasted like saw dust to me and Amazon's excellent customer service gave me a full credit because I was so disappoined. Don't be fooled by the Italian name. Kraft grated cheese is 100% cheese and in a pinch is just fine and obviously sold in any supermarket.

For many years I used Locatelli Romano cheese, and truly enjoyed it. I still do, however the price is, and always has been, staggering. Several months ago I began using the DeLallo Romano brand cheese. I think that it would be unfair to compare it to the Locatelli as they are two very different, though same type of cheeses. I love the Locatelli's texture and consistancy, but I love the DeLallo's flavor. For the difference in price, I will continue buying and enjoying this cheese (DeLallo). For those who may be sceptical, try it, you may find as I did that you not only have a money saver, but a terrific alternative to high priced name brand cheese.

Grated Romano cheese has become so difficult to find in my area that, once again, I turned to Amazon to save the day.  This brand is a bit more salty and somewhat less "full" flavored than the Kraft Romano which I'm used to, but it's nonetheless tangy and delicious.  If I'm still unable to find a grated Romano locally by the time I polish off this case of DeLallo, I'll be happy to buy it again from Amazon.

column9: Strong coffees for serious java lovers
column10: All of these blends land on the strong side.  The Newman's Blend and Green Mountain are the mildest of the lot.  The Caribou has a very bold flavor that is well suited to addition of milk or creme.  The Tully's french roast really screams for a cafe au lait blend, as it should.These all appear to be ground coffee in each pack with a paper filter.  This may seem obvious, except that some manufacturers are selling keurig cups with only instant coffee in them.  My personal favorite is the Newman's Own.  However, I also yearn for some milder blends for the morning.  Green Mountain makes a good breakfast blend.If you are looking for a good Keurig system, then I recommend the Cusinart system (also reviewed).  It has a large capacity reservoir and the ability to brew your own ground coffee, which is much more economical.  For instance, I like the Starbucks Breakfast Blend and/or Community Coffee.  The Cuisinart system does a great job for single cups of these products as well.In short, this is a good bold batch of coffees that will blend well with milk or cream.  They will also appeal to those that like a aromatic, flavorful cup after dinner.

column9: Perfect for dipping and much more
column10: This set of spices is designed for mixing with olive oil and used for dipping. Most folks think it's strictly for bread, but it is also perfect as a seasoning over oil and vinegar with pinzimonio (raw vegetables such as bell peppers, cauliflower, celery, etc.)For bread, I keep it on hand for guests, along with a quality extra virgin olive oil, Since most of my guests are convinced that one must mix in balsamic vinegar, I also make sure I have Gia Russa Balsamic Glaze on hand (read my review of that product for the reason why I use it instead of so called balsamic vinegars such as Balsamic Vinegar of Modena.)  For the record, I consider mixing either of the balsamic products I just mentioned in high quality olive oil to be a crime because those products mask the nuances of the oil. But that is just me.Other uses I have for these dipping spices include: drizzle oil over indents in the dough, then grind the spices over it when making focaccia. Also, a few grinds over insalada Caprese, or even a fresh garden salad also works wonders, In fact, let your imagination run wild because these spices are fragrant and not overpowering.Be aware that there is sea salt in the mix, which means you need to be careful with respect to sodium if you or your guests have dietary restrictions. column9: Hard to find, worth the money!
column10: This is hands down the best dog food we have ever found.  I have 2 Boston Terriers who, putting it mildly, have issues.  One throws up when given anything out of the ordinary, the other has skin problems and allergies.  Normally we find a dry food that may work for one and not the other.
