I first purchased this at Costco many years ago (sadly, Costco no longer carries it but luckily I can still buy it online). At that time, I could not have imagined that it would become my "go-to" spice for EVERYTHING - and I mean everything.I use Johnny's Garlic Spread of course on bread to make great garlic bread with pastas. Also, use it on buttered bread to make incredible Grilled Cheese sandwiches. Chicken, shrimp, in salads. Johnny's is there. One of the BEST things to make with it, however, are baked french fries! So easy and soooo good (and healthy!). Here's how:1) Slice up a fresh potato into thin strips. Leave the skin on for extra deliciousness.2) Place potato strips into a gallon size zip storage bag. Add olive oil and Johnny's seasoning. Shake well to coat.3) Dump seasoned fries onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake @ 400 degrees for 17-20 minutes. Flip fries and bake the other side for another 17-20.Enjoy some of the most amazing baked french fries ever!:-)
I originally purchased this at Costco. They no longer carry it. I was so happy to be able to purchase it on Amazon. I cannot be without this seasoning!!

Bought it costco and now costco doesn't carry it. Just ordered from Johnny's directly because they are selling it on amazon for double the price. It's $7 at Johnny's. Taste good on pasta, bread, dipping sauces, over veggies. You name it! Delicious.
I have been using this for years.  I use it in almost everything I make, except for breakfast!  Try it - it is a fabulous all around cooking seasoning!

Oh my goodness.. This is indeed the best garlic seasoning made.  I too first became familiar with it via Costco and they no longer carry it at my store.Costco keeps products on the shelves by demographics & by your buying choices.  There is a "feedback" box near the door going out.  Place a request for them to bring it back!  It works with some products.I used it in everything where there is a need for a garlic & parmesan combination.  Often times to make garlic bread, I just spread some butter on the bread & sprinkle the Johnny's on it.. no need to muss up a bowl to mix.I sprinkle it on top of just about anything & everything & I love using it in the last minute when cooking shrimp.Yummm... My mouth is watering.  :D
i mix this seasoning with soft butter, it makes great texas garlic toast, it can be added to steamed vegg's, try it, its great
Johnny's Great Caesar is a staple in my kitchen.  Love this product.  Makes my food come alive, and so tasty.I would be lost without it.
Add this to butter and you have the BEST garlic bread spread, OR shrimp scampi sauce on earth!  Anything that can take garlic, can benefit from this seasoning!
My wife is now addicted to this.  She uses it to make her own style of salad dressing and of course it is great for making garlic bread.  This is too good.  We need to buy another one real soon.

column4: SF Steve C "SF, CA Bay Area guy"
column10: Like most reviewers here, I love this product! Why did Costco stop carrying it!! I tend to go their website ([...]) and order 3lb. buckets. I reorder about once a year.

I love this stuff!!! I tried this five yrs. ago, for our Christmas dinner. We have seafood every Christmas and this is the only thing I want to use on shrimp scampi. They use to carry this in Costco and Walmart, but they haven't carried it in a few yrs. Johnny's Great Caesar! Garlic Spread % Seasoning 18oz (510g)
I use this for garlic butter, for pasta seasoning, chicken...it is such a great product. I'm never without it in my kitchen.

We love, love, love this product!  It's our absolute favorite for Garlic Bread.  We use it with unsalted butter because there is plenty of salt and seasonings in it, so regular, salted butter isn't needed.  Just the smell coming from the container is amazing.  We are always sad when we don't have any on hand!

column9: Amazing I can't cook without it!!
column10: I have been using Johnny's Garlic Spread for years now and the family loves it. Use it on Garlic Bread, add it to tomato sauce, add it to anything you want to spice up. Johnny's also has other items that I have found to be just as good, try them all you won't be sorry.
Packaging was not great!  One of the bottles was broken and the product was all in the box.  Had to send back the next day.

column9: Bait & switch! Not the real thing if from The Spice Lab!
column10: Das Salt fleur de sel is the best of those I've tried. Awesome as finishing salt and a touch on chocolate ice cream can't be beat.Update 5/10/2011:  Amazon will not let me delete the review I wrote in 2010 (it keeps the date) and start over, so all I can do is give this added information.  Since my first purchase, I've tried a few other brands of fleur de sel de Guerande.  Das Salt is the best.Unfortunately, the salt sold by Spice Lab is NOT Das Salt even though he uses a Das image and description & says it is by Das Salt. Seriously, if it ships from The Spice Lab it is NOT Das Salt. What you will get from The Spice Lab is repackaged salt in an unsealed container and a lot of trust-me-trust-me-trust-me crap about how honest the seller is -- from him, of course. No real surprise the seller misrepresents the product -- would you buy it if he advertised it as it is: repackaged salt, who knows how, from who knows where?This section is product reviews, not seller reviews, so buyer beware.  My first review was for Das Salt fleur de sel, not the stuff you will get from The Spice Lab, but you'd never know it.  I guess because Mr. Spice Lab says he is selling Das Salt, the reviews still apply but as noted, he is NOT selling Das Salt.  Some of the reviews here were written for the real deal and not for that you will get from Spice Lab.Update 5/19/2011.  After multiple complaints, it must be that Amazon made Spice Lab take down their falsely advertised product because Amazon is back to selling Das Salt from Das.  The reviews follow the product, not the seller.  I will leave this post as negative in case dear Brett from Spice Lab tries his trickery again. My praise for Das Salt is HIGH.  My low rating is for FAKE Das salt sold by Spice Lab.

column9: The Best Sea Salt I have ever tasted!
column10: I am new to the world of gourmet salts--and this jar of flakey white granules has been in great demand in my house since we received a few weeks ago!  The granules are the size of the salt on a hot pretzel--but that is where the similiarities end.  The salt dissolves instantly on the tongue; it has no bitter or cloying aftertaste.  The jar suggests it be used  on grilled fish and salads, but I would reccomend it in lieu of table salt also.

I originally bought this small container of fleur de sel for a fish recipe I found that said it was "de rigeur", however I thought it was like any other salt simply grainier.  Of course, I only added a little bit of salt after I had grilled my fish and did not think it would add much to the dish.  Can you imagine my surprise when I tasted the fish, only to have a veritable bouquet of flavour explode in my mouth.  I must say that I'm never going to use commercial salt on my food anymore.  Now I understand why the great chefs of the past and present consider this the queen of all salts...

column9: A Must Have in Your Pantry!
column10: This is the salt that started the whole fancy salt craze, go to any fancy gourmet store this days and you will find 20+ varieties of exotic salts from Hawaii to Tibet (yes Tibet...go figure!) with every color shade from grey to pink. If you ask me, that's the only Salt you need in your pantry, this is the real thing! Harvested by hand in Guerande, France and dried under the sun, a little crystal on your tongue is like breathing the fresh marine air of Brittany. Use it on cooked scallops, fish and even meat and it will take your food to another level. Highly recommended by a Private Chef and many many Celebrity chefs out there.

Fleur de Sel is the best finishing salt there is. Don't use Fleur de Sel in a soup, but on a crisp salad or on sprinkled on a soft-boiled egg. You want to taste it not melt it. It's worth the money! My favorite is a raw freshly rinsed raddish dipped in the Fleur de Sel it's the perfect combination!

This salt has a great flavor.  And, a little goes a long way.  I was very pleased with my order from DAS Salt/DAS Foods - fast shipping, great product, pleasant thank you note and samples included with my order.  Although it's not inexpensive, an order of gourmet salts is well worth it from this company.  I will be trying other varieties soon.

I purchased this salt to make salted caramels- it has a great taste and texture, and is very comparable to the Williams and Sonoma Fleur de Sel, but a lot less expensive.  I wish the jar weren't plastic, though.

though this salt is ideally as finishing salt, but i use it for marinating chinese dishes and its still fab, esp on fish and seafood dishes which enhances the unique favor of seafoods itself.Paying a bit more can definitely see the difference!  will keep using it....being able to buy this online from Amazon is great too, much cheaper and easier than in Asia, where not many places is selling this kind of salt.

Not as good as Le Saunier De Camargue Fleur De Sel. I did a side by side taste comparison and it isn't as good as the aforementioned. It has too much moisture, the flakes are bigger, and the flavor was not as good.

I received the Fleur de Sel De Guerande by Das.  Yes, the REAL Das.  It arrived in ONE day.First, the texture is sublime.  It looks like kosher salt, but once it hits your tongue it melts with a sharp, clean, salt taste with no aftertaste.I will be sure to order this again.
Delicious salt, doesn't dissolve too quickly so must be used with care.

This pertains to the Das Salt with the white and blue labeling. If you've never tried it, you won't believe how different it is from what you think of as 'salt.' ...it's not salty, not in the stringent, NaCl kind of way. Instead, it just adds flavor, lots and lots of little tiny bits of flavor, none of which stand out enough to be identifiable (at least, not yet to me), but all of which are certainly detectable as a difference over whatever you were used to it tasting like before. (and if you've eaten KCl and are thinking of that - bah, rinse your mouth). Whisk with oil and vinegar for salads; sprinkle it on fresh veggies; we even put a pinch in watermelon puree for smoothies. For things that are supposed to be a little bit salty, try 50/50 this and your kosher salt; maybe after a quick pass with a pestle. It's called salt, but is a totally different ingredient than the other stuff. My new go-to housewarming and 'what to give when I have no idea' present.

column9: Fluer de Sel, French Sea Salt
column10: A very nice sea salt with a light flavor and texture. Melds into food gracefully and leaves a soft hint of the sea behind to savor.

I debated buying this, as it's rather expensive. I'm glad I got it. Just a pinch on top of a finished dish (such as fish or steak) really brings out the flavor of both the salt and the dish, and it looks elegant as well. It's more effective than a similar amount of table salt, and has a great deal more depth of flavor. And since you need so little, it'll last much longer than the small container would make you think.

I bought this because I'm making Fleur de Sel Caramels and it arrived early and in perfect condition. It tastes so light and wonderful, the texture is fine and light as well. Unlike regular salt it's mild and I don't think I'll use regular salt again unless I absolutely have to lol. It's awesome I'm completely impressed.

The fleur de sel I ordered was sealed in a plastic container with a tamper indicating seal.  Would be nice to have a glass container, but I don't really think its necessary for salt. Overall, I'm very happy with the product and service I ordered!
Excellent texture to finish all of my favorite foods, especially fresh picked garden tomatoes and a perfectly seared steak...need I say more?
This product, Fleur de Sel De Guerande, is a wonderful touch to any kitchen.I made caramel and sprinkeled a bit of Fleur de Sel on top, so pretty I photograhed the end result
This salt is the final touch every meal could use. Adding this salt to your dinner increases the taste of it and brings out all the flavors. Highly recommended!
A fantastic salt for a variety of foods.  Perfect to sprinkle on steaks and other foods right off the grill.  Highly recommend.

This is a new product for me. Made pan seared sea bass the other night and sparingly finished it off with fleur de sel. The salt flavor jumps out at you as you crunch the small granules. Excellent flavor. Won't use regular salt again. Have used it on beef and salmon also. Love it.
I always wanted to try different salts but this one was not for me...too crunchy

I WAS DISAPPOINTED IN THIS PRODUCT.IT IS SUPER SUPER SALTY...LIKE KOSHER SALT(CHEAPER CERTAINLEY)I HAD IT MIXED IN A CHOCOLATE BAR THAT I PURCHASE. THERE IT SEEMED MUCH BETTER.ON IT'S OWN.. WELL, MELTING ICE WITH THIS STUFF WOULD BE A BETTER MODE FOR IT.

This is one of the most delicious chocolate bars I have tasted. I don't normally eat raw chocolate but this one surprised me in the depth of it's chocolatiness :) I would definitely order this one again!
OMG! I eat a raw diet, and have to say that until this moment, detested raw chocolate.....but now there is LULU's!! Love, love, love this bar. Going to order lots more right NOW! Fabulous product!

I bought this when I lived in California.  You have to look in the taco seasoning aisle for a little brown paper bag, usually on the top shelf if they have it.  Here in Washington you can't find it.  When making chili, I add the meat and beans, and this kit does the rest, down to the Masa to make it thicker.  It contains cayenne pepper, I add the whole packet.  It is hot, but not hot enough to make run for a glass of water, it is perfect.  I know Carroll Shelby started this company and sold it after several years, but they kept the same stuff and it is great!
My dad was actually the one that told me about the chili kit and instead of looking in stores, I bought it here. It was delivered fast and the spice packet did wonders for my chili!

Have you ever tried the real BORSCHT?, native to Poland, Check Republic, Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and Israel? If you haven't - plz, do NOT buy this product! `Cause it actually kills the good name of the most popular soup in W&E Europe! One more thing, I have to add - the package reads not a word! in English! WTH!!! I mean, seriously, WHY? They sell this product in the US, don't they, right?! Is it too much to ask to translate the label into English!!! Stay away!

These "pasta pick ups" are really gross.  My 16 month old, who loves pasta of any kind, would not touch these.  The texture is just not right.  The ravioli is mushy, and it does not have the look, feel, or taste of normal pasta.  I would have been better off buying a different brand of pre-made ravioli that I can cook by boiling it in water.

I spent the first five years of my life in Brazil and my American parents both spoke Portuguese fluently and introduced me to Brazilian food and culture. This is one of my favorite foods ever, and the lingering memory I have of Brazil. Fluffy, moist and made out of Tapioca flour, these little rolls are nothing like American cheese bread-- seriously they aren't! Its hard to describe the taste of one these hot out of the oven, and they're just as fabulous cold.Yoki is the best maker of the dry mix, and you just add eggs and oil and pop them in the oven for an easy, delicious treat or side dish. They never turn out wrong.

I made these recently for a holiday party.  I have never seen anything go so fast!They were very easy to make-- just add a few ingredients, mix, and throw them in the oven.  I will definitely be buying and making these again.

These are not as good at Houston's Samba Grill but they tasted great. The texture is different but in lieu of having these on a daily basis, I have found something that I can make. I would surely recommend these to anyonr.

column9: I was able to eat bread again!
column10: Since being gluten free I've tried all types of GF breads and they are all very expensive. Who knew that the brazilians had the bread game on lock with this inexpensive tapioca version of cheese bread! It's custom which is probably why they are all so skinny! lol But I loved it and will be ordering a whole lot more!
My item got to my house on time and I was surprised on how well my package was packed. I recommend this store to anyone;)

This mildly spicy baby corn and spring onion soup is a pleasant change from bland canned soups.  The MTR line of soups in shelf-stable retort pouches is generally of good quality.  The flavor of ginger is discernible.It's very easy to make-- just boil 500ml (0.5 liter or about 2 cups) of water in a pot, add the paste, and stir a little with a wooden spoon.  I make it mostly as directed but substitute about 4 oz. of milk for some of the water and add a few leftover or frozen vegetables to the pot.Ingredients:  baby corn, edible starch, milk, cabbage, carrot, cauliflower, spring onion, salt, onion, butter, sugar, ginger, garlic, cumin, and malic acid.This soup is vegetarian but not vegan as it contains milk and butter.  Note that the label indicates five servings per packet but two or three is much more realistic as it makes less than three cups of soup.  Note that the nutrition information is for 5 servings per container, which would be a little over half a cup per serving which is not realistic.Calories 40Calories from fat 10Total fat 1gSaturated fat 0gTrans fat 0gCholesterol less than 0mg (!)Sodium 850mgTotal carbohydrate 6gDietary Fiber less than 1gSugars less than 1gProtein less than 1gVitamin A 0%Vitamin C 0%Calcium 0%Iron 0%The primary nutritional criticism is the high sodium content--each package contains over 4g of sodium.
you can buy same pack from grocery store for $6:50. anyone who would buy this for that expensive price will be stupid.

column9: They Need to Replace the Sun Chips...
column10: Honestly, they do.  At least if they want to make my family super happy.  (Even my dog won't eat them.)But now for the POSITIVE.  These bags are 1 oz which means that they are perfect for kids and adults who have a problem with portion control.  In our house the rule is you get 1 bag... and that's it.  And the fact that there are 22 bags means that there's an assortment for lunchboxes, or for kids who can't agree on whether they like Doritos or chips better.As for price, the current offering is ridiculous and I'm going to ignore it and pretend that they don't really want to go to the storeroom to sell any.Pam T~mom/blogger

Delicious and fun!  Fast service.  Having kids who are crazy about moons and stars, these were the perfect gift to add to their Valentines bags this year.  I would definitely come back and order more items from them.

column9: Tasty and Healthy...A great snack option
column10: If one of your New Year's resolutions is to snack more intelligently (without giving up the taste of a great snack), then Eden Organic's Dry Roasted Spicy Pumpkin Seeds are an option that's worth trying.I find their non-spicy pumpkin seeds to be a little bland, but these have just the right mix of cayenne pepper, garlic, and tamari soy sauce.  Relatively low in sodium, they are rich in protein and fiber, and pumpkin seeds are naturally high in nutrients such as manganese, magnesium, phosphorus, tryptophan, and zinc.Amazon's case price means I save almost $2.00 a bag over my local health food store, but the most important element to consider is that this is a great snack!
Perfect snack. Besides the great benefits of this super food, the taste of this product is great. I cannot recommend this enough..http://health.learninginfo.org/herbs/pumpkin-seeds.htm
These taste wonderful, but keep liquid close at hand! For those who want a bit of a burn, but without being to strong, similar to medium salsa, these are perfect.

These organic pumpkin seeds are a winner.You might not think you can get a good snack out of seeds,so this has got to be the best kept secret in snackery! And if you`re a guy with a prostate issue,look no further.If you`re a gal, the omerga 3&6&9 and zinc and potassium and various other minerals not listed has got to be good for whatever might concern womens health .If you`re a kid, they taste a lot better than they look and a lot cooler to eat than greasy potato chips.(chew thoroughly before digesting)

These things are fantastic. I didn't expect them to be shelled, which I love. These seeds are a perfect snack that taste far superior than your common store brand seeds, in my opinion. They have an excellent flavor, unless you prefer food with all sorts of processed toxins. Nice touch of spice - not too hot, not too mild.Although the taste of food is subjective I think anyone would find these to be of good quality as far as texture & freshness. Good source of protein and fiber too!

I don't like pumpkin, but apparently, I like their seeds (and they're healthy!) I keep these at work when I get the munchies. They could only be more satisfying if they were covered in chocolate!For those interested, here are the nutritional facts printed on the bag:Serving size: 33g, Servings per container: 3.5 (I get more than this since they're rather filling)Total Fat: 16g (Saturated: 3g, Trans Fat: 0g, Polyunsaturated: 8g, Monounsaturated: 5g)Cholesterol: 0mgSodium: 75mgPotassium: 270mgTotal Carbs: 5g (Dietary Fiber: 5g, Sugars: 0g)Protein: 10gIron: 10%, Phosphorus: 20%, Magnesium: 50%, Zinc: 15%

I'm always looking for snacks that don't need to be refrigerated, and aren't sweet. These fit the bill nicely.They have a relatively long shelf-life, so I just keep bags stashed in my various backpacks and jacket pockets (not in the glove compartment - they will get rancid if they get too hot).If you don't like spicy foods, Eden also makes a plain version. (I do like spicy foods, and I wish they'd make a WASABI version).

I like to snack on pumpkin seeds because they pack in a lot of nutrients, but I have never been a big fan of the taste. That doesn't matter a bit with these seeds. The spice is what you notice with these pumpkin seeds: the "hot" is pretty darn hot ... not to make you run for a glass of water, but hot enough that you'll want a long drink when you're done. The bags aren't huge, so 15 of them is not a forever supply. I go through 1 or 2 per week eating the "recommended" serving size pretty much daily. Good product. Good price. And organic to boot.

These pumpkin seeds were really, really good.  I used to only eat sunflower seeds and had tried eating pumpkin seeds before but did not like them.  I tried these from another site and found them so good that I bought the 15 pack from Amazon.  I especially love that they're not too salty and have a spicy kick to them.

We love these! It is hard not to eat the whole bag in one sitting since they are so delicious. But the bags are reclosable, so perfect for snacking in the car, keeping in your desk at work, or slipping into your kids' backpacks for a healthy munchable. Fresh, spicy, perfect!
i add these to my soaked/sprouted and dehydrated sunflower and pumpkin seed batch in order to add a little bit of salt and spiciness.  they also serve as great little gifts for folks.
This is one of the best organic treats I've ever tasted. Thanks Eden. How about a wasabi version or habanero. YUM

... with an equal amount of plain toasted pumpkin seeds. I love the flavor of these, but eaten "straight up", they are too hot for me. My easy solution is to buy plain toasted pumpkin seeds at the local bulk store and mix them half & half with these spicy ones to dial the heat down a notch. It not only stretches the flavor, but it stretches my dollar. Pumpkin seeds are such a healthful snack and full of protein. I will continue to buy this brand because the seeds are a good quality and have never been stale.

These seeds pretty much taste like dirt with cayenne pepper and soy sauce.  Every handful you pop in your mouth has a few 'bad seeds' that make the decent ones taste bad too.  I bought a case of these and can't even make it through the 1st bag.  I was hoping for a taste similar to a davids pumpkin seed without all the shells and salt but add some spicy flavor. These are tiny little seeds that are mushy.  The spicy flavor gets very tired quickly, and the overall taste is not good.  I hate to write a bad review, but I wish I read one before buying.

If you like heat with every mouthful, this snack is for you. But buyer beware if you DO NOT LIKE HOT, do not buy. The taste is also very different tasteing than from what I expected, kinda bland with the heat.
For some reason these seeds did not agree with me.  I wish for something with some flavor but these won't work for me.
I eagearly opend the box from Amazon, and was disappointed in that I thought they were in the shell...oh well I can give them as gifts...
I have 2 dogs and they love all the cadet products.  I feel good about buying their products, because my girls love them so much.

My dog is smitten with these.  She's a little overweight, so we've had to adjust her diet (treats especially).  I thought she'd turn her nose up at these, but she actually loves them more than the higher calorie/fat treats we had been giving before.  Who knew?

Not to be a negative review, but adding some information I learned on this product that I feel should be on the product description for buyers. The information on the package states that the fries should not be given to small dogs. Well, we have a 10# Maltese small dog. Seller was very quick to respond to my question on this, saying that the product is like jerky and should be cut into smaller bits for small dogs. Well, I tried to cut it into smaller pieces, but it is tough stuff. Also, the product is from China. Not a surprise as lots of stuff from China. Other sweet potato fries at local store are from China also. And they say sweet potato jerky on package. I elected to ask Amazon for a refund and they were very prompt to issue a refund. I will go back to my local store and buy the treats I had purchased; the sweet potato fries were soft and moist and no problem for our small dog. These would probably work fine with a larger dog and be no problem for dog to eat.

column9: Not what I need, I don't think?
column10: I got these for one particular cookie recipe. Previously, I was buying a package of Andes mints, and chopping all of them into little pieces. I realized later that my previous method would probably have cost less than having these baking chips mailed to my house. Far more convenient, but they are $4.50 a pack.

column9: Great organic cereal with no added junk! Guten free!
column10: I love products with very few ingredients, and Barbara's Brown Rice Crisps contain: Organic whole grain brown rice, Organic fruit juice concentrate, and sea salt, that's all!  No preservatives, gluten free, Dairy free, Vegetarian, no artificial anything, and it tastes great!  The light sweetness of the organic fruit juice isn't quite enough for me, so I drizzle a tiny amount of agave nectar over it.  This cereal is yummy with soy milk or rice milk if you are staying away from dairy.  There seems to be a few overbaked "crips" in most boxes, but for a cereal that is minimally processed it really doesn't bother me.  I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 because I think this cereal is way overpriced!  It is costly in stores and here on amazon.  I mean come on, we know what's in it, how could it cost so much!  I still highly recommend this product, if you want a healthy cereal with no bad stuff in it, and you have lots of money!
I like this brand of Brown Rice Crisps.  I use it in my granola recipe.

The box says, "Made with Gluten-Free Ingredients."Yay!The side says, "Made in facility that processes wheat products."Boo!Tastes great.Yay!If you have highly reactive celiac, this will make you sick for a day or so.Boo!Too bad.  A dedicated gluten-free line would probably change this into something that is edible to your average celiac.

I have been using Barbara's Brown Rice Crisps cereal for over 10 years.  It has simple and pure ingredients.  I have food allergies, so that is important to me.  This cereal makes a good breading substitute for baking if you are avoiding wheat and corn (like myself)- I use a rolling pin to crush the crispy cereal.

I was very grateful to be able to acquire this item when I could not locate a supply of it locally. My son is on a specialized diet and needs the whole grain. AWESOME!THANK YOU SO MUCH!Looking forward to repeated orders!
Good tasty cereal for anyone with wheat/gluten intolerance.  Second scheduled shipment due to arrive any day.  So far, so good!

After reading the bad review, I had to add my 2 cents. There's only 2 rice 'krispies'-type cereals on the market that my kids can eat (well, 3 if you count the no-salt version by Erewhon) - Barbara's and Erewhon's. Erewhon's is slightly better because it's sweetened w/rice syrup instead of concentrated fruit juice (read on to see why). We, unfortunately, have severe food allergies. I can't even eat the Barbara's version - it's sweetened with some fruit juices that I'm allergic to. (Well, I can, but I'm not supposed to.) Anyway, for rice 'krispies' that my kids can eat without breaking out or getting stomach troubles, this is great. Price at the supermarket - not so great. Hence, I purchase from Amazon (yeah!). Great with rice milk, or, for milk-like consistency, try coconut milk - very healthy & milk-like. I'm pleased that it's only a little sweet. I don't want my kids all sugar-hyped, or, in my & my daughter's case, cane-sugar-allergic-reaction hyped! If you're used to a natural, non-sweetened diet (i.e. no sugar-coated cereals, sweetened chocolate products, or sweetened yogurt, super con'c juice, or sweet colas, etc.), then it tastes just fine. If you're on a high-sugar diet like the rest of America, yeah, it's not gonna taste sweet. Try adding liquid Stevia (the powder doesn't dissolve well in cold foods/drinks), because if you use sugar, you're gonna need SEVERAL more grams of sugar per serving to get it where you want it. [And try cutting back on that sugar, too!] Also, you'll note that it has no added vitamins or minerals - another plus if you're avoiding corn - several vitamin additives are derived from corn and can cause reactions in sensitive people. Truth be told, this is a processed breakfast cereal, so it's still not the healthiest thing to eat, especially everyday. But, when you're short on time, or the kids want a treat for breakfast, this is great. I can add fruit to it (freeze-dried or fresh) and the kids love it, and they'll at least get a serving or two of fruit with it, and some healthy fats if I use the coconut milk. And try the peanut butter rice 'krispy treat' recipe on the back - it's good. Use sunbutter (sunflower butter) if you're allergic to peanuts.
Gluten Free, Organic and taste good. Something healthy that both children and adults would like which is hard to find.

column9: BB Organic Brown Rice Cereal Review
column10: I was a disappointed with the Organic Brown Rice Cereal.  The cereal had a hard crunch to it and there were several overcooked pieces.  The cereal is described as naturally sweetened, but it was not sweet at all.

column9: easiest way to stop your dogs bad morning breath
column10: i love my dog, but she often gets a bad case of "doggie breath". since i am not the type with the patience to grab a toothbrush and toothpast and brush her teeth after each meal, i was very happy to find breath busters. they are such a simple idea,a nice little bone-shaped crunchy treat that my dog loves.they are made with parsley and eucalyptus oil,both well know for getting rid of bad breath,and the crunchy-ness of them helps keep my dogs teeth clean.  we have made it a ritual each morning to give her one as soon as she gets up(which works very well at getting rid of her morning breath),and she sits and begs for it,thinking that it is just a great tasting treat. we also give her one after each meal, or any time during the day that her breath starts to get a little rank.  the package says that you can give a medium size dog up to three a day, and a large dog, such as our german shepard,up to five a day. but we have found that we hardly ever have to give her more than three a day.  we have been using breath busters for over three years now, and have never had any problems with them. they do not upset her stomach, or give her diarrhea. so, if you would like your dog to have fresher breath, and want to do it the easy way, give breath busters a try.
We have been giving these to our 3 small dogs for several years and they still get excited every time they get one.

Our dogs love these treats and they last when you buy in quantity.  We go thru a bag a week and 8 bags last us 2 months at a real cost savings.  They really do help keep their breath fresh.  Thank you.

I have a 10 yr. old Bichon/Maltese, and after 10 years of not brushing her teeth daily, yeah, she has bad breath.  These do the trick.  They are not for all dogs, but my dog seems to like them and it really helps with the bad breath.  Couldn't find them in the stores anymore, so Yay! for Amazon carrying them!!
This is a great product. My 9 year old border collie mix loves this stuff. Packaging was really great, and I will continue to order--

column9: Pedigree Breathbuster Snack Food for Small Dogs
column10: For some reason my wife (who does most of the shopping) told me it is becoming harder and harder to find Pedigree Breathbusters at our local grocery store et al. stores that sell pet foods. We have no complaints; Our dogs are satisfied, and we are too. We will reorder from Amazon again once our supply gets low.
I order this product by mistake and wasn't able to return it. The quantity is just to much. I learned that this product is not good for my dog... Be careful when ordering. Tara

I will admit that I was worried that the product would be old or stale, but I was wrong. To make a long story short; my dog is happy, I'm thrilled that I saved some money and I recieved a quality product.  I would use this vendor again.
My dog is a black Lab - 13 years old.  His breath is still nice and fresh, like a puppy's.I feel certain it's because of giving him Breath Busters.  Plus, he loves them.
This is our dog's favorite treat, every night at bedtime this is their treat. The treats are minty and help a little with bad breath.
Our dog Lilly loves these treats! We only give her one when we leave the house.  She sits and waits for us to leave every morning so she can have her treat.

column9: Dog loves them and they work
column10: My dog is getting old and she has bad breath sometimes, we give her a couple of these treats every other day or so, she loves them, will eat the whole bag if you let her and they work, her breath is fine after these.update 7/19/12, i am not sure if they changed the recipe but these no longer have the good strong smell, now they seem to be just like regular dog biscuits.

column10: Just opening the jar of this honey and smelling it... I knew it was going to be delicious.  I use Browning's Honey in place of sugar in lots of my recipes--salad dressings,sauces, honey butter, in a cup of warm water and anything else.  The stuff you buy at the store is NOT nearly as good as this is.  The shipping was quick and professional.  I will purchase this again.
Love them but they are hard to find. I wish they could be ordered by the bag as 12 is to many to store.

column9: Just as good as I remembered as a child
column10: My nine year old daughter had never tried Zotz until a trip to Savannah, Ga.  She loved them and asked us to buy her more when we got home.  The only way to get Zotz is online.  When the Zotz arrived, we noticed that these were better than the ones we purchased in Savannah because these are fresher.  This product is just as good as I remembered when I was a child.  We love them!

Zotz is a great-tasting candy, fizzy and fun to eat, but can be hard to find. It was great to be able to order a whole box, which will last me a long time. Each piece starts out like a hard candy, but then they start to fizz for a great explosion of flavor. The box was shipped promptly and arrived in perfect shape.

Had a couple at a vintage candy store on the Atlantic City Boardwalk and sought these out.  This price is outstanding and the candy is as fizzy and sour as I recall from childhood.  I would have preferred something other than grape in the mix and I've had these now for several months and we still have a half a box left.

column9: Candy with a little something extra
column10: Good candy from when I was a child. Good then, good now.Glad it can still be purchased.
These aren't the easiest to find and I'm glad I can buy it by the box load.  This isn't my first time ordering these- and probably wont be the last.

Box arrived promptly and was well packaged. Although the Zotz candies "best by" date was in October 2013, the candy was sticky (even the "powder" centers) like they had been exposed to high temperatures. Quite a few of them were found to be broken. We have never had this problem before.
If you enjoy Zotz go for this large variety pack. The candy was well packaged, in good condition, and fresh.  Great Zotz experience.
My family and I think Apple is by far the best flavor, followed by the lemon, grape and orange.  Hard candy on the outside, and a fizzy somewhat sour center on the inside.
Cherry is still the best flavor, but grape is pretty good too.  If you can't get enough of the sour fizzy center, you should try Shockwaves lollipops.[...].

These plugs were popular with the birds, but they were too small in diameter to stay in the log feeder and, when I tried to knead them into a more usable shape, they just crumbled.  Too much fill and not enough suet?

I love chocolate and I have been trying to loose weight and always looking for a low fat cookie.  These Macaroons are wonderful and all natural. I found them in the grocery store a few months ago, I went back to get more and they didn't have any in house. I looked again the next week and still all out. This seems like a hot item. I decided to order them through amazon this way I know I will have them. I love them.

I am a coffee FREAK!!! This is hands down some of the best coffee I've had. If you like your coffee strong, this one is for you. It has more of an espresso type taste, but is really smooth. Get some and pour you a glass. You won't be disappointed!
This is the only food color I use to tint my icing for my cakes! I love it! It makes great a great black color with minimal drops! And of course, less is better when it comes to tinting icing!!

This matcha smells like Hawaii in tea form!  I've only been there once and have missed it ever since.  I'm sitting here in 60 degree weather drinking matcha that will take me to a warmer place.My first impression of this matcha was heaven!  I opened up the pouch, preparing it for the tin that will keep in the yummy goodness.  The small size fits perfect in the tin with a little wiggle room...enough to be able to get the measuring spoon in.  I could not wait to dig in to this matcha.  If I had a piece of pineapple in the fridge I would have paired this matcha with it.  I think that next time I will try preparing this iced and be sure to have some pineapple on hand!I always make sure to warm up my bowl and chasen under a bit under water, sitting in the bowl.  My matcha does not cool down as fast when warming the bowl.  All items ready...bowl, chasen, matcha, water and my sifter!  I didn't forget it this time.  I think I might need to get a matcha preparation bag so that all my tools are handy.  I tend to get excited and forget a key item.First I mixed 2 oz of water with 1 perfect teaspoon of matcha. Once that was properly mixed I added a teeny bit of sugar and 5 oz of water.  I added a bit less water this time as I wanted the matcha to be thicker.The smell of this matcha once mixed with water takes on different notes...almost a chemical smell.  I did get notes of coconut and a touch of pineapple but it's almost a fake smell now like an airfreshener.  I'm surprised that the smell would change from the powdered form to when water was added.  The quality of the matcha is very good, I think it's the flavoring that is throwing it off.I'm just so sad that this flavor will not make my keep cupboard.  My plan for the rest of Pina Colada is to mix it first as a latte, then try it over ice.  I might try cold brewing it in the fridge, but I'm not sure you can do that with matcha.  If all else fails, I will add it to my health food drink which is a vanilla base.  I'm hoping that maybe it'll be perfect one of these ways so I can add it to the keep cupboard!To try Pina Colada Matcha from Red Leaf Tea visit here:[...]

column9: Like a tropical vacation in matcha form
column10: Pina Coladas are my favourite tropical boozy drink! Okay I'll also drink them without booze, but that kick of rum keeps me happy. Haha! I love the creamy texture of ice cold, slushy coconut milk with the tang and sweetness of fresh pineapple! A drizzle of grenadine and I'm taken to my happy place. To be fair, I haven't had a pina colada quite like the ones in Cuba. That was my only hot resort holiday, so it has lots of good memories and good drinks.I was hoping to recreate that deliciousness by making a slushy, creamy, matcha smoothie with this matcha! To be fair, that was the best result, after trying this hot and as an iced latte - slush was the way to go!My Pina Colada Matcha slush might have been better, but I used waaay too much matcha by accident, so it was a bit too strong in the flavouring department. I just crushed some ice with agave and milk to make the slush, so as the ice melted it did become more palatable. I really think the trick for this one is to make sure to use around 170 degree water (that tempers the bitterness) and use a little less matcha powder that you would usually. With other flavours, I could go crazy and dump 3 tablespoons into a cup and it was palatable (and energizing!), but less is more with this particular blend!When I'm out of this tea, I think I will order some coconut and pineapple separately and do some blending of my own! I still have total faith in Red Leaf Tea - they hook me up with delicious matcha, and I can't wait to try more flavours!

These crackers are not only healthy and gluten-free, they taste great too!  My daughter likes them, and she's a picky toddler.  I think the price is steep here, but you can find them elsewhere for less.  Great for dips, with cheese slices, or by themselves!
Good product! good price  fast shipping . needs an insert in lid to seal container better!

coriander is one of those spices that i found out about a few years back.  it's a mild spice that adds a distinct flavor to many dishes, but is difficult to locate in large quantities.  this is the second purchase of coriander in the last 18 months.  at stores, you can usually find an ounce or two for about half the price of this package.  great product, great vendor and great value.

Has a good smell. Lid is not very tight, so I had to transfer it into a different container.Overall - Good buy. Will purchase again.
I was cautious about the low price, but this has a good fragrance and taste. I'm pleased with the quality.
I got the product very quickly.  It was fresh and of great quality.  I will definately use this company again.
The season has a good flavor, good price, and I do plan to purchase it again.Update:May 16, 2010, I am about to place another order for this product so it has to be good! lol

I prefer this hemp powder over the Living Harvest brand.  The Navitas hemp protein powder is a much finer grind, almost a powder, which makes it much easier to blend into drinks and smoothies.  I also appreciate that it has a higher protein content: 50% rather than the 43% the Living Harvest brand boasts.  It costs a little extra, but I think it's a much better product.

I've tried many other hemp powders and I found them far too grainy, but this product is nice and fine so it mixes easily and while I wouldn't drink it straight with just water, I find it adds a nice nutty flavor when mixed with almond milk or rice milk.  I usually blend 3 tbs. hemp powder, 1 banana, about 8 oz. almond milk and a dash of cinnamon for a good vegan post-workout drink.
Great in smoothies, makes it less expensive to creat high protien shakes ,with a few more high protein ingreds a nice alternative tocommercially prepared protein powders.

Unlike other suppliments and health foods I've got I actually make a point of using this every morning, the protein is just great and my body can definitely tell when I haven't had this, just adding a tablespoon or two to whatever I'm having for breakfast makes me feel so much better, it's quite filling and the feeling lasts for hours.I don't particularly care for the taste it adds to my smoothies so I generally don't add it to those anymore. I really love using it to make berry pancakes, muffins and scones; I just sub out some of the flour and I've got an awesome breakfast (oat flour makes the best hemp baked goods by the way, the two flavors really work nicely together). I've actually gotten in the habbit of subbing out some of the flour in pretty much all the recipes I do. I really love this brand of hemp powder and I will most definitely continue to buy it.
I like this produce because it added up favor in my smoothies. Good for health, and easy to use. But the price is a little too high.
This is a must have if you enjoy high quality, non dairy protein for an amazing deal. Mixes well with my smoothies. Fast shipping and not as expensive as purchasing directly from Navitas Nutrals.
This has more protein than the whey protein I was previously using in my healthy smoothies.  So now, I use a mix of half whey and half hemp protein.  I recommend trying it.

column9: Good for others maybe, not for me
column10: I put two tablespoons (two-thirds of what the package describes as one serving) in my morning oatmeal the day after I received it.  It turned the oatmeal an odd greenish-black color, but I did not find the slightly herby taste at all unpleasant.  I felt great for a couple of hours, and thought I'd found a good way to add more protein to my largely vegetarian diet.A little over two hours after I ate breakfast, I started to feel very warm and then became violently ill.  I had chills for a few hours afterwards and spent most of the afternoon resting and gradually starting to feel better.Since I didn't eat anything else new and no one around me has had similar symptoms, I can only attribute this to a very bad reaction to the hemp protein powder.  No one else mentions having such a reaction, so it may be too unusual for anyone else to worry about.  But please, if you're going to try this product, start with little and make sure you can tolerate it before trying a full dose!

column9: As tasty as hemp macrame jewelry is pretty
column10: I no longer try to use this in my shakes/smoothies; it's too grainy and not so pleasant.  It's OK in my morning oatmeal, but I won't buy it again.  I'm sure it's good for me, but it doesn't dissolve and it isn't smooth.  It could be incorporated into baking, too, I'm sure, but why? column9: Eww, is all I can say

Great product, practically flavorless which is a good thing, mixes great in smoothies and other concoctions. Would def. order again cheaper than in stores.

The hemp protein is not only a great buy but it has a pretty good taste especially when mixed with white grape juice(8 oz). Mixes easily with liquids. Love it and happy to be healthy. Great option for those with ulcerative colitis or lactose intolerence.
I love this protein powder. I mix it right in with my morning shake. Mixes well and I don't even taste it in there!
As a vegetarian sometime I do not get enough protein so I use a scoop with my protein powder and mix it in a smoothie maker.

I'm not a soda drinker at all, but Jones Green Apple Soda is my exception! Although it's carbonated, it's not overwhelmingly carbonated like other sodas or cola products. A wonderfully refreshing treat that takes you from the usual sodas you find at your grocery store, you won't regret purchasing this soda that complements any meal!

column9: There are better flavors, but still great Jones Soda
column10: I didn't like this as much as other Jones Soda Flavors - maybe because I don't like that real sweet candy taste.  I find this similar to a sour apple Jolly Rancher candy.  Overall I rate Jones the best niche soda maker around.

column9: Great for Indoor Cats on a Budget
column10: I do cat rescue work, which means I get to keep the special needs cats.  Most of my gang is over 12 years old.  I started them on this because it sounded like a better cat food than the commercial stuff I find on sale, and the money for it was in the same ballpark.  Since I have put all 15 on this food the "Hawking up Hairballs" has went down to a small fracture of what it has been for years.  And they eat much less, which means litter boxes are not as busy, and they are more healthy.  Its a good deal for me, and a great deal for their health!  For the price, its the best I can find!  And I would know after 30 years of cat rescue.

My three siamese love to eat well. I first started them on this food about seven months ago and they simply love the taste. Since they are household bound, they get all of their proper nutrients from this food. I have noticed softer & healthier shiny fur, cleaner breath, and more alertness in them.I would highly recommend this cat food for your cats.

It pains me to have to disagree with reviewer K.Wessel. The information in that review is incorrect. This product is healthy for cats. Maybe not so for humans, but healthy for the digestive tract of a cat. My five year old Siamese neutered male is stupendously healthy, satisfied and very happy. He has maintained his exact weight for three consecutive years. We have his vet records to back up these statements. His vet is happy, his mom is happy, and best of all he (Tu'i Tonga) is happy. If you have questions, please consult your vet. A cats digestive needs are much different than a humans. The ingredients may sound awful to us, but it's not our health we should be concerned with when buying pet food.

My kitties and I love this catfood. Had some problems with the boy kitty after neutering and he went off his food for over a week. He was wasting away. When he got back to having an appetite (no amount of treats or special foods would tempt him) he went back to chowing down on the GoodLife Recipe food, and regained all the lost weight and muscles he had lost. I believe this food saved his life.

column4: Jessica VandeLeest "Mother of 2 Boys and 3 Cats"
column9: My 3 cats eat it...  guess it's good.
column10: My three cats seem to really like this cat food, although I think they would be happy with any cat food.  Every feeding they act as if I never feed them.  As a pet owner I looked more at price and quality.  Decent price, decent quality.  I am on the fence weather I like this product or the new Purina One Beyond better for my cats.  I think I will stick with The Goodlife Recipe primarily because it is cheaper through amazon and it is just a lot easier to have food automatically at my doorstep when I need it.  Believe me, you don't want to run out with three cats swooping around like vultures at food time!  If amazon starts carrying the Beyond with Subscribe and Save, I could be swayed.In the past, when my oldest cat was younger, I would buy the cheapest cat food money could buy.  This caused him to be over-weight and his coat was dull and he just didn't look good.  Once I got him to a normal weight with a high protein food of Purina One Healthy Weight Formula, I began looking for a lower price food to maintain this new lower weight.  They have been eating this food for over 6 months now and coats are great and all three cats look very healthy.I gave it four stars because, although it is a decent food, I know there are better out there, just not as convenient as this item on amazon in my price range.

column9: Goodlife Recipe with Chicken Food for Cats
column10: Even though this dry cat food has nutritious ingredients, my cats don't seem to like it.  Maybe it's because other food has more tasty, but not nutritious, additives.

column9: Healthy Food For Our Feline Friends
column10: When my parents first got their cat, they tried every cat food brand - dry or wet - it didn't matter, their cat would not eat more than a few bites.  Then they discovered The Goodlife.  That is all their pampered cat eats.A few years ago, when I adopted my lil feline buddy from the shelter, I wanted the best for her.  I tried the expensive, all-protein brands, but my cat would have various stomach issues.  I finally switched her over to The Goodlife and again, voila!  For the past 2 years, that is all she ever eats (plus her treats).Currently, I also am a caretaker for a feral cat colony in my condo complex and feed them a combination of the store brand stuff and The Goodlife.  They are healthier and more lively than I could possibly hope for.Plus, with Amazon's Shop N Save program, I never run out of food for my feline best-friend.

column9: Not the best, but better than most
column10: I have two boys...well first we had one. He was a little panther zipping and yowling around our house and would anything, especially bagels...I still can't keep bagels in my house. Then we decided he need a playmate. That's when we came across Octavious or "silky" as his current human called him. And he was silky, such much so in comparison our first cat felt like velcro when petted. We couldn't afford Science diet and they seemed to hate the plain taste of it. We started mixing the good life with it and we have noticed more energy, more love from them and softer shiny coats. Less itchiness too.Yes it has corn, but guess what so does half the things you eat. I am not concerned on wheat/corn debate as my cat goes after my bread, my bagels or anything tasting like wheat.
I have 2 brothers that are cats and they have had this food on and off their whole lives they love it.  It's healthy and at times hard to find at stores so I prefer to order it online.

We have 4 cats a little over 1 year old. We started out feeding them Blue Buffalo but they were always very gassy and 2 of the cats were getting plump.. while another was too skinny. So we ventured into trying other brands healthy or otherwise. They can be a bit picky but they eventually got used to anything. "Their" favorite was the Purina stuff... but that's just like us loving junk food isn't it...while the 1 skinny one did attain a normal weight the 2 plump ones became quite fat! So eventually we picked up this Goodlife brand, for indoor cats. They took to it well and before we knew it the 2 fat cats are down to a healthy weight. The skinny cat is looking a little skinnier too but she has maintained a healthy weight with this stuff. It's been about 5 months now and they are all still very healthy and I am very Happy with this brand and this particular recipe (indoor). It has been a perfect balance for all 4 of our cats. We did try the all ages a couple of times but it doesn't seem to satisfy them as well and they eat a lot more of it.

I have two adult Siamese cats (they are actually Tonkinese) and they have the healthiest, softest coats. They have also had less hairballs - not that it is a "hairball formula" food, but I have definitely noticed a decrease.

column9: sadly cats (not fussy eaters either!) won't eat it
column10: My 3 cats are not at all picky about what they eat.  They'll happily gobble everything from Meow Mix/Friskies through Royal Canin and Iams.  But this food - no way - they will not touch it.  Sad.

I have three adult indoor cats, and I feed them Goodlife indoor formula in the chicken flavor. I wanted a moderately priced cat food that wouldnt make me go broke, but also wasnt full of ingredients that were unhealthy for my kitties. I used to feed them Iams, but at 17 bucks a bag I knew there had to be a food out there that was comparable!Goodlife Indoor with Chicken has high quality ALL NATURAL ingredients that taste good (well I dont know that they taste good but my cats LOVE it)Inside it has:*REAL chicken and skim milk for strong bones and teeth and lean muscle mass.*WHOLE grain brown rice that has alot of good vitamins*Natural Garden Peas and Spinach with Iron and Folic Acid that helps metabolism*High quality protein and taurine needed for a healthy heart and eyes.*Whole Grains rich in fatty acids and fiber for healthy digestion and a shiny coat*Colorful veggies that provide antioxidants for a good immune systemMy cats have a clean bill of health, shiny sleek coats, no plaque on their teeth, and my oldest one who is 12 has a healthy urinary tract system which we all know is the number one killer of senior cats!

I bought this for my 2 indoor only cats. The price was very good at the time for what seemed to be decent quality food for the price. It arrived super fast with Prime shipping. I was very impressed that the 15 pound bag had a very sturdy resealable zipper to help reduce the food going stale or needing to put it in a storage container.Unfortunately though, my cats would just not eat this food. I had bought it on a whim since money was tight and I was trying to save a few bucks. I filled up the self feeding container for the cats and they just would not touch it..the food just sat and sat, for literally a week. They had nibbled at it now and then, but did not eat as they do with their regular food. It was like they would eat just a few pieces and that was it.Luckily, one of the cats prefers wet food anyway, so she was still eating daily, but the other cat does not eat wet food and just refused to eat this Good Life Recipe. I was hoping she would come out of being stubborn, or would just get so hungry that she would eat it, but no such luck. I ended up buying our regular food after it was apparent that she would not eat this replacement.A few years back, when this cat food first came on the market, I had received a sample bag of it in the mail. At that time I had another cat who has since passed away, and he ate it just fine. I assume it has a particualr taste or smell that just does not appeal to certain cats. I will say that this food does have a strong smell and oddly enough it sort of reminds me of vomit. This could very well be the reason that some cats do not take to it.Since getting our regular cat food, I tried mixing it half and half with this Goodlife recipen so that I would not be wasting an entire 15lb bag, and the cats would still not eat it. I added more of the regular food, maybe 75/25 and now they seem to be eating it since there is more of the Iams than Goodlife. I will keep mixing it with that ratio so that it does not go to waste.

I just recently started buying this food for my 2 cats and I must say they really seem to enjoy it.  Even the chihuahua has been enjoying it much to the cats chagrin.  The only problem with it is that it seems to make my cats a bit smellier than before.

column9: My Sensitve Stomach Cats Love it!
column10: I want to start by saying I am not a professional, just an average cat owner. I realize this isn't the highest quality cat food out there. However, in my opinion, this is a great middle of the road more natural cat food. Our cats love it and haven't had any problems digesting it.We have 2 cats that are a year old. We adopted them from a shelter 4 months ago. When they were babies they got a virus and as a result have sensitive stomachs. I had to find a food for them with not a lot of fillers and dyes. Particularly the red dye found in most cat foods. The foster home gave them Purina Naturals which was more expensive then Goodlife so I am very happy I found this brand of food. I am a realistic common sense cat owner on a budget so price had to be a factor especially with 2 cats. I admit I didn't know anything about corn and other stuff in cat food. The ingredients in this cat food hasn't had any negative affects on our cats. In fact they have a soft shiny coat, very seldom get hair balls, and are full of energy.I always had cats growing up that ate just regular cat food and they lived to be old. In fact my one cat is 13 years old now. I don't understand why all of a sudden people are so critical of cat food. There are certainly worse cat foods out there with a lot of fillers and dyes that in some cases can be more expensive. I recommend giving this food a try and let your cat decide if he/she likes it.

column9: Great choice of food, no stomach sensitivities
column10: One of my cats is 17 years old and I rescued her from the outdoors.  She had a rough life before I had her.  Over the years I've fed her premium brands and a few regular brands.  I tried this food after I first saw the commercial and I've never had to switch to any other since.  I like this food because all 3 of my cats like it and they don't have any sensitivities to it.  The bottom line is that I'm certain there are many brands on the market that may have only natural ingredients in them.  But I think all food has to have some preservatives in them so they are able to be packaged for sale in dry form.  So how can even the purest foods with preservatives in them really be any better than this one?  I don't feel as though I'm shortening my cats' life span feeding them this brand.  Hey, 17 years and still kickin' is enough proof to me.  I give The Goodlife Recipe two thumbs up!!
It is a 5 stars! The package is nice and fair price. My cats Walle and Eva loved it! I will get this one for my cat next food supply!

My cats love this cat food.  It is the only cat food that I have ever used that they seem to digest well. There is seldom any "throw up" with this cat food. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, corn cannot be completely digested, it is just a filler and causes dogs to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

My bulldog is allergic to kibble food so I tried this and added supplements, vegetables and a  whole grain that she could tolerate and she loved it but had a lot of gas. Now I have changed to a raw diet and she is doing even better on that.

column9: Great supplement for use with regular grain-free dog food
column10: Evanger's all meat product is a great addition to regular grain-free premium wet or dry dog food. Since my dogs have problems with skin allergies I mix a dry food made with salmon and potato into the Evanger's all meat canned food. I think this combination has done wonders for their health and well being.
I LOVE caramel and sugar, but I hated this caramel syrup.  The old Hershey's caramel syrup was infinitely better.  This one tastes very chemically processed.  Bring back the old one!!!

column10: I ran into this on Amazon a couple of weeks ago at a killer price for the 6 pack, so ordered it on a whim.  What a nice surprise.  It's really tasty on ice cream without being too sweet.
