It is ridiculous to not have this information readily available to consumers.  I for one will not buy anything with high fructose corn syrup in it, which most things seem to have these days.  Not being able to find out the ingredients easily turn possible purchases like this one into an absolute NO from Amazon.  If I have to go somewhere else to get the information then I will buy it somewhere else as well.
A Very tasty and quick alternative when you want Okinawan soba but can't get the real stuff. I would highly recommend this.
I am so obsessed with this flavor that I am on a quest to buy and try all the fruity ones :) So good!!! Thank you Trident! Finally something for the peppermint haters :))))
I reveiwed the peppermint flavor--love it. This flavor is so bad, I threw it in the trash BEFORE I finished the first piece. Yuck. Just too sweet--makes my teeth hurt to think about it!

We are allergic to GMO corn, and it's very hard to find organic corn starch.  Whole Foods has it, but that's 1/2 hour away from us.  I use a lot of corn starch making my own quiche, sauces and puddings, so this 6 pack was perfect for us!  It's fresh, and it is sealed in an air-tight bag inside the box.

column9: Cooking With Let's Do...Organic Organic Cornstarch
column10: When I received this product I thought the boxes were really little, but I've made several cream pies with just  one box, and there's still enough to make something else..  I love how creamy, rich and silky smooth this cornstarch makes the puddings and pie fillings.  I didn't realize what a difference there is in corn starches.  I would definitely recommend this brand to anyone who is trying to decide which one to use.  This shipment arrived in a timely manner. I put this on a regular rotation--once a month with no shipping.

I had no idea there was a difference in corn starches prior to ordering this product.  I initially set out to find a cornstarch that was derived from non-gmo corn as the gmo cornstarch products make me very itchy.  We make our own homemade pudding on a very regular basis so that is what we first used this cornstarch for.  It only took one spoonful of the vanilla pudding recipe for us to immediately notice how smooth the pudding tasted.  Even my teenage son noticed the difference!!  I now keep my shelves stocked with this excellent product.  And by the way...no itching!

Since I know that every other corn product that contains corn that is not labeled USDA Organic IS GMO and GMO corn is so bad for our health this is a required purchase if I plan to use any cornstarch at all in my cooking.  It is just that simple.
If you are gluten free, then this is your product.  Comes in a little box with little clear bags super neat.
I bought this because it was organic.  We really like this product, and although it is a little bit more expensive (being organic), we will be buying this again.  Thank you!!

Will be using this to make gluten free products.  The price was very good for organic product.  Since use is more than normal when baking such products this is a plus.  Received the product in excellent condition.

I think this is a little known brand of coffee, but it beats Senseo's  by a mile! I'm glad Senseo was on backorder - I was tempted to try The Pod. It's a very full-bodied coffee, but smooth. Doctor's orders, I can drink only so much regular coffee, and finding a decent decaf is a problem. This decaf is superb! In fact, my husband brought me a cup of decaf the other AM - and I couldn't tell that it wasn't "hi-test.!"If you like a dark, deep, smooth coffee, give The Pod a try.
As with the Columbian Supreme variety, this coffee is delicious!!  I'm so glad I found a good replacement for the senseo pods I was ordering from amazon!!
This pod make a really nice cup of coffee and it a FULL 8 ounce size not that wimpy half cup that we suffered through with Senseo - you should consider that when costing out the purchase.

column9: Pamela's Gluten Free Bread Flour, 25 pound bag
column10: I love this bread mix!  It is really as close to regular bread that I have found since going gluten-free.  This bag sets up to make 20 loaves of bread (3-1/2 cups each).  You will need to add 2-1/4 tsp of yeast to the mix.  I use a bread maker.  Nice thing for this mix is that you can use a regular cycle and don't need a gluten-free maker.Down side of this large sack is that it does not give you the recipe!  So, here it is for a bread maker:Pamela's Best Gluten-Free Bread mix3-1/2 cups Pamela's bread flour2 large eggs1/4 cup oilHot water2-1/4 tsp yeastIn 2 cup liquid measuring cup, measure first the oil, add the two eggs to the container, fill the container up to the 2 cups mark with hot water.  Add 2 tbsp hot water.  Pour into bread maker pan.  Add the Pamela's bread flour to the of the egg mix.  Make a shallow well at the top of the flour mix and put the yeast into it.  Put into bread maker.  Set the bread maker at 1.5 lbs and at medium color.  When the bread maker is at mix, use a spatula to scrape the sides and corners to help mix the flour in. Remove the pan right after it is done baking (do not allow to remain in the bread maker for the warm cycle after baking).Remove from the bread pan immediately and cool on a wire rack.  Use butter to coat the outside while warm.  Cool before cutting.  Enjoy!For regular baking, you will have to look at a mix.

column9: Best GF bread mix at best price per pound
column10: Let's face it: most store-bought gluten-free bread is absolutely terrible.  This is the best-tasting bread mix for making fresh gluten-free bread at home.  With this mix, I find that if I activate the yeast before mixing the dough and then keep the dough extra-warm after I shape it, I can get the loaf to rise just like wheat bread.  Priceless!It should be noted, however, this is *not* a good mix to use for pancakes or waffles, even if you add your own baking powder.  It is too starchy to make a good pancake or waffle, and it tends to stick to the pan or waffle iron even when plenty of oil is used.Update 12/25/2009: this mix is fantastic for pie crusts!

I have a large family with seven people and 4 of us are unable to eat gluten. This bread mix is wonderful. I recently bought a used bread maker for $15.00 and have been making our bread. The bread is a breeze to make in the machine. I make bread twice a day and it only takes a couple of minutes to add the ingredients. It is delicious - tastes very much like regular bread. It is also convenient, since I start a loaf an night before I go to bed and one first thing in the morning we always have fresh, yummy bread.

Pamela's Amazing Bread Mix truly lives up to it's name.  My husband is very happy with the taste and texture of the rolls and bread that I've made with this bread mix. It is so convenient to use and I was able to get recipes from Pamela's website. I will definitely purchase Pamela's gluten-free products again.

If your diet needs to be gluten free and you want to make your own bread, this is a great product. It does not require kneading, so it is faster than traditional breads.It does have ingredients that produce a slightly sweet taste, so lends itself to fruit & nut breads.  We have also been enhancing the nutrition by adding sunflower, pumpkin, and flax seeds in various stages of fine or chunky grind. A simple $12 coffee grinder does the trick. Add these after the other ingredients are mixed. Enjoy.

I haven't been able to try it yet since mine came damaged, but here is an egg-free bread recipe.Egg Free Bread Recipe from [...]1 bag (3-1/2 cups) Pamela's Gluten-Free Bread Mix1 yeast packet1/3 cup prepared egg replacer (equivalent of 2 eggs)1-1/2 cups warm water1/4 oilThis recipe is best prepared by a hand mixer.Prepare egg replacer in a separate container, then combine all ingredients, mix for 2 minutes on med/high. Let rest in greased pan for 1 hour. Dough will rise when baking. Bake in a preheated 350º oven for 1 hour.Variations:Cheese Bread: add 2 cups fine shredded cheese, 2 tablespoons melted butter (optional add 1/4 cup chopped green onions or jalapeño peppers).Herb Bread: add 2 teaspoons Italian herbs, and 1/2 teaspoon onion powder.Three Seed Bread: add 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, and 1 tablespoon poppy seeds.Croutons/Stuffing: Cut slices of bread into small squares and bake n a cookie sheet for 2 hours in a 200º oven. Cut larger pieces to make toasts for appetizers. Or in a skillet, brown bread squares in butter or olive oil for salad croutons. For salad croutons, brown bread squares in butter or olive oil in a skillet.

This stuff is GOLD!!!!  I have made Toll house cookies, bagels, pizza dough, bread, pancakes, waffles - there is nothing you can't make with this that regular flour would make and this is BETTER!  I use it all the time!!  Thank you Pamelas for fabulous products - you never fail!

We've been making bread from this mix for over a month now.  I like it, my family likes it, and it's really not complicated or difficult to make.  It is a little sweeter than what you've come to expect from a loaf of bread, but not in any way is that a problem.  I find that toasting the slices at about twice the heat of normal bread does make it possible to use this for sandwiches, and it makes an AMAZING grilled cheese.  French toast was fantastic as well.We do bake the bread at a lower temperature for a longer time (325 for about 100 minutes) in order to try to get a good rise out of it.  Just know that the first couple of times you make the bread, it might not turn out great, but it doesn't take long to adapt the recipe to fit your needs.

For the person who has a severe gluten/wheat allergy, Pamela's is the absolute best bread mix! The taste and texture are excellent and the smell of the bread baking is heavenly. I have a simple bread maker machine and making the bread is quick and no fuss! Two eggs, oil, Pamela's bread mix, water and yeast; set for regular size loaf, medium crust and press the start button. Two 1/2 hours later I have wonderful fresh, hot bread! Or.....I have it waiting for me when I get home from work! Mix in chili peppers and pepper jack cheese for your Mexican meals (my husband's favorite.) Pamela's slices beautifully for sandwiches and makes great French toast. For some one who has missed bread for years, Pamela's bread mix has been a blessing!

column9: The Best Gluten-free product out there
column10: Out of all the gluten-free bread mixes, this is the best. It doesn't have that strong sorghum taste that makes you know that it's gluten-free. Our guests don't even know -except they rave about how good the homemade bread and pizza is.

column9: Never thought I'd love a mix
column10: I love LOVE this bread mix.  I'm one of those people who was raised eating everything from scratch, and I cook everything from scratch myself.  In fact, prepared foods and mixes are super gross to me.  That being said, I've tried dozens and dozens of gluten free recipes and there's only one or two that taste even nearly as good as Pamela's.  With most other foods, I've managed to create recipes that are just as good as non-gf, but NOT with bread.  So I'll have to swallow my pride and bake from a mix. :) I'm really happy that its so healthy (most gf breads tend to be of the white empty carb type) and easy and delicious and that I can whip out 5 or 6 loaves of bread with only about half an hour of actual work!  Yay Pamela's!

We (husband and I) love Pamela's Amazing Bread Mix.  It is so easy to use and always turns out a good loaf of bread, which I find very hard to do with gluten free.  The directions are for bread machines or for stand mixers, which also simplifies things.

column9: The best gf bread, hands down
column10: We have tried many gluten free breads, this is by far the best. It has a very good flavor and is not crumbly unless it sits in the fridge forever, which it generally doesn't because all our kids love it.  It takes about five minutes to prepare, just throw the mix, yeast and a couple other things in the mixer...easy as a cake mix. And when you purchase this 25 lb bag it's inexpensive, FAR less than a purchased loaf at the store, which tastes gross anyway.  Works out to about $2.50 a loaf. Without this bulk size available we would not be able to have bread on our gf diet.

I recently purchased Pamela's Bread Mix in bulk and started using it immediately.  It was easy to use and the videos on her website give even more ideas.  Bread is a part of my diet so when I had to go gluten-free I needed to find my alternative and it is all here in one package.  Now I make a lof for myself and another for the family while it is hot!  Thanks, Pamela!

I enjoy using this for bread - perfect every time.  .... and many other things - recipes at Pam's site.  But also can use it cup or quick bread/pancake/muffin stuff by mixing your own plain gf flours into it(oat, buckwheat, coconut...).  Pam's just makes it a little quicker/easier, since it's got most of the necessary gooey stuff already in it, at about twice the proportion you'd need for quick breads ... 1:2 proportion of bread mix and plain gf flours (just don't add any more goo stuff like xanthum gum and potato flour).

We have been gluten free for about 10 months.  Prior to this I had never baked  anything with yeast in it for fear that it wouldn't come out right.  Now, I refuse to pay for store-bought gluten free baked goods and so I must make my own.  But bread generally contains yeast, as does pizza dough and dinner rolls.  Pamela to the rescue!  The directions on the bag as well as the website are easy to follow even for a novice such as myself.  I have made several beautiful loaves of sandwich bread, cinnamon swirls, pizza and dinner rolls for Thanksgiving!  I am so grateful for an easy to use, tasty product.  I know that some felt the bread had an undesirable sweetness, but we have not noticed that and in fact used it for tuna sandwiches the other day.  I highly recommend this to anyone starting out on the gluten free journey.  I have also used it as an "all-purpose" gluten free flour in several cookie recipes with great success.  All-around winner for our family!ETA: We now use this as an all-purpose flour in many "regular" flour recipes and have not had any problems.  We have found the flavor of the bread to be bit flat.  To improve this, along with the water in the bread recipe, I add 3 teaspoons of apple cider vinegar.  This adds a bit of the sour flavor of regular bread.  To the pizza dough I add a bit of garlic salt and Italian seasoning.
Love Pamela's Bread Mix!  I searched many GF bread products and was very happy to find this delicious blend that my whole family loves.

This product is wonderful.  Gluten free bread is usually so bad - dry, tasteless.  Pamela's makes wonderful products that are so-o-o good.  This flour can be used for bread, pie crust, or pizza, among other things.  The pie crust is even better than the regular recipe I used to use.  We have not found any Pamela's product that is less than most satisfactory.  We will continue to buy these products.

Three of us in our family of 6 needed to switch to a gluten free diet. Pamelas products especially the flour was a lot better than the other brands I tried. They are so expensive, I wished I would have had someone tell me to try this one 1st.  I use it for everything I need to use flour for.  I am making bread every couple of days using my once denouced bread maker.  My husband who won't go gluten free is eating all of my bread. I am also happier having the 25 bag handy rather than purchasing the little bags for $6 every couple of days. Buying it through Amazon the shipping was free which I really appreciated.

My family loves Pamela's bread mix.  I found I get the best price, usually, by buying in bulk.  I bought a large food grade container to hold it.  For my family with about 1-2 loaves a week the cost per loaf is in the $3.50 range now.  I do wish the price would stop increasing each time I purchase, but that seems to be the case with most things I buy anymore.  Amazon ship and save is incredibly easy and fast.  I love this service.
This is a great product.  Now in a large bag it's more economical than ever.  It's so versatile.

Need a wheat-free, dairy-free bread? This is it! I have allergies to wheat, dairy, nuts and corn. Finding bread I can eat in the stores is difficult, and when I do find them, they are expensive. You would never know this bread was wheat and dairy free unless someone told you. Its awesome! The only downside (for me) is that it contains xanthum gum, a corn derivative. Usually I don't react to it, but once in a while I get a little itchy. Otherwise, this is the best choice out there!
This is my staple! I make my bread, cookies, and all kinds of things with this great blend. My family loves it! I've tried others and Pamela's products are some of my favorites.

My Father recently went gluten free & I have been trying to help my Mom find things for him to eat. He ate lots of bread along w/ pies & other pastries so he was desperately missing his breads. So far he thinks this is the best tasting bread. I've tried it numerous times myself & like it. I would compare the texture to an english muffin bread. I've made pizza dough, bread and pumpkin pancakes w/ it so far & it's all been great! I'm going to try making pie crust soon.
This gluten free flour is great for baking breads, cakes, etc. but not so good for non-sweet foods.
This is a great-tasting sea salt that can be used on a variety of dishes. I like it on eggs, pasta, and pizza. It lasts a long time too.

The Spice Lab Himalayan Organic Natural Unprocessed Cooking, Grain Salt, 2 PoundI have this salt in a few dishes. It gives a nice mineraly salty taste to the food. This a great value compared to other Himalayan salts out there.
Used them with this recipe.bit.ly/savorylentilsquashsoupWas fabulous and very pretty.

column9: Great cure for a cold winter day
column10: This is a soup I grew up eating (barley soup) and one my family lovesIt has become so hard to find in local stores I was happyTo finally find it on amazon -

I have had the plant for three weeks and it is slowly dieing. Stalks are turning yellow, some are white.It was beautiful when I received it. I love the ceramic container with the frog. I have read and re-read the card that came with it to see if I was doing something wrong in my care. It said add water and keep out of direct sunlight. I even purchased the lucky bamboo plant food, but it's dieing. I'm very upset.The plant is in the bathroom where I had my previous lucky bamboo plant, a plant I had for 12 years, I bought it at a Jewell food store. The previous plant I just added water.....never gave it another thought. Our bathroom has a bamboo theme.I'm 63 and I quipped to my wife when we received this plant that it could possibly out-live us. Well, unless I die tomorrow, and yellow and white bamboo stalks can turn green again.....I was wrong about that assumption. I would steer away from products from this seller. The plant came in a USPS "IF IT FITS IT SHIPS" box, not really a professional packing and shipment container, to say the least.

I was extremely disappointed with this plant.  I feel it was not represented correctly...very small...healthy but did not make a Mother's Day gift at all.  I never gave it to my Mother as I was embarrassed to do so.  Never purchase again.

column9: An excellent balsamic vinegar at a great price.
column10: This balsamic vinegar has 4% acidity so it is more mellow than most balsamic that you would find on the supermarket shelves. And it is thick like a syrup.  It is great for dipping and for drizzling over fruits or ice cream. Have not tried using it as a meat glaze but I'm sure that will taste great, as well.

column9: Amazing tea for those with water retention issues
column10: I have used this tea for several years.  I love the product.  It helps move the water out of my body when I am seriously bloated.  Works better than prescription pills I have used.

I am, mathematically speaking, middle aged. My body is making some unauthorized changes but the worst has been the swollen ankles. I could not believe how big my ankles could get! I tried everything I heard of to try to slough off the water I retained, some of them quite unpleasant, and I feared that the second half of my life would involve serious cankles. This tea solved it. I drink a cup every day and have no more swollen ankles. I feel much better and now order it by the case. I might even get an ankle tattoo, something impossible just a few weeks ago.
Both boxes of the tea arrived from Amazon in packages just the right size for really good traveling through the places along the way.

My husband loves this tea. Out of all of the slimming teas he has tried this is my favorite. A good minty and refreshing taste. Other slimming teas are very licoricey or bitter. This one is nice. I'm not sure how much it slims or suppresses appetite as he usually drinks it after he eats (I've told him a million times it's supposed to be the other way around). However we like drinking it nonetheless. Best price we've found is the bulk pack on Amazon.

column9: Can't make it taste good enough for a serious trial
column10: I can't tell you if this works as a diuretic, because it tastes so bad, I can't make myself drink enough of it for a decent trial. Somebody must like it or they wouldn't keep making it, but it's not for me.

Every person is different and therefore react differently to products. I bought this product last night. Well, I started drinking it from a mug tonight and just from 7-10 slow sips of it (it was hot) I threw up yellowish/greenish liquid stuff. Only liquids came out and it gave me a violent headache. Granted, it does taste good especially with two teaspoons of honey. But just about a half hour after those said sips, I was in my bathroom spewing not only the tea, but what seemed like tons of water/fluids. I have NO idea where all of the liquids came from given that I really have not eaten anything all day today (except for a cheese sandwich at 7am this morning and it is now 9:32pm) and I have only taken 7-10 small sips. This all happened within a matter of 25-30 min! :(I'm slowly recovering now because for some reason, it gave me a really bad headache as well. This may sound a bit over dramatic, but I kid you not, this is what just happened to me. :(If you're looking to lose some weight, your contents may spill out from your mouth and not from your behind. Good luck.

I bought a box of gum only to find that the entire thing would expire the following month.  Amazon, as always, was great at refunding me my money, but bc I bought this from an Amazon affiliate, and not from them directly, I did not bother trying to reorder.  I figured it's a problem with the seller.As for the gum itself, it's a 5 star--long lasting, has good flavor, and is not too sweet.

I just wish the gum wasn't so much like chewing nothing. The consistency is almost nothing at all but the taste is great. I chew gum because of a bad nervous habbit of chewing the skin off my lip and i like to have something a bit tougher in my mouth to chew. Trident layers(Sweet cherry, Island lime) is my favorite. This is great as well and i have 3 packages of it which will be gone soon.

column9: I like it, I really like it!!
column10: It only takes a cursory look at my reviewing history to realize that I haven't exactly made a career out of rating gum, but this new Trident Vitality is so darn good that I thought I'd better get in a few words on it. I've tried all three of the available flavors and can't seem to choose a favorite.The Citrus with Vitamin C flavor reviewed here is definitely pretty awesome. The gum has the physical profile of an old-school Chicklet. It definitely has a serious citrus taste profile, though I guess that there might be a slight strawberry backbone in there somewhere. But boy, does this gum LAST. I can usually go a good 3-4 hours and still get some flavor out of this stuff. That makes it a good value in my book for sure.Typically retails for around $1.39/pack at my local grocer, although I've caught it on sale for under a dollar once or twice. My kids and co-workers can't get enough of this gum.Highly recommended.

I agree with one of the other reviewers. My order was outdated (Oct 2011), but since the packages were well sealed I did not complain. The gum is fresh and I love the taste, although when chewing, it feels as if you should have two pieces going! A bit skimpy. I read that Vit C sugarless gum is supposed to be good for gum disease, so thought I would try it, although my gum disease is minimal. I will know more after my next dentist appointment. For the most part, I chew it after lunch and dinner. I love the taste!  Flavor is long-lasting, too.
I searched for chocolate only bulk tootsie pops but nobody had them in stock. Decided to try the Caramel flavor and LOVED them. Highly recommend them!

they were good and all.  but, maybe it was the  time of year i ordered  them.  they arrived  w/ a few  all cracked and busted up.  i live  in northern illinois.  we had  a pretty tough winter.  i can't suggest these.
The Caramel Tootsie Pop is the very best! I emailed the company and asked that they continue production. No luck. Guess I'll have to wait until next year.

These Tootsie Pops are delicious!  I was really surprised at how good they taste.  I wish it didn't cost so much to ship them, but I know that just goes along with getting them through the mail.  However, they were definitely worth it.  Thanks!

column9: LOVE this oatmeal!  Doesn't taste instant!  DELICIOUS!
column10: Tastes like you just made it from scratch, after only 2 mins in the microwave.  It is nutty, delicious, and nutritious.  I add a handful of blueberries after I take it from the microwave, and Wala.. I'm in Heaven!  EXCELLENT PRODUCT!!

I LOVE oatmeal but often don't find the time to make it at home, and I really don't like instant oatmeal (until now!). I would stop by McDonald's or Chick fil A occasionally for oatmeal, but that's an expensive habit at $1.99 to $2.59 a bowl.I found Abundance at a local big box retailer and it was on sale, so I tried it. It is absolutely delicious! Lower in sugar and salt than the regular microwave oatmeal too! Even those who don't like oatmeal should try it. I've tried Maple & Brown Sugar, which is tasty, and Apples & Cinnamon. I particularly like the Apples & Cinnamon. The apples are plump and taste like real apples. The addition of other grains gives the oatmeal a wonderful texture and contributes to a wholly satisfying meal.The measuring pouches are a nice touch; my workplace has bowls for our use, so I just tuck a few pouches into my lunchbag for use throughout the week. I don't have to worry about how much water, the measuring line on the pouch is very handy. Since I found Abundance, I've been eating oatmeal for breakfast nearly every morning.

I have to watch the sodium in my diet and came across Better Oats Abundance last year.  There are not many instant oatmeal products that are lower in sodium, so I was happy to find this one.  It has now become a staple in my house (as long as I can find it).  It is not as sweet as other instant oatmeal products, but if you like it sweeter you can just add some honey.  I have also tried the Maple and Brown Sugar but I think the Apples & Cinnamon is better.

I really like this oatmeal,its simple to make and has a great whole grain bite to it not mush. My favorite is the chi but its not available yet on amazon.This oatmeal isn't overly sweet and the apples are plump and not bland, I've found a new favorite and love it.Would recommend to anyone looking for some great oatmeal.

I might have gotten a bad box, but the first pouch I made was distinctly rancid.The first bite tasted horribly of mold.. I had to spit it out.I won't be trying the other pouches, or buying this brand again.

So, I was looking for a healthier option than the oatmeal I was currently eating (market pantry apple/cinnamon reduced sugar). This product has half the salt of my previous brand, actually has 3g MORE sugar, but was not good at all. I even tried adding (at different times) honey, sugar, and syrup. None of these things helped. This product was completely unpalatable and inedible. I had other people try it and they had the same result.I have just come across a way to make this edible. Adding peanut butter, it's a simple fix but shows how it needs a complete flavor overhaul in order to be eaten. I normally love whole grains, I'm not a sugar addict, this product was just not good.

Better Oats has a real winner with their instant oatmeals:  not too sweet, genuine flavors.  Each package comes with it's own built in guide for measuring water and the oatmeal cooks in the microwave in two minutes.  We love this product in all flavors. Thanks Amazon for making it available to us.

Just received 3 gallons from amazon. Ingredients are as follows: distilled white vinegar, molasses, water, sugar, onions, anchovies, salt, garlic cloves, tamarind extract, natural flavorings, chili pepper extract. I am seeing no HFCS and these bottles are from New Jersey. I personally compared this to French's version which was found to be completely inferior to Lea and Perrins.

Not too long ago, I picked up a two-pack of 15-ounce Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce at my local warehouse club store. It's been years since I had any of this product and, boy, does it taste delicious! I use it as a general-purpose flavoring agent on all sorts of things, not just steak. I even tried it with macaroni and cheese! It's an excellent additive for lots of dishes.It's billed as "The Original" Worcestershire Sauce and a lot of critics have pointed out that it uses high-fructose corn syrup rather than sugar in the recipe and, thus, is not the original recipe. Well that may be but I have no way to get the original formula from England so this American version will have to do. I'd like to try the English version, but, in the meantime, this American stuff is excellent!Gary Peterson

column9: Worcestershire Sauce has much less sodium than Soy Sauce
column10: Salt always contains cancer-causing nitrosamines.  Worcestershire Sauce gives me the benefit of Soy Sauce with less than one-fourth of the sodium.  As for the argument over high fructose corn syrup, diabetics would be much better off if pure fructose was used instead of pure table sugar (sucrose, cane sugar), which is half fructose plus half glucose.  Fructose is converted into glycogen in a person's liver and increases a diabetic's blood glucose only very slightly.  Glucose increases a diabetic's blood glucose very substantially.  Splenda (sucralose) would be the healthiest choice for everybody because it has no calories and does not increase a diabetic's blood glucose at all.  However, using Splenda might increase the cost slightly.  Soy Sauce tastes better than Worcestershire Sauce for some foods (sashimi, sushi) but Worcestershire Sauce tastes just as good as Soy Sauce for most foods.

I had always bought Lea & Perrins Worcestershire Sauce because I thought it was the original and the best.  Unfortunately, upon reading the ingredients label, I noticed that Lea & Perrins uses high fructose corn syrup.  I seriously doubt that HFCS was part of the original recipe.  I know a lot of people say that HFCS is no different than sugar, but I disagree for two reasons.  First, HFCS is made through a chemical process.  Second, I, like many people, am fructose intolerant.  Some studies show that fructose intolerance is just as common as lactose intolerance.  I can handle a normal amount of natural fructose, but the additional fructose in processed foods leads to digestive problems.Is it really worth tarnishing the reputation of this classic product by using HFCS?  How much does this actually save per bottle?  I bet less than a penny.  If they are willing to cut corners on this ingredient, how can the rest of the ingredients be trusted?Because of Lea & Perrins cost cutting, I have switched to French's Worcestershire Sauce.  They use molasses and regular corn syrup, not HFCS.

This ice cream is awesome! It is more like frozen yogurt in its consistency than ice cream and it does have a slight whey protein after taste. But my husband and I both loved it! I am axious to try the other flavors...especially the peanutbutter chocolate! That is definitely next on my list!

I ordered the chocolate, vanilla and strawberry/banana flavors. I love them all. As another reviewer mentioned, they came well packaged and frozen hard. I had to wait a while to try them. The vanilla is lovely. Very subtle flavor and not too sweet. It's not premium ice cream, but then I would never indulge in premium ice cream anyway. My calorie restrictions only allow for stuff like Skinny Cow and Arctic Zero is as good or better. I still find it amazing that I can eat a whole pint of this for less than 150 calories. Thank you Arctic Zero! I'll be a regular customer.

I bought this at a store down in Newport Beach a few weeks ago when I was visiting some family. This is some great stuff. The maple vanilla and chocolate peanut butter are my two favorite flavors. The chocolate and strawberry banana are good to, but these are my favorites. I usually like to eat it at night while I'm watching a movie. It's hard to feel guilty about eatting it since it's got less calories than a can of soda and it's fat free. The high protein content is an added plus too.

column9: Very Good, but they changed the formula and it used to be great
column10: I loved the original formula for Arctic Zero, but as the company grew, they recently changed the formula and the great maple taste isn't quite there anymore.  However, at 150 calories per pint, it is still a decent dessert.  Of all the Arctic Zero flavors, this is still the best of the bunch.  It's not cheap, but is it a nice treat at the end of a long day.

I have severe food allergies so it is difficult to find products that I can eat - especially ice cream!!  I have tried the chocolate and the vanilla and they are both terrific!  I make a smoothie shakes for my husband out of the chocolate peanut butter - he LOVES it!!  Besides the ice cream being fantastic, the customer service is amazing!  I had concerns regarding allergies and concerns regarding shipment of frozen products and they were extremely helpful and always got back to me right away either via e-mail OR via telephone! I have never dealt with a company that was so courteous.  I can't wait until the products are available in my hometown!

column9: this ice cream is the answer to my prayers!!!!!
column10: Arctic Zero ice cream is AMAZING. It's SO nice to finally have a fantastic tasting "healthy" ice cream to look forward to!! I'm a huge fan!! The chocolate peanut butter is delish. I just ate half the pint and topped it off with cool whip and sprinkles. Normally I'd feel wicked guilty and beat myself up over eating half a pint of ice cream, but NOT with Arctic Zero. I LOVE THIS STUFF. I hope they start selling them in stores on the east coast. HIGHLY recommend trying this. You'll be hooked!!!

column9: Calorie Count Hugely Undervalued Per Independent Testing
column10: This product's label says that it contains 10 grams of carbohydrate (including 9 g sugars and 0 g fiber) and 5 g protein per half-cup serving. This should mean that it contains about 60 Calories, yet the label says it has only about half of that (34, for 150 Calories per pint). The manufacturer's website justifies the low Calorie count with a very scientific-sounding explanation of why the body will not absorb all the sugar, but there is no actual testing in humans or even mice to prove that this fairy tale actually matches reality.ABC's Today Show recently tested Arctic Zero Maple Vanilla along with Arctic Zero Chocolate Peanut Butter, and found that "Arctic Zero Vanilla Maple had a whopping 46 percent more calories than the label. The Chocolate Peanut Butter: an incredible 68 percent more calories." If you do the math, 46% more Calories than 34 is 50 Calories -- a bit less than what you'd calculate from looking at the protein and carb, but still far more than the manufacturer claims.You can find the report by Googling "Rossen Reports: Can you believe diet frozen dessert labels?"

The texture, flavor, and overall product is the most delicious of the arctic zero family. Honestly, I steer away from the chocolate ones because the texture is a bit more icy and just not smooth.This is simply the best--you can't go wrong here. Subtle maple flavor, sweet, smooth. TRY IT!
The vanilla arctic zero so good it tastes just like vanilla frozen yogurt! I put Walden's Farm zero calorie chocolate syrup on it, it's like a hot fudge sundae. My husband even loves it!

column9: This wouldn't normally get 5 stars but . . .
column10: it's 136 calories for the whole pint!!! For anyone who knows ice cream, they know this is insanely low. (With most ice cream, the most you'll ever get from 136 calories is about 1/4 of a pint.) Anyway, I have had the maple vanilla flavor and the chocolate peanut butter. I prefer the maple vanilla but both are probably worth trying.A side note - as others have said, this doesn't exactly taste like real ice cream. It has a definite distinctive undertaste/aftertaste. Oh well. That's probably to be expected. Every once in a while I want to sit around and eat a pint of ice cream and nothing else will satisfies this want. When that time comes, this is the ice cream I'll reach for.

When you dig into it and let it melt in your mouth you can tell it's the xantham/locust-bean/guar gum at work.  That being said, this flavor is my favorite, because it really does have that maple taste.  If you can ignore the slightly gelatinous/slimy texture, this ice cream is for you.  Unfortunately, it's extremely expensive, and the cheapest I've seen so far is $3.99 a pint at Whole Foods.

I've had the vanilla and pumpkin (when it was seasonably available).  They're not going to taste like real ice cream for a good reason...it's not! But I like them...a great, guilt-free alternative dessert.  The vanilla is interesting with that 'hint' of maple, but there is enough sweetness to satisfy my constant cravings for ice cream and without the calories.

I love the Vanilla/Maple flavor. I am a health nut and am also lactose intolerant. This ice cream enables me to pig out without all of the fat and calories that come in traditional ice cream treats. Yippee! I wish they sold this closer to me so I could buy it by the case. The taste will melt in your mouth!

column9: Amazing!!!! Great Taste, Smooth,and Extremely Satisfying!!!
column10: I can't believe how great this product is. The guys at Artic Zero(Garett, Gary and Greg)were so friendly and helpful. Great product and even bettter customer service. Even though it is expensive(not the fault of Artic Zero) it is definitly worth the cost. I will be ordering this again and again. An unbelievable,sinfully delicious low-cal product by Artic Zero.  Thanks Garett, Gary and Greg. You guys are the best.Michelle in Florida

This stuff is simply amazing.  At first bite, it seems a bit bland, but after eating a little bit I forgot it wasn't regular ice cream.  If you try to eat it without letting it melt a little, it's rock hard and the texture is almost reminiscent of gelatin,but after a little melting it's just like any ice cream.  I particularly love this flavor.  I am a big maple fan, but this is mild enough that anyone who likes vanilla will probably like it too.  Great product!  I would recommend looking for it in stores before ordering online though, as it gets pretty expensive.

This was the 1st flavor I tried.  I purchased at my local store for WAY less money than Amazon is offering it for today!  $5.29 a pint locally.  However, Amazon does have a better selection of flavors available.I have not eaten ice cream in years, the high fat upsets my stomach.  This a tasty treat for the person who does not have to have heavy fat and sugar content.  The only things that would make this product better is if it cost less and it was totally free of processed sugar.Because of the cost this will only be a once in a while treat.  I do think I could eat a pint each day...

column9: I was not sure what to expect, but loved this flavor.
column10: I was not sure what to expect, since this was my first flavor of Arctic Zero I had tried, but I loved it. It was sweet with the texture of sorbet. I also loved that it was essentially guilt free. I am so glad Amazon carries this stuff, because I would have to drive a ways to get it.

column9: Creamie but tasted like whey protein.
column10: I did not like the vanilla flavor at all. I had to add strawberries just to enjoy it, but it was yucky. I think I will try the coffee next time.It was very creamy once it thawed and the packaging was EXCELLENT.UPDATE: Ok I have had the peanut butter and choc and the choc, love them both. I still add frozen thawed strawberries with stevia. I have this every night for dessert. 3.99 at publix. Ordering it from amazon is a RIP OFF.I tried the coffee it is excellent.

I first learned of Arctic Zero when I watched an episode of Dr. Oz last week.  I am not an ice-cream lover by any stretch but I am a health nut so I figured I would give it a try.  I bought my first Arctic Zero today, the vanilla maple, in a local grocery store.  I must say that I like it...4 stars.  I opened it right away when I got home and the texture was not hard, only just a bit icy but it spooned out quite easily.  I may let it sit out a few minutes next time to see if I get a creamy consistency. I DO NOT like sweet things and this was perfect for my taste buds.  Yes, it's not ice-cream, but I consider it a good substitute for us health nuts and others who are trying to stay on a diet.My local grocery store only had two flavours but I went to Whole Foods and got four additional flavours to try, both of which sell it for less than Amazon.  I would like to try all the other flavours so it would great if there were an option to mix and match any six, rather than a pre-determined mix...just a thought.  I would spend the additional $$$ to try the other flavours.

As long as you remember that this isn't high quality frozen custard you're dealing with here, and that you are in fact buying a diet "ice cream," you should be very happy with this desert! I loved it. Creamy and a bit gooey with a great vanilla flavor. Careful though! If it melts & refreezes (either in your care or before it got to you--as I believe was the case with one pint I bought), it will get an italian ice consistency, losing its creaminess.

column9: Great maple low calorie diet ice cream
column10: Arctic Zero has now added more creamyness to their products.  This ice cream is only 150 calories per pint, which is SUPER! It tastes just like a maple (I dont' taste the vanilla).  I buy this flavor all the time, as I love the low calories, the high protein content, the texture, the no caffeine and the maple flavor.
Arctic Zero Maple Vanilla is my absolute favorite flavors - It is rich tasting and creamy.

I have tried all the flavors, except coffee & cookies & cream.  And the maple vanilla is is one of my top 2 favorites (the other is the pumpkin). It kind of tastes like praline.  You really taste the maple & vanilla. The chocolate, chocolate mint & chocolate peanut butter are OK.  They kind if remind me of the ices I used to get, from the Italian Bakery, when I was a kid.  But the strawberry banana is just terrible.

I love the Chocolate Mint and Peanut butter flavors, but this flavor tasted like vanilla whey.  It was not bad tasting, but I drink enough whey and have experimented with various whey ice cream recipes and this reminded mea bit of some of the concoctions I have made and for the price, it just wasn't that special of a treat.  I won't buy this flavor again, but I do enjoy choc. mint and choc peanut butter a lot (which is unusually because I normally don't like chocolate ice cream).

this is so so so good.  It is so easy to stick to my diet because I know that I get to have dessert,  AWESOME. I love the taste it is just like icecream yummy!!!!! I love all the flavors of Artic ZeroArctic Zero Combo Pack Frozen Desserts, 16-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6)

I was having one of those days yesterday where no matter what I ate (staying within my Weight Watchers points, of course), I was hungry for more.  Everything seemed so small that it just wasn't enough!  Arctic Zero is really expensive, but it's a real diet-saver in this case.  It could have turned into an all-out binge, but it didn't because I was able to curl up with a pint of ice cream (for only 3 points) in front of the TV, and eat the whole darn thing for a whole hour.  And then, I was full, and I was ok!That's why I'm willing to shell out the $50 for this.  I just ordered another shipment yesterday.  I like the maple vanilla, but my husband doesn't.  We both like the chocolate, though.  It's really a matter of personal taste, I guess.

column9: can't believe it's so good and so low calorie!
column10: I loved the vanilla maple, but the pumpkin definitely needs some low fat cool whip, but even with cool whip, it's super good.I hope it isn't too good to be true!

This is an incredibly delicious frozen treat, without all the calories of regular icecream. My shipment arrived just as frozen as it would have been if I'd just pulled it from the grocer's frozen food case. It's pricey, but well worth every penny! I wouldn't want to be without a supply on hand. I highly recommend Arctic Zero Frozen Dessert!

The reason I typically would buy something online is because I can get it cheaper than in store.... not the case.I can get a pint of this for $5 and change.  Why is it so expensive online?  $7.00+++  ?????That's outrageous.
I was very skeptical of zero calorie frozen dessert, but I had no reason to be when it comes to this one. It is very creamy and sweet. Absolutely delicious!
It is like an ice milk and not at all like icecream. However, if you are used to eating diet items you will love this.It is an amazing treat without the guilt. I love it! love it! love it!

creamy yet not mushy. this is the ideal rice for risotto. i'm not sure what the other reviewer did to have a bad result - perhaps the rice was "shocked" with cold broth or wine (you must always heat your broth and wine before adding it) - but this stuff is the real deal. i was lucky enough to find this in two-packs at costco for 99 cents! that's $14 worth of rice for less than a dollar! still, i'd gladly pay full price, since a single cup will yield enough risotto for four people, which makes it quite economical.my process:heat heavy pan (i use a 3-qt sauté) and add a little olive oil (i add a little clarified butter, too)heat a separate saucepan with at least a quart of chicken stockadd some chopped onion to the sauté pansauté the onions for a couple of minutesadd 1 cup of rice, stirring to coat with oiladd 1/3-1/2 cup of dry white wine, heated, stir until absorbedkeep adding stock from the saucepan until it is absorbed, one ladle at a timeafter 20 mins or so, the rice will be creamy and ready to servei usually finish with a bit of butter and some grated parmesan and maybe some fresh ground black pepper.at this point, you can add any extras you have (i like steamed or grilled asparagus, chopped)

I have to respectfully disagree with the previous review.  I've used many risotto rices and this is by far the best I've found.  It's flavorful and creamy.  I don't deviate much from the recipe on the box, and I find that I always get rave reviews from my guests.  Excellent product.
Carnaroli Riso di Molinella  Very disappointing.  Did not come out creamy as expected even after adding plenty of chicken broth and stirring for a long time.

column9: Good stuff for desserts: know what you're getting.
column10: This is the same review as at Whipped Peanut Spread 12 oz, and is the later, improved version of the product in the squat jars shown in Walden Farms Creamy Peanut Spread Calorie Free, Carb Free, Fat Free, Sugar Free. The previous reviews for this product are one extreme or the other, I think probably for 2 reasons. First, the original "Creamy" version in the squat jars was kind of slimy and a bit weird; the newer one is improved in texture and taste. Second, this stuff has  a sweet, 'lite' taste like Reese's PB, so customers used to natural peanut butter or even Skippy, and expecting to use it to make a PB sandwich, probably don't care for it.By contrast, I think this stuff is great for low-Calorie peanut buttery desserts, like spread thin on low-Cal brownies or on fat-free ricotta with a drizzle of Walden Farms Chocolate Syrup (Low-Carb) 12 oz.Do be aware, however, that as with all Walden Farms products, this stuff DOES contain Calories: the zero Calorie labeling relies on the FDA's rounding rules (like all those products that claim 'zero trans fats' but contain partially hydrogenated vegetable oils). Assume 3-4 Calories per labeled serving for all.

I like Walden Farms a LOT!  And I use their calorie-free concoctions with a relish.  However, this peanut spread is going to take more effort than I can muster.  The taste is way, way off.  Perhaps Walden Farms bit off more than it could chew with this peanut butter wanna-be.  Mind you, I haven't given up, and I plan to mix it with real PB to see whether I can make my own low-calorie peanut butter.  I might even mix it with my calorie-free fruit spread or my chocolate syrup.  I LOVE YOU, WALDEN FARMS, BUT I THINK YOU NEED TO GO BACK TO THE DRAWING BOARD ON THIS ONE.

column9: One of Our Dog's Favourite Toys
column10: A very impressive toy. Our dog can chew his way through virtually anything, and is more than happy to have one of these, instead. It lasts forever, it doesn't chip or split, and our vet says that it's a great toy for a dog to exercise his gums and keep his teeth clean. Definitely one of the best buys on the market--it lasts almost a full year before it's just to disgusting to keep. High recommended.

So after reading all the reviews here we were excited to try another Nylabone for our Rottie who, putting it mildly, is a super aggressive chewer. He either has had or currently owns all of the largest Nylabones the company has to offer and we were happy to see the size of this one compared to his other large bones. Unfortunately the honeymoon didn't last long because within the first few hours of ownership he chewed off 1/4 of the green middle part. He starts with the nubs and gradually works his way onto larger chunks. He is always supervised with new toys and lucky for us he isn't a swallower of large chunks, although I'm sure we will find our fair share of green nubs in the yard tomorrow morning after his usual morning business - a nice little St. Paddy's day treat for us all! Oh yeah, it does smell pretty good overall as the mint hides some of the usual slobber stench so that's a plus as well.

column9: It is still a toy! After a month of getting absolutely knawed on!
column10: My Rottie destroys toys of all kinds. Unbreakable, indestructible... Forget it ! He can CHEW! After a month, yes it looks gnawed, but the green band is still on it. It is his favorite toy to chew! It is loud w hen he drops it on the floor as it weighs a ton. But he loves to chew it in his crate! I highly recommend this for POWER or extreme chewers.

column9: Looks Boring to Me, but the Dogs Love It
column10: I hesitated a long time before buying our first Nylabone chew toy.  They are moderately expensive and, frankly, don't look all that exciting.  But, the dogs love them.We have two Rhodesian Ridgebacks, one of which is quite a chewer.  He picks the Double Action Combo Bone (Souper size) to chew, hands down, over any other in his arsenal.  The toys do wear down eventually, but it takes a long time.We have two of these toys now and will replace with exactly the same model when they wear out.

Ordered this item because it was advertised for POWERFUL chewers. Received it yesterday. Within an hour our 60 pound, 1.5 year old pit bull has the center green portion more than half eaten. She also managed to get off a few of the nylon nubs on the end. I would not recommend this item for powerful or extreme chewers.

column9: Stands up to an agressive chewer
column10: My pouch chews and destroys everything she posses. Nothing lasts but nylabones. Thank goodness my pouch likes them otherwise I'd be sunk and so would my possessions! This thing was massive!
Great toy! A little big but she loves it! Purchase if you have a big dog who loves to chew and tear things up!

To each, his own!  That phrase basically says that each one of us is different and as such, our preferences also tend to differ.  This idea applies not only to humans, but to our canine friends as well.  And when buying toys for your dog, that is an important consideration to keep in mind.  Some dogs will love this toy, while some will simply ignore it.  That is a frustrating part of trying to keep your dog entertained.  Because you see, buying toys for your dog can be just as much of a hit-or-miss proposition as buying a gift for a blind date.So what can you do, to avoid spending money on a pricey item that your dog might not like?  There are no guarantees, but you can take the time to watch your dog carefully.  After some time, you will notice what types of toys captivate his attention.  Based on my observations over the years and owning different breeds, I have come to believe that the more impulsive individuals might not find entertainment with this toy.  However, those obsessive, focused types like you see in Rottweilers, German Shepherds, and Labradors would be delighted to chew on this for days.Impulsive dogs tend to be the types who do not like to play fetch.  They may chase the ball once, but pretty soon, their attention span is very quickly diverted elsewhere.  My current dog is like that.  He just does not like to spend a lot of time chewing on an item that does not break apart easily.  The only way to engage him for a prolonged period of time is to give him something that breaks apart easily (pressed rawhide) or something that dispenses food (Kong and Starmark treat dispensers).  He is just not the obsessive type who would spend a lot of time gnawing on a durable object.  He needs constant and frequent reinforcement to keep his attention from wandering away from the toy.  Your dog may like it, depending on his personality and his breed.Nylabone is a maker of high quality dog toys.  This is a quality item.  It is just unfortunate that my dog's attention span is too short to be entertained by these types of toys.  Ofcourse, I found out the hard (or the expensive) way.  I bought the toy and my dog ignored it!

column9: Dogs enjoy it, but no more than their other bones
column10: We got this Nylabone because of the bacon flavor figuring our dogs would love it. They definitely like the bone and chew on it, but no more than their other bones (beef femur). I guess that's pretty good since a plastic bone holds its own against a real bone.One thing to be aware of -- this thing is kinda heavy. Might not be a big deal for your dog, but I have 2 dogs that like to wrestle for toys and also like to chew their bone while laying on the couch. When this thing gets dropped, especially on my hardwood floors, it is loud.

My dog never even attempted to play or chew on this toy. I think it is too hard which gives her no desire to chew on it because who would want to chew on a rock... well she does prefers rocks over this toy. This was a waste of my money, oh well.

Our dog is a 80lb german shepherd mix. He is just over 2 years old and is a pretty aggressive chewer. We bought almost all of the "durachew" nylabones and this product is by far the best option, at least for our dog. He loves chewing on the edible ends and has been working on it for over an hour now without any damage to the toy. Just ordered 3 more while this 8 dollars off over 40$.

We have a 70lb German Shepherd / Akita mix.  When we first got her from the foster we tried all sorts of toys to keep her from chewing on furniture, but she only like the soft squeaky toys which she managed to destroy in minutes.  We finally found the Tuffy's Mega Ring (available on amazon) and she loves it.  The only problem was without something hard to chew on, she was developing plaque / tartar on her teeth.  A vet cleaning was $150+ so we look for alternative chew toys.  The dog came to us eating only vegetarian food, so we have maintained that (we tried giving her a rawhide, but she just left it alone).  I emailed Nylabone and they confirmed that this chew is 100% vegetarian; the "bacon flavor" is an aromatic that is not derived from animal products:Double Action® Chews ("DuraChew® Double Action® Chew", "DuraChew® Double Action® Chew - Round Ball", and "DuraChew® Double Action® Chew - Football"), "bended bone" and "stick" brand Nylabone products are unflavored, but contain a bacon aromatic in the ends to make them more attractive.These products are flavored with a vegetarian (plant-derived) natural flavoring that does not contain any meat protein. Similar to "tofurkey" and "veggie-burgers," they have the meat flavor without the meat.Our dog has had the bone for about a month now and the plaque / tartar is nearly gone from her teeth thanks to this chew!

column9: Will not be buying this again!
column10: I know that my 1 year old bulldog is an extreme chewer, so I bought him this toy.  I had read the reviews about the middle part being chewed off, but I didn't think that my dog would or could chew off the middle part, especially since he had different nylabones before and he loved chewing the part he was SUPPOSED to chew.  I WAS SO WRONG.  The first thing he did was chew up the middle part and had chewed pieces off in less than an hour.
My dog loves his Nylabone so much.  It prevents him from chewing on things he's not supposed to (like the furniture).

When we got our dog, Sydney 3 years ago... I could not find a single thing that she would chew on that would last more than 10 minutes.I tried everything, until I found this!  It's definitely her favorite and every once in a while, I toss it in the dishwasher with her Kong and bowls to keep everything fresh.  I just bought another one for the first time because she's finally chewed through both sides.I highly recommend this to anyone who only wants to buy a chew toy every few years.

I originally purchased this for our black lab puppy because she could chew through everything and I needed the toughest toys I could find. This toy was one of the only toys she had that actually held up, so that is a huge plus for strong chewers! However, I purchased a smaller version for my 3 year old shih tzu and my chihuahua puppy and it pretty much got ignored. I think it is difficult for them to chew on. Also, these two dogs are not as strong chewers, so they have more stuffed animals and other toys around to choose from, where as our lab was not allowed to have stuffed animals because she shredded them. Overall, all three dogs preferred just a regular-looking nylabone to this one. The black lab had her regular nylabone chewed down to a tip, but it took her awhile to do that. I would only purchase this bone if your dog is a very strong chewer and you are having trouble keeping toys around for it, otherwise it may get ignored.

column4: SLBJWS "Dont breed or Buy While Shelter pets DIE"
column10: My dogs prefers this over the Nylabone Galileo Bone Dog Chew Toy, Souper.Alto this one is not as strong but will last for a while. I have 2 pit 50lbs pit mixes that love to chew. Just make sure if you have a larger breed dog that is an intense chewer to get the Souper size.

MY GSD loves this bone.  Like most GSDs she absolutely destroys any normal non "K9" type of chew toy.  However these last a long time (9 mo at least) and don't form sharp edges until the chew has finally given it's all.  If you have a heavy chewer this is a great toy / chewer.  Be aware, it's heavy and when your dog drops it on your toe you'll know it.

I have a 4 year old Weimaraner and it is next to impossible to find toys he does not instantly destruct. This is the second of this bones like this. The first one lasted nearly a year before he had the knobs on the end wore down. He absolutely loves it.Only downsides are: occasionally he will get a sharp piece on it and has put a couple small cuts on his gums. It is VERY heavy for a dog toy and hurts really bad when stepped on or dropped on your foot.....I highly recommend!!!!!

column9: Yay!  Passed the pit chew test
column10: I am so grateful for this chew.  My medium sized pit has gone through everything in minutes and he gets crazy OCD about chewing.  He tore the green nubs off in minutes and thought for sure this thing was dead meat, but after that he settled into going after the ends of the bone.  I am concerned with how sharp it gets but I keep checking it for blood and don't see any.. yet.  He's probably had an hour a day with it for a week and it's not much worse for wear.

column9: Chew toy that lasts and lasts
column10: This is the only chew toy that stands up to my pit bull's strong jaw.  She had one and used it continuously for 2 years and it still was intact but I replaced it.  She LOVES it and always goes for this one amongst all her toys.

In 15 years, this has been the only bone / chew toy that my dogs could not destroy.  We dogsit and can have up to ten dogs in our home at any time.  Even the Rots and the Puppies can't destroy this chew toy.  They seem to enjoy carrying it around too.  The one downside is that we have nicknamed these bones "Bleeder Bones" because after a few years of chewing, they get very rough on the ends and when kicked in the middle of the night, can result in bloody toes.  Well worth the risk though, truly a great product for dogs!!

column9: Even my pit bull didn't destroy it!
column10: Fantastic chew toy! I have two MAJOR chewers and they both love this toy! And the best part is that it's lasted a long time. Even my pit hasn't terminated it yet!
My rescue lab mix is a very strong, heavy chewer. Nothing stands up to this dog except Nylabone products. Excellent chew toy!

For whatever reason I have always been hesitant to buy nylabones for my German shepherd. With the introduction of a new German shepherd puppy into the household, I remembered what a hard time I had the first go round with chewing. We bought this toy from a local store since it was last minute before going to pick up the puppy, but I'll sure purchase many more (from Amazon, of course) now that I see how well it holds up and how much both my dogs like it! I'm sorry now that I waited so long to buy one in the first place!
This is pretty much the only bone that stands up to our 50 lb pit bull's chewing!Eventually, she gets bits of the green off & it's time for a new one.  But they last for months.  She loves it!
My dog didn't really care for this chew toy.  She has loved other Nylabone chew toys, but I struck out with this one.  My dog likes the Nylabone Dura Chew Bone, Chicken Flavor, Souper much more.

column4: I tell it like it is
column10: Probably her favorite toy.  It is heavy yet she manages to walk around with it in her mouth like her prize.  She (57 lb. aggressive chewing golden retriever) works on it daily and it lasts a long time before it starts looking kind of nasty and unappetizing.  Not one single instance of even a small to medium size piece coming off, nothing ever bigger than a piece of uncooked rice.  I think it does help with scraping the teeth too.Her oral care routine is a little obsessive compulsive but it works.  Nylabones, CET rawhide chews, and Petz Life citrus spray.  Brushing isn't an option because of lack of patience by all involved parties.Great price on amazon as well.

My 110 lb mastiff loves this toy, so much so that we got him a second one just to use when we take him to the in laws house. He destroys bones like it's his job, and this one we have had for a little over a year now (with quite a few other nylabones on the ground). This makes the bones last a little longer when they have a large variety to choose from every day!

I just got a little dog-a terrier cross who weighs fourteen pounds soaking wet. He is the most aggressive chewer I have ever owned. He goes through toys labeled "Battle Tested" and "For Large Dogs" in less than a day. Even worse, he swallows everything he bites off his toys. I didn't think a Nylabone would work for him because the really durable ones are so big but I was at my wit's end so I got him this toy. He loves it-he will lay there chewing on it for half an hour at a time and so far all he's managed to do is scuff up the ends a little. He also carries it around, despite its size, and sometimes even tosses it. He has a lot of fun with it and I finally have a toy he can play with.
Great chew toy!  Lasts a long time and will keep you buddy busy for a long time.  Our 85 lbs foxhound loves it!

column9: May not be for hardcore chewers
column10: I have a lab-wiemaraner mix and he can devour almost any toy in minutes.  He liked this toy but he was able to chew up the green rubber pretty quickly.  The hard plastic ends get sharp with a lot of chewing. Didn't hold up as well as I thought it would.
Product came quicker than expected. My dogs love them!! Having Great Danes, I need something they can't chew through immediately!  This fits the bill.
Unlike the smaller versions, the center of the green part on this one is nylon rather than a pressed paperboard-like substance.  Lasts MUCH longer this way!

I have a 70 lb lab/pit/x and he loves to chew on these. He knows only to chew on his toys. This one isn't quite his favorite but it will last a long time. It is heavy though so be careful not to let your dog drop it on your foot. It hurts if he does. I would recommend the regular souper bones before purchasing this one.

I have a 105 lb. male yellow lab who can tear through most chew toys in mere hours. This Nylabone is his favorite by far. We are on our third one and counting. Each one lasts about 6 months. Eventually he will work off one of the ends and start ripping chunks off the green rubber center part. That's when I know it's time to pry it out of his jaws and order another one :)

I did not like this chew bone AT ALL. My poor lab's mouth started bleeding after just chewing a few minutes. My daughter noticed pink in her mouth. After checking the bone I decided to return it. The nubs on the end turned pointed immediately causing the bleeding. I like Nylabone products, just not this one.  Amazon sent me a return shipping label and credited my account right away.
Both of my dogs love them and try to take each other's, which is hilarious because the bones are HUGE, and they can barely fit one in their mouths!

The thing I like best about this nylabone, is that the ends are HUGE.  Unlike the regular souper bones where the ends are rather thing, these are triple the size.  Our dogs only chew the ends anyway, and this bone will last 3x as long.

This toy has held up tremendously well, but it does have a problem in design. Once your dog chews on it for a little bit, it seems to make some very sharp edges on the ends. The last time I saw my dog chewing on it, it left the bone covered in blood on both ends. Once I picked it up I quickly realized why. If it was made a bit softer I think the sharp edges created by chewing would not become a problem

We've searched for and tried just about every chew toy for our four year old Golden Retriever and he has torn through everything with ease...until this bone. He's had this toy longer than any other and it's quickly become his favorite. The other good news is that it has not developed any kind of nasty odor like many of the other toys we've tried but has kept a pretty fresh scent to this day (and I know this because he drops it on my lap ten times a day...). As hard as he's worked at it, he has not even been able to rip a tiny piece of the the thin green section off the center of the bone. I highly recommend this bone and just bought two more that should literally last us for the next year or more.
Our eight month old lab is a big chewer.  He has really loved this nylabone.  And it has held up very well.  If your dog seems to destroy any toy that you buy, this is the one for you.

I have 3 labs, the smallest of which (Leopold, a lab/basenji mix) definitely qualifies as a 'power chewer'. He destroys tennis balls in a matter of minutes, rips large Kong Wubbas apart as though they were paper, and murders stuffed animals with ease.  This bone, however, has lasted since I got him in February.  It was one of our first purchases and the look of happiness on his face while he chews on it is priceless! Since his brothers can never get it away from him, I've gotten 2 more.  They are heavy and make a lot of noise when dropped on the floor, but that is a small price to pay for a chew toy which can actually be chewed on!
This item is great!!!!  I highly recommend it for all pit bull owners! it is the only chew toy that my 5 year old pit bull has not ripped apart.  It keeps her busy for hours!  She loves it!

I have been a fan of Nylabones ever since we got our Lab in 2008.  I heard questionable facts about raw hides, and didn't want to try them.  Nylabones are typically expensive, but always long lasting, and EXCELLENT quality.  This particular bone (Dura Chew Double Action Combo, Souper) is so awesome, and the price was excellent!  I seen this exact bone at PetSmart for double the price.  My Lab loves this bone.  It is a bit bigger than what we are used to, but she loves it and it is not too big at all.  Also recommend the "Big Chew" by Nylabone.

column9: Cute product, excellent service, quick delivery!
column10: I ordered this for my son's birthday party, which was bumblebee themed. We gave them as favors to all the kids, and the parents thought they were so cleverly packaged in the bumblebee foil. We were getting nervous about delivery, but customer service was great, and they arrived in time!

My husband and I bought some of this seasoning at the grocery store thinking it was the usual taco seasoning mix. Boy were we wrong! This has such a distinctive, wonderful flavor! Of course, after we used it, we couldn't find it in the store anymore. A few months went by and we kept searching, then we thought, let's try Amazon! Glad we could find this here!! We'll be enjoying some nachos as soon as we get it!!

My son introduced me to the Chipotle flavoring of Taco Bell seasoning mix. We really like the smokey flavor.  Then all of sudden he couldn't find it in his Florida store and I can't find it in Arizona.  I called Kraft hoping I they would be able to send some or tell me where I could find it..  They did tell me to try.. Amazon.Com.I kept a few and sent the rest to him for his Birthday..  Won't he be surprised!!!!!!

column9: I get this regularly via Subscribe and Save.
column10: This is such a good product. I like to have it on hand to make Taco Salad. It's so convenient to order with Subscribe and Save. I just change the delivery date if it's not time for a new shipment.
I'm not a big fan of at home taco mixes, but the TB Chipotle mix is great!  It has plenty of unique smoky FLAVOR that is not bland or generic.This is the ONLY taco mix I will buy now.  Very pleased!

Contracting in Afghanistan, I was very weary about the possible delivery time on this product -- but on the contrary, I received my fudge in less than a week.All I can say is this stuff's wonderful. I don't indulge in sweets too often, but rest assured that when I do, I want stuff like this. Highly recommended!!!Job superbly done by the makers...

I am not usually a review writer, but when it comes to this coffee I cannot help myself.This is the best cup of joe I have ever had!! Strong, rich, bold, a fabulous cup of coffee.It is like a treat everytime I brew.

column9: Lovely but smaller than image shows
column10: I purchased this as a gift thinking it would be a nice California themed gift.  It arrived about the size of a book! The quality is excellent, and the presentation lovely, just on the small side for the price.

They shipped the wrong product.  The one I ordered was shaped like a flower and had nuts.  The one my mom got for mother's day was all fruit and was not shaped like a flower.  On the plus side, my mom did enjoy it regardless of the wrong product.

column9: It's the name of the plant, not the location of where it was grown.
column10: Also known as Lemon Verbena and Verveine Odorante, Verveine is a fragrant herb indigenous to South America, namely Argentina, Chile and Peru. It was introduced to Europe by Spanish explorers in the 17th century where it was given the name Aloysia triphylla after the princess Maria Louisa of Parma and for its spirals of three (tri) leaves (phylla).
Maybe it was indicated somewhere, but when I see "French verveine" that is what I expect to get. Not from plants grown in USA.Shipping was prompt and packaging good.

Introduction: Also known as Lemon Verbena and Verveine Odorante, Verveine is a fragrant herb indigenous to South America, namely Argentina, Chile and Peru. It was introduced to Europe by Spanish explorers in the 17th century where it was given the name Aloysia triphylla after the princess Maria Louisa of Parma and for its spirals of three (tri) leaves (phylla).

I would first like to thank all of the reviewers who mentioned the fishy smell. Knowing that it was an offputting smell did help me take the plunge in actually tasting the noodle. It really is tasteless, as I tasted the noodle before eatting it with sauce.  It's a wonderful canvas for the flavor of the sauce and absorbed the taste beautifully.  So cool that something like this exists for a diabetic that needs to lose weight!
I REALLY ENJOY THE NOODLES, A LITTLE FISHY WHEN YOU FIRST OPEN THEM, BUT GREAT WITH TOMATO SAUSE. WILL BUY AGAIN.

column9: I love them!  -But don't expect regular noodles.
column10: I love these, but they do have a chewy texture and are better in Asian dishes then with regular pasta sauce.  There is a strange fishy smell when you open the package, but when rinsing and parboiling as directed the finished product does not taste fishy at all -even with just tomato sauce.  I will be eating these regularly.  Even my kids liked them.  My husband thought they were OK.  He is not thrilled with the texture but will eat them for the low calories.  I like the chewy texture.
I bought one because most of the fat free low/no carb products aren't that tasteful. I was very wrong about this item. After eating the noodles, I'm hooked. I would highly recommend this item.

Due to the restricted diet I am on, I can not have regular pasta.  The Miracle Noodle is a nice substitute for a pasta when the rest of the family is eating it!  They don't have much flavor, but will absorb the flavor of the sauce you use.  Make sure you rinse them well!
these noodles have virtually no taste so were exactly what I was looking for to fill me up on the hcg diet and just absorb what ever topping I put on them, very good

These are totally disgusting!  This is the second time I have tried them because I really wanted to like them.  I have read so many good reviews and Hungry Girl strongly recommends them.  I am not a picky eater at all, but I just cannot swallow these.  The fishy smell does go away, but the texture makes them inedible.  YUCK.  I have tried both the angel hair and the fettucine.  I was laughing so hard when I read the reviewers remark about her husband spitting them out like on the movie BIG.  I spit them out too.  LOL

There is no doubt, these noodles filled me up...however, i'm not sure if they suppressed my appetite because they are filling, or because they smell SO bad i couldn't stomach eating them anymore.  There is something about the fluid these noodles are packed in, they have an EXTREMELY strong fish odor...even when i rinsed the noodles and boiled them for nearly 10 minutes, the smell was still there (even with some tomato sauce on them).  Seriously, the smell was horrid.  The consistency was strange too, but that i could get used too...the smell...no way.  :-(

column9: Shirataki miracle noodles are no bargain
column10: These noodles were enticing for me because of the absence of calories. They are definitely edible, but they have no flavor and the texture is like thin rubberbands (I bought the spaghetti version that was recommended by other reviewers). Considering the high price of these noodles, I prefer the flavor, nutrition, texture, and cost of of spahgetti squash!

These noodles have the weirdest texture, flavor and they Stink like fish.  Even after rinsing, It still stank up my kitchen.  No Matter how you fix them NOTHING made them taste good. Threw them out !  There is no miracle here. Except for the Miracle of your Money going POOF-- Gone!  Just GROSS!

The only thing miraculous about these noodles is that anyone likes them. They have the consistency of rubber bands and/or a snotty nose. And on top of that, they smell like fish and the smell gets on your hands when rinsing for a very long time.I have never felt the need to leave a poor review on any of my Amazon purchases until now. This one takes the cake!

I'm all for biting the bullet when it comes to avoiding unnecessary carbs but these miracle noodles sacrifice taste and texture.I've eaten 'raw' for an extended period of time and to me raw zucchini or squash noodles are more convincing than these.  By no stretch of the imagination do they taste like or remind you of noodles.  The TEXTURE is like trying to chew jellyfish. (Not that I've ever tried them, I just imagine this is what the texture would be like)I was so excited to try them with a nice marinara sauce.  OMG, I couldn't finish them.  If I remember correctly, I don't even think I risked giving it to my dog.  Despite the cost, I threw these in the trash.  In hind sight I probably should have found somewhere to donate them.  But I just wanted to get rid of those darn things!  Yuk! YuK! YUK!

I love pasta and am a pretty adventurous eater so I was eager to try these. What could be better, right?  Zero calorie pasta. Sounded to be good to be true.  Well, let me tell you, these "noodles" are perfectly awful.  I could get past the smell (which can be covered up) but not the texture.  These noodles had a seriously plastic-like consistency.  It's as if you cooked up a bunch strings from a tennis racket. Really.  They are hard and rubbery and so "un-food like" I couldn't eat them at all and I truly don't understand how anyone else could either.  Try them if you like, but they're definitely not for me.
the noodles came in a very fishy smelling package when opened. you really have to wash it well. Tasted okay. But will not buy again.

I use these frequently.  Calorie and carbohydrate free, but just as filling as spaghetti.  Although they don't taste like standard pasta, they're a wonderful substitute for when you have carb cravings.  The fishy smell rinses right away and they absorb the flavor of the sauce.  A little on the strange side with texture - 'rubbery' sounds worse than it is, but I can't figure out another description.  Still really enjoy them.
