I use udon seasoning packets or boullion usually, but pasta sauce works well. I find that if you rinse and prepare them, then allow to sit an hour or so to absorb the flavor, it works really well.  Toss them in the microwave and voila!  Great product.

Stick with the angel hair.  They "chew" much better.  I first tried the thick linguine one and it was like chewing rubber bands.  I took a chance on the angel hair and it was actually very edible.  Satifies the carb crave with no guilt. I get them at the supermarket cause AMAZON does not offer them with free shipping.

Some of these reviews crack me up!  Obviously the directions were not read or followed.  The noodles are put in a solution that does smell 'fishy', BUT it says that and it also says to rinse in warm water for 3-5 minutes, not 15 seconds. Then it says to DRY them in paper towel or other. When you add to your meal or sauce, the noodles absorb that flavor.  The Miracle Noodle website is great for explaining the whole concept of the noodle. Is the texture different? YES, but to me it is worth the acquired feel.  You eat these noodles, you will not be hunger for the rest of the day, seriously!  And...let your imagination make recipes for you.  I do wish there were more recipes out there to find, but I just get creative.  Try a bag and see for yourself...BUT follow the directions and if any questions the Miracle Noodle website has an online chat... (No, I do not work for them, I just like the products).

column9: Great, Easy to make and NO Calories!
column10: Yes, the noodles does have fishy smell when you open it. However, it goes away once you start running against hot water for a minute or two.Though tasteless, the noodle, absorbs flavor thus making it tastier than the actual noodle.

I want to preface this review and say that if you want a really healthy alternative to pasta then you may want to try these. My husband really likes using these for a zero calorie option. I, on the other hand, will not eat them. They still have a fishy type taste and the texture is very different. No matter how we prepare them I can still taste the weirdness and would rather have the calories from real pasta. My husband has an easier time getting over the taste and taking them for what they are. For health nuts who can't or won't eat real pasta this would be a good product to try and see if its something that you enjoy.

Let me start by saying that these are not like regular pasta noodles. There is a specific texture to these that is hard to describe. When you first open the package, there is a fishy smell. The easiest way to deal with this is to dump the bag into a strainer over the sink (hold your nose if fishy smells bother you) and rinse with water for about 30 seconds. Then put the noodles in a bowl of water with vinegar in it (about 3 or 4 cups of water and 1 or 2 tablespoons of vinegar) and let it soak for about 10 minutes. This gets rid of the fishy smell. After I do this I like to split the package in half, put one half in a paper towel-lined container in the fridge, and "saute" the other half with a small amount of olive oil. This will replace the "drying" that is recommended. Then I add a sauce like spaghetti or curry sauce and eat.I can't say that I really enjoy eating them all that much, BUT replacing my lunchtime meal with these noodles has helped me to lose about 3 pounds already. They really fill you up quickly, and the fiber is very good for you. I did a lot of research before I tried them, because I had heard a lot of bad things about the smell and texture, and after trying them I can say that the benefits outweigh all that. They're really not that bad if you prepare them as above. I would recommend them if you are trying to cut your calories.

column9: These are great tasing Noodles, Low Carb, Soy, Wheat & Gluten Free YEA!
column10: I am so Thankful that there are companies out there trying to make products for those of us, who need Low-Carb, Soy, Wheat, & Gluten Free.  These noodles really take on the taste of whatever you make.  But you must wash in warm water first for 3-5 minutes to get rid of fishy smell.  And it does go completely away.  If it dosn't you should call the company and let them know, because you may have gotten a bad batch or something.Now, the texture is more like Top Ramen noodles, which makes it perfect for soup. But I have also used it for other types of sauces. You just have to get use to the interesting texture like for Spegetti Sauce.These Noodles are a winner for me, and I will continues to use them, although, they are a bit expensive for a big family.  I hope as they become popular for, Low-Carb, Soy, Wheat, & Gluten Free Eaters, that the price will go down, and be more reasonable to buy.  Keep up the good work Miracle Noodles Company, and may other companies pick up on the idea of making more prodcuts that are Low-Carb, Soy, Wheat, & Gluten Free too.

These things work great. I've eaten them before to curb carb cravings. Wash em once or so and they are fine. I never noticed a fish smell ever, so to be honest .... I thought they tasted fresh and enticing each time. 5 stars!

column9: You have to like Asian to enjoy this product
column10: I am a fanatic of authentic Asian cuisines. No American-Asian foods...I want the real thing and have been cooking and eating authentic Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Chinese and Thai cooking for many years.  These noodles are very comparable to bean thread (mung bean noodles) aka glass noodles, vermicelli noodles, etc. They are virtually calorie-less and carb-less. Great for dieting.  If you are looking for a western/Italian style noodle, you'll probably be disappointed.  However, if you enjoy authentic Asian soups, stir-fry's, etc, you will be delighted with these noodles.  For those 'steak and potatoes' eaters, you may not enjoy this product.  I think they're great! But I also like, squid, sushi, sashimi, and all sorts of Asian dishes that might turn off many western palates.
I'm ordering my second round. These are a great substitue for pasta. Rinse, Rinse, Rinse to get the fishy smell off. Love that they are 0 calories and 0 carbs!! Definitely recommend!

column9: Nobody reads 3-star reviews, but I'll try to be helpful anyway.
column10: When the five packs arrived they were much smaller than I expected, so I made one large spaghetti casserole with meatballs. Like others mentioned it had a fishy smell at first, but after cooking it there was no trace of the smell. The casserole was pretty good, although the texture was somewhat chewier than you would expect from normal spaghetti, and you could tell you weren't eating the usual processed carbohydrates. Given the high price for a small amount of noodles I don't see this as a viable diet alternative -- I would have to spend way too much to replace my normal noodle intake. Fine then, I'll eat less and exercise more.A note about making a large casserole - YOU CAN NOT FREEZE THESE NOODLES!  I froze the leftovers, and when I thawed some out a couple of weeks later the noodles had turned into a desiccated rat's nest. It was like eating a knotted ball of butcher's twine. Blech.

This is not normal pasta. This a flavorless, odorless, spongy-textured dietary fiber in noodle form. It's a US-branded Shiritaki noodle, made of glucomannan.Why do people say it smells? Because it's a japanese product, and the packing fluid that smells neutral to the japanese smells fishy to us. However, rinse the noodles in a strainer thoroughly, parboil them for a minute, and the smell is gone. There is absolutely no fishy odor or flavor (or ANY odor or flavor, for that matter) to properly rinsed and parboiled Shiritaki noodles.These noodles just add texture and filling to your meal. Add them to soup or stir fry, serve them with grilled meat... they're an excellent complement to a carb-free or low-calorie diet. Just don't expect them to taste like spaghetti. They make you feel full, and the fiber is good for you.The noodles are totally fine stored at room temperature for a month or two. They last even longer in the fridge.Some Shiritaki noodles have tofu in addition to the glucomannan, and therefore have calories. This particular brand, however, does not.Shiritaki noodles will not substitute in your favorite Italian dish. They're much better paired with various Asian recipes and spices.

I too made the mistake of buying a bunch of these horrible "noodles" and threw away almost all of them.  I am not a picker eater, I like most any food, but I could not stomach the texture of these noodles!  No matter how much you chew them, they just bounce around on your teeth like rubber. I tried them in soup, with stir fry, and with pasta sauce - all disgusting.  Don't commit to buying a whole box of these, look for them at Central Market or an Asian store and just buy one bag.

column9: Added this to our culinary arsenal
column10: My spouse and I were expecting something like a dried noodle that would need to be boiled to absorb water, but these things come already hydrated, soaking in a bag of fluid.  This seems inefficient in terms of transporting the product, and I wonder if it is necessary to pack this way, but that isn't really what this review should be about.We used these noodles with stir-fried veggies (onions, red peppers, mushrooms, and green beans) and a thai-style peanut sauce.  We went with this sauce because other reviewers suggested the product seemed a little fishy, and thai cuising makes use of fish sauce, so it felt like it could be complementary.  It was excellent.Do not expect the noodles to be a pasta, despite their appearance.  They have a different consistency.  Someone else suggested chewy like squid tentacles and that doesn't seem too far from the mark.  We also were reminded of the consistency of spaghetti squash, if you are familiar with that plant. As for flavor, there isn't much, though maybe there is something subtly fishy (or was that the power of suggestion?).  In addition to adding texture, its functions in your meal revlove around its ability to act as vehicle which other flavors (sauces) can cling.Nutritionally, it contributes soluble fiber and little else, as far as I can tell.  We are calorie concious in our meal prep and decided that there is a place for this product in our cooking arsenal.  Its value may be more enhanced for you if you restrict gluten in-take.  Even if we were not calorie concious, we appreciate the unique texture the product has, as eating is a multi-sensory experience.  Vive la difference.

after you get used to the texture and smell, conceptually the product is great but- FOR ME- the burdens outweigh any benefits when you can't move because digestion (bathroom, bloating, gas, and paiiinnnn in the stomach all over) is such an issue. 300Lb gorilla sitting a top your chest and stomach....It seemed to be this brand in particular for me but all of them seem to have the same ingredients except the Tofu Shirataki which has tofu in it and I seemed to be able to stomach better.It may just be me, but boy- I just cannot eat these
I LOVE Shirataki noodles...but Miracle Noodles are SO overpriced. $3 a bag! Asianfoodgrocer.com sells the same noodles (White Shirataki) for $1.50. Don't buy these, its a rip off!

I have never written a review for any product, but I always read reviews of products I'm not sure about.  I had to throw these noodles away.  I followed the directions on the package as written.  The smell was terrible.  I cooked them and then added them to pasta sauce.  I ate several bites trying to like them.  Finally, I gave up and threw the rest of my dinner away.  My stomach was upset for the rest of the evening.  I threw the rest of my order away as well.  Just thinking about the way they looked and smelled makes me nauseous.  Don't waste your money.  If you're wanting real pasta just eat skinny for a few days then enjoy the real thing.

I first learned of the noodles through a health publication and I've had them in sukiaki at an oriental restaurant.  The noodles are just as described.  A great low calorie alternative. The smell of the noodles bagged in fluid was a concern at first but just follow the directions and all is well.  I would have liked a few recipes included with their typed instructions.  I recommend the product and the merchant.

As others have mentioned, the texture of these noodles is something unlike anything I have ever put in my mouth. Also, others have mentioned that the horrifying smell can be washed away but that was not so for me. Once I caught a whiff of these fishy noodles, it was as if it was emblazoned into my olfactory senses. It was as if nothing could erase that odor, and it came back to me as I tried to choke these down, following a variety of recommendations I had seen here. I had ordered a large quantity of these noodles thinking it sounded wonderful and lived to regret it. I felt terrible about throwing the remaining packages out but what was I to do? I felt that if I donated it to a local food bank, there would be many needy people out there scarred by the horrible memory of those noodles. So in the trash they went.

Yes, when you open them they have a little fishy smell to them but once you wash them you no longer smell it. Do not try to eat them plain...they have no taste and have a strange texture. BUT if you cook them in some broth they are yummy! I have done all kinds of things with them...mostly adding them to a stir fry. Try them if you are trying to eat a low cal diet...you don't have to starve...they fill you up!! I'm happy with them just don't expect them to be like a reg noodle...the have more of the texture of seaweed...but hey, I love seaweed salad:)

I first heard about these noodles when Nigella Lawson was raving about them and as she's lost so much weight my "miracle weight loss" antennae immediately pricked up!  I'm currently on the Acai Berry capsules and thought I'd speed up the process with whatever else I could lay my hands on.  I initially ordered 5 packs thinking they'd last me ages when in actual fact it's more like 5 servings - one serving per pack.  I have a really strong sense of smell and after hearing how awful they smelt was prepared for the worst.  However I don't think they smell that bad and certainly after rinsing them thoroughly with cold water unless you get up close and personal with them, they don't smell at all.  So far I've stirred them into soup and a stir fry and I really like them.  I quite like the al dente texture too and they're very filling.  The only mistake I made was microwaving them for a minute in water and they went all dry and brittle and didn't taste good at all so stirring them into hot food and gently heating through seems to be the best way to cook them.  They are quite expensive however and certainly not a cheap alternative to your normal pasta or noodles.  I've just ordered another 10 packs which with delivery has cost me £31.  However if I lose weight (I have a stone to lose) then as far as I'm concerned it's worth it.
I wanted to really like it but couldn't get pass the way it felt in my mouth.

column9: how to remove fishy smell -- easy and effective
column10: You are not supposed to eat them with a fishy smell. Just follow this simple pre-cooking method; that's how they're prepared in a Japanese cuisine.1. Put the noodles in a small pan. Rinse briefly with water.2. Leave water enough to soak all the noodles in the pan.3. Bring them to boil.4. Keep them boiling for ~3 minutes.5. Pour the noodles onto a strainer. They are ready for cooking.The point is to boil the noodles in water. Don't put them in hot water from the beginning -- it's not as effective.

column9: Try this no slime recipe,  It really is good.
column10: I understand how some may find these slimy, they are, but I found a way to eliminate that. I cannot have gluten but I love my noodles like most of you. I tried these in soup and I truly found them a bit lacking. I remembered a recipe that I used to love, if you can have eggs this is the recipe to try.Wash the noodles really really good and drain on paper towel. I cut them up a bit.Dice one small potato and fry it is a not stick pan with about 1 tablespoon oil. When the potatoes are cooked spread them out evenly, add the noodles spreading them also, let them cook for a a few minutes to allow for some drying. Scramble 4 eggs and pour them over the noodles, do not disturb them, if you can have parmesan cheese sprinkle some on top now, but it will be good without them, I eat them without cheese. Sprinkle about 1 tsp. oregano on top, salt and pepper to taste. Cover and allow the eggs to cook through. If you like, place the skillet under a broiler to brown the top, but it is not necessary. This may serve 4 if you are on a diet and two if not.Slide them onto a plate a slice and serve plain, with ketchup or tomato sauce.I will track this review so if you have any questions don't hesitate, the noodles in this recipe are nice and dry and when combined with the eggs and potatoes you can hardly taste them. You can also make this with other vegetates like asparagus, onions, chives, even sausage, chicken and other meats. Enjoy!
These do smell fishy when opened but rinse and dry and they are great they take on the taste of whatever you put them with and NO calories !

Only if you can stomach a raw smelly fish smell when you open the package and the rubbery noodle texture that doesn't go away with chewing should you order these.  I made the mistake of ordering 10 and threw most away after trying to do something with them twice.  These noodles were like eating rubber bands -- NASTY and look like clear tapeworms.  I tried cutting them, only could stomach them if I cut them in tiny pieces and didn't chew after smothering them in Ragu.  NOT GOOD - I threw that meal out.  I'd steer clear, goes to show if something looks to good to be true - a no calorie no carb noodle  it is too good to be true.... These are also not worth the price.  If you do decide to order the noodle, there are also much less versions than the "Miracle Noodle" on amazon.com.  Order one package for trying - not a lot.

I almost cannot believe that these noodles have next to no calories or carbohydrates. As a pasta-lover who is attempting to eliminate gluten from my diet as well as lose weight, I am in pasta heaven after discovering shirataki "noodles." I have made great use of this product with vegetable sauces and in soups. The noodles themselves don't have a lot of flavor on their own, but then, neither do semolina noodles. I was very surprised that the texture of shirataki noodles is so similar to traditional pastas; so many gluten-free noodles just don't satisfy my cravings for pasta, but this product does. I need a truckload of this stuff! Highly recommended for anyone seeking a low-carb, low-calorie, satisfying pasta meal. Even better that they are gluten-free! Shirataki noodles are now a must-have staple in my kitchen.Did I mention that shirataki noodles are also vegan and GMO-free? They are. Get some and enjoy!!!P.S.---After reading several reviews from others, I wanted to add my two cents on the fishy smell and preparation of shirataki noodles:Yes, this product does have a fishy smell when first opened. RINSE the noodles. Duh. Rinse them well in cold water and then drain before using.Several reviewers mentioned a "rubber-band" texture to the noodles. Personally, I don't find their texture unpleasant; if I had to compare their texture to anything, it would be to semolina spaghetti noodles that are very slightly overcooked. They are a bit more tender than al dente pasta, yet firm in a different way as a result of from what they are made.Some reviewers mentioned that they boiled or roasted the noodles; I like to simply rinse them in cold water and then heat them in the microwave with my favorite sauce (marinara). I know that microwaving is anathema to foodies and gourmets, but it allows a girl on the go to make a satisfying meal pretty quickly nonetheless.If using the noodles in soups, wait until the soup is done to add the noodles; don't boil them, they really don't need to be cooked. Add them just before you are going to serve the soup; they only need to be in the broth long enough to get hot. (Or, you can heat the noodles in the microwave for 30 seconds or so and then add them to your soup!)If using the noodles in a cold salad, simply rinse them well in cold water and drain.Of course, not everyone will like shirataki noodles. Not everybody likes mushrooms...or meat...or strawberries. I like them. Maybe you will, too.

I bought the tofu shirataki noodles for my son (21 yrs. old )who has autism.  He is obsessed with pasta, and I was looking for a healthier alternative for him.  I was a little skeptical given his sensory/texture issues, but I bought a bag.  I rinsed them thoroughly (3 minutes), cooked them in a bowl of water in the microwave for 1 minute, dried them thoroughly, threw them in a bowl with some leftover spaghetti meat sauce, let them sit about an hour to absorb the flavor of the sauce, then heated them in the microwave for 2 mintues.  I served it to him with some trepidation.  He added butter and parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.  He took one bite, then another, then another, and kept going until they were gone.  He prounounced them "A-OK"!  A small miracle given his sensory/texture issues.  Needless to say, I made sure he was nowhere around when I first opened the bag b/c they did indeed have that fishy smell I had read so much about, and since he has a hairtrigger gag reflex (has to brush his teeth BEFORE breakfast or breakfast may and has come back up), I wasn't taken any chances.  Next step--I have to try them.  Yikes!!!

column9: I LOVE THIS NEWLY DISCOVERED PRODUCT!
column10: I am on the HCG Diet program that is very distinct and precise--500 calories per day.  After a few weeks of my menus, the Medical Center featured the Miracle Noodles products.  Being very cautious because of the smell, looks, and that it had "no nutritional ingredients"--like calories, carbs, sodium etc., yet good fiber-- I decided to try the Angel Hair and the Rice noodles.  The Angel Hair was ok, but I have loved the Rice from my first recipe!  I was really afraid that I could not stand the fishy smell.  So here is how I became to love them.I bought a new strainer--not colander--poured the entire package in it and run COLD water over it for 3-5 minutes--then drizzle lemon juice on it, stir around--then rinse another 2 minutes--I have NO smell at all.  I make up a vegetable broth with good spices--and use this for blanching instead of plain water--and I boil them abour 2 minutes in the broth.  Then dry on the paper towels.  I usually do 2-3 packages at a time--put them in 1 cup containers with a little of the broth, and store in the refrigerator until ready to use--saves time.My favorite way to eat them is to saute' meat or seafood with a little oil.  Set aside, and in the drippings add a little onion, chopped spinach or asparagus--add a litte broth, stir to mix flavors--add the little rice "pearls"--then the protein (chicken, meat or fish), put the lid on and steam for a few minutes!  The flavors of everything get in the rice, and it is delicious!!!  On the HGC Diet, I can have it every day--I divide it, and add it to both meals.  That is how much I love it!  I am so glad for this Miracle product!!!

I was so hopeful about this product.  Yet, it was squeaky when chewing.  It didn't make much food (two servings a bag?), it didn't absorb flavor and I was still hungry afterwards.  I use Dreamfield's low carb pasta and was looking for a better alternative.  This wasn't it.  I'll stick with the Dreamfield's.

I was skeptical about purchasing the shirataki noodles after reading some of the reviews, but I must say that I was pleasantly surprised. I made a lighter version of chicken alfredo and it is yummy. I have suffered no side effects thus far and my belly is full. Please have an open mind when trying these because the texture is not like regular pasta. The shirataki noodles sort of remind me of cooked squid... but in a good way. In conclusion, try them for yourself. The noodles are packaged in a fishy smelling liquid, but the smell goes away after rinsing.Go to your local grocer if you don't want to invest in bulk packaging online for your first purchase. That's what I did.

column9: Tasty if cooked with a salty flavor sauce
column10: These are great, no calorie and a nice texture. They have the texture of a rice noodle. They do stink like fish when you open the package, but rinse well and there is NO fishy flavor.  There is really no flavor at all.  They are really good with salty bouillons or soy sauce-type of sauces.  OK with marinara but not a ton of flavor absorbed.  The packages are kind of small and will only serve 1-2 people.

column9: Don't forget to "roast" the noodles to remove moisture
column10: These are a miracle noodle for me, because  they take care of my cravings for  pasta and can used  in all casserole type dishes as well as just adding sauces.  I used the linguine  for my Mom's best Mac and cheese recipe and It was just as good, if not better.  It is hard to believe I am now able to enjoy such a treat as this with almost zero carbs and very few calories.The key to getting rid of the extra moisture associated with these noodles is to "Roast" them in a dry pan before using for a recipe or adding sauce.  I discovered this by trial and error, before I actually saw this posted as the standard practice for preparing these noodles for use.  I wish they  had this posted on the package, I think more people would enjoy them if they take the time to do this very important step.I roast the noodles by placing in a dry hot frying pan and "stir fry" them until all the steam evaporates from the noodles.  Then you can add your sauce or use in a  pasta recipe.Give them a try again if you have had a bad experience, and  try "roasting" them this time.For a pasta craver like me, they are the best inventions  since slice bread!!

The initial putrid scent is much abated by rinsing the noodles before use.  However, that is not the cause of this low rating.  The noodles are a nice attempt to bring low or no calorie foods into a restricted calorie or restricted carb diet.  The taste is quite plain and it takes to a sauce well.  However, within a few bites, I had to throw them all away, as I felt like I was eating rubber and it became increasingly thusly disgusting in texture.  I don't mean a good rubbery texture like chewing gum, I mean like something you wouldn't want to ingest or even chew on. I am a fan of many popular diet foods and don't like to waste food, but I couldn't swallow this and ended up wasting it, dumping into the trash.

I wanted to love these because calorie-free pasta sounds amazing, but they are just too weird and gross. I didn't mind the fishy smell because it rinses right away and I expected them to have no flavor because they are supposed to absorb whatever sauce. I put a yummy spicy peanut sauce on them, but the texture just sucks. It's like rubber. The clear noodles look exactly like raw squid and the texture is slimy. Yuck. I dumped them out in the trash.

Tried these and they are so totally GROSS.  Don't believe the rave reviews.  These are NOTHING like spagetti noodles and no matter how you cook them - will never be like spagetti noodles.  My whole family tried them but the funniest was my husbands reaction.... I didn't tell him what they were and he took a big bite.....  Did you see the movie "BIG" with Tom Hanks when he ate the caviar... well that was my husband -- so while it was a HUGE waste of money.... that was almost priceless...It is worst thing I have ever tried.  I agree with the others about the fishy smell. never goes away but the texture is Like eating "jellyfish tentacles" - and they look like jellyfish tentacles as well.I am passing these on to the trashcan and hope the seagulls like them....

column9: They are as good as claimed
column10: I was not sure the noodles would tast good, or if  they would acquire the taste of the dish they were added to.  The excelled in both of these. I used them in soup and with pasta sauce with great success.

column9: Horrible!  Expensive!  And they come out exactly like they go in!
column10: First off, they are way to expensive, and they have zero food quality which explains the fact that they are 0 calories, you could slice up rubber and add to some sauce and get the same result!  Not to gross anyone out but I noticed that they came out exactly the same as they were when I ate them, that should tell you something!  Horrible Horrible Horrible, gas bloating stomach issues, I can go on and on about these things.  Do not buy!!!!

column9: Great for angel hair spaghetti on atkins
column10: Have to wash it because the packing chemicals are a little odd smelling, however I boiled it for about 2 minutes took it out and put it on a plate with paper towels dried it in a minute. Then served the noodles with spaghetti sauce with fresh grated parmessan cheese. Tasted great. I wouldn't have known it was anything but real angel hair pasta if it wasn't for the color. Very good. A dream for someone on Atkins.

I was actually surprised that these noodles tasted ok. I'd heard that there was a horrible smell when you opened them, so I opted to hold my breath and have the water running.  It worked.The noodles seem to take on the flavor of whatever you put them in or on. Somewhat like tofu.Satisfies your desire for the fattening pasta.I would recommend them.

I never write reviews but I must say these noodles are really good! You do need to rince them at least 5 minutes or that fishy smell will still be there. I made a pork and veggie stir fry with mandarin sauce and these noodles just absorbed the flavor. It was very yummy and filling! This is coming from a person that can't stand seafood so make sure you rince well.

column9: Funny texture but flavorless great substitue to reg noodles.
column10: Way better than the tofu shirataki. These need to be rinsed and then blanched in boiling water. Great for making soups or stir fry. Pretty much flavorless and picks up the flavor of whatever it is cooked in. The texture thing is either a hit or miss. I don't mind the somewhat jelly like texture but have read that others cannot tolerate it. So far tried it in soups, phad thai stir fry and it worked great. Spaghetti was kinda weird but still edible.

I'm very open to new flavors and tastes, but I had a rough time with these.  I put a small amount in a miso soup and the "bouncy" texture was less than appetizing.  Worse, they were TOO filling, meaning they sat like rubber bands in my stomach for quite a while after the bowl of soup was finished.  Love the concept, but I couldn't stomach them----literally.
i was so excited to try this, as it was recommended by Hungrygirl.com....i'd rather starve than eat this again. This goes down as one of the most disgusting "foods" i've ever had in my life.

column9: Sounds too good to be true!
column10: Great idea, noodles without calories! I've tried this in noodle soup and wok, and it is OK. It doesn't taste quite as good as regular noodles, but it works fine for me! I will buy it again.

I ordered this as a result of a colleague's recommendation.  Needless to say, I was pleased.  Yes, the noodles do smell a bit fishy - just rinse them in water.  I put them in my soup (chicken stock) for filler; and I use them in my spaghetti.  Hey, for the price and no calories, you can not go wrong!

column9: Worth the cost and satisfies the craving!!!
column10: I was skeptical because other reviewers stated that it was fishy and not what they expected, but if you have ever had rice noodles or Asian cuisine with stir fry noodles, these are very much like that. I didn't even use them in an Asian dish either. I made a homemade Alfredo sauce (butter, cream, Parmesan) for my husband who is on the Adkins diet and it turned out excellent. He was craving macaroni and cheese and these noodles with that Alfredo sauce did the trick. I, of course, tasted the results and was pleasantly surprised myself. What a great discovery!!!
I like the product.  The noodles are as advertised but too expensive.  You can get it much cheaper from the Miracle Noodle Co.

The reviews for this product are all over the map. I have tried 4 of the 6 bagsand am going to reorder soon. They are not pasta, but more like glass noodles asis used in sukiyaki. They take on the flavor of what you cook them in, such asbroth, and the consistency is very soft. I can see how they don't appeal to everyonebut I rather enjoy them, and they are very low carb. If you are on a low carb diet,these are a great substitute. If you cook with something like broth with soy sauceand add veggies, they are a great meal.

Now...the shipment was great.  I am not sure if I like the product or not.I am still trying to find a way to fix them where they will taste good.it will take a lot of seasoning.  Chili seasoning so far is the best Ivefound.  The noodles do have a slight Fish smell and taste that I cannotget past :(

This isn't "real" pasta. Don't expect it to be!!! You won't fool your family!! And, yes, they smell fishy when opened.Remember no calories, no carbs.....I rinsed for several minutes (longer than instructions say) and the smell fades out. I did have to wash my hands a couple of times (I have a very acute sense of smell).Package says to then blanch one minute. I put then into my saute pan with a little water and cooked the water off, added a little more water and cooked it off, etc. I have added different spice combos and I've been very happy with the results.I am on the HCG diet which is very restrictive. These are allowed.This will be a great alternative to pasta in the future as well.

Am so pleased with all the Miracle Noodles, so much so I have signed up with their 60-day auto shipment.  They are carb-free, calorie-free and just the perfect amount to fill you up on those 'lean' days that you need an extra filler for.  Just rinse for a couple of minutes, blanch in boiling water for a minute more, and then either dry with towels or just add to your meal.  They pick up the flavors of whatever spice you are using, and are great especially with the Braggs Liquid Amino marinade.  Can be on the spendy side but these days of obesity problems, this product is a great substitute and worth the money.

I LOVE these noodles. I heard about this miracle food while watching Dr. Oz and decided to give it a try because I was so amazed that there was a pasta with no carbs and low/no calories. I use a generous amount of seasoning because it is very bland without it. I even have put salsa on the noodles and loved it. I will definitely be ordering more but will try asianfoodgrocer.com for a cheaper alternative. We need more foods like this in theoworld! =]

come on people. Are u expecting it to be the same as eating regular pasta?? If you want the "real" thing, eat the real thing. And deal with the carbs and calories. ZERO guilt makes these an awsome choice...I can deal with the chewy texture and everything I am reading everyone complain about because THIS IS GUILT FREE. I used my pasta sauce on top of the noodles after I prepared them and it was fine! No complaints from me---filled me up, no calories or carbs, and I didnt feel deprived while my kids ate thier pasta. Great product!

column9: Excellent product but did not receive entire shipment
column10: I have been using Miracle Noodles as part of an HCG diet program.  They are useful for any low-carb, low calorie diet.  The second time I ordered them I ordered a pack of five and received only one, along with the other merchandise I ordered.  I called Amazon and they credited my credit card in a pro-rated amount for the missing four packages.

I haven't try the Miracle Noodles and assuming Shiritaki are the same but I love it.  Especially when I'm on the HCG diet, phase 2, I ate the noodle like a crazy mad woman.  I wish in the future they would create more other food with 0 calories, 0 fat, 0 carbs.  So far I like the stevia sugar and the Shiritaki noodles

column9: Not as bad as naysayers make them sound
column10: These are NOT replacement noodles, let me just say that first and foremost. Not that great as an Italian pasta substitute. However, if you like thai food and are used to the texture of rice noodles, for example, these won't be a disappointment. Just follow the instructions already listed here - rinse them THOROUGHLY (3-5 minutes) before you cook them. They really do absorb the flavor of whatever you cook, so if you're making a cold teriyaki sort of salad for example, leave them in the fridge overnight. I find they're better the 2nd day!

I can't understand why some people don't like these.  I can only think that they either didn't check the expiration date or they didn't carefully read the instructions.  I rinsed them in cold water, then in hot water and set them on a paper towel to dry.  Then, they tasted like what ever sauce I put on them.  You really can't ask for more in something that is zero calories.  I am so happy to have and eat these noodles!  They help me look forward to a meal.  I would recommend them to anyone who is on a special diet like me.

The concept of a filling pasta with virtually no calories was the most tempting thing about this product, but alas...But for someone raised in a Euro-American culture with pastas and noodles made from carbohydrates -- even if you like those pastas served al dente, which I do -- the texture of these noodles is really overwhelmingly hard to get accustomed to.It is as if the noodles were made of rubber band material or a kind of somewhat sinewy raw meat.  Really unpleasant.And I have found since trying the straight shirataki noodles that the ones which combine the shirataki with tofu are better?  But I still would rate them low on my list of food choices.If only they could find a way to improve the texture, then I might go for it, because the taste is not all that bad -- a little bland maybe, but the taste is not too bad.I just can't get past the texture of these noodles.There are no "miracles" when it comes to weigh loss.You just have to eat wisely and move a bit.

I started on the hcg diet recently and thought miracle noodles would be my favorite thing. I can eat pasta by itself and really like ramen noodles as well. These noodles have a fishy smell and are slimy. I bought 8 packs and had to throw 7 away. I tried them with grilled chicken but they arent very good at absorbing other flavors. I wouldnt recommend buying them.

I know why they have zero calories/carbs etc... Its because this is not food. It tastes like nothing and the texture is utterly revolting. If you are someone who is sensitive to textures of foods (mushrooms, for example) stay away. And if you aren't someone who is sensitive to textures of foods, you will be after you try these.

column9: Great concept... poor flavor, texture, etc.
column10: I bought this when I saw them on Good Morning America, thinking they would be a great sub. for pasta.  They are low calorie, low carb and looked as if they would be at least ok to try.  I was WRONG! When I got these I was excited to try them, but when I opened the first bag, I got the fishy smell others have described, so I rinsed them until it was gone.  I then, blanced them in boiling water (as directions stated) and when I took them out they were congelled together in knots.  Well I thought I would still give them a try, hey how bad could they be? I put pasta sauce on them, and onto my plate (still excited to try!)... but when I put them in my mouth.... it reminded me of a frozen pasta (like a Healthy Choice) but much worse!  I threw the whole plate of food away and the other bags of the so-called "Pasta"!I would all in all not recommend these!  Save your money, and just limit yourself on the real thing, trust me it's worth it!

I love these noodles.  They must be rinsed and dried thoroughly.  I add them to a small serving of pasta to "bulk" it up.  I also love these noodles with Walden fetticini pasta sauce over it and some parmesan cheese.

I don't normally rate things, but I feel I owe it to the public to write a review.  My husband has a gluten sensitivity.  I can eat just about anything.  I'm Asian. I've never heard of these noodles.  I saw them on Eversave and decided to try them.  Some of the reviews were good, so I decided to buy them.  Expensive as heck!  I don't mind the fishy smell.  The texture is a whole different story.  And I eat just about anything!  Balut and durian, for goodness sake!  But these are gelatinous and crunchy and aloe vera like texture.  I've only tried it with marinara sauce.  I will try to cook them other ways, but dang!  Good luck!

column9: At first a bit weary but they taste good!
column10: I bought these as an alternative for pasta or to help create simple and quick meals for one.  I still use pasta when I cook for the family but decided to try these as a low calorie option for me.  The smell was bad and if I hadn't read the packaging first, they would have been thrown out.  But, I followed the instructions and emptied the water from the package.  Then I put them in a strainer and rinsed them in COLD water, while swirling the noodles around so that each strand was thoroughly rinsed out.  (about 20 seconds)  It already smelled better! (It smelled like nothing)  I heated up some low fat chicken broth and water.  Then I added fresh veggies, spices (salt, pepper, garlic, and cayenne pepper).  I brought it to a boil and added the noodles.  I stirred a few times and then poached an egg in the broth.  This was a DELICIOUS meal!  A few important things to remember!- If you don't rinse properly then they will probably be gross.- They are VERY SIMILAR to rice noodles- tasteless.  If you don't season them it will taste like nothing!-also if you don't like rice noodles- YOU WILL NOT LIKE THESE! They have the same texture!So, in the end I really like these.  They are pricy but there are deals out there- so keep your eyes open!  Add any spices that you like and some veggies and maybe some protein and it is a low calorie, DELICIOUS alternative.  THIS DOES NOT REPLACE PASTA for me!  So, if you think this will taste the same as regular semolina pasta- you will be disappointed!

These are really gross.  They taste like rotten fish and have the strangest texture ever!  That being said, I wasn't put off Shirataki Noodles forever so I tried another brand.  The House Brands Tofu Shirataki Noodles are actually pretty good.  I guess the addition of tofu tempers the strange texture and it definitely gets rid of the smell if you follow the directions and rinse them well first.  The angel hair are better than the spaghetti.

At first after looking at some of the reviews on these noodles I was very worried that I would be disappointed, but after just having tasted this amazing product I am completely overjoyed! As an Italian girl who loves her pasta, giving it up to lose some weight on the hcg was very discouraging. After trying these today I am SO excited!To all those out there who are cautious and wondering if these things are really worth it, they are! It depends on how you prepare them. I rinsed them thoroughly and then dried them in a pan over medium heat. After preparing my vegetable in a bit of sauce I added the noodles and TADAA!!!! They tasted amazing- a lot like ramen noodles. I'm very happy with this product!!!

column9: Don't listen to the Whiny Babies!!
column10: I cant get over the big whiny babies who are complaining that they can stuff their faces with a meal that is delicious for under 100 calories that will keep you full for hours. They dont upset your stomach and you dont feel sluggish after eating them like you do with pasta...WHAT MORE CAN YOU POSSIBLY ASK FOR????????????????????? They are amazing and if you are counting calories, they make life so much easier. Follow the instructions and they don't taste or smell fishy. They can be used for all kinds of dishes, not just Asian inspired ones.
This is the most disappointing product I have ever ordered. The experience was like chewing a rubber band. They have no flavor and are not palatable.
This is garbage.  Fishy liquid, and the noodles are completely tasteless.  It ruined my chicken stir fry.  Will never use it again.
Miracle Noodle Shirataki Angel Hair Pasta, 7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)These noodles were like rubber bands, could not pulverize them with teeth.  Inedible.  What did I do wrong? Please tell me.

I thought that I would try the noodles to help me on my HCG Diet. Not only do they stink, they are hard to swallow. The texture is disgusting. It seemed as though no matter what I but on the noodles to try and make them better, nothing worked. And if you try to contact someone about the noodles, NO ONE GETS BACK WITH YOU. So by that, I feel the seller has horrible customer service.

A friend of mine suggested these noodles as a good alternative to pasta.  I have to say, very pleased.  I just added sauted veggies to it with a soy sauce with baked marinated chicken and the family loved it.  These are a winner and will be trying the other versions as well.  It's worth the extra money (being that pasta is cheap in the store) for cutting out the bad stuff!

These were really a great find. I've been eating low carb for 3 months now and was missing having a noodle dish. These are kind of off putting when you first open them because of the fishy smell, but i soaked them in cold water for a few minutes then boiled them for about 2 mins as the package says, dried them off and added to a stir fry of meat and veggies. It reminded me exactly of Ramen noodles!! My husband loved them, which is saying a lot because he is picky when it comes to 'replacements' for his normal comfort foods. I did not find them rubbery at all...maybe its how i prepared them? I will be ordering these again.
These noodles are good.  They smell a little fishy when youfirst open the package, but then you rinse and cook them for a coupleminutes and they smell fine after that.
Amazon's amazing miracle noodles - Japanese Shirataki noodles made for those who are trying to stick to all natural foods or who are on a diet.

Some people said these were fishy.  I took a chance after reading just remember to soak for 15 minutes.  Don't worry if you still notice a fishy smell, as this goes away after boiling.  That is what I did and they were great.
I really did not care for this product. I tried a lot of different ways to prepare them with no success. I will never buy them again.
Noodles smell like fish, difficult to season and have no substance( dose not mix well with veggies or meat).  A stand alone tasteless meal.
These noodles are guite to cook.They have no flaver, so you can add your favoret seasonings to them and make them taste like what ever you want.Great for those on a diet.
Once you rinse them and boil them, they really aren't bad. The initial "fish" smell is a little overwhelming, but put some sauce on these and they are great!

A few weeks ago  a friend handed me a packet to try , she did warn me about the texture  and the fishy smell ....so I gave it a go .I  made a spicy soup with Tomyum paste, added veggies , noodles 1tablespoon of coconut milk  and it was the best noodle soup. The texture , the smell , they disappeared .My husband thought it was the best soup he has had .

I just tried these for the first time in a low fat, low carb, healthy Shirataki Chow Mien dish. These are fantastic for Asian style dishes. The texture would not work at all for Western style noodle dishes like Spaghetti, I think, but I don't even feel the need to try because they are so good used in the cuisine they were meant for.As far as the fishy smell many people complain about, I didn't have any issues with this. I rinsed them off while I was preping the veggies, and they didn't have any smell AT ALL after that.I will definitely be buying more of these!

I certainly had my doubts about this product, but because I'm part of the low carb crowd and ready to lose a few more pounds, I ordered them.  What a delightful surprise!  The odor isn't that bad and rinsed out easily, although I did rinse well and then soak the noodles in clean cold water for a few minutes before then blanching them in hot water as the directions state.  I tried them with spaghetti sauce and true, they aren't like spaghetti but were very good.  I'm going to try them in a stirfry and a Philipino recipe for Pancit ...they remind me strongly of rice stick noodles or silver noodles. How can you go wrong with 0 calories!!!
I've tried these noodles in soup, and found that their texture is a little different than traditional pasta.  However, they are low-carb & low calorie which is what I was looking for.
These are a great substitute for pasta for low carbers. To expensive to eat as much as I would like.

I read about these noodles on line.  I usually don't believe when there is so much hype.  Thought this time I will give it a try.  Don't know why.  The order came in the mail and when it came I had forgotten i HAd ordered the noodles.  I had some sauce I had made the day before, so I rinsed them and dried them then poured the sauce over them.  Pleasently surprised, they were actually good.  The texture is not as a regular noodle, more like a rice noodle.  The taste was good and I plan on ordering more
Noodles received promptly and packed well.  Just as a side bar, I was surprised that the noodles have a 'fishy' smell but goes away after rinsing.
These do not taste like pasta, however, they pick up the flavor of whatever sauce or soup they are added to, and make a person feel less deprived, because they are filling.

This is my new favorite food to implement into my Weight Watchers routine! The noodles totally soak up whatever flavor you stir-fry them in - so I use potent, no calorie flavorings like garlic, ginger, miso, and hot sauce to create a base and then let them soak up the flavor while cooking. They TOTALLY fill you up - so you end up completely satisfied, taste wise and filling wise. Don't expect them to be an ordinary white wheat noodle - just be thankful that they are what they are and you can eat a whole bowl of them for 0 calories.

column9: The best savory seasoning mix ever!!!
column10: I've been having trouble finding this in my local grocery stores, so I ordered a case.  This stuff is great - toss with veggies or potatoes and a little olive oil and roast.  Delicious!  Sprinkle over fish with some breadcrumbs and dot with butter or olive oil and bake.  I have no idea if you can actually make soup with it, and don't care.  I use it just to season foods and it's excellent.

I LOVE this soup mix and use it often as a marinade for chicken. Easiest recipe: Spray a 13x9 inch pan with Pam. Slice peeled potatoes paper thin and line the bottom of your pan with two layers of your potatoes. Put boneless, skinless chicken over the potatoes. Take two soup packets and combine them in a bowl with 1/3 c. olive or vegetable oil and about 1/3 c. water; mix. Pour marinade over chicken and then bake entire thing for an hour. SO EASY AND SO DELICIOUS! Every time I make this, I get nothing but compliments; it's even my husband's favorite. Lipton nailed it with this one and I'd recommend it to anyone who loves garlic and zesty spices.This was also a pretty good deal since the packets can sometimes be difficult to find at the store and usually aren't on sale for less than $1.50. I'm very happy with my purchase!

I had been searching on and off for this product for a long-time,after it vanished from shelves.I had a much of recipes in a cookbook,that all called for this! Needless to say,I am glad to have it. I was looking,long before I became internet sauvy. Now I can make a few awesome side-dishes for thanksgiving! I feel like sharing a recipe with you all...here goes!Can't Get Enough chicken wINGS!Twelve chicken wingshalf cup butter or margarine.1 envelope lipton garlic savory herb mix1teaspoon cayenne pepper sauceCut tips off chicken wings.Cut chicken wings in half at joint.Deep fry, bake or broil until golden brown.In medium bowl, blend butter,savory herb with garlic soup mix and cayenne pepper sauce. Add hot cooked wingsToss until coated.Enjoy!

Roasted red potatoes has become a staple of our Sunday Brunch. The Lipton Savory Herb with Garlic Recipe Mix is an essential ingredient. Not only does it save time but the quality and consistency of flavor is actually better than creating the same result from scratch.
I've used this on many things. What a great flavor. It's best on Carne Asada. Get some thin skirt steaks and powder both sides with this. BBQ. Then get ready for a treat!! Jim

column9: Can't Believe It's No Longer In Stores!
column10: Though I've never actually made this as a soup, this product makes THE BEST oven roasted potatoes (originally found recipe on package). It was well worth buying 12 boxes just to know I'd always have it! Just combine one package of this soup, 4 medium potatoes (about 2 lbs) cut into chunks, and 1/3 cup olive or vegetable oil (I use olive oil). Put in a 13x9 baking dish in a pre-heated 450 oven uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. AWESOME!

WOW, this is the best boxed soup ever!There is a phenomenal recipe for a baked vegetable dish on the back, and it's just great.I have searched high & low for this at my local grocery stores and cannot ever find it, so I will have to resort to using the Internet.Veggies + this soup mix = Yummmy!

column9: Savory Harb & Garlic - Can't go wrong!
column10: This makes the most awesome chicken.  Cut of the chicken into bite sizes and cook in the soup mix with a small amount of water and oil (recipe is on the box). YUM!

column9: Lipton Savory Herb and Galic Recipe Secrets
column10: I love this product and cannot purchase it anywhere near here; I just wish that I could have bought it in smaller quantities than a whole case. At least I got it and am happy again that I can make the best chicken and vegetable oven bake. This recipe is no longer on the box, but found it online. The recipes on the box are also delicious.

Last week I rubbed the Savory Herb and Garlic Soup Mix on the whole chicken I was about to roast, popped it into an oven bag and followed the roasting directions. It was out of this world good. My family isn't terrible fond of potatoes, but mixing the soup mix, 1/3 cup of oil and the potatoes cut in about 1" pieces, they couldn't get enough of them this evening. DS likes the ones that get really brown, so everyone's happy.Except for the Onion Soup Recipe, we can't find any of the other flavors in our stores. But since I can get what I want from Amazon, I'm content.

column9: I love Lipton Savory Herb and Garlic Soup Mix
column10: I think this soup mix is awesome!  I have a Lipton Recipe Secrets cookbook and a lot of the recipes call for Savory Herb and Garlic soup mix.  I can't find it anywhere in our city so I order it on-line.  I'm already on my second case and plan to buy more when this runs out.  I make chicken and pork chops using this mix.  My family loves them.

I use this soup mix in several recipes that I have been making for years. A couple of years ago Lipton quit selling it in stores. You can order it directly from Lipton, but the price and service are not nearly as good as Amazon. This soup makes a great sauce, marinade, crock pot base, vegetable glaze and several other things. I truly use it a couple of times a month, and wouldn't know what to do for a replacement. If you love garlic (and who doesn't?) you should try this soup. It comes with recipes to start you out too.

I have used this soup mix almost 20 years.  It is my secret ingredient for my greens (Collards).  People who have eaten my greens say they have never had greens so good.  The "Secret" is out.  I also use it for a personal recipe, Cabbage Stew.  It goes well in gravies, over roasts, and even in BBQ sauce.  It is a very nice flavor for anything you want to add it to -- even spaghetti.  This is as common an item in my cabinets, as a box of salt.  If you have not tried it, you do not know what you are missing.When the only store in my city was discontiuning this item, I bought the last 13 boxes.  That was over 7 years ago.  I buy a case of this (10 boxes) every three months.  Now that the holiday season is upon us, I have bought 3 cases, yes 30 individual boxes.  The first time I bought this item, I made the recipe that was on the box -- savory herb and garlic potatoes.  I have been hooked ever since.

I absolutely LOVE this soup mix!! I have tried the mix on roasted red potatoes with olive oil, the oven baked chicken recipe on the box as well as the white pizza dip recipe & all three are Fabulous!! As other reviewers have said, I haven't been able to find it locally in a long time so I am really happy to see that I can still buy it in bulk on Amazon.com! Please don't ever stop carrying this item!
I thought this product was discontinued and when I found it about a year ago I was one happy cook.

I have used this product for years and then it was gone from the shelves of the stores I shop in. I forgot about it until my daughter asked why I never cooked the "special"  pork that I did when she was younger. So with the help of the computer I found it again and ordered 2 cases because my scattered family also loved whatever I cooked using it. It's good on pork, beef, chicken, and vegetables.

I use this product for a specific recipe i make for every party. Problem is that I can't find it in my local grocery store any more - Amazon pulled through and I now purchase it by the case from Amazon!!!

column9: searched high and low for this!
column10: it's wonderful done on chicken that is grilled. Just mix with mayo and a little water to make a paste and brush it on.

column9: Savory Herb with Garlic soup mix
column10: Lipton's Savory Herb with Garlic soup mix is the best for adding zest to your recipes. I use it for many recipes to give that extra touch of flavor. If you like Hot Artichoke Dip, then use this soup mix to make it better! You will love it.

column9: Lipton Herb and Garlic soup and dip
column10: I'm enjoying all the things and ways this product can cook.  I couldn't find it in the grocery stores around here, so I had to order it.  Thank you...  ~Janny Smith
This is my favorite flavor of Lipton's Recipe Secrets.  I use it in my Turkey Meat Loaf, dips, stews, and meatballs.  It's truly my "secret weapon" in the kitchen!
I was very pleased with the speed that the product was shipped, since it was a food item.

column9: Savory Herb and Garlic soup mix by Lipton
column10: Absolutely wonderful produce for oven roasting root vegetables.  If you have left-overs they mix well into any soup you are making, just add them to broth or stock and simmer.  For a creme soup, put small batches in your blender.

column9: Lipton Savory Herb with Garlic soup & dip mix
column10: Was very glad to be able to purchase this item through you people as i could NOT find it anywhere in the markets'.Thank you.

I love cooking with "Savory Herb with Garlic," but for some reason my grocery store quit carrying it and I've never been able to find it anywhere else. I was so glad to find it on Amazon. Now I don't have to go from store to store looking for it, it's delivered to my front door. I use this in a lot of dishes, but where it really shines is in our "roasted potato, carrot and onion" dish. It's also excellent with wild rice pilaf or any kind of rice. Thank you Amazon!

I Love it, but the store I shop at stop selling it, and I am not happy about it cause they are the only ones that carry it. But it is some good stuff. I just wish I could buy it when I need it. But it has good flavor and taste.
It is very hard finding this item in the stores. I use it on meats,dips and even gravy. It has a great blend of garlic and herbs. I even gave my daughter some of the boxes, now she is hooked

column9: My family loves the recipe I make with this!!!
column10: Follow the directions for the garlic chicken.  My family loves it.  Great product.  I can't find it in store so it is well worth it to get the case.
I don't know why our local grocery stores stopped carrying this particular Lipton variety. My family loves it in meatloaf.

I was thrilled to find Lipton Savory Herb soup mix on Amazon.  I've been searching the local grocery stores but have been unable to find it.  This soup mix makes the most AWESOME ROASTED POTATOES!!  My friends and family always ask for them, so I was worried that my secret ingredient was no longer available.  Well, now I have a case of this GREAT stuff and look forward to lots of good TATERS !!!

It is delicious. I live in HI and it's really hard to find there. My friend made a vegetable dip / salad dressing with it. i think i ate it all!!! Some red wine vinegar and olive oil and a pack of this... make it as thick (for veggies to dip)or as dressing-y as you want. Ok, and for us, we actually add fresh garlic to it, but that's only if you really love garlic!!!
This is great to use for recipes. We have a cookbook using soup ingredients that uses this one a lot. This is hard to find in some stores.Would buy again.
Thanks for being so prompt. This is a good base for my chicken vegetable soup.

I am so glad to have found that amazon is carrying this product.  I make a chicken cordon bleu recipe using the savory herb & garlic mix.  My local grocery store quit carrying it and my family has been craving this dish for over a year.  I am glad to have found it.  My only negative is that you have to purchase by the case.  I would have liked to have purchased it individually.  Oh well, I have a plentiful supply now!

column9: Lipton Savory Herb and Garlic Soup Mix
column10: Timely delivery on a product I can't buy locally.  It's very convenient that I can buy certain food stuffs from Amazon.com.
I used this product instead in the Onion Roasted Potatoes recipe on the Onion Soup box.  Used medium sized red potatoes cubed. Fabulous!!!  I love the flavor and will try it on chicken next.

We absolutely love this mix. We use the recipe on the back for the Cheesy Garlic Chicken and it's sooo good. It makes this awesome "gravy" type sauce with the chicken and we pair it with Cheesy Au gratin Potatoes and Asparagus for a great meal. My fiance asks for it at least once a week. Unfortunately our grocery story doesn't carry it any more for whatever reason, so thank god for Amazon!

I stumbled upon this years ago, but can no longer find it locally.I make a lot of soup. Sometimes I don't want to get creative with my own herbs and spices. This stuff fits the bill when I'm lazy & all love what results.I also have used this stuff on breadsticks, on top of bread, in low-fat sour cream to make dips, and in mayonnaise. Each time, it's been a hit.It works nicely on oven baked potato skins too! I'm not saying we use it exclusively -- but as I mentioned prior, sometimes the ol' creative juices in my brain want a break. It's nice to have this on the shelf for those times.

Lipton must have changed the recipe for this; it tastes the same but kept me up all night the last time I cooked with it.  I have always loved using it in a recipe for chicken, but no longer; I will be giving it away.

Davidson's has done an outstanding job of combining the teas and spices in this Tulsi tea. It is delicious with or without a sweetener. (I often add a touch of Stevia which makes the spicy, sweet flavor of the tea pop.) And the smell of this product is so good, it could be kept in a pot on the stove to scent the house. In addition, the product comes in a 100-bag size so there isn't the waste and cost involved in the pretty, individually wrapped bags you see in the smaller-sized boxes. This has easily become my favorite tea. In fact, I'm going to order another box right now!
This is a tea that tastes wonderful.  It has many positive attributes, also.  It comes in this large box, 100 count bags.  I received good and speedy service from this seller.

I have purchased The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg brand peanuts with several different labels.  They are consistently perfect, with a taste and texture as close as you can get to the old fashioned "just cooked, hot out of the oil" peanuts of my youth.This brand is the only one I've found that uses peanut oil rather than the genetically modified cotton seed oil that is used for most other brands.  I think there are a couple other brands "out there" that do not use toxic oils, but I'll stick with this one!!!I like things more salty than a lot of people so I usually sprinkle a little extra sea salt on the nuts when eat them but I think they are just right out of the can for most people.If you really want to splurge and have a good food processor -- these nuts make the best peanut butter anywhere!

I sent these Virginia peanuts to a friend ... I kept getting really short e-mails from her that said things like, "Crunch crunch crunch  ....OMG" "Got home, ate more of those delicious peanuts" "I hid one of the cans of the peanuts for later".She did finally speak in a full sentence and said that they were the tastiest freshest peanuts she ever had.
This seller consistently provides high quality edibles for very reasonable prices, and this Fleur de Sel is no exception.  Extremely tasty, well packaged, and timely delivery.
If you've ever tried this natural salt from France you know it's the best every-day salt around.  I buy regularly and enjoy the best flavor when salt is needed for meals.
The salt is find, but the package is bad. Unable to open neatly and then it rips open and your salt is all over the floor.

column9: Treats are Wonderful, but Shipping Costs are Outrageous.
column10: Our two Miniature Schnauzers love these treats.  They are small, flavorful, and not too hard, like some chew treats are.  I wish I could find a retailer in the Washington, DC, area (in Virginia, that is) who sells these at a decent price and doesn't charge an arm and a leg for shipping, like the Amazon shipper does - Companion Caterers charges more than 50% of the cost of the item for shipping, and they have the lowest price.  I will not buy these treats with that kind of cost:  it is outrageous and unacceptable.  I'll go to a competitor of "Etta Says!" and "Companion Caterers" before I'll pay that ridiculous price.  Our Minis aren't that crazy about the treats.

column9: Tastes very much like fresh homemade pasta
column10: Now of course no dry pasta is going to taste exactly like fresh, but I've got to say, this is as close as I've come. Pay no attention to the title description. This is not spaghetti but a very large (nearly lasagna size) and thick strip of egg noodle. The packages are 10-ounces. The flavor is deep and natural. A-lot of dry pastas these days have very little flavor, this stuff has tons. The texture is also great. These noodles are very "toothsome" they are chewy (in that great homemade sense of the word). One thing to watch out for is the packaging. As soon as you open the box, check the bags of pasta for holes. The stripes of pasta are so thick that their corners can punch through the plastic. I found a couple of bags that had been breached. I used one right away and popped some tape over the other one.

I purchased the Almond Roca online, because if you go to the malls, the prices are up the roof.  When I saw the price of the 42oz can online, I thought it was unbelivable.  I was a little worried at first, thinking that it would not be the same type of candy, or the same great taste.  I was wrong!  The item was very well packaged.  I am completely satisfied with my order and I am already thinking of doing a couple orders more soon.  Thank-You.

column9: Filipinos (people from the Philippines) and Chinese love these and so do I!
column10: You will always find these in Chinatown because Chinese people and Filipino people love these, and why not?  So buttery is the toffee!  The little nutty covering feels funny on your tongue and I think they just put it there to keep the toffee from being sticky as it does not contribute much to the overall flavor.  These are not the deformed ones that they sell cheap--each one is beautiful and perfectly-formed.  Buy a can for yourself and any Chinese or Filipino friends you have, and even for your girlfriend for Valentine's--the pink tin practically SHOUTS "Happy Valentines Day, I love you like a little toffee candy!!!!!"

Wow, I never thought that I'd actually be writing a review on confectionaries, but as soon as I did a successful search for Brown & Haley in the Amazon Gourmet Food shop, I just couldn't wait. The fact is, Brown & Haley, the makers of Almond Roca, beloved by millions of fellow sweet-toothers, is based right here in my hometown of Tacoma, Washington. That's right, the place of the infamous "Tacoma aroma" is also the home of the very sweet aroma of Almond Roca, and has been for over one hundred years!Almond Roca is a bite-size combination of milk chocolate with crushed almond pieces surrounding a core of rich butterscotch almond brittle, so it's kind of soft-but-crunchy & chocolatey on the outside, and hard & crunchy & almond-sweet on the inside. My mouth is watering just describing it! I've got to get some right now....luckily, I can drive just three miles down Pacific Avenue to get it wholesale right from the source!My hometown should be proud of the rich tradition of Brown & Haley; if you're located nowhere near Tacoma and you've *never* tasted Almond Roca before, then what are you waiting for? Order the 7-ounce tin today, and give yourself---or the one you love---a treat that you or they will never forget!MOST RECOMMENDED

column9: Excellent treat at an excellent price
column10: These candies are wonderful. They are really rich and melt in your mouth, with a crunchy almond and toffee center. The danger is that they're really easy to eat. I often have 5 or 6 of these at a time before I've realized how many calories that is.They're very popular in the Chinese-American community as gifts, especially around Lunar New Year. They're made in Tacoma, Washington and if you're traveling abroad, they make excellent souvenirs if you want to give something made in the USA (very few things are these days). Almond Rocas are exported all over the world and I found them in Japan at the gourmet import store (but very pricey). They're also popular in Hong Kong. I've never seen anyone who does not like these!I paid $30 for 2 boxes (each 21 ounces) at my local grocery store. This tin is $22 for the same amount of candy, and sold directly by Brown & Haley, the manufacturers. That's a fantastic deal! I wish I had bought mine here.Nutrition information from the side of the box: 3 pieces is 200 calories, 130 of which is from fat (15g). Cholesterol: 15mg, Sodium: 115mg.

I love Almond Roca. Unfortunately, the price at Amazon is over twice what it is at Costco, $10.79. I buy a lot from Amazon, as long as the prices are reasonable. Do your homework, Amazon's price for this item is outrageous.

A super good friend of mine just loves Almond Roca (and so do I) so instead of buying her three or four small cans to fill a stocking I purchased this huge 42 oz hard to find canister and the price was excellent.  I liked the size of the canister so much that I wrapped it up instead of putting the candies in a stocking.  She was thrilled and so was I.  Highly recommend for the Almond Roca fans in your life PLUS this is an excellent price and will purchase this item again and again.

I'm working through my second big tub of Almond Roca, trying to make it last, but losing that battle. The flavor of this candy is lovely, buttery, not too sweet, but the best thing about it is its texture. I expected a rock-hard candy (especially given its name), but unlike other toffee, this one doesn't threaten your molars or get stuck in them for the rest of the day. It's crunchy in the best sense. A real treat!

This tub contains almond toffee coated in chocolate. Very addictive. I can confirm that $20 bucks for a 42 ounce tin is about what you'd pay in stores. I do enjoy it, but I'm docking one star on account of the quality seems just little bit below what you'd expect for the price. Overall though, it's a great buy.

How can anyone not like these?For some reason, people like to give chocolate as gifts. I don't know why because taste is a very personal thing and you never know what people like. We usually re-gift Russell's or See's but I like really Almond Rocas. First of all they're all individually wrapped so it's not like you feel you have to finish a can quickly when you open it. Then, there's the taste, there's a layer of nuts on the outside, then chocolate, then crunchy caramel on the inside. I suppose you can melt this in your mouth but I always crunch it. It's not overly sweet which is a major plus and they say nuts and chocolate are good for your health so that's two major positives.This is a 42oz can so it's mainly for aficionados, but the great thing is, if you've never tried this before you can go to your local drug store and chances are they'll sell a small pack of these for you to try. It's great, because they only used to sell this in one size, but now they sell it in small packets to large tins like this. And tins like this are great as gifts, especially for dentists!Lastly, the tins are great and you can keep them in your pantry for putting things in. All in all, a great product in great packaging.

When enjoy a piece or three of Almond Roca it is easy to see why they haven't changed the recipe since they started cranking them out some 90 years ago. It is a delightful mix of buttery toffee and chocolate with just the right amount of almonds sprinkled on the outside.  It all melts in your mouth with just a perfect amount of crunch to make it all work.A funny little bit of history is that Almond Roca was the first candy in the world to be sold in a sealed tin (way back in 1927). You can also get Cashew Roca and Mocha Roca if you want to try some other flavors but I prefer the classic Almond.I give the 42oz size an A+ for value. I am a huge lover of See's Candies but a 16oz can of the product they make to compete is $16 so a comparable amount would be $42 from See's.

Almond Roca is for you if you love English Toffee.  Made even better with a nutty crust, it is almost impossible to eat just one buttery, crunchy piece.  If you enjoyed these in your childhood, but just haven't treated yourself lately, they are better than you remember.  Get yourself some and do a happy dance when you enjoy one.  Worth every penny.

a coworker brought in the 42oz canister and over the next week, we enjoyed them.  i had eaten these before, but didn't realize they came in a giant tin like this.  i was even more surprised when i looked up the price on amazon!  a box of sees candy is about 14 bucks and you get some good, quality chocolate, but a box of sees candy does not compare to a seemingly endless can of almond roca candies for about $22 bucks!!ok, i love candy.  i did buy a canister and took it home and ate it and did not share a single piece.  even when i had company over, i hid that canister, because i know if anyone has one piece of this almond roca, they will want another, and another, and another until they are gone.  these candies are excellent in almost every way and i need to place another order!  :)
Fresh and yummy.  My son-in-law loves Almond Roca and I'll it buy again and again for other family and friends as well!!

No one makes a product like this. It is a one of a kind candy.  It is awesome and has been for as many years as I can remember. I don't even regularly eat candy, but I love it. But, my 89 year old mother has loved this for all of my lifetime and I am 63.  She get's this every year from me for Christmas.

I ordered the 42oz. canisters for a party.  We needed a certain amount so when they said 100 pieces per canister, I ordered just the right amount...however, the first canister was short by three...the second short by two, the third short by five...a total of 10 short.  Why??? Not pleased.  Yes the candies are good but if you say 100 pieces, makes sure you put 100 pieces in the canister.  A ripoff...
the price is madly wrong. Wal-mart 10 OZ is under 4 dollars and on Brown's site 42 OZ is about 20 dollers

column9: Attention All Peanut Putter Lovers - Great Flavor!
column10: I couldn't wait to get this flavoring to enhance my morning protein shake! Peanut butter can be an 'iffy' flavor when it's artificial, but who needs the extra calories from the real thing? I wasn't disappointed in the least in this great tasting product! I even have been using it in my coffee and on my cottage cheese. There is no chalky aftertaste, just a smooth peanut butter flavor. Give it a try if you are a peanut butter lover, you won't be disappointed!

column9: Didn't taste like peanut butter to me.
column10: The product didn't taste bad but to me it was more of a caramel / butterscotch flavor, not peanut butter.  I wanted to try this to replace real peanut butter in chocolate protein shakes.  I made a small test shake and added a small amount of the flavoring.  I could taste it for sure, but it wasn't a peanut butter taste.  When smelling the liquid it doesn't smell like peanuts either or taste like it (at least to me) when putting a small dab on my finger and trying it. If I was looking for a caramel / butterscotch flavor then this would have been okay.

I am a chocoholic, but I am also a triathlete and have to be careful with my cholesterol, so I have to limit my chocolate consumption. In the past, trying to find alternative that satisfied me, I came across the Skinny Cow ice creams, especially the chocolate fudge cones, which I love. A few weeks ago, I was at the grocery store and these candies caught my eye and I decided to try them.The reason I bought them was that each pouch (which has 5 or 6 candies) was only 120 calories and the fat content was pretty low (6g of fat per pouch). When I tried them, I was in heaven, since they deliver the experience that I had come to expect based on previous purchases of this company's products. The chocolate flavor is full and rich, without making it overbearing, and the caramel softens the texture and add to the balance of the candy. The only drawback I can see is that every time I get a serving of these I fell like I could eat a couple of more servings! :)Highly recommended, try it, since you won't feel like you are eating "low fat" chocolate, it is just a great product even when compared to traditional chocolate candy.
Love it!  Id recommend in a heart beat. And only 110 calories?  Perfect!  Its yummy and just enough to break that sweet tooth craving!

column9: AMAZING!  doesn't taste SKINNY at all
column10: These are heavenly!  They are my 'treat' everyday.  For 120 each packet, I'm in CHOCOLATE HEAVEN!  They are a bit salty, sweet, crunchy, and chocolatey all wrapped in one delicious treat!

This is a very misleading product.  Grocery items in general on Amazon are jumbo sized versions of what you find in the stores, i.e., you get multiple packages of the product.  However, this is seriously the same box of food you find in the grocery store...6 individual packets in a single box... but costs three times as much.  Very very frustrated with this purchase.
