I know this isn't supposed to be like ice cream, but how can people honestly find this to be good? its so so bad. i could barely finish a spoonful of this stuff. its like a frozen fat free instant chocolate pudding with little taste. there is so peanut butter taste. the texture is terrible. as it melts, once u stir it, its like a stringy, sticky, watery texture. so gross

column9: Great Taste, Light - Reminds me of the old Ice Milk
column10: I love this product! Can't believe it's only 150 calories per PINT.  Carbs are pretty low, but not as low as I'd like; why not use artificial sweetener and get the carbs down too; then it would be perfect.  It is light, kind of like the old ice milk, so not creamy like ice cream, but has great flavor - at least the flavors I've tried: Mint Chocolate Cookie, Strawberry, and Chocolate Peanut Butter.  Only drawback: weird texture when melted.  Eat it ice cold!! Highly recommend.

I had high hopes for this product.  It was reviewed on the local morning news and I got the impression that it was a good, low-calorie substitute for ice cream.  In my opinion, it is not a good substitute at all.  It doesn't taste like peanut butter at all and barely tastes like chocolate.  My daughter tasted it and thought it tasted gross.  I wouldn't go that far but I will never buy it again - especially since it costs so much more than ice cream.  I'll probably take the suggestions of other reviewers and use it as a base for a shake. I have only tried the chocolate peanut butter flavor so I can't vouch for the other flavors.

When I bought this I figured that it would taste something like a frozen protein shake, which it did, so I was not disappointed. However even though this does not taste awful I would not buy it again even if I could not have any other frozen "treat", as it is easy to make a protein shake with chocolate and peanut butter that is healthier and taste better than this. And although they are not low calorie, there are other gluten free, lactose free, sugar free/low sugar options to choose from that taste a lot better than Arctic Zero.

column9: Misleading marketing of a modestly above-mediocre product
column10: Why can't they promote this product honestly?It's not a *bad* product. I didn't find it actually objectionable. It's mildly sweet, and has a sort of nondescript, chocolate-simulating flavor. On its own merits, If I were in a really great mood I might even give it four stars in spite of its relative synthetic blandness and the lack of peanut butter or any resemblance to its flavor. They've actually accomplished something fairly worthwhile in creating a frozen dessert with so few calories, and I'd give it some appreciation on that basis.But ... "ice cream replacement"?  "Smooth and creamy"?  It is neither of these, by any estimation. It's an "ice cream replacement" only in the sense that yogurt or pudding or a ham sandwich are -- as things one might eat instead of ice cream. It's objectively not "smooth", and anyone expecting it to be (for example, because they read the label) is going to be highly upset to find that it is instead gritty and grainy, so much so that it actually makes sound when you pass a spoon through it, similar to scooping packed wet sand. It has a mouthfeel more like a poorly-made sherbet; the ice crystals are large enough that you can almost see them. This doesn't mean it can't be "good" -- snow cones are super gritty with huge ice crystals and they're still well-liked.Overall, it was okay. I definitely like that I can eat small amounts of this stuff even on a keto diet. I think they've got a good product idea, and it deserves a slot on the shelf next to the other frozen desserts.But, a note to the Arctic Zero folks -- celebrate your product and promote it for what it IS. Why spoil your efforts by lying about what you've made?

I like this flavor, because it has a nice chocolate flavor, as all of the chocolate Arctic Zero's do. The peanut flavor is light, so if you want a strong pb flavor, you may not be completely happy with the flavor. It tastes really good with whipped topping and a sprinkle of PB2... then it tastes sinful.

If you are on a diet or are just looking to cut calories, this is a great option. I recommend letting it soften in the fridge for 10 mins or so, otherwise it is like eating a rock! Fairly good taste and lots of protein!

column9: The coffee flavor is sooo good
column10: First, don't compare this to ice cream. If you get sugar free frozen yogurt-- this is what its like. I've tried many flavors and coffee is the best one to me. It has a rich flavor. I love that the whole pint is 150 calories. I like to have 1/4 at a time so its under 35 calories worth. I drizzle with a little agave syrup and sprinkle with a few almonds and its a great dessert. On its own its good too.  Its the best pint to have in the house because if i do go over board and eat the whole thing I don't feel guilty.

I got a pint of Arctic Zero Peanut Butter Chocolate last night and I nibbled on it for the better part of an hour. It's not SUPER flavorful, but considering that the entire carton has only 150 calories, I don't care. I barely finished a quarter of the carton--totaling not even 40 calories! My only real complaint is that it is rather expensive, but even then, I feel it will last me so long that it'll be worth it. I can't wait to try other flavors.

This product is truly delcious for people who are following a clean/healthy lifestyle.  It is no Ben & Jerry's peanut butter cup, but its not meant to be.  Its light and fluffy and has a truly chocolately taste with a hint of PB.  I'm so satisfied with customer service and the shipment stayed frozen for a while...seeing as I wasn't home when it was delivered.  But it was fine.  In fact i had to let it defrost a little so i could taste it!  I am extremely pleased with this product and look forward to trying the other flavors!

When purchasing Ice Cream I would choose vanilla over chocolate. So, I first tried the Maple Vanilla. The texture was icy, and it was okay but you can taste the Whey protein alot. Even though I don't like coffee, I do like coffee ice cream, Artic Zero's Coffee flavor was creamier than the Maple Vanilla and was just okay, but the Whey Protein taste is still there. The Chocolate is creamy and by far my favorite, no Whey protein taste at all, really the closest to ice cream. My second favorite would be the Mint Chocolate cookies, again creamy and no whey protein taste, big surprise since I hate mint chocolate chip ice cream. Chocolate Peanut Butter is good as well,and doesn't have the whey protein taste.I have never had Pumkin ice cream but it also tasted pretty good without the why protein taste. The Strawberry is horrible, icy with a very strong whey protein taste. Being on a reduce calorie diet and getting ice cream that is also high in protein and fiber is a BIG winner for me.

I gave this product a very fair shot, but after opening up the carton and taking my first bite I instantly regretted ever purchasing it. For the record, I'm a fan of most sweet things, and I'm also really into nutrition and healthy options. I've eaten some weird things in my day in the name of good nutrition, and completely enjoyed them, but this is one of the worst experiences I've had with diet food, hands down. The flavor was awful, I would venture to say disgusting. So much so that this stayed in my freezer for over four months. Every week or so I'd give it another shot and take a few bites, remember how disgusting it is, and be done. I guess on the bright side, I was always so grossed out that my cravings and desires for food would just disappear completely out the window. I finally ended up throwing the rest of it into a protein shake, which was still gross.

This stuff is amazing: great texture, light flavor, and very refreshing. Is it ice cream? No. But it's a good substitute during the week when you really want some ice cream! I have no idea how anyone could ever eat the entire pint -- I couldn't eat an entire pint of Ben and Jerry's! But I had regular ice cream (Chunk Monkey by the aforementioned B and J) and this stuff. I was very pleased. The flavor is light -- gentle chocolate, without tasting sickening. The peanut butter flavor is very, very gentle. They could bring that out a little more, in my opinion. But yummy, ice cream/sorbet texture, and very filling. I loved it, and loved the fact I can have it guilt-free. Can't wait to try some other flavors!

The chocolate peanut butter is INSANELY good!  Considering the nutritional facts I wasn't expecting to much and just wanted a low cal treat but this stuff is awesome!!!!  I am not one of those people that expects things to taste the same as regular:)  But it is honestly great!!!  Plus each serving has 4 grams of protein!  You absolutely can't go wrong!!

I just received my order today and I love it! The packaging was done very well. It was almost 100 degrees with the humidity and I didn't get home until 8pm and most of the cartons were still frozen. I don't love the packing peanuts though. The ice cream itself is surprisingly rich and creamy. The flavor was nice...not too strong or sweet. It was so rich I didn't think there would be any way I could eat the whole thing. Well...I did! You definitely don't need to though because it does leave you satisfied. I would completely stock my freezer full if it weren't so expensive. It's hard to justify spending so much on ice cream. Definitely worth it for the occasional treat though. Please sell in NYC shops!!

I really liked this product, it tasted much better than I thought it was going to and it was great eating an entire pint for only 128 calories.  It also satisfied my craving for ice cream, as it is very filling. I was concerned about the delivery of the product, but it arrived quickly and was in great condition, especially since it was sitting outside in 100 degree weather. I know that I will continue to buy this product, the only drawback is that it is rather pricey for only 6 pints.

I absolutely love this product.  I was a bit concerned with living across the country from where a frozen product was being shipped, but the customer service of the company is extraordinatry and the items were packed perfectly.  I got my product in 2 days & there was still quite a bit of dry ice so the ice cream was perfect.  More importantly than that, it is incredibly delicious!

This ice cream is awesome! I was very skeptical since the container contains no fat, 128 calories for the whole pint, and has little to no sodium. OMG! This is wonderful. I wish that it was carried at a store nearby, but it isn't. I can only find it on Amazon. I am in heaven!

column9: Greatest invention since the printing press
column10: No need to exercise discipline to avoid eating the entire pint of haagen dazs, ben and jerry's or whatever! Go ahead and eat the whole thing of this great stuff, and do it sitting up in bed and dip in a granola bar. pure heaven!!!I do this after returning from the gym. yes!! and feel no guilt and suffer no extra pounds in the am.

Although this ice cream may seem a little pricey, it's DEFINATLY worth the splurge! The peanut butter chocolate is to die for and you'd never know it was low calorie! I just got my order last week and i'm already making room in my freezer to buy more. haha. I can't wait till they get Arctic Zero ice cream in grocery stores on the east coast!

OK. First off, the price for this stuff online is incredibly expensive. The price for each pint on Amazon is $6.00! I bought this at my Publix, and it was about $4.00 per pint. So, when I got home, the "ice cream" was a little melty, which is what most people said tasted best. They're right! If you don't set the arctic zero on the counter for ten minutes before you eat, it's going have the texture of Italian ice. The texture of the "soft" arctic zero was like sherbet. Pretty good for 35 calories a 1/2 cup! I can taste the chocolate and peanut butter flavor. It is kind of muted though. It tastes just like a chocolate fudgesicle! I want to try vanilla maple next! ( :

I eat Arctic Zero pretty often and crave this stuff when I want some creamy chocolatey goodness!! (Doesn't help that I live half a block from Whole Foods and pass a Sprouts store on the way to work every day :)) My favorite flavors are Chocolate Peanut Butter and Coffee!! (I don't eat the coffee at night though-caffeine) I've noticed, however, that each pint of Chocolate PB has varying amounts of the subtle peanut butter. I actually add a teaspoon of natural organic peanut butter when I have some AZ, because its a healthy monounsaturated fat and in low portions, keeps me slim!!  Love the contrast of textures! If you don't want to add PB to the Chocolate PB flavor, try softening at room temp rather than in the microwave, as it does slightly change the flavor and denatures the whey protein.I make a mini meal out if sometimes by stirring in some organic plain, nonfat greek yogurt like Stonyfield, to add protein and creaminess to it! Yumminess!!However, I most often eat a serving in a little ice cream dish with a sprinkle of ginger, nutmeg or some chia seeds or berries.I was just amazed at how many people find the taste lacking and amused that one person accused others of working for the company because their opinions differed from hers. I believe I know why such a wide range of opinions here:Depends upon the condition of your palate and sensitivity of your taste buds.Some people are supertasters, other not. However there are environmental factors. The more sweet and processed foods you eat, the more dull your taste buds become, craving more sweet and processed flavors, because you've conditioned your taste buds accordingly.Usually, the cleaner your diet, the more sensitive your taste buds will become. I see this often with my patients who give up soda (especially diet soda), and they report having less sugar cravings from just that switch.Also, as people age, their taste buds also grow duller/weaker. This is why seniors often love very rich/sweet foods, because their taste buds can pick up some of the taste, whereas blander foods are harder for them to taste.Love Arctic Zero. Wish they'd make a mocha flavor!
If you want a low calorie food that tastes good, have a glass of water rather than this gross stuff! It is cheaper and far more satisfying. What a waste of money!

Ok so I don't usually review products, but this ice cream is that good.  Seriously, it blows my mind.  This stuff tastes exactly the same as regular ice cream, and while a bit pricey, it's totally worth it!!!

column9: Couldn't be happier with Arctic Zero!
column10: I just got my delivery yesterday (6 pints Choc. Peanut Butter, 6 pints Vanilla Maple) and I've already polished off a pint of this Chocolate PB- it's THAT GOOD. I read about Arctic Zero on Hungry Girl and was anxious to give it a try, seeing as the calorie count is ridiculously low. This is the perfect ice cream substitute, hands down. I didn't know what to expect as far as texture, but I was pleasantly surprised to find it nice and creamy- like a cross between frozen yogurt and ice cream. This Chocolate Peanut Butter flavor is insane, so much tastier (and better for you) than all the artificially flavored "diet" treats I've tried. The Vanilla Maple is great too and I can't wait to try making some smoothies and shakes with both flavors. Bottom line, I don't think it's an overstatement to say this stuff is life-changing. Try it and you won't be dissapointed- and spread the word! We need Arctic Zero to get bigger and bigger so it becomes more available nationwide- I'd love to see this in my grocery store.

column9: Cute but too many m&ms at once
column10: Very cute. Mine is a little tilted, he leans to one side--the legs weren't assembled straight, but it's still functional. The only thing I don't like is that the dispenser gives about 15 m&ms at once and you have to make sure to catch them when you use the lever in the back--they just fly out because it's such a large opening. The good thing is that I should be able to refill with peanut m&ms (they came with regular).

Very disappointed with this item.  It arrived very quickly but it is small and tips over easily when you lift the dispensing handle.  The mouth opens to dispense the candy but then doesn't close as the M&M's are all stuck in the mouth. Will be returning this item.

Every year there is a limited edition M&M holiday dispenser that is cuter than the last.  This year the Nutcracker is just adorable.  A super cute addition to my Christmas decorations . . . I just love him!
haven't got the chance to look at this product, still in the box. however, price was good and the deliver was great.

column9: Should be advertised as a scrumptious sedative!
column10: Abuelita is a Mexican chocolate drink. It comes in tablets or packet form, but I prefer the tablets. The directions call for you to use one entire tablet, but I would think that would be too much. I use about 1/3 of a tablet and 2 1/2 cups of milk. You heat the milk until it is warm enough, but do not boil. When blended, it creates a nice froth. I like to have Abuelita before bed. It must be something about the warm milk and subtle chocolate and cinnamon flavor, but regardless of how wired I am, Abuelita puts me right to sleep.It has a complex, but lovely flavor. The bottom of the mug can be a bit gritty if not fully blended, but even that is not unpleasant. Try Abuelita and you will be able to swear off any sleeping pills!

I ordered 2 cases of this chocolate, because you can't find it in stores anywhere anymore.  And it was cheaper to buy by the case.  My kids and I love this drink, it's perfect!  It is fattening so, we only splurge on this once a week and we don't add any extra sugar, even though it suggests you do.  It's sweet enough without.

I recently bought the Abuelita tablets just to try them. I am a big chocolate fan and love to try anything that includes chocolate. I was very surprised at how wonderful it tasted. Now I cant stop drinking it. It is great as a treat throughout the day or before bed. I would highly recommend this drink and suggest that anyone try it.

MMMMMMMM.....If you love hot chocolate you have to try Abuelita.  It's much different than the traditional "American" average tasting powders.  It's Mexican and it has such a bold, deep, and rich aroma.  You will be hooked!  I tried it in Mexico and haven't used anything else since then.  I bought a case and shared it with my friends.  Now, they want to know where to get it!

Each tab will make a quart. Each box will make 1-1/2 gallons, or 24 cups of yummy Mexican Chocolate. This is the best miss out there.If you make a large batch use the stove and tabs. If you make small batches go ahead and grind up the tabs in a blend or food processor and just mix them with the warmed milk.

column9: Why able to ship the Mini but not the regular size
column10: I was happy that you were able to ship to my oversea APO address the MINI size Ritter Sport candies, however when I try to have the regular size shipped to my address I receive a message that it can not be shipped to a APO address. WHY?

I order some trophy pistachios, which had way to much salt on them. I would have loved them but they put to much salt on them, so i will not order them ever again. I loved my pistachios without all the salt on them.

I have only recently found myself to be gluten intolerant, and in the process of trying to find products which meet those parameters, I have found them to be horrible, disgusting, moderately okay and then low and behold you find a product and a brand that is exceptional.  This is one of those products and brands.  You can't find a granola any better than this one.  My granddaughter loves it too.

Last year we got a new dog.  He was not crazy about the food we were feeding him so I started looking at researching different dog foods.  Innova is one of he top brands so I tried a bag and he loves it.  With the old food he would pick at it and eat slowly but with this he gobbles it right up.  He likes it more and it has much better ingredients.  The main ingredients in Innova are real meat.  His old food was nothing but byproducts.  It is a little pricey, but if you love your dog it is more than worth it.

Alright I am finally sitting down and doing this review. It's only been about a week since I received my Red Leaf Tea order, but I've had this tea three separate occasions since then. Every time I went to sit down and write a review - I was already finished my cup and I didn't quite know what to say.I think I understand what took me so long. This is a seriously mysterious matcha. When I opened the package and took a whiff, I associated the sweet vanilla smell with something else, but I couldn't quite put my finger on it. I whisked up a cup between 175-185 degrees - the matcha itself was bright, vegetal, creeeamy and full of vanilla deliciousness. Definite vanilla bean or real vanilla extract - a flavour that isn't sweet but is associated with baking. When I bake with my 3 tablespoons+ of real vanilla - it always smells sooo delicious and sweet, but if you were to taste it itself - it doesn't taste how it smells. That's the opposite of this matcha - it really does taste how it smells - I think that's where the mystery came from.Finally I associated the smell with the matcha whipped shortbread I made a while back. Of course! It smells and tastes like delicious flour, sugar, matcha and vanilla! Since I ate over a dozen of those cookies, it's now obvious where that taste association comes from haha. Love it.  I really want to do a comparison of this vs the new French Vanilla matcha. Subtle but delicious differences I'm sure!Oh man I just got an awesome idea. Mini matcha shortbreads for summer, using the different flavours of matcha! Ah! I can't wait to see how the flavour translates into a simple flour, butter, sugar cookie. Paired with an iced matcha. On the front porch. Okay I don't have a front porch : ( But I have the makings of the rest of it :DI don't know if I mentioned this in my other reviews - but this matcha (and the others) has an amazing echo of taste. The aftertaste of the natural flavours lingers long after I'm finished the cup. To be honest, it kind of makes me crave more. If I wasn't already bouncing off the walls with matcha energy, I might make more! No joke. This stuff packs a serious energy punch. I've been having it every morning! I feel lucky :)

I certainly would not classify this as a "blah" tea, but when I want something flavoured it isn't what I'll reach for - the vanilla flavour is there, but I had hoped for stronger. I made some before work today, and as it cooled (I find it gets better as it cools) I just kept thinking that it tasted like extra smooth regular matcha. Like a toned-down on the grassiness matcha, which isn't necessarily a bad thing. I think this would be perfect for someone who has been newly introduced to matcha, or for someone who maybe had a bad first experience. If I had tried this as my first matcha, I think I would have thought "Ooh....matcha is awesome!". What I really thought was: "This is interesting....but I think I need to try more before I decide."The Madagascar Vanilla is definitely something that I can see being great in baking or smoothies, and I have read about a few people mixing it with other flavours such as mint (that may be something I need to try in the future!). I can also see it being a go-to tea to make when I'm not sure exactly what I want. I do wonder though how different the French Vanilla matcha is from the Madagascar Vanilla. I may have to place another order soon to compare...The best thing about this matcha is that it seems to be pretty versatile...I feel like I could probably use it to extend the life of some other kinds if I really wanted to. The taste is mellow and smooth, and there is no artificial taste to the vanilla flavoring. I recently noticed that on the Red Leaf Tea website they have an option for a "2 in 1 custom matcha", and I think this would be a really awesome option to use as one of the flavors. I'm not sure I will pick up more of this when it is gone, but that is more due to the fact that there are so many different kinds that I want to try. I could see me coming back to this sometime in the future.

This here is so good its not an "in your face" vanilla but just the right touch to allow the yummy base to shine through. The base in this matcha is far better than many other matcha I have around and then to consider all the flavors this company offers! Its astounding! This particular vanilla is not as strong as some - such as french vanilla but if you want your flavors to taste as natural as the flavor additives Red Leaf Tea uses then this is your vanilla!

For the past two days every time I walk past my tin of Red Leaf Tea's Madagascar Vanilla Matcha, I have to stop and smell it. It really is an indescribable wonderful smell!I have had this Matcha in Red Leaf's "2 in 1" option combined with Caramel Matcha and it was heaven. This time around I bought each of those flavors separately so I could use them individually or combined. This past weekend, my awesome daughter bought me a Magic Bullet blender because I have been so into making tea based drinks and smoothies etc. Already I have used this amazing flavored Madagascar Vanilla Matcha to make some super scrumptious smoothies. This morning I added it to a peach greek yogurt smoothie and it was delicious. Vanilla goes so well with so many fruits such as strawberries, blueberries and raspberries. Or this Matcha is spectacular all by itself, hot or cold. This flavor Matcha remains my top favorite and I believe I will be reordering this probably every order I place with Red Leaf because you just can't go wrong with this one. (Perhaps I should give Red Leaf's French Vanilla Matcha a chance though!)Besides tasting so yummy, one cup of Matcha tea is equivalent to ten cups of green tea, so the health rewards are astronomical!

column9: Vanilla is the one for me.
column10: So now that I've caved into a growing adoration of matcha, I gave myself permission to cave to the siren's call of Red Leaf Teas. My wife already adores them for their Earls, and Tea Equals Bliss on Steepster has nothing but good things to say about their matchas, so it was an easy next step to take. And the Madagascar Vanilla Matcha was an absolute must for me.Anyway, on to the matcha. I'm in love, y'all. My wife asked how it was, and I could only put the mug down long enough to say "Oh my gawd...." Geez, I'm starting to sound like a Paula Dean special. There was no butter added to this tea, y'all, I promise. You all know how much I love vanilla, it's my chocolate, to be perfectly honest. Especially French Vanilla....mmm. Anyway, this has a creaminess that reminds me of a good French Vanilla, but without being overwhelmingly sweet like some French Vanilla teas can be. The greenness of the matcha isn't lost in the flavoring, it's a very nice balance. It doesn't taste artificial, it just tastes delicious and creamy and smooth and everything I ever wanted in a vanilla matcha. This is definitely one I plan to stock up on, once I've tried all of the ones I want to try! Next on my to buy list is cinnamon, and I'm already dreaming about mixing the cinnamon with the vanilla and drifting off into a delicious, delicious sunset! While full of excess energy, of course! Oooh, and mint for homemade, dairy-free Shamrock shakes! Mmmm....I see a lot of possibilities with this little beauty. Anywhere you need touch of creaminess, this matcha is there! Oh man, remember the blueberry pie I made with Vanilla Oolong? It would be out of this world with this matcha. And make it healthy! Well...healthy-ish.This matcha inspires me to bake and blend my own flavors and just go crazy with matcha. I used to only drink matcha occasionally, but I think this particular tea might lead me down the road of "My Morning Matcha". There are too many possiblities! Blueberries and Cream matcha, Shamrock Shakes, Dreamscicle matcha...do you see where I'm going with this? And the baking ideas are just as endless. Matcha butter cookies....oh hey, y'all! Lookie there, there is butter in this review. Dang.  I guess I am Paula Dean. I promise I will never deep fry matcha.

I loovvve this product. It's so rich and creamy. I use fat free half and half in it and it is sooooooo goooood! I just love it.

column9: A great enhancer, pleasantly sweet with a little kick to it
column10: I love this sauce. My favorite use is over grilled salmon. Try this: bed of greens (arugula or spinach are good), 1-1/2 oz feta cheese, about 1/2 c FRESH pineapple (can throw in some raspberries in-season),  8 roasted almonds, juice of half a lime and about 2 t good olive oil. Top with the grilled salmon (about 6 oz piece)which has been doused with a couple of tablespoons of the raspberry-chipotle sauce. Yum...about 14 points on the WW system but very low fat, high nutrition, lots of volume and tastes GREAT.

Oh my gosh this stuff is sooo delicious.  Pour it over cream cheese and serve with crackers.  The subtlety of flavors is so amazing, like no salsa I've ever tried.  Give yourself a treat and try it.  It makes a great hostess gift, too.

I use this on all kinds of things.  Two favorites are as a condiment on bratwursts and poured over a pork tenderloin that's been rubbed with salt, pepper, garlic, and rosemary, and roasted.  It's sweet with just a bit of spiciness.

This is possibly the greatest dipping/all purpose sauce ever!!I order about 2 cases yearly, for use myself and for gifts.  My adult niece & nephew drop by for it all the time.  My neighbors look forward to receiving it for Christmas. You have just got to try it.  If you buy a case (can be mixed with other products) shipping is free.

If you mix this with a bit of balsamic vinegar and pour over (spread out) cream cheese it is amazing!  It's great, all the cooking stuff from Fischer is amazing!  You can only find the big jar of this at costco in summer months, I always stock up, it lasts a long time opened in the fridge.
I have tried other raspberry chipotle, but this is by far the best. Amazon has the best price and arrives very quickly w/ fair shipping costs. Order extra bottles!!!

i bought the european and the north american one at whole foods because they just looked good.  my favorite is defiantly the european!!!!  it's a little tart but still sweet!  i love it as part of a pb&j sandwich.  super good!!!

And the smokey flavor pairs very nicely with the fleur de sel.  I haven't tried other smoked salts, so I can't compare, but I really loved this product and thought it had a well-balanced flavor. ****Tazo's Calm Herbal Infusion is a nice chamomile tea. I taste the chamomile and some flavorings, and they are not unpleasant, just hard to pin down as to what they are besides the chamomile. In general I'm not a big fan of tea with flavorings added, preferring the subtleness and authentic taste of the real thing.The ingredients in Calm are: chamomile flowers, hibiscus flowers, spearmint, lemongrass, rose petals, blackberry leaves, safflowers, peppermint, sarsaparilla, lemon balm, licorice and natural flavors. It is caffeine-free.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "a soothing blend of chamomile blossoms and other relaxing herbs." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Calm as "creamy, floral, minty, toasty, sweet, honey-like. As the name gently implies, Tazo Calm has a lovely floral bouquet with an apple-like flavor and distinct toasty notes. Naturally sweet in a nice light way, with a smooth finish". Tazo describes the aroma as "minty, hay like, rose". I don't taste all of these various flavors, but I do taste the chamomile, and it is fine, not overwhelming or as artificial tasting as several of the other Tazo teas I've sampled.I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as other tea companies that feature only natural flavorings like Numi, which is why Tazo Calm gets only four stars.****
Vendor service was exceptionally quick and the tea has been the best tea for after dinner and begin to relax!

The milk chocolate chunks in this product are heavenly.  The reason for the 3-star rating, whereas my other reviews of the Al Wadi halvas are higher, is primarily because of the inconsistency in the quality of the product from tub to tub in the same case, in the same shipment.  The first one I opened was amazing.  There were enormous globs of those wonderful chocolate chunks and the halva was soft, and resembled chocolate chip cookie dough in texture with this sweet, nutty taste that was to-die-for.  The next tub I opened was quite dry and although it had some good chunks in it, I found that I was basically digging out the chocolate and avoiding the halva, which was hard, dry and nearly tasteless.  The remaining tubs followed this trend.  I compared the halva in this product (just the halva) to the plain Al Wadi halva and it didn't taste nearly as good; it was also harder and drier and more compacted.  If I were rating on the halva alone in this particular iteration, I would have to give it 1 or 2 stars, but the stellar chocolate pieces really deserve some credit, so I settled on an overall rating of 3 stars.  I don't think that this type has as much benefit for breastfeeding mothers as the plain or pistachio types because of the large amount of chocolate which has been introduced to the product, and the benefit comes in the halawa extract which is in the halva and not the chocolate.  If you're looking to increase your breast milk production, get the plain or pistachio; however, I think the American palette would be more receptive to this, the halva with chocolate, IMHO.  Get some gas relief pills if you're going to be snacking on halva constantly for breast milk production (take it from me and save yourself the pain)!

column9: Actual product is great, but ordering it from Amazon isn't.
column10: I originally ordered erythritol directly from Emerald Forest and have fallen in love with it. For those familiar with xylitol, this is better in almost every way.It's nominally 70% as sweet as sugar. I find it slightly less sweet than xylitol, but my roommate finds it to be more sweet. It also has less of what I would describe as a "bite" to its sweetness than xylitol, especially in warm beverages.It doesn't have the upset tummy effect, since it doesn't seem to attack our symbiotic E. Coli. This does make it less interesting for anti-microbial applications, such as a nasal or oral/dental rinse. I still keep xylitol around for that.It works just fine in nearly all cooking. It even caramelizes. I haven't tried pushing my luck with yeast-leavened bread, however. My yeast still gets fed dextrose, with erythritol as a supplement for sweet doughs. If the yeast can't, in fact, metabolize the erythritol, this will make adjusting sweetness much easier when using a bread machine.Now the downsides. It does have about a fifth of a calorie per gram, which means a single packet is closer to 1 calorie than 0. It has much more of a "cooling" effect when dissolving even than xylitol. It's a bit time consuming to dissolve in iced tea, and I tend to need to "zap" my coffee in the microwave for a few seconds if it's not at just-brewed temperature.I've had one successful order from Amazon of this item and received the thousand-pack bulk box. My most recent order, however, turned out to be xylitol instead of erythritol. Fortunately, I'm not completely out of my first order yet. If actually getting the correct product is important, I'd say it's worth paying the extra money and ordering direct from Emerald Forest Sugar.

column9: Wish I could say it was better

Do yourself a favor & try the other coffees available for the Tassimo, incl on their website. The Gevalia Espresso is good, so are the Maxwell House Latte & Capuccino.

I adore my Tassimo machine,and this is my favorite blend. The machine adds a wonderful whip to the top of the coffee, but it's not dairy--it's the coffee itself. It has a wonderful, full bodied flavor and is a joy to drink the morning.
My very fav tassimo blend for drinking black. It is smooth and subtaly strong with no bitterness and the whipping on top  make its seem lighter.

This coffee is excellent. Smooth, not bitter. I bought it based on other reviews and they were very accurate.  So glad since I had never tried it before, yet signed up for subscribe and save with my fingers crossed.  Glad it turned out well!  Thanks!

I've been buying Johnny's Seasoning Salt for years, it's perfect to add to any barbecued meat, especially lamb. It adds just enough seasoning without masking the flavor of whatever it's added to. We also add it to vegetables, salad, and more.
My husband and I love this seasoning salt, and so does most of our family. We put it on everything - it is magic!

This tea is very tasty and wonderful for a sore throat. It gently coats the throat. You can drink it hot, or make up a full water bottle full to sip all day long when you can sit and sip hot tea. I use to send my kids to school with a water bottle and 3 bags in it, they loved taking it with them and help them through thier day when not feeling well. I enjoy this tea even when I am not ill too. Ive not bought in bulk like this ad shows. I do not know this seller, I just know the product is very good.
My husband drinks this and it is one of his favorites.  Smells good to me though I don't drink coffee.  Little mess with the K-cups though I wish they were more environmentally friendly.
Not a good deal at over two dollars a can plus shipping and these are the8oz cans, not the larger 13oz cans.

Bought the product Aug 2012, at a summer hot day with delivery to my office.The product arrived well packed, cooled and preserved, the ice didn't melt until evening when I got home. Speedy and pro shipping.Quality product as advertised, nicely cut and packed, made a great dish,

We bought this item to specifically help to detox intestinal track. It's great stuff. It was shipped fast, it's a very good price, and this is raw food!We grind them in a processor, add raw honey, take it and then  2 hrs later take couple spoons of castor oil. Trust me it's worth doing once in a while as it helps you stay clean on the inside.I also make pumpkin & raisin raw cookies out of it. Pumpkin seeds are great or you! Especially for men as they take care of prostate health  as well!
I like roasted pepitas, so I buy raw pepitas and roast it myself. This particular brand of pepitas is very high quality, big enough, solid seeds. I love it and will order it again soon.

Our Golden Retriever loves this food and it agrees well with her sensitive digestive system. We've tried more than 10 types of kibble with her and this is the one that she digests the best, and seems to make her not hungry at the same time. We've tried more expensive single-protein / all-natural foods and this one still comes our ahead (except of course table scraps, which are still her favorite).
We use to use science diet and it was good but she was always hungry so we decided to switch to this and she just loves it.

column4: Yvonne T. Mcfadden "Mac in New Mexico"
column10: This was a thank you gift for some friends.  They were delighted and, of course, they loved the jelly beans.  Jelly beans is a long-time treat for our family, so what better candy treat than we know will always surprise and please.If you want to gift your friends with a small treat, then jelly beans is your selection.  It never fails to please.

column9: nice to be able to have cereal again
column10: I rated this as someone who cannot have regular cereal because of severe diabetes. I loved the cereal but made it better by adding cream and some extra splenda. I found it quite tasty and liked the fact that it has lots of fiber so it was beneficial to my intestinal tract. Adding a little extra cinnimon also tasted good.
Very high quality.  Love to use it in my bread baking.  Equal to King Arthur quality, but better price!  This is for baking only.
This Is the Best sauce ever .  Use it alot over the holidays.  My family loved it. Please don't run out of this sauce.
I got this at a true bargain price and am pretty surprised at the quality. It's tasty alone on pasta, but one can easily add ingredients to it and pump up the flavor. I'm happy with the quality.
Got this thru subscribe and save at a really good price.  It's a good sauce for plain spaghetti and sauce.  Additional herb & spices and homemade meatballs optional :)

This is an excellent value for people who go through a lot of pasta sauce and like to have it on hand.  The jars arrived completely intact with no spillage since they had been very well-packaged.  I'm impressed with the price on this.  I don't think I could make my own sauce and compete with this!
This is a great tasting base sauce which you can add spices or additions to add to the flavor.  Very economical and great texture as is - plastic jars too!

I wanted to try this sauce mainly because of the price and because I "jazz up" jarred sauce most of the time.  Trying it by itself proved to be a better-than-expected experience, but after adding some other ingredients which, by the way, I always have in my pantry or hanging out in my fridge (no special trip to the grocers), it was very good and indeed comparable to more expensive "ready-to-eat" marinara sauces. I'll buy this again for sure.

I remember wide flat noodles made by Mueller's years ago.  Can't figure out why they're not longer available.  Hoped these would fill the bill but they do not.  The flavor and quality is okay but I would prefer a much wider noodle.  They also require such a large order that I am overloaded with bags of noodles! Can't really recommend it.

The Jar is square and has convenient narrowing of the back side to allow a grip on it. But this makes it difficult to get the spread out of the corners of the jar and impossible to get the spread out of the lower corners. Kraft should supply a special spreading tool with each jar, I have nothing in my kitchen that does the job.This kind of jar is great for nuts and candies, but not a spreadable.
Everything about this product was excellent, the shipping on the item was a little high I thought.
As this order of Coffee Chuppa Chups was cancelled by the supplier as they no longer had stock, I don't think I can comment on it.

The product I ordered has been discontinued by the manufacturer.  Although disappointed, I was notified promptly and my money was refunded promptly.  An email was also sent to me promptly indicating the reason.  I am still looking for a supplier of the Chupa Chup Coffee Flavored Lollipops.

These lollipops are awesome. Three flavors are in the tin: espresso, capuccino, and mocha. They are all delicious. If you like sugar in your coffee, you will love these. They are a staple in my house. Yum yum!

column9: love chocolate flavors - miss the ice cream mix
column10: I used to buy the "ice cream" flavor mix of Chupa Chups, they had chocolate, vanilla, banana, and strawberry cream(?).  I'm not a big fan of the fruit flavors.  The coffee and ice cream flavors are really unique and well done, the fruit flavors don't stand out that much from other brands of fruit flavored suckers.I love the cappuccino and espresso flavors.  The mocha flavor is a little on the yucky side though.  It tastes like instant mocha coffee.  Since there are only 3 flavors, it's disappointing that one would be so undesirable.  My kids love them all though, so I just pick out the mochas for them.These really are great lollipops for adults.  All the fun of a lollipop with grown up flavors.

We liked the product, my kids thought they were wonderful, but I was bummed to see that the sell by date on the cookies was less than 30 days from the date that I received them.  How can we eat 12 bags of cookies in that amount of time?  We won't and they will get stale.  I thought that was lousy.

I was looking for a night time snack for myself that would satisfy my sugar cravings but not have a ton of calories.  Well this certainly fit the bill.These are so good and the small bags are just the right size.  Yes I could eat a whole box of these in one sitting but that kind of defeats the purpose.  But because these are low in calorie I don't feel guilty if I eat two packs.I didn't even look at expiration dates since I don't care and they're not going to last the month.I do wish they had this in all chocolate but the cinnamon is really good also.I'm really glad I got in on the subscribe and save before they closed it but the price went up.  I saw K-mart has these for $5.99/box which is better but it's worth it to have them delivered.  I don't know why the price hike.All I can say is Yum Yum!
Very vast delivery of Teddy Grahams Snacks. If you haven't tried them I suggest that you try them and you will be hooked on them as I am.I take a bag to work to share with coworkers. Just GREAT.

These cookies are great for kids snacks and for adults. But be careful, cus a little can get out of hand! I ate half of box while snacking and watching tv one night. Plus on auto ship, they are a great bargain.

Teddy Grahams are soooo delish, they are what a chocolate graham should be. The ones I received were expired, but Amazon worked with me to find a resolution. This issue would not prevent me from ordering them again; Amazon is one of the friendliest, most customer oriented and easiest online or brick and mortar retailers period.

column9: Love the variety snack pack, but price is too high
column10: My kids LOVE these things. They are so convenient too.  I really like to order from Amazon, because it is so convenient... but watch the price on these little babies. I originally bought these in Sept 2011 for under seven dollars. 2 months later the price is over 14. Really?! I can appreciate inflation, but this kind of price increase is robbery!

I get these on the subscribe and save program. My kids and I love these crackers.  They are great to have on hand and you can't beat the price. I am paying $7.62 for 2 12 count boxes right now.  I can't even get that price at the store when they are on sale.  Great deal!
Great way to top off a meal with controlled amount and not a lot of sugar. One can never get to old for this kind of treat.
They are definitely Teddy Grahms.  In much better shape than what I could buy at the store.  Not many broken crackers.
I got them all none broken! I wish that the boxes were alittle bit bigger other than that everything was wonderful. I hope my Marine in Okinawa loves them!!!

Chocolate Teddy Grahams are so yummy!  As an adult, I love them.  I'd imagine kids would too.PROS:- No high fructose corn syrup.- Crunchy little bite-sized cookies.- Nice chocolate taste that's not fake.- Great to eat in the car, at your desk, or wherever.  It's a portable snack.- Sweet but not sickeningly so.CONS:- I really have no cons other than they will get stale if you don't wrap the bag up tightly.OVERALL OPINION:I enjoy Chocolate Teddy Grahams as either dessert, or a snack with a cup of coffee.  It's a sweet pick-me up that doesn't leave me feeling too guilty.  Cures the need for chocolate, and has a nice crunch that sometimes I really want.  Oh yeah, and they're cute little bears!
This is a great snack for my 2.5 year old son.  Easy to carry with us and he loves them.  Got them for a great price which makes them even better!
I love these packs. They are delicious and easy to throw in a diaper bag or my kids lunch in the morning. I can feel better sending them with this instead of cookies and junk.

We definitely enjoy Teddy Grahams in our house and for the most part these were good. The only issue I had was that the taste of the chocolate ones were a bit off, maybe a bit stale tasting. Otherwise these are a great, easy and convenient product.
My kids love these snacks and I loved the variety! When buying in bulk, it's nice when there are different flavors in the same package ... no boredom here!
I like the single-serve bags. I like the variety. And I like that they were on sale. Kudos, Teddy Grahams! You keep the Teddy Roosevelt legacy alive and tasty!

I purchased these on a whim (as with most of my Amazon buys!) thinking they would be nice for snack time in my busy household.  The kids and I both are crazy about them!  They're the perfect size for a 4 or 5 year old's snack.  They're also easy enough to open that my 4 and 5 year olds can open the package themselves.  Our favorite variety is of course chocolate.  Love having these around for trips to the zoo, on the way to the store, or to throw in the lunchbox.  Will be buying these again!

Delicious! Large bags with great taste. 5 stars because they are organic, grown in the US, and the most affordable of the Organic Soynuts available on Amazon!"Thank you for your inquiry..The organic soybeans used to make our roasted & salted organicsoy nuts are grown in the United States.Sincerely, Gerry Knight"
It was incredible, and the price is great. We now know where we will always be getting this.
Drakes yodels are simply the best.Substitutes just don't cut it.Buy some right away, and if your state don't carry Drakes products like mine don't,then order them online here at Amazon.

My 3 dogs LOVE this kibble.  For years, my 12 year old male vizsla was on a raw food diet due to inflammatory issues when he was on kibble as a young dog but when we got a new puppy, decided to try switching him back to kibble.  In the past, when we tried feeding him any kind of kibble, including many very expensive, organic foods, within 3 days he would start to limp and become incapacitated.  This was not the case with any of the Natural Balance line of kibble.  He has done very well and his bloodwork improved as a result of being off raw and back on a good kibble.  My 2 year old female vizsla is very finicky and prefers this specific type the best.
This was the first time i used this product, have to admit i love it, very smooth and the price was right. Thank you, Rosa.

My wife loves this shampoo. It smells really good and she says it doesn't wash out her color. She has been using this for over 4 weeks with good results. This is a good product developed for people who dye their hair.

I like my regular conditioner better.  I didn't see anything special this conditioner did, no glowing or silkiness.  I guess it is just okay.  I wouldn't buy it.  Soybean product in conditioner?  I don't like the idea of soybeans in my conditioner.  Maybe that's why the hair didn't glow or was silky.  This conditioner might be good for some, but not for me.  Oh, it's usable if you don't have anything else, but I wouldn't buy it.  It could have gotten 3 stars, but the soybeans brought it down to one.

column9: Excellent product at a reasonable price!
column10: I received a bottle of Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Damage & Color Repair Nourishing Conditioner to review. I was not able to get a bottle of the shampoo, so I had to try this after my regular shampoo. I have been coloring and bleaching my hairs for many years and it tends to be dry and brittle.To evaluate the condition, I used the following criteria:- Does it get the knots out? Yes, excellent!- Does it leave my hair too oily or too dry? I liked the way my hair felt after I used the conditioner,- Does my hair style properly after I use it? Yes, I had no trouble styling my hair.- Does it have a pleasant smell? I liked the smell a lot!- Does the bottle sit firmly on the tub (I often leave the lid open and knock it over!) It has a large, flat surface that keeps the bottle upside down for easy removal.- Is the price reasonable? The price is $4.79 for a 12.7 oz. Bottle. VERY reasonable!I liked this conditioner so much that I went to the store and bought the shampoo. After using both, my hair feels smooth and silky! Highly recommended for color-damaged hair.

I received this item free for review.  I've got shoulder-length curly, frizzy hair.  Color is put on my roots every 3-4 weeks.  When I ordered this, I just hoped for the best regarding healthier hair.  The temps and humidity have been brutal this summer and I have seen some days since using this where my hair wasn't as frizzy.  Is that due to the shampoo and/or the conditioner?  Hard to determine.  Yesterday it was pretty frizzy again.Been using the product for about 2 weeks now.  Something I did notice a couple of days ago, was that there wasn't as much hair on the floor of the shower as I've been seeing for the past couple of years.  Wow, I wasn't expecting that.  It makes sense since this product is supposed to make your scalp healthier.  But slowing down hair loss is not listed as a selling point.The conditioner itself has a silky feel and a light pleasant scent and my hair feels good when getting out of the shower.  Both the shampoo and conditioner can be stood with the opening down, making it quicker to dispense.Two things I need to mention.  The first is that the item came well-wrapped in plastic, and it's a good thing it was.  There was some leakage with the shampoo during shipment.  Not a lot, but it would have messed up everything else in the box.  Probably better to purchase this from a brick and mortar store to avoid possible loss of product.The second is that in order to see a list of ingredients, you are told to pull up part of the label.  What???  Can you see doing this in a store?  Would you purchase one that already had part of the label pulled back?  I think a redesign is in order.On the whole I'm happy with using the product.Amending my review.  I've been using the product for over a month and I'm torn as to what I think of it.  I am definitely experiencing a lot less hair loss since using it, which is a HUGE plus.  However, my hair doesn't look and feel nearly as good and the color is being stripped out of it with each washing.  I think I'm going to have to stop using it.  I've downgraded the rating from a 4 to a 3.

I love this conditioner.Pro's* You don't need a lot to cover your hair (I have medium length very thick hair)* You don't need to leave it on your hair longer than a minute or two.* It comes out of the bottle onto your hand very thick, not thin and runny like most conditioners at this price point.* It makes your hair extremely soft in a very short amount of time.* Bottle rests upside down which I prefer, none wasted.* Hair remains soft, even after drying.Con's* I really cant think of any.  I tried this product because of Amazon Vine sent one for review, but I will continue to buy it as it is about 75cents to a dollar cheaper than my old conditioner and I think it works better.  It is suppossed to increase the health of your scalp, but I am not sure how I would notice that type of change.  I will also say that I am allergic to many shampoos and conditioners and I have had no problem with this after 4 uses.Great product, great price.

I used Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Damage & Color Repair Nourishing Conditioner for some time before I finally wrote this review. At first, I liked it very much. I am a conditioner junkie, and will give any new product a shot if it seems to fill the bill. However, my initial delight with this conditioner sent me running back to my other conditioners when I realized that the initial softness that I felt was being replaced by a dry, brittle feeling -- almost as though I had left soap in my hair. Not good at all! Furthermore, when I gently comb through my hair when it is dry, I am suddenly experiencing breakage, and this is NOT a problem I had before I used this conditioner.In essence, I do not recommend this product, and I am glad that I waited long enough to have gone almost through the entire bottle so that I could be sure about my results. FYI, I always thoroughly rinse my hair out in the shower, but the residue from Clear Scalp & Hair seems almost impossible to get out.

column9: Good Conditioner; the Packaging Needs Work
column10: I have fairly thick, shoulder length colored hair that literally has a mind of its own.  A standing joke that's only part joke in my house is that the hair I wear all day is the hair that I woke up with.  It really is that thick.  So one of the things I look for in any conditioner is whether it can make my hair behave.  And I am pleased to report that this conditioner passed that test.I used it for three weeks and for that entire time my hair was amenable to the brush.  In other words, I got to have some (not complete but way more than normal) control of it.  I also noticed that I lost less hair than I do using regular shampoo and conditioner.  So the claim that the conditioner is good for the scalp is probably accurate.It feels good when I put it on--a kind of silky feel and when you wash it off, I can really feel how soft and pliable my hair is. The other nice thing is that it didn't seem to discolor my hair more than regular conditioners do.The only thing I didn't like, quite frankly, was the packaging.  It leaked.  And, while this doesn't sound like a big deal we have two very curious little dogs at home and about the last thing I want them to eat is hair conditioner.Overall though, I would say that this is a good product that, given the benefits I experienced, is reasonably priced.

Some might say a conditioner is just a conditioner...all the same. I disagree as I have used some that are just awesome and make my hair feel thicker as well as tone down brassiness. That said, this conditioner did nothing for my blonde hair and after using 3/4 of a bottle, I didn't notice any "repair" to speak of.  Nondescript.

I have used a couple of Clear brand products in the past and been very pleased with them, but I felt like this conditioner didn't condition well at all.  I found myself using more and more every day trying to achieve the conditioning results I got with other brands.  My hair is about shoulder length and when I was using about 1/3 of a cup daily and still finding my hair to be dry, I decided enough was enough and went back to my old brands.

I didn't purchase this product through Amazon but at my local Target. I've tried the Total Care shampoo & conditioner, Strong Lengths shampoo & conditioner, AND Damage & Color Repair shampoo & conditioner. This review is inclusive off ALL of the products of theirs that I've tried.When I first bought the product (Total Care) I thought the smell was pleasant and the size of the product seemed in line for the price point they were selling it at. I purchased one shampoo and two conditioners (as I have really thick hair and generally go through conditioner faster than shampoo). After the first shampoo and condition when my hair dried I immediately thought that my hair felt softer than it had before ... which is saying a lot because I'm growing my hair out and the only non-color treated portion are my roots.I stuck with the Total Care line through 2 purchases and then decided to switch to the Strong Lengths line when I started noticing that my hair seemed to be breaking more often or just plain falling out more. Strong Lengths had the same good smell and left my hair feeling the same but didn't seem to be addressing my issue of hair breakage/falling out.Just two days ago I purchased the Damage & Color Repair line to try out. So far same scenario as before but I now believe I know why!!READ THE INGREDIANTS!! The ingrediants for ALL THREE shampoos & ALL THREE conditioners are EXACTLY THE SAME!!! How the heck does one work for damaged/colored hair specifically if both the Total Care & Strong Lengths have the same ingrediants. Just seems like a pure marketing scheme now.I'm not one to waste shampoo/conditioner so I'll finish out the bottles that I have purchased but I know when I'm done with them I WON'T BE BUYING THE PRODUCT AGAIN!Also, I read a review where the person mentioned that it seemed to take longer for their hair to get fully wet once they started using this product and I have to say that I agree with them.SOMETHING ISN'T RIGHT WITH THIS PRODUCT!

Has made my daughter's very curly hair (like mine) more manageable for a time, but very drying. We both can tell that this product is not good for our hair, especially considering its high alcohol content... Could be used as a decent de-tangler when used sparingly.Update:Had to downgrade my reviews for this line when the skin on my arms and neck started breaking out after accumulated exposure-washing my daughter's hair in the sink in addition to using other products from same line on myself that day. Not the best choice for sensitive skin.*Found a "silver lining:"When scalp became extremely dry as a result, with dandruff "raining down" to the touch, I did an internet search. I found that VINEGAR is an excellent conditioner. I used 1/2 vinegar/water-amazing results! My scalp calmed down and my hair seems to have recovered-now soft to the touch instead of brittle.

I have long, fine very curly salon colored hair and a sometimes flaky scalp, so was eager to try this conditioner. Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy Damage & Color Repair Conditioner has a lovely but not overpowering scent, goes on smoothly, doesn't require a large amount to evenly coat my hair, and leaves my hair feeling soft and silky without being weighed down. It's definitely doing a good job of conditioning my hair. I've also noticed it has helped my flaky scalp. I wouldn't call my hair damaged but it does get dry and frizzy fairly easily. I've been using this conditioner with the Clear Complete Care shampoo, both of which I received free of charge from Amazon Vine, but will be purchasing my next bottle because I like it so much.

I really like this conditioner. I have thick, wavy hair that is fairly long, and lots of grey around my scalp that likes to curl. Most conditioners are too heavy to put on the scalp area, leaving me few options for the gray. However, when I use this, it tames those coarse gray hairs for at least two days. Not only that, but since I have been using both the shampoo and the conditioner, my hair has gotten more compliments! I have found that it is smoother, shinier, and just looks healthier. I was curious about this new brand after seeing a commercial, and I have to say - I really like it!

column9: Move over Nexxus, this is just as good, if not better
column10: I am really picky about my shampoos/conditioners, and was SO dubious when Amazon sent me this item to review.I have colored, fine hair, which frizzes easily and breaks often.  It grows very slowly and any harsh shampoos/conditioners will either break my hair or weigh it down and make it look dirty and lifeless.Amazon sent me this item (Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Damage and Color Repair Nourishing Conditioner) and the corresponding shampoo (Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Damage and Color Repair Nourishing Shampoo).I usually use the Nexxus damaged hair products that are found at Costco.  It is expensive, even at Costco.  But it didn't weigh my hair down nor cause breakage.This shampoo and conditioner smells GREAT.  I usually don't notice the scents, unless they are gross or medicinal, because my sense of smell is limited.  But this one smells really great, like fruity flowers.I use it basically like everyone--shampoo, rinse, condition, let sit for a minute and rinse.Here is where it's different:  When I comb out my hair, which is longer than shoulder length, it doesn't pull, tangle, or (on the other end of the spectrum) feel greasy or heavy.  It combs out sleekly (is that a word?) and as my hair dries naturally, it's not frizzy or lifeless--it shows off my natural curls.  If I dry it with the blowdryer, it doesn't frizz at all.  I can flat iron it, and maybe because it really allows the hair to curl naturally, it takes a bit more work to get that curl out, but it looks GREAT.I have been using it for a month now, and my hair dresser actually noticed a difference in my hair. She said that it grew more than usual (she's been doing my hair for 3 years now, every 6 weeks).  I believe that because my hair doesn't break or frizz, my hair really is "growing" faster because it's not breaking off.I didn't think that any line could replace my Nexxus, but this has.  It took me a long time to find the Nexxus--with my sensitive hair that breaks so easily...  And it saves me money, too, which is a great thing, especially in this economy.

Clear conditioner may feel good in the shower, but that is about all. Hair is easy to comb, but once dry impossible to style unless one adds a ton of other product. Claims that it is good for your scalp are unfounded - try Nioxin Scalp Therapy, Conditioner System-1, Normal to Thin-Looking, 33.8 Ounce if you truly want a conditioner for scalp. Scent is overpowering and next day hair is dry and lifeless. Not a good product for those with super straight styles.

I love the scent of this product. That's the good news.But in my old age, I have developed a horrible itchy reaction to certain hair products, namely WEN, which gave me an awful rash on my hairline (front and back) as well as my entire neck. So when I saw this product, I thought it would be a relief now that my itchy WEN rash is finally (after SIX months of healing) a thing of the past.Sad to say that I was wrong. I used Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty conditioner and shampoo  three times in a row and guess what happened?  Yup. Same sort of irritation and itching in all of the same places.There must be a very specific ingredient the makers of hair products are including in their respective cleansers and conditioners because the fact that this has happened AGAIN literally has me scratching my head in disbelief.Again, this conditioner has a lovely scent - but I will not spend my waking and sleeping hours scratching myself like a cat with fleas.  If you have any sensitivity to hair products, avoid this one.Boo. So goes this product the way of WEN. In the trash.

I gave this to a woman in my life who is a lifelong salon shampoo and conditioner user and she said she really noticed a difference in the texture of her hair afterwords. The split ends were helped considerably. Being an older woman who has had her her colored many many times this was a conditioner that was surprisingly helpful despite its price. What was most noticeable to me was that her hair seemed to have more sheen than before using the product. Now I myself can't say I've used it, but for a woman that's had many hair treatments she has a pretty good estimation of how well these types of products work. I'd recommend a sample.

column9: nice scent but could be more moisturizing
column10: I have thick straight hair that was colored a few months before I tried this product. Over all, the packaging is nice, the scent pleasant, and I like the texture. However, I don't find this conditioner as moisturizing as my standards - Dove and Tresemme. My hair just feels coarser and drier after using this as compared to my regular products. It's OK and not bad, but I need something more moisturizing.
This conditioner works great. It smells great and my hair feels so nice. I love the bottle design however it is hard to get that litte bit out of the end.

This conditioner does the job. It coats the hair well, smells pleasant, and seems to work fine. After using it rinses out well and my hair feels soft and manageable. I really can't find any superlative things to say about it, it does the job without any problems. I will say that I have an issue with telling which is the shampoo and which is the conditioner because the bottles are almost identical and I always forget which is which.I can't really tell if there is a benefit to using this on my colored hair or not. Everything seems fine with this conditioner, nothing stands out as being wonderful or awful. I did not have any leakage like other reviewers have reported with the shipping of this product. The cost is reasonable, that might be the best thing about this product.  I do like that the product is thick and not a runny consistency, it's easier to apply when I can get it to my head without having it drip off my hand.

I have color treated hair and wanted to try this conditioner in combination with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Total Care Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce in hopes of keeping damage from color treatments at a minimum.  The shampoo works great and I continue to use it but this conditioner leaves my hair frizzy and unmanageable.  I wondered if the combination of the two was causing my problems but I have since used the conditioner with Alberto VO5 Tea Therapy Healthful Green Tea Smoothing Shampoo, 15 Ounce and my hair is still frizzy and unmanageable so it's not my shampoo causing the problem.  Something in the conditioner doesn't agree with my hair and I do not like it.

I've tried a few of the "Clear" brand conditioners. Like the other ones I've tried, this one is lightly scented and I would have to say that I like the scent. I'm not sure exactly what the scent is but it is pleasant. The consistency of the conditioner is okay but I prefer thicker conditioners. It rinses out well enough and leaves my hair soft.I like that the spout is on the bottom because this helps the conditioner settle and makes it easier to get the last bit of conditioner out of the bottle.

I've been coloring my hair for too long to mention... There is a point that my hair starts to go from beautiful and shiny and newly colored to looking more rundown and dry.So after trying this conditioner for awhile, I would say it is a nice one, I'm not sure if it makes a difference with dyed hair but that's a tough one to measure. It smells okay, rinses well and has a really thick consistency.I also like the convenience of the container. It opens on the bottom and stands up solid. So it is always coming out from the bottom instead of having to be squeezed from the top.For the price, it's a nice conditioner and a good deal.

This bottle came and smelled so vile that I had to leave it on the porch! After a few days I could bring it inside.Not sure what caused that, as there was nothing unusual about the packaging. The conditioner's smell also is unappealing (though not as bad). As a conditioner, it worked fairly well,smoothly out tangles and leaving hair shiny. But it's hard to imagine anything gentle and "nourishing" would smell like this.

I use Damage Repair conditioner because I suffer from terrible split ends. I've struggled to see the difference between many of the brands, most of which charge more for repair style conditioner. Clear Scalp was different from these.When I buy conditioner, I look out for two big things. Does it smell good and is it worth the money? The answer to both on these questions in the case of Clear Scalp is yes.This conditioner is only five dollars and comes in a pretty big container. It's a great value for your money. I plan on ordering more of this conditioner in the future.

I home color my hair every couple of months and that is pretty hard on it, so I'm always looking for shampoo and conditioner that are targeted towards reversing the damage I cause.  This conditioner is great!  My hair is feeling healthy and much softer since I started using it.  The color seems to be lasting longer than normal which is definitely a plus.  And it smells great too!

Nice formula, smells good and makes my hair smooth and easy to comb through! Been using for over three weeks now- My hair is super smooth-My color still looks good- Very happy with this product, will most likely purchase in the future!

I have short color treated hair and oh my does my hair love it.  This is a wonderfully luxurious conditioner that feels like silk when you use it and it does give my hair some fluff and omph.  I haven't had an issue either with this stripping the dye from my hair like I have with some conditioners which is a plus in my book.I have been trying the entire line of Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty products and have to say I love them all.  I will gladly pay the small amount for this than the large $$ amount for the shampoo and conditioner I was buying at the salon.The product I feel is a nice quality product with an affordable price, nice fragrance without a yukky buildup on the hair and just an overall fantastic experience that will keep me using this for a long time to come.

I got both the shampoo and conditioner in the Damage & Color repair and so far I really like them both. They have a nice scent that I don't find to be strong at all. This conditioner leaves my hair very soft and smooth. I can't say I see a difference in my scalp from any other kind of shampoo and conditioner that I use but the price is right so I would probably buy this again.

I believe I am permanently switching to this brand.  I have extremely long hair (to my waist) and it even moisturized the damaged ends without removing my natural curl.  It's a pretty light conditioner, but manages to work as well as deep conditioner or a leave in variety.  Controls frizz as well!

I have shoulder length medium to thin hair. Weighing it down with heavy conditioners that cause it to look even thinner is unacceptable.  Additionally, within the last year I noticed that a couple of areas on my scalp were itchy. So, I was curious to see if this product would soothe the itch and condition without making my hair droop.Well, I am impressed. I've been using the conditioner for a few weeks and love the way my hair looks and the itchiness is greatly improved. I use about a quarter-sized dollop and focus on the ends of my hair with the majority but then run my palms over my scalp and wait a minute then rinse. The fragrance is mild and the price very reasonable. I will update my review if I encounter any problems.

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column10: I'm a bit of a conditioner junkie :) I love to try lots of scents and 'promises' with different conditioners, so I will rate this on the following that I go by for myself:Price: Five starsScent: Five stars, I love it. I even let my hair dry naturally a few times so that I could enjoy the scent longer!Conditioning during shower: This did great for making my hair easy to comb through before I dried it.Conditioning overall: Not so much. Even though I love to try new conditioners, I always end up rating them against my favorite (Tresemme Vitamin E Moisture Rich Conditioner, 32 Ounce) and it doesn't come close. Before I dried my hair, things looked good. My hair smelled great, felt great. But after I dried it, it already felt rough. Hours later it was hard to believe I had conditioned my (colored) hair at all. With the Tresemme my hair is baby soft, and I mean that literally, I can't stop touching it. I guess the rule here is why change when something works? Because I'm a conditioner junkie, I told you!! :)Ultimately, if you can't find the Tresemme, this conditioner is okay.

Okay, so I'll be the first to admit that I'm not super picky about the kind of conditioner I use. I'd been using one by Joico, but was running low. So when I saw this in the vine program I ordered it. I like the scent, and it doesn't seem to dry out my hair or scalp, so all's good.

So far I really like this conditioner. It has a nice, light, creamy feel to it and quickly absorbs into the hair. For anyone with dry or damaged hair, whether it's from coloring, sun, pool or just naturally dry hair, this is the perfect conditioner. After using it, my hair felt softer, less frizzy and more smooth when I blow dried it. If you are someone who has fine or thin hair, you might want to apply it toward the middle and ends and avoid the roots because the oils in the conditioner might be a little too heavy for certain types of hair and weigh it down.

column9: For Best Results Use Clear Shampoo As Well
column10: I started with just the shampoo first and instantly regretted it. The shampoo requires the conditioner for good results.  The conditioner is very thick and feels oily but doesn't leave your hair oily. It definitely makes it very sleek, soft and silky to the touch. It also takes the frizz out of your hair (if you have trouble with that like I do) but doesn't make it limp like some shampoo/conditioner's do. The smell of both the shampoo and conditioner is light and pleasing. It's not fruity or floral. I'd describe it as a very light perfumed scent. I don't know that I will switch to this shampoo and conditioner exclusively when I run out, but the price and free shipping (with Amazon Prime) certainly makes it appealing. I awarded it three stars because it requires both the shampoo and conditioner to get great results. I like more freedom in selecting my hair care products.

column9: It's clear that Clear is a quality conditioner.
column10: Not long ago I bought a superior expensive salon conditioner because I liked the irresistible smell and the way it left my hair -- manageable, not greasy, not weighted down. Then I tried new CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Damage & Color Repair Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid OunceFirst I liked the package better than the pricey product I had been using. This bottle stands up and is a sensuous lavender color. The opener works better than the other one.Next my nose loved the way Clear smells. I was surprised that the two products smell almost the same. Since I usually am in a hurry, I didn't leave the conditioner on very long, but it worked in a short time. Buy this one!

column9: Leaves my hair soft without robbing it of body
column10: This summer my hair has been frizzy and hard to manage. The other conditioners I've tried have tamed the frizz, but left my hair limp and hard to style. This product made my hair feel incredibly soft without sacrificing body. While this creamy, extra-thick conditioner is not going to win any awards for being all-natural, the results are pretty wonderful. It's my latest favorite hair care product.

I have hair that is thick and goes about 3" past my shoulders and difficult to manage-it always seems to be frizzed out (just thought I would included that so you know when reading the review you can compare your hair type to see if this will work with your hair or not) I am a Head and Shoulders Loyalist, however, this conditioner works pretty well.It is smooth and goes on easily.  I also like that I didn't have to use a whole bunch to get full coverage (I only had to use about a quarter sized amount). It smells pretty good (I would say about as good as Pantene or Garnier Fructis, but better than any of the Head and Shoulders scents I've tried) and after blow drying left my hair soft and silky, but not greasy-even the next day.  I did use it with the Clear shampoo, so I think that using both products together also helped and would recommend that you get the shampoo as well!Packaging Note: If you plan on ordering this on Amazon, be aware that it may leak in transit-Mine did leak a little bit, it was wrapped in a plastic bag so it didn't get all over the box/other items, but it was still messy and needed some rinsing off when I took it out of the box.
