I have very long thick hair and have been coloring it for years, so no matter how often I get my hair trimmed most of it is dry and fairly fragile.I'm always looking for an inexpensive product that may be the equivalent of a salon product. Well I'm sorry there just aren't any, but this conditioner comes slightly closer than most.My biggest issue with this conditioner is the smell ---I don't know who think that the aroma of musk (at least this is what I  think this is) is going to be a good one for hair.  I hate wearing anything with a smell other than my perfume.  I usually use fragrance free everything. The aroma of this product clung to my hair for the whole day.I did  seem to see less hair in my  comb as I was combing my hair out after my shower and my comb ran through my hair quite easily.But even after thorough rinsing my hair felt greasier than it did silky. When dry my hair did not have the usual manageability that I normally do with my OTC 'Nexus' products.

Since I like using "companion" products, I looked forward to using this conditioner with the shampoo color repair nourishing shampoo. While it did soften my hair, I honestly can't say that it's in better condition than before I used it. And yes, I've used it several times over a period of weeks. On the plus side, it's creamy, pretty, and pink.

column9: Great conditioner, just what I wanted
column10: When Vine offered this conditioner, I was looking to replace my brand. I have fine, fragile, medium-length hair, which I dye with permanent dye every two months. I never use a blow dryer, which would dry out my hair too much, but I still have problems with breakage.After trying it, I find that this conditioner is what I need. It leaves my hair soft, smooth, and tangle free--I almost don't have to comb it after washing. It's neither too thick, too thin, too greasy, nor too watery. It's easy to apply; I just rub on a little bit and rinse it off after about two minutes. The fruity scent is rather strong, but pleasant, and it does fade a little soon after application.I don't know why some reviewers say this conditioner has a "salon price." In the city where I live, this conditioner has a drugstore price.

I've been faithfully using Dove conditioner for, well, awhile, but I'm always interested in trying something new, so I had no problem with giving Clean Scalp & Hair Beauty a shot.O.M.G.This conditioner is seriously amazing. Firstly, it comes out nice and thick, which, to me, is always a sign of a quality conditioner. The conditioner smells amazing and I was really hoping that it would work as good as it smells.IT. DOES.It not only got my hair nice and almost completely tangle-free after my shower, it did the same for my 8 year old daughter, and anyone who has an 8 year old daughter with almost waist-length hair can definitely appreciate that!Sorry Dove - I think I'll be cheating on you!

column9: I have thin baby fine hair.
column10: I like this, it's a little heavy for my hair, so I have to wash it out quickly, but it's a great detangler... my hair will dread if you look at it meanly and so detangling is important to me. The only detraction is the heaviness... but all in all, not too bad of a product, if you don't have baby fine hair, it probably wouldn't be heavy.

Ironically, my scalp was dry and flakey...no clue why...just as the advertisements for this product started to appear. Huh...well, decided give it a shot...other dry scalp shampoos, don't have companion conditioners and quite frankly are good tools if you want to remove hair coloring from your hair! Nothing strips it like dandruff shampoos! But this not only in two uses, relieved my itchy dry scalp, it left my hair nice...and has been much gentler on my OTC hair color. I like the scent. I use both the shampoo and conditioner. Will continue to do so.

column9: I think these products work very well.
column10: I had seen the commercial for the Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Therapy.  I was intrigued by the idea of a shampoo and conditioner working from the scalp and its claim to restore the scalp's natural moisture balance.  I had never seen a product focused on the nourishing of the scalp which makes more sense than all the shampoos and conditioners of the past that are supposed to work on the ends of your hair.  The past products focused more on the prevention of split ends or ending fizzy hair.  I color my hair every 6 to 8 weeks, so I always purchase a color-safe shampoo and conditioner.  I also liked that has vitamins and nutrients including vitamins B5, C & E, sunflower, almond, soybean, coconut oils and aloe vera.The bottles arrived wrapped in plastic bubble wrap and did have a small amount of leakage on the shampoo bottle but the conditioner bottle was okay.  I have used both the shampoo and conditioner for over a week and I like the products very much.  The shampoo has a lovely lavender color and a light scent.  I didn't find the scent overpowering.  I like that it takes a dime size amount to get a good lather.  The conditioner also works well with a small amount in your palm.  Most conditioners I use require quite a bit to work through my entire head of hair.  I think the conditioner is very easy to work through my hair without a lot of pulling and snagging.  It feels good and it doesn't leave a heavy, greasy film on my hair.  It rinses very clean.  Overall, I like the products.  Often in the past, most store bought shampoos begin to break my head and scalp out and neither of these products have done that.  I like that both shampoo and conditioner are designed to be set in such a way that the conditioner and shampoo bottles can be set flat so that the product is always draining down towards the opening.  I would recommend both of these products.

column9: Great scent, scalp isn't itchy, hair feels silky
column10: I wanted to try this shampoo since I saw the ads in the magazines.  Since I have colored hair, I was afraid of using a product that would dry out my hair further.  The shampoo smells great, doesn't have too much lather and doesn't feel like I have to wash twice.  The conditioner is a nice creamy texture with the same familiar fragrance, a little like Finesse.  Scalp feels great, not itchy at all.  Very happy with Clear.

i recently tried and reviewed another conditioner by Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty that I loved. I thought I would try this one because I color my hair red which can fade fast. This was not very nourishing at all. It left my hair frizzy when I air dried it and that doesn't usually happen. This is more for someone who needs a very light conditioner, not hair that gets damaged or repaired.

I was prepared to not like this product very much. I expected a drugstore quality product that retails for a salon quality price. I was wrong. The conditioner rinses clean and leaves my color-treated hair feeling noticeably softer than before. I also *really* like the bottle. Somehow, with the cap on the bottom, there seems to be less waste. Now for the cons -- I don't believe the claims that it can really strengthen hair. If you look at the ingredients statement, the nutrients they promote are in minimal supply. That said, I'll continue to use it, even if it doesn't live up to the promises on the label because I like the scent and the soft way my hair feels.

column9: Silky soft hair and a great fragrance
column10: This conditioner makes my hair silky soft, and it smells great!  This is the only conditioner whose instructions say to work it into your scalp, so I do and it's very easy to rinse out.  I will definitely continue to use this.  :)

column9: It's good to use with the shampoo
column10: I dye my hair and live in a dry climate, but my hair gets very brittle.  This conditioner, along with the shampoo, makes my hair stronger and easier to manage. I do also use Sensories Smoother Passionflower and Aloe Leave In Texturizing Condition By Rusk, 33.8 Ounce after I towel dry my hair after washing so maybe all three make my hair easy to comb and style without a lot of split ends.

I have color treated hair that has gone coarse and a bit brittle from coloring. After a few weeks of use, my hair feels soft and silky after washing. I was concerned over how it would affect the color over time, but so far, it seems to have no negative side effects.

This product delivers what it claims. It made my hair soft and looking a little healthier, without making it feel heavy. It rinsed clean and didn't make my hair feel like it had a coating on it. It has a nice feel to it and smells great

column9: Protects and coats the hair and I love the scent and the shine
column10: This conditioner is a great complement to the shampoo of the same brand.  The conditioner not only helps restore moisture to your scalp but it also helps protect your color and prevent future damage. It is color-safe and it coats the hair completely and sinks into your strands helping them feel softer and it made my hair shiny too. Some of the ingredients include Nutrium 10 which is touted as "an advanced moisture complex of vitamins and nutrients" and they include vitamins B5, C & E, sunflower, almond, soybean & coconut oils & aloe vera. The scent lingers even after your hair is dry and isn't overpowering when applying. It rinses cleanly but your hair still feels coated like it soaked the protective elements into the shaft.

I color my hair and naturally it gets damaged.  This is a wonderful product.  It makes your hair so silky and the scent is great.  I use the shampoo too and I would highly recommend it.  This is a very thick creamy texture so if you really need help with your hair being dry or damaged this is the one to get.  I love it.

I have used ths conditioner for a little while. This bottle was the first i recieved from amazon but not the first i used. I'm very happy with it. It has a pleasant but not overpowering scent, goes on and through the air smoothly with none of the unpleasant thick clingy consistency i have experienced with some other products. It also rinses out easily and completely which is very important for a conditioner. My hair when dry doesn't look weighed down at all. It was shipped tightly wrapped in plastic and while there was a little leakage into the wrap it was completely contained and easily rinsed off from the bottle so it didn't concern me.

My husband and I tried this product along with the corresponding shampoo. His hair is dry, thinning, and brittle, very curly but not color treated. Mine is normal, slightly wavy, with good body, and salon colored.He likes this product for the moisturizing effect. We have tried just about every product we can find but his hair continues to be fragile.  This is the first product that he said actually makes a difference. His hair is softer and breaks less after only 2 weeks.For my color treated hair, it's made no positive difference. I don't like the texture feel of the hair when wet, and my color has faded twice as fast as it does using John Frieda conditioner for red hair.We'll probably keep buying this product for my husband's brittle hair, but I've stopped using it on mine.

I needed a lightweight conditioner to help my color treated hair because it is oily and a bit damaged and this fit the bill.  It really smells nice without having an overly perfumed smell.  But best of all it left my hair feeling silky and easy to comb.  Once dried, my hair was not weighted down and felt so soft.  I will be using this conditioner in the future and am giving up my way expensive Lanza product because I like this better.  I knocked off a star because I thought the design of the bottle was a bit odd.

I ordered both the Clear Scalp Shampoo and the Conditioner for Damage and Color Repair since I regularly color my dark hair and like to use products that help sustain the color. I typically buy sulfate-free since those seem to work best, and was a little bit surprised that this formula contained sulfates. However, I didn't notice any negative difference in my color after using it for a just few weeks.The shampoo did seem to be a thorough cleanser,leaving my hair "squeaky clean" and once I added the conditioner it left my hair soft and silky as I stepped out of the shower. I found the scent clean and pleasant and it doesn't linger at all after rinsing.Once blow-dried, it did seem that the shampoo might have been a bit of a stronger cleanser than I am used to since my hair was slightly fluffier than usual. It could also be that the conditioner was not as deep conditioning as I have found with other products made for color-treated or damaged hair. I should note that I have relatively "normal-dry" wavy hair and this might be a bit more ideal for those who have "oily-normal" hair.I would recommend this combo to anyone looking for a super clean head of hair with body, but not to anyone who tends to have very dry hair to begin with since it may be a bit too harsh. I also wonder about long term use on color treated hair with a product that contains sulfates, since I prefer those without. They performed pretty well, so I did give the shampoo/conditioner 4 stars, but it could have had 5 if it were sulfate-free.

So far I've used the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY DAMAGE & COLOR REPAIR CONDITIONER for about a month. I've got coarse, dry, and thick hair, which tends to poof up in high humidity. I also dye my hair, so I was looking for something that would not only condition my hair, but preserve the color in between tint jobs.I colored my hair about 2 weeks before starting the CLEAR SCALP CONDITIONER, and now, about a month and half out, the color still looks fresh and my hair is nicely conditioned (however I do add a leave-in conditioner afterward because if I don't my hair looks like a helmet, but my hair felt nice and soft and detangled right out of the shower before applying my leave-in).It softened the first time I used it and has a fresh -- but light -- scent that smells like a combination of citrus, strawberries, and some flowers. There was a brand called "Liante" in the orange bottle that I found in a Korean Supermarket and this smells like that.Another thing I should mention is that I've been breaking out on my scalp, not from this product, but I suspect it might be one of my styling products and so far this conditioner hasn't made the problem worse and I haven't had any issues. I was using a shampoo and conditioner with Neem Oil in it, which I read helped with scalp issues until I used this one.CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY does have a formula that supposed to help with dandruff and other scalp maladies but it contains, like most, Pyrithione Zinc, which hasn't really helped me.Anyway, I think it works better than similarly priced conditioners so give it a try.
This conditioner left my hair feeling very soft and moisturized after one use. The smell is kind of strong, but once your hair dries, it provides a really nice scent that lasts.

This is the matching conditioner to the shampoo I also used and reviewed.I liked this also, worked nice w/the shampoo, gave my hair a bit moresmoothness.  I am not a scientist, so all the additions of the vitaminsand other goodies I am sure are good for my hair and scalp...I just goby how my hair/scalp feel after the use and the scents...its a big YESto this product and its matching shampoo.  Again as I stated in theshampoo review, I love the shape of this products bottle, a plus fora small arthritic hand...even though I am sure that was not why itreceived its shape, I appreciate that its not one of those huge tallround bottles.

My hair is very fine, so I am very careful about which conditioner I use. I need one that will make my hair soft, but not greasy. This conditioner fit the bill. My hair feels very clean and soft without feeling like it has a ton of conditioning product in it. It also seems to be more shiny since I've been using this.

column9: Best drugstore conditioner I've ever used
column10: This conditioner makes my hair so soft and I have super dry damaged color processed hair! Love the smell and have tried so many conditioners finally something great that makes your hair feel so much better

I've been using this product along with the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Damage & Color Repair Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce for two weeks. I'm very satisfied with the two as a pair. My only complaint about this conditioner is that it's fairly thin. I prefer a thicker conditioner that feels like it's sticking to my hair. After I rinse it out, my hair doesn't have that ultra-smooth, luscious feel to it ... but that's a minor quibble. This conditioner does its job, and I'm satisfied.

column9: Great product with one tiny flaw
column10: I've been using CLEAR Conditioner for a couple of weeks now and it does what it says it'll do.  I have very long hair and CLEAR has cut down on the frizzies to an incredible degree.  My hair looks healthier and feels better than it has in a long time.  Highly recommended for those two attributes alone, and an added bonus is its lovely lingering fragrance, not overwhelming at all.The only drawback to this product I've found, and this is probably because my hair is so very long, is that I've developed some nasty snarls at the nape of my neck.  They're fairly easy to untangle, but they're there and didn't used to be.  The first one could have been an anomaly, but three or four a week is not.  The only thing I've changed is to use the CLEAR.  It's not a deal breaker, but worth a mention.I'd rate CLEAR four and a half stars but since that's not an option, I'm awarding it four.

column4: Valerie J. Wood "Author and Sports Journalist"
column10: I'm always careful about products for my color treated "naturally blonde" hair. This conditioner is thick, goes on smoothly, has a fresh and very pleasant scent and does a very nice job. My hair is silky and smooth after use, and I've noticed it doesn't get so flyaway in humid weather. This goes great with the matching shampoo, of course. Highly recommend.

I really like this product. I have curly hair which I color and it frequently has a slightly damaged appearance unless I use a host of products on it. Clear Scalp conditioner has a light, pleasant smell (in fact, I wish it was stronger.) It makes my hair very soft and looks better after only two uses. I recommend this product because if it helps my hair, chances are good it will yours also.

I like the shampoo, and I'm happy to say that I like the conditioner too.  I like that it works without having to use a handful of it.  Some conditioners just do NOT work on my thick hair and I end up having to dump half of the bottle onto my head just to be able to run my fingers through my wet hair.  But not with this stuff.  Happy to report that it works well and you don't need a whole lot of it either.  I'm also happy to report that my blow drying and straightening time is fairly quick and my hair seems to stay less frizzy so far.  Good product.

Having also reviewed the shampoo which accompanies this conditioner, with comments which apply to the products used together, I will summarize my previous review.Clear Scalp and Hair conditioner is packaged very nicely in a bottle which is inverted and opens from the bottom. It is very easy to get the conditioner out of this bottle, unlike some conditioner bottles.The conditioner has virtually no odor, and feels soft and creamy.It distributes well and rinses easily from my hair.My hair is nice and soft after blow drying and flat ironing, although it is a little fly-away.I really like this shampoo/conditioner combination, but it does not help with frizziness, which my hair has a tendency to, especially since I live in very humid Florida.I will be trying some leave in anti frizz products, which, if they work, will make these products really good.Both the shampoo and the conditioner are priced very reasonably.

column9: Excellent product at a great price point
column10: I am usually not overjoyed at trying new haircare products because once I find something that works, I stick with it. But Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Conditioner was well worth it! I recently had a great color job done on my hair and this is preserving it so well. My hair feels softer- yet manageable. It's shiny without the greasiness and smells wonderful. I am going to buy the shampoo now simply because the conditioner is wonderful. I have short, thick hair that I color and use a quarter sized squirt to cover my hair. It will last a while because it's not runny like cheap conditioners.

If you didn't know that conditioner can also double as a shaving lotion, you do now. It's a great cheap(er) alternative to buying shave lotions or gels and IMO works way better.As a hair conditioner, Clear works really nice. My hair feels just so soft and silky after I use it for just one day. The only thing I'm unsure of (and I have noticed this with some other conditioners, but not all) is that after I use it I seem to shed a LOT of hair. So, that's why I didn't give it 5 stars. I do love the way it makes my hair feel, though.Given how soft and silky it left my hair I decided to try using it so shave my legs. Doing so gave me a really nice smooth shave but also doubles as an in-shower lotion, leaving my legs feeling super silky smooth and soft.

I have been coloring my hair for at least 20 years.  I started graying way too young and the many years of color processing has left my long hair prone to being dry & brittle.  I am constantly on the hunt for a moisturizing conditioner that leaves my hair healthy yet lightweight.  I tend to switch up my conditioners and use 2 or 3 on a regular basis.I tried this new Clear conditioner with the usual skepticism I have for every hair product.  I was pleased with the first use.  Its smells clean and doesn't have any lingering over powering fragrance.  It rinses clean very easily and left my hair feeling soft.  This won't be an everyday conditioner for me, but it will be a good choice for lighter conditioning days.I wash & condition my hair everyday and I live at the beach so good conditioners are a must.  I will use this again.

column9: WOW!!! - Day 2 & I Love This Product!!
column10: Having a full head of thick, frizzy, long, curly hair, I was looking for a product that would help me get rid of those areas that were just too unmanageable.  I went to the Caribbean and the ocean seemed to make parts of my hair want to "dread-lock".  While to some that may be cute, it was not appropriate for my work environment.Nonetheless, I kept hearing about this product and wanted to give it a try.  The price was worth it.  I figured that even if it didn't work at least I wouldn't have lost a large amount of money as you would on some salon products.Today is the 2nd day that I have used this product.  It is amazing!!!  I got the tangles out with no trouble; nor, did I have to yank my hair out to get the dreads to unlock.I cannot wait to get to day 7!!!  If my hair feels this fabulous on day 2, then I'm in for a treat!!  I am extremely thankful to have such a nice product to use without the expensive price tag.Thank you Unilever for bringing this product to the States!

last night I tried the clean scalp and hair shampoo for damaged colored hair repair and the long strengths conditioner WOW what a difference in the texture of my hair..I walked into work and the compliments where outstanding some people thought I had my hair professionally done.. I also work with alot of Asian people the ones I work with can be very critical and opinionated their not a fraid to tell you if they like or dislike something. WOW is what I said when they all comlimented my hair that spoke volumes to me..... One lady wrote down the names of what I used and is planniong on purchasing these products also. The price is so affordable I purchased them both in Walmart for under $5.00 each both together is usually what I pay for one bottle of my old shampoo...Ahhh yeah I'll be sticking with these products Great Hair Great Price there's no going back to the old and the best thing No Frizz No Big poof. My hair is naturally wavy curly and thick..... I finally found a solution to my problem I can't wait to get my hair styled to see how much nicer my hair will look good style great products I can't go wrong!!!!!! All I can say to anyone out there considering these products is try them for yourself and you be the judge its affordable and I know you'll just love them if you have problem hair

column9: It's clear!  CLEAR is a winner.
column10: I gave my wife the new "CLEAR Scalp and Hair Therapy shampoo and conditioner for damage and color repair" for her birthday. She is picky about her hair products and has trained me to purchase only those for color treated hair, though she rarely admits to having color added. I've learned my lesson, about her pickiness, when buying shampoo and conditioner, but I dared to try something new.Whew! Did I ever score with CLEAR! She told me "the bottle shapes are so cute, and the open/close mechanism was very secure," something she doesn't always find on her regular brands. She also said she doesn't need to use as big a portion to clean as she has before, making it very economical. She said the suds felt thick, smooth, and it had a nice mild scent.After just a couple days of use, and especially after a full week of daily use, she thought her hair was indeed shinier thatn before, had much better texture, and seemed smooth, manageable, and extremely soft. Usually in the humidity of warm weather she has the "frizzies." When the CLEAR runs out, she asked me to get her more. Boy, do I now have little gifts for future occasions--the jackpot of suprise gift-giving!

I've been using this conditioner with the accompanying shampoo (clear scalp and hair beauty damage and color repair nourishing shampoo), and together they make a good team for a daily thorough cleaning and conditioning. I actually like the conditioner a little better than the shampoo; it is just the right consistency (rich but not too thick) for a smooth application, and the light fragrance is pleasing. It leaves my dry hair well conditioned; also, the price is very fair.

column9: A gentle conditioner, but it is not a deep conditioner for extremely damaged areas of hair.
column10: I damaged my long hair when I got highlights.  It is pretty dry and brittle.  I have been looking for a conditioner that will be gentle.  I have been using Clear Scalp and Hair for three weeks.  It makes my hair softer and more silky, closer to how my hair used to be but the most damaged ends are still a bit dry.  I like that it is a lighter conditioner, absorbs quickly and doesn't lay as heavy on my hair as most conditioners.  But the floral scent is a bit strong and people with allergies might find a bit much.A gentle conditioner, but it is not a deep conditioner for extremely damaged areas of hair.

I've been using both the shampoo and conditioner for a few days now. It has a nice long lasting fragrance. My hair feels clean and soft. I reitterate SOFT. I go the salon on a regular basis to have my hair colored. I use shampoo/conditioner for color treated hair and some have left my hair feeling dry. Not the case  with Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty. It really left my hair feeling soft through out the day.Another bonus: for people like me, who need eye glasses to read and have a hard time deciphering which bottle is the shampoo and which is the conditioner, the shape of both bottles is not only very helpful but is also very clever. Both bottles have a flat spot and you push down for the spot to open and dispense shampoo or conditioner. The shampoo sits up right with the spot on the top and the conditioner sits with the spot on the bottom. No problem with trying to figure out which bottle is the shampoo or conditioner.I liked this product and will be purchasing more.

I found this to be a nice, light conditioner with a fresh scent that wasn't overpowering. The instructions tell you to gently massage your scalp after applying the conditioner. I have short, naturally curly hair that tends to be dry, so I generally use a heavier conditioner than this one. But I think this would work well if used regularly on most hair types. I recommend it for everyday conditioning -- it's not a deep conditioner.

First of all I have to say that based on my initial use of this product very early one morning when I was half asleep, I feel that it's a terrible shampoo.Of course once I realized that it wasn't sudsing I remembered that it was conditioner and reapplied it after shampooing.  It rinsed out well, which is a plus in my book, but I didn't notice any appreciable improvement in my hair.  The shampoo I normally use does a better job conditioning than this did.The worst part, though, is the smell. Like most products made by huge companies like Unilever, it's got a sharply unpleasant odor.  Now I admit I'm sensitive to smells, but this was so harsh I ended up shampooing again that night to get rid of the smell.  The scent is much too strong, and completely phony. I don't honestly know how anyone endures it.I really hate this stuff, but the job it did wasn't wholly bad, so I'm giving it two stars, and tossing the rest of the bottle in the trash.

column9: Goodbye Garnier Fructus, Hello Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty!
column10: I have thick shoulder-length hair that every 3 - 4 months my salonist either colors or highlights (and chops away some of the thickness so I don't look like a wooly mammoth).  For this reason, I switched from using my usual brand, Garnier Fructis Fortifying Conditioner Sleek and Shine With Nutritive Fruit Micro Oils, 13 Oz, to this brand.PLEASE NOTE: This was used in conjunction with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Damage & Color Repair Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce.I rather liked the packaging.  It is a little similar to the Clear Shampoo, but fortunately, I have sharp eyes.  The shampoo itself had a nice, light pleasant smell, and a good consistency (neither too thick, nor too thin and watery).After shampooing with Clear's shampoo, I started out with about a palm-sized amount of conditioner, about the same amount I'd use with my regular brand.  This was adequate for my hair (I did have to use a little more, but I don't know if that was just me, not coating the hair properly).  I left it in my hair for a few minutes, then rinsed.  It took a few rinses to get it all out and seemed to leave a coating on my hair.But the end results were what stunned me.  My hair was delightfully soft and smooth!  After flat-ironing my hair, my hair was sleek and flat in a way that I could only rarely get from my usual hair products.  But the best part was when a coworker approached me and asked if I had recently gone in to have my hair cut and colored.  I told him, no, my last appointment was a month ago!I am now a convert; I'm saying goodbye to Garnier Fructus, and hello to Clear and better hair!Brought to you by:*C.S. Light*

I absolutely love this conditioner.  I have long color-treated hair that is thin and fine.  Many conditioners I have tried, including expensive salon ones, have left my hair either straw-like and full of tangles, or else weighted down and limp.  This conditioner leaves my hair silky smooth with almost no tangles.  It does not weigh it down; my hair actually has more volume than usual.  I don't have to use very much of it to get a good conditioning, which is great because the bottle is going to last quite a bit longer.  Also, the fragrance is very pleasant.  I don't have a bad thing to say about this conditioner and plan to continue buying this instead of the more expensive conditioner I had been using.  This is a great conditioner so don't hesitate to purchase it!

I like the smell and the consistency. I have colored hair and my hair gets oily, but the ends are like straw. This conditioner has helped my ends stay soft throughout the day. I will be buying the shampoo and trying that too. Hopefully it will help my oily scalp too after I have used it for a month or two I will update my review.

I ordered this for review (provided by company) and thought it's conditioner, it's not a miracle.It's not a miracle product, but it out performed my regular conditioner and I would say it worked as well as the product I bought at the saloon.It smells nice--not overwhelming.My hair isn't heavy or greasy.I'll purchase more when I run out of it.

column4: Juanita A. Floyd "Life is too short to read b...
column10: I have to say this stuff is truly amazing. I figured this was just another conditioner and I have used them all. Not so. We had recently been to the Blue Lagoon in Iceland. The ends of my color treated hair were like straw ever since. The minerals in the water just sucked right into my hair and it was nasty. For the last week I had been using all kinds of conditioners to try to get this resolved. Last night I used this product that came yesterday and VOILA! My hair is soft again and the ends are healed. I would not have believed it if it hadn't happened to me.The container opens from the bottom which is nice because you don't have to wait for the conditioner to run down. My only caution to you is make sure you have it snapped shut tightly otherwise it leaks out.

My hair is long and thick, and it's dry.  This conditioner made it soft and silky, so it performs well for me.  I suspect it might be a bit too heavy for those with thin or fine hair.  It has a pretty standard hair product smell- not offensive, left a bit of scent on my hair.  It opens very easily in the shower, which is a plus.  The only problem I had was in shipping the bottle opened and it leaked.  As I got this form Vine, my shipping might be different from a regular order.  The bottle really does need to be shrink-wrapped or otherwise held shut, as it snaps open far too easily.  Not an issue for me getting a bottle I didn't pay for, but paying customers will need more effective packaging.

I had already tried the Volume shampoo in this brand before trying the conditioner;both work well. The conditioner is a nice consistency. The smell is too flowery for me (on both products) a very strong scent. Also, the conditioner bottle has the opening on the bottom of the bottle instead of the top like the shampoo. I'm sure this is to distinguish between the two--but I'd rather just have two different colors. This worked well on my layered long colored hair, but it seemed to make my hair straighter then normal. Maybe I used too much. A good product, except for the strong scent.

The first thing I noticed was the bottle design. The shape makes it easy to hold/ The cap is on the bottom & super easy to open. You press one end & the other end pops up, squeeze conditioner out & press it down. I've had some bottles that feel like they need the jaws of life to open.The conditioner isn't too runny & has a pleasant smell. Not over powering. I have long hair and the ends damage easily. I was able to run a comb through my hair without it tangling while it was still wet. It's a really nice conditioner for the price range.

This is perhaps one of the best conditioners for treated hair I've used in a long time.  The shampoo was lovely but when i used the conditioner I could immediately feel and easing and smoothing of my normally okay hair.  I don't have long hair or anything unusual to test this prodcut but when I used a hair drier I could tell how much more manageable my hair became.  This is a great prodcut and one I hope to use again.

I've never reviewed a conditioner before, but here it goes.  I like conditioner that is thick when squirted out into my hand and then coat my hair.  Conditioner that is thin and slides through my fingers annoys me.  This is pretty thick.  I can rub it over my hair and then drag my fingers through my hair immediately afterwards.  This definitely helps with any tangles and makes my hair feel soft immediately after washing it out.  I'm not sure what to say it smells like, but I like it.  It's not overly flowery.  It also has not had an adverse effect on my color.  I guess the best part of this product is that it is cheap and effective.

I've been coloring my hair for over 10 years, along with using a blow dryer on an almost daily basis. Because of the on going damage done to my hair I have found several inexpensive products that work well for me so that I'm not breaking the bank just to fix my hair. The pricing on this product is slightly higher than what I normally pay and because of that I expected it to be a better performing conditioner.I used the conditioner for a full 7 days expecting to see at least some results at that point. Unfortunately I did not see my hair get any better, it actually stayed the same. I know that quite often they suggest using the same brand shampoo, in addition to the conditioner, but I have found that this isn't always necessary to get good results.  No matter how little or how much conditioner I used, I didn't see any improvement. Eventually I had no choice but to go back to my old brand because my hair just couldn't take it any longer.I gave this product 3 stars because I didn't see any improvement, but since I did not use it in conjunction with the same brand of shampoo I didn't rate it any less. Whether that would actually make a difference I don't know?

This is a good conditioner, but I don't think there is anything really special about it. It has a pleasant, apple-y scent. It left my hair reasonably manageable, though I still used a leave-in conditioner. I would buy this if it were on sale, but I don't think it's noticeably better than less-expensive products (such as Herbal Essences).

I looked at the ingredients and it's a bunch of chemicals and dyes that I don't know whether they are safe or not (A Google search listed several of them as harmful, irritating or toxic)...and I won't continue using it. It also burns your eyes if you happen to get any in while rinsing.Here are just some of the ingredients: cyclopentasiloxane, stearamidopropyl dimethylamine, methylisothiazolinone, methylchloroisothiazolinone and the list goes on of all these chemical sounding ingredients.

The Udi's brand gluten-free pizza crust is the best that there is. Yes, of course, it's inferior to a gluten-based pizzeria-baked crust, but this is the equal of any supermarket-sold pre-baked pizza crust out there. And by that I mean it is the equal of any gluten-based supermarket-sold pre-baked pizza crust. It is far superior to any other gluten-free pizza crust out there, many of which taste like silly putty. This tastes just like a good pizza crust. And when you're on a gluten-free diet, a good pizza crust is as good as it gets.

These are my favorite pizza crust or just plain flat bread. They are best heated up or toasted.I have been gluten free for over 15 years and have found these to be the BEST by far.I buy them by the case and eat them by themselves, as pizza, a sandwich, hamburger bun, or tear and dip.No gritty taste and a pleasant flavor.

Love these!  They are a staple in our house.  And always useful in a pinch since they stay fresh in the freezer. I cut with a big knife into quarters and often make quick broiled pizza slices for kids' school lunches using pasta sauce and frozen shredded mozz.  Top with roasted butternut squash, spinach, thyme and goat cheese for a fancy appetizer.  Top with cinnamon, sugar and honey then vanilla ice cream for a kids dessert pizza.

The coffee I ordered was here in less than a week after I placed the order. The packaging was excellent. The coffee was fresh and tastes very good. I will buy from this company again in the future. Thanks Don.

For texture and taste you can't beat this rice. This rice is grown in France and is firmer on the tooth than brown rice, with a nutty flavor that's unique. One reviewer was irked because the fine print on the label suggests that there are other grains of rice besides the Camargue rice. If you pour this rice into your hand you'll see that you're getting exactly what you thought you were, so I would respectfully discount this objection.

column9: Product information is confused; label misleading.
column10: This is indeed an interesting product, but the large-print label does not tell the whole story. If the customer reads carefully, the contents are revealed: "Camargue Red Rice is a delicious healthful rice that includes Extra Fancy 100% wild rice, and delicious blends of wild rice, brown rice, and basmati". From this, it is not clear whether it contains Camargue Red Rice at all. Is this packaging statement simply inept while there actually is the desirable specialty red rice as would appear from the picture, or what? I for one would not want to spend this kind of money online just to find out.You will also note that the Amazon description includes the statement "6-Grain medley combines three beautiful and delicious rices with hull less barley, rye berries and black and purple barley" but after a bit of thought, I realized this refers to a different product and somehow was put here where it doesn't belong. That actually is what caught my attention because rye and barley contain gluten, which is off-limits for sufferers of gluten intolerance who often seek alternatives such as these interesting rices.

Don't be a carb-a-phobe... This rice is the most nutritious as well as delicious brand of red rice. May need longer cooking than package says, but unlike other brands it is sturdy, does not overcook easily, crack apart, or loose it's color. Add to all kinds of dishes, soups or eat plain; has a nutty wonderful flavor.
Delicious and comes with a tea ball! I will definitely be purchasing more for the holidays, as these make fantastic gift items! :)
My dog loves these treats. He goes crazy for them.And, I have to admit, they do smell pretty good.
This 9.5 ounce jar of jelly works out to $1.47 per ounce. Today, gold is selling for $1.62 an ounce. So....I'll pass, thanks.

The muffins were very good, BUT the streusel topping was WAY too crunchy and hard.  The tiny, hard pieces were very hard on our dental work and my son's braces.  One of the brackets may have even come loose, which would cause us some expense plus extend his treatment time.I will buy the mix again because we loved it and the kids are begging for it, but next time I will either throw out the streusel or make my own.
this is just as addictive and crunchy and salty as potato chips.  I can eat a bag in one sitting no problem!

column9: SeaSnax @ The Go Green Expo Los Angeles 2010
column10: Length:: 0:55 MinsSeaSnax! Lightly Roasted & Seasoned Seaweed - The Healthy Alternative to Chips (4 Pack)

column9: Good but a slightly weird aftertaste
column10: The packaging says "surprisingly addicting" and that says it all. This is good and satisfies my need for salty foods, but you will have an odd aftertaste like you just ate sushi.

column9: Monin Gourmet Sauces White Chocolate Sauce 12 Oz.
column10: I have seen Monin products used at Reed's Coffee Shop in the downtown area. I personally love the white chocolate sauce. It is creamy and rich tasting white chocolate sauce. It is a nice, thick sauce that still pours easily. I love it and I use it at home on ice cream and also in my coffee to give it that coffee shop taste. Monin also offers a white chocolate and a caramel sauce. All three of these sauces taste fantastic. It comes in twelve ounce squeeze bottle, however I have seen it offered in large pump bottles as well. Monin also offers high quality syrups for your coffee as well. I have not found a bad tasting Monin product yet!

These are the best speculaas cookies.  We've tried other brands and always look for the red package from De Ruiter.  I had trouble finding them this year and Very Asia had them. Very Asia's customer service was tops and called me continuously until they had tracked down the cookies and could confirm when they would be shipped.

column9: I loved these cookies in the Netherlands. De Ruiter Speculaas are delicious.
column10: One of the fondest memories as a child was when my father gave me Windmill cookies. When I finally made it to the Netherlands I found Speculaas that have windmills and other common Dutch images impressed upon them. These little cookies are very tastie. You will find it impossible to stop at eating just one. A trully fond memory of the Netherlands.

I should have saved my money, but curiosity got the best of me. I did not have great expectations for this product, but when it arrived, I was surprised to see how small the gumballs were,that when chewed became pretty small in the mouth. The flavor left something to be desired, as it had a smokey chemical taste to them which to me was not enjoyable. Perhaps it would be enjoyed by someone else. By the way I love bacon, but this was not bacon.
Try the bacon mints if your going for a gag gift.  Everyone who tried these spit them out, they taste terrible.

couldn't stop laughing in the store, so just had to buy them. they smell kinda like bacon, but taste like something the dentist uses for fillings in your teethnext time take the time to laugh, but keep the cash in the pocket............
Great gag gift, the flavor doesnt last long but its cheap! I <3 it, my friends love it. Everyone you get it for will lov eit. Obviously not educational.. But, it doesnt even taste that bad!
I really enjoyed the cupcake mints so i thought I would try the gum as well. However, the gum didn't taste as good to me. I guess it comes down to personal taste.

i order this pickle gum as a gag gift ,  came in a big box but a very small package  it was cute  was fun when someone opened it, but then u do try it an theres not much of a pickle taste  an what little taste there is  goes fast

column9: Adorable but flavor is gone almost right away
column10: O ordered for my daughter I told her the amazon fairy sent her gum her eyes lite up as far as that surprise factor awesome....cute tin...but gum stinks taste ok for about. 3 mins and then the flavor is gone my little one asked me about 10 times for a new piece because it started tasting blehhhh. But  it does make a really cute surprise or gift for little ones I'll give it that much.

I love the idea of bacon anything...I bought this for my kids for Christmas and they all got a laugh out of it, but none of them liked the taste. I would still recommend for the novelty, but don't expect that it's gonna taste good.
Ordered this gum for my daughter and it was not only missing 2 pieces of gum but it taste horrible! Would not recommend to anyone!

Got this as a gag gift which was great for that purpose. However, I made the mistake of actually trying this. It was awful! Still, it served its purpose. My husband no longer thinks that EVERYTHING is better with bacon! LOL

I bought a tin of these because I like bacon, I like gum, so how could I lose.  Well after trying one, these quickly turned into one of the best pranks in the office.  We have been in tears from both laughter and the smell of these wondrous treats!
A good gum, great flavor, ok bubbles, firm, and a little grainy though.
This is good gum! A little firm to chew and ok bubbles.

I love Jolly Rancher sour candy. They wake up you mouth with thetrue flavor of the fruit. I just wish they would make seperatebags of them. I am not a fan of the sour watermellon and it seemslike every bag has more of them than the green apple ones which Ilove!!!!!

We were so happy to find the sour hard candies on line. My guy just loves them and the stores seem to stop carrying them. We were so finally happy to find them here and be able to order them without any hassles.

Pretty good assortment of flavors in each bag (12 bags to a case), though the most numerous candies were the Sour Wild Strawberry ones. These are my least favorite, but only because I prefer the sour apple, cherry, and watermelon ones...and the sour blue ones (raspberry, I think) are good too.No complaints, and the Jolly Rancher Sours were shipped promptly and arrived in perfect condition.  I was a little worried about them melting and getting gooey in the August heat in Texas, but that was not a problem.

Almost 5lbs of Jolly Ranchers is insane. That said if your in the market for the sour variety of the classic hard candy this is the only route I know of.12 bags is a bit much but I just got my case today and they're good until the end of 2013. Factor in I owe a friend of mine a bag(he picked up the last few at an oddball Wallmart that stocked them every now and then) and really not a bad deal for roughly $25.The only thing keeping this from a 5 star review is the minimum quantity. Yes they'll be long gone before they expire but now I'm looking at a case of Jolly Ranchers on my desk- kind of depressing.
My husband loved the lemon Jolly Rancher but they aren't available anymore so these sours seem to hit the spot with him.

column9: They messed with my favorite - and I like it
column10: I didn't think my childhood favorite could be messed with - but Jolly Rancher made it even better!  The box is roughly the size of a shoebox filled with bags.  That's 8,400 calories worth so put it in a hard-to-reach area like in a corner of the attic so you don't eat it all in one setting, because they are addictive.  Conjures up memories of Willy Wonka's factory.  Another sour candy for the sour connoisseurs is called Zours, another modern classic to try.

I personally loved every flavor in this bag, which my supermarket carried for only a limited time it seems. I really wish there were a way to still get these but not so many bags at once, but for these things I might just get it anyway - they are totally worth it.They are a perfect blend of delicious fruit taste and sour, they aren't SUPER sour so they won't melt you, but I probably wouldn't advise leaving them in the same spot in your mouth for a long time. I do this sometimes to see how long I can last, but moving it around solves any 'burn' or anything immediately and is quite pleasurable spreading through the mouth.I do not understand why these are so hard to find, as even other web shops appear to no longer carry these, it's a shame :(
Packages arrived quickly and product was fresh; HOWEVER, I really didn't need boxes of cracker crumbs, and that's what arrived.

column9: Harney & Sons Organic Bangkok silk Teabags
column10: Green tea is often more refreshing and supposedly better for you, so this lovely product adds a touch of elegance to your entertaining because they are contained in beautiful silk teabags!

column9: Love it! One of my favourite teas ever!
column10: This tea is simply wonderful. Smooth and refine! Love the hint of coconut and lemon grass. I discovered it in cafeteria in Bahamas and completely fell in love.I was very happy to find it on Amazon (at that time it was out of stock on the Harney & Sons website).
I first had this tea at a nearby restaurant and was hooked! This tea has a great coconut flavor that isn't took intense. I recommend all Harney & Sons tea highly!
It's a green tea with a hint of cocnut, lemon grass, ginger & vanilla. I was expecting more of the flavours to come through but it's quite pleasant hot or cold.

column9: A fine cup of tea, and that's an understatement!
column10: I am urging all my friends and acquaintances, with something approximating evangelical zeal, to try the wonderful teas made by Harney & Sons.  This afternoon, at (well) tea-time, I discovered the joy of Organic Bangkok Tea.  And it really is a joy: a green tea with subtle flavors of coconut, lemongrass, ginger, and vanilla.  It is a tea that will bring out your inner Niles Crane.  Do something kind for yourself, and experience Organic Bangkok Tea by Harney & Sons.

This is a wonderfulgreat tasting dry food that all the20 felines of mine love & not just temp they want itforever & ever they should know they are the ones thateat it all cats all over the world should have it mixedwith their own dry food & if cats could write theywould tell you them selves.
Quality gumballs don't get stale quickly but some purples change color in the sun and you know what that is cool. A++ would chew again.

column9: Chocolate Italian kisses - need I say more?
column10: My family has been in love with Baci's ever since we lived in Europe.  When my daughters were small they coined the term "Baci Pill" for whenever they were hurt or not feeling well.  They are a wonderful treat, after a meal with espresso or cappuccino.  Pop the entire Baci in your mouth and experience the famous Perugina chocolate and then the still crunchy hazelnut center.  The Italians do everything with class and this beats a Hershey's Kiss any day!

I ordered this item in a large quanity, but wanted the items packaged as shown.  They were for favors in a holiday bag for the company employees.  When they arrived a few were packaged as shown but the bulk were loose.  If I had know they would come like this I would have gone to COSTO or some other discount store for the purchase.  The cute little box that would have helped make them special and what I thought I paid for was missing.

column9: Baci's are pure heaven - great gift, stocking stuffer!
column10: My family has been in love with Baci's ever since we lived in Europe.  When my daughters were small they coined the term "Baci Pill" for whenever they were hurt or not feeling well.  They are a wonderful treat, after a meal with espresso or cappuccino.  Pop the entire Baci in your mouth and experience the famous Perugina chocolate and then the still crunchy hazelnut center.  The Italians do everything with class and this beats a Hershey's Kiss any day!
Just returned from Italy and was told these little chocolates were the favs of the Italians--perfect little two-chocolates for gifts -- and gloomy days -- or happy days --
Delicious candy.Outstanding price for such a rich product.The "fortunes" on the inside are an added bonus.Great options relating to packaging.

column9: Perfectly packaged popcorn for single people
column10: Say that 10 times fast! It's true though. They really put just enough kernels in the bag to satisfy you without feeling like you should have made 2! I love the Kettle Korn flavor too! If you've never tried it, you don't know what you're missing. It can be very addictive so maybe you better not try. Neah! Go right ahead! It's popcorn - a great healthy snacking alternative to chips, candy, and other junk food.Tip: It says not to use the popcorn button on your microwave which is good advice but if you check that booklet thingy that came with yours (if you can remember which drawer it's buried in) you might find that your popcorn button has multiple size settings like my Samsung model does. All it takes for me is to press the popcorn button 3 times to select "Snack size" and it comes out perfect every time - none burnt or scorched and only a few kernels unpopped.

We really enjoy this popcorn snack in the evenings.  It has an excellent flavor/taste and doesn't add hundreds and hundreds of calories to our daily intake.  Just the thing to enjoy while watching a TV show or movie.

I bought this popcorn without reading the ingredients.  I never would have guessed that it would contain artificial sweetener.  I made a bag, and soon had a funny aftertaste in my mouth.  A familiar aftertaste.  Sucralose!  Who would expect to find that in a non "diet" popcorn!  WHY???  They ruined it.  It went in the trash.  We don't like the taste of artificial sweeteners and we don't like the fact that one's body doesn't know what to do with them.

column9: Great taste, I was surprised it was this yummy!
column10: The taste of this kettle corn is mildly sweet, not overpowering & not at all artificial-tasting.  The product I tried was the 94%-fat-free KETTLE CORN, not to be confused with the Butter.  The Kettle Corn has clear white kernals of popped corn, and there is not the first hint of yellow residue anywhere.The best feature:  94% fat-free!  Although I am a bit confused and uncertain over what the actual fat content of a bag is (read the label of unpopped kernals v.s. popped corn--whaat?); as near as I can tell it is 2g of fat per popped bag, which yields approximately 3 cups of popped corn.  Excellent!  Since this is kettle corn, it is a great fix for a sweet tooth that also wants a crunchy snack.  I was pleasantly surprised, & will have this in my cupboard 24/7 for those snack-attack moments without guilt.  Definitely give this one a try!

Whats with the artificial sweetener? Its the only thing I can taste. Awful. Especially since they don't mark it at the front of the box. And it doesn't have that caramelized crunchy sugar coating that I like about Kettle Korn. They carry Orville Redenbacher's kettle korn at movie theaters that tast 100% better then this. Why are they selling this crud to regular consumers then?  I've resorted to making my own kettle korn or buying the pre-popped bags from Trader Joe's.

I bought Orville Redenbacher mini-bags of Kettle Corn because stores in my area stopped selling it. I have a compact microwave and the larger bags won't fit. This was not only a great deal, it is a healthy single serving snack that has aided me in my weight loss. Salty/Sweet, fluffly, perfectly done in less than 90 seconds. So glad I bought it.

Real kettle popcorn is sweetened with sugar and is a real tasty snack.Unfortunately sugar burns in the microwave so Orville Redenbacher (ConAgra Foods) have sweetened this with sucralose.Sucralose is definitely something I wouldn't give to my kid.  Read all about it online.

column9: Try it before you buy a large quantity
column10: I bought three boxes of the Kettle Korn ("Slightly Swee & Slightly Salty") flavor at my local grocery store. Nobody in my family likes this flavor at all. It's actually going into the trash, that's how bad it tastes.Our tastes may be different than yours, so go ahead and try it. Just don't buy a lot of it without trying it first.

column9: I wanted circus animals, not a polar bear!
column10: I ordered two dozen Barnum's Animal Crackers for my son's first birthday party which was circus themed. I thought these crackers would be perfect favors for the kids because it had circus animals on the box. But to my disappointment, when the boxes arrived they were the blue Holiday box with a polar bear on it. (I'm assuming it's because I ordered them in early January? But still!) Plus, they were stale! Ewww. I wish I would've known that's what I would be receiving otherwise I wouldn't have ordered them. I ended up going to Target to buy the original ones.

column9: Good price, not quite what I ordered
column10: The picture showed the animal crackers I have come to know and love from my oyuth. the animal crackers that came in had the design of winter scene/polar bears on them. (I guess because I ordered them in January?) That would not have bothered me except that I ordered these specifically for a circus animal themed birthday party.

My daughter and I love twizzlers so I decided to buy these smaller packs of Twizzzlers nibs for the both of us.  These Twizzler nibs are the perfect size to put in my daughter's lunch box and perfect size for me to get my Twizzler "fix" without eating too many.
The product description says 100% Juice when the actual can says 15% juice! Pricey bait & switch, don't be fooled like I was duped.

If I could give this product 6 stars, I would! It's light and fresh and delicious--and ALL JUICE. It's great to have my 6 yr old ask for a can of juice instead of begging for pop or another soft drink! Pouch and box drinks aren't big enough...but this is perfect. LOVE it!

My kids love this fizzy soda candy, but it is pretty difficult to find. Each unit comes with six cans of four flavors (two sprint/lemon lime, one crash/orange, one loca cola/cola, and two splash/grape. The best thing about the candy is that it has a nice fizz to it. This year Nov 6, 2012 might be scarier than Oct 31, 2012. Because this must be the flavor Obama supporters are drinking. And that's scary.
the amount paid for what i got was terrible, taste nothing like blackberries more like chem grape

I took this one to work with me today and it just about saved my life. It gave me the much-needed energy to deal with with busiest doctor in our practice. It was light and sweet and painfully refreshing. I had some while it was hot, but by the time I was able to find time for finish my thermos-full, it was cold. Even better! My thermos is vaccum-sealed, so I carefully shook it to mix it up again and downed the rest...oh yes. This will definitely be an amazing addition to my summer smoothies. Never mind that it snowed today. Anyway, the berryness of this was just right, not overly sweet or fake, just amazingly delicious. I'm only familiar with goji berries in tea, but this is the best goji flavored tea I've ever had. To be honest, I kept taking sips and being surprised by how good it was. I have the memory span of a goldfish, so it was like I given a gift of amazing tea every time I took a sip. If you're a berry fan who isn't really into strong greens, this might be the tea to get you into matcha. It wasn't overwhelmingly bitter like some matchas can be, it was just a smooth, tasty sip for a long workshift.I am very impressed with their matcha, I have to say. My wife recently bought me a matcha whisk (so much easier!), but I was making it with a regular whisk in a cereal bowl and I have yet to encounter a clump. Like someone else said about their matchas, it's not flavoring added to cover an inferior product.
These little gummi clown fish are very delicious. They are nice and chewy and have a great taste! I would recommend these to everyone.
These are pretty good little gummies. Suprisingly sweet. They do get hard after about 20 days, so don't order more than you need.Great, tasty product.
Haribo is by far my favorite brand of gummi - so I've been trying out the different flavors. This one is a great combination of the citrus-y flavors.

I ordered several bags of Haribo gummy clown fish expecting soft and flavorful candy, but received gummi candy that was harder than what I could get in the bulk candy bins at the local store.  Very disappointed.  They seemed old and not fresh.

Excellent fine ground coffee that easily bests more well-known brands, it is aromatic and tasty without bitterness. For the price (currently about $5 for 12oz can on an Amazon subscription) you can't beat it.
Love this seasoning, great for any poultry or just to spice up a salad, fantastic customer service and speedy delivery!Will use them again....
I love this stuff. You can put it on anything. I like to put it on shrimp on the grill, it also taste great with roasted pork. This is all the spice you will need for most dishes.

I use this on everything from chicken to roasted potatoes.  You don't need to add anything else!  It really is a wonderful all-around seasoning with just the right amount of salt.  Also, the shipping was fast.Will definitely be buying some more.

Outstanding product. Comparable to the finest local restaurants. My only concern was how to make small quantities. By trial and error, 1/3 cup boiling water to one tablespoon sauce mix. Remove from heat, adjust the amount of sauce as necessary for the thickness desired. Enough for two Eggs Benedict.
I love hollandaise sauce, but this stuff smelled horrible and tasted even worse... by far the worst thing I have ever tasted

If only this excellent product were available in convenient smaller, meal-sized packages!  However, it is well worth measuring it out and storing the larger container (and probably cheaper than retail sizes).

I used a vanilla bean from this package making a vanilla ice cream (from JENI'S SPLENDID ICE CREAMS, an excellent book by the way).  It was fresh and pliable and full of vanilla 'seeds.'  The price is very good (10 vanilla beans for $9!).  I would purchase again.
I like the quality and price of this produce and will buy it again when this order runs out.  I would recommend it to anyone looking for quantity AND quality.

column9: Chiken Poppers are my dog's favorite treat!

Now, I'm a Southern girl through and through, but I'm going to let you in on a little secret...I was born a Yankee. Yup, born in South Bend, Indiana and raised in Michigan until I was ten, when we moved to Tennessee. As a Michigander, I can say with complete confidence that Michigan blueberries are the best blueberries in the entire world. Blueberry season comes around and the state explodes into a world of deliciousness. You can stop at just about any roadside stand and get a ten pound box of blueberries, or you can head out to one of those you-pick places, if you're feeling particularly energetic (or you've got young kids...I'm looking at you, Mom!). Blueberries played a huge role in my childhood. We would snatch up all the blueberries we could during the season and freeze them. Blueberry pancakes, muffins, and cobblers were served all year round, but my favorite blueberry dish was blueberry ice cream. It's a real complicated recipe, y'all ready? You take frozen blueberries and pour cold milk over them. Yup. We're a simple folk.But my love of blueberries has come with me through my travels and life path. So when I spotted a blueberry matcha, my immediate reaction was one of "Um, heck yes, please!" The scent when I open the package is to die for. Oh my goodness, blueberry. In your face, juicy, sweet blueberry. My mouth is watering already.The taste? Oh my. No, no, let me rephrase that. Imagine that I'm George Takei. Oh myyyyyy. Yep, it's that good. George Takei "Oh myyy" inducing good. You know when you go into one of those bath and body stores, and you pick something blueberry up, smell it, and immediately tell your wife you wish you had something that tastes as good as it smells and then you lick it and it just plain doesn't taste as good as you want it to? No? Just me? Well, this matcha tastes the way those soaps smell. Intensely blueberry and incredibly delicious. Juicy is just the word that comes to mind with every sip...it's incredible. I have a few blueberry fans among my friends who will go ape over this.This review brought to you by the letter M and the number 2, which is the number of cups of matcha I've had this morning in an effort to taste them all and get my reviews written...and it's only nine o'clock. Pray for my wife, folks, she's in for a crazy morning.

Yummeh. Blueberries are not my favorite fruit, but when I opened my package I knew I was going to love this just as much as the mango. The scent was strong blueberry! It reminded me of fruit leather, deep purple, chewy, yummy homemade fruit leather by the hippie auntie I used to have. Ah sense memory, I love it so.So I whisked up this delight with the plan to make a couple little lattes - one with soymilk, one with almond and one with regular. I don't know, I just wanted to taste the nuances and find my favorite pairing I guess! Also to see which milk went best with fruit flavoured matcha.Honestly though, I really enjoyed this one sans milk - just with some sugar. (I also experimented with sweetener, and found I prefer sugar over agave for my matcha).The froth! I got a crazy amount of froth with no clumps in this batch. I definitely credit the quality of the matcha for that, because my whisk skills are shoddy at best. That's when I knew I was in for a treat today. This blueberry matcha in particular was very smooth. The berry taste fluctuated from sip to sip - one sip it was a tart not quite ripe berry, the second it was an overly plump, huge juicy ripe berry. The aftertaste was definitely the latter. The flavouring felt more strong in this batch than I expected, but I loved that very much. What a deal :D Again, I love that this company uses natural flavouring - it really shows in the quality of this matcha that it tastes like the berries, not like a candy.With almond milk, the matcha latte tastes almost like a baked good - a blueberry matcha scone or shortbread. The soymilk tasted, well, like soymilk (I think it was my least favorite of the 3). With hot frothed 2% milk it was very sweet. I find hot milk to be naturally sweet, so that probably accounts for it!Last, but certainly not least, I had it as an iced latte. (If you're wondering, with all this crazy matcha energy - I'm learning the ukulele!) I HIGHLY recommend enjoying these fruit flavour matchas from Red Leaf Tea as iced lattes. Oh my goodness! The fruit flavour just comes alive and honestly tasted like a blended real fruit smoothie. Of course, once I get a blended I will be making blended iced drinks 100% - but until then, the ice cubes will suffice.

Each sip of this Matcha was smooth and sweet, even though no sweetener was added. Its thickness made me imagine a sip of blueberry smoothie in my mouth, it even made me feel full after finishing the cup! It is a delightful experience. I also tried it iced which was delicious and refreshing.This Matcha is now permanently invited to live in my tea cabinet. It is a staple that I can't imagine living without now that I have tried it!

In the tea base and flavoring itself, is that the green matcha really nicely stands out even more so than in some of the other flavors I have bought. You know, the more I drink this the more I am loving it for that very reason. You lose none of the blueberry flavor mixing it with a shake, latte, smoothie, whatever... and the green matcha base comes out even MORE! Its like some magical blueberry matcha gnomes came in while I was not looking and sprinkled some mojo on it! Mmmmmm. Such an interesting flavor, as I continue to drink I seem to pick up different subtle nuisances in this tea mixture. I mean I am used to that in non matcha teas, but I have to say this is the first matcha, let alone a flavored matcha I have tasted something slightly different each and every time! Sometimes its just really fresh and refreshING, other sips I get more sweet, some sips I am getting far more of the matcha base with that vegetal buttery sensation, other times I get peppery note even! Its strange, and enjoyable.
