These are a great product.  My extremely picky pug surprised me when she actually ate one of these and wanted more.  I have spent so much money on different products and Smokehouse are the one for my entire house.  I would recomment this product for your pets.  They are about the size of a piece of popcorn.
Great product and shipping! Hopefully these aren't made in China as I will no longer buy this product if it is. There are plenty of US and local made products to choose from that are safe.

My 21 lb mixed breed who can (and does) eat just about anything had a bit of trouble with the size of the Poppers -- a bit too big for him to handle. If they made a smaller size, I know he'd gobble them up. I passed the bag on to a friend who has larger dogs and they devoured them.

I had a small bag of Chicken Poppers that I took on a trip with us.  Dogs can get pretty finacky in a strange environment but the chicken poppers really settled her down.  And they had such a satisfying crunch when she ate them!  I had no idea where to get more, but then I found them on Amazon!  THanks for a great product!
We have used this product for more than 12 months, but this is the first time that we ordered it in the 1 pound tub.Thank you for making it available in that bigger container.

column9: Chiken Poppers are my dog's favorite treat!
column10: I love all Smokehouse products, and I know they are completely safe for my dog.  They aren't messy and are great rewards and treats for my dog.

column9: Lili's favorite time of the day from Amazon.com.......Smokehouse chicken poppers treats
column10: My little 1 year old Lili, who is part mini Dachshund and we think Chihuahua, she absolutely loves these Smokehouse treats, before this product came along, they  ate different treats and had stomach issues, got fatter and sometimes just did not actually eat it. Lili likes to sit up to get one, gives kisses to get one and loves it so much when I roll her one across the living room floor, this yummy chicken poppers makes have a fun too, she chases it down, throws it in the air and her tails wags intensely - it becomes an eatable "ball" game.We have used this treat to teach her to go out to do her business since she was 2 months old and now as soon as we come inside from a successful potty run, she sits near the container and stares at it patiently and lady like, with one paw on the container we use until we give her one, then she is a happy little camper, she also has found sneaky and absolutely incredible and creative tactics to actually steal the one that belongs to her kennel mate Chachi, he is 14 loves the treats too but likes to savor his, of course we replace his stolen one if Lili is succesful in getting his, He does protect it watchfully as best he can to prevent it being stolen, and he will walk around with it in his mouth until ready to much it down.They both love it and we love giving it to them, great product... Thank goodness Amazon.com has it on their site with free shipping living too a huge bonus in Hawaii is sometimes a challenge to get great stuff at a reasonable price.... shipping is free so we can afford to buy from Amazon.com  Thank you so much!!!!!love it in Hawaii, Lili and Chachi's "mom"
I have three small Maltipoos and this is one treat that all three love, which is unusual for them!  I like the fact that it is healthy and I don't feel guilty giving it to them.

column9: My dog rates this as a top 10
column10: These are excellent treats for the smaller breeds.  I recommend these highly to those training pups or older dogs as well.  Thanks for offering these in your catalog!!

Every night my dogs each get 3 chicken poppers.  One of them likes to take the treat from my hand while the other likes to catch his in the air.  I haven't used these for training rewards yet, but I think they would be perfect.  My dogs would probably willingly walk a tightrope across the Grand Canyon for one!
My dogs LOVE these, great for just a treat, or for training. Low is fat and calories, which I worry about as my dogs tend to gain weight easily.I would recomend these to everyone.

column9: The perfect treat for even the pickiest of eaters!
column10: I have two min pins that absolutely love these chicken poppers! The second they hear the resealable bag opening they run to me at full speed. I use these as training treats and give out way more than I should in a day. Nonetheless, I've been feeding them to my dogs for a little over a year now and neither of them have lost their love for chicken poppers. The only bit of advice I have to offer is watch out for the size of the poppers. I have a larger dog who chows them down like m&ms, while my smaller dog treats it like a jawbreaker. Hes able to eventually chew it up, but it does take him much longer (which is a plus for most dog owners!) For the smaller one, I try to pick out the smaller poppers. You definitely can't go wrong with these treats though. They are made of the best quality and your dogs can vouch for that!

column9: SMOKEHOUSE HAS THE HIGHEST QUALITY DOG TREATS - ALL 3 OF OUR DOGS LOVE THEM !!
column10: WE ARE VERY PLEASED WITH ALL THE SMOKEHOUSE DOG TREATS - WE HAVE TRIED SEVERAL AND THEY ARE VERY HIGH QUALITY AND OUR DOGS REALLY LOVE ALL OF THEM!!  WE HAVE FOUND QUALITY - HEALTHY TREATS FOR OUR DOGS - THANKS SMOKEHOUSE !!!
The poppers are the favorite of my dog and her friends.  At the end of every long walk, I give them three poppers each.  They always behave well when they know a popper is coming.

column9: Good, but not as good as the chicken chips or strips
column10: Neither one of my dogs were very enthusiastic about these.  My bigger shar pei ate them, but she will eat anything.  My friends pit didn't like them and neither did my smaller shar pei

Wow does my dog Pie LOVE these treats!! I was so happy to find them on Amazon. I love the fact that these treats are all natural. I'm careful about what I give Pie, especially after the last recall.And putting artificial food coloring in dog food has to be one of the most idiotic things that a company can do. All natural is the way to go!!
My Lhasa and Shih Tsu, the 2 most finicki dogs I know, love it. Thanks!

I think they are absolutely perfect for training. They are easy to throw and deliver quickly in training distance, particularly in utility obedience go outs. They dog can hear them hit and find them quickly so there is no searching for crumbs etc. They also fit in my dogs kong-like spaceship and he can entertain himself for 15 mins working to fish them out.They also hold up well for most of the year inside the car or a tracking bag. I can also feel them well with mittens on inside my coat in the winter. Very big plus this winter training in the northeast this winter. Poppers also float. this is a huge asset for training water dog work. also the dog can smell them well enough to find them in the water.I love the product I find the availability needs to be improved. I prefer the round ball shape and that is the variety that is hardest to find.!!I am going to try them in the treat in train next.Lisa  NJ
This is a healthy low fat snack for dogs and a good value too!

column9: Our Girls' Favorite Treat by Far
column10: Our Portuguese Water Dogs, Onda and Lilly, love these treats. They get lots of goodies, but they love the chicken poppers best. Nothing else gets their tails wagging quite the same way.

My dogs are occasionally picky about their treats, but whenever I pull out the Smokehouse Chicken Poppers their eyes light up and they will do anything to get them.  They will turn their noses up at soft treats and go for the Chicken Poppers instead.  An excellent training treat too.  They are wonderful.

column9: My cat won't eat anything else... that says it all! :)
column10: I received TWO (2) 24-pack boxes of this product; not the 12-pack as pictured. The price is better than I get at the grocery store (Amazon Prime member).I've tried other brands of cat food, even the more expensive "healthier" brands; I even try the regular Whiskas. But, the Tender Bites is kitty's favorite! I can't get him to eat any other kind anymore. If I try, he refuses and turns to his dry cat food until I clean the dish and refresh with Tender Bites!

I buy this products occasionally for my 5 cats, since they really like the taste.  I think it's a very good product, it's not filled with too many fillers, and it doesn't smell too strong. The biggest downfall with all of these Whiskas pouches is that they are messy to dispense, and it is very difficult to get all of the product out of the pouch.  I find I get the gravy all over my hands, not the biggest issue, but ewww.

We have six indoor cats, and they all have different likes.  Our siamese cat will only eat the Whiskas Tender Bites chicken.  That is the only flavor she likes, and it has to be the tenderbites.  She usually just likes the juice but will sometimes eat some of the food as well.  Why she only likes this one, I don't know.  Amazon is the only place I know to get the box of 24 in the chicken only.  I rated it five stars because she likes it!

My cat is not a huge fan. Sure, she'll lap up the gravy, but leaves the little meat-like bits as dry as a bone. It feels like saving money, but not if your cat is only gonna eat cornstarch gravy and turn her nose up at the meat by-products. It's probably fine for a grocery-store food, but a better quality food will make your cat happier and maybe healthier. Also I can't imagine gravy has got the nutritional content my cat needs.Pouches seem like a great idea compared to messy, annoying cans, until you can't figure out a way to get the stuff out of the package without getting gravy all over your hands.I switched to Merrick cat foods and my cat is happier--she doesn't leave lots of uneaten bits.

To all you cats out there,I love this food, my pet keepers feed it to me 4 times a day, I meow in protest if it's late. If asked I'll even sit on command so I can eat Whiskas morning, noon, and night!Thank you for keeping them well supplied.Stella(typed by the Keeper)

I purchased this as an option for my cat since he only eats chicken. This is a much drier and diced product (no juice) as compared to the other Whiskas products in a pouch. However, the pouch is quite stuff, so if you cat likes it, he will surely get enough to eat from this pouch. Also, the picture does not look like the product I was shipped.

Our older cat (14 years old) would only lick the juice from the bowl and let the chunks alone.  I've read since then that cats are carnivores and therefore should not be fed a grain-based diet.  So many cat foods on the market have grains as the main components, and so you have to look for products labeled "grain free".  We found some at our local feed store.  Maybe our first cat would have lived longer if we'd fed him better.

Even my most finicky cat LOVED this flavor.  The bowls are spotless after their meal!  I haven't been able to find this flavor by itself in the store, only in variety packs, and my cats don't like all the other flavors in the variety packs.  I'm willing to pay a little more to get a box of food I know they love!

This used to be my cat's favorite food.  But a couple of months ago, they changed the formula and now my cat won't touch it, and I know why.  Each of the four flavors says "in juices" after it.  But since the formula changed, there is absolutely no juice in this food.  The food comes out in one big dry clump.  The juice was my cat's favorite part.  I'll still by the other Whiska's flavors, but not this one.
Walmart.com has this for $4.88 for a box of 12 packs.  It was even cheaper at my local grocery store.  Amazon is ripping us off.
This is a Repeat Buy for me. My cats eat these and its cheaper and easier to buy in bulk.
I love being able to order this item online and have it delivered. The price is amazing and not having to worry about running out of food for the furry foster babies is much appreciated!

If you subscribe, you save and you don't have to trek to the store to buy these bulky boxes. I thought purchased enough for a 2 months supply but no, my cats must not be felines because they have appetites like pigs. ;) I have to change my subscription so that they deliver more frequently.

I sometimes get notes from my cat Steve regarding his food, litter, toys etc. and I post them here. - - I know, its weirdDear Grocery Lady,Please don't think because I am of the feline persuasion that I did not see and understand the "buy 1 get 1 free" coupon I saw for this terrible food. In case you didn't get the hint that I don't like this and you should never bring it again, I threw up in your shoe as gentle reminder.You know I have a delicate digestive system and a discerning palate.  Stick to the cuisine I like....don't go rogue again!Sincerely,Steve-the-cat  ,,,^. . ^,,,~

I am very pleased with my shipment of wiskas tender bits turkey with giblets. I have been unable to purchase the box of all one flavor. I have tried to special order this at my local store and been unsuccessful on several occations. purchasing this through amazon.com I am able to get my cats favorite food on a regular bases.  thank you amazon.com

Although I like the convenience of the food and my cats like the taste the 24/$15 is more than 50% over what I pay even at Petsmart. I was going for the convenience of monthly shipments, but the premium price is too high.

column9: Love the product - question the price
column10: I love the tender bites as do my senior cats (17 & 18 yrs old). But I do question the price, which is a unusual.  I get the 24 count variety pack for $9.49 at my local Food Lion grocery store.  I would expect a 48 count pack to be no more than double that price (18.98) so $28.11 would seem a bit high.  Unless of course  48 means 48 - 12 pack boxes.  Then the description needs  a little work.

The Cheesiest of Cheez. It's tangy and tastes a bit like American cheese. A thick, smooth paste you can put on crackers. It also comes in very handy for people who don't know how to cook. With this, you can hide that fact. At least long enough to make your special someone one very easy meal. They never need to know it started with Cheez Whiz.You'll need 1 box of noodles, 8 ounces of shredded cheese, a mix of Mexican and Italian and you can honestly call it your 7 cheese pasta dish. You don't say macaroni and cheese when it's 7 cheeses! and a half a jar of Cheez Whiz. To make it really fancy, also get a bag of frozen broccoli florets and maybe a can of chicken. If that's not too much cooking. If it is, skip them.Cook the noodles according to the directions on the bag. Strain them.If you're adding broccoli, put it in the strainer before straining the noodles. Then you're steaming it at the same time. Leave them in the strainer while you put the Cheez Whiz and cheese into the same pan. Melt them together stirring constantly. If it looks too thick, throw in a bit of milk, or water if you just don't have any milk. Put the noodles back in and mix it all up good. Add canned chicken if you'd like. Serve with a bit of extra cheese on top, or maybe some toast with butter and a sprinkle of garlic. Think of some good name for it. "Oh honey, I wanted to treat you to my special Pasta Discursive, it has a 7 cheese sauce, chicken breast and steamed broccoli."Nobody has ever guessed the secret ingredient is Cheez Whiz when I make this for them. Then for myself later, I eat the other half with Nabisco-Ritz Crackers or heat it and serve it over tortilla chips, the empty wide mouthed jar makes a good place to keep loose change or small hardware.

What a scam!This was nothing more than the regular Kraft cheese whiz you get off the shelf today- and for more money!! NOT the original recipe. I got my hopes up but was duped.  Kraft continues to cheapen their products and they have lost me as a customer.

I'm a popcorn lover!  I have diverticulitis and really shouldn't eat popcorn at all but these little kernels have a hull that almost disappears when it pops. I have very little to no trouble eating this popcorn.NOW the best part.  It has a wonderful flavor and texture.  This jar has a lot of popcorn in it and is well worth the money.I recommend popping your popcorn in a Whirlypop corn popper.

For the price, I was expecting a larger amount for some reason.  (This will be a gift, so I can't report on taste, but I thought I would mention the quantity aspect in case another customer is like me.)  The online description says 2 lbs, but the label says 28.35 oz.  Close, but not the same.Anyway, the container is less than 6" tall, not too much bigger than one of those chunker flashlight batteries.  Now you know.
Very nice corn, lovely texture. needs a little more oil than usual to get it popping.

Every now and then I'll try a different popcorn, but haven't found one I like better than Crimson Jewell Red.  (In fact, I've ended up feeding some of the others to the backyard birds.) Flavor is rich and satisfying.  I like the convenient package, too.  It has a nice shape and is easy to grab even from my highest shelf; large opening and lid. Prompt delivery from vendor.

I have been buying the fireworks popcorn from Amazon and have been very happy with it. I bought this to try something different. First of all I was disappointed by the rather small container for the price, but then I was very disappointed by the taste. I use canola oil in an electric popper. This popcorn had a slight taste of insecticide. I tasted it in every batch from the jar. It was a very distinctive and unpleasant taste.
Popcorn has no favor.  It is too bland and doesn't have a taste, expecially if you compare it to the black crimson.
Very tasty, and as has already been said, as close to actually being hull-less as you'll find. It has a distinctive flavor, very nice. This is as good as any corn I've popped.

Omaha Steaks' Franks are really quite delicious but I could not find out what meats are put into them so I only buy them on rare occasions.  Their web site is really geared for pure beef products with no explanations for products of multiple origins.  I know my sister has multiple GI problems but she can eat one of these every once in a while without a stomach upset.  She does complain of the salt content though.  If you don't care how these hotdogs are made then I highly recommend them for great flavor.

My husband bought some of this for me at Christmas - to say it is delicious is a tremendous understatement!  This is absolutely THE best huckleberry taffy I've ever had!  We used to buy huckleberry taffy in a store close to where we grew up, but living far away now, I'm so happy that he found a place to order an old favorite!

column9: Lesser evil for less of me!!  These things rock!!
column10: I discovered Lesser Evil snacks about 6 months ago when I started a serious diet.  Being a salty, crunchy addict, I was eager to try anything to help me avoid temptation.  The Krinkle Sticks are fantabulous.  You get the satisfaction of a crunchy snack, tastiness and, most important for me - size.  The servings are so generous you can't believe the bang for your buck.  Unlike the 100 calorie snack packs popping up all over - which normally are teeny tiny - these snacks last.  When I'm done eating them, I feel like I've had a real treat.  I even have my two teenage sons hooked.  For the price - great value.  In case you are curious - I have lost 30 pounds in the last 6 months and Lesser Evils have been on my diet plan the whole time.  Highly, highly recommend.

We have been buying these chips for awhile now.  My son who is on a gluten/casein free diet is able to eat these and just loves them.  The taste is excellent and they are not as bad for you as traditional potato chips.  I would recommend them to anyone...they do have other flavors such as sour cream and onion and hot if you want to try the different ones.

Tasty, salt is just right. Dairy Free and Made with Non Gluten IngredientsThey taste kind of like a multi grain chip, but the flavor is milder.relativly low fat and low salt makes this a great snack for the diet and health consciencePurchased 11/2009 expiration date on the package is 10/2010

I love these!  They taste great and are much healthier for you than regular chips. The small bags are perfect for the lunchbox or snacks.  They work great for my Weight Watchers eating plan.  Give them a try!

For these all natural potato chips! They are tasty with just the right amount of salt and flavors don't overwhelm like with the PopChips. After seeing the post on yeast extract in PopChips decided to switch to these and I am very happy with the choice.
I've tried a few Lesser Evil products and have to say, everything is pretty high quality, good tasting. And when you read the nutrition info, you don't hate yourself! Great snacks.
I love this snack! It packs a ton of flavor in a low-calorie and healthy snack! Great for kids, great for adults too!

These are still very tasty, but since the last time I ordered them, they seem to have more of a salt and vinegar taste.  Will order again because I do like them, just wanted others to be aware they have a slight vinegar taste.

column9: Not additive as most snack foods but but a good snack
column10: Taste a bit like Styrofoam but then again did not think it was going to taste like the best potato chips I have every eaten and I have eaten some really good chips. If you are looking for snack food that tastes good without being self indulgent then this product will fill the bill.
great low calorie taste treat...if you love potato products this is well worth it.  Salt content is lower than most other products. Highly recommended,,,,,

column9: Excellent love them more than regular chips.
column10: I love the krinkle sticks. They are better than regular chips.Do you have any specials on a dollar amount to get FREE SHIPPING?I buy them in RI from a nutritionist. and with the item amount and S&H it is almost cheaper to buy here in RI. If I can't get a DEAL I may buy them from RI.Edna ORourkesaltaire59@verizon.net

column9: Too good, but watch the bag weight
column10: I too love the Krinkle Sticks.  I order them thru Amazon on a monthly basis at a great price.  I only have one complaint.  I noticed that one of my bags looked fuller than usual, so I got out my kitchen scale and it weighed 1.8 ounces.  So I then weighed several more bags, and each bag weighed a different amount, and all were over the stated weight on the bag.  So, if you are diligent in counting calories, it would probably be a good idea to weigh your bags so you know exactly how many calories you are really taking in.  I just separated them into individual Baggies weighing one ounce, or 1.2 ounces and they stayed just as fresh and I can be sure I know how many calories I am really eating.

I enjoy these Krinkle Sticks. Before ordering I was a little worried but they taste very good.I am a big time snacker but I needed a healthier choice. I read the reviews and ordered a box. The bag was definitely packed with enough sticks not to feel deprived. I felt the saltiness was just right.Of course it's not like eating those high calorie high fat chips but it's a good enough substitute for me.

column9: Awesome and only 2 Weight Watcher points!!
column10: These are a great snack for those of us watching our weight! The entire bag is only 2 Weight Watcher points and is a decent sized serving! I've bought boxes of these and they are a favorite in our house...even for the thin! I'd give more stars if I could...great snack!

O.K., I'm a snack addict and decided it was time to check out some healthier foods. After reading the reviews on this product I decided to try them.I thought at first,  what a waste of money ! They were bland and just tasted like freeze dried french fries. I tried them again....thinking of the money I had spent. Hmmm, not bad. They started to appeal to me. I eat them in lieu of potato chips with my sandwich and before I know it, they are gone! Eating healthy is a priority for me and these help.

column9: These are low calorie and taste amazing!
column10: The Krinkle Sticks are for sale at Smoothie stores and cost 1.09 a bag so this is a great deal.  Also, they taste fantastic!

While these will never be mistaken for fast-food french fries, they are quite yummy and oh-so-much healthier! The name really says it all: Lesser Evil. My husband liked them too, and he hasn't been eating exclusively diet food lately like I have. There is a bit of a...somewhat "powdered" aspect (that's pretty much what they are) and there's definitely a residue on your teeth after eating them, but I'm glad I bought them and will enjoy them as an occasional treat.

These things are great!  They taste somewhere between french fries and potato chips, but they are way healthier.  A good sized snack is only a little over 100 calories.  I brought some to the office and they have been a hit. I can't recommend them enough!

These are really good and have a great flavor--there is a little more than one serving in each bag, but I usually don't eat the whole bag in one sitting.  Low calorie and low fat also...would buy these again for sure!!

I was really surprised at how these tasted when I received them.  I bought them for my kids to have a little healthier snack in their lunch, but I have been eating  them!!  They taste like french fries to me without the grease, and only 110 calories. Love it!!
These taste awesome.  They have great crunch, saltiness and flavor.  It's nice to know there's a snack that doesn't have all of the unheathly additives.

These Krinkle Sticks are the best! They are delicious! Even though the entire bag is a bit over one serving (1.2), the calorie count is 110. And there are a lot of Krinkle Sticks in the 1.7 ounce bag. I plan to order more and try some of the other flavors. I would highly recommend them to anyone trying to ward off a craving for something crunchy.

As always, my 3 yr old grandson, who has Celiac disease, LOVES this product! Some gluten free products have an odd texture that 3 yr olds don't care for, but these "crackers" are a hit every time! Thank you Lesser evil for making snacks that can let my grandson have safe treats!

I can't believe everyone who rated these didn't give them 5 stars!  I always have these on hand, and everyone who I let try them NEEDS to know where they can get them. I  have never met anyone who didn't love them!  I like the sour cream and onion flavor as well!  What a great healthy, low fat snack...and there are so many in the bag!! YUMMY!!! 5+++ stars all the way!

When I first opened the bag, I caught a whiff of the smell and it smelled like a mix of plastic and cardboard.. not very appealing. But it tastes fine. It's no potato chip but it's a pretty good runner up. There is a good potato flavor. It reminds me of those rice cake snacks but in a krinkly french fry shape. It really does satisfy my salty crunchy fix though.

These things are great. They remind me very much of French fries in look and flavor. They are good and crunchy and seem to be more substantial and satisfying than the same amount of chips. They have fewer calories to boot.

This is the best tasting, satisfying,LesserEvil Krinkle Sticks Classic SeaSalt, 1.2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24) low calorie alternative for potato chips or anything crunchy & salty on the market today.  I will keep them on hand.
These Krinkle sticks are a great way to get your crunchy, salty snack fix without feeling guilty!
This product was recommended by Hungry Girl as a great alternative to high fat potato chips.  We tried them and they are great!  Crunchy and great tasting. Low fat, low calorie and only one WW point.
Loved these Krinkle sticks.  They are low in fat and taste good.  They also were very fresh.

column9: Healthier potato chips that taste great
column10: My husband is a potato chip junkie.  Rather than nag him about fried food and deny him his beloved potato chips, I buy LesserEvil Krinkle Sticks for him.  They are baked, not fried, and have a lot less fat and fewer calories than regular potato chips.  Plus, my husband loves them and actually eats them!

column9: Terribly dry - surprised by good reviews
column10: While I agree that these snacks are a healthy alternative to potato chips.  And I will concede that the flavor is good.  The texture is unbearable.  These are so horrifyingly dry that I could barely choke them down.  They require tons of liquid and stick in your molars.I was very disappointed and will not purchase these again.If you need a crunchy snack - try the Kettle cooked chips - much better flavor and texture if not quite as good for you.  Still better than potator chips.

The following ages in our household tried these "french fry" sticks: 44, 37, 18, 10, 5 and none particularly liked them.  They were just very bland and did not really taste very potato-like to us.  The 17 year old thought they tasted like potato and pepper and liked them.
Wow! This spice is out of this world. It's tasty, aromatic and tenderizes the meat. You'll love it-I do!! I can't wait to order more.

The apple flavored candy is pretty weak and low quality. My initial reaction was to instead break up the candy bar into several servings due to the quality of the candy. The ants in the candy were neat and interesting, with a smokey flavor not very much unlike that of chewing on popcorn kernels. Would definitely try other ant-based products!

Years ago we read about Coltibuono in one of Ed Giobbi's books. He is an artist who loves to cook, had to cook in early starving days. Yes, these oils are not cheap and we don't waste a drop. But boy, do they have flavor! Save up and try it once in your life.  One of these days, I'd like to try a true 'fresh-squeezed' olive oil from a known grower.  I imagine it'd be like eating a garden-grown tomato instead of one from a supermarket.

column9: Best Olive Oil on the Market
column10: I have become a big fan of this fantastic olive oil from Tuscany.The smooth buttery flavor taste is a great addition to any recipeor salad dressing.

column9: Fine smell that makes me want use in all my cooking
column10: The smell is not like anything from the store,smells clean and somewhat like freshly cut grass. I don't know if that makes it healthier to use ,but it just seems like it is.  If you drink it you can taste  nothing,but when you swallow it ,it has a mild burn  with zero after taste. I use too much of this stuff when I cook because I marinate things in it,then dump more on my food. I also use it on my skin,if you can't drink it,you shouldn't put it on your body,the skin is the most important part of your body. I give this oil a ten out of ten,two thumbs up.

column9: The Heavyweight Champion of Olive Oil.
column10: OK first off, this wonderful oil is not associated with the Badia Spice Company.They are a great outfit, but not affiliated with this Tuscan estate.Golden yellow with hearty green nuances, this oil has a balanced fruity flavorwith a hint of toasted nuts. The distinct peppery sensation produced at the backof your throat on the oil's finish is an attribute of oil whose olive harvest wasyoung and fresh. This oil is very rich and is perfect for dressing salads, meats,pasta, soup and particularly with your favorite breads.Sounds expensive but its not, worth every penny.

If you are old enough to remember the wonderful crunch of coconut with peanut butter in Zagnut before everything became chocolate coated, here they are, still.  If not, you really should try them.  The great mystery is why they are no longer available except for a few places in the South (naturally).

I spent a long time trying to find these Healthy Edibles for puppies.  They are good for puppies 3 months and older.  I really needed something to keep my puppy busy during our meal times.  However, most products (even puppy products) are for puppies 6 months and older.I was able to find these (after searching high and low) at Pet Smart.  I found them after I had already ordered on Amazon.  These are expensive on Amazon, so shop around your area first.

My puppy absolutely loves these treats!  In the product listing, it claims they are a good alternative to rawhide chews.  I definitely don't agree with that, as these last nowhere near as long as a rawhide.  Nonetheless they are an excellent occasional treat.  My pup goes nuts when she sees me opening the bag and can barely contain her joy once she's chewing on it.I have a chihuahua/dachshund mix--so quite "petite"--but she's a vigorous chewer and can polish one of these off in about 10 minutes or less depending on how elated she is.  I usually only give her half of a chew, to make the bag last longer and since I think a whole one is a bit much for a dog that weighs less than 10 lbs!

I recently got 2 west highland white terrier puppies. I love the nylabone company, but was worried about the regular nylabones, or getting them rawhides during their teething stage.  I came across these at Petsmart. I am very concerned about what goes into their bodies, I always read the ingriedient list. I was very pleased that they offer flavors like lamb and apple and turkey and sweet potato that are better for their digestive system than bacon flavor, or roast beef, etc.They are only 2 months old and teething like crazy. I love that they prefer these to my toes and fingers :) They gobble these things up. Which makes me wish they had these available in the larger sizes. Also, they leave tiny bits behind. Maybe my dogs just like to chew it and not eat the little bits. They are also easy to twist in half so if you have two dogs, they can share it, instead of fight over it! Great Product...But kind of expensive. Less than a dollar a piece for the non puppy healthy edibles, but over a dollar a piece for the puppy version. But it is cheaper than having to buy new furniture, cables or shoes!
Nylabone Healthy Edibles Puppy Chews, Turkey and Sweet Potato, Petite, 8-Count PouchThis product has given my puppies diarrhea.  Avoid it.

Our four month old puppy loves these chews.  It keeps her busy (completely indistractable) for about five to ten minutes which is good for her!  They do not seem to upset her tummy at all either which is great.  They are a little pricey but that isn't really an issue when it comes to the happiness and well-being of our little pup! :)

The Nylabone Healthy Edibles are a great product that Puppy loves. The Lamb and apple flavor is a real treat for her and she really enjoys them.

This is a GREAT product!  Steaks are delicious with this rub.  I put it on about 4 hours before grilling.  The spices are delicious and penetrate the meat.  I highly recommend this product.  Because I couldn't find it in any stores near me, I ordered it on-line and found the company very responsive. Should be five stars.
The best steak seasoning on the market today! Can't enjoy steak without this seasoning! Rivals longhorns cowboy steak which is amazing! Will buy this product for life!!!!!

The product that I have bought in stores and love had lager chuncks of spices, this was not the same product that I have recomended and used over the past years. Also the top had come off during shipping and half of it had spilled out. VERY disapointed!!!!

I am a Chaga lover and was looking for a pure product to enjoy.  I stumbled upon this tea while looking for pure Chaga drops and decided to try a box. When it arrived I brewed a cup and noticed one tea bag was strong enough to easily make two cups of dark strong Chaga brew. If you have used the pure drops before you can tell that the tea is a rich deep color full of Chaga, a powerful antioxidant.  I have been enjoying Chaga in pure liquid form for years but now love the tea even more.  The price is right for me because I get 40 cups from 20 bags. It's also very versatile for me because I make iced tea and drink it throughout the day. A huge savings over the drops with the same amount of health benefits. My sister tried mine and had to have it, and so did my neighbor, so of course, I have already ordered several more.  The fast shipping and excellent communication from Sayan makes it an even sweeter deal.

I've been currently taking the wildcrafted siberian chaga extract. The extract is more powerful compared to the tea, but the tea is more convenient to take as I travel a lot. I take both (extract/tea) everyday and my health improved tremendously! I've never gotten a flu or cold since I've taken it. I have more physical energy throughout the day!

I've been drinking this tea for a few weeks. First bought it because I had a sore throat, heard Chaga is good for that. I have to say, it felt really good on my throat, and even helped my cough a little bit. I like the herbal, slightly chocolate-y taste of the tea. I personally don't add any sugar to it, I think it tastes better by itself. Overall - great buy, would recommend to others - it works as advertised.

I was sooo excited to get this damn tea! I have been researching Chaga for some time and it's amazing. Tea was wonderful but what really floored me... was the motherf@$&ing hand written thank you note I got from the owner!!! ::special::

You're better off buying a powder and making your own tea. These tea bags are overpriced, not to mention that ALL of the reviews are bogus, and more than likely from the people working for or related to the manufacturer. Just check their other reviews (if there are any).Chaga is a potent mushroom, but get the real deal and make sure it's organic.

column9: Bland flavor compared to other Cannellini
column10: I found these beans to be nothing special. I found their flavor to be boring and bland compared to the best of other Cannellini beans I've purchased in bulk from health food stores. On the positive side, the beans were big, plump, and fairly healthy (many had crosswise deep cracks, which was not good) and seemed fresh (purchased 12/2009 and had "best by" date of 9/2011). They cooked quickly, which is a sign of freshness, and they tasted fresh.But their flavor was bland; some nice mineral notes, but just not very "beany." There were also some slightly off earthy notes, which I did not care for. I also found their texture to be a bit grainy and not very creamy.I cooked them once with an overnight cold soak in a salt brine (as recommended by Cook's Illustrated to tenderize skins, which really works) and once with a one-hour hot soak in brine (Cook's Illustrated's recommended quick method). One time I cooked them on a very slow simmer to keep the beans whole (which does sacrifice some creaminess), and once at a strong simmer to let the bean skins break open to maximize creaminess. But even this latter method failed to make them creamy -- unlike most white beans. I cook lots of dry beans and have many years of experience cooking beans, so how these beans turned out had nothing to do with how I cooked them. The best of other white beans I've had cook up wonderfully creamy and flavorful. These beans were just far from the best.

Bob's Red Mill Cannellini Beans worked well for making cassoulet recipe that was in "Cook's" magazine. Used the whole bag and mulitplied recipe by 1.5 and made enough to serve a small army. Beans were uniform in size, almost no waste, flavor was wonderful.

Cannellini beans become like a creamy soup after they are cooked.Although I love lentils, pinto beans and black eyed peas; I can't compare the creamy taste of cannellini beans with them.Since I can not find it in the grocery stores, I am glad that amazon.com carries this product.When you soak cannellini beans all come out fine, however with navy/small white beans i end up throwing away a handful because some of them won't absorb the water and stay flat.

Maybe I'm doing something wrong, but every time I make these, they crack more than any other bean I've ever made and they turn out dry in consistency.  Otherwise, they have a great flavor and are from a great brand.

I don't do canned beans as I prefer my beans without BPA, plus it's just so much cheaper to cook them myself.  I cook a pound at a time and freeze in 2-cup portions, which is pretty close to a "can" in recipes.Cannellini became my favorite legume as soon as I tasted them.I can't find dried cannellini beans in any of the groceries around here, so this is darned handy. So getting them in bulk from Amazon works well for me.
These beans are delicious and the value is great! Recommended for any health enthusiast looking for a high-quality bean...you know who you are.

I first heard of these beans on The Doctor Oz show.  They were unavailable at the local grocers.  I found them on Amazon and now send them as gifts to people I care about.  Saute onions, bell pepper, plenty garlic in olive oil or coconut oil.  Let them carmelize...then follow the package directions.  I added one pound of smoked sausage (Cajun Style) and let the beans cook for nearly two hours.  Serve over brown rice.  Good enough for a company meal. This is an Amazon verified purchase.

column10: These dried beans are better to cook for yourself rather than purchasing canned beans and having to rinse all the salt from them. I set up the subscribe and save and it is a good deal for us.

After searching for Cannellini beans in my local supermarkets, I finally gave up and turned to the internet. I was happy to find them on Amazon. I have, so far, made two excellent dishes with these beans. I look forward to purchasing more in the future.

The quality control at Bob's Red Mill seems really good. I cannot compare the taste with other beans' but I am quite pleased with Bob's Red Mill's.
Cannot buy this product locally.  Quality was excellent.  Each package is enough for two plus meals for two people so it was worth the shipping.
This is coriander. It's well-sealed and it seems to have kept its strength nicely. All the jars are individually sealed.

This will keep the water from stinking. I also recommended putting a drop of liquid food in every month or as needed to keep them nice and green. They do take some weekly maintenance but they will live a long time and look great. Hope this helps!

I received my bamboo in a timely manner.  The bamboo was packed very well and the place I ordered from sent me an email educating me a little more on how to take care of the bamboo. The prices are very reasonable as well. That was very nice and I really appreciated the notion.  I had a few questions that were answered in the email.  I will be ordering more very soon!!!

I purchased this bunch last year, and was extremly pleased with the quality and cost. The price is unbeatable, Ikea sells the same thing for $1.50 to $2 bucks a stem.  I cant wait for this years shipment!!

column9: Truly Cures or Helps Most Stomach Problems
column10: A miracle in my life! I tried this out of desperation, and it really does work. Over 20% of Americans suffer from Stomach problems and Doctors truly cannot help.  They will give you tests, limited diets, medicines and generally albeit Innocently...they do not help.  This is not weird Health food, it truly works.  Plus it is good. Read up for yourself and you will understand how incredibly simple and logical this is.  Plus it is delicious.  I take a couple lg teaspoons /day, am careful about what I eat and have experienced an amazing recovery.  Try it yourself, you can't loose.

We have spent a number of weeks in NZ over the past 5 years and discovered this honey - as well as hiking through Manuka bush country.  There is something to this "active" honey that my wife swears helps her allergies.  On top of that I swear by it because it is so darn good on toast.  It is win-win!!

This honey is delicious in tea, although I've found that I have to use quite a bit to get it sweet enough. I have some acne scars on my face, and redness. I've put some of this honey (mixed w/ a little tea tree essential oil)on that area of my face and I've noticed a difference in the redness and the scars seem to be fading a bit. Pretty good stuff. Also try Garden of Life Lehua Honey which I have found to have some healing properties as well (plus I think it tasted better...)

My oldest daughter is very into natural healing and products. She suggested Manuka honey. It has a very good taste and can be used externally as well. My youngest daughter had a place on her arm we applied the honey, the next day it was completely gone. We also did this on a cat, who was having skin problems.This is an excellant product!!

column9: Wonderful Flavor, Unsure of Manuka Properties
column10: This honey doesn't have a UMF rating for some reason. New Zealand is strict about how manuka honey is labeled, and Comvita sells other honeys that do have a UMF rating, so I'm uncertain why this one is labeled "certified" and "active" without having an actual UMF number or certification anywhere on it. That being said, this is probably the best testing honey I've ever tasted. I love to spread it on toast, as several others here have mentioned, or mix it into hot tea (PG Tips, of course). I'm not sure if this has helped with my mild GERD, but some of the GERD issues I have seem lessened since I started regularly consuming this honey. I also tried it as a mask for my face and I didn't notice any particular improvement, but maybe my skin was in better shape than I realized. YMMV, of course. Regardless of its purported magical properties, the taste is incredibly delicious and this could be a staple in many pantries. My husband at first said it tasted "mediciny" to him, but later grew to love it it. To me it tastes like a spoonful of heaven.

I have been using this on some recent surgical incisions & also some scars that are more than 2 years old.  The honey seems to be helping.  Also a friend had an ulcer on her lower leg & she is also impressed with the healing.  We have been using this several weeks.  It's not an overnight cure, but there is definite improvement.
Just bought it. I have stomach problems and I use it when I start to feel pain. It takes it away. I do not eat it all the time as it is very sweet and have not adjusted to that yet.

I have ordered Comvita honey for about two years and have always been satisfied with the product.  Recently, I ordered this product and was sent a different brand which did not hold up to shipping. Twice I had to re-order and twice the package came not properly insulated/wrapped.  I had a leaky mess both times as the caps had popped off the jars during the mailing process and the honey was spilling all over the leaking package.  If this product (Comvita Brand) is no longer available then it should not be on the website, and if this other product is a substitute, then it should be properly wrapped for shipping. I do want to say  though that each time I called, the customer service reps were very kind and helpful and tried to handle the problem immediately without any hesitation.  It is one of the many reasons why I continue to do business with Amazon.
I have read the praises of Manuka honey for a while, and decided to get it when I found it on Amazon.  The honey is wonderful in tea, and spread on toast, YUM!!

This honey has a very nice taste. It arrived in a somewhat crystallized state (more like spreadable honey paste), probably because the weather here is quite cold. I'm sure it will liquify if I put the jar in warm water. It's great just the way it is. Not sure if it has any of the health benefits Manuka is known for but I would buy this honey again.

I love this stuff. At first, the taste left me with a funny face, but I got used to it and now crave it every morning. My aunt recommended it to me and she gives it to her kids for cold symptoms and allergies, and it works for them. I found that it helped clear up my face a bit, too. I can't promise it will do the same for you as various reviews can tell you, but I found my acne came down to a more controllable level, making it easier to maintain my few breakouts. The honey isn't a a solution for every cold, allergy, or acne breakout, but in my case, it certainly helps a lot.

I first learned about manuka honey in the form of a hand cream.  I recently purchased a jar of this honey at a time that I was starting to get a cold and was also suffering from another bout of acid reflux.  I got up in the middle of the night and had a spoonful and felt immediate relief in my throat.  When I lay back down I felt less and less heartburn.  (Tastes a lot better than apple cider vinegar too)  I am even keeping a jar of it at the office.  It's worth giving a try.

I was recently diagnosed with acid reflux esophagitis and ordered this honey based on recommendations from others and I'm glad I did. Taking a spoon full of this honey whenever I would begin to experience painful esophageal spasms helped a great deal. I've gone through a jar and a half of it, and along with nexium and quitting smoking I am healing and no longer having the spasms.I'm ordering two more jars now just because it's some of best tasting honey I've ever had!-Mike

I read several articles about Manuka honey helping people with stomach problems and decided to give it a try.I mix about a tablespoon of honey with some peanut butter to cut the sweetness,and put it on a cracker. I eat this every night before bed and it sure does seem to help.I don't wake up with a problem stomach first thing in the morning anymore.My stomach lets me know if I forget to eat the honey for a few nights.This honey is very sweet to me but everybody's taste is different.
This is a fine product for eating, and tastes great as a spread. I think it could be the start of a terrific BBQ sauce as well.  Amazon also provided excellent customer service with my purchase.

Although this is of the more viscous kind, it smells good and has a nice sweet taste. I have been using it as a sugar substitute and it has worked very well. It's a bit pricey compared to all the other commercial, processed honey available, but well worth it. Buy the 2 pack, you won't regret it.

column9: Best honey product on the market
column10: I recently tried Manuka Honey and have found it to be one of the best honey products on the market. It is not as liquified as most products, but it dissolves quickly into any hot liquid. I recommend it highly to anyone looking for a high quality honey product.

Rather disappointed in Amazon... This is not "Comvita" honey but"Kiwi Kosher Parve" and does NOT taste like Manuka honey whatsoever. It is cheap for Manuka but expensive for the regular honey it actually is. I guess that he problem is that hey changed the source and kept the ratings for the old, Comvita product, which is incorrect practice from Amazon... I ate Comvita brand Manuka honey before and it definitely tastes better than this one!It is incorrect practice changing the product and keeping the ratings for the old one.

My daughter has been suffering from eczema for years. She would go to the DR and they prescribed steriod cream. After researching online I heard about honey. We tried this product and it takes care of any flare ups quickly!! I feel much better applying honey to her skin rather than steriods!

Manuka honey is a daily staple. I use it right out of the jar or in my daily cups of tea. I also use it to sweeten oatmeal It is a sweetener par excellence and its health benefits have allowed me to be free from colds for the past 3 1/2 years, a string I plan on keeping up as long as my Manuka allows me to.

column9: Not Comvita but still Manuka - but so what?
column10: For some reason the company doesn't have their name on the label but on the side it says it's "packed by Arataki for Pacific Resources International" and it does seem to be a large well-known respected company. I bought this at Whole Foods knowing nothing about Manuka honey but wanted to see what it would do about a burn on my hand. It did improve it very much and I was sold. So I read up about Manuka honey and went and bought Wedderspoon 16+. that was LESS effective than this jar. However, then I tried some local raw wildflower honey and it was just as effective as this, and tasted better, and was a lot cheaper...The NIH tested four types of raw honey. They found that Manuka did have a higher level of antibacterial properties, but it was not as high as something called mountain honey. They didn't specify which mountain and also didn't indicate the level of Manuka. Also, ALL honey clears skin blemishes. Manuka may be better for internal problems as stated - I don't know about that - but I'm sticking with the local raw stuff for $10 a jar. I think wildflower honey is the best because who knows where the manuka bees go anyway? They probably go all over the place unless they are confined.
Tastes great, I will keep ordering this product since its honey and honey doesnt usually go bad. Over all this is good stuff

column9: A class all of it's own. You might eat the spoon!
column10: I love Honey. This Manuka honey (I'm on my 10th jar in three years) is much more mature and smooth than anything I've ever had. A spoonful of this honey in the morning will do wonders for you all day. I say order it to try it - you will be back for more. I saw this honey for sale today at 125th Fairway for $28 per bottle. Amazon is offering a great deal.
I found this honey to be very good and certainly will continue to purchase it.
I've had the comvita UMF+5 lable in New Zealand and this is not it. They showed that lable but sent another brand that doesn't come close to it. It's a fake.

Have to say something about this "honey". At first I didn' believe those negative comments, and bought it as gift for friends. But when I finally tasted it, I had to admit that I made a mistake. Some part of the honey is tasteless, and other parts taste too sweet. And it doesn't taste like manuka honey at all. Perhaps it is some some chemical mixture of sweetener, strange spices and starch. I cannot believe I sent this as a gift to friends. They may think I hate them!

column9: Not an Acne medication, not a health medication just something for the sweet tooth
column10: I purchased this raw honey, in hopes that it will do wonders for my health and my blemished skin, but my hopes were set up too high.The raw honey does have a unique taste at first but after half way through the bottle, the taste gets annoying. It's not as tasteful as the honey that is sold on grocery stores. This one is more thick and therefore makes it VERY hard to spread around your waffles or pancakes.I read many reviews stating that this honey is good for your health. Well ever since taking it, nothing really changed at all. I've had this honey for months and no significant health improvement of any kind has happen.I was mostly aiming at the skin issues that I have. I heard honey is recommended as a mask to kill bacteria on the skin that could cause blemishes. So with all of the health benefits that this honey was said to have, I trusted that it would not only improve my health but also help fight my acne. Well it sure didn't do a single thing to change my skin condition. Just hours of annoying thick honey on my face. No blemish was stopped, no quickness in fading away the red spots and absolutely no skin improvement of any kind. My skin didn't feel cleaner at all nor did it glow or changed a single thing. A simple soap sure left me more satisfy than putting this on my face day after day in hopes that it would help.Bottom line is that this is a good product if you are just using it as a substitute for sugar. It has that sweet taste for the sweet tooth. It's thick but if you have time you could warm it up in the microwave or in something hot.THIS IS NOT A HEALTH REMEDY OR ACNE FIGHTING TOOL!!!So if your planning on getting this to help fight acne, I would recommend spending that money for a product that at least labels it self with the ingredients to fight acne. This is just for the sweet tooth!
I question the freshness of this honey.  I took it in an attempt to help my ibs and found that it was ineffectual.  Moreover, it just taste bad.

column9: don't buy this horrible tasting honey

Because of this, my cat was only licking up the gravy, picking at a few pieces, and leaving the rest in the dish. I don't know if it was more difficult to eat or less palatable, but I ended up having to donate the rest of the cans to an animal shelter. Because of the wide variation in preparation, I had to stop buying this food for Moxie.ORIGINAL: My cat goes crazy for this wet food. When he was younger (about 7 months ago), I tried to give him the same brand dry food supplemented with this wet food, but we had vomit problems with the wet food. When I re-introduced this wet food about a month ago because I was concerned about only giving him dry food, it was like night and day. He gobbles it all up every day, and there have been no vomit issues whatsoever. He knows that morning time is when he gets his morsels, and he sits in the middle of the kitchen and cries until I give it to him.I like that this food comes in larger chunks rather than tiny shredded pieces. column9: We don't like the new formula
column10: I first tried this canned food at the recommendation of a local pet care/store. They gave it very high recommendations and so I have tried both the dry and wet.  My three cats liked the wet. So I did the economical thing and putchased a whole case of 24 on Amazon.  but I noticed the difference as soon as I opened the can. The NEW wet food is not the same!! It's like they have cut the actual food in half and then doubled up on the gravyI went back to the local store and they had a few of the older recipes and I I bought all they had.Cans that are marked with a thin green band with the words "New Formula with Increased Flavor" are inferior.

I have a cat that throws up whenever she eats food with grain, and she's 17 years old. I noticed her getting thinner, and so I have been supplementing her dry food with this, and she LOVES it. She is a much healthier weight now, too.

column9: Cats in my vicinity hate this stuff
column10: Not only will my eight cats not go near this stuff, neither will the neighbor's cats or strays in the neighborhood.  It seems they like to lick off the gravy and leave the rest.  The possum finally ate it, but only after hesitation.  I don't know what it is about this product or its dry counterpart, but my cats would rather starve.  Will not be buying either again.

I was excited to find the "old" formula of this cat food on Amazon (at least that is what the picture is of). It was my cat's favorite canned food. The company has recently changed their formula. I received my case, opened 5 cans of it for my cats, and they all sniffed it and walked away. That is when I noticed that it said new and improved formula in small writing at the top of the can. So now I am stuck with 19 cans of food that my cats won't eat.  And Amazon will not let me return this item.  Even though I received something that was different than the description/picture.

column9: Ingredients are Very Good, and My Cats Like It
column10: I mostly feed Blue Buffalo, and my cats have done very well with it. With rare exceptions, Blue Buffalo is the only kibble that I feed to my cats. However, my cats appreciate some variety in canned food so I look around for different quality foods that I can rotate into their feeding regimen. Among the things that I look for in any cat food are primary ingredients consisting of poultry, fish or meat, and an absence of corn, soy, wheat, or gluten of any kind. Two of my cats just turned twenty-two, a third will be twenty-two in a month, and a fourth is ten years of age, so I include canned food in their diet twice a day, to ensure proper hydration. While I rotate between the various Blue Buffalo canned food choices, I add other quality canned food choices to the diet plan, as well. My cats are satisfied with the same kibble day after day, but they get bored with the same canned food more than a couple of days in a row.The Taste of the Wild Rocky Mountain Feline Formula in Gravy was well received by all four of my cats, and I am very pleased with its ingredients. The ingredient list is my first test, and if I don't like the ingredients, my cats never get to taste the food. Other than that, everything in the ingredient list is recognizable to me as being either a natural food, vitamin, mineral or other necessary ingredient.In summary, the ingredients are very good and my cats like the taste, so Taste of the Wild is a go in this family. The only problem is remembering that you have to soak it 12 hours before cooking, and that is MY problem, not the merchandiser's problem. This chana dal cooks up fine; here is my favorite recipe: * 1 cup chana dal, soaked 12 hours and rinsed * One large onion, chopped * 4 cloves garlic (or more, to taste), minced or pressed * 2 tablespoons olive oil * 1 cup bulgur wheat * 2 cups hot chicken or vegetable broth (can use bullion) * 1 teaspoon salt (or less, to taste)  *  1/4 t. cloves  *  1/2 t. cinnamon *  1/4 cup finely chopped parsley or cilantro *  freshly ground black pepperPreparation:Soak chana dal for 10-12 hours. Drain and rinse.Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft (5-8 minutes). Add drained chana dal and bulgur wheat. Sauté for about 3 more minutes, until bulgur wheat is browned (it will begin to smell heavenly). Add all remaining ingredients, bring to a boil, and lower heat.Simmer, covered, for about 35 minutes. At this point, check to see if the chana dal is tender enough for you. If not add a quarter cup more water and simmer another few minutes or until you are satisfied. Turn off heat and let sit, covered, for at least 10 minutes.Makes about 6 cups.

These cashews are so delicious! They are fresh, full of flavor, and packaged for easy to-go activities. Helping Indonesian farmers produce a quality product is an added benefit. They are a great snack to get you through a Pilates or yoga routine.

column9: A taste of Italy for Breakfast
column10: Our family recently returned from Italy. We were introduced to this cookie by friends while staying with them. My family loved it. I wish we could buy it in the US. It is great with hot chocolate or coffee.

column9: I'd not heard her voice until now!  She calls for her dinner!!!
column10: I give my cat canned food because she's old & I think that dry food hurts her mouth & so she swallows it whole and heaves.  BASICally, I got it to make MY life easier.......Thanks!Jana
Love the flavor of this coffee, full bodied and rich, and strong.  Love buying it in bulk, too.  Thanks Amazon!
I have tried many different coffees but can not find one that comes close to comparing to Dancing Goat!

column9: Great coffee at a good price
column10: The Dancing Goats blend is a versatile coffee that makes great Americanos in the espresso machine and also brews well in a press pot.  The five pound bags with free shipping from Amazon are quite a bargain relative to buying one pound bags from the maker.
I was not sure if this would be as good tasting as the price, But it was GREAT coffee...

I came across Dancing Goats coffee on a trip to Olympia Washington.  It's much smoother than Starbucks.  The 5lb bag through Amazon is much cheaper than ordering through Batdorf and Bronson's site.  Plus if you're an Amazon Prime member, shipping's free!The only coffee I've found that's better is Stumptown, but it's more expensive.
If you like a rich full-bodied coffee I encourage you to try dancing goats blend.  Without a doubt far superior to anything Starbucks etc. offers.  I am hooked!

These unheard of sour strings are delicious. My girlfriend has gotten addicted to them, and started eating a bag or more a day, so I had to hide them.  With some hard work and a lot of motivation, she has been clean for the past 2 days!
I purchased this item for a birthday party.  The kids loved the Sour S'ghetti.  It doesn't leave the hands too sticky and the flavor is good.
This was the best tasting sour candy ever!! IT is actually sour unlike other imposters that claim to be sour. I recommend these to ALL. Fun to eat too!

I've had my fill of sour patch kids, so as a lover of all things Haribo, I decided to give these a try (in bulk, too). I wasn't disappointed. I *think* the flavors of the s'ghetti are green apple, raspberry (blue) and watermelon (pink). First two ingredients are sugar and corn syrup, but no high fructose corn syrup. There's also wheat flour, which I found odd, but I thought I'd put it in the review in case someone allergic to gluten might come across my write-up. Warning: if you get mouth sores from sour candy, these will definitely do that, so try to restrain yourself and not eat the whole bag in one sitting!

I love Haribo, but this product was not as fresh and chewy as most of the other Haribo products I have ordered. It seemed a little tough and chewy like it was not as fresh as it should have been. Maybe it is supposed to be this way, but I was expecting something more like the sour gummi worms. These are not the same. I thought these would be easier/better for my younger grandchildren to eat than the larger gummi worms, but they don't like them either. Oh well, win some, lose some!
Love these. If you like sour candy these are for you. Sour, sweet, excellent. Makes you pucker when you eat them!!! That is a good sour candy!

I love sour candy and was pleased to find such a great deal on Amazon. The shipping was fast and the bags were packaged in a sturdy box. It is quite a bit of stuff, but if you love sour candy this is worth it!
My local gas station stopped selling these so I bought a case online. They are extremely tasty, and a good sour fix.

column9: Awesome but obviously paying for packaging
column10: I think these are my new favorite gummy candy (and I'm addicted to gummies). Well at least my favorite sour gummy candy. Normally like their centipedes but last batch shipped out and was completely different from normal. If that's a "new recipe" or something I may have to switch to these fantastically addicting, mouth-watering treats. ONLY downside is that you only get about 3.75lbs for the same price you can get other bulk Haribo gummies in 5lb bags for. Likely due to the fact they come individually packaged...but if they put out a full on "bulk" 5lb bag for the same price it would be one of the sweetest deals on gummies around.

column9: Very good sweet and sour flavor
column10: These were great. Think Sour Patch Kids only a little less intense. I like the short thin strings of candy that come in these bags because they're not as hard to chew as sour patch can be sometimes.

column9: Sour candy that the entire family likes!
column10: I've purchased these Sour Spaghetti Strings a few times per year for the last several years.  Amazon always sends fresh product.  They are great to put in goody bags for birthday parties and they are also great to have on hand for when 'sweet' doesn't hit the spot.  This candy is SOUR!  Not jaw achingly sour but nice and tart.  We don't have them in the house at all times but sometimes we'll have a craving and realize we are out:  Amazon to the rescue.  With our Prime membership we have them back in the pantry within a couple of days.  Glad they are always in stock here!

I've had a lot of sour candy in my day and I have to say that this is hands down the best I've ever had. Better than sour patch kids, sour punch straws, sour skittles, etc. It's a great price on a hard to find sour candy, and each bag is packed full of these little strings. Great value, great product, overall a terrific buy. Don't hesitate if you're thinking of getting it!
From the maker of the ever yummy Gummi Bears - they have made the BEST sour gummi candy on the market - Unique flavor - NEVER Disappointed!  I buy it by the case!
sour s'ghetti will keep you wanting more. before you know it, you will have finished your bag and be craving another handful of yummy gummies. def worth to order multiple bags.
Haribo makes the best gummy candy, in my opinion!  I try them all!  These Sour S'ghetti gummi strings are very sour!  And they are, indeed, addicting.  Great colors and wonderfully sour!
These are great, as soon as i opened the bag i could not stop eating. Low in calories was a plus.

column9: A missed memory made available at the click of a button.
column10: I had this candy, which was found at my local store, when I lived it Korea 6 years ago. I fell in love with it then, and I am still in love with it now. The flavor is more sweet than sour, but I don't buy these types of candy for the "sour" factor. The taste is amazing and will have you going back for more. Amazon is the best!
My daughter & I loved it!  For the sweet & sour taste lovers this is an excellent choice.  Fun to play with too.
I love these sour stragehtii, there is nothing like them. I tend to freeze them on the frezzer, they harden up and taste even better.I recommend this product to all sour candy lovers

The best Gummi Bears in the world.  Was born and raised in Germany and brought up on the product - used to buy and haul them home from Germany in 25lb. lots.  Both regular and sugar free are a treat and they quickly become addictive.  Love them.
This stuff is just great. Give it a try, you won't regret it. Something that I really appreciate is the short ingredients list written in language that you don't need a PhD in chemistry to uncode :-)

column9: Quite usable in the eclectic cooking recipe box
column10: I originally purchased this as a required ingredient for a copycat recipe of Chipotle Mexican Grill's salad dressing. It worked great, and I've found it a regular "go to" in my spice collection any time I make something with chicken or with a slight southwestern hint. It's great for chilis, chicken that's cooked before being added to other recipes like chicken taco soup, or chili, and others. I also agree with the other reviewer that it has a nice list of simple ingredients without a bunch of "modifiers" and other non-natural stuff.It does not contain cumin, which was a big win for me, because I don't like cumin, but there are other Goya mixes that do contain cumin if you prefer it.

I have ordered several items from this seller and have to say that this particular bamboo well exceeded my expectations.  It is very healthy, lush and green and makes a beautiful addition to my decor.  Don't pass this up if you are looking for some great plants and a unique look!
I have it for over a year now and it has grown a lot. It is a very good product. I highly recomend it to everyone.

This honey is very nice tasting.  A little pricey, but it does have very good flavor, not sure if it is really raw though, sdoesn't seem to be.  Overall, a nice flavor. My dad was a bee keeper and pproduced his own honey for many years, this is good like that just not as dark.  Very sweet!

Exactly how I always pictured Bertie Bott's beans would be. I have the generation before these and they've been spot on since movie 1 (GOD, the HORSERADISH flavor was AWFUL. UGH.). The generation before these has a single flavor that literally made me retch. The fish flavored jelly beans are SO AWFUL that you will gag.You will.Trust me.These, on the other hand, only have a few really awful ones. Avoid vomit if you can, because that's probably what you'll be doing next.whoever makes these is awesome.

These beans are a wonderful thing. The good flavors, you can eat, and they are totally fantastic. The terrible flavors, you can belittle the manhood of your friends with. The in-between flavors? Like grass? They're largely there to confuse you, and do so wonderfully.To sum up my experience with them, an anecdote:Driving along one summer, eating said beans, my two friends convince me to eat the Booger flavoured one. "Okay," I begin "but only if you get a good flavored one ready to get the taste out of my mouth."My first friend passes me the booger-bean, and gets a grape-bean ready on deck. The booger bean was mostly flavourless... until the saliva hit my tongue! Retching, I spat out the window, and demanded the grape bean. Blargh! The dark colour tricked them! It was dirt! Spitting again, I demanded another bean. They produced another dark coloured one, this one seeming noticeably more purple in the light. Noooo! It was more dirt!Pulling over, and spitting out the bean, they presented me with a white one. "Alright," they said "This can only be popcorn, or marshmallow."Seeing no bad option, I took the bean and chewed it gratefully. Then I vomited in my mouth.It was neither popcorn, nor marshmallow. It was rotten egg!Suffice to say, that these are not the kind of jelly bean you buy, thinking that every one of them will be wonderful. The rotten egg, dirt, soap, and vomit beans all taste exactly what they are supposed to. And that is what makes them a fantastic product.

These things actually taste like they are described. My girl was so fascinated at the idea of being able to eat candy like Harry Potter ate that she tried the vomit, earwax and soap flavors and giggled her way through every disgusting moment of the assault on her poor little taste buds. She LOVED them. But I guess you need to be a true Potterhead to really appreciate the things. Ugh!!

These boxes are very small! Each is 1.2oz ... yes, you read that right, ONE POINT TWO OUNCES! About the size of a box of raisins. At $5/box you would think you would get something more substantial. I ordered these for a party, thinking the kids could share it. Ha! I'm embarrassed to even bring them out :(

I was really excited to find Bertie Botts Every Flavour Jelly Beans because my kids would love them.  It was a 2-pack, and for $9 I figured that the boxes would be pretty big.  Boy was I wrong.  The boxes are the size of small raisin boxes, and they aren't even filled very full.  I was very disappointed and feel ripped off.  Breaking the cost down, each jelly bean costs about 25 cents, and these are small candies - the size of jelly bellys.  Don't waste your money unless you have a lot to waste...

I first bought these jelly beans in a local store, my boys 9 (8 and 14) had so much fun with it I had to find it again and buy it, this time for my 18 year old niece who chain reads the Harry Potter books (and loves jelly beans). Some of the beans are delicious (lemon drop, cherry, cinnamon, blueberry, toasted marshmallow etc  but I didn't dare to try the unconventional ones...the kids do tell me though they taste exactly as described (sardine, rotten egg, pickle ,sausage, ear wax, earthworm ...)Fun twist on an all time favorite.
Ordered these for my grandson who loves everything "Harry Potter"  He had a BLAST feeding the really weird ones to his Dad.

column9: My Dear Daughter - loves these - a must for Harry Potter Fans
column10: If your child is willing to share a few of these jelly beans: BEWARE: as you will probably end up with flavors like: rotten eggs, dirt, vomit, and spicy pepper - but still fun.
they were good, the boxes were smaller than i thought and the flavors were a nice mix. all in all a good buy.

I knew what I was purchasing - those wierd flavored jelly beans for my sons Harry Potter Birthday Party. Now sure if I'm supposed to rate the seller here but they were awesome! The product arrived just in time for the party and see the boys squirm at tasting them!

So we ordered this for our daughter for Christmas and when they arrived WOW was i surprised !!! Not only did we only get one box but the box we did get was CRAZY small. Top of 15 beans! i would have NEVER ordered if i had know the box was so small
These jelly beans tasted like the real thing.  The kids had fun tasting the different and some disgusting flavors (like dirt flavor for example).  I ordered more boxes!

we sent these with bertie bunny jelly bean dispenser to our daughter in Texas for Easter.  The cute bunny makes the Harry Potter jelly beans even more of a surprise, mostly good, but always interesting.  These jelly beans are for fans of the books and movies, they are what they say they are, not a sweet treat but cool and great conversation starters!
this product is good for laughs  my daughters and i got alot of laughs watching their friends and each other taste them  they do not taste good in anyway

Perfect for a small gift topper or as a part of a gift bag or set! Just the perfect amount to make them enjoyable but not too much to feel like it's a waste if a flavor was... Surprising. Great fun for everyone.

So happy to see these nasty little candies are back- my kids were soo disappointed last year when all we could find were the knock-offs. Nothing gets by my Harry Potter fans! The boxes are quite small, so yes- this is expensive for a few jelly beans. Gross ones at that. But my kids will have a ball tasting them and playing HP while they do. Thanks again, Amazon!

Big Harry Potter fans get a big kick out of these because some the flavors are genuinely odd like those in the books (such as "rotten egg" or "soap") but they're quite expensive for the size of the boxes. Be aware that each box is tiny - not much bigger than a small pack of gum or mints. My daughter enjoyed sharing them with her friends.

column9: NOTICE HOW small THE BOX IS!!!
column10: I didn't pay attention when I ordered these jelly beans, and was shocked at how small the box really is.  Only 1.2 ounces.  I paid WAY too much for them, but I hope my daughter, who is a Harry Potter nut, will enjoy them.  Currently, Amazon has 2 boxes of these available for a better price than 1.

Just received these two boxes which I purchased to go in my son's stocking for Christmas, but the boxes are so small, I regret ordering them, especially for $10! BE WARE! These boxes are about the size of a cigarette lighter. (I bought a box of these years ago and they were a regular size candy box, so i had expected these to be about the same size.)

column9: Harry Potter Bertie Botts Jelly Beans
column10: I bought this for my daughter who is a fan of the Harry Potter movies.  She got a laugh out of it.  The flavors are just as horrible as they said in the movie.

column9: Read the Product Description Before Buying
column10: These aren't meant to be a meal, they're meant to be a fun novelty, and for everyone complaining and moaning about the size, READ the product description before buying, it clearly gives the size.

column9: Wonderfully disgusting (dont pay more than 5 bucks for the 2 pack)
column10: A few human flavors mixed with some amazingly gross and disgusting flavors.  Im not going to tell you about them, find out yourself.I tell you though,  HOW Bertie figures out how to make them taste so realistic is scary.  My kids and I had a great deal of fun with these.(actually the fun is not over.  Mama doesnt know the nasty beans have been mixed in her regular beans, and she never reads reviews  hehheh)Easily worth the 4.50 I paid for the 2 pack

If you are going to buy this to eat for enjoyment you sir are outta luck! These jelly beans are nasty and only good for some pranks on friends! Includes every FLAVOR for the most variety of nastiness (For the most part they are nasty). I love them for pranks!

column9: Fun but don't expect more than 20 beans.
column10: My son loves the Harry Potter books and movies so he had to have these as soon as he knew they were available. The box was very small and had only about 15 beans in it. There were several duplicates so he did not get one of each flavored, which was a bummer. I also think the price and shipping cost is outrageous for the size.
