column9: AMAZING vanilla beans with AMAZING price!!!
column10: I have ordered these beans twice now. I have made my own vanilla extract, vanilla sugar, homemade chocolate sauce, eggnog, cheese cake, white cake, pancakes, and so on and so on. EXCELLENT!!! The beans are supple and very fragrant! YUM! Makes me want to bake something every time I smell them ;) As others have mentioned, vanilla beans in local stores are $5 per bean on up...this is a great value and I intend to order this over and over again...the taste is wonderful and I go through them fast! Using these beans make me feel like a professional chef ;) Please don't have any doubts, order and enjoy!Update: 03/09/11Still buying them and still very pleased! WONDERFUL!

Overall, I was happy with my purchase.This was the first time that I bought vanilla beans online, and so thought that Amazon would be the safest route to go.First off, my advice is to buy the beans on a Monday. The shipping is fairly fast, but I ordered them Wednesday night...so the package was stuck (with the sweltering summer temperatures) at a post office for the weekend. I'm not quite sure if that affected the vanilla beans or not.I made a batch of vanilla extract with a few of the beans and was shocked by how much white "fluff" came out of the beans. I just pray that it's vanillin and not mold.The vanilla beans have the scent of vanilla enshrouded in cigar smoke. As bizarre as that sounds, that's a fairly accurate description.The package is airtight and was small enough to fit into my mailbox. There was no hassle whatsoever with signing for the postman.I just hope I don't get food poisoning when I first use my vanilla extract...especially since I love to share my baked treats with family and friends.Would I recommend buying from Amazon? Sure! Personally, however, I will try out a different source next time (if only to see the difference in vanilla beans and shipping).

I was looking for Vanilla extract but found these beans at such a good price, I thought, why not make my own extract. All you need to do is soak a dozen beans in a 750 ml Vodka for a month. For the same price as good extract, I now have extract (a lot of)  plus plenty of beans left over for ice cream and other projects.

column9: Great deal, great beans, fast & free shipping - Thanks!! Love it, love it!!
column10: This is my second vanilla bean purchase from RJ Mushrooms.  The beans are amazing AND a great value - if you've ever purchased quality beans, you know what I'm talking about.  I made my own vanilla extract with these & it is amazing!  I'm giving some of my extract as Christmas gifts this year.  I'm also interested in trying the Creme Brule recipe which comes free with the purchase!

I was excited to get these for homemade vanilla extract. The beans seemed good quality but there was "fuzz" on them! And I found what appeared to be a white dog/cat hair. I pictured someone holding them against their sweater while trying to get them in the bag. I obviously have no idea how they got fuzz on them but I was disappointed for that reason.

I have bought things from this company before and I guess I expected more from their vanilla beans. They have a weird smell, maybe a little burnt? I don't think they are supposed to smell like that. They are plump vanilla beans, but don't have the aroma I expected. Overall, I guess they are just ok. I wouldn't buy them again. And now I have a 1/2 lb. of vanilla beans that I don't really want to use.

I received these beans quickly and they are all and more than represented.  We have made vanilla extract, vanilla sugar and a number of other products with tremendous success.  I highly recommend this product and will order it again.

I purchased these beans through Amazon to make my own real vanilla extract.  When I got these in the mail they were so fragrant I could smell them through the packaging!  I have never seen plumper, softer, delicious, more beautiful vanilla beans.  And for the price you can't beat 'em!

I did not care for this product!!! It is a weak bean.The vanilla specks didn't show in the homemade ice cream.The vanilla flavor was very weak even when I put extra beans in the custard.I would not recommend.

I have been researching how to make my own vanilla extract.  I found many great articles and suggestions for making vanilla extract, but I ran into a very important issue - which beans to use?  After careful deliberation, I decided to purchase these beans for everyday baking and a variety of Mexican beans from this same company for ice cream only.  These beans came promptly and in great condition - they were plump, and had a wonderful fragrance.  I will update this post in 6 months and let you know how the vanilla turned out!Here is the link I used to research which type of beans I wanted to use for my extract.[...]

I was super excited to find my beans in the mail today, I placed my order on Sunday and they shipped on Monday. I was however a bit disappointed when there were only 43 beans in the package. I was truly hoping to get closer to the approx 54 they state. The beans were very aromatic and to me they seemed quite nice. I have never dealt with vanilla beans before so I guess my comparison is quite limited :) I am using them to make my own Pure Vanilla for baking so I guess I will find out in 6 mos how it turns out. Nice buy but disappointed in how many I received.ETA: After thinking about my review, I wasn't thinking about the fact that these are measured by weight. That does make a big difference. I was disappointed because the recipe I was using called for 40 beans and in the end I only had 3 leftover to use for something else. I will definitely be buying more though!
I ordered these vanilla beans to make homemade vanilla extract.  I received them quickly, they were fresh, and smelled amazing!  I can't wait until my extract is ready!  :)

These Beans are wonderful. I honestly recommend them to many people. I moved to the midwest a few years ago and have had HORRIBLE luck finding quality ingredients out here (I am from the West Coast). These are moist, plump and Incredibly flavorful Beans.
I was worried that for the price, these vanilla beans would come to me shriveled and dry. Nope!  Plump and deliciously aromatic.  They made fantastic vanilla extract, and my baked goods extra yummy.
And I love my vanilla beans!I have nothing to complain about, only to praise. It is the second time I buy the beans from them and I will do it again. They are definitely my source for vanilla beans!

I received my vanilla beans quickly via USPS.  They were moist and fragrant.  I store them in a glass jar and none of the leftover beans have dried out, molded, shrunk in size, etc.  These beans are excellent quality for such a great value.  I will purchase from this seller again in the future.

Vanilla pricing fluctuates, but it is pretty low right now. Still, buying a vanilla bean from a gourmet shop will still run you $20+! There is no reason to buy vanilla in a brick-and-mortar store. You can buy literally 50 times the beans for the same price here on Amazon, or through other online retailers who buy more directly from growers.The beans themselves are great. I have made creme brulee, hot chocolate, vanilla extract, and sauces with them, and they never disappoint. Can't praise highly enough.

These beans are wonderful! I got them to make vanilla extract. They are plump and fragrant, with a lot of oil (in other words, a lot of flavor). I used about half of them in a large bottle of vodka and after only a week, my extract already smells stronger and is darker than my expensive, store-bought extract.

These are above and beyond. Wonderful flavor, nice oiliness to it. Despite the high reviews I was a little worried about ordering a product like this online but I couldn't be happier with the results. These were better than others I've seen in specialty cooking stores and spice shops.Other important facts:-comes in a sealed (and resealable) plastic bag-shipped quickly and with no hassle
These are high quality beans, with tons of seeds, but they are not the type used in extract.  Very moist.  Remember, never refrigerate or freeze.

These vanilla beans/pods/whatever-you-want-to-call-them are really amazing. I used about 20 of them to make vanilla extract (but I got so excited that I forgot to slice them open before popping them into the vodka), gave some away, made freaking awesome desserts (vanilla bean cupcakes anyone?), and I still have quite a few leftover to use on a whim!I saw 1 measly vanilla bean in a jar at the grocery store the other day for 9 BIG DOLLARS. I can't even imagine spending $9 on just one bean/pod/whatever. You cannot beat the quality of these moist b/p/w for $25. And you get 54 HUGE B/P/W.AMAZING. BUY THEM.

column9: Great place for bulk vanilla beans
column10: I needed vanilla beans to make vanilla extract.  These beans are fresh and plump.  They arrived quickly just as the seller described.

The pods were vacuum packed which was great for freshness. I would say 90% of the beans were about 7" and amazing quality for the price. Plump and juicy. I've already used half the package making extract, spiced rum and vanilla sugar. Half a pound sounds like a lot (and it is) but you will be surprised how quickly you can use them all.

I was a little skeptical to purchase 54 vanilla beans. These beans are fresh.  I vacuum packed them into packs of five plus made vanilla extract with 15 of them and traded my neighbor a gallon of fresh milk for a couple.  I had never used fresh vanilla bean but have been using it in ice cream, cakes, pudding, etc.  Don't hesitate to buy these vanilla beans.

These are by far the best vanilla beans I have ever purchased anywhere.  I have purchased beans in grocery stores, and the so-called "gourmet" shops, and have gotten stale beans and paid premium prices.  These beans come in two heavy plastic vacuum sealed envelopes.  I popped one bag right in the deep-freeze, for future use.  The one bag I opened, and used a couple beans to bolster my homemade vanilla extract, and I have made vanilla sugar, and used the beans in homemade cakes and ice cream.  The flavor is spot-on!  This is the most economical way to get real, quality vanilla!  Bon appétit!

I make a variety of homemade foods requiring vanilla beans.  This has become very expensive.  While looking for containers to bottle vanilla extract this website popped up.  Very intrigued that vanilla beans could be soooo cheap I ordered them.  What a fantastic find.  Not only was there more that 54 beans in the package, the package arrived in 3 days, fully sealed moist not dried out beans!!!  GREAT VALUE!!

I have always shied away from buying real vanilla beans because of the price. You cannot beat this deal! I made almost 2 gallons of extract, and still had half the bag of beans left intact. Definitely recommend the investment.

One of the main reasons that I didn't do anything with real Vanilla beans is because the price was allways prohibitive. I was afraid that these would be hard as rock and nasty. To my great surprise they are wonderful.Thank you, I will be one of your repeat customers.
Great smell - beautiful shape and color.  First time user - will be making vanilla extract.  Can't wait until it is done. :)

I used these beans to make vanilla extract for gifts!  Certainly TOP shelf quality.  My entire house smelled so wonderful all night long.  I would highly recommend these to anyone who is thinking about purchasing them.  Even my husband & daughter loved the aroma through out the house.  I did use the two day shipping and was wondering if the extra cost was worth it...it was :)

column9: Excellent price and quality vanilla beans!
column10: I keep these in the freezer to keep them fresh.  I use them for baking and I keep a running amount of vanilla sugar going too.  Amazing how much better things turn out with vanilla beans rather than extract.  Good price too for the number of beans you get.  I highly recommend this product.  The seller shipped very quickly too and also answered my questions that I sent by e-mail.  Good seller.

Ordered these for the first time (have never tried ordering anything like vanilla beans before) and was completely satisfied with the experience! The vendor had the shipment on its way in just a day, and I actually had the package in my hands in 3 days even though I used the free standard ground shipping! The beans were fresh and extremely fragrant, everything they were billed to be - can't wait to start using them in cooking. Highly recommended!

These beans arrived quickly and well packed.  I could smell the vanilla as soon as I opened the box!  The beans were moist and fresh.  I made homemade vanilla bean ice cream the first weekend and family members said it was the best vanilla ice cream they had every eaten!  I used a recipe from the Williams Sonoma book, title "Ice Cream".  I highly recommend these beans and this seller!

Love this vanilla.  Arrived in great condition, very fresh and moist.  I've already used it in a few recipes and look forward to using it more.  It's so much better than using vanilla extract from the store; a real culinary sea change for me.  Also, the price was great.  Best deal I could find for the quantity, with no apparent sacrifice in quality.

We got the beans very quickly.  Before we even opened the package you could smell the amazing aroma.  Right away we made some vanilla waffles, nummy.  We cant wait to start cooking with them.  We were also very impressed with the price.  Williams Sonoma sells 2 beans for 8.00.  These beans are a great deal, and high quality!  Go for it!

These beans are awesome! First time buyer, but not the last! :-) I will definitely buy from again. My dad and I ordered these after paying over $4 per shriveled little bean in the grocery store. I never knew vanilla beans were supposed to be so plump and "juicy". Wow, these are amazing! They smell divine! Packaged wonderfully, but you can still smell the yumminess packed inside. :-D Highly recommend! As a bonus, the estimated delivery date was Sept 16. I got them today, Sept 11! Woot! :-)

These beans are wonderful... You simply can not beat the price for the amount you receive. I had my beans very quickly and the aroma is very strong. You can smell them outside the package they come shipped in. The entire room had the great smell of vanilla in the air. That is how fresh they are! The quality is incredible. Soft and loaded with the black seed inside. Why pay $5-7 for a single bean in the store when you can have 50+ shipped to your door, fresh as can be, for just over $20?Highly recommended... Incredible beans!

I ordered these beans back in December to make vanilla extract. It turned out great! (had to wait several months to test it)There were right around 54 beans, exactly as described. Opening the bag (nicely vacuum sealed, btw) was a heavenly experience in itself.The beans were moist and plump, and had lots of good seeds. This was definitely a good buy if you're looking for a bunch of vanilla beans.

Bought these a few weeks ago.  Received the item about a week later.  Beans were moist and smelled awesome.  So far made creme brulee with the beans and it came out awesome.  My local supermart sells vanilla beans for 9.99 for 1 bean.  This is a much better deal than buying from the supermart.

column4: Rachel @ My Naturally Frugal Family "Rachel J"
column10: I bought these to use in the recipes from Natalia KW's Pure Heaven Cupcake book.The shipping was fast, the quality is superb, and you can't beat the price of .50 per bean....you won't find it any cheaper
These are plump, juicy vanilla beans! Perfect for ice cream making and making vanilla extract. Very satisfied and will not buy expensive vanilla beans at the grocery store ever again.

I purchased this product in Aug. It shipped quickly and with no problems. The beans were moist and smelled amazing. I used almost all of them right away for homemade vanilla extract and have a couple still in a ziplock bag (still moist and aromic).  I was able to get 24 4oz bottles with 1 and half beans in them plus a 750ml bottle with about 8 beans as well. I will update on the flavor of the beans when the vanilla is done in a few weeks.

Delicious. The beans that I received were good and fresh. They were soft and seemed almost oily but naturally so. Highly recommended if you are looking for fresh vanilla. There whole beans are much better than pre-ground type. And the aroma was fantastic. I hope they continue to offer a good quality product.

column9: great vanilla extract and bean quality.
column10: I kept 8 whole beans out of bag for recipes calling for vanilla bean. The rest I split open with a razor knife and using a teaspoon extracted the paste and set aside. Then I chopped up all the bean pods to 1/4 inch and placed them in a mason jar with a fifth of Smirnoff vodka, sealed and set aside for 6 months. Strained the batch with a extra fine sieve. Fabulous flavor after aging. Used this extract in a creme brulee, custard, and pastry. Amazing vanilla flavor. And here's the happy kicker. Bought a fifth and made another mason jar batch with the originally used beans. After just 6 weeks, I used this recycled batch in a creme brulee, can't tell the difference. I will continue to age the new batch, (shake the jar once in a while, storing it a cool dark place). I got enough vanilla extract for the rest of my life. No more $6-7 2 ounce bottles of the national brands for me- with my homemade stunningly flavorful. Good luck.
This is the first time using vanilla beans. They seem to be high quality and moist.  I'm making homemade vanilla and it has an excellent scent.

column9: I HATED vanilla until I started buying these!
column10: When I first ordered these in Aug. 2010, I ordered two 1/2 lb bags. thinking that I would need that much at the rate I would be using them. I made homemade vanilla extract, I put 1-2 vanilla beans in my cookies (which I make at an ungodly rate!), in ice cream, and various other treats and I only ran out in Feb. of this year! so it took me two years to go through 1 lb! I love these vanilla beans. They are fragrant and moist. After I scrape the beans I throw them in my sugar container. The sugar absorbs the moisture from the spent hulls and the end result is a very fragrant vanilla flavored sugar! If I have too many on hand I will let them dry out and throw them in a spice grinder, until they become a fine powder. It is great to sprinkle in coffee or on top of oatmeal or waffles in the morning! vanilla beans are too expensive to waste so use up as much of it as you can! Make sure you store them in an air tight container! You want to keep them moist. I bought an OXO Good Grips POP container just for the purpose of storing my vanilla beans.and just a note...even though I clicked the same link I originally purchased the beans from in 2010 and they came from a different company...International Spice Holdings LLP. AND even when I go to my orders to leave the review (it even says International Spice Holdings LLP  on the invoice) it brings me to the JR Mushrooms & Specialties page!! They were packaged differently from the first time I got them too! But that made no difference in the quality!

I live in a fairly large city, Green Bay, so one would think that it would be relatively easy to find some good vanilla beans. This just isn't the case...Almost 6 months ago, in February, I purchased 1/2 pound of these vanilla beans and I couldn't believe how fast they were shipped to me! And I was beyond excited to get them!! I made my own vanilla extract with some of them, shared some with friends, and made lots of vanilla sugar. Sadly, I ran out of my beans and had to suffice one time with a bean that wasn't quite as good... But, I just placed another order for some more of these beans, so I'll be happy as a clam again in a few days!My vanilla beans arrived perfectly plump and juicy. They have great flavor and made my entire house smell wonderful the entire time I had them. I even told my boss how great they were, and she paid me to add on a package of the beans for herself. I would definitely recommend this product.

I recieved my order today and was very happy with what I got!  Just as described and they smell so good even through the sealed package!  I am planning on using them for making home made vanilla for teacher gifts this year!  I would recommend this vendor and product very highly!

These beans are wonderful. I opened the package to find these big plump aromatic beans. I love it. Even better than the last ones I purchased. I make my own vanilla extract and it's going to be great. I am very pleased with this purchase.

These beans were just as described and I got 71 of them in my 1/2 lb package!  Like others, I was making vanilla and these worked perfectly.  They were moist and easy to cut.  Extras were saved (one thrown in with the sugar) for the next round of vanilla making!
I bought the vanilla beans to make vanilla extract and was impressed with the quality. They were so fresh and fragrant! It was an added bonus when they arrived early too

I was looking for a good deal on vanilla beans and thought I might be taking a gamble when I ordered these, but I was pleasently surprised. The aroma of vanilla could be smelled before I opened the box. The beans were moist, and pliable. I used one to make a large batch of oatmeal yesterday with some cinnamon and sugar and it was delicious. The only reason I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 is because the resealable bag they were sent in won't do a darn thing to keep air out.  So I followed the advice someone else left on another review and wrapped them individually in plastic wrap.  I will up date this post in a few months to let you know how they fare over time.
These vanilla beans were the best ever. Much better than I have purchased from some of the best spice stores.

column9: Intoxicating aroma! Very plump and full of seeds!
column10: I'm more than impressed with the quality of these beans! They come in a vacuum-sealed plastic bag and are truly pristine! I've been using them to make my own homemade pure vanilla extract. The result is absolutely heavenly! Couldn't be more pleased with this product!

The bubble package had been opened when we recived it, so we have no assurance that the beans are safe or if they have been tampered. The aroma is not a "vanilla" aroma. We have used vanilla beans several times and have never experienced this unusual aroma.

I purchased these beans to make some homemade vanilla extract. I found some vanilla beans at a market near me, but they were sellng 2 beans for $8!!! These were delivered early on a Saturday instead of the Tuesday they were scheduled. The beans were in a nicely vacuume sealed bag, but I was still able to smell the strong vanilla scent. I used a ton of beans for the extract and still have a ton remaining. The beans were moist and plump.  I will update after my extract is complete and after using it to make vanilla bean ice cream.

It is so great to receive a natural product that has not been denatured (essential oils partially or wholly removed).These beans are the real thing - moist, plump and full of aroma and flavor.Two (2) beans in "McCormick" brand sell in WalMart for nearly $10 - that's $5 per bean.  These are around $0.40 per bean.

What a lovely product!  Huge, moist, fragrant beans bursting with rich, flavorful seeds.  I am making wonderful vanilla sugar for sprinkling; also custards, ice cream and liqueurs. Great company.  Product came fast and packed well.Vanilla Heaven!

These beans came sealed and when I opened the package, my whole kitchen filled with the amazing aroma of fresh vanilla. They were perfectly fresh and I've made several dessserts with them already.  I will definitely order more soon, as I plan to make vanilla extract for Christmas gifts.  Thank you!!!!!

I thought these arrived on time, and packaged really well sealed in an airtight plastic. I used them to make a huge batch of vanilla extract. I put them in a large jar with Vodka in February and the extract was ready by April. Whenever I need vanilla beans (like when I made ice cream a couple weeks ago) I just pull a bean out of the extract, snip off the end and squeeze the paste right out. Works perfect! (Got that idea from Ina Garten, love her!)

They arrived in a vacuum sealed pouch, exactly as I expected. I could feel through the packaging how moist they were, a sure hallmark of a quality bean. Arrived in a timely manner. With vanilla bean prices soaring, I jumped on these puppies because the price was reasonable and was not going to be caught short.
Beans arrived earlier than I anticipated.  They smelled wonderful!  I'm using them to make home made vanilla. I would reccomend this product, and I would buy it again.

I was very pleased when my beans arrived today. They were moist and plump and smelled so good! As soon as I came home I started making homemade extract. I hope it works!! I need to find some more recipes to use some of these! Will buy again from them when I need more rather than spend $13 for 2 dried up beans in the store!

I bought these mainly to make my own vanilla.  I put a liter of vodka and 23 beans in the bottle (as recommended by another reviewer) and it's looking good!!  I plan to use the remaining beans in cooking. I hope they're as good as they smell!!
I had to wait awhile to get these but it was worth it.  The beans were beautiful and smelled wonderful! I'm making home-made vanilla extract to give to my daughters for Christmas.
I'll revisit this site again, so I can keep making my own PURE VANILLA and using it for gifts as well.  This is great.  I'm more than pleased.  So glad it was this easy to find.

column9: Delicious, Fresh, Wonderful, Everything I Hoped For!
column10: I was extremely happy with this product...it arrived in excellent shape, and the beans were long, plump, tasty....I found them to be wonderful additions to many foods my wife prepared, and when we scraped out the pods we placed the pods in our sugar bowl, giving our sugar a happily vanilla undertone in, say, coffee, tea, etc.Perfect!

These beans far surpassed my expections!  I have bought vanilla beans in the past.  This is the best deal and the best quality I have come across.  I purchased these to make my own vanilla extract and for other recipes.  Vanilla extract came out better than store bought.  My home made cookies have never tasted better!
The vanilla beans came super fast and they look and smell amazing, they came in a vacum-sealed package that can be resealed.  And obviously the price is excellent.

I had purchased some extract beans (from another company) and was looking forward to trying the higher grade beans.  When I opened the package (which arrived promptly) I was not blown away by a heavenly aroma of vanilla and at first was dissapointed, the beans, however, were (are) moist and plump and when I made a custard with them the flavor was rich and heavenly.  I put the beans into a couple zip lock bags and put them away, and a couple days I started smelling this amazing smell, like REALLY nice pipe tobacco, it of course was the beans (I bought a nice airtight container for them)These are fantastic and far FAR better than anything I've ever gotten from the grocery store, I will be buying these again (and again).
these were far better than what you buy in the grocery store!  they came vacuum packed and fresh.  bigger and better than anything you can buy in the stores. will definitely buy them again!!
It was what I wanted, thanks I can't wait to try the homeade vanilla that I am making with this product.

Got the vanilla bean order today and like other 5 star reviewers I am impressed with the quality of the beans.  They are moist, fragrant, and slightly oily (as they should be).  They came vacuum sealed in a heavy plastic bag.I am impressed with the value (paid $23.27 here on Amazon.)  Last time I priced vanilla beans in my local Whole Paycheck analogue, they were $7.95 for three; last time I broke down and bought them there, probably 16 months ago or so, the beans were not as good quality.  Last time I priced Bourbon Vanilla Extract was last Christmas and it was $14.95 for 4 oz.Overall, I am pleased with the quality, the quantity (60 beans in my half pound) and the value.  I have a quart of extract "brewing" already; I even sprang for the high-dollar microdistillery brewed vodka!
The price is great and the beans are wonderful! They aren't hard to store and they are wonderful to use in vanilla bean cupcakes.
I have purchased this product a couple of time I love them for cookies and for making vanilla sugar and they have always been plump and moist and a great bargain if u bake alot

column9: Premium Vanilla Beans -- Fresh and perfect
column10: These beans arrived in a vacuum sealed package.  They were soft and fragrant and perfect for making our own vanilla extract.  I have the beans marinating and can't wait for the vanilla to be ready.  Shipping was super fast.  Will be making ice cream soon with fresh vanilla.

I was very impressed with the quality of the vanilla beans I received. Not only were they at least 60% less expensive than the beans in grocery/specialty stores, but the beans were plump and very flavorful. I also received my order very quickly (sooner than the seller stated). I will definitely be back to buy my next batch of vanilla beans here.
I bought these beans to make vanilla with vodka.  They were moist, good quality and much cheaper than other places I looked at.  Highly recommended.

I bought these beans for all my baking needs--creme brulee, cakes, custards, and the like--and as other reviewers have stated, they are beautiful, moist and plump. I actually received closer to 80 beans in the package, so it's an even better deal. I will definitely purchase them again when I run out...which won't be for a long while!! Wonderful product.

Made pure vanilla extract. Recipes on line.These beans were great,they came vacuum sealed an very fresh.Had 54 beans for under ten dollars.I will recommend these beans to anyone.I'm sure i will order more.Many people will receive vanilla extract for presents this year.Ialso received I also received my beans in less than a week regular shipping.be kool big dave.
Arrived promptly...as advertised....smells great...packaged well, awesome priceVery happy with purchase, hope to do business with them again in the future
Product arrived a lot sooner than expected.  Vacuum sealed and wonderfully fragrant upon opening.  The homemade vanilla I'm using them for should make excellent Christmas cookies!

These vanilla beans are of very high quality. I'm very pleased with the purchase. They aren't quite as long and fat as some that I got at a gourmet store for three bucks each, but the flavor is equally excellent. And really, 54 beans for the same price as six at the local store? I can afford to use more :)
maybe becase of this heart shape thing....it costs twice as much as regular Truffles same brand...great product thought! but i'd rather get it from the local store twice as much for less
No thanks - too much. We paid $17 for this in December and it is almost $27 in March. Jif took it off the market for a while but it's back - just at a 60% price increase.
I like this peanut butter and was getting ready to order it again, but the price has MORE than DOUBLED since my last order in December!  Are you kidding me?????

column9: Too bad it tastes so good!
column10: It's delicious, but I won't be ordering again, because I can't keep my hands off it! It tastes just as good as the more fattening version!
Arrived promptly, good price.  Would purchase again if peanut butter keeps going up in the stores.  It's nice to get a product shipped right to  your home in large quantity like this.

The price was great!  Delivery was right on time and of course the product is Delicious~I would recommend this to anyone who is a peanut butter lover.  It is half the fat and calories as regular peanut butter.
