I HAVE PUT AWAY SEVERAL CASES OF THIS STUFF..OK, IT'S MORE THAN SEVERAL, BUT I JUST FOUND OUT THE PRICE OF PEANUT BUTTER IS ABOUT TO GO UP DUE TO THE DROUGHT.  WELL, AT LEAST I WON'T STARVE.I DID WANT TO TELL ABOUT THE SINUS SURGERY, BECAUSE IF THERE IS ANYONE OUT THERE THAT'S CONSIDERING ANY KIND OF SURGERY, YOU MIGHT WANT TO MENTION THE COCAINE THING TO YOUR SURGEON IF YOU HAVE A PROBEM WITH STIMULATES.BOTTOM LINE..THIS IS THE BEST DARN PEANUT BUTTER IN THE WORLD, IN MY OPINION.

This reduced fat peanut butter taste good, but probably because its so high in sugar.  I didn't realize the high sugar content and high fructose corn syrup until I received it.  I also ordered some sunland natural peanut butter that contains sugar but no high fructose corn syrup.  In the future I'll avoid the high fructose corn syrup and hydrogenated oils too which this product contains both.

I looked for other products by this company (Living Tree) because I was very impressed with their almond butter and tahini. I wasn't totally sure how I would like this but was looking for things that could work as *healthy* light snacks throughout the day.  So I knew this would be healthy because of Living Tree's commitment to quality ... but I did not know it would be this outrageously delicious! I had to read the jar after my first bites because I could not exactly place this amazing blend of flavors that happen in every bite.  It's a dense pesto, more paste like , not like a sauce or liquid.  The base is lush sun-dried tomato flavor, which also gives it a very slightly chewy texture from the sun dried tomatoes ... just enough to be amazing. And then five or six other ingredients that go together perfectly, with every chew releasing a new harmony of texture and flavor. Each ingredient is a health star! It's good dabbed on almond crackers, on carrot sticks or celery. I know I will find many other uses, like warm pasta would release some of the flavors even more.  Thank you Living Tree for your amazing products and your commitment to an ethical, healthy industry not to mention *deliciousness*.  Truly outstanding and worthy.

This is by far the best organic product out there for this wonderful tasty tomato almond pesto.. Its very concentrated, a lil goes a very long way... that jar is packed full with nutrition with ALL goodness!  I LOVE THIS COMPANY!!  they have extremely high standards!!

column9: Best organic chicken noodle I've found.
column10: We love the flavor of Campbell's hearty chicken noodle, and Progresso's is a close second. But these days, we want an organic alternative from a socially conscious company, so we've been trying all the different brands from Wolfgang Puck (weird strong seasonings) to Health Valley (almost no chicken and milky liquid) to Imagine (flavor okay, but almost no chicken and overcooked noodles) to Muir Glen (tasteless and the company is owned by General Mills). This Pacific Natural Foods Organic Chicken Noodle Soup is the best we have found, the closest to the major brands in flavor and contents, texture and amount of chicken. On the down side, I don't know if the foil lined boxes are recyclable.

I bought this beef jerky based almost solely on the other customers' reviews, and now that I've tasted it, I am so pleased with this purchase.  This is absolutely the best beef jerky I've ever eaten, hands down.  The pieces are so moist and tender, and it is very flavorful as well!  There is no doubt in my mind that I will be buying more of this jerky, and I recommend anyone who's reading this and considering it should do the same.

column9: If you like Jerky it doesn't get any better than this,
column10: Buffalo Bills 8oz Teriyaki Beef JerkyI ordered Buffalo Bills 8oz Barbecue Country Cut Beef Jerky Pack and got a free sample of Buffalo Bills 8oz Teriyaki Beef Jerky with it.If Virgil had eaten this stuff it would be defined as "the food of Gods"  If you like Jerky it doesn't get any better than this, at least I haven't eaten it.I highly recommend this product.  Since I'm a diabetic I should say it has 2 grams of carbohydrates per 1 ounce of product.  I eat it as a dessert, about 1 ounce at a time.Gunner  January, 2010

This is by far the best Teriyaki Jerky I have tasted. It is a thick cut, salty, sweet and tender. The price is the only thing that is no good. I would buy more if it was bulk or reasonable but this seems to be the only place to purchase. I am a repeat customer and will continue. Thanks!!
This was a wonderful company to order from.  It arrived early and they even gave me a sample of another flavor.  The Teriyaki has so much flavor and it's so chewy and moist.  I'm a fan!

Everything was good about this jerky except the saltiness. The pieces were very moist and tender and it had a very distinct teriyaki flavor. If it wasn't so darn salty I would have given it 5 stars. I ended up giving this bag away.I've tried other flavors from Buffalo Bills that I loved, but this wasn't one of them. If you like things extra salty then go for it, if not you might want to look elsewhere. Buffalo Bill's  cajun flavor beef jerky is outstanding!

This is the first time I've had this brand and I must say it's excellent. Lots of well cooked and flavored meat and it is moist. I'll definitely be buying more of this!I'd also like to add that the shipping was fast and the item was well packaged. My only complaint is about the price. It is rather expensive but still this will be a nice treat every now and then.

Teriyaki is something I use on the grill all the time. It's a specific flavor and one that I love. But in this jerky, the flavor just seems to become way too salty. The jerky from Buffalo Bills is very moist and tender it's true, but it also has a wetness to it when you reach into the bag that I didn't find appealing. Have had better teriyaki jerky and would not order this again.

Possibly the best "jerky" I have ever tasted, and all my friends that sampled it agreed! It is moist and easy to chew, which is a bonus for us over 50's. It looked almost like freshly cooked steak strips! It did not look "processed", Excellent in every way except the price. This was just too high to purchase again, unfortunately.

I ordered this product on a whim and was pleasantly surprised! Easily some of the best beef jerky around. Not overly sweet or salty, but with lots of flavor. Extremely tender as well. I immediately gifted some to the family and they were hooked instantly! I've been buying a steady supply for all of us ever since. Due to a change in Amazon's shipping service, a couple of orders arrived a little late - with one coming in a completely squished box. Choo Choo R Snacks were very helpful and appreciative of the situation and even sent a nice little care package filled with goodies and a lovely card!  An excellent product backed by a standup company. Can't go wrong!

Satisfyingly thick and tender like the BBQ jerky I tried earlier. I know teriyaki isn't everyone's cup of tea, but if you into salty and sweet, this might be worth trying. Good for camping and it's light years better than the jerky you see in convenience stores. This company really knows how to do beef jerky.
This was a very good product! I loved it and would highly recommend it to anyone!! I plan on ordering more when I can.
Not my favorite flavor but I love any Jerky from this supplier so no complaints here. I don't think you will either.

Ordered some Honey Beef Sticks (highly recommended by the way) from these folks as an alternative to Jerky. Most national brands I have tried are very unforgiving to my mid-life toofs' if you know what I'm talking about so I gave up on jerky of late. When I received my order of beef sticks I was pleasantly surprised to find a sample pack of this Jerky included! I was blow away by the flavor and most of all how tender and easy to chew it was. This product melts in your mouth...they obviously start with quality meat!! I was so impressed I immediately placed an order! I can eat jerky again!!

I ordered Buffalo Bills 1.4 lb Western Cut Beef Jerky Pack and got a free sample of Country Cut Teriyaki Beef Jerky with it. This jerky is amazing!  Whole family finished it in a matter of minutes!  Country Cut is very different from the Western cut, but both are great.  Will definitely order more and I am happy I took a risk and tried it out.

Today was the first day I've ever tried Buffalo Bill brand Beef Jerky.  It was at my door in like 4 days, which was sweet.  The expiration date does not stand out and was hard to read.  But best I can tell I've got 11 months until it expires.I had the Honey Pepper earlier and really enjoyed it (A++++++) and polished off a 1.75 oz bag in a minute.  The Teriyaki was very good and worthy of a 5 star.  I would recommend the Honey Pepper if options are available, but this was really good beef jerky.I highly recommend the moist and tender teriyaki beef jerky, eh!!!

I got a small sample pack of this jerky with another product from the same company.  Although the other product, their "Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Mild Short Shots (120 beef sticks per bag)" wasn't bad and I rated it four stars, I found the little sample pack of this jerky to be the real highlight of the order.  I'm strongly considering ordering a pack of this jerky, or a couple packs in a couple different flavors now despite having just gotten the package of snack sausage today, it's that good.Addendum:  I did order two 8 ounce packs based on the sample they sent me with my first order, and I just got them Friday.  The quality is consistant with the sampler pack, this is a wonderful beef jerky.  Fairly easy to chew, not at all tough.  Nice flavor that I'd describe as a mix of soy sauce and slightly smokey perhaps, with just a hint of sweetness.  They again sent a sample, this time of their barbeque flavor.  I liked it but I do think the Teriyaki is better.  Still, I may review the BBQ flavor since it was good as well.  I also ordered some of their vennison jerky, which is flavored well (smokey and some soy flavor) but not cut the same, the vennison jerky is made from pressed pieces of meat, not small whole dried strips from what I can see.  Still, I'd also consider the vennison jerky for times when I want something different then this flavor.

Buffalo Bills 3.5 oz Teriyaki Beef JerkyI ordered Buffalo Bills 8oz Barbecue Country Cut Beef Jerky Pack and got a free sample of Buffalo Bills 8oz Teriyaki Beef Jerky with it.If Virgil had eaten this stuff it would be defined as "the food of Gods"  If you like Jerky it doesn't get any better than this, at least I haven't eaten it.I highly recommend this product.  Since I'm a diabetic I should say it has 2 grams of carbohydrates per 1 ounce of product.  I eat it as a dessert, about 1 ounce at a time.Gunner  March. 2010
The Country Cut beef jerky is wonderful. I never thought beef jerky could be so tender and tasty. No more boring snacks - the Teriyaki flavor makes this beef jerky a special treat every time.

column9: Tough and too greasy for my taste
column10: Not a very good jerky.  I prefer several other drier jerky products.  They responded to my criticisms and are sending me a sample of another product from their store.
Didn't know what to expect but I was impressed.  Nice and juicy.  Really tasty.

I ordered this teriyaki beef jerky base on the free sample that came with another order (which is a great way to promote the product).  I thought it tasted really good and wanted more, however the teriyaki jerky i recieved tasted nothing like the sample i was given.  This was really dissapointing because i was really excited to recieve this product.  Some people might like this, but i find it has a weird overpowering flavor that is really offputting.  I did order the honey pepper also and that is much better get that one instead!

Great tea, good taste and its well beyond soothing for bedtime but please be warned that it does contain st. john's wart which is an herb that can reduce the effectiveness of your hormonal birth control pill.  Check the warnings on you pill, mine warns against taking st. johns wart.
Have tried all the other bedtime teas at the health food store, and this is the best.  And the price here is great, too--about 40% less than in stores.

*****This Bedtime Tea from Yogi Tea is an caffeine-free herbal tea that is relaxing and a natural sleep aid. Bedtime Tea is made from organic licorice root, organic spearmint leaf, organic chamomile flower, organic skullcap leaf, organic cardamom seed, organic cinnamon bark, organic St. John's Wort leaf & flower, organic rose hips, natural orange flavor, valerian root extract, organic raspberry leaf, organic English lavender flower, stevia leaf, and passion flower extract. The taste is mild, delicious, herb-y, and very slightly sweet. It is subtle and lovely.I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Bedtime Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site has a helpful glossary of tea ingredients and is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.There is a warning on the box that this tea is not to be used during pregnancy or while nursing. If you are taking MAO inhibitors or other prescription drugs, you should consult your physician or health care professional before use. There are no other cautions or warnings on the box except the standard disclaimer that the tea is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.Best of all, it works...I love drinking it before bed to relax and drift off into blissful sleep. This is a great tea that I highly recommend.*****

I drink Yogi Bedtime Tea before going to bed because it relaxes me and helps me fall asleep.  If the noisey neighbor wakes me up at 3:00 am, I drink some of this tea and can get back to sleep.  Otherwise, I toss and turn for hours.

column9: great tea but too much stevia
column10: My 10 yr. old and I drink caffeine free tea every night. This one has more and seemingly better ingredients than our usual sleep time tea, but it is too heavy on the stevia leaf which leaves a very strong "sweet & low" type aftertaste.It does have very relaxing qualities and the flavor is great until the aftertaste of each sip. I am going to try using one bag of this and one bag of our usual sleep time tea to see if this helps because it really is a good tea if you are used to using artificial sweetners (as I am not) and want a healthier alternative. Half as much stevia and I would give it 5 stars.

I picked up Yogi Bedtime Tea because a) I'm a tea lover and b) I was searching for teas that might make me sleepy. So far, Yogi's Bedtime is the only one that does the job. One mug makes me pretty drowsy and ready to go to sleep. Two mugs make me very loopy and three mugs just put me under. I sleep through the night and wake up feeling slightly groggy; however, the feeling passes quickly and I'm ready to start my morning. If you're having a hard time getting to sleep, or if you know you need to sleep but just aren't ready to settle down yet, this can help.I notice the information for this tea advises you to drink it during the day to calm and relax yourself. I can't imagine doing that. I would pass right out. (Definitely don't drink this before driving anywhere!)The tea is sweetened with Stevia which does leave a taste in the back of your mouth. It is not altogether unpleasant but might irritate some.Also, as another reviewer mentioned, some of the ingredients in this tea can interact with certain medications such as hormonal birth control, so be advised and ask your doctor first.
Of all the valerian teas I've tried, this one tastes best.  It's not quite as strong as some but you can always use two bags.  Very relaxing, very calming, really does help you sleep.

I am an eighteen-year-old college student and I love this tea. A friend gave me a pack and one night when I couldn't sleep, I took it and it was so utterly calming. It doesn't put me to bed quickly but the feeling I get from this tea is wonderful. I love taking it before bed because even if I'm not tired, I start feeling drowsy. The taste is also moderate. I personally need two spoons of sugar with tea or coffee and this needs nothing.  The taste at first is bland and bleh, but the after taste is sweet and stays in the back of your mouth for a while.I also gave my tea to two young children I was looking over with a friend. They were hyper ten-year-olds that ran up the walls and yelled a lot. We gave them the tea (with a bit of sugar and lied saying that there was honey in it) and the two drank the tea and enjoyed every bit of it. Sad thing was, they were too hyper for it to even work on them but it did calm them down slightly.Also, please remember to read the warning label! It states that mothers to be and nursing mothers should not drink the tea! I honestly don't know what will happen if they do but it's best to not find out.
Tastey and straong for a bag tea. It really works as a sleep aid. It does have ingredents that may aggravate sensitive people.
I highly recomend this product to those who are able to use herbal treatments. It helped me greatly in getting a more sound sleep.
Yogi Tea Calm, Bedtime, Tea Bags, 16-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)This tea works really well if you drink it an hour before you plan to go to sleep.  It helps you gently relax...and doesn't harm the liver!

I am totally addicted to this tea.  It tastes wonderful and really relaxes me to sleep at night. I used to have to take benadryl if I really wanted to sleep, but now I just have a few bags of this and I'm out!!  I'll even drink it during the day if I'm stressed out.

First off, don't pay more than $3-$4 for this box. Kroger and some Walmarts carry this in their "organic" section.Secondly, the second time I used this I squeezed the teabag.  I was in a catatonic state for 4-5 hours afterward.  The best way I can describe this tea is that it WILL make you sleepy but doesn't put you to sleep.  My best analogy would compare this with alcohol.  Enough alcohol makes you drowsy but actually interferes with a restful sleep.BTW, valerian root acts on the same GABA receptors as Xanax, Ativan, and Klonipin.If you've been using this for a long period, ween yourself off ... don't stop taking this abrubtly.

As an individual who has difficulty falling asleep, I have tried a number of natural products to make it easier to fall asleep. A friend recommended Yogi Bedtime Tea and I have found that it works well for me. I also found that it is wise for me to get in bed and drink it there, it works that well for me.

I had been taking a low dose prescription drug to help me stay asleep at night.  I would often wake up in the middle of the night two or three times.  I wouldn't consider myself an insomniac but just wanted to stay asleep all night.  I have been using two tea bags in a large mug and drinking it about 30 minutes prior to going to bed.  I find myself falling asleep easily and staying asleep all night.  I'm cutting down and eliminating my prescription drug altogether.  It works!

I am a night owl, not by choice but because my mind is so full of information, stress, memories, etc I cannot just fall asleep. I have stopped drinking caffeine but still was having trouble. I usually would just pop a tylenol PM, and off I went, but wanted to break that habit and try to find some alternative natural way of relaxing and getting to sleep.A friend gave me a box of Yogi Bedtime tea, and I was skeptical. I knew that it wouldnt have the same effects as taking a pill, but I didnt think it would relax me to the point where I could stop taking the pills all together. I WAS WRONG.This tea of course didnt knock me out, but it for sure relaxed my mind, calmed me down, slowly nestled me into its aromatic comfort and I was in bed asleep quicker than quick! Its consistent, reliable and all natural and that is all I wanted out of this product.AND its delicious by the way, just keep it away from your cats, valarian root has the same effects on kitties as catnip.

I have not always been a serious tea lover, but this tea has really changed my mind about how wonderful tea can make you feel.  This bedtime tea has a much more rich and complex flavor than other sleepy time teas.  It does contain natural ingredients that may affect medications that you are currently taking, so please read the box.  I enjoy this tea in the evening.  It has a very rich flavor that does not need to be sweetened.I love the packaging so you can take some with you if you are traveling.  Included on every tea bag is an uplifting fortune.  The price here is so much cheaper than my natural health store.  I can buy the package of six here for what three boxes of tea cost at my local store.  All in all I really enjoy this tea, and have given away several packages as I find this tea relaxing and tasty.  If you are looking for a new bedtime tea, I would highly recommend this tea for you.
I was pleasantly surprised that this tea made me drowsy.  I knew it couldn't be the chamomile because other teas have been useless.I use 2 teabags each night.I enjoy the taste - no sugar needed.

This is the first bedtime tea I've tried.  I'm not much of a tea conossuier of any kind for that matter.  My wife bought a box from our local "whole foods" grocery for about $5.50 and I liked it.  I bought six boxes (including shipping) for $14.71 with Amazon's auto-refill option.This tea is very good tasting.  It definately helps me fall asleep.  I doubt the effect is chemical, I think it's more of a perception.  Anyway, I highly recommend this product.  Also, at $0.15 per bag you can't go wrong.  Happy tea drinking!

I have struggled with lack of sleep throughout much of my adult life.  By the time I got to sleeping only 2 to 3 hours a night I started to take this thing seriously.  Here's what I know now:-Forget about the easy route. Doctors don't perscribe 'knock-out' pills as in decades gone by.-Do find out from your doctor if you may be a candidate for 'sleep apnea'.  Find out what it is and if you have it. (It's dangerous and important that you find out!)  The good news is that most people are able to 'cure' sleep apnea by loosing weight. If you need to loose weight, do it now. You wont regret it. (Don't use a fad diet, eat a healthy lifestyle diet, such as by the American Dietetic Association, that you will continue for the rest of your life) For the record, I had sleep apnea and with loosing just 25 pounds was able to be healthier and sleep dramatically better.-While you are at it, investigate sleeping information on a quality web site like www.WEBMD.-Build some amount of exercise into every day. Even if all you do is walk around the block, get out and do it. Find out more about exercise, but don't do it if it leads to bodily pain.  Also, don't now exercise within several hours of trying to sleep.-Establish a FIRM time you wake every morning and STICK WITH IT!! If you decide to sleep in some days please know it may take several days or nearly a week to get back in the swing of things.  Decide what time you will wake, and let it be that time for the rest of your life.-I take YOGI Bedtime along with YOGI Kava (two bags in one cup) before bedtime.  I believe it helps.I also take "Sedalin" by Xymogen along with my Yogi Herbal Tea.  Sedalin is an herbal blend that has also really helped my sleep.-Also being realistic about your sleep duration is important.  Just because you slept 8 to 10 hours as a young person, don't expect that you will be able to achieve this now. I consider a night when I get 5 to 6 hours of good sleep a sucessful night. Very rarely do I sleep more than that. (Let me be the first to welcome you to older age!)Even given all of the above, I still have trouble sleeping some nights, but on the whole my sleep is much better than it has been.PLEASE KNOW THAT THE ABOVE IS ACTUALLY WHAT I DO TO AID MY SLEEP-YOU SHOULD CHECK WITH YOUR DOCTOR BEFORE BEGINNING ANY SUCH THERAPY.

I bought this tea because I'm a very light sleeper and often have difficulty staying asleep through the night. Although this tea isn't my favorite tasting of Yogi teas, it does the job. About 30 minutes after I finished my cup of tea I got a bit drowsy and I was out like a light when my head hit the pillow! I fell into such a deep sleep it was great. Too bad the taste wasn't better, next time I'll add some Splenda.

column9: Great Tasting W 20mg Valerian and others.
column10: I got one box of this from Super Target for about $3.75 for 16.Tea is comparable to Celestial Seasonings Sleepy Time Tea , though the STT Extra has 25 MG valerian, which is likely the strongest relaxing ingredient. The Yogi Tea, however, is far more tasty and I prefer the Yogi tea with a couple tspns of sugar. I researched the ingredients, and all are classic relaxation promoters with a long history of success. I wish they would make it clear how much of each ingredient was in the tea though.Overall, this is a wonderful tasting and effective tea .

Yogi Bedtime Tea makes it much easier for me to fall asleep at night.  I have fibromyalgia and sleeping is something that I do not do well, so when I find a product that helps me sleep, I love it and this one works well.

I drink this every night before bed and it really does relax me and help me fall asleep.  It has a little bit of sweetness and overall quite delcious. I definitely recommend this to anyone who is high strung and whose mind moves a mile a minute.

I have had insomnia all my life.  I take Unisom sometimes, but I don't like taking a pill to help me sleep.  I have been drinking this tea every night for a week and it really helps me to relax and sleep.  I have had some intense dreams after drinking this tea, but at least I am sleeping for once in my life. The taste is not unpleasant to me.  I love tea and this is not one I would drink for the taste, but it isn't bad.

I bought this because I read that it creates a calming effect and I get incredibly nervous when it comes to interviews. Since I have a bunch of interviews lined up I thought maybe if I drink some of this before the interview I wouldn't be as nervous...and let me tell you it worked! I brewed 2 tea bags in about 10 ounces of hot water, I took the tea once it was brewed and refrigerated it, then took it once it was cold and transferred it to an empty water bottle and 10-15 minutes before the interview I chugged the entire 10 ounces. Halfway through filling out the application I felt this incredibly strong calmness take over and I was no longer nervous at all. By the end of the interview I was shocked at how calm and easy the whole application/interview process had gone. About an hour or two after drinking it however I did feel a very intense urge to sleep, I took a nap for about a half an hour and woke up with a huge headache. The headache is the reason I gave this tea a 4 instead of a 5. It'd easily earn 5 stars if I hadn't woke up with a headache, I will definitely have some of this tea before any stressful event I plan to attend.

This tea actually has a soothing, relaxing effect that is noticeable. It's like a mild sedative--very mild. Its affects last perhaps a half an hour. But if you want something to help you relax and get in the mood for a good night's sleep, it's just right. Also, this tea tastes fantastic. Even though it has valerian root in it, which in capsule form smells light rotting gym socks, the tea has this minty, herby, sweet aftertaste that makes it good all by itself, even aside from the relaxing affects.

Yogi Bedtime, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)I decided to try this tea because I was out of Unisom and not in the mood to cross the street under the blazing tropical sun to visit the pharmacy. Now, I'm not actually an insomniac, but I am high-strung and nervous and tend to be over-anxious about... stuff and just have trouble sleeping at night. I'm sick of pharmaceutical drugs, you know how that goes right? I take a drug to fix one problem, the side effects create another problem so I take another drug to fix that problem... wash rinse repeat.. I'm sick of that. I'm too young to feel this old.SO: Herbal stuff is less complicated, for me anyway. This tea is delicious. Just add hot water. Perfect for my tired and well, lazy soul. And it works too. It relaxes me, I sleep through the night every time. I've noticed that I dream more when I drink this. I have really long, vivid dreams that I actually remember when I wake up. That's different for me. I like it!!! I've done some googling and I suspect it is the Valerian. Or maybe I'm just crazy...I was so impressed that I also tried Yogi Peach DeTox, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) and Yogi Skin DeTox, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) and they taste good too. Seem to be working also. I am thinking now that maybe Yogi products are good stuff that works. So I'm going to try their Yogi Breathe Deep, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) and Yogi Woman's Moon Cycle, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6) to see if those will help my other annoying health issues. Will let you all know how that works out.So there you have it. Yogi Bedtime tea is awesome.

column9: This tea really works for me!
column10: I brew a small pot of tea every night and this tea has improved my sleep duration tremendously. I had trouble falling asleep, and this tea has really helped me.
Maybe I'm imagining it, but this stuff seems to do what it promises. Tastes good, too, though a little sweet.
It's a very good tasting tea if you like licorice, that flavor is among the more potent flavors, in my opinion.

column9: One of My Favorite Yogi Teas
column10: This is a wonderful, relaxing tea that tastes great on its own (slightly sweet) or sweetened with a few drops of stevia.  A single tea bag works for me, but you can brew a slightly stronger cup with two bags, if needed.  I only use one and probably drink this about 3 nights a week, since I take Source Naturals L-Tryptophan 500mg, 120 Tablets, Country Life - Chelated Magnesium, 250 mg, 180 tablets, and Source Naturals Melatonin 2.5mg, Peppermint, 240 Tablets as part of my healthy sleep regimen.I find this tea relaxing and calming, but not necessarily sleep-inducing.  Everyone's biochemistry is different, so you'll need to experiment.  I wouldn't however, recommend this for daytime use.  If you need some daytime relaxation & you're not on prescription medications, try this:  Yogi St. John's Wort Blues Away, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6).Yogi's Bedtime Tea is one of my favorites; highly recommended by an enthusiastic tea fan!

I first tried this after a family member died and I inherited most of her pantry items. I am not a big fan of "minty" bedtime teas, but I gave this a try anyway since I had never tried the Yogi brand before. I am now hook! The flavor is so much better than your typical bedtime teas. The mint flavor is there, but not so overpowering. I really love this tea!
yogi teas are the best tasting tea i have ever bought,but i could never find them in most local stores, so when amazon had them for such a low price i bought quite a lot.
This is my favorite sleep-time tea.  Works better than any other sleep-tea product.  Tastes great!
much cheaper if you buy it in the six pack, helps me rest before bed time, i use it almost every nite
Even after price increase Amazon still has the best price if you get enough for free shipping.
I've bought this tea in the store, and I really like how it tastes. My grocery store doesn't sell it anymore, so I ordered this six-pack online to last me.

This tea tastes terrible. I was very disappointed. I would not recommend it to anyone. I am a tea drinker and always love the natural flavor of the tea and the soothing feeling you get after you drink it. This tea tastes more or less like over the counter cold medicine.

column9: i love YOGI teas, but this one doesn't work for me......
column10: i've tried many calming & bedtime teas & none of them work for me, this is no exception. maybe i'm just immune to the ingredients???  i don't know. or perhaps i am just WAY too high strung & i need a triple dose or something.  all i know is it didn't help me fall asleep the two or three times i tried it.  and i don't like the taste of valerian, so while this blend really isn't that bad compared to some others i've tried it is "not my cup of tea".

column9: Good but tastes a bit medicinal
column10: The tea works but sometimes I think that it causes me to have strange dreams.

Taste like cough syrup! It's kind of sugary but has a very plastic and unnatural taste, and a slightly bittersweet after-taste.Wait, no, it's not exactly sweet. It's just slightly bitter. And leaves a very, very strange, chemical-like, unnatural sensation on your tongue... Yup, taste like cough syrup!

This is my favorite bedtime tea. I used to use Sleepytime, then Sleepytime Extra, but this product is better tasting and more effective for making me drowsy. The ingredients also appear to be higher quality. It has a pleasant flavor similar to chamomile but with other herbs added.
Great tasting too! Would highly recommend as a gentle yet powerful blend of non-toxic herbs that calm the body & mind into a blissful sleep.

I came across this tea a few years ago and decided to give it a try when I was having trouble sleeping. Now I won't say that it's a miracle tea and knocks you flat on your butt after a few sips but it is calming. It has a great flavor to it too which I didn't expect with all the herbs and spices. Plus you get a hint of sweetness from the stevia that helps tie all the flavors together. I've tried other bedtime tea's and so far this one is my favorite.
Drinking tea usually helps me relax anyways so I can't speak to its Bedtime abilities. However, I do enjoy the flavor immensly! It has a real earthly and spice flavor.

I love this tea. I find that I have trouble falling asleep without this tea in my nighttime ritual. It tastes great, a little sweet and very mild. It's not overly minty like others I have tried. This is a great tea to send yourself off to sleep with...

I take medications that do not allow me to sleep. Instead of adding more prescription medications I was told about this tea. It is all natural which I like because I don't have to worry about side effects with my other medications. My boyfriend is a cop and when he comes in late or leaves early in the morning I don't wake up. I finally found something that helps me to get the deep sleep I need to rest my body. I tell everyone about this tea! It really does work!!

Overall, I think it does help both ways.  The psycho effect is that when you drink it you expect it to work.  The taste is acceptable, but I wouldn't say it is delicious.  The drawback is that before bed, you need to drink it.  It might actually cause you to pee during the night which is what it supposed to do.  I am the type that need to avoid drinking too much after 8 o clock.  If not, during the night i might need to wake up for the bathroom

I just started drinking tea three months ago. Started with a Whole Foods brand green tea. Taste is sort of blah but I'm used to it now. Was having some insomnia around that time and came across this Yogi Bedtime tea.  I have to say that I am sold. This tea is absolutely delicious. I can not wait to drink a cup every night (and have not missed a night since I started drinkiing it). Additionally, my sleeping has never been better in my entire lifetime.Amazon's subscribe and save price is a great deal too. I pay $3.99 a box at Whole Foods. On Amazon, I can get six boxes for $12.70. (my last order was $17 and I thought that was a great price.)

column9: I never believed an herbal tea would put me to sleep...
column10: ...until now! Yogi tea has made a believer out of me! I'm now going to order about 5 different types and try them out, including Passion Perfect Energy, Get Regular, and Stomach Ease.

column9: The best for a good night's sleep
column10: This is the best sleep aid that I've tried. There's some valerian but not enough to make me groggy. The other herbs all seem to help, and the whole effect is very good. I use two or three teabags in a big cup of very hot water and brew for 10 minutes. Try it!

My fiance and I have a hard time sleeping. He can never stay asleep and I can never get to sleep. He found this tea and we started drinking it. I couldn't believe how delicious it was. We don't even use sweeteners. Both us of fall right to sleep now. My fiance stays to sleep and has so much more energy now. We drink it every night. Awesome stuff.

column9: Tastes great and does what it's supposed to
column10: When I have trouble winding down, I make myself this tea. It has stevia in it, so once I weaned myself off of needing REALLY SWEET tea, I realized that I don't need to add anything to it. The longer it steeps, the better it tastes. This is what started my love affair with Yogi teas. It's usually about $4.50 a box in the grocery stores (DC area, so your mileage may vary), so the subscribe and save option on here, or even just getting one six pack, is a HUGE savings. Highly recommended.

I have tried three different Yogi tea varieties and they are great. Compared to similary products that I have bought in the grocery store in the past, Yogi teas have more flavor and seem to produce a stronger infusion. They are about the same price as the comparable teas. The Bedtime tea is so flavorful that sweetening is not needed. The desired effect of the tea is to produce sleep and it works. I recommend this tea.

I have been using Yogi Bedtime Tea for a while.  It really does help you to relax and sleep!  I have been buying it at Whole Foods and it's expensive there!  Sometimes they would have a 'twofer' sale but they would be sold out before I could buy it. I decided to try Amazon and found a pretty good deal. Bought 6 boxes and split the cost with a friend. !

Yogi Bedtime Tea totally crushes Celestial Seasonings' SLEEPYTIME tea.  I've tried both and the difference is amazing.  I have awakened at 3:00 am on some nights, made a cup of YBT and fell back asleep within 15 or 20 minutes.  It works everytime, so I take a cup of it every night about one hour before hitting the sack.  TRY IT!!!

column9: Works but I can't get over the taste.
column10: The valerian taste is a bit strong in this blend, it adds a odd sweetness.  The few times that I did make a cup it did help lull me to sleep.  But, I think I might stick with my other blends.

I grew up drinking Sleepy-time tea. I was convinced it had magical powers when I was a kid that would put me right to sleep. As an adult, I was looking for something with a little more punch. The Yogi Bedtime tea contains St. John's Wart so it does a much better job of relaxing you and helping you fall asleep.

I rarely have trouble sleeping, but when I do I drink this tea.  It really does work, though not sure how effective it would be if one were to drink it all the time.  My significant other, who does frequently have trouble sleeping, tried it and was really turned off by what he called the 'oily' taste.  It DOES have a certain viscous taste probably from the essential oils and herbs in the tea but it didn't bother me at all.  I found it to be an interesting difference from most teas, though I would not want to drink it often.  He did admit it might've had a positive effect on his sleep, yet still wont drink it because of the 'oiliness' so... so much for that.I'll be drinking it, and sleeping soundly.  I'm not sure I'd recommend it based on taste alone.  It's a somewhat pleasant herbal taste but nothing delicious.  For deliciousness alone, I HIGHLY recommend Yogi Egyptian Licorice Mint which I drink all the time and find to be the most soothing and tasty of all the Yogi teas.
It's a very soothing tea. I really recommend it for people who wants an after-dinner tea and a restful sleep at night.
Really good stuff.  Has more and better ingredients than most sleep aid tea.  Can not find it everywhere either.

I have fibromyalgia and my sleep cycle can really get off. I try many different things.  If you make this really concentrated it should help you sleep.  Not only did it help me sleep, when I stopped drinking it after 3 days, I was still able to get to sleep at a decent time and wake up 7-8 hours later without waking up in the middle of the night.  That's rare.
This tea has become a staple in our house. Nothing like this wonderful tasting tea to wind down with at the end of the day. The flavor is amazing! Try it! Can't beat this price on Amazon.

column9: Try this when you need to relax.
column10: I was having trouble winding down at night, so I shopped around and found this Yogi Bedtime tea. I loved it right off the bat because it smelled so wonderful. I was surprised by the licorice flavor because it wasn't overpowering at all. It was ever so mild in the back of my throat. Overall, the flavor was delicate and smooth. Although this didn't help me fall asleep, it was still a good tea that helped me relax and calm down after a long day.
I drink this tea everynight to help get to sleep. I highly recommend this tea to anyone who needs a little relaxer to help sleep.

I don't like the citrus after taste the tea leaves in the back of my throat.  My fiance, however loves it.  I will say however, that the mint scent is very relaxing.  It may be the way I am brewing the tea: I tried brewing for 1-2 minutes, 5-6 minutes and 9-10 minutes.  The box recommends a brew time of 9-10 minutes, but I've found that too short a brewing time tastes like poorly flavored watered, but too long a brewing time really kicks up the notch on that citrus after taste.  My fiance says that she doesn't think it taste like citrus, but rather more of a sweet honey flavor.Update: I now brew about 4 minutes but in a much bigger cup and now I enjoy the tea (although I still think other tea's taste better) So I'm changing from 3 stars to 4 stars.

This is the best of the "bedtime" teas.  I don't love all the yogi products, but i must have this in my cabinets at all times.  And it's become more challenging to find in my grocery stores, AND it's about $4 a box.  Amazon is cheaper and they bring it to my door!This tea offers both chamomille and valerian root.  the latter is similar to melatonin, in that it is a subtle herb and it builds up in your system over time.  I have a cup of Bedtime every evening around 8 or 9, and it helps me unwind.  I believe that part of the unwinding is the ritual of having tea everynight, but this tea does seem head and shoulders above the others i've tried.  and i like it.  What more could you ask?

column9: I'm sure it works if you can stomach it...
column10: I'm sorry to give this a poor review, but tea has to taste good in order for me to drink it. I often drink a large variety of bedtime teas and have never tasted any tea this awful. I can't speak for how well it works because I couldn't drink the whole cup even though I attempted to force myself. Yogi makes some good teas, but this I just couldn't stomach.
This tea is not a replacement for any sleep aid medication - this is much too weak to work as that. On the other hand, it is not a bad tasting tea and does not keep you awake either.

column9: Must Age to Gain Full Strength
column10: This tea is so mild that it has no real effect on me or my husband.  Tastes okay though.  I guess it may help you to relax a bit but as far as making you sleepy,  it just doesn't.Edit(08/24/2012):  This tea needs to age before it gains full strength.  When we first got it, seems it had no effect on either of us.  Now, a few weeks later, it has gained potency and when I tried it again, it definitely does pack a punch...it puts me to sleep.  We must have gotten a freshly made batch.  I have never had a bad experience with the Yogi teas but this Bedtime tea is the first one that did not live up to its claims at first.  I would order this again. I put honey and hazelnut creamer in it and it tastes very exotic and good that way. I do the same for the Yogi Triple Ecinachea tea also but I also add lemon balm tincture (15 drops) which really boosts the healing power of the tea to new levels!!!  It even heals cold sores overnight prepared with the lemon balm tincture(homeade with fresh lemon balm leaves steeped in 100-proof vodka). At my age, you need all the help you can get lol.

I've been trying various bedtime tea's & this one tastes horrible!! The first cup I tried I thought it was because i'd ate something just before drinking it & mabie that affected the taste, but I made myself another cup this evening at least 2 hrs. after eating & it was all I could do to finish it. I won't be drinking anymore Yogi tea, that's for sure!
wxcellent seller,great communiccation and speedy delivery of ordered product.Yogi Tea Calm, Bedtime, Tea Bags, 16-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

This tea does not work at all. I bought it considering the fact that it contains Valerian Root, which is the tea that aids sleep. Completely disappointed. Did not help me sleep at all after 2 weeks of taking it each night. It didn't even make me a little bit drowsy. If you want a good night's sleep without taking sleeping pills, take Valerian Root Tea. If your nearby food store does not have it (Whole Foods- been waiting for 3-4 months), then just get it online. Amazon has some really great prices. And yes, Valerian Root Tea Smells like straight up poop, but one bag knocked me out after 30 minutes and I suffer from MAJOR insomnia. Hope this helps. Do not get this tea!

This is the polar opposite of Sleepytime tea. I had one cup last night, and I laid in bed and didn't fall asleep till well after midnight, and then kept waking up every few minutes after that. Worst sleep I have gotten in my entire life! I'm going back to Sleepytime tea. At least that stuff works.

Honest I am not Patrick. I am Patrick's wife :)On with the review.....The yellow is probably the best tasting to me. My kids like it too followed by the pink and then the purple varieties. Each can contains 2 servings. The product uses melatonin and Valerian as it's "relaxation" ingredients. Other ingredients include sugar, b vitamins, rose hips, acai berry and natural flavors.I split a can between my 4 kids when we are transitioning from a "break" schedule back to a "school" schedule. We are all night owls and early mornings can be rough for us. So when I need to get them back into a schedule we rely on this stuff. Within a half hour or so they are in their beds asleep. I of course tried it for myself and it really does calm the body down making it easier to fall asleep. I highly recommend this product if you can find it. I can't say much about the price since it varies from each vendor. I find mine locally at the gas station here. You may go to  their site and see if it has places you can purchase in your town/city.

column9: Best price around on Pine Nuts!
column10: I love the 4 ounce size because its the perfect way to only use what you need at a time. They taste great and can't beat the per pound price!
Great pine nuts, I would suggest to anybody to buy them. Better than any other brand I have ever tried.
Good quality; arrived on time. Only wish they'd have a set of 3 or 4 packs too, apart from the 6 pack

I purchased these for my 93 year old Grandmother.  She loves pine nuts.  She has seen many pine nuts in her 93 years.  She declared Klein's Naturals Pine Nuts (Chinese Grade) to be the best she has ever tasted.  She likes them so much she wants to give Klein's as gifts just to show off.  She indicated the flavor, freshness and appearance make this a very high quality product.

Fabulous on salads, Fabulous on humus, Fabulous on lots of things I eat on a regular basis.It's amazing how these plain, simple pine nuts make a bland salad turn into a standout salad.I wouldn't consider being without this product in my kitchen.

column9: Healthy, portable, non-perishable(ish) product that tastes good
column10: There are a lot of conflicting views about soy but one dietary rule of thumb experts often agree on is most foods are safe in moderation.If you are on the run and need something to eat, there are very few options that are portable, non-perishable, and healthy.  I've spent significant time researching foods that meet these three categories and one of the select few options I identified was nuts.  Of course, only soy nuts have all of the amino acids to qualify as a complete protein.  Beyond their value as a quality protein source, soy nuts also provide a good balance of carbs, protein, and fat, one of the strongest of any single whole food.  This balance is important to maintaining blood sugar levels and deriving a sated feeling from the food, and it also conforms to various diet plans, i.e., the Zone.  These soy nuts provide all these benefits without even the negative of added salt/sodium.Conclusion - it's worth researching whether substitution of soy nuts, especially on an infrequent schedule, for other types of snack food is right for you.  I happen to think it is.I received this product fairly quickly and it met the description on Amazon.  I'm deducting one star only because the taste of these soy nuts is not quite as good as green soy beans that i've roasted at home myself.  However, the taste isn't bad, in fact it's reminiscent of popcorn kernels without the toughness if you've ever accidentally eaten one of those.

I like soynuts. I think these would be better to snack on if they weren't so dry. So not sureexactly their process. I will say, I put them in my cereal, and with the milk and other things I add,they are fine.

There are no expiration dates on the bottles of yeast. I am assuming they have been setting a long time because the seals on the bottle are dried out and failing. The product arrived linking out of the bottles.
Great protein and B12 supplement. Tastes great and can be used on salads, smoothies, popcorn and more.

column4: Robert Lipsitz "study but doubt, question and...
column10: Ever since I started marathon running I've been searching for a calorie supplement. Ive tried the gels, goos and cubes but was never satisfied. The cubes are too big and its hard to breath while chewing them. The goos and gels are just too dessicating, its like putting peanut butter in my mouth and I need to get something to drink to wash it down.The jelly beans are the best yet. They are smaller making it easier to breath while running. they do not dry your mouth and they also taste good, aways a plus. They provide 100 cals per pouch and contain no caffeine.That said it is not the perfect product. The package can be difficult to open while running and occasionally a few beans drop out as you are trying to negotiate them out of the bag and into your mouth. Also they should make a variety pack. 24 packs is enough to last me a month and I prefer to buy only one at a time. The same flavor, while good, can get a little boring. They have other flavors, a variety pack should not be too hard to make.Enjoy your exercise!

column9: Same Starbuck's Quality for a More Reasonable Cost
column10: Make my own coffee with a French Press; add these great-tasting syrups; and VOILA -- a Starbucks at a fraction of the cost. These syrups taste great and offer a wide variety of "Designer" coffees each and every day. Amazon Prime makes it even a better deal. I'll be using them for a long, long time.
Good, but lacking in the mint department. I mixed a bottle of Torani Peppermint 50/50 to give it more punch.
I used to use two different bottles of syrup to flavor my iced coffee.  I gave this a try and love it.  Just right for me.
I love Torani Chocolate syrup, and this Chocolate Mint is a close second. Not so minty that it overpowers the coffee -- just right.  Another Torani winner!
This has a bit of a hard time standing up to coffee, but it's a good syrup for sodas.

column9: great value for something i use all the time.
column10: I love Torani syrups in my coffee and usually pay much more per bottle plus shipping.  This was too sweet a deal to pass by.

This product that I recieved was old... My dogs turned their nose up at it... My dogs really love this when they are fresh... These must have been over 1 yr old... I can't believe that Amazon had sold these... Bad, Old, Products...

My dog really loves these, and I do think (with the help of the occasional brushing) that these help her teeth stay cleaner. She just loves to munch on one and it keeps her busy for a bit, which is more than i can say for some of those wimpy treats that just add sticky gunk to your dogs teeth...

column9: Made both of my dogs sick!!
column10: I gave each of my two dogs one of these bones after I picked them up grocery shopping on Monday evening. By early tuesday morning one of my dogs was already throwing up (first time on my white bedding, of course) and everything after her first bowel movement of the day was pretty much water. She had diarrhea on the carpet in MULTIPLE areas while I was at work, and then two more times during the night. She was very lethargic and unable to keep any food down at all. Meanwhile, my other dog has now gotten horrible diarrhea as well. Wednesday morning I made them some boiled eggs, but the one dog that was already throwing up ended up losing her breakfast a short while later. I gave her white rice with a little bit of chicken stock for dinner that night and she held that down. But sometime during the night, one of the dogs had diarrhea in the house again! Today is Thursday and both dogs are still loose, but (knock on wood)it seems like the vomiting is under control. I called the vet and she said to split an Immodium AD between the two of them and make sure they are drinking plenty of water, which they have been all through this debacle! I will keep my fingers crossed that my carpert will still be clean when I get home. I will never, ever buy another Hartz product again!

My beagle loves these bones. We give them to her every sunday as a treat after clipping nails, getting a bath or cleaning her ears. She gets so excited when I pull one out of the bag. She loves them so much that I have signed up for subscribe and save to receive them every month.

I love pasta. I've tried white, wheat, veggie, gluten free (which is aweful). I found miracle noodles. At first it was hard to get past the irredescent look of the noodle but I washed them, parboiled them and put them in my favorite sauce with veggies and it was perfect. Why wouldn't everyone try these. On special occasion like at my Italian grandmother's dinners I will eat pasta but these miracle noodles are an awesome replacement otherwise. I haven't yet tried them with an alfredo or pesto sauce. There is one other noodle that compares with the miracle noodle and that is shirataki noodles. Both are amazing. I can have my pasta and eat it too.

After reading several reviews with the pros and cons on this product I decided to take the plunge and give it a try. I was expecting a fishy smell as was described  in some reviews. It had almost no smell at all. I would describe it more like a whiff of rain or a fresh water lake---definitely not a turn off and the rinsing completely took care of any scent. The consistency was pretty much as the other reviewers described---somewhat chewy but not like rubber bands. I prepared it per package instructions which was very easy---just rinsed and parboiled. I used a tomato sauce and grated cheese and I do plan to try it again with olive oils and other sauces. It doesn't taste like pasta. I tried it without sauce first and there was no taste.

After seeing this on an episode of Dr Oz I thought I would give it a try.  They are really great.  Just follow the directions on the bag and mix with your favorite sauce.  They remind me of asian glass noodles.  Delicious and totally guilt free!

column9: Great taste but .....look at expiration date
column10: I ordered these noodles in bulk after trying them out first. I really like the taste of them especially when I add spaghetti sauce. I would not recommend ordering in bulk, unless you plan to eat them all in a month. My entire box had an expiration date approximately two months after I purchased them. I ended up sharing them with friends so that I didn't have to throw them out, when my intention was to have it for months of meals. I rated them on the low end only because of the early expiration date.

I love these noodles.  Being the only one in my family with grain allergies I always felt like I was missing something when pasta nights rolled around.  Not so anymore!  Sure, they are not like the noodles we are 'used to', but then, why should that matter?  They hold any type of sauce or flavoring you put on them and are certainly better (for me) than going without.  I like them simply with butter, salt and romano cheese.As for filling, they are that also.  When I need to drop a few pounds they fill me up without added calories.  I never noticed anything fishy about them, and don't mind the different texture (really, if you have had gluten free noodles, texture is not something you get too picky about.  Moreover, they act like pasta and my eyes, mouth and brain are all too happy to have some pasta like thing in our diet again.They are portable, palatable and guilt free.  If you are looking for any of that, then give this noodle a try.

If there is one thing that I would have found really valuable it is the date of the noodles. They are only good for 6 months. I did not see that anywhere.I love the noodles and found that the price asked on Amazon was far lower than what I have previously paid on the Miracle Noodles website. My purchase was delivered quickly and packed well.I would indeed purchase these again from this seller ... please give the date.

I am on a low carb diet, and these noodles have been wonderful! Do they have a horrible fishy smell? Yes, absolutely. Does it last? Not if you take care to rinse them properly.1. Dump the noodles in a strainer and rinse for a few minutes.2. Soak them in a bowl with water and a dash of white vinegar for at least 5 minutes.3. Rinse the beejesus out of them againYour noodles should be fishless.If you are having problems with the texture, make sure you cook them at the right time. I take care to cook them for only a minute, and the texture is fine for me.I have found these a great substitute for spaghetti, and next I will try them as a ramen dish.And yep, they do take on the flavor of the foods you cook them with!

I couldn't do it, the consistency was too slimy, and the fishy smell ruined it even after rinsing the noodles for 10 minutes before cooking them. Im on the ideal protein diet and read that these are a great substitute for pasta but no thank you! That was a waste of money, I gave my mom what I didn't want and she said the same thing.

Gooey with a tiny, tiny crunch.  Literally felt like I was eating worms.  Took two bites and tossed it.If you are thinking of using this as a replacement for pasta, think again.  Better just to eat less of the real stuff.

I have been buying these on a regular basis for about a year now and absolutely love them. I eat them as a quick and easy snack and they are a good price on here. Will buy from again..Oh, make sure you rinse really well at the beginning...will take on the taste of whatever sauce you use
These noodles are the best.  Zero calories. Zero carbs. Zero gluten.  They smell funny but other than that, they're great.
Save you time and money and just buy whole wheat pasta.  This product is tasteless and if you get a whole in the package it leaks all over.
I but this in my soups or stir fry.  I recommend cutting it.  I love angel hair, but this is not pasta!  I would purchase again.

These noodles do have a bit of a odd smell when you first drain them but they taste great with pretty much anything over them. I put a cold sesame noodle sauce on them & it rocks.  They are great for keeping at work since they dont have to be boiled and they heat up quick. That and LOW CARB/LOW CAL!

column9: Great product for low carb/no carb diets
column10: This is a great substitute for spaghetti. It really is only enough for one portion, but when prepared as directed it is a great item under your tomato sauce. No affect on blood sugar readings. So nice to find something I can enjoy without a blood sugar spike or guilt. Went back and bought more of each variety to keep on hand. Plus it does not need to be kept refrigerated.5 stars.
No calories, and they taste pretty good.  What more can you ask for.You may need to raise them for a while, but who caresStephanie H

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Yuk.....just awful.......just looking at them in the package....slimy nasty looking stuff...Miracle Noodle Shirataki Angel Hair Noodles 10 Pack.....I'd rather starve or be fat.....so bad....

column9: I'm not a picky eater, and this is the grossest thing i've ever put in my mouth
column10: I bought these noodles because of all the stellar reviews I read. I am not a picky eater. I eat sugar free, low-carb, low sodium, fake cheese, cardboard-like things all the time and like them. In fact, there is no food that I absolutely don't like or won't eat until now.When I opened the package, the first thing I noticed was the terrible smell. I couldn't quite put my finger on it, but it's kind of like joint compound or drywall spackle, or something that is definitely NOT food. I figured it might be the packaging, so I spent a little extra time rinsing the noodles than the directions called for. Smelling them again, I knew it was the noodles, but stayed hopeful that parboiling and sauce would fix everything. I followed the directions, and since I love asian noodles decided to dress my Miracle Noodles with good ole soy sauce. The noodles tasted just like they smelled, AWFUL. However, being the daughter of someone who grew up very poor with little food, I couldn't waste them, so I took another bite. The taste and smell mixed with the texture of rubber bands started to gross me out and make my throat clench. I took a breath and looked into my bowl. I own two cats and thought there was a cat hair in my pasta, so like any other time, I plucked it out; no problem. I took another bite, and noticed another "hair." I picked it up and found that it was attached to a noodle. I poked around the bowl with my fork and discovered these strings everywhere. In fact, you know when you clean your hairbrush and you pull out hair balls with spider-like hair legs? Well, I found a "miracle" hairball happily squatting in my bowl. That was my last straw and I had to stop eating. This wasn't the worst food experience of my life, but it ranks up there. Zero gluten and zero calories is just too good to be true. Don't waste your money.

column9: For us, not worth the money
column10: I was excited to receive our Miracle Noodle as both my husband and I are limiting carbohydrates.  When I opened the first bag (noodles ship in some kind of liquid), the odor was very off-putting but I washed, blanched and dried the noodles as instructed on the package and proceeded to prepare one of our favorites, Singapore Noodles.  I figured that even if the flavor was not the same as rice noodles that the strong curry, shrimp, onion, garlic and ginger flavors would help disguise it.  We found that NOT to be the case.  The noodles do not absorb the other flavors as rice noodles do and the mouth feel was not tough and spongy.  Neither of us liked for the noodles.  Especially at the high cost.
Inedible. Gave it to my kids who eat stuff like jellyfish and even they had a hard time with it. Yuck!Miracle Noodle Shirataki Angel Hair Noodles 10 Pack

had to give 'em a try. sounded too good to be true but I had hope. alas, I was not impressed. they're not worth the trouble. gotta rinse forever, boil, dry and then wait an hour for them to absorb some flavor from whatever you put on them. and after all that they feel like chewing rubber and I'm still starving after.

column9: Best White Chocolate (after Leonidas Manon Blanc & Cafe)
column10: I had no shipping problems with my first order of this Lindor White chocolate from Amazon. Pricing is excellent! Each box clocks in at 1 pound and 9 ounces, and you get two boxes in the package, for an amazing $33.18 with free shipping. I live in Utah and it is mid-April now - I didn't get any hard or deformed chocolates.Taste is very good! Creamy, almost buttery center, with a fragrant vanilla white chocolate shell. I wonder if Lindor and Leonidas are related somehow? Leonidas is a Belgian company and Lindor is Swiss, but it appears that they are mimicking each other through this white chocolate. However, make no mistakes! Leonidas is the clear winner here! The so-called "truffles" center of Lindor's chocolate is completely synthetic flavoring - there are no true white truffles according to the ingredients on the box. As far as I know, there are no synthetic flavorings for Leonidas Manon Blanc and Manon Cafe. For those who have tasted both companies' chocolates, there is a slight hint of salt in Lindor's creamy center whereas Leonidas' is a heavenly creamy butter. Besides these differences, Lindor's makes a great substitute to Leonidas for those who do not wish to splurge every month on decadent chocolates.Lastly, I'll close with a warning for those who are still wavering about buying this chocolate. It will not help you lose weight (but it will make you very happy)! Just three balls of Lindor's contains 70% of your recommended servings of saturated fat. This type of fat can be good or bad for you depending on your health. The good news is that there is zero trans fat - the really bad kind - and only 5mg of cholesterol (2% of recommended daily doses). Sodium levels clock in at 1% for the 3 balls. You also get a decent dose of fiber, protein, calcium, and vitamin C, according to the box. So if you don't already have an exercise routine, these bonbons can make you really fat (which is true of any good chocolate)!

We started experimenting with all kinds of snacks and he hated pretty much everything. When he tried these pretzels, he wouldn't put them down. He won't even share!! They are delicious and he doesn't even ask for the goldfish anymore.

Glutino pretzels (and Pastas) are the best on the market and taste SOOOO much like the real thing. I lived 35 years before discovering Celiac, I know what the real thing tastes like!!  They make our gluten free life so much more normal!!

My daughter is on a Gluten-Free Casein-Free diet and this is one of the only snack foods I can get her to eat.  3yr olds aren't known for their desire for new and different foods so this has become a staple snack food for her.

I actually like this product better than regular pretzels, which is good because I'm a celiac.  My sister, who lucky for her didn't get the celiac disease gene, will even steal some pretzels when I'm eating them.  If only all gluten free products were this good!

Gluten free pretzels never tasted so good. I'm a little disappointed with the price, as I can get them pretty much anywhere for the same price, but the Amazon prime shipping made it worthwhile. These are by far the best gluten free pretzels on the market!

Many gluten-free products don't live up to their gluten filled counterparts, but these certainly do.  The kids loved them, and so do I.  We now keep them as a staple in our pantry.

My kids and I love these.  We take them on trips and outings with ease. Wish they weren't so expensive, but without any other G.F. pretzels in single serve packages that taste as good I guess sometimes you just have to pay for it to have something "normal" again.

My 14 year old was recently diagnosed with celiac.  It has been difficult finding snacks that she enjoys and can bring to school.  We have found these pretzels to be great, really delicious.  Even her friends prefer them to regular pretzels.
These pretzels are the best I have tried since switching to a gluten free diet approximately 2 years ago.I would definitely buy them again.
I cannot believe that these are gluten free.  They taste exactly like "regular" pretzels, maybe even better.  By far the best gluten free item we've ever tried.
Glutino Gluten Free Pretzel Twists are buttery, crispy, and they taste like regular ones.  Perfect for Celiacs or non-celiacs, they can't tell the difference, either.

This product comes to us from the Middle East, which represents so much carbon impact for a food product that gluten-free folks (such as myself) may be purchasing frequently.  There are other gluten-free products made in this country which have similar quality...which is how I'm going to spend my money.

My son lives on these pretzels.  They are a life-saver as a snack for school or outtings.  He is very picky and I have to admit that they taste better than regular pretzels.  We are so grateful for such a tasty product.

column9: Great deal on best GF pretzels I've found!
column10: I fell in love with Glutino stick pretzels when I started a gluten-free diet six months ago. I actually think they taste better than the regular pretzels I used to eat! The only downside was the price -- the local store charged $8.99 per 14 ounce bag. When I checked on Amazon, I was pleased to find they carry Glutino pretzels. Interestingly, the 8 ounce bags turn out to be a better price per ounce than the 14 ounce ones, so that's what I ordered. With the subscribe and save deal, the 8-ounce bags came out at just over $3 apiece. If you or your gluten-free child loves pretzels for a snack, and you have the space to store a dozen bags, this is an awesome deal! I have a handful of friends who also are gluten-free, so I've shared some of my order with them. These are amazingly good pretzels and Amazon's subscribe and save price is the best you're going to find anywhere!!

Of all of the gluten free pretzels I have tried, these by far are the best.  They are close to the real thing as I recall.  Sometimes they are difficult to obtain.  Stores do not stock them since they are a bit pricey but well worth it for those of us who are gluten-intolerant.  These are a must for me.

column9: Get these if need a POWERFUL LAXATIVE
column10: I purchased these at a local store, and had half a bag for lunch.  They tasted OK, but were definitely not worth the after effects.  Within about 7 hours after eating these my stomach started feeling awkward.  Shortly after I started having cramps and severe watery diarrhea several times throughout the evening and late night.  Looking at the ingredients, the thing that stands out is carboxymethylcellulose AKA cellulose gum.  The package I purchased said cellulose gum on the ingredients list, but on the web sites it is listed as carboxymethylcellulose.  You will find they are synonyms if you Google them.  All I had for breakfast that day was a bowl of dry corn flakes, and didn't have time to eat dinner before my stomach started cramping.  If you look up this ingredient, or look it up along with "side effects" you will find it is undigestible and can cause side effects such as bloating and diarrhea.  Never again.  All I can say is please post a review if this happened to you to others are forewarned!

column9: Great product but needs to be packed better
column10: As far as the product goes - these are excellent.  Can't even tell they're gluten free.  Nice and crispy and good flavor. They had slapped a shipping label right over the "fragile" that was printed on the box.  Not good thinking.
These pretzels are very yummy. But, be careful they can be addicting and before you know it the whole bag is gone!

column9: Thumbs up from a new gluten-free dieter
column10: We have decided to transition to gluten-free.  I bit into my first gluten-free pretzel with trepidation, but they are good!  Really good.  Maybe even a little better than regular pretzels.  Still not exactly health food, but the taste is awesome.  My kids love them, too.
My son is Gluten free and Casein Dairy free and he loves these pretzels. I tried them and they taste good. Light and crisp, salty. I liked tham better than regular old fashion style pretzels.
Delcious!  You don't even have to be gluten free to love them!  The Sesame seeds are a great substitute for extra salt!

There is nothing that compares!! These are better than regular pretzels!! You can't eat just one!!  Thanks Amazon for giving celiacs or anyone that is on a gluten free diet a break in the price that is normally paid for these pretzels...we couldn't do it without these pretzels! I am on a gluten free diet and so are my two little girls so these pretzels go fast in my house! You won't waste your money!!
These are great pretzels, better than regular ones.  Crunchy with just the right amount of salt.  Opened a bag at work and my co-workers ate them right up.
Most of the pretzels when I got them where smashed into little pieces. The packaging seemed appropriate. Maybe that's why there was a deal on these.

I am not gluten intolerant but my 2 grandsons are. My daughter-in-law bought the Glutino gluten free pretzel twists for the kids and when I tasted them, I was hooked!!! They are, hands down, the BEST PRETZELS I've ever had. A nice crispy texture, not hard, with a great flavor. Much better than any regular wheat flour pretzels you can buy. Try them... if you dare... LOL, but be forewarned, you'll be hooked too!!!
Mmmmmmmmmm.... This is all I can say. This is a great snack. It is better tasting than wheat pretzels I hear from everybody including I myself say so, too! Crunchy, tasty, and great!

I bought these pretzels for my dad, who suffers from Celiac disease and Type 1 diabetes. He has a hard time keeping any weight on due his restricted diet, and often resorts to potato chips for his sole source of carbs between meals. He absolutely loves these pretzels, and said he enjoys them more than the regular kinds. I think they taste excellent, with that very slight "burnt" flavor that makes pretzels so good. They also seem to have a delicious buttery aftertaste IMO. Plus, they're very satisfying and healthier than potato chips.

I did not expect these to taste just as good as regular pretzels but they do. Even my husband likes them and he usually turns his nose up at my wheat free foods.  For the first time I can fix Chex Mix with these and Rice Chex and enjoy it along with every one else.  Hurray for Gluten Free Pretzel Twists!

column9: Better than the sesame gluten free pretzels
column10: The pretzels aren't bad for those of us that have to maintain a gluten free diet.  They are tastier than the pretzels with sesame seeds.

column9: Best Gluten-Free Pretzel - I love these!!!
column10: I love these pretzels.  They are just hard to find.  I think pretzels have too much salt on them and I am always trying to scratch off the salt with my finger nails or a knife or something. I was afraid because they are gluten free they wouldn't taste very good because a lot of the gluten free products you sacrifice taste.  But not with these. Within a few weeks, I found these at a health food store, and we've been hooked ever since.  They are even better that wheat pretzels and now they're a snack staple in our house.

These taste as good as "normal" wheat based pretzels - we discovered them locally at a health food store, but the price was crazy high.  Much cheaper on line.But buyer beware - 12 packages of these come in a big box !

Was pleasantly surprised how delicious these pretzels are and there is no odd aftertaste as with some gluten free products.  Perfect for munching and the pretzel sticks stay fresh in the bag for quite a while, that is if you can resist finishing the bag.  Would purchase again.
We find these pretzels better than the "real" ones. I order them by the case!
These pretzels are so good - so much like the "real thing" for those of us who cannot eat gluten -(wheat,barley,rye and oats).  We recommend them highly!
Just bought a case of these, and they are fabulous.  I love pretty much anything from Glutino.  My sister, who does not have CD, thought they were great too.
These pretzels are extremely good tasting.  Very difficult to tell the difference compared to pretzels with gluten.
These gluten free pretzels are enjoyed by everyone.  Friends have even said they taste better than their regular pretzels.

column9: The Best Gluten Free Pretzels around!!
column10: You will not waste your money...simply the best!! You can't have just one!!

We had been eating the Glutino regular pretzels for a few years now and they were okay, but recently our health food store started carrying these.  I bought a bag and we enjoyed them so much I was back buying a few more.  Pretzels are one thing I've missed since going gf - but not any more!  Taste great with dip, too!

I'd never heard of Glutino before. I bought a snack pack of these pretzels at a health food store. They cost a fortune. I was shocked when Amazon had them by the case. What a great find for my son on the GFCF diet. They taste great. No different than other pretzels. We bought a whole case. We love them! Thanks so much Glutino.

column9: May not be totally gluten free
column10: I ordered this for my mom, who has Celiac disease. She could not tolerate it, it gave her bad diarrhea, as if it had gluten in it.
