column9: Best Jerky on the planet when Fresh
column10: I have loved this Jerky ever since they used to sell it at Costco about 20 years ago.  I do not know why they stopped selling it there, but ever since, It has been hard to find, and ever harder to find it fresh.  I am so thankful I have found it for sale on this web site.  I overnighted a box the other day, and as soon as itt showed up  I immediately ate two of the 3.5 ounce bags for lunch.  Looks like I will be making another order shortly.

I love Jerky. I use to order it on eBay and other sellers mainly from Seattle. Like pizza, everyone has their preference to the type of jerky they like best. My preference is the harder type and then I'll leave it in my mouth and slowly chew on it. I don't like the soft gooey type. To me, the hard dried out jerky is the best, as 20 or so seconds in your mouth will soften it like a piece of gum ready for chewing. Being a vegetarian my preference is the salmon and tuna jerky. SnackMasters makes both. I ordered a box of each. It arrived in short time and I could not wait to jump in. You must watch out when your friends come over as the jerky will be consumed in record time. I had a friendly poker game with 6 friends and we went through 5 packages of jerky! My friends are now all sold on SnackMasters jerky. This by far is the best jerky I have ever had and I highly recommend it.

I don't often write reviews, but if you like jerky, but prefer a non-beef option, the SnackMasters Teriyaki Turkey Jerky is a tasty snack--relatively low in carbohydrates, high in protein, and less salty than some other brands (though bear in mind, it's still jerky). Happy snacking!
This is, by far, the best jerky I have ever tried.  The hot and spicy is an excellent snack without having too much salt like most store bought jerky.

column9: Too dry and way too overpowering salty teriyaki flavour
column10: Could do with a touch of sweetness as the salt is far too over powering and it seems over dried. I bought a box and can't get rid of the rest

This was recommended as a snack, because I eat 3 meals a day and needed 2 quick non perishable snacks. But I did not care for Turkey Jerky.It was not satisfying for me. I ate but won't buy again. I just don't care for this type of snack

I started eating this Jerky when I was in elementary school. My parents bought it as a snack from Trader Joe's and I became addicted. I am 24 now and still a fan of the Teriyaki jerky. It really is the best I've ever tasted, and I have tried many times to find a jerky that is just as good or better than SnackMasters. It just doesn't exist. Trader Joe's no longer sells this jerky. They replaced it with a terrible Jerky that really is inedible, so I've resorted to buying this from Amazon. The Gelsons sells a one ounce package for $5 but that is just unreasonable. Lucky, Amazon sells it for much cheaper.

This is absolutely the best jerky I have ever found.  It is getting harder & harder to find, thank goodness for Amazon.  I agree with other reviewers, the larger packages are better than the smaller because then seem to have the larger, better pieces.  Enjoy!

column9: The best Turkey Jerky I've had
column10: This is hands down the best Turkey Jerky I've had. We used to buy it at Trader Joes, but it was then discontinued and replaced with their own, inferior brand. I was then on a hunt to find it elsewhere.This jerky walks a great line of not being either too dry or too soft, has great turkey flavor and a salty, pleasing teriyaki flavor. Some may think this is too salty - for me it is perfect, but I love salty things.
This hard to get item is not only tastey but a greatsnack to control hunger.
I ordered this jerkey for my husband who tells me its the best jerkey out there. We have tried both the beef and turkey and both are great. There isn't another jerky out there that can compare.

column9: Best Turkey Jerky on the market
column10: Snackmaster's makes the best Jerky I've ever had. All of their Turkey Jerky product are exceptional, but I'm quite partial to the Teriyaki. It has a faint hint of sweetness that's very nice. Most turkey jerkies I've tasted had a slight chemical taste. And most were somewhat powdery. Not the case with this brand. Great taste and nice and chewy.
A very good product.  Makes a nice, quick and healthy snack.  Not too salty.  Satisfies hunger.  Very tasy.
its the only turkey jerkey i will eat... others taste disgusting.. I first tried it at trader joes, and now this is the only place that I can get... order it all the time!
The best turkey jerky.  Once Trade Joe's replaced this product with its own mushy version, we stopped buying turkey jerky there and had to order it online.
This is a wonderful product. The flavor is outstanding, and it is a healthy snack (not a common combination, unfortunately!). I also appreciate the reasonable online price and speedy delivery.
This is the best turkey jerky I have ever eaten.  Can't stop ordering it!!! Reasonably priced too!!!
Best and most natural Jerky available.  Minimal processing and better for you than Beef Jerky.Can't go wrong on the price either !
Bought this jerky on a recommendation from a friend and I have to admit I loved it!! I use to buy jack's link's but I'm switching over to snackmasters.

column9: Excellent & tasty source of lean protein!
column10: SnackMasters Teriyaki turkey jerky is a great option for high-protein, low fat snacks. It's tasty stuff & I use it all the time. Just keep an eye on the sodium intake!
this product used to be acceptable a few years back. now its dry.sinew-ish,funky old turkey flavor like road kill possum burger. sorry snackmasters change your name to slackmasters
Jack Link's turkey jerky has not been available for a while, so I tried this.It tastes like jerked worcestershire sauce. There isn't much I can add. I'll not buy it again.

The actual product is fine, but all of the cans arrived so crushed that they could not be opened with an electric can opener.  I had to use multiple starts and punches with a manual can opener and finally pry off the lid.

column9: not quite what i was expecting!
column10: My family loves olives and we generally go through a bag this size in a couple weeks.  These took us much longer to finish since the taste was not to our liking and the olives had lots of broken pits in them.  I will not be buying these olives again.

Cracked olives should not result in small bits of olive pits.  Most of these olives have bits of broken bits from the cracking process.  The spice and oil mix is ok but not pleasant.  A bit on the mushy side as well.  I was disappointed.
These are good olives. A few broken seeds, yes, but it's 5 pounds - you are bound to find a few. It's the same in Italy. The flavor is right, I usually add a few more garlic (cloves).

column9: The Best Roland Cracked Sicilian olives
column10: Without a doubt these are the best available Sicilian olives on the market. No cracked seeds just the right firmness.
I can't tell if I want this product or not as a picture without a description of the ingredients is not enough information.  What is the seasoning performed on these olives?

Although these are a quality dog treat please be aware that these do contain chicken. I did not see this ingredient listed on the product page. This is just to advise those pet parents if your kiddo has a poultry or chicken allergy like mine do that every variety to date contains both chicken and natural chicken flavor.The ingredients are as followed for the Puppy Health varietyIngredients:Organic brown rice powder, rice powder, vegetable glycerin, gelatin, water, tapioca starch, chicken, natural chicken flavor, fat product (natural source of DHA from algae), organic oat fiber, dehydrated carrots, organic flaxseed, alfalfa, cranberries, calcium carbonate, cinnamon, parsley, chia seed, carrageenan (natural seaweed extract), peppermint.

It is awesome to find a dental chew that is safe for a teething puppy AND nutritious.  I also love that it has cranberries in it to help my little girl's urinary health; and DHA to help her developing brain.  My 4 month old Lhasa Apso puppy, Alexi, goes crazy for these! She polishes a small one off in about 15 minutes.  I've considered getting the large ones to keep her chewing longer, but I worry that they might be a bit too big.  These are a fantastic value and are much cheaper than similar brands.  I tried the CET dental chews, and they made her terribly sick (and I won't consider Greenies at any age due to the ingredients).  Alexi eats a corn-free, gluten-free, wheat-free, soy-free diet, and these fit the bill perfectly.  She eats Canidae Lamb and Rice as her food and gets these and Zuke's for treats and chews.  I'm happy to have a puppy in great health, and I am relieved to find something that she loves to chew on while her mouth hurts from teething.  Also, these don't leave a mess on my carpet, and they sit perfectly on her little tummy.  Really, I am addicted to this product.  Also, the price is great for 18 of them!  I got the antioxidant ones for my Mom to give to her older dogs.

My pomeranian is very fussy so don't take my review as a bad review.  All dogs are different and have different tastes and habits.  I'm simply stating I had to give these away to another dog family because my pom would not eat them.

I have a sensitive nose and can't stand the smell of puppy breath, but these really help a lot. They smell very faintly of peppermint with a slight sweet twist to it.My 2lb yorkie loves these things! I cut them in half for him to chew on since 1 a day is for 5-10lbs.. but they last him forever! He can chew on half for probably 30 minutes and still have at least half of what I gave him still there.Only problem I have with it is that little specs of it come off and rub onto the carpet or whatever he is eating it on, so be careful!!
My year old Lasa loves these treats and they don't upset her delicate tummy.  They arrived quickly and I plan to order more soon.
My Shih Tzus & Pekinese loved them  - I only wish they had these available under "subscribe & save" so I can automatically get them sent to me monthly.

I purchased this product because of the quality ingredients and the belief that this was a long lasting chew stick.  My 14 lb. lhasa apso devoured this in under 5 minutes. She seemed to enjoy it but I was disappointed. I will searching for another type of chew stick that lasts longer.

I have a beagle puppy that like to chew everything and cries when he doesn't get attention. These treats help with both problems, it keeps him busy so he is not whining and not chewing on anything but his sticks. I love that it is natural as I do not give him any foods or treats with any byproducts. I cannot say that he prefer these treats to others. He eats anything and everything I give him.

My puppy is pretty finicky about her treats. But, she absolutely loves these.  It's a great value to boot for the price.  An added bonus is that it's made in the USA for those concerned about product safety.

I got these because I wanted to only give my dog natural treats/chews, he likes it but doesn't love it so I will continue my search of finding the perfect natural chew. My dog isn't picky so he'll eat anything, but if he loves something, he will cry and beg for more and will also finish it in a flash. With these, he only ate it half way and didn't touch it again until the next day.

I bought these for my 10 week old puppy to keep him busy for a little while during dinner or in the morning when I get ready.  I was previously using the N-Bone Puppy Teething rings but these are smaller and less expensive. My puppy can chew through one of the small ones in about 15 minutes but it is made to be eaten.  It keeps him busy for a few minutes, which is nice.  I would reccomend these to keep their attention for a short time.  A lot of other reviews mentioned that there was a strong smell, so I specifically checked this, they do have an odor but I had to hold it to my nose to smell it.  Overall it is a good product.

I've been giving the small dental chews as a special treat for when my mini Aussie has been really good since she was 2.5 months old, shes now only 4.5 months old but still freaks out with excitement  whenever she gets one.  Used to take her over an hour to complete or she would save/hide the nubs for later now she plows thru them in 20 minutes tops, she is just so happy to get one!

We bought these for our German Shepherd puppy when she was little. She LOVED them, and it was the only way we got her through those first stressful vet visits! They're a bit pricy, but worth the investment.
Good product...and dogs love,  but still be careful if you have a dog that eats fast. Always monitor dogs with treats to make sure they don't swallow big chunks.

I have a 12 week lab/border collie mix who is in the beginning stages of teething. (Teeth aren't coming out, but the new ones are working around in her gums, giving her pain.) This is the first item I've found that keeps her focused and happy for 15 minutes at a time. Anyone who has owned a lab puppy knows this is a LONG time for focus on a single item that isn't furniture. She chews for about 15 minutes, then walks away. I give it back to her later and she goes at it for another 15. I'd say it lasts for about four sessions of this. I don't give her a whole stick in one day, since she's still small- but it has been a great way to refocus her teething for short periods of time.

column9: My 5 Month Old Puppy Loves These
column10: These are his favorite treats ever... and he's tried so many... Love the way these make his breath smell... If i ever need him to do something I just pull out one of these bad boys and Voila he is at attention... They're just so expensive 6 for 8 dollars is a bit much and they dont come in larger quantities... My puppy easily eats one of these in 30 minutes so i wish they were less expensive and had bags with larger quantities... One a day is a great way to keep your puppy's bums, teeth and breath clean...

i have a 6 month old labradoodle and we noticed her breath was getting a little stinky.  i got a package of zuke's z-bones dental chews.  they were great, but very $$.  i did some research and compared this product to greenies - i think there is less risk with this product that she may have digestive issues with these chews.  she loves them and they smell nice.  her breath was never that bad, but now it's back to normal.  it doesn't take her that long to eat them (under 5 min), but she is a pretty big dog. i will probably stick to this product, even as she gets older.

My patterdale terrier loves these chew sticks. They keep him occupied for awhile, depending on how hungry he is. They smell nice (considering they are dog treats of course!) and aren't overly hard like some chews. Give them a try!
Our 9 week old Mini Dachshund loves these. They're the perfect size.  Happy to finally find something he will chew! They smell pretty good too. :)
My puppy loves these dental sticks. He goes crazy for these. He loves them so much and after he eats them his breath smells so fresh and clean.

column9: My puppy used to love these
column10: I have a 6 month old mini schnauzer and he used to go crazy for these chews! It was a great way to keep him out of trouble for a little while. Unfortunately, he seems indifferent to them now. He'll chew on them a little bit but then they just lay around the house. I'm not exactly sure why he lost interest but they were great while they lasted.

column9: Longest lasting of all the "EDIBLE CHEWS" (not including bully sticks!)
column10: My bulldog loves these! He'll go nuts to get in his kennel for these, so I use them as kennel-bribing treats :).  They last a super-long time, too, compared to the 5 minutes that he can polish off the Edible Nylabones.  Not quite as long lasting as a bully stick chew, obviously, but these are very hard and compact, so they're good for my strong chewer!

These are awesome. My puppy loves them and I love that they made his breath smell better. They are soft and much safer than giving your dog a Greenie in my opinion (not to mention that they are safe for puppies whereas Greenies are not recommended for dogs under 6 months). This makes these the ideal teething chew-able treat.

column9: Pup loves them, great Kong stuffer!
column10: The favorite treat of my collie puppy. She gets so excited when I get open the package.  They do have a lovely smell. Sadly she eats them so quickly! To extend her enjoyment, I break a small one in half and push both pieces into a small Kong. She chews on them for a bit then when she can't get anymore out, I push the remainder up and she enjoys it for a while longer. Good stuff!

When I first received this product, my puppy exhibited interest in it, but they pretty much just lay around the house now. I don't know why she doesn't like them now when in the beginning she went nuts for them.

These are FANTASTIC! My puppy loves them. He's constantly chewing things and these are a very welcome distraction. Also, they last quite a while, and it's a perfect snack for my growing puppy. They smell great. They are hardy enough to keep his attention for a while, and his tail wags a mile a minute when he sees me getting them out. I'll be getting these nonstop from now on, thanks!

I got these for my 8 week old lab and she really enjoys them. She chews on everything, so these are good distraction for her. The only thing I don't really like is that the first ingredients are enriched flours. It does contain good fruits and veggies though. Serving size is just one per day for a puppy, so i cut it in half.

I have an 11 week old Labradoodle that loves to chew on everything and anything. She loves these, and demolishes them in a short frame of time...but better than her chewing on fingers. They're great for her teething and help with the less than pleasant puppy breath. Much cheaper here on Amazon than at the local pet store.
Great chews and no rawhide worries. Great for sharp puppy teeth. Can't find these in stores. I love because they're safe and good for her and she's not chewing on my fingers!

I bought these for my new Maltese puppy in March, and she thoroughly enjoys them. My other two adult dogs love them, also. Just bought several more packs. It lasts the puppy a good while, and it's awesome for her teething.

column9: Toy poodles love this dental treat
column10: Our toy poodles enjoy this treat! We give our 5 lb poodle 1/2 stick each day and they chow it down quickly. Freshens their breath and it's a great dental chew. We try not feed them this every day because like any treats or food, our dogs can grow weary of them.Something to keep in mind is to seal the bag tightly so that the sticks do not dry out and seals in the freshness.This item is a regular staple of their diet regime and we gladly order it online to avoid the pet shop hassle.
These were his first treats he got! I wish I could have broken them up to use more to train... I had to buy basic treats for that reason, but he thinks they're delicious and it keeps him happy!

I bought these based on the good reviews, but they didnt work for my little girl. I have a 3 month old pitbull who is teething pretty bad lately, so i figured these would be a good way to help her teeth as well as be a good treat for when she does something good. I broke the treats up into four smaller pieces, and she had about one total stick a day. The third day in she started having very runny BM. They may just be too strong for her tummy, but they definetly didnt work for her. I was pleased with the shipping, and didnt need to contact the seller so i dont have any reviews on that.

column9: Keeps our pup busy and happy!
column10: So far, these Get Naked Dental Chew Sticks are one of the longer lasting chew treats for our pup.  She wags her tail when I get the bag out and if she is happy so am I.  I do supervise her the entire time she chews on any chew treats and sometimes divert her attention while I take back the treat when she chews the treats down into pieces so small she may choke.  I would buy these chew treats again and I would recommend them to my friends who have pups or dogs.

Our puppy goes ballistic over these and she would probably rate them as a "5", but they are gone in a flash and I don't think the price is worth 5 minutes of quiet time.  She is 4 months old, 7 pounds, but goes through these like a buzz saw.  I bought them because of the positive reviews and will try again once she's through this acute teething stage.

These are very nice chew sticks and smell great!  However, our young (toothless puppy) didn't much care for them.  She has chewed them a bit, but prefers the ribs from the deer we shot over these sticks.  :-)).  We hope she will eat them eventually, but if not we will give them to another dog.  She is getting her teeth now so it may  happen.  Will update this review if she goes to town on them.  We feed her only all natural foods, so she is used to the natural flavors over the nasty stuff found in majority of pet foods.

My 5 month old lab mix loves these sticks.  They're a bit too long for him so I break them in half, but he loves to play with them before chewing them.  Great product, doesn't shred and I don't find pieces all over the house. They do seem to dry out quickly though, so keep them in the plastic bag.

My small yorkie licked it, but besides that wouldn't touch it. He disliked the smell.He doesn't seem to like hard dog chews. In the case some helpful kind soul passes this review, can anyone recommend a healthy chew for small dogs that do not contain fillers (wheat, etc.) that is soft?
Great way to help with dental health for our goldendoodle Brooke. Great price, fast ship and the dog loves em"

column9: 3 Month Old Jack Russell LOVES the Large keeps him calm & quiet
column10: Stumbled upon these while looking for an alternative to Greenies b/c my little Caesar doesnt care for them. He LOVES these! He went through the entire bag of six within a week. I went for the large because he has some tough teeth and I wanted something to occupy him while we're driving, while i'm at my desk working or while i'm doing work around the house. I read a review about the smell being not so pleasant but i found them to be gentle on the senses. My only gripe with these are that I wish more came in a pack or that I could order them in a bulk size.

My dogs loves these, and they were helpful with getting him adjusted to his crate at night (I would just drop one in after locking him in). I can't say that they really help to keep his teeth clean, although my husband says that he can smell the mint on the dog's breath after the dog has eaten one.

These are great for my 4 month old Bichon.  It is really difficult finding appropriate treats for puppies under 6 months.  Usually the puppy edible bones or rawhide are for dogs 6 months and older.  I want to keep my little puppy busy during meal times or times when he needs a distraction.  These are great for that (about 10-15 minutes) and are healthy for him!  The Nylabone Healthy Edibles for puppies are great as well (for puppies 3 months and older), but only last about 7 minutes on average.  These Dental Chews last about twice as long.
My puppy *loves* these treats, and I feel good about giving them to him too because made with healthy ingredients.

my 4 1/2 month old min pin shakes when she sees the pink bag.  She jumps extra high for these and they provide 20 minutes of chewing.  They are very healthy too.  Cranberry for bladder, chia seeds for brain, carrots for eyes and her breath is fresh.  They are not cheap but Ive bought 3 bags and they are all natural.I love my baby, so it's worth it.

I have a baby pomeranian and he is the biggest cry baby when he has to be put in his crate! I don't tolerate it so I'm training him to be in his crate for longer periods of time and these help. It takes awhile for him to be quiet when I open the container, but I give him one when I leave for a couple of hours and when I come back he is happy as a clam and much more quiet! I think it takes him about a half hour to eat one, but I think he's getting faster. I saw someone wondering if they should get the large to last longer and I'm thinking the same thing. They are really stinky, so I recommend putting them in an air tight container that's easy to get in and out of. My only complaint is that they are a bit expensive! I wish they came in one of those Amazon Bulk deals.
Our dogs absolutely love these sticks, but it did take a little while for them to warm up to them. Once they figured out that they were edible they became addicted to them.

column9: My dog is crazy for these!
column10: My black lab absolutely loves these dog chew sticks! She will go through one in about ten minutes. They make her breath smell good and don't affect her tummy! I highly recommend them for any puppy owner!

My dog goes crazy when she sees me getting these out! They are healthy treats , and clean her teeth too. They are 18 in a pack for the small treats , so they go a long way. I research extensivley before I give my girl anything , I give her only healthy food and treats. I feel good about giving her these. They aren't a hard treat , say like pig ears. They are softer and they digest good. They don't break off in little pieces that can splinter. They are more of a hard but chewy treat. I highly reccomend them!

column9: My dog loves it!  But it's expensive...
column10: I have a 7 month old chiweenie puppy who goes crazy for these treats.  I like the fact that it has quality ingredients so I feel good about giving the treats.  I give him 1/2 a stick at a time because my dog is so tiny (5-6 lbs) and I don't want him filling up on these only, and it takes him about 3-4 min to eat it, so its not much of a "chew-toy" that keeps him occupied. It IS hard to cut...but I've learned to break it in half without knives. And it IS expensive...8 dollars for 18 sticks??  The price is my reason for not giving 5 stars.
Our papillon puppy (13 wks) Sasha likes these but has a hard time chewing them we haven't actually gotten through one. I am thinking these will be easier for her to chew once she has her adult teeth.
I give our new pup one of these when I'm sick of her biting on my or our furniture & it definitely keeps her busy, she doesn't leave it until it's gone!

column9: 5 month old yorkie poo loves it!
column10: I got these for my son's yorkie-poo puppy, and they were a lifesaver. They are healthy and didn't give him any stomach problem, and kept him quiet for about 20 minutes (which is amazing for him!) Since he only gets one a day, we decide when we need the quiet time and then give it to him. He LOVES them!
These treats are awesome!!  They hold my dogs over if we are feeding them later than usual, and they're just plain good for everyday yumminess!  They love them- every single flavor!!  :)

column9: Gave it 2 stars for the ingredients only...
column10: I bought this product for my Yorkie and was so disappointed.  First of all, they completely stink.  Second, the sticks are so hard that you have to cut them for a smaller breed with a good quality steak knife (I used my high end stainless Henkles knives and it took some effort).  My puppy (7 1/2 months) has torn through extra durable Nyla bones and is a VERY TOUGH chewer, so I was looking for something he can "play with" and eat which wasn't synthetic.  He didn't know what to do with it even though he seemed to like it as a toy for a minute or two.  But, the smell was overwhelming to me.  I will donate them to a local rescue.  Interestingly enough, I also bought him other Get Naked treats and he didn't care for them either.  Perhaps he just doesn't like this brand.  He does love Blue Buffalo treats, Welness Puppy treats (they also stink, but in a bearable/pate kind of way!) and SoJo's too!
I really don't chew on it beacause its too hard for me. it takes me too long to bite and i just knock it around

minute rice:)  how i love this stuff...its fast cooking...delicious and satisfying..plus its healthy !..whats there not to like? ..you can make  as little or as much as you want...sometimes ill make a single serving just for a snack..and it gets the job done...

The 12" size takes my 5 month lab up to a week to work through. She did just get all of her permanent teeth in, so maybe that time will speed up given some months. Yes, they do have a bit of a smell, but it's more like I get an occasional whiff when she's chewing on it.  If the chew is just lying around, I don't smell anything.  They haven't left any stains on my carpets, and she hasn't lost interest in them.

I am a frequent user of bully sticks from other vendors online and from pet stores. These are listed as "THICK" bully sticks. I usually buy thick ones from another vendor and my German Shepherd pup loves them and they last a couple of days. These arrived and I was immediately disappointed. Many of them are the thickness of a pencil or slightly thicker. They are about 1/3 the thickness of the "thick" bully sticks I usually buy. But I did not want to deal with sending them back so I gave one to my pup. It smelled HORRIBLE, like a person who had not washed in weeks. My pup liked them okay but because they are so thin she can eat an entire, 12" one in under an hour. Will NOT buy these again.

Straight from my two Incredibly wonderful and literate Basengi girls: They are not as hard as others but they smell just the same. They have have helped sparing many corners of furniture. Bring them on! Bailey and Brandy.
My dog loves them!  They are perfect to keep her busy for a long time.  They do smell a little, so best to give them to your dog outside or in separate room.

column4: K. Likins "The Further we go the Stranger it ...
column10: Having a puppy means having enough things for him to chew on. I love these bully sticks because they last a really long time and can keep him busy chewing for what seems like forever. Because they last so long they are economical as you don't have to buy them week after week. Bottom line is he loves them and I lvoe that he loves them.

Great chew toy, long lasting, dogs loved them. Would highly recommend, especially as an alternative to rawhide chews.- these are much easier to digest and therefore easier on the stomach for my dogs with sensitive tummies

My dog loves bully sticks and we try to find good natural ones for her to chew on.  They are healthy and good for dog's teeth.  I am very pleased with the purchase, and my dog loves them.  No bad smell when she eats them.  Will definitely buy again!
I have 2 dogs that love these things.  Nice to get a large quanity, because buying them at the store individually can cost 2-3 times as much.

First of all, the sizes vary a bit, which in fact I love especially if you have different sized pups. Most of them are very thick with some smaller sized mixed in.  Love that they are grass fed and hormone/antibiotic free. This is EXTREMELY important to me!!! The length was near perfect on every one. The smell was minimal. My dog loved them and I recently purchased more. The price is out of this world!!!! I was paying over $7.00 for one, locally. Great product, great price, great value!

My dog loves these bully sticks, she is a 20 lb beagle and usually takes a few days to finish one but for some reason with these she is going through them within a day.  I received the product quickly and in great condition.  Thanks!

I purchased the 12" bully sticks (7 pack) from Downtown Pet Supply about a week ago.  One of my two dogs recently passed away, and the other was feeling a little depressed.  I wanted to give her a "special treat", but also hoped that these would help perk up her poor appetite since her sister's passing.  Boy have these done the trick!  I let her chew on the stick for about 30 minutes & then took it away.  Low and behold, she remembered she was hungry and ate all of her food!  She is a 50lb Lab mix who is very healthy at 13.5 years old.  In the past I had purchased 6" bully sticks at a local pet supply store for $5 each.  These sticks come out to be just under $3.50/stick and are twice the size!  This purchase was well worth it -- quality product for a great price.  I will re-order again.  Thank you!

column9: Great Value, but the smelliest so far.
column10: My 13 week old GSP puppy loves bully sticks. He loves to chew and will chew these for hours. I ordered the 7 pack of 12."  They are nice sized, and 1/2 the price of the local pet shop's brands.  But, they smell the worst out of all the brands I have tried so far. So, we will not be ordering them again.  I won't describe the smell. Its vulgar.

column9: Downtown Pet Supply 12" Bully Sticks 20 pk. thick
column10: The dogs absolutely love them but their odor is awful - like rotting fish. I have bought this product many times and noticed that some batches smell much worse than others.

This product is the same price as a bag of 15 to 20 bully sticks and yours comes 4 in a package for this price.  It was my mistake to not see 4 in a package but I saw instead 12" bully sticks with a photo of a large bag of bully sticks.  Very deceptive.  Why not put a photo of the 4 bully sticks one receives.  I will never buy them from you again.

I was hesitant to purchase this product after reading other reviews about them not being "thick".  But, since I couldn't find any other thick bully sticks on here, I thought I'd give them a shot.  Well, I am very disappointed!  They are not thick at all.  They are the same, "slim jim" thickness as every other bully stick I've bought before.  I'm not even sure why they advertise them as thick.  The thickest one is MAYBE as big around as a dime.  Not at all what I expected, and I won't order them again. I kept them just because they are at least cheaper than the same size ones I can get at the store - and it's a pain to have to return them.  My 10 month old beagle consumed one in less than an hour, start to finish.  I was hoping to find something that would last longer than that!
super smooth coffee. may buy another couple bags of this rather then buying another. like ravens brew a ton. better than starbucks and smoother finish cuz coffee is steam roasted.

I like this coffee, but compared to the 3 or 4 other blends I have tried from Raven's Brew, this is my least favorite. I was looking for a smoother blend to add a little variety, but this almost boarders on bland. There are hints of a great flavor there, but no matter the grind, amount used or method of making a cup it never tastes better than okay. There is a bit of floral flavor as advertised, but it is not pronounced enough to make this a unique experience.
I like this coffee bean very much - it's smooth and doesn't taste burned like so many coffee beans do. It's my favorite so far, but for me, I'll still keep trying to find "THE ONE."

In our town the local coffee shop/ cafe, serves Raven's brew coffee. I have enjoyed it over the last several years and was glad to find that I could buy it on Amazon at a lower price that locally. My two favorites are Resurrection Blend and Three Pecker Billy Goat. The last name may put you off but the coffee is terrific.
Tastes good , not amazing.  This coffee has a very similar flavour to Caribou Blend, but not quite as good IMHO.

I rate this coffee at a 5 not because I really really loved it, but because it is exactly what it describes. I have only ever had very dark roast beans with chocolatey and earthy undertones. I honestly had never tried a coffee that has been described as "floral" or "winey." However, I can honestly say that my first impression of this coffee was "hmm.." I have had only one other Raven's Brew coffee and that is Wicked Wolf blend, which I found delightfully earthy and full bodied. This cup tastes exactly how it is described, like a fruit and wine symphony which works very well with this roast. I can imagine that if it was a dark roast, the mellow wine flavor would become bitterness. Which brings me to the next point, this coffee is not pure unleaded petroleum in a cup. It is a lighter roast and results in a more delicate flavor.It's not my favorite cup ever, but that is today. I can imagine it being an excellent summer coffee and even a good iced coffee. I was not sure what to expect from this cup, but know that when Raven's Brew describes it's coffee, it is very accurate.

I am not a coffee drinker, but tea is what wakes me up in the morning. This is a great black tea, with a wonderful flavor.  I french press it to bring out the flavor, this loose leaf tea is perfect for this.  I have never enjoyed a cup of tea more than this one.

column9: Don't use the latte glass for this without making this adjustment...
column10: I tried this at a demo and it was awesome but when I made it myself it was watered down tasting. I called Dolce Gusto to complain and it turns out that the glass they show on the side of the box to make it in isn't the latte glass it looks like. That's a 7 oz. glass, and the latte glass that ships with the machine is 8 oz. The other glass isn't available as yet. That's why it tasted watered down. If you use the latte glass just add about a 1/2" or so less of each capsule and it should be fine.The Dolce Gusto folks should have mentioned this on the box as I'm sure many have made the same error not knowing it's a different glass. It does look like the latte glass but if you look closer it's not as tall. Since it's an easy error to make I wanted to mention it here.

One of the excellent varieties of coffees offered by this brand.  The texture and taste is very different and yet very good.  I would go as far as to say outstanding.  Initially I had doubts about trying a mocha coffee since I am a diehard coffee drinker, but this was a pleasant surprise.

This is my favorite Dolce Gusto flavor but the Latte Maachiato is wonderful as well.  Both pods produce a high quality, coffee house caliber drink that's perfect any time.  The Mocha coffee pods haven't been added to Amazon's subscription service but I hope that error will soon be corrected because it means a few dollars off.

column9: Swithching to Auto order to save $$$$
column10: The product is great and so is the machine have had it for a year now. Amazon has the best prices on pods. I am switching to Auto delivery once a month and will now save even more and get free shipping. Great stuff.

column9: Terrible - but don't let that stop you from buy the Dolce Gusto
column10: I'm not sure why all the glowing reviews for this mocha.  I've tried everything to make it palatable, and was on the verge of returning the whole Dolce Gusto machine as this was the first coffee we made.  First we followed the recommendations for brewing to the letter, than tried variations.  LOTS of variations.  Nothing makes this taste like a good mocha.  It always just tastes like bad hot chocolate with some weak coffee thrown in.  A couple days later, after seriously considering sending everything back, I tried the Cappuccino.  It is AMAZING!  So, moral of the story - don't return your machine until you try another flavor for the Dolce Gusto.  The only reason this gets two stars is that they actually produce a mocha; so far none of the other 1-cup machines do.

Tried the machine at a kitchen shop that was demonstrating it.  My husband and I were so impressed by the cappucino the Dolce Gusto machine made that we bought it on the spot.  At home, we decided to try the mocha flavored coffee and I thought I was in heaven.  My husband said it was the best cup of coffee he had ever had... and I agreed!

If you own a Dolce Gusto coffee machine, you can't beat the Mocha capsules for delicious flavor.  The machine itself is fabulous, and there are many capsules from which to select.  But being a chocoholic, I favor the mocha and find it superior to that found in most professional coffee shops.

My favourite coffee is strong bitter espresso. Sometimes I like to try capuccino, late etc.. I like this  product - It is not strong, have a nice aroma and for a coffee in capsules (it is impossible to get fresh and good coffee in capsules) is very good. I would like again to say how impressed I am with purchasing from Amazon - very fast delivery, well packed.

I recently purchased the Dolce Gusto machine, and Mocha was the last flavor that I tried.It is definitely my favorite. I made it with a little more of the coffee/chocolate capsule than the milk one, and it was delicious.A must have for any mocha lover!

column9: Sinfully delicious product for the Dolce Gusto
column10: I ordered the Dolce Gusto mocha for my family to drink on Christmas morning.However, I immediately opened it when the package arrived, and I devoured every drop. My mother has a Dolce Gusto machine as well, and she loved it, too. In fact, she even had a rare second cup before I left.Christmas is coming in a few days, and I am already excited about sitting down with my family to taste Mocha on Christmas morning. This is an excellent product that is the perfect new product for the Dolce Gusto, which is one of the best kitchen appliances of this decade.

column9: No coffee grounds, it's instant coffee
column10: When my husband and I tried the Dolce Gusto mocha for the first time, we were surprised that it tasted more like hot chocolate than coffee.  Further inspection of the box (and confirmed by opening a used capsule) revealed that unlike the other DG flavors (with or without milk) which have real coffee grounds, the mocha coffee capsule contains soluble instant coffee instead.It's not bad if you like a caffeinated hot chocolate, but by the name "mocha" I was expecting a proper latte with a little cocoa added, so I was rather dissapointed.  Wish the description had mentioned about the instant coffee - neither Amazon (at the time of my order and this review) nor the DG website says that.  I love my DG machine and crave a cappuccino more than once a day, but this mocha is not a flavor that I would come back to regularly.  On occassion though (since I have 3 boxes of this stuff!) I'd use this to make more of a cafe Viennois by adding whipped cream to it...

The Nescafe Dolce Gusto Mocha is rich and tasty. The machine puts a real foam on top. Each cup is uniform in taste. At just over $1 per cup it is not expensive if compared to similar drinks purchased at coffee houses.

I used to have a tassimo coffe brewer but when they stopped making starbucks I decided to switch. I decided to switch to the nestle machine based upon its glowing reviews. I loved the mocha drinks on the tassimo machine and I did not want to go back to plain coffee so I was pleased to see the nestle machine offered a pretty good flavor selection. The mocha flavor has a rich chocolatey, coffee flavor and the milk capsule forms a nice foam. I will admit the starbucks mocha capsules were better on the tassimo machine but this is still pretty great for a home machine!
This is a great product for a good machine.  I wish it was available more in-store, but that's the only complaint.

Being a long time mocha drinker (Starbucks and a local coffee shop near my home), I was looking for a cheaper alternative to $4.55 per Grande and for something I could make at the office.  I thought the Dolce Gusto system would fit the bill.  Maybe first, a bit about the coffee I like.  For regular coffee, Starbucks is okay but weak.  I definitely prefer Starbucks Espresso ground (bought from store) made with my Aeropress  (one and 1/2 scoops coffee to make 1 coffee mug worth of coffee (4 oz)).  I don't like Peete's coffee (too bitter) and although I have tried Barefoot coffee, I don't care for that either.  Back to the Dolce Gusto.  The biggest problem with the Dolce Gusto Mocha is the milk pods.  The milk tastes incredibly artificial.  The coffee is also very weak.  I ended up getting milk (stored in a refrigerator at work), mixing it with Ghiradelli Chocolate Mocha Hot Chocolate and using the Cafe Americano (but pulling only 3.7 oz).  It's acceptable but hardly a replacement.  Thus far, I have also tried the Caramel Latte Dolce Gusto and the artificial milk taste is there also.  I would imagine that the person who likes this Mocha also likes International Delights type of coffee.  It's definitely not for me.  I will try the Dark Roast with my mocha mix next and hopefully get a decent mug of mocha.
Very wonderful coffee. Great for me to begin my mourning with. Sometimes after dinner I add whipped cream and shaved choc,which is really nice.

Makes Starbucks & Dunkin Donuts seem like junk & is lots less expensive. Of course you must have one of the Nescafe Dolce Gusto machines but they are worth every penny. Not only are they incredibly easy to use, they will pay for themselves by saving you the time & expense of having to go out & buy each individual cup of coffee that isn't as good despite being more expensive. I can't wait for nescafe to me up with even ore variety of coffee:D
This is a great cup of coffee! I have pretty much given up going to the expensive coffee places because of this mocha!

It does keep my caffeine headaches away though.  The best part about this drink is the creme.  It is like drinking a melted truffle on the top of your coffee - yummy!
This is a great cup of coffee. If you like Mocha from the coffee houses and don't want to spend the big bucks for it, this is great coffee. Love my coffee machine and love my coffee.

When my wife was recently diagnosed as hypertensive, finding ways to avoid or at least minimize the use of prescription medications became a high priority.  When it was also determined that she was salt sensitive, use of the DASH diet seemed like a natural step to take.  We began to methocially read food labels and were shocked to find how many simple things:  condiments, breads, everyday staples were really loaded with lots of sodium.  So we set out to eliminate as much salt from our diet as possible while not having to sacrifice our pleasure in good dining.  Mrs. Dash salt-free products became one of our first and most delicious finds.  Substituting Mrs. Dash Marinades for our old standbys was incredibly easy and the feared cravings for the sacrificed salt proved to be illusory.  With our dining exprience preserved and blood pressure readings beginning to approach normal, we knew that Mrs. Dash was a winner in both satisfactory taste and health.

Marinated chicken with this and was very disappointed with the flavor! To describe with one word-BLAND! I first let my son taste it, and the look on his face said it all.  Thinking maybe he was just being picky I then tried it myself and the result was me throwing it and the chicken both out. Maybe Mrs. Dash's other flavors are better but this one left much to be desired!

All of the Mrs. Dash marinates are wonderful.  They're quick and delicious.  We initially tried them for their health benefits... but the flavor is why we continue to buy them.  I highly recommend every flavor!

If you like Kombucha  and enjoy a happy gut because of it, do yourself a favor - buy the kit and simplify your life.

column9: DIY Kit Made even easier,  for those less industrious
column10: I debated starting a homebrew via the many tutorials on the internet. I decided to order this kit, unsure if I was making the right decision.  For me, it was absolutely the right move.  I felt more confident as a first timer getting everything I needed in one kit.  Regarding the scoby, it is clearly advertised that one has to order it with a code you get upon opening the box.  Why would anyone want a scoby that has been sitting indeterminately in a box in a warehouse?  It would not make any sense as it is a live culture.  It arrived within days of ordering it online.  For a first timer with no present human guiding me through the steps, the process was not as daunting as I would have thought. I have no doubt that this kit serves its purpose and gives its money's worth for those like myself who aren't as industrious as others. Sure, one can piece-meal all the necessary utensils and ingredients for a bit less, but for me the convenience and tech support are worth the little extra I paid.

At first I was disappointed because I didn't realize the culture had to be ordered separately (free with a code that came with my kit) AND my kit was missing the sticker thermometer. Then I realized this system allows for me to get a live, active culture. That is awesome! So much better than starting with a dried or frozen starter. I ordered the culture, contacted Kombucha Brooklyn and they mailed a new thermometer right away. 3 days later I started brewing. KB's product quality and easy to follow instructions helped me make some of the best kombucha I have ever tasted! Plus, they have great customer service. You may have to email or leave a message, but they will get back to you. I am having so much fun with this kit. As soon as I become more proficient with the brewing process, I will share recipes. This is a great product and more than worth the money. In a short time, my constantly brewing KBK jar has become a staple in my kitchen.

This is just a great kit,  the packaging is well done, the scoby was easy to order, and the ingredients were wonderful.  The kombucha I brewed was so delicious!  The only recommendation I would make would be to include printed directions/ recipes in the box (the directions were printed on the side od the box.) my first batch led to another, and the culture was so healthy, I now have four different batches brewing!  Remember to brew clean: wash your hands and prep your brew area prior to starting.  As long as you brew clean, and follow the instructions, you be able to brew your own awesome kombucha in no time!
This kit is a wonderful way to make sure you are off to the right start with making kombucha! Great gift idea, too!

Ok, for anyone who is interested in making their own kombucha...get this kit!  My first batch was wonderful, as good as the stuff you pay $4/bottle for at Whole Foods.  We have continued on with experimentation (trying fruity green teas, adding in fruit after fermentation, etc.) and the original SCOOBY that gets mailed to you has afforded us with 6 new SCOOBYs!  We have 4 different jars going now with a variety of teas...so much fun!This kit is wonderful and couldn't be easier to follow...thank you!!!

column9: Best Kombucha kit on the market
column10: Don't waste your time or money buying any other Kombucha kit.  This company is incredible!  The Scoby I received was pristine.  The products were labled nicely. The instructions were plain and simple.  The follow-up support on their website is top notch.  I'm so glad I went with this company to start my Kombucha adventure.  Currently brewing my third batch.  Fresh Kombucha is superior to anything you can buy in the store!  I'll be buying more kits to increase my home production!April DunnGreenville, SC

column9: Great kit, easy to order the starter
column10: I don't understand what the other reviewer complained about. Ordering the fresh culture from their website is easy and free. I guess they expected live cultures to be in the box somehow? Like sea monkeys, I guess. Anyway, this is a great little kit and I can't wait to try the tea.

column9: not at all as described missing the culture
column10: in the photo, it has everything needed in the kit. But you have to get the SCOBY Culture by entering a code, so when it the kit comes, you have to wait all over again to actually make the tea, because there is no culture.  I should have ordered it from someone else. seriously dissapointed.....

column9: 90. for two glass jars and some tea. no thanks.
column10: it's so unique getting the scoby that it's not even in the packaging and i don't care what the reason is. you can't show a picture and then the product thati'm paying money for isn't in the packaging. i came to my senses since you can by a scoby for how much? i like to be fooled and maybe you do too. so please goblow 45 dollars on a glass jar to then be told of some free claim for a scoby. no thanks.

I purchased the Teddy Grahams Soft Paws for my grandchildren and was pleasantly surprised with the product.  I chose the Oatmeal Raisin and found it to be a nice soft, flavorous cookie, individually wrapped and ready to be taken on the go for a reasonable snack. It did not crumble apart as it was held and eaten by an 18 month old, yet was soft and easily chewable.  Each cookie has 110 calories with 1 g of saturated fat and 6 g of sugar--better than many of the snacks available.  I was not impressed, however, with the price as I paid $2.69 for an 8 pack box on sale.  However, I will stock up on these when they are on sale again as the only allergens they contain are wheat and soy, making them among the few ready-to-eat snacks that my nut allergic granddaughter can have.  We are so excited to have found them for her and they make her feel "just like the other grandchildren" when I hand out snacks...Thank you Nabisco.

column9: Best if mixed with the bars
column10: The powder by itself is okay, thick and rich, but it lacks depth found in the original Spanish drink. We found that it is best to mix with the Valor chocolate bars. The two compliment each other and give you that rich authentic flavor. Stove top preparation with milk is the best.

column9: This is the best quick and easy meal you'll find.  And healthy too.
column10: The whole jar is only 180 calories with very little fat and even a little fiber.  Easily makes a meal for 4. I cut up 4 chicken breasts into 1" chunks and cook it, dump in the sauce, simmer for a minute, serve over rice and voila! So fast, easy and gooood. It's a little spicy and full of flavor.I buy it at Cost Plus World Market.

column9: Trip to India through the palate
column10: Indian food lovers, this sauce is for you! The smell and the flavor was awsome! Very exotic! Really great with chicken.

My family loves eating curries, that is why I was surprised at how much we didn't like this one.  It reminded me of a badly seasoned spaghetti sauce.  Loaded with tomato sauce and not much else.  It was edible, but not very enjoyable for us.  We have tried other sauces made by this company and liked them, so I cannot say that the brand is totally bad.  I prefer the spice pastes though because I can work with them more.

column9: Good for a quick, India-inspired meal
column10: This is very easy to use, just brown up 1-1/2 lbs. of diced chicken and simmer in the sauce for 15 min.  We prefer it on basmati rice, and like a little yogurt or labna in the sauce.  Pataks' sauce has a slightly sweet flavor, and is only a little spicy (the jar says hot, but it wasn't by our standards).  We ate it with some chili relish and mango pickle, to kick it up a notch. Usually we use a dry mix for Rogan Josh by Shan, or make it from scratch and personally I prefer these better, but they take 2-3 hours.  We also usually use beef, which I may try this with another time.  For something fast and easy it certainly fits the bill.
Ice Blue Mint Coolers 1 LBThe candy is very good and hard to find in stores. I was finally able to find a distibutor through Amazon.

This mix perfectly captures the cornbread style of the Upper Midwest (which is hard to find in a boxed mix): sweet, not crumbly, not coarse or gritty, and light. It has also turned out beautifully even when prepared very poorly indeed. I once found, after beginning, that both the butter and egg called for in the instructions were missing from the refrigerator--and the oven was unavailable, too. I split the mix into two large, straight-sided cereal bowls, stirred a tablespoon of oil into each bowl, added enough milk to make a good batter, and microwaved each bowl, at 1200 Watts, for 2 minutes. Even after all that abuse, the cornbread was wonderful.

This is much like Big Red (maybe a bit 'stronger'), but sugar-free. It is made with sugar alcohols (sorbitol), so there is a risk of diarrhea- so far, I've been fine :)  I will order again.  :)OK... edit time.  I chewed quite a bit of this stuff today since it arrived, and I'm pretty sure I'd be ready for a colonoscopy in the morning because of the diarrhea.  MUST LIMIT QUANTITY CHEWED !!  My innards have got to be sparking by now. :o
This is something I've never seen locally.  If you like Hot Tamales, you will like this.  The first bite is different, not sure if i'd say taste or texture but I get that past that quickly.

Our dog LOVED the edible bone, and the floppier brown rubber bone was a favorite for a long time.  The floppy brown bone survied her puppy teeth with almost no damage.  The white bone is really stiff and hard, almost plastic feeling, and she had no interest in it then and as she has aged, doesn't like it now either.  She ignores it completely, not even bothering to bury it in the backyard, which is her favorite thing to do with all her treats and toys.  Maybe other dogs will like it better.  2 out of 3 bones were great!
It took my 3 minature dachshunds about 5 minutes to eat the bone.  I was hoping that the bone would be more of a challenge to eat!
For a long time my one greyhound could not have any treats due to Inflamatory Bowel disease. These do not cause any relapses and it is really nice to watch the hounds enjoy these
My dog loves these sweet potato flavored bones. She's a vegetarian dog. They're hard enough but not too hard and she likes that.
My little dog really loves these.  However, she can go through one in about 15 minutes.  I was hoping for a few hours of chewing at least, that's why the 4 stars.  Will probably purchase again.

Our dog absolutely loved these! I loved that there were no inedible parts that I had to keep an eye on. Daisy's a big chewer, and these gave her something safe and delicious to gnaw on. Highly recommend. Would have been five stars, but each bone lasted less than 10 minutes. I found them to be a bit expensive for 30 minutes of fun.
The 2 hard bones worked very well with the puppies, but the softer, chewable one broke easily, so I watched the puppy with it.

I got the "souper" size version. Let me remind you my dog is a 1yr old, 25lb male Boston Terrier. I bought this as an alterenative because it was edible. I bought the "souper" size thinking that he would take FOREVER to chew this. I had gave it to him, and at first he was a bit scared of it. Once he got started there was no stopping him. He ate 90% of it in an hour! If your looking to buy this to keep your dog busy, beware. If a small Boston can chew a "souper" size in little over an hour imagine what bigger dogs could do. For the price, I wouldnt recomend this to anyone. It's just like a "souper" size cookie.

I bought this product for my mastiffs and while is took them a couple of hours to eat it, it only took 20 minutes for my Boston to eat it. I was hopeing that it would last months not minutes or hours. Great product for light chewers and for dogs with allergies to meats.

This is an excellent mix for belgium waffle makers. The taste is delicious, with a perfect, light crunchy exterior. It is so simple, everything in one package, just add water. Most "all in one" mixes are time savers and simple to make, however you usually give up a great deal in the taste. NO sacrifice here, they taste like "from scratch" waffles. I couldn't be more pleased with this product, not only tasty, but very cost effective too! In my opinion, you just can't go wrong with the Heartland mixes. I have tried 3 flavors now and they are all wonderful. I look foward to trying other flavors as well. Heartland makes it fun to make breakfast again with no sacrifice to taste. I have a disability which makes standing for any length of time very painful. I usually have to opt for microwave or toaster or quick options for meals, always loved to cook, so unfortunately, not my favorite decision. These mixes allow me a little "home cooked" freedom! Thank You Heartland!!

column9: two strawberry lovers, one bag of mix
column10: My two college kids love strawberries and they loved the waffle mix so much that I had to divide up the batter to send back with them to school. Sam has always been a strawberry nut and Soph loves waffles.  What a great match.  I need more batter for me!!!

Sure, the taste is not like fresh strawberries in the mix, but then, you didn't expect that, did you?  It's great for the kids and when I want something a little different.  Crunchy outside, soft and chewy inside.  I haven't found a better line of mixes.

Bought the chocolate mix also, but have not tried it since the strawberry is so tasty. Just add water. Also w/ the 3/2 proportion ratio, you can make just one or as many as you need. Good price. 5 lb. bag will last quite a while.

Item description says no trans fat, but towards the bottom of the list of ingredients you'll see that it "may" contain the partially hydrogenated oils that = trans fat.Amazon says they'll change the description in 2-5 days.This mix is bright pink and it contains corn syrup plus a bunch of dye. It has an overwhelming artificial candy taste rather than a taste that reflects actual strawberries.Really disappointed in this after trying the multigrain version which is amazingly yummy and doesn't contain a bunch of crap.Also disappointed in Heartland for trying to make their product seem healthier than it is by manipulating the fda food labeling rules.I'm not a health freak at all, I just want wholesome yummy FOOD. Not a bag full of dye, corn syrup, and cheap oils.All they really had to do was add a bit of dried fruit to their already lovely vanilla or multigrain mixes... I don't understand why they went this route.

column9: Great for dog with food allergies
column10: My dog ate lamb and rice for years, but then started to have extreme digestive upset from the food, even tho it was California Natural lamb and rice.  So the vet suggested he switch to the venison, and he's been fine ever since.  Great product!

column9: Great Food -but buy from Local Small Business instead
column10: I was using Natural Recipe from Target then switched to Iams which has put profits before their mission; using corn fillers. A friend referred me to a local small business pet shop to try this brand.  This brand has been a major changer in my Dog's eating habits.  She is full, less begging, and less waste!  The price point on Amazon is only $2.50-$3.00.  Small Businesses need our help!  They also have baked dog goods which are a welcomed in my home.  Please use this brand for a more satisfied dog and buy local for more money in the Community, more jobs and a Free Market!  Let's Get America Stronger!

I did check their website and it states all their products are made in USA.  I was concerned when I didn't see it on the package.  Rexie loves these and knows enough to chew things until he has tiny bite sized pieces to swallow thankfully as I gather most chews have a choking risk.  He looks better since he refused his commercial 4 and 5* dog kibble and canned foods.  I am now giving him low fat filet mignon which is reasonably priced, sirloin, fat removed lamb chops and chicken breast skinless.  He gets some supplements and nourishing chews.  He is learning to eat vegetables slowly but surely.  His coat is much softer and actually shimmers for the first time since we got him!

Barry Farms will send you excellent grain, flour, etc, and when you compare the price per lb to other products on Amazon, it will seem like the best deal, but BEWARE. The shipping is unbelievable.The short grain brown rice is perfectly fine, tastes fine, has nice texture, but it was absolutely nothing special. I've bought short grain rice in the grocery store that tasted the same, but DIDN'T cost me nearly $18 (after shipping) for 3lbs of it. Other vendors' products will seem high priced until you factor in the shipping, and then Barry Farm Foods is kind of a rip-off.It just wasn't worth it at all. I got average product at a crazy price tag.
I love brown rice, especially the short grains.  I also appreciate Barry Farms and have not been disappointed.  This is great brown rice from a good company.  You must try!

The rice itself is not bad at all. But there is nothing spectacular about it. This small bag of rice is not worth the price they charge for shipping. Only get it if you have free shipping (7.80 is alot). I thought it would have some type of slightly different taste being organic but whatever. There is not even a huge difference in the production of this brown rice and other short grain brown rices. I would suggest that unless the shipping price goes below $2.25, maybe if shipping was for about $2 with no more than $2.25 for the item, than it would be a nice price. Otherwise, look for a less expensive short grain brown rice because it will have the same health benefits for you and let you buy more with your money.Basically, it's just rice and it is overpriced (suggest you search your local chinese markets or grocery stores a little harder for short grain brown rice, or find one with a better shipping cost).

This is sort of what I imagine apple cider and gelatin would turn out as.  If you want to pay $5.00 for low-cal jello, then this is for you.  It tastes good...it's just waaaaaay over-priced for what it is.  Definitley more apple jelly than apple butter...but not even that.

The shipping worked out smashingly, however I will most likely never order this stuff again.  It tastes...all right I guess, but it does not work well with a knife, so getting it on the biscuit is always a challenge of frustrating proportions.

Granted this isn't really like apple "butter", but yet again, we're not getting all the fat, calories and sugar that we'd get from real apple butter either.  I tried the strawberry and raspberry fruit spreads, and this was my favorite of the three.  It's not the best thing ever, but is okay for what it is.
If you are looking for an apple jelly this is great.  Not quite an apple butter.
Love this product! The apple butter goes great with my lc pumpkin pancakes!! Also with cinnamon toast no after taste like i thought it might have.
This has a really good apple flavor and when it's warm, it looses that medicinal after taste.  I use it in place of the pancake syrup for a different taste.

I bought this apple butter as a change of pace from my normal peanut butter or laughing cow light cheese spread.  It is absolutely delicious and very healthy.  It's more like a jelly but I am willing to compromise given the nutritional value.  Real apple butter is higher in everything ... calories, fat, sugars, etc.  My next purchase will be a case of it!

I had low hopes, I have picked up Walden Farms from a local grocery store and for the most part be underwhelmed with their products because of the cellulose flavor...If you want a nice creamy apple butter that is almost like apple sauce, this is not it. You can tell in the jar that it is thick; but the flavors are on point and no cellulose flavor. I started eating it with a spoon out of the jar...cause you know that is healthy. The one draw back is that it gives me gas, a common thing with sugar replacements. I will buy again for sure!

column9: Tastes really good considering ZERO calories
column10: If you're looking for an exact replica of that buttery sweet taste and texture of fresh apple butter then this isn't it.  If you're looking for a good tasting ZERO calorie snack then this IS it.  The texture is like loose, chunky jello.  I take a whisk and stir it really well until it's smooth.  Spread it on a 30 calorie rye cracker and you've got a filling snack that tastes like dessert.  If you really want a smooth texture then use the food processor.

column9: Very nicely packaged, variety of goodies
column10: Sent this as a Mother's Day gift. The lady who received it thought it was wonderful. The 3 decorative oval boxes can be reused. They contain a variety of sweets & goodies that taste good and last a while. Although I had it "gift wrapped" by Amazon, you don't need to do that because the original gift packaging is already decoratively designed without the need for additional wrapping. All in all, a nice gift for a lady with a sweet tooth.A previous reviewer mentions a "watering can" which is NOT part of this gift; this food gift tower comes in 3 graduated size oval hatbox-style containers, not a watering can.

I received this lovely presentation which was full of stuff.  However, the edible goodies were horrible and the other stuff was really below even average.  The basket itself was nice. Not worth the money. Send your mom a gift card instead.

Sent this last Mother's Day, and my review could simply what my mother told me upon my calling her that day: "LOVE this!"A little more: She enjoyed all the goodies inside, but especially liked the containers. She's kept those to house her head scarves, cotton balls, and for mere decoration.  Good purchase!

I ordered this gift for my mother-in-law. The phone call I received from her touched my heart. She is a woman of impeccable taste and style. Being our family Grand Dam a compliment is definitely earned. The package was delivered on time and secured nicely. She commented on the beauty of the gift wrap. The three hat boxes were study, well made and of good quality. She said she felt like a kid at Christmas. Each hat box had a number of treats that thrilled her to no end. Each was a surprise. When all of the edibles were gone she felt that the hat boxes were beautiful enough to be placed in the family room. They are now being used as storage. She is still talking about it. Thank you Amazon and Art of Appreciation. There will be more purchases in the future.
It was cheering the whole clinic while this gift pack arrived in according the nurse lady there.  So 4 stars here.  If I had a chance to taste the candies, I might raise the 5th star~

column9: Best Mints and Candy Ever A++
column10: I had one of the Perugina Glacia mints when I was visiting my sister in Minnesotta. They had them at a restaurant. I looked all over for them when I got home to NJ. Finally finding them here on amazon.  Thank you so much.  Great!!!

The combination mint and citrus hard candy are a nice mix to put out in an office or at home.  Everyone loves these.  A pound goes pretty fast.  The shipping was fast and the price was in line with what I would pay locally.  These are relatively expensive for hard candy but in my opinion they are worth it.

column9: These Spring rolls are made with a weird tasting sauce!
column10: I guess I was looking for steak and cheese spring rolls but these did not have any cheese flavoring.  Instead, they applied this awful sauce that ruined the whole roll.  Don't get me wrong, the meat was tender and delicious but as a complete package....goodness that sauce ruined the whole taste experience.  I won't be buying this particular product ever again but you may like the taste of this sauce so....give it a try once, like I did!

column9: it is doubtful that it is natural
column10: the smell of perfume is very strong, so this product can not be natural because so hides the smell of chemicals in beauty products.

I gave it a 4 since I am not usually fond of  plain long grain brown rice, but make an exception for this.  I still like their short grain better, but this was very good.  Barry Farms have a lot of organic foods in their online cataloge and I really appreciate that!
This was just what I needed to make my Pollo la Brasa gringo styley beer can chicken. My wife is Peruvian and agreed that the product is genuine. It also makes a mean Aji de Huacatay sauce too.

It took quite a while for me to finally receive the huacatay paste. It took eight days to process the order and another seven to ship it. Given the timeframe for standard shipping, I think they could have processed the order a little faster.The huacatay paste is good quality. It would be nice if the description here on Amazon listed everything else that was in it (salt and preservatives, mainly). There's about 100mg sodium per tsp, so you'll want to adjust the salt in your recipes. Barry Farms should list this kind of information for their other products. I noticed some reviewers were surprised to find their dried fruits were preserved with sugar. I know this kind of stuff is common sense, but not everyone wants sugary dried fruits.I can't wait to start using this. Each jar is about a cup of paste, so it will last me a while. Given how long the order took, I'd recommend ordering several jars at once if you use huacatay frequently.

column9: Do you love a Chai Latte?
column10: I'm a big fan of Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf's Chai Latte.  With their process, you can actually taste the spice of this particular tea, and the added steamed latte mellows the whole thing out and is a perfect way to start the day.  (And it is not as sickeningly sweet as the beverage made by their major competition.)  But it can be over a four dollar a day habit, which I'm not willing to spend.  So I bought a 3-pack of the tea bags along with the Coffee Bean and Tea Leave vanilla powder and I make my own.  YUM!  It's also fun to make this for guests...always a big hit.

A spiced tea with a very nice aroma that lingers in the cup (not found in very many other spiced teas). While alot of people add milk and honey to Chai, this tea is best without. The tea itself is in those triangle-bags.Would recommend and will buy again. Have already mailed a package to some family.

column9: Great taste at an excellent value
column10: I went looking for this pasta after I recently tried a dish at a restaurant recently that featured this form of pasta.  The local regular supermarkets did not carry this kind of pasta and it seemed a bit overpriced at the local exotic markets.  I turned to Amazon to find a great deal.  Since there were no reviews on this pasta I took a leap of faith.  Having had the pasta a few times now I am excited to say that this is an excellent product and is worth purchasing at Amazon.  I am now inclined to try the other pasta's from the same brand.  I have tried it with both salt added and no salt added to the water and they turn out great both ways.  It depends on how you plan to cook the sauce I guess but the pasta itself is versatile and very easy to cook.  Just follow the instructions. I used a large 12qt pasta pot to make it and it worked out great.

Orecchiette is by far my favorite pasta out there and it is hard to come by at the grocery store, unless you go to a specialty Italian store (and those are usually quite expensive).  I am on the auto-shipment plan for this product and it is definitely a GREAT DEAL!

This is the best commercially available beef jerky around. It's drier than most products out there (Pemican, Jack Daniels) and much more authentic. Sadly, it seems that Trader Joe's has stopped carying it and started using their own, inferior brand. Honestly, it'g going to reduce the number of trips I make to trader joe's by 1/2. Anyway, if you like authentic beef jerkey (like the kind you used to find in the glass jars at gas stations) this is the only brand for you!
I love this brand of beef jerky. It's healthy and great tasting snack. I buy snackmasters from gelson in Los angeles and its always fresh and great tasting!

column9: Best beef jerky on the market!!
column10: I love this brand of beef jerky!! It's healthy, high in protein and has low saturated fat!! I always buy from gelsons and have never been disappointed.

I can't claim that this is the best tasting Jerky for anyone since everyone has their own opinion/tastes, but I am not afraid to admit that I buy beef Jerky anytime I see it within reach.Been a huge fan of beef jerky since I was a little kid since I was on plenty of road trips from New Mexico to Colorado because of family.  Jerky was the perfect snack.  From 20 years ago to now, I always have had a passion for Jerky and never surprised by any Jerky until this came around.Was only able to find this Jerky in my company's cafeteria.  Then they stopped carrying it and immediately looked online to find it.  Yes it might be expensive, but its totaly worth it.  Even their customer service is great because one time I got a bad package from the cafeteria and reported it on their site.  They ended up sending me 4 fresh packages (all different flavors) to make up for it.This is worth a try if you want something new.  Unfortunately I can't afford to get this all the time.  Maybe its a good thing because I ordered 2 orders of the Jerky (24 packages) and went through it in 3 days.

I first tried this in CA. It was carried for a while in VA but was no longer carried a few years ago. I hope it continues to sell since it is by far the best beef jerky. It is high quality meat (not too soft, not to fatty) and has a nice flavor.
The jerky is good but the worcestershire sauce is a bit much, it dominates the flavor instead of complementing it.  If your like Worcestershire sauce a lot then you will love this jerky!
I like the Snackmasters Turkey Jerky much better.  The beef was pretty tough, though if you like beef jerky better than turkey it still is one of the few jerkys available that is nitrite free.

I discovered Snackmasters Beef Jerky almost 10 years ago at BJ's.  They stopped carrying it several years ago and now only stock Slim Jim and Pemmican.  I couldn't find Snackmasters anywhere and tried every other brand of jerky I could find - Jack Link's, Trader Joe's, anything I found.  Nothing compared.  Finally, for Christmas 2008, my wife got me a couple bags of Snackmasters straight from the company and I have to say, it's still the best.  It tastes like what I imagine jerky is supposed to taste like - seasoned, dried beef.  Everything else is soft and greasy; Snackmasters requires a lot of chewing and the flavor is perfect.  I'm glad Amazon is carrying it now.

column9: best beef jerky i've ever had

The flavor is "O.K."  Won't buy again!  Very thin, and very tough!  Can get any generic brand with this texture!  Expected thick and soft from the description...NOT!  Not worth the price at all!  I eat a lot of jerkey for the low fat/high protein, but won't do this one again!  Disappointed!Jen

The two bottles of brown rice syrup I ordered arrived intact.  It is very delicious.
Great service and product one bad they still have a wrong listing 3 for $ instead of one for $.
