Tastes more or less like Karo dark syrup, but not as sweet.I've tried baking a couple things with it and am less satisfied on that front, it's not sweet enough...I think I'll stick with using it as a topping.

I bought this because I've read that it's used to keep baked items crisp.I make granola with honey, so I know what's in it and to keep down the cost.  I substituted some of the honey with this, and it works great.
This product is great!  I love to use it in oatmeal cookies!  Just the right amount of sweetness.  I'm ordering more today! It was not that expensive.

since i am borderline diabetic, i try NOT to use sugar products at all.  many web sites recommend using brown rice syrup for recipes for diabetics, though, so i've decided to give it a chance.with the purchase of this product, i feel empowered to start baking things that i would like to eat but have not been able to eat because of their high sugar content.blessings to all at NOW for being the wonderful company that it is.
This is a very healthy product. It was exactly what I wanted and at a fair price.  Highly recommend.

This is very fresh and good quality sumac. I use it whenever we make persian rice with kabobs. It has a wonderful tang to it and the price is very good. It's hard to run to the international food store just for some herbs so I love purchasing them from amazon because of the convenience factor.

Unfortunately the batch of Sumac I received had very little flavor to it at all. I expected it to have it's usual fresh, potent citrus flavor and instead it's mostly bland. I've added more than three times the usual dose to my dishes and I can still barely taste it.
Tastes just like the stuff you find in Mediterranean restaurants.  Great with rice, kabobs, popcorn... basically anything you could imagine putting salt on.  YUM!

Now I've eaten a LOT of pistachios in my 62 years......these are the BIGGEST ones I've ever seen.Excellent quality, very few unopened nuts and they are perfectly salted. An open bag is an empty bag at my house !. Highly Recommended. I am glad Amazon sells this brand.

I bought these as a little gift for my mother, and she told me she was shocked that there were so many gigantic nuts. Very few of them were still completely sealed, and the sea salt gave these roasted nuts a very good flavor. I'll definitely buy them again!
i have purchased these before and always tasted great, this batch was disgusting, something had to be wrong with them, had horrible chemical taste to them, very dissappointing

column9: In My Opinion The Gold Standard of US Pistachios.
column10: I hesitated to pay 'so much' for a pound of pistachios but after peering into the canvas bag to look at the nuts packaged within I couldn't help but purchase them (and anyway, I only discovered later that the bag is actually 21 Oz. making these inexpensive).For, these nuts really are extra-large and virtually all of them are open wide enough so that the two halves can be pulled apart with minimal effort (thus perfect for snacking on even whilst driving; although, this is definitely not a recommended usage).I now know that the reason they are so easy to open is that these nuts were tree-ripened such that the hulls opened naturally just as God intended for them to do.  Many, if not most, other unshelled Pistachios have been machined-opened which makes it more likely that the shell will be partially opened and tough to crack.I prefer just about everything with a little more salt so I wouldn't have complained if these had been more salty; still, these are plenty good as they are.What I like most about this product is that the nut meat is actually sweet and flavorful.  In other words, if you would like to know what a premium California Pistachio nut tastes like, you should certainly buy a bag of these.The very best Pistachios I have ever had was in, of all places, Iran, and I think these the best Pistachios I've ever had since then.

I bought these as a gift for a friend who loves pistachios.  She has been beaming about them since she received them.  Her words..."They were huge and not a bad one in the bag".  I am only sorry they are out of stock.  I would order another bad today.

I absolutely love these. I have a 15 lb mini aussie who is notorious for devouring things that should take him days or weeks to chew through in a matter of a couple hours. I decided to try these after trying a different dental bone that lasted 2 days. These looked harder, so I had high hopes.It took about 5 minutes to get him started chewing on the bone, I'm not sure if it didn't smell like food or if he was just unsure about the density, but after that he was hooked. He chews on it quite often, but it's lasted 2 weeks and he's still got about 1/3 of the first one left.The best part about these are that they REALLY freshened his breath. He's always had a breath problem, it just stinks! But these bones have made it perfectly tolerable. They've also cleaned his teeth, although not as much as I'd hoped (hence the 4 star rating instead of 5) however, I do not expect a bone to take up all the slack in hygiene, so I am quite content letting it freshen his breath and still getting his teeth cleaned regularly.
total ripoff, go to a near by indian store and u get the same or 99cents.its  also called methiseeds

One of my favorite candies!! it was nice too because it came in two separate bags which i thought was nice in order to keep the candy fresh and prevent it from becoming stale. surprisingly it did not melt at all during shipment, very satisfied, excellent product!!
These were excellent for the price. The gummies were soft and fresh and tasted great. I'm looking forward to purchasing them again in the near future.

I ordered the product and had my parents send it to me in Denmark. It cost a lot in shipping fees and upon arrival, I was left disappointed.The product wasn't Trolli brand gummy worms, but rather some gift shop type knock-off. Furthermore, Trolli's sold in-store do not contain gluten (I have celiac disease) but these did. It made it obsolete.In their defense, it could be old Tolli brand worms (as they used to) but then they would be old. These looked new but didn't have the same taste and consistency as normal Trolli worms.

My puppy LOVES these, we go through them really quickly and wished they were made bigger. At any rate, these can last up to a week in the house. Once they are about the size of a golf ball they get thrown away. Very inexpensive to buy singly, I should look into buying them in bulk!

I have been drinking tea for about 50 years or so, and Stash makes a great-tasting full-bodied tea.  This tea has a smooth fruity taste (peach).  It is not overbearing, but a nice subtle peachiness.Individually sealed in a paper/foil pouch for added freshness, this tea is listed as having 100 % natural ingredients.  They are, in the order listed, wuyi oolong teaorange peel, lemongrass, and white peach flavor.It has been said that oolong tea was named after the part of Wuyi mountain, in China, where it was originally produced. It is among the most popular types of teas served in typical Chinese restaurants. (I have also found Jasmine tea and varieties of green tea in typical Chinese restaurants¡Xand plum wine.  Yum.)It is also suggested that oolong tea is useful for weight loss.  In my (non-medical) opinion (I am not a doctor), like anything else, it can HELP but won¡¦t carry the load.  Oolong appears to be a diuretic, helping you to loose excess water.  If you lose too much water, you might dehydrate or lose valuable potassium.  So, I suggest that you limit yourself to 24 oz a day.  As with anything else, seek guidance from your health care practitioner.I suggest adding agave cactus juice, unbleached natural brown sugar, or honey, if you want a sweetener.  I like fruity teas often in the evening, and instead of dessert.Darn it!  Now I¡¦m craving Chinese food and am snowed in--in a blizzard¡Xwith over 40 inches of snow on the ground.  I wonder if they will deliver? º

Wow, this is good stuff!  I brew mine up and pour into a mug with 4-5 drops of apricot liquid stevia and a little soy vanilla creamer.  Wonderful to sip as an after dinner treat.  So creamy and tropical...yum!

Generally, I don't like flavored tea. And the experiences I've had with chocolate flavored tea left me convinced it really couldn't be done in any palatable way. I was wrong. I don't know what led me to try Stash's Chocolate Mint Oolong but this tea is outstanding! It does NOT taste like Palmer's chocolate coins dissolved and diluted in too much water, which is what most chocolate tea tastes like to me -- not even a Hershey's kiss, but Palmer's -- yuck! This tea has a very light yet distinct chocolaty flavor followed by sweet mint. It's refreshing in the evening after dinner when I want something sweet but don't want to load up on sugar right before bedtime. And, truth be told, it's a delight any time of day.

This Stash flavor is so deliciously tropical I love it hot or cold.  Made with 100% natural ingredients of :wuyi oolong tea,  orange peel, and flavors of coconut, pineapple, and mango.  It's caffeine free and I like this espeically as a cold drink in the mornings vs coffee in the summer time;  very refreshing and tropical.  Takes 3-5 minutes to steep and if making iced tea Stash recommends using double strength...2 bags per cup.  As with many of the unique Stash brand varieties ; licorice and pure peppermint,  this is difficult sometimes to get at the local stores so I buy either direct from the company or here on Amazon. Delicious. 5 stars to a great brand of Stash.

Love this tea.  Unlike a lot of (supposedly) flavored teas, this one actually has a strong flavor; more coconut "tropical" than mango but really tasty, with a strong smell too.  I think it tastes best with a touch of sweetener (honey, agave, etc.) to further enhance the flavor.  After finding it once, I haven't been able to find this flavor at any of my local grocery stores, so I ordered the box of 6.  Everyone I have shared this tea with has loved it too!.
I drink a lot of tea and Stash's White Peach Oolong is by far my favorite.  It's smooth and has a great flavor.

I like this tea because it has a nice subtle flavor without the bitterness that one often experiences with black teas.  And, I'm told that oolong tea is good for your health too, and that's why I tried it.
This tea has a fresh peach flavor, not artificial-tasting like some others I have tried. It has a natural sweetness, and is refreshing served either hot or iced.

I love this tea!  If you like peach flavored teas, you'll probably like it.  Good amount of peach flavor.  Mild overall - not strong like black and not grassy like green.  Now and then I try other brands but end up always coming back to Stash.  Their blends/flavors are always my favorites - especially their Earl Grey.

This isn't bad - peach but also a bit of citrus.  Was looking for a substitute for Celestial Seasonings white peach and it's not quite what I wanted.  However, a friend of mine whom I gave it to loves the product.  :)  Each to his/her own!

I love drinking different peach tea's during summer. The white peach oolong has a sweet peach flavor that has a slight lemmongrass flavor with a hint of citrus. I drink this tea with milk, sugar, peach bits, then chilled, and the taste really comes together well. Not as strong as Celestial Seasoning Country Passion Peach tea. I've also tried Liptons Peach tea which has a light pina colada flavor, but as far as white peach, it's definitely a great Summer treat for the family picnic.

No offense to the Swiss Miss, but this is the best cocoa ever. It's rich, chocolatey and so creamy, you'd think it was mixed with milk. If you've ever been to Waffle House and had an awesome cup of cocoa, you can bet it was Butternut. They give you something that you can crunch on that has high protein and lower carb content.  They also don't use any scary additives like MSG.  To me, they are almost like a crunchier version of Cheetos.  Okay, they are a bit different, but I love them the same.  My only complaint is that one bag is 1.75 servings.  This is rather strange to me.  Either make the bags one serving, or give the nutrition information for a whole bag.  I'm still giving it 5 stars because the product far outweighs this shortcoming.

Very unhappy with purchase.  These taste awful.  Remind me of the cheap boxed salad crutons that used to be popular in the 1980s.  Even though they are gluten free they remind me of dried out bread. column9: Good - but please note the size of the bag!
column10: I enjoy these snacks but I hope buyers note that this bag is NOT an individual serving.  Depending on the item, the bags are usually 1.5 to 1.75 ounce when the single serving is 1 ounce.  So that 130 calories is NOT for the entire bag.  If you eat the entire 1.5 ounce bag it just shy of 200 calories.  That's a significant difference for me.  I still enjoy Kay's Naturals but I wish they would bag them differently to make it easier to eat the correct amount.

column9: Absolutely amazing texture and flavor!!! YUM!
column10: I am absolutely amazed and thrilled to have located these snacks!!!  I've been on the Medifast diet plan for 3+ months now and the plan entails keeping carbs low and protein a bit higher.  Unfortunately, Medifast food is very expensive.I happened across a mention of these in one of the medifast discussion threads  and decided to give them a try.  I WILL NEVER buy medifast parmesan cheese puffs for more than $2 per serving again!! These are so much better - and while they have slightly less fiber - they have fewer carbs as well - and nearly equivalent protein.  Less sodium too.Best of all - they have a light, non greasy texture, suberb crunch and a good cheese flavor.Just ordered 2 more boxes so my kids can have some as well!Woohoo!!! Yay Kay's!!! Keep 'em coming!

column9: Great snack with the protein Gastric Bypass patients need!!!!
column10: After gastric bypass surgery, you have to eat 50 or more grams of protein EVERY DAY.  Sugar-free Protein shakes give you most of it.  But you do like to get it from other sources also.  You have a very small 1/8-1/4 cup stomach so you can't waste your space on snacks that can't benefit you with vitamins, proteins or some nutrient of value.  Also, you can't eat sugar., but you can eat sugar substitutes.  So KAY'S NATURALS PRODUCTS ARE GREAT!  They have tons of protein and they taste great!  The kruncheeze are like cheetos and you like to be able to have a snack when other people do.  Also, the cinnamon toast pretzels are great...the sweetener is low enough in the ingredient list to be able to tolerate it--because there isn't much of it.  Thank you KAYS!  You help us take casre of ourselves while we ENJOY food and make eating a little more normal.  Lisa

column9: Product is barely edible & packages do not include the amount advertised.
column10: The quantity information on this product is inaccurate. The ad says each bag is 1.5 ounces, (even 1.75 ounces per bag, if you read further on the description), but it has actually been downsized to 1.2 ounces.For the case of 12 that I bought I received a full 3.6 ounces less than was advertised. column9: DIABETICS: take a look at the label!

These taste like crunchy, gritty, cheesy soap. Awful!!! I had one bite and I nearly gagged.

column9: Very good and very very hot!
column10: But thats what you would expect and thats exactly what you want with a realjerk marinade!I'm not exaggerating the heat level of this stuff, its probably more thanmost can tolerate. But, being a front line chilihead from way back, the heatblends perfectly with the other spices to make either your chicken, fish, orpork come alive.The directions say to use 1 Tsp per pound of meat, but I use considerably morethan that, and let marinate for an hour. Actually you will get better resultsif you go for 24 hours in a ziplock bag in the fridge. You don't need to usesalt and pepper, this has all the spice you need, and its all natural. Maybethe best thing about this wondermous stuff is that its available locally almosteverywhere for under $4.BTW, the other commercially available jerk seasoning comes from Walkerswood.They are both fantastic, the Walkerswood is a little saltier however so if youhave any sensitivity to sodium then this is just the trick for you. But with theGrace seasoning, your finished product will have a green color, if you've used thegrill you probably wont notice... the oven is another story.

this garlic juice is great on everything, that is if you like garlic which i do

I'll be going back to Zukes and cut them in half.

Cheap, good alternative to something like Zuke's for training (which I cut in half for my dog's training class, since it is a clicker training evening where he stuffs his stomach with tons of treats).  I'm sure they're not as great nutritionally as some other treats, but comes with quite a bit for $4.  My dog likes them, but he's not very picky either.  They're smaller than a centimeter in diameter, and would not be good for a kong because they'd fall out wayyyy too quickly.  I think they're just good training treats, or good for a food puzzle with only a very small hole (akin to the kong wobbler with maybe a tennis ball inside along with the treats).

I wanted so much for my dog to like these treats. She turned her nose immediately. It looked like years old brown dried dog food all crumbled up opposed to the nice vibrant mixed colors one you see in the picture. The only thing positive is the size of the treats that can go in the Twist toy.
I this product is a little small and comes out of the tug-a-jug too easily.  They also make my dog's stools very soft.  My dog loves them though, so we give them to her in moderation.

I have an older Westie.TRAINING: She loves the taste of these treats and I use them for our weekly "lessons"...they are so small that they make a wonderful positive reinforcement without adding too much to her diet.ENTERTAINMENT:  As an older dog, she tends to sleep much more and play a lot less.  I was looking for something to entertain her but the treat dispensers were not holding her interest.  Instead, I scatter a small handful on my rug and she really enjoys sniffing them out... she cannot see them because the detail of the oriental rug is so intricate so she has to rely on her nose - it's fun to watch her get excited when she catches a whif of one! I'n not sure who's being more entertained!

column9: My dog did not even want to try them.
column10: My dog was not interested in these treats, and we even bought the toy that you are supposed to stuff them in.  I am not sure why he did not like them, but I have a whole bag that he turns his nose up to each time I offer them.
my dog doesnt like the toy that goes with these. the treats are ok, she loves the treats by themselves.

When you buy the little toys that require treats make sure you get this as well.  I just brought the toys then filled with some of the puppy food and it made due but I didn't get the full effect of the toy. So, i ordered this thinking what will it hurt and it works so much better.  Then again thats what its made for

This is a great idea for a treat given with the bone but the issue is they come out too quickly and now this is the third time my dog has swallowed the treat and choked  They tend to be too hard and unfortunately my dog tries to eat them too fast.  Other products seem to be safer so we will toss these away for something my dog will not choke on!

column9: My Yorkie and Golden Retriever both love these treats!
column10: I bought my Yorkie and Golden Retriever one of the Tug-A-Jugs and filled it with the Premier Buddy Berries Dog Treats. They love to push and pull the Tug-A-Jug around the floor until they can get one of the Berries treats to come out. It's very obvious that they love these treats! I would recommend them to anyone who is looking for a small treat to put into the Busy Buddy toys.

they are indeed tiny but there are so many in the bag so thats not a problem. my toy poodle loves these treats. i can even put just a few in my dogs dry kibble and he gobbles it down. :) they work great in the squirrel buddy!

My dog is a little chihuahua and he is normally a very fussy dog when it comes to food. When I opened the packet and gave him one biscuit to see if he would like it, he gobbled it straight down. I gave him another one and he still enjoyed eating it. I was very happy that my dog enjoyed eating the biscuits, so they were not a waste to buy. Even a fussy dog has his weakness!

I was surprised when I opened the box & these Buddy Berries didn't look at all like the photo. They actually look & smell like cat food, small bland tan pellets. So far my dogs don't mind eating them but I won't buy again. Would not recommend to anyone.
This is a great puppy training treat. Small and easy to use. We just use these to train the puppies with  and is working great!

My dogs lOve these things. I have two different toys they go in and whenever they see me picking them up they follow me to the kitchen and wait fir me to fill them with he treats then immediately start rolling the toys around to get at them.

We have a "Chuckles" treat dispenser toy for him, that we first saw with my brother and sister in laws dog. Fill the Chuckles with these things and the dog will just go nuts over the toy and the treats, tossing it up to knock treats out for hours on end!
My dogs love these to fill up their buddy toy.  My dogs can't eat all treats but I'm buying more of these, that pretty much sums it up.
i use these with the round treat ball. my small dog loves it! they dispense out of the ball just right so she keeps entertained.
I use them for rewards and my two Havanese puppies love them.  They are very particular abouttheir treats, but will do everything I ask to get these.

I use these in the Busy Buddy Twist n' Treat for a very small dog and she loves them. she rolls the toy around until all the tiny treats have fallen out. I give her the toy about once a week and I still haven't run out of these treats.
Well, the pups love em and they are small enough to fit in their kong as well as a couple other treat dispensing toys.  Will buy again!

I bought these to fill the Busy Budy Puppy Waddle Treat Dog Toy.  I have to say my Pomeranian puppy LOVES the taste of them, but they are almost too small for the toy and the fall out without him even having to work for them.  I wish they were a little bigger, but I still use them.  Also, a ton come in the bag, so they should last a while.

I'm sure some dogs find these treats irresistible.  My dog kind of looked at the "treats" as regular dog food.  She isn't impressed and is in no hurry to chow down.  They are good for filling a treat ball though if you don't want it empty in minutes.
Use these treats to reward your puppies for sitting, dropping, etc. They help train your puppy.

column9: Too small for their intended use
column10: These were linked with the Waggle -- there may even be a photo of the toy on the front of the treat bag.I'm still using these, just to get rid of them, but when used with the small Waggle they provide no challenge for my 12-pound mix. They're too small and fall right out with almost no effort on her part, which -- I want her occupied! The pieces are also too small to be used as treats; each is about the size of a small pill or long grain of rice. To keep the pieces from falling out immediately, I usually seal the opening of the Waggle with peanut butter before I give her the toy.The chicken flavoring grosses me out; it reminds me a little of cereal "icing" the way it coats each piece.Regardless, I'm not disappointed in the product per se, we're still using it, and my dog has no complaints.

column9: This has been my dogs favorite toy for YEARS
column10: She loves to play with it all the time, with or without treats.  It's very rugged and just now starting to tear on one side after 5+ years of use.  Ordering a replacement now.

column9: For those of us who don't like plain ol' water . . .
column10: I've always kept powdered drink mix on hand for when I run out of my favorite bottled drink, juice or tea until the day I ran across these Totally Light 2go at a friend's house. I filled my green tea bottle with cold water and added the pre-measured, pre-sweetened packet and the tap water instantly became an enjoyable, satisfying beverage!With an abundance of flavors, I actually look forward to having these drinks; they are that good!-Stephen

Truly great alternative to sodas.  Really refreshing taste and without all the side effects of other drinks on the market.  I keep several packets at work for when the "urge" for colas hit me I can just mix this into my water and enjoy
I've been drinking this for quite awhile.  Ordered through Amazon for convenience.  I mix it with 32 oz water instead of 16.9 or 20 oz (as recommended).  I prefer it to be less strong.

column9: Great- no artificial sweeteners at all !
column10: I can't do artificial sweeteners (medical issues), so was so pleased to find a naturally low calorie sweetened drink mix.  There is a very slight aftertaste, but nothing as bad as the artificially sweetened stuff.  It dissolves very quickly, and is a nice change from plain water.  I am most fond of the grape, which is odd, as I don't generally go for grape flavored drinks of other types.  The lemonade is also good.  Much more healthy than the Monsanto-based aspartame products.

column9: It may be cat food, but my dogs love it.
column10: After noticing my dogs LOVE to eat from cat bowls of friends/neighbors, I got them some. I've generally heard that ~most~ cat foods are richer than most dog foods, so if true, that makes sense why dogs like it too. Although you may be able to feed cat food to dogs, you're not supposed to give dog food to cats. I don't want them getting doggy gout from overly rich food, so I trained them to understand that they can split one of these (2.75 oz plastic cup) AFTER they finish their regular dry food. I've given them Friskies too, which is a larger size (5 or 5.5 oz), and they love that too. One of the dogs grabs the cup and holds it in his paws and licks every last speck out. If they're happy, so am I.

column9: Cats love it but a powerful smell!
column10: We decided our cars were getting a little hefty and wanted to switch them to wet food. We ordered this based on the ingredients being mostly fish and it being affordable compared to some of the other healthier cat foods. Our two female cats immediately devoured the first can, while the male cat gave us a mournful look like "Why did you foresake me??", we've since switched him to healthier dry food and he is happier. The one caveat with the whitefish and tuna flavor is that is has a very very powerful fish smell that seeps into your fingers and wafts through a kitchen and living room.
I have used this on roasted potatoes, vegetables and fish and it is delicious!  I would recommend this to anyone who enjoys cooking and eating!
Discovered at a farmer's market in Portland and lucky to find it at Amazon. Easy to make and use on anything.  Makes delicious grilled veggies and chicken.  Even great on sourdough bread.

How very happy I was to receive this product through your advertisment.  Being a baker/cake decorator it was difficult for me,(as both my husband and mother-in-law are Diabetic), to make sugarfree desserts.  With this product I have been able to make them Upside Down Pinapple Cake and an Apple Coffee Cake! Thank you so much for you awesome lists of sugar free items.Sincerely,Davia ManciniRensselaer, New York

This is fabulous chocolate - one of the only mint-flavored chocolate bars available that is at least 70% cocoa. However, for some reason a number of bars in the box that I received weren't terribly fresh. Some of the bars had that light, chalky color on the outside. This doesn't mean the chocolate has gone bad, just that it's been around for a while - though these older bars were also a bit more brittle than the newer ones. Maybe the company is having inventory problems, or manufacturing problems. I used to be able to get the Endangered Species dark chocolate mint at a couple of local stores, and then for several months none was available. That's when I decided to buy it online.

column9: REAL chocolate with a hint of mint
column10: This is a nice bar.  It's about 1/4 inch thick and about 2 3/4 x 5 3/4 inches in size.  The 72% cocoa is nice because it is bittersweet without all the added sugar but not as harsh as the higher cocoa content ones.  The mint taste is light, just a hint of mint. The higher cocoa content like this bar is supposed to be good for you (but does not mean you should eat a whole lot.)  The bar says it has 2 servings, and honestly, half this bar is enough.  (I found that usually the first mouthfull satisfies the urge anyway.  So, unless you can afford all the calories, eat half the bar and put the rest away for another day---OR, better yet, share with friends.)Ingredients are nice--like real food (chocolate, beet sugar, vanilla, etc.--not a bunch of chemical names.  Only 12g sugar.  Also contains 3g protein and is 10% iron and 2% calcium.  10% of the profits are donated to help support species, habitat and humanity.  An all natural, 3 oz/85g product and it is delicious.

I've had quite a few mint chocolate candies in my life, and this is definitely my favorite.  Not only is the bar 70% chocolate, but it's not where it's a case of chocolate surrounding an overpoweringly sweet and minty center like the Ghirardelli ones.  The mint is actually infused into the bar, which makes it so delicious - you get a deep chocolate taste and subtle mint flavor in every bite!

These have just the right amount of mint taste to them.  We use them to make mint chocolate chip cookies and use broken up pieces instead of chips.  Recipe is in Drenna Burton's "Eat, Drink and Be Vegan".
The  mint in this dark chocolate is just right, not overwhelming, just enhances the taste of the chocolate.

This chocolate was absolutely amazing. It's rich and dark and creamy, definitely something a dark-chocolate lover would find a treasure to savor. The bars come in a neat little box in a design similar to what one typically sees in a chocolate containers for individual bars in markets. The outer paper wrapper contains some info on various environmental causes. Pretty nice.Again, chocolate was better than I expected. I read reviews about how some people had aged, possibly expired, chocolate, but I went ahead and bought this and the expiration date was a year away and tasted great, so I was very pleased. It's dark chocolate, alright. Smooth and slightly bitter, just how I love it. The only problem I had was that it didn't have as much mint flavor as I would have liked. It's still there, alright, but it's just not very strong. Overall, these are some lovely chocolates.
these are really great bars- good texture, mint flavor nicely balanced with bittersweet chocolate. Me and my husband have a couple squares after dinner every night; I will for sure buy them again.

I am a dark chocolate fanatic (and I mean a good brand, not Hershey's), and this brand's mint is my absolute favorite. It has just the right balance of silky, smooth dark chocolate and just the right amount of mint. I eat other brands also, but only because they have certain flavors that Endangered Species doesn't carry (such as orange). If they had all the flavors I like, I would buy only this brand. Definitely worth the money.

I had tried their 88% Extreme Dark Chocolate bar and whoa, that was insane. This was a lot more palatable and the mint probably helped a bit. I don't enjoy it as much as their 45% "Sea Otter" bar, but if you prefer a strong, but not too strong dark chocolate, this would probably be good for you.

column9: 5 Star Bars, But Watch Out for Warm Weather Shipping
column10: Love these bars, great taste for high-cocoa chocolate mint. However, just had a package shipped and it was a melted and rehardened mess. It is cool where I live, but it was shipped from the east coast where it's been hot. I have to return them and then wait for a refund which is kind of a pain. So, I think I would only buy these online during cool weather in the future. However, the product itself, when it is shipped without incident, is great, my whole family enjoys them.
This is absolutely delicious.  It's good for you, has 72% cacao, and I appreciate that they contribute to endangered species conservation.
If you like mint and Chocolate you'll love this bar. It's absolutely scrumptious. Great taste and quality.

The most over-rated chocolate bars on Amazon. Could barely taste the mint. Only with my eyes closed, in a dark room and with the TV off and then it was a struggle. I have had German chocolate (Ritter) 3 years past its expiration date and run over by a car that were better than these. At three bucks a bar it is a sin.

Ordered a case of these to make Christmas gifts with.  We wrapped them in paper and decorated like snowmen.  They were a great value for the chocolate, everyone loved them.  Haven't gotten to taste one myself yet!

column9: Where is the flavor of the Rainforest
column10: This is the third product by this company I have tried.  First was the one with the chimpanzee on the label.  Fine chocolate, but alas no chimpanzee flavor.  Then the one with a bat on the label.  Can you guess the outcome?  Again, the chocolate itself was good, but no flavor of bat!  So fine, I figured since trees are stationary and not moving like chimps and bats, maybe third time is a charm.  Perhaps there is some sort of exotic Brazilian wood flavor in this chocolate.  So, I bite into it..and what do I taste?  Chocolate and mint!  Now who knows, maybe the mint leaves was lugged about by some native in the rainforest.  But really now, a forest is the trees!  Even if the mint was grown in the Amazon, that's not what I expect at all!  I want this chocolate bar to taste like honest to god wood!Well, I was fooled again.  Chimpanzee chocolate bar, no chimp flavor.  Bat chocolate bar, no bat flavor.  Rainforest chocolate bar, no tree flavor.  So again I am forced to give an otherwise quality product one star.  It's a shame, if they would stop their false advertising and just advertise this as a mint chocolate bar, I'd give it four or even five stars.  I'm not normally a fan of mint but I did like this chocolate bar.  Or would have if it had tasted like a tree!
I love these cinnamon certs and can't hardly find them. Got a great price and quick service. If you want great service & price this is the place to buy them.

I've been using these since the 90's for my workouts.  Just one keeps away dry mouth, which is a workout killer.  One is good for like an hour.  These seem to be disappearing from all the places I shop and seem really hard to find anymore.  Thanks to Amazon I'm now loaded up!  These are the best.  Not too sweet, just sweet enough, with a little spice. I think they're just a perfect tool for my diabetes. One mint has 2g sugar and 5 calories. Plus, they're perfect for spontaneous flirting!

column9: Delighted to find cinnamon Certs at last.
column10: Cinnamon Certs have been  my favorite breath mint for ages, but they have become increasingly difficult to find in the stores.  My local drug stores and Dollar Tree used to be my source, but they all have ceased carrying cinnamon Certs.  Once again the internet came to the rescue, and I was able to replenish my supply of this favorite.  This is the second time I have purchased them through Amazon.  They are always fresh, and in perfect condition (no broken pieces).

I ordered these certs because i love cinnamon candies!This is like a double deal to me. It's like candies/mints.I love these little mints! It's a great snack, & this was definately a great deal.It doesn't really keep my mouth fresh for long though, it starts to taste like i just ate candy or something sour. I still will purchase these again. I ate them so much non stop i was afraid to allow myself to keep the suscribe & save!

I have a very small dog (4 pounds) and it's hard to find treats for her.  She loves the cheese flavored and the mint flavored treats.  They clean her teeth and she gets something special too.  Perfect for smaller pets.

My malti-poo will not eat these.  I tried and tried to coax him into eating this product, and finally he would take the little bones and go hide them in the couch. However he loves the "talk to me" minty treats.
My dog loves these and I was very pleased to find them on Amazon at a reasonable price.  The Petsmart here does not carry them so thank you!

column4: Helen Joy Dhar "Joy Dhar, Pastry Chef"
column9: Talk to me Treats for dogs
column10: My miniature Schnauzer absolutely loves these Talk to me Treats - cheese flavor!  They are also a favorite of my son's miniature Schnauzer.  Pet Smart no longer carries these treats, but thank heaven for Amazon.com!  Joy Dhar

OUR DOG IGGY IS A RESCUE AND HAS AN OVERBITE AND CROOKED TEETH.  AS A RESULT, IT IS DIFFICULT TO FIND TREATS THAT HE CAN ENJOY AND THAT ARE NOT TOO HARD FOR HIM TO CHEW.  HE ALSO HAS A SENSITIVE STOMACH AND MOST TREATS ON THE MARKET MAKE HIM SICK.  THESE TALK TO ME CHEESE TREATS ARE JUST WHAT HE  LOVES AND THEY DON'T UPSET HIS STOMACH AT ALL.  EVERY NIGHT HE REMINDS ME THAT IT'S TIME FOR HIS TREAT.
My dog also loves these treats and I'm finding such a hard time finding them. The ones I have are crunchy, but cheesy and he just loves them.

column9: My dogs will do anything for these treats!
column10: My dogs love these cheese treats and will do absolutely anything to earn one! The treats are small and stay soft and they must taste great (they actually smell pretty good - cheesy). The treats don't leave crumbs behind. I have toy breed dogs and these treats are just the right size and a perfect reward for good behavior.
One of the few "meat" snacks she really likes.  Can be a little expensive at times, but for a real treat this is really good.

I recently purchased a couple of cases of this when Amazon had it on sale.  I'd never tried it before, but since it's healthy, I thought I'd give it a whirl and pawn it off on somebody else if I didn't like it.  When I opened my first bottle, I thought it had a really strange, fermented taste and smell -- yes, sadly, I tried a sip of it -- and had a lot of thick, gooey pulp.I contacted the manufacturer @ (415) 775-6355 and asked them if this was normal.  Apparently, they had a bad batch with their old manufacturing plant where the bottles were not being sealed properly and have since spoiled.  She asked me some questions about the bottle, got some order numbers and cap numbers from me, and they are sending me out some replacement cases.  They were very friendly, apologetic and helpful.  So if you get some from Amazon and the taste seems to be off, I'd encourage you to call them and let them rectify the situation for you.

column9: Zola lives up to it's claims.....
column10: I had read several articles proclaiming the wonders of Acia juice... Skeptical?..of course.  The price was somewhat prohibitive but I found it on the shelf of a local health food store and decided to give it a try.  At first the taste was quite strange...fermented like wine(but I got used to it and actually enjoy it..).  The juice is not a smooth drink it includes some pulp( not like you're drinking oatmeal)so there is definitely texture. My interest lay in the fact that it promoted weight loss ... result...it has increased my weight loss slightly BUT it has resolved bloating and bouts of constipation and fatigue.  Although I am not losing weight by leaps and bounds the resolution of the other 3 issues gave me more than enough positive evidence to continue using Zola.  I do have hope that someone out there will have a generous sale on this product =)Zola Original Acai Superfruit Juice, 12-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)

I wanted to taste it just because I like to taste new stuff, and because it is claimed to be "superfood". I liked the taste and now I drink this one or ONE Acai nearly every day, just because I like the taste and because it's conveniently delivered to me by Amazon's subscription.I buy tons of stuff on Amazon and rarely write reviews, but I remember when I first open this web-page I hesitated to buy, because there were a lot of negative reviews. I finally bought it out of curiosity, and was prepared for something awful. It turned out to be one of my favorite drinks. So I thought it would be fair for the product if I write a review.I gave it to other people to taste, and most people liked it. Like with any food, there are personal preferences. Some people drink coffee, some don't. So my advice is - ignore any review (positive and negative). If you want to taste it, taste it.P.S. I'm not telling that Acai juice is any better than let's say blueberry juice. It's just that I like variety, and that Amazon delivers this one to me. I would enjoy Amazon having more natural berry juices available for delivery.P.P.S. Amazon, please, resume selling the Acai+Blueberry juice from Zola. I liked it the most out of Original/+Blueberry/+Pineapple, and you took it out...

column9: Hit and miss - Quality control seems to be a disaster
column10: I'd rate this drink 5 stars because I've loved it so much that I've "subscribed" to have it delivered at least every month, it's always been my tasty treat in the morning or to finish off a day. I absolutely loved it.Lately, though, I've been getting cases of the stuff full of bottles with foul-tasting fluids. I mean, RANCID. Make you gag stuff. And not just occasionally. With my most recent case, I drank the first one (squinty-eyeed, I figured it must be something I ate or drank before it) and had indigestion all day, the next two I threw out completely. The fourth one, I have here, and it has a slight foul aftertaste but it's mostly the same delicious sweet juice I originally enjoyed, so I'm drinking it.The frequency of these had me motivated to post here.I also noticed that, at least I think, they've been tinkering with their recipe. Besides the new packaging, I think they changed some ingredients out. The second ingredient is "organic evap cane juice". Cane juice? As in, sugar? I think the Zola I fell in love with several months ago was naturally sweetened by the fruit itself, not by added sugar.Overall, the drink is now okay. But I'm cancelling my auto-order "subscription".

column9: Tastes good, healthy, not sure about energy benefits
column10: I bought 2 cases of this and have finished both of them.  Taste is very good and I enjoyed having one in the morning and another in the afternoon.  Can't honestly say that I felt any substantial energy boost, it was more of a subtle boost.  It's supposed to give you a sustained energy level as opposed to the quick pickup and subsequent drop that energy drinks normally give.  Personally I don't think it has helped my energy level that much so it's mostly the good taste and healthy nutritional profile that made me boost the rating up to 4 stars.I bought this in large part because of the subscribe and save discount along with an additional discount code they have during March.  Not sure if I would continue ordering without an additional discount but I just ordered the acai-blueberry flavor today while the discount is still active.  I'm hoping the acai-blueberry tastes at least as good as this original acai version.

I really enjoy this product and have been buying at my local supermarket for about a year and a half.  Amazon saves me only a few dollars on a case, but the convenience of having it shipped to my house is what really makes the difference.  It tastes good, but the little seeds can make it seem gritty.  I don't personally mind, but I know a few that do.  The real reason why I drink it is the way it makes me feel.  I can really tell a difference and it's almost tingly.

column9: Nectar of the gods.  Just wonderful.
column10: Had this on auto ship when it was available in its old packaging.  It was often out of stock and when it did not return I was crushed.  I have looked far and wide for a comparable product with no success and I am elated to find Zola again!  This is by far my favorite acai and faithful friend for a quick and enjoyable pick-up without the unpleasant effects of other "energy" drinks or coffee.  The pulp does offer a gritty texture but shaking the bottle periodically makes this less noticeable. I love this product and the pulp is a wonderfully unique part of the experience.  Wish my order was here already!!
I was tempted to put one star- because if everyone found out how GOOD this stuff is- It would always be out of stock and I would NEVER be able to get any more!!!!

I have purchased this numerous times at Wholefoods so I was very happy to find a cheaper deal here on Amazon. As I have had acai drinks before for therapeutic purposes, I found that this particular brand did not have the same cleansing effect that other acai drinks have. This leads me to suspect there isn't much acai juice in it. Well, at least it tastes alright. Please note that this juice has more sediment than your average American strained juice.

column9: Now too Expensive, and too much sugar.
column10: Ive been buying this for a few years through Subscribe and Save.  I checked my buying history and first paid $16.20.  Now its $35.00. Well Im done with this. Im also concerned with the amount of sugar in this product.  Too much sugar and too much money !

column9: Best Acai juice on the market - but no longer with guarana
column10: UPDATED 8/3/12I may be a little late to notice, but since the price hike of Zola's juices a few months ago they appear to have also removed the 24g of guarana they used to include in this original variety and in the pomegranate flavor. I stopped buying it because Amazon had such unreliable inventory of it for a while, so I bought a few in the store. I didn't read the ingredients until today. Reason being that yesterday I discovered that Zola has removed the peel-off seal from the bottles. I called them about that and they confirmed that this is the new packaging. Today I decided I might as well check if anything had changed (in the ingredients), and sure enough, I saw that the guarana is no longer listed. Why would we pay more for Zola than Sambazon when they actually take stuff out? I am looking for another acai juice with guarana but so far haven't found it. Bossa Nova also doesn't include it and WF doesn't have the only variety of Sambazon that I know has (or used to have, who knows anymore these days) guarana.ORIGINAL REVIEWLike someone else wrote, I used to buy this in a store until I got the bright idea to see if Amazon had it...just being facetious, but I already had other subscriptions running here so I could have known. Anyway, if you are completely new to acai I wouldn't know how it would taste so I can't help you there. To me it tastes very similar to blueberries, without the tartness. There is a bit of graininess in the end because it's all natural and I guess you do get to drink the pulp as well. Just shake it so that it mixes all together. Needs refrigeration once opened, then again, I drink the whole bottle right away, it's not that big. It's sealed and I have never had a quality issue.I find the uplifting effect that the guarana gives so much better than the caffeing jolt from regular coffee. Very similar to green tea I guess, though green tea's caffeine lasts a bit longer I think. Then again, green tea doesn't have the omega 3 and other good stuff that Zola puts into this bottle. A great drink, highly recommended!

Love Zola! It is delicious & really good for you. It's a much better deal to buy than Monavie, which is $35.00 a bottle.(And is a pyramid scam, by the way). With the Monavie, you only drink a couple of ounces a day. But Zola is a nice size and 93% pure acai pulp.It's great!

column9: New Item, not really. Big price increase though...
column10: Amazon used to sell the same product in box form for $21. They stopped selling and reintroduced in this current form but also sneaked in a $4 price increase...

Acai, an antioxidant with omega 3s, is delicious.  We tried the original flavor and the blueberry flavor - both excellent.  We mix with a little bit of orange juice.  The Zola product is 93% juice.  Look carefully if you purchase Acai elsewhere since some have only a trickle of acai. The price on Amazon is much better (less expensive) than anywhere else. Local groceries and "health food stores" charge 2X-4X. Acai puree is also am excellent value on Amazon.
Tastes great and is great for you. You really get the taste of the Acai in this drink since it's made from the pulp.

The one odd thing I noticed in reading these reviews is that everyone is treating this acai berry juice as just another beverage.  It is FAR more than that, and that should be your main motivation in drinking this juice.  I have drank acai berry  (the expensive brand and this brand) off and on for years.  The health benefits are MANY...weight loss, improved brain function, joint pain relief huge increase in energy and more...try it..you won't regret it!

I ordered these a bunch of times, and they're always great.  Except one time I ordered them from amazon, mid summer.  They smelled so bad I had to throw them out. extremely delicious peanut butter. the best i have ever had. I cant wait to try the almond butter flavors next. My favorite was the honey pretzel.

My family really likes these cookies.  They are so crunchy and good.  I love the fact that they are organic and taste good too.  They are a little dryer tasting than regular vanilla wafers.
These have a great flavor, stronger than some other brands and they are crispy without being too hard.
these are the best ginger snaps that we have ever tasted, we only eat organic, natural foods and rarely eat sweets but these are wonderful cookies and most of the ingrediants are ok.

column9: Used To Be Great, But No More!!
column10: These cookies used to be great, but alas, no more!!  I bought two cases (12 boxes) of the ones with an expiration date of "OCT 11 09 B" from Amazon recently. Of all the brands of shirataki, I prefer Matsuda.  I use the flat noodles, the thin, the bundled "dumpling" type, and the cubed.  Matsuda noodles are packed in a sealed tray, which is then sealed within another wrap. As a result, I think they are the freshes and the least "fishy" of the shirataki brands.The secret of enjoying these noodles is in the preparation.  While water comes to a boil, I open and rinse the noodles under cold running water; place the drained noodles along with some frozen vegetables in a Pyrex quart measure; the cover the noodles and vegetables with boiling water and let them sit while I prepare a protein.  I drain the noodles and vegetables and add them to the protein in a pot or skillet, season, and cook on low heat so the flavors come together.  The noodles, of course, simply absorb the flavors they are cooked with.  Any form of Matsuda noodles can be used the same way.  In cold weather I combine them with soup, etc.If you haven't tried this brand, and think you really don't like shirataki noodles, give Matsuda noodles a try.  I buy them 10 or more packages at a time and just keep them in the frig.  They are easy to use and really help with weight loss.

We used these as a spaghetti substitute, and they were not bad. Definitely worth considering if you want to feel full of carbs, without the carbs. The initial smell is not strong, and we have found many other uses for the noodles. Definitely worth trying if you are struggling with weight.

This packet makes excellent pulled pork. It calls for a 3lb boneless pork shoulder roast with most/all of the fat trimmed off, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/2 cup firmly packed brown sugar and 1/3 cup cider vinegar. Mix up the sauce, place your pork roast in your crockpot, pour sauce over, cover and that's it! You can cook your pork on high for 4 hours or low for 8 hours.If I'm going to be gone slightly longer than 8 hours then I take the pork roast out of the freezer the night before and the next morning put it in the crock only partially defrosted. This seems to help keep the pork more moist if its going to be cooking more than 8 hours on low. Because usually if I'm gone for work, I'm going to be gone at least 9 hours and sometimes as much as 10. If you're going to be cooking the 4 hours on high or 8 hours on low then I recommend that the roast be completely defrosted because you want it to cook thoroughly enough that it's "pull apart" done.I make this exactly as the recipe says except instead of regular brown sugar I used Splenda blend. I thought the ratio between meat and bbq was perfect using two pounds of meat rather than three. If you use 3lbs and you like your bbq pretty "saucey", I'd add a couple of tablespoons of water to the mix to make it stretch a bit further.If you decide to cook this on high, I recommend using 1-2 tablespoons of water to keep the bbq sauce from scorching because generally I cook this on the low setting for 8 hours and once I let it go almost to 9.5 hours because I was late getting home and the sauce got kind of coagulated. That was fixed by adding just a bit of water and it was still fine but it might scorch if you are cooking on high and leave it longer than the 4 hours the recipe calls for.This is a great summertime meal! I serve it with cole slaw or potato salad or macaroni salad and corn on the cob. It's fast and doesn't heat the house up and no hovering over a hot stove.One last thing, I HIGHLY recommend using a crockpot liner when cooking this. I ran out the last time I cooked this and ended up having to soak my crock overnight and still had to scrub a bit to get the baked on sauce off of it.

I am not one for using envelope seasonings, but based on the few reviews I tried it.  My family, too, loved it.  The package says four hours on high, though I really think five hours is more accurate.  On low all day while you're at work would be outstanding.  You can't go wrong here.  The flavor is wonderful.

Butterscotch is not my favorite flavor, because I associate it mainly with cheap candies. I was really hoping this matcha would be more like the fresh butterscotch syrup you put on ice cream sundaes, and I was right! The flavor is so smooth and perfectly butterscotch-y. And not at all like cheap candy. No, this is rich decadent creamy sweet gooey butterscotch. The matcha base keeps it from being too heavy and sickly-sweet, it's the perfect balance of health and decadence.

If you love butterscotch hard candies then this is the matcha for you! Its my new secret sinful delight! This is EXACTLY like those butterscotch hard candies from childhood!I think if I had to pick one matcha that I would never share with others this would have to be the one. Although there are so many I have yet to try I think so far this is my favorite. I just made myself laugh though because I have said that with almost every new matcha from Red Leaf Tea I have tried. Seriously though, this is so very yummy, and sweet, and just really the one that I feel will always hit the spot for me! What is even more cool is that when I mix it in my latte concoction - which is how I usually have my matcha, the butterscotch flavor comes out even more and is not by any means hidden underneath the milk or vanilla creamer!I always do try matcha straight before mixing it in my latte and I will say that the butterscotch flavor is stronger in the latte mixture than straight which I found interesting and odd at the same time.I don't know how Red Leaf does it but their flavors are all natural and while I certainly appreciate the health benefits to matcha I am finding I reach for it more and more simply for the flavor but I can't deny the excellent energy boost! Its like an energy drink without all the sugar which means you don't come down and fall on your face later in the day! This is a different kind of energy boost, one that makes you more alert and on the ball and it does not end abruptly finding yourself feeling lower than before you had the drink as energy drinks do. This trails off nicely and in a mellow fashion allowing you to ease into the afternoon or evening!I am now drinking at least one matcha per day, after my morning black tea!

Butterscotch is another one of those flavors that I adore. Butterscotch anything is pretty much a guarantee I buy it. I love the rich buttery-ness of it. In my drinking days, butterscotch schnapps was my go-to drink. I love it. Mix it with a bit of milk or hot cocoa...oh yes. The best, though, is around the holidays, mix a touch of it into egg nog. Ooooh, now that's an idea, egg nog matcha. Red Leaf Tea, I will love you forever if you develop an egg nog matcha by the holidays! I can't have real nog any more, so I've been hunting for a good tea substitute.Anyway, yes. Butterscotch is love for me. It's another Dad memory, he loves it and it makes me think of him...or maybe I'm just homesick this week. Butterscotch pudding is the only pudding I'll touch and if an ice cream shop offers butterscotch topping, I'll risk the dairy allergy to get a cone covered in the stuff. Liquid gold, it is. And seeing the success of Red leaf Tea's Caramel and French Vanilla flavors, I have complete confidence in this blend being amazing. I want to sip on this all day, but I need to save some for when it's cool enough to be able to handle a hot drink. It does taste like candy, but it's not overwhemingly sweet. It's just tasty. column9: This is NOT the tea as described on amazon.com!
column10: The description of this product in amazon.com is "Aged for 5 years deep in the mountain caves of Yunnan, China". The tea which we received has a paper sticker which says "Goldden Pu-erh Aged 5 Years Loose Leaf Tea" on a plastic pouch labeled "English Tea Store" which has extremely small and nearly illegible note in the back which says "Our tea is crafted by masters blenders using the finest tea from India, China, Sri Lanka (Ceylon) and Kenya." If this description applies to tea in this bag, then more tea in this bag comes from India than from China (and China is a very large place, while Yunnan is a province in southwestern China), and possibly from Sri Lanka and Kenya, Africa. There is no certification of where this tea came from, and whether it is what its sticker claims "Pu-erh Tea" and whether and how much of this tea came from "the mountain caves of Yunnan, China". I opened the bag to sniff and taste the tea, but this says nothing about the autheticity of its advertized claim on amazon.com. I am doubtful whether this product is in fact "Pu-erh Tea" from Yunnan, China, and am therefore returning the tea pouch to the vendor, with a request to amazon.com to refund me the purchase price. I am going to buy Pu-erh tea from a Chinese herbal medicine dealer instead.

column9: Mix is fine; challenge is the prep and the frying
column10: After several dismal failures using a pot on the stove, I finally had great success after firing up the big turkey fryer kettle/propane burner in the driveway, using about 8 inches of peanut oil.  Taking advice of others - refrigerate the dough for several hours, and then make sure you roll out the dough to EXACTLY 1/8th inch thickness like the instructions say, about the same as a piece of corrugated cardboard - no thinner (don't puff up and turn out like cookies) and no thicker (too heavy, flat and thick - like they serve at the Cafe Beignet and some other places).  I started test frying them at 320-340 degrees, but finally got the best result at higher temperature of 380-400.  First time I've ever had them puff up perfectly like at Cafe du Monde, light and fluffy like little pillows with one inch vertical rise.  Good luck.

column9: World-Famous New Orleans Donut squares you can make at home!
column10: Anyone who has ever visited New Orleans will most likely have a tale to tell of a late-night or early morning visit to the world-famous Cafe Du Monde (cafe of the world) for a snack of Beignets and Chicory coffee.This simple little square fritter with powdered sugar is often imitated but somehow never quite the same as the cafe Du Monde version.  The authetic mix guarantees you that Cafe Du Monde taste and they are relatively easy to fry up at home for a weekend morning treat.  Traditonally fried in Cottonseed oil, most home-cooks opt for a healthier, lighter oil but anyway you fry them, these are not exactly health food!Essentially, Beignets are fried dough covered with generous amounts of powedered sugar.  Traditionally served by themselves on a plate a of three with cups of Chicory coffee, you can, if you want, get adventurous and fill them with fruit (cherry works best) compote or sweet cream cheese for variety. You can also set a few sugared blueberries and a sprig of mint in the middle of a plate of three beignets for a classic presentation. They are so scrumptious that you needen't really offer anything else but some folks like to include Beignets as part of a larger brunch menu.  Me, I prefer just the Beignets with their traditional beverage, for a mid-morning light brunch.  These are best if fried up in large batches for a group since frying anything in small amounts seems like too much effort for too little outcome, but one box at a time is okay too.While there are plenty of beignet recipes out there, this mix is super-easy and carries the Cafe Du Monde name. They turn out well and taste very much like the real thing.  It is worth the effort to make sure you also serve up some Chicory Coffee as well since it is the pairing of the two that evokes the strong memory of nights in New Orleans.  The strong taste of the Chicory compliments the simplicity of the beignets beautifully.

column9: Chalky chocolate, this is the New Hampshire version of Lindt 70% "Smooth Dark" rather than the "Extra Fine" or "Intense Dark"
column10: If you are hoping for the foreign (Swiss or French) version of this product do not buy this, as it seems only certain sites off Amazon even stock it (I have found no seller on Amazon so far that does). Last fall Lindt reformulated their wonderfully balanced 70% recipe which was identical to the original Swiss formulation produced in both Switzerland and France. Nothing has changed despite the slew of negative reviews, the new bar is still chalky, bland, and terrible, cardboardy as most brands that cater to mass appeal (Hershey's, Dove, etc). True chocolate enthusiasts have to be content with either sending for ones outside the United States or switching to another brand. Lindt posted an excuse on their site that they reformulated the 70% recipe (under their FAQ, likely due to the high volume of complaints) due to more favorable responses to this "new recipe". Exactly how I always pictured Bertie Bott's beans would be. I have the generation before these and they've been spot on since movie 1 (GOD, the HORSERADISH flavor was AWFUL. UGH.). These beans are a wonderful thing. The good flavors, you can eat, and they are totally fantastic. The terrible flavors, you can belittle the manhood of your friends with. The in-between flavors? Like grass? They're largely there to confuse you, and do so wonderfully.To sum up my experience with them, an anecdote:Driving along one summer, eating said beans, my two friends convince me to eat the Booger flavoured one. "Okay," I begin "but only if you get a good flavored one ready to get the taste out of my mouth."My first friend passes me the booger-bean, and gets a grape-bean ready on deck. The booger bean was mostly flavourless... until the saliva hit my tongue! Retching, I spat out the window, and demanded the grape bean. Blargh! The dark colour tricked them! It was dirt! Spitting again, I demanded another bean. They produced another dark coloured one, this one seeming noticeably more purple in the light. Noooo! It was more dirt!Pulling over, and spitting out the bean, they presented me with a white one. "Alright," they said "This can only be popcorn, or marshmallow."Seeing no bad option, I took the bean and chewed it gratefully. Then I vomited in my mouth.It was neither popcorn, nor marshmallow. It was rotten egg!Suffice to say, that these are not the kind of jelly bean you buy, thinking that every one of them will be wonderful. The rotten egg, dirt, soap, and vomit beans all taste exactly what they are supposed to. And that is what makes them a fantastic product.

My grandma was an amazing cook. She passed on many of her secrets, and this was one of them. Not only do we use this this as a versatile salad dressing (mix it with different citrus juices or vinegars and oils for a variety of great flavors) but we add it to spaghetti sauce, coat chicken with it before baking, mix it in with rice, add it to bread dough, and more. column9: Real vanilla bean flavor with the convenience of vanilla extract.
column10: I LOVE this stuff! It is so handy and goes a long way. It has a syrupy consistency and is packed with vanilla bean caviar. This gives your food that extra special gourmet taste.
