So I found that I enjoy my shakes with the ON more, and it's faster and easier to mix my oatmeal in the morning with the ON.Please don't get me wrong -- this is a great product. But I just don't think it warrants a higher price than the Optimum Nutrition protein.So, to recap, as compared to Optimum Nutrition 100% Egg Protein, Rich Chocolate, 2 Pound:Pros:Lower in carbsLower in fatCons:More expensiveClumpier/harder to mix

column9: A Protein Powder to make you Gag.
column10: I have tried many different protein powders over the years, and while it is hard to write a review based on taste alone (since everyone's taste is different), I'm going to go ahead and say this is the most rancid tasting gunk I have ever had the displeasure of putting in my mouth.I mix my protein shakes with a hand blender, so I rarely have any mixing problems - and even this protein mixed well.  The fun really began when I tasted it.  It tastes sour and acrid at the same time, absolutely horrendous.  I could not finish the shake I had mixed up, and had to wash my mouth out with apple juice to get that sick taste out before I could actually eat or drink anything else.This is a terrible protein powder from the standpoint of taste, in my opinion.  Of all the types I have tried, which is many, this has taken seat as the new "worst" one.FYI, I had ordered this with another brand because I am testing egg protein powders due to casein sensitivity.  If anyone has an egg protein powder recommendation, PM me.

I've tried a number of protein powders over the years.  Most problems I encountered ranged from poor taste, to not mixing well, to leaving me bloated.  The Healthy n Fit egg protein is only 100 calories and you get 24 grams of protein with no cholesterol, no fat, no carbs, minimal sodium (in the big scheme of things) and even some potassium.  Add to that the fact that it mixes really well and tastes good either on it's own or mixed with fruit.  I don't feel bloated with this at all like I did with other products like Muscle Milk light.  I usually throw a banana and some blueberries into a blender with one serving of the protein for breakfast and then I use it straight right after a good workout.  Again, it tastes great on it's own or mixed with fruit.  I strongly recommend this product.

Having a lactose intolerance, I've tried multiple egg proteins as well as some Whey Isolate proteins as well. This is hands down the best tasting protein powder out there. Vanilla and Chocolate are both delicious (I would stay away from Strawberry, it has a strange artificial taste to it, this was the updated formula too so they still haven't worked it out). I prefer to mix with some Vanilla Coconut milk and it's actually something I look forward to drinking (as opposed to some that I had just choked down as quickly as I could). I have also mixed in a teaspoon of cinnamon with just water and the vanilla protein and it is good as well.Another plus is that it uses stevia instead of artificial sweeteners such as sucralose or aspartame.If you can't handle Whey/Casein protein then I would absolutely recommend this one (even if you can but want to try something else). Best bang for your buck compared to other egg proteins and the taste is actually good.

column9: TASTE ACTUALLY GOOD LOL, IM SHCOKED
column10: I like this product, and i agree with any post, who says it mixes well, i bought a sample case just to test the waters, and i dont feel bloated or anything after i drink it, i think i feel my body is responding to it very well, i am going to finish up the muscle milk protein because i bought it and i pay over 30 for it, lol, but when i finish up the other proteins i purchase, i am going to stick with egg white protein, since i dont like eating them, everyone taste buds is different, some may like it, some may dont, then depending on your body chemistry some responds well to egg whites, some dont, but as for me personally i like it so far, might try out the strawberry passion protein, but the vanilla kind taste very good, i would suggest this protein should be used for edurance athletes, or people who are into calistenics such as push ups and pull ups,

This egg protein is great!First off, it is sweetened with Stevia, a natural herb, and not some artificial sweetener like aspartame or sucralose.Next, it is very easy on the stomach, even whey without lactose is a lot harder on my digestion system it seems.It tastes good, mixes well, and is a good value.I bought all 3 flavors and found I prefer the vanilla.Goes really well with some almond milk and blueberries.I'm glad I've found a pure protein source that is dairy and soy free.
I loved vitalabs egg protein, but I think their out of business.  This healthy n fit will substitute just fine,

I BOUGHT THIS PRODUCT TO TRY AS A REPLACEMENT FOR JAY ROBB EGG WHITE PROTEIN SHAKES, WHICH IS WHAT I PREFER BUT DOESN'T FIT MY BUDGET - TO EXPENSIVE FOR EVERY DAY USE.  I WAS LOOKING FOR AN ALTERNATIVE AND CAME ACROSS THIS.  SINCE ONE OF THE REVIEWS SAID THAT IT WAS SOY FREE I DECIDED TO TRY IT.  I DON'T HAVE ANY PROBLEM WITH THE TASTE WITH ALL OF MY HEALTH PROBLEMS OVER THE YEARS I HAVE LEARNED NOT TO EXPECT A LOT IN THAT DEPARTMENT.  IT JUST TASTE LIKE WATERED DOWN CHOCOLATE TO ME.  I DRINK IT WITH WATER OR SOMETIMES WITH RICE MILK BECAUSE I NEED THE EXTRA CALORIES ON DAYS THAT I CAN'T HANDLE SOLID FOODS.  HOWEVER,ON RECEIVING THE PRODUCT, IT DOES CONTAIN SOY. HOW MUCH I COULDN'T SAY AS IT WASN'T LISTED ON THE INGREDIGENT COLUMN.  I FOUND IT MENTIONED ON THE BACK OF THE LABEL STATING THAT IT CONTAINED SOY LETICHEN(THINK I SPELLED THAT RIGHT).  I HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO FIND OUT HOW MUCH.  IF SOMEONE COULD SHED SOME LIGHT ON THAT I WOULD APPRECIATE THE INFO. ALSO,I NOTICED THAT IT HAS GONE UP ABOUT $10.00 SINCE I PLACED MY ORDER LAST MONTH,SO IT MAY NOT BE AN ISSUE ANYMORE, BECAUSE THAT PUTS IT ABOUT EVEN WITH WHAT I WAS PAYING FOR THE JAY ROBB EGG WHITE SHAKES.
Excellent Product. Great taste and easy to sue in cereal, yougur etc..  That's it in a nutshell.  Very Timely delivery.
Although it is very high in protein, I thought the vanilla ice cream flavor was very bland. I would not buy this again as it was not tasty enough.

Well I have tried many protein shakes and the taste is never been a problem for me but this was just horrible. It's GOOD for YOU but I just couldn't do it. It might be a good protein shake but it's extremely salty, i tried to drink it with other liquids to help the taste but every time it tasted worse and worse =( too bad because I was looking forwards to see some results!!

So after comparing this to Jay Robb, I can say that this protein is not as good. The taste isn't as good, and it doesn't mix that easy. I don't think it is horrible, just not that good.One thing I like about the Jay Robb is that they use hormone free chicken eggs. I sent Healty N' Fit an email asking where they get their eggs from, but they didn't reply. It is a little cheaper, but I found the Jay Robb at Vitamin Shoppe for 20 per 12ozs, which isn't bad. I have to say that I don't like the dudes picture on the bottle, but that's my only complaint.
The protein powder is ok, not to good as i expected. if you pour hot milk over it will will form substance like egg white, which is very bad in taste, not at all drinkable.

column9: Not too sweet, not too salty
column10: Amazon's vine program regularly offers me this type of vaguely healthy, vaguely sugary snacks.  Sometimes I accept.  Usually, I am disappointed.  These things, though, are actually pretty good.  They are described as dark chocolate, nuts, and sea salt.  That's pretty much what you taste.  The strongest flavor components are the nuts, which are very lightly salted with sea salt.  So, you taste the nuts, not the salt.  On top of that, they use dark chocolate, but in relatively small quantities so that the nuts remain the primary flavor component.  The fact that they use dark chocolate keeps the bars from being too sweet, and the light amount of sea salt is just enough for the nuts without overpowering anything.  I hate healthy snacks that try to mimic candy bars.  Such attempts generally use poor quality chocolate in large quantities, and usually wind up with about as many calories per gram as normal candy bars anyway.  These bars, though, just taste like what they are.  If you want a snickers bar with fewer calories, you are out of luck.  However, if you like nuts that are very lightly salted, dark chocolate, and don't want something as sweet as a candy bar, these are actually pretty good.

Delicious free sample arrived with another order I placed on Amazon. I got the dark chocolate sea salt. At first I cringed at the idea of sea salt and chocolate...but it's wonderful and complimentary. I did not expect the pronouncement of the sea salt flavor to be as bold as it was, and to go so well with the dark semi-sweet goodness of the chocolate laced nut variety. I will be ordering these in bulk. Been on a gluten free kick lately after reading up on the horrors of gluten on blood sugar. You'll have to do your own research, but it's shocking, thinking you've been eating healthy wheat, only to realize that for some wheat can be the cause to many progressing health problems. Again, subjective information. Do your own reading. But these are not modified, are gluten free, and I can pronounce and understand everything on the label. Nothing hydrolized or masked.

I ordered 3 flavors of the Kind bars and these are hands down my favorite. I met with a nutritionist who suggested these bars as one of the healthiest (even over my Luna bars which had become my afternoon staple snack) . I LOVE the simple ingredients and fresh taste of these bars! The sweet & salty combination is a winner for a healthy pick me up (usually at 3 in the afternoon!) - They do not "travel" well though, and I have been putting them in an old sunglasses case so they don't get smooshed.  I have a bowl of them on my desk at work for a no-brainer snack instead of a candy bar. Yum!

I pick up an evening meal at my nearby Fresh and Easy store quite often, especially during the summer. this evening it was a delicious salad. Plus, they had Kind Nuts and Spices bars on sale. They make good deserts. They're very low in sugar and have a good fiber and protein content,  not exactly your typical desert. Tonight I chose a Dark Chocolate, Nuts and Sea Salt bar. It was very good. Excellent!Gary Peterson
Yummy new flavor doesn't disappoint!  The sea salt and dark chocolate compliment each other.Another favorite from Kind.I'll be ordering again.

These bars are the best ever, delicious beyond compare. I will always buy these yummy bars,they are the best! The nuts were fresh, crunchy and delectable. This is an elegant cinnamon nutty bar with indulgent dark chocolate. Also this bar has fiber 7g, protein 5gm and only 5gm of sugar. The fat content is a little high at 16gm. You will swear this is a sugary treat and not a healthy satisfying bar. Have them with a glass of no fat milk or chobani yogurt and you will feel full for hours. And they are only 5 points on the weight watcher point system.
These are simply delicious and satisfying.  So much healthier than reaching for a candy bar or some other snack with no nutrients and loaded with sugar & calories.

column9: Incredible taste, no HFC, feel good energy snack
column10: This is pretty much my holy grail; a tasty treat, packaged to go, but I don't worry about the ingredients.

These are both healthy and delicious, this is a tough combination to find. I've tried their other bars and they are good but nothing like this one. FYI, I've added this to my subscribe and save for a monthly delivery...
I enjoy Kind bars, and was pleased to find one with chocolate that's low glycemic - these are quite good and satisfy that need for chocolate. They were shipped and received promptly.

Whoa! This KIND Madagascar Vanilla Almond bar is so good! You can taste the natural goodness in it and it's nice to know that there's no added junk in it. The vanilla is subtle and comforting. This is what wholesome snacking should be. Perfect as an on-the-go snack, small enough to keep in a purse or pocket and with just 210 calories (the good kind of calories, not the kind you get from a bag of Dorito's) it isn't going to throw you off track. I'm glad I had the chance to try these, I've been looking at them for months at the grocery store. I'm an instant fan and can't wait to try their other flavor combinations.

Disclosure:  I'm a big fan of KIND bars.  Every flavor I try has been consistently delicious, and made from high quality natural ingredients to boot.Full disclosure: Madagascar Vanilla Almond, while still quite good, is probably my least favorite kind of KIND.  A mix of nuts, crisp rice, with hints of chicory and vanilla, this flavor tasted like eating high quality mixed nuts to me, plus the vanilla flavor.  Delicious if that's your thing, but I find that prefer the KIND bars with fruit, chocolate, or both to mix things up.Highly recommended if you want to stick to nuts, but if not, I would start with another flavor.

I haven't heard of these bars before so this was a first for me.  They are delicious! With so many snacks out there, it is difficult to find just the right combination that satisfies your craving without overdoing it.  I normally just grab a small handful of nuts and go, this bar makes it so much easier and it's so good.  I buy Madagascar vanilla beans so I knew I'd like the flavor, I was right.They are 210 calories so it is not very low cal, but it is still a good snack if you keep yourself active.  I tried one as a lunch replacement yesterday and found it satisfying for the moment, but I was very hungry when the next meal came around that I think I overdid it - won't do that again!Very good, very tasty, not too sticky, I'm planning on buying some more.

column9: Review: KIND Nuts and Spices: Madagascar Vanilla no less!
column10: In the interest of full disclosure...I'm not a huge nut fan.  Usually, I will skip brownies, cakes and other items that have nuts in them.  I'm willing to eat them by themselves but I find they kind of ruin other thing people stick them into.  Further, I'm trying to lose weight and usually nuts can be a good way to go.The KIND Nuts and Spices nut bars are part of the KIND Healthy Snacks line.  They are very upfront about pointing out the use of only 5 grams of sugar (or less) and nothing artificial.  further internet research shows that they keep the sugar levels low by using spices.  In this case, its Madagascar vanilla.The bars are very tasty, not too heavy and rather filling for what volume they take up.  They are a little sticky (the plastic wrap they come is is surprisingly strong) and the bars themselves really do taste well for the amount of sugar.I will point out that the bars I had boasted 16g of fat, 14 g of carbs, 5 g dietary fiber and 7 grams of protein.  From Weight Watchers standpoint, that's 6 points.  Having said that, I could see one of these bars being a decent substitute for a meal so from that standpoint, its cheap points wise.All in all, the bar is pretty good...I'm glad I got them and I will buy more!

column9: KIND Bars...delicious way to satisfy hunger
column10: I am so happy that I got the chance to try KIND Nuts and Spices - Madagascar Vanilla Almond Bars.  I The bars are not only gluten free, they're low on the glycemic index (meaning they don't significantly impact blood sugar). They're sweetened with a mixture of honey and non-GMO glucose. And they have whole nuts -- almonds, peanuts, cashews and walnuts. It's a delicious way to curb hunger and not feel guilty after snacking.Although KIND is a great-tasting product, it has a few flaws. KIND contains a chicory root.  If you're not only gluten intolerant, but are also allergic to chicory root, then should consider whether or not you'd like to buy these. Additionally, for those on the SCD or GAPS diets, the bars also contain rice(a starch), glucose and soy lecithin -- which is considered "illegal".  It also contains peanuts.These bars taste wonderful and are an excellent, quick snack. I wish the manufacturers would create a line where the glucose, soy, rice and chicory root were eliminated. I know, however, that probably won't happen any time soon.I still recommend these bars. I would actually purchase them in the future.

This is a very good flavor.  Not the best I've had out of the kind bars,  but that's because I like this brand so much I try every flavor and have come to find out what my favorites are.  There's no reason to be disappointed with this.  There's a yummy layer of chocolate coated across the bottom of this bar,  and then a bunch of nuts in a caramel like coating that I don't think is caramel,  Also looks like it has some of those rice pops you would find in the nestle crunchy chocolate bar? Not sure what thos are but they are mixed in with the nuts.  Hope this helps.  They really are yummy!

Kind bars are one of my favorite new snacks. They are healthy and give a nice little energy boost, but most of all, they taste great. I have had the fruit & nut, the peanut butter chocolate, and the dark chocolate, nuts, & sea salt; Kind bars. The dark chocolate, nuts, and sea salt flavor are my favorite.These are the perfect blend of roasted nuts and dark chocolate, along with cocoa powder, sugar, oil, crisp rice, and vanilla, all rolled up with a hint of sea salt. There is nothing that brings out the taste of the chocolate and the nuts like a hint of sea salt. This may not be a completely low calorie sugar free snack, but it is a delicious tasting snack that is still fairly healthy.Kind bars are becoming really popular and with flavors that taste like this one, I can see why. These make great snack bars and really hit the spot when you are looking for something to tide you over until meal time.

When I first opened up the box, my heart leapt at the idea of nut bars that looked like my favorite Payday bars.  Could something healthy for you taste like something that is bad for you?OK, maybe my eyes jumped to an unrealistic conclusion, but come on now, there is always hope.Not to say that there is no sweetness, there is a little, just enough to feel that you are having a treat.  I really do not taste a specific type of vanilla so calling it Madagascar Vanilla is a bit of over marketing, but that is ok.  You do have to love nuts since there seems to be one of every type in it.  The syrupy stickiness that holds them together has a bit of a grainy taste, but it is not offensive and as for spices, nothing stands out as remarkable.Seven grams of protein is not enough for a meal replacement, but is perfect for an in between snack or a holdover if you will not be getting to lunch or dinner for a while.They are surprisingly good and I recommend that you keep a couple either in your purse or desk draw.

I'm a big fan of trail mix, so I expected to like this product. Nuts, chocolate, salt, sounds good to me. But the salt was overwhelming, and it was just kind of stuck together with this foul-tasting glop - also heavily salted, and almost bitter at the same time. I shudder to think what it was made of. I'm glad I got it as a free sample, because I definitely wouldn't have paid the $2 it normally costs.
I FOUND THE KIND BAR EXCELLENT.  ATE 1/2 BAR @ A TIME.  WAS LIKE A DELICIOUS BROWNIE.  THIS WAS A FREE SAMPLE BUT I WILL BUY THE BAR IN THE FUTURE & HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT.

If you're looking for a way to help your teenagers eat healthier, these Kind bars are great. Our teenage boys eat them as a preferred snack, and get useful helpings of fruit, nuts and antioxidants in the process. While sweet and yummy, these bars are not extremely high in sugar like regular candy bars, and have more nutrition than many other purchased snacks. And the best part is, my husband and I like them, too.The dark chocolate nut and sea salt flavor has become my new personal favorite. I can get a chocolate fix without eating too much chocolate, a nice full feeling from the nuts, and a touch of salt taste to add a kick to it. If they could find a way for the chocolate and nuts to be low in calories, it would be the perfect snack.

I like these bars. They contain some nuts, lightly coated in dark chocolate. They are a bit harder than many other bars to bite into because of the whole nuts used; this is not like a Quaker Chewy bar by any means. The ingredient list is relatively short, so it's easy to comprehend what's actually in these things, and the low sugar content makes them seem almost healthy.The one point I have against them is their price. $1.67 for a relatively small (40 gram) bar, purchased in bulk seems like a bit too much. That's a rate of nearIy $20/pound. I would probably not purchase them at that price. Bring it down to about $1.00 each and I might consider it.

Kind Nuts & Spices Dark Chocolatye Nuts & sea Salt bars are a tasty snack but labeling them "dark" chocolate is misleadingThey are basically a bar of Walnuts, almonds, peanuts, and rice krispies glued together with honey and chocolateWhile tasty, the main problem is the chocolate. I really wouldn't call it "dark". It certainly did not taste like dark chocolateOtherwise, it's pretty good. Low sodium, low sugar, no sugar alcohols or artifical sweeteners, gluten and transfat free.I'd say other than the chocolate not being that dark, these bars are one tasty snack

I rarely give 5 stars for any review, but this snack is really good. I love nuts and I'm trying to cut down on sugar. This bar is perfect for that.And it really tastes pretty good. I wouldn't have guessed that it had so little sugar (less than 5g).The only slight surprise is the 210 calories - a little on the high side. But still I highly recommend trying this out.

Although these are expensive, you will be able to tell immediately that it is a quality product. The nuts are plentiful and large, and the dark chocolate doesn't taste cheap. These bars are ideal for my mid-morning snack before I work out. They give me energy and only have 200 calories.It is not, however, the kind of bar I can carry with me, at least in the summer months. The bar melts easily, and I can see it turning into a real mess. Other than that, I can highly recommend this to people who want a tasty treat with not a lot of calories.

These are very nutty bars with a nice dose of chocolate as well.  Also, for being low in sodium, they have a salty kick to them as well from the sea salt.  It's nice that they're made of pretty healthy ingredients, though they're not big enough to be more than a snack or a nice treat if you're craving something sweet/salty.

The combination of dark chocolate, nuts, & sea salt make for an addicting combination. I've already made it through two bars since it arrived in the mail earlier today. I also love the fact that it is made with quality ingredients, so even though it approaches dessert like status, it is more healthily than a candy bar and tastes better than many granola bars, as much as I love granola bars. The salt, chocolate and texture reminds me of Ben & Jerry's Chubby Hubby minus the ice cream of course,

For me this is the perfect snack to tide me over.Working in perfect harmony, none overpowering the other, combination of salty, sweet, crunchy and chewy.If I did have to lessen any of those attributes it would be the salty one.  This Kind Nuts & Spices, Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt, the chocolate part is not too sweet.If I could increase one part of this bar it would be the dark chocolate, but really, this bar is just about perfect the way it is.It's also refreshing to know what you are eating, to see what you are eating, without having to read an ingredient list.I love that the nuts are left in whole pieces, not chopped up.This is a great satisfying snack!  It's like the perfect candy bar, but healthy!

What I really like about Madagascar Vanilla Almond bars is that the nuts are not super hard. I can even give small pieces to my toddler, makes it easier to chew for him.Taste is great and it makes good snack on the go. Contains mainly almonds, peanuts, cashews and walnuts.

There are so many trail mix bars out in the market so how does KIND nuts & spices, Madagascar Vanilla Almond compete?  Well, while the taste is different, the main thing is the health factor.  Made from almonds, walnuts, crisp rice and held together with honey, this bar boasts only 4 grams of sugar.  But, the fact that it has 210 calories, 140 from fat is a bit alarming.  However, the fat is from the nuts.  Nuts are high in fat, but these are good fats.Overall, I would say these are good alternative to those nugget, chocolate, full of wasted calories and fat bars.  I recommend these as a quick snack for on the go.

This bar is nothing but nuts held together with a really nice substance that is sticky enough to hold the nuts together, but is not hard to chew at all and does not get stuck in your teeth.  I honestly didn't taste much vanilla or much of any kind of spices, but it definitely has an all natural taste.  We're especially glad to find a bar with such a low level of sugar.  The calories are a little high for this small of a bar (approx 1 1/2" by 5" and they are 210 calories per bar) and I'm not someone who can just stop after eating one of something I like, so that could be a problem.  But, if you have enough self control to just eat one, this would be a really healthy and satisfying snack to have.

column9: Not too sweet, not too salty, plenty of nuts & a great crunch; very satisfying!
column10: Over the last 10+ years I couldn't even begin to count the number of bars I have purchased and tried. Many have ended up in the trash without hesitation because of being too sugary sweet, packed with fillers, unappealing textures or flavors that taste off or artificial.  When I received the Kind bar (Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt) I immediately looked at the ingredients, saw only 12 and thankfully they were all ones I recognized and could pronounce. I also appreciated that they were low sodium, lower in sugar than most bars, plus they had a decent amount of fiber and protein. Of course the most important part was going to be taste and these didn't disappoint! I love anything that combines sweet and salty in the right amounts and this was perfect for my taste. The crunch and amount of the almonds was also really good at extending my chewing, which in turn helps me feel a bit more satisfied because I take longer in eating it instead of just scarfing it down.  Overall I have no complaints about the Kind bar and I look forward to trying out some of the other flavors, even if I think I've found perfection in this one.

column9: Nice combo of chocolate, nuts and sea salt
column10: This KIND Nuts & Spices Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt bar manages to blend three favorite ingredients (chocolate, nuts, salt) into a rather healthy bar (compared to mass market candy bars and sugary energy/nutrition bars). The dark chocolate is distinct, taking over the bottom side of the bar. Thanks to the sea salt, despite having just 5% RDA sodium, you get a decided salty taste out of this. There are three kinds of nuts in this, almonds, peanuts, and walnuts.It has a mild crunch to it but I did not feel that my fillings were at risk of crumbling under pressure.Because of the chocolate and such, your hands will get a little sticky, so keep that in mind if you are planning to eat one of these before an interview or if you are going to be far away from a place to wash.One bar has 200 calories (140 from fat) and weighs 40 grams. It has 15g total fat (3.5g saturated, 0g trans fat), 0% cholesterol, 16g carbs (7g dietary fiber, 5g sugars), 6g protein, 125mg (5% RDA) sodium (thank you sea salt), 210mg potassium, and various other minerals and vitamins.

Wow, I've gotta admit: I thought these KIND Madagascar Vanilla Almond bars were just gonna be some regular ol' bars when I ordered them from Vine. Boy, was I wrong. These aren't a bunch of ingredients blended together and they aren't held together by some outer opaque coating. Instead, the ingredients are all right there for you to see while you're eating each bar. There are only 10 ingredients in these things, including almonds, peanuts, cashews, walnuts, honey, non GMO glucose, chicory root fiber, crisp rice, Madagascar vanilla, and soy lecithin. Notice anything about those ingredients? That's right, they're all PRONOUNCEABLE and stuff you've actually heard of! That means you can feel good about what's in these because you aren't putting a bunch of chemicals or fillers in your body. And you know what else? The nutrition facts are pretty great as well! Only 210 Calories per bar (just slightly high), 16 grams fat (I'm assuming this is due to the nuts because there are only 2 grams of saturated fat), only 14 grams of carbohydrates, 5 grams of fiber, 7 grams of protein, and last but not at all least only 4 grams of sugar. Yeah, in a time when pretty much everything we eat is packed with sugar, each of these bars only has 4 grams of it! They've also got various percentages of a bunch of different vitamins and minerals. And on top of everything, these are really tasty. This is one of the few food items I've tried from Vine that I do plan to purchase more of when I run out.If you want a food bar that has decent protein and fiber and isn't loaded with sugar AND only has ingredients you've heard of, I wholeheartedly recommend the KIND Madagascar Vanilla Almond bars!
I thought it was coming free but it was sent in a oversized box which cost me 5 bucks at the ups store. The bar tasted good
This bar had an excellent taste and consistency - especially for something healthy. I plan to order several the next time I order coffee!!

The free sample of the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt Bar was just ok.  I was hoping for more of a contrast between the sweet chocolate and the salty nut taste, but I got more of a nutty and less chocolate taste.  Plus, it was very hard to chew - kind of like the hard, brittle consistency of peanut-brittle, which made me worry about chipping a tooth.
I loved this bar got the free sample and immediately realized I was going to need to buy a box.  It is a wonderful way to start the day.

column9: kind dark choco nuts w sea salt
column10: I recieved a Kind choco sample with my Amazon order. I could tell it was "healthier" than normal, because it was not very sweet or chocolatey. However, after getting past the expectation of a rich chocolate experience, and accepting that it was more like a trail mix bar, it was better. By the end of the bar, I had enjoyed it. Just don't think you're going to have a chocolate experience with this bar, and it will be good.

column9: Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar
column10: I would like the word "nuts" defined, telling me there were almonds in the bar.  I try to limit my intake of almonds, and would much prefer other nuts.  Other than that, it would have been great!
The bar was a little too salty for my taste and a little hard to chew. Other bars I have tried from Kind are much better, so this was a little disappointing!
I liked Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt so much that I bought a box of them! I also tried a couple other Kind bars but the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt is my favorite so far.

column9: Want to feel good about what you're eating and ENJOY it?
column10: I love this snack bar.  I'm not even sure what to call it.  Candy Bar?  Snack Bar? It is my go-to snack when I want something sweet.  It is so much better than a candy bar.  The flavors are so good and of high quality, and you feel good about what you're eating.  I love it for what it has...the healthy nuts and dark chocolate...and for what it doesn't have...the artificial junk and high fructose corn syrup.  This is the best, good for you snack I've found.  Highly recommend it.

column9: Long-lasting energy, real vanilla beans - yummm
column10: Kind Bars are a wonderful snack for those who are interested in protein and longer-lasting energy.  I love Kind bars, because I don't get a carb energy drop after eating one, thanks to the low sugar & high protein/fiber content.  When I know it's going to be a long afternoon, I grab a Kind bar.The Madagascar Vanilla Almond has a very good vanilla flavor without being heavily sweet, thanks to having only 4 grams of sugar.  You can see all the little black vanilla beans in the bar!  This means they used real vanilla (as stated in the ingredients), and no artificial flavorings.Lots of satisfying crunching & chewing means I feel like I had a snack of substance.  Kind bars definitely fit this criteria.  There's also some crisp rice mixed in for extra texture.  There are a few too many peanuts and cashews in this variety for my tastes, would have preferred more almonds, but it's not a turn-off.The calorie count is a bit higher than I'd usually go for in a snack - 210 calories per bar - thanks to being mostly all nuts.  But it's still worth it to me, for the benefits of the protein.My favorite flavor is still the Kind Apple Cinnamon & Pecan variety, which I have on Subscribe & Save, but this Madagascar Vanilla Almond is a great runner up choice.Granola bars are overdone, mostly carbs, and just plain not so great for you (depending on the brand).  If you want a better snack, stock up on Kind Bars.

column9: Not the best when in hot environment but still tasty
column10: I received the package of KIND Nuts & Spices, Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt, 12-Count Bars in the early evening, so it had been sitting in the shipper's truck all day in the heat.  Unfortunately, when I opened the package, each bar was soft because the chocolate was melted and sticking to the wrapper.  Regardless, when brought back to a temperature closer to the 80 degree range, I eagerly tore open a cellophane package and carefully peeled it back to try my first KIND bar.  With the first bite, I was impressed by the great flavor of fresh nuts and simple dark chocolate, even after exposed to the environmental heat.  On the second bite, I was hit with the sea salt, making me think about how smart it is to add sea salt instead of using salted nuts which I sometimes do when making chocolate covered nuts.  That creates an inconsistent salt burst which I find appealing.  At the small size of 1.4 ounces, it's loaded with fiber from the nuts and chicory root fiber, with relatively little sugars.  I personally would seldom consider eating one of these as a meal, but would have it as a filling food when needed in times where a meal could not be obtained.  I would supplement this and would not rely on this alone for nutrition!  Without further information on what else is included in the diet, I don't understand how the "Yale-Griffin Prevention Research Center indicates that eating 2 KIND bars each day helps maintain your weight through low glycemic, deliciously satisfying, nutritionally rich ingredients that will keep you fuller longer."  I think that 400 calories of intake per day is too much for any snack item.  With that being said, I now carry one of these bars with me instead of another grain type bar for the times when I absolutely need something to eat or desire a chocolate fix.  When I have these, I no longer carry a little bag of nuts either.  Because I haven't yet purchased bars which haven't been heated, I can only say that those I've received are not visually appealing and require eating directly from the cellophane because the bits of chocolate fall away.  Despite that flaw, these are a great snack item that I will be purchasing and will try other varieties as well.  I would like to see these offered at a better value when purchased in a box rather than the current cost at about eighteen dollars for a pound box of twelve bars.

column9: I love Kind bars, but this flavor only ok
column10: Let me preface this review by saying that I love Kind bars.  I love their all-natural ingredients, use of non-GMO products, and marginal amount of sugar per bar.  This "Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt" flavor sounded intriguing, but I was ultimately disappointed by the subtle flavors.  The dark chocolate is a very light touch and I could barely taste the sea salt.  The nuts are plentiful on the other hand, but a little too hard and gummy and they usually got stuck in my teeth.They did make a tasty snack with Greek yogurt however, which helped to soften the nuts.

My wife and I love KIND bars, particularly since she is pre-diabetic and loves snacking.These are perfect for anyone who is watching their blood sugar for spikes and wants a high protein snack.  The flavor choices of all of the bars kind of run together after a while.  They're basically variations of fruit, dark chocolate, coconut, and nuts.The Dark Chocolate/Nuts/Sea Salt combo is quite tasty, though I found that the salt didn't hit my tongue consistently.  Also, and this is my biggest complaint about this particular bar, is that it's MUCH harder to bite into.  It was like trying to bite off a rock!  Needless to say, make sure you have strong teeth and drink some milk for calcium to support your taste for these!I think we'll stick with our macadamia and fruit combo as our favorite...

Essentially this product is nuts (almonds, peanuts, cashews and walnuts) glued together with honey and a bit of sugar.None of the ingredients is particularly unhealthy.  I'd rate it higher except the taste is only "so so".  It does provide more fiber than sugar so that is very good.  And of course the easy to carry packaging makes it a good choice for travel (or taking to work).Good product, unremarkable flavor.Edit: I should point out that I'm reviewing the "Madagascar Vanilla Almond" product, the other flavors sound more interesting.

column9: Nom Nom Nom! Read Further For Details.
column10: KIND has done everything right on these yummy little nut bars. What you've got here is a conglomeration of different nuts (seemingly glazed a bit) glued together with enough dark chocolate to be very tasty without overwhelming the surprisingly fresh taste of the nuts. The hint of sea salt is just right. As far as texture, it's chewy (but not TOO chewy) with hints of crisp along with the solid but gently yielding nut meats. What an indulgence!Note that these aren't a low calorie snack (more's the pity), but they do deliver a nice amount of protein. These would make a great meal replacement (or between meal pick-me-up) to store in a desk drawer and enjoy with a cup of coffee.

It's a good thing I am not allergic to nuts because this Vanilla Almond Bar is really loaded with them.  There is only 4 grams of sugar so the total taste is not very sweet but it is still quite delicious.  Each bar is 210 Calories but 140 of them are from fat.  This is not really a problem since the fat is from nuts which is the good kind of fat.  The bar is a bit dryer than most other ones I've tried so I like to have a drink on standby near me when I eat one.  This appears to be a really healthy snack and tasty without making my blood sugars hit the roof.  I will be buying these again and I highly recommend them.

This was a new-to-me product.  I REALLY enjoyed it. I have been very stingy with them, eating them as a planned snack ~only~ as I could see where this bar could become an issue for me! Yes, its THAT good. I LOVE that its a more natural productunlike a lot of its 'competition' that is out there. This is decent in protein, low in sugar, all natural flavors...what else could you want? A lower price maybe? If you have young kids this would be a great after school snack but it could become a very pricy one for you to purchase on a regular basis. There are several flavors to choose from and enjoy.

I'm not that much of a bar lover: a banana or fruit is my go to grab food.  But the KIND Nuts & Spices Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt bar is my new favorite "too crazy busy to eat a real meal right now" item.This bar does not taste like processed food. It has a simple set of ingredients - nuts, three kinds of  them, almonds, peanuts, and walnuts, chocolate and a touch of sea salt - and you can taste each one.  The sea salt and the hint of cinnamon elevates the taste, and the chocolate is sweet but not too sweet.  For some reason the chocolate is messy  and the only thing that seems to prevent it is keeping it super cold - not always easy for an item that lives in the bottom of my purse.These bars are filling, and at 200 calories, you need them to be. The calories do pack a nice nutritional punch though: 0% cholesterol, 7g dietary fiber, 5g sugars and 6g protein.

column9: A hit out of the park
column10: A collection of these came with me to work, to overwhelming acclaim. Everyone who tried one was nothing less than enthusiastic, including myself. The perfect balance of salty and sweet, this mostly-nuts combo held together by a sweet sticky binder is over-the-moon good and a true find for those who have no nut allergies and really appreciate an energy-type bar that fills in the empty corners and takes the hollow feel out.I thought them a little pricy, but the generous size of the bar coupled with the amount of bars provided (twelve in a pack) makes up for the price. There are several different varieties as well, giving you your choice of chocolate, fruit and nut, or peanut butter preference (or combinations thereof).Excellent pick-me-up, and I will be getting more of these.

Dark chocolate?  Check.  Nuts?  Check.  Sea salt?  Check.  How about a perfect size bar that is also the perfect texture -- chewy, but not "too"?  Check.  Even the price is right.  So what are you waiting for?

This is a fabulous product. The dark chocolate gives it a little hint of sweetness, yet it's still a low-carb snack. The sea salt isn't overwhelmingly salty, but it adds a nice burst of flavor. These bars taste great, and they're also a decent protein, fiber and good fat boost.

column9: A delicious, all-natural snack bar, but it is definitely NOT a low-cal snack
column10: These snack bars are part of KIND Healthy Snacks range of whole nut bars made with only 5 grams of sugar and no artificial ingredients. I tried the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt.The first thing I noticed when I unwrapped my first bar was that it seemed to rain bits of dark chocolate. There was still plenty of chocolate left on the bar, but there were a lot of chocolate crumbs on the piece of paper in front of me. I am very glad that I was not sitting back when I opened this, as I would have had a lap full of chocolate!The second thing I noticed was the taste. The bar is quite, quite yummy - tasting of almond, peanuts and walnuts, with a nice shadow of cocoa, and periodic flashes of sea salt. In this respect the bar is a home run!The third thing I noticed was the calorie count. A Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar has 200 calories, with 140 calories coming from fat, and it has 16 grams of carbohydrates. As far as I am concerned, this does put the bar in the candy bar range, which is unfortunate.So, I would say that this is a delicious, all-natural snack bar, but it is definitely NOT a low-cal snack. Also, beware of opening one of these when wearing dress clothes!(Review of KIND Nuts and Spice Bars Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt)

The clear wrapper on these bars immediately reveals a product that is more like homemade bars than typical snack food, and the ingredients are simple and natural.  On taking a bite, I was impressed with the crunchy texture of the nuts, and it was not too sticky to hold.  The flavors that stood out the most were the almonds, sea salt, and dark chocolate.  I was particularly impressed with how well the salt flavor stood up, and the chocolate tastes like real chocolate that would be good alone.I have become more and more of a fan of these sort of "back to basics" products recently, and not just for health reasons.  While some brands do taste very bland or boring, as if being natural is enough, others take the taste and texture seriously, with no need to hide cheap ingredients behind a wall of chemicals.  This is one of those delightful products.

I've tried a number of different kinds of Kind bars and honestly I didn't think anything could make them better.  I was wrong.  Dark chocolate, which of course makes everything better, doesn't gild this particular lily, it makes it even more delicious.Kind bars are wonderful amalgams of dried fruits and nuts, and other good things.  They seem minimally processed; the nuts are cracked, not ground, and everything is held together with a bit of honey.  They're not too sweet, not too salty, not too dry... really they're just right.  Top this Just Right off with a thin layer of dark chocolate and you have a true winner.Honestly, I don't care if they're good for me.  They're simply one of the best snacks I've eaten in ages.

These are among the best bars I've ever had. They are simply great.They are sweet, but not overly so.Chewy, with a very good amount of crunchy nuts (almonds in particular) around them.Natural sugars! (honey, non-gmo glucose), and the only relativeDon't confuse them for health bars (these are better than most of them, 5g of fiber, no weird ingredients), or protein bars (though they do have 7g of protein), but obviously no comparison to sneakers or typical granola bars that have tons of sugar (these are just 4g per bar).All in, these are simply delicious, perfect blend of chewy and crunchy. And the ingredient list is something rare these days.Oh they have a low glycemic index and are gluten free too. Did I mention they are delicious?The only down side is the price, of ~$1.50 per bar, even in a large pack.

column9: Great Product - Just Not As Great Shipped In The Summer
column10: I have been buying bars from KIND for a few months, and I decided to see how they do shipped from Amazon rather than buying from the store.  I love the Dark Chocolate, Nuts, and Sea Salt variety as well as many of the others.  The bars buy themselves are worth 5 stars for taste and healthy diet considerations.  While they have a high ratio of fat, the fat from nuts is beneficial in reasonable amounts.So if everything is so great, you might be wondering why I only gave them 4 stars.  Unfortunately, the product is somewhat degraded in the delivery process.  I'm not sure what time the Post Office left them in my mailbox, but the Texas sun was not kind (no pun intended) to them while they waited for me to get home and retrieve them.  The dark chocolate wound up melting to an extent.  Even after waiting for it to solidify the next day, the melted chocolate that adhered to the wrapper went everywhere when I opened the bars.  It did not affect the taste any, but this is not a problem that I encounter when I buy them in the store and bring them straight home.  This is not an issue for the non-chocolate varieties, but I cannot recommend buying any of the bars from KIND in the summer.
I like them all -these are the Best Kind YetLow fat-sugar and fills me up during my afternoon break.
I tried this product, I didn't like it it was to Salty.  Anyone who has high blood pressure should use with caution.

These nut bars are a delicious treat.  They are more like a natural dessert/candy bar than a meal or protein bar though.  Imagine a pile/row of nuts held together by a sticky honey glaze and you can imagine these bars.  210 calories (140 from fat).  14 grams of carbs, 4 grams of sugar, 7 grams of protein.  They taste very good for an all natural snack.

These are the best kind bars I have ever had. They taste great. They are 200 calories so they  make a nice breakfast or snack. The flavor is perfect and I love the nuts. Plus kind is a great company so you can feel good about buying this product.

column4: L. Reeves "A Life Bound By Books"
column9: 5 Stars for KIND Nuts & Spices Vanilla Almond Bars
column10: I've not much to add that hasn't already been said. These are the best tasting bars I've tried. They are, or taste like they are laced with Sugar. Perhaps because the nuts are held in place by tons of honey! Only 4g of sugar but with a 40g bar that's 10%. It's great to be able to see what you're eating too as nothing is smashed together or ground up. Visually appealing and very tasty.

Doc OZ has reccommended these bars but I say,"Doc OZ- You crazy!"They taste ok.  Standard, standard. They really taste like any other bar but at 180 Calories, I'd rather go with something else. I thought 100 calories was the caloric threshold for these power bars but I guess not.If you are looking for a quick 180 calories, this is for you! If you are looking for a quick alternative to lunch- this is not a bad way to go. Looking for a low calorie snack, you can do much better than these.

column4: Jessica R. Westberg "A Catholic with a sense ...
column10: I enjoyed this KIND bar. The crunch of the rice is a nice contrast to the crunch of the almonds. The vanilla is almost too subtle to be noticed, though. This makes for a good mid-afternoon snack, very filling. I will definitely buy this in the future.

column9: natural, delish and full of good for you monounsaturated fats but low in sugar
column10: I'll admit I was not at all sure why, when I bought my contact lens solution, there was a special deal that I get this kind bar free. I knew there was hidden target marketing in their somewhere but I simply couldn't fathom what it was.Still, I was gonna buy the lens cleaner anyway so I may as well have a snack after a lens cleaning session, dontchaknow.I had unpacked my Amazon box and was headed to walk the dogs when I nabbed a taste...woa, unexpected.I am a KIND bar afficianado already. I even nabbled a KIND tote bag at a tasting event. I thought I'd pretty much sampled all of them and boubght many of them at Whole Foods in the years past. Either this one is new or I overlooked the best of the bunch along the way.I buy chocolate bars that have sea salt in them...it's a taste that sounds odd but the saltiness and sweetness combo is devine.They have taken it up a level. The crunch of the nuts with chocolate and seasalt and sweetness is truly superb.Now add in dark chocolate and nuts which are a monounsaturated fat and MUFAS have been shown in study after study to actually assist in weightloss (you still have to watch your caloric intake, mind you) and boost heart health and viola! A 200 calorie low glycemic snack...it's actually very low in sugar for a treat (12 grams)Packed with protein, this also will help satiety far better than a candy bar...and, in my opinion, the taste is simply superior.

column9: Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt
column10: I was upset that I was billed $1.34 for my FREE Sample of this product. I feel tricked into paying for it.I am so annoyed that I haven't tasted it yet.

This was "free" when you ordered another item. I'm glad we did not "pay" for it. It did not have that rich choc flavor...instead it was bland and tough. I'd bet they were "free" since they seemed stale.

What a ripoff. I thught this was a free sample and the item name even says " Free Sample of Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar, 1.4 Ounce" but yet my bank was charged a $1.41 charge for this. I was all for trying a free sample but not a free sample that costs me a $1.41. Talk about false advertising!!

I have no idea if this chocolate bar is good, or not. It was advertised with Popchips as a add on that would have a credit on the checkout, that would make it free. Imagine my suprise when I looked at my credit card charges, and found a charge for $1.33. I checked my purchases from Amazon, and there it was. A charge 0f $1.33 does not a "Free" item make. I am disapointed Amazon.

column9: Tasty, crunchy, nutty flavor that is not too sweet, and (YAY!) no corn syrup that is often (over)used in other snack bars.
column10: Fuzzy Wuzzy's Summary:***** Highly recommended with warm fuzzies!Nutritional Value: ***** Excellent 5-fuzzies ratingPackaging, Appearance, Flavor: ***** Excellent 5-fuzzies ratingCompetitive Pricing & Value: *** Average not-good not-bad 3-fuzzies ratingPositives:+ Delicious nutty flavor with a very crunchy texture.+ Only 4 grams of naturally-derived sugar (AND NO CORN SYRUP)!+ All-natural minimalist set of ingredients.+ Due to the all-natural nutritional content that is not artificially fortified with extra vitamins, these serve solely as snack bars and are not meant to be used as meal-bar diet aids.Negatives:- Slightly expensive considering the small 40-gram (1.4 ounce) size of each bar.Although these snack bars come in four different flavors, this review is specifically for the "Madagascar Vanilla Almond" flavor...The Amazon product listing for this snack bar currently does not list its nutritional information, so I included it below (copied from the kindsnacks Web site):Ingredients: Mixed nuts (almonds, peanuts, cashews, walnuts), honey, non GMO glucose, chicory root fiber, crisp rice, Madagascar vanilla, soy lecithin.Vitamins and Minerals: Vitamin A (0% DV), Vitamin C (0% DV), Calcium (6% DV), Iron (6% DV).Vitamin E (25% DV), Vitamin K (2% DV), Vitamin B1 (4% DV), Vitamin B2 (10% DV), Vitamin B3 (10% DV), Vitamin B6 (4% DV), Folate (6% DV), Phosphorus (15% DV), Magnesium (20% DV), Zinc (8% DV)Serving Size: 1 Bar (40g)Calories: 210Fat Calories: 140Total Fat: 16gSaturated Fat: 2Trans Fat: 0gCholesterol: 0mgSodium: 15mgPotassium: 210mgTotal Carbohydrates: 14gDietary Fiber: 5gSugars: 4gProtein: 7gNutritional Value: ***** Excellent 5-fuzzies ratingAs befits the Kind company's slogan of "Ingredients you can see & pronounce", the ingredient listing for these snack bars includes just the necessities, without the various chemistry lab listing of corn syrup-derived sugar, vitamin additives, preservatives, and strange-sounding artificial compounds that some snack bars include.  The "non GMO glucose" means that the glucose is derived from non-genetically-modified sources.  Unlike the sucrose table sugar, glucose is a very simple sugar that is easily digested by the body.  "Madagascar vanilla" is sometimes promoted as being a premium vanilla that comes from Madagascar, even though most of us would not really notice any difference between vanilla sources and where the plants were grown.  But many so-called "vanilla-flavored" foods are artificially flavored with vanillin derived from lignin instead of vanilla fruits, so at least we get real vanilla here, instead of artificial vanilla flavoring.  The "soy lecithin" ingredient acts as an emulsifier to hold the ingredients together and keep them from separating.  Soy lecithin is a byproduct of soybean oil production.  So all ingredients used in these bars are vegan and natural in origin.  If you are allergic to either soy or nuts, you should not consume these bars.  But these bars are gluten-free for gluten-sensitive people, dairy-free, cholesterol-free, very low sodium, and have a low glycemic index with no trans fats.I am particularly happy with the fact that corn syrup, and all its variants, are not used in these snack bars, and that they are not all loaded up with sugar.  Too many snack bars list corn syrup as one of their primary ingredients!  These bars also have less sodium than most snack bars out there.Because these snack bars are not artificially fortified with additional vitamins, they do not serve as meal replacement bars, so they are not comparable to a meal-bar like SlimFast 200 Calorie, Sweet & Salty Chocolate Almond, Meal Bar 5pk, 7.93-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8) (which, like many meal bars and snack bars, is full of corn syrup).Packaging, Appearance, Flavor: ***** Excellent 5-fuzzies ratingThese bars have a hard, very crunchy, whole-nut texture that I found totally enjoyable to eat as a snack in between meals and on hiking trails.  The texture is somewhat like crunching on peanut brittle, but certainly not as sweet as peanut brittle.  If you prefer your snack bars to be soft and chewy, this is not the right bar for you... but be aware that "soft and chewy" often translates to "loaded with sugar".  If you have sensitive teeth or gums, biting into this crunchy bar may cause some discomfort.

I love nuts and dark chocolate, so for me this was a no brainer. These aren't big enough for a meal replacement for me personally, but for some dieting or trying to do whats right and eat a breakfast in a hurry these are a great option. If you still eating those chewy granola bars, don't you think it time for an adult bar? The taste on this is great as you get the crunch from the nuts, the sweet and smooth from the chocolate, and sweets favorite companion salty. The only negative thing I could say is these do cost a good bit, but in my opinion it is worth it.Pros:-Natural ingredients-Minimal sugar-Great taste-Healthy fat, protein and fiberCon:-Cost-Not filling enough for a meal replacement.Overall five stars as it is a great product and I will continue to use it as a morning snack.

I LOVE these bars! I first started eating them at Starbucks and had to buy a box! They are delicious and nutritious! Amazon has them a a good price and they nicely wrapped and packaged so they are fresh!

column9: Great tasty product, but a "free sample" as seen here? I think not.
column10: The offer said, Free Sample of Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar, 1.4 Ounce, so I clicked on it, wondering if it was truly a freebie. It wasn't but I ordered a couple of them anyway. More on this "free sample" offer later, but how good are they?Subjective Taste Test:Perhaps this is a little unfair as I've tested the KIND Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar before. Bought a couple of them at a local store some time ago and found that they were a good snack alternative to my regular Clif Bar Energy Bars when out cycling. And followers of his show will already know that Dr. Oz, recommended KIND and keeps some in his briefcase at all times. As far as taste goes, these are good, nice and chewy with a decent nut flavor, and the dark chocolate is not sickeningly sweet as one will find with some products. I have a thing for sea salt, and the combination of that with the nuts and dark chocolate works... and they don't leave a bad artificial aftertaste.Nutrition Stats:Checked the KIND site and found the following ingredients were listed for this product:Mixed nuts (almonds, peanuts, cashews, walnuts), chicory root fiber, honey, palm kernel oil, sugar, crisp rice, cocoa powder, non GMO glucose, sea salt, soy lecithin, milk powder, vanilla extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Vitamin A (0% DV), Vitamin C (0% DV), Calcium (6% DV), Iron (8% DV).Vitamin E (25% DV), Vitamin B1 (4% DV), Vitamin B2 (8% DV), Vitamin B3 (8% DV), Vitamin B6 (2% DV), Folate (4% DV), Phosphorus (10% DV), Magnesium (15% DV), Zinc (6%).> Serving Size: 1 Bar (40g)> Calories: 200> Fat Calories: 140> Total Fat: 15g> Saturated Fat: 3.5g> Trans Fat: 0g> Cholesterol: 0mg> Sodium: 125mg> Potassium: 210mg> Total Carb: 16g> Dietary Fiber: 7g> Sugars: 5g> Protein: 6gThe Offer as Posted Here:At the time of this review, the title for this product is: "Free Sample of Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt bar, 1.4 Ounce." It had shown up this way when I had done a quick search for sea salt, and it looked interesting with that title. But they weren't free, so I figured that I had just missed some special deal. They were being sold by Amazon LLC for $1.49 each at the time, with free two-day shipping for Amazon Prime members, and since I've tried them before, picked up a couple of them.Now I see that the original Amazon deal is gone, and has been replaced by a third party offer. At the time of this review, they are being sold for "$1.59 + $5.95 Est. shipping" and available at an external website. That comes to $7.54 per bar. So much for the "free sample" being offered here.This deal reminded me of something else. Do you remember Vince Shlomi, also known as the "ShamWow Guy" and the one in the Slap Chop infomercials that we used to see? Television's fastest talker used his double entendre signature line "You're gonna love my nuts!" so often that people bought the product... often to their dismay. I like the KIND bars as noted above, but with the deal being currently offered here, it's reminiscent of that one from the "ShamWow Guy" a bit too much.There is another deal here on Amazon for KIND Nuts & Spices, Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt, 12-Count Bars which is far better; just do the math, as it comes out quite reasonably if you want a dozen. They have been endorsed by Al Roker, Dr. Oz and other nutrition folks, but luckily we don't hear them saying "You're gonna love my nuts" on their television segments.9/23/2012

I have already reviewed several of the flavors and gave them 5 stars.  My favorite has always been the Cranberry Almond but I think the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt is going to rapidly become my favorite.  I have an aversion to dark chocolate but liked the Dark Chocolate Peanut one pretty well so I went ahead and bought a box for those times I have a late afternoon sweet tooth at work.  I received the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt as a free sample with some Kashi oatmeal and again, didn't expect to like it because of the dark chocolate & the sea salt seemed odd to me. It is so incredibly delicious! The sea salt adds just the right contrast to the rest of the bar.  The only drawback - its hot outside and the chocolate became a serious melted mess in the wrapper by the time it ventured thru the heat to get to California.  Regardless, I got online and just ordered 2 boxes of the Dark Chocolate Nuts and Sea Salt.  I highly recommend trying this one and I never would have without the free sample.
It was ok just not what I was expecting. So I won't say yes or no you have to try for yourself.
I have heard about these bars, but never tasted them. I will look for them on sale to buy now. Really delicious! Just expensive.....

Kind is good for your mind and body.  I like the fact that the ingredients are natural and things that I can pronounce.  The dark chocolate and salt play off each other nicely.  I enjoy the Kind prodcuts are will continue to purchase and recommend in the future.

The best advertisement in my opinion for any product is to let customers try a sample. I received one of these bars, a full size at that, for free through the mail & I am hooked. I am purchasing a box as we speak. Wonderful product!

column9: Best bar I've tasted in a long time!
column10: I received one of these free with another purchase.  Mine was fresh and delicious. So good that I ordered a box of them.  Hope the great taste comes through in the box, since I have read the other reviews that warn of inconsistency.  I'll update this after I receive it.Update:  the box of 12 bars arrived in perfect condition, and the bars are fresh, crunchy, slightly sweet, slightly salty, and absolutely delicious.

column9: Sea Salt, Chocolate & Nuts Oh My!
column10: OMG - These are the ULTMATE, as far as I'm concerned the cadillac of Kind Bars. Like them even better than the chocolate & peanut butter ones. They basically taste like a great chocolate nut cluster from "individually wrapped candy at" the infamous candy store FM, only better & the hint of sea salt enhances the favor even more. I'm blown away by how delicious these are. And they're healthy 7 grams of fiber, 6 grams of protein, gluten free, are you kidding?  How could something healthy taste THIS GOOD, beyond good? Color me a chocolate connoisseur that's blissed out in chocolate/nut heaven. Unless I try extra hard to limit myself, there's no way these will last until the next "1" month autoship arrives.  They are however very satisfying, & believe it or not stave off cravings for unhealthy junk food. It's one of those products that's almost too good to be true, and if I hadn't tasted it myself I'd have never believed it.

column9: Disappointing the second time I ordered.
column10: I LOVED these bars the first time I ordered them!  They were the right combination of chocolate, nuts, and sea salt.  The sea salt made the difference for me.  It was exactly right.  The second time I ordered them, I think they forgot to use the sea salt.  I couldn't taste it at all.  Very disappointing!
Frankly i love KIND bars but this simply tasted like Nature Valley...not bad tasting but not up to my expectations for KIND.  Stick to Dark Chocolate Cherry...they are the best.

These bars pack a ton of flavor, are totally natural (except for maybe the soy lecithin - I hope it's non-GMO), and have almost no sugar!  Great for after dinner or even as a bridge between meals.  Highly recommended.

These bars keep me going all afternoon; I like that the energy comes mainly from nuts and not quick-to-burn sugar.  And I appreciate that I recognize all the items on the ingredient list!  These bars are made of food!One FYI: I'm not into overly sweet things.  I have my baristas use half the syrup they normally would when they make my espresso drinks and find that plenty sweet.  So, the fact that I find these bars perfectly sweetened means that some people will find these not sweet enough.  My husband described them as, "...okay, but a bit bland."  I'm kind of glad he isn't a big fan.  That means I get the rest!With free super saver shipping, these bars are much more affordable on Amazon than they are in my brick-and-mortar grocery store.  I'm getting more!

My youngest child is on a gluten- and dairy-free diet and it can be difficult when we are out and about finding safe snacks for her that aren't totally junky like potato chips. I've been a fan of KIND bars for a while because they are portable, GF, all-natural, high in protein and fiber, and don't have a ton of sugar. While these vanilla almond bars are not quite as yummy as the KIND PLUS, Cranberry Almond + Antioxidants, Gluten Free Bars 1.4 OZ (Pack of 12) or the KIND Fruit & Nut, Almond & Apricot, All Natural, Gluten Free Bars (Pack of 12), they are still very good. Recommended.

If you are looking for a mid-morning or mid-afternoon pick-me-up, KIND Nuts & Spices Madagascar Vanilla Almond bar is a great alternative to a surgary sweet candy bar.The bar, which is all natural, contains mixed nuts, chicory root fiber, crisp rice, Madagascar Vanilla Almond, and soy lecithin. That's it. No additional chemicals or hard-to-pronounce ingredients. It's all natural, with only 4g of sugar, 5 grams of fiber, and 7 grams of protein.Another big plus for me is the fact that the bars are cholesterol free, with no hydrogenated oils, or trans fats. The bar, because it contains a variety of nuts, is not low fat, however, with 16 grams of total fat, but only two grams of saturated, or bad, fat.Taste wise, the Madagascar Vanilla Almond bar tastes pretty much as you would expect. The bar consists of almonds and peanuts and those are the tastes that dominate, with a hint of honey. The bars are not sticky, however, so they make a good snack if you are work or school. Being made primarily of nuts, the bars have a crunchy texture but the bars are not hard.I like the fact that these are all natural. While the Madagascar Vanilla Almond bar is not a meal replacement bar, they are perfect if you are looking to snack on something tasty and natural.

I really enjoyed these bars.  They are one of the few bars claiming to be "natural" that actually aren't filled with unpronounceable ingredients.  There are very few, simple ingredients, which are all non-GMO.  A gluten free product.Very lightly sweetened.  Calories a little on the high side for a snack at 200 calories, but high in protein.I was mildly amused that the packaging is labeled as "may contain nuts" when it is a nutty granola bar that has visible nuts in it. :)  What can I say?  I'm easily amused.  I will certainly by these again and will be looking into their other flavors.

I enjoyed the flavor and contents of each bar.  And if the bars are kept in a cool place you can actually remove them from the wrapper.  Cool doesn't mean house temperature unless yours is 62 degrees.  Otherwise, if somewhat warmer the bars become extremely sticky and are hard to remove from the celephane wrappers.  Expect sticky licking-good fingers as well.  Were it not for that I'd give it a 4+-star.

column10: There's nothing artificial in these all natural healthy nutritious snack bars, each containing:4g Sugar7g Protein5g FiberThey're also:Gluten FreeLow GlycemicCholesterol FreeDairy FreeNo Trans FatsVery Low SodiumKosherThese snack bars were created by a marketing genius, appealing to a lot of people. non gmo, healthy snack bar-- the only problem we're having with it is that the grandchildren have discovered where we store them and they keep disappearing HA!

Put almond in your frosting, put lemon in your waffles, put any of them in creamy sauces and you will go wild. This drink shares a lot of its flavor profile with the aperitif Campari.  If you like Campari, you'll almost certainly like Chinotto.  As for the rest of you, read on!The first time I tried Campari, it was on a lark, because a character in Sarah Caudwell's novel Thus Was Adonis Murdered drank it frequently during a trip to Venice.  My first impression was that it was bitter, complex, and a bit overwhelming.  It wasn't awful, but I couldn't really bring myself to like it.  Eventually, I tried it again, and knowing this time what to expect I was better able to appreciate its multi-faceted complexity.I encourage you to practice the same perseverance with Chinotto, whose primary ingredient - a bittersweet citrus fruit - is also a major part of the Campari formula.  You will almost certainly NOT enjoy your first bottle.  Fear not...there are six of them, so take advantage of the opportunity to experiment with your palate.  Wait a few days and try again.You won't know until the second or third tasting whether you are a budding Chinotto aficionado or a detractor in the making.The reward, for those of you who take the time to discover a love of it, is a soda whose balanced taste makes it a far better companion to cuisine than the sickly sweet sodas we're accustomed to in America.  Chinotto marries excellently with the sorts of meals you'd normally have wine with...not something one could easily say of Coke or Pepsi.Ironically, American sodas (particularly the colas) often have complex and interesting formulas, but all that complexity is obscured by an excess of sugar (or sugar substitutes).  Chinotto has sweetness, but it's a balanced sweetness that lets the other ingredients shine through.  It's a drink that wakes up your whole tongue, which makes it excellent as an aperitif or a with-dinner drink.The only reason I give it four stars is that the spirit Campari, and the bottled pre-mixed CampariSoda cocktail (10% alcohol content, very difficult to find outside Italy) both have an extra splash of genius in the formula.  But for those times when you can't be drinking alcohol, Chinotto nearly reaches the same heavenly height.

My wife and I have vastly different taste buds, which is perfect.She loves the green apples and green bananas and I love the yellowspotted bananas and the mealy ripe apples.  She loves the San Pellegrino Chinotto and I like my syrup sweet hot chocolate.  If you like sour things, then give this a try.  My wife wants this drink to stick around so is enouraging me to write a good review of it, since she does not write online reviews and barely emails. (^:Jonathan

I first stumbled upon chinotto at a Italian  food distributor.  We decided to purchase this particular product because the cashier said that it was by far her favorite, although an acquired taste.  I now know why.  My first sip was.....interesting to say the least.  The flavor journey passes through sweet, sour, and unknown tastes.  Initially my favorite element of the sip was the middle, the beginning too sweet, the end too bitter.  After many tries, I can now appreciate every aspect of this unusual but tantalizing beverage.  I encourage anyone who wants to venture beyond the traditional and insipid American drinks to buy a 6 pack, your opinion will change.

column9: You'll eiither love it or hate.
column10: As these ratings suggest, this is a beverage people either love or hate-- no in between. I got introduced to it by my Itallian girlfriend in high-school and then did not see it again for years. 25 years later on a trip to Italy i found it again. (It is a common soft-drink you can found everywhere. Fanta makes a popular version of it. San Pellegrino makes the 'elite' version.I had been under the impression it was made from artichokes because it has a taste somewhat similar in flavor to Cynar, which is an alcoholic drink made from artichokes (also Italian I believe). If you don't like the taste of Chinotto, you will HATE Cynar. If you like Chinotto, you might try the slightly harsher Cynar.But Chinnotto is my 'nectar of the gods' and I savour every miniature bottle of it.

For me San Pellegrino Chinotto sparkler is a special summertime treat that you have on ice rocks or right out of the bottle after dinner or afternoon break and never with meals. You must not be parched thirsty either, because it is to be sipped slowly to thoroughly enjoy the flavor of this unique beverage. As for the taste even though it is from the Chinotto Orange it has the taste of a herbal/liquorice root beer but sharper. So if you love exotic flavors then I think you will enjoy this fine beverage.

This is just about my favorite soda in the world. If you like cocktails with Angostura bitters or orange bitters -- here's the sweetened, non-alcoholic version. One reviewer here said it tastes like Campari, but I think Chinotto actually has warmer orange notes and lacks some of Campari's sharp antiseptic or medicinal notes. Chinotto us a bitter orange delight -- I'm delighted Amazon is stocking it!

column9: I liked it on the first sip
column10: If you like chai, I think you'll like this. I didn't find it to be bitter or undrinkable. Pleasantly spiced and refreshing.

Some people find it "bitter", I read. BITTER? No,no, delightfully complex is a far more accurate term.  Think not-so-sweet root beer mixed with orange or lemon peel.  If you want soda to taste like candy, this is not for you. But bitter it is not. It is very reminiscent of Campari, Cynar, or Fernet Branca.  Think angostura bitters with a bit of sugar and mineral water.  Try it!  There is nothing else like it.

PEPPER!!!!

It does have a little bit of an aftertaste which tastes like fermented grapes... a little like a wine cooler, and this aftertaste goes away very quickly. Not bad. It is good. But nothing special. If they bottled it state side, and therefore would be much cheaper, I would buy more often. But, all in all... it's a good drink.. ok, not bitter,... very sugary though.

column9: TOO GOOD FOR MY OWN GOOD
column10: I agree with Chuck...these are TOO good. I ordered my first bag because I wanted the health benefits of Dark Chocolate without that wretched bitter taste that makes me not like dark chocolate. Also, several research studies have demonstrated the benefit of (something in) pomegranate in going after ugly things like cancer cells. So, I tried them and and they were sooo good tasting (No, make that GOOD TASTING!!!) like those things you start eating and just can't find a stopping place, you know? I now SLEEP with a bag of these. My husband really likes them, too, and I find that sometimes when he rolls over, I find that he is in truth groping for the Brookside bag.  Now the other downside is that these are high in fat...and it is ugly Saturated Fat, high calorie, contain cholesterol, and contain sodium. One MUST not give in to unrestrained eating of these yummy little bits, or one will have the shape of your average hippopotamus and lose all those nifty health benefits. This amounts to eating like a smallish handful per day...sort of like trying to put only one bubble in your bath. You might wonder why I still gave them five stars when I realize how UN-healthy they could be in excessive amounts...and the answer is because the taste calls for more than 5 stars, so health=3 stars, but taste=8 stars. Beware!  I ordered the single bags with no problem. Then I ordered the two-bags from GR8-Mart, but, being in the throes of my unrestrained addiction for them at that time, I ordered 4 bags (2 bunches of 2 bags each). I think this must have confused their packers who are probably unused to really piggy people ordering that much, so I only received two bags total. I contacted this seller with terrific fast follow-up in getting my other two bags to me, so I'm ordering from them again.  Just follow these rules and you will be okay:  1. Don't eat more than a handful a day.  2. Don't sleep with your bag next to you.  3. Don't expose tubby family members to these...too dangerous. Plus, you might have to get creative in hiding your bag(s) from them!  4. Don't keep your bag in a hot place (Duh!), and try to reseal the bag after each foraging because I suspect that even gnats, little ants, and no-see-ums would be interested in these.Incidentally, we had to drive to several days of meetings, so I packed my Brookside bag in a large strong ziploc with two of those frozen gel ice packs, and all arrived successfully with no chocolate melting despite outside temps (while stopping for lunch, etc.) of 100-plus.
