Have tried Erythritol and like it very much.It arrived quickly and was exactly as described.Would purchase this product again.

column9: The best Gluten Free Pasta I've ever had!
column10: This is the best GF pasta!  I was shocked when I had it one time with the texture and taste and found it online to buy (I can't find it in our local stores).  I could have sworn it was regular pasta.  There are only 3 ingredients when I bought it, Corn, Rice and Buckwheat (buckwheat has no gluten, totally different class of food). This pasta is great.  It does not get mushy when you cook it like some of the rice pastas do.  My husband is not GF but he eats what I eat, and agrees that this is the best GF pasta we've tried.

column9: only brand of pasta worth eating

column9: Perfect for those who must avoid soy product
column10: This is a good bar, if it is refrigerated before eating. My daughter has the easiest time with this formula so despite it being pricier, I've decided to stick with it. Every order I've received from this seller has come quickly and in great condition. The fact that each container is 2oz is perfect for night feedings since I don't have to warm up anything and can add 2oz at a time depending on how hungry she is. It's great for us!
My baby loves this formula, and the package of 2 onz is good for traveling, going to the mall or even the movies, great product!
It's the best!  Our son Alex (2 months old) loves this formula and I have already ordered about 4 to 6 cases of this.

i bought this for my son so it would be convenient when we went somewhere. The milk is not the same as the regular allementum. different texture and lighter. my son threw it up. and i wasted 80 dollars

I've been drinking Trader Joe's Irish breakfast forever. Then we went to Ireland and I discovered what real Irish tea was supposed to taste like. We were served Bewley's a lot of the time, so I bought it when we got back, and it is indeed far superior to TJ's. Smooth, creamy wonderful tea! I had this at a B&B in Kilkee and was so happy to find it here in the States!Excellent value also...and shipping was fast as ever.

column9: This is awesome if you like strong tea
column10: Bewley's Irish teas are my teas of choice. I love strong tea and the Irish do it right. It's not bitter at all. If you like the taste of tea and want a little more kick of caffeine, I receommend this tea. This is slightly more mild than their strongest tea, which I have trouble finding. The other one if you want even stronger tea is Bewley's Gold (I think that's the name). The box is schoolbus yellow, and one teabag makes two cups officially, but I use one bag for a large mug and am HAPPY.

I lived in Northern Ireland in the 1980's. I would drive the 140 miles into Dublin in order to stock up on Bewely's coffee and tea. The coffee would be fresh roasted and the smell would permeate my car and would stay there for several days. The tea has a creamy rich flavor that I cannot find in any other brand. Whether you drink it black or white you are in for real enjoyment. I would recommend it to all for their morning tea choice or anytime black tea. You will not be disappointed.

there are many bagged teas out there, too many at last count. but of all the brands my personal favorite is Bewley's. this Irish purveyor provides a hearty cuppa every time. i'm partial to both the breakfast and afternoon teas, black and strong. the cafe in Dublin is an institution and worthy of a visit if ever you find yourself in that part of the Blue Marble. barring that, however, snag yourself a box or two of the bags and brew yourself a little bit of celtic heaven in a cup.  Slàinte!!

Bewleys Irish Breakfast tea is a wonderful blend of black teas.  A great way to start your day! I have been drinking this brand of tea for several years and although I have tried other teas, this is my favorite

column9: Gentlease has 1/5 the lactose of milk-based formula
column10: A good way to start shopping for this product is to call Enfamil to see their current pricing, keeping in mind any differences in can size and number of cans in a case. I have purchased this product through Enfamil, Amazon and a few other places, always taking advantage of the best deals.  I have purchased Gentlease in every conceivable size and also case and continue to use it for my twins.  When they reach a year, we plan to go to quit.Next... The World Health Organization recommends exclusive breastfeeding until six months of age. But here in the U.S. after your 3 months maternity leave, are you able to pump enough and store in a refrigerator at work? And you might need formula anyway as we do. I mention this because some imply their formula is as good as human breast milk.We're blessed with twins. They started out colicky and we found that Nutramigen worked at that time. They got through that phase and we've been using Gentlease and solids. After they're a year old it will be all solids. Our pediatrician recommended Gentlease. It has 1/5 the lactose of milk-based formula.I really researched formulas. There are even organizations promoting the sale of human breast milk and there are organizations wanting to stop the sale of human breast milk for fear of health hazards that the FDA cannot control. No matter, those offering breast milk do so at prohibitively high prices - nothing charitable about it.All the brands that I've seen have DHA and ARA, nutrients found in breast milk that promote brain and eye development, iron which is necessary for growth and many more ingredients. The government requires them to have certain ingredients. The major brands do not seem highly differentiated to me except for their specialy models. Gentlease is one of those.Gentlease is one of the special formulas because it has a much lower amount of lactose as well as broken down proteins to make it easier to digest.The prices vary and so do the size of the cans and the number of cans in a case. Unfortunately, I haven't seen Gentlease in big cans at the big box stores. One can also check at the local pharmacy or grocery store for comparison purposes. Keep an eye out for coupons too. You've got to keep constant watch for the best price, and there have been times when the Amazon price prevails.

column9: Our Rabbits Love this Beautiful Rabbit Food!
column10: We do every thing organic & that includes how we raise & breed our English Angora rabbits.  Our normal supplier of 50lb bags of organic rabbit feed went out of stock for 2 weeks.  We found ourselves scrambling to find Organic food fast!This food is beautiful!  No dust or busted up bits that equals waste. This feed is by far the nicest looking rabbit feed we have ever encountered!  The bits are nicely sized &  in perfect condition.  A rabbit house full of bunnies can't be wrong - they love it!We already placed a second order & will be placing a 3rd very soon.  If you want to feed your rabbits something healthy go with this wonderful organic feed!

I am very pleased with this as a basic food for my hamster.  He eats all of it especially the pellets - unlike the Gerbil mentioned in the other review.  It is refreshing to be able to buy a good quality unprocessed organic food for our little fellow.  We supplement with defrosted organic petite pois, blueberries and corn on the cob (which is packed into our freezer for his winter supplies) and an almond daily.  He is very happy and healthy (in his extended modular condo!).

column9: My gerbils ate it, but not with gusto
column10: I decided to try this food because it's organic and has less processed ingredients than most other gerbil mixes, but my gerbils weren't as impressed as I was. The seed mix isn't as boring as a lot of commercial mixes, but apparently the millet and alfalfa pellets (a large proportion of the mix) weren't appealing enough, since I always found a lot of them left over when I cleaned the tank. I'm not sure how hamsters would enjoy this food, but I probably won't be buying it again for my gerbils.

My 6 month-old bun Floyd LOVES these pellets. At first I got him Meijer brand because a 4 lb bag was $5, but it didn't seem he liked them very much; they had dried fruit bits that I read weren't the best for buns (House Rabbit Society). My friend had half a bag of Ecotrition left from her buns, and as soon as I switched Floyd has been devouring these pellets. And they smell like chocolate! AWESOME!

column9: It's a good alternative to fresh food
column10: I've been feeding my rabbit this food for a while now after switching brands several times because I could readily ge the Hartz food anymore.  She just wasn't liking what she was being fed after Hartz until this.  I'd say she's a picky eater but she eats plastic (mere oversight, won't happen again) so she's not that picky.  Vet gave it a nod also, so all in all...satisfied.

My rabbit won't eat pellets and there is no food around here that has no pellets so I decided to get this because, although it contained pellets, they look darker and larger. I was hoping they tasted different and they probably do and that maybe my rabbit would give it a chance. In my opinion, it smelled like cigarette ash and my rabbit wouldn't eat it and just avoided it. I can't stand the smell and it seems my rabbit can't either but I spent $16 on this in Petco. I ordered a new bag of Kaytee Rainbow Rabbit food that smells like play-doh and paint and last time it ate every piece to give you an idea of how bad this is. I strongly would NOT recommend it.

These have a good kick, come in nice packaging, and have an initially good flavor, but they have a sour aftertaste that leaves a nasty flavor in your mouth that lingers.  Not exactly what I think of when I think of Cherry Jelly Bellies.  However, they do give you a quick shot of energy.

column9: Does improve energy during a run
column10: I like this product because of the caffeine and sugar do seem to help about 30-40 minutes into a run, esp. if I run after work but before dinner.  Plus they are really portable (stick them in your pocket and go)  Like a cup of coffee in your gym bag.  Taste is good with a just the slightest bitterness from the caffeine but no aftertaste.  Eat ten minutes before a long run with a drink of water and you will notice more energy when you hit the last mile of your run, at least that is what I seem to notice.Not candy; keep away from your kids.  My 5 year old took a pack as a snack to kindergarten.  Needless to say, he did NOT take a nap that day.  50mg of caffeine in a little guy is like rocket fuel. . .

I love these sport beans anyway and having the cherry flavor plus the added kick of caffeine seems to be a good way to start a race.  There are multiple studies showing caffeine boost performance and even boosts recovery and they're yummy, that's a bonus!  :)

column9: A must for family cycling tours.
column10: We use the Sport Beans all the time for a quick pick me up when cycling.  They help with your energy levels and are a good compliment to sport drinks.  The cherry flavor is our favorite.

I take these and other (pricy) Jelly Belly "pick-me-ups" with me when hiking. I thought they would get me over the last hill if I really got worn out. Sorry, but I - and I emphasize I - don't feel or see the benefits. There's no boost other than a little sugar high, and if anything, the caffeine has an opposite effect. I'm always better off with sufficient water and a little trail mix in a plastic bag. My daughter loves 'em. They're "just" Jelly Bellys to me and I wouldn't be surprised if the same effect couldn't be gotten from regular jelly beans.
Taste good but I think I will stick with the regular beans without the caffeine. Good if you need a pick me up during your training though.

column9: Low sodium no fat salad dressing
column10: I love it. It tastes great and is natural. I need to watch my sodium intake and I don't see the benefit of having additional fat calories in a dressing. Besides home made, this is the best salad dressing (the only good one on the market in my view). I wish they'd carry it in the supermarket here in Nashville.

column9: Very Sour Taste, Not Greek at All!
column10: I purchased this to replace the no longer available Paula's No Oil Dressing with Cilantro and Lime, which I used to use on Mexican salads. Since the Sophia's dressing had those ingredients I was hopeful it would taste somthing like it. I was wrong. My husband had it on one salad and refused to eat it again. I never got around to using it. Whenever I had a Greek or Mexican salad, there was always another dressing I'd rather have. When I recently cleaned the refrigerator and pantry trying to get rid of things I don't use for more space, I tasted the dressing. The flavors don't seem to go with Greek food at all. I thought it was horrible and immediately threw out the open bottle and the 5 still remaining in the pantry. I'm sorry I had to purchase 6 of these. It was an expensive mistake.

My daughter is a vegan, so when I bake I use the powdered soy milk with the appropriate proportion of water to subsitute for regular milk and it works out fine. My omnivorous husband and son are happy, and I don't have to make something separate for my daughter - what's not to like!

I really like this product. Over the years, I've tried many brands. Some are a bit bitter. This soy milk is not bitter at all. My kids will even drink it with no complaints. I am going to try to get as many people in my family of 9 as possible to go vegan. I will be buying a great deal of this milk.
My wife and I are both milk intolerant. There are several recipes we could not make without this product, and they taste just great with it.
5 of these arrived in the lot. It came in handy because I didn't have to add sugar which is a plus, just add water and wahla instant cup of Kool Aid :)

Purchased this so I could make homemade play-doh for my kids.  We go through a lot of play-doh in this house and cream of tarter is crazy expensive at walmart.  Purchasing here is a great way to make cream of tarter affordable.  The quality was fine.
ANGELINA'S IS THE FRESHEST I HAVE EVER BOUGHT.ANGELINA'S - BEST SPICES WITH THE BEST PRICES!(no, i don't know her or the company)

The product I purchased was a gift for a friend. It arrived in a timely fashion. Unfortunately,the safety cap was not secured once my friendreceived and product. I subsequently notified the supplier and informed them of the problem. They indicated that we should discard the product and they would re-issue a replacement. The replacement product took about eight days to arrive and again the safety cap was not secured. This was not a good gift giving experience.  I chose not to attempt it again.Regrets,H.F. Slayton
Super fast shipping! Great value for the money. I wouldn't hesitate to order from this company again.
very pleased with this product. It arrived in good time and order. Will order again.

column4: James D. Taylor "Mrs. James D. Taylor"
column10: THIS IS THE CHEAPEST PRICE I HAVE FOUND FOR CREAM OF TARTAR ANYWHERE.  AND YOU DO GET 30 OZ. OF CREAM OF TARTAR.  AT $13.15, IT CAN'T BE BEAT.  THE CUSTOMER SERVICE WAS GREAT, TOO.  WILL BUY FROM AGAIN.
I've ordered twice from this company, the candy arrives fresh and tasty. I have so far ordered the standard maple sugary candies as well as the hard ones. Highly recommended.

column9: If you have a nespresso machine. Do not buy this capsules
column10: If i satisfied a condition that i have a nespresso machineIt costed about $5 a capsule on Nespresso website.But i didnt know that...You have to buy capsules on nespresso club membership site.

I had always been a Jif fan, but one day I bought a jar of Reese's peanut butter.  It may not be good for me, but it sure is good to my taste buds.  Again,  it could rarely be found on grocery shelves.  When I found it on amazon.com, I was thrilled.  I have ordered it twice - 6 jars at a time.  No more seeking with no finding.  Thank you for having one of my favorite things available once again.

We discovered this product several years ago at our one of our local supermarkets.The store stopped carrying this brand about six months ago.  When we found out it could be ordered on line we were very pleased.  It's lots more expensive than purchasing locally but it's worth it.
I am not a big peanut butter fan. This is the best out there. How is this not healthy? Slap it on some whole wheat bread. Makes eating horse food and bird seed bearable. =)
Best Peanut Butter on the market. Large grocery store chains are fools for not carrying this product. Like a peanut butter cup in every bite.

This product is LEGENDARY!  One of the best tasting peanut butter out there. If you like Reese's peanut butter cup this is the main ingredient in them.  Get it to make your home made bars, you would love it!

I like the convenience of the packaging, but the contents was not as I had expected. Too much sauce, and too little sardine. The taste was not a "fresh" as the canned version of sardines. The product is not worth the price. I will not purchase again, nor will I finish the other pack.

My fifth grade class read "Maniac Magee" and the character enjoys this snack and we don't have it in our area so Amazon was a good source.The kids were thrilled when I surprised them at the end of the year with this treat during AM snack time.  Many wanted to read the book again over summer break.I was hoping to get a discount from the originating company but this didn't happen so Amazon was convenient, though the supplier cost and postage was a bit much for one of many "gifts" I give my students.

My border collie, Roxy, loves these! I had heard about pigs' ears and got her some before, but she lost interest with them after a few. But, she LOVES these ones! She didn't get bored with them and would scarf them down. My only problem is that I wish I could find them in a 10 or 15... or even 20 pack so that I don't have to buy so many bags or so often...

The product is very good. Best oatmeal around. This vendor is NOT. I've tried to get a response from them about the shipping and they have ignored 4 attempts. I paid for expedited shipping, which was more than the oatmeal, or the same and it arrived about 10-14 days later. They shipped it ground and took my money for 2 day shipping. All I wanted was the difference of ground/2nd day reimbursed to my account. I'll go to Ireland before I order from them again.

An Irish friend passed some of these along to me so that I could try them without risk and I must say, I'm impressed. My go-to porridge is Old Wessex Ltd. Scottish Style (sic) Porridge Oats but I love oats and wanted to try some from "the Auld Sod," so she very kindly surprised me with some from her personal stash.I tend to prefer a sturdy rolled oat which these are not: they're small and thin. But they cook up to a comforting, creamy mass that's not only good with milk and a sweetener but plain with a bit of salt (which I always include) as well. The flavor is lovely--very "oatey," and like all whole grains, they stick to your ribs in a satisfying manner. Cooking one cup according to package directions yields two enormous servings that could economically and healthfully provide a delicious breakfast for several hungry children, if you're so inclined. Tip: try toasting them in the pot, stirring constantly (careful--they burn quickly), until they smell nice, then add your pre measured water and cook according to package directions.My satisfaction was such that I was motivated to buy a bag of Flahavan's Jumbo Oat Flakes (they're also available organic) while shopping at our local Irish market yesterday and I fully expect them to be as good the Progress Oatlets. Now, if they'd just stock the Pinhead Oatmeal, I'd be a completely happy woman.Update: not unpredictably, I like the (non-organic) Jumbo Oat Flakes even more than these and am glad I made the investment. I'd review them on their own but Amazon doesn't stock them. I'll buy the organic next time and my vendor has promised to order Flahavan's Pinhead Oatmeal as well. Since Amazon actually carries it, I'll review it once I've bought it.BTW, the name is pronounced 'FLAvans (kinda like "taverns" without the r).

My family in Ireland always eats this oatmeal. It is very creamy and never lumpy. Really hits the spot on cold mornings. Sometimes I add raisins, cinnamon, brown sugar. It is wonderful and healthy too.

While in ireland, we found Whites oatmeal to be very good. Couldn't find it in U.S., so tried McCaans. Couldn"t eat it. Tried Flahavans. This is even better that Whites!! When we return to Ireland, it will be Flavahans.

My husband and I eat this every morning and never tire of it.  Leagues better than American oatmeal ... wish we could get somebody here to start milling oatmeal this way.  We call our morning bowl the oatmeal souffle.  Not gluey.  Light and delicious.  I adapt the recipe on package to 1/3 cp oat flakes per serving, with one cp water.  Always soak first or cook to boiling at medium.  If you get distracted and it thickens too much add a bit more boiling water, cook a minute or two longer, and serve.  Lowers cholesterol; great source of fiber.

I feel ridiculous getting so excited about oatmeal, but I really love Flahavans.  A friend's Irish nanny introduced it to me about 14 years ago and I've been buying it since (whenever I could find it).
This product is easy to make, and wonderful by itself.  With a little extra Swiss, some white wine (Reisling, say) it makes a superb party dish, or a cozy meal for two when no one else is around.

column9: Dead ringer for my family recipe...
column10: This is a wonderful product!  My family recipe calls for Ementaler and Wonderbar cheeses and of course garlic and kirsh but wow, buy all that then shred and prepare?  This is soo easy unwrap and warm, add fresh crusty bread, carrots, or apples to dip and voila!  A little taste from back in time.

Good quality chocolate with tasty biscuit. A lot of chocolate products are filled with sugar and what not. You can easily eat a cpl of these without the sugary flavor in your mouth. Been buying these since I was a kid.
Worthy successor to the no-longer-available Girardelli Chocolate Raspberry coffee I used to be able to buy.  I mix it 5 parts to 7 parts of Columbian, for a (for me) perfect mix of flavors.

My whole family loves this coffee.  It has a delicate hazelnut flavor.  The coffee is rich and well balanced and never tastes burnt or bitter.  I have tried the Bean Company Ground Hazelnut coffee, but definitely prefer the whole bean.  I have this product auto shipped each month so I never run out.

Since this review is to be 30 words long . . how many ways can I say THIS Peach flavor is FANTASTIC . . delicious . . outstandingly superb !  Just received it 15 minutes ago and it was just in time to go right into my vanilla protein shake.  Great day in the morning, I am sold on this one.  I have tried the Raspberry (I love it too - but this peach is my fav ! )  Thank you, thank  you AMAZON for making it available !  I'm hooked.Da Vinci SUGAR FREE Peach Syrup 750mL with Splenda

column9: Small boxes keep cat food fresh
column10: And my cat digs it, so I will reorder. Big bags go stale in a one cat household, a case of small boxes is better for freshness.

column9: is it a pack of 12 or 6?  make up your minds...
column10: In the title of this item it states "16.2 ounce- pack of 12". BUT...if you read the description below- it states "pack of SIX" Huh? So now I have to wait and wonder what will be arriving. I purchase Friskies dry and wet food as a gift for my mother's cat. Mom can no longer drive, so it helps to have Amazon deliver heavy items like bags and cans of chow right to the door. (I'm in Tx, she's in CA) THis is the cat's favorite flavor of dry food, and she'll eat it quickly, so it would be nice to know if I should have ordered two of these packs, or just one! Just a note- for older cats who seem to be getting finicky, try them on strong seafood flavors. Sometimes their old tastebuds apparently can't enjoy bland turkey or chicken flavors. Every cat seems to enjoy the "surfin' favorites" in this variety.(One last note- WHY does Amazon frequently state "hurry, only one left!" Huh? How could an operation as big as this have ONE left of an item?? That's ridiculous)

This is the McDonald's of cat food. It's loaded with absolute crap that cats simply do not need and is designed to be highly appealing to customers who make purchasing decisions while minimizing costs to maximize profit. The top two ingredients are corn and corn meal, products that are simply cheap fillers which cats digest very poorly. It's also loaded up with artificial colors which cats simply do not care about, but makes the product prettier to humans. The product's protein is rather low at 30% and is derived from cheap protein sources like soybean meal and chicken by-product meal, it's so low that it should not be fed to kittens. While it's nutritionally adequate for adult cats, so is McDonald's for humans and I would hope that cat owners would aim to provide nutritionally optimal food for their cats diet. My friends fed this to my cat for two days after running out of EVO and my cat started wheezing much like a friend's cat who had been fed Friskies. Wheezing stopped after dumping this junk.

My children always called Hamburger Helper "Burglar Helper". Anyway, I'm currently in Afghanistan and this is a pleasant change from the military dining facilities and so easy to make...add a little hot sauce and you're good to go.

column9: Tasty and convenient.  Great for kids and teenagers.
column10: Fairly tasty and convenient.  Great for kids and teenagers.  Barely enough for an adult and I would not want to eat this too often.  But fine for an occasional quick lunch or even as a side dish.  Might be a bit salty for some.  Tastes pretty much like you'd expect.  Tiny bits of meat add something.  Be sure to let 'em sit for the extra 3 minutes (or longer) after microwaving (as instructed) so sauce can thicken properly.

column9: Was a great value with free shipping!
column10: This stuff tastes just like Hamburger Helper from the box, that you've made with your own meat, milk and simmered for 15 min.  The pieces of hamburger are small and the texture isn't too terribly bad, which I expected.  The instructions don't have you stir in the middle of cooking, but we have found that you do need to once, or we end up with some over-cooked pieces (which might be our microwave - as our wattage is very low and we have to cook it a little longer.)

column9: Tastes good, wish it was a little bigger
column10: I love the taste of this stuff, but one cup isn't much food. It is a good size for a small kid, but not an adult. Super easy to make, although they have boiled over a couple times in the microwave. I just set it for a little less time and it was fine.

i love these,prefect when i want a snack but dont want to cook.taste just like the one u get in the box i buy mine at local grocery store for a dollar or less sometimes two for buck but hey cant beat the price on here when u cant find them anywhere else.

Like the title says, its good in a pinch if you are hungry and not feeling the kitchen thing. As many others mention it is NOT a meal in a cup. Farm from it, more a side or appetizer.With that said, the flavor is not all that bad, its a tad salty IMHO but adding some hot sauce or cut up veggies/hot dog seems to even it out. I've made a couple with no microwave just boiling water and they turned out ok. They make great trade offers when you find another Hamburger Helper aficionado in the sandbox(Afghanistan).No where near as good as the big box mix BUT a heck of a lot easier to manage.

The product tastes good. Have no complaints. Remove top, add hot water from the tap to fill line, stir, pop in microwave on high for 3 minutes, and then let sit for 3 minutes. Stir again and enjoy. Quick and easy to prepare.As a college student, the fast preparation is great. The quantity of food on the other hand leaves more to be desired. Think of this as a side dish, because if you're really hungry--you'll be looking for something else.

I bought these to have on hand here at work for a quick lunch.  They are pretty good although the hamburger is a little tough and you should really keep it sitting after a good 10-15 minutes for the noodles to soften.  I tried to eat it about 5 minutes after cooking and the noodles were still pretty hard.

I eat all of cup foods and this is the best food to put in a cup. My favorite dinner now a lunch snack. Good for work or anywhere with a microwave. Full taste of a Hamburger Helper dinner.Very good value for the best microwaveable cup. If you like cup snack than this might be your favorite.If you try it you'll know. Five stars for a snack
the hamburger helper chesseburer ma was just as described on the website, arrived on time (early in the morning)and was very good i will purchsae this agin soon

I read somewhere that chocolate is now good for you. I don't remember where. It was just one of those things that stuck in my mind. I suppose it's because I've always liked chocolate, and especially really dark chocolate. Oh, you know, in that article, it also said that the darker the chocolate, the better it was for you. Go figure. Well, it used to be that chocolate was bad because it had a high fat content, but these days it seems that there's bad fat and good fat and chocolate has the good kind. Plus, this chocolate (70% Cacao content) is organic, not the ordinary kind. Modern nutrition is marvelous. Well, all of this came to mind as I strolled by the candy rack in a nearby Fresh and Easy Market where I was grocery shopping and this Green and Black's Dark Organic Chocolate Bar (3.5 ounces) was impossible to pass by. Did I mention that this bar is really tasty? Here's to my good health!Gary Peterson

Vernor's Ginger Ale Diet, 12 oz Can (Pack of 12)The standard (non-dietetic) Vernor's is something special. Unfortunately, because it isn't available everywhere, I haven't had it for years. Anyway, if it's still the remarkable drink that it used to be, its dietetic version version should hang its head in shame. While it's not the worst soft drink I have ever had (Zevia Cola is) it's not something I would ever buy again. The difference between the two Vernor's is the effervescence. The standard has it to an extent unequalled by any other soft drink that I know of. In fact, it's lack of popularity may be because it's too strong for most people. However, if you like it, nothing else is as satisfying. The diet Vernor's, on the other hand, is completely unremarkable in that department. It tastes the same as the Standard, but it just doesn't have the punch that the standard drink does, and punch is what makes Vernor's Standard so remarkable.I'll have to keep looking. I  had settled on Coca-Cola Zero as being the best diet drink, but it seems to me that its taste has changed. I can't prove that, but it no longer satisfies.Oh, one more thing about Vernor's Diet drink. I ordered it on May the 23rd but it didn't arrive until June the 5th. That's too long to wait.

This plant germinates well, but so far the plant has grown only 2 feet tall. It does produce up to 4 ears per plant, but the ears seem small so far.  I grew it in really fertile soil and it was very well fertilized and watered.  Perhaps one of the cold fronts that came thru when it was six inches tall stunted it.
The raspberry is not as strong as the lemon flavor variety.  Still very good and you can't beat dark chocolate.  The raspberry flavor is a candy shell, like Jordan almonds.

While these are good, high quality nuts, the price listed here on Amazon is over twice what they sell for at the Target store.  What's going on with that?  When I saw the price, I figured it was a double package, but apparently it's not.  Amazon, are you seriously asking $25 for less than two pounds of nuts?

I have been purchasing this item directly at Target once a week for the past four months, and have been very satisfied with each purchase. The nuts taste fresh, they are crunchy, and a good variety. No peanuts!!! I made the transition from slated nuts to thesewithout any trouble, because they are so good. A great product that you will feel good about eating.
This is made with margarine. If you've had the brands made properly with butter, the difference is obvious. They are worth the extra money.

Robertson's Lemon Curd is the best tasting and best quality lemon curd available.  It is a product of England and no one makes a better lemon curd.  The perfect companion to a toasted English muffin and served up with a cup of tea.

I needed to view the product and see what was included in the gift basket so presentation of the items was great and informative.  The recipients were extremely pleased with the gift and thoroughly enjoyed the various tasty treats.  Thank you for this thoughtful Christmas Holiday Sleigh Gourmet Food Gift Basket.

What I like best about this syrup is, it's not obnoxiously sweet. I can use it to flavor seltzer, or as an 'additive' to other drinks (like hot cocoa). When fruity syrups are too sweet, they have almost a slightly bitter taste to them. This doesn't. It's very smooth, but it's not weak either. You don't have to put a ton of syrup in to taste it.
What is the sodium content per serving size of Wa Ja Shan Low Sodium Soy Sauce ? The product description does not provide the Nutrition Label

The fine print now says that the salmon is caught in Alaska and then shipped to China for processing and packaging.  I've been buying Wildside salmon for years but no more.  I have no faith in food products that are handled in China and I'm disgusted with Wildside.  I suppose profit margins wouldn't be quite as big if they freeze dried and bagged it in North America.

Unfortunately, for the safety of our pets we will no longer feed them ANY treats made/processed in China. This treat, while a great size for cats, is in fact made in China. Real shame I did not know that before buying it for my cats.
This is my cat's favorite treat, and it's good for her, too.  100 percent wild salmon with no additives.  I use it as a training reward -- and just because I love her.

My vet saw that Wildside Salmon is freeze-dried and processed in China and recommended I stop feeding my cats the treat. I'm so sad to agree. One cat positively "lives" for the rattle of this package, and I was so happy to think I was feeding him a healthy treat that he loved. No more. Wildside, please consider processing in a country whose standards we can trust. I'll gladly come back as a customer when you do.Update: In fairness, Wildside Salmon is alert to concerns; I went onto their website where they address fears about processing in China. They say the reason they process in China is to be able to ship more economically worldwide, and mention standards that the plant is held to through inspections and other means. They also state that the single ingredient(salmon) does not COME from China. I admit, I don't know how to assess the standards they mention, either here or in the U.S. but to be as safe as possible, I'm still looking at alternative freeze-dried salmon treats.

We have 5 cats... and 4 of them will stop whatever they are doing, no matter where in the house they are, no matter at what stage in their naps they are, no matter if I served them Beluga Caviar for dinner 5 minutes ago... if I shake a bag of WildSide Salmon Treats, 4 of 5 come running. My female will cry if she sees the bag until we give in and give her some. And one you start, they will keep coming back for more until there is nothing but dust, but then they hoover up the dust, too. I don't know why the 5th cat is a hold-out, but 4 of 5 of my cats recommend this treat...and one of them is getting sent to rehab, just like a crack addict. It's actually pretty hysterical.

My two kittens absolutly adore this stuff! We call it 'Kitty Crack.' :) They're pretty picky when it comes to treats (who knew a cat would turn down food!?) Some of the chunks are a little bit large, though and we have been known to break them into small pieces.

column9: What? sent from alaska to china? my cat will be heartbroken he has to give these up!
column10: I found these pure alaskan salmon treats at the vet where my kitty was undergoing radiation for skin cancer of the nose ( he is white/ fair skinned. and all those years of laying in the hot california sun gave him skin cancer of the nose.)  I am originally from seattle,washington and have been to Alaska many times.  I was thrilled when i found these treats of pure 100% Alaskan freeze dried salmon for my cat.  I knew they would be a healthy treat that would help his ammune system instead of hurting it.  My cat LOVES them too! He goes crazy when i pull out the bag, and sits in front of the pantry letting me know "its treat time".  I am so dissapointed to learn that the salmon is now being flown from Alaska to China to be packaged!  My cat will be even more dissapointed!  Please, wildside salmon co., go back to packaging in Alaska!  Even if it is more expensive to buy it would be worth it!  The whole reason i bought them & tried them in the first place was because of the fact that they came fresh from Alaska- and are 100% pure and healthy salmon!  I dont trust products from china and unfortunately my cat will miss these horribly.  shannonWildSide Salmon - Wild Alaskan Freeze Dried Salmon Treats for Cats, 3 oz. (3 Pack)

My cat knows what's in this package and comes running when he hears the telltale crinkle.  He loves these so much he'd go headfirst into the bag if I'd let him, and will actually take the treat from my fingers.The only criticism I have is that the shipping seems to crush/pulverize some of the treats, so when you get to the bottom of the bag it's tiny crumbs that are best suited for pouring over food or putting into the cat's food bowl alone.
Kitty finds these to be acceptable as far as cat treats go, and they don't break the bank as much as some of the other freeze-dried products.

Husband bought this treat for Mr. Kitty several years ago for Christmas, and we have not been able to be without it since.  If you enjoy demanding yowls near the treat cupboard, I highly recommend this freeze-dried salmon.  It's also nice to be able to make the fur-beasts happy without all the ground up chicken beaks and chemicals.  We love this stuff.  Be warned - it stinks!  The treats are big enough that you can give just one or two treats at a time, and make the bag last.

Crispy chunks, both my kittens like them  a lot. When they were barely 3 months old, I had to split the bigger pieces (no problem: they crack easily), but now they're very happy to eat them whole.  They're very light, so 3 oz includes a LOT of treats.The only treats they like more are the salmon flakes that make up Kitty Kaviar 1 oz. for every cat I've offered these to, and they will beg for more.  My cats wait for treat time and are now addicted to these.

I agree 100% with "nuttinbutdtruth"--this coffee is great and, thankfully, does not have the Starbucks "burnt" flavor which comes from roasting the beans to a higher internal bean temperature (i.e., burning them).  The Eight O' Clock 100% Colombian coffee is smooth with a real coffee flavor.  I have also bought Eight O' Clock Original coffee, and it tastes similar to the Colombian--both are great tasting and apparently are American Roast ("American Roast is a light to medium roast...This roast results in a full bodied, acidic cup of coffee.").Starbucks coffee, on the other hand, tastes to me like French Roast ("French roast is similar to Espresso roast only a little bit darker. This roasting style produces a full bodied coffee that has low acidity and a dominating bittersweet flavor.") or maybe Italian Roast ("Italian roasted coffee beans are nearly completely black in color. This roasting style produces a coffee that is very weak bodied with strong burnt flavors and low acidity.").  Each to their own, but according to many coffee experts, "...acidity is a good thing when it comes to coffee", and as stated on one coffee website: "In actuality the medium roast better preserves the true coffee bean as the darker roasts burn off some of the natural coffee oils and cause it to have a harsher taste. The medium roasts allow you to better savoir the way the coffee bean was intended to taste."  Also, according to the same website: "A darker roast can actually make a lower quality coffee bean taste better. The bean no longer relies on the flavors from its origin and leans more on the burnt flavor that results from the darker roasting process."According to another coffee website: "Maximum aroma and flavor, is generally found at the lighter end of the dark range. At the darkest end of the dark range, coffee has lost all of its acidity and has a distinctly burnt flavor."  And according to Wikipedia: "At lighter roasts, the bean will exhibit more of its 'origin flavor'; the flavors created in the bean by the soil and weather conditions in the location where it was grown. Coffee beans from famous regions like Java, Kenya, Hawaiian Kona, and Jamaican Blue Mountain are usually roasted lightly so their signature characteristics dominate the flavor. As the beans darken to a deep brown, the origin flavors of the bean are eclipsed by the flavors created by the roasting process itself. At darker roasts, the 'roast flavor' is so dominant that it can be difficult to distinguish the origin of the beans used in the roast."As a fan of American Roast coffee with a truer coffee bean flavor, I think this Eight O' Clock 100% Colombian coffee is extremely hard to beat.  It is also reasonably priced.

I'm the guy who buys the coffee for our office and I'm always on the lookout for something new for the staff to try, and this one was a BIG hit. Flavorful with a smooth richness one would expect from a more expensive brand but, without the price tag, and the burnt aftertaste of some of the other coffees to include Starbucks, this is one that made the office shortlist in well short order!

Perfect coffee at a really good price. Can't complain anything about it. Color, taste, smell are all great.I would prefer the smaller boxes to be sold at this price to retain freshness throughout the use.
This product is a good value for the money; costs less than at our local grocery store.  The taste is satisfactory for an every day coffee.

It's OK.  I was a bit disappointed because I was expecting this to be a 4 or 5 star rating, but I'm giving this a 3.  The taste is too mild for me.  There's no bitterness or acidic flavor, but I drink it with milk and sugar.
Tried this coffee for the first time today, and was amazed at how good it is. After reading the mostly favorable reviews had to give it a try. I'll be changing brands as this coffee is really good.

The taste of this coffee is as good as Juan Valdez Coffee, better than Starbuck's,  but cheaper. I know something about good coffee. I grew up in a coffee-growers farm in Colombia. This coffee is just what I wanted.

My husband is a fussy coffee drinker. When I told him I had ordered 8 o"clock coffee. His 1st comment was that is awful coffee. I asked him to try it out. He grumbling replied he would try it.He not only liked the coffee he said it was the best Colombian coffee he had had in a very long time and when was the next shipment coming.So I even increased my order to monthly. Just for him.

column9: Eight O'Clock Coffee, 100% Colombian Ground, 33-Ounce Bag
column10: At one time many years ago, this coffee was good.  Now, it just does not seem to have any flavor.  After having some of the other Columbian brands of coffee, this coffee will not do in my Cuisinart coffee maker.  It seems the few times I ordered this coffee, thinking the last batch I ordered was terrible, I found that the coffee had a stale aroma and the flavor was the same.  I cannot order this again.  Everyone has different tastes, but for my taste buds, this is not doing the trick.
This coffee tastes good and it is cheep at this price. I also bought French vanilla favor, which is terrible.

I don't buy this from Amazon, but I get it at a local grocery store.  I prefer buying coffee roasted locally, but when I'm not in the mood to make the trip somewhere else I'll pick up Eight O' Clock Columbian as my backup.
After Years of Mawell house, and Folgers...I finally found COFFEEEight O'Clock 100% Columbian is CoffeeThe Aroma alone from it's brewing,  is the tell tale signof a good coffee
Medium/light roast you can really smell and enjoy the aroma of high quality arabica.  If you are a fan of medium/light roast you will enjoy this coffee.  Smooth, no burning flavor.

I like good coffee, so I bought Eight o'Clock.  Most coffees are so bad these days that I have to look for good coffee.  Eight o'Cloce Columbian is great. Store brand Columbian used to be all I would ever buy, but those days are gone forever.  Most coffee just tastes nasty now. But Eight o'Cloce is still very good.

I have researched and this coffee beats them all.Although, I found if you order it from eight o'clock coffee.comwebsite you save 1/2 the cost.  It's double to buy it here.That concerns me due to my budget.annieEight O'Clock Coffee, 100% Colombian Ground, 33-Ounce Bag
Great flavor , real good taste coffee that you enjoy its smellAlso the amazon prime delivered it in two day !!!
The Eight O'Clock brand rarely disappoints and the Columbian Ground is a truly fine coffee...The rich flavor is deep and is (to Me) as fine a coffee as other brands priced much higher.

Eight O'Clock Colombian Coffee has the best flavor.  It is on par with Starbucks but at a more reasonable price. It is delivered every month (on time) so you can plan on always havng coffee.  Our guests are always praising my coffee and it is soooo much cheaper than buying it at the grocery store. It's a great bargin anyway you look at it!  Keep up the goood work AMAZON!!!!!!
I must say that this is one of the best coffees on the market. I have tried a lot of different coffees and some  of them were goodbut to me this has the full flavor that i enjoy.

This coffee is a solid choice for an office or break room where you probably don't have a grinder. It's not going to "wow" you with a deep, complex character, but it's not going to leave you with a nasty aftertaste either. It's a nice, mild taste that is surprisingly good (to me) when cold as well.You're probably going to want to transfer some amount to a smaller container and take it out of there when you make a cup, refilling from the bag when that container is empty. That will keep it a bit fresher.

Let me preface this review with a warning: I'm a coffee heretic.  That's right, I drink my coffee with milk and sugar.  Always have, always will.  I'm not interested in drinking straight black coffee and grimacing my way through a cup because I don't enjoy that overwhelming bitter taste the majority of packaged coffee has, so this review will be oriented toward the other coffee heretics out there.I don't drink drip coffee very often.  When I'm at home, the coffee maker is reserved for making iced tea - if I try to bring coffee within five feet of it, there's a freakout and I'm forced to clean it directly afterward with several cycles of vinegar.  When I'm at school, I don't generally have time in the morning and just grab a coffee on my way to class or use the crystallized coffee mix which comes in boxes.  I also don't have much money to spend on coffee.  When I do get to make a pot of drip coffee, it's usually on the weekend when I'm working on papers, and it's a joyous time indeed.Eight O'Clock coffee has a reasonable price at most supermarkets and on Amazon, putting it within my budget.  When I make a pot, it's always very dark and rich and has a smell which fills the apartment in a wonderful way.  I was surprised at how different it was from the crystallized stick coffee I'm used to.  For one, a little milk doesn't overwhelm it.  I actually needed more milk than usual to even the taste out while leaving just a bite of bitterness, and it actually melded beautifully, becoming slightly mellow and even richer.  The milk didn't hurt it but was a nice compliment.  A few spoonfuls of sugar added just the right bit of sweetness.This is a slow drinking coffee for me.  I like to linger with it while writing.  Unlike most coffee I drink just for a shot of energy, this is enjoyable.  It's smooth, not burnt, and just tastes plain good.  With the price point and the taste, buying a bag or three should be a no brainer.

We drink this in the morning and then somethning even stronger in the afternoon.  I like that we can buy the big bags of pre-ground coffee here.  None of the stores around us carry that option, and we really don't find much pleasure in grinding the beans ourselves.  The price is right too.
Rich bold coffee with a smooth taste. Brews well in type coffee maker . Great value and shipped for free.

This is a great tasting coffee any time of the day.  Sometimes I drink it black to get the full flavor and sometimes with a little half and half in it. Other times I use it to make iced coffee and it's a crowd pleaser.I like the convenience of the automatic delivery. It saves me time and a trip to the store.I hightly recommend this coffee product which I have been purchasing through Amazon.

We love Eight O'Clock Colombian coffee and buy both the whole bean and ground coffee in 33-ounce bags through Amazon Subscirbe and Save each month. It's hard to find in local stores, plus it's much cheaper with Subscribe and Save. Since we're avid daily coffee drinkers, buying the better brand at lower prices is a real plus.

This is the first time I have tried the Eight O'Clock brand and I was pleasantly surprised. I've tried several other Colombians (Coffee Bean, Starbucks, Nabob, and a couple others). I think this is my new favorite. It has that typical citrusy nuance of a good Colombian without the actual roasting smothering the flavor. I'll order another as soon as my current coffee inventory is depleted. I am currently drinking the Eight O'Clock  Original roast which is also good.
We've been buying this brand coffee from the shopping markets in our area and we've been paying this price for half the size! This size is twice as big, and is the same price.

Have been drinking this coffee for years. Have tried all the coffees recommend in Consumer Reports and this is my favorite. Can't find it in the stores locally so have been purchasing it from Amazon. Highly recommend!

If you are looking for the finest Colombian coffee I doubt you could do better than the Eight O'clock brand. This has been a gem for many years in The Great A&P and now Waldbaum's and Pathmark. Priced really reasonably on Amazon it is well wort the price.

Not sure what all the hype is about. Its an Ok coffee but nothing special. Kona and jamaican Blue mountain is better or the german coffee this is not something i would use again there are too many out there to choose from.

The coffee is sent in sealed bags, tastes fresh and has a nice flavor..  I love Columbian blend.  I have tried their other blends as well, and they are always smooth, no issues with bitter taste and the size of the bag is right for how much I use per week, smaller bags just weren't cutting it.

One of my favorites coffees to make at home has always been Folgers' Columbian, but this is even better. I went through it fast over the holiday season, and ran out before my subscription sent me more. In the meantime, I bought another brand at the grocery store, and was disappointed! I drink at least a couple cups of this daily, and never get sick of it.
I buy the big 33 oz bag for myself and the 4 smaller bags for my grown kids. Terrific aroma, terrific taste and such a wonderful way to wake up in the morning. I highly recommend this product.

column9: Works but does not taste very good
column10: This coffee has a decent amount of caffeine, but it's difficult even for me to drink, and I drink black coffee every day. This stuff reminds me of the icky Folgers stuff I drank every day in high school before I realized that coffee could taste good.Maybe it's just this flavor and not the brand, so I may consider trying another flavor in the future, though I'll probably keep trying out other brands a bit more before trying Eight O'Clock again.
very happy with this product price was great we liked it a lot we would recomend it to other people
I use this coffee that I grew up with, to mix with more expensive "flavors."By itself it is good; but with more expensive grinds, it improves both.

Glad to know there are lovers of this coffee out there because that means not everyone is on board with the Starbucks 'burnt' bean flavor I so deplore. This Eight O'clock coffee is for those of us who truly love the taste of coffee--just a simple cup--either black or with a little cream. This coffee is perfectly roasted to allow the true flavor of the bean to come through. Now it probably wouldn't stand up to the heavy creams and caramel and what ever else Starbucks sells in their coffee. At any rate I'm not buying it. Give me true coffee flavor any day. This and Melitta are my favorite coffees.

I've been drinking this in combination with Cameron's French Roast so it's a little difficult to rate on its own.  Having said that, this is a nice solid Columbian coffee that can be enjoyed on its own or mixed with another.  I tried several combinations but found that 50/50 works best when mixed.  Definitely worth the price of admission!

I'm not much of a coffee snob and usually make do with stuff from the big box stores. That being said, every time the wife and I drink this coffee we both stop and say "this is pretty good."Definitely a solid buy.
This is a good coffee for the price (~5$). I enjoyed it.If you are budget-minded, I recommend the coffee.

column9: Still the best for the money
column10: I've been drinking this for over 30 years and still find it to be the best medium blend out there. You can find better but not within this price range. It is also a plus to receive fresh product and not be concerned the expiration date is within a few days or weeks. All in all a very pleasant experience and TASTE.

this coffee is pritty good, much better than say foldgers and it has a good price, i'd buy it again as soon as i run out, it's far cheaper than starbucks even at costcoand in my opinion it tast better.

This is our favorite brand of coffee...and we are "coffee snobs."  (My husband and I are former owners of an upscale coffee shop in a touristy town)Its even better than it arrives via subscribe and save every month...and at such a great price!

We love this coffee, and was so happy to see it available by subscription.  Suddenly, the price is a LOT higher, and is no longer a savings.  I will be purchasing it in the supermarket, with coupons once again.  Oh, Amazon!

100% Colombian coffee is very smooth to drink. The taste is subperb. I use a peralator for my coffee, and, it perks just great. Again, great coffee. I say buy this coffee if you light great flavor, smooth to the taste, and great to drink.Sincerely,David A. Kahle ("Super Chef")

Eight O'Clock Colombian coffee is one of the best coffees out there. We tried a number of coffees in the same price range(that was before coffee prices skyrocketed)and the Eight O'Clock Colombian was the best tasting. If you want a good tasting coffee get Eight O'Clock 100% Colombian.
What a great deal the auto-ship option is and what a great price for our daily caffiene fix!! we will never be stuck without coffee again waiting for our favorite to go on sale with this deal!
Love this coffee and it was a great price!  I will continue to buy bulk this way if the price stays right.

My parents used to take me to the A&P supermarket where  I got used to watching them select this brand. Their metal percolator with the glass cap was on the stove and the aroma of this delicious coffee filled the house. 8 o'clock coffee is better than any gourmet coffee I've ever tasted, at less than half the price. I treated my friends who stopped by with this coffee, and I hope you do too!

I didn't understand why my parents only buy Eight O'Clock coffee until I tried it.  After the first cup, I was sold - it even smells richer when you open the bag. I only drink columbian coffee, and now I only buy Eight O'Clock brand dolumbian coffee..  and I get it delivered via autoship from Amazon so I don't worry about running out.

Not knowing how fast I would go through 2 pounds, I ordered it every 3 months.  When I realized that I was drinking more coffee because it is SO GOOD, I increased the delivery to every 2 months.  Somehow that caused the delivery date to be put off for another month and my original order which should have arrived in August was canceled.  NO no no no.  I've been out for a month now and really want my 8 O'clock Columbian, which has not been schedualed to arrive for yet another month.  It is not nice to give me something that good and then postpone it for so long, and there is nowhere else that I can get it any faster. Eight O'Clock Coffee, 100% Colombian Ground, 33-Ounce Bag

It was suggested that the coffee I prefer tasted like "dish water" so I asked for suggestions regarding a good Colombian Ground Coffee.  I was told that Eight O'Clock Coffee, Colombian would be a great coffee. Although it was pricier than the Folger's Lively Colombian, I decided to buy it along with the Folger's and the Maxwell House Colombians and do a side-by-side taste test.  Results:  Maxwell was bold, smooth, full-bodied dark.  Folger's Lively Colombian was lighter but more complex, smooth, and "lively" and absolutely lovely.  The Eight O'Clock Colombian was dark, flat, bitter even after trying to adjust measurements.  I don't regret spending my money on this adventure and really wanted to see what it was all about. I will donate the remainder of the grounds to an organization that needs really strong coffee.  "Delicious is in the tongue of the taster." To each his own.

Something changed in the past year (it's December 2011) and Eight O'Clock Columbian has officially fallen off of the great-coffee radar.  What a shame, I'm off to find something that's as good as this once was.
Really puzzled with all the favorable reviews! The coffee I got was nauseating. It had a dry nasty stinky flavor, and was NOT Good at all.
Very tasty and aromatic coffee and have ordered it several times before; been satisfied with it.  Woud recommend this product.

I had never tried this coffee before but I figured what the heck it fell in my price budget. Well let me tell you the coffee fairies knew what they were doing when they created this coffee. It has a nice nutty taste and smooth flavor. It works well in any drip coffee maker and smells delicious when it is brewing.
I am a coffee lover and I have been on this coffee for a good 4 months now. That says it all!! This is one of the best dark coffee I have tried.
I thought this coffee would be a good substitute for the Starbucks roasted coffees, but not. The flavor was OK but did not get that "roasted" flavor found in the Starbucks coffees.

This coffee brand is extremely bitter and very high in acid. I adjusted the levels of grounds high and low several times, but the results were all about the same. I was very disappointed in this product, I will never use this brand again.
This is the worst tasting coffee I have ever tasted. Flavorless, bitter and acidic taste.  I threw the whole bag out.
This was the worst tasting coffee i ever bought, no taste and it did not taste or smell like 8 oclock coffee

I have ordered the Italian Roast and loved it, but this has to be some of the worst coffee I have ever had. I cant even return it which is sad. It is like drinking bad coffee in a bad restaurant. It has a bitter burnt taste to it. I will not be buying this again.

THIS IS A REVIEW OF AMAZON'S SERVICE AND NOT THE QUALITY OF THE COFFEE:I originally purchased three bags of this product when it was on sale direct from Amazon. One out of those three bags was actually vacuum sealed and all had expiration dates within a month period. I guess the dates were the reason they were on sale but seriously, not sealed properly makes for stale coffee and is not acceptable. I complained and was refunded my money. I since have ordered several more and each time they come loose (not vacuum sealed), I'll complain to Amazon and so far they've been good about refunding my money but shouldn't they have some kind of quality control? If the bag is soft to the touch it's garbage. I guess they ship this crap out knowing few complain and they get to make money on what a grocery store would likely have to discard. Amazing to me that they'd waste their time and mine. Anyone want some free coffee to use as a deodorizer?
We did not care for the flavor of this coffee at all. We passed it on to our son, who also did not care for it.

column9: I ordered 100% columbian coffee and was sent 100% arabica.
column10: I ordered 100% Columbian coffee and 100% arabica coffee arrived. according to the policy I have no recourse but to absorb the cost myself and to trash this Arabica CRAP coffee. There is not a refund for this Arabica coffee, for years we could get 100% Columbian coffee, it is a large bean grown in the Columbian highlands. The aroma is easy on the nostrils, and while brewing the aroma permeates the entire house. Now try that with Arabica, the taste is bitter and unappealing to the senses.

This matcha may not really jump out at you compared to some of the other divine sounding flavors Red Leaf offers, but it is not one to be overlooked! The nutty flavor is so good and really strong, it permeates the whole cup and you'd swear there were ground up Macadamia nuts in this latte! It's rich, creamy, and just divine. The flavoring is spot-on, super natural tasting and not at all artificial. One of their best!

Well I have to admit I was not as excited to try Macadamia Nut Matcha as I had been other flavors. A nut matcha to me seemed to be something one would mix with another outstanding sounding flavor, such as white chocolate mixed with macadamia nut perhaps. Alas white chocolate has not been released yet. I am sure I could have found something else to mix with this flavor but since it is my first time having it and I wanted to do a review I had it on its own.I can only say WOW just simply WOW. This is the most amazing macadamia nut taste! It is such a strong flavor!All I can say is once again I am absolutely not disappointed in Red Leaf's quality and flavors. I was so worried this flavor would only be so-so, a little nutty but not really having any true flavor unto itself. Fact is this tastes more macadamia nutty than anything else I can remember having outside of macadamia nuts themselves straight out of a can or jar, and I rarely have the nuts that way. Usually when I have macadamia nuts they are in a cookie somewhere.Let me just say this, if I had to choose between a couple of the cookies, and this matcha - I would pick the matcha hands down every time! And know that while I say that White Chocolate Macadamia Nut Cookies are may all time favorite cookies!As always RLT's base matcha is superior to any other I have had.

Wow. I ordered the 8 oz bag and this is a GENEROUS 8 ounces. Quite a lot here. I'm sure I'll use it, but if you only use these occasionally you may want to consider getting a smaller size, as this company doesn't stint one bit on quantity. This bag was packed to the brim, and I mean packed tight. None of that "contents settle" stuff some merchants try to pull. Very nice to see such fast service too.

I bought the 4 oz. package of this last time, and compared flavors, as I'd also found some at an International Market. (We live in California and have a big Mexican foods section.) The grocery store brand was a few bucks cheaper, but we found ourselves using more to get the same amount of flavor. Also, the grocery store brand had more of an "ashy" flavor, as opposed to a good "smokey" flavor. So I'm getting the larger package this time. We add it to a "Chipotle Potato Soup" at The New Deli, and it's a hit.
I do like a good Chipotle(Who Doesn't?)and these are the best. Wonderfull in a pot of anything, Chili, Lima Beans even scrambled eggs! I recommend them highly!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Yummy white peach halves in sugar syrup! No corn syrup!
column10: Delicately sweet, these Roland white peach halves are packed in sugar and water, the old fashioned way, with NO corn syrup, so the natural flavor of the peaches shines thru. (About six halves per can.) They are perfect right out of the can, or try making upside down cake with them (instead of pineapple) adding a touch of cinnamon. Wonderful! A great Summertime lunch, too, served with reduced fat cottage cheese. We also make individual luncheon treats by adding one peach half to a half cup pyrex bowl of lemon Jello, then unmold round side up for each guest. (Garnish with fresh mint.) Highest quality - you won't be disappointed!

Being white peaches, the flavor is muted but it is still delicious!  Each can has about ~4 whole peaches sliced in half.  They are packed in light syrup which is not great but may be necessary to preserve the terrific really ripe yet firm peach quality.  This is a great way to spice up a cake topping or ice cream or just to eat by themselves.  Roland does a great job preserving their fruit (forget their vegetables though) with all their great flavors.  The cans sit in your cabinet waiting for when you need them, not for when they sit rotting in your refrigerator because you did not use them within their limited time span.  I will be buying these again......they truly are delicious!

I bought a box of these canned white peach halves because they were on sale with a very good discount, and because the chances of ever finding fresh white peaches (which I understand don't ship or keep well at all) in my local farmer's market is next to nil, so this seemed like my best chance to try this fruit.  As others have noted, these peach halves are packed in syrup, rather than juice, which is not normally my preference, but otherwise I have no complaints at all.The white peaches seem to have a much more delicate flavor than the robust yellow peaches we're all more used to, but they're a lovely appetizer or dessert on their own.I will confess, though, that my favorite way to serve these has been to empty an entire can (syrup and all) into a covered glass bowl, toss in a handful of frozen red raspberries, and let them sit in the refrigerator together for an hour or a day until I'm ready to serve them for dessert.  The raspberry flavor nicely complements the white peach flavor, and the peach halves and their syrup take on a gorgeous range of dark pink to lavender to plum shades of purple.  Tasty AND pretty to eat (and even with the syrup, still more nutritious than most desserts of comparable appeal, I'd argue).And if you warmed the white peach and raspberry combo slightly and served it with scoops of vanilla ice cream, you could call it a lazy cook's version of Peach Melba.  But I think the ice cream is unnecessary, myself, and enjoy a cold dessert that requires no cooking whatsoever, now that daytime temperatures are back in the upper 80's.

column9: Like no peach I have ever tasted
column10: Peaches are beyond crisp. Had to poach them for ten minutes in order to use them in peach melba. Taste more like an unripe pear.
These did not taste like other canned white peaches I've had before.  It had a slight metallic taste from the can.

It has arrived badly damaged. Only two cans in the center of the box were in good condition. The box was so flimsy that has arrived tattered, and the post office taped it all around the box. I was disappointed because it's hard to find white peach can.

I have not tasted the product but am extremely dissatisfied with Amazon. Such shoddy merchandise should be an embarrassment to the company. ALL the cans, not just one or two were dented (and we're not talking about aesthetic nicks here). How can Amazon send out such low quality items? I will not be ordering this product again. Unacceptable.

I've eaten FRESH white peaches in the past. This is my first time tasting them canned. These taste more like canned pears; firm minus the grit texture. Actually I thought I had grabbed the wrong can from the pantry and went to the trash to verify these were actually peaches. Not sure I'd buy these again.

White peaches are my favorite during the summer!I love canned peaches during the winter, usually.  This brand of fruit was the most DISGUSTING I have ever had the misfortune to attempt to eat.As soon as my shipment arrived I opened a can and poured it into a bowl. So far so good.  Then me and my daughter ate some. We both looked at each other with an odd look. Ok, maybe the first bite is a little off. So I try another bite, yuck.I checked the side of another can to see why these peaches would taste so funny.  The ingredients state:  white peach halves, water, sugar. Packed exclusively for American Roland food Corp.  New York, NY 10010.  Product of ChinaPeaches, water, and sugar can't possibly taste this nasty!  The texture of the liquid has an unusual viscosity to it for light syrup. This produces an odd mouth feel after the second bite, can't exactly explain it.  Something is just off.Based on the other reviews that are favorable I will give the rest of the box (11 more cans left) to the next can food collection, maybe someone else will enjoy them.My review:  YUCK, NASTY!
pure clear oil, no overwhelming smell, convenient size bottles.  Pricy, but you get a very good quality product. Will buy again
Sunflower oil has such great health qualities and this 32-ounce bottle is a good kitchen size.Love the product with a good price and flawless shipping.

column9: I cannot even fathom this product
column10: When the package from Del Monte showed up at my door, I immediately jumped off the couch and was like, "Oh to the yes". When I took them out of the cans, the kraut was fresh as if it had been pickled and canned that very morning. Everyone thought it was amazing: my wife, my kids, my dog, and especially myself. I would definitely order this again and will tell all my friends to do the same in an email, beginning, right, now.The only reason I gave it four stars and not five is because when I was struggling to open the package the cardboard gave me a pretty bad cut on my left thumb. Del Monte should look into cutting down on the excessive packaging of their canned vegetables - they are already in aluminum cans, you can just put them in a paper bag. That would be better for the earth, too.
Like this tea.....wasn't exactly what I had expected though.  It is a little tart and not very strong.  Used twice as much to make it stronger.

column9: Not sure that there is actually tea in this product
column10: I should have paid more attention to the photos of this product when purchasing it.. I thought it looked like it was red-ish brown..but it is truly as red as Kool-aid and tastes completely unlike tea to me - it was most like unsweetened Kool-aid in my opinion.I'm an avid iced tea drinker - I drink it year 'round and a pitcher of tea is always at the ready in our fridge. I tried this tea to see if it would be a nice one to add to my rotation (I like Paradise Iced Tea and China Mist Mango & Passion Fruit ice teas). It was so horrible tasting I couldn't drink it. It doesn't taste like Mango at all - it tastes vaguely of herbal hibiscus and rose - it doesn't taste fruity at all.I plan to give it away to someone who likes herbal teas -- because I'm quite certain it lacks any black tea (or any tea at all?)..and therefore wouldn't be useful to me (I like caffeine in my tea).
This tea is good but my package was late and the flimsy box was inside a plastic bag. Needless to say the box and many of the tea bags were mangled. Very poor packaging.

Had a cup of this tea and it was like reliving the past. Always drank this blend at a small Chinese Resturant in Queens, NY. After my first sip I felt like I was back thier enjoying a big pot of tea. Smooth and Relaxing, great blend and will be ordering more soon.

column9: Don't know how this one passed the taste test...
column10: Has a chemical flavor to it and it literally smells like vomit to me.  No resemblance of any con queso I've ever had!I love con queso salsa and have tried several variates.  Tostido's brand is pretty good, compared to this one.  I'd go with that!

I bought this elsewhere (locally) because it was on sale, and it was absolutely disgusting. It tastes and smells like vinegar and chemicals, not the creamy cheesy flavor I expect from a queso. I've never met a queso I didn't like until I made the mistake of wasting my money on this garbage. Avoid this product if you don't want to permanently damage your taste buds.

column9: Is it poop or is it vomit?
column10: Most of my family of eight managed to eat this cold the other night with chips.  We thought it tasted weird--kind of like it has green olive juice in it.Tonight my family was gone and I decided to heat some in the microwave.  It had just finished heating when the family returned.  They walked in the house and covered their noses.  One said it smelled like a terrible poopy diaper.  Another said it smelled like vomit.  My nine-year-old thought I had somehow invented something new and utterly disgusting.Is it more like poop or vomit?  Buy a case and decide for yourself!

column9: I would give this '0' stars if possible- DO NOT BUY!!!
column10: I am on a mini mission to tell people how horrid this Newman's con Queso tastes- we just threw it out.  Don't buy it.  I'm not sure what it's made if, but it ain't cheese folks.  How could a guy that I've always respected put his name on something so awful with proceeds going to charity?  Hello- you have little proceeds with products like this!  I am hoping that this product is an aberration and not the norm.We did not buy this on amazon (where I frequently shop), but here's a forum where people who care can ensure others of their experiences- just sayin'.

I bought this tonight - and after having some - I washed my mouth out and looked online to see if there was a recall... No, there is no recall on this "con queso" - it's just bad. column9: Great food - INCORRECT PRICING INFO BY AMAZON
column10: Blue Buffalo is an above average quality dog food - and I can't recommend it highly enough. column9: My Terriers Actually Like This Stuff
column10: The "Dynamic Duo," (a male Westie and a female Scotty), have been eating Blue Buffalo's Adult Weight Control Chicken and Brown Rice kibble for more than two years. Well, to be entirely honest, they eat equal parts of Blue Buffalo and Natural Ultramix, supplemented with fresh boiled chicken, peas, carrots, and apples - and an occasional can of Halo or Evanger's. So why do we include the Blue Buffalo?First, because it is made from the best ingredients - if you were going to make the stuff yourself, besides chicken, you'd probably include grains like brown rice, barley, oats and rye, (no wheat, corn or soy), and vegetables like tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and sweet potatatoes, not to mention a few extras like blueberries, cranberries and, (I swear), green tea extract.Second, because they actually like it. And if you've got a finicky dog, you know what I'm talkin' about. Our Scotty will eat almost anything, (delicacy prevents me from going into any detail on this point), but our Westie? This is a dog for whom every bite is a thoughtfully considered proposition. Should I eat this? Hmmmmmm? Maybe not. Perhaps I should move it from my bowl to the living room carpet and contemplate it? Ah.... It's Blue Buffalo. I'll eat it.We generally buy the 6 pound bag - that means that we buy more frequently than we would if we were buying the larger sizes - but it's easier to store and stays fresher.Many people are concerned about feeding their dogs "dry" food - and to some extent, I share that concern. But when it's a quality product like Blue Buffalo and is fed as part of a "menu" that includes other fresh and healthy "entrees," I think that it's an excellent addition to your dog's diet.[This is an up-date to my review: Economic times being what they are, something had to give - so a couple of months ago, we eliminated the Natural Ultramix from our terriers' diets. We also eliminated the canned foods, (my wife is convinced that even a small amount of canned food was contributing to our Scotty's tendency to put on a little extra weight). So we've been feeding them Blue Buffalo exclusively, supplemented with fresh boiled chicken, peas, carrots and apples. This change has had no ill effects on their health or appearence - and they continue to love the stuff. I remain convinced that when it comes to kibble, Blue Buffalo is an outstanding product.]

column9: A solid entry to the GoPicnic lineup: vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free
column10: If you've already tried GoPicnic meals before, you know basically what to expect here: a main dish, a couple of side items, and a dessert.While all GoPicnic meals are gluten-free, this meal is designed to avoid SEVEN types of allergens: wheat, dairy, fish, shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, and eggs. It's also completely vegan. Just about anyone should be able to eat each of the included components of the meal.The main dish is SunButter Creamy Sunflower Seed Spread with Crunchmaster Multi-Grain Crackers.The sunbutter is pretty interesting- you have to sort of knead it before opening the package to make sure it's nice and mixed and pliable. It tastes a lot like peanut butter and is similarly sticky. The texture is more on the smooth side than the crunchy side. The crackers are pretty good- they're crisp and have a mild, subtle flavor.The side dishes are a seed-and-fruit trail mix and a fruit snack.The trail mix is really good- it's Mountain Mambo Nut Free Trail Mix, Gluten, Dairy & Nut Free, the main ingredients of which are pre-shelled sunflower seeds and bits of dried fruit (raisin and apple). My only complaint is that there's only 0.75oz of it, so it goes really quickly. The fruit snack is Niagara Natural Simply Fruit Tropical Bites (no Amazon link, sorry). They're shaped like little pellets or logs and have a flavor and texture that vaguely reminded me of Fruit Roll-Ups. They're mostly made of apple-based ingredients, but a few other fruit juices are also included.The dessert is a Enjoy Life Double chocolate Crunchy Cookie). The cookie is definitely crunchy! I was surprised when I bit into it, though not really in a bad way. The flavor was okay, but honestly, I'd have preferred a little square of real chocolate like you get in the GoPicnic Hummus + Crackers meal.One thing to note, though, is that this all ends up being a little light on protein. This meal has 12g, versus 25g for GoPicnic Hummus + Crackers. Also, a word of warning: although the meal is pretty healthy, it doesn't skimp on the fat. This little box crams in 26 total grams of fat.Bottom line:Pros: Gluten-free and nut-free; even picky eaters should enjoy every item; high in fiber and low in sodiumCons: Not very filling; flavors, while good, aren't very exciting or varied; dessert is good, but not great; fat content is surprisingly high(If this review was helpful for you, please choose "Yes" below!)
