These are different from your average packaged bar. Each individual package contains two thin, crunchy bars as opposed to the standard one sticky, chewy bar.They have a great nutty taste, and are not too sweet. Perfect with a cup of tea, and one is enough... which is good, because it makes for a satisfying yet not-fattening snack.HOWEVER, to call them "high-fiber" is beyond misleading. Each individual bar contains 1 (ONE) gram of fiber.

One of the original "healthy" mass market bars and perhaps still one of the healthiest and tasiest despite the High Fructose Corn Syrup.Prepackaged granola bars are convenient: they are neatly packaged in a wrapping that keeps your hands clean and the bar from melting into your bag. Plus, they keep longer than a homemade bar.  The Nature Valley Oats 'n Honey bar is still one of our backpacking and snack-on-the-go staples for this reason.  We also like that they are all oat and have no crisped rice fillers that many other bars have. We also use this broken up over yoghurt or over cooked fruit to add variety when camping.One thing we did notice recently is that the ingredients list is different for same product in different packaging.  Some list pecan flour and other nut flours while others dont.  While all their different products may be manufactured in the same facility and cross contamination is expected, there IS a big difference as to whether actual ingredients are added to the mix.While there may be tastier options out there and healthier options, the Nature Valley line is the most widely available and the most versatile bar.

Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Oats 'n Honey have a flavor like a tasty oatmeal cookie. I really like them and they are good for you too. I suppose you could make these morsles but who has time. I highly recommend these for the fiber and nutritional value.Chow down!

These have a denser oatmeal flavor than most granola bars - in a good way.  The first bite makes it seem that they are not sweet enough but then that is followed up with an almost too sweet after-flavor.  There is good flavor separation between the honey and the brown sugar (syrup) that is used.  There are two bars in each foil and that is the serving size so you seem to get a lot of bang for the buck (180 calories). I bet it would make a great topping for baked apples . . . . .

These granola bars are the best! Where do I begin? Nature Valley bars are 100% natural, include no high fructose corn syrup, contain a good source of whole grain, include no trans fat, and total caloric and carbohydrate intake are relatively low. These bars are perfect for breakfast or can be consumed as a snack. I'm a health nut and I approve these bars without question [and I'm pretty picky about all the information I have posted above)!!The only minus (if anything) is that the bars are quite crunchy/hard; therefore, if you are one with sensitive teeth, you might want to break down the bars into bite size pieces or soak the bars in yogurt or milk [if necessary]. But, do yourself a favor and try Nature Valley crunchy granola bars!!

I've been eating these NV Granola Bars since I was but a lad, munching away on them with orange slices at soccer games.  They're timeless, and a sweet treat.  Yes, they're probably not too healthy considering they have a fair bit of sugar.  But in this economic climate, they're cheaper than say a Clif bar, and no less tasty.I rarely eat these bars plain- usually I break it up into my plain yogurt with fresh fruits, or into my cereal. 5 thumbs up for a nice snack.

column9: Oats: A grain ... to support the people
column10: I have been a fan of Nature Valley granola bars for years.  They come in many varieties.  My favorites lately have been the Pecan Crunch and Peanut Butter bars.  So, I was pleased to learn that Amazon now offers the bars in their many different types.Certainly, Oats and Honey are a classic combination. Oats go way back. Samuel Johnson included a definition of oats in his 1755 Dictionary of the English Language.  I have adapted liberally from his definition for my title.  Actually, Samuel Johnson said: "Oats: A grain, which in England is generally given to horses, but in Scotland appears to support the people."  Little did he know that two and a half centuries later, England's colonial offspring would enthusiastically endorse oats as a food for people.Earlier this month, I spent a week skiing in Colorado at Vail, The ticket counters were equipped with baskets of the Oats and Honey bars provided free of charge.  It was a nice gesture considering the almost $100 daily ticket price.  The granola bars pack nearly 100 calories for a single bar, and obviously double that for a two-bar pack.I took the Oats bars with me skiing, but I also depend on them for hiking.  An extra 200 calories is what you may need to give you enough energy to get up the last 200 feet to a mountain summit.  The taste is good.  They do not melt.  If you get tired of the Oats, there is always a choice: Pecan, Almond, or Peanut Butter, to provide variety.PS: Despite an assertion that the Oats and Honey bars contain high fructose corn syrup, it is not on the list of ingredients for my bars

While the bars are wonderful, the price isn't a deal at all.  If you were to go to your local grocery store or Target, you can get an entire box for $2.50.  Here the price comes out to $3.43 per box.  That is alot of money more per box!

If you're like me, you probably don't need 12 boxes of 12 of these things, but if you have a large family and they all like them, by all means check out this deal!I was using them with my lunch, but I just couldn't take it anymore after months of eating these... Gave me heartburn a little bit. I ended up giving the rest to people I know... But, I still love these bars! I just got a little burnt out is all...

The package is 12 packages of 6 Pouches.  In each pouch, there is two bars.  But who cares how many bars in each pouch?  The weigh of each pocuch matters, but not how manufacturer package the each pouch.  If manufaturer decides to package each pouch with 8 small tiny bars, it does not make the package more valuable.  In short, I thought it is 12 x 12 snacks for me, which is good price.  It ended up 12 X 6 snacks for me, which is not so good price.  I can buy the same product at local stores cheaper and at smaller quarntity.  Why shall I order online and buy large quantity if there is no saving?  Disappointed.

Had this on automatic order.  3 orders ago most bars crumbly, 2 orders ago most bars crumbly, last order stale and crumbly.  Reported this but no response.  Unfortunate since when previously ordered most bars intact and fresh.  Must be a shipper problem?  No longer on automatic reorder.  Will purchase elsewhere.
My hubbie loves to take them to work for breakfast.

This is a great tasting product, however, it is unfortunately NOT an all natural product as they would lead you to believe. It is a shame that so many manufacturers have started using high fructose corn syrup in their products. Any nutritionist, particularly those dealing with diabetics, will tell you without exception what high fructose corn syrup does to  elevate your blood sugar. It is a manufactured product they would have you believe is completely safe, but look at the incidence of diabetes in this country. Why is the the first ingredient the nutritionist say to completely avoid. It is worse than sugar in what it does to the blood sugar and I can't even get into the ways it helps to create obesity. Too bad, I also stopped drinking Arizona and Lipton iced tea product for the same reason. Hello, out there!! There are natural sweeteners like stevia and xlitol that are truly GOOD for you!!! Why is high fructose corn syrup actual banned in several countries, including Canada? Could it be that the pharmaceutical companies helped to develop and expand the use of this product so they could sell more drugs????? Many foreign countries that pay for universal healthcare must think so. Why else would they ban it to reduce their medical costs?? Hello FDA. Where the heck are you???

I'm afraid I don't have a lot of experience with granola bars. I did want something to take the edge off my hunger between meals that wasn't heavy. These are a bit dry, but very sweet.I can understand the attraction because these contain so much fiber. The issue is that they taste so much more like candy. The amount of sugar in them worries me. There doesn't appear to be much more to these than oats.There are two bars inside the foil. They break quite easily and have a tendency to go crumbly. I found that one packet really wasn't very satisfying. The portion is quite small. For an adult I would say two or three of these would suffice with a large glass of water.Overall, I didn't find anything particularly attractive about this brand. I would have preferred something with a little more volume and taste other than over powering sugar.

This one of my favorite Caribbean snack from Jamaica that made me really retake about what porridge actually taste like. This is rich in flavor, though I wish it didn't have some milk,bits of sugar and soy since I'm a vegetarian but hey I prefer eating this than those mainstream trashy candy that has too much garbage in it and it less allergic for me, but it's best to talk to your dietitian about this product before eating. This a put in hot water, let sit for 7 minutes, stir, and ready to eat.
POSITIVE: I LOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOVE THIS PORRIDGE IT TASTE SO GOOOOOOOOODNEGATIVE : IT'S TOO EXPENSIVE IN THE SUPERMARKETOVERALL IT TASTE GOOD, I LOVE THE HOMINY , THE OATMEAL, AND THE BANANA PORRIDGE

when i first bought this product i thought instant cornmeal it csnnot be that tasty! wow i cud not believe it it tasted like the real thing. very easy to travel around with and a small flask of hot water. Very filling.
i love this tea for dieting its the best i will always purchase this tea for me and my family

column9: great healthy spice- perfect for everything and with no salt
column10: This Vegie pepper is perfect for soups, steaks, lamb, salads and almost everything - and so healthyy as it contains no salt.

I use this seasoning on nearly everything I used to use salt and pepper on. With it I don't even miss the salt. It adds just enough heat without being too hot like cayenne tends to be. For someone trying to cut back on salt, it is a godsend.

a friend told me that this coffee was the best she had ever tasted. said i needed to get some. well, i did, and guess what, this coffee is WONDERFUL! this is the second time i have gotten it and i will defenitely order it again. i highly reccomend this great tasting coffee, and oh, by the way, the aroma will send you back for cup after cup.

column9: DELISH!!! Love this spread any time of the day!
column10: I love this spread...tastes very similar to Nutella but creamier. Perfect for breakfast, snacks or when you need something quick. I am completely satisified with this item...kids will love it too!
This Nut Chocolate Spread is just the right thing to start a day. Great brain food and perfect before a  workout.

Unfortunately we can't seem to find this stuff at the grocery store anymore, so thankfully it's still available from some sellers here on Amazon.  It tastes really great without that "sugar free" aftertaste and is great just by itself, or put into a smoothie to give it a little kick.

For just a cup of good decaffinated tea, hard to beat.Not a fancy "designer" tea, but if you drink substantial quantities, especially for its general health properties, then this is my gold standard.Used to buy quantities at Sams and Costco, but neither has carried it for a while, and my wife and I didn't wish to buy small quantities at full retail from grocery stores, so Amazon saves the day again.

column9: Excellent value for a decent tea
column10: While a cup of Lipton is not going to stack up taste-wise to more premium brands or a good loose tea, they make a very solid, decent product that tastes good either hot or cold.  This particular packaging is a really good value if you get it on one of the Amazon sales -- the cost per 48 bags (the number you get in a normal size box) comes out much better than if you buy it in a store or even in the 12 box pack from Amazon.Came quickly and well packaged.
Tea arrived on time and is being enjoyed. That's about all I can say about it for now anyway. OK?
My mom drinks a cup or two of tea everyday and makes iced tea so we go through these pretty fast. Amazon has a great price!

column9: Lipton Decaf is just the BEST for making iced tea
column10: We make lots of iced tea in iced tea maker, and Decaf Lipton tastes so much better than other brands.
very tasty and delicious. I like this tea very much. It has a very good flavour and my whole family likes when I serve them a cup of tea,

column9: Great price for 72 count box & you get 2 boxes of decaf tea!
column10: I love Lipton decaf tea and so does my entire family.  The price on this one is excellent for the 72 count box and you get 2 boxes for the price! (72 bags per box is also difficult to find in our local stores).  Ordering through Amazon saves me the long drive to the store as it is delivered directly to me.  This is very convenient and also saves us money in gas money and product pricing.  I use subscribe and save on this item and also order for my mom as well.  We drink a lot of iced tea and this is our favorite (and it makes a decent cup of hot tea though usually we do get flavored tea for hot tea).  We use 3 bags to make a large pitcher of ice tea and we use 4 bags for making sun tea, which is a larger container.  Either way, it tastes wonderful with no bitterness at all, which is one of the reasons we like Lipton decaf.  So, it not only tastes good, it saves money, plus it is convenient -- can't beat that!

Lipton has black tea has always been my favorite tea that I drunk for over 40 years. I start each day with a cup of Lipton tea, with a bit of milk and sweetener, and I look forward to Lipton's slightly bracing bitter taste.In the afternoon I make up a batch of Lipton iced tea and I look forward to drinking it freshly iced with a bit of lemon. I love Lipton iced tea as it's so refreshing.Highly recommend.

We love to drink iced tea and recently found some pre-made stuff at the local store. We soon became addicted to the stuff and it quickly became an expensive habit (haha). So we decided to try to make our own. There was a recent sale on these Lipton tea bags so we decided to try and make our own. Wow, there is a lot of sugar that goes into store-bought iced tea! It was nice to control the amount of sugar that went into the tea AND this package made four times what we got from the store and at a quarter of the price! Oh, and the taste was still great :-)
This is a good product.  I enjoy my iced tea!  I have it on "Subscribe" so I  do not have to remember to reorder.  That works great too!

column9: Very nice light tea, good cold, not so good hot
column10: Makes a great light and refreshing iced tea since the sugar and lemon carries the tea nicely but it doesn't work well with a hot tea, especially if you're drinking it plain.  I am not a big fan of caffeine so I just make a hot cup of tea with 3 of these bags for some robust tea flavor.  You have to sacrifice flavor for lack of caffeine.  Overall it's a nice tea to drink.

I was using the Walmart brand "Great Value" tea bags for my ice tea, which we drink EVERYDAY since we live in the deep HOT SOUTH. These bags are very good tasting and the bags hold up better in hot water than the great value brand, not that great value was bad by no means in taste, but their bags leak like a sift in hot water and you get LOADS of tea flakes in your ice tea, who likes that!. We tried these as we are as said, everyday tea drinkers and we like them, hope this helps make your choice of purchasing easier. P.S. yes, we make our tea the old fashion way, we boil the water first, then throw the bags in and let them soak for a while, tastes awesome and you have sterile water which is best on taste and for your health.

I purchase all of my tea from Amazon. I don't drink coffee so I drink a lot of tea. Best price you can get anywhere & just about any brand you would want. I use this for my summer iced tea & add fresh lemon. I would suggest buying all tea from amazon.
My husband and I only drink decafe tea.  This was a great buy.  The individual tea bags are purfect for us to carry in our lunch and have a nice cup of tea iced or hot anytime we want.
Lipton tea is the best !! This decafffeinated product is just as tasty as the regular tea and we now use it every day and love it.
I wanted to experience different kinds of no in my Lipton tea, so I bought this tea But I found it very light tea resembles other types wonderful  As taste, color, different, not as you imagined
This is a fine item.  Arrived on time, fresh and delicious.  I Plan to order again.  My only complaint...I eat two at a time!!

I have tried the Kraft Velveeta Chicken & Broccoli Cheesy Skillets Dinner Kit 14.64 oz (Pack of 6) and found it to be pretty decent, despite some of the bad reviews. However, I would agree that the pasta wasn't quite my style...like a strange hybrid between rice and pasta, it does sort of create a strange texture for the dish.So, I decided to try the Tuna Melt instead. Tuna kinda skeezes me out, so I added a 10oz can of chunk chicken breast instead of the 2 cans of tuna that the box calls for. I spiced it up with a bit of black pepper, and it turned out great! Cheesy and tasty, this dish hit the spot, and it was ready in like 15 minutes.For vegetable snobs, I will go ahead and tell you that the veggies that are included in this pack are minimal. It's a great choice for families with kids who are a bit picky about their veggies, though. Next time, I might add a drained can of peas or some frozen broccoli florets for a bit of added nutrition and flavor, but this dish is perfect without. I'm sure those who like tuna would enjoy it as directed as well.
I really like the flavor of this gum, and the flavor lasts quite awhile. It is more expensive than most gums so maybe not a good deal, but I still enjoy it.

I always have this gum when I can get it.  Years ago I read that chewing gum after meals was a good idea because it gets down in the nooks and crannies of your teeth and cleans out whatever is stuck in there better than brushing or flossing.  So that's what I always do.  I like an orange flavor best, and this one has the bonus of giving you your daily Vitamin C.  Also, it has that great crunch from the candy coat.

I'm not usually big on "fruity" gums, but this gum is delicious.  Everyone I share it with likes it too.  It maintains its flavor for a good while, as well as its texture.  As a bonus, this gum never sticks to my crowns!

Zukes Dog treats are always moist and flavorful, but this flavor specifically seems to be delicious and a perfectly sized treat to be used for training a new puppy as they seem to be so delicious that they are worth doing anything for! And the price they are offered for on Amazon can not be beat!  I generally have purchased these locally at a small feed store and farm supply which sells these for almost twice the price I obtained these from Amazon for! Wonderful product at a wonderful price! Thank you Amazon!! I will be back again and again; over and over again!

I'm not sure how you can rate something one star without having ever tried it...Anyway, I use these for lunch occasionally and the flavor is fantastic.  The portion is a bit small so I usually bring a piece of fruit or vegetable along.  Very easy to make, but if the plastic container gets cracked (as mine have in the past) you're screwed....so be careful with it!

This is the first Thai Pavilion product I have tried.  My expectations were low because pre-packaged foods like this are not usually very tasty.  I was wrong about this one!  The box claims that the noodles are hot and spicy, and they are!  Very tasty, very spicy.  Like a previous reviewer mentioned, the portion isn't huge so you should pack a salad or some fruits or veggies to round out your meal.  As prepared, the meal has 300 calories and 4.5g of fat.  Not too bad for a quick, easy, cheap, tasty microwavable meal!

I'm so glad I stumbled upon this product.  It is delicious ~ just like my favorite pad thai from a restaurant where we used to live!  Its a good size portion for one person.  And its super easy and convenient!  Finally only 300 calories!  Not bad for a meal.  I love it!

column9: Great stuff for hiking/backpacking! Here's a recipe...
column10: For backpacking, using the "Pack it in, pack it out" and "Leave no trace" frames of mind, I do admit that the packaging requires some re-packaging to reduce the amount of garbage you'd want to deal with.  Unless you have a Sherpa (and I don't) - Lose the exterior plastic wrapping on the package, the carboard box, plastic fork (if you have an alternative - like a spork, which I'm assuming you do), and also lose the plastic tray container with lid.  (I use a Jetboil stove, and the cup and lid serve me just fine as an alternative).  You'll be left with a small plastic bag of noodles (break them if you have to), a small plastic envelope of oil (which could be omitted if you carry a small squeeze bottle of oil), and an envelope of their spices/magic ingredients that make this taste as good as it does.The addition of some chicken in a foil envelope or can makes this dish better in all respects (except for perhaps, sodium).Foil envelopes obviously pack out out better than cans, but you probably already know that if you've read this far.  :-)  Boil up some water (about 12 oz.) in your stove, add the noodles and let that soak for about 5 minutes with the lid on (I think 7 minutes works best for me).  Drain out the water, and then stir in the oil, spices, and then the optional chicken.  Mix well, and enjoy!Really hungry? Eat two!  The calories wouldn't be a concern when hiking.  You can always divide the chicken in one package (if used) into two portions, and that works well.  My local supermarket has this item for a little under two dollars per package (one cent less) each.  More expensive (but tastes a LOT better) than Ramen noodles - you get what you pay for...  If you're thru-hiking the AT on a budget vs. a weekend getaway, this is a no-brainer to me.  These are available in both a regular and spicy variety.  I like both.  Light, easy, taste good, pack in and out well, and a great alternative to some other "staple" trail meals I've dealt with.  Happy trails!  JimiH

column9: Thai Pavilion Single Serve Spicy Pad Thai
column10: I have never tried this brand of food before I ordered this. Nonetheless, I love spicy foods and especially oriental. The directions on the package are easy to follow and the packaging itself is awesome because it includes a fork! Also, there is no way the rice noodles can break unless someone perhaps sat on the packaging. Having tried this just by itself there is NOT a whole lot of flavor going on, spicy flavor especially. There is at most a strong peanut flavor. I squirted a ton of Sriracha Hot Sauce on this and that helped a ton in the flavor department. Next time I'm going to make a stir fry with them which will just add more flavor and fill me up even more! Suprisingly, despite the lacking flavor, this is quite filling given the portion size. I don't know how much they cost in a grocery store because I've never saw them even while I worked in a grocery store for almost three years, but I say its worth it if you want to throw a curve ball in your home meals.
Bought this for my little sister, I thought it was a little too spicy, but it was delicious. Good buy. Yumm :)
Maybe i am spoiled by having worked in authentic thai cafes but these noodles are awful. Flavor packet is all powder, just gross. The green curry flavor is even worse. Save your money.
How can you buy a food product on-line when the ingredients aren't even listed?  This is a problem with all the Thai Pavilion foods.
I used this product in the jungle in Belize for 7 weeks this past May-June, one bottle lasted the whole session and did an amazing job of keeping the insects off...highly recommended!

column9: GET THE LOTION - WORKS GREAT ON MOSQUITOS!
column10: My Husband and I went to a Farm Dinner in Boulder, CO in the middle of mosquito season.  I bought this Repel Sportsmen Max Deet Lotion at Target as a "just in case" back up.  The OFF spray the farm provided didn't help at all!  But this lotion, you'd literally see a mosquito land on us, then jump off immediately within seconds -- The whole table of 35 people ended up passing it around.  WE WERE SAVED!!! - Not a strong odor (unlike the spray) - Lotion doesn't last 10 hrs but long enough to relax and reapply about 3 or 4 hrs later - OK to put on face - OK on clothes -- Just rub it on your palms before applying to clothing (It didn't leave any stains or ruin the material when we did that at the Farm Dinner)

It's an outstanding product, I used this and another product on a trip to South Dakota and never once had a single bug touch me, what I really love about this is the climbers clasp attached to it, you can rig it to you anywhere, and after it's used just remove the clasp and you have a key ring!Good value, function and recycling all in one.I think you could do allot worse than this right here.If you're planing a trip and need to kick the bugs off your turf "body", I say go for it, the stuff may need to be rubbed on, but there's no chance of failure like there is with a pump bottle.Awesome item.Bugs ante'  going to touch me xD

I used this repellent at the end of May in Louisiana. My friends got bitten profusely, and I didn't even have a scratch.I get bitten a lot and also am allergic to bites, so am always looking for something strong enough to protect me.This product actually smells quite pleasant, is a cream so does not dry out your skin, and 100% actually works. I also didn't have to reapply once I'd put it on in the evenings.I would say it doesn't last too long as it's quite a small bottle, but it can probably be put on more sparsely than I did.
Bought this for a 2 week trip to Thailand and it worked great.  The bottle was small enough to carry in my purse and the lotion has almost no odor.

The product works okay, about as well as anything else that contains DEET will work. You'll want to bathe as soon as possible after applying and exposure, but it will keep mosquitoes, for the most part, away from you.However I realized I paid way too much for this through Amazon. I bought it because we had a camp out coming up and stores had already put away the sunblock/insect repellent sections. I paid $8 for this on Amazon, and the very next day saw it in Walmart's camping aisle for $4 - same size, same product. So check the camping section of your store before ordering here.

Used this during my summer trip to several South East Asian countries (Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos...). We did quite a bit of outdoors hiking, especially in heavily forested regions, and some of the regions were known to have malaria-carrying mosquitoes. I was recommended this by a friend who spent time in the Amazon, and I'm glad I took his advice. Compared to my tripmates who had the aerosol sprays (even the "outdoors" stuff), I was not bitten at all where the lotion was applied, which was great since it's such a pain to wear long-sleeves and long pants in the humidity. The mosquitoes will still try to bite through clothes, and though I think the lotion had a repelling effect, I'm going to coat my clothes in permethrin next time.Lotion dried well, wasn't greasy, didn't cause any break outs, so I don't think I'll be switching back to the spray even now that I'm back home.

column9: Lotion works great - carabiner is tinny and flimsy
column10: I am a mosquito magnet and this lotion worked great for me.  Part of the reason I purchased this product was because of the carabiner feature.  I attach sunscreen and bug repellent to my kayak, backpack, etc.  I didn't expect the carabiner to be load bearing but I did expect it to be sturdy enough to keep the lotion secure.  This is the only product I've seen with a carabiner so I will order it again and replace the carabiner.  Oh, one more thing - the cap broke off the first time I used the lotion.

...Granted, it was a little rainy.  I was in the woods for about 9 hours digging holes in the Adirondacks and I came back with NO bites. The people I was working with had some nasty ones, but I was spared.  I only applied once in the morning and I was good for the entire day. Highly recommended!
Product worked great keeping the mosquitoes away however it isn't scent free for hunting. The smell is very strong. Keep that fact in mind when purchasing
I squeezed out all the product I could into a 2 ounce plastic bottle to be able to get through TSA screening.  That it should do, BUT LESS than 2 ounces came out.  See two photos on product page
Worked great in repelling mosquitos in Mozambique!!  We were in the village areas of Namatanda and Muturarra for several weeks in Sept 2012.

Although we're not quite in a tropical zone, spending two months in Puerto Vallarta during the rainy season gave Repel Sportsman Max with 40% DEET a pretty good test. This stuff works. We'd tried Cutter Advanced with Picaridin, OFF Family, Bye Bye and some other brands while our bodies turned into bloody pincushions from those relentless buggers. Then a friend brought us some Repel and within a day of use, we were bite free. In the past, I've used the 98-100% DEET but it's oily base and gasoline-like smell is offensive. This Repel creme is non-greasy and fragrance free. Can't beat it.

column9: Won't believe it until you use it!
column10: I picked this repellent on clearance from a local store mainly for the D-clip the came with it.  Had it sitting around for a couple of years until I used it.What a mistake, not the using it, but waiting around for so long to use it.  This is by far the best repellent I have ever used and I have used a few.  I have worked in the conservation field for over 7 years now, everywhere from Louisiana to Montana to Minnesota, so I know my repellents.This lotion does not have the greasy feeling that come with most sprays, in fact once its on, you don't even feel it.  This lotion does not burn when you apply it after working up a sweating.You also avoid two of the major problems over application, it takes very little to get good protection, and breathing in spray fumes.You can't go wrong with this insect repellent the guys I work with love it.

I live in Florida and this is the best product ever.  I have been using this for over a year and nothing else can compare.  This keeps the mosquitoes away for hours...I recently pruchased the spray form and love both....I keep one in the car, beach bag and at home....love it!!
Worked great against mosquito's while I was in Maine. I prefer lotions rather than sprays, but lotions are harder to find so I was glad to see this product on the market. Repel did the job.

I like this cream style product over the spray. You can apply it to your skin easily and very effectively repel bugs. You only need to apply a very small amount of the cream evenly on your skin and you are protected pretty much through out the day.
Found this in Canada when the mosquito were chewing me up....it's the best!You don't need much, just a dot on wrists and ankles keep the villains off!

I read all these reviews and purchased this for my daughter and I to use when we went to the poconos for a week.  The first day we did not put anything on and took a walk...big mistake.  came back and we got eaten up by horse flys.  We then learned from out mistake and put on this product.  You do not need a lot it is very strong and last all day.  We did not get bit once and when we were in trails in the woods insects flew towards us but always swerved away.  we did not have one insect even on our clothes was great.  Just need to remember when you get back take a shower, you need to wash this stuff off can not let that sit..again another mistake I learned from...lol.  Great product will purchase again when I am done with this no question.

Bought this product with anticipation of going fishing. Unfortunately unable to go. Loaned product to my friends. Said of the Deet products, this one kept the mosquitos at bay most effectively. Guess they used it all. Adding to my shopping cart as we speak...

column9: Not as effective on biting mites.
column10: I bought this product specifically to repel biting mites that have invaded my home and vehicles.  It works for maybe an hour for mites.  Unfortunately, products with deet that are effective for mosquitoes and ticks are not as effective for repelling biting mites.

column9: no outer package so no expiration date in view
column10: I am in MOSQUITO CENTRAL...with West Nile Virus at the peak of its season & when I applied this, I was bitten at least 20 times in 10 minutes.I looked for a expiration date but there was not one.I am sure this is expired or it would have worked.This was a waste of money & now I have to pray those bites are not from infected mosquitos.West Nile is DEADLY!!!!
Product worked well.  No mosquito bites.  Rubbed lightly on skin and clothing.  Pump spray would probably work well also.

I'm very picky when it comes to green tea, Bigelow is the only brand of bagged green tea that I like. I can't stand the packaging that the Bigelow organic green tea comes in at the supermarket - they're for some reason bundled in bags of 4. This particular item is not only a fantastic deal, but the bags are individually wrapped! I don't have to worry about the tea losing flavor from air exposure. I hope they never discontinue this packaging as I'll be buying this twice a year!

I purchased this to serve during my birthday party, which was done with a Doctor Who theme. I had a TARDIS cake, jammie dodgers (stored in Doctor Who Tardis Cookie Jar Lights and Sounds), and a bowl full of these jelly babies. They arrived quickly and displayed well on the table of snacks.These are kinda sorta like gummy bears, but not really. Each candy is about an inch long, and nicely thick. It's got a dryer, tougher texture on the outside, and then soft and moist on the inside. They're very tasty - especially the green, red, and purple ones!The bowl of jelly babies was nearly empty by the end of the party. Everyone loved them and the bowl got passed around the room a good bit. :)Perfect addition to any Doctor Who-themed gathering.
this candy was okay but some of the pieces were squashed and melted together, i would only purchase again if a real deal on price

column9: another great deal on a snack from amazon
column10: Subscribe and save offers a great price on these. They taste great and make a perfect healthy snack for the lunchbag.

These peanuts are very, very salty. I love salt as much as anyone, but they just overdid it here. Half the salt wold have been plenty. Otherwise great, very convenient, but can't give more than 3 stars.(Also, for those interested in such data, each tube of peanuts contains 25g of fat, so not the sort of snack that you should graze on all day long.)

column9: Fresh & fast delivery of Planters Peanuts 1.75 ounce via amazon
column10: The box was delivered swiftly and the product is great - tastes great and has a LOOOOOONNNNNGGGGG far out expiration date, too, in case you can't trust your taste buds.Cheaper than buying at the grocery and packaged in good portion sizes.We keep little bags in our car "emergency box" and purse, too, for kids and selves when running hungry on the road.

column9: a little expensive but worth it
column10: I had tried 3 different brands of puppy food in the market, Pro Pac performance puppy is the only food that my 12 weeks old lhasa poo puppy will eat.  I feed him a half cup in the morning & another a half cup in the evening.  I heat that up for 15 seconds in microwave or till a wee bit warm in touch, not hot, then put them in his bowl, he'll eat them all up in second.  He is also starting to gain weight!

The Honey is great but the little 1 oz. jars are wonderful. A great size to bring your supplements to work each day, I set up 5 on the counter,put my vitamins and supplements in one for each day at work! Great size for salad dressing for one,as well as may other uses!
First ate this honey in hotel in Munich Germany...had to find and order for our home...delicious!!This is the BEST HONEY in the world!

We ordered Bonne Maman Mini Honey for our daughter's wedding on September 29, 2012 and they were perfect as favors.  We decorated the top and added a 4" honey dipper.  The guests loved them.  We also received excellent service as I had to place a second, smaller order which we had within days.  They were a finishing touch to a special day.
I needed these perfect small jars of honey to fit into a mason jar of other small gifts for a bridal shower and they worked fantastically.. And they shipped and were delivered right on time.

column9: Cute and Functional for Tea Party
column10: These mini jars of preserves were a huge hit at a tea party baby shower I threw a few weeks ago.  I got the raspberry, strawberry and honey jars.  They were perfect to put on the tables for individual's scone condiments.  I purchased enough for two for everyone so they could use them during the tea and also take them home as favors.  Tasted great and were incredibly cute!

I had used these smaller jars of honey while on a trip in France a few years ago. They were in the hotels with the breakfasts. I don't use honey very often and the larger jars I purchase at the grocery store end up going to waste. These little jars are perfect for me. The flavor is not too intense and the size is perfect for my use. Plus, they bring back memories of a wonderful trip I took to a country where I grew up.

column9: Makes a great country wedding favor
column10: We used these as favors for our rustic/country wedding.  We cut out circular pieces of fabric and placed them over the top, then tied a ribbon around them.  Then we bought those cute wooden honey stirrers (small ones) and used clear small elastic bands (like the kind for teeth or small ponytails) to secure the stirrers to the back on a tilt.  We got lots of great compliments and the honey itself tasted delicious.
great for gift packages, we used this as a part of one for the holidays.. very good price, and the cute pretty jars are just in the right size!

Great Service! Wonderful- well promised & delivered Before I expected! Tremendous pacakging that hit the mark for our recent Jewish New Year! The addition for the dinner-table along with floral arrangements, miniture challahs, candles, & fruit (tooting my own horn-here!) really good-I was a little dissappointed with the flavor of the honey- not what I expected; but then again I'm not an expert of the many nuances of the-bee & it's ability to produce the golden necture.
This is the best honey I ever  had.Had it on NCL cruise and when I got home look for it to buy.
I would order it again!  Worked out great for gift bags, and it looked cute and appropriate for my purpose.

Out of 15 honeys, 7 arrived broken inside the box.  The packaging of small glass jars should have been much more rigorous...why wouldn't they have used bubble wrap at least???!!!  The worst part was, these were supposed to be part of a favor bag for my friend's baby shower and I couldn't replace them in time.

I love this cereal, easy to eat out of the box. Sweet but not too sweet and very crunchy. Since Frosted Mini Wheats have gelatin in them they are not an option for vegans or vegetarians, these are the best replacement.

column4: Randall F. Miller III "Randy Miller III"
column10: The previous "Frosted Shredded Wheat" made by Post---until last year, unfortunately---was much better...frosted on one side and not the other (like Kellogs' version).  This new "Lightly Frosted" version isn't nearly as good, even though the sugar content is the same as before.  It just doesn't pack the same punch when the sugar is coated around the whole biscuit.Still not a bad cereal, but I don't reach for it on the shelf quite as often now.
I love this product.  I love to eat frosted shredded wheat but they are usually too sweet for me. This one is lightly frosted which makes it perfect.
I think this cereal is very good but I have one complaint.  It says "lightly frosted" but I found the cereal to be very sweet.  Not exactly a bad thing, simply unexpected.

column9: Trying these instead of Frosted Mini-Wheats
column10: I'm a big fan of Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats, but I decided to give Shredded Wheat a try because Amazon is offering it at a really great price for four boxes.When I poured myself a bowl, I first noticed that Shredded Wheat is a lot smaller than Frosted Mini-Wheats.  These are closer to Chex in size and shape, but each piece is a dense brick of shredded wheat lightly covered in sugar.  Biting into them, they definitely felt harder and crunchier than Mini-Wheats too.  They also tasted a little more toasted and slightly less sugary, even though both products contain 12g of sugar.After having a bowl of Shredded Wheat, I think I still prefer Frosted Mini-Wheats.  Shredded Wheat is a little too dense and crunchy for my taste, but it's not a bad cereal.  I'll happily finish my four boxes, but I probably won't be buying them again.

column9: Kids love it, not low sugar
column10: Kids and I love it, it does contain preservatives and at 12 grams of sugar the "lightly sweetened" is slightly deceptive. Lots of good fiber and no HFCS.

We love the smaller sized shredded wheat. Other brands have a big air pocket in it. My kids especially the little 16month old I babysit loves to suck all the  milk out of the middle of the cereal pieces and then chew it up.Great value when they were on the subscribe and save. Now that they are not, I may have to find it elsewhere.We have compare them to Generic Target brands and to other name brands and we like the Post brand best.One box would be gone in a morningn for my family. My boys eat 2 bowls a piece.  But to feed a family of 5 for less than 3.00 a meal is awesome.

column9: Post Shredded Wheat Lightly Frosted Cereal
column10: This is my son's favorite cereal. Unfortunately it is difficult to find in the stores. It is nutrious and tasty.

column9: LOVE IT! WISH IT WASN'T SO HARD TO FIND
column10: When I first decided I wanted to start eating a frosted shredded wheat cereal, I didn't know which one to choose, so I bought both brands - all our grocery stores carried both at that time. Initially, I thought I preferred its competitor, but then I came to decide otherwise. Additionally, right around that time I had my annual check-up and was told to cut my sodium intake, so I then took a look at the labels of all the cereals I had previously eaten for my health looking for sodium content. What I found was that Post Frosted Shredded Wheat was the only cereal to have ZERO sodium! ...The thing is, all of a sudden, I can't find it in any of our grocery stores. They don't even have a space for it anymore. All they carry now is the other brand. So I've had to resort to purchasing it on-line in mass quantities - constantly afraid that Post will discontinue making it. (Or maybe they have already and what we're buying is all that's left...)

column9: Fabulous, not too sweet, well toasted
column10: OMG, shredded wheat that is actually toasted, lightly sweetened, doesnt melt in your bowl before you get to the bottom. Truly delish and I'm not a cereal fan...except for Cocoa Krispies and if my kids found that on my shelves I'd get hollered at...so shredded wheat it is:-)

This is a great cereal.  It has more sugar than some people might like, but if you have a sweet tooth it's good to know that you're eating real sugar and not HFCS.  Even then, it's only 12g--much less than many cereals on the market.  I think the 4g protein and 5g fiber more than make up for it.  On top of that, every box has a coupon for a free Fruit Naturals fruit cup ($1.59 value at my local grocery store).  Very good value, overall.

column9: Definitely Not Frosted Mini Wheats, But Okay
column10: Post's Shredded Wheat isn't really what's pictured on the box.  Instead of a block of wheat with one side frosted and one side not, it's a block of wheat that's very lightly frosted all over.  This isn't necessarily bad, but because the layer of frosting completely surrounds the block, it makes it more tough/crunchy than what I'm used to.  The shreds of wheat are also a little more compacted than Frosted Mini Wheats -  it's a little harder to chew if you're eating it plain without milk, but will stay crunchy a little longer if you eat it with milk.  Despite the full coating of frosting, it isn't overly sweet.  All in all, it definitely wasn't bad, but I probably won't buy it again in the future.  Try a box before ordering the pack of 4 like I did!

column9: Healthy and Incredibly Tasty 100% Whole Grain Certified!
column10: Post shredded Wheat in the Lightly Frosted Cereal flavor is our FAVORITE cereal! It is 100% Whole Grain certified with the stamp on the side of the box to let you know for sure. It has a finer texture that is not so rough on the inside of your mouth. It also does not tend to leave residue leaving you feeling like you are "snacking" on it for an hour after breakfast! It is not overly sweet and has a nice vanilla type flavor. It is amazing for gastric health if you know what I mean!It is also tasty in warm weather put into warm milk to make a hot cereal.Our local stores all stopped carrying this cereal. Because I take a lot of medications that can make my digestive system sluggish it is an important part of my diet and more satisfying than a glass of medicine. When our store couldn't get it in Post had a link to Amazon.com. With FREE shipping and cost Lower than what I ever paid in any store it was an all around great buy!Shipping was MUCH faster than they told me it would be. Packaging was great and secure for a porch drop of.I am 100% happy. I think I will go eat some now!
Lightly sweetened is accurate. Kids loved it - - as well as the adults. Great to eat as a bowl of cereal or grab a handful as a snack

column9: Can't find it locally, we love it.
column10: This cereal is a big hit in our household.  Don't know if the "Lightly Frosted" is misleading or not but this is pretty sweet.  Nice texture and very yummy.  My only complaint is that I can't stop with just one bowl and others in the house - who will remain nameless - sometimes stash a box in their truck for road snacking.

I loved this cereal. Just the right amount of sweetness. I have difficulty swallowing at times, food gets caught in my throat, this cereal was easy for me to swallow. Nothing gets caught in my throat, what a blessing.
Cereal on avg. in New York City is around $5.50 a box. I bought a six pack and ended up only paying around $3.50 a box. Def well worth the purchase. I also love the frosted shredded wheat.

I bought this as a substitute for Nabisco shredded wheat, thinking that it would be the same.  Unfortunately, the Post product is much sweeter.  The second and third ingredients are sugar and brown sugar.  It certainly can't be a healthy breakfast with that much sugar in the bowl.  I'm going back to Nabisco!
Post Frosted Shredded Wheat is my favorite cereal and it's hard to find in the stores.  Purchasing it through Amazon was fast and easy!
I like this,but gave it only 4 stars because it has less sugar in it. But it is healthier, so I still will buy it in the future.

The cereal was great. I got it for my grandson and I sampled it too.I have another comment I'd like to make. Something is interferring with my Amazon web site. I cannot navigate through the site to order anything else. What could be causing this?
My favorite olive oil in metal can.  The pour spout only lets out a little at a time which is great. Also is easier to deal with then the one gallon cans.

These are the best mints.  I'm allergic to GMO cornstarch which is in so many mints- and the mints that don't have it taste bad.  These mints are not so strong they burn your tongue, and they are pleasingly sweet- without being too sweet.  The Wintergreen are just perfect.  I always carry them in my purse.
taste great, very refreshing, and most important, the ingredients are wholesome and not a chemical factory.

If you are a fan of Lifesaver's wintergreen flavor but want to go organic, well this is the product for you. Besides being organic, the other differences are the hole is missing and the flavor is considerably less intense. If you like the fresh breath sensation of eating one wintergreen lifesaver and inhaling w/ your mouth open, well you will need to eat 3-4 of those for a similar sensation. Still I will continue to buy this flavor although the ginger mint flavor may become my favorite due to its intensity.

column9: The best organic mints and economical when bought in bulk!
column10: I've been  using these mints for years now and the quality is always great! I work closely with children and use these to avoid bad breath moments! They're also economical when bought in bulk from Amazon. I love that Newman's Own donates to worthwhile charities too!
Newman's Own Organic Wintergreen Mints are nice organic alternative.  The mints contain no artificial colors or flavors and they taste great!

column9: Very nice tea - But this is not a good deal!
column10: I have enjoyed this tea for some time, and as I am British, I know my tea. I highly recommend the tea.I usually buy this at World Market (Cost Plus), and they used to sell it at about $4.99 for the 80 bag size.  My local store is currently out of stock as I believe Williamson Teas in the UK are changing the packaging (and perhaps the price?).  Anyway, you can see that this is not a good deal even if the shipping was free, but these people (not Amazon) charge over $10 to ship from FL. USPS Priority Mail is $5.55 across the country for a 1 lb package (package of 80 tea bags plus packing is < 1 lb.). Outrageous! - they are marking up their shipping as well as the tea!  Most of their (again not Amazon) other British products are also over-priced.I recommend you look elsewhere.

I have enjoyed Lifeboat Tea ever since my other favorite Jackson of Piccadilly was discontinued.  I now find it ever increasingly hard to find Lifeboat. What will I do?Please get more or recommend one just like it !!!!  I like the strong flavor of the black tea wonderful. Many tea's i try are wimpy. I am getting very low, I hope your "notify" pops up soon that you have more in.Many Thanks  Carol

I love this tea. But there is a problem. Once you start drinking Lifeboat, nothing else measures up. It can be hard to find. And when you have to make due with something else, you quickly realize that you have become another Lifeboat addict. The World Market used to carry Lifeboat, but I have not seen it there in some time. The Amazon prices are are a good bit higher. But there is no choice but to pay them. Lifeboat is just not an option any more.

This is a very good, strong, black tea, without any bitterness.  I add a little milk and enjoy it the way I once did coffee.  I don't need to add sugar and it gives me the lift that I need in the afternoon.  I highly recommned this tea.

This tea isn't like a revelation, or anything.  I like several blends from Taylor's of Harrogate's just as much, and those are easier to get a hold of (at the local grocery store, and online).  But when I see this one at a good price, with FREE SHIPPING on Amazon, then I'll often get it.  A nice (but not at all dramatic) change of pace.  If I had to choose between just Yorkshire Gold or Lifeboat, though, I'd go with YG.(And, I should mention, I first got this as a gift and ended up liking it so much I started getting into black tea again.  So, it's a good one (I like it a lot more than Twinings), but part of the attraction for me might be sentimental or something, at this point.)

Oh this tea..is soo smooth and nice...it's heady and thick and rich tasting. The company donates proceeds to the rain forest and to the Royal Navy Life Saving Organization.It's brews up rich and full, it's the best tea I have ever had. I love, love PG Tips as well, but Life Boat is my favourite cuppa tea!!

column9: Finally, Lifeboat Tea is Available Again!
column10: I discovered Lifeboat Tea about four years ago--first purchased it at Trader Joe's and then they stopped carrying it, but I found it at World Market.  Then World Market stopped carrying it, but I found it at Amazon for a reasonable price and ordered four boxes.  The price for the tea at the one shop at amazon.com was high, so I started drinking another brand of tea, but longed for Lifeboat.  Now I see that Lifeboat Tea is available again and the price is reasonable.  I love the tea because it is fairly strong,  yet mellow, smooth and not bitter at all.  I am very picky about tea and Lifeboat is my favorite.  There are many expensive teas but none better than Lifeboat!

column9: Lifeboat: You need this tea. So do I.
column10: I've been drinking tea for fifty-some years now, ever since I was a wee shaver and my dad led me down the path, and since becoming an adult, sometimes I like my tea strong enough to stand a spoon up in.Lifeboat fills the bill.When you read an Agatha Christie novel where some poor soul is about to collapse from nerves, and Miss Jane Marple offers them a strong cup of tea to buck them up before she goes and solves the murder, it's surely LIfeboat she's pouring. When Prince William gets back from diving off a helicopter to save some poor sod who was drowning off of Wales, and Kate shares a restoring cuppa with him, that'd be Lifeboat. It'll put hair on your chest, a gleam in your eye, a song in your heart, and in no time at all you'll be off looking for a grizzly to rassle.Lifeboat is also lovely and relaxing on those blustery cold evenings when the wind and rain smite the windows, and my wife and I are curled up in front of the fireplace.Not to mention, a chunk of the money goes to support a fine charity, the Royal National Lifeboat Institution.I can't see a thing wrong with this tea, and that's something you can't say about much in this world.

I wanted to like this tea, but it's pretty blah. I tried using two bags in a cup, with different brewing times, and still couldn't get a satisfying sip. On the other hand, I do prefer teas with a lot of flavor, like a good Assam, so maybe that's why I differ so much from the other reviewers, or maybe I got a bad batch.
This is a very nice tea.  Not too light, not too heavy.  Good for breakfast or even later in the day.  Rather mild but without any fruity taste.  Just a good solid English tea.

I have been drinking Lifeboat tea for years -- every afternoon without fail. I've made converts of my family. It's a delicious tea with a rich mellow flavor that does not get bitter. It makes delicious iced tea, as well, as it holds up to the ice and lemon. Most of us don't steep it too long, but I have friends who like it that way, too. I just delivered a few Lifeboat teabags to my British hairdresser, who gave it her approval, as well. I give Lifeboat tea to all my tea-drinking friends with hopes they'll enjoy it as much as I do. A percentage of the price you pay is always donated to families of fishermen in Great Britain who've been lost at sea. Those of us living in the fishing communities on Cape Ann -- Gloucester, Ma -- understand the perils fishermen are up against.

column9: Outstanding cup of strong black tea
column10: I love a very strong, unsweetened (though I live deep in South Eastern Sweet Tea territory) cup of black tea.I love this tea because you can brew a very strong cup if you like - but without any worries about over-brewing bitterness and such (such as with Typhoo et all) It also doesn't "stack" poorly. I.e. I brew 6-8 bags in my kettle and cut it half to the fridge container (so figure 4 bags per pot) and the extra strength from multiple bags as well as extra time it still comes out very clean strong tea.As in drop the bags into your kettle and in five minutes you're done. Forget and leave them in for 60 minutes? No problem - barely a difference (I'm making iced tea so I don't hover over or immediately pour after normal steep time).All in all - an outstanding cup of black tea. And as strong and you like it. Buy it by the 12 pack as it's somewhat variable in availability.12 pack Lifeboat, Tea, 80-Bag (12 Pack)

Experiments in Japanese cuisine will inevitably lead to soba (buckwheat) noodles. This brand is available locally, but at far greater expense. The flavor is nothing spectacular or intrusive. The texture and flexibility are the selling point. They have been used in Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, yakisoba and stand-alone hot or cold in dipping sauce with excellent results. When properly cooked, the noodles have a wonderful texture and flexibility. It is Japanese-polite to slurp your noodles (suck them in). Regular pasta will not allow that technique, I've tried. These wrap around the chopsticks just right and slurp just fine. I like the ingredients, just wheat and buckwheat flour. The less expensive brand uses wheat with barley etc., that's regular all-purpose flour, ugh. Just a personal preference.

This soba's quality and taste are very good!Since I am Japanese, I have eaten many kinds of sobas in my life.So, I know the real Japanese Soba taste. It remains firmness and soba flavor afterboiling it. It is made in Australia, but the quality is guaranteed, and I can highly recommend it.Pricewise is also very reasonable. Please enjoy real Japanese taste!
does not stick together when cooked according to package instruction.absorbs sauce and spices VERY well.I love this noodle.

column9: Tasty noodles once you get the hang of cooking them
column10: The first recipe I tried with these noodles was a complete disaster.  I tried just throwing them into a soup I was making and they completely dissolved.  They don't cook like wheat pasta.  I've used them several times since then and we love them.  I cook them now and rinse in cold water for recipes.  I've used them for sesame noodles and tofu spinach soup, with wonderful results.  I can't find soba noodles anywhere at local stores, so these were nice to find on Amazon.

column9: pricey but worth it for me
column10: actually, the price on amazon is very good, though i can't remember how much my local grocery listed it at. but when compared to other soba noodles, this brand is insanely expensive, but since this is the only organic and unsalted soba noodles i heard of, i'm paying for it.given how salty regular soba noodles are already, then you add more salty ingredients into it, i wanted to cut back on the amount of sodium. i guess getting unsalted noodles is like not adding salt to your typical italian pasta, though adding salt to your pasta probably doesn't add as much salt as the soba noodles you normally find at grocery stores. but having unsalted noodles is that your dish may not taste as "tasty" due to the lack of salt - you've been warned.my main reason for purchasing unsalted noodles was to cut back on the saltiness, so this works out great. but if you're out to impress with a soba dish, you may notice the missing salt.

Length:: 0:46 MinsHakubaku Organic Soba, Authentic Japanese Buckwheat Noodles, (no salt added) 9.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8)Fast to make and very good for you. I love buckwheat as it is - this is just another to eat it

I wanted to try buckwheat noodles for a while, and finally found these at the store.  We tried them in a stir fry and it worked out great.  They do seem a little salty, and apparently that is just how they are based on another review, so be careful adding salt to the water when cooking.  We use them in a beef and pepper stir fry with a homemade sauce and they are a perfect match.We use one package, 1 lb beef, 2 peppers, 2 onions and that makes 4 dinner servings to give you an idea of how much is in one pack.  Cook as directed and add them in at the end of the cooking to heat through.
I'll continue to buy them. I need to watch the amount of gluten I eat. These are a good alternative to pasta for me. I do wish there was more buckwheat in them.
These soba noodles are delicious and have NO SALT ADDED.  More soba found in stores is laden with salt.  I will definitely buy these again!
simple, perfect.  packaged as three servings per and cooks up in only 3 to 4.. no need to salt the water..

column9: good but on the bland side
column10: I've been getting most of our soba from a local Vietnamese grocery store and although we've gotten some great stuff there, it seems hit or miss with the brands they carry so I thought I'd try good old Amazon for soba.  This one has a much better consistency than some we've had, but it is paler in color and the flavor is not quite as bold as what we remember eating in Japan, and what we've sometimes been able to get here.  Sooo .... it was good; we enjoyed it; but it's not quite the soba I'm looking for:  I'd probably try a different brand next time.
I prefer these soba noodles over any other I've tried. Udon and Ramen are OK, but these are fabulous, organic and delicious.

This is the first brand I have ever tried of soba noodles. They are very easy to prepare. I boiled them in water for about 2-3 minutes then put them in a strainer. Then I run cold water over the noodles. I could eat them like that with a little salt and dipping sauce or add them to a stir fry with veggies and meat. Great food. My husband is addicted to them too.

This is perfect for my dad, who is on low sodium diet! He can eat soba (with special sauce for him, also low sodium) without worrying how much sodium he will get just from noodles! The ones we get from markets have too much sodium for him, so this is perfect for him. I hope amazon keeps carrying this soba noodles so my dad can enjoy it for this upcoming summer. The taste is okay and the texture is little rough compared to the ones with more sodium, but this is so worth it for the less sodium. Thank you amazon!
These are so easy and fast to make plus, they are really good too! I pretty much pair them with everything now :)

column9: even my picky kids will eat these!
column10: Healthy ingredients, SUPER FAST easy to make quick dinner, and even my picky kids request these.  I add whatever veggies come in my CSA that week + soy sauce, yum!

My family uses these soba noodles all the time.  Boiled, stir-fried, hot, cold: they are always good.I am most impressed with the fact that they make good leftovers.  They can be chilled and reheated without lossing texture or turning into a sticky glob.They can easily be used as Spaghetti noodles too, or broken up and used in soup if you are in a  pinch.Relatively easy too cook, they don't desentigrate if you accidentally leave them on the stove a few extra minutes, and they don't require the addition of salt or oil to keep them from sticking.
does the job, although i like mine with more buckwheat.rinsing the noodles in cold water after cooking is KEY!!!!that's how the soba chefs do it!

I decided to try these noodles with pesto sauce. They were great! They are whole grain buckwheat which is supposed to be nutritious and they taste good. I will use them instead of other pastas whenever I can.
We cook this soba at home every week and we love how tasty and healthy it is and how easy it is to cook!

As a parent of two busy teenagers, I can say that this makes just about the fastest meal I've ever made.  My son can call from school, and in the time it takes him to drive home, I can have some kind of meal on the table for him.  I can use leftover meats, sauces and vegetables.  He eats and is out the door to his study group/evening activities, etc.  I'm sorry I didn't learn about these, sooner!

I just love this noodles, cook up in 4 minutes after water is boiling. They hold sauce flavor with out getting mushy. Biggest scoring point with me is their organic with only 0.1mg of salt. I love them in meals with veggies but sometimes I just cook them and splash on some sauces, very satisfying.  Can be used in hot dishes or cold.
Not much to say, these are good soba noodles. I don't know why you would notice the lack of salt, sauce or broth is salty enough.

(Purchased at grocery store) I slipped up and only read the front which says buckwheat noodles. We are a gluten-free family and soba noodles are on the list of gf-friendly foods. I served the noodles for dinner and in the middle of the night my fiancé woke up with a splitting headache that went on for hours. The ingredients are organic wheat flour (70%) and organic buckwheat flour (30%). BACKGROUND:When we got our cat from the Humane Society (which was a great place with great people), we were told to keep her on a prescription diet for the rest of her life because she had a surgical procedure that removed a portion of her intestine caused by Intussusception. She is perfectly healthy now other than having a slightly faster digestive cycle for obvious reasons.When we took her to the vet for a regular check-up, our vet recommended a web site [...] concerning litter box tips as well as cat food information. We learned on this web site how most pet food brands and even some that claim to be natural and healthy are actually very unhealthy and are the root cause of obesity, diabetes and other issues cats suffer that become quite costly to treat. We decided to seek out a healthier alternative and this web site had Instinct as one of the recommended raw food options for cats. We plan to transition our cat over to their raw meat option eventually (or at least incorporate it into her diet), but in the meantime, we found that their canned food options were healthier than the mainstream.PROS:Our cat's prescription diet was the d/d Duck and Pea and we were happy to find that Nature's Variety offered a Duck Formula as well. She had no bad side-effects transitioning over to this food and took to it immediately. She actually loves this food.The fact that it's 95% meat with only %5 vegetable and grain free is rare to find compared to other canned foods which pile on grains and fillers. We also only feed her canned food, since we read that most dry foods contain way too many carbs which leads to obesity and can dehydrate cats causing urinary tract infections, whereas canned foods with substantial moisture provide way more water to them naturally. Not to mention the addictive chemical most companies add to dry food to make cats crave it (Note: I have not purchased or looked into the dry food option from Nature's Variety, so I have no idea if it is as bad as other brands).We are happy to have found a healthier alternative and hopefully by paying a little bit more for this food now, we can save a little money later in her cat life from expensive bills related to health problems.CONS:I do wish they had a traditional 24 pack (less packaging than ordering 2 packs of 12). It is also slightly more expensive, but worth it in the long run, hopefully.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy they catchy jingle from the commercials. My cats did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first three ingredients (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are chicken by-product meal, corn gluten meal, and ground yellow corn. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with cats and dogs." Basically, corn cannot be fully digested, it is just a filler and causes pets to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more (more for us to clean in the litter box), and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Meow Mix at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I recommend to stay far away from Meow Mix, as it is simply a very low quality food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat meat, and there just isn't real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or corn.

column9: With Great Power Comes Great Responsibility
column10: It should come as no surprise to anybody reading this review that bacon has a well deserved, and nearly cult like following.  Whether it be a highfalutin' cut of pancetta or some good ol' American pork belly bacon, that entire family of cured meats garners a lot of love.  It is with a heavy heart that I can not in good faith continue believing bacon makes everything better, for jerky has on this day sullied that Utopian meat dream.Generally as I approach a new food item I'm openly forgiving of its appearance based on the old adage of not judging a book by its cover.  Looking at this vacuum pressed mass of grease and what only vaguely represents bacon in a nearly cartoon like sense of thinking about it, the very foundation of my foodie philosophies faltered.  This stuff looks repulsive, there's really no kind or candy-coated way about it.  The meaty bits have the look of rancid meat and the generous slabs of fat look almost marshmallow-like.  To say it was an unapproachable off-shoot of bacon as you know it would be putting it kindly.The smell is about what you'd expect, oily aromas and heavy spicing.  This remains as possibly the least offensive attribute to this product short of the cheerful pig on the sticker attempting to assure you that nothing but porky bliss lie herein. Oh you jolly pig, your insidious smile will forever haunt me.Taste.  Taste can me a lot of things to a lot of people.  Some people swear there is a right and a wrong as to what makes food good but I have no qualms with somebody that prefers a McDouble to a juicy steakhouse burger.  Different strokes for different folks I say.  Alas the taste of this product, I have unequivocally deduced, is wrong by all standards.  Knowing full well some people love to eat bugs, gristle, brains, and all manner of foods one wouldn't suspect could be edible, let alone enjoyed, I find it impossibly difficult to imagine there could be a soul alive whom would find satisfaction in the experience that is Bacon Freak's Bacon Jerky.  The meat has the texture of marrow mixed with space ice cream and the fat goes down like one could imagine snacking on packing peanuts would be like.  Granted the texture alone could probably be saved in capable hands but the overwhelming blend of spices which I can only closely describe as being that of a gritty cut of smoked fish puts this experience to rest.At this juncture you'd hope for the end but bacon jerky likes to hang out a while and make itself at home in your mouth for substantial amount of time.  Almost worse than the initial undertaking is the trials and tribulations of aftertaste you will have to endure.  With a taste that floats between regurgitating brisket and a bad case of salad dressing acid reflux, you will beg for nothing short of the sweet release of death.  Attempting to wash the sin out of you mouth with a selection of beverages only added new layers of head-spinning nausea to what had already become the most regrettable thing I had eaten in living memory.Don't do it.  My fellow man/woman I can not wish this on another soul.  This gift will be laughed about but not loved.  As a personal challenge, or fulfillment of bacon loyalty, this will only leave you as a remorseful husk of a person who's perfect image of bacon will be besmirched.  Having read this should you choose to pass this on to an enemy then you are truly diabolical, a foe not to be meddled with in the future to be certain.  You have been warned.

column9: The worst snap-lock reseal ever made?
column10: I feed Hills Science diet to my pet because I love him and the vet tells me I should. But in all honesty, this product has what is quite certainly the worst snap-lock reseal that I have ever encountered. It is painfully difficult to get it to close properly; and even when it is resealed as best it can be there are still gaps on the side that allow air in to oxidize the product.Packaging IS important. It is no better for your pet to live on stale, oxidized food than it would be for you. Oxidized fats are also called rancid. If you imagine how healthy a rancid diet is for a human... well, you get the idea. This is about more than just inconvenience.I am posting this review for all the Hills Science diet products with this kind of packaging. If you have had the same experience as me with this product, please take the time to let this company know about it.I love my animal. I want to keep feeding him what the vet tells me is good for him.
