These are good to eat at anytime but addictive thus I think it is wiser to buy smaller bags. I try to limit my salt intake and this products helps but I believe they still could cut down on the salt to make them more healthy.

All of the Popchips were very good - the only one I did not like was the Salt & Vinegar (not my preference).  I wish the company would let you pick & choose the variety you would like to have and not have to take the ones that are not to our liking.

column9: Some Flavors are Good, Others are Great
column10: I really, really love Pop Chips. They are much lower in fat and calories than regular potato chips, plus the texture flavor is much more enticing. I would say the BBQ is far and away the best. The Sour Cream, regular potato, and cheddar are in the "good" category. I don't care too much for the Sea Salt / Vinegar and Salt / Pepper flavors, I usually end up giving them to friends or family. Purchasing in this bulk size means saving at least $1/bag over the chain stores though, which is definitely a plus. If you haven't had them yet, give them a try, almost everyone I've introduced them to loves them. If you're already a fan, consider these bulk packs from Amazon, they're convenient and inexpensive.

column9: A healthier alternative to the regualr potato chip
column10: I wanted to try these chips because of all the good reviews and I enjoy trying new things. My first reaction when trying these chips was they're very good as a healthier alternative to a "regular" potato chip BUT in terms of taste they're not as good. A regular potato chip is fried, it's slightly greasy, and has a lot of fat and saturated fat and tastes great. Yes it's not the healthiest thing to eat but that's not the point - I'm talking strictly taste. Just to give a comparison a 1 ounce serving of Popchips has 120 calories, 4g of fat, and 0(zero) saturated fat. A 1 ounce serving of Kettle krinkle cut potato chips has 140 calories, 9g of fat, and 1g of saturated fat. A 1 ounce serving of Lay's Classic potato chips has 153 calories, 10g of fat and 3g of saturated fat. So you can see the Popchips numbers are a lot lower.As for the taste of the Popchips given what they are - they're pretty good and do satisfy my salty snack cravings I get a lot. But when I want to indulge a little more every once in a while I'll go for the greasy and fatty potato chip.
good price and great taste. my favorite are the barbecue chips. you can also find them at costco

For those who have never tried Pop Chips, I would HIGHLY suggest you do.  They aren't Lay's or Dorito's, but they are delicious.  Personally I don't care for normal potato chips and I tend to each healthier than the average person. Pop chips are still empty calories, but they are much better alternative than other chips you might buy at a super market.  An entire bag of pop chips is around 400 calories, as opposed to a serving size of normal chips.  My favorite is Sour Cream & Onion, but they all are pretty good. Take my word for it, try them and you won't be dissapointed.  And you will be eating healthier!Happy eating!
this is the best tasting and best value for the popchips......even with shipping(mine were shipped free) the price is better than if i went to target to get them.....super great!!!!!!!!!!!!

I ordered these because I could not find the newest flavors locally,the cheddar cheese, and sour cream & onion.  I don't like these two flavors as MUCH as the BBQ or Sea Salt & Vinegar but they are still good.

column9: Huge box holds a gift from the gods!
column10: I usually buy these at the local Trader Joe's, but the possibility of having them delivered to my front door was too much to resist! They make me so happy, especially when I combine them with Tuscan Whole Milk, 1 Gallon, 128 fl oz (http://www.amazon.com/Tuscan-Whole-Milk-Gallon-128/dp/B00032G1S0). The only thing that could make it better would be wearing a Three Wolf Moon t-shirt while munching on my chips.Actually, the best part of this purchase is the ginormous box the chips come in. If I ever foreclose on my mortgage, I can live down by the river in this box. Winning!

These are amazing and I can only hope they continue to experience with more flavors.  I'm a weight watchers member and I can enjoy 23 chips for only 3 points, and it's very satisfying.  Way to go pop chips.  Can't wait to try the tortilla ones :)
All of the flavors were good.  Salt and pepper were my favorite.  They were also considerably cheaper than at the grocery store.

I discovered these, as I'm on Weight Watchers and I can weigh and pack up my portion and know the points - 3 for 1 oz, and this product gives you quite a few. Had not had chips for almost a year, and this lets me have the crunch, salty snack and stay on the program. Now, there are many flavors to boot!

I bought this because it seems to be quite popular amongst people so I decided to try it and see for myself. The flavors that came in this six flavor variety package were Original, Barbeque, Cheddar, Salt & Pepper, Sea Salt & Vinegar, and Sour Cream & Onion. Although I tried all the flavors, the last three mentioned flavors have dominated my taste buds to create the impression that Pop Chips is mostly of salty or bitter flavors. The Original flavor was okay, gives you an idea of what the original Pop Chips is supposed to taste like. It's cool that it's not baked or fried so it's healthy. When I think Barbeque flavor, I immediately think of Lay's Barbeque Potato Chips. If you can't match or surpass Lay's Barbeque flavor you fail, and Pop Chips fails. You can taste the barbeque flavor but it is very subtle. The same goes for the Cheddar flavor; the cheddar flavor is very subtle. I like the cheddar heavy on please. I'm guessing Pop Chips is trying to make healthy chips so additional flavorings like barbeque and cheddar are moderately laid on. As for the remaining rest (Salt & Pepper and Sea Salt & Vinegar), they're not very tasty and somewhat bitter to boot. If you like bitter than those flavors are for you. I prefer sweet flavors. My mom tried an unfinished bag of Salt & Pepper that I had laid on the table one day and later told me the chips were not very good and to not buy them again. Sour Cream & Onion I like when I'm really hungry or in the mood for sourness and have sweet liquid around to neutralize the sour. When I first received this package, I had touted to my mom about all the good reviews. Needless to say I was disappointed after I tried these chips out. I don't think I would buy these chips again unless I was seeking to eat a little more healthier.

column9: Good variety, lighten up on salt please
column10: This used to be a better deal then the price went up somewhat. It is still an easy way to get a variety of Popchips with no fuss. The mix tends to be heavy on the sea salt and salt and pepper varieties. These are always the last to go in my house. I like it, just wish the original price would have stuck.
We love Popchips at our house. I'm not a fan of regular chips - too greasy - or baked chips - too bland, but these are the perfect balance. I don't know exactly what popping means, but I'll take it!

For years, my weakness has been chips in particular. As I got older, I've tried to quit the chips but was unable to do so. So I've been looking for a healthier alternative for years with little success. I've tried organic, low sodium, baked, even forayed into the sweet potato chip.  Taste was always a compromise, but when you compare nutrional value, there just seemed minimal benefit to switch from regular chips..., until I found these Popchips! I'm not saying the taste is an exact replication, far from it. However it's leaps and bounds ahead of the other options I mentioned. And nutrionally, forget about it; a fraction of the fat and calories! I can pound a 3oz bag of these without any remorse. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a healthy alternative to chips like I was.
Chips were fresh and packaged so well we could not find many that were broken.  Nice selection, I will be ordering these again.
These chips are delicious and they were packed so nothing was crushed during shipment.  They are so good with salsa or cheese dip.  I will be ordering more in the future.

Light. Crunchy. Salty. I didn't like the vinegar ones AT ALL. BBQ is definitely my fave flavor. The consistency and texture is a little strange. But, all in all, I think these are a great substitute for regular potato chips.

Popchips are amazing!  I have them auto delivered. Saves money!  These chips are healthy snacks and great with my favorite sandwich. One serving is 3 points on weight watchers plus program. They satisfy the crunch factor!  I like all the flavors and like having a variety. Hard to choose favorite flavor. Great to take to parties for healthy chips. Goes great with weight watcher dips!  Stay on track and make your taste buds happy!  Thanks, Amazon!  Always fast delivery!

column9: Who knew you could pop potatoes
column10: These things are pretty dang good!At first I wasn't too sure...but the more you eat...the better they get!I loved the Original, Salt and Pepper and Cheddar.My co-worker's favorites were the BBQ, Sour Cream and Onion and Salt and Vinegar.Light, pretty healthy for a chip and satisfying.

Just received my first package ever.  It won't be my last.  I bought big for me this time and I am so glad.  I have the Original and BBQ, might try others, but this box of a dozen packages of popchips will keep me happy for awhile. I will buy again and I recommend them to people who like snacks.

I love Pop Chips, but they are very hard to find in most stores. Was happy to see that the web site sent me to Amazon. Got my first delivery, bought the variety pack and all the chips are great and have a chance to try them all. I am on Weight Watchers program and these chips fit into my food allowance and give me that needed crunch now and then, so they are great!

I love these things!  Not only are they healthy, they're sooooooo good!  I love potato chips with flavor, and these have flavor that pops!  Original flavor has just the right amount of salt (and I like salt), and all the other flavors are just spot on too!  But check out the nutritional information --- compared to regular potato chips, these are like eating spinach!  And if you're like me and sometimes eat an entire bag, it's only 360 calories!

column9: Once you Pop, you won't stop!
column10: These chips are delicious and stay fresh for many days; however the problem with all low-fat potato or rice snacks is that they barely do fill you up. I'd suggest buying the 24 pack of the 0.8 ounce bags as you're paying around the same price per ounce.

These are the best potato chips ever! I've already ordered more because my family, friends and co-workers can't get enough either. If you're looking for great chips at a good price that will arrive on-time or better, this is what you want!

column4: Mtani M. Holiday "Lover of Peanut Butter"
column9: The best snack ever without the calories
column10: I used to just buy these at the airport and Amazon has made them more affordable.  The smaller bags ensure I don't eat too much.  They are fresh and have enough of the seasoning on the chips.  The best flavors are the BBQ and Sour Cream and Onion to me.  My dad who is a potato chip fanatic loves the original and the Sour Cream and Onion.  I would suggest starting with the variety pack.  I think all of the flavors are fine but you will have a few favorites.  I figure if I can get my Dad who is always skeptical about my healthy snacks to eat it then even the most avid junk food people would like it too.You don't have to wonder where the seasonsings are.  Have you ever had a BBQ chip and wanted more of the flavor.  Well with these chips you won't have that problem.  They are satisfying and you cannot get a better price for these, especially if you put them on subscribe and save.

Pop Chips are an answer for people that want a light snack. No greasiness or setting heavy on your stomach. Although the Cheddar Cheese is a little on the very light side of taste, it should taste a little more "Cheddary". But overall they're outstanding.
Crunchy, not too salty, not too sweet, light, what more can a potato chip eater ask for?BBQ is my favorite!

My aunt from Pennsylvania introduced me to Popchips while her and my uncle were visiting in Virginia.  Since tasting my first Popchip I have serched everywhere trying to find them for sale.  I couldn't find them anywhere so I looked online and what do you know, I found them!  I had to order the Variety pack because the only flavors I thought they had were plain, BBQ, and Sour Cream & Onion.  Come to find out they have Chedder Cheese, Salt & Pepper,and Salt & Vinegar also.  They are all great but my favorite is the BBQ.

i love the product.  so happy to have them on hand when people come over.  They were packed perfectly, came on time and must say my friends and i certainly enjoy them and love the fact that they are not a saturated fat fried product.
These chips are great!  If you are dieting and have a craving for something you normally shouldn't have, these do the trick!  A whole bag for only 360 Calories!  They taste great too!

Popchips 6-Flavor Variety Pack, 0.8-Ounce Single Serve Bags (Pack of 24)After reviewing this product on Hungry Girl's website, I tried these low cal chips.  WONDERFUL!!!!!! I LOVED THE VARIETY.  GOOD ALTERNATE FOR THE HIGH FAT PRODUCTS.

column9: Great Textures - 4 of 6 flavors are great
column10: I've had popchips before from local delis and stores, but only ever had the BBQ and Sour Cream and Onion.  I was pleasantly surprised by the Salt and Pepper and the Cheddar flavors.  The plain flavor is exactly what is expected.  By itself it's mediocre, but with dips it's delicious.  I'm not a fan of the Sea Salt and Vinegar.  My friends enjoyed the flavor, but I didn't.  To be expected, it comes down to personal preference.The texture of popchips are great.  They are light and crispy and a nice change from regular chips.Before buying the big box, I would recommend finding them locally and trying a bag to sample the flavors.  Many reviewers note the strong BBQ flavor (much like I didn't like the Salt and Vinegar).Packaging comes straight from popchips.  I had no issues with broken chips or crushed bags.  Signed up for subscribe and save!
These chips are very good, but I didnt like the 'Salt and Pepper' or the 'Salt and Vinegar' Chips. All of the other flavors were delicious and were only 360 calories a bag.
This is the perfect option for those who want to try all the PopChips varieties! Haven't gotten to try them all yet, but two outta six are awesome so far! :)

Totally shocked at how good these are.  In more ways that one.  Taste great and aren't nearly as guilt-ridden as other chips.  I'd almost say they are good for you.  I stress almost.  Definitely worth a go.
These chips can taste good if you like the strong flavors. I prefer the regular potao chip flavor as the others are strong and xometimes too fake in taste.

It sound's cliche, but like most... skeptical on these chips, as far a taste goes.. and quality. Lays BBQ is a favorite, but the things are really greasy, they really don't put enough BBQ flavoring, and in general more unhealthy for you; and when I am playing Halo Reach, the last thing I need is greasy hands while playing an FPS. (snacking to avoid a meal)Every time I have tried a new brand/flavor of chips, it normally bites me in the ass. This one time was the exception. I took the plunge and ordered the 24 pack from amazon.WELL WORTH IT! No regrets. That's my tag line. Hehe.The bags for these chips, seem to be really high quality just like the taste. I guess it protects the chips better, so you get a bag full of whole chips, rather than crumbs, and there is no chance of stale chips?Well worth the money from my perspective. Of course got some family members to try them as well. All thumbs up from them. And my Diet conscious step-mom favored them for.. obvious reasons, calorie intake.Bottom line I loved em! My only regret really is the fact I can't buy them more often. :(

I'll admit, we like most of the baked potato "chips" in our household, though I'll also admit that few (if any) taste as good as traditional chips.  Since we eat a lot of chips, we try to alternate between the types, just to stay a little healthier.  We rate these as high as any of the reduced fat or baked types of chips.  I've tried all flavors, and would say that the only one that I didn't enjoy was the Salt & Vinegar flavor.  I LOVE this flavor in regular chips, but these do not represent the flavor well.  I don't know if it's the base ingredients in the chip, or the flavoring they use, but the result is not very pleasant.  All other flavors are great.
These pop chips are a great altenative to potato chips. Less fat but tons of flavor. I highly recommend these. My whole family loves them.

column9: Popchips a tasty snack without quite so much guilt!
column10: I have found the Popchips to be quite enjoyable.  I got the variety package and did like some better than others but all were enjoyable. Maybe my least favorite was the barbeque but would be hard to choose best of others.  Try them -- you will like them.

column9: Best "Chips" out there right now - but may lead to bad breath
column10: Flavorful doesn't even begin to describe these chips; in some cases there is almost too much flavor. The BBQ flavor is my favorite, but after even eating just a few you can tell that you'll need to do some serious breath freshening before talking to anyone. These are clearly much healthier than potato chips but they are still crispy and salty enough to satisfy those cravings. We've put these out at several parties and they've been a big hit with everyone including people that didn't realize they were supposed to be a healthy alternative. Finally they are gluten free which is great since they do closely resemble a cracker and most crackers are jam packed with gluten.

I really do enjoy the flavors and texture of these chips.  I don't care for the Vinegar and Salt flavor but everything else is delicious.They have a wonderfully low point value for Weight Watchers, but are a little pricey.
Not much to say, a lot of popchips for very little money. Comes out to about half of what a store would charge me.
I have only tried the Original, but they are so yummy!!! I am sure the other flavors are just as good.It has the most amazing texture and flavor. I am hooked!
These Popchips are so tasty and I am so happy that I found them on Amazon.  Previously I had to wait to purchase them at a store 1-1/2 hours from my home.  Ordering them was convenient and easy!

column9: can't just eat one.... one bag that is!!! =)
column10: these chips are the best! all flavors are great. my favorites are the BBQ and the salt and vinegar. too expensive in stores but by the case on line is most reasonable. =)
Popchips are addicting. The price on Amazon is about the same as if you purchased from the Popchips website. Only, Amazon has fee shipping.

column9: I always have some of these on hand
column10: Pop chips are really flavorful. I love all the flavors though barbeque, salt and vinegar, and the sour cream are the best tasting to me. These seem be similar to a very thin (and much better tasting) rice cake. Some of my friends say the original taste like Munchos brand potato chips. For the calorie content these are awesome. My only complaint about these is I wish you could mix and match instead of having to buy the 12 bags of one flavor or the 2 bags of each flavor. The price is not bad at all about what you would pay for a name brand bag of potato chips. I have bought these many times from amazon with no trouble and they package them very well.

Just what I was looking for .....a low calorie, healthy snack that would satisfy my occasional need for something crunchy.  I have tried almost all the flavors and haven't found any I don't like yet.....BarBQue being my personal favorite.  Next time I will try the individual packaged chips, which will make it a bit easier not to graze on the entire bag in one sitting!

column9: the best chips on the face of the earth
column10: I love these chips.  I love potato chips, and wanted to find a healthy alternative that did not taste like card board.  These are perfect.  You will never believe you are eating a healthy snack.  I am addicted.
I love Popchips- the barbeque flavor is awesome!  You don't even know that they are lower in fat and calories than regular chips.
Addictively light chips without the fat.  With these larger bags, you do tend to eat half the bag in one sitting without realizing it!

These chips are unbelievably good! My favorite is the salt & pepper and the vinegar and sea salt come a close second. They taste like potato chips should, with a potato flavor that is not greasy and filled with fat or so bland they taste like cardboard. I have recommended these chips to my Weight Watchers group, and the local organic store can't keep up with the demand.  They are a hit!  A guilt free snack with lots of flavor ... thank you PopChips!

I recently saw an advertisement for Pop Chips in a Weight Watcher's magazine and wanted to try them.  I make my own "mini" bags so that I only eat "1 Point" of chips, because they are so good that I'd probably eat the whole bag in one sitting!  They are very yummy and I would recommend them to everyone - infact I do to all my friends!
These chips are everything I hoped they would be - very crunchy and delicious!  Don't hesitate to try them.  Bet you can't eat just one!
Thanks for the PopChips!  They arrived on-time and in excellent shape.  Great product!

These are by far the best tasting healthy chips I have come across.  One ounce servings are plenty because the chips have volume but are light.  Unlike certain other 'light' chips (cough-Baked Lays-cough!) there is plenty of flavoring coating each chip so you never wonder if you're eating, say, barbecue chips or plain ones.At current pricing, the twelve pack qualifies for free shipping, and the pricing is pretty reasonable.  These are hard to consistently find in local stores so if you want all the variety available, this is a great way to get it.

column9: These are too good to be healthy!
column10: These popchips have so much crunch and flavor. They put baked chips to shame and can rival any "real" potato chip, but minus all the unhealthy ingredients!

column9: I don't even miss regular potato chips
column10: I've been trying to find an alternative to regular potato chips and these are it!They are great and taste just like the real thing without all the grease and fat. The sour cream and onion are soo good!

Here's a unique product -- something new in the salty snack category.  We really enjoyed this product -- personal favorites in our family were the Salt and Pepper and the Cheddar Cheese.  The variety pack is your best bet.

At my job we all bring in snacks and treats to share. Well, it was a bit of a pain lugging stuff in from home, on the subways and all. Someone had purchased the Popchips from a local drug store chain and we all LOVED-LOVED-LOVED them! Problem--a little pricey and they didn't carry all the varieties, and were out of stock at time. Since we are all trying to watch our weight as well, this product appealed to us very much! I said, I am going to check Amazon for that, and WA-LA!! Amazon carried it in a 12 pack of 6 assorted flavors!! It was a huge hit in the office! It arrived the day after I ordered it, and best of all--the price!! We were paying about $3/bag at the store, now it is just over $2. And if we sign up for automatic delivery we can get 15% off that! WOO-HOO!! We finished the 12 bags in record time--now the only question is--how often will we get them delivered? BTW --hands down Barbecue was the favorite flavor, though I must say I have a soft spot for the original!!

The only reason why this isn't perfect is because they included original instead of another flavor. I personally do not see why anyone who eat non-flavored chips anymore, especially Pop Chips when all of their flavors are sooooo good. Besides that 1 grievance, these chips are light and taste great.
This was a horris sample of the product. We LOVE POPCHIPS but for some reason we got stale...funny after taste, or broken version in ordering this way. Stick with the grocery store on this one.

I cannot stay enough about Popchips! They are a great snack, low calorie & low fat but actually taste great! They are not greasy or make you feel like you've been eating junk food like other chips do. I personally enjoy the Original and Salt/Vinegar while others in the house prefer the BBQ, Sour Cream/Onion and the Cheese. On a sidenote, we have tried the Parmesan (available as a separate purchase) and were not fans AT ALL. I do wish they would offer the Jalapeno flavor online as we've purchased Jalapeno a few times at various stores.
i liked the plain, bbq and cheddar. did not like the others. the bbq was also voted best in some recent chip review.
The variety pack is a great way to find which favors you like the most.

I don't know why everyone loves these chips. They are healthy but taste disgusting. Only the original flavor tasted good, so getting the variety pack was a very bad idea. I would not buy this again and would rather go with baked chips than these. Pirate's Booty makes popped chips that are way better.
The potato chips are great!  We love them.  The corn chips are not so great.  They taste stale, even though they are not.  I don't think the popping process is a good fit for corn chips.

I ordered these chips because I wanted to try the 6 different flavors.  I received 3 flavors...Original...Salt & Pepper...Sour Cream & Onion.  Disappointing when you expect and pay for one thing, and you get something else.  Won't order this again from Amazon because of this.

column9: A little confused, and very disappointed
column10: I purchased this product with very high hopes; a healthy, delicious snack in a variety of my favorite flavors. The reviews were absolutely astonishing, so I figured, what the heck.Wrong, wrong, wrong!Every popchip I tried had a very faint taste and smell of being burnt. Most of the flavors and seasonings are so weak that they don't come close to masking the taste. The end result? They tasted like water with 1/4th as much flavoring added or coke with a tall glass full of melted ice.Worst of all, the taste of burnt potatoes only accumulated as I ate more chips. I could not bear many of these in one sitting, and I hate to waste.There is, however, 1 exception. Barbeque flavor. These had a strong enough flavor to almost completely mask the burnt taste, and actually be quite enjoyable. Unfortunately, there was only 2 of those bags in this box (out of 12), so I still had 10 unbearable bags to consume.I sincerely wish this product was better, but there's clearly something wrong with their manufacturing process. Please don't be misguided by the shocking number of positive reviews.

After I saw those great reviews, I thought I'd give it a try and ordered this variety pack. And, the bottom line is they are the worst chips I've ever had. Ther're too salty and seasong is too much. The only flavor I could manage to eat was BBQ. Others, I threw them away. Never gonna buy it again.
There is way too much seasoning on this stuff.  Since I could not return it, I ended up throwing out this lousy product.  I would never buy again.

These chips taste average and they are insanely expensive compare to the big bags of chips from safeway or costco, for $2, you can get a big bag with 10 times the amount of chips compare to these 0.8oz bag chips, so for $5 in safeway, you can get $30 worth of popchips, these bags are so tiny, it's like serve size for fat people trying to lose weigh or something, for me, i never gain weigh, i rather go buy big bag of chips, these are expensive ripoff chips, will never buy again.Maybe i think the price is high because i bought it from amazon.com, maybe elsewhere is cheaper, but chips as junk food, shouldn't be that expensive compare to local stores.

This stuff is a miracle! Tastes great, no calories, no sodium, no sugar! I can't believe it. I drink all of the flavors. Can't decide which is my favorite. Don't know how they do it but I loooove It!!!

This, along with at least 2-3 other flavors, depending on what's available, is now a regular purchase every 2 weeks for our office supply.  In our office of health nuts, I think everyone got sick of drinking plain old water.  Our President had the Skinny Water Crave Control Raspberry Pomegranate, and promptly came to the office the following Monday with the request to track it down and start ordering it for the entire office.  We narrowed down our flavor choices, and now order about 2-3 cases every other week because it goes by so quickly!The flavor is good, and it's not sugary or "candy" tasting at all.  Some of the flavors have a bit more flavor to them then I personally like, but the over-all office consensus is a positive thumbs up and seems to have earned a permanent place in our fridge!
This drink is refreshing and tastes good.  No calories and healthy for you.  I love it. I only wish it were available in more stores but Amazon will ship to your door.  A good item

Finding the skinny waters have been the best of my life.  Every flavor is great. Great flavor without the guilt or bad stuff.  And when I wanna cocktail. I use good vodka and a dash of diet sprite. Yummy

These beans are the real deal if you're a British ex-pat like my hubby who needs a "beans on toast" or "beans, sausage and chips" fix. So much easier than begging Mum to pack a few tins in her case when she visits! However, be aware that Amazon ship these cans individually in a big box with air pillows for padding which means they roll and bang about. More than half of the dozen cans were badly dented. Still, everything's going to be happily eaten. Just would have preferred more care in the shipping. BTW, when you sign up for Amazon prime, you can get 12 tins shipped 2-day air with free shipping. (For us regulars, that's a fantastic deal!)

We are from England and miss one thing from back home: Heinz Baked Beans in tomato sauce. It's hard to believe that this healthy, tasty essential fodder for all occasions, made by an American firm, is not in our local supermarket. Shipping from Amazon could be pricey, so add them to an order where you get free postage. Also, they are packed loosely so the cans will be dented but the contents are fine. Yummee!!
These are so good.  They don't have the sweet taste that the American beans have and no artificial colors, preservatives or flavors either.  Good deal as they are more expensive to buy individually.
They taste great. But the package was pretty poorly put together and half of the beans tins were beat up.

I just had Heinz Beans for the first time this morning, as part of a traditional "beans & fried egg on toast" breakfast, and I must say it lives up to the hype. I grew up eating Campbell's Pork & Beans, and in the grand scheme of things there isn't *that* much difference, but Heinz Beans does have a distinctly richer, cleaner taste than Campbell's. Without the extra salt and HFCS that you find in most canned beans, the tomato flavor really shines through.NOTE: Although I won't take away any stars for it (because a product review is supposed to be for THE PRODUCT), Amazon's shipping of this item does leave a lot to be desired: a much larger box than necessary, padded with standard pillow packing that was all popped by the time the shipment reached me. About half of the cans were dented, some quite badly.

OK, there are other Baked-beans-in-tomato-sauce makers, including supermarket brands that are every bit as good, and who knows? possibly made BY Heinz - but the fact remains that the GOLD standard worldwide is the classic Heinz Baked Beans.Iconic tin, I have a label pinned to my cubicle wall.Personally, my all time favourite is Baked beans with pork sausages, but it's impossible to get in the US so I have to wait for people to smuggle them into the country in their luggage.Here's how I cook them - my comfort food:1. in a pot, add a splash of milk and a small knob of butter.2. add some form of hot pepper to taste - three shakes of 'Mr Tapatio' works well for me.3. Cook well, stirring continually until the beans lose any 'crunch'.4. I like it to have more sauce than normal which is why I add the milk - it also gives the sauce a nice creamy taste.5. Eat with good break - two or three slices, plain, no butter - use to dip.enjoy.

As the previous reviewer stated, the cans do arrive dented up.However the shipping was timely and free, and the beans are the proper tasting Heinz Beans that I miss so much from Britain.They are wonderful with just buttered toast, or with the toast and a fried egg or two for breakfast. Yum!

column9: Cheapest way to get beanz I know
column10: So many online stores specializing in British foods are selling Heinz beans, but the shipping costs are astronomical.  I can buy these in my local Cost Plus World Market but it is $1.99 a tin.  By setting up a recurring shipment every 3 months from Amazon I am getting them for about $1.38 a tin including shipping to Colorado.  This is by far the best price I've found!Now, if Amazon starts selling English pork sausages and black pudding I'll be in hogs heaven.
The packaging was fine, so these were already crushed when Amazon packed them. EVERY CAN damaged, something large must have been dropped on them.

column9: I believe in a supreme bean
column10: If you have seen Monty Python's "Party Political Broadcast", or marveled at Ann-Margret swimming in baked beans in the Rock Opera "Tommy", then you will have some idea of the importance of the baked bean in popular British culture.  It has long been a staple throughout the British Isles.  A "Full British (or Irish) Breakfast" has to include them, and beans on toast are a ubiquitous snack.There are many species of baked bean in tomato sauce but the undisputed supreme bean is the Heinz, as manufactured in the UK.  Here in the US, we have plenty of canned "Pork and Beans", but they are different.  They have pork fat added, for flavor, and are heavily sweetened, often with high-fructose corn syrup and/or molasses.  These Heinz beans do have some sugar but they do not have that distinctly sweet taste that their American cousins have.  Also, they are free of artificial additives.  And they certainly have no pork fat.  They are thus a healthier choice.  If you are used to the pork and excessive sweeteners, then these beans may taste somewhat bland at first but, if you persist, you will soon come to prefer the cleaner, lighter taste and will not want to go back.As they are imported from the UK, they tend to be more expensive than the native US canned beans.  In fact, some specialist stores stock them here, sometimes at prices slightly lower than Amazon is offering, although Super Saver Shipping and Subscribe & Save make them very competitive, and of course you have the convenience of home delivery.A bigger problem is packaging.  At the time of writing, Amazon has still not quite mastered the art of shipping canned goods.  They are packed too loosely and tend to knock together.  As a result, 3 of the 12 cans in my consignment had dents in them.  Small dents, to be sure, but I know that some people are reluctant to eat food from even slightly dented cans.  Hopefully, Amazon will solve this problem soon.

Just got my first shipment. Based on the warnings of other reviewers, before the shipment went out, I called up amazon customer support and read them the riot act concerning proper packaging. When the box arrived, the cans were NOT floating around freely in the box but rather were held tightly together with heavy duty plastic wrap and were inside a the little cardboard tray.When I opened the plastic I found that in spite of even this, some of the cans were still dented, only NOT as badly as some of the other british things I've ordered from amazon, such as the Heinz Soup, Potato and Leek, 14.1-Ounce Can (Pack of 8) soup, which has every time I've orderd it arrived dented so badly that it looked like kids had been playing kick the can with them. (On the up side, a call to Amazon customer support has resulted in them either refunding me, or sending me another shipment -- which genearlly arrived almost as badly dented as the first; I just can't seem to convince Amazon that you can't just toss canned goods that are not bound together in some way into a box with a little bubble wrap and think that the cans won't slam into each other and dent each other during shipment.I would say of the 12 cans of the baked beans, 5 were dented enough that I put them to the side for quicker consumption (dented cans can result in botulism -- a deadly toxin, the same stuff they make botox out of, only in this case it'll kill you, not make you look younger ---growing inside the can over time, and must be eaten quickly)The rest of the cans however were just fine.Edit: April '09, I just noticed a NEW feature on Amazon's page where you check the status of your shipments. There is now a specific link for complaining about bad packing that resulted in a damaged product. YAY! They're listening!

These beans are the perfect accompaniment to eggs and toast in the morning.  I love them!I was a little nervous about ordering them as I read the reviews with shipping issues, however, as I cannot purchase them nearby anymore I took the risk.  These cans were shrinkwrapped together in a set of twelve with a box around the bottom.  Then they had the air-filled plastic packaging around them and were placed in a second box.  All of my cans arrived in perfect condition - no dents, no spilling, no rattling around in the box.  They also arrived within 48 hours (under normal shipping), although I imagine that I was just lucky!!  In all, I couldn't be more pleased with my purchase.

For some strange reason Heinz chooses not to sell the same product in the US as it does in the UK - So do NOT be fooled - These are NOT the same as Heinz beans in a US grocery store; These are VERY healthy, no artificial additive, GREAT tasting beans - The BEST!

column9: I love Amazon! Where else can you find items like this online?
column10: Having moved from Australia, where baked beans are in a tomato sauce base, my children were upset to discover that nearly every brand of baked beans on the US market had large amounts of brown sugar added. They did not like the sweet taste and this meant one less source of protein in their diets (which are terrible to begin with). I drove to every supermarket in a ten mile radius looking for Heinz baked beans and only found their "vegetarian" variety, which surprisingly, contains brown sugar (guess you gotta go with the flow?). Anyway, I'd pretty much given up on finding Heinz baked beans with the tomato sauce, until... after googling them, I found them on Amazon. Wow! I had no idea that Amazon sold groceries! Anyway, a dozen cans arrived in a tight plastic wrap, so no damage to the cans (not that it's a problem, just noted others reviews that cans were bashing around in the box). Have to say, I LOVE Amazon. I got these delivered to my door. No more wasting time trying to find them!! Awesome!

column9: What can I say?! SImply the best!
column10: We have lived in the USA for 13 years now but there is one thing that we still have to have from England! HEINZ BAKED BEANS! We have tried various US versions & NOTHING compares to these beans. These are quite simply THE BEST! LOL!So glad that Amazon sells them as it sure saves alot on the shipping. Makes them a economical "essential."
These Heinz beans cost about $2/can at stop and shop.  By brit hubby will eat no other bean, so now he gets his at cost I can tolerate.  Thanks amazon!

column9: THE BRITISH KNOW HOW TO DO IT!
column10: I find the treacly versions of American baked beans inedible, cloying to the palate.  Since a visit to London I have been searching for the baked beans I was served as part of breakfast fare.  At last I have discovered them.  These beans have a tomato, rather than a sugar, base.  They are pleasant, even refreshing, and delicious served on toast.I also have good news:  THESE BEANS CAN BE PURCHASED AT UPPER SCALE GROCERY STORES IN THE U.S.After ordering mine from Amazon, I went grocery shopping and was amazed to see cans of these beans sitting on the grocery shelf.  Now I live in a small town where a lot of specialty items are not available, so those living in big cities should have no trouble at all in obtaining them.
I love these beans. I eat em cold right out of the can frequently - but they are delicious heated also :)Glad I can get these - and glad I stumbled on them.

I grew up eating beans on toast and always missed them after moving to the States. I'm so glad to have a easy way to get them online. I really wish that Amazon would package them better as the cans were quite beat up when I got them.

column9: The original and still the best??
column10: No American beans can compare to Heinz beans!  Yes, they're pricier, but they're so good!  And buying them in bulk is even better.  We will never be without our baked beans on toast anymore.
Far superior in flavor to the 'sugar' beans readily available here (to go with the 'sugar' bread, what gives?) however if batchelors beans become available try them as they are the true 5 star bean!

The beans are great.  Stationed in UK for three years and missed them when I got back.  Not sweet and take well to added ingredients (hot sauce, onion).  Shipping was poor.  Of the twenty four cans five were badly dented and I had to dispose of them.

I love real (i.e., English) Heinz baked beans.  However I have to give these a low rating here becuase I just received a case of 12 cans and they were so badly packed they were rattling around in the box.  When I opened the box, 5 of the cans were so badly dented and I will have to throw them away.  One of them was leaking.  I know I could return them but that is too much trouble for $10 worth of baked beans.  I can't find anywhere else on the Amazon site for leaving this kind of feedback for the seller/packer, so I'm leaving it here.I will still love the other 7 undented cans.
These beans are the best you will ever taste. they are a must have in the UK and I urge everyone to try them I know you will love them

How come is it that the American company Heinz is unable to make these beans here in America.  I have an English wife and her family has asked me that for years.  We put men on the moon but can't make beans.  Yeah Bush's beans are good but like anything, one product does not go in all meals.  Make a shepherds pie with Bush Beans and it will be the last time you make that mistake!  Same with beans on toast, nothing but Heinz Baked Beans for those to be eatable!!!

Was very glad to find these on here, especially with the subscribe and save option. I used to have to make a special trip to a local market that sold these for a reasonable price, but it was the ONLY thing I ever needed from there. There was no damage to the cans when I received the package and the quality of the beans were outstanding. If you're on the fence about ordering this, go ahead!!

I was delighted to find these Heinz Baked Beans available on Subscribe & Save.  Having moved to the US in the last two years, I was surprised to find that Heinz Baked Beans were not readily available for purchase in supermarkets without being mixed with frankfurters (yech).  The nearest equivalent was the Heinz vegetarian beans, but the taste was not the same.  Moreover, the price in the supermarket is ridiculous.  The price on Subscribe & Save is a little high, but at least I can get the product I want

This is the first time I have ordered canned groceries from Amazon and having read some of the reviews about the less than satisfactory packaging, I was a little concerned what condition my order would arrive in.  However, the price for these beans is a little lower than our local store, shipping was free with Amazon prime and it is easier to lift a 12 pack of beans off my doorstep than in and out of my cart, then from cart to car and car to kitchen, so I decided to give this a try.I placed my order on the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend and was promised delivery by Thursday.  I then received an email on the Monday saying my order had been shipped and updating delivery prediction to Wednesday.  So I was very happy to find my delivery on my doorstep this lunch time (Tuesday) - very impressive for a holiday weekend order!With a little trepidation, I opened up the package, fully expecting at least a few dented cans.  But I was very pleasantly surprised - they were packaged in a cardboard tray, then wrapped tightly in plastic and surrounded by plastic 'pillows'.  Not a single can was dented so I will definitely order again.Oh, and as for the beans themselves?  What can I say, I am British and was practically weaned on Heinz Baked Beans!  They are pretty much our family's only 'must-have' since we have lived in the US - a real taste of home.  We eat them on toast, with a cooked breakfast, with pies, quiches, practically anything!

column9: The real deal and I have never had a dented can.
column10: This is the real deal, English baked beans.  I married a Brit so I spend a lot of time in England and became addicted to THESE beans.  USA has nothing like them. I don't know if it is the simplicity of the sauce but I love them. This is cheaper than the local grocery store, if you can find them.  I have never had a dented case.  I noticed a lot of reviews stating that was a problem but I never once had a dented can and I am on auto ship, which means... a lot of cans (tins to the Brits) of beans.

column9: Heinz Beans - The Best By Far
column10: I moved to the US from the UK almost 18 years ago and for a long time went without my beans on toast; that was until British stores popped up here and there but a 40 mile each way drive was not in the cards for me, not even for beans.  I then found a place about 12 miles away, but they charged the earth for them, then I found amazon carried them.  Ever since then I have them on a standing order for a case every 6 weeks.  I love my beans and for those of you not used to these, an excellent source of fiber, cheap meal addition, versatile, etc. LOVE EM.

Just back from England and came across these beans. I could resist. Nothing better than Heinz baked beans and toast. Amazon has changed the packaging and the can were bubble wrapped. No damaged cans. Good job Amazon. Now I will put in my order for mushy peas. They will be really good with Bangers and Mash.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for
column10: The original baked beans in tomato sauce from the UK, so you can have beans on toast. Amazing that I can get the original on Amazon!

i subscribe and save to these - excellent value and always arrive quickly.  they seem to be packaged with more protective packaging now which is better, as there always used to be a few dented cans.  i am a brit living in NY and couldn't live without these!

Being a Brit, we miss good old Heinz Baked Beans, so being able to purchase them through Amazon is great news.  Love these beans, not too heavy on the sauce, or tomato flavor and perfect for that Nursery afternoon tea, Beans on Toast !

These are the best Baked  Beans, no brown sugar, or pork, or bacon, or any other add-ons, Beans in  a tomato sauce plain and simple but full of flavour!  Great fibre very healthy, the English style Beans.

If you ever lived in the British Empire (now gone) these are the beans to eat.  The bulk price at Amazon cannot be beaten.New Info Oct 2011:  The price has gone up a lot since my earlier review. I still cannot find it cheaper elsewhere, but I eat it less often.
I like these best right out of the can for a quick snack all day long.( Cold )

After living in England and getting these at about $2 or less per can (after conversion), I hate to pay $2.99 per can here in the States. These are the ONLY baked beans I really like - they are also now a "comfort food" for me!Thank you Amazon for selling this product in bulk!

I lived in England for seven years and learned to love Heinz Beans. They are much more expensive in grocery stores (if you can find them).I ordered once before and the cans were loose in the box. I didn't like this, but the latest shipments I received were packaged much better. The 12 cans were packaged as a case in plastic, and I preferred this very much.Enjoy the exceptional beans and the new and improved packaging. I would rate this product as a good buy, and the new shipping method makes this an exceptional purchase.

Most of the cans were badly dented!  I hope this stuff is as good as other reviews say, I would like to try a British variation on a classic dish but I'm not impressed with Amazon's packing of the product.  Also it is on the expensive side
Best baked beans I've tasted among a couple of dozen different kinds I tried. Unfortunately they are not made in US so the cost is a bit high.

The Heinz beans are great but the packaging was awful.  No padding for the heavy cans as they shifted around in the box.  So, three of the 12 cans were bust and completely unusable.  If the packaging cannot be improved then I will cancel my repeat order from Amazon.

column9: every single can arrived dented - twice.
column10: Growing up in the UK I was really excited to be able to get the original for beans on toast.  I set up a subscription assuming I'd be eating a lot!The first batch came, and even though the box they were packed in was undamaged, every single can was dented.  I gave them the benefit of the doubt and waited for the second batch, as I really love these beans.  Unfortunately, it was a repeat and I have now cancelled my subscription.  A big disappointment.I suspect they are selling cans that can't be placed on shelves in the stores and using this as a means to clear their damaged stock.Edit: March 2010.  A friend convinced me to retry this purchase, and me being the fan of baked beans that I am I did.  Very pleased to report that the packaging issues have been resolved.  I'm now a regular subscriber and cans arrive in shop shelf condition.  Upgrading my original 1 star to a 4.
I thought these might be like the ones we used to buy in Canada, but they were not.  I still liked these okay but seemed a little more bland.

I searched diligently in Tucson and found a can of these British Heinz Beanz.  Although good, both my son and I agree they are VERY similar to Van Camp's Pork and Beans, available quite inexpensively (I prefer Van Camp's over Campbell's for some reason, can't remember why, though).  Heinz', of course, don't have the little dollop of pork fat in the can, but if that doesn't bother you, you might be disappointed if you order these (and receive them in heavily dented cans as many people have reported on this site).

Yum, yum, yum!  I love Heinz baked beans!  I'm American and I had never had them until my English fiance made me beans on toast.  Now I crave them!  (They are not like the BBQ baked beans we have here!)  Heinz baked beans are sold in some grocery stores, but they are expensive.  Nothing beats the Amazon subscribe and save price!  We get a shipment every 3 months!
The beans are very good  and remind one of  how beans aleays were  in England. I just wish you could supply the small cans of  CURRY  BEANS dcheffings0@gmail.com
I love these beans, just not in dented cans!!!!!!!The beans taste excellent, and all the other reviewers are right---every single can in the box was dented.

The UK no1 selling brand, from a US company thats not available in the stores here in the US... go figure lol. But these are wonderful on hot buttered toast, even better on grilled cheese on toast or even cold as a side with a salad, far better than the yucky sweet ones all the Americans devour. Amazon does it again :)

column9: Better value than the grocery store!
column10: Moving from England this is just one of those things that we really miss! I usually have to pay $2.00+ at the grocery store per can of beans.  This was a great value and arrived packaged really well (and of course, tasty as always!)

I introduced my American husband to beans on toast.  He loves them, but until we found out that Amazon would send us Heinz beans we had to settle with the few cans I could put in my suitcase or the few times I would find them at the super market.  Now we only have to control ourselves to how many times we have Beans on Toast each month. The Beans are winning!

I know Americans don't have beans for breakfast. But the Brits do!  I Love watching Top Gear ( A GREAT BBC car show ) On the show the presenters are shown at breakfast many times eating.... BEANS!  I thought this sounds really, really bad.  But I got to thinking if it's good enough for the Top Gear guys I gotta try them.  I'M HOOKED!!!  I love two eggs sunny side up, Toast, Bacon and... Heinz beans from England.  The beans are different than American canned beans-not as sweet no ham they are great!

As a Brit in America, this is the best and cheapest way to get your HP Beans fix at a great price. Select the re-supply option and get them on a regular basis. Because of the repeat order you will receive them at a great price. ENJOY....

I placed the order on Feb 9th and received it on Feb 11th. Very happy! I received a 12-can pack in its cardboard tray and plastic packaging. This was wrapped well in bubble wrap and there were air pillows in the box too (one of them had popped). Three of the cans on one side of the pack each had a small dent, but I felt that the seller had done everything possible to prevent damage, and this was just unfortunate. Perhaps there could have been more pillows. The rest of the cans are in perfect condition. I will just eat the three dented ones first, no big deal. I am grateful to have found such a good deal! Very convenient.
The beans are great, the parcel arrived on time, but many of the cans were badly dented due to poor packing.
I am subscribing this order. The pack came here with standard plastic film with paper stuffing, every aspect meets my expectations. Highly recommend.

This for us and our friends is the preferred baked bean product. The taste is good, and for the health conscious, they have lower sugar than other products and are vegetarian. Please note that the US Heinz vegetarian beans (green label can) is not the same. It has no fat but is still high in sugar. Why oh why do not the US Heinz people speak with their colleagues across the Atlantic?

column9: The perfect companion for a jacket potato
column10: O.K. I admit, it is always better when you prepare this yourself. But if you are like me, and have little time to cook, well, this is the easy way to prepare jacket potatoes. This sweet beans in tomato sauce are perfect also with eggs and sausages, a slightly cooked tomato also fits very well. You can have a full english breakfast or lunch prepared in a snap with this. The taste is quite good in my opinion, but if in doubt, try to get one can from a local store and then buy them for less in amazon.

We love these and were excited to get them from you!  Four of the twelve cans were banged up a bit but not much and none had split the can itself.  The price was pretty good for a taste that we've missed for many years!

Heinz beans with tomato sauce are easily my favorite baked beans. (Beanz means Heinz, right?) I use them frequently when making English breakfasts and they are great for beans on toast, or just as a side. The subscription option with Amazon is great, giving an even further discount and allowing customers to stop or rush their next orders at their discretion. The price is very good compared to the store price.Also, as I have been ordering these for some time now, I have not had any serious problems with the condition of the cans. They have always seem packaged rather well in my shipments.

column9: Heinz Baked Beans ... No sugar, Same Great Taste I Remember
column10: These taste better than your run of the mill Safeway baked beans or the barbecue kind with brown sugar.Heinz the original british bean has no brown sugar and a distinctive great tasteJust warm add a little black pepper and serveEither as a side dish with chips (french fries) or beans on toast, these are a treat.I just wish Amazon packaged them a lot better as 4-5 cans are always bent pretty bad but content do not spill out.

For the longest time I have searched NC for some plain canned beans.. <desperation> just plain beans maaan! (or what they call Vegetarian beans over here), what I found turned out to be like the worst kind of baked beans (non-Heinz) that you might get in London - too sweet and overcooked.. but I accepted my fate and munched away.Then on a whim I did a search on Amazon and found these beauties, these beans *ARE* the same recipe as the ones we have in England, however the cans are slightly smaller (390g as opposed to 415g).They arrived quite promptly (UPS) in their own shrink-wrapped pallet (not loose), some cans have *very minor* dents such as those you find in the store but in my case at least the dent issue is only mentioned here because some others who reviewed seemed to make an overly big issue of it.With subscription the shipping is "free" but it still feels a little expensive for what is essentially a non-gourmet food, however Amazon seems to be offering the best price all-in-all (free shipping considered).No complaints so far!
came in proper packaging.  Have loved British Heinz baked beans since I was a kid so was not disappointed!
This product is fabulous!!!!!!!! pretty good taste, much lower calories(compare to American baked beans) and healthy!!!!

column9: Yay beans for toast - 8 of 12 severly dented
column10: Very excited to find this product.  Item was packed well, wrapped as a case inside a fitting box.  Unfortunately, 8 of the 12 cans were very dented.  There was no apparent damage to the box in which it was shipped leading me to believe it was packed that way.  Damage to the cans were random throughout the case not just the outside.  But alas, I have toast waiting...

The first box of beans that was delivered had obviously been dropped, & most of the cans split open.( What a mess!) But I called Amazon & they replaced the shipment without any hesitation, I was very impressed with their customer service.
You just cant beat Heinz Baked Beans but Amazon really does need to do something about the packaging.  Every tin was dented badly and I will not order on line again.
For proper beans on toast, you have to use the Heinz English variety.  It is not just beans without the pork, the flavor is all together different.  They are also delicious cold in salad. Try them.

column9: The original heinz baked beans now on Amazon- how cool is that!
column10: Why so great!  It has a lot less sugar than the american version and the beans hold their shape after the processing system.  A lot less mushy than the american vegetarian version.  If you are looking for baked beans with a lot less sugar then this would work for you.  Super goodness.

column9: nice to find it at all!
column10: These beans are great, just like I had in Australia.  They are very difficult to find around here in the states.
Can't live without my beans and so much cheaper to get them this way than the international aisle at the grocery store!Brit in the USA

Years ago I used to buy Heinz Vegetarian Baked Beans until one day I bought a tin and wondered why they tasted different.  I saw on the tin "new and improved".  I had an old tin and compared the contents.  Heinz had doubled the sugar content and lowered the fiber.  I cannot eat such sweet beans and have been making my own but they are not as good as the British recipe.  The British recipe had a fairly high sodium content but I believe they have reduced this, so maybe I will try them again.
IF YOU ARE EXPAT LIKE ME AND MISS SOME OF THE FOOD OF BRITISH ISLETHEN THIS WILL NOT DISAPPOINT YOUIT TAKES ME BACK TO MY CHILDHOOD MEMORIES OF PROPER ENGLISH BREAKFASTCHEERIO

column9: No problems at all, more convenient than the grocery store and cheaper too.
column10: This is one of my subscribe and save items and I was dismayed to find that the item is currently under review for shipment issues.  I have got to say that I have had several deliveries of these beans with no problem at all.  Not one dented can - EVER.  Buying them from Amazon and having them delivered to my door is not only easier for me, but cheaper too.  I hope they resolve the shipping issue soon (not that I knew there was a problem in the first instance)and I can look forward to conitnued deliveries of Heinz Baked Beans!

When I opened the package, I saw that one of the cans was punctured and has spilled beans all over the other cans. Who knows how long they had been inside, because they were rotting and molded. Completely disgusting and unacceptable.

Usually these arrive with small dents in the tins and I ignore them.  This time some are collapsed into themselves and the bottoms bulging - not sure they should be eaten!  Box not damaged at all. Obviously not checked before sent out.  And not returnable! Wish I could find another place to buy!

I did not buy this product from Amazon because I wanted to try one can first.  Fortunately my supermarket (ShopRite) stocked them.First I must say, the beans, the sauce and the canning are of VERY HIGH quality.However I do not like sweet candy like vegetables.  Maybe it is part of my heritage but Italians typically make vegetables with oil and garlic, or oil and lemon.  Never sweet.To salvage this product I added it to two cans of white cannellini beans and added some cayanne pepper and two spoons of olive oil.  Not bad!!!I am giving it 5 stars based on quality and not on my taste preference.

column9: beans are good... dented cans suck
column10: Love the beans, but the shipping is horrible.  I bought the 12 pack, and every can was dented.  Two of the cans were actually folded.  Until Amazon is willing to spend the extra half cent and add another layer or three of those inflated bags, I will not be buying from them.

Beans.  With Ketchup.  From England.  My first thought was, what kind of beans?  But when you package them in ketchup, Heinz ketchup no less, who cares?  They gotta be good!  Brings to mind a poem from my childhood:Beans, beans, a musical fruit.The more you eat the more you toot.The more you toot the better you feel,So eat your beans every meal.Gotta love 'em.Five Stars!!!
I have looked up GMO foods and these beans are listed as being a GMO product. Always good to be careful.

These are nothing like the Heinz baked beans i had when i was a kid, not near as tomato flavoured as i remember. I think these particular beans are aimed at at the American Market, bland and tasteless, may as well buy cambells at 3 for a dollar.

column9: I Eat This Salt By The Mini-Spoonful
column10: I just bought seven different Sea Salts via Amazon and thus far this one is my favorite.  I was worried about buying Fleur de Sel from a 'name brand' (Roland), perhaps expecting an inferior quality product, but this salt does it for me.  For all I know this Fleur de Sel is a more mass produced and cheaply made product -but I do know that straight out of the bottle I like its flavor the best out of the sea salts I have tried so far, even better than Maldon (which I expected to like the best).  The 'Non-Roland' sea salts have an after-tang I don't quite like;  this salt tastes. . .  'smoother' is the best word I can come up with right now.  I am interested to find out how this salt compares with more traditional Fleur de Sels.  4.5 Stars (to leave room for other contenders).Is this salt worth the price?  I'll have to get back to you on that one.  As a sea salt novice I was going to wait to review the salts after I tried them on various foods, but I am in a reviewing mood tonight, so I'll just have to update later as I experiment with the 'Salty Seven' and other new salty acquisitions.  This review is based on comparing and contrasting salts right out of the bottle/bag.After writing this review I am hankering for another spoonful of Roland Fleur de Sel!

column9: No scent of ginger at all
column10: I bought this to boost the ginger flavor in ginger margaritas.  It has no ginger scent at all when you open the bottle and added no ginger flavor to my recipe.  The seller says that it has ginger flavor when used in baking and the alcohol cooks off.  I have no idea about that, but the overall scent is alcohol, not ginger, when it is opened.

I made the  mistake of opening a package of these mediterranean apricots, (bought at the local IGA store) in a darkened room and popped some in my mouth without  being able to see them.BIG mistake...I trusted the name and I should not have.They were hard and bitter.  When I tuned up the lights I could see that they were almost black in color and looked and tasted horrible.No more Sun-maid for me....
I like this noodle so much. Easy to make it, unexpensive, has a lot of flavours. I bet everybody will like this noodle also if they tried.

Came across this once in a store. Brought it home and it was a huge hit! Then couldn't remember where I found it so went on a hunt of every store I had been in - nothing. Family was requesting it, couldn't find it local so turned to Amazon!The favor is an excellent blend. Just the right mix for all palettes. Your family and friends will think you are a wiz in the kitchen even if you can barely read a cookbook!

I got two different brands. Actually I assumed that Emeril's would be spicier, but the other one was take-your-breath-away spicy. Both were delicious. I would feel good about recommending Emeril's Guacamole Dip Mix to anyone. Maybe the other one should come with a warning.I'll be using both in the future, depending on my mood. Price will have a lot to do with it as well.

I'm one of those people who won't eat foods if they look suspicious or unappealing.  Guacamole -with the exception of a wonderful authentic Mexican restaurant in southern Delaware that my family takes me to on special occasions- is mostly really awful.  The sewer-looking and barely adequate taste and appearance of guacamole just doesn't get the job done as far as leaving me satisfied.  I'd rather not eat it and I certainly don't want more.  Unfortunately this type of guacamole dip mix falls under the category I mention above.  It's really bland and just makes your food taste worse.  It's a matter of personal preferece of course so you and your family might actually enjoy it.  Me?  Not so much.  If I *have* to eat guacamole I will, but otherwise I'd rather avoid it.

I had never tried this tea before. My grocery store is discontinuing Wissotzky - I found these teas on Amazon including this flavor. I wasn't fond of it at first - now I like it a little more - I think they could have used less cinnamon in the blend - it may be overpowering. I don't know that I would reorder this one.
The product was as expected.  And it shipped quickly. Price was a bit high.

While Spectrum organic shortening doesn't market the product as organic palm oil, the ingredients on the label state that the product is "mechanically pressed organic palm oil".  My wife loves this oil as it is a healthy fat containing medium chain fatty acids like coconut oil.  It doesn't oxidize under high heat making it great for cooking.  Also it doesn't add any negative flavor to the mix.

column9: Todd's Incorporated Roasted & Salted Sunflower Kernels,
column10: Please beaware if youre allergic to peanuts do not buy these! They taste like sunflower seeds and peanuts combined although there are no visable peanuts among the kernels. It must be the oil they use. I particularly do not like these ones because of the over whelming taste of the peanuts instead of the sunflower taste. I will be giving them away for free to some of my family and friends. I will stick to what I know best, David's seeds.

Just tried these last week. Delicious! Savoury! If you like baked beans, you have to try them. This is a very rich, savoury flavor with a good balance of sweet. Navy beans, raisins and curry, yum! Beans as a dessert. Reminds me of a really good plum pudding for some reason; must be the richness of the spices.

These are wonderful baked beans, with subtle, not overwhelming, curry seasoning.  Also very healthy--protein, fiber, no saturated or trans fat. Only minor caveat is sodium, a bit high, but nothing like many beans/"bowls" found in US stores.

Excellent quality and the price cannot be beat.  I got a case for $1.40 a can and the shipping was free.  In the past it has been costly to order cans of beans from specialty shops and pay shipping.  The case arrived within a few days.  The beans are exactly the same quality as sold in England but much cheaper.
All I can say is yummy. I would eat them when I would go over to england with my parents.I opened up a can and the aroma alone took me back many years ago.Love the beans.

column9: Does what it says on the tin
column10: The can I bought was made in England and was labelled "Heinz Curry Beanz", where the 'z' in place of the 's' tells you it's chock full of zed-y goodness. If you like canned beans and you like curry, this is the thing for you. If not, you'd best avoid it.

These chocolate cookies are the best! They have a very distinct chocolate favor unlike any other chocolate cookies I've ever tasted.I buy these for ~$2.50 per box at the supermarket. The famous bull's eye store sells the Emperador sandwich cookies but unfortunately not these chocolate ones.

I just received my package and I couldn't wait to try them. I opened the box right away and I gota say I was surprised at how big the boxes were.These cookies taste extremely good, they're nice and crunchy and very chocolaty.

I got this sample pack so i could try all four flavors, and they're all fantastic (my favorite is butterscotch, though). Like another reviewer, i expected dryer, flatter cookies, but was pleasantly surprised to discover that the cookie medium is classic shortbread seeded with tasty bits of the additional flavor.My co-workers all admired the packaging as well. I'm definitely going to buy more, and keep this in mind as a great little gift for people who like sweets.One caveat on that, thought: this wouldn't make the best gift for people who are extremely picky about appearances: the cookies themselves end up a little battered by the time they arrive, with many broken in half or chipped. If you care about the taste, this doesn't matter, but if you wanted to arrange them on a plate for company, it could be annoying. I don't (yet) know if they fare better in the single-flavor cans.

column9: A unique and delicious culinary gift
column10: Flathau's Snap Pack was purchased to see how good these four flavors would compare with each other. Peppermint cookies - no way. But, yes they work. I wanted something to look forward to but not crumbly or flaky. Once you learn not to pig out and eat slowly and prudently your focus turns to flavor and the baker's sugar stays on the cookie where it belongs.Took these cookies to the office suite which is full of Marin County foodies and supercilious gourmet snobs. First thing I said was "you can't have any because they were made in Mississippi and you loathe anything of or about the South". To them, if its not cooked in New York City or San Francisco any possibility of these being gourmet cookies is an oxymoron. That is until they saw the UPS guy who is also a very well known caterer wolf two key lime snaps down. Recklessly tossing their political correctness and self esteem aside, the resident food fascist requested a taste which was granted despite the fact some personal injury lawyers were mixed among them.Doling out the Flathau's snaps for a week while emphasizing their Southern orgin was a treat in addition to the snaps. Several geographical gourmets are in recovery from the fact that something of culinary greatness came from Mississippi. Then again, ignorance is its own reward.These cookies are a real "pick me up" and are delicious. When dining out while traveling I will eat one for dessert and present one to the server who usually raves about the taste. Its a good way to stay on a diet and to make friends, especially with servers who are in a position to return the favor.

Good tasting cookies, with unique flavors. Kind of expensive for what you get which is 4 small boxes within a big presentation package. Cookies are absolutely covered in powdered sugar, way more than needed. Next time I will buy something else, even though these are OK, they seem a little overpriced.

I saw these on food networks "Unwrapped" and couldn't wait to try them, I actually and thankfully signed up for an Amazon CC and got a 30.00 credit. So I didnt actually "pay" for these. Anyway, I was expecting the "snap" as advertised and shown on T.V. The only "snap" was actually a "crunch" of a LITTLE candy in the cookie. I was very disappointed. The flavors were okay. A very mild flavor not as I expected. A typical shortbread, not a lot of crunchy candy and over half of the cookies were broken in the package!! And about the packaging. I understood all the cookies to be in a cool paint can, apparently when you buy the sampler package they just come in a foil bag inside a cardboard box. If you only eat a few cookies the rest get stale VERY quickly. Well, One bite of each cookie was enough for me, Now I have 30.00 worth of cookies sitting in my cupboard. UNDERWHELMED and DISSAPPOINTED. Guess you shouldn't believe what you see on T.V. IMO

These are very good!  I can't say which is my favorite flavor, but I'm leaning towards the Key Lime. When I read the review and description I figured they'd be crispy, but they are normal shortbread with little chips or "snaps" you might say of flavor.  I love the packaging of the four flavors as well. I will be reordering.

column9: Crisp, buttery with right amount of sweetness
column10: Loved these cookies.  Reminded me of "ladyfingers."  Each flavor is right on the mark.  Does not leave an "after taste" like some cookies.  There are bits of candy in the cookies that match the title:  peppermint, butterscoth, key lime and raspberry.I will definitely order these again.  They didn't last long in my family.

column9: Couldn't keep my hands out of the boxes!!!
column10: This gift pack is a great intro to these delicious cookies.  Although I am not very fond of peppermint, I really enjoyed all the flavors included.  My favorite would be the Key Lime with Raspberry and Butterscotch a close second.  The whole family liked them and we plan on getting the bigger tins of each flavor.

I sent this gift set to my friend for her 30-something birthday after reading the positive reviews.  She called me right away to thank me and tell me how delicious the cookies were--especially the key lime cookies.  I would definitely send these again.

column4: Bonnie Jo Davis "Loves to read and review books."
column10: These darling little cookies are very tasty but I found them too dry.  It's like trying to swallow the Sahara desert!!!  I finished the key lime box and gave the rest to my son.

At first I was reluctant to try these cookies but, now that I have, I can't get enough of them.  A sales rep dropped them off at our office and then I was on the search to find them.  Thank goodness for Amazon.  The key-lime are my favorite.  They have a nice light taste of lime and they are nice and cruchy. Perfect combination of flavor and texture.

I had never heard of these cookies before purchasing them online for part of my husbands birthday gift... He likes shortbread cookies, so thought I'd try them-they were shipped timely, and arrived in good condition. Each of the four flavors were individually packaged inside a foil bag inside it's own box.Darn cookies taste too good...little decandant powdered sugar dusted bites that beg you to keep eating them...oh, did I mention that I also like shortbread cookies? If you like shortbread cookies, you will go for these!Redheaded Wife-

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Given as a gift.........Flathau's Gourmet Cookies 4 Variety Snap Pack Gift Set, 4-Ounce Boxes..........They were very happy with this and I would buy again for others!~
Have brought them to work several times. Everybody loves them! My favorite is Butterscotch. We also love the gallon pail packaging!

I was happy to have the ability to sample the four flavors of their snap cookies, but the only one I really like of the 4 is the Peppermint Snap. I received the Peppermint Snap cookies as a gift a while back, and I loved them so much, I've been on a campaign to try to find more of them. Unfortunately, Amazon only offers the 4-pack-variety or the other 3 flavors individually, but not the Peppermint Snap!

I went to Costa Rica for a short vacation and didn't realize how great the coffee is over there.  I ordered some online, same price as coffee sold in the US.  People at my work love it, way better than any starbucks.  Verrrrry Smoooth!
We went to Costa Rica on our honeymoon and LOVED their coffee.  This brings back memories! Great coffee for an unbelievable price!
While in Costa Rica I had many coffees but I think my favorites overall is Cafe Britt.  The Cafe Britt Poas is especially good, very smooth yet rich and no harsh bite.  Love it!

I love dark/bold coffees, and this is just perfect. Used to buy it direct from Cafe Britt  but now that I can get it from Amazon with prime, no-brainer.The coffee beans were still oily indicating freshness, perfectly roasted and great coffee.

Since visiting Costa Rica a couple years ago and touring Britt coffee farm, I have been hooked on Cafe Britt Poas coffee.  Volcanic soil is what makes this coffee so rich.  Excellent coffee and a great price from Amazon too.
This coffee is superb with a mild earthy flavor and freshness that are worth the price. I will definitely purchase more in the future.
I purchased the whole bean Poas and was very satisfied with the taste. It's very smooth with what I would describe as an "earthy" taste and low in acidity. I would definitely buy again.
A really good cup of coffee........smooth-not bitter, almost (very very close) as good as Kona Peaberry, great flavor and aroma.  Try it, you'll like it!

I wouldn't call myself a coffee snob, and probably not even a coffee connoisseur, but I do know good coffee.  I've tried a lot of different kinds over the years, and when a friend of mine went to CR and came back with a bag of this, I was hooked.  I've been ordering it for years now, and it's my daily drink.  Every now and then I run out, so I try something else as a gap-filler until my next order arrives, and I'm always disappointed.  This is the best!
IT was delivered fast and the coffee was fresh and most delicious. I went to Costa Rica years ago and this tastes just like a cup brewed in a coffee shop there.

I really like most of the Britt coffees.  This is one of my favorites.  It's not bitter, has great flavor and aroma.  It's too good(and expensive) to serve to a crowd, so buy something else for the crowd and hide this for your selfindulgence.
This coffee is acceptable in flavor, but nothing special. For the price, Kicking Horse or Jammin' Java is better I think.
