I went to Cafe Britt on my honeymoon in Costa Rica.  This was our favorite coffee.  It reminds me of our trip every time!

Having already ordered directly from Cafe Britt, I jumped at the chance to order Cafe Britt product from Amazon thus saving shipping costs and even getting a break on the price. My experience dealing with Cafe Britt was great. I ordered the 2lb bag of whole bean Costa Rica Dark Roast coffee and loved it.  Wanting to try something different, I ordered 2 1lb bags of Tres Rios valdivia whole bean coffee THRU AMAZOM.COM. Upon opening the first bag I noticed a difference in quality that was quite apparent. I assumed it was probably because of the different type of coffee, and only after opening the second bag did I think of looking for a freshness date on the packaging. Now I ordered this coffee on July 30 and received it on August 3rd but the package has a freshness date of JUN 12(lot # 11173407).  So it appears as if AMAZON shipped me coffee that was way out of date. I know my local grocery store is not going to sell food that is out of date so why is AMAZON doing it?Second Entry(8/25/11)Having spoken to a customer service rep at Amazon, I have been told my out-of-date product will be replaced at no cost. I appreciate this and must commend Amazon for their responsiveness to my complaint.

Simply the BEST coffee ever!  My husband and I are big coffee drinkers and first experienced this brand while on vacation in Costa Rica.  I was so excited to be able to purchase Cafe Britt Costa Rica Dark at home via Amazon.  We've been on an "auto-shipment-plan" for this coffee over six months now and still love it!

We usually buy Lavazza, or from a private roaster, since this coffee had good reviews, we tried it. I would compare it more to a grocery store brand with private roaster pricing. We learned our lesson, we'll stick with what we know is good.

If I was told I could only have one choice of candy for the rest of my life, it would be this.  I've tried dozens of other cherry balls, trying to replace these because I thought you couldn't get them anymore.  I can't believe I finally found them again.  These have the perfect balance of sweet and tart.  I know that they've been around at least since the 1970's when I began to mass consume them.  You won't be disappointed by these, you'll be addicted!

I've been eating ice cream for over 50 years, and the thought of non-dairy "ice cream" didn't appeal to me, until I tried your product... Amazing! How in the world did you get a nut-based non-dairy product to taste like ice cream? I followed the directions on the label and let the Ice Supreme sit a while at room temperature, and get "spoon soft," Fabulous! As I get older, I'm paying more attention to what I put into my body, and it's a joy to read an ingredient label that does not have the multi-syllable additives, preservatives, and other hard to pronounce chemicals. Just old fashion all natural ingredients like grandma would use. Thanks for such a great product, my favorite being "Pecan Passion." The whole pecans on top are like a gift. Thanks again.

column9: Excellent Product with Health Benefits too!!
column10: Almond-licious ICE Supreme - Strawberry BlissIt is hard to believe that I finally found a product that is delicious, yet healthy.  This low calorie treat is good for persons who enjoy a vegan diet, it is organic, dairy free, sugar free, gluten free, low calorie, excellent for people with diabetis, or anyone who does not want to gain a lot of weight from eating frozen treats.  My family has a history of diabetis and we enjoy Ice Supreme without having to worry about whether it has too much sugar.  The natural taste of  agave nectar, pure vanilla bean, chocolate and strawberry nibs, we are hoping to eliminate this disease from our family.  We buy all flavors and it is "simply delicious." With more than 35% of Americans classified as obese, I highly recommend it to anyone who is lactose intolerant, enjoya a vegan diet, wants to get their weight under control, or just enjoy the natural taste of food without all of the sugar and salt.  If children ate this product, we could be well on the way to stopping childhood obesity. It is the product of choice for the children in our family now.Val Calvert, San Antonio

Just tried the strawberry Bliss.  Can't say enough good about it. Really gives the sensation of ice cream going down.  Ate a whole pint before I realized it.  Not low calorie treat, 4-180 cal servings per pint.  I ate all four in one sitting.  I could stretch it to two, but not four.  Got it from Almost all organic in West end ATL.  I will try the other flavors next time and give an update.

Pain IS good!  Not for the weak, but if you like a kick without having a hole burnt in your tongue (as with ghost pepper peanuts) these are the best!  We send these as gifts to family members who don't shy away from that habanerotype heat.

This product is absolutely great. Here's a suggestion, you could buy this as a gag gift (I did) or if you want to spice up a party (say work or birthday), I'm sure it'll be a hit! I would recommend this to anyone who loves the spicier things in life. The only thing I believe they can do is make it a product that's even hotter. (I don't know if it exists), but this'll be good for now... :)
I bought this on the basis of rave reviews, but was very disappointed. Perhaps it's a matter of taste, but this oil does nothing special to enhance a dish, or a slice of bread. Keep looking.

I work at CVS and whenever someone buys this water bottle, it's because of how appealing the bottle actually looks rather than the water. These come in two different types of bottle, one being glass and other being plastic. This one is a plastic bottle. Don't get me wrong, the plastic bottle still looks beautiful and is very sturdy, it's not your average poland spring bottle. Aside from the looks, the taste of the water is no different than Poland Spring or Nestle bottled water. These usually sell for $1.60 at CVS so, this price online is kind of high. If you really want to try this water, or just want the bottle for the look and future use, just go to a local drugstore or grocery and pick one up. It will be much cheaper and you will get to see and feel the bottle in person to see if it's for you. Overall, it's a good buy and offers a very appealing bottle but the taste is pretty much the same as any other bottled water. I personally bought a bottle because it is so sturdy and I can refill it for everyday use, plus the appealing presentation of the bottle doesn't hurt either.

These are healthy and alkalizing, and easy to eat as a snack.  They keep me out of the tortilla chips and the almond butter!  I just fold the sheet in half lengthwise and tear along the fold, stack them, and fold again in half lengthwise, tear, and repeat crosswise to quickly divide a sheet into 16 squares. A little stack of those in my hand, and I also have my dog's attention.  She loves these and gets the thrill of the chase when I drop them from a height and they flutter down like butterflies.  Sometimes they stick to the roof of her mouth.  The toasted ones are tastier than the raw and are ready to go.

Great product!  My son loves nori but I couldn't find Organic Nori anywhere locally.  I am so glad that this was so inexpensive and Organic.  It tastes, looks, and smells just like the Eden Nori he was eating before.  Thanks for offering a 6-pack- he will go through it in about two months, I'm sure!

Emerald Cove Organic Toasted Nori Sheets, ever since I found the Emerald toasted Nori I put it everywhere, I make Sushi with brown rice, decorate Fish dishes with shredded Nori and even fish burritos. It has a pleasant fishy taste that I like, each sheet has only 10 calories and each bag contain a packet of moisture-absorbing powder to protect the Nori from dampness.Also on the back of the bag there is a Pledge of Organic Purity "All Ingredients Certified Organic - No Ingredients have been Irradiated" I am glad about that because that was my very first concern. There is a nice and simple Sushi recipe on the back as well and Emerald Cove Nori has no Sodium. Even my Cat likes it! Product of China, Certified Kosher, I like that! Thank You

I ordered these because I was going to make sushi for my in-laws over Christmas, and the regular nori that I order from an Asian food website hadn't arrived before I left for vacation. With Amazon Prime, I could have the Emerald Cove Nori delivered to their house in 2 days. These were okay, but they were not nearly as good as the Edomae Roasted Sushi Nori that I usually use. Both my husband and I noticed a huge difference in flavor.They served their purpose in that I had nori when I needed it, but now I'm stuck with 5 more packages of sub-par sheets that were much more expensive than the Edomae. I'll try using them for inside out rolls; maybe the flavor won't be as noticeable if it's not the first thing to hit the tongue.

A fine masala dubba: sturdy construction, decent size(small enough to fit on a shelf), and has an inner cover. This is my first dubba, so I can't confirm the "Superior Quality", but it does what I need it to do and I don't imagine any reason you might be disappointed with it. I've heard that some cheaper ones arrive dented or the lids are warped, so maybe the superior quality is in the slightly thicker metal.

column9: Best Spice Box on the Market and Packaged Beautifully!
column10: I have to say this is one of the best quality spice boxes I have ever seen. The steel is very heavy duty. The spices that come with it are beautifully packaged in a box for gift giving. I love the contemporary look of Ajika brand products!
I bought this as a Christmas present for my nephew the chef and he loved it. He uses the organizer for his spices when he's preping his meals. Definitely a great present for a chef.
so helpful. so kind. such great customer service. and their product was gorgeous. a small business on which, in an ideal world, all other businesses would model themselves!

This Indian Spice box was exactly what was described.  Gave it to my daughter as a gift and she loves it.  She uses all the spices that were included so it sits on her counter at all times.  Quite a conversation piece because most people have never seen or used one.  I want one for myself.

This is my new favorite snack food for whenever I have a craving for sweets!  There is so much fruit for so little calories.  I love to eat it at night when watching TV and I even bring it to the movies to eat instead of popcorn.  I get all the crunch I love from chips, all the sweetness I love from candy and none of the guilt!  And my kids love it too - win, win, win!

It is too bad that the product is from Bolvia and it says **USDA Organic**. They did not test the product inside the package. First the packages are kind leaking powdery substance and second they stink and tast ROTTEN. I am not kidding DO NOT ORDER this PRODUCT, you will be disappointed. I should of listened to the review that said they threw it all away...
Different flavors than usual. More in each bag than many of the others. Fast shipping, no problems. I wish more bags came with the order. :)

column9: No, No, No! Don't get these
column10: They tasted awful. I really could not tell the mango from the pineapple. They are little tiny peices. I will not order again.

column9: Great For A Mid Day Snack
column10: In our house we are very much snack people whether it be chips, fruit or cookies we love to snack on food. So, when we got these we was super happy to try something new. My kids love banana's so that was the first one they went for and in no time the whole bag was gone but at least I did get a picture of the stuff before it was completely gone. They also really loved the strawberry. My husband and me sampled all and they had a very pleasant taste that wasn't to strong but wasn't faint enough where you couldn't tell what fruit you were eating. It had the perfect taste. Another thing I really like is I tried the mango in some yogurt and was extremely surprised at how well it tasted plus it was nice to have a different texture in with the yogurt. I am not much of a yogurt person but this did help me a lot in wanting to eat it more often. Plus, as a mom with kids in alot of different extra curricular activities it is nice to have things like this to carry around that won't go bad and is the perfect size and serving.

Wow, I can't believe I just threw all of this stuff out and wasted all that money.  I am going to ask for a refund with Amazon because I feel the "USDA approved" is misleading.This stuff stinks so badly I had to take my trash out after I tossed it.  I was also hugely disappointed to see it was a "Product of Bolivia".I was looking for a nice organic, USA grown freeze dried fruit - when I saw the "USDA approved" I assumed it was made in the USA, but it says right on the label "Product of Bolivia".If you are looking for a good snack, I strongly suggest checking out 18 Rabbits Cheeky Cherry Chocolate, Organic Granola bar, 1.9-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12).  They are made in the USA and everything is certified organic, and best of all, they taste like something so good that you should feel bad eating it!

I love this coffee. I may be just me (I'm n absolute coffee lover) but I find the taste just great. I'd definitely order again. I had an issue with a broken package but I don't think it was the seller's fault and I chose not to go through the hassle of returning it and asking for a new one.
I agree with another reviewer who wrote that this is a full-bodied, bold-flavored coffee. The brew is delicious and the price is right. I would buy this product again.

column9: Extremely good Kona blend for the price
column10: I'm a coffee addict who fell in love with Kona coffee on a recent trip to Hawaii. Genuine Kona coffee is expensive and hard to find on  the mainland, but this Kona blend is inexpensive and very similar to what is brewed on the islands. Price is cheaper than any specialty coffee offered at a Starbucks or Peets, but the quality is identical. I'll be buying this again!
If you like a full bodied bold coffee... this is it.  I prepare mine with a french coffee press to take full advantage of the great flavor.
I purchased this as a gift and the recipient said the coffee was good but not as good as other Kona they had tasted.
I find many coffees to be too bitter, but the Magnum Kona is delicious. It has a very smooth, rich flavor, without being as expensive as many "premium" coffees in the stores.
I just finished a bag of this same coffee but it was their whole been coffee that was good. This stuff is worthless. It is very bitter and very little flavor. I am staying away from this bag

First time I decided to try this out. For Kona the price is great of course, and the freshly opened bag is fragrant, and yet it's one of those "you get what you pay for" situations (except here you get much LESS than you paid for): the brew barely tastes like coffee (even with five teaspoons to a small cup it still tastes like boiled cardboard). You will buy a better coffee in a supermarket; any kind you pick will be better and cost about the same. Bottom line: not recommended (I won't reorder).***05/07/2012: I'm so pissed I paid for this crap, I'm trying to get a refund. The ground matter itself, when dry, smells nice, but the brew... you could brew sawdust with the same exact result. No taste, no aroma, no caffeine kick, no matter how much you use per cup. Black sludgewater. Horrible, and should be against the law to sell it. The only use for this junk I can see is to sprinkle it around the house dry -- 'cause it smells nice while dry. This product is a quintessential ripoff; stay away.05/14/2012: Sent it back and just got a refund. Whew! So that's that. At least I can thank them and Amz for the complete lack of hassle with returns.

column9: love it, great cup, great price
column10: Of course it is not "real" Kona coffee. It says blend on the bag and description. We love this coffee and it makes a  good cup of Joe. It works wonderfully in our french press and makes a nice, fresh, coffee shop grade cup.

I accidentally ordered this a second time. The word "Kona" in the name of the coffee throws me off. Such a waste of money.I love Kona coffee and ones like it. They, in my experience, are mellow and not burned tasting.
Lets keep this simple... This coffee has NO FLAVOR, except for a hint of cardboard.  I used half the bag to make a pot and it was still tasteless.  Worst thing I ever bought on Amazon.

I LOVE coffee.  Kona in perticular because of its taste.  It's strong, but at the same time very smooth.  That is not the case here.  I don't know if it has something to do with the beans come already grounded (I ground the beans just before brew.  I also keep it refrigerated after opening), or it's a package issue, but this coffee has no taste.  I am sorry to say that I will not buy it again.
Bought this for a coffee-lover friend, and she LOVED it.  Had a cup of it every day until it was gone.
MY BROTHER SENT ME A BAG FOR CHRISTMAS.  IT IS THE VERY BEST COFFEE I HAVE EVER DRANK!  I WILL BE BUYING MORE.

For an avid coffee drinker this is a great choice! The price is also fair. If you buy dunkin donuts coffee it is the same price and not nearly as good. It is a pretty strong coffee which I love but it also is very smooth! A must have a++!
Not bad.  Most coffee taste like water to me, this one has some flavor.  Flavor kinda-sorta reminds of Kona coffee?  Maybe?
I really enjoy this coffee!  Not bitter, doesn't bother my tummy like some do.  The price can't be beat either. A great value!

column9: Low price, still not worth it
column10: With coffee prices going nuts, I decided to start trying a bunch of different ones to see if I could find something affordable and tasty. Chalk this one up as a failure. This stuff has no taste. Accidentally put too much in my machine, but decided to leave it in to see if that created flavor (plus I could use it up faster that way). The result was another bland pot of coffee. Definitely won't be buying this stuff again.

I was looking for a Kona blend  as I can't financially justify the pure Kona coffee. Amazon offered the Magnum Kona Blend and I ordered 2 pounds. I found my first pot too strong using 6 tablespoons for 6 cups as I did with my previous Kona blend. I then went to 5 tablespoons, still too strong. I then went to 4 and that was the winner. So I got the same enjoyment with only 4 tablespoons instead of 6. GOOD DEAL!!!

If you like coffee that's bold but not burnt tasting; coffee that you can enjoy throughout the day this is a great choice.  Hawaii and Jamaica have always been known for the extraordinary coffees.  This blend gives you all that satisfaction without the large tab.
I have tried a few of the magnum coffees and love them. Hawaiian is my favorite but Costa Rica coffee is excellent also. 10 bucks is a great deal.
It's a very delicious coffee. If I have brewed left overs I make iced coffee from it.Love it!!Love it!!Love it!!Love it!!

Just got a bag of the Kona Blend.  I don't know how much Kona is in it, but it is a good medium body coffee bean.  It reminds me of Costa Rican Tarrazu coffee beans.  Four stars only because I've had better from a local fresh bean roaster.  The Magnum Kona Blend is a very good coffee and a good value here from Amazon.

column9: Not my favorite cup of coffee
column10: This coffee was drinkable, but I won't buy it again.  Having had pure Kona coffee, this is a pale impersonator.  It may be worth it to buy the real thing if you want Kona Coffee.  I felt this had a strong artificial flavoring taste to it.
If you like Kona, this is great coffee! Mellow yet full-bodied when brewed strong (if you like it that way).

If it's not 100% Kona, don't buy it. Yes, it's expensive, but 100% Kona is the best. The import of other beans to Hawaii is ruining the crops there. What's the point of having a 10% Kona blend? I have not bought, and will not buy, this coffee.

These are totally delicious, and also one of the few breakfast cereals without high fructose corn syrup (even All Bran has that). They are a bit sugary but not too sweet. Certainly filling and just what I like for breakfast, and so do my kids.I'm not sure why Amazon isn't doing this on subscribe and save (at least when I'm writing this), but seeing as almost every grocery store I know of runs out of these on a fairly regular basis, probably worth getting from Amazon.

column9: My favorite cereal since I was a kid
column10: I grew up eating Quaker Oatmeal Squares, and they're still my favorite cereal and a great source of fiber - I tried Fiber One for a while, but the aspartame in it gave me headaches and Fiber One leaves an awful aftertaste. Quaker's doesn't have aspartame, and there's tasty brown sugar which gives it just the right amount of sweetness (the cinnamon sugar one is really good too!)What I love about Quaker Oatmeal Squares is that they're perfectly delicious with or without milk. They're super crunchy without, and after soaking in milk for a while they absorb the liquid and become like cereal-milk gushers. I personally like that, but for those who don't, you can always just eat the cereal immediately after adding milk.

column9: Who cares what color it is?
column10: My family has LOVED this cereal for years.  I recently read the packaging and have discovered that it contains artificial colors.  We are trying to avoid eating foods with artificial coloring in them.  Please reconsider Quaker?  We don't care what color it is!

column9: Good with milk but not withouth
column10: I'd like to give it 3.5 stars but it's not possible.I usually like to eat cereal as a snack between lunch and dinner, but this one is not good to eat alone, it's very dry and not much flavor.Of course adding milk, some fruits and a little sugar, it's very good, but for me it's not a good buy so I canceled my subscription. Time to try another one.I tried the Honey Nuts bunches of oats and that one it's better for me so far. The other one I like it very much is the Life Cinnamon.

column9: sweeter than it used to be
column10: This used to be my favorite cereal and I still really like it. However, over the years they have sweetened it more and more and it's just not as good as it once was.

These things are better than steak.. filet mignon! It was well worth the purchase of this package. It saves you a couple bucks versus buying them in the store. Go ahead, splurge yourself and get some.

This is one of my alltime favorite cereals, my 3 yo likes it too, she calls it "mommy's cereal". It is also great in party mix. This cereal is approved for WIC, which is nice because it can be kind of expensive.When I was pregnant with my second daughter, I had an aversion to this cereal, and couldn't stand to eat it, but luckily after I had my daughter my taste buds went back to normal and I eat this cereal all the time....in fact, I'm going to go eat some now. :)

This is a great cereal. What more could you ask than something that tastes good and is good for you. Take a good look at the nutritional panel. On a very reliable site that evaluates food by grade (can't remember the site)they gave it an "A". This is the highest rating and is usually reserved for fruits and vegetables. The thing I like about this cereal is that it's great in milk and stays very crunchy for a long time. But the best thing is that they make a fantastic dry snack. You can have a cup, for a reasonable amount of calories, munch on them, and be satisfied. I put some in a ziplock and snack on them all day. I have given boxes to my friends and they and their kids love them too.

Oats are my favorite kind of whole grain. As for oat based cereals, Cheerios is a bit expensive and so is this, but this beats it in texture, flavor, and viability of eating dry straight out of the box. Quaker's product line has some things that I don't like, but I know to spot the brand name to find some new ways to enjoy oats.They rarely go on sale at the supermarket. The lowest I've seen was 4 for $6, but I was in NY and it got buried in snow and we had no power for a week, so I missed stocking up.

column9: Tasty, healthy cereal for the whole family
column10: We agree with the other reviews of Quaker Oatmeal Squares (Hint of Brown Sugar) cereal.  Our child really likes it, and it doesn't contain excess sugar or any fructose.  Plus these cereal squares don't become "soggy" quickly, which we all appreciate.  We'd highly recommend purchasing this cereal via Amazon.  It's also a very competitive price per ounce, which isn't true of all cereals offered via Amazon.

I was so excited about this cereal when I tried it.  I bought it off Amazon here and when it arrived I dug in.  Well I had a headache and nausea episode quickly following.  I suppose I ate too much as the little sample I tried before did nothing to me.  It has to be the food dye as any other cereal didn't do that to me.  I used to be allergic to yellow #5 and #6 before (it would make me jump off the walls as a kid!).  I thought I outgrew it.  Maybe this is an "adult" allergy.  Quaker, keep the food dyes out!  I love your dye-free oatmeal, why does this have to be so different?
Like the product, but the size keeps decreasing with the price also rising at the same time.  Amazon still has the best price by far and I will never buy this product in a local store again.

column9: My favorite way to eat oatmeal
column10: Love love love this cereal.  7yr old son loves it too.  Great for breakfast and for quick snacks.  Will grab a container and bring in the car for a quick snack in between appointments at work.  Love this stuff!
Cereal came as advertized. The outer box itself was a tad dented on the edges. The cereal itself was not crushed so all is good. We would order cereal online again.

This is one of the few foods that is not only healthy for you but tastes absolutely amazing! This cereal is so good we could eat the whole box in one sitting. Unfortunately we cannot afford to do this too often as the cereal is a bit pricey.What we like most about this cereal is how it tastes nutty and sweet without being cloyingly sweet.Highly recommend.
My whole family loves Quaker oatmeal squares.  They are slightly sweet, healthy, and leave you feeling satisfied for the entire morning.  Over time, it has become the only cereal we eat!
Our whole family loves this cereal (especially my 5-year-old)! And it's a whole-grain, high-fiber meal. Plus, it's a bargain when you subscribe and save, and get 15% off. You can't beat that!

column9: Ate whole sample box with no milk! Delicious
column10: Got a free sample from Quaker's FB page...ate the whole box without milk!  They are just the perfect sweetness with the great crunch of oatmeal.  Lots of fiber to fill you up w/ far fewer calories than other cereals or snacks.  I recommend them highly.
I received a free sample of these.  I loved them! they are crunchy and have just a touch of sweet.  Can't wait to go buy some more!
I enjoyed my free box...and used the coupon to buy a regular sized box which I had to hide from the cereal monsters I live with.  Delicious!

I received a free sample from the company and fed it to my 16 month old daughter, and she loved it! She kept sticking her hand in the box for more and ended up eating the whole thing. I would definitly buy this again.

column9: One of the best cereals EVER!!!!
column10: This has to be one of the best cereals ever!  Everyone in the house likes it, it is good both dry and in milk.  It doesn't get immediately soggy once you add the milk, which is an added bonus in my eyes!  If you haven't ever tried it, you don't know what you are missing.  My family of 5 prbably goes through 6 or more boxes a month!
I received a free sample of these last week and I ate them that day.  They were absolutely delicious!  I hope I can find some good sales at my local store, we eat a lot of cereal at our house.

column9: A great summer option to oatmeal.
column10: I enjoyed my sample so much that I took the coupon that came with it and bought a whole box. My husband thought they were great too. We usually eat hot oatmeal, but when it's too hot outside or I don't have time to cook this cereal is a great option.
Quaker Oatmeal Squares has been our family favorite for a couple of years now.  Can't get enough of it.  Just the right sweetness and crunch.

Unlike Roberto Bárcenas, I thought that these little squares were wonderful either way!  I snacked on them for two days (1 or 2 at a time) before I ever tried them with milk, and I PREFER them dry!They are oatmeal - what could be wrong with that?????????
We love Quaker's Oatmeal Squares.  They are a healthier breakfast cereal option but also make for a perfect snack or on the go.

I got a sample box of these in the mail a couple of weeks ago and ate them then next morning.  They were even better than I could have imagined!  They were not to hard, but did not get soggy in the milk, either.  They are just the right size for a bite and don't irritate the roof of my mouth like a lot of similar cereals will.  They also had just the right balance of sweetness without tasting sugary nor being bland.  Overall, I was very pleased and will definitely consider buying these in the future.
I love this cereal thank you so much Quaker Oatmeal for sending me a sample.  I love them dry for a snack.  It is delicious!!
I love it.  Going to be on my shopping list from now on.  Great as a snack.  Dont need milk but great that way too.

i am totally in love with this cereal. i mix the brown sugar and the cin. together and i eat a bowl every morning~~also...in the evening i will warm the milk and let it set just a bit and it is amazing.  like eating a dessert~~except its good for ya!!LOL!!

Why does Quaker find the need to put BHT (a preservative) in their near wholesome and nutritionally sound cereals? Other companies, Kashi, do not add preservatives.  Also, some other companies use Vitamin E as a preservative, which is more wholesome, as preservatives go.  Just a thought, thanks!

This cereal is delicious with milk.  Not so much straight out of the box though.  My children also loved it (again with milk) I usually give my boys dry cereal to snack on thought this would be a great healthy cereal however they only like it with milk but still delicious!
I loved my sample!  This cereal is good as a snack or a cereal.  With some blueberries and some cold milk - YUM!  Thank you!
These oatmeal squares have a hint of sweetness and a nice crunch. I found them filling, and my children kept stealing squares, so they're kid-friendly too.

I saw another review that said these were best with milk. I agree, without they are a little plain and dry, but taste sweeter, somehow, with milk. I got a free sample and thought they were really good.

column9: DELICIOUS AS A SNACK OR WITH MILK
column10: I RECEIVED TWO FREE SAMPLES. WHAT A DELICIOUS CEREAL FOR SNACK OR BREAKFAST. IT WAS GREAT TO TAKE TO WORK FOR AN INBETWEEN SNACK TO GET ME TO LUNCH WITHOUT FEELING STARVING.

my large family easily goes through 3-4 boxes a week. at shop rite it is one of the cheaper cereals so thats an added plus. half of us have high cholesterol and this is an easy yummy way to bring it down. its been eaten with cows milk and goats milk and plain as a nutritious snack on the go!
I tried this cereal I personally liked it but like most households my children choose the cereal they tried it and didn't liked it. I would recommend it for adults but not so much for children.

I received Quaker Oatmeal Squares (Touch of Brown Sugar) as a sample from one of my coupon sites. I had that one little bowl which also came with a coupon and I had to go buy more. I am almost finished with my first box now which was the Brown Sugar, and I am about to try the Cinnamon!! Very tasty, almost healthy,and surprisingly satisfying. I feel full on a much smaller amount of this cereal than with other cereals. Very Good!!

Quaker Oatmeal Squares are my son's and my favorite cereal so I was very excited to find it so inexpensive per box on Amazon, but when they arrived, the boxes were so small!  Only 16oz!  That made me unhappy and I thought they may have cost too much.  But then I went to the Wal-Mart and found the boxes there are only 16oz now, but still the same price.  So the Amazon price is good, but Quaker is making the product smaller.

column9: Quaker Oatmeal Squares is Number One

column9: More of a short-lived breath mint than gum
column10: I tried several different flavors of Mentos gum, but was rather disappointed by the overall product.First of all, the good points.  The gum comes in a hard, durable container, which is easy to carry around in one's pants pocket, and also facilitates dispensing.  Additionally, I like the initial texture of the gum, as it has a hard exterior shell and a soft chewy interior core, which immediately releases a burst of flavoring.  Lastly, the texture and consistency of the gum is maintained throughout the mastication process.Now, the bad part.  The biggest drawback is that the flavor only lasts at most a few minutes, necessitating me to eat several pieces at once in order to maintain any semblance of lasting mint flavor.  Compared to other rival brands such as Dentyne or Eclipse, this is unacceptable.  I'm not interested in chewing a piece of bland plastic after just 2-3 minutes.  Some have also commented that the hard container makes too much noise in one's pants pockets when walking around.In summary, the Mentos are best used as an ephemeral breath mint, rather than a long-lasting gum.

My dentist recommended I chew Mentos gum because the main ingredient is Xylitol and that it breaks down the bacteria that causes cavaties.  Right there, I was sold.  I'm a lifelong avid gum chewer and to have a dentist actually RECOMMEND I chew a certain brand was like music to my ears!  I like that it's got the crunchy shell and then the inside is soft - and stays soft!  I think the flavor lasts a decent amount of time - but I like to chew and usually have a piece long after the flavor is gone.  I highly recommend this gum - my favorite is the spearmint flavor, but I've enjoyed all of the mint flavors.  I haven't tried the fruity flavors because Xylitol isn't the main ingredient - dentist says it MUST be the main ingredient for it to work properly.  :)

This tea is amazingly tasty white tea. For most people they may not know what white tea taste like. Where black tea has the acidic taste of coffee and green tea has a very earth/leafy taste, white tea comes in as you would expect for its color. It is very light tasting with almost a lightly sweet maltiness to it. It doesn't have any of the harshness that you could find in black tea or coffee. And you can't really over brew it to release off-flavors as there is so little to the leaves. I find this tea works best for iced tea, it works well cold and has a much more refreshing flavor that other teas do on a summer day.Of course there are there is the added benefit that it is good for you. Times vary according to volume, natch, but usually 10 minute bursts work: 10 minutes high, 10 minutes at 70% or whatever, another 10 minutes at 70%. I like to let it sit covered between the last two ten minutes and after. As long as it's hot and covered it will absorb water. Can't wait to try it in a pressure cooker to get the cook times down, but thus far, I let it cook while I'm making a curry or something else.Love it! That is how it is with us and the SARDINE CUTLETS. We can really chow down on them, but then we need a break. About three weeks seems to be right and then we have a go at them again. Those cutlets are lovely, but they are NOT an everyday food for us fur people!"And that folks, seems to be exactly how my kitties feel about the Sardine Cutlets. If I give them some every two or three weeks, and it seems every three weeks is the best, they have a wonderful time eating Sardine Cutlets. If I give them another can right away, they just walk off. So, therein lies the "chili dog" analogy. They LOVE, LOVE, LOVE them once in a while, but too often is TOO OFTEN. So, I buy a case and it lasts me quite a while: 2 or 3 months. But, when they are in the mood, LOVE THEM THEY DO!Since this is not an everyday food that they like all the time, all five have agreed that this is a four star item. EVERYDAY, ANYDAY foods get 5 stars. All are agreed on this vote and they say "Thank you very much for your attention to our opinions. We only tell you Amazonian friends the truth and the truth is that the Sardine Cutlets are a four star food feast, BUT they are Wonderful now and again for your feline people, so do order them. column9: Nerds, The Candy of My Youth
column10: Whether or not you like Nerds probably depends on when you were a child. I was not yet in high school in the early 80s and the sweet, tangy taste was a salve that help take my mind off homework, bullies and girls. After bus dropped me off at school, I'd run up the hill to the candy truck and buy a box or two. The grape and strawberry where the originals and my all time favorite. Eaten one at a time or in an overwhelming mouthful, I just loved 'em.Nerds were the "Candy of the Year" in 1985. They're thickly glazed with carnauba wax that gives them their hard crunch, and a flavored gloss. The center of each candy is composed of one or more complete, tangy sucrose crystals. If you were patient enough to let the coating dissolve in your mouth, then you could take it out and see that the crystals were clear. I was rarely so self retrained though, and would usually suck on their fun texture for a little while then just crunch away.The box has two openings at the top, one for each flavor. It was always a mystery which side I'd finish first, since I went back and forth between the two. I tried them again recently, and though my taste buds have evolved over the years, I found I still love them. It doubt they're very healthy, but that's not the point, is it? Candy has no point, it is just to be enjoyed! :)

When I was around 8 years old my family took me and my younger brother on our first trip to Cape Cod Massachusetts, since then we went up once every summer for a week or so, those first few years we would take a pop up camper to a camp site by the beach. The campsite itself had two memorable things, the first was a play ground my brother and I would spend time at, and the second was a small candy shop down by the end of the road leading up to the camp site, it was in this candy store that I had my first box of Nerds.My brother and I looked all over the candy store with the wide eyed wonder of the literal kid in a candy shop. The one thing that caught my eye was the small pink and purple box of candy up by the register. Since our mother only let us buy one thing each this is what I chose, and my brother (always copying me) chose the same, which we enjoyed on our way back to the camper. Of all the tastes on that trip, the marshmellows we toasted over the campfire, the seafood we had in the local resturants, my first bite of buttered lobster, the wind and saltwater on the beach, it was that little box of candy that my brother and I shared on the way back to the camper that stands out to me the most.Many years later in high school I met one of my best friends working at the local FYE, his name was Andrew and we first started talking over one of the jumbo boxes of Nerds, striking up a conversation about how you got almost a pound of candy with the box of Nerds, and how other candy boxes skimped out and filled it with mostly empty space. For most of my high school years he and I would hang out at the store, exchange stories, shoot the breeze, ect, usualy over a box of Nerds.Ive now been out of high school for almost four years, Andrew and I have lost touch over the past few years, and my brother died almost 7 years ago. After all this time these tiny little candies still bring back all the happy memories from my childhood and teen years. Bravo Wonka on this exellent product.

I love these!!! Unfortunately I have a small allergic reaction to marzipan but I put up with it in order to have one of these. The reaction is to almond extract and happens with anything that has the extract in it. It has nothing to do with this candy. I highly recommend buying these. So yummy!!

This stuff is totally amazing and I use it on everything. I got everyone in the family a bag of it.  It enhances the flavor and it is addictive!!!!  Cannot live without this stuff.  My order came right away.  I put it on fried potatoes and it was delicious.  If you haven't tried this stuff go for it and I promise you won't be diappointed.  Hamburgers on the grill have never ever been this wonderful!!!  Dashida I love you!!!
A beefy hot drink on a chill morning, a boost for sukiyaki, beef stew, or spaghetti sauce, at 3/4 tsp per cup, this stuff is potent and economical!

This gluten-free mix makes rich, delicious brownies.  My neighbor is gluten-intolerant and has a terrible time finding delicious foods that the rest of us take for granted.  I didn't realize how common the condition was until I started talking with neighbors and friends. These make the perfect neighborly treat for her.  Regardless of whether you have celiac disease or not, this mix makes some amazingly good brownies.

Until you have tried the smoky Lapsang Souchong tea you have no idea about what a real quality tea is like.

column9: Creamy strong and needs white wine
column10: Epoisses is not well known.  For those of you who know what washed rind cheese is, this is one of the greats.  For those of you who do not, this is a class of cheese that is strong.  So do not serve it as the only choice for the uninitiated.  Better to serve at least the classic three choices, one sheep, one goat and this for the cow.  You know, half a Noah.If you are trying it for yourself for the first time, here are a couple of points:- take most of the top crust off, gently with a sharp paring knife and fork.  Not deep.  The crust is soft.- let the cheese come to room temperature (this is a creamy almost soupy cheese and looses most of its taste if cold and firm)- serve with a small spoon, no bigger than an espresso spoon.  (caviar spoons work.  in a pinch, the handle of an ice cream bar works.  The point is not to have big glops extracted) - good on bread.  Bath Oliver crackers are good.  Water crackers or cream crackers.Wine is essential.  The first time I had this cheese, I had a shmear on a piece of bread.  Wow, the cheese was extraordinary.  Then I had a mouth wash of white wine.  Then the cheese opened into the transformational moment of perfection.  True Sartori.  So always serve with cool white wine,  The fat and alcohol mate to explode all the hidden flavors.My choice is a Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru.  But since I cannot pay for my choice, I am reduced to mere extacy  with a good chalky, flinty Frascati.  For American wines, the new style of lean, un-oaked chardonnay works.  You might better reach for a Fume Blanc otherwise.If you are interested but not quite comfortable, then go for the plain Epoisses, not the creamy.  It is a gateway cheese, as we pushers say.Finally, this is a fair price to pay.

This mix has a delightful flavor and texture, and it is an excellent source of fiber.  Barley has a beneficial effect on blood sugar levels, and this product makes it literally an instant side dish without excess fat or sodium. In addition to a side dish, I have added it to soup and used it as a component of a cold salad.
We love this product!  We use it to make our own chile powder.  Very high quality and consistent in flavor.  Highly recommended.
Product was as advertised.I have not used much, as yet.  So I am assuming the quality is good as well.

If you love Girl Scout Thin Mints you will crave these little gems.  I am not a huge sweet fan but I could eat the entire box in one sitting.  The downside is I think you can only get them during the holidays.  Not sure if I will make it until then!

Absolutely delicious. I received them as a gift this past Christmas and was hoping to get them for myself. Rich chocolate with an amazing texture and great real mint flavor. They were the best when kept in the fridge/freezer, a little crisper and the cold set off the mint and chocolate. I definitely recommend them, and would buy them for myself and as a gift for others. Wish I could get them year round, but it is probably best I don't or I wouldn't fit through the door. :)
My 2 cats really like this cat food best of all! I have regular deliveries in order to be sure to have an ample amount available.

This is the only flavor my cat will eat.  She goescrazy over this flavor.  I think because it is easyto eat instead of a big chunk.  This looks like littlesquare slices of beef.  It smells good too.  WheneverI open a can of this, she comes running!  She's meowingat me repeatedly if she sees the can in my hand, and Iimagine that she is saying "Hey, hurry up and open thatcan! I know what you got there.  You can't fool me.Gimme that yummy food!"  But of course, she's sayingthat in cat language.  Because I love her, I can totallyunderstand what she's saying. The cats don't like this flavor. I would have preferred an assortment of flavors. The product itself is good. I just have finicky cats. And I am weaning them off wet food, anyway. My older cat is getting too big! Notice I didn't say fat!  ;-)

If you are looking for a new flavor try chocolate and rasberry, you won't be disappointed.If you've sampled the weight watchers chocolate with rasberry filling you'll know what I mean.  Shipping is quick!Karen Port Richey Florida

Wife and I both enjoyed the first bag.  The second bag was harder to get through...  More of an occasional food.  "Dehydrated to preserve living enzymes & vital nutrition."A couple of bites takes awhile to chew.Original BBQ flavor is sweet vinegar style.
These were awful.  However, I sent them to my daughter in Hawaii and she loved them.  She's more into EXTREME healthy eating than I am.

This is a great canned dog food! I never feed my dog canned dog food alone, I mix it in with her dry kibble.  I've been having a hard time lately getting her to eat, so I started mixing about 1/6 of a can of this with a little water into her kibble and now she devours it as soon as I put it down! My dog has some food allergies, but she can eat avoderm foods no problem!  Glad I found this brand and I think i'll be sticking with it for quite a while!
This is a premium canned food that my dog loves, and stays very healthy on.  It is highly recommended by official dog food review sites, and I would not hesitate to order it again.

I purchased this based on the "natural" ingredients and a general thumbs-up from my vet. My first dog got very sick with severe vomiting. Thinking she got into something unrelated to the food, I continued to feed this to my other dog. Within 2 days my other dog got sick as well. The result = 2 sick dogs + a vet bill. The remaining cans went in the trash immediately.  I would NEVER recommend this dog food to anyone.

Chances are, if you're not European, you will not like this. It is a very thick, sour milk (lapte batut in Romanian). :o)Growing up on it, I was very happy to find it here in the states.You can usually find it at Whole Foods, Wild Oats or in the gourmet section at Safeway/Vons.The regular tastes much better than the low fat, but it's still very thick and sour. They also make it in Vanilla and berries, Blueberry I think.My husband, who is American, says it tastes like milk that's gone bad. I happen to disagree.  :o)

column9: Good stuff but a little too expensive
column10: I have not tried the plain one but the berry one taste very good. I found them on sale at Kroger's and bought 6 bottles. They taste like yogurt but a little bit more sour. And it is liquid. Love it and would recommend. But the original price is way too expensive, I think. 3$ a bottle is would be about right.

This is the first and only kefir brand that I've tried. I have not had the flavored products, but I prefer the sour and plain taste. My family is Indian and we are used to making yogurt at home. Store bought plain yogurt is usually too flat for me, but this plain kefir has the right taste, similar to the yogurt I miss from home.The bubbly feeling might take some time to get used to, however. It's very good cold, with a tiny bit of salt, like plain/salt lassi.

column9: Recommended in the 17 Day Diet Book
column10: If you're looking for a great, nutritious liquid yogurt type product, you might like to try this lowfat kefir.  I learned about kefir in the book The 17 Day Diet: A Doctor's Plan Designed for Rapid Results.  A nutritionist recommended having protein for breakfast and combining protein with fruit.  I love to make fruit smoothies with this: one banana, one cup frozen berries, 1/2 cup kefir and 1/2 cup berry juice.  The protein keeps you from getting hungry.I also love to buy this in fruit flavors when I don't have time to make a smoothie in the morning.  I've tried the peach, pomegranate and raspberry and they are delicious.  They are probiotic with 10 different kinds of bacteria and naturally cultured.  Kefir provides 25% of Vitamin D, 30% Calcium and 11g of Protein.  It's a great breakfast, lunch or snack option.  A cup is about 140 calories.

column9: It's all what you're used to!
column10: I happen to enjoy Lifeway's plain, low-fat yogurt.  Doesn't at all seem sour to me!  You can make fruit smoothies with it and have a healthy low-fat meal/snack that is filling, tastes great, is inexpensive AND good for you all at the same time!!  If you enjoy plain, low-fat yogurt, with fresh fruit, you will enjoy this as well.  Best bet would be to try and find it in your local health food store first, or a Super Wal-Mart may have it, before you buy the carton.  When making fruit smoothies with it, I add frozen unsweetened fruit (1 cup of fruit to 1 cup of Kefir) in a blender, you can add sugar, agave nectar, honey, truvia or whatever you wish to sweeten it, a little flaxseed oil and blend.  It's DELISH!!!
We drink this for the probiotics, but we usually add protein powder, 1/2 cup  frozen berries, a banana and sometimes a couple TBS of lecithin or hemp seeds.  We enjoy this every day.

I purchased this product for it's probiotics, but found it difficult to disguise the sour taste.  Lifeway's flavored products were a much better option.  This product can make a good substitute for sour cream as far as taste goes.  It has a much thinner consistancy though.

For breakfast, about 3-5 times a week, I take one of those 2-cup clear plastic "take-out" containers (the kind that can hold soup without spilling) and fill it with 1 cup or more of grapes or other fresh fruit and then pour 1 cup of the lowfat plain kefir on top.  To add texture or nutrition or variety I might sprinkle a tablespoon of slivered almonds and/or a tablespoon of fresh ground flaxseed on top.  I take it to work and eat it with a spoon, the same way I would eat a yogurt.  I'd rather "eat" my kefir than drink it because eating is more satisfying and there's less prep/clean-up time vs. making a smoothy.Sure, the grapes are high in natural sugar, but they make the whole combo tasty, satisfy my sweet tooth, and are still a lot better than eating processed sugar, in my opinion.  I like but avoid the sweetened/flavored kefirs for this reason.  Adding flaxseed is my way of painlessly sneaking in some seriously healthy stuff while keeping the meal "easy on the palate."Frankly, I'm lazy about food prep and not entirely health-conscious with my diet, but I do try to stay on the lookout for foods/recipes that meet all of my three criteria for the IDEAL food, and kefir is one of them:  --Tasty  --Healthy  --Quick & EasyI've even noticed that my mouth and breath feel "cleaner" throughout the day after I've eaten my kefir breakfast.  I think my oral and digestive health are better when I consume kefir regularly (every day or even every other day).

I recently purchased for the first time a kefir product.It was a lowfat cultured milk with peach.I was extremely disappointed. Being from Argentina and used to drink "drinkable yogurt" of the finest quality, I had waited for years to find a liter-sized drinkable yogurt. I think I will have to keep waiting.Yogurt was extremely acidic.The quality is good but the taste is not.

column9: Soft, full of flavor and delicious
column10: This gum is fantastic.  When I want some gum Bubblicious is what I reach for.  The gum came well dressed upon delivery.  The gum is fresh, smells fabulous, and great price.  I am getting ready to order more, I hope there are more flavors available.

This stuff is EXCELLENT.  It is very pricey, but the taste makes it worth the added expense.  I use this with my Fage or Chiobani Greek yogurt instead of the fruit they add.  That way it is a super healthy and amazingly tasty treat instead of just yogurt or yogurt with a lot of sugary fruit.  I order this all of the time now and will never go back to any other sugar-free jams.  This one tastes better than even the regular full-sugar jams.  Lots of chunky fruit inside, not a colored jelly goo.I HIGHLY recommend these jams.  I am a HUGE fan of xylitol and stumbling across this stuff has made me very happy!
I wasn't wild about this flavor because I am not a big fan of blueberries.  My family loved it, so I guess I would say it is great, if you like that flavor.  I prefer Strawberry and theirs was good.

This is a good quick meal.  I did find that the sauce is a little strong with fish sauce for my taste so I add extra garlic and a spoonful of peanut butter.  It's a good sauce for sauted meat and veggies for a more rounded meal.

I really appreciate the flavor of this sauce. I know you can make it better homemade however I am no thai expert in the kitchen and this is a great quick alternative. I can add some chicken to dress it up if I want my usually just eat it plain.

Always looking for easy gluten-free meals for those nights that previously called for ordering pizza. This kit, with meat and vegetables added, fit the bill. Teenage son and non-celiac husband both approved.

column9: Thai Pavilion Peanut Satay quick dish just okay as is.
column10: Okay for a quick meal - tasty, but not spicy, filling dish for one or two, if add vegetables and meat or meat alternative. The quantity enclosed is a small amount, but it can be easily stretched with added ingredients. You can spice it up with added garlic and/or ginger. I used sesame oil for vegetable oil and added peanut butter to stretch sauce.

For the size of the box, I was surprised that this only makes 2 very modest servings - we have to add a good amount of veggies and protein to make it a meal. The sauce does have a good flavor though, and the peanut satay version is rich enough to cover all of the "add-ins" with sauce too. Overall, not a good value, but tasty for packaged.

I've been buying this stuff for years (10 - 15+?) at the .99 store.  It is so good, I buy several bottles at a time, figuring once they're gone, they're gone.  Now they're gone, hence the internet search.When I purchase, I just recognize the bottle & grab it, after making sure to get the right flavor.  It wasn't until I started researching on the internet today, that I realized that this last bottle is the sugar free version.  Couldn't say what I had before, but this does not taste sugar free.  24mg of sodium & that's it.  ZERO everything else, but TASTE.  That is 100% goodness.The flavor is concentrated, so it doesn't take much to flavor your coffee.  Maybe a teaspoon or so, after adding the sugar, so a bottle can last a long time.  Don't use sugar to get the french vanilla taste without the sweet. Don't know why you'd want to do that tho'.....

Hamlyn's Scottish oatmeal is steel-cut oats, not the rolled oats (like Quaker's) most familiar in North America.  Steel-cut oats are the equivalent of cracked wheat, with each oat cut into three or four hard pellets (groats).  The groats are prepared by simmering them in a 50-50 mixture of milk and water until soft, a process that takes longer than cooking rolled oats, but results in a porridge with better flavour and texture.  There are supermarket brands of rolled oats, which can be prepared in the same way.  However, the Hamlyn's seems to be cut into somewhat smaller pieces, so that the groats are tender at about the same time the oatmeal is done.  The larger groats in other brands of steel-cut oats are often still unpleasantly hard when the porridge is done.Hamlyn's is hard to find in North America, and I was glad to find it on Amazon.

I was so happy when I first found this brand in a local imported food store--it was next to the Irish brand I had previously been buying.  Hamlyn's is just as delicious and can be cooked in five minutes instead of 30.  Plus, buying it online is cheaper and more convenient.  Anyone who has eaten Pinhead Oatmeal (similar to Steel-cut Oatmeal) will never go back to the flaked kind!

We love this oatmeal. For quite a while we were able to find it at a local market. The market changed hands and we can no longer find it locally. We are so pleased that we can receive it from Amazon. It is  a steel cut oatmeal from Scotland. It has subsatance, not like that gummy instant stuff. Hamlyn's is our every Saturday morning treat.

My wife and I were given a tin of this some years back and thoroughly enjoyed the taste and ease of preperaton.  We lucked into this product just recently and decided to give it another try.  After several years between the two events, we heartily approve of this second taste-test.  Good eating!

column9: I can't believe the price doubled!
column10: Since June 2011, the price went from $15 for 6 cans to almost $30 for 6. That is a terrible price jump. I love the oatmeal but not at that price. I will find another, cheaper, place to purchase.

Don't rely on that one star review.  If you don't want to taste the sea then don't eat SEAweed foods.  Seasnax is better than Sea's Gift brand in my opinion because they do not use canola oil.  Canola oil is not a healthy oil and the use of olive oil is sooo much better for you. I love the spicy flavor the most!

I am completely addicted to these things and I eat them all day, every day. This is the best brand because they are made only with olive oil, not canola oil. I read the post from the person who thinks they taste like the bottom of the sea, and felt the need to post my opposite opinion. Yes, there are some people who have not acquired a taste for seaweed (my daughter for one). But for anyone who likes sushi, they would probably LOVE these seaweed snacks. I felt in love the first time I bit into one, and always keeps a couple cases at my house.

column9: crispy, not  oily, but beware  chipotle
column10: I have tried countless Korean brands of roasted nori -- this brand rates very high for flavor, freshness and lack of oiliness.  Some brands have pools of oil in the individual bags, some are soggy -- these are very light.  Be careful with the chipotle -- I love spicy, but these just burned my tongue and I could not enjoy the flavor -- make sure you have some sort of dairy or cucumber available to absorb the heat!

column9: Easy, healthy, and the kids love them!!!
column10: I saw these an a blog dealing with healthy eating and the paleo lifestyle. Everyone in my house likes sea weed so I thought I would give Sea Snax a try. My kids LOVE them! It's a healthy snack that is easy to carry in a purse or lunch bag. I highly recommend them because they are easy, healthy and they taste great. My kids were fighting over who got to eat the last package. Although sea weed can be an acquired taste, the flavors of these Sea Snax make the taste easier to acquire.
Heard about this product online and decided to give it a try. It IS strangely addictive, but you have to like the taste of seaweed. Only problem is my kids keep snitching them!

I discovered these in a local health food store when I began searching for seaweed products as a way to add some iodine to my diet. The store carried lots of products, but most were processed with nasty canola oil which I try to avoid as I do all the high-PUFA oils. Then I found SeaSnax which use olive oil!I bought some and the rest was history. Now I buy them in bulk from amazon because the price is much better. Yes, they do have a slightly fishy odor and flavor - but I *like* that. You may not like them as much as I do if that bothers you. But for me they are the perfect snack - great taste, a nice crunchy mouth-feel, low in carbs and calories. No matter what your eating goals or eating style - low carb, low cal, low fat, vegan, etc. these snacks can fill the bill, but you *must* like that slightly fishy taste and scent. However in my case I do!I eat these so often that it's great amazon has them in bulk like this, although my most recent purchase was a 6-pack and not a 12 as I wanted to buy ALL the flavors, not just the plain, so I bought 6-packs of them all. But I'll certainly be ordering again soon. These are one of my favorite food finds of the year.

column9: Three reasons NOT to buy this product
column10: We really wanted to like this product, it seemed so sensible, lo calorie and healthy, but:1. They taste NASTY. If you didn't grow up with this flavor, e.g. fishy tasting, you're probably going to react like everyone in our household -- YUCK2. The portion sizes are very small. It's just @3" X 3" pieces of toasted seaweed and not a lot of them at that.3. Probably the most environmentally wasteful way to pack a product these days. Plastic tray holding the "snack" wrapped in more plastic. With all the promo about how healthy the product is what's with the packaging?Do yourself a favor and buy some bulk bin unsalted roasted nuts instead.
I am not a very picky eater, I really thought I would like these.  But they taste like FISH.  I deffinatly would not reccomend them.

I ordered the SeaSnax on the reviews that claimed they were strangely addictive.  I've eaten a few of them so far, and it keeps tasting like I'm eating the bottom of the ocean.  I won't order them again.

If you like honey, you are going to love this one. It is incredible, awesome and gorgeous. It is so good, you are not going to want to 'waste' this honey over toast bread. I eat it with teaspoon ever day and night, sometimes put a tiny bit of it in my home-made oatmeal reduced in organic milk and stir it together. Oh my god, it turns my oatmeal to the best recipe on Earth! I have not yet received a single negative or even a so-so reference from any of the people around me who has tasted this honey.A shopping tip: Due to its unique and wonderful taste, and the pretty package, it makes one of the best gifts for honey lovers. Two of these together makes a better Christmas gift than useless & cheap electronics or textiles.

column9: The perfect honey with a lot of taste for a change!
column10: This honey is of great quality!It comes from the "Pays Basque" region of Southwest France in the foothills of the Pyrenees Mountains between France and Spain.I have traveled many times in this region and have tasted a lot of food specialties in the many open air markets that you can find in almost every small towns in France.You can really taste the many flowers used by the honey bees. It has a very hearty taste, great to eat on hot toast for breakfast. I will buy more!Enjoy!

This honey has a very sweet and unique taste to it. It has a thick and creamy composition, and possesses a smooth rich flavor unlike any other honey that I've tried. Interestingly, though much sweeter than other brands, it still has the same calorie values - 60 calories per 20g. The honey is packaged in a sealed container, which is placed inside the decorative metal pail. I highly recommend this to anyone who loves honey.

This honey is the best honey we've ever eaten. Silky smooth we eat it on toast, off the spoon,  a little bit of heaven. Relatives clap when they open their gift and see we've given it to them as a present.
If you love honey, you will really love this!!!! We love to eat it on toast. My wife eats it by the spoonful. Very glad we tried it. This will be one we continue to buy, and have on hand.

This is the best honey I've ever had.  At first I put it in my tea since I always put honey with my tea.  After tasting it by itself, it's probably too good to be put in with tea.  It looks like caramel, and is very viscous.
Amazing honey!  Smooth texture and nice, light flavor.  A GREAT find!  Try it.  You'll be glad you discovered it too.
This is the best honey we have found.Thick and creamy, not clear like some honeys. However because the price has almost doubled lately we use it more sparingly.

Best honey I have ever tasted.  The only problem I encountered was one bucket was poorly sealed and was leaking. Aside from this, the honey is excellent - so good that I have ordered it under Amazon's Subscribe & Save program.

Like others, I had a sticky surprise when I opened up my Amazon box.  A small amount of honey had leaked out, which given the price, wasn't welcome.  I also worry about ant access.  Be that as it may, this is a very good honey and I eat a spoonful of it most days.  I'm on the fence on the price/value equation but I certainly don't regret buying it.  I do hope they consider a glass jar for packaging.

This is the second time I have ordered Bernard Michaud 1000 Flower Honey and for obvious reasons.  It has a smooth, almost creamy texture with a rich taste.  By far, this product is well worth the price.  I enjoy it with whole grain oatmeal and a sliced banana almost every morning.  I highly recommend it to the individual who is looking for premium honey.
I use this honey for my tea and won't go back to sugar. Adds a nice flavor to anything.

column9: Disappointed in this first time Honey purchase
column10: I thought I would try a different brand of honey from Amazon. The package arrived in tact in the box with no outside honey drippings as I had read in previous reviews, so I thought the purchase made it fine. However, upon opening the package, I found that both cans of honey were placed in a single plastic bag placed inside the box with no cushioning wrap around them. This did not protect what was in the plastic bag. Both cans crushed into each other in transit with one that popped open a leak in the top of the can, leaking half the contents out in the plastic bag inside the box. I was able to clean up both the cans, so I received a can and a half of usable honey for my purchase. Overall, the honey is ok, packaging is not good, so I was very disappointed in this purchase. For the price of this honey, I would suggest for anyone looking for a daily honey to use trying the Ambrosia honey from CO. Ambrosia Honey from Colorado is much better in taste, texture, price and packaging.

Very long time user and will be one for life.  The last shipment came and one can was leaking honey.  I contacted Amazon and they gave me a full credit and did not me to ship the product back.  Needles to say, I am ordering a replacement!  Love Amazon and Love this Honey!!!
The best honey I ever ate and worth the money-I have it every morning with my cup of tea.

I have truly never tasted honey with the character that this honey has. I was a bit shocked at what I had to spend to acquire it but now that I have, it is impossible to go back to average store bought honey. A side by side taste test with clover honey will make a believer out of anyone!

First shipment arrived smashed and unusable.  The postman particularly enjoyed the honey dripping all over his vehicle and himself.  After a lenghtly search for a contact number at Amazon, I finally found the setup for emailing a request for a call-back and through this means, reached a voice.  This person promptly shipped a replacement order.  This honey containers (alum), in this shipment were ALSO dented, but thankfully not leakiing.Summary: Caveat Emptor!

column9: Great product, just realize the implications of "bulk"
column10: I ordered this in November 2011, it was a great deal then and an even better deal now, especially with Amazon Prime shipping. Yes, it comes in a garbage bag basically (not vacuum sealed) in a cardboard box. They save money and get you this great bulk deal by NOT individually wrapping it into 1 or 3 pound bags. So basically what you have to do if you're an average Joe home brewer is bag it up yourself into 3lb bags, that way it stays fresh. You can't just open the big bag and scoop out 4 or 5 pounds when you need it because unless you're brewing twice a day 7 days a week, the DME will absorb lots of moisture from opening and closing it so many times, and then it'll go bad. But it DOES come in good shape and it IS good quality DME. It just won't stay in great shape for super long if you leave it in their packaging. I brewed once a week with the stuff for... I don't know how many months, many, and I never had any problems. Just bag it up into smaller brew size portions and don't worry about vacuum sealing it, just try to use each bag fairly soon after you open them. It's a great product and it really made brewing affordable for me. Zeppelin Rules.

column9: What is going on with the packaging?
column10: We just received one of these from Amazon after having bought Cooper's cans of ME here in the past without incident. Unlike the canned ME, which is just an OK deal, this is a better deal on dry ME per pound than I'd found anywhere, so naturally we were quite excited. It came shipped as a bag inside a Cooper's cardboard box inside an Amazon shipping box. However, the inner Cooper's box had been opened (it had been previously taped, and I cannot imagine why Cooper's would ship these unsealed) and the bag did not seem to be factory sealed, either. Rather, the bag was loosely tied in a knot at the top end, and the dry ME within the bag, just beneath the knot, was caked up inside the bag under the knot as if water had gotten into the bag. There was also some dried ME that had gotten wet around the outside of the bag by the knot. I'm posting this review to find out if others have had the same experience with this before I send it back (if I should bother demanding a replacement or not), but mine has been previously opened and exposed to water or other liquid, so I really cannot recommend this..

column9: Great sauce, but a bit pricey
column10: I bought a bunch of these when Amazon was running a sale. I love the basil chicken (ga kra prao) that is served at Thai restaurants and have tried to replicate it myself with no luck. I am pleased to say that the sauce included in this product replicates it perfectly.My tip is to use ground chicken rather than sliced. One sauce packet goes perfectly with 1/2 pound ground chicken. I also prefer jasmine rice rather than the included rice noodles.Which brings me to the expensive part. If you do what I do, you're basically paying for a packet of sauce. And depending on how much you eat, and how many there are of you, that could mean multiple packets per meal.Anyway, to sum up, I recommend you give it a try using ground chicken and then decide whether it's ever worth it to buy it again.

It took a while to get here, but it got here nonetheless.  This dish is actually quite spicy (and I love hot food).  It was too hot for my wife.  However, it was very tasty, and I will definitely buy it again!

This is my favorite "Asian food in a box" product.  Per the instructions, I add a half pound each of sliced chicken and fresh vegetables to the mix.  One box is plenty for 2 people and the flavor is rich, but not too spicy.  There is a different "Thai Pavilion Garlic Chili" product that is much spicier.  If you don't add meat or vegetables to this product, I can imagine how the spices might get out of balance.

I found it very helpful to disregard the directions and simply put the noodles in a dish with water and microwave for about three minutes. Add sauceand eat. I find it to be a wonderful lunchtime meal.  Three people per serving??? I don't think so. I'm also 6'9" 265LB and can need an entire pizza at one sitting so I guess it's not the fairest criticism. I enjoyed the sauce because it's not a watery broth. The sauce is warm but not overpowering. For those that aren't accustomed to Thai food add peanut butter, yogurt, or sour cream, depending on the flavor. When I started out I threw peanut butter into just about everything hot. Also try drinking milk Instead of water.

column9: Good with shrimp and snow peas
column10: I have used this product for some time. I cook it with fresh shrimp and add a few snow peas. Great

column9: Should not have to search all over the internet for the ingredients.
column10: After a 20 minute web search, here are the ingredients (Thai Pavilion Garlic Basil Stir Fry Rice Noodles With Sauce, 7.05-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)):Stir-Fry Rice Noodle Ingredients: Rice Flour, Water, Salt. Sauce Ingredients: Fresh Garlic, Fresh Green Chilies, Soy Oil, Oyster Sauce (Water, Cane Sugar, Salt, Oyster Extract, Cornstarch)Fish Sauce (Anchovies, Salt, Water, Cane Sugar, Vinegar)Cane Sugar, Fresh Thai Basil, Soy Sauce (Water, Soybeans, Salt, Cane Sugar, Vinegar)Salt.

I tried this with beef and added broccoli and added extra noodles. I'm glad I added extra noodles because w/o it, it would've been tooo spicy for me..and I like it spicy! Definitely would reccomend if you can handle the spiciness!

Am buying again, taste like eating out and you can make it quickly at home. The Pad Thai was the best but this was also excellent and the price is good because in the market they are 1/3 the weight and expensive as opposed to Amazon

I really enjoyed the flavor of this dish and I like to add chicken to it. However it was a bit spicy for me. The noodle take a little bit longer than it states on the package to cook evenly and I've never had a problem with them "overcooking."

I've purchased this product numerous times at my local grocery stores, and normally it runs about $4 a box. That is a bit pricey for a sauce packet and some cheap noodles, but it is so convenient and tasty that I continued to purchase it until they stopped selling it.Honestly, I don't think I would eat this without adding at least one vegetable and one protein to it. It is not a meal in a box, but a meal building block. I would normally sautee some onion, chicken, water chestnuts, and asparagus spears, add the sauce, and noodles. It is also very good with chicken and snow peas. It would probably be good with shrimp as well.I am fairly particular about boxed food, I don't ever eat Hamburger Helper because I don't like reconstituted sauces. I find this sauce to be very good, however, and the convenience aspect puts it over the top. As far as the other reviews noted about the spice level, I do agree that it is spicier than I'd expect to come out of a box, but not overpoweringly spicy. I've had spicier dishes from many Thai restaurants, and I've never ordered anything over "medium" spice level. I'm not sure about the serving amount if you add nothing to it, but with some chicken and vegetables, it will serve 2 average eaters with no leftovers. I've never finished it all by myself. All in all, this is the best meal I've cooked (partially) out of a box. Although to be fair, I do most of my cooking from scratch.Hope this helps!

column9: in my opinion Thai Pavilion is best boxed Thai  product
column10: I really appreciate Thai Pavilion's quality. especially when it comes to their sauces. their sauces are just not a watery paste they have real vegetables in them. open up any other thai product and just look at the sauces, I think you'll see literally that Thai Pavilion is much higher quality. taste them smell them. I think you agree with me Thai Pavilion is head and shoulders above the competition. I found this to be true with all their flavors.
Not worth the price.  Barely enough for one person, and the cost (including shipping) was more than at the local supermarket.  Good, but not worth the price.

I debated ordering these for months, then finally threw caution to the wind--I mean, I am not a food snob in the least and usually enjoy boxed meals like this. Unfortunately, it was a BIG MISTAKE. This stuff was horrible.1. The initial look? Disgusting. (See photo.) But I forged on because looks aren't everything.2. There were actual pieces of basil in the mix (see photo) but they were dark green/brown and barely distinguishable.3. The smell wasn't terribly enticing, either.4. The noodles--which they say take just 3 minutes--don't. I trusted that and they were still hard and not fun to eat. I could hear my TMJ-jaw cracking with each bite.5. The finished dish wasn't terribly appealing-looking, either.6. It said 1-2 servings but it was barely one. Maybe if you put three cups of chicken and veggies in it...but then the servings go up to 3-4. Ha.7. It was SPICY. Nose-running and lip-burning spicy, in fact. And not even a tasty spicy.I knew as I was eating it that the remaining five boxes are either being donated to the food pantry or going in the trash (Amazon doesn't take grocery returns). I can't see the addition of chicken and/or veggies helping out this stuff in any way at all. To the reviewer who said this is exactly like the Basil Chicken he gets in a Thai restaurant? Oh my, I feel bad if this is what he gets in a restaurant, and I'd suggest he find a new place.So please, if you think you REALLY want to try this stuff, please please please try a single box from the grocery store first--like I should have done and was originally going to do.

Red Chile (not green) are in the sauce and the amount exceeds other spices by a wide margin - can not even taste the other namesake ingredients such as garlic and basil due to quantity of red chile - would not recommend.
If you want this item, be ready to wait. I haven't received it within 3 weeks and it still has not shipped. I am about to cancel my order.
Dont you hate the way these companies discreetly add in an animal product into an otherwise unseemingly vegan product...

Our greyhound absolutely loves these bones! Even though it's designed to clean her teeth, I think she plans her day around the opportunity to chew on this luscious bone. She knows she gets the bone after she finishes her dinner. I think she would eat sawdust to get to this bone! Like the original Coke recipe, does it have Cocaine in it? Our dog is a loving, docile pet, but regularly growls if we try to take it away from her...we give her 1/3 of a bone after each dinner meal. Too much of this product seems to effect the stool negatively. If you want  your dog to place you on a pedestal, buy this product!
Nice size and quality for the price.  My dogs chew this things 24/7. Fast shipping.  No problems.

column9: DO NOT BUY THIS BONE, IT WILL MAKE YOUR DOG SICK.
column10: I bought this bone for our 8 month old schnoodle. He loved it, and ate all of the inside 'meat' within two days. True, he shouldn't have been left to eat it so quickly but he also shouldn't have gotten sick. The day after he started eating this bone, he developed diarrhea with some blood for a couple of days. After a week, he is still having loose stool and yesterday he vomited twice. Otherwise, he has been eating his food and drinking water as usual and is playing like he always does so we have been trying to wait for his system to clear up on its own.
