I love good coffee and for medical reasons must drink Decaf.  Emeril's Dark Magic Decaf tastes rich and flavorful, just like real caffinated coffee.
Emeril's coffee in the K cups has a rich flavor, minus bitterness. Tastes like well brewed coffee, without all the work.

i bought this product because the reviews said it was a great tasting decaf. when the box arrived it said "decaffeinated using methylene chloride"i looked this up. this is a dangerous chemical and a known carcinigen. amazon will not accept the unopened box as a return because it is a grocery. i have lost the moneycorrection - amazon is refunding my money.
Emeril's Jazzed-Up Decaf is the reason I bought my Keurig coffee maker!  I tasted the coffee when getting a haircut and knew I wanted to drink it often.  Since I must drink decaf, why not enjoy it?

Coffee wasn't bad, but the majority of k-cup pods malfunctioned and sent coffee grounds everywhere.  Spent more time cleaning brewer than enjoying coffee.  Even when they didn't blow up, there were always grounds in the coffee.

column9: The end of a long search for great decaf
column10: After buying my Keurig (Signature model with the expanded water reservoir), I tried several different decaf options in search of a decaf with real flavor.To be honest, my favorite doesn't come in Keurig format - Trader Joe's French Roast decaf. So I was searching for something close, since using the do-it-yourself K-cup accessory results in too much cleaning for where my Keurig is located: in my cube at work.So I tried: Donut Hole Decaf - meh  Newman's Own Decaf - much better, but still a lighter roast than I wanted  San Francisco Bay French Roast Decaf - was so bad I got a refund from Amazon (thank you!)  Tully's Decaf - very good, but not quite it  Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf - excellentand finally...  Emeril's Jazzed-Up Decaf - outstanding!!I drink mine black, and want to taste the flavor resulting from the roast. Emeril's has a rich set of flavors typical of a great French Roast, and smells fantastic. Most people that smell it can't believe it's decaf.A simply wonderful product. My hat's off, Emeril!
I've been waiting over a month for this to be shipped!  I really like Emeril's Jazzed Up regular coffee and want a decaf version.
My wife likes this k-cup a lot.Its a good  k-cup coffee.This coffee has amazing flavor and aroma.You can really taste the coconut in this blend. This is my new favorite flavor.
I often like a cup of coffee late in the day or in the evening yet dont want the caffiene and this fit perfectly. Good taste, strong but not overbrearing.
Son and I like strong coffee even when drinking decaf.  This one is full bodied and substantial.  So much better than most decaf coffees.

I expected a better product because it's Emeril and since its called jazzed up I thought it would be strong. Not the case at all. Its just plain old decaf coffee. Nothing special about it. Its weak and not jazzed up at all. Since Emeril is located in New Orleans, I thought maybe it would include chicory or something from that area that would make it a better coffee but that's not the case.  If you want a dissappointment try it. If you like weak coffee try it. But, otherwise, keep walking.

I was intrigued by the name of the coffee, and it lives up to the hype.  I enjoy it both hot and over ice, and it fulfills both requirements nicely.  Price, free shipping, and being decaf are also a bonus.
Both my husband and I like this coffee... and that is an accomplishment, as he likes VERY mild and I like bold, so it is a winner at our house.

column9: Quality K-Cups without emptying your wallet
column10: Got these decaf K-Cups for my boss and he enjoys the coffee very much. My sole driving factor was price. I figured even if the coffee wasn't so great it wouldn't be too bad because we didn't pay >$1 per K-Cup like the grocery stores want you to. We were pleasantly surprised to find this coffee delicious and the aroma that fills the office is refreshing. Kudos!
Great bold taste, great price. I love string coffee and this one is great. I highly recommend it to someone who enjoys a strong cup of coffee, but needs decaf.
I think I've tried about all the decaf coffees on Amason at one time or another, and I consider this to be the best.
Better than Tully's decaf and couple other brands I've tried. Not bitter at all. Got it when it's onsale, will be watching this item.

This Emeril's Jazzed up Decaf taste very good.  My only reticence is that I'm wondering if it has some caffeine in it.  When I have caffeine, I get a sort of a increased blood pressure buzz.  I had that type of buzz after having this coffee.  My wife had the type of feeling in her stomach that she gets when she has caffeine.  I have no way to test the ingredients to be sure.  But I wonder if this coffee is so "jazzed up" that it has a little caffeine.  It would be interesting to see what other people's experience is.UPDATE: - I've now tried this coffee a dozen times...I think it is safe to say that it has no caffeine.  I haven't had the "buzz" I described above.  But the coffee sure does taste good, so I increased my rating to 5 stars.

My husband wanted this coffee maker, not me. I thought it was too expensive (still do) and the coffee was too expensive (still do). We bought the Newman's decaf and really liked it, when we were in a hurry the coffee maker is great. I decided to give another decaf a try and tried Emeril's Jazzed Up Decaf. It is a great coffee, no after taste and a good rich coffee. My son who drinks only reg. coffee does not know the difference with Emeril's. It's still over priced but it's good. I am not a big coffee drinker, one cup in the morning is about it but I like this one.

I'm not a fan of decaf.  This one is drinkable with just a tinge of "conference coffee" taste.  I also like Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold

No where on the box, other than the shipping label, does this state decaf? The k-cups do not say decaf either. Don't you think that the producer would label the box somewhere that it is decaf?If this is regular than I rate it a 3.

I was not sure I would like this coffee after reading some of the reviews on it, but I like the coffee and the fact that is has no bitter taste. It brews beautifully in my Breville K-cup machine! It tasted smooth and full flavored, even using the larger cup setting on my machine.

I have been buying Emeril's Jazzed Up Decaf Coffee Keurig K-Cups for several months, and I've always liked it. Unfortunately, the batch I most recently received, with a use-by date of April 24/2012, seems to have about half the usual amount of coffee in the cups. The result is coffee that is weak and watery, unless I set the coffee maker on the smallest cup (espresso size).
It was a gift, so I'm not sure how it tasted, but I was excited to be able to find a nice bold decaf coffee!  And it came quickly in the mail!

My husband and I love this decaf.  It is our "Go-To" choice in the afternoon and evening.One would hardly guess that it is a Decaf.Emeril's Jazzed Up Decaf Coffee, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)

column9: Do Not Buy - Only 8 K-Cups in a 24 K-Cup Box
column10: I paid over $30 for a box of 24 K-Cups.  The box came sealed; from the outside nothing looked wrong.  However, there were ONLY 8 K-CUPS IN THE BOX!!!  ARE YOU KIDDING ME?  According to policy, there is no way to return or exchange.It doesn't matter whether or not the coffee is good if you don't get what you paid for.  DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!
This is my favorite decaf after trying many others.  It is strong enough for those who like full bodied coffee.  I enjoy it as much as Starbuck's.
This coffee tastes like colored water.  It has no flavor.I like Emeril's regular Big Bold coffee and thought it would taste similar.Don't waste your money
This is my husband's favorite coffee by far and away. It has a nice robust flavor and a little more pep than most decafs. The coffee is consistent as well, consistently good.

We switched to decaf a couple of months ago and Emeril's Jazzed Up Decaf is one of the best we have tasted. Works well in our Keurig, have not had any duds. Love the price as well, one of the more affordable choices on Amazon for the quantity that you receive.

column4: David "I like fantasy, sci-fi and other books...
column10: I found the coffee to be too weak. I wonder what his Un-Jazzed Up coffee is like, it must be like drinking plain boiled water. This coffee is only good if you like your coffee weak or make a 6 oz cup maybe.
Strong but not bitter.  I drink it with a little milk, no sugar.  It is the best kcup coffee and a good price.
There must be 200 flavors of coffees for the Keurig machines.  I've tried about 20 of them and this is by far the best of the decaf products.  I'll be a repeat customer.

I ordered this coffee based upon Emeril's reputation in the food industry and the fact that it's called "Jazzed Up".  I generally buy Starbucks or other premium coffees but Starbucks isn't out in a k-cup yet.  I am still in shock about how bad this Emeril decaf is.  I can't even say it's like poor quality grocery store level - it's seriously revolting.  I tried another one just to make sure I didn't get a 'bad' k-cup, but it was just as horrible.  So now I have 48 of these putrid things left.  Wonder if Amazon will take them back?!

column9: not tasty, not strong, not good
column10: The only real flavor this coffee has is burned. No matter how little creamer I use all it tastes like is hot water if you ran it through an old, used k-cup. I really like donut shop decaf and especailly like green mountain french roast decaf, both have great flavor even when brewed on the largest size setting.
I am now restricted to decaffeinated coffee for health reasons, but was very pleasantly surprised with Emeril's Jazzed Up Decaf.  It is by far the best decaf coffee I've had - at home or elsewhere.

This is certainly the best decaf K cup I have tried yet.  I use it with the 4oz setting on my Keurig platinum  machine.  It is still a little too weak, but is head and shoulders above all the other decaf's I've tried.  I've heard that Coffee People Decaf French Roast is superior, but I've had a hard time finding it in stock anywhere.  So until I do find it, Emeril's Jazzed Up will be my decaf of choice.  I'm about to put in my second order. I'm also thinking that a different K cup machine (eg Cuisinart) might result in a better extraction thereby making a stronger brew???  Any thoughts?  Thanks.

i was looking for something bolder and different, and I found it.  Emeril's Jazzed up Decaf has amazing taste and good flavor.  Most decafs are bland, but this one has a great aroma from brewing on.  Worth the extra $$.

column9: BEST Decaf Coffee for Keurig Machine - HANDS DOWN!
column10: I have tried many Decaf coffee's for use with the Keurig machine and this one beats them all.  I'll save you a lot of time trying them all out - use this one.  It's amazing!

We have been trying out decafs to find good strong ones. I was so hopeful when I opened the box covered with exclamations of  'BAM!' and 'Oh Yeah, Babe!'. That first cup was a huge watery letdown. I can only say that it is not acidic. I tried it a few more times and now it is the coffee that the kids are allowed to drink. Weak, sad decaf.
Emeril's Jazzed up Decaf gives nice robust smooth flavor without the caffeine.  It has proven to be my favorite among several which I have tried.

As a fan of the regular Big Easy Bold coffee cups, I did not hesitate to order the decaf, expecting the same depth and richness.  I was disappointed however when I brewed the first cup to find that it tasted much like Dunkin Donuts. The next time I brewed it using the 6oz water selection, and it was better, though still not as I had expected.  Next time I order I will go back to Green Mountain French Roast decaf, which I still have to brew at 6oz, but has the richness I expect.  46 pods to go..............

column9: used to be fab, formula changed, increased fat, poorer quality
column10: used to be fab, formula changed, increased cheap fat content and nonessential fillers.  I no longer purchase Petguard, it has been bought out and the quality suffers.  In fact my cats lived on this stuff for about 8 yrs, then refused to eat it, and, the local holistic store refused to sell it anymore.  switch to Wellness, if you are looking for an excellent catfood.

This product does come in a shaker cannister not only the small packets. The latter are useful for when you are on the go or at work. Like the lemon and orange versions this product adds excellent citrus flavor without much acid. This product has a good shelf life and can be used creatively. Not only do I add it to water but consider some of the following. Use it in chicken salad, turkey meatloaf, glazing for pound cake, with some butter and pepper over vegetables as well as add a few packets to you pasta water. Fresh lemons and limes may be expensive during certain times of the year and it can be disappointing when they go to waste. This product will not replace the need for the real thing but would be a useful addition to your pantry.

If you like limelime flavor, you will love this product.  Our local stores quit selling this product so I was very relieved that I could find it on Amazon and ordered a case as we use it so much.  It is very versitile.  We use it just in water, in our smoothies, and in cooking.  It's a wonderful portable product that you don't have to worry about spoiling anytime soon like you do with fresh fruit.

I was trying to find a way to make it easier to get my 8 glasses of water every day and bringing sliced lemons to work was messy.  But I just can not stand the taste of plain water!  I got a sample of this and have been HOOKED ever since!  I like the lemon but it is a bit acidic.  The lime is just right though!  It will flavor up to a 20 ounce botttle of water - perfect to keep at my desk and easy to use.  I just clip open the pack with scissors and it easily pours out.  To be honest the orange is my favorite - but I can't find it anywhere yet.  So lime remains my #1 choice so far!!  I am going to look for it in the shaker to use with my cooking - I can just imagine the lemon on fish!! MMMM!

These Lime packets provide all the health and taste benefits from fresh limes without the mess or spoilage.  They are super convenient and quite versatile.  You can add them to any kind of beverage and even cook with them.  You know the secret to preventing sliced fruits from oxidizing (turning brown) is to put a little lemon or lime juice on them-this works just as easily, just sprinkle it on!  And it's perfect in sauces and salsa.  I carry several packs in my purse at all times since I prefer the taste of lime over lemon and so often, eating establishments only carry lemon, if even that.  The benefit of limes is actually better for you than lemons, I've heard.  The vitamin C content is comparable but I believe it's touted as having more of other types of vitamins.  Whatever the case, I LOVE this product!  I'll never be without the fresh flavor and wholesome goodness of lime.  Unfortunately, all the places I used to buy it locally have stopped carrying this item.  I was thrilled to find the item in a large quantity for less than I would have paid here locally.  I'm not concerned that I may not use them all up by the expiration date because it's kind of difficult for a dehydrated product that is completely sealed in individual packets to go bad if stored in a cool, dry place.  I may not have a bunch left over but it will still be great just the same.  You can't go wrong with this product.  And it comes in Lime, Lemon, and Orange so you can choose your favorite citrus flavor and have it all year-round!  But of course, I'm quite partial to LIME...

column9: packaging is a huge downer, otherwise, fine
column10: So the taste is fine. The lime IS unsweetened, okay, fine, and the flavor does come through. No, it doesn't have any real tartness or "fresh lime" quality. But it does add lime flavor. But WHY THEY CAN'T offer this in a jar, resealable bag, etc., instead of tiny packets that have so little solid inside that it's actually hard to empty the contents--that, I don't get. Plus it's a lot of little garbage to throw away that surely isn't necessary.
Mailed and received in great time. An excellent flavored soup base.  Easy to make.  We plan to order more in the near future.

This soup is the best. Easy to make , perfect for a cold rainy day. I've made it with gr. turkey instead of beef and it's excellent. You can also sprinkle in some cheese on top before serving.Serve it with a loaf of bread and you have the perfect meal. Makes a large pot of soup.
I re'cd this item well before I expected.  I will not re-order this particle item, because there is a certain spice in this that I did not like.  Not company's fault.  Just personal preference.

This soup is easy to make and tastes great.  My favorite is to make it with ground beef.  I have used it with beef stew meat and cubed chicken breast meat and it tastes really good, too!  I am on a diet and the calories are low and it is very filling.  It freezes really well.

Great soup, seems to be hard to find over the Garden Vegetable.I like the Country Vegetable better, because it has a more red intense flavored broth.I put fresh ground pepper and a spoonful of Kraft grated Parmesan cheese into the soup BEFORE heating.  Really makes it YUMMY!!

column9: So good my kids will eat it and gluten free
column10: We love this soup.  My kids love it so much and one of the few soups I can find without gluten or meat in it.  We sometimes add sour cream or cheese to  give it a little more kick or even some gluten free rice pasta...makes a great meal for the kids and my kids eat vege's they wouldn't normally eat if they weren't in the soup.

This is my favorite Healthy Choice soup. Chock full of vegetables and very tasty. I'll add some green beans to "beef" it up when I serve it as a main course. Also a great, low cal snack on a cold day.
This is one of my favorite soups! It's very thick and filling for only 100 calories per serving.

i try to eat healthy overall but am also very convenience-driven. i'd rather give up a bit of taste for the former 2! this may be a bit bland for people who are used to eating more fat and/or sodium, but for me its perfect [suitable for vegetarians and vegans]try adding a bit of vegetarian 'ground meat' [or i guess lean beef if you eat meat] for a seriously hearty but still supereasy meal - 2 min in the microwave and you're done

column9: Healthy Choice Country Vegetable is the best soup
column10: I eat a bowl of Country Vegetable soup every day forlunch.  I have tried many other kinds of soup andthis is the only kind of soup I will eat.  Most storesin our area do not carry it any more.  I am thankfulthat I can have my supply delivered to my door cheaperthat I can buy it at the one remaining store that does sell Country Vegetable soup.  When I was receiving 24 cans a month, I would run out before the next shipment.Now, I have ordered 36 cans and I won't run out.I LOVE Healthy Choice Country Vegetable soup.  Yum! Yum!
My son is a "Starving Student".  We try to send him a case of soup, occasionally, to make sure he doesn't STARVE!He LOVES soups....Especially HEALTHY ones!  =)

The soup was a good price compared to grocery stores but half the cans were seriously bent in the middle.  It appeared that Amazon was shipping what the big buyers were rejecting.  I bought 48 cans of soup shipped in three different shipments so there was no reason cans on the inside should be bent in the middle.  I was very disappointed but had been warned by previous feedback.  Won't buy again.

Very tasty and surprisingly hardy, better than C or Proges..o.  Price not to bad either.  Try it You'll like it.  I took another chance and bought a pack of the slit pee w/ham as well and it blows away C or P.  Wish they offered Minestrone in low sodium. Better than big brand FULL sodium soups IMO. I went with subscribe and save on both I liked them so much.Highly Recommended

column9: good staple for a gluten free vegan
column10: This is one major brand soup that is both gluten free and vegan. It is low in fat and sodium, but the flavor is excellent. It also adapts well to making a quick stew with tofu, beans, corn, or gluten free pasta, a dash of spice or tomato such as pasta sauce or salsa, and you have an entirely new dish in a few minutes.
this soup is excellent.  everything in it a vegetarian needs to stay healthy.  very filling.  tastes great.  Healthy Choice Country Vegetable Soup, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
I love this low salt soup.I have bought 3-4 cases so far and will buy more
This is a very tasty soup, seasoned well, and full of veggies. I either use the soup as a veggie side or use it to create a gumbo or meat stews.

column9: Country Vegetable Soup by Healthy Choice
column10: Full of nice vegetables but has a flavor I didn't care for and didn't recognize.  That doesn't mean it isn't good.  You may like.
My husband enjoys this soup; we mainly eat soups with no meat products.  It's pretty thick and not a lot of calories.
GarbageI purchased a case , but was mailed a case of soup that had expired 3 years ago. Was worthless
This may be good for you but it is sooooooooooo bland.  I try to add things to it to give it some taste. I cant even give this stuff away. No one likes it.  The chicken soup is good tho.

column9: Love this stuff - great diet aid
column10: Just adding this to my normal diet routine has caused a big difference in my weight loss.  I'm not hungry and have plenty of energy - a huge change from before I started drinking it.  I was actually a little concerned at first due to the sudden drop in weight.  I thought I was losing water weight but I was wrong.  I use about a teaspoon/teaspoon and a half per day and brew it 4 times - about 8 cups - per day.  As a bonus, it tastes pretty good too.

Smells strong, but the brew is a nice calming flavor that isn't too overpowering. I enjoy it both iced and hot. Not sure of the "weight" promises as I don't think it has had any effect for me. But a yummy tea no less!

column9: Teavana Weight to Go Pu-erh Weight-Loss Tea
column10: This is a delicious tea, but I don't know if it did anything to reduce weight. It also contains Oolong tea which has research behind it to support a slight rise in metabolism. The taste is good enough that I don't care if it works for weight loss.
This tea is so good and it smells yummy.  I highly recommend it.  I really like the Teavana brand and will try more flavors in the future.
The product has a special taste I found to be a treat. This tea and a good book will take you away . The shipment was very slow so it will take a lot of patience, However well worth the wait.
This drink offered from Gatorade is really great tasting and low in calories. Thanks Gatorade for thinking of us that are always watching our caloric intake.
Wow, I was able to purchase and subscribe to monthly deliveries of gatorade for way less than I pay at our local WalMart!
Never tried these before, but I was looking for a kosher candy product and stumbled upon these. Devoured the whole box in a day!
The flavor of the "Kansas City " seasoning is terriffic.  It is crowd pleasing.  A great GRILLED flavor.  Tastes like my favorite steak place!!  Am terriffied that Durkee might try to change it!

column9: Best grilling spice in the world.
column10: I love this spice! It is coarse, flavorful and works on every meat. Walmart used to carry it and now it is only available through a vendor on Amazon. It is pricier than it was in the store but it is well worth it. I have tried others with the same like ingredients but they don't have the same boldness. Don't waste your time on others, spend the money and buy it!

I called Spice Advice at 800-247-5251 and they told me that this Kansas City Steak, Weber (or Tones) Canadian Steak, and Grill Creations - Grill seasoning are all the same.However, if you are not convinced and want to order this under the Kansas City name, you can get it through diversified distributing (the distributor for Tones, Durkee, etc).I cannot verify that these are all the same.  This is just what I was told.

This is the best steak seasoning I've ever found in a store.  I've established a great reputation for my steaks based on this seasoning.  Unfortunately my local grocer stopped carrying it!  I am worried I won't be able to find it any longer.  It really is the best!!
This is the best seasoning!  I use it on chicken, salmon, hamburgers, sauteed squash and zucchini...it's the best and my family loves it!
A very pure mint flavor perfect for baking for adding a drop to hot chocolate!

I love anything that's strawberry flavored and this strawberry laffy taffy is the best tasting taffy!  My nephew and I are both crazy about it.  I'm glad they have only strawberry flavor in a big tub like this...  Usually I only see mixed flavor tubs (I hate the banana flavored ones) so when I saw this one, I ordered one immediately.  I'll definitely place this tub right next to my bed :)

Dear Readers,This is really a good product for those who love Laffy Taffy like me. It came in very early from shipping, very fresh, soft, and chewy. I recommend this product to anyone who loves Laffy Taffy. 5/5

column9: What can I say?...It's Laffy Taffy!!!
column10: I have always had a weak spot for Laffy Taffy so I'm always going to love it's sweet, soft texture and taste.
I love strawberry taffy but am not a huge fan of most other flavors. Being able to order my favorite type is simply amazing and the product has always arrived fresh.
I love the strawberry and cherry flavors the best. Why would I want BANANA to muck that up? I don't! I want to reach in my tub and pull out a favorite everytime. With this tub, I know I will.

Taffy arrived very fresh (soft and chewy). Not always the case when you buy laffy taffy (not so fresh stuff is hard and breaks into pieces). Received quickly, but have prime membership.  Great that you are able to buy specific flavors, so you get the flavors you really want.
This arrived quickly. It was so fresh, which is probably why my office devoured them in less than 2 weeks. Good seller, good product! Satisfied customer.

switched to this product and have not been happy with the results. Product seperates with a white cloud forming on the bottom of the bottle which looks horrible and the taste of this product is not as good as some of the cheaper brands. Color of the product is never the same either and has a tendency to turn dark
I can't disappointment my grandchildren and forget their pets each Christmas, and this one was a big hit... the children thought it was cute and the dog LOVED it :o)

I could not find this item in any store in my area and was happy when I found it on Amazon. It has a very good vegetable beef taste, and is a good lunch or even dinner on a cold day. I probably will buy more when my supply runs out.
I got this on a 40% off special, great price, and the soup was good. It was tasty, good amount of ingredients, I was very happy.

column9: HORRIBLE SOUP Healthy Choice Vegetable Beef
column10: Healthy Choice Vegetable Beef Soup. TRUST ME, This soup is HORRIBLE. Does not taste like any soup I've Ever tasted. No Beef Flavor. Taste more like the metal can. Vegetables are hard. Heating the soup longer won't make the vegetables softer. I'll never buy healthy choice again. Zero Stars.
Healthy Choice Vegetable Beef Soup is a great soup with less salt than most other soups.  I love it!
My review falls inbetween the previous two reviews.  While I do not consider this soup horrible, the prospect of consuming 11 more cans is unappealing.

These were awesome.  I bought them for a bachelorette party.  We ate at an Asian restaurant and I thought it'd be a cute favor for the guests attending. Everyone loved them!  I bought them more for the novelty, but they actually tasted really, really good!  I ended up eating all of the leftovers. :)  The fortunes were awesome as well.  I was afraid they'd be cheesy, but they were perfect.I had to call customer service to verify the shipping because I was afraid I wouldn't receive my package on time.  They were really friendly and answered all of my questions and assured me I would get my package on time.  Totally going to try to find another even to use them again!
These are yummy and the WHOLE cookie is covered, unlike other chocolate fortune cookies.  All are individually wrapped.  Not the best tasting chocolate ever, but yummy nonetheless.
My daughter asked for fortune cookies for Valentines. I found these on Amazon. They are absolutely delicious!! I highly recommend them and will be ordering more, myself.

column9: 3 bags were open.  Won't order again.
column10: will not buy thru mail again.  Bags were open.  Perhaps bubble wrap would help. Great product will purchase again.  Shipping quality is poor.
Had never tried anything made with spelt so ordered these snacks. They are quite tasty, fresh and not oversalted. Try them the price per package is right.
Please edit your description. It says 45 pieces of gum in each tube however, what I received was 30 pieces of gum in each tube.  The gum is great though.
The only coffee to get if you have to use instant. I am allowed one cup a day;therefore, I use this product. It is great. tastes almost like brewed coffee.
I really like this coffee, better than other brands I've tried.  It tastes very close to brewed coffee, and the packs are very easy to open for my arthritis hands.

I've been using these at work for over a year. We have a brewed coffee club but some people can't follow simple directions so I switched to the Taster's Choice sticks.  I love them - they are inexpensive and the taste is good.  Since I'm adding the water and the coffee is premeasured I get consistent cups of good flavor which is what I wasn't getting from the coffee club.  And they are super convenient.Unlike another reviewer I have had no problem with dissolving in hot water.  Comparing to coffee that is much more expensive seems kind of silly to me.  These are instant coffee crystals, the kind you would get by buying a jar of Taster's Choice.  Before joining our horrible coffee club I used to buy twice a day at a local coffee shop, spending in one day what I now spend in a month.

I take these to work for my mid-morning/early afternoon coffee.  We have a regular office coffee pot, but there is only one pot made first thing in the morning, since no one else besides me drinks coffee later than that.  So I started bringing these to work so I could indulge myself, and the convenience is great.  The flavor is decent, too.  The one aggravation is that this stuff doesn't dissolve well.  (Nescafe dissolves great, but I can't seem to find that anymore.)  Oh, and I should mention that sometimes the packets are hard to open.  There are perforations to open them, but sometimes they don't work.  All in all, this is a good product for my particular use, but there is room for improvement.

Bought a pack from Target a month ago and didn't like it that much. If you're not expecting VIA qualiy, or even cheap coffee quality, then you'll be alright. It kind of tastes dirty, and a little burnt. But, it has caffeine and if diluted with water will provide a somewhat pleasent taste. Well, an acceptable taste. I ended up trading up to Douwe Egberts instant coffee for my instant fix. You're mileage may vary though, some think it's the bee's knees.

column9: If you're expecting a VIA-like coffee, forget it.
column10: This product is obviously aimed at those who are enjoying Starbuck's VIA coffee (which isn't bad). This, however, looks and tastes pretty much like any instant coffee. It's not microground like VIA. Just get a regular jar of this stuff if you like it.
i purchased this product as a present for my husband ......He loved it.......... !!!! I think we will try the 3 am reserve after this hot sauce is over.

I rate this sauce as hot as 357 Silver edition and Da Bomb ground zero.  It is supposedly hotter than Blairs hottest (non-a.m.) sauce, Ultra Death.  I have a bottle of Ultra Death and I love it, but it still is not as hot as this.  These Zack Wylde sauces feature the same great quality and taste that you would come to expect with all the Blair Products.  I cannot believe how unpopular it is!  try it, you won't be disappointed!

I just started using this product, and really like it.  I used to hate lemon juice in a bottle, and if I didn't have a lemon around, I did without.  Now you can have the real taste of lemon with you all the time!.  [...] Though I thought 12 boxes was a lot at first, I've shared with friends, and sent several boxes to our soldiers in Iraq and Afghanistan as they are always looking for ways to add a little "zip" to their water.  By the way, a single packet in a quart/liter of water does the trick for me, but you can also add a little sweetener if you would like lemonade.  Also try True Lime.  True Lime Crystallized Lime Mix, 40 Packs, 1.0-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) True Orange just came out, and I hope that Amazon.com will offer it soon as well.

column9: Worst tasting Celsius product ever, by far!
column10: I have had about 9 flavours of Celsius products, which I believe is all of them.My ranking (Best to Worst) based on my preference:Sparkling Ginger AleGreen Tea Peach MangoStrawberry KiwiIced Lemon TeaSparkling Wild BerrySparkling OrangeSparkling ColaGreen Tea Raspberry AcaiApple Orchard (Stevia)The Ginger Ale, Green Tea Peach mango, and Strawberry Kiwi are top notch to me, very tasty!  Everything up to the Cola is really good in my opinion.  The Raspberry Acai doesn't taste nearly as good as the others to me, but most friends like it.  The Apple Orchard is SOOOOOO incredibly BAD that it makes me feel nauseous, and makes me like the Raspberry Acai (which I previously detested) much more.  A friend who usually likes the Stevia sweetener flavour found in the Apple Orchard describe the flavour of Apple Orchard as 'monkey urine.'

column9: I hope "Celsius" creates more flavors using Stevia for the sweetener
column10: Personally, I think the other reviewers must be commenting on some other product, because they're all crazy!!!  While this flavor is not the absolute best of all the flavors, the fact that they used Stevia and Erythritol for sweeteners instead of the fake and "bleached sugar" otherwise known as Sucralose, makes me immensly happy.  The Apple orchard blend tastes like they blended a bunch of different apples and some other sweet flavor and that's what you have.  I am DEFINATELY willing to sacrifice a very small amount on flavor as long as I get the same great product with less harm to my body.

column9: Horrible taste! Do not waste your money!
column10: I am a huge fan of the Celsius drinks, I have converted some of my coworkers from regular energy drinks to Celsius. I was excited to try the stevia version. I have 11 can left that I will end up throwing a way. The taste is horrible! It taste like bitter medicine. Stick with the original.

A lover of Celsius for many years...this is by far the worst product I have ever tasted. It is like bitter medicinal apple juice...I would give it zero stars if possible. Bought a 12 pack...threw out an 11 1/2 pack. Seriously...not sure if the formula is off or the Stevia isn't integrated properly, but it is flat out terrible!Do yourself a favor and get Orange or Wild Berry...or the teas, all of which are really good!

column9: Couldn't even get down the first sip without spitting out!
column10: I'm assuming this one is goint to be discontinued, if it hasn't been already. Because my local discount store is selling them dirt cheap. No Pun intended - it does taste like dirt - worse!

First let me say I REALLY like the Orange and Kiwi flavors of Celsius.  They had the Apple at my local store so I grabbed several cans at a good price.  They are horrible.  It tastes like a combination of Apple Juice and raw sewage, with a hint of Robitussin to top it off.  Just a horrid after taste.  I could not even finish the can, and I was really happy to find this after they were sold out of the other flavors for a while.  I wish I never found it.  Putrid.
I did not like the flavor at all.  A bad aftertaste.  Love the other flavors but this is not a favorite

There are several energy drinks that sweeten with Stevia and taste much better than this one. It's not the Stevia that makes this drink so horrible, it's the caffeine, I can tell. The "Drive" flavor of Vitamin Water has a similar bitter bite except much weaker.This has 200 milligrams of caffeine, which is ridiculous. That's not a magical calorie burning formula, that's a cheap buzz. This stuff sucks.

I love Celsius.  By love, i mean i drink at least two a day and sometimes more (i suppose I'm pretty addicted at this point).  At any rate, I ignored the warnings of all my fellow reviewers about the taste and boy, was that a terrible mistake.  This stuff really does taste like goat piss or some kind of chemistry experiment gone bad.  I wanted very badly for it to work, as I was feeling like ingesting so much artificial sweetener was probably doing something bad to me, but I can't even gag this stuff down.  Three sips and i poured the can out.  I have 11 cans sitting here, and as it's non-returnable they will be going in the trash. Amazon, you shouldn't carry this crap!  It really tastes AWFUL!!!
I like most of the celsius flavors but this one is not very good. I would not recommend this product.

I agree with the others who mentioned this is the worse tasting of all the Celsius drinks.  The price was so cheap so I decided to purchase.  I almost threw up on the first try and couldn't even drink the rest.  Its smell wasn't even appetizing.  But if you decide to keep it and drink it, I would recommend eating a banana or something after drinking to remove that lingering taste off your tongue.

I ordered the variety pack and 4 of this flavor came in it.  It is absolutely the worst thing I have ever tasted in my life!I tried to drink them without tasting them, but it didn't work.  They were just sooooo bad I had to dump the rest down the drain.Order another flavor and stay away from this abomination they call a drink.

Be warned, your first one you make a face that says it is nasty as all.  After that, the taste grows on you, and is tolerable at best.  I recommend you try other flavors, like cola or orange.  The carbonated flavors are much better tasting and much more refreshing.

column9: Solid Energy Drink (that's also relatively healthy)
column10: The other reviewers are being melodramatic.The taste is good - not great - slightly weird aftertaste.  If you like the other Celsisus drinks, I'm not sure how you would find this one so much worse.  Expect a decent tasting drink, trading off some flavor for health, and you won't be disappointed.  I've come to like the taste much more as my taste buds have slowly recovered from years of drinking artificial sweeteners.Seriously not worth all the uppercase reviews, exclamation points, and comparisons to "goat piss."

I came across my first Celsius marked down at a Walmart. I used to drink one brand of sugary energy drink, because it worked, but so did the Celsius after the first time. It's a fact none of the sugar free energy drinks taste great. However, I thought this brand tasted pretty good. I was glad to be off sugar, but then realized it had sucralose, which I don't want in my body at all. I am so glad for this Celsius which gives me energy all day, and with all natural Stevia! I ordered the 2 cases Amazon had in stock, and will continue to do business as long as they sell it. It is so good, I use it in my Dr. Oz daily smoothie in the mornings, as well as neat, when I don't have time.
The product showed up in perfect shape.For the shipping charged, the package tooktwice as long to arrive as stated.

It's great for a cheese combo lover. The sizes are pretty big, and there's 6 bags. I overestimated how much I could eat. Think about if you can finish them, I had to give some away since it was too much for me. But it's really good and fresh from the bag.

column9: What can I say? I love combos
column10: it was a fun amazing experience having that many combos and I absolutley love them and I thought after that many I'd be all combo'ed out but hell no, I'll buy more soon.
Combos are one of my favorite snacks because of the quality of the cheese. The price is also good

How in the world are you guys going to jump your price all the way up to 17.99 when they were just 14.02 a couple hours ago. This is insane. Makes me not want to shop through you guys at all smh.*UPDATEPrice was lowered to $15.99 so I decided to purchase these, mainly for someone else. I just wanted to save money on them. Overall this product was very delicious & it was very fresh they do not expire until May,2012 which is darn good. So If you have a large family or like handing out free food to your friends then this is great to get.I only rate this  a 4 star because I know I could have gotten these for cheaper if I would have bought them sooner. But when it comes to taste & quality of this product it would get 5 stars.

Yes, the cheddar cheese wrapped in crunchy cracker is my favorite style of Combos. The salty filling actually tastes like real cheese compared to many other snack foods. My favorite methods of eating them is to either chip away at the cracker coating with my teeth until only the strip of cheese remains, or to suck on the cracker until is softens enough to get at the yummy filling.Combos were a staple snack food of mine in high school and college. I rarely eat them these days because, let's face it, they aren't overly healthy. They have some protein, but are loaded with fat, salt and carbs. The ingredient list reads like a dietitians worst nightmare. I challenge anyone with an appetite to stop at the recommended serving of 1/3 of a cup (10-14 pieces).Of course, you don't pop open a bag of Combos for health reasons. It would be wonderful if all of the best tasting food were also really good for you, but that is rarely the case. Sometimes you just have a hankering for a salty, crunchy and hearty snack; and waistline, arteries and blood pressure be d@%mned! For snackers who really want to throw caution to the wind, you should check out the Cheddar Cheese Pretzel and Pepperoni Pizza Cracker versions as well. Enjoy with your favorite super-sweet carbonated beverage, but you never heard that from me!~ Kort

column9: GREAT SNACKS - MORE CHEESE WOULD BE NICE
column10: I EAT THESE AS A SNACK & GIVE THEM TO MY DOGGIES AS WELL - I WOULDN'T SAY THEY ARE REALLY GOOD BUT THEY'LL DO AS A BETWEEN MEAL SNACK AS I LOVE ALL THINGS MADE WITH CHEESE.
This may not be the best black tea in the world, but it is the best I have ever had.  It makes Twinnings taste like dishwater in comparison.

Everyday with this tea.  The flavor is full and brisk and invigorating.  I discovered this tea on Amazon and now I have it on the subscribe and save program.It is a dark robust flavor.  There is no namby-pamby "delicate" or "light" flavor bit about it.  I have a sensitive stomach and some ceylon teas by other companies are too acidic and upset my tummy.  Not Taylors.I am Chinese American and have drunk tea all my life at home and at restaurants; this is my favorite.
My kids love Skippy creamy peanut butter. This price is kind of high, however. And it's not eligible for Amazon Prime. Not such a good deal IMHO.

I love SKIPPY Peanut Butter, especially SKIPPY Creamy peanut butter, but the one thing I find so hard to believe is why Amazon has to charge almost $10 just to buy 1 40 OZ jar of SKIPPY when you can get the same exact brand & size for under $9 bucks at the grocery and/or retail store, but I guess Amazon figures that they can get away with it if somebody wants the product bad enough and doesn't want to have to bother getting out and over to the store.Another thing that I have a hard time comprehending is why Amazon sells SKIPPY and JIF in a 40 Ounce size jar individually, but wont sell PETER PAN in a 40 OZ jar individually and only let you buy the 40 OZ jars and 28 OZ jars in a multiple packet of 3 or more and will only sell PETER PAN individually in a 16 OZ jar or 28 OZ jar only, but apparently it may be due to SKIPPY having a higher demand in more options and perhaps SKIPPY and JIF outsells PETER PAN.Overall, SKIPPY was one of my favorite peanut butters growing up, especially in my childhood years when my mother was trying to watch how much sugar I ate in my diet since they say SKIPPY only has 1/3 less sugar than most other peanut butters.

I was the loser in high school, the chicks would run away from me and the dudes would wrap me up in duck tape and throw me into the river saying "Why are you at our school  you 30-year-old pervert?" But one, I came into school with Skippy Creamy Penut Butter spread out all over my chest and my life changed. Girls started to lick my chest or faint at the sight of me, men would turn in shame, and teachers would give me weird looks and make me pass my class because of the Penut Butter. This is a great complement for me three wolf moon t-shirtA word of warning though, if you leave the penut butter on for too long, it will cause a rift in time sending you back to when you were a loser and didn't have a Nintendo 64 or a three wolf moon t-shirt.

The Company was wonderful. Fast and accurate shipping and great customer service, however I was not really thrilled with this Bikaji Rossogolla. Very little "rose water" flavor, way to sweet and the cheese balls had a very strange texture to me. I supposed if I doctored them up in a recipe they might be better, but out of the can and (rinsed) not really very good at all. (Just my humble opinion) Again, the company that sells it is 5 star all the way though!Warmly,Jackie

The tea appears as pictured in the stock image.  I found it to be of good quality.  Also, the container is made of sturdy plastic and would be re-usable if you wished.  I will most likely order this item again.

I like this tea very much, I do however wish there were more Chrysanthemum flowers in it as those flowers and there effects were the reason why I bought the tea. The white tea does really balance the flavor of the flowers out, but I wound up adding more flowers to the tea.
Perfect for making all my yummy almond desserts.  Now I don't have to search for Almond extract sales at the store, I have more than enough for the year on stock in my cabinet.

column9: Packs alot of punch in a tiny bottle
column10: Fantastic stuff. I use it when I make iced tea for almond flavored tea, and it is divine for baking use. The bottle is beautiful and the fact that it's organically grown without pesticides (even if you're not paranoid about consumption of pesticides, they do have an impact on the environment). And honestly, if you don't care about any of that, why are you even on this page? Not one bad thing to say about this stuff.

So happy I ordered these...they are so good I briefly considered moving to WA state to be closer to Sweet Mona's. The caramel is so soft and delicious, like no caramel I've ever had. The sea salt is the perfect accompaniment to the dark chocolate and caramel goodness. I ordered in the middle of a heat wave on the East Coast and my order was packed with such care and attention to detail that every piece of candy was in perfect condition when they arrived. I will definitely be ordering from Sweet Mona's again, well-worth the splurge!

My girlfriends and I were in the midst of a shopping day and got the munchies at TJ Maxx. I saw these chips and grabbed them on my way out the door.  We opened the bag in the car and we loved them so much they were gone in a matter of minutes.  They sent me back in to get another bag and of course we had bought the last one in the store. Hmmmph.  Glad to see I can get the from Amazon.  A perfect chip!

I didn't know what to expect when I ordered these. I can say with no fear of exaggeration that these are the best potato chips I've eaten in a long time. The lime flavor is perfect, and there's just the right blend of spicy and sweet. Fair warning: They can be addicting.
Very delicious potato chips and the seasoning flavor is great! A nice alternative to other kinds of kettle style chips. The avocado oil was the selling point for me.

column9: WORTH LICKING THE INSIDE OF THE PACKAGE!!!
column10: Oh my! These chips are soooo gooood! I have to be careful not eating 2 or 3 bags at a time! I am not a huge fan of chips - but these I cannot live without now! LOL
this is the best potato chip i ever taste.  i like sea salt and chilean lime and its really good idea using avocado oil which is very healthy fat oil.
These chips are so ADDICTING. Let me tell you how addicting they are, they are so addicting that whoops I used up my 20 word minimum already.ADDICTING!

Scrumptious, delicious, delectable, mouthwatering, tasty, appetizing, rich, savory, flavorful, succulent, luscious, yummy, lip-smacking, finger-licking good.(Amazon reviews have to be 20 reviews long.)

this product was rancid when i recieved it, i know this to be a great product as i bought individual bags while on vacation in florida, i contacted amazzon who immediately refunded my money as they were out of stock.  i have since bought more from amazon that were great
These chips are amazing! Frying chips in Avocado was the best idea ever. I can't wait to share these chips with everyone I know. Seriously give them a try. The BBQ is fantastic.

A few months ago, bought from Amazon a 24-pack of these...they were called "avocado oil potato chips with sea salt". Ingredients were:potatoes, all-natural avocado oil, sea salt.  (3 grams protein)Today I bought from Amazon a 24-pack of potato chips called:" avocado oil potato chips Chilean lime".....ingredients are:potatoes,  all natural avocado oil,Whey,Salt,dextrose, sugar, maltodextrin,citric acid, malic acid, vinegar, parsley flakesButtermilk powder.  (Zero protein)1) Many people have said positive things about ? Which product?2)How can I buy just plain potato chips with avocado oil and sea salt? (brown label, same company)3)So sorry that I can't say these most recent chips are just healthful, nourishing. And great! But they are't great:  so sorry:  Maltodextrin and dextrose are questionable, and add nothing to the original flavor.  Do you have influence to ask the manufacturer to remove dextrose and maltodextrin?  Thanks. Oh, the good old days! Just simple lime chips, no chemicals.  (I can just see the comments that malto...is "GRAS". Still not safe)..

I've got them on auto ship because they are the best tasting potato chip I've had in a long long time, if not ever.  I had to limit myself to 2 bags at a time because I just wouldn't stop eating them; too easy to keep opening another bag.

column9: Delicious fresher taste with the Avocado Oil
column10: The Good Health Avocado Oil Potato Chips are delicious!  Every flavor I've tried is delicious including the Chilean Lime which has a strong lime and a just a touch of chile pepper.  The secret to the fresh taste is they don't use the standard sunflower oil and/or safflower oil and/or canola oil and/or some other junk oil.  you can taste the difference in freshness and in high quality oil.  My subscribe-n-save order arrived with 7 months to expiration which means I need to eat at  least one of these lunchbox size bags per week - no problem - they'll probably disappear at the rate of at least one per day!  Delicious!
Yes, I know we shouldn't eat too many potato chips, but the avocado oil and the lime flavoring make them irresistible. Yummmm.

This is the first time I've had this flavor of chips. They are more delicately flavored than I thought they would be given the word "Chilean" in the label.  I like having this size to limit my chip munching, and I will order these again in this quantity.

These chips were good but I just wish there was more of the cheddar chasse kind because they're my favorite. They give you all them plain. But overall it was at a great price. I've never had any problem buying things from here.

Gave four stars only because 24 small bags? Why not fewer larger bags? Other wise love the chips.  How many potato chips are good for you?  These can be.  Just read the description and nutrition table.
This little gem became a big hit with kids and adults a like.  I bought it as a stocking stuffer.  Easy to re-laod and fill with Sugar babies candy.

Oh Deer Reindeer Pooper is certainly a conversation piece. It is very different and quite adorable.  The kids as well as the adults get a kick out of it.  You fill it up with jelly beans and it poops it out.  It will definitely make someone smile and even laugh.  Great product I recommend it highly.
Kids loved this at Christmas and us adults were laughing harder than them.Shipping was great & very fast!

Cute item.  Got the reaction I was looking for.  Actually pooped the jelly beans just like it says.  Pretty amusing.  =)It does tip forward when it's stood on all fours on a table, but still a good purchase for some laughs.

I bought 3 of these.  One for each kid as a stocking stuffer and one for a white elephant gift exchange that my girlfriend's mother ended up getting.  They all loved it!  It was so funny to see the kids saying how gross it was, then having so much fun with it.  Out of all their christmas gifts, anytime they showed what they got to someone the pooping reindeer was always first!

I ordered three.  One was broken upon opening.  The other two broke within 20 minutes.  What a waste of money.  Then I found out that my daughter bought a similar item in Target for one dollar.This experience would make me hesitate to order from an unknown company in the future.
I think this is a horrible idea for a product.I'd never buy such a thing.It's not funny.It's crude and gross.

column9: EXCELLENT PRODUCT, HOWEVER, A JAR RECEIVED BROKEN
column10: I USE THE SMUCKER'S PINEAPPLE TOPPING, TO PUT INTO MY COTTAGE CHEESE, A COUPLE OF TEASPOONS FULL, IT TASTES MUCH BETTER THAN COTTAGE CHEESE WHEN YOU PURCHASE IT WITH THE PINEAPPLE IN IT. PLUS, IT IS LESS EXPENSIVE. I ALSO USE IT TO COOK WITH. FOR EXAMPLE, WHEN BAKING A HAM I PUT PINAPPLE SLICES ON THE TOP AND THEN POUR THE TOPPING ON THE TOP. MAKE A GRAVY WITH THE DRIPPINGS AND ITS WONDERFUL. I HAVE NEVER USED IT FOR ICE CREAM, BUT FOR CAKES AND CUPCAKES TOO. ITS A VERY VERSATILE PRODUCT. IT IS DIFFICULT TO FIND IN THE LOCAL STORES, WITH THE OTHER TOPPINGS, I THINK SMUCKERS SHOULD MAKE UP SOME RECEIPES AND PUT IT NEAR THE PRODUCTS I MENTIONED, THE LOCAL STORES MIGHT STOCK THEN, I PURCHASED IT FROM AMAZON.

My dad and I love this ice cream topping. Our local grocery store rarely has it in stock and we use a ton of it. I was delighted to find it on amazon for a cheaper price than it costs at the grocery store. With free shipping, you can't beat it!

I'm surprised by the review "T. Bates" has left because I think these Nairns dark chocolate chip oat biscuits are delicious.  I have to wonder if s/he has had oat cakes before, because, if so, s/he would have known to expect a somewhat rough, rustic, hearty, and not overly sweet biscuit.  These are nothing like the typical cookies one can buy in American grocery stores.  I love the rich grain taste and texture and the subtleness of the dark chocolate chips.  These are more of an "adult" European biscuit and less of a true cookie.  They are definitely something good for those of us looking for a less processed, different cookie rather than the same old tired options available at the supermarket.

Yum! This is a new flavor for me, and I am addicted! I love the combination of chocolate and oats, with just the right amount of sweetness and a satisfying crunch. Perfect with a cup of tea or a glass of port. I also really love their stem-ginger and fruit & spice flavors,but this harder-to-find chocolate chip is my new favorite. I agree that the negative reviewer sounds like someone unfamiliar with Nairn's products. I consumed an entire box in less than two days! These are also a real treat for folks like me who can't eat wheat, dairy or eggs; though people with an extreme sensitivity may need to avoid these, Nairn's does make a gluten-free range of oat cakes & biscuits.

These are delicious, not very sweet, and perfect with tea. Even though they are not gluten-free they do not seem to cause inflammation like other grain products, but then, I am sensitive and not allergic and do not have Crone's.Sometimes, when I want something sweeter, I mix softened butter with raw cocoa, vanilla, stevia, and coconut sugar--in other words, I make frosting--and smear it on. Yum yum.

I am very pleased with the taste but disappointed in the text of the written advertisement.The fiber content is about one half of 1 g per cookies. A serving, of two cookies, contains 1 g of fiber but 3 g of fat. I don't think this ratio indicates healthy!I will not reorder.

We discovered these oatcakes on a recent trip to Kenya.  My daughter can't have gluten so we were at a health store in one of the malls looking for some snacks for her and came across these "cookies."  My husband and I enjoyed them as well as they aren't overly sweet - but definitely delicious! They're low glycemic and made with good fats! Definitely a product we will continue to purchase for that occasional treat! The chocolate ones are very good!

If you live in Scotland, perhaps these are delicious. Here, I would not label them "cookies", but maybe crackers. Imagine a densely-packed wafer of oat bran. Hard, brown and with the flavor of cardboard, (or maybe presto-board) and you have these "cookies". :  I don't know where the chocolate is. I don't know where the calories come in, either. One word: nasty! If I could return these, I would. They are also in very small 7 oz. boxes. Well, they say "live and learn". I have learned I do not like these!

I ordered a basket on December 2, 2009 to be delivered to my daughter during her final exams. First of all, I paid for the basket to be delivered the next day ($30.00) and was notified on December 8th that it was just then being shipped. Second, my daughter NEVER received the basket. I spoke with someone there and they discovered the error in delivery time and refunded the $30.00, however they did say that they would have to do an investigation to find out why the basket was never received. It is now February 6th and I still haven't heard anything about their investigation into the matter.  My daughter, later, went door-to-door asking if anyone had received a study basket and they said 'no'.  Hopefully I will received notification as to why the basket was never delivered and if it was, where was it delivered because it certainly did not reach my daughter's house.  I suppose I will have to wait the outcome of their investigation before I could make a decision as to whether or not I would recommend ordering a Study Basket again.

Although I have no other pistachios to compare the taste to, Swanson Health Products organic roasted unsalted pistachios (purchased via Amazon.com) are very good.Will definitely include this product as a (re)order.

As a youngster, I grew up eating pistachios from Iran long before the current embargo of Iranian products.They were,in my estimation,the best tasting, most flavorful pistachios.I've traditionally not been a big fan of California pistachios but recently tried several bags of these Swanson Organic roasted, unshelled and unsalted (although they do have a tad bit of sodium)pistachios.(orderd them directly from Swanson) I never thought I'd say this, but these California pistachios were really good, fresh, and difficult to stop eating. I wish they weren't so expensive, but are good as a special treat once in a while. Very few shells were unopened.

These can be purchased in most markets that carry hispanic products for about 79 cents a can. This price is outrageous unless you wait for a deal.It is a wonderful Salsa Verde, though. I used it when I lived in Mexico and would 'doctor' it with some garlic and a little extra onion. I really couldn't tell the difference between it and my homemade version. It's fabulous with pork, especially riblets (have your butcher cut the ribs into 2 inch pieces for you.But definitely wait for a sale.

If you have not tried Dilmah, you have probably not tasted the best tea on Earth ! The aroma, the flavor, the texture, it is simply SUPER! Must try to appreciate the real tea..... We just bought lots of Dilmah for some of our close friends. Dilmah Tea, English Breakfast Tea, 20-Count Foil Wrapped Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
Got this 6-pack Dilmah about two months ago and now there is only one pack left. One teabag is good for at least three mugs. It's really good.... rich and smooth! Try it and u will enjoy it.
If you like your tea to wake you up with a "kick" this is a strong, full bodied tea; it is not over-powering, though.

Ceylon (now Sri Lanka) tea is the best tea in the world! If you can't get the pure, unlabelled tea leaves, plucked off the cool hills of up country Sri Lanka, this the next best thing. I usually get my tea directly from SL but when I run out I have to fall back on Dilmah...and having moved here from Australia (where the tea is widely available), I'm very happy that Dilmah is finally available in the US.Update - March 18th, 2010I've been drinking Dilmah Premium for a long time now and love it but lately wanted to widen my horizon; With that in mind, I tried the Dilmah Supreme and Dilmah English Breakfast. Dilmah Supreme rated an average on my scale but ah, the English Breakfast! If you wish to have an extra special cup of tea, bold and rich in flavour with subtle nuances, then the English Breakfast is definitely your cup of tea! While more expensive than the Dilmah Premium, it is well worth the price! Enjoy...:)

I'm not sure why this tea is poor, it tastes worse than Lipton which is odd.  I'm used to some bitterness with that trademark Ceylon flavor, but this is flavorless and quite bitter.  I did not care for it and I cannot even finish the remaining 3.5 boxes.  I much prefer Impra, sorry.
This is the best tea ever! I've been having this tea for 2 years. The tea is also very popular in Australia.

column9: Better than Ahmad, not as good as Twinings
column10: I've tried Twinings', Ahmad's and Dilmah's English breakfast teas. I would rank Twinings first, followed by Dilmah and then Ahmad.Twinings has the best flavor and comes closest to the classic taste. (Ironically both Ahmad and Dilmah are foiled wrapped while Twinings is not.)Dilmah is decent, but doesn't taste as full bodied as Twinings.I didn't like Ahmad. It tasted more like Dilmah's Ceylon tea than English Breakfast Tea.An aside - I haven't tried Twinings' Earl Grey, but I love Dilmah's Earl Grey. I find its smell and taste very therapeutic after a long and tiring day. In fact, I would prefer it to wine if I'm really tired.

column9: It is not that great tea!!!
column10: I bought this tea last month for $9.20 - six boxes. After reading the reviews, I had to try it. It is a little bit better than Lipton, but not as good as Tazo. I would not buy this again.
I liked this rice, taste good and fluffy. and yes i recommend this rice,give it a try,it's  well worth it...

I was offered one of these candies in a local business several years ago and enjoyed the taste.  Later, I began to read of the medicinal properties of ginger and decided to try to find this candy.  Not finding it locally, I looked to Amazon and found it. Now, I have ordered it several times over the years and continue to enjoy it. I've found it an enjoyable candy and helpful to ease an upset stomach.

I love this stuff!  I gotten it in a grocery store when traveling and haven't been able to find it since. I'm ordering a pack now for my sister-in-law to try for nausea.  Hopefully it will be as good as I remember, chewy, spicy, and full of ginger!
To all Pez Collectors --This is the place to buy !  Super fast service & very well packed.

column9: Almost as good as the Dutch Chocolate sprinkles I like
column10: I got these because Amazon no longer carried Deruyter sprinkles when I went to buy them. I couldn't find the Deruyter sprinkles anywhere, so I gave these a shot. Not quite as good on my toast in the morning or on ice Cream, but a close second and about equal in price.This:Deruyter Chocoadehagel Puur (Dark Chocolate Sprinkles), 14-Ounces Boxes (Pack of 3)by DeruyterList Price:  $22.47Price:  $17.31 ($0.41 / oz) Eligible for free shipping with Amazon Prime.You Save:  $5.16 (23%)Now back - would be my regular purchase.That's what happens when you work in northwest Europe - you get hooked on this stuff.

I have only used one bag so far, but I put in a 2-lb salmon fillet glazed with an apple juice reduction and the results were so delicious that my family of three ate the entire fillet in one sitting.  Neither my husband, nor my daughter have ever even liked salmon before.  It was incredibly easy, the directions are very clear, and best of all:  no mess to clean up!

column9: great trick and delicious for ribs or brisket.
column10: I've lived in apartments with no outdoor space for years-- but can always get nicely smoked foods by using these bags.  True, your entire home will smell like wood smoke, but not such a bad thing (you can always undercook a bit, take the meat out and finish it outside the bag if you don't want a strong smell to linger).  The times for cooking and the recipes included on the inside are right on target every time, you really can't go wrong.  Makes wonderful brisket-- I let it cool after cooking, slice it, and then add sauce and reheat.  My friends and I agree that the poultry/fish bags aren't quite as good.The first I tried was a similar import from William's Foods, but they no longer carry these.  Wish I could get them locally, but this works!

column9: EASY TO USE GREAT SMOKEY FLAVOR!!!
column10: I have been using these smoker bags for several years. the first time I used them I bought them from my local Cub foods grocery store. i however now just order them on line since I can get them year around. I have used them on the grill, but mostly inside in the oven. I use them mainly for smoking ribs and turkey legs. They always come out perfect. Everyone compliments me on the flavor and tenderness of the meat. I usually finish them up on the gas grill with barbeque sauce for that perfct taste. I have given these away to friends nd family and they are now using them. I would be really surprised if anyone tried them and didn't like them.UPDATEI used a smoker bag to make incredible pulled pork. I used a 6 lb pork shoulder and seasoned it. Placed in the smoker bag at 225. I put mine in the oven at midnight and let it slow roast till 7 am. I was afraid at this low heat it would not get smokey enough but it was perfect. I pulled the pork apart in the juices from the bag and it was as good as any pulled pork I've had.

To the person who rated this low to due getting just 1 bag...read what you order. Very unfair to rate a product 1 star due to your own error.The bags are great!! So far I've only tried the alder one which gives a lighter taste than the mesquite.*Read the instructions WELL on the INside of the cardboard*I bought a 4-pack of rainbow trout from [...] and rubbed kosher salt inside the fish a couple of hours before cooking. Preheated oven to 475F, placed 1 large cubed zucchini and the 4 fish inside the bag, folded closed and placed on a low rack. Lowered temp to 375F after 15 min and continued for another 25-30 min (3 lbs of fish) = perfection! My kids were crazy about eating "fish tummy" and this couldn't have been any easier to cook or easier to clean up.A very light smoke lingered around the kitchen, but nothing that I'd need to even open the windows for. If the smell is a problem, use your bbq (instructions include oven, coal or gas grill).Too bad the price is such a rip off...these are available for under a buck in Finland.

column9: Smoker bag is great!  Transaction was great!  Thanks!
column10: These bags are incredible.  We use the hickory smoke bag.  The food comes out tasty, tender and with virtually no clean up.  I recommend them highly.  We love them.

I love these bags.  Make the best ribs ever.  I put ribs in the bag with a dry rub according to directions.  After about 1 hour, I take out of oven and let sit for 30 min.  Then I slit the bag down the top, add a gooey sauce and broil or BBQ to brown.  Moist, delicious---everyone raves as the meat falls off the bones.  The whole process takes less than 2 hours.
The Savu Bags were simple to use and gave our meat a super smoked flavor.  Made cleanup easy and quick.
Whereas the Savu Smoker Bag is an excellent product, I was disappointed at the fact that the supplier decided to substitute without prior acknowledgement.
I followed the instructions to the letter. I cooked 3 pieces of salmon. They were dry and no smoke flavor. The price is too high.

I would not recommend in the slightest. It makes my whole house smell like a smoker (even with an air purifier running), the food does not taste like it is smoked and I've done ribs and chicken and both just come out mushy like they have been steamed. Don't buy it!

column9: Smoked the house more than the food
column10: I bought this item based on such good reviews. I thought I would do some ribs in the stove using a smoker bag instead going out in the cold to use the barbeque grill, but what a mistake. I followed the directions exactly and all I got was a smoky house and smoky clothes. The ribs had a weird and faint wood taste not smoky like you get on the grill. YUCK! The ribs were the worst I ever tasted. I usually don't do reviews unless I feel it's necessary and this is one of those times. I really expected to have good results. I give this one TWO THUMBS DOWN.
This was represented as 3 bags and was only one.  I could have bought one bag at 1/3 of the price elsewhere.
I was so happy to find this.  Our local store was out.  My husband loves this in his coffee, so I was thrilled to be able to buy several bottles of this.

column9: Helped my sick cat take his medicine.
column10: My cat has been having some health problems, and I have to make sure he eats so he can take his medicine.  After spending the day at the vets, he had no interest in food.  I sprinkled Foodie Cat on his wet food and it was instant...he chowed it all down.  I've also used it to get him to ingest a crushed up pill that I had put on top of his food.It works great!  Cats are crazy for it.Thank you Foodie Cat!

All four of my "finicky" cats loved this product!  What I love is that it's PURE and wholesome!  Needless to say, FOODIE CAT is here to stay, and will have a home in my animal pantry for years to come.  Thanks for creating an additive that I can trust and gives my felines something to relish!  I must say...I'm tempted to sprinkle it on my rice!

My cat loves to eat but she's fussy. Doesn't matter if the cat food is dry or canned, cheap or expensive - I've tried everything - if it doesn't meet her nose test, she won't touch it. Turns out Foodie Cat smells really good to her (and to me too) and must taste delicious as well. Ever since I started sprinkling a little Foodie Cat on her breakfast crunchies and her canned meat at dinner she eats everything with gusto! Even the food she wouldn't eat before is now totally palatable. Try it, your cat will be pleased. And so will you!

We make these all the time and especially when having BBQ ribs or chicken. The rich cheesy taste of the potatoes works well with the hearty BBQ sauce. My daughter and I also like them cold right out of the refrigerator! I like how they provide instructions for making two packages at a time, which we usually do, and they also give times for different cooking temperatures in case you have something else in the oven that needs a lower temperature.
I know how to cook fresh food, but have a soft spot for this product.Sometines you just want one of the original "fast foods" that your mother/grandmother heated up.  Great with any kind of meat.

General Mills CORN Chex ingredients on this site lists "barley malt extract", which means that this product is NOT gluten free.Be careful.A version of RICE chex, however, has just been made available where the barley malt ingredient has been replaced with molasses. Thank you General Mills! As always, be sure to read the ingredients on every item you buy, each and every time!

As of 6/1/09, General Mills has made many varieties Gluten Free: Corn Chex, Rice Chex, Honey Nut Chex, Chocolate Chex, Strawberry Chex and Cinnamon Chex.  [...]There are, however, plenty of the not-GF versions still floating around grocery stores, so be sure to read the ingredients before you purchase your box!

column9: One of my dogs favorite treats
column10: These are one of the best dog treats that are GOOD for my dog as well as delicious to him!
This product is WAY over priced.  I bought the same thing for $4.29 at my local Safeway and K-Mart.  My two dogs love them and I give them as a treat.
Hunted this down during a recent business trip to Chicago. Displays some real roasting skills and will be a favorite, even in Peets country.

I was introduced to Intelligentsia coffee when we visited our son in Chicago some years ago.  It is very high quality coffee; and, while this ground product is not up to the standards of Black Cat freshly ground beans, I was not disappointed. This is smooth but powerful espresso; if you drink this coffee for breakfast, you will not doze off after lunch--I promise!

If you've never had Apple Jacks - try them.  Apple Jacks are just awesome, not overpowering taste of sugar but more of a sweet flavorful blend of apple and cinnamon.  This cereal is easily addicting.What's not to like about Apple Jacks...unless you REALLY don't like Apple flavor, but if you do...this is the cereal for you.

Ok I tried this gum at the natural food store which cost me $1 a box and it tasted great and a plus is that it is all natural without chemicals like aspartame and all of that. The flavor does not last long BUT if that is a must then you will go through these packs very quickly looking for a sugar rush. I love this gum as a digestive aid after eating, to produce enough saliva for digesting protein and carbs, and it works great. I can't tolerate the additives that most gums and candy have so as long as I can chew on this gum I am happy. Hope this gum stays around and amazon prices are wonderful!
Great alternative to the other chemical-laden gum on the market but this item loses flavor and gets hard to chew within minutes.

I am looking for Aspartame-free gum. There are not many in the market. So I am glad to find Glee. It tastes good (not great though) and does the job. The flavor doesn't last long. That's the only problem.

column9: Loving it but taste is too short lived
column10: Bought the Triple Berry, Tangerine, and Mint flavored ones.  They all taste great and I am very pleased that they use all natural ingrediants.HOWEVER, the taste like others have said is very short lived.  Maybe a minute no matter how many you stick in your mouth at a time.  Also I can't blow bubbles with these either but that doesn't really matter.  Usually I eat 2 pieces at a time as 1 just seems to get stuck in my teeth.Overall I really like this gum but I will be looking for another brand that has longer flavor duration.

You need to chew 3 pieces of this gum for the flavor to last two to three minutes.  One piece is way too small and the flavor is gone very fast.  I purchased this to avoid things that are not good for you and that is why it got four stars.  If you want a healthy gum this is the best I have found so far. The Glee tangerine better, but get both for variety.Pros: Not harmful and has good flavor while it lasts.Cons: The flavor does not last more than three minutes with three pieces and it is sticky compared with regular gum.

It took awhile, but I finally found a gum that doesn't contain cancerous chemicals. Unfortunately, at least for this flavor, my search isn't over.Positives:+ This flavor tastes really good. Fruity.+ There's no artificial anything.+ You won't be risking cancer by chewing this gum.+ It's relatively cost effecient.Negatives:- The sweetness lasts for less than 1 minute. Seriously.- After 1 minute the flavor is gone and you'll have to eat another piece just to maintain some level of sweetness.That's it. Therein lies the biggest problem. This flavor isn't for sweetening your breath. It's for dessert and it only lasts approximately 30 seconds. I can eat half the box in 10 minutes and feel compelled to do so because it tastes so good.Maybe the mint flavor lasts longer? Or perhaps Spry gum is a better fit?
horrrrible gum, it sticks to your teeth and takes for ever to come off, its like glue....and it cant be returned.  So they made their money and we got stuck with 12 packs of unchewable glue gum!
Found this on a quest to find a gum without a bunch of artificial sweeteners, flavors, etc.  Tiny little pieces of gum, taste pretty good.  Will probably be ordering more.
I like this gum.  It has great flavor and no chemicals!  I've had a very hard time finding gum that doesn't have BHT, phenylalanine, etc.
This is the only gum I chew.  All the others I have found use artificial sweeteners.  It is harder to chew than the others.  But I can handle that to avoid the chemicals in the others.

Have tried this gum in Triple Berry & Peppermint - very pleased with this product. Shaped like the old Chiclets gum, but without all the toxic ingredients most commercial gums now contain. Real chicle and natural flavorings amount to a good product. The gum flavor is not artificial hence not as long-lasting as some, but does provide a nice burst of flavor and a good firm chew. Would definitely buy this product again. The only improvement I can think of would be in the box design, which has a tendency to open in your purse if you're not careful. As a side note, the graphics on the box are so retro & fun!
This gum is too hard and the flavor is good but doesn't last long. I wanted to try it because it doesn't have any artificial sugar. Not sure if I would buy it again.

This is by far one of the best chocolates I have ever tasted. OMG!!!!I purchased a bug bunch from Germany and brought them back to the USA with mean and now that I see the price of them here...I shall eat mine ever so slooooowly. In Germany these chocolates are like three us dollars for 1 pack of four. The pic shows 1 pack of four. I would not mind competing with this seller and sell mine here but they are way too good. lol.

I put an order in for a bag when they said they would be getting some back in stock in a few days.
