column9: So great to find a bully stick for sensitive/allergic dogs!
column10: I was hesitant to order the Canine Caviar Buffalo Stix based on other Amazon reviewers comments about some of their other "stix" products being flimsy or quickly eaten, but I researched this specific item on the Canine Caviar website and these are actually Bison pizzle, unlike other products which may be made from gullet or intestine and are less sturdy. Therefore, these are directly comparable to beef "bully sticks."I was pleased with the case of individually wrapped Buffalo Stix that I received. I bought a 16-ounce bag of Bob's Red Mill Organic Golden Flaxseed Meal a few months ago and have been using it ever since. I have heard that you shouldn't keep it that long once you open it, but I haven't noticed any problems. The bag says "keeps best refrigerated or frozen," and I keep it in the refrigerator. I add about a tablespoon of the flaxseed meal to a ~16-ounce smoothie I blend fresh every morning, and I love it for that purpose! It doesn't really add any flavor that I've noticed, but I do believe it makes my pumpkin smoothies taste more like pumpkin PIE smoothies (I guess the flaxseed meal taste and texture reminds me of a pie crust being crumbled into the mix). I used more flaxseed meal in my smoothies a few times when the bag tipped out more than I was expecting, and it just made the smoothie thicker than I intended (not a big deal). The blender I use is a cheap single-serve blender, so it doesn't grind the meal up very much more than the original product straight out of the bag, but the texture doesn't bother me. The texture is not a fine powder like flour, nor is it sand-like as with cornmeal...it's flaky. I do have to wash my cup out within a few hours of finishing my smoothie, or the meal flakes will stick to the sides and make handwashing difficult.I have used it once as an egg substitute in a box cake recipe (for each egg, use 1 tablespoon flaxseed meal and 3 tablespoons of water; stir and let sit for about five minutes to get a bit gummy). Though the cake turned out okay, I'd probably not use it that way again. The cake density was a bit off, and my husband didn't like finding little flakes of flaxseed meal in his cake. He is fine with it in his smoothies, though.

column9: One of my favorite things! DELICIOUS
column10: I love this organic tart Cherry Butter by Eden.  It is just pureed cherries with nothing else!  It is so delicious. I wish Amazon would put this on the subscribe and save!The Remarkable Health Benefits of Cherries...Acute inflammation is part of the body's protective response to injuries, infections and other irritants, but long-term low grade inflammation puts you at risk of serious conditions like heart disease and diabetes.Tart Cherries' amazing potential to lower disease riskNow, new research, reported on at the Experimental Biology annual meeting in California, adds even more evidence to support cherries ability to alleviate inflammation.In one study, 10 overweight or obese men and women were provided with 8 ounces of tart cherry juice or a placebo beverage daily for four weeks. The results were encouraging. Participants, drinking the cherry juice, showed significant reductions in known markers of inflammation and lower levels of triglycerides (blood fats) and LDL cholesterol -- both known risk factors for heart disease.Researcher, Dr. Mitch Seymour, who led an animal study at the University of Michigan, in which tart cherries were again found to lower inflammation, said: "Chronic inflammation is a whole body condition that can affect overall health, especially when it comes to the heart. This study offers further promise that foods rich in antioxidants, such as cherries, could potentially reduce inflammation and have the potential to lower disease risk."To start with, tart cherries can aid muscle recovery following exercise. A study published in the British Journal of Sports Medicine revealed that strength loss and pain following exercise were significantly less in the cherry juice trial compared to the placebo trial. Most notably, strength loss averaged over the four days after exercise was 22 per cent with the placebo but only 4 per cent with the cherry juice-drinkers.Several earlier studies have confirmed that tart cherries offer benefits for patients with autoimmune, neurodegenerative and connective tissue diseases, particularly rheumatoid arthritis and diabetes. Studies show that tart cherries not only reduce pain and inflammation but also offer protection against cancer. These effects are attributed to the high amounts of plant phytochemicals, known as anthocyanins, they contain.Research has shown that a diet containing cherries is beneficial in reducing the risk of colon cancer. When researchers fed a diet containing tart cherries, anthocyanins, or cyanidin (a non-sugar breakdown product of anthocyanins) to mice with a genetic susceptibility to colon cancer, the animals developed significantly fewer and smaller colon tumours. This study also revealed that these compounds effectively reduced the growth of two human colon cancer cell lines.The cancer-protective benefits of this fruit were validated in another experimental study, in which cherry fruit extract reduced the growth of both human colon cancer cells and human breast cancer cells in a dose-dependent fashion.Researchers have suggested that a possible mechanism by which cherries may confer these benefits is through shutting down the growth of cancer cells by depriving them of the proteins they need to grow.Supporting melatonin levels and brain healthTart cherries are one of the few food sources of melatonin, a chemical released in the body by the pineal gland that is closely connected with the regulation of the sleep-wake cycle. Melatonin also acts as a powerful antioxidant, providing neuro-protective and immune-modulating effects.Ongoing scientific studies are demonstrating how foods naturally rich in melatonin - like Montmorency cherries - can help sufferers of insomnia gain deep, restful sleep.Tart cherries are also rich in phenolic compounds, which have strong neuro-protective activity. In a laboratory setting, cherry phenolics protected neuronal cells from cell-damaging oxidative stress in a dose-dependent manner. Tart cherry compounds may therefore play an important role in protecting ageing adults against neurodegenerative conditions such as memory loss, senile dementia, and perhaps even Alzheimer's disease.Give it to me!Why do people use tart cherries and tart cherry juice?Both sweet and tart cherries and cherry juice have long been used by traditional healers as a folk remedy for gout, because cherries are thought to lower urate levels in the body.Tart cherries are used for conditions involving inflammation and pain, such as:* arthritis* gout* muscle pain* back pain* diabetes* neurodegenerative diseasesBoth sweet and tart cherries contain phenolics, naturally-occurring plant compounds that have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant effects.The main type of phenolic in cherries is called anthocyanins. In general, the darker the cherry color, the higher the anthocyanin content.Anthocyanins have been found to block two enzymes, COX-1 and COX-2, which play a role in the production of inflammatory compounds called prostaglandins. Aspirin and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as naproxen and ibuprofen also work this way.In test tube studies, cherry anthocyanins have been found to protect neurons from damage by oxidative stress. However, there have been no studies that have looked at whether cherry extracts could prevent or slow the progression of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease or Parkinson's disease in humans.Both Balaton and Montmorency tart cherries contain relatively high levels of the antioxidant melatonin compared to other foods. Montmorency cherries contain approximately 6 times more melatonin than do Balaton cherries.Are tart cherries more effective than sweet cherries?Generally, tart cherries have been found to have higher concentrations of phenolics and anthocyanins than sweet cherries.Tart cherries are also slightly lower in sugar. Half a cup of sweet cherries contains 9.3 g of sugar and 46 calories, compared to 6.6 g of sugar and 39 calories in tart cherries.However, there is no real evidence that these differences are significant-both types of cherries are very high in anthocyanins compared with other foods.It may be that we are hearing more about the health benefits of tart cherries because of the way they are marketed. In 2005, the US Food and Drug Administration sent warning letters to 29 cherry farmers and distributors for positioning tart cherries on their websites as a medicinal food that could possibly help people with gout, arthritis, diabetes, and prevent cancer.What research has been done on tart cherries?Although anthocyanins, which are also found in blueberries and other purplish-red fruits and vegetables, are known to be powerful antioxidants, no studies have looked at whether cherries--tart or sweet--can relieve symptoms of arthritis, gout, or diabetes outside the lab.All studies involving cherries have been very small, so we'll have to wait to see whether tart cherries are beneficial and in what quantities. In the meantime, here are a few of the studies that have been conducted so far:* A small randomized controlled trial in the British Journal of Sports Medicine examined the effectiveness of a tart cherry juice blend in preventing symptoms of exercise-induced muscle damage. Fourteen male college students drank 12 fl oz of a cherry juice blend or a placebo, twice per day for eight consecutive days. Strength loss was significantly lower in people taking the cherry juice (4%) compared with the placebo (22%). Pain was also significantly lower in people taking the cherry juice.* Jill M. Tall, Ph.D., research fellow at Johns Hopkins, was the lead researcher of a study that tested the effectiveness of orally administrated anthocyanins from tart cherries on inflammation-induced pain in rats. The results of the study suggested that tart cherry anthocyanins may have a beneficial role in reducing inflammatory pain.* One small study published in the Journal of Nutrition supported the anti-gout effectiveness of cherries. assessed the effects of Bing cherry (a sweet cherry) consumption on healthy women and found that cherry consumption decreased blood urate levels, and there was a marginal decrease in inflammatory markers c-reactive protein and nitric oxide.

I don't advise you to buy these unless you enjoy artificial cheese and the waffie itself has no taste to it.(I thought they were going to be cheese flavored) I feel like I wasted the money on my gift card. NEVER will purchase these again. I had to give them away to some kids.

This brittle is absolutely delicious! The almonds add the best flavor and crunch to a very light and airy brittle. It makes for the perfect snack or after dinner treat and would be a wonderful present for fellow brittle lovers!
Because my husband is a truck driver, we purchased these as favors for our wedding guests.  They loved them and it added something personal for him.  Thank you Amazon!

column9: Waiting all day to cancel order. . . . .
column10: I ordered this along with the Hello Kitty Pez then attempted to cancel both.  Hello Kitty cancelled within 2 minutes, but this item hasn't cancelled all day despite the status expectation of update within 2 hours or less.  I  may have to refuse, since I don't intend to pay any shipping on the item  That said, it's Xmas Eve, so I still expect it to cancel soon.  The trucks look a bit plain per the Google images, and I don't really want them although the wheels are functional.
Great product. Kids and parent's love it.  I have made several repeat purchased of this item (and best price around).
We ordered a large amount of these as handouts for Father's Day. They arrived in time and were a big hit.
They can be used as toy trucks (the wheels roll). A big success for my 3 year old's birthday party.

column9: Super Gummi Cola Bottles....Super Value & Flavor!
column10: First of all I would like to say that HANDS DOWN, Haribo makes the best Gummi Candies. It's true! If you've ever tried another brand, you'd know, and once you try Haribo, you'd never go back!These Haribo Gummi Candy Super Cola Bottles, are just Bursting with Flavor! They are soft and chewy. (But not so soft that they are sticky and stick to your teeth)! I've loved these since I was young and now my son loves them too. They come in a delicious cola flavor and they are huge pieces of candy!  These are not small like the bears, at all. They're a great snack and most people can eat them because they're not a "chocolate-type candy" where you'd have to worry about allergies.They arrived at my home fresh,delicious and full of flavor.  To keepthem this way, I put them into two different "freezer type bags" and of course, I kept some out. Everyone that's stopped by has had the temptation to eat some and that's OK. I bought this HUGE five pound bag!Speaking of the Five Pound Bag, the price for this is a true VALUE! These cost so much at the market or candy store at the mall per pound! And these are the same exact cola bottles that you get there, without the worry that everyone has touched them or how long they've been out in the open before you came along to scoop them up in your bag! That's a big plus for me!I definitely recommend these gummi super cola bottles, they are a sweetand delicious treat and the VALUE is phenomenal! I will definitely be ordering more super cola bottles, plus a few different kinds of other gummis as well.  Simply because, we all have our favorites!

column9: If you LOVE gummies, this is IT!
column10: I love these large size cola gummies even more than the regular size ones!  If you love the chewy gummy texture, you probably can't stop eating them!  Not too sweet, just PERFECT!
I didn't realize when I bought them they were so big I just thought they were little bottles . They still have the same great taste.

I just love this candy I remember eating these when I was A child.  And this is the first time i've come across these in years.  The price is right and the taste is the same good and chewy just how I remember.
I was a little afraid that these wouldn't taste as good as the original smaller version. They're actually better, plus very fresh and soft!
Not much to say really, just that these are awesome! They are just like the original, but over 2" tall! AWESOME!!!

Nearly 30 years ago, I lived in Germany where I first tried the Haribo Cola Gummies.  I was hooked from the first bite.  When I moved back to the US in '83, I was unable to find them.  Then, about 8 years ago, I found them at a local candy store and was hooked again, but didn't like how stale they were, nor the price I was paying.  Then, I found these on Amazon and havent turned back since.  Thank you Amazon!
very fresh soft and moist with great cola taste. I think I said every thing I need to in 9 words.

column9: Soft, fresh and half the price
column10: I buy these because they are my wife's current favorite candy.  I can get them locally but they cost more then twice as much, even after shipping costs, and are not as fresh as the ones I get through Amazon.  The ones I get are soft, fresh, have more flavor then the exact same ones I can get locally that have sat in a plastic container waiting to be purchased.  I usually split the five pound bags into one pound ziplock bags but if kept from the air they  stay fresh and soft.
These tast the same as the little coke bottle but are about 5 inches long.  Awesome!  Also these are among the freshest gummy candy's i've ever had.
These are the BEST. Love the smaller ones. Love these even more. I LOVE Haribo Gummy's!

The authentic Large Cola Bottle.We used to get these as kids growing up in Ireland.These are the exact same ones.Buying in bulk such as a bag like this saves a fortune over Pik'N'Mix type candy stores where I've calculated they may cost anywhere between $.60 and $.80 a piece!

Love Haribo gummis!  These taste as good as the smaller ones, but are huge, about 3 inches tall.  That makes them a bit harder to chew, however, especially for little kids or people with dental devices.
Great candy...comes in a huge supply that lasts a long time.  My favorite Haribo product.

Haribo can do no wrong (we'll let those nasty berries covered in nonpareils slide).  These cola bottles are always an attraction in the big jar in my living room. My guests seem to become even more addicted than I am.
I will need therapy because of these things!  If they are in the house they are MINE!  Haribo is the very best and I think these large ones taste better than their smaller counterparts!

column9: The ONLY "Super-Sized" Gummi Colas worth buying
column10: I buy these bags of cola-goodness about 3-4 times a year for my little brother -- these are the same product that he adores when he drives to Disneyland and makes a pit stop at Casa de Fruta. If you're wondering how big a 5-pound bag is, you'd be surprised at the size: since these are the "giant" cola bottles, imagine a grocery-store produce baggie, fully packed and heat-sealed, but "super heavy". This is a nicely textured gummi: not too soft and it has just the right touch of cola flavor.
What a great deal on a favorite treat. I love these things and is was an incredible value from Amazon.

column9: Remember biting the top and pretending to drink the cola out?
column10: I do... Every time I eat one of these gummies I am reminded of my youth...
Super fresh gummi colas! Not like the stale american knock offs! These were great!
These are very yummy.  I used to eat the gummy coke bottles all the time in Germany where I grew up.  If you like gummy candy, eat these!

LOVE these!  These are a great treat at any age.  I bagged the giant cola bottles, giant crocs and gummy bears in a treat bag for my 4th grade students.  They were savoring the giant cola bottles.  I don't blame them.  I find myself chomping on them, too.  I don't even like coca cola.

column9: Good texture, ok value, taste not strong enough
column10: I bit into this expecting it to taste like coke, but it really has a vague taste, and if you didn't tell me the flavor of it, i wouldn't have guessed it.but like all haribo gummies, the texture is very good.
Just thought it was a large bag of the small ones, but it was a large bag of the huge bottles, still good enjoyed

We bought these cola flavored candies for my son to pass out in class while doing his presentation on the inventor of Coke, John Pemberton.  They taste TERRIBLE, and there was no way we could use them.  They were a waste of our money.

i bought this 5 pound bag of candy because the reviews were all beaming about how good these are and i've bought the gummy frogs in the past and liked those so i thought i'd give this a try. These are gross... not only that, but they're huge. i recommend the gummi frogs as a better alternative. Now i know to try out the candy in a smaller portion first,before investing in my next 5 pound bag. 2 stars because well it's not fair to people who like these to say they are absolutely terrible, but still, now i have a 5 pound bag of candy i have to get rid of.

These look like gummy candy, but that's where it changes. They are soft and chewy and do not stick to your teeth or pull out your fillings. The flavors are right on to tasting like the real thing. The one down side is the bag is 2.5 oz and has 2.5 servings. It is very hard to not eat the whole bag at one time. That is 200 colories which is less than a high fat candy bar but still if you are watching what you eat..it's 200.
GRAND KIDS LOVE THESE AND I BUY THEM BY THE BOXES FOR THEM AS WELL ASME AND MY HUSBAND.  EVERYONE LOVES THEM!!!!

These are very tasty snacks, lo cal, no fat, easy on the teeth and very satisfying. Just the right size package. I wish they were in supermarkets. I also believe they would help people who struggle with weight.

column9: Tasty, but needs more mixed berry
column10: These are a tasty candy. I say "candy" because that's what they are. The first two ingredients are corn syrup and sugar. Don't delude yourself into thinking that these count as a serving of fruit, or in any way provide positive nutritional value beyond the added vitamin C. They are tasty though. I enjoy their strong fruity flavor and their quality of being gummy but not too sticky.I think this assortment should contain more of the "mixed berry" flavor and fewer of the other two flavors (cherry and strawberry). When there's a case of these fruit snacks available for snacking on at my workplace, the mixed berry always disappears long before the other flavors.
This item is great for a sweet tooth and has a good taste. I like that it is no fat but it still has high sugar so I have to watch how much I eat of it.

This is a nice snack for kids.I got this for my toddler because he always wants more of his gummies vitamins. So this one does help curb his cravings. He still can not finish a whole pack...But I can..This one box can lastt me a good few months even if he has 2 packs a week

I love these snacks! I know there is more than one serving in the bag, but I actually like that. The other types of fruit snacks that sell tiny bags just aren't big enough for me.I also love that they are fat free and have no high fructose corn syrup.FYI...the 36 count box is much cheaper at Costco.

column4: A. Sutono, a.k.a., Birdey The Observer
column10: Kellogg's Fruity Snacks variety pack consists of three flavors; cherry, mixed berry and strawberry. We used to have them at work, but they usually went out fast within days. I'm not sure why we no longer have them. They have great taste, don't stick to your teeth unlike similar products like Jelly Belly and the nutrition content is not bad. The sugar content might be a little too high, but each bag has 100% daily value of vitamin C. If you decide to buy, try Costco. The last time I checked, they charged you about $11 for a pack of 36 that has 12 bags of each flavor.

These are seriously the best fruit snacks I've ever had...and I've tried a lot of different kinds.  They are soft, chewy, and have great flavor.  I love that the packages are larger than other kinds, too...they actually are pretty filling.  My husband questioned why I was so excited to buy these till he tried some...then he ate more than me!  Another plus is that they are actually pretty healthy for you (:
As the subject states, quick delivery and these snacks are always delicious.  Considering they delivered to an APO Box, it arrived quickly.  Very pleased.

column9: No fat snack that tastes great
column10: It's funny that these are called 'snacks' when they are actually candy. I guess 'snack' sounds better for marketing purposes. However, if you're expecting these to fill you up like an actual snack (snack bar or otherwise) you're going to be out of luck. These are just gummy candies labeled as snacks.The best thing about these is that they contain no fat. They are very tasty (and addictive). My favorite flavor is the mixed berry variety which included blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries. None of the flavors are too sweet or too chewy; they have a very pleasing consistency that doesn't stick to your teeth.

I bought these and my family Loves them. They are so good. They are fat free and yet all natural juice. No additives and yummy. They also come in a size serving that is nice. There is not like six in a bag. There are lots. So it is really a snack. My seven year old likes them and I don't mind him eating them knowing they are not bad for him. Thanks ivorysoul
It is the best! Trust me I looked - I am an expert by now after many years of searching. Its the perfect balance of heat and flavor!

If you actually like sauces that have more than just HOT appeal, you will love this one.  Melinda's XXXXTra Reserve is my favorite out of the hundreds I've tried to include some homemade sauce on St. Croix......which runs reeeeeeeally close *smile*Great flavor and bite.......delish!  Also, this seller takes care of their customers :o)  Good all the way around!

column9: Among the best hot sauces in the world
column10: I am a chile head. I eat habanero sauces just about every day; from Dave's, Da Bomb, Z sauce, Iguana, Blair's, El Yucateco, Liquid Stoopid, and many others-it's safe to say I've tried most of what's out there. I looooove Melinda's XXXXtra reserve sauce.Like other reviewers have stated: this is NOT the sauce that will land you in the E.R. This is a sauce that is reasonably hot and packs amazing flavor. It's the flavor of Melinda's that keeps me constantly stocking it in my refrigerator alongside my other hot sauces. Sometimes I want heat that isn't overpowering and this stuff fits the bill. It's delicious on just about anything-I could probably pour a bowl of it and dip tortilla chips-it really is that good! Try it, even if you can handle hotter, you're taste buds will thank you.

Bought this for my husband who is a major pepper head. I think I ended up eating half of it, and I have no tolerance for heat. Despite the fact that it is NOT very spicy, it has a great taste and we put it on almost everything until the bottle was gone. Still recommend for those who want the flavor over the burn, but will be trying the naga jolokia next.

Hard to beat the flavor of this stuff, its fresh and clean.Still not going to blow your head off, maybe Melinda needs to come out witha XXXXXXXXXXXtra Hot version of this stuff, but you'll still have a hard timefinding any other habanero sauce that tastes better on fish, pork, or chicken.Still not as universal as Tabasco Habanero, but a great complement to veggiesand other light dishes, and when you go to Firehouse for a sub you can try thison your smoked turkey and you will be pleasantly amazed at the effect. Great stuff,a staple for any decent collection. BTW, if you like the flavor of this stuff andstill crave more heat, check out Iguana Radioactive Atomic Sauce, its got the samebasic ingredients as Melinda's, the same consistency, but is about 6X up the heatscale from this relatively weak XXXX sauce. 5 Scovies

column9: My favorite hot sauce by a mile!
column10: I have tried MANY different hot sauces but melinda's XXXXtra reserve is by far the best balance of flavor and heat. It adds taste and kick to any dish. Melinda's other products are also worth a try if you want some variety with the same quality.

column9: Best stuff in the world - just hard to find!
column10: This is hands down the best commercial habanero hot sauce available. When I can find it I order 6 or 8 at a time. The flavor is sublime - real flavor, not just heat. I tend toward spicy foods and this is not hot compared to Dave's Inanity for example, but Inanity has about the flavor of motor oil. I can eat Melinda's off a teaspoon with nothing else - it's that good. Marie Sharp's doesn't even come close.

Tried this for the first time and I love, love, love it! It has such a great taste. We sat there and just kept putting it on every bite of our breaded chicken cutlets, yummmmmmmy. Try it, you won't be sorry! I can't wait to try the other flavors.....

When I look for a hot sauce I want something that adds heat.  Plain and simple.  It should not have an overpowering flavor of it's own but simply a pleasant background upon which to serve up the heat.  I use hot sauce to accent the flavors of the food I'm eating with heat.  Amongst the hot sauces on the market any sauce that claims to be XXXX Habanero Hot should provide heat.  This sauce does not do that.  I usually use small drops of hot sauce on my foods.  With this sauce I was able to literally eat it by the tablespoon without a true heat sensation.  I gave it to my 18month old son and he didn't even raise an eyebrow.  No, I am not exaggerating or misusing the word 'literally'.  I put a large dose of this in mac and cheese I was eating and let my youngest have a bite too.  He didn't even seem to notice a difference in taste.If you are like me and want a sauce that can be added sparingly to provide heat without changing or masking the defining flavors of whatever dish you are eating then this sauce is not for you.  It would be impossible to add enough of this sauce to create the desired heat level without burying your food in it.  Since, this sauce straight out of the bottle is on the high end of mild I doubt you could ever add enough.Hot sauces labeled XXXX Habanero Hot should be on the high end of hot.  This sauce is nowhere even close.  It is mislabeled.  If it had been properly labeled I would not have wasted my money on it.  It is one X hot.

column9: A sinful choco bar without the sin!
column10: My first bite into SJ Luxury Organics' Choco Bar was pure heaven.  It has the smoothness and richness of cacao and an extremely satisfying bite from the nuts and seeds.  It tastes almost sinful, but raw cacao is actually one of nature's best foods.  Can it be?  Can it really be that a choco bar is actually good for you?  I found out that those bad things that are attributed to chocolate such are actually caused by the dairy, sugar and others fillers added to the dark chocolate.  A sinful choco bar without the sin...I love it!

I love this product.  I have tried multiple pastas in my pasta fagioli soup,  this is the best substitute for tubetti. Great in all soups from chicken noodle to vegetable.  Nice texture.BUT WHAT IS REALLY COOL IS USING IT TO MAKE A GLUTEN FREE SPAGHETTI-O'S.  My daughter recently had both a tonsillectomy followed by placement of extensive orthodontia appliances.  So I wondered if it would work for a GF spag-O.  It was a huge hit, will definitely use for school lunches.  Place in boiling water, stir frequently (to get through the sticky/clumping phase), return to boil, boil for a few minutes then turn to low to medium heat and allow water to cook down (just like many brands of mac & cheese).  Then add spaghetti sauce.  It is always great to duplicate something that other kids can eat.

We use these for gluten free SpaghettiOs too.  But for the sauce we use...1 can Tomato Sauce2 Tbsp Cheese Whiz1 pinch Sugar (for some reason it just smoothes out the taste)Stir while heating to melt and mix the cheese whiz in until smooth.  If it starts to look thick add in a little water. Then gently add in about a cup, (more or less to taste), of cooked noodles.  Continue to heat just until warm again and serve.Another great use for these is as a light and refreshing alternative in your favorite tuna salad recipe.  It is our favorite Sabbath Salad recipe and when we took it to a buffet party, everyone asked where to find these noodles.  :o)  (No one realized they were gluten free).
This pasta is great. I bought it to make gluten free, dairy free "spagetthi o's" for my three year old and they are great.

column9: good substitue for acini de pepi pasta
column10: I used this pasta for my acini de pepi pasta salad (frog eye salad). my daughter grew up eating this salad at holiday dinners and was very sad when she could no longer eat it. I tried this Anellini out last year and made it again this year. You can not tell any difference.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! glad we found this pasta ! :)

Bottom line:  If you like bacon (and let's be honest, who doesn't?), you'll love this product.  It's two of John Candy's favorite things wrapped into one - bacon and salt.I am one for combining things that make sense.  Shampoo and conditioner.  Peanut butter and jelly.  Paris Hilton and an electric chair.  Bacon and...well, anything.  I can put bacon with any dish and it'll taste great.  Eggs, salads, steaks, macaroni, etc.  Now, I just put a little of this Bacon Salt on whatever I'm eating, and it tastes like a million bucks.I'm not one to look at the back of the bottle, so you'll have to go elsewhere for the health exploits of the product (however, as far as I know, it's low on sodium).  For the taste, however - you can't go wrong, as long as you like BACON.RATING - BUY...NOW.

column9: Imagine a (low-sodium) world where everything tastes like bacon.
column10: Those of us who must limit sodium intake tend to be desperate for palatable low-sodium seasonings and grateful when we find them. BaconSalt has leapt way beyond merely "palatable," however, and brought new seasoning products to market that can make salt-hungry, bacon-deprived deprived folk like us absolutely giggle with delight. When we first learned about BaconSalt, we bought one of each flavor (the basics on Amazon, some special ones on the company website), plus extras for gifts. We sent a half-price gift package to loved ones at an APO address (as of this writing, the company actually gives military buyers/recipients a 50% discount -- imagine that!). We have no interest in the company, BTW ... we're just happy consumers grateful to find that we needn't abandon the savory flavors of bacon in the pursuit of good health.

This stuff is great with eggs or french fries or pea soup and about a hundred other things I could name. Tasty and very close to actual bacon flavour. My spice rack isn't complete without this!As it says on the label, everything should taste like bacon.

I originally bought one bottle of the Bacon Salt as a Christmas present for my husband. We decided to put it on Kraft Macaroni and Cheese as a taste test.One bite and we knew we had to buy more.  One bottle was not going to be sufficient.This stuff is good on pretty much anything, though so far, the macaroni and cheese is the best flavor combination.  I can also confirm that it is excellent on baked potatoes, pizza and veggie burgers.It gets bonus points from me because I'm sensitive to greasy foods, so I don't get to eat a lot of real bacon.  The only disappointing part is that our local grocery store doesn't carry it -- they only sell Baconnaise (which I've yet to try).  Thankfully, Amazon's great deals save the day!

I have high blood pressure and try to stay away from bacon because it has so much sodium. This seasoning gives me an excellent taste of bacon and very little sodium.  It is a blessing 'cause I love the flavor of bacon. Thanks.

column9: When there is no time for bacon...
column10: When there is no time for bacon, there is time for bacon salt!  I bought my Dad some of this as he thinks pretty much everything that isn't a dessert should be flavored with bacon.  He loves it and I have already had to order a refill as he was running out!  So if you love the taste of bacon but don't always have the time to cook some, you can toss some of this on there and it is a tasty substitute.

I used this as an "augmentation" to a certain box of prepared potatoes.  It was won-der-ful.  Yes, I use bacon bits on a regular basis, but this just gave it so much more.  I recall reading "secret ingredient."  Yes, this has become my secret ingredient!  I recommend it to any at-home cook. A must-have for anybody who prepares covered dishes for family or friends.

It isn't quite as I remembered how bacon tastes (I'm a recently-converted vegetarian), but it's pretty close. I sprinkle a lot on a veggie sandwich and it tastes a good deal like bacon. It's a great product and I recommend it.
I guess I expected a "huge" punch of bacon flavor and it was only so-so. I've used it on eggs, baked potatoes, popcorn and pasta salad. Again, just so-so.
Could not discern enough bacon flavor.  Did like the fact that it was not salty.  Tried it in soup, on salad and on steamed cauliflower.  Was disappointed.  Would not reorder.

column9: A great addition to the spice rack.
column10: "Everything should taste like bacon," and with Bacon Salt, everything can. J & D's, obsessed with baconizing everything from popcorn to ranch dressing to lip balm, really hooked me with Bacon Salt. This seasoning works on hamburgers, mashed potatoes, popcorn, scrambled eggs, cheeseburger quiche...basically anything I usually sprinkle with salt, I have used Bacon Salt, and it always enhances the taste with the bacon flavoring.Original Bacon Salt contains 135mg of sodium per 1/4 teaspoon, has no calories, and is safe for those on vegetarian or kosher diets. There are other Bacon Salt alternatives, from Mesquite to Jalapeno to Hickory to Applewood, each with a slightly different sodium content.Bacon Salt is a great addition to the spice rack, and adds a different dimension to favorite meals.

I grew up in Illinois with Southern parents. My mother was a southern cook with little or no knowlege of spices. Our food was plain but very tastey. the flavors my mother used was all natural seasoning, salt, pepper, onions, garlic, dill and the ever present bacon fat that was our favorite. Today, the fat has been removed from our diets as we all try to be healthy. When I discovered J&D bacon seasoning I was absolutely esstatic!!!!Now I can prepare some of our favorite comfort foods and they are fat free!!Some I simply add J&D to the Olive oil or Canola oil I'm using and the taste is B-A-C-O-N!!!!!Beans and cornbread seasoned with J&D is a favorite at my church!! Even the children love my Pinto beans!!! I also put it in my cornbread!!!Love the J&D Bacon Season!!!!!Gale Osborn  galejean2001@yahoo.com

This past weekend I found myself working the grill with some friends and their families.  One of our concoctions was a bacon wrapped pork loin and the other (second, lesser, afterthought) was a bacon salt rubbed flat iron steak.  Libations were flowing and by the time it came to prepare the steak, a generous amount of J&D's Original Bacon Salt was applied to both sides of the flat iron steak.  Now I've done dry rubs with grilled and smoked meats before, but I've usually concocted my own rubs, specifically concerned with things like salt and mono-sodium glutamate levels, etc.  After applying the rub, I had an "oh shoot" moment as I thought, this isn't one of my recipes, this is from a jar,... what if it totally sucks?  What if it is way too salty?  Now remember, the tenderloin was the main event, the bacon salt rubbed flat iron steak was the teaser.So both cuts of meat were thrown on the grill at around the same time, knowing full well the flat iron would come off first.  We pulled the flat iron off at around medium and let it rest.  Patience grew thin and we decided to give it a shot.  The flavoring from the rub was sublime and far better than ever expected.  This rub is truly low sodium and was surprisingly delicious.  The flat iron steak disappeared within minutes with the help of both adults and teenage children.Now don't get me wrong, the bacon wrapped pork loin was still the main event, but the bacon salt rubbed flat iron steak was definitely regarded as an equal and not an afterthought or teaser.  It was enjoyed equally.J&D's Original Bacon salt comes highly recommended.

Excellent product for saving on fat grams.  Use in place of regular salt and bacon fat on eggs, beans, peas.....anything that you normally would want to season with bacon flavor.  A new staple in our house.

column9: Doesn't make anything taste like bacon
column10: because it isn't bacon.  It tastes like Baco's, which don't taste like bacon.  I fail to understand how anyone who really loves bacon can be satisfied with an imitation.
We liked this product, used it on salads and on eggs, a little goes a long way.
I really like the Baconaise but was not impressed with the Low Sodium Salt.  I didn't think it tasted like bacon.

Sugar free Hawaiian punch is the best sugar free cold drink I have ever tasted.  I mean this seriously, try it.  No aftertaste.  It tasted just as good as the original.  I like the red and also lemon berry squeeze. Trust me on this one and try it.  I get it locally at Walmart for $1/8 pk.

column9: Perfect if you don't like to drink straight water!
column10: I mix these with a 24 oz bottle of water instead of the 16.9 oz bottle it recommends and I absolutely love the flavor! I have tried all different types of Great Value, Crystal Light, Koolaid and Hawaiian Punch sugar free drinks and this is my favorite flavor.  You can not tell at all that it's sugar free and it makes it so much easier to drink the water your body needs for the day!
I have no idea how there is anyone who actually likes this stuff - it is AWFUL!!!! I like regular Hawaiian punch so I got these but I wish I hadn't.  It is so bad.

I never liked sugar free drinks or drink mixes because I couldn't stand the aftertaste. But this drink mix doesn't have the nasty aftertaste. It is soooooo good! Buy them at the Dollar tree, they only cost a dollar ( as it should since it's a dollar store)

For you keurig lovers...all you get is coffee.  I love the cappucino and latte and mocha flavors of dolce-gusto.  Makes a really good froth for a home machine.  My older daughter is very specific about taste and flavor, and she loves the mocha.  So I guess it's all about taste.  I find plain coffee makers boring.

We really enjoy the Mochas from our machine. They are rich and chocolatey. Because you get two capsules you can adjust for more milk or more coffee. I prefer to make as much coffee first then add the milk. A little sprinkle of cocoa or colored sugar on top adds a special touch. If you have a glass mug drizzle chocolate syrup down the inside of the mug and make it look really fancy!  If you have a new machine and it tastes "off" rinse the machine out up to 10 times.I found the more I used my machine the better the drinks were! Now it is well broken in! Don't forget to add your code inside the box to your rewards account!

I love my morning coffee, so I bought a Dolce Gusto machine (on sale for only $20 which is a fraction of the retail cost)to try and curb the cost of lattes every morning. Not to mention, having to rush to work if the line at the coffee shop is long or service is slow etc etc.  Much to my dismay, I discover that I can only buy the coffee pods online. I thought for sure I could find them wherever Krups was sold, but, no dice! What is up with that???So, I suck it up and place an order through Amazon for the Dolce Mocha. Wow!!! I am really shocked at how disgusting this flavor is. The hot chocolate from the gas station tastes better. This tastes cheap, and there was no element of coffee flavor to it at all. If you are a coffee lover, skip this flavor. column9: Best whole food energy source around
column10: I have tried several different brewers yeasts and this is by far the best of them ALL! I use this to make a whole food source of all those great energy giving B vitamins. Better than coffee by far. I have 4 children and believe me I couldn't do it without this product.

It forgives a long steep or a wide range of temperatures (though hotter temps bring out better flavor), and I find the blend of flavors quite nice, particularly for such an inexpensive brand of tea.As with most chais, this tea is not at all bitter.

column9: Vitamin Burst Strawberry Pomegranate Fruit Brew for Keurig Brewers
column10: This stuff is awesome! Of course it's easily made by using a Keurig Brewer. To brew over ice with a Keurig(R) brewer follow these three easy steps:1. Fill a 16-oz. plastic cup to the top with ice and place on the Keurig(R) brewer. Do not use glass. Put a Brew Over Ice K-Cup(R) pack in the brew basket.2. Brew 6-oz. or 8-oz. for optimal flavor.3. The ice does the rest - stir and enjoy!There are 2 flavors:-- Strawberry Pomegranate: Sun-warmed strawberries are paired with sweet pomegranates to create a delicious fruit brew.-- Acai Berry: A tasty combination of powerful super-fruit and luscious berries creates a refreshing fruit brew.Both contain antioxidant vitamin C as well as some other vitamins (check out the picture of the nutrition facts.)INGREDIENTS: Sugar, Apple Powder, Dried Strawberry Puree, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Dried Pomegranate Juice Concentrate, Natural Flavor, Dried Black Currant Puree, Beet Juice Concentrate (color), Reb A (Stevia Extract), Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), D-Calcium Pantothenate (Vitamin B5), Pyridoxine Hydrochloride (Vitamin B6), beta-Carotene (color), Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12)Perhaps the only drawback is that sugar is the first item on the list, and thus you are consuming 17 grams of sugar. However if you compare a can of Coca-Cola, 12 ounces is 39 grams of sugar, with a 20 ounce bottle containing 69, so it is much less than that.I decided to compare the Vitamin Burst sugar content to the sugar content of some fresh fruit:apple 23gbanana 17gpeace 15gstrawberries 7gand watermelon 18gIf you compare Vitamin Burst Strawberry Pomegranate Fruit Brew with fresh fruit, Vitamin Burst fits right in there in how many grams of sugar.Vitamin Burst Strawberry Pomegranate Fruit Brew contains 40% of Vitamin C, 20% Niacin, 20% Vitamin B6, 20% Vitamin B12 and 20% Pantothenic Acid (also called B5). It does taste really sweet and it is really, really refreshing.

column9: Freddy Krueger, I've got your hand
column10: Although my cat will play with this, I wouldn't recommend you purchase it.  The size is way big for me yet too small for my boyfriend, so it's difficult to manipulate comfortably.  A (much) longer, elasticized ribbed cuff would be better plus tailoring the fingers to actual human dimensions instead of all one length.  I'm kicking myself for not noticing that in the product pic.  The fingers have a rigid material (guessing plastic) that runs along a channel on top of each.  This allows you to wave the fingers for the cat. An elastic cord holding each bug to the finger also seems to run along the channel and will bunch up should the cat pull the bug for any distance.  The bugs themselves are cute and seem sturdy enough under supervision.  I would not allow my cat to play with this without me because there are too many little parts that could come off and tempt him.  Conceptually an interesting idea but the execution of this product is lacking.  I do plan to keep it tho since my cat enjoys the bugs.

column9: Fun to play with your cat & keep your hands safe!
column10: Whenever I play with my cat my hands are always getting scratched. This glove  is a heavy canvas with long fingers so when the cat grabs at them your own hands receive minimal damage. There is a long spine (maybe plastic) in each finger which keeps each finger straight and the toys are actually attached with a retracting elastic cord so the cat can grab the toy, pull it out and chew on it, and then the toy snaps back to the finger tip. I've seen that the toys are replaceable too so when they get worn out (or eaten up) you can get new ones. I have a few toys by Fat Cat and they hold up well to play and washing, and I enjoy the color. Amazon has the best price and if you have Prime you don't pay shipping.

column9: Almost as Good as the One with Mice Lures
column10: I bought two Catfisher Garden Mitts with the 4 mice lures, and my cat just loves, loves, loves them so much that the mice are all destroyed.  I thought I would try the insect one too.  He loves this a lot but not as much as the mice.  The insects make a crinkle sound that the mice do not, and because there are no feathers and string tails or body made of string, the insects have held-up signigicantly better.  I would buy this in conjuction with the mice lures just to have a back-up when the mice lures are destroyed, and you are waiting for replacements.
This toy excites humans more than my cat, I had to disconnect 3 of the 4 catnip lures to play with my kitty, lures tangle up together.  Not bad over all, but not the best either.

My cats generally love all toys made by Fat Cat.  I don't know if it's the catnip within or the vast array of colors, shapes, sizes and crinkly noises that attracts them.  All I know is that I'd never purchased a Fat Cat toy my cats didn't like.  Until this one, that is.I thought it would be perfect for interactive play, and if I had kittens, I probably would've been right.  They'll play with just about anything though.  Problem is, the glove itself is just plain awkward (very much in the style of Freddy Krueger), primarily because the fingers are twice as long as human fingers and you can't achieve much separation between them.  Oddly enough, all of my cats seemed to view having four toys simultaneously shoved in their face as an invasion of their personal space rather than an invitation to play.The good news is that after I removed the lures from the glove (which seemed to be well constructed and durable), they played with them on their own.  The bad news is that I paid far too much for those four tiny toys.

column9: A smooth and robust breakfast tea
column10: I must admit to being a bit of a tea connoisseur.  I tend to like fragrant teas but I like a base of robustness to stand up to milk.  I have drunk the Yorkshire Gold tea in bags at the office, and I thought I'd try this as a base for mixing with my other teas.  I have to say that it is not as smooth and tasty as the Taylors of Harrogate Kwazulu, which Amazon also carries, but it certainly does the job of an above average black breakfast tea.  It's also fine alone but would do best in the English style cup with milk.

column9: One of the best breakfast teas
column10: Yorkshire Gold is one of my favorite breakfast teas.  I like my tea strong, so I use two heaping measuring teaspoons for a 12 ounce tea pot.  After preheating the pot with boiling water for one minute, I empty the pot, add the tea, fill of the pot with boiling water and let the tea steep for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile I nuke a little milk in the microwave in my mug.  I then add the tea to my mug, together with a packet of Splenda.  The result is an excellent mug of breakfast tea, malty and rich tasting.  It may not be as refined in flavor as teas one can buy from a specialty tea website, but it's great for the price.

Great breakfast tea, not as strong as some of the Twinings breakfast, but not as bitter, either.  Seems to make good tea at lower water temperatures compared to other black teas, which is good for me since the hot water tap on the office water cooler is not very hot.  Very economical in the large bags of loose leaf. I use a Swiss Gold infuser which does a good job on the fine cut teas like this one.

column9: Best Morning Tea and Iced Tea!
column10: This is a wonderful full-bodied tea, perfect for your morning cup. I can't start my day without it. It also makes outstanding, very flavorful iced tea. (I use 7 tsp for a half gallon pitcher of iced tea.) It is finely cut, so a tea ball won't work well with it, but a good brew basket will keep even these fine leaves out of your cup. column4: Bea Knight Johnson "bea knight-johnson, tea m...
column10: As a  black tea aficianado, I have tried them all, esp. in my efforts to find a tea for all time or one that I will return to again and again.  As fate would have it,I  stumbled upon Taylors and Harrogate Yorkshire Gold Tea while browsing in an English import shop. I bought a bag and loved it from my very first cup.  Although it's not organic which would give it 6 stars in my evaluation, it's deep in flavor and smooth and has become my everyday tea.  As cabernet is to red wine, as dark French roast is to coffee, as 70% chocolate is to chocolate, Yorkshire Gold is to tea.

If you like your tea strong, full of flavor with a clean fresh taste this is for you. You will never turn back to weak Tea. In the UK we are advised to drink 4 cups of tea a day for optimum health & happiness.Yes, my husband is a very Healthy happy man!

So much so that when I got to the bottom of the box, I horded the last tea bag because I didn't want to use it all up. After doing a search for this tea on the net, I was super pleased to find that Amazon carried it because my local grocery stores (and I checked all of them) didn't. column9: WOW!  Biggest little fish ever!  Healthy Breakfast in a Can!
column10: I've started eating a can of these for breakfast on many days.  There are typically only three per can because they are so plump, but the can is still packed full, and they have a distinctively mild taste when compared to other canned sardines I've had.  Sure, they smell fishy, but it's not the "slap in the face with a cold fish" kind of fishy.  In fact, dare I say they taste almost...uh...fresh?Well, almost, but these are the best canned sardines I've ever had.  Hurray for Spain!

column9: A great, simple meal in a tiny can
column10: OK, I know some people will find it hard to get excited about tinned sardines.  But these are excellent quality and well priced, fat and fresh, usually just three or four beheaded fish per tin.  If you occasionally get an uncontrollable urge for sardines in virgin olive oil, as I do, these will do it for you.  I plate them in their own oil, sprinkle them with minced meyer lemon zest or some brine-preserved lemon, piment d'Espelette, a teaspoon or so of aged sherry vinegar, a generous pinch of fleur de sel and some snipped Italian parsley and chives.  Toast and butter slices of baguette and put them in a basket on the side.  Slice up an apple, grab some Picholine olives, pour a glass of chilled Muscadet, and you have a really tasty and very healthy meal (mega omega-3 in them thar sardines!) in under ten minutes.  Now I'm hungry!
These are outstanding. I have made them a regular part of my diet; delicious and healthful.

column9: What a canned sardine should be !
column10: I've tried every locally available sardine I can get my hands on.  Most are OK, a few are "good".  Then there are Matiz Gallego sardines.  Just outstanding.  No matter how many cans I order, I never order enough.  Wonderful sardines and I'm thankful Amazon makes them available.
These are large sardines packed 3 to a can. The flesh is a little firmer than regular supermarket sardines. Will buy again, definitely.

My wife has been to Spain numerous times and has always returned with informationabout food she has eaten while there, especially the "tapas." Aside from the smallPadron pappers (which I now grow), her comments about the Matiz Gallego sardinesmade me eager to try them. I searched the web and finally decided on Amazon to buythem, considering price and availability. This was well over a year ago, and havebeen getting them ever since. I love sardines and these are the best I have evereaten; large pieces packed in olive oil, absolutely delicious , particularly withfresh lemon juice over them and then mopping up the oil and juice with some greatbread. A must for sardine lovers!!!

column9: Very Good But Pricey and Scales

I also enjoy this flavor.PROS:- Made with a bunch of organic ingredients- Nothing artificial- Can taste the macadamia nut pieces- Soft- Fills me up and keeps me going when I cannot eat a real meal- Has a nice overall flavor, moderately sweet, mildly nutty.CONS:- Could use some more white chocolate- Makes me thirsty, must have a beverage with itOVERALL:This is a pretty good flavor.  The macadamia nuts help deviate from the regular nut flavors typically found in this kind of food, like peanut and almond.  It could stand to use some more white chocolate, though, as that flavor isn't very prevalent.

column9: Delicious, chewy, white-chocolate, organic meal bar
column10: This meal bar doesn't have as much protein as a Zone or Atkins meal bar, but the ingredients are organic, and it has no artificial sweeteners, which the meal bars which are highest in protein all seem to have. Each bar has 42 grams of carbs (4 grams of which is fiber), 7 grams of fat, and 9 grams of protein. It is sweetened with brown rice syrup, barley malt, and evaporated cane juice--which a great improvement over the corn syrup used by many other meal bars. The protein is from soy flour and roasted soybeans.This bar is relatively small and condensed providing perhaps 12 small bites or six large bites, but it is very filling. I carry one in my purse at all times, because you never know when you might need a healthy, emergency snack.The texture of all Clif bars is smooth and chewy, and most taste really good. They are not as sweet as candy or a bakery cookie, but definitely sweet enough to taste like a treat. There are many delicious flavors of Clif bars, but this one is my favorite. I am a big fan of both white chocolate and macadamia nuts.

column9: worked nicely,  but not when paired with the same brand shampoo
column10: I like having 3-4 different shampoo and conditioners on the go,  so when I was offered this on Amazon vine,  even though I didn't know the brand,  I thought,  what the hey,  and ordered it.  I received a shampoo and conditioner that were the same brand but not identical titles. It's a winner.It also has a pleasant scent.The downside is the upside down tube. It's a little bit weird and the contents are difficult to squeeze out. Most of the time I wear my hair back so that it's important that I'm not flaking all over my clothes.This stuff is thick.  Be careful when you squeeze it out of the tube because it has the consistency of yogurt.  That does make it a little difficult to spread around, so you need to rub it in your hands first then put it on strategic spots and then rub it into your hair.  A little extra water when your rubbing your hair (especially if its long) will help.  If not just use it on the crown of your head and a conditioning shampoo after.  It does have its' own conditioner so you can just was it out and leave your hair easy to comb.I didn't do anything unusual like washing my hair twice, and when I finished not only was my hair clean and tangle free but the skin under my beard was totally free of dry skin. I had great feeling hair after using this product. The container was a bit different with the opening on the bottom. But I liked it.

column9: Seems like a good product, nothing particularly unique
column10: I liked the smell and feel of the product, and it was nicely conditioning.  I did not notice any particular scalp benefits (I use another product, Neutrogena T Gel shampoo, that I feel as if makes my scalp feel less itchy), but otherwise had no complaints about it.  Decent product.
I love this conditioner it works great, it smells great. My hair feels soft but not heavy. I like how the bottle is made with the shampoo being opposite of the conditioner.

column9: Product Did Not Work For Me
column10: I think it would be unfair to try to draw conclusions about a hair care product based upon how it works on one person. I tried the product once. Followed the directions. Found it was not as good as my present hair shampoo/conditioner. In my case (one cannot generalize from this experience), all I can say is that my hair obtained more body but at the expense of being more difficult to dry and style. Two days later and I had an annoying scalp itch and the beginning of a scalp condition. Took two times shampooing with my present product to clear up the itching and some dandruff like developments.  I do not think I will try any more hair care products under the Vine Program. Better to stick to books.

column9: Feels different than other conditioners.  Rinses clean.
column10: This conditioner feels different to me than other conditioners.  Let me explain:Cheap conditioners go on slick but rinse off completely and my hair is left a tangled mess.Expensive conditioners (like tresemme or Loreal or Pantene) go on slick and leave a certain amount of slickness in and my hair is way more manageable, but you always wonder about the residue left behind.This conditioner doesn't really go on so slickly, and it washes away completely... and my hair is left somewhere in between the two other examples... not quite so tangled but not totally tangle free.  I have to add detangler when the shower is complete.  (I have very long, fine, curly/wavy hair.)The packaging would seem to indicate this product is more for a scalp treatment and not focused as much on the hair though.  But the conditioner has a nice feel to it and a nice light scent.I still think although I like the no residue feeling that I am so "conditioned" pardon the pun to like the slick feeling and no tangles that that is what my preference is even though I don't like the residue in my hair.  It's hard to break old habits.EDIT - I am now down to the last 1/3 of the bottle and I am having difficulty getting the product out.  This is a design flaw of the bottle I think.  The bottle is really thick and hard to squeeze it.  There isn't a good way to take the cap off either.I should note that I also got a bottle of shampoo from the same manufacturer and although this bottle of conditioner did NOT leak in transport - the shampoo did leak.  Something to note if that is a concern.  The leak was not much but it was a hassle to clean up.

I'm working on the greying, sexy librarian look and so have grown my hair to be longish.  I don't color or perm it or anything else like that --though my mother and sister say that's a mistake-- but I also don't need to.  During the summer my hair is crazy wild with nothing but humidity to urge it on.  (And I'm telling you this so you have an idea of exactly what I'm conditioning.)I used the Moisturizing Dry Scalp Shampoo that is the conditioner's partner and then the conditioner itself.  It went on more or less like Pantene conditioners.  It was thick and pearly.  I thought I might have had to rinse a little longer than normal to get it out... BUT I'm very pleased with the results.  I mean, I my hair looks great.  My librarian-wannabe locks are shiny and defrizzed and have stayed that way even after trips outside.This conditioner might be too heavy for winter, we'll have to see, but it's now my summer favorite.Pam Tmother and owner of a combo of Spanish/German hair.  Fine and flat during the Winter.  Frizzy and wild during the Summer.  Some of us are just blessed that way.

column9: Not so great for daily use.
column10: I have thick, overly processed colored dry hair.  I am very choosy when it comes to hair products.  I make sure not to use products that contains ingredients that will strip my hair of color or make it limp, lifeless and especially strip it of it's natural moisturizers.  Hair coloring can leave your scalp dry and itchy and  I normally do not wash my hair everyday since that can also strip your hair of natural oils.  I really liked the fragrance of CLEAR SCALP & BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Conditioner.  Once applied it lathered nicely was saturated my hair.  Rinsed off easily with no residue and left my hair soft, and shiny.  After just one use my scalp did not itch as much, it was not 100% itch free but not it was not as intense like it normally is.Water and cetearyl alcohol are the first ingredients listed. Cetearyl alcohol s a mixture of cetyl and stearyl alcohols that can come from vegetable or synthetic sources. They to eliminate the dryness that can occur in hair that has been styled with a lot of chemicals or with heat producing hair tools.  However, it does contain sulfate and sodium chloride which is good for hair loss but can dry, dull or strip hair color quicker.This is a good anti-itch conditioner to use in between my normal conditioner.  I will probably use it once every 8 to 10 days and especially after having my hair colored, but not after every shampoo since I worry that some of the ingredients may dull or strip my hair color if used to often.

column9: Irritates my scalp/skin, way too many chemicals
column10: Something in this irritates my scalp and skin, giving it a tingling/burning sensation.  I looked at the ingredients and it's a bunch of chemicals and dyes that I don't know whether they are safe or not (A Google search listed several of them as harmful, irritating or toxic)...and I won't continue using it.  It also burns your eyes if you happen to get any in while rinsing.Here are just some of the ingredients: cyclopentasiloxane, stearamidopropyl dimethylamine, methylisothiazolinone, methylchloroisothiazolinone and the list goes on of all these chemical sounding ingredients.

column9: It's OK, my head doesn't itch as much
column10: I've been using this for about a week along with the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce. I have dry, color-treated blonde hair. My head has been itching less using these products. Other than this, I can't tell much difference in the way my hair looks or behaves. One positive so far is it doesn't appear to strip my hair color. On the downside, the scent of these products is way too strong.

I usually do not have an itchy, dry scalp in the spring or summer (winter is another matter altogether). But due to a recent medical issue and the medication I received, my scalp has been very dry, itchy, and flaky for the past couple of months. So, I decided to give CLEAR SCALP & HAIR THERAPY MOISTURIZING DRY SCALP NOURISHING CONDITIONER a try, along with the shampoo of the same name. And I am pleased to say, that after just 7 days, the itching and the dryness have vanished. YAY!CLEAR SCALP & HAIR THERAPY MOISTURIZING DRY SCALP NOURISHING CONDITIONER is extremely thick and creamy (almost like body lotion), with a pleasant light scent. Just a quarter-sized amount thoroughly coats your hair and soothes your scalp and then rinses away completely, leaving no residue. CLEAR SCALP & HAIR THERAPY MOISTURIZING DRY SCALP NOURISHING CONDITIONER moisturizes your hair and scalp, getting rid of flakes, fly-aways, and tangles. Your hair is left shiny and bouncy, not weighted down or greasy. For me, personally, my hair (which I color about once every 2 months) looks better than it has in a long time. WITH that added benefit of no itching. And, I have also noticed that if I just let my hair dry naturally (no blow dryer) that my hair has more volume. Again...YAY!Overall, I am very please with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR THERAPY MOISTURIZING DRY SCALP NOURISHING CONDITIONER, and would recommend it to anyone who has a problem with dry hair and itchy scalp.

column4: Jean  Yates "jean, jewelry designer, book and...
column9: Not a Dry Scalp in the House
column10: I wanted to try as many of the Clean Scalp & Hair Beauty products as possible, and this was the first conditioner I tried. I have raved about the shampoo. Here, we all like it, but this conditioner is way too drying! How odd!I cannot imagine why the company named it Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Conditioner.It was terrible at doing its job--which would be to moisturize and condition ... unless I messed up, and don't HAVE a dry enough scalp, and therefore shouldn't have been using this product in the first place.I would have given it two stars but I am still puzzled by the name DRY SCALP. Maybe it is my fault!By the way, all three products from this company arrived leaking. Even the last one to arrive, which came packaged differently (in a more protective hard box) was leaking, and the top was popped open. I have never had this experience with any other shipped product from Amazon.The company who makes these products needs to go back to the drawing board on the design of the bottle.

This product was tested, directly after using 'CLEAR SCALP ANTI-DANDRUFF SHAMPOO.' The results were very pleasing. Many Conditioners on the market leave hair oily and greasy, this product doesn't. After a few days of using this product, hair is still clean and conditioned well, without that greasy wet look. Highly Recommended for all those with dry scalp problems, caused by skin conditions or extreme heat conditions. I would continue using this product.

Well, I bought this conditioner to go with the matching shampoo and I couldn't be more pleased.  I usually wash my hair every day.  Yeah, I know that may be a lot, but if I am going out then washing my hair is a must to get it to do what I want it to do.  I have dry scalp so I thought this shampoo and conditioner would help and it is brand new too.  I like trying new things!  This conditioner does a great job and leaves my hair silky smooth.  No tangles and it is not greasy.  It doesn't weigh my hair down like other conditioners that I have tried.  I would buy this again!

column9: Not the Best Choice for Me
column10: I ordered a bunch of different products in this line to make a comparison between them.I think I was exposed to too much of whatever is now making me itch and break out all over. It started with my arms after washing and conditioning my daughter's hair in the sink (I had already washed and conditioned my own hair with different products from the line)...I noticed red spots along my arms, small bumps and itching. The kids saw red on my neck (which usually happens when I am allergic to something), but then it disappeared within an hour of first seeing it.For the last several years, my previous shampoos and conditioners were mostly PH balanced and all natural.These CLEAR beauty products have a "common thread" between the shampoos/conditioners, despite have slightly different smells...They are most abundant in ingredients that may initially detangle, but are drying and irritating on my hair and skin with accumulated usage/exposure. It is now clear that these products are not good for me to continue using.*Not the outcome I had hoped, but found a "silver lining:"When scalp became extremely dry as a result, with dandruff "raining down" to the touch, I did an internet search. I found that VINEGAR is an excellent conditioner. I used 1/2 vinegar/water-amazing results! My scalp calmed down and my hair seems to have recovered-now soft to the touch instead of brittle.

I like the Clear Scalp because it actually manages to give a bit of the old feel back, without making my hair feel greasy as if I've left conditioner in it. I've used this for about a week now, and really like how it makes my hair look and feel. Definately worth a try if your trying to avoid that brillo pad head of grey hair like me.I used to have to worry about greasy, oily hair back in the day. I searched out shampoos that would dry out the scalp and leave my hair less oily. Well a handful of years ago I started to go grey, and when I went grey, I skipped right over the "salt & pepper" look and jumped from a dark brown to Bob Barker in what seemed almost overnight.Now, I didn't mind losing my hair color at a young age...at least I still had a full head of hair which is more than I can say for several friends, but what I hated was that the grey hair was of such a different texture and feel from my regular hair. It was coarse, dry and wiry. Suddenly shampoos like Head and Shoulders and Pert we too harsh, and my scalp felt brittle.

The Clear Scalp moisturizing dry scalp conditioner is wonderful. I have a very dry scalp during the summer and the nourishing conditioner moisturized my scalp and made my dry scalp within days of starting to use it. I would highly recommend this product to anyone with dry scalp.

column9: Very rich conditioner, works well with matching shampoo
column10: I have used this conditioner along with it's matching shampoo for a while now and using the two of them together really makes a difference with my dry and itchy scalp. The shampoo is thin but super rich and I really notice the added moisture to my scalp. The shampoo feels like it has conditioner in it as well. I usually wash my hair twice with the shampoo and then I use the super thick and rich conditioner and leave in on my hair for about a minute and then rinse. My hair is left very healthy, smooth and rich with moisture. Both the shampoo and conditioner have a nice scent. I have tried a variety of different Clear Scalp shampoo and conditioners but this set is one of my favorites.

column9: Just ok for my hair type
column10: My main problem with this line of products is how thick both shampoos and conditioners are, to the extent that it's hard to squeeze them out of the bottle. As for other qualities, it's just ok for my hair. This conditioner just doesn't detangle my hair, which is supposed to be one of the primary purposes of a conditioner.

In the interests of full disclosure, I received this item through Amazon Vine. However, I try extremely hard to write my reviews as if I had paid the full purchase price, for I think this is only fair for those who read and rely on reviews.I really enjoyed this conditioner. It made my long (and somewhat dry) hair really soft and manageable. Over the years I have used a variety of products - from drugstore brands to high-end salon brands - and I think this is equivalent to even the most pricy products.  It smells *amazing* and I plan on buying a bottle when mine runs out.Highly recommended.

While my MIL was visiting this awesome conditioner came in the mail for me to try out. She snatched it up before I even had a chance to try it.  She just ranted and raved about it and it ended up on the flight back with her!  Her hair was a thinner lightly permed white (she's in her 70's) and she loved the way it made her hair silky smooth without weighing it down.So I tried it as well and I also loved it. I have waist long medium/thick blonde hair that is straight and gets greasy really quick, but also has a tendency to be dry initially both on ends and scalp (and fly-aways are popular in my head of hair!).  So I loved how the conditioner eliminated all my fly aways and made my hair more attractive overall... plus conditioned my scalp so it did not get as greasy right away. I would give it a glowing 5 stars for that.  But the one thing I was wishing for is that it would be a deeper conditioning for my ends, which still seemed like they needed more.  So I ended up blending it with my other favorite conditioner: Pantene Long Lengths Replenishing Hair Mask.  I use the mask on the ends and halfway up, and I use this clear scalp conditioner all over.  Now my hair is perfectly smooth, light and moisturized. PERFECT!Also, I tried a couple different CLEAR SCALP types of conditioners and they just didn't work the same way as this one... so I would highly recommend trying this one if you are going to try any of them to control for dry or fly-away hair!

I coupled this with the matching shampoo and loved the results.  I don't have the money for the high priced salon hair care products so I'm always on the look out for something affordable that works magic on my hair. I have to admit that I wasn't expecting much from these products but I was pleasantly surprised.  Not only do I love how this feels while using it, it leaves my hair feeling soft and shiny.  What I love the most is how it makes my hair smell, and the compliments I have received on how great my hair smells.  Who can deny that compliments are nice?I have found this available at my local grocery store for about the same price as a comparable size pantene or herbal essences. And to be honest I have like this shampoo and conditioner set enough to continue purchasing it after my trial bottle ran out.  I intend to continue using this product until I find something I like even more.

I recieved some sample packets of this product and the matching shampoo in the mail.  I was extremely impressed.My hair gets baked and beaten almost on a daily basis since I swim outside every day in the tropical sun.  Often I swim in the ocean.  What a tangled mess it can become.  There are times when no brush or comb will begin to go through it.I used this conditioner as I showered outdoors after coming out of the pool.  My hair immediately smoothed, softened and turned to silk, and a comb could glide through it no problems.When my hair dried it was full, and shine with tons of body.  I was amazed.  They have a great product here.  I plan to get a bottle of this to take to the pool and beach with me, and coat my dry hair with it before I enter the water, to protect it from damage, as my stylist recommended.  This is a fantastic conditioner.

I've been using Nexxus in my hair for quite some time now so I may be biased. This does the same thing as almost any conditioner that I've tried. Although it did not leave any greasy residue and did not dry out my hair, it did not leave me thinking that it was such a great product that I wanted to buy and use it again. It does have a very nice smell to it. Not overpowering at all. If you want something cheap that conditions then I definitely recommend this.

I don't really have issues with a dry scalp, but did use this conditioner. It was a little too heavy for me to use all the time. I did have my two swimmers use the conditioner and it worked for them. Their scalps can get dry from so much swimming and showering. This is definitely a conditioner that I would suggest.

column9: Good product; nice smell, seems to work well
column10: This product is very good. It has a nice smell and it seems to work well. I like the consistency too...somewhere between normal consistency and glue (and I mean that in a good way). It's not as runny as most shampoo/conditioner, and it feels like it's actually got some substance to it. Recommended.

I found this conditioner to be really thick (much like their shampoos) so I felt like I could get away with using less. It seemed to work fine. I put some on my palm, rubbed it in while in the shower and waited a few minutes. It rinsed clean and fairly easily, no left over residue, and left my hair smelling very fresh. I didn't see much difference in the way my hair acted in humid weather and such, because my hair has a mind of its own and can only be tamed by Treseme Mousse. Other hair products are child's play for my locks, which just laugh at my feeble attempts to break their spirit. And since my mane is very curly and thick, your millage may vary.

column9: It's okay, just not my favorite
column10: It has a light scent, it washes out well, and leaves my hair feeling soft.  I didn't notice if it made a difference on my scalp, but it didn't dry it out either.  The consistency is creamy, not oily, and it doesn't seem to weigh my hair down.  This stuff seems to hurt more if it gets near my eyes, then other conditioners do.  I like it, but I won't order it again.  It lived up to its promises, but I just wasn't thrilled over it.  I will stick to my regular shampoo and conditioner.

This is a good conditioner.  It didn't leave my hair feeling greasy, which some conditioners do, even after rinsing them out.  Most importantly for me, it did not leave a scent in my hair, and the smell during use was extremely mild.Another nice aspect of this product is the container.  It has a completely flat bottom, so it rests easily in a shower caddy or on the corner of the tub.  The conditioner is dispensed from the bottom of the container, which means you don't have to shake it or leave it upside down to get some out.There is not anything amazing about this conditioner, but it is a good product that I would use again.

I have hip length, very straight, very fine, medium thick hair. It's normal, but damages easily, especially near the tips.Using this with the matching shampoo works very well on my hair. My hair is sleek, soft and shiny. I've noticed using this line that there is actually less breakage and splits in my ends.I've been going through shampoo and non-shampoo methods for years, trying to find the best combination for my hair. This is the best choice so far for commercial shampoos, doing even better than the more expensive ones I've tried.It might be too conditioning for people who want body and fullness, leaving their hair limp.

column9: If anything, a little too lightweight
column10: I keep my hair very short, and this conditioner was so light that, if anything, it made my hair a bit too fluffy.
