A very smooth, soft, nice-to-run-my-fingers-through sort of fluffy, but still fluffier than i'm used to.Using this with the matching shampoo, i did experience a reduction in dry scalp symptoms, so it seems to deliver on the 'dry scalp nourishing' promise.My two problems with this conditioner are both pretty trivial.1) The conditioner comes in smaller bottles than the shampoo. No woman i've ever known goes through conditioner more slowly than shampoo, so having the conditioner come in a smaller bottle is a little strange.2) The smell. It's generic perfume-y, and awfully sweet. But it doesn't last after my hair dries, so it only troubles me in the shower.

I deal with dry scalp from time to time and have been impressed by the fancy deep treatment conditioners out there. However, as far as great bargains go, this is a winner.  The product smells wonderful and is effective in moisturizing both scalp and tips. The price is right, nice and inexpensive.  I love how my hair feels after this.

My scalp gets dry because I shampoo a lot and this product really helps to reverse the damage.  It feels like it goes deep and lasts a long time.  My hair feels all around healthier after only just a few uses.  It smells great too!

This is a really nice conditioner.  It does appear to add some nice soft shine to your hair without making it look greasy or coated.  I always find with a conditioner that they either produce buildup, which weights down or can actually "flatten" the appearance of your hair, or they tend to be very greasy.This conditioner does neither.  It rinses out easily, so your hair doesn't feel coated, and it leaves your hair looking "healthy" with a soft sheen.It also feels like tangles are easy to comb out on longer hair.As far as how it feels on your scalp, I do notice my scalp doesn't feel dry or itchy, something that I do sometimes feel in weather extremes, like the summer heat and sun, lot so swimming in chlorinated pools, the ocean, etc.Ingredients are typical of a conditioner.  The product is not "store brand" cheap in price, but nor is it "salon expensive."  It's fairly inexpensive, especially considering it yields top quality results.So for the price and results I would give this product a try!

I'm someone who normally uses the cheapest shampoo and conditioner I can get because my mindset was any worked just as well. I may be changing my tune after using this. After only a few days using this nourishing shampoo and conditioner together I found that I was running my fingers through my hair. That's not a normal thing for me to do because I swim a lot and usually my hair feels like straw. Not so using this combination! The conditioner is thick and rinses out pretty well; although my hair still feels a little slippery after rinsing.I still find myself running my fingers through my hair; definitely a winner for me! :-) I would suggest trying the shampoo and conditioner together. I definitely recommend this highly if you want soft silky hair like mine now feels! :-)

column9: Nice conditioner, Won't help scalp itch by itself
column10: If you use this conditioner, buy the shampoo to go along with it. This is a nice conditioner, it rinses clean, has a pleasant scent that is not overwhelming and leaves hair soft and detangled. It does nothing for frizz and it does not relieve itchy scalp by itself. Itchy scalp will go away after a few days if you use the CLEAR SCALP AND HAIR BEAUTY Shampoo with it.

I love this new line of hair care products from Clear Scalp. The Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Conditioner goes perfect with the Clear Scalp Shampoo that I am currently using. This conditioner smells great and my hair feels extremely soft and healthy. I love the shape of the bottle which makes it easier to store if you need the space. I know that this is nourishing my scalp but you surely will see the difference in your hair within a week because my hair already feels quite voluminous in just this short period of time.I also use the Clear Scalp &Hair Beauty Therapy Ultra Shea Intense Scalp Nourishing Balm to help provide my scalp with moisture as well as nourishment. I am in love with this conditioner and will definitely continue to use this in my hair. I like that I can maintain a healthy head of hair without spending a ton of money.

This conditioner is very thick and rich. It smells really good and rinses easily. The moisturizing and detangling ability is fair at best, though. I would have liked to see better performance in those areas. I don't think it should be called a "moisturizing" conditioner - at least not in my case.Usually with a moisturizing conditioner, I see better results. I had to use ALOT of this conditioner at a time, and use a leave-in conditioner afterwards. With my normal shampoo & conditioner, I only use the leave-in once or twice a week at most, but with this I had to use the leave-in everyday.I used this along with the matching shampoo and saw no improvement with dry scalp issues. Now, I do not have full blown dandruff or severe dryness either... just a little dryness and itch at times.My hair is long, to my waist and very wavy/curly. It is a little dry, but not severely and not damaged. This pair may work better for someone with a different hair texture and quality, perhaps, but I wouldn't recommend it for someone with hair like mine, based on my experience with it.

I liked the way this conditioner made my hair feel but I'm not sure if it did much for my scalp. At the price of the conditioner, it's certainly a value for what you're getting. But if you want a good scalp nourisher, you might want to explore another route.I've used this conditioner around the same time as two other Clear Scalp & Hair products. Maybe it's because I'm not an expert, but I didn't see much of a difference between the three. They are great values though.If your scalp is dry to the point that you might want to seek a more effective solution. I doubt this product will cure your problems. That doesn't detract from it completely though, it's still a nice conditioner.

column9: Smells nice, works well in the shower to detangle.
column10: I used this in conjunction with the Clear Scalp Shampoo.It might seem ridiculous to have some dandruff as well as oily hair. My hair gets oily in about 3 days. I try to not wash more than every 3, to not dry out my hair on the ends. This means I do get some dandruff.I loved the scent and design of the bottle. It was smooth and thick, which I like in conditioner. I need it because while I have thick hair, the individual hairs are very fine and when not using conditioner, I have awful tangles and flyaway hair. The shampoo alone did a nice job, but it left my hair a little lacking after rinsing. If I hadn't had a conditioner, I sure would have needed one. I used it mainly on the ends, trying to avoid my scalp.After air drying, my hair was shiny and silky. However in a day, I noticed more oil than normal on my scalp and hair near my roots. In 2 days, I found myself needing to wash my hair, when typically I can do another day. So while it might have made my hair feel good immediately after the wash and condition, it wasn't a good fit for me on a regular basis.I am now trying to use it without the shampoo to see if this makes any difference.

column9: Didn't seem too much different to me
column10: I'm not a hair expert, but I do have medium length hair, and use conditioner a couple times a week.  This conditioner seemed to do the same thing as all the other conditioners I've tried.  Nothing to help it stand out above the crowd, but also, nothing terrible about it.  I can't attest to the scalp nourishing factor, besides the fact that I rarely have dandruff, and didn't get it while using this product.

This gets the job done, when it comes to dandruff/dry scalp I have always kept a Head & Shoulders on standby. This works just as well so far however my scalp issues are mild so not sure how it hold up against reallly bad scalp problems. I also use a different conditioner-in addition to this one in the end for improved scent and feel, as well as other benefits it does not have a strong medicinal smell it's just not a scent I preferr. I would recommend this item.

I've been using the Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty line for awhile now, specifically the Shea Ultra Nourishing shampoo & conditioner.  I love it. I recieved this conditioner last week and I'm equally impressed.I have really long, naturally pin straight, relatively thick hair.  It has never been dyed or treated in any way.  I shampoo & condition daily despite being told "its not good" well, I've done it all my life and I still get complimented on how healthy my hair is, so...This conditioner smells wonderful.  Floral and fresh were my initial thoughts. It felt thick, easily coated my hair with just a dime sized amount and rinsed out cleanly.Afterwards my hair felt soft, nourished and smelled fantastic.Maybe I'm just easy to please, but this new line of shampoo & conditioners has me hooked!

I don't have a huge problem with a dry scalp, but my hair itself is very dry so I thought I would try this out. It didn't really do anything for me. It works fine for normal cleaning, but because I have such thick, dry, frizzy hair, I didn't see any great improvements and would not use this over my regular hair care products (Aussie). I wasn't too fond of the scent either, but it wasn't very strong to me so it was bearable.

The Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty conditioner sells itself as a moisturizer for dry scalps.  My scalp is usually dry, so it seemed like a good product to try.  I am not really sure if it has helped at all with my scalp, but my hair does feel nice after I use this conditioner.  It also smells pleasant, but not remarkably so.

column4: B. McCarthy "Engineer, CERT, Amateur Radio Op...
column10: How much can I say about a hair conditioner?  I buy really expensive stuff at my salon which is better, but it's like 5 times the price.  Of course, a bottle lasts months, so it's worth it.  But I tried this and it was pretty darn close.  So 5 stars all around!

We chose to try out the Clear Scalp & Hair conditioner to see if it's all it claims to be. Both my wife and I have used it, and I would have to say it's lived up to expectations. The conditioner is not as thick as the Clear Scalp & Hair shampoo that they recommend using with it for best results. We've found that the conditioner lathers up well and leaves our hair feeling smooth and refreshed. It has a pleasant smell which isn't overpowering, so both men and women alike should be able to use it with no problems or hesitation. Overall, using this over the past couple weeks in combination with the Clear Scalp & Hair shampoo, we've been mostly happy with the results. Definitely a worthwhile product to try and see if it's right for you.

column4: Y. R. Wu "The will to win is nothing without ...
column9: Excellent conditioner for fine hair...detangles fairly well...
column10: I'm the one with a dry scalp but my hair is rather coarse so conditioner isn't as much of an issue.  On the other hand our 3 daughters (4/6/9 years old) all have long fine hair.  This summer has been harsh - pool chlorine and lot of sun and sunscreen means really nasty dry hair that's even crunchy when wet and tangles like the dickens.This stuff works well to restore the oils stripped out without leaving too much residue.  We try not to rinse it out too much so there's still some detangling to it.Four stars - I think that Paul Mitchell The Detangler, Super Rich Conditioner, 10.14-ounce is better for conditioning and detangling.  If you really need some hard core detangling I'd recommend  Garnier Conditioner, Sleek and Shine, 13 Fluid Ounce. but it does leave more oil in as residue - that's what gives it the shine.  Too much and it can leave hair a little flat.If you have any questions, comments, or if you found this review helpful, please let me know!

I have dry, damaged and color treated long hair.I always have to use a conditioner otherwise there is no way I will be able to get a brush thru my hair.I normally have to buy thicker conditioner for it to work.I used this along with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid OunceIt is not too thick and not too thin.Smells nice and my hair looks and feels soft.My scalp sometimes gets itchy in the heat but this along with the shampoo I am sure has helped with that a lot.Really like this product and its a great price!

column9: A good choice for thick hair
column10: I have thick hair which was recently cut from very long to shoulder length. Prior to the haircut, I always needed to use a super thick conditioner to keep control over it, because in addition to being long and thick, I also color it every 6 weeks. After getting my hair cut, I didn't need quite as thick of a conditioner (think like a jar of body butter lotion). But very light weight conditioners (like Suave) would make my hair a tangled mess. This Clear Scalp conditioner is a great middle ground. It's slightly thicker formula works well on my thick hair to control it, but it's not a deep conditioner like I used to use that would now just weight my hair down. I would suggest this for people with medium hair, thick hair, colored hair and graying hair. Anyone with very fine hair my find this formula weighs their hair down more than they would like. The only real issue I have with it is that the bottles of shampoo and conditioner don't always ship well. I ordered 4 bottles of Clear Scalp shampoo/conditioner, and 2 our of the 4 bottles had leaked some in transit. The bottles are packaged in plastic bags to help in case they so leak, but when it came to my orders, 50% of them were leaking in some way upon arrival. So it's possible there is something about the bottles design that causes them to be more likely to leak than others.

This conditioner has a mild scent and has the consistency of hand lotion. It applied easily and washed out without a problem. Overall I am pleased with it. But I can't say that about the bottling.The flip-spout is located on the bottom of the bottle. So it will either leak over time or get an accumulation from use and piddle on whatever counter you store it on. I realize that the idea was to be able to avoid shaking it like a catsup bottle. Additionally, since their shampoo bottle has the flip-spout on the top, this helps to avoid grabbing the wrong bottle. But it is a problem you likely will have to deal with.

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column9: Smells great, works okay, great price
column10: This is at a great price point. I do think that using it long term is the key. At first blush, it smells heavenly. All of their products do! I don't enjoy conditioners that smell like flowers or fruit per se, I like the ones that smell like good salon products. This conditioner fits the bill there! Plus, at just $5 it's a great price point for all those good ingredients. I will say that my hair felt good at first rinse, not goopy or like I had to turn up the heat to get this out of my hair. It was a few hours later when I decided that it did, however, leave a slight film on my hair and that my hair just wasn't as soft as it is when I use my favorite conditioner.

I've been using the moisturizing version of Clairol's Herbal Essence conditioner (the one that comes in the blue bottle) for years now.  When I saw this conditioner, it sounded relatively comparable, so I thought I'd check it out.  I've been using it for the week it supposedly takes to give me stronger, more beautiful hair, but I haven't noticed any difference.I have fairly short, thick, dry hair that curls just enough to be nearly unmanageable if I let it grow too long.  As long as my hair is really short, I usually just shampoo and condition, and then comb my hair lightly into place and it works.  As my hair gets a bit longer I often use a mousse or leave-in conditioner as my hair is still rather dry even with the moisturizing products.  This product has been working pretty much the same way.  My hair is just on the cusp of getting too long, and if I just shampoo and condition, this product leaves my hair a bit flighty.This product looks, feels and works much like Herbal Essence, except that it's white in color rather than blue.  It has a thick, rich feel to it.  The product rinses nicely from my hair, leaving it noticeably softer.  It has a decent, mild, floral scent.  Despite the claim that it helps dry scalp, I have not noticed any change in this product from Herbal Essence, either during the conditioning process or afterwards.This product comes in a bottle that has a wide, flat base that doubles as product dispenser.  Personally I would prefer a container that could be stood on either end.  It is helpful to store the product on its cap as it's getting low, but when the bottle is full, storing it on its cap tends to produce a rush of product when the valve is opened, which results in much more product than I need, and there's no way to return the excess to the bottle.Overall I think this is a good product, but not necessarily better or worse than Herbal Essences.  Whether or not I would buy this in the future will depend solely on pricing - I would buy whichever one is cheaper

The Clear brand dandruff shampoos seem to be everywhere now. They use pyrithione zinc to control dandruff, similar to other brands, but cost a bit more in my experience. How does this accompanying Dry Scalp conditioner hold up?FRAGRANCESimilar to cheap children's perfume. While it is not overpowering, it does linger all day and I think a simple "clean" smell would be preferable.TEXTUREThe texture is creamy and easy to spread through long hair.CONDITIONINGThe name implies that this is a deep conditioning product, and I think it lives up to that claim.  My hair is soft and manageable, without being greasy.  This may even work well during the winter.OVERALLClear Dry Scalp conditioner is a good conditioner hampered by a cheap floral fragrance.

column9: Thick, but doesn't weigh my hair down
column10: I used this product with its companion CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce and enjoyed them, although I normally prefer a single shampoo that does both.I found the scent of the conditioner to have a bit more of a "spice" overtone than the matching shampoo, but my hair smelled nice following, and did not have a heavy feel.Both the shampoo and conditioner are very thick, and with my shorter hair, I only used a small amount of each.  The conditioner was appropriate and didn't leave my hair feeling heavy or oily, in fact my hair passed my personal "squeak test" afterwards.So, while I still have a personal preference for conditioning shampoos, this is a very nice combination, with a pleasant scent.
I love the smell of this conditioner and it's smooth and effective.  Just a very small volume of the conditioner makes my hair looks shiny and smooth.  High recommend this product.

column9: Conditions okay, smells nice but does not detangle hair well
column10: This conditioner just conditions okay. I expected to be able to run my comb through my hair easily with this product but I could not. To me it did not feel very moisturizing.  One positive is that it does smell very nice but has a subtler scent than the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce I use.This is not a conditioner I will be purchasing in the future. The only positive is that I liked it better than the complementary CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce.

This product is great! At first I was skeptical because the conditioner isn't as thick as other brands but it delivers on it's promise and leaves your hair silky and soft! I love the smell, it's light and stays with you for a long time. The products labels are clear and concise though I noticed that the ingredients weren't an obvious find. Further investigation led me to find a peel-able label that reveals the ingredients AS WELL AS the actual sent of the product--very unique. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for a conditioner with a light, pleasant fragrance.

My hair is long and easily tangled. One thing I especially want in a conditioner is a product that will let me effortlessly comb through my hair after shampooing and conditioning. This product was not quite as good as Pantene in this area. My hair also seemed to frizz more than with Pantene.The conditioner is thick and has a nice scent. It is especially designed for itchy scalps which is not something I suffer from. People with that condition might find this product more useful than I did.

The Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Conditioner is a fair product. It works great at smoothing and making hair feel softer it however does not keep that soft and smooth feeling as long as other products I have tried. The fragrance to this is fair but I did not personally like it. I liked that the conditioner itself is thick enough to spread and work into the roots and ends of the hair. The bottle is easy to grip and use in the shower and is wide enough to sit without tipping over easily.

column9: Goodbye tangles and itchy, dry scalp...
column10: Every summer my hair and scalp seems to get very dry which makes my scalp itchy. I've been using this Shampoo and Conditioner for a week now and I've noticed a huge improvement already. The itchiness was gone after the very first use and my hair feels so much healthier now as well.  This Conditioner sure helps in the tangle department as well.  It makes my hair tangle-free and so incredibly soft.I've been having my 10-year-old daughter use these products as well and she keeps going around telling everybody to feel how soft her hair is now. The chlorine from the pools sure drys her hair out in the summertime but after using these products it seems to help out tons. The Conditioner sure helps those awful tangles that she's always fighting.I wouldn't say that the scent is something to rave about but it's not bad either.  The Conditioner seems to smell a bit better than the Shampoo does.I really like how much healthier and softer our hair is after using this product and I would recommend it.

I have very long thick hair and have been coloring it for years, so no matter how often I get my hair trimmed most of it is dry and fairly fragile. Although the aroma of this product is a little lighter than the others products of this line that I have tried, it is still a little over-powering for my taste.  My hair scent clashes with my perfume.  I hate that and that is why I try always to purchase fragrance free products.But that issue aside- this product seems to do what it claims to do.I'm always looking for an inexpensive product that may be the equivalent of a salon product. Well I'm sorry there just aren't any, but this conditioner comes slightly closer than most.I did seem to see less hair in my comb as I was combing my hair out after my shower, my scalp seems to bee less dry  and my comb ran through my hair quite easily.After drying and using the heated flate iron on my hair it appeared silky, somewhat shiny and was quite  easy to manage.

column9: works well on my fine hair
column10: Shampoos and conditioners are so tricky to review because everyone's hair responds so differently to different products. I have long, straight, baby-fine hair, and this makes my hair very soft. I normally use all-natural conditioners so I find the scent stronger than I'm used to, but as long as my hair is out of my face (say, in a pony tail), it doesn't bother me.So hopefully that's useful to someone else out there with long, straight, baby-fine hair!

column9: This with the shampoo is my new duo.
column10: I washed with the shampoo for moisturizing dry hair by clear. I was very happy with the way it lathered and rinsed. I then followed with this conditioner. I left in on for about 5 min as I took a slow massage shower. It rinsed out well and left my hair feeling silky.To give the ultimate test I let it air dry about till 80% dry and it was going a bit frizzy so I finished with the cool dryer and then a very low setting ceramic ceramic hot iron. My hair looks the best it has for months since it came it frizzy after losing about 1/4 after an illness. It is not total frizz free but this is only one use. It claims 7 days I think it can happen.I don't have to wash everyday so 7 washings will be more than 7 days.I will buy this again and the price cannot be beat. Better than anything a salon has ever used on me.

This conditioner is acceptable; it leaves hair soft and smooth initially, but after a couple of splashes of river water later on in the day, it felt like I was wearing a hair helmet, albeit soft.The bottle has a curved top, in order to distinguish the conditioner from its shampoo counterpart. The matching shampoo sits on either its base or its cap, whereas the conditioner must be set on only the cap. I hope that it's not just a matter of time before it falls down onto some toes.

I used this conditioner after I washed my hair with the shampoo that is supposed to be it's partner (Clear Scalp and Hair Therapy Moisturizing Dry Scalp").  It was nice and viscous and I used a dollop about the size of quarter.  I worked through my wet hair and left it on for about two minutes.  It rinses out easily and my medium long hair was easy to comb out.  I blew it dry and the texture of my hair was soft and smooth.The only negative thing I have to say about this product is that it is kind of strong on the scent.  Even several hours later I can still smell it in my hair and I'm not partial to anything with perfume.  But if you like a scent that lasts a long time then this would be good to use.

column9: Moisturizing conditioner with a great fragrance
column10: I've been spending a good deal of time outside and in the chlorine with the kids, and the hair has definitely felt the heat and abuse.  I'm fair-skinned and have had some sunburns on my scalp as well, and it's hard to find a product that does not irritate my scalp when the sunscreen fails.  This one is great!  I really like the fragrance, and it's done a good job of providing moisture without irritating my skin or making my hair look too greasy.  My hair has been tending towards the frizz recently, and after one week of using this conditioner, it does seem to be laying straighter and 'behaving' better.  The cost is about the same as any other conditioner I've tried, and the results have been better. So far, I'm very pleased!

See my review for the matching shampoo product as well.  This conditioner is just as nice.  It also dispenses with a white, pearly consistency and a clean fragrance.  I love the feel of it on my scalp as I leave it rubbed into my hair while I finish the rest of my shower.  It feels nice and creamy in my hair and rinses out cleanly.  Some of these other products are harder to get out of your hair and you feel that they are leaving a residue on your hair.  Not this one.  This is also a recommend to buy.  Don't think you'll regret it at all.  Enjoy

This has a pleasent smell and conditions wel. This is a bit on the thick side, but with my long hair, it doesn't take as much as other conditioners to cover my hair. It does a good job moisturizing my hair. I use it with CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce and I was very happy with how well they worked to moisturize, clean, and condition my hair.

column4: Shana "That's my opinion- I could be wrong!"
column9: Good, but, left my hair a bit frizzy
column10: For reference, I have long, baby fine hair that is wavy, it tends to get dry on the ends and my bangs tend to get oily looking by the end of the day. My hair also tends to get frizzy looking after it dries when using certain conditioners.This conditioner it a little thinner in consistency than most conditioners that I usually use. I had to use more of it than my usual favorite conditioner ( Suave Professionals Keratin Infusion Smoothing Conditioner, 12.6 Ounce (Pack of 2) ). This conditioner has a nice scent and it seems to last quite awhile on the hair.Overall, I liked this conditioner, but, I didn't like it enough to make it my staple conditioner. My scalp didn't seem to feel any more moisturized than it usually does with my usual conditioner.

There isn't a lot I can say about conditioner, but after using this product (along with the moisturizing dry scalp shampoo) I noticed that my scalp was much less dry and itchy.  The conditioner is very thick and works well on my hair.  I did notice my hair was a bit flat when using it, but that is to be expected with any heavy conditioner.  One good thing is that the bottle is designed to be stored upside down.  This is important when working with a very thick product.  Overall, it seems to do what it was designed to do though.

column9: Got this for the wife, she is pleased
column10: I had the chance to try this conditioner out so I got this for the wife, she is pleased with it. Her hair is clean, scalps not dry, it's not greasy and overall she's happy. I could see us ordering this again.

My hair looks great when using this conditioner and although I do have dry skin and a dry scalp this conditioner makes my scalp feel a lot more moisturized and a lot less dry. I don't use this conditioner as often as I should but when I do I really like the results. If you have dry skin and are looking for a conditioner you could do a lot worse than this product.

For my particular hair I think this conditioner may be not quite heavy and intensive enough. It's really not bad, but it's also not something where the results really stand out beyond what I've experienced with a variety of other conditioners on the market. I haven't noticed any particular change in my scalp, for better or worse either.I'm going to keep using it and see how things go, but for now this one isn't making a big impression one way or another. It just does the basics that I'd expect.

What made me want to try this product, Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy, Moisturizing Dry Scalp, besides that, was that this is a new product line.  To be honest, their product line is so extensive, it was kind of hard, at least for me, to know which product would be the correct one for me.In the end, I decided to go with the Moisturizing Dry Scalp version, but I was only able to order the conditioner version, and not also the shampoo, which is what I would have ordered, both of them, because I have found that when you use both the shampoo as well as the conditioner, the results are better than if you had used only one of the products.  The shampoo version was already out through the Vine Program, which is how I was able to order this conditioner.First of all, I like the sleek, modern design of the bottle, tho I would have preferred that the opening be on the top of the bottle, rather than the bottom of the bottle, which is how it is.  I guess due to the shape of the top of the bottle, maybe that made the option of having the opening be on the top of the bottle instead of the bottom of the bottle, how it is, impossible.The bottle opening is to the left of the bottle, so you just open that rather than other bottles, where the whole opening has to be opened up, like if the opening is on the top of the bottle, at least for some shampoos and conditioners, to enable you to be able to dispense the shampoo or conditioner that you need.  In any case, I prefer the opening to the bottle be on top of the bottle, and not on the bottom of the bottle.  It's a personal preference.The bottle size is 12.7 ounces, which seems standard as far as the size of the bottle, unless you buy the supersized bottle in a shampoo or conditioner.I love the scent of the conditioner, which thankfully I love it, because I always smell scented products. If I do not like the scent of a product, I will not purchase it.The bottle says there are 10 Vitamins and Nutrients.  The back of the bottle says it provides up to 2 times more moisturization, but that is if you use both the shampoo and conditioner.So, it's kind of hard to judge how well this product really works, without also using the shampoo too.I did like how it made my scalp feel, but then I normally do like how most shampoos and conditioners, in the dry scalp version, make my scalp and hair feel.Having very, very thick hair, I cannot just use a conditioner.  I also have to use a conditioning, detangling spray, in able to brush my hair out when it's wet.So, in all fairness it is kind of hard to judge this conditioner, without being able to try the shampoo too.

column9: I like the product  but the packaging leaks
column10: I tried this even though I had previously not like another clear scalp product.  The long lengths shampoo and conditioner had not worked well for me but I decided to give the brand another try.Like the first Clear Scalp product I ordered, this one had leaked substantially.  I would estimate that about 1/5 of the product had leaked into the plastic wrapper surrounding the bottle.Other than that this was a completely different experience from trying the first product.  I really liked the smell.  The conditioner felt like it soaked in and rinsed out nicely.  My wet hair felt smooth and tangle free.  I live in the high desert so my hair gets dried out terribly.  It is also color treated.  But the Dry Scalp conditioner made both my scalp and hair feel good.  My hair was soft but had no  flyaways.For the price and performance I will keep using this product.

I have hair that is thick and goes about 3" past my shoulders and difficult to manage-it always seems to be frizzed out (just thought I would included that so you know when reading the review you can compare your hair type to see if this will work with your hair or not) I am a Head and Shoulders Loyalist, however, this conditioner works pretty well. It is smooth and goes on easily.  It smells pretty good (I would say about as good as Pantene or Garnier Fructis, but better than any of the Head and Shoulders scents I've tried) and after blow drying left my hair soft and silky, but not greasy-even the next day.  I did use it with the Clear shampoo, so I think that using both products together also helped and would recommend that you get the shampoo as well!Packaging Note: If you plan on ordering this on Amazon, be aware that it may leak in transit-Mine did leak a little bit, it was wrapped in a plastic bag so it didn't get all over the box/other items, but it was still messy and needed some rinsing off when I took it out of the box.

My hair is fine, slightly dry,and I have periodic dandruff. I massaged this product into my hair, waited 2 minutes, and rinsed my hair first with warm water and then cool wate. I wasn't pleased with the end results and thought it left my hair sort of greasy and limp. I also detected some build-up which is definitely not something I want.In all fairness to this product, I suspect I should have not used this formulation. I used a similar product by a different manufacturer  recently and had exactly the same results with the exception that I paid at least $2 more. I suspect that if I had thick or coarse hair this would have worked as promised. As for the build up,  i can't say. This just doesn't work well on straight and extremely fine hair.

column9: Does what it says it will
column10: I have been using this conditioner along with the shampoo for a month, and I am pleased that my dry, itchy scalp--probably caused by medication I am taking--is much relieved.  The fragrance is very light, and it doesn't take a lot of the product to get the job done.  My hair and scalp feel clean and it lasts the three days between shampoos.  I like the packaging, too.

I take medications that really cause my scalp to be dry and itchy, especially in hot, dry weather. I tried the Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Conditioner and I liked the way my scalp and hair felt and looked afterwards. The downside was the fragrance - it was too strong for me, but I have respiratory issues that make me extremely sensitive to most fragrances, and have to be very careful with any product, preferring unscented if available. This fragrance is pleasant but not for me.  I would definitely try the product again if it came out in an unscented or very light fruity/citrus fragrance, not floral.When I received the product it was tightly wrapped in plastic, but the bottle was leaking.  The manufacturer needs to address that, perhaps with a safety seal under the cap both for leakage and consumer protection.

I have thick long hair and this conditioner worked great for removing tangles and making my hair soft. It does not have a strong, overpowering scent. You do have to make sure to rinse it out well, as this is a thick conditioner. My hair tends to frizz and this helped my hair with that also.The product was shipped wrapped in plastic and in a box, but the top still leaked a little bit. The weather in my area has been in the high 90s, so I don't know if that contributed to it.

I used "CLEAR Moisturizing Conditioner" in junction with "CLEAR Moisturizing Shampoo." The results were better than expected. Here is my experience:Having long wavy hair, I first experimented with "CLEAR Strong Lengths Conditioner" (paired with the moisturizing shampoo). After a week of use, my hair was surprisingly weighty. It appears that the product had been causing unwanted build-up. So, I used a different brand of shampoo/conditioner for a few days and then switched to this conditioner (with the same moisturizing shampoo). The results were greatly improved. My hair was bouncier and still shiny. So, the lesson here is that you might need to find the perfect combination of CLEAR products for your hair.Other notes:I really like the "upside-down" design of the bottle (it helps prevent that awkward "vigorously shaking the bottle in the dangerously slippery shower" moment). Likewise, I enjoy the pleasant scent (but, those who are sensitive to perfumes may this product overwhelming). However, if you have long hair like me and are considering the "Strong Lengths" conditioner, you should know that this "Moisturizing" one is best for non-processed/non color-treated hair. (If you have longer, processed hair, then "Strong Lengths" is probably a good bet. It is thicker and coats damaged hair).

This shampoo is so gentle, yet cleans my hair of all products used since the last shampoo without stripping essential oils and minerals. I was so impressed with the shampoo (received through Amazon Vine Program) that I went out and bought the conditioner. It is equally as good as the shampoo. On a scale of 1-10, I give this shampoo a 12!

This conditioner leaves the hair silky and soft, great smelling, helps with the tangles AND conditions your scalp, doesn't make my hair greasy or weigh it down.  I LOVE this conditioner and it goes perfectly with the shampoo!

column9: I'm out under hot sun much of the time . . .
column10: . . And my hair was looking very fly-away and dry.  AFter using this product for a couple of weeks, I saw a noticeable difference.  My hair appeared smoother and had some shine.  I wear my hair short, but always had wisps sticking out and up which I had to control with a curling iron, which I hated to do because I feared that was making my hair dryer.This product is effective and pleasant to use.  I like it.

I have thick, coarse, curly hair, and this product didn't give me results I like. My hair was soft, but it became almost sticky. I could barely run my fingers through it because the hair was sticking to itself. However, it worked great for my sister, do perhaps it's just my hair type that's the problem.

I really like this conditioner, way above the normal dry scalp conditioner, it leaves your hair feeling soft and smooth.  It also smells very nice.  Very creamy formula.  Works really well to keep from flaking.

I am IN LOVE with this conditioner! I was skeptical trying it since I've tried so many hair products over the years that only dry out my hair & make it frizz, but I was very pleasantly surprised.The conditioner had leaked a tad during shipping, but it was in a plastic bag so it didn't get everywhere. I simply rinsed off the top & no harm done.The first thing I noticed was the sweet, floral smell. It's feminine & flirty and I immediately loved it. The texture is thick and creamy; exactly what you want for a serious conditioner.My hair is fairly long, naturally curly, and thick. I wear it naturally (air-dried and curly) about twice a week so that it can recuperate, and flat iron it to death the rest of the time. I want my hair to be as shiny, soft, frizz-free, and generally  healthy as possible either way I wear it, which is a tall order.In order to accomplish this I've developed an optimal routine over time & experimentation. I use a miniscule amount of shampoo ONLY on my scalp, & condition the bottom half of my hair BEFORE rising. This way, the shampoo is pulled through the strands & cleans them without overly-drying the bottom half.After rinsing, I then fully condition my hair... now with three conditions. Adding the "CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Moisturizing Dry Scalp Nourishing Conditioner" has made a noticeable difference in my hair. It smells wonderful, is even silkier & less prone to frizz than ever. I can even go out in the hot, ultra humid summer weather without worrying about it puffing up and frizzing!I will DEFINITELY buy a new bottle once this runs out. I'd like to try the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY shampoo version as well. I strongly recommend this conditioner for those with medium to dry or curly hair.

My new favorite conditioner. After using both the shampoo and conditioner for a couple of weeks, my hair has more body and my kind of dry scalp is not flaking at all. As someone else with grey hair mentioned, I noticed right away that my hair feels more like the hair of my youth when it was naturally blond. If you have flakes, or dry feeling hair, I recommend you give Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty products a try.

This conditioner made my hair silkier and softer as well as making my hair and scalp feel healthier. There have been no ill-effects and it keeps my hair nice just as well as my usual brand, Tresemme, does.
Easy to hold bottle and a pleasing scent. It rinsed cleanly and when paired with the shampoo, it left my hair feeling very soft and clean.

column9: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY MOISTURIZING DRY SCALP CONDITIONER - Weathers the elements
column10: This conditioner is great for "outdoor living."  My hair is a wreck due to lap swimming.  And the sun in the Sunshine State makes it worse.  This conditioner fixes these problems, better than the athletic conditioners that I have used in the past.  Its application is creamy and not greasy.  There is no need to turn around and then wash this conditioner out to due any gunkiness. After using, my hair is easier to comb and lighter to the touch.  Also, using this every other day seems to work just fine.

I really like this Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Moisturizing Conditioner. This pale lavender color conditioner as a lovely fresh, clean scent, not too strong, just lightly scented and pleasing. The formula has a light creamy feel, not at all greasy, and rinses out easily. It leaves my hair feeling soft and silky, manageable and shiny. I've used all the big name products and I like this one better.

I've only used this a few of times and it seems to have had an effect.I never had dandruff falling on my clothes but (don't be grossed out here) when I'd scratch my head, I'd have debris under my fingernails.  Since I've been using this, my scalp doesn't itch as much and when I do scratch, there's less dry skin debris.Wow, I sound like Big Foot's sister - HA!!  But that's life.My hair is also soft and not as dry.  SO - less scalp itching because my scalp is cleaner and nicer hair - it WORKS  : - }

column9: Nice conditioner - smell is OK - leaves hair soft & with almost no tangles
column10: Very nice conditioner! Contains natural oils & left my curly hair a lot more manageable, even after a bath with Epsom salts!Didn't do much for my scalp (but then my scalp is only dry in hot or very cold temperatures, which don't generally last too long in S. CA.Can back comb right through when wet.Smell is OK - not my favorite, but is OK and doesn't bother me after use. (I prefer natural pure essential oils rather than chemical scents)I'm not sure why the cosmetics industry uses so much titanium dioxide in everything from toothpaste (very concerning if you have kids around, but not great for adults either, but it Does apparently make your teeth whiter, and hair more reflective I imagine, yet I can't help but wonder how daily exposure affects a person?!?) or coloring for their products that are used daily (I suspect the red dye #33 might be the culprit that caused some itching after a couple of uses itching? Could have been something else, or just "that time of year"?)Thankfully this conditioner doesn't contain Formaldehyde, like many, many shampoos & conditions do, & that can cause allergic reactions - especially after using them for a long time.Overall, works well, smell is OK, not bad, but not a favorite scent (but neither are some really great, truly natural shampoos & conditioners!)It does work nicely. If I had to just grab something and the store didn't have my brands, then I would be drawn to this & a few others.To be fair, if you look at the labels of just about ALL good shampoos and conditioners, there are going to be chemicals.My favorite conditioner is Vegetable glycerin with my own blend of sweet PEOs (pure essential oils) from a respectable PEO brand... great for hair, dry skin & you can choose & create your own scents by mixing your own oils. (NOTE: If you do decide to make your own, MANY so-called "PEO blends" are adulterated, or stretched out with cheaper oils!Oils vary WIDELY by price... for instance orange oils are roughly $4 an ounce, while real rose oil (Rose absolute) is roughly $435 per ounce! Aura Cacia is a VERY respectable brand/dealer of PEos and there are others, but that one comes to mind. If it says "blend" or x% Rose (or whatever you favorite oils, go elsewhere for your PEOs.I just planted my own roses and use a rose "tea" & open the windows and doors when the roses are blooming!Really, this is one of the better "see it everywhere" products out there, although I'd like to see REAL natural products that work & they do exist!Many chemical additives can be absorbed through the skin.My philosophy is that if you wouldn't eat it, then you probably shouldn't be putting it on your skin, with the exception of mud & mineral baths, which are incredible, and are fine with me in a bottle as well, IF naturally occurring and non-toxic!For a drug-store brand, they did pretty well in comparison. The small is nice, but not a favorite & it does get the tangles out!I'd rather have a natural formula, or make my own, but this one, if you need to jut grab some conditioner & it's good after a swim in the pool as well! Pretty good, but lost a star for the chemicals that weren't needed or really desirable IMHO & the smell was a bit odd.

column9: Just a bag of dried beans
column10: This is essentially just a bag of dried beans with a 'flavor packet'. Don't be fooled by the ingredient list to think it is anything else. The quality of the dried beans is top notch, but is hardly a 'hearty meal' as they describe it. Just get straight up dried beans in bulk and save your money.

column9: Skippy Natural with Honey is way too sweet!
column10: My husband and I eat peanut butter by the spoonsful.  We had been buying Skippy Natural Creamy for several years and liked it very much.  Recently, when I bought it I noticed that it is now Skippy Natural Creamy with Honey.  I like honey so I thought it would be the same wonderful peanut butter with honey instead of sugar.  Unfortunately, it is not.  Instead of replacing the sugar with honey, they have added MORE sugar in the form of honey.  It now has 5 grams of sugars per serving instead of the 3 grams it did previously.  And it tastes so sweet now that the sweetness masks the natural peanut flavor. If the old style is not still available at the same price then we will be switching to Jif Natural.

My wife and I absolutely love this stuff.  We have been having trouble finding it in the store so Im ordering a case from here. I have never ordered any type of food product online, but this stuff is just that good.

This product is great and so much cheaper then store prices, plus it came in three bottles so I won't be needing ginger again for a good long time! Came directly to my door, with free s/h and ever so quickly as well!
Prompt response from company, it is great to be able to select the different variety and not end up with cups you dont want

I was looking for a selection of k-cups but having commitment issues. I just couldn't bring myself to commit to buy 24 cups of Vanilla Creme or Toffee or a certain decaf blend, without actually knowing what it tasted like. And the pre-packaged mixed selections already had half the flavors I wasn't interested in. This is an ingenious idea! I just ordered a wide selection of exactly what I wanted to taste. Ordered it Saturday, the seller emailed me back within two hours of receiving my order email, and mailed it out Monday morning. Package received Wednesday. Great service, all the flavors I want to try. Can't recommend this enough to folks!

I have been eating Skippy since childhood. I still wish they would cut back abit on the salt for us older people. I do like the size of the jar and I gota great deal on the pricing. Hope it stays at a good price.
Bought this product and was very disapointed when it arrived. It smells and tastes like fruit punch, not like passion fruit. Will have to try out another product that has more reviews.

Love these dumplings; just like the ones we enjoy in Munich when visiting family.  Best part is how easy they are to make.  They are in individual bags and ready to go...just soak and boil.  Done!  No mixing, no mess.  Be careful, though, when removing them from their individual bags as they are hot and you must use your fingers to open them.  There are little tabs to hold onto, but it can still be a bit precarious.

I love old-fashion puddings and this mix delighted me, my grandchildren, my children, and even the neighbors. I left a loaf of wheat bread out overnight to harden, then crumbled into my big mixer along with the pudding mix, crushed walnuts, and ingredients as listed. My entire condo was filled with the aroma within about ten minutes in the oven. By the time the large pan of pudding was baked, the aroma was out into the street. I topped it with raisins for the grandchildren who like them and left them off for those who do not. Vanilla ice cream and whipped cream topped off the steaming hot pudding. The next time, I added even more walnuts and some dried cranberries to one end--amazing!! I next want to try sourdough bread with diced apples. This is as good as it gets!!

column9: Very healthy lasagna, not bad but don't expect it as same as regular lasagna.
column10: As long as you won't expect to taste as regular lasagna, this is pretty good as whole wheat lasagna. A bit gummy, different texture from the regular type, of course. For the health benefit with flaxseed, I can take it to substitute regular ones occasionally. One thing to point out is that one package may not be enough for traditional lasagna recipe.

i got this after the reviews...The 7 minute cooking time really left my lasagna undercooked. Was a huge waste and ended up trying to fix it but in vain...I guess it needs longer cooking time that needs to be figured out well...but really dunno if it was me...considering this is whole wheat i should have realized. It really did not do well.

Have been disappointed with typical store bought "healthier" pastas, but this brand has never let me down.  Consistency is same as traditional pastas... cooks, tastes and reheats just as well.  So much better for you too, being organic and whole wheat.  I am so pleased to have discovered this brand. I can't find it in local stores yet, so God bless amazon! We are big on healthy eating but also at having some kind of pasta at least once a week, so buying in bulk on amazon at a good price really suits our grocery buying purposes. So pleased that amazon offers so many organic choices that don't necessarily break the bank.  I buy local meat and produce from farmers, but for packaged organic foods, you can't beat amazon.
My family has been moving to healthier foods. My wife and I made turkey lasagna with these noodles, the kids did not complain! REST MY CASE

We really like the  Hodgson Mill pastas and the lasagna did not disappoint!  Once you get it baked in the lasagna you can't even tell how good for you it is.  It makes the lasagna taste richer and even more of an indulgence.  Mmmm, writing this makes me hungry for more lasagna!
I've ordered several whole wheat pastas because I'm trying to eat a bit healthier. This is the best kind I've found. The milled flaxseed is an added bonus.
This is good stuff.  It was a little on the heavy side when making lasagna.  I think maybe using regular noodles and some of these would have made the dish less dense.  Great price.
I love these lasagna noodles, and my whole family likes them too. I've tried others that are whole wheat but these are better--maybe it's the flax seed in them--don't know, but they are great.
I like this brand.  It doesn't taste like some healthy pasta.  More like regular pasta in taste w/ all the health benefits.

I ordered this hoping it would be similar to a HK or Royal style milk tea found in Asia.  Unfortunately, the powdered mix is just an instant sugary, milky tea mix.  Once water is added, you get a very sweet, milky tea product: the exact same thing can be replicated at home with Lipton tea bags, 2-3 teaspoons of sugar and 1/4 cup of milk.  if you're looking for mill-tea, look elsewhere.  If you can't be bother to buy Lipton, sugar, milk and mix them together yourself, then go ahead; I guess this works.
My mother ordered the tea for me because she knew I liked to drink this tea which is not too sweet, and the quality is good.

The bar itself was decent and didn't have many calories associated with it. I generally try to avoid snack foods but this fact made it fairly easy for me to grab one or two of between meals.The taste though was semi decent and nothing special. If you don't like the taste of dates I suggest you avoid. At times it tastes like a neutrograin bar and other times it tastes like dates themselves.I also had, on several occasions, the unfortunate experience of getting some of the bar stuck in a tiny hole in my teeth. It's very hard to remove once it's stuck up there I can assure you.It's a decent bar for a quick snack but nothing too special.

column9: Taste good if you are a vegetarian
column10: Don't be dissapointed with the look (brown, like a piece of soggy food). It tastes like a real strawberry.

PROBAR Fruition Superfood Snack Bar, Strawberry 1.7-Ounce, 12-count Box is a good product.PRICE: Impractical.OVERALL TASTE: Yum!SPECIFIC TASTE: Dates, oats, strawberries, respectively.LABEL: "STRAWBERRY made with organic dates and oats" (Capitalization as on the package)NUTRITION: 160 calories, very satisfying; dietary fiber, 4 grams, helpful fiber-dense food.TEXTURE: Like glue, gummy.COLOR: Brown.ALLERGY INFORMATION: "Produced in a facility that processes nuts"OTHER INFORMATION: "100% VEGAN - NON GMO" (Does everyone know what "GMO" means?)PACKAGE DESIGN: Attractive, suggestive of abundant strawberries.INGREDIENTS IN ORDER (quoted): Organic Date Paste, Organic Rolled Oats, Organic Brown Rice Syrup, Strawberry Puree, Cashews, Apple Juice Infused, Strawberries, White Chia Seeds, Black Chia Seeds, Natural Strawberry, Strawberry Extract, Tocopherois, Natural Flavor, Ascorbic, Acid, Citric Acid, Arabic Gum.TAGLINE: Simply Real

Being that this fruit bar is Non Gmo,I'm impressed.But!! It also says, Made with Organic Dates and Oats, which I think is miss leading.As all the other fruit that are in this are NOT, but organic brown rice syrup (SUGAR)..The wraping shows strawberries , but its strawberry puree, Juice infused strawberries,Natural strawberry flavor.Also white chia seeds, and black chia seeds, which is very good, but its just about at the bottom of the list.That said, its full of sugar 22 G. Which you will get some energy from, butthen a downward spiral.Only 3 G of Protein..No Vitamin A, or C.Which I find Odd, as Fresh or frozen strawberries do have C in them.I'm not impressed by this fruit bar,and the price.The taste is not bad, its like a chopped and formed date bar..The 1st Ing is Organic Date Paste, then rolled oats..I most likely would not buy this.I would buy a protien bar first..My Grandkids where also not impressed, and there not babies, but late teens, early 20s, and do buy protien bars. Although this is a Fruit bar, not a protien bar..I will keep one or two of the bars in my car for emergency if I'm starving lol..

column4: Matt Hill "PARATAXIS and THE CLOUD RECKONER"
column10: Seems to be a consensus here with most of the reviewers that this is a decent product. I concur. The nutritional value is high; the flavor is decent, with a good synergy between the strawberry, dates, and oats; and it is vegan and certified organic for those who care about this.Now, here comes the however part ... The product description says that there are two servings per 1.7 oz bar. Now, 1.7 oz = 3 bites. Which means that a serving size is 1 1/2 bites. Just who is it who makes up these standards anyway? This is ludicrous if you ask me. The cost/benefit ratio here is so low as to be ridiculous.So, if price point is not an issue with you, then this would be a fair product. It will be interesting to see what the retail price is set at. THAT could be the product killer.

This is a very tasty nutrition bar. It has 160 calories, 2 grams of fat, 20 mg of sodium, 3 grams of protein, and 22 grams of sugar. The sugar content, even though it is arguably natural, is very high and would not recommend this with people with sugar problems.The bars are labeled as vegan and contain no trans fat. They are very yummy and have a nice strawberry and dates taste. It is not overpowering but, it is a bit sugary.Now, the issue with these bars is the cost. At twice, and even three times the costs of other bars such as CLIF ZBaR, Larabar and Kashi Bars these bars are not a good economical option unless you follow a vegan diet.

column9: Only get them if you like dates
column10: I was really looking forward to trying the Pro Bar fruition Strawberry bars.  I love snack bars and often will have a couple for breakfast. Nutritionally, these bars are great loaded with fruit and fiber and some protein.  They're 100% Vegan and non-GMO. My only problem with the bar is I'm not a big fan of dates and these taste overwhelmingly like dates.  The bars say they are made with organic dates and oats.  The taste of oats is pretty neutral.  I was expecting a bar that tasted like strawberry with some oats and dates along for the ride.  Instead this bar tastes like dates with the strawberry thrown in along for the ride.  Neither of my daughters is a fan of dates.  One wouldn't even try the bars.  The other took one bite and wouldn't eat any more.If you like dates and strawberries, I think you'll love these bars. They're soft and moist.  And, as I said, nutritionally, they are a winner. But, expect a big date flavor.

I think some of the other reviewers are being a little unkind. To be honest if I had read the reviews before deciding to order I probably would have passed. As it was, I only read the other comments AFTER having tasted the bar. My considered opinion is that as far as healthy energy bars go "Fruition" hits the mark. It is a little like the texture and taste of a fig Newton without the soft cookie shell, but it has a very definite strawberry flavor that I personally like. It made a great mid-afternoon snack - though I'm not sure that just one bar would constitute a meal replacement. The main drawback to the product is the price. I'd have to be convinced that there were other tangible health benefits to eating this bar in order to justify the high price at over $2 per bar.

The fact that that this bar is made of healthy ingredients is good, and, as a snack, is is healthier than a chocolate bar.  It is dense and chewy, which I liked, but I could not detect any rolled oats or cashews.  What I thought were pieces of cashew nuts had no cashew texture.  The whole bar has the same dried-paste texture except for some small seeds, possibly strawberry seeds.  Unfortunately, I did not like the flavor of Fruition Strawberry.  After I took a bite, I thought it was made from fig paste, but the list of ingredients shows date paste, it appears that dates and strawberry together taste similar to figs.  In any regard, if I have not seen the packaging, I would not realize the bar had any strawberry in it.  Furthermore, in my opinion, Fruition Strawberry bars are very sweet.  I consider them high in sugar - 22g per bar (one bar is 160 calories).  I compared a Fruition Strawberry bar to my preferred Nature Valley Trail Mix Fruit and Nut bar, and Trail Mix has only 14g of sugar AND five times less sodium than Fruition.  In addition Fruition Strawberry is quite pricey - the price per bar is four times that of Trail Mix.UPDATE:  Wy wife really likes these bars.  She likes the texture and the flavor, although she agrees that the bar does not taste like strawberry.  She also agrees that the bar is pricey.

This vegan snack bar contains no trans fat or artificial flavors.  It tastes like a Fig Newton, very dense, chewy, and dry.  It's not sweet enough for me and I probably wouldn't eat one unless I had nothing else.  Recommended for those who want a healthy snack and don't mind bland taste.

I eat a lot of granola/nutrition/cereal bars, and this bar is a nutritious and OK-tasting alternative to existing products.  Each bar is packed with 160 mostly organic calories, making it more satisfying than most in terms of hunger.In  terms of nutrition, these are mostly organic but otherwise have fairly standard nutrition as far as granola/nutrition bars go: nothing either positive or negative there.My only negative is taste: it tastes good, but not AS good, in my opinion, as a nutri-grain bar. My taste buds aren't tuned to organic foods, though, which is worth mentioning: if yours are, you might vastly prefer the taste of these. Of note: our toddler loves these.

I love the taste--and especially the texture--of these bars. They're moist and chewy, but not at all sticky or gooey. The texture is almost like a brownie, dense and chewy. And filling! As good as they are, you're not tempted to eat two, because one is satisfying enough.The sweetness comes mainly from fruit sugars, but as I don't have a sweet tooth, it was slightly too much for me. However, I'm assuming that most people have a higher tolerance for sweetness than I do, so they'll probably find the level to be just right.Of all the "healthy" bars I've tried, I have to say this one has the healthiest ingredients. And at only 160 calories with no saturated fat, I feel good about eating it, because it's not just a candy bar in disguise like most bars. My niece is used to there only being "healthy" food at Auntie's house, but I think this time she won't mind!

column9: A blah date paste based bar
column10: The name of the bar is "Fruition", but really all the fruit in it is just dates. Dates are not a super nutritious high-antioxidant fruit, they're just really sweet. The bar basically has a datey and brown rice syrup taste, with just a hint of mild berry flavoring... it doesn't taste authentic and bright and exciting. Hardly any cranberries! Also, the chias are a little annoying; they get stuck in your teeth after swelling; however, there really isn't that many chia seeds to state a "superfood" claim.This bar I thought to try, because it seemed similar to Betty Lou's Just Great Stuff Superberry Acai bar (which I love, and has a great ORAC score), but it really doesn't have the nutrition or flavor that Betty Lou's bars do. It's really too sweet and nothing special. I'd say the best part about it is the packaging--the designing of the film is nice. Based on the beautiful packaging, I was hoping for a great tasting nutritious bar. Not so much. :(

column4: Miz Ellen "all the letters of my real name"
column10: PRO BAR "fruition" snack bars have a robust fruity flavor. The sweetness is a natural compound of strawberry, apple and date. I love the fact that this is a vegan snack that has no cholesterol and very low sodium. One of these bars makes an excellent snack and contains only 160 calories.The one flaw is the texture which is not chewy enough. Everything including the oats and cashew nuts has been ground up fine and the result is a rather gluey texture.

column9: Bad Texture, Decent Taste, Deceptive Ingredients
column10: I was mostly disappointed with these snack bars. The flavor is okay -- definitely heavy on the dates taste -- but I absolutely hated the texture. It feels almost chalky or sandy in your mouth.While it doesn't purport to be organic, some reviewers have already said that this product is "organic" and "natural". This is not the case. While some organic ingredients are used, the bar is not 100% organic, like other products on the market. This is somewhat deceptive.Bottom line is that there are better tasting bars out there and some of them are true organic.

column9: Hint of Strawberry is more like it
column10: I gave one of these to my sixteen-year-old niece, who took a couple of bites and summed it up: "When you first open it, it smells like you're going to get a tangy strawberry flavor, but when you eat it, it there's hardly any strawberry flavor at all." After she went home, I found that she took maybe 2 bites and then left the bar on her plate.The first time I ate one, a week or so earlier, the phrase "hint of strawberry" came to mind as a better description of the flavor. It should be noted that, in terms of nutrition and ingredients, there is no downside at all (unless you're counting carbs: 34/22 sugars). I've eaten a few of them over the past few weeks. I did not find them nearly as bad as some of the one- and two-star reviewers, but cannot find anything about them that deserves more than three stars.

column9: Some health benefits, but don't buy it just for taste.
column10: I'm a big fan of snack bars, as I often eat them at work when I'm facing late afternoon hunger.  I tried this Fruition Strawberry Bar and had mixed feelings on it.Pros:- Texture.  It reminds me of a Fig Newton's texture.  It's not crumbly, so it won't make a mess (which is a big bonus for snacks on the go).  But it also isn't too gooey and sticky.- Two servings of fruit in each bar.  Since very few people get their full allotment of fruits in a day, this definitely helps.- Four grams of fiber.  Not a huge amount, but again, most people don't hit their fiber target in a given day.- Contains a lot of organic ingredients and is vegan.  Some people may not care about this, but it's very important to others.Cons:- High price.- High sugar (22 grams)- Strawberry flavor is not strong (and it's low on the list of ingredients). The primary ingredient is dates.Mixed feelings:- Taste.  It's not the greatest tasting thing, but it's not bad either.  I don't picture myself ever craving one.  My vegan sister-in-law tried one and thought it was disgusting.- Calories.  It contains 160, which is high or low depending on what your alternative is.  Is it healthier than eating a vending machine candy bar?  Of course.  But it's also higher than eating actual fruit, or a Fiber One bar (which is around 135 calories).

column9: Satisfying healthy bar lacks strawberry flavor
column10: Overall I was happy with these bars. They had a decent flavor, moist, relatively filling, relatively healthy, good mouth feel.I was however a bit disappointed with the flavor. I was expecting something to be a bit tart and strawberry but it tasted much closer to a fig newton or dates than anything strawberry I can identify.Ingredients organic date paste, organic rolled oats, and organic brown rice syrup strawberry purée, cashews, apple juice infused strawberries,white and black Chia seeds natural strawberry flavor strawberry extract tocopherols, natural flavor, ascorbic acid, citric acid, arabic gum.I like this bar enough to buy a single unit in the future but not an entire case. If I liked the flavor of dates better I would be much more likely to purchase a case.

Ugly brown in color, very chewy, not nearly as sweet nor as strongly strawberry flavored as we expected.  But once we ate the first one, what can I say -- we were hooked.  If you like Fig Newtons, you'll love these.  Low fat, low calorie, filling.

column9: Tastes like a strawberry scented date bar
column10: The ingredients list for the probar is pretty marvelous; everything is organic.  The consistency appears to mainly comprise dates, which is fine with me, since dates are delicious.  There is a slight hint of strawberry; the box hypes the addition of a super-food ingredient called a chia seed, but I couldn't see the seeds.  Perhaps they were ground up and added with the rest of the bar.While the bar may appear to be unappetizing, it tastes delicious and wholesome.  The sweetness is perfectly balanced.  The only downside is that each bar costs roughly between $2-$3.  If you absolutely must have your intake of chia seed and it must be in bar form, then you can't go wrong with the probar.

column9: For a Healthy Bar, Pretty Good Overall
column10: This bar ranks pretty highly in its genre. I like that it is organic and vegan, and only has 160 calories. It also has 4g of fiber and very low fat, which is great. I didn't expect it to taste like a candy bar or granola bar, but I think it tasted better than others in the same genre, like some soy bars. The strawberry flavor is pretty light, but it's there. I also liked the density and the texture. It's not gooey or dry and doesn't stick in your throat. It was also filling and energizing enough as a snack. I would have ranked this with five stars, but I can't picture myself buying it because it's so expensive for only 12 bars. If it was half the price, I would definitely buy this product.

This bar is like a healthy fig newton without the outer cookie part. That is the best way for me to describe the taste. This date and oat bar was better than expected. Sometimes these healthy bars are like eating grass, but this one had decent flavor. Also, this was pliable and easy to chew. My six-year-old son loved it and ate a whole one himself! Incidently, being six, he has loose front teeth. As he was eating one, he lost his tooth! We think he swallowed it! Yikes! He enjoyed the bar so much, he never noticed. Give it a try. It would be a great pick-me-up for hiking or snacks for vacation.

My family and I eat a lot of organic foods, and when I saw these Fruition snack bars, I was excited to try them, and offer them as a healthy alternative when my kids get hungry for a snack.  As with most of the other disappointed reviewers, I am not a fan of the Fruition Probars.  In theory, Probar came up with a great concept for a quick fix bar.  The ingredients list has mostly organic ingredients and foods that are good for you.  Organic date paste, organic rolled oats, organic brown rice syrup, strawberry puree, and chia seeds make up the bulk of the bar.  There are very few fillers or chemical ingredients added--things that I am trying to avoid in food products.  These would make an ideal snack, except the taste and texture of these bars is pretty unappealing, and despite the fact that these are healthy for you, it keeps me from wanting to eat them.As other reviews have pointed out, there is very little strawberry in the bar, and the overriding taste is date and mashed oats.  The bars themselves resemble a suet when you open the wrapper, and the texture in your mouth is like sticky, slightly hardened, pasty oatmeal.  The bars may be healthy, but the experience of eating the bars leave a lot to be desired.  They are visually unappealing, as my nine year old pointed out (and thus refused to try) and the texture in your mouth is not all that great either.  If you are using the bar as a meal replacement, or for a quick snack, you will be left wanting for something else, including a giant glass of water to wash it all down.  I think that Probar is on to something in trying to create a healthy organic snack bar alternative to what is on the market, they just need to figure out how to make it taste (and look) better.  I give the ingredients 4 stars and the taste of the bars 2 stars.

Confessedly I rarely to never eat health food (certainly not if it can be avoided), so the Fruitation strawberry bar met every one of my stereotype expectations: awkward taste, terrible consistency, and wholly unfulfilling.Light on strawberry and heavy on... dates, barley, and other unpallatables, this bar doesn't really deliver on its flavor promise.  Much worse though, it has the consistency of instant oatmeal that's been left out for 2 or 3 hours, then shaped into a bar - soggy and moist-ish, providing enough solid substance to chew against, but barely.I do give the bar props for the whole no-gluten, no-sugar thing, and again my view could be wildly skewed by my virgin innocence to health food stuffs.  For me, trying the Fruitation bar was a less-than-pleasant experience I shan't repeat.

I received the ProBar Fruition Bar in Strawberry flavor; the label said it's made with organic dates and oats. Each bar has 160 calories, 2 grams of fat, 4 grams of fiber, 22 grams of sugar and 3 grams of protein.The bar is 1.7oz, so pretty small, but I found that eating just one was satisfying enough. (I loved the wrapper - it just looked very fresh - but that's irrelevant) The ingredients were pretty straight forward with no confusing chemicals. Even though the bar was supposed to have a strawberry flavor, I could taste more of the dates and any strawberry flavor seemed artificial despite the fresh strawberry puree ingredient.The bar does not look very appetizing, but the taste is OK. Compared to many other nutrition bars out there, it wasn't overly chewy and did not leave a cardboard taste in my mouth. However, I think that 160 calories and ESPECIALLY the 22 grams of sugar is a little much for a tiny bar. If those 2 factors were balanced by more fiber and protein, I'd feel better about eating it. If you follow Weight Watchers, each bar is 3 points.

These bars have a pleasant strawberry smell, but little strawberry flavor.  Nor do they seem to have much strawberry in them.  I suspect the claim to their having two servings of fruit is based on the main ingredient, date paste.As far as nutrition goes, I prefer to have quantifiable nutrition in what I eat.  These bars contain no recognized vitamins whatsoever and small portions of only two minerals.  I suspect this is because the primary ingredient is fruit sugars.  On the plus side they do contain a lot of fiber and highly touted Chia seeds, which can't hurt.The taste was not bad at all, but I do't recommend eating it without something to wash it down.  I also did not find it very filling, despite all that fiber.

These dense, moist bars made mostly of date paste aren't pretty, but they offer a relatively healthy alternative as an on-the-go meal supplement or breakfast.  The bars are chewy, with a bit of seed crunch from black and white chia seeds.  They taste more of dates than strawberries; strawberry puree is fourth on the ingredient list, after date paste, rolled oats, and brown rice syrup. The cloying sweetness of dates simply overwhelms the berry flavor, although the strawberry taste and scent are there.  For me, that isn't a bad thing -- I like dates -- but people expecting a fresh, dominant strawberry taste will be disappointed.  The cashews cannot be easily detected in the flavor, either, although they add to the protein.With 22 grams of sugar, the bars aren't a good choice for people trying to limit sugar intake, although the modest 2 grams of fat (no saturated or trans fat) works for those who are on fat-restricted diets.  The primary nutritional benefit of the Fruition bars comes from the fiber (4 grams) and protein (3 grams), with antioxidants from the fruit, nuts, and whole grain oats.  They contain no vitamins and only a small amount of minerals (4% RDA of calcium and 6% RDA of iron.)  In fact, the complete absence of vitamin C suggests just how few strawberries each bar contains.Because these are vegan, they contain no dairy products -- no eggs, no milk, no butter, no whey.  They are the organic counterpart of the usual meal and sports bars, both in taste and texture.  If you don't like dense and chewy sports bars, you won't like these, but if you do and like the taste of dates, try these out.-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

there is a lot of sugar but mostly healthy ingredient but best of all, my three year old loves these healthy snacks. They have the consistence of a date bar, and since it is basically a date paste, that makes sense.  They are not "too" sweet, even though they have 22g of sugar. I think they are tasty, especially with a cup of coffee and are way better for you than a donut, at and 130 cal. a lot less fattening. They are pretty good size for a fruit bar and filling. I'd buy them again and recommend them.

This is my first 1 star review.....I can't believe I'm writing it.I wanted to like this bar.  But I couldn't. The texture of the bar is repulsive and there's very little real flavor.  The idea of an organic strawberry bar really appealed to me.  Until I took a big ol' bite of this bar...can you say gag reflex?Organic foods can taste good....this one doesn't. Pass on the ProBar Fruition.

column9: This tastes very healthy! And that's the problem...
column10: Organic, natural foods should taste great and be satisfying. While these bars are very healthy for you, they taste too grainy and heavy. Eating them makes one happy for trying to eat healthy foods, but they honestly do not taste that great and it's a bit of a chore to finish even one bar. I wish that there was more fruit flavor in the bars because the fiber taste seems to overtake the fruit flavor.

column9: Not much strawberry taste, mostly date
column10: After opening the package, I was surprised the unappetizing product was even edible. It's a dark mass of gooey nuts, oats, dates, strawberries and etc. Surprisingly enough the gooey product didn't adhere to your teeth and make you crave brushing your teeth right away.Tastewise, it was edible and kind of sweet, but it's not something I would pick up normally and eat as a snake. The only time I would eat such a snack would be if I had no other food and was hungry. The 160 calorie per bar is great, but I couldn't get much strawberry taste from it. The date taste was overpowering and does remind me of the fig newton bars.Both my husband and my 6 year old tried the bar, but immediately after taking a bite their faces cringed. While they could swallow it, they did not enjoy the taste whatsover.I'd recommend this to others who are extremely food conscious and can take the expense of these snacks.
