I was very disappointed with this batch.

I have a severe wheat allergy, so it was great to find a delicious pretzel I could eat!  Newman's Own has done a great job with these!  I buy them a case at a time and recommend them to everyone!  In fact, I use Spelt flour for everything!  Well worth the money!!

We love Newman's products...but Amazon lists this as 'wheat-free'.  The package ingredients label shows 'contains: Wheat'.  Not a big deal unless you have a wheat allergy...which by the way LOTS of people do.  Just thought I'd save you the hassle since food products aren't eligible for return.  As far as taste, my husband (not a pretzel fan) tried one and gave them a 3 out of 5....  'a little bland...need more salt.'
I purchaed these to keep at my for a quick snack... these are amazing.. crispy with just the right amount of salt... great price...
We love these pretzels.  Appreciate the long expiration date too.  Makes a great kids snack paired with nutella.  5 stars!

We buy the organic spelt pretzels by Newman's Own. This company sends them fast and so nicely - packed and separated in individual slots so they don't break or pop open. The pretzels themselves are yummy. Lately we've been dipping into different mustard flavors - a great snack! A good variety of non-salted ones mixed with some salty ones, a good balance. They taste better than your average pretzel on the market and they are healthier for you. I recommend the spelt pretzels!

column9: Need to know how long they are?  How many in each bag?
column10: These taste great, and when I got them very few were broken... on average one pretzel per bag was broken.  They are shorter than most pretzel rods, about 4 inches each.  I was making chocolate-dipped pretzels and was trying to figure out how many I could put in each gift bag, so I had my kids count how many there were per Newman's Own 8-Ounce bag.  There are about 40 pretzels per bag.  I ordered two cases trying to make sure I had enough, so hopefully this info will save someone from doing what I did--buying twice as much as needed.  Now we get to eat them.  :0)

I ordered a case of these pretzels to give away as snacks--I ordered it on Dec 17 and when it came, it had the "Use By Dec 27, 2011" date stamped on each bag. I'm not happy that they sent me "old" product that is nearing the end of its shelf life.

We love these pretzels. They taste like normal white pretzels to me. My whole family eats them--baby on up. I never bought pretzels before because they were made with white flour, and I was so thrilled to find these.

I purchased the High Protein Pretzels.  I've had Newman's Own Organic Pretzels before and they tasted great - but these are not good at all.  95% of the salt is at the bottom of the bag (have to have salt on pretzels!) and they have an overwhelming flavor of being burnt and not a good burnt either!  I have no use now for all these pretzels and i can't imagine anyone enjoying this taste!It is upsetting to see that a few others also ended up with the High Protein pretzels having this awful BURNT flavor and yet they still kept sending them out.  I'd think maybe they'd look at batch numbers or something to prevent them from being shipped out to dissatisfied customers who will give it a bad review.Generally Newman's Pretzels are really good, but buy these at your own risk....
Very good and a bonus for those trying to find fiber and protein.  helps with those midnight cravings and a reasonable price!

We try to avoid wheat here and there, so we love substituting with spelt.  These pretzels are great.  They've been a regular snack in our pantry for a couple of years now.  Taste just like "regular" pretzels, only much healthier!

Purchased these on sale around superbowl time when we go through lots of dips.  Normally buy locally, but the town was sold out and we try to be as organic as possible.  Family has mixed reviews about taste & texture.

At the office I am surrounded by hungry snackers when I pull out these pretzels! I even order them in bulk with of my co-workers.They have a slightly dry taste compared with conventional pretzels but the nutritional content can't be beat. I love feeding my body with the complete protein and fiber the chickpea and wheat combo provide. I have and will continue to order these yummy snacks!

Simply put these are great pretzels. High roasted flavor, though my cousin said it tasted burnt, and proceeded to eat more. Very crunchy without any hint that it is fortified with soy protein. Only issue with the product is that every few bags I get several oddly shaped pretzels which are thicker and crunchier which is actually a plus in my opinion. The best part is that they're both organic AND affordable! My favorite way to eat them is to pair them with a good quality chocolate for a sweet treat.
Everyone that comes to my house, I have these out for a snack and everyone loves them. These are amazing pretzels and taste so good. We love to eat them with goat cheese and other cheese's too.

column9: How can a pretzel taste this good?
column10: A pretzel is a pretzel right?  Wrong.  I was amazed at how these really taste better than any I have had before.  I think these are the best tasting pretzel rods you can get in a supermarket or here on amazon.The malt really makes a difference in the flavor.The diameter is perfect for dipping in mustard or eating plain, not too thin and not too thick.They have an even and sufficient coating of salt.They arrived undamaged and very fresh with high crunch factor, not at all stale.Mine were not burned like others have experienced with their orders.I have 12 bags and am happy to keep a supply in the pantry to put out for guests when they drop by; it makes it very easy to serve good food at a good price by buying in bulk on amazon.

column9: Burnt taste and shelf life short or used up
column10: I was excited about buying these in bulk at the special price Amazon was offering. However, when I received my case of 24 8 oz bags (purchased 2 sets), I was extremely disappointed to see a use by date of 1 month later.  Even more so, when I tasted them, and like a few others pointed out, they have a very distinct burnt taste.Pretzels last just about forever. Realizing these are organic would allow for a shorter shelf life, but the real issue is that the shelf life was used up before the sale. So, in short, these were essentially a waste of money as I had to coax people to take them away.

column9: Not so good & close to expiry
column10: These might be OK for hi-protein pretzels but they are not so good as pretzels, period. In addition, the bags I received will expire in less than 3 months. I am not pleased.

For Hi-Protein carb food, these pretzels are the best!  Crisp texture, and a nicely well cooked (burnt) flavor which brings out the best in a pretzel, you can't go wrong with these.  I like them better than any other pretzel I've have to date. If you think they are too salty, just rub the bag before opening and a lot of the salt falls off.  I'm on my second order :)
I agonized over what to put in my five year old's lunch.  I know she will actually eat these and they have a good amount of fiber (and even protein)!

Newman's Own Pretzels are by far the best I have ever had.  We can get their pretzel sticks at a local store but I always preferred rods and these are much better than Snyder's.  The fact that the ingredients list is short and sweet is just gravy.

These pretzels are pretty good. By accident I ordered 2 boxes and had a ton of them. The expiration date was June and I got them in March and was kinda nervous, but we are down to out last 2 bags...many of our friends have enjoyed them! They are very crunchy because they are very thin. They are not like a snyders if that's what your looking for.

Discovered these online and looked high and low for some that I would not have to buy a case.  Well I found them at Whole Foods, bought a bag - then I ended up ordering a case since I don't live near a WF & I wanted them to be my snack of choice. Anyway, my VERY picky 13 year old daughter really like them.  They really taste like pretzels not like the gluten-free/high protein ones. My only complaint, dare I say it is, they need more salt!  Even sesame seeds would be good they need a little something more.  I don't think I will order a case soon b/c that's a lot of pretzels(!) but am hoping the word gets out and health food stores close to me would start carrying them so I can buy just a bag or two.

didn't know what the diff was between the "sticks" and the the "rods" because when I was little (yes, I really was little... a long, long time ago) I used to go to the "candy store" and buy two pretzels or pretzel sticks, not knowing that what I was really buying was a pretzel rod....live and learn...Anyway, once I realized that I had bought these "mini-rods" I could get on with the taste testing. Testing good. Up to the Newman standards...and there is this completely illogical belief that having the exact same calories spread over three or four pieces instead of one large pretzel is more satisfying...bonus...

column9: Excellent product-feel good about my kids eating it...
column10: These are the thin style pretzels that are truly "thin" which is what my family likes.  Many "thin" pretzels are very thick.  The best thing about these is they are organic and a  Newman's Own product, which makes me feel good about my kids eating them.  I send them in their lunches to school and they love them.  Healthy snack and good price on Amazon.
I love a crunchy snack with some protein, they are a little dry though.  Dont tasta as good as a regular pretzel, but still good.

These are the best pretzels on the market today. We have been acquiring them for quite some time. They are crunchy, just the right about of salt and package size. However the most important attribute is their profits are provided to a charitable causes.

We had never eaten spelt before we ate these pretzels....We love them.  I love the fact that spelt has protein in it.  Typical pretzels have less nutritional value to them.  I feel good about giving them to my family.
I love the Newman's pretzels, both the wheat and the spelt versions.  Not too salty and very crisp.

column9: Real Super-thin Pretzel Twist Taste and Texture
column10: These have a taste and texture surprisingly close to my favorite brand of super-thin pretzel twists.  With the added benefit of only 1.5 grams of fat but 4 grams of fiber and 5 grams of protein.  I do wish they came in "serving" size packages instead, though.

I really enjoyed the Spelt Pretzels.  They were less chalky/dry than other pretzels and had a nice mildly nutty/buttery flavor.  The four (4) grams of fiber per serving were also an added plus.  I purchased these from a local grocery story for $3.79 for one (1) bag.

Newman's Own Organic Pretzels are far better than any other pretzel I've eaten. As most probably know, any product Newman's Own produces is superior to competitor brands. My favorite Newman's Own pretzel however is their Organic Spelt Flour Pretzel. Once you eaten them, no other pretzel compares. Unfortunaly, very few retail outlets carry Newman's Own Organic Spelt Pretzels. The only stores I've been able to find them is at the Whole Foods Grocery Chain. There are not many Whole Foods around, but it worth the trip.

I love the shape and taste of mini pretzels like these but don't like the flavor of wheat - so this is the perfect solution. Light on salt, baked just to perfection, with the slightly nutty taste of spelt. They don't overpower anything else I'm eating or drinking, very well balanced. Thanks Newmans' Own, another winner!

I bought these for my husband for healthy snacking in the evening,and they are great! High in fiber and protein, but low in calories per serving.  Even my 5 year old (who does not eat anything!)will eat these pretzels.They are crispy, and slightly nutty tasting. I will always have a case on hand.

I finally found a delectable little pretzel!  Not too big, not too salty, not too dry, never a burnt taste, just right for MY tasty taste buds! You ought to try Newman's Own Organics Spelt Pretzzels! Nell Newman really came up a winner with these! Snacking or dipping...they are GREAT! jpg/UT

In my search for healthy snacks I found this item: Organic, high in fiber, low in fat and they use sea salt. They sound like they should be boring, but they are just as good if not better than any pretzel out there.I can eat 20 of them for only 2 points on my Weight Watchers program and that is a whole lot more than other snacks. They're very filling with a piece of cheese or two which is extremely important when watching what you are eatting!I highly recommend them to anyone!
These pretzels are absolutely delicious!  I did not notice the excess salt or burnt flavor some other people experienced - we loved them!
Good;, healthy snack for those parents seeking alternatives for the junk food their kids think they want.

column9: I've liked every kind that I've tried
column10: My latest purchase was the Honey Wheat variety, but I've had the Hi-Protein and Spelt varieties in the past.  I have really enjoyed all three of them.The Honey Wheat have a good taste and crunch.  It took me about five pretzels to get used to them as compared to "normal" pretzels, but then I really got into them.  I like the taste, but I also like the ingredients and nutrition.  The following can be found on the web, but I'm adding it here for convenience:Ingredients:  Organic unbleached wheat flour, organic whole wheat flour, organic honey, organic sugar, organic sunflower oil, salt, yeast, soda.Nutritional Facts:  Serving Size: 20 pretzels (30g), Calories per Serving: 110, Calories from fat: 10, Total Fat: 1g (saturated fat: 0g), Cholesterol: 0mg, Sodium: 180mg, Total Carbohydrates: 22g (dietary fiber: 3g, sugars: 2g), Protein: 2gSome typical advice - watch for sales on these!  I got the Honey Wheat 7-oz bags, 12-pack for twelve dollars in October 2010 (the price is why I decided to try them).  As of this writing, they are almost sixty dollars.  At a dollar a bag, I'll recommend them to everyone.  At five dollars a bag...all I can say is that I wouldn't pay that much for these, or any pretzel in a 7-oz bag.
Everyone loved these pretzels. Very flavorful, not too salty. I plan on buying more from Amazon, best price I've found on this brand.

column9: DOUBLED IN PRICE WITHIN A COUPLE OF WEEKS
column10: The pretzels are tasty and convenient, but I can't give them a higher rating due to the extreme jump in price (nearly double the price it was a couple of weeks ago when I made the purchase-around $17). Due to this, I assume the previous great reviews are based on the former price. Now I can pick these up at my local Grocery for close to the same price per bag, which defeats the purchase of buying in bulk online.
We did not receive our order.  We were informed that it was shipped and then (ONLY)a couple of days later we were informed that it could not be delivered by the shipper.

These were "stale" dated when I got them but I must admit that they taste pretty good, WAY better than any overly salted Snyders or especially-slated Rold Gold (or Rold Salt).  Very well done, Paul, we will miss you in all aspects.

I like sardines, particularly sardines smoked and packed in olive oil. Sardines are available without being smoked, in a ketchup sauce, in mustard, and packed in a non-descript vegetable oil.Reese's have proven, over the last several years, to be a consistently high quality product. They fare well, even when placed against the best of competing brands like King Oscar.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: When I saw that someone had brought in some of this coffee for us at work (along with a shiny, beautiful new Keurig machine), I was pretty eager to try this, even more so after I realized that it was coffee and not a cider. (And therefore "safe" for my diet.)I have to say that I'm more than mildly disappointed by this. As just a regular basic cup of coffee it's not bad, but you don't really get that much of an apple or caramel flavor here, let alone a mixture of the two. It's really just the lightest of flavors, which will disappoint anyone looking for a more pronounced taste. This is very much in opposition to other Keurig cup flavors such as the pumpkin spice cup where you can really taste the spice. (I know it's by different people, but this is more to highlight that it is possible to put more flavor in the coffee.)I've waffled between 2-3 stars and finally settled on 3 because while the flavor is barely there, it's still a decent cup of coffee. It's just that if you're buying a whole pack of this specifically because you want the taste of an apple caramel pie without the calories, you're not really going to find this here. It's something that I wouldn't be upset to find in a pack with other coffee cups, but it's not anything that I'd go out of my way to purchase by itself.

column9: Tastes fine, but not very caramel apple-y
column10: This wasn't bad for coffee, but the flavor isn't very strong.  If you add enough sweetener, it brings up the flavor, but if you're not a fan of sweet coffee (like me), then it's maybe not the best choice.

Our family loves this gum.  We've tried other brands of xylitol gum and found this to be the best.  The flavor is very nice, although it doesn't last as long as some commercial brands, the flavor is good and your mouth is left feeling clean and fresh even after the flavor is gone.  Also it does NOT dissolve away while you're chewing it - like some other brands.  We're glad we found it.

I used nicorette to quit smoking and I used gum to quit nicorette...regular gum has a bunch of things I can't pronounce in the name that gave me headaches (because I chew a lot) so I had to go to a natural gum with no sugar (sugar is bad) :)....this gum is great and all natural...not sure if Xylitol really does help your teeth or not...but as a far as natural sugar free gum goes this does trick...highly recommended....

500 pcs * 1.5 gm = 750 gm = 0.75 kg = 1.65 lb500 pcs * 1.0 gm = 500 gm = 0.50 kg = 1.1 lb xylitolSweetener in this gum is apparently 100% xylitol, as opposed to Trident "sugarless" "with xylitol" where I can not find any explicit indication, but probably has far less Xylitol, and perhaps much more aspartame.It seems that simply holding 1/2 teaspoon of xylitol in the mouth as long as possible leads to far higher peak concentration of xylitol to saturate those bacteria, holding far longer than chewing gum, as I can't stop swallowing when chewing these small chewing gum, such that peak concentration of xylitol is far lower in mouth with gum.

column9: Best aspartame free gum I've tried!
column10: I am very happy with the taste and texture of this gum.  Traditionally, aspartame-free gums suffer from their flavors not lasting very long.  I have tried Glee Gum and Xyloburst and I must say that I like Xyloburst much more than Glee gum!  The flavor still doesn't last as long as those poison-filled gums, but Xyloburst lasts longer than glee and I think tastes a little bit better too.  If your trying to decide which aspartame-free gum to try first, I would recommend Xyloburst! I am giving it 4 stars because someone still needs to eventually figure out how to make gum flavors last a bit longer without adding poisons.

I have used this since it came out and as the sole iced tea drinker in my family I find it very handy. I can use a couple of these bags in a small pitcher and have tea when I want it all day. The flavor is excellent and will not leave you as nervous when you're off on a real tea bender. Often, for my sweetener I use Splenda and peach syrup half and half. Or try it sweetened your way and use 1/2 of an orange and 1/2 of a lemon. The possibilities are endless.

Lipton Cold Brew Glass Size, 44 Tea Bags (Pack of 6)My friend can only have unflavored non-sweetened iced tea.She was frustrated that the single serving bags were no longer in the grocery stores,so I decided to surprise her and buy a case.She was so happy.She carries them in her bag and also uses for work.Thanks

I like plain (no sweetner, no lemon) iced tea.  This tasts just like actual brewed tea to me.  Much better than instant tea.  Only down side is finding stores that carry it.  It "disappeared" from a shared cottage, so I have to buy some more!-----3 years later, I still like this, getting low on supplies, so I'm ordering more!
Cold Brew is the best tea ever!  It is smooth and wonderful, no bitterness whatsoever!  I highly recommend that you try it!Quick and easy!
If you are looking for a fantastic glass of iced tea WITHOUT the fuss, this product is for you! Just add water, your favorite sweetner, and enjoy!

I'm the only iced tea drinker in my house, so I was excited to find this product. The first couple of times I tried it, I used the recommended one teabag in the time suggested, dunking it several times. The result was weak, weak, weak tea. In order to get a flavor noticeably above plain water, I need to use 2 teabags. Then it's great! In the long run, like most convenience products, it's not very economical, and you'd do better making an entire pitcher of sun tea or hot brewed tea.

I've been so frustrated because I've been using these tea bags for some time and suddenly I couldn't find them in stores.  It's such a great product, I can't believe lack of interest by customers.  So one day I had a flash and went to Amazon.  I found my tea bags and mass ordered them so I wouldn't have to worry about it.  I love them.

This definitely is not as good as brewing a fresh pot of tea, but it is very convenient for on the go. I use it at work where we have a cold water cooler, and use two tea bags in a 20 oz cold cup. Works perfect, tastes good, and brews quick!

I have been drinking iced tea my entire life. My family came from the south, but this California girl learned to drink iced tea 24/7 year round.  When I discovered the cold brew like ten years ago, I fell in love! Not only do you not have to wait and brew tea, but put one in an ice cold bottle of water, and you dont even need the ice!Someone once pointed out to me that there is less caffeine in each serving of this tea, and it seems to help the tummy issues I have gotten over the years. I actually use these tea bags every day, in every glass of tea I drink. It makes the perfect serving of tea every time, and again, I dont need to fool around with actually brewing tea. This is a staple in my life, the ease of use makes it practical to put a couple in my purse that I use in restaurants, or put in a bottled water when I am out.One word of caution, if you put a tea bag in a glass filled with ice and water, it will take up to ten minutes to brew...so, if you are at a restaurant, get your glass of ice water first thing!My greatest dream, would be for Lipton to put a bit of dried lemon peel in the tea bags...now that would make the PERFECT glass of tea!!!
you cant go wrong with these.. and this is sooo muchcheaper than starbucks!!!Thank you.
I am completely hooked on Lipton's glass size cold brew tea bags. The small tea bags can stay in your glass of tea all day and never leak leaves like the big tea bags.  Thank you Lipton!

column9: I love Cold Brew Lipton Ice Tea
column10: I love Cold Brew Lipton Ice Tea in the individual tea bags.  It's clean and refreshing. The sweetened teas leave my stomach unsettled and makes me jittery.  The individual tea bags are convenient for work, trips, camping.  I like to stick a bag in a water bottle for a walk.  Can't live without it.  Wish it came in caffeine free so I could drink it all day.

Can't find it in stores any more and it works great for me. I can have a glass of tea any time with out having to heat water. It's fast and about 10 cents a glass as comparied to $2 at a local establishment.

This stuff is great!!! No powder to worry about, and the flavor is just like BREWED iced tea, without all the hassle...I carry a few in my purse at all times; just in case.  I've already gotten a few friends hooked on this product, the flavor and convenience are great, I especially like that there is no "powder" taste like with some other products of this nature...

I'm surprised at the high ratings of this tea. Maybe the people rating it don't really like tea? This stuff tastes like water with a little tea added. I tried using 2 bags per serving which helped but it was still too weak. I LOVE tea and to get a really good tea taste I'm afraid I would have to double the strength with these. I'm giving it an extra star for convenience.

I toss one of these bags in my water bottle each morning and add water throughout the day.  Perfect for the iceteaholic like me.  :)  I was having trouble finding it at the local grocery store, so now I have a 6 month ++ supply!

column9: Price went up 5$ in one day
column10: I like the product, but I didn't like putting the product in my cart one day and the very next day the price had went up 5$ (I almost didn't buy it).

I  have  bought  many  cases of  this  before i  dcided  to  check  on the  internet  for it...My  son is in  Iraq and  he  loves  the  cold  brew  to  put in  his  water  along  with a little  sweetener and  he  get  the  delicious  taste  of  brewed  tea...I  also  asked  lipton  to  donate a  case  to me  so i  could  send it to  my  son and  of  course  they  could not ...I  will  continue  to  buy  it  for  him  though  it is  one  enjoyment  he  gets  over  there...  I  myself  started  using it  when i  worked  in the  factory 3rd  shift and  wanted  the glas  of  tea  without having a place to  keep it  by  the  jug  ...Thank  you  Lipton  is  is  the  best

I got this almonds for my daughters wedding candy buffet and they look as beautiful as in the picture and they taste so good, there pricey but they are worth it I mixed them with ivory color almonds and it looks just stunning .Now you have to be careful with what almonds you order this are eatable theres some that they been sold cheaper and they are not eatable so be careful . Also theres some that they just have a gold wrapping . But this ones are eatable and they have the gold finish shiny coat . This are the ones if you are looking for beautiful gold almonds .Thank You

I purchased these as "cupcake toppers" for some "Dead Velvet" cupcakes I was making for a zombie themed party. Most of the body parts that were gummy were melted and it was hard to distinguish what they actually were. Not all the body parts in here are gummy. The "teeth" are hard sugar candy. The parts that are gummy aren't very evenly distrubuted and my pack had a TON of feet, hardly any brains and some "sticks" that looked like they should be fingers. I only needed 24 so I found the best and trashed the rest ... Next year I will be looking for something better.

I agree with Shelley's review. Many of the gummy pieces were melted into an unrecognizable mess. About half of the box is unusable. Also, the taste is lacking... texture is very hard and difficult to chew.

These gummies would have been very good except for the fact that over half the box was melted by the time they got to me. I don't know if they sat on a hot tarmac in Dallas, or if they were melted before they left the store. Unfortunately, it was too late to send them back because I had ordered them for a Halloween party. For the price, I really expected more. Since I ordered two boxes, I was able to get enough unmelted gummies for the party, but the rest were just a gross mess. Since the point of the candy is that it looks like a body part, it was very disappointing to have over half the product melted in a gooey, unrecognizable mess.

I actually bought a small bag of these last year from a grocery store. I fell in love with this candy! It looks scary enough and still TASTES AMAZING! I was so excited to find this on amazon and at such a good deal! The bag I bought last year had only 20 pieces or so and was a little pricey, but I bought it to go with my themed Halloween party. But this pack here has 90 and was a waayyyy better price! So awesome!

I've bought this product at the local markets for years, but they recently made it a Holiday 'seasonal' item only.  So I bought it through Amazon.  I still like the product, the the case I got was OLD.  The powder mix was largely solid (had lost moisture) and several bags had cracks and product loss.  I'm guessing it was just a fluke thing - but when you order, you do get a case of the stuff.  A bit disappointing.
I was so happy to see that I could get this drink from Amazon. I do not drink coffee or tea and this is a great drink on a chilly morning or evening.

I love Alpine Spiced Cider,as do several of my co-workers.  I have been drinking it for a number of years.  In the fall of the year one can generally find the product in a local market, however in off seasons the markets just don't stock it.  Since there are a number of us who enjoy the Cider, we have begun taking turns buying it and it is very convenient to purchase it through Amazon.com.  By getting a couple of boxes of the 12 packs, we get a fair price and also enjoy free shipping...so why run around - let it come to you.  Enjoy it Alpine Spiced Cider Apple Flavor Drink Mix, 10-Count, 7.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)year round.
This is a really good apple flavored drink. It disolves well in hot liquid. I have it on automatic shipments so Im never with out it.
My husband loves this stuff.  We moved from Colorado to Virginia and couldn't find anywhere to buy this so I looked to Amazon. Yay, it was here!  Have always loved and and will continue to buy.

I love the taste of this drink! I usually only use half of a packet for a normal sized mug as the flavor is very strong. This is the perfect non-caffeinated drink and it has vitamin C! I didn't care for the product cold, but hot is great! It always dissolves completely with a little stirring unlike other products that leave powder clumps at the bottom of my mug.
I drank this back years ago and then could not find it. I was pleasently surprised when I saw it on Amazon.com. It still the best Spiced Apple Cider I've tasted and the price was great.

column9: Just right on a cold night
column10: I LOVE this hot cider mix!  Because chocolate triggers migraines for me, I can't enjoy a mug of hot chocolate when it gets cold.  This does the trick to warm me up.  My daughter also enjoys taking this to school in her insulated cup on chilly mornings.

column9: I love this cider ...and the Ligthening Speed Shipping
column10: I ordered my Autum supply of Alpine Apple Cider on SUNDAY afternoon...received it on MONDAY morning!  I have Amazon Prime and love the 2-day shipping, love it even more when I get stuff in less than 24 hours!I am already enjoying this cider, I am really glad I can get it on Amazon because it's become really scarce at grocery stores and it is super convenient and cost effective to get it via Amazon

column9: Product great, problem, two were open
column10: I love being on the automatic sending of this product, It saves me in shipping. I always end out ordering it early. Its extremely economical. Amazon has great customer service that you can't beat anywhere. My only issue is once in a great while you will get a box that has an open packet, but with the money you save on shipping etc. Its well worth it.
Best Cider mix ever! Have loved it since I was a little kid. They got it shipped out quickly as well.

column9: Good Drink Mix with some packages not well sealed
column10: The product is what I expected (I had tested it before), though Some of the packages were not perfectly closed, there was product in the seal area and in the box (out of the packages) as well.

column9: Balance of Sweet, Tart and a Hint of Spice
column10: Alpine Spiced Cider is a great instant cider blend. Many quick, powdered drinks are one-note, but this one isn't. It manages to be both sweet and tart like real apple cider, and has just a hint of cinnamon and mulled spice in the background. During long, cold winters, it's so nice to have a fast treat like this cider to help warm you up inside.Because these have a good amount of Vitamin C, they are also excellent for the inevitable winter colds. On those horrible days when even opening and heating a can of chicken soup seems too hard, all you have to do is switch your electric kettle to on, dump the packet into a cup and you're good to go. Maybe a cup of apple cider a day can even keep the doctor away, who knows?Overall, I recommend the Alpine Spiced Cider Drink Mixes as a quick and easy way to enjoy a hot beverage. It won't be as authentic as homemade cider, but it won't be a hassle to prepare either.

I've ordered the original and the sugar free, and they are both delicious. There are 120 packets here so they will last for a long while. Great deal! Nothing better on a cold winter morning then a hot cup of Apple Cider!
good, right product, but one of the packets of cider mix wasnt sealed properly when made so the mix leaked out

column9: Utz Barrel of Sourdough Pretzel Nuggets
column10: I was very disappointed with my order. The first thing, I did not receive the complete order. When I called , they said they could not help me. I only received only one Barrel of Pretzels. Second the one Barrel i did received looked just awful.I do not even want to open it. I am a Pretzel Lover, and Utz is one of my Favorites. I do not know what happened, but I will never buy this item again through Amazon. I am even concerned about ordering any Food item through Amazon.I have ordered many items through Amazon and I never had a problem until now. It was just disappointed that Amazon did not help me...
All 5 bottles of pretzel are fresh from the factory!!! Each time the nuggets breaks down inside of mouth and brings nice roasted flavor  I experience my happiness ;-D

Found these on a trip to London and had them each morning for breakfast--(saved on high cost of meals there)and nighttime snack.  Though high in fat content, they are delicious!  Only occasionally do I find them in US markets.

I think the McVities with chocolate is by far the best tea snack.  My only dislike is that during shipping, they get a little bumped around.  if you don't mind some crumbs as you open the package, this is a good choice.

column9: Great tasting coffee, awful price from Amazon
column10: Usually when I drink coffee I brew at home (flavored and non-flavored), I am compelled to add a good amount of cream and sugar in order to enjoy it. This coffee, however, is different. I actually drink it black and truly enjoy the flavor! It has a phenomenal aroma that lasts for the duration of the bag. Amazon, however, is charging too much for New England Coffee. It is 30% cheaper at the grocery store when the grocery store doesn't have it on sale (Amazon = $10/bag, Grocery = $7/bag), and 50% cheaper when it is on sale ($5/bag).

Received item very quickly. I didn't try it until just lately for grilling season. Mixed it with a few other spices to make a rub for steaks ... oh so good. I have used other cheaper smoked hickory salts ... this has much more flavor. I just used it on Steel Head trout with some butter and garlic and dash of lemon ... mmmm good.

These mango slices are just the most lovely, tasty and healthy ever! They are less yellow than the photo represents. But, that is only to be expected in non-sulfured and organic dried fruits. They are also without the additional added sugar of all other types of dried mangoes. These slices are naturally sweet and have a lovely chewy and easy to consume texture.The lack of the sulfur and added sugar reveals the fresh, subtle and delightful taste of a "real" mango. I found myself gorging on these and had to restrain myself, in order to prevent their disappearance on the day of their arrival in my home. Eat these as they are, grind them with pineapple and banana to make a delightful and fresh-tasting Smoothie. Alternatively- add chopped bits of the dried mangoes to your baking, as with scones, gingerbread cake, or healthful cookies. You won't be disappointed with these lovely slices of dried mango.They are expensive, but well worth the price, especially considering all of their healthy contributions to your daily diet. The shipper was responsive, the slices were very well-packaged and arrived far in advance ot their estimated date of delivery. This is a no-brainer! I highly recommend these mango slices to one and all.

I love dried mango when it hasn't been spoiled with added sugar.  However it's somewhat expensive so I thought I'd try buying in bulk online.  The actual product looks somewhat darker than the example picture, and the quality is not quite as consistent as what I can get at my local WholeFoods.  I estimate that 90-95% of the dried mango tasted excellent, however 5-10% was dry and brittle, and lacked sweetness.If you can't obtain good dried organic mango locally this a good deal, but think I'll pay the extra $5 and get it from WholeFoods since there I can also select which pieces I want.

column9: Best way to make low carb eggnog
column10: Why no large commercial dairy has come up with a low carb, sugar-free eggnog had me stumped. (still does - plenty of diabetics in America). There may be some out there, but not in my grocery store in Houston, Texas.  This syrup along with whole milk, half and half and heavy whipping cream made the closest to "easy" store-bought eggnog I found.  I didn't want to use raw eggs and splenda, so this was a great alternative.  Topped with nutmeg, it was good enough to satisfy the Holiday craving.

This stuff is nice and sparkly and is probably the same stuff that Dean & Deluca has.  I don't know what the heck I am going to do with this much hot pink sugar, but when the time comes, I will be ready!

column9: Pillsbury Sugar Free Chocolate and Vanilla Cakes & sugar free frosting
column10: I tried both the Pillsbury Sugar Free Vanilla and Chocolate Cakes for thefirst time several weeks ago.  They are both outstanding products.  Myhusband is a diabetic and was able to eat these cakes without a negativeresponse in sugar levels.  I also used the Pillsbury Sugar Free VanillaFrosting with no negative results.  I served the Chocolate Cake frostedat a very elegant dinner party and received rave reviews from the peoplewho attended.  I did add a teaspoon of real vanilla extract to both mixes toenhance the vanilla flavor. My guests were unaware they were eating sugar free.Both cakes rose to a remarkable level; frosted easily and stayed moist for several days.  The crumb was the very same as I would expect from any goodcake mix.The vanilla sugar free frosting was a bit hard to spread eventhough it wasat room temperature.  I popped it into the microwave covered for 20 secondsand that solved my problem regarding spreading the frosting.  I will use theseproducts regularly.

The cake had a weak chocolate flavor. I was disappointed.  I did get compliments on it.  But I think that was because I did use Pillsbury Chocolate Fudge Frosting, and it was really good.  It made up for the weak flavor in the cake.I bought the cake mix because it was cheaper than Duncan Hines but I will go back to Duncan Hines for cake mix, but I will continue to use PILLSBURY CHOCOLATE FUDGE FROSTING. IT WAS EXCELLENT.

I found this at our local grocer ( at a fraction of the price here ) labeled as a fruit spread ( not fruit conserv ). It has lots of strawberry pulp, seeds, etc. and is not overly sweet. The best tasting spread I've found so far.

My wife and I are runners and all around athletes. I bought these after seeing Ryan Hall rave about them on his blog. Here are a few thoughts.They may seem expensive, but what I found is that they are so filling, we don't have to eat much. We make 3 servings per meal (I usually eat 2 and my wife 1). This is 1 cup which is about a 1/7 of the box. That meal ends up being about $0.75 for the two of us! Also, most pancakes usually have tons of calories, I can eat two servings, be comfortably full and only have eaten 260 calories. That's amazing!They are very quick to make. We have only made pancakes so far, but it only takes about 20 seconds of whisking. How easy is that?As for taste, I'm not AMAZED but they are good. They are boarder-line bland, so I put a little butter spray on them. We often mix them with fruit. However, for wholegrain... I'd say they are excellent. We've started mixing in protein powder and that has the potential to improve the taste depending on the protein you use.Healthy, cheap, easy, tasty, hearty... what more do you want?

This waffle mix is delicious - the only thing I would change is adding a little melted butter to the batter to help it release from the waffle iron a little easier. (I've sprayed PAM, but a combo of spray and butter works perfectly.)

Nothing else even comes close to the taste and quality of this mix. One of the few traditions we have around here is waffles on the weekends w/ berries and whipped cream, and while there have been incremental improvements to the idea over time, such as using home-made whipped cream and organic, locally grown berries, trying this product was a game changer. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a little more from their breakfast and even follow them on facebook for recipe ideas and general product updates.

This mix makes the most delicious pancakes. I've been using this product for several years and am still incredulous it only needs water! The local supermarket stopped carrying it because of price but now Amazon has it for a very reasonable price for the quality, especially on its Super-Saver plan.It is also delicious if you mix it 50-50 with the whole grain mix from Heidi's Rainy Day Pancakes that has that wonderful flax seed taste.

THE MIX:I really like the taste of this pancake/waffle mix and it's whole wheat which is much healthier than most of the mixes I see in the markets that are just white flour.  I've had trouble finding a whole wheat mix I like but was not disappointed here.  My little one is a picky eater and she likes it too.THIS SELLER:Really fast shipping, I was very impressed.  I'm in CA, not sure if that matters.  Expiration date was 11 months from date of arrival.  This is same as when I buy it in the store so I was very pleased with that as well.  Overall extremely satisfied.

This pancake mix is excellent, if you are looking for a wheat pancake, that is light and fluffy, look no further. The combination of wheat and oat flour, makes this pancake mix, one of the best! I gifted Kodiak Cakes Mix, this past Christmas, with a wooden spoon & spatula...there were smiles all around.

Found this in the grocery store while looking for a healthy (read: no artificials, has whole grain) mix for the kids.  It was so easy and so good that it's the only mix we use.  Heck, we use it to make cookies too at times.I'll never use another product.  They taste great, and they also have an oat & honey version of the flapjack mix that adds some variety.Also, as others have noted while they are a little more expensive, we use less and any extras are used for snacks on trips to the zoo, etc.I also like that it's just a 50/50 ratio of mix & water, so they are a breeze to make either for flapjacks or waffles, though I tend to make it a little thinner for pancakes.

There always seems to be something weird about every pancake mix I try. But these just have the best taste, they're perfect pancakes. I've tried a few cheaper brands but I always come back to this.I think it says to mix 2 cups of water with the powder for the serving size I make, but I do one cup, and then the other cup I replace with an egg and some milk. (One cup's worth, together.) Very rich and delicious.I haven't tried waffles yet, but I just got a waffle iron and I am very confident they'll be amazing.

I moved to an area where Trader Joe's is more than an hour away and none of our local stores carry this mix. So I was more than happy to buy it in bulk from Amazon! Check out the ingredient list, you can't go wrong. This is hands-down the best tasting pancake mix I have ever used, and it's healthy!
Great product  Love this pancke mix.  I am happy to have found it at Amazon.  It is great for thin pancakes i just add 1/4 cup additional water.

We started eating healthier about 9 years, and a major part of this was eating only 100% whole grains.  I was just making whole wheat pancakes from scratch until I found these, and I never went back to home made.  If you are used to Bisquick and that's what you like then these might be a change for you, but for me I couldn't tell these were 100% whole grain.  We camp quite a bit and I loved that I finally found a 100% whole grain pancake mix that was good, low in sugar, and most of all that all I had to do was add water, even better is that it is a 1 to 1 ratio on the mix to water so you don't need measuring cups while camping.  There are some good recipes I use this mix in, one was the apple spice cake which I now can no longer find one Kodiak Cake's website, maybe they'll repost it.  I tried their blueberry muffin recipe, not bad for a 100% whole grain muffin lower in sugar and fat, my daughters loved them, so...  We eat these quite often for breakfast and I don't feel bad that the girls eat them, they have a lot of fiber and except for a little bit of honey in them are a whole food.  I highly recommend this pancake mix!

My husband and I were introduced to Kodiak Cakes on two week trip to Alaska.  Ata hotel breakfast we were served these fantastic waffles and syrup. The chef smiled conspiratorily and told me that I could get them in certain lower 48 stores.  On return home, I could not find them in stores, so I tried on line.That was the beginning of a beautiful relationship.  We buy them by the case. We leave the waffles in a little extra time to make sure the outside is crispy, and to bring out the nutty oatsy flavor.  I also use the three delicious syrups, but my favorite is Marionberry.  We have had these delights every Sunday for nine years.

I grew up eating homemake pancakes from scratch every Saturday and haven't been great about contenting this tradition with my children - until now!!! I recently was turned on to Kodiak Cakes from a relative. Not only are they healthy (whole grains and no fillers!) but they taste unbelievable. All my children love them (even the baby) and the fact that they don't' require anything but water makes them easy enough to do on school mornings. I also love the exact directions as now I finally don't burn pancakes. This would be a fantastic item to bring camping or RVing as they are easy and don't require milk or eggs.You will not be disappointed.

column9: Quick, tasty, healthy! Our favorite breakfast!
column10: My husband and I LOVE these! We picked this up at Fresh Market one day, and wow, we've been hooked for several months now. I make the pancakes (haven't made waffles with this mix) every Saturday, or at least every other Saturday. To feed my husband and myself, we use one cup of the batter and mix it with one cup of water (as per the directions). Too easy. I've made them plain and with blueberries. I love that I can sign up for the subscribe and save with these, so I never run out.***To make blueberry pancakes, I buy frozen organic blueberries (so I have them on hand at all times), thaw them in the microwave, pour my batter onto the griddle, and then drop the thawed blueberries onto the top side of the pancakes before I flip them. What you get are delicious blueberry pancakes without the blue batter and smashed blueberries.

My sister LOVES pancakes (the way I LOVE pizza).  We were looking for a healthier pancake mix when we came across this product.  We tried it and LOVED it.  And now we love it even more at the AMAZING price we can purchase it on this site.  We got creative w/it and mix about 1-2 tablespoons plain pumpkin (lessen the water a bit), a dash of pumpkin spice, and package sweetner for the BEST pumpkin pancakes ever.  We're thinking about adding a little applesauce and maybe some chopped apples...with your creativity, the possibilities are endless.  I probably wouldn't make chocolate pancakes because then I might be eating them all day long!

column9: Really good mix - is fun to change it up a bit
column10: This Kodiak pancake mix is great for waffles.  I prefer to add in either flavoring, chocolate chips, or small pieces of nuts to the mix for a great variety.  I'm pleased with the texture of the Kodiak mix.  It cooks up well too with a nice color and crispness in my Belgian Waffle Iron.  I haven't tried pancakes with it but I am sure it would be just as tasty!  I'm especially happy that all you need to add is water - makes the mix even more cost efficient.

Just add water and you have a tasty nutritous breakfast. We can taste the grain, yet it's very light and filling. I was just browsing through the grocery section and stumbled on this item. It is a very pleasant surprise, Even if you don't usually like whole grain wheat or oats (like me) its great. Only 2 grams of sugar.
Kodiak Frontier Flapjack and Waffle Mix is the best mix you could ever have.It is very healthy, easy to mix and they melt in your mouth.  We will never (I hope)use another brand.
This is an excellent product. A five year old could prepare it and it tastes great! I will certainly purchase it again. By the way, I also love the name and the packaging!!

Found this item on our local Fred Meyer on sale for $4.00 - regularly $6.50.  This has got to be the best box mix pancakes we have ever had.  So good I went back to FM to get two more boxes before they sold out.
They are the best, that's all that can be said. if you like the doughy, creamy type of pancake, rather than the light and fluffy.

Having started cooking before age 12, I've even had the chance to cook professionally in my 55 years of life. Pancakes and other breakfast foods have always been one of my favorites. Even made from scratch with the best ingredients, it's hard to match this mix. I no longer bother with any other brand. These days, I eat Kodiak flapjacks almost daily, and I never get tired of them.

For the past 5 years, my husband has been experimenting with making whole grain pancakes. He is constantly trying new whole grain pancake mixes out on the family. We were visiting some friends in Brooklyn when he discovered the Kodiak Cakes at a small deli. He bought the box and made them for us and we couldn't believe how amazing these whole grain pancakes are. They are super tasty and made with amazing ingredients. Hands down the best whole grain pancake mix I have ever had. We bought 12 boxes to start giving away as gifts when we go to someone's house (instead of giving a bottle of wine)!

My 19 grandchildren LOVE these pancakes and waffles.  They insist on having them whenever they come over so I had to subscribe to always have them on hand.  I like the complete mix that only needs water so I can easily make a few or a lot easily.  I Like, as well, the fact that the ingredients are all natural and healthy without added fats or sugars.  Good stuff!

I have purchased this item for many years in the grocery stores, which has been hard to find and the price is almost doubled to the Amazon price.  I have purchased directly from the company, but had trouble with delivery and communication.  I love this product.  We all love this product.  I have given it away to many friends and one came back with the Amazon site and price.  This will be my second order in a bit over a month because I gave quite a few boxes of this product in a gift-basket for the holidays.  It was well received and reviewed.  It is delicious, but most of all I am a diabetic and the whole grain mix is allowed.Kodiak Cakes Frontier Flapjack & Waffle Mix, 24-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

If you enjoy living a healthy lifestyle by choosing the right foods this is right down your alley. I am a health nut and this whole grain panake and waffle mix allows me to still enjoy those Saturday morning pancake breakfasts without falling off the wagon and feeling bogged down by carbs. One cup of water, that's all you need! One cup of water and one cup of mix makes around 4-5 pancakes or one large waffle :)

I've been buying this for years at local grocery but at a much higher price.  If you're looking for a healthy alternative to bleached white flour chemical pancakes you should try these.  They're super easy to prepare, nothing but wholesome ingredients, and actually taste good!  Makes good waffles too.  Once you try them you'll never go back.

These are hands down the best pancakes ever. I am so sad my grocery doesn't have them anymore. They are incredible. I will have to buy online it seems. Anyone who doesn't like the gut bomb feeling of a pancake should try these, you will be surprised at the way you feel after you eat them. You feel great, and they are so much better in texture and flavor than any other mix, and better than the pancakes I've made from scratch from several recipes. Give them a try!

Kodiak Cakes Frontier Flapjack & Waffle Mix is the PERFECT breakfast indulgence!  I can have the pancakes or waffles I crave, without the guilt of feeling that I've just blown my healthy diet in one small meal!!  Every member of my family thoroughly enjoys this product, and as a mom, I know it's actually good for them to eat while being amazingly delicous!

These flapjacks mix so nicely. I love that they are whole grain but taste as decadent as any. It's also great that I can turn to these when I don't have milk or eggs in the house. Terrific for camping too. Love them.

column9: Quick and easy waffles (and healthy, too!)
column10: I picked up a box of this waffle mix at our local Target store recently.  My husband is a waffle afficionado and we usually get waffle mix from Williams & Sonoma and/or Bouchon Bakery, but I can't often bring myself to pay $12+ for waffle mix or wait two hours for the yeast to work its magic.  I tried this mix since it had used natural ingredients.  I was nervous when the first waffle came out of the iron.  They looked flatter than I was expecting, but when I bit into it, I was pleasantly surprised by the fluffiness.  My husband really enjoyed them too and I think this may become our go to brand when we're in a hurry.  Now I'm thinking of trying their brownie or cookie mix.  I don't like to bake from mixes, but this is one I can feel good about using.

There was a road show at Costco with these Pan Cakes and I love , that they are, so Healthy with only a few ingredients in them, and they taste so good!! and I put other ingredients, i , such as extra egg whits, pumpkin, cinnamin,Coconut oil, they are good no matter what!!!

a whole grain flap jack with out being heavy.  We made chocolate chip pancakes with them on the first day and they were so delicious.  The next day we tried them plain to taste the true flavor of the flap jack and we were very pleased.

column4: N. Ferguson "Two, Daisy, Hannah, and Kitten"
column10: Absolutely delicious flavor from ground wheat and oats- who knew that healthier pancakes would actually taste better? :)  These really seem like a product made by a company that cares about quality and tradition vs. maximizing profits.  Our family LOVES them and has them at least twice a week for breakfast.  We keep a couple of spare boxes on hand so that we never run out!Not heavy but substantial--I have noticed that fewer pancakes are needed to satisfy a hungry family.  A bit more expensive than Aunt Jemima-type pancakes, but they truly taste far better than any other pancake mix I've tried, and they are much healthier.  Highly, highly recommended.

if you like a grainy, nutty taste than this is for you. my wife liked the homemade ones without the whole grains better but in my mind these are much better. more flavor and healthier. i add flax to these for even nuttier taste. top with berries and syrup and you're good to go. i use a belgium waffle maker and it's real easy.

For a really good variation, I get my wife (I am a useless cook, so hold your fire, ladies!) to add some cooked oatmeal and fruit yogurt into the mix. column9: Good taste, good gum, nice size for a home gum machine
column10: I have an old Carousel "King" gum machine that's been sitting around my home office for years gathering dust.  While I was finally cleaning up the office (it's taken years!), I decided to reinvigorate the gum machines (perhaps my daughters would stop by and say hi more often).I looked around for some gumballs and most I found were the larger size that's typically in the $.25 commercial machines (which clearly wouldn't fit my machine).I found these and gave them a shot.  The gumballs are 1/2 inch and fit nicely in my machine, the amount filled my machine about 2/3rds of the capacity (it's hard to tell exactly since some is below the glass and the glass shrinks towards the top -- but clearly I could not fit another package into the same machine.The gumballs were fresh (I hate stale gum) and the taste is good and varied amongst the balls.  They taste lasts about as long as you get from most gum.  I'm certainly happy with the product and my girls are -- the first thing they do when they get in from school is stop by the office for a gum refill.The only reason I'm not giving them a 5 star is that I think they are a bit on the pricy side for the amount of gumballs provided.  I think a more reasonable price would be on the order of $10 to $15 -- though I do have to admit that I've been unable to find similarly sized balls for that price (unless they also included a large shipping cost on top of the lower price and netted out to be even more expensive).
This is the best flavor of all the bubblegums I have tried (I'm a bubble gum lover)!  Although I have my favorite colors, I TRY not to chew them all first!!  Love the packaging also.

column9: Incorrect Listing: This is INSTANT, Not Quick-Cooking!
column10: Bob's Red Mill sells a few varieties of oatmeal, and the one listed (quick-cooking) is not the one pictured, described, or sold (instant). Indeed, Bob's Red Mill Quick Cooking Rolled Oats is not the same as Bob's Red Mill Instant Rolled Oats. This listing sells the Instant Rolled Oats, yet is titled as Quick Cooking. Some people feel that the Quick Cooking Oats is tastier than Instant, and when they place an order for the former, they don't want to receive the latter. I am deliberately giving this listing a low rating to draw your attention, in case this makes a big difference for you.The product itself is very good, of course, and I would gladly give Bob's Red Mill Instant Rolled Oats five stars if only it were the item listed. I urge Nutricity to make corrections to its listing as soon as possible.

column9: Gritty, cheap knock-off of high quality juice powders
column10: The label on the back went as far as making this claim: "100% Whole Leaf Powder...not from juice!"  Ummm... the reason we drink wheatgrass JUICE, is because it's 99.9% digestable, because it doesn't contain any fiber.  Throw the fiber into it, and it takes a lot more effort and energy to digest.This Amazing Grass powder is gritty, and doesn't taste ANYTHING like real wheatgrass juice.  The gritty-ness is so bad, that it's very, very difficult to drink.  Do a google search and look for Wheat Grass JUICE powder.  Not just wheatgrass powder.  This stuff is 25% fiber by weight, so 25% of this product is filler.I used a similar cheap powder that came in a glass jar a number of years ago, and I was wary that this was the same stuff.  Sure enough, it's EXACTLY the same stuff.  You can find this stuff in bulk in canisters at Vitamin Wholesalers for 1/3 the cost.Again, the gritty taste and the fact that it doesn't even come close to dissolving in water should tell you something.  If it doesn't dissolve in water, it doesn't digest well in your body.

Great price here on Amazon.  I bought a box of this stuff at Whole Foods and I gotta say this stuff is the hardest form of wheat grass to drink.  Very, very, very gritty.  It does not dissolve well into whatever form of liquid out there.  They suggest you use in a smoothie, . . granted I never have tried that quite yet.  I drink with 8 oz of water and a packet of emergen c lemon lime flavor.  I really hope drinking this is as good for me as I think it is.  When mixed it looks like sewer water, . . .and although I've never drank sewer water, . . .I wouldn't be surprised if this is what it tastes like.  I guess it sure beats having to juice my own.

column9: Best way to keep from getting sick!
column10: I decided to try wheat grass about a year ago as part of an effort to improve my overall health. I would mix 1 packet in a bottle of water and just chug it every morning. It doesn't taste great, but in my opinion its much more tolerable than fresh juiced wheat grass. The taste can change quite a bit based on my own body alkalinity and what I've been eating recently. Its really not bad at all, and the benefits are truly amazing. As long as I was drinking wheat grass, I was immune to every illness floating around. I never got sick once while on this stuff. My boyfriend also tried it with me and also never got sick while his co-workers were out consistently catching each others colds. He uses the loose power in the large container but I prefer the individual packets because they are so easy to carry around with me. I've eased up on it over the summer but I plan to start using it again daily as the fall/winter cold and flu season approaches. After a few months of using it, I didn't even have to worry about people sneezing on me or missing the hand sanitizer one time because I was simply immune to everyone's germs.

I've only recently become aware of the health benefits of drinking wheatgrass juice, but like many I can't stand the taste, and it's too much trouble to juice the grass myself.  Unless you live in California or someplace where juice bars are abundant, who's got time for that?I already use the Amazing Grass/Amazing Meal Chocolate flavor, especially for breakfast because I tend to skip that meal and it's an easy way to make sure I don't.  I usually mix a sleeve of this wheatgrass powder with Amazing Meal to get a little extra boost of nutrition without adding a ton of calories.  (Wheatgrass is already in Amazing Meal, but people probably wouldn't drink it if it tasted too "green.") Also I like that I can conveniently store the one serving packs in my desk at work or in my tote, so I have no excuse.  Yes, it is a little gritty even when I blend it in my Vitamix, but that doesn't really bother me; I know it's not a milkshake and I feel good that I'm consuming a nourishing drink.  I have to say I was hoping for but haven't felt any significant energy boost as others have mentioned, but I figured a few extra greens couldn't hurt.

column9: A flavorful alternative to he produce section
column10: A while back, I realized that the produce section tomatoes I was buying didn't taste like the tomatoes I remembered from 60 years ago. While I'm sure that Tomatoland documents this better than I can, they tasted like cardboard, had thick and tough skins, were gassed into looking red and ripe when they weren't, and worst of all were costing me $2-3 a pound and more.Gourmet alert (or maybe I mean gourmand alert)! What I'm going to say next may upset you if you have preconceived ideas about how to eat tomatoesLike any other enterprising senior citizen who is tight on cash, I switched to these when using tomatoes in salads. Actually, what I started doing was tossing these into a colander, along with garbanzos, mushrooms, black pitted olives, and green salad olives. I prefer these diced tomatoes over canned generic diced tomatoes, because the garlic gives them more taste and depth of flavor. And then I toss a portion of the concoction over lettuce. Sometimes I just eat it by itself. With dressing, of course, whatever seems handy at the time.I consider it a win when I can get these for $1.15 a can or less, but I will go up to $1.25 a can before I start checking the supermarket sales instead. By the way, this should make pretty good salsa as well when mixed with hot peppers, but I haven't tried that yet. I also have mixed these in with spaghetti sauce to give it more body. Over a couple months I (and others) bought up every can, and every can I had was EXCELLENT.Others who claim smoked Sprats blow away the usual U.S. brands of sardines are 100% correct, and I grew up eating them all. These are much smaller than sardines and herrings. RIGA SPRATS are sold by the country of LATVIA. Do not have the strong smell or taste of sardine at all and that is why a pound of sardine cost less than $2.00 dollars and sprats cost more which is the same as herrings from Germany. Herrings and sardines are bigger and packaged mostly in Morocco and Germany. Latvia joined the EU food lately so you need to check the expiration date on the cans since they used to sell expired cans which I got myself. I consume these and few other brands. Sprats do not feed on anything big so not only they do not have mercury but more importantly since sprats are so small and feed on plankton which is the same food for whales, it is probably one of the healthiest fish out there. Comes from cold waters of Baltic sea. Approximately some 27 count of fish in a can, smoked in vegetable oil. I love the sprats itself but each can has some 1000 MG of sodium which is not low so I drain the oil since vegetable oil is unhealthy, regardless of the type specified, and never trust when they claim olive oil either, to get ride of the oil and the unhealthy salt and then consume the fish. It goes well with crackers unlike sardines. It is excellent with salads as well... A very healthy wild fish with true fish qualities. Bravo.

column9: lots of flavour in a little bunny

My daughter loves all the Annies snacks so this is a great way for us to take them along and have a variety esp. if we are traveling.  Will order again.

Annie's Bunny Snack Variety Pack has been in our home for a while.  This is the first order through Amazon.The only CON was that it took a very long time to receive the item.

column9: Price More Than Doubled Since Yesterday!
