column9: Cats Enjoy the Taste. Good Nutrition for Those Who Can't Eat.
column10: When our cat was sick with no appetite for solids, she had no problem drinking some Catsure here and there throughout the day.

Bought this for a very sick cat whom I've been force-feeding for two weeks. She has thyroid cancer and can't swallow regular food, and I was hoping she would be able to lap it up, since she still drinks water. She would not drink it, so after reading a couple of reviews here I tried force-feeding her some. She vomited it back up within a couple of minutes (she doesn't vomit the other food).For comparison, I tried giving it to my healthy cat who loves everything. She wouldn't touch it, and when I rubbed some on her nose to give her a taste, she shied away from the saucer I set in front of her.I looked for an expiration date on the can, but found none, so I can't tell if it could be spoiled. column9: item is ok but not great
column10: This item was a bit of a disappointment. I expected better flavor. It has a sour start but that is it. The cherry and soda flavor is very faint and difficult to taste. The texture is what you would expect from a quality gummy, soft and slightly firm but chewy. The sour is spot on, it will make you pucker.  e.frutti normally has wonderful products with abundant flavor, sadly this product was not one of them. I ordered 4 bags (8.8 pounds), opened one and ate a few and gave the three remaining bags away to less discriminate gummy consumers. I rated this product low because I expected better flavor and not just sour gummy. If you enjoy sour and are less concerned with flavor, this product may be right for you.

column9: Saving the life of a tot with severe multiple food allergies
column10: My little one was 14 months and below the 3rd percentile.  I nursed him and strictly limited my diet to accomodate his severe allergies to dairy, soy, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, corn etc.  The time came where I just couldn't handle the limited diet any longer (and cooking of 3 separate meals for he and I, a vegetarian husband, and three other kids all three times a day).  So I decided to wean.  My little guy couldn't have many of the rice milks which were devoid of protein and all the formulas (even the terrible poisonous Neocate) had something he couldn't have. Then I found Toddler Health--a God send!!!  The taste is honestly strange and pretty repulsive at times (he refuses it as a drink) but I'm able to get him to eat half a scoop of it in a bowl of oatmeal daily mixed in rice milk and homemade oat cakes as well.  Finally because of this formula, my little guy is slowly starting to catch up.  I bought the rice one and plan on getting the oat too in the near future.

I just found Starbucks Kcups in Bed/Bath/Beyond (also in Target) and of course I had to grab them on the spot!  I tried the House Blend and, unlike other Starbucks flavors, this is very smooth and not at all bitter or "burnt" like the Pike Place blend.  This flavor didn't require nearly as much sweetening and, since it isn't overly strong, it's perfect for use any time of day.  I bought a box of 16 for $11.99 - ($14.99 less the typical Bed/Bath/Beyond 20% discount).  I can't even begin to comprehend Amazon's pricing on this item.....or most other Kcups for that matter.  These kcups will be even more readily available nationwide than Dunkin' Donuts kcups so why the ridiculous pricing, Amazon??!!  Starbucks kcups (10-count) are also available in Von's (Safeway) supermarkets.

Here's the deal with K Cups: they will always taste slightly different than regular brewed coffee.  The reason is with brewed coffee, you can control the strength of the brew, both with how you grind your beans and your water-to-coffee ratio.  With K Cups, the only control you have is how large or small a cup you choose to brew. Larger obviously is weaker, smaller is stronger.I have these K cups.  They are better than many of the others I have tried.  Again, it won't taste EXACTLY like a cup of Starbucks brewed coffee, but is pretty close.  I definitely recommend this over many others.Now, if we could just find them cheaper!

It's a decent coffee, however I find it to be a little too strong to be called a "breakfast blend"/medium blend. I guess if you're into bold coffee, it's fine. It's also more expensive than other K-cup varieties.
Finally some great coffee, thank goodness Starbucks finally gave in.  More varieties please.  Wish they would come in larger quantaties.

I have tried every k-cup out there, and I do mean every one.  These are the best by far.  Funny thing is, I don't care for Starbucks coffee in house.  The beans are over roasted making it bitter.  The k-cups are definitely not bitter and actually taste nothing like the house blend, and in my book this a good thing!  It's a medium/dark roast and very smooth.  Only con is the $$$price$$$.

column9: Very Good Coffee Will Buy Again

I won't buy it again because nobody else cared for it at my house and it is a little too bitter for me.

column9: COFFEE DOES NOT TASTE LIKE STARBUCKS COFFEE AND OVER PRICED
column10: this product does only get 3 stars from me a bit over priced and not any better than other less priced coffee not that the coffee is bad its not but i would expect more from starbucks does not have that starbucks flavor some thing is lacking with this coffee im not sure if i would buy it again starbucks needs to lower the price a bit on this coffee and go back to the drawing board and try and inprove it

I picked up a box of K cups at Wal Mart today and was delighted.  I set my Keurig on the second to smallest cup setting and end up with a really great cup of coffee.  This is my new fav.  I cant wait to try the breakfest blend and the sumatra.

column10: the Starbucks kcups are the best kcup available, perfect brew with smooth taste, great product, simply the bestunfortunately the Amazon price is way too high, it's much cheaper in the local grocery or TargetI'd be fine buying these at .75 a cup or better... until then..... The Starbucks has more flavor than Caribou but pulls it off without turning you off. My daughter bought a Keurig coffee maker for my husband for Christmas. His favorite coffee is Starbucks House Blend so when I found that I could get the K cups I decided to get several for him for Christmas. They arrived very quickly and were just as described. column9: Good strong flavor, but no burnt bean taste
column10: Not normally a fan of Starbucks over-roasted beans BUT this is an excellent full flavor coffee without the burnt bean after taste I often find with Starbucks.  A great way to start the day.  I'll definitely continue to have this on my variety list.
Starbucks quality is maintained via K-cup.  While the most expensive K-cup, it is still about half what you would pay at Starbucks.
Great smooth flavor for everyone who likes a mild full flavor coffee.  A little pricey but now that Green Mountain's patent has expired perhaps the price will go down.
What can I say? I can now get a nice cup of Starbucks coffee at home in my own kitchen with the press of a button. Delish!

This Starbucks House Blend K-Cup is a bolder coffee than expected that tastes every bit as good as the in-store brew. This Starbucks coffee is a little better tasting but it is a too expensive when drinking 4-5 cups a day.Recommended for the flavor (4 stars) but not at the retail price (3 stars).CFH

I have been a Starbucks afficianado for years and am a recent user of the Keurig system (from Amazon - gift that I thought I would never want!), which I have become very pleased with. column9: Very smooth but solid flavor, a great all around coffee
column10: Everyone has different tastes, and I like to mix it up too. After trying many brands and blends for half a year, I have determined that this is my daily drinker, el numero-uno.The closest I can compare it to is perhaps the Caribou Blend, only this is a tad smoother yet somehow richer, and has zero bitterness, and zero aftertaste or chemical taste.  I brew it on the medium (8 oz) setting for what it's worth, but it is probably great stronger or lighter.  This Starbucks blend is very friendly for all drinkers, lightens easily with a little half & half, and so it is my go to for hosting parties.  It is definitely a good way to experience the best of your Keurig!

column9: One of the Tastiest of the K-Cups
column10: Keurig has, for better or worse, pushed the coffee market in a strange direction.  Convenience is championed over quality.  Luckily, Starbucks' House Blend K-Cups are just as good as the bean versions of the coffee that you can purchase in stores.  Out of the blends that I have tried, the House Blend seem to be the most balanced: it's not too acidic, not too bitter, not too bland.  It's just right.  I would recommend this coffee to both coffee novices and coffee experts.With that said, I would recommend comparing prices off Amazon before buying these here.  The prices seem to fluctuate (as they do in other stores as well).

I absolutely love my Keurig. But every now and then I found myself getting bored with the selection of K-Cups. I resorted to buying a reusable K-Cup and filling it with freshly ground beans from Starbucks. The results were less than desirable. I would never get the mesaurements right and I would end up having to make a trip to get coffee.These K-Cups from starbucks are a godsend! the price is not bad. The ratio of coffee grounds to water is the same every time so my coffee comes out great. I am a happy person once again! I also love the house blend because even though it says its a lighter blend, its starbucks. Its roasted darker than most. So if you are a strong coffee lover i think the house blend will suit you just fine.

column4: Millers Rocks And Gems "ethel miller, crosswo...
column10: I don't drink coffee but order it for my husband......apparently he enjoys it cause it looks like I will have to reorder.....kids were here over the summer and they enjoyed it too.....so guess you have something going for you.......

column9: Good, but Strong Cup of Coffee
column10: These K-Cups make a good cup of coffee. As others have said in the reviews, it is stronger than what I would expect from a "Medium." But if worst comes to worse, I believe they can be made drinkable (or at least you will be able to find someone else that will drink it, unlike other K-Cups that I have tried, which I could not even give away).

Price per K-cups get poor marks when assessing for "value"; however, in terms of quality there is an earthiness and flavor profile that far exceeds any regular drip brew that I have experienced for home brewers (with an obvious exception for french press coffee).  What I sacrifice in terms of increased per K-Cup cost is made up for in terms of quality.  I enjoy Starbucks, regardless of their corporate profile.  Going to Starbucks is likely to result in a $4-5 dollar cup of coffee; where as I sit here now and for just about a buck I am enjoying a natural, black cup of Medium Roast Starbies... Loving it...

As someone who is sensitive to chemicals in foods, I was very upset when Malt O Meal who mass produced Puffed Wheat stopped. The only other product available to me was Quaker, but that had BHT preservatives in it which set off allergic reactions.Being desperated I tried Arrowhead Mills product and was so grateful it is just puffed wheat without anything else.For people who have eaten enough puffed cereals, they will know that some taste burnt and some are light puffed. This comes from a process where one company explodes the grain in puffing by heating the grain which toasts it and another more modern method which uses steam pressure.It is either the heat or steam pressure which when released which causes the grain to "puff".Arrowhead Mills is the toasted type and it is very good. It also unlike the steam pressure or the old Malt O Meal type not as perfected in that it is a bit more crunchy like the original puffed wheat of a century ago.For those with allergies, I believe the toasting makes the product less inflamatory to the body in "killing" the oils, germ and hull which affect many people.The bags are small, but surprisingly one can get around 7 bowls of cereal out of them.The puffed wheat is though like all puffed wheat in softening readily in milk, but as stated the packages I have the puffed wheat has a bit more texture like original puffed wheat.I was quite pleased with this product and hope to have it stocked locally. It was good enough for me to even consider purchasing puffed millet in the future.I hope this helps people in their decisions. God bless.

They're coated, artificially colored, preserved and generally tinkered with so that Lord only knows what you're really eating with the finished product.This cereal is just what it says, no more and no less. column9: A good source for this distinctive and unique spice
column10: Piment d'Espelette is a unique product.  It is subject to Appellation d'Origine Controlee regulation, which extends the right to use the AOC label only to ten communes in the Basque country in France.  The peppers are grown, harvested, dried and prepared subject to strict regulation and, like wine, cheese and other products subject to the AOC, must display the typical "organoleptic characteristics" of the traditionally produced spice.  Piment d'Espelette is never strong or screamingly hot, so if you are expecting something akin to Scotch Bonnet peppers, or the acrid bite of "chili pepper" blends, look elsewhere.  However, it does have a sweet and smoky aroma, akin to good pimenton or paprika, along with a distinct peppery 'bite' at the finish.Piment d'Espelette is never inexpensive and it is usually not easy to find in the US, so having this source available is great.  I use it in almost everything -- for example, peel and slice cucumbers, toss with a good quantity of freshly squeezed lemon juice (Meyer lemons preferred), a pinch of sugar, a large pinch of fleur de sel or kosher salt, and a pinch of piment d'Espelette.  Let the cukes sit in a colander for up to half an hour, tossing occasionally, then serve.  Trust me, you will not fail to notice the presence of the piment. It's also great and sufficiently assertive to dress a good sized composed salad with just a pinch in a basic vinaigrette dressing of lemon juice, white wine vinegar, dijon mustard and grapeseed, walnut or olive oil. Wonderful sprinkled lightly over a platter of carved "rotisserie chicken" from the grocery.  Adds a nice edge to rillettes or a terrine.  Adds pop to scrambled eggs, quiche... just think of anything you'd like to lend a subtly sweet, smoky and hot red peppery note, and give it a healthy pinch of piment d'Espelette.Another reviewer reports that he received piment d'Espelette from this source ("Touch of France") that was tasteless.  I've not had that experience.  I received very fresh piment with the AOC labeling, with aromas and flavors that are perfectly "typique."  If you really want to get "fresh," you could go with the whole dried, corded peppers which are also sold subject to the AOC (corded by hand with no fewer than 20 peppers per cord).  I like the convenience of the ground piment and recommend this supplier without reservation based on the product I received.  The price is about as fair as one can find nowadays, and I bet you can double up on the order for a single shipping charge.For more about piment d'Espelette generally, you can google piment d'Espelette and you will find the "Site officiel de l'AOC" (alas, for some reason the good folks at Amazon would not allow me to include the URL in this review).

We have been trying to get my kids to eat healthier and these are certainly better than candy bars but the real test is if my kids will eat them, and they really enjoy them. Being a Type 2 diabetic I am fairly careful choosing snacks and these are at the upper end of what I feel safe eating with 170 Calories and 17g Net Carbs (11g of sugar).My only issue is that the layer of peanut butter on the bottom can be messy in warmer weather or if heated up by holding in the hand too long.Recommended!CFH

column9: Love the bars, but this isn't that good of a deal
column10: I love these, but at little over $.83 a bar, it is not a good deal. You can get a box of 30 at Sam's club for less than than 9 dollars. At the price I paid, which was $8.47 it comes in at about $.28 per bar. Just letting you know that there are better deals out there. Not to mention it comes in one box, and you don't have to deal with 12 six pack sized boxes.

column9: Ooooh La La- Yummy Granola Bars!
column10: Do you love peanuts?  Are you tired of chocolate?  Do you love granola?  If so these are the bars for you!  Unlike many granola bars they don't taste like cardboard.  They're a wonderful combination of granola and peanuts.  They are 170 calories each (80 from fat) and a bit expensive.  When you see them for $2/box that is a good deal.
These are the best granola bars ever, plus I got them on sale which made them even better.
A perfect blend of salty and sweet -- its nice that they come in a 12 box package since they go pretty fast around our house...

column9: Tasty but peanut covering is messy in the heat.
column10: The beauty of store bought prepackaged granola bars is that they are convenient and are usually non-sticky/messy compared to homemade ones.Nature Valley has always made some excellent bars that did not melt into a soggy mess when stashed in the car or brought on extended roadtrips/hikes/camping in the warmer months.  However, this new line of bars from Nature Valley features a sweet peanut coating similar to the yoghurt coating pretzles are dipped in.  This coating is quite sweet and melts in the heat.I would not reccomend particular Nature Valley line for outdoor activities in the warmer months, but would not hesistate to for the winter months.It is also a great treat to get kids off candy bars and into healthier granola bars as the sweet coating is quite peanuty and sweet enough.  The bar itself does contain crisped rice that their original crunchy line does not, but it is still a vast improvement healthwise over other more common snack bars available.

column9: These Sweet and Salty Nut Bars taste so good!
column10: These Sweet and Salty Nut bars are handy for breakfast, snacks and quick meals.  The combination of flavors is delicious.  They are filling and easy to "take with" you to eat on the go or just to eat at any time of day.  The peanut are my favorite.
My famiy loves these granola bars.  They do not have a bland taste, rather, they are sweet and taste of peanut butter.

Extremely tasty to a point of being addictive.  The sweet yogurt like coating gives it a nice smooth taste and sweetness to go with the almond.  Great with coffee if you don't put sugar in your coffee.  Product has no bad ingredients besides the usual High Fructose Corn Syrup, which isn't exactly bad.  Amazon has the best price when you buy on subscription, and even cheaper then Walmart.  At less then $2/box, you get 7.4 Oz, which is reasonable price.

I'm a personal trainer and often my clients arrive in the late morning or afternoon needing a calorie boost to get them through a tough workout.  The combination of sugars and peanuts are just the ticket.  The Nature Valley Fruit and Nut bar is also excellent.

column9: Was looking for a tea with hibiscus as first ingredient
column10: Because I read somewhere that hibiscus has more antioxidents than green tea.  This tea has that as the first ingredient and I love cherries, so I thought I'd try it.  It's delicious!  No sweetener needed and it's great tasting cold or hot.  You could probably even get kids to drink this as an iced tea in the summer!
yummy yummy yummy make it then wait 5 minutes then it will taste so good yummy yummy yummy something something something something (that song)

column9: Fast easy treat, Not so great taste
column10: This is so easy to make - add a little water, stir, put in the microwave, and you're good to go. It's very high fat though, and the taste isn't as good as baked items. We tend to put a lot of ice cream or whipped cream on it to help the taste, but that just adds to the fat content. I'd encourage anyone to try a single box from their grocery store before being this large package to make sure you like it.
Not the greatest thing in the world.  But for what it is, it's not bad, a good treat.  Though definitly not worth the $59.99 plus the $11.64 shipping, price tag.

I'd keep these on hand for emergency food prep only, the exact situation we faced (snowed in, couldn't get to store). Luckily, we still had power during the snowstorm so we made the product as instructed.One tip here: remember that microwave ovens all cook at different temps and speeds, adjust cooking time accordingly. This should be gooey and not hard as a rock. We had two packages and had to test one before finding the right cooking time.The taste: Totally disappointing. While we all wanted a sweet treat, this barely met our needs, providing only calories and some energy, making me qualify it as suitable for "emergencies only". As far as providing a taste of sweetness, yes, this was fine. However, it fell far short of the "warm delight" promised by the cover photo and title. There was a decided hint of preservatives and some unpleasant flavors, creating an unsatisfactory culinary experience. No one expects a microwave mix to be high cuisine but this was barely palatable.We don't have gourmet standards by any means but this was not liked by anyone in the family, although the adults managed to eat our portions. The kids? Forget it.However, although I couldn't find them here, we DID try some mixes during the snowstorm that exceeded our expectations. One was Better Homes and Gardens Chocolate Chip mix. If you can find it, get it. It not only came in a lovely container but included the bonus of a year's subscription to BH & Gardens for only $5.00,  a bargain rate (optional, not required to subscribe to buy mix ). The mix in container cost $5.99 so we felt this was a better use of our money, leaving us with a reusable and microwavable container and tasty cookies for the $5.99. If we wanted, we had a monthly  magazine for another $5.00. You do the math and conduct a taste test and I think you'll agree that "warm delights" aren't so delightful. Just a thought.

Sea salt is my favorite, I think, but all the flavors are yummy. I'm trying to avoid snacks with an endless list of ingredients (and do I really need more corn or soy? no thx!). Also, I'm really glad these are roasted rather than fried. The Good Bean is such a great find, particularly since my son loves it in his lunch box.

column9: Ok - not quite what I expected
column10: These have a slightly chalky, soft consistency compared to nuts.  I was expecting something a little crunchier.  I love that they are beans and have fiber (6 grams), but the taste gets a little getting used to.  The #2 ingrediant is brown rice syrup and #3 is canola oil.  And if you are watching carbs then nuts are lower.  These have 23 grams total carbs and 5 grams sugar.  The fat on the other hand is much lower then nuts - only 3 grams of fat.  140 calories so about the same calories as most nuts.  Would I buy them again?  Probably not.  I might try adding these to trail mix and that might help.  I gave them a 3 because they are edible and healthy, but maybe get a sample before buying a whole case.  By the way I love the sweet cinnamon flavor - for some reason the softer consistency was fine with the sweeter taste.

This is the coolest, yummiest little product. I hadn't heard of roasted chickpeas as a snack until recently. Then, when I tried The Good Bean samples at a local grocery store, I was hooked! They're super healthy and delicious, and I'm quite smitten with the packaging. Glad to see this on Amazon!
Fun for a party, pre-dinner nibbles or an after-school snack - just don't tell the kids they're chick-peas and they'll never know!

I bought this variety pack on a whim, thinking it would be a great healthy snack food substitute for the bag of chips that usually goes into my lunches. Boy was I wrong. I should've listened to the other mediocre reviews of the product. The good bean has absolutely no crunch whatsoever. The beans feel limp and kind of mealy in the mouth. Do not buy this if you expect something like the crunch and texture of Corn Nuts, peanuts, or even a PopChip. I ended up donating the remaining 11 bags I could not eat to a charity food drive, and I felt bad doing so--but at least they are healthy, I suppose. My suggestion: try this product at a local grocery store before committing to a whole box on Amazon. They taste and feel highly unusual--not at all like a chickpea, and may turn off a lot of people. Caveat emptor--buyer beware.

I bought the sea salt flavored Good Beans recently and almost ate the whole bag in one sitting! For someone who has a gluten intolerance, The Good Bean replaces that crunchy snack you want while drinking a beer (gluten-free) or while watching TV. They remind me of pretzels! The cracked pepper are good too, a little spicy! I will be buying more very soon!

I've tried all flavors of the Good Bean and enjoy them all. I stock up on them (personal faves are the classic sea salt and the sweet cinammon) for inter-meal munching when I want something to tide me over. This is a super satisfying snack - flavorful and surprisingly filling. The texture is a little bit of a surprise at first (they're not quite as crunchy as you might expect) but they're really delicious and a great-for-you food. Thanks Good Bean!

I was really excited to get the Good Bean sea salt snacks in the mail and slightly disappointed when I tried them. They were really chalky and a little too salty for me. But I kept eating them because, hey, I bought six bags and I wasn't going to waste them! The funny thing is they grew on me. I liked the cinnamon ones better, but I now reach for them out of a desire to snack on them rather than feeling like I have to eat them.
The Good Bean sea salt flavor is fantastic. I did not buy the other flavors because I was not sure I would like them but just personal preference.  I highly recommend this snack option.

I really wanted to like these. But they are too hard, like chewing bullets. I fear for my teeth. The dried chickpeas we ate as children were light and airy like popcorn. Anyone know where to get those?

I've purchased this product many times at the grocery store before and really liked the taste. The beans were small and dry (some reviewers said chalky, but I liked the taste) and did not have oily residue from the roasting. They were much crunchier and saltier. However, I just purchased this product on Amazon, opened the package and found that the beans were bigger and almost slimy from the canola oil. This was the complete opposite of the store-bought ones. Honestly, I'd stick to buying them at the grocery store because I don't like the oily taste of the ones that I bought from Amazon.
Was looking forward to this item. Like chickpeas but found these to be kind of spongy and not very good tasting. Will not purchase it again.
It was like eating cardboard!  These were awful.  Can't find anyone who wants them because they are worse than tasteless.

I tried three different flavors and they were all pretty bad. The texture is also kind of powdery instead of that crunchy chickpea texture you might expect. The sweet cinnamon flavor is probably the worst since it smells and tastes like an old peron's house(potpourri). I bought the small snack sized version for 99 cents each and ended up just throwing them away. Also the spices were unbalanced and unevenly distributed between the peas.

This is the very best decaf coffee I've ever had! And it's water processed, so it doesn't upsetmy stomach.  Coffees that use chemicals to decaffinate it affect me very adversely.  I really likethis one! Had to go on decaf for awhile prior to a heart procedure.  This coffee taste very robustand not like colored water.  Very excellent coffee!

column9: Love this stuff - great diet aid
column10: Just adding this to my normal diet routine has caused a big difference in my weight loss.  I'm not hungry and have plenty of energy - a huge change from before I started drinking it.  I was actually a little concerned at first due to the sudden drop in weight.  I thought I was losing water weight but I was wrong.  I use about a teaspoon/teaspoon and a half per day and brew it 4 times - about 8 cups - per day.  As a bonus, it tastes pretty good too.

Smells strong, but the brew is a nice calming flavor that isn't too overpowering. I enjoy it both iced and hot. Not sure of the "weight" promises as I don't think it has had any effect for me. But a yummy tea no less!

column9: Teavana Weight to Go Pu-erh Weight-Loss Tea
column10: This is a delicious tea, but I don't know if it did anything to reduce weight. It also contains Oolong tea which has research behind it to support a slight rise in metabolism. The taste is good enough that I don't care if it works for weight loss.
This tea is so good and it smells yummy.  I highly recommend it.  I really like the Teavana brand and will try more flavors in the future.
The product has a special taste I found to be a treat. This tea and a good book will take you away . The shipment was very slow so it will take a lot of patience, However well worth the wait.

I HAVE BEEN USING HODGSON BREAD MIX PRODUCTS SINCE I PURCHASED A BREAD MACHINE. I HAVE USED THE 9 GRAIN MIX,THE CARAWAY RYE,ACTUALLY ALL THE MIXES. I HAVE BEEN VERY SATISFIED WITH THESE PRODUCTS AND HAVE RE-ORDERED MANY TIME. ACTUALLY , IHAVE A SHIPMENT ON THE WAY. THEY ALWAYS ARRIVE INTACT IN GOOD CONDITION. I WILL CONTINUE ORDERING. I AM 82 YEARS OLD, A WIDOWER AND DO MY OWN COOKING,ETC.
I made a loaf last night in my bread machine.  I put the setting on light crust and the bread came out perfect!  Couldn't ask for anything more.

I've made this bread a couple of times and it is very easy to make since only warm water and butter is needed in addition to the boxed ingredients.  Tastes great and I've used it for healthy sandwich bread.

column9: A View from the Novice Seats
column10: I ordered the Breadman TR-875 the other day when it was a Gold Deal.  I have never used a bread machine nor made bread.  I read the reviews for the Breadman and discovered the Hodgson Mill, referenced by a Breadman reviewer.  While my Breadman was being prepared for shipment, I ordered a case of 9-Grain.  They both arrived the same day and I spent the evening discovering the Breadman.  The next morning with trepidation I ventured forth to make my first loaf of bread, and posted a picture here and for the Breadman. I cut the heel and had soon eaten almost half the loaf.  It is fabulous.  The way that bread is intended by Mother Nature.  Today I just completed making the other five loaves.  Every loaf was perfection - Six of Six.  Everything was so simple, with a little research.  I am one proud novice; soon to be considered a professional. :)

This is one of the better bread machine mixes out there. Hodgson Mill has managed to provide us with some very fine products that don't contain a bunch of preservatives and great tasting loaves of bread.They are one of the only ones that recommend using the whole wheat cycle for a box mix, and it works well. This may be the reason that some reviewer wound up with a bad loaf. Funny thing is, the first time I used it, I neglected to read the instructions and used the basic white setting on my bread machine and it still turned out pretty good.I'll be ordering this mix on a regular basis.

column9: Great for the health conscious and tasty too!
column10: I ordered this and have enjoyed eating it over the past few months. The ingredients are very healthy and pure, and best of all i love how simple they are! I am very health conscious, and avoid high fructose corn syrup found in most store bought breads. This bread has great ingredients, and not a very high sugar content either. I compared the ingredients to all the other bread mixes i could possibly find on the internet.. well, i spent all day researching, and I didn't like how others had high sugar contents (such as the number 3 ingredient being 'cane sugar' or the number 4 and 5 ingredients being sugar and brown sugar, etc). I also wanted a bread packed with whole grains, and 9 grain is great!And of course i looked for something easy on the wallet. I originally made my own bread and tried buying whole grain flours from health food stores but i just couldn't match 9 grains, and it got pricey. Obviously just plain white flour bread making will be cheaper than buying this boxed stuff, but i wanted whole grain bread. It turned out to be difficult exactly comparing the price of this compared with baking from scratch since all the flours are by the ounce, etc, but i decided that this price is very good. Compared to other brands of bread mix, this price is pretty much the lowest I have found with the free shipping.In terms of taste, honestly I really don't care as long as it's healthy, I will basically like it or learn to like it, but I will say that I love the taste of this bread and have been making sandwiches almost every weekday for the past couple months. If I want to be real nit-picky i would say the milled flaxseed SLIGHTLY gives it a bad smell, but its subtle and overall the bread still tastes great. Besides, its super healthy! I should also mention that I bake this bread using a very nice bread maker, so I would take that under consideration when reading this review. And for those that care, I bake it with some earth balance butter substitute. Lastly, if your bread is coming out a little dense, add more water and yeast and it will come out great! If you need to spice it up you can throw in some dried cherries and/or walnuts, and other things I'm sure will work too I'm sure. It was even more delicious when I did this.

column9: We love Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix
column10: We bought a Breadman TR2200C Ultimate Bread Machine about five years ago.  We discovered Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, Hodgson Mill, Bread Mix Nine Grain, 16-Ounce, at the HEB supermarkets when we lived in the Austin, TX, area, and found them at Sweetbay and Publix here in Florida when we moved her three years ago.  For some reason both stores quit carrying this item, so we were delighted to find that Amazon carries it at a very reasonable price Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).My wife adds dried cranberries, coconut flakes and walnut pieces to this mix and it makes a delightful bread, comparable to artisan loaves selling for $5 or more.

This mix makes an absolutely delicious loaf of multi-grain bread in my bread machine.  Just dump it in, follow the directions, and voilà- a tasty, perfectly baked 1.5 lb loaf of bread.  The bread is very moist and airy, not dense at all.  The sliced bread results in really large slices, but we just turn them sideways and slice in half.  That doubles our production and allows for a more manageable sandwich-sized slice of bread.  This mix is just delicious and I highly recommend it.  I sliced two slices extra thick for French Toast this morning for my husband.  He said it was the best French Toast he has ever had!  Kudos!!

That a healthy bread can taste SOOOO good is a revelation in my house and this and other breads from the same Mill disappear as if by magic. No more store bought bread in this house! Because I am usually in a hurry, I mix the dough in the bread machine, then bake it in a regular pan. It makes such a big, beautiful loaf!  I am truly hooked on the Hodgson Mill bread mixes and have tried them all with equal pleasure. You will not go wrong purchasing this item.

For those of you who love a nice, hearty whole grain bread, I very much recommend Hodgson Mill's 9-Grain Bread Mix.  It is a very chewy and filling bread that is great for sandwiches.  The blend of nine whole grains come together to make complex tastes and textures that are rich and satisfying. Instructions for both bread machine and oven baked bread are included on the back of the box.
Worked well even in my 2# breadmaker. Slightly nutty, hint of sweetness. All this and high protein too. Love all Hodgson Mill products.

I love multi-grain breads.  I read the reviews and bought this to be the first mix I used in my new Zojirushi breadmaker.  It is delicious.  I would like more grain chunks, but the taste was excellent.  I ate both heels while still hot with real butter.  I will definitely buy this again, as well as several of the other Hodgson mixes.

I like this bread so much, I order it through Amazon's subscription service.  It is now my everyday bread, because it is tastes good, has good fiber content and ingredients you could buy at any grocery store. Its really home-made bread, but you don't have to buy all those flours and try to figure out how to store them before they go rancid.  Everything you need except oil and water is in this box.As healthy as it is, I wouldn't be baking up a loaf a week if it weren't delicious.  And easy!  I use it in a bread machine that has a setting for whole grain breads and gives extra time for development of the dough.  It comes out soft, but with an interesting texture.  Because you add the oil (or butter if you prefer), it has no trans-fats.I highly recommend!

I AM NOT AN EXPERIENCED COOK. I RECENTLY ORDERED A BREAD MACHINE AND THE RECIPES WERE CONFUSING TO ME. SO MANY DIFFERENT FLOURS,BAKING POWER,SALT,BAKING SODA,YEAST,ETC....I WAS FRUSTRATED! AFTER SEEING Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6), ON AMAZON, I DECIDED TO GIVE IT A TRY. ALL THE INGREDIENTS ARE INCLUDED, EVEN THE YEAST. ALL I NEEDED TO ADD WAS WATER AND BUTTER OR VEG OIL(I USE OLIVE OR PEANUT OIL). THE BREAD TURNED OUT GREAT AND VERY EASY TO BAKE. THE PRODUCT IS PERFECT FOR A NOVICE LIKE ME. I WOULD SUGGEST ANYONE, NOVICE OR NOT, TO TRY THIS MIX OUT. ONE THOUGHT ....YOU MUST FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS ON THE BOX EXACTLY! I HAVE SINCE PURCHASED EVERY VARIETY OF HODGSON BREAD MIXES AVAILABLE THRU THE "SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE" PROGRAM ON AMAZON AND THE PRICE IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN THE GROCERY STORE AS WELL AS THE EASE OF DELIVERY. Hodgson Mill BREAD MIXES ARE ALL EASY TO MAKE AND ALWAYS TASTE GREAT. AFTER A WHILE I MAY LEARN MORE ABOUT BAKING BREAD FROM SCRATCH, BUT I WILL CONTINUE TO USE THE Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). TAKE MY NOVICE ADVICE AND TRY THIS, YOU WILL NOT HAVE ANY REGRETS!

This was my first time using this product and I absolutely loved it. I experimented with it in different ways just to see what would happen. For example I added 6 tablespoons of oil instead of 2 or I left it longer in the oven to get it crustier, I flattened it more instead of elevated so it came out like a thick cracker or I left it rising for 3 hours. Every single attempt was awesome.Unfortunately because my daughter and I loved it so much we ate each one in just 2 days.....:) What a delight!!!!!

column9: 5 stars for convenience; 4+ for product quality
column10: Add water and butter (or oil) - that's it.  I prepped in bread machine and baked in oven.  Makes a medium size loaf.  The product is 1 lb per package.  The bread bakes up crusty on the outside, fairly soft inside, chewy, slightly sweet, with a mild 9-grain flavor (although the overall taste is pretty hearty).  Great toasted with eggs for breakfast.  For the subscribe & save price, this is a real winner, IMO.  You can purchase with confidence!

This recipe is wonderful! I have only tried the 9 grain mix, but I will try others! Even if you don't have a bread machine, you can still knead the dough and it truly comes out perfect! I am a fan, and will be using this recipe again! Great product, Hodgson Mill, keep 'em coming!

column4: L. S. Pray "Blonde, little old lady"
column10: This is one of my favorites.  I like to set my breadmaker on dark crust as I like to make sandwiches out of it or just pop into the toaster and make toast covered with almond butter.  Great for slicing hot or cold.  I really enjoyed the taste of this bread and have tried to duplicate this on my own with no success yet.  I'm still trying.Would recommend if you like whole wheat bread.  Freezes great after slicing.  Just thaw out or pop into toaster for a treat just plain.

Bought this bread mix (using my bread machine for only the second time) and it came out beautifully.  We like a medium dark crust and it was just perfect. Rose very high and makes a 1-1/2 pound loaf.  Follow instructions carefully for both mix and your bread machine.  Butter in mix recipe give the bread a wonderful, moist flavor and the texture was better than the bread at the bakery.  Very pleased with this bread mix - just ordered more.  I will be baking one of these each week.  Toasts beautifully and makes a wonderful grilled cheese sandwich.  Hearty texture for making a panini, too.  Ordered on subscribe and save for delivery each month. Next we'll try the caraway rye Hodgson Mills makes.  If you like hearty wheat bread, this one is for you.

column9: The Best 9 Grain Bread in a Box!
column10: I read some negative reviews about no taste or too sweat. Then there were the ones that said it did not rise.Well I thought I better put in my two cents.The loaves of breads have all come out perfectly. My husband puts the bread machine on the 2lb and box mixed selections. The bread has been great. It has risen all the way and taste very good. We have tried adding nuts and dried cranberries and have really enjoyed it. So plain or with added nuts it's still wonderful.

I love the whole grain breads and this is excellent.  It is almost fool proof.  Being a man I some times think I remember the directions.  Wrong!  There are just 2 things I had to add, well I forgot to put the oil in the first loaf.  The loaf didn't rise as much as the other loaves but was still very good.  I remembered everything in the 2nd loaf and it was perfect.  I put cold water instead of warm for the 3rd loaf and it was perfect.  Was I just lucky?  I will read the box every time from now on.

I never believed bread mix until I tried this one... I was amazed how easy and tasty this product turned out to be. I am glad to join to the "subscribe & save" program to save $$ and time to get this delicious and healthy bread mix. Almost no effort to bake it (both in the bread machine and in the oven)!!A good gift(s) to family members and friends too :)

column9: Very good, especially when I only use the dough cycle.
column10: I like this mix. I usually make my own from scratch but during the summer I don't like all the mess and time this involves so I tried this mix and it's definitely worth the costs. I only use it on the dough setting and then bake it in two smaller loaves. The bread crust is much finer and softer, which we like. Also, we are always watching our weight and smaller bread means smaller sandwiches, toast, etc. which means fewer calories. These mixes are convenient and suit our summer schedule.
My wife bakes this in a breadmaker.  loaves come out uniform, kinda dense, but does not tend to fall apart when slicing.  excellent flavor.  as good as any on the shelf for less than 2$ a loaf.
Easy to make in the breadmaker, rose like a charm, even the kids loved it and thought it was a dessert!

Love these bread mixes; I use them for all my bread in my breadmaker.  I like to add tons of extra ingredients for even more fiber: seeds, quinoa, oats, wheat germ, bran, walnuts.  This makes a small, more dense loaf (don't add more than about 1/2 cup to 3/4 cup of extras).

column9: Way better than most bread mixes
column10: I had used Krusteaz for years (had a ton from Costco), but wish I ran out of that sooner. This bread has so much more flavor and texture, as others have noted. Also, it almost always comes out right, whereas I had more failures with the Krusteaz for whatever reason.

I don't do many reviews so when a product inspires me enough to write one, you know it has to be good.  This mix is over $3.50 a box in the only store in my area that carries it.  This price for 6 boxes at Amazon is a steal!  And the bread is absolutely excellent.  The review saying it is too sweet is crazy...I actually add an extra tablespoon or two of honey for fun.
This bakes up great in my bread machine, and I love the texture and "crunch" this bread has.

column9: Amazing Bread for the bread machine.
column10: I purchased this for my bread machine.  I am very happy with this product.  It worked great, made a great loaf of bread, and tasted even better.  I have no complaints.  You basically just follow directions with a bread machine and pour in the ingredients.  Within hours then you will have a great loaf of bread.  I like the ease of this mix and everyone that ate this bread really like the light and fluffy taste.

This bread was good but not good enough to keep me coming back for more. I consider it just average for a multi-grain bread, and not as good as what Kroger offers in its bakery. My favorite Hodgson Mill mix is the Cheese & Herb which has become my daily bread.

Makes delicious loaves for less than the price of good bread at most supermarkets--I've started bringing them to parties instead of a bottle of wine, and they've been well received! Although it's designed for bread machines, you can easily make it by hand if you don't have one.  Perhaps because of the nine-grain flour, I've found that this bread doesn't seem to rise quite as high as some other recipes, but I haven't had a dud loaf or batch of yeast yet. The different grains make the loaf wonderfully complex without being too strong-tasting; I've tried this and the Honey Whole Wheat from Hodgson Mill, and this one is my favorite of the two. Might be good with nuts and dried cranberries added, as well!

I subscribed to one Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread 6 pk a month & the Potato Bread 6 pk every 2 months.It's great waking up in the morning to fresh bread made in my bread machine.GREAT products . . . if you like fresh, homemade bread, I recommend Hodgson Mill very highly!!

This bread is delicious and easy to make.  I like the various textures that come from the different grains.  I use a one pound breadmaker, and this mix is made for a 1.5 pound breadmaker.  So I have to measure out the mix rather than use the whole box. This is a minor inconvenience.

Since we're basically a whole-grain vegan family nowadays, it's super to have a source to get the right kind of mix for our bread machine.  We eat a lot of legumes [various beans made various ways] and a hunk of this bread is a perfect go-along.  Product arrived as promised, on time and in good freshness condition.  Would not hesitate to recommend this one...fine taste, good quality.

I have tried and fail miserably at bread making. This is a cinch. No way to screw it up. And this is one substantial bread. Great for sloppy sandwiches. Tummy filler in the morning with jam and coffee.

This is very good bread. It has a great texture and doesn't dry out as quickly and has better flavour as comapred to Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). I make it with olive oil and it comes out moist an delicious. The only downside is that it's a bit more expensive, but worth the cost.

My husband & Ilove this bread!  I usually make a nice, hearty lunch sandwich with it to take to work. The bread is dense with a nutty grainy flavor. I use my Kitcheaid stand mixer & make 2 loaves at once, so the machine does all the work for me. It also freezes well. Buying the mix with "subscribe & save" also saves money.
I love whole grain breads and have been baking for years. This is better than my own recipes.

The Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix is the best bread mix I have ever used. The only hint I would give you is you might want to use another half packet of dry yeast to the mix. I usually put it in the water before I pour in the mix.
Easy to make without a bread maker and very tasty.  It's good with everything, but we especially like it for breakfast toasted with butter and honey.  Very good value.

Absolutely my favorite bread! Bake it weekly. Cannot find this product in my local grocery stores. Since I starting using this mix, have not purchased a single loaf of store bought bread. Nothing better than freshly baked bread and this mix is so simple to use and a money saver in the hot summers of Texas with no oven heat running up the AC bill while baking this in the bread machine.

But I do consider mixes of any kind to be expensive, so in the case of this bread mix I add more of my own flour to it and get two large loaves of bread instead of one.  No need to double the yeast when you do this, just the water and oil. It makes using a mix like this much more economical, and it's still a great, tasty bread with different grain flavors that's home baked.

This is a great product.  It's way better than any store bought bread.  I won't be able to buy it anymore because the price went from $13 to $21 in one month.  But if the price becomes reasonable again, I look forward to purchasing.

column9: Great bread at a very low price
column10: I've calculated out that it costs me about $2/loaf to make whole grain organic bread from scratch. Hogson Mill 9 Grain is very economical, at about $2.29/loaf, given that it is also 9 grains. It's not organic, and that's the only downside.I'm ecstatic with this bread! I make incredibly fluffy loaves. I do not use the included yeast, but rather use the Saf-Instant yeast (http://amzn.com/B003Z7VYXW). I microwave 1 cup + 3 tablespoons of filtered water in the microwave for 26 seconds (1300w microwave). I then add 2 teaspoons of yeast and 1 tablespoon of organic coconut sugar (http://amzn.com/B005HGOIQ4), and let set for 5 minutes.I then add the yest/sugar/water mix to my bread machine and dump in the entire package of bread mix. I also add 2 tablespoons of dough enhancer (http://amzn.com/B0001AVTDQ). I add 1/4 of olive oil/canola oil blend (http://amzn.com/B003WT31SY). I set the bread machine on the white bread setting, and let it do it's thing.These loaves are SUPER fluffy, very tasty. The whole family loves it, and now demands that I make bread regularly. I don't mind because it's less expensive than buying whole wheat bread at the store, and much tastier!

This bread used to rise for me a few years ago.  I have tried it over the past few years, about four or five times and it doesn't rise.  I tried different yeast, more water, putting the dough in a warmer place and it still didn't rise.

Must have been bad luck. The yeast packet was bad/inactive. The bread did not bake correctly. It was just a partially stirred mess at the bottom of the baking pan in the bread machine. (I've seen this happen before. I don't think I can blame Hodgson Mill. Please comment if you know more about this phenomenon?) I tasted some of the quasi-baked bread and could tell that it would have been generally a good loaf - not a great bread, but decent.

This is the third variety of Hodgson Mill bread mix we have tried, and so far it's the best of what we have sampled.  However, for whole grain bread, it isn't THAT tasty.  Nonetheless, is is infinitely easier to make bread from this handy little box rather than tracking down and assembling all of the ingredients on their own.  This mix makes a 1 1/2 pound loaf, which lasts about one meal at our house.  The procedure is pretty simple, add water, then the flour mix, yeast, and some butter and turn on the machine and wait (you only supply the butter and water, everything else is in the box).  The six boxes actually don't take up that much room, so it is not too burdensome to buy this quantity and it is handy to have the fixings for fresh bread readily available.  I give it four stars, though, because the bread isn't really all that special or tasty, although it is fine.

I never had 9 grain bread before and thought I would give this a try I'm so glad I bought this mix this bread tasted very good. I made it in our bread machine and had the settings on whole wheat & light crust and the loaf turned out better then I thought. we will for sure be buying this bread mix again along with the other flavors.

Evidently bread machines have gone out of fashion since I last had one 15 years ago. I bought a machine (Zojurishi Supreme) without knowing grocery stores no longer sell mixes.  Amazon to the rescue.This bread cooks easily according to the directions even where I add crushed walnuts, raisins, flax, strawberries, vegetable pulp -- that's right, I experiment with everything.  Cleanup is a breeze if you own a sponge and a sink. Amazon ships you a case within a few days of ordering and I will likely have to go on subscription since I eat this so quickly.
I've been using the 9 Grain mix for about 3 years and never had a bad loaf.  I couldn't even imagine going back to bread from the grocery store.  An added bonus is that it's cheaper than store bread.

I've tried to make bread on my own and not been very successful.  This mix comes out fantastic every time!  I mix and knead it with my hands, put it in a cold oven to rise, and bake it with a sauce pan of water in the oven (to help with the moisture as it bakes).  My husband, two kids and I usually finish the loaf before the end of the day!

This mix makes a very tasty bread, I made it my breadmaker and it came out great.  The only thing is I think its made for a smaller breadmaker, the loaf was only about 2/3rds the size of other mixes I use.  I'm sure with the proper measuring and adaptation, I could get it just right.  Even so, its very good and a healthy alternative to homemade white bread mixes.
I HAVE MADE THIS BREAD FOR YEARS BUT THE TWO STORES I GOT IT FROM NO LONGER CARRY IT. I WAS VERY HAPPY TO FIND A SOURCE TO BUY IT. IT ALSO MAKES GOOD ROLLS.  THKS JT.

My local stores have stopped selling this bread.  Buying it from amazon.com is great.  Good packaging and fast shipment.The bread made in a bread maker is easy.  We add raisins to it.  It is gone the next day!
This is really good bread. It is so soft and easy to slice for sandwiches. I love it as toast with a little butter and honey.

I bought my first bread machine, and decided to buy this bread mix to try it out.  It couldn't have been easier.  I used the wheat bread setting, and just added water, canola oil, the bread mix, and the yeast provided in the box.  Oh so easy, and the whole family enjoyed it!
Although all of the Hodgson bread mixes we have tried are good, this is one of our favorites.  It has a wholesome, hearty flavor and the aroma while it is baking . . . mmmmmm!!!

I bought this for my bread machine and was very pleased with my first loaf of bread.  I did use the directions from my bread machine how to place each ingredient, because the box didn't have clear directions. Looking forward to our next wonderful loaf of grain bread.

I ORDERED THE 6 PK OF 9 GRAIN HODGSON MILL BREAD MIX BECAUSE I WANTED TO BE ABLE TO USE MY NEW BREAD MACHINE AS SOON AS IT ARRIVED. I KNEW THAT THIS BRAND WAS A RELIABLE ONE AND I ALSO WANTED TO HAVE A MIX ON HAND SHOULD I NEED TO BAKE BREAD ON SHORT NOTICE AND WAS IN A HURRY.  I HAVE NOT BEEN DISAPPOINTED.  THIS MIX MAKES A GREAT LOAF OF BREAD AND IS CONSISTANT.  I WILL CONTINUE TO USE IT.
Of the different bread mixes from Hodgson Mill, the 9-Grain is my favorite.  Family & friends like it as well.  Great tasting bread!!
I was so pleased with this bread that I ordered 3 of the other ones.

column9: Could not be eassier to make some very good bread
column10: The baking aroma was wonderful and preparing in my bread machine could not have been easire.  This very good tasting bread was much less expensive than a comparable bread from Whole Foods Market.  I recognized the Hodgson Mills brand as one carried by Whole Foods so that created a higher trust factor.  There are cruchy grain particles in the mix that are delightful.  My only thourht is that the texture could be a bit more firm but still very pleasant.  I will be ordering more in the future.As always, the ordering and delivery through Amazon.com was seamless.

I had been buying the Hodgson Mill Whole Wheat mixes for awhile and one day just decided to try their 9 Grain. It was a good choice. I have cancelled my Subscribe and Save to the Whole Wheat and switched to this. The taste is "heartier" with a sort of chewy texture. It also smells SO good -- yeasty and nutty.

I make one of these loaves every week. I used a combination of bread machine (to knead) then let rise, shape and put in baking pan . Bake in oven. Have had excellent results every time. these mixes are to be highly recommended. Reasonable prices, clear instructions. what's not to love?
This is the best bread I have ever had.  Not only is it easy to do, it is delicious. When I think about paying the $5.00 I used to pay for a loaf of bakery bread, I am happy I found Hodgson's Mills.

If you're looking for a brown bread mix that's delicious and not loaded with sugar, molasses or honey, you've found it!  We're English and like our bread to be of the non-sweet variety!  We have a Panasonic bread machine (like our one at home!) and find that if we use 300 mls of water, the 'rapid bake' and 'large' settings, you get an outstanding loaf in one and a half hours - perfect!  Enjoy.
Having fresh bread baking in my home is such a treat and being able to eat freshly baked whole grain bread is an added bonus.

column9: Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: Great product for bread makers this bread taste great just like a bakery. Easy to follow directions.
Very good overall. Easy to user in a bread machine.  Only sort of negative is that some of the grain in the bread can get into and between teeth.
Very easy to bake. Produces a very flavorful dense loaf (that's the grain). You don't need a machine, I bake in the oven and get consistently great results with this product.

The Hodgson Mill 9-Grain Bread Mix is one of our favorites. It has an excellent flavor and is better than any store brought bread including the artisan types. We just love to eat this fresh from the bread maker and consider it to be a dessert. We use the light crust setting on the bread maker, pour the bread mix in followed by the yeast with just the right amount of warm water...a few hours later and we have an excellent loaf of bread.

This is a great mix especially if you add dates and walnuts. Cook an extra 5-10 minutes. If your kitchen is cold let rise in a warm oven 115 degrees. Hodgson Mill 9 Grain Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

column9: great if you don't mind your bread not rising too much
column10: The taste of this bread is good, the ease of making the bread is good, and the overall product is o.k. But, I do not know why the bread will not rise very high. I'm new to a bread maker, finally using the one I bought 15 years ago, and though my bread tastes good, the bread does not rise very high - regardless of what I do. Still, for the cost and taste, this product is adequate. I tried one other brand and it didn't rise too much either, so perhaps its me....

column9: Hodgson Mill Bread Mix a Great Product
column10: The Hodgson Mill Bread Mix I purchased on Amazon.com is wonderful.  It works beautifully in my bread machine and the quality of the loaf is a-one. Yummy!
Yuck!  This stuff has no flavor at all.  I donated the other five boxes to a food bank.

This product is terrible.I use different types of bread mix in an automatic machine.  This bread did not rise at all.  I used 3 different packages out of the 6 and all were bad.  Basicallythe bread did not rise.  I switched to another brand and the loaf came out fine.  Be warned...  not a great product.  Basically cooked a loaf that looked like asoftball.DO NOT BUY!

column9: tasty, easy and reliable bread mix - again
column10: howdy y'all,this makes a nice bread. it's not special or flashy - it's simply good bread. quite nice for sandwiches or just nibbling.made it with both olive & vegetable oils. the olive oil is - as expected - better.rated a THREE cuz it's neither more nor less than expected.take care,lee

THIS MIX IS MY ALL TIME FAVORITE...IT RIVALS ANYTHING I HAVE EVER TASTED IF YOU LIKE A GRAIN TYPE BREAD...USE IN A BREAD MACHINE AND IT TURNS OUT PERFECT EVERYTIME...HAVE STARTED BUYING IT AND HONEY WHEAT MIX TWO CASES AT A TIME AND USUALLY ORDER ONCE A YEAR..24 BOXES...IT'S TERRIFIC
Just received this item in the mail. It's not organic, but is listed as such. :(

column9: Nice fluffy, but way to sweet !!!
column10: It`s basicly like toastbread, just sweeter. Don`t buy it, it isn`t the money worth !!!

I ordered the 9 Grain Mix but received the European Cheese and Herb Mix.  I should have sent it back but instead, I baked a loaf of the Cheese and Herb bread.  My mistake.  It baked nicely but the crust was tough and chewey and I was not impressed with the flavor.
Bought one of these cheeseman fruitcakes for christmas for myself and my mother-in-law and we both thought they were delicious. I will be ordering more in the futureas soon as I lose a few pounds.
Was like the packers in last years playoffs , a total loser.If you want to buy a good fruitcake, find it elsewhere. Wisconson need not be proud of this product.

This is very good bread mix. It works out to less than three dollars a loaf. It actually tastes like bread. It is very tasty and has good texture.Much better than the bread you buy at the store. Plus when you make it at home it is always fresh. I will be trying the rye and plain white next.

I tried these mixes because my sister likes them with her bread machine. I just get tired of having to think too much about what to put in my bread, so, a mix made sense. The yeast is really sensitive to temp, use your thermometer to be sure the water is not too hot. Reliable delicious bread or rolls with only a few minutes of effort. I want to try them all now.

I made this a couple times as is out of the box with great results.I live with my brother, who shares my love of heated foods; he suggested adding a little heat to this mix. What a great idea it turned out to be.My first try was some dried, ground chili peppers (I dry my own in a dehydrator); not bad.Next, I tried some fresh, finely chopped jalapenos. Wow, what a great loaf!Here's the thing; if using dried peppers, put them in at the beginning. If using the fresh peppers, put them in at the time for add-ins (according to the instructions for your machine).Enjoy...

column9: CHEESE AND HERB BREAD IS VERY GOOD
column10: We have been purchasing this bread mix for a couple of years now.  It virtually never fails to make good bread in our bread machine.  The bread is a heavy bread with a subtle and, we think, quite a good taste.  If you like a good dense bread with a slightly different flavor you may very well like this.Dr. Richard Pendleton

This is a tasty, hearty bread with great texture, fabulous flavor.  Smells fantastic while baking.  Makes a beautiful loaf of bread that holds up well when cut.  I've had many bread mixes that didn't rise properly or came out gummy.  This was perfect.

Oh, the smell of this bread.  Yes, it tastes just as good.  This is called a cheeese and herb bread, but you will mostly notice the herbs.  That's fine with me because this is a delicious blend.I am not a sandwich person, prefer hot food, but I made a sandwich with this bread using ham, salami, mayo, and some shredded Italian cheese.  Oh my gosh, it was so good I had it for dinner three days in a row.I've used the mix several times in my bread machine (a mini loaf in the Just for Dinner bread machine that Amazon used to sell, gosh those were great machines), cutting the recipe in half and being rather careless about the measuring.  Came out great each time no matter how nonchalant I was about the amount of yeast, et al.I've also made the full recipe once with my new KitchenAid stand mixer (a Friday Sale special on Amazon -- thank you, Amazon, thank you!) and it came out even better.  I might add that there were no instructions included for mixers, just bread machine and hand.  I just did it by guesswork, and it came out wonderful.So no matter how I mess up this recipe, I've been successful and gotten great bread.  It is a very forgiving mix.

I bought this bread because I was buying another item and could get the $10 discount for a more than $49 purchase.This bread is FANTASTIC.  Great flavor, great texture, and a total hit with my company.  I'm going to feel sad after I bake the last box, but no loaf of bread, especially a loaf you bake yourself, is worth almost $3 a loaf.  If the price becomes more reasonable, I'll buy it more often.

column9: this Cheese & Herb Bread is GREAT
column10: Before you get to eat it, the smell of this bread baking is amazing. Like the other mixes I have tried from this company, the ingredients are fresh, including the yeast. Cheaper than buying bread, especially if you buy it through the Amazon subscription plan (6 @ $9.60). The cheese & herb flavor is a delicious accompaniment to any meal. Makes a great grilled cheese sandwich with provolone & mozzarella. Also makes a fantastic pizza crust.

This is my family's favorite bread.  Whenever I make it, it NEVER lasts more than a few minutes.  All 4 of my kids BEG me to make it.  The smell is incredibly aromatic and wonderful.  I actually make and give this bread as a gift, with a pot of soup, whenever a friend needs a "pick me up".You won't be disappointed with this mix.

We bake these weekly at my office.  Everyone agrees this flavor is the best the brand has to offer on Amazon.  We've easily eaten 18 of these since we started baking them twice a week.We had a case of Honey Wheat that, to be honest, became the least favorite and sat unused till we ran out of Cheese & Herb.
I like the ease of use and texture of finished product; however, I'd like alittle more flavor from the cheese and herbs.
This bread is absolutely fantastic....you just can't go wrong with it.  The flavor and texture are the best I've ever found.  I love it and the price is terrific!!

This is my family's favorite bread mix for the bread machine. I was so happy to find it for sale in bulk. It is a little more expensive but worth every penny at our house.The texture is light and the flavors truly remind one of an old world stone ground clay oven baked loaf. Outstanding!

The flavor is brought out nicely by toasting. It booted sourdough toast down into second place in my esteem. But Krusteaz Cinnamon Raisin bread is tied for first place with this one. With the crust set at medium, it comes out of my bread machine perfect every time. I keep plenty on hand so I'm never without it. It's my daily must-have bread.

I found this product while looking for their Kentucky flour mix.  It is made to use with a machine or to make by hand.  It works great with a bread maker!  This bread has just enough flavor to be absolutely scrumptious using it for chicken salad sandwiches. It also makes a nice light flavored toast. Can't wait to try it with other things!After trying this, I bought the Whole Wheat, which I haven't tried yet.

I bought a number of pre-packaged bread mixes, including several by Hodgson Mill (white and caraway rye too).They are all delicious, and no fuss to prepare in a bread machine. My wife and daughter love this mix, and frequently ask me to make more. Time for another order!
I love this bread.  But I also added into the mix in the mix in.  Sun Dried Tomatoes with Italian Basil.  The smell when the bread was baking was great.  The taste was even better
This is very yummy, super soft bread. I used it for both pizza crust and loaf bread and am very pleased. Will order other varieties soon!

This is great for sandwiches, or as a crust for pizza. Or foccacia. Just add a little cheese and some fresh herbs like rosemary, parsley, and thyme after you roll it out on a greased pan. A little ground pepper and bake. It is very good with soup or salad.

Bought this bread with several others to test out. We are hooked on making pizza crust with this bread and have had friends who have also become enamored with it. Was a little strong as just bread for us. But we have plenty of other bread types to use for that.

Easy to make and comes with all the ingredients including the yeast. I didn't like this bread at all. It tasted way too much like rosemary. I gave away the other five boxes and no one else seemed to like it either.

I loves this bread . Just brought a bread maker and this was the first bread I tried. I added the yeast first then the dry mix then sugar and butter then I added the water. I was told that this is the best way to make the bread. It came out very good. I added dried cranberries to this to give it a much better overall flavor and it came out wonderful. I will be using this again because it came out so great

We are big fans of fresh bread. While we usually make our own from a number of recipes available over the Internet, this company produces fine products as well. We have been pleased with this flavor as well as the Barley and 9 Grain. This makes the best toast and bread for vinegar and oil, while the other two excel as sandwich bread as well as toast. Good stuff!
This bread is more "herby" than cheesy. Sort of heavy but really good toasted. I can't really taste the cheese.  Will try adding some chunks of cheese and jalapenos for fun!
This is by far my favorite Hodgson Mill Bread Mix.  Absolutely delicious, however I chose not to order the mix several times last year as the price went up 40% at some point.

column9: Hodgson Mill Bread Mix Is Great Stuff!
column10: Hodgson Mill makes a fantastic array of bread mixesthat are easy and fun to make.  I buy the EuropeanCheese & Herb to make the most heavenly pizza crustswith.  I usually use 2 mixes and make a gigantic pizzawith very thick crust filled with every kind of toppingyou can imagine.  Everytime I share this pizza withothers, they *ALWAYS* comment on how wonderful thecrust is, and say they are dying to know what my secretrecipe is.  No commercial pizza company can beat thetaste, no matter how expensive or gourmet it is.  Ifyou want to make a truly "knock-your-socks-off GREATpizza" you simply MUST try Hodgson Mill European Cheese& Herb bread mix for your crust!  I'm getting hungryjust writing about it, so I'm gonna go now and make mea yummy pizza!

We love, love, love this bread!  Have it now on auto delivery!  Hodgson Mill has proved to be the most dependable bread mix.  I have a wonderful bread machine and all of the Hodgson Mill bread mixes come out perfect!  Every time!  This one is our favorite! Texture and taste could not be better!  Makes the house smell wonderful when baking!  Sliced thin this is amazing for sandwiches or toast.  Keeps for a week in the frig, but we usually eat it faster than that!  Highly recommend!!!

column9: Great bread mix, makes me look like a professional bread chef
column10: I make this mix in my Cuisinart bread machine nearly every week. It's my husbands favorite mix. Great for ham and cheese sandwiches that he takes to work, or even better served fresh baked with some butter and Parmesan cheese along side pasta and sauce, instead of garlic bread.
Awesome bread mix.  Makes great pizza crust, bread sticks, calzone crust or just a delicious loaf of bread.  Will definitely buy again.
This bread came out big and fluffy in my bread maker.  It has a very nice flavor for dipping in marinara sauce or olive oil.  Makes a good sandwich with meat and lettuce.

Whenever I make a loaf of this my family eats it as some would eat popcorn, taking a slice every time they walk anywhere near the kitchen.  It does slice nicely, and would probably make great sandwiches if it would last that long.  I make it at high altitude in a 2 lb Cuisinart breadmaker, so under perhaps less than ideal conditions.  It's very easy to make, and with the Subscription, it's affordable, too.

This bread worked out great in my machine. I made a few loaves on delay, and one right away. Each came out exactly the same: perfect.Flavor: it tasted great to us. I serve it when my extended family is around. Everyone liked it, plus it gets the "freshness" bonus points. The cheese and herb are light in this brand, so if you like a very strong herb flavor, this might not be for you.Price: With Amazon Prime, I'm paying $2 a loaf. I see that some people don't like the price, but is making home-baked bread a money decision? Not for me - I do it for the ceremony, for the great odor in the house, and the luxury of a fresh loaf of bread.

I have purchased this product many times.  Makes a great tasting BLT.  The only problem I've encountered is the yeast package sometimes is old and the bread does not rise.  Happens a lot when I purchase several cases of the product.  This can be fixed by purchasing fresh packages of yeast and using it instead.

column9: Hodgson Mill European Cheese & Herb Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)
column10: Great product for bread makers this bread taste great just like a bakery. Easy to follow directions.

This was the first bread we made in our new bread maker and even before it was done, the kitchen smelled sooooo good.This bread is really delicious. Not sure why this is called "European", since I don't recall having bread this good when I lived over there.Anyways - this is very tasty!

column9: Best Bread for Grilled Cheese Sandwiches!
column10: We make this great, tasty bread two or three times a week. It's great for sandwiches -- especially grilled cheese. We also make braided loaves baked free-form to serve as "pull apart" bread to serve with soup and salad. However, a tip if you don't use a bread machine. We add a tablespoon of honey and a teaspoon of sugar to the water to proof the yeast then add a teaspoon of regular, not fast-rise, yeast to that provided with the mix. This seems to work better using a KitchenAid to mix and kneed the bread. Bake as directed. The extra east seems to withstand the longer rising time required when using an oven to bake the loaf.

column9: My favorite Hodgson Mill bread by far!
column10: I bought this bread to use with my Panasonic SD-YD250  Automatic Bread Maker.  The directions were simple (and with that particular bread maker, the water temperature is inconsequential) and within 2 minutes my work was done.The bread smelled delicious as soon as the mixing began and got even better during baking.  The loaf rose very high and the herb flavor was great (not overpowering).In addition to traditional loaf bread, this makes great rolls, pizza crust, and calzones.The Amazon price is good, too, compared to my local grocery, where these are sold in the "organic" section (with the requisite "organic" price tag) for twice as much.

I AM NOT AN EXPERIENCED COOK. I RECENTLY ORDERED A BREAD MACHINE AND THE RECIPES WERE CONFUSING TO ME. SO MANY DIFFERENT FLOURS,BAKING POWER,SALT,BAKING SODA,YEAST,ETC....I WAS FRUSTRATED! AFTER SEEING Hodgson Mill European Cheese & Herb Bread Mix, ON AMAZON, I DECIDED TO GIVE IT A TRY. ALL THE INGREDIENTS ARE INCLUDED, EVEN THE YEAST. ALL I NEEDED TO ADD WAS WATER AND BUTTER OR VEG OIL(I USE OLIVE OR PEANUT OIL). THE BREAD TURNED OUT GREAT AND VERY EASY TO BAKE. THE PRODUCT IS PERFECT FOR A NOVICE LIKE ME. I WOULD SUGGEST ANYONE, NOVICE OR NOT, TO TRY THIS MIX OUT. ONE THOUGHT ....YOU MUST FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS ON THE BOX EXACTLY! I HAVE SINCE PURCHASED EVERY VARIETY OF HODGSON BREAD MIXES AVAILABLE THRU THE "SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE" PROGRAM ON AMAZON AND THE PRICE IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN THE GROCERY STORE AS WELL AS THE EASE OF DELIVERY. Hodgson Mill BREAD MIXES ARE ALL EASY TO MAKE AND ALWAYS TASTE GREAT. AFTER A WHILE I MAY LEARN MORE ABOUT BAKING BREAD FROM SCRATCH, BUT I WILL CONTINUE TO USE THE Hodgson Mill European Cheese & Herb Bread Mix. TAKE MY NOVICE ADVICE AND TRY THIS, YOU WILL NOT HAVE ANY REGRETS!

howdy y'all,this stuff tastes grand! makes me think of pizza for some reason. would be nice if the maker supplied the list of "herbs" somewhere. [*sigh ...*] i guess it has basil or thyme but i don't have a good enuf palate to tell. smells delightful, delicious, delectable and "delovely" while cooking and almost that good when eating it. another good bruschetta base.made it with vegetable oil and with olive oil. the olive oil is detectably better.rated a FOUR cuz it's more than i expected.take care,lee

This is our favorite of all the Hodgson's mixes.  I like to add poppyseeds to the mix, or dried onion, and extra herbs.  It's a delicious bread with our without additions.  It has a delicate flavor, which is great, because you don't always want an overpowering bread, but if you do you can easily add more ingredients to it.  I've never had a mix fail to rise.  I usually make this in my breadmaker, but I've also made it in to rolls in the oven.  This also makes a great focaccia base.  One of our favorite ways to augment this mix is to add tomato powder and garlic powder- and it smells like an Italian meal is cooking in our breadmaker.

column9: Amazing Bread!  Tastes best warm but cold is great too!
column10: Husband and I love this bread. It makes our house smell like pizza when we make it and it has a wonderful taste of cheese. I am using a 1.5 lb old breadmaker (probably at least 5 years old) and it rises perfectly.  Will be ordering this for a long time to come.  They really got this one right.

You taste the herbs but they aren't overdone. Don't really detect the cheese but overall a nice flavor. I bake from scratch in my oven in cool weather but in the summer the bread machine comes out and these mixes make it quick and convenient.

I have bought several types of bread mix for my breadmaker.  My family likes this type of bread mix "head & shoulders" above all others.  I like each different type, but this one is the best.  Hodgson Mills deliver exceptional quality.  Never had a problem with any box, every one created a great loaf of bread.  And the price from Amazon is GREAT.  Buying one box of this in a grocery store would be 2 time more expensive or even more.  Great product, great company and Amazon, in this case, has the best price!

column4: L. S. Pray "Blonde, little old lady"
column10: I loved this bread.  Very tasty with a good texture and taste.  I tried making something similar from scratch and it didn't turn out anything like this bread.  Slices great warm or cold.  I bake for my boss and her family and they all voted a resounding "Yes, we like this" when I brought her in a loaf.  Freezes well and toasts up great either plain or with butter or cream cheese.  My boss ate hers with spaghetti after lightly toasting.  She said it was outstanding and wanted more (am I surprised, no).  Would highly recommend if you want a good Italian style bread.  I made mine in my horizonetal Wolfgang Puck breadmaker and used a crisp or dark crust setting.  I tried all other settings, light and medium and the bread came out great with a little different texture but still great nonetheless.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: My very favorite...........Hodgson Mill European Cheese & Herb Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).......Great mix simple to use and smells wonderful as it is baking!~

I had purchased the Caraway Rye as the first bread I tried from Hodgson. Maybe the yeast was bad, but it was terrible, so my friends and I were apprehensive about this pack.
