This bread is fantastic.In my opinion, take this bread, toast it, butter it, and put garlic salt on it and you will have the only bread you will ever eat with pasta again. It would be easy to find your own favorite use for this bread. I have given some of it to co-workers and friends and I have not yet met someone that did not like this bread. I had to give up a whole loaf to someone who tried it it today!You won't be disappointed in this bread.

I do not like store bought bread at all! Been making bread machine bread and in the oven for years.Mixes of course. So call me spoiled. Only the best for me and mine:)I love good sandwiches. On the grill or off. This bread adds a dimension to a grilled ham and cheese like you never had. Making a ham and cheese, roast beef and swiss, egg salad, chicken salad tuna salad, turkey club? OMG! Toasted adds yet another dimension to this fabulous bread. and with and Italian meal I sauted E.V.O.O. and lots of garlic and applied it to the slices then broiled. I SLICED THE LOAF INTO WIDER SLICES THEN REGULAR BREAD SLICES. Crispy and yet the bread substantial enough to be chewy. No fluff bread here!  What a CONCEPT!

I first bought this mix about a year ago. I am no expert at the art of bread making but I have made approximately one dozen loaves from this mix both by hand and bread machine and each method produced a delicious, well formed and consistently textured loaf. The simple and accurate instructions on the box include hand and machine methods for preparing this bread so even the novice can turn out a nice loaf with this mix. The texture is somewhat dense as you would expect from a European style mix. We love the hearty texture but for those preferring a spongier bread just add a couple tablespoons of gluten. We love it for sandwiches and it makes incredible garlic toast served with Italian dishes and steak dinners. It freezes exceptionally well but we always use ours within two months of freezing. It also makes terrific pizza dough.

column9: Hodgson Mill Cheese & Herb Bread Mix
column10: Love this product.  Makes a good tasting bread.  The value is in the size versus the price.  I would buy again.

column9: Not bad, but I personally need to spice it up a bit
column10: I purchased a Breadman TR875 breadmaker back in December and I'm a newbie to the baking world.  I always found it easier to just buy a loaf, but figured I'd love to try to make my own one day.  When the breadmaker deal came across, I dove into breadmaking.  Bought a few books, tried a few recipes, and really haven't been wowwed.  I had gotten this 6 pk for about half the current price on a Gold Box deal (just over $10).  The first box I made came out absolutely perfect; nice texture, good taste, had risen perfectly, but something was missing.  I jazzed it up with the herbs used in another bread recipe I've had (which was awesome) and became one of the best toasted-with-butter breads I have encountered to date.  I've been playing with the amounts of spices and still haven't found that perfect loaf, yet.  If the price is right, I'd definitely purchase this imparticular "flavor" again.My additional spices (jarred), in case anyone is interested:1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp basil, 1/4 tsp tarragon, 1/4 tsp dill weed, 1/8 tsp thyme
I tried this bread for the first time and it tasted great. I would recoommend this bread for any bread lover.

Wow! No better word for this mix. Received exactly what I ordered and when I purchased it, it was on sale for $9.60.they taste so incredibly good. And tastes like bread unlike regular bread machine breads.Awesome texture. Moist. Same awesome texture and taste whether using oil or butter...I made two kinds... one with jalapenos and red pepper and another one without any extra ingredients.. they both were gone within hours...Delicious... Also, i oven baked them. No bread machine...this one is a keeper. Best bread mix ever!
I love this cheese & herb bread!  My friends just gave me a bread machine and I am having a lot of fun with it.  I have ordered more Hodgson Mill flavors and am looking forward to trying them.

This bread is so good, I'm going to buy a case of it! I made it into cresent rolls and put little pieces of ham in each roll for a dinner party. omg, it's so good you don't need to add cheese or mustard to the ham as you would on a regular roll...easy and delicious!

column9: Goof-proof PERFECTION, my family loves it!
column10: This is one of the BEST bread machine mixes I have ever used! For me, this is one that you dont get to be too "creative" with, just follow the directions, and you WILL get a perfect loaf. The only time I have had a bad result was when I thought it would be a super idea to semi-replicate a from scratch concept with bacon and MORE cheese.As my friend Heather reminded me "baking bread is science".  (ok, when I add stuff I use Hodgson Mill White bread mix. So THERE, Heather!).I like the fact that it truly is goof proof - from the newer machines, to my Mom's trusty West-Bend dual paddle unit ( yup, she has a newer one, but still likes her "vintage" 1994 ((??)) unit, best).Though any bread-machine mix is (honestly) pretty easy, some results are sub-par. Not with THIS mix. I would guess that it maybe takes 5 minutes to prepare, including reading directions. The result is outstanding! This is a great one to give as a gift too- the unique aroma and flavor really seem to please people.NICE!

This bread mix is easy to prepare (either in a bread-machine or an oven) and the taste is outstanding! When I brought a loaf to a friend, she thought that it was made from scratch! I will order more soon.
This is the best tasting bread machine mix that I have ever tried! It has a wonderful flavor and aroma and the whole family loves it.
this is a great bread mix. one of the few mixes i've used where the season doesn't overpower the flavor of the bread. i will be re-ordering this bread mix often

The taste is wonderful and what an aroma while it baked was wonderful. I read an earlier review of this product where the purchaser said there was a gloopy mess in the bottom of the bread machine. As with most bread mixes, you must add exactly the amount of liquid in the instructions.  Even a very small variance and mix does not work correctly.  Will reorder for sure.
this is one of the breads we make instead of store bought bread flavor is great and easy to make
This makes very good bread with a truly homemade taste. I do not use a breadmachine but bake it in the oven. My granddaughter and my neighbors cannot get enough of this. I recommend it very highly.

column4: Ramsey Boyd "Would rather be living in Costa ...
column10: Not only am I a believer in this great tasting bread... I'm a subscriber and now have it shipped to me on a regular basis.
This is a good, full-bodied, flavorful bread.  It's great for sandwiches, toast, snacking, whatever.  I will be ordering more of this one.

I bought this mix to use in my bread machine, both for loaves and pizza dough. It is delicious! It makes a beautiful dough and my homemade pizza was that much better with the cheese & herb flavor. I'd like to try breadsticks next, which I'm sure will be amazing as well. Highly recommended!
Hodgson Mill has another great bread mix with European Cheese and Herb Bread.  The taste is mild, and the texture is wonderful.
This bread really deliverd - it was great. Purchased similar bread mixes from local grocers - no comparison. This is a great buy.  Try adding some of your own ingredients - even better!
I make bread all the time & always look for variety...this bread is tasty & delicious! I have a two loaf bread machine and my husband kids favorite is this one!

I purchased these bread mixes intending to use the finished product with bread dipping herbs and olive oil. My guess was right, this bread went perfectly! I baked it in my bread machine and it turned out beautifully with the setting for a medium crust. All I had to add was a little bit of oil and some water. Fresh bread doesn't get any easier than that!My only complaint is that one of the boxes of mix did not have the yeast packet included as it should have. Other than that, no complaints at all. The price was also very reasonable.

column9: Hodgson Mill European Cheese and Herb Bread Mix
column10: It produces a decent loaf of bread however the flavor is rather mild. Which we found disapointing. We also noticed that the aroma when baking was minimal. Again not a big perk. One of the reasons for baking at home is the scent flooding the home making you eager for dinner! However we found when served with dishes of seasoned olive oil it was wonderful! We may buy it when we find it on sale but otherwise we are not likely to go out of our way to purchase again.

column9: Speedy......and great too! New price doubles old price!
column10: If you haven't checked recently, the cost of these bread mixes have more than doubled!!!! Even with subscription rates prices have doubled. If I didn't look closely at my subscriptions, which include this mix and also the Whole Wheat Honey mix, I wouldn't have noticed it and Amazon would have shipped as normal without informing me of the new price hike, kinda' unscrupulous. I know food prices are skyrocketing all over because of fuel costs, but more than double the original subscription price? The original price of $9.60 was tremendous, but does the extra fuel costs justify the new cost? The same is true for all of the Hodgson products, including their Vital Wheat Gluten. All of their products are great, but is anybody out there making more money now in this economy? I cancelled all my subs because I felt the wool was being pulled over my eyes. Do not let my criticisms hold you back from purchasing these excellent products, but with things looking like they are not going to get any better soon, I am going back to making my breads from scratch. See below for my original review:I purchased a case of Hodgson Mill European Cheese and Herb Bread Mix two days ago!!!! I purchased it as a Gold Box deal just for me, which made it ridiculously inexpensive, $10.73 a case of 6, delivered, which will average out to about $2 a loaf, more expensive than scratch, but  not much more expensive, and I do not know of a recipe that could challenge this one. (If I knew in advance how delicious this mix is, I would have put it on the subscription program, bringing it down even further, to less than $9.60 a case, delivered) It was in my bread machine within 15 minutes of receiving it. Three hours later... my house starts smelling like a pizza parlor back in my home town Brooklyn 50 years ago. And, this stuff tastes like it smells, luscious! I made the mistake of baking it in my machine on dark, which made the crust just a little too dark, just short of burnt, but it was still the most delicious loaf I've produced, scratch or mix. It was liberally laced throughout with the herbs, and it was so moist and tender, you must try some! Do not hesitate, get this mix, it is the ultimate in ease, just add some butter, or oil of your choice, some water, the included yeast, and the mix, according to your machine, in 3-4 hours, your house too, will smell like your local home pizzeria:~)P.S. It makes a 1 1/2 lb loaf, but can easily be adjusted down to a one pounder, there are directions for both.P.P.S. Yeahs to Amazon for getting it to me in two days.P.P.P.S. I have learned early in my bread machine history that you must let the finished loaf sit and cool down to room temperature on a bakers rack. It comes out of the machine piping hot and still cooking through the steam generated, so please, try to resist the urge to slice it up right away...... hey, hey, hey, I saw you... put that knife down! It really makes a huge difference.P.P.P.P.S. I will try to post several photos of my latest loaf shortly, cheers.....P.P.P.P.S. I have since used this mix for pizza dough(instructions on box). It has turned my normally bland pizza into pizzeria style pizza, I was so proud of myself, I can now make pizza that rivals pizzeria style pizza!!!!

We want you to know that we are very pleased with the quality of service your company provides. We sincerely appreciate your responsiveness and the way you conduct business. We have recommended your company to others because of our satisfaction with your service & product. We look forward to doing business with you for years to come.

I found the bread mix very easy to use.  I've tried it in our bread machine and also in the oven.  Each time the loaves turned out beautifully and my family just loved it. You certainly made a new customer.

We bought this bread with high hopes since we had been making bread for a while now. However, this bread won't rise. I replaced the yeast thinking that it was bad and I have used different temperatures of water, and still nothing. We live in VA altitude is not an issue. Your product is.
I recieved this item in record time, and I love the quality of it!! Thank you
European bread? In no case (I am from Europe). I never ate something so disgusting. The taste of the herbs is extremely dominant.
The title says cheese and herb and all I got was the regular 9 grain.  If you order this, you won't get what you think you ordered.

The blueberry concentrate arrived seeming in good condition but upon adding the amount of water to make juice as instructed, it tasted rotten, almost like wine. I tried adding even more water but that just made it taste like bitter water. I don't know if it was kept or shipped in too hot of conditions but it tasted nothing like blueberries. I will be buying this from a health food store from now on.

column9: Rare concentrate from organically grown blueberries.
column10: Awesome product! Many are skeptical how naturally sweet this concentrate is, but if you take a bite of real blueberry and real cranberry, you'll notice right away how tangy cranberries are and how sweeter and much less tangy the blueberries taste, so comparing this concentrate to cranberry concentrate for the natural sweetness is not feasible. I'm quite this concentrate's sweetness is natural sweetness, as I'm very sensitive to the high fructose corn syrup in the drink. This blueberry concentrate is from organically grown blueberries, so a big higher price compared to others is understandable. I usually add 1/10th of glass and filled with water to drink. No need to add any more sweetness as it is naturally sweet as is. In our rural area, it's hard to come by organically grown blueberries, so this is product is great to compensate my problem!UPDATE on June 29, 2012Almost right after I posted this review, I noticed that the company stop listing "organically grown blueberries". Now it's listed "blueberries", and I assume they are no longer organic. It's too bad since this product was the only one that I know that was made organically. Don't the companies know we consumers want organic products especially when it comes to produce as listed as "dirty dozen" based on how pesticide contaminated!

The Amazon.com description does not list ingredients and two of the reviews were confusing in this regard; one indicating that the product contains sugar and the other mentioning cranberry juice, not blueberry.  I checked the website and it stated that the product is made from 100% blueberry concentrate.

I was very surprise by the taste of this product. Having been suggested by my new eating plan program, I thought it would be very bitter. I love it and recommend it to anyone trying to get away from sugar.

column9: The best way to purchase blueberry juice.
column10: I have purchased this blueberry juice several times now,the concentrated juice is better for shipping,and for storage space in the kitchen.It is delicious,and natural,good for your health,it has no added sugar.I also noticed the ants don't go near it like other juices.

column9: Ok product, but leaked during shipping
column10: It's a good product and I'm glad I bought it but my only complaint is that the bottle leaked during shipping and it was a mess when I got it.

I was sceptical about this product because it tastes like no other unsweetened cranberry juice I've ever tried. Its syrupy, sweeter than other cranberry juices and has a grape juice taste to it. I contacted Dynamic Health and they say its 100% cranberry juice. I still feel a bit sceptical though. I'm used to Tree of Life brand so I think I'll just go back to it.

column9: Tea to enjoy, hot or cold
column10: We had the opportunity to sample Adam Tea. May favorite is Black Tea.  My wife loves the Peach Tea.  We both enjoy either both hot and cold.  My wife could be a tea aficionado as she is very particular about flavor.  We both enjoy a robust, flavorful, fresh tasting tea.  Adam Tea fills that desire for a wonderful bold clean flavor.  The Black Tea has a unique flavor almost like coffee except lighter and healthier or better for you.

I had heard Mum Mums were a great finger food for babies so as soon as I got the OK from my son's pediatrician to start finger foods/teething biscuits, I purchased these.  I was a little worried about the fact that they were from China, but after doing some research, I found that the milk powder that Mum Mums contain is made in New Zealand and that the Organic Mum Mums do not even have milk powder as an ingredient (although the box does state that the product may contain trace amounts.)Anyway, my son loves to chew on these and play with them, and they don't make a mess like other teething biscuits.  They are easy for him to hold and manipulate.  I definitely recommend these over the other types of finger food and biscuits that you can get.I bought mine from Amazon (for a good price for six boxes) but I have also seen these at Babies R US.

Baby Mum-Mum Organic Rice Rusks are great for calming a fussy baby.  They are slightly sweet and dissolve quickly in the mouth.  You would still watch your baby when they are eating these because they can still choke on these if they try to stuff a big piece in their mouth.  This happened to us only once and our baby just spit it back out with a gag reflex.  I love giving these to our baby while we're having our dinner so he can feel like he's eating with us.  The only problem with these are when they get moist from being in the baby's mouth and it ends up on the baby's clothes or high chair or car seat, they dry like cement to whatever it is sticking to.  I love that they are organic though but I don't like that they are made in China.Pros: calms baby's fussiness, dissolves quickly, baby can practice self-feeding, organicCons: potential choking hazard, made in China, hardens to fabrics and objects when wet

My 7-month-old easily gums these and they dissolve without inducing gagging!  He liked them so much the very first time he tried them, I took a taste and was a bit disappointed because they did taste slightly sweet to me (they do have sugar)...but I'll likely buy these again, and recommend these over anything from Gerber!

column9: Get Coco Pop Rice Cakes instead
column10: I've been buying these by the case for years.  My first child LOVED these as a baby and toddler, and my second baby loves them equally.  I always had them on hand because they were a neat snack that always made my kids happy and kept them occupied.  I had huge qualms about the fact that they were made in china, but thought it might help to buy the organic type.I've found a new product recently, coco pop lite rice cakes, that are my new substitute.  LOVE them.  For anyone who has the same qualms about the made in china for the mum-mums, I recommend you try the coco pop rice cakes.  They equally melt in the mouth, and my kids LOVE them.  They aren't really marketed towards babies and kids, but they really should be.  I will still probably get some mum mums to keep in the diaper bag or car, but I won't be getting them by the case on subscribe and ship like I was before.Original Flavor: Coco Multigrain Pop Cakes, 12 Bags, 16 Calories Per Piece, 0 Weight Watcher Point, Great Diet Food, Free Shipping, Only $35.99

My daughter LOVES these and from the rate they are disappearing I am starting to think my husband does as well. The first time we got them we ran across the banana variety at a local grocery (at around 4 bucks a box!). But as soon as we got them home and baby started freaking out with joy every time she was given one, I ordered the box of the organic. I ordered the organic mostly because of the a) "China" thing, and b) the banana ones seemed like they might have more sugar. We just received our 2nd case yesterday and this time we went with the veggie flavor. These I may end up eating if baby doesn't hurry, they're delicious! I really am not that concerned about the Made In China aspect at this point...I understand the concerns of the mothers who are, but since it is a product exported that is also used there on their own children...and the ingredient list is pretty straightforward...it seems a bit xenophobic to worry too much.Now I'm just waiting for her to get enough teeth so we can try the strawberry toddler ones. :)

column9: GREAT, BUT WHY NOT MADE IN USA?
column10: GREAT, BUT WHY NOT MADE IN USA? ITS A GOOD PRODUCT BUT KINDA UPSET ABOUT THE NOT USA FOOD. I WOULD RECOMMEND.

Our little one has been enjoying these for several months now.  They are great for little hands and melt in little mouths.  They are a little crumbly so you do have to watch your child with them.  We make sure she has plenty of water to drink with them and have never had an issue.  They have only a few ingredients and are very gentle on the stomach.  Great pick for teaching little ones to feed themselves.

These are fantastic snacks.  Individually wrapped, you can take them anywhere.  I have given them to my children from the time they are about to eat chunky foods, as they dissolve in their mouths, thus not ever choking on them.  Very happy to have in my cupboard for all snack times.  These are also great if you don't want to give your child a big snack to put them off their next meal.  It's enough to tie them over but not fill them up to not eat their lunch or dinner.

I buy these crackers from my grocery store (military commissary) and wish I'd know about them when my oldest was a baby. The rice is healthier for them than most brands, they come in veggie flavor, and they are organic. I love that I can give them to my baby to chew on while I make her food. They dissolve almost immediately and even my 3 year-old asks for one whenever her sister gets one!

I bought these on a whim while shopping at Babies R Us a few weeks back and my daughter (who was 6 months at the time, now 7 months) loves them! When we were running low I made sure to stock up this time! I love that they're organic and easy for my baby to chew. There IS sugar in these though. It's listed as the 2nd ingrediant on the back of the package. I tasted it myself and they don't taste sweet so at least she's not developing a sweet tooth because of them. These are great for a little snack in between meals and have become part of our normal daily routine with my daughter.

My one year old baby boy likes it. Whenever he cries in my car, BABY MUM-MUM solves the problem!It is good to know for you that this cracker is not sweet, which is good.It's just plain rice cracker, and I think it's better for babies.

column9: My baby loves these BUT watch the sodium
column10: My baby LOVES these. She is teething and would eat the whole box if we let her. BUT just a word of caution about the sodium. It's pretty high. I don't understand why there is salt added to these in the first place! We keep her to two a day at most, which is a real shame as she loves them so much.

I love that these are organic and as an infant, my son loved munching on these. They are quick to dissolve which is a plus for new solid eaters.They are pretty bland and tasteless and have the consistency of a rice cake almost. It's good for new eaters, but as a toddler my son won't eat these anymore.

My son loves these "cookies!"  I realize they are made in china, but they are ISO certified and held to the highest standards.  Would love to buy them made in america, but such a thing doesn't exist.  It's difficult to find gluten free things for babies.  FYI, They sell other flavors that are not organic, so be careful and read the description.

My daugher loves them so I usually give it to her when we go for a walk. However, like other reviewers noticed they are made in China which really worries me. I don't think I will buy them again. Need to look for another snack for my baby.

My 13 month old daughter loves these!  They were her first solid food if I recall correctly.  I used to get the regular, but switched when I realized they came in organic.  I feel like the organic ones are smaller though.  Has anyone else noticed that?

These are a must for every mom!  They are relatively mess free (at least compared to teething bisquits).  They disolve so you don't have to worry about your baby choking. Individually wrapped so an easy grab for the diaper bag. AND they are great for learning how to self feed because they are easier to grab then a tiny puff.  My only con is that they are not fortified.

Our first box was given to use by friends with a baby 8 months older than ours shortly after our baby was born.  "He's going to love these one day!"  Sure enough, as soon as my son was old enough to eat solids, we found out the awesomeness of the Mum-Mum.  My son loves these things.  It's easy to throw a pack of them in a bag for road trips or for daycare.  The USDA certifies the Mum-Mum as organic, which is super-duper!  I'd rather they weren't made in China because I'm tired of us giving China all of our money, but oh well, if an American company can make a snack as cool as the Mum-Mum, I'd happily switch over! For right now, our family is sold on the product.

These are great items because they encourage the learning to eat solids phase safely.  The crackers dissolve in their mouth very quickly, yet they can practice the chewing skill.  They love putting things in their mouth so it keeps them entertained.  My 15 mo old still likes them.  :)

My baby really enjoys these.  They are her first real solid food and they dissolve really easily in the mouth even if she takes a bigger bite.  She is going through them really quickly because she likes them so much.

My baby loves these! She has been eating them since she was 6 months old. The veggie flavored ones and the organic ones are great. She doesn't care too much for the banana ones. I am a little concerned regarding the "Made In China" tag, but see other reviewers who have stated they are backed by an independent company as well. (There are multiple of reviews that have mentioned this statement).This product has saved me from many headaches and meltdowns as once she has it in her hands, she is quiet and content. happy baby, happy mommy. they melt in her mouth, she can hold them, they aren't hard like many other teething biscuits that crumble when you bite into them. Yes, if you put it in your purse, and place your wallet on top of it, it will crumble. Otherwise, it holds up well.definitely try a box. BTW, my older son loves these as well.

column9: Terrible sticky mess - but the baby loves them
column10: These things dissolve when in contact with saliva or water into some kind of rice-glue-paste which apparently tastes great to the baby. It's either that or she just loves to manipulate it and feed herself. It's probably some combination.I was concered that these were made in China, given the lack of trust I have for foodstuffs made there (PRC has terrible food safety standards:[Link to Food_safety_incidents_in_the_People%27s_Republic_of_China removed]). However I did verify that Bigwant Foods is listed in the USDA's National Organic Program certified operations database ([Ref # 41799 in the NOC database link removed]). This makes me more trusting as there is some independent verification.

This was my daughters first solid food at 5 months and she still at 13 months loves them! I love having a healthy snack that is easy to take along and not very messy. They are great to take to the grocery store to keep her occupied while I am shopping.

My friend (has three kids) recommended that I buy these for my 6 month old. I couldn't find them in my grocery store so I ordered online on amazon. I was a bit nervous because I had to order a whole case but it was a great decision. She loves them. They keep her busy and QUIET for sometimes 20 minutes at a time. Awesome treat for a baby. And I love they are organic.

Mum-mums are one of my favorite finds for baby. We have given them to our three children as early as 6 months.We LOVE them!!! They disolve almost instantly, so there's not much worry of choking; they have a nice crisp so they feel good on teething gums; they are not very messy like most teething crackers; the ingredient list is simple - not loaded with sugar or preservatives; and most importantly they love them!They are also conveniently wrapped in two packs, so they are great to throw in your purse or diaper bag.My 3 and 5 year olds still ask for them when I have them out for my 11 month old.Also love that they come in organic as well as a vegetable flavor now.I buy them buy the case!!!
Dissolves easily since my little girl has no teeth yet.  It's easy for her to bite off a little bit or she can just suck on the rusk.  Tastes good.  Easy for her to hold.
I really don't like the fact that they are made in china.Even if its organic, I don't feel comfortable that it's from china so I probably wont get it anymore...

column9: My 7 month old baby loves these-texture+++
column10: My baby does NOT like purees.  She wants table food, and lots of it-give her a grain of rice or half a pea, and she is your friend for life, but if you give her a bite of mushed banana or baby food from the jar and she makes a horrified face and spits it out.  That being said, she LOVES these!  She has two bottom teeth, and the only down side to these great biscuits is that she can easily chomp off a mouthful, but they dissolve so easily they immediately begin disintegrating in her mouth.  What I am doing is breaking them for her into bite size pieces.  I don't understand all the cheerio comparisons, because a baby that can chew and eat cheerios well doesn't need 'teething' biscuits, they are beyond that stage.  These biscuits are a great transitional food to get to a point where a baby can eat cheerios, not to be used in place of them.  The little pieces disintegrate almost immediately in the mouth, unlike a cheerio.  They also stick to the slightest bit of dampness, making them easy to grab for a little one who is still working on fine motor skills.  My only disappointment is that they are made in China, and they do have a lot of packaging, which is convenient but not very eco-friendly, to say the slightest.

I bought Mum-Mums for my son when I saw my nephew eat them like popcorn. Usually companies who make organic foods have an interest in being eco-friendly. This product is the total opposite. Box, inner plastic bag, foil wrapper around each and every mum-mum. No thanks, I'll use cheerios in a reusable container. It's an easy choice since my son does not like them. He always hands them back to me after the first bite.

column9: Baby LOVES and so does mommy
column10: Our 1 year old is a huge fan of these.  She's loved them since she was about 8 months.  I had no worries about giving them to her at such a young age.  They melt really quickly in her mouth so there's no fear of choking.  They're not sweet, no salt so there's no worry about spoiling her palate.  They're great for her to just hold onto and munch on.  She loves them at home, in her car seat, at restaurants.  They're fantastic when I need her to focus on something for like 5 minutes.  Definitely my go-to snack for her.
We call these cookies instead of rusks.  We use them as a tool to say what a good time our daughter has done. I highly recommend. Tastes a little like Kix. :-)
My baby loved these baby mum mums and it bought us 10 minutes so we can eat too!
My daughter loves these.  I was so happy to find an organic snack that doesnt have sugar, wheat or dairy in it.  She would eat these all day if she could.

I bought the mum-mums for two reasons: to provide teething itch relief for my 6-month-old son and to keep him independently occupied with something to munch on. The mum-mums disappointed on both of these counts. They are way too fragile and crumble easily. column9: Hoping to start a less biased discussion
column10: Immediately after drinking Penta, I definitely felt "refreshed" (whatever that means), the texture seems "smoother" and the water appears clearer, but I believe that these characteristics are merely psychosomatic and fall in line with thinking of what pure water means. I felt calmer overall, but I attribute this to the water, not the oxygen. Otherwise, I think the oxygen takes away from the full benefit of the product.After a few cycles of testing Penta, my instincts kicked in and I started reading about the effects of too much oxygen in the body and brain. Since it stands to reason that if Penta is infusing their bottles with oxygen, their water would end up being impregnated with it. Though the oxygen in their bottles could be minimal, it could be enough to offset the nitrogen and carbon dioxide levels in the blood after drinking enough of it, especially with their patented level of filtration. There's no doubt that Penta water feels like it is being absorbed more readily than others, an effect which seems enhanced when drinking it cold. I have noticed this effect also when I had a bout of altitude sickness in Colorado. At the time, someone recommended I drink plenty of water to feel better as it had oxygen in it. I found some bottled water (from another commercial brand) and drank as much as I could. I could literally feel the water oxygenate my body as I drank it.Logically, then, one might assume that water impregnated with oxygen would be better for you. I believe, though, that the benefits of oxygen in water are only met if the oxygen is within natural levels. Penta claims they add oxygen only to tighten the bottle. I'm sure their marketing team knew that people would come to their own conclusions about this statement and may assume that this was yet be another "purifying" aspect of Penta water. I know of no other drink manufacturer adding oxygen just to tighten their bottle, so I doubt there is a real concern about its use for packing purposes. For some of you who drink several bottles of Penta a day, you may want to consider how much you are over-saturating your blood with oxygen.I started doing some research on Penta with a much more critical eye. That is when I found James Randi. Mr. Randi, as some of you know, is a hyperbolic debunker and skeptic who has offered a one-million-dollar prize to anyone "who can show under proper observing conditions, evidence of any paranormal, supernatural, or occult power or event." After reading the letters (*which can be read publicly online) exchanged between Mr. Randi and the owner of Penta, I got the impression that the owner was just another health trend exploiter, not some arbiter of a new scientific frontier. The guy can't even spell. My thoughts are that this person stumbled upon the next trend of water purification and made a business decision to add a little something extra to merit a higher price point that would reap a greater profit than a competitor's brand. Don't get me wrong. I believe that deionized, low pH, metals -and -trace pharma free water is legit, but claims that Penta water is somehow more special than others using the same methods are truly unmitigated.I think people who are health-conscious these days are toeing the line between reasonable skepticism and hopeful hypochondriacs. I wanted to believe, like many people these days, that I could use an inexpensive regimen of pure supplements to undo any damage I've done to my body. I imagine that people think that when something like water, a necessary ingredient for sustaining human life, is hard to come by in an unadulterated state, it somehow means that ingesting great amounts of pure water must act as some sort of great equalizer in the body, that if you drink clean water, you are aiding your body in being able to reverse and repair damage.I'm sure some of you think my impressions of Penta are crackpot science at best, but consider how it is no different than staring at a few pdfs on the manufacturer's site, understanding none of it, and yet still believing a doctor claiming better benefits who was likely funded by Penta themselves to do the research. This method of boosting the appearance of legitimacy for purified water is common. Look up "Ilumati Lithia water." It appears they had involvement with a clinical trial from the University of British Columbia, a study that has been suspended due to "logistical issues." It's not that as a given I don't believe in the truthfulness of clinical trials. I just won't fall prey to believing that a product is better simply because it was involved in a clinical trial, especially if the product developer has anything to do with it. Think of how you yourself may be buying into quackery just by taking what a business driven for profit says at face value.I urge you to take stock of your own body and share what you've realistically experienced with Penta. I still believe pure water is extremely helpful for the body's regulation. Though this is not a cure-all, based on the competition out there, I believe this could be the best water on the market - if oxygen wasn't placed in the bottle as "added value."

column9: Acquired taste, and proud of it
column10: I am a soda fan, and I order unique sodas from all over the place. I just love to try the neat regional sodas that you just can't get anywhere but a limited area. Moxie fits that bill, as it might not be found in the local grocery. Having heard about America's longest continually produced soda from 1884 for many years, I finally determined to try one. They say it takes nerve to drink a Moxie. I learned you can throw all of your normal conceptions of soda out the window when it comes to the taste of Moxie.It has less carbonation than most sodas, so some people think it goes flat fast. It is just that is has less fizz to begin with, and that is OK since too much fizz actually masks the flavor in many sodas. It also has much less sugar than most sodas, only 25 grams per 8 ounce serving rather than the 40 plus grams of most sodas. The flavor is spicey, as in pepper - not Dr Pepper but peppery. It has a strong hot bite to it that some people say reminds them of medicine. It has a strong aftertaste. And that aftertaste stays with you for awhile, which is good if you like the flavor. I like Moxie better when I first taste it in my mouth as that is when the sweet part hits you, (it seems at first like Mr. Pibb) rather than a few seconds after I drink it until you get used to it. The taste is unusual enough that I hear New Englanders pride themselves on their ability to get used to the taste and like it. It is definitely an acquired taste. I myself noted that it tasted better the second day than the first, and the next day and so forth. Of course this is how we learn to like the taste of things like coffee. It is very dark like a cola, and it has caffeine. Today it is owned by Monarch in Atlanta, Georgia now. For another unusual but delicious regional soda at Amazon, try Cheerwine.

I grew up in a family of tea drinkers; and although I now tend to have a lot of coffee while I'm at work, I still drink almost exclusively tea when I'm at home. I generally prefer loose leaf teas - that way I know I'll get "the real thing," whereas tea bags tend to contain merely the leftovers of a harvest; little crumbs too poor in aromatic and other content to otherwise pass quality control standards.The exception are Bigelow teas: and first and foremost among those their flagship, Ruth Bigelow's original "Constant Comment" with its recipe of black tea, orange grind and holiday spices (primarily cinnamon). Created by Mrs. Bigelow on the basis of an old colonial recipe over half a century ago, the blend soon became so popular among her friends that their "constant comments" of approval prompted Ruth and husband David Bigelow to found their own tea company. Since then, "Constant Comment" has long become a true classic ... and if you love tea, it is indeed the perfect refreshment; whether or not it's Christmas time. (E.g., it also makes for great iced tea in summer; particularly if you add a bit of lemon.)If you're making more than a single cup of tea, and unless you like your tea *very* weak, you may want to rethink the company's measuring directions - based on the the "one bag per cup" ratio, you'll likely need two or more bags for an entire pot (depending on size), even when steeping an extra minute or two. It is so gross. I have tried adding honey, drinking it cold, drinking it hot, etc and they all taste horrible. As far as a diet aid, I don't think so. I guess if you had a lot of excrement in you, possibly. I even doubled the suggested amount and I still did not anything happen (and no, I was not on the toilet a lot either). All in all, this product was a big thumbs down to me.
I was very happy with my order.  It arrived on time and as described.  Thank you!!
This powder is great for adding a mocha flavor to baked goods. It is easy to work with too.
More than I expected.  I received item quickly and it was wonderful.I am very happy with it all.

is what the recipe called for.  I searched at many different stores and could not find anything close. Leave it to Amazon to have a source for this baking need. Right amount, fast delivery, and perfect in my cookie recipe "Gin soaked raisin cookies"--dee lish...

Love the product! I make a mean Tiramisu cheesecake. I have used regular instant coffee in the recipe but it calls for espresso powder... I was really excited to find this product on Amazon.com. Thank you!

Needed the Instant Expresso Coffee for a chocolate Cake recipte. The package was more than I needed, but the cake turned out wonderful. Thanks Amazon...I couldn't find this item anywhere and a friend suggested I try Amazon.com.

We have used these for years in salads. They are just the right size, easy to chew, and have a nice pecan flavor. If you refrigerate them after opening (as directed on the bag), they will taste fresh for weeks.Kirkland is the Costco brand. I currently buy these at my local Costco for fifteen dollars, which is less than half the current price on Amazon.Bottom line: These are high quality nuts, but shop for price.

column9: Mediocre - small pieces, many "bad" pieces, and not very fresh
column10: The bag says "Pecan Halves" but very few halves are intact - most are broken (so if you want to decorate the top of a pecan pie - good luck!).  It should be called "Pecan Pieces."  There is a fairly high percentage of shriveled nuts (that are chewey) and too-dark nuts (that are bitter).  Speaking of bitter, I've encountered a few little bits of shell.  And, overall, they are not very fresh.
I expected more from Kirkland because every other product of theirs is great. These, though, are rather mediocre. I was disappointed.

Love cooking with pecans - esp in scones and these are great. They taste fresh with what I think is the correct under flavor of a good pecan.  They are much fresher than I was getting at the local grocery store.
Am I missing something?  This exact same bag of pecans can be purchased at a COSTCO store for $15.00!  I know because I just did.

column9: Just what does US#1 fancy mean?
column10: If US #1 fancy is an estimation of quality then I'd haveto wonder why a great number of the pecans are not "plump"there are quite a number that are fiberous (don't know if that'sactually the word I'm searching for) I mean not "plump.Sometimes I do get a bag that's #1 quality thru and thrubut most times not.That's it.

My wife and I bought this coffee just before Christmas, hoping to be able to serve a truly extraordinary coffee after our very first Prime-Rib-For-The-Whole-Family get-together at our house.  After dinner, I prepared a 12 cup pot in our Cuisinart coffee maker (the one with a carafe: wonderful!) and poured cups for those who wanted coffee.  I hadn't bothered to tell them that it was really expensive and that it was special for Christmas.  (Sort of thinking: our coffee's not always this good -- don't make a habit of coming over for coffee on Sundays!)Every single person who tasted it stopped after the first sip to tell me how good the coffee was.  I hadn't tasted it yet.  When I did, I knew why they had to remark.  This Limoncillo coffee is the most complex, most refreshingly delicious coffee I have ever put to my lips.The next day I went online and ordered five pounds.It's worth every penny I pay for it. You'll not be disappointed, believe me.

column9: A Great Buy At Any Price
column10: I usally buy the smmall bags of jelly babies at a local Scottish import store here in the town where I live, but every once in a blue moon, they would have the cartons. Each carton is about equivalent to maybe three or possibly even four bags of jelly babies but at a slightly better price and the carton is much more convienent-- or at least, I think so.These cartons are definitely worth buying if one is a lover of jelly babiess. It's just too bad that they are so hard to come by. When they become available, buy them and stock up because these cartons will go quickly.  :-)'Ron

These are soft and almost melt in your mouth. They taste like fruit too! I think these are great. Not too sweet, not unsweet either. The problem however is they are not vegetarian. If you read the ingredients on back you see that they contain bovine (cow) gelatin. It's sort of sick. But they do taste good.

Arrived fresh! So very important for proper tast, nothing worst than a stale Jelly Baby. In my house nobody else likes Jelly Babies, so I have 2 BIG boxes all to my self.  If you eat too many at once they are really overwhelming. Best to bite their litle heads off first, then savor the body.Only BASSETTS Jelly Babies for me!

I've had these on trips to England before and really wanted to share the experience with my kids.  Bought this and was really happy with the product. It's exactly what I had in England.  It was well worth the cost.  It only lasted us a few days but that's only because everyone - wife included - kept wanting "just one more, please."  If you want the real Jelly Babies, buy these.  You will not regret your decision.

column9: Would you like a Jelly Baby?
column10: Fantastic! It was a cheaper solution to buying the bags at the time. The only problem is they arrived on a hot day, and all of them had melted together. :( But they were still good!

I have to admit that my interest in this product stemmed from watching Doctor Who in the 80's. The Doctor always had some jelly babies in his pocket. The box arrived in good shape and the candies were fresh in the package. The flavor was good and the jelly babies were soft when the package was first opened. I did notice the candies got chewier a few days after the package was opened, even with closing it up between uses. My recommendation is to buy smaller packages if you don't think you will eat all the jelly babies within the first couple days after opening.

I LOVE walnuts and I LOVE a great cup of cappuccino. The bar is pretty good but a bit sweet for my taste. The walnuts saves it from being too much of a candy bar. Sugar content is high for the size of the bar. I just balance it out with fage yogurt. (sugar ~protein). Packaging is great where I can see exactly what I'm buying and eating.

column9: Spicy curry is very easy to use, but too hot fo rme.
column10: I fell in love with yellow chicken curry after a vacation to Hawaii. I though that by buying an Indian brand curry paste, I could make the dish easier and faster. I do not like hot, spicy food, but I like curry flavor. This paste is too hot for me. If I use one table spoon for the whole pot (feeds 8 people) it's too much. If I got back any, I don't get the curry flovor and the dish is not yellow. This would be great for someone who wants to make a fast yellow curry dish, and who likes it HOT!
We gave this flavor a try but it didn't appeal to our tastes at all. I'm a huge fan or LorAnn's oils but this one just didn't hit the mark for me.
I have used Spike to make beans and in soups, and it is delicious.  You hardly miss the salt at all.  Very flavorful!

I have two dogs. They just love these antlers. Only problem is they always seem to want the same one the other dog has. Keeps them happy and quiet. If your dog loves to chew I highly recommend these. Five stars.
This is pretty decent gf gravy.  A little bland as is, but even a mediocre cook such as I can manage to punch up the flavor.  Good consistency and easy to make.

I am a newly diagnosed Celiac with dairy and egg allergies and love this gravy for mashed cauliflower! What a life safer some of these products have become in making our diet switch easier. Highly recommend this product.
This is a great alternative for a gluten/casein-free diet.  It's a great option for a gravy, for stroganoff and substitutes well for Cream of Mushroom soup.

I have tried all the GF gravies and have found this to be the best.I use it a lot over rice with a tad of GF soy sauce, mushrooms, some veggies,ground meat, chicken etc. I've added sour cream for stroganoff  and swedish meatballs.Great for stir fry,meatloaf,in the crockpot for pot roast or stew. A big plus is that it is organic , not loaded with all the chemicals most package food contain.
I purchased this gravy along w/a few other flavors and love them all.  So tasty and nutritious, and the price was right too!

I subscribe to the Road's End gravy packets because they are a great way to make a satisfying backpacking or camping meal - I can sautee up some fresh or re-hydrated veggies, add some gravy and eat them on top of instant mashed potatoes for a rich, filling meal.  The flavor is great & you don't have to use the whole pack - just roll down the top and save some for later.These gravy packets also make an excellent binder, to replace the UBI (you know - Campbell's cream of mushroom) in dishes like broccoli rice casserole (throw in a little Daiya cheese!).

column9: Better than I expected and versatile
column10: I can't say that I experienced a mouthful of Shitake flavor on my first taste but I was pleased nonetheless.  It was easy to mix and thickened quickly.  I was in the market for a lower calorie, lower fat, lower salt (?) alternative to canned and packaged gravies that I could use for weeknight menus.  I love those old fashioned hearty casseroles that my mother used to make but have become "unhealthy" in my older years.I've used this mix, as is, for mashed potatoes, but prefer to use it as a base for vegetable pot pie, chicken/tofu/tempeh a la kings, cream soups and stews.  It worked pretty well for all of those without a strong "packaged" flavor that some mixes have.The quality of this mix encouraged me to try a few other Road's End products - I think that, in itself, is a pretty good recommendation!
This doesn't even vaguely resemble gravy.  After following the easy instructions to the t this stuff turns into a glob of oatmeal-like consistency and tastes of cardboard.

One of the best, if not THE best iced tea I ever had, was served at a little cafe beside a golf course in Arizona.  I asked the cook/waitress what type of tea they used, and she told me Farmer Brothers brand out of Flagstaff.  So I ordered a box of the Farmer Brothers Black Tea bags.  Each tea bag they say makes a gallon of iced tea.  She had a special machine to brew hers in, but I just use a large saucepan, pour hot water in it, and put the lid on it and let it steep for five minutes or so. When making mine, I use only three quarts of boiling water.  I guess the difference in the amount of water it takes is the machine, which I priced, and they started at $500.00.  However, you can still make the same great tea using just a little less water.
I had the best ice tea ever at a bar and grill (Chuy's) in Phoenix Arizona.I inquired and found that they used Farmer Brother's Ice Tea.Now, I can enjoy the best ice tea ever at home!

My wife loves this kit but I don't like it that sweet... But on one of the other  cornucopia kits ( Peach ) I just added half the small bag ( finishing bag )in at the start with the large bag at the first fermentation  and only filled to 5 gallons not 6 gallons. This gave the wine a little more kick and not so sweet... it really makes the wine a lot better. Lets put it this way my Peach is gone and my wife's Strawberry is still here and she drank most of my wine. try it!!!!!
Wine came with all the packets to get started as well as the sleeves and corks to complete the bottling.  Would highly recommend this wine to all winemakers.

This wine turned out fantastic!  Everyone who has tried it has absolutely adored it.  The labels, however, are a different story.The word Zinfandel is missing the first N.  The label says Blackberry Zifandel.  How embarassing!  Not to mention that they are a mustard yellow and not the nicest looking.Again, GREAT wine, weak labels.
Very Good Wine Kit! I have tried 3 different Cornucopia Kits and all have been good. I won't say top notch wine but for the cost and for an occasiional wine drinker is it perfect...
The longer this wine was on the rack the better it got.  Everyone of my friends loved it and that is why it is gone.

I am a major fan of the Cornucopia kits and this kit was the third kit of theirs I bought.  The wine was great, but as one reviewer pointed out, the labels are misspelled.  That's just a minor issue and was good for a few laughs.

column9: Very enjoyable wine with great taste
column10: We prefer a sweeter dessert type wine and all the Cornucopia kits we have done (and we have made several) have proven to be to our liking. Sweet wines with very good flavors. We also enjoy the lower alcohol content these kits tend to have and that they don't over power the flavor. If you like a bit more alcohol, it's easy to boost that with a little corn sugar when you start.Having done a number of kits now, it's hard to beat the price on the Cornucopia kits. Other kits don't include corks, labels and foil wraps and are more expensive. Another bonus for us has been time. The Cornucopia kits are done and ready to bottle well within the 4 week time while "other brand" kits have run longer than the 4 weeks to bottling.

First of all, there are two or three negative reviews for this tea flavor. Let's face it, we all have different tastes and what's a delight to me may be disgusting to you.But this is one of my favorite drinks. It's clean tasting, refreshing and just a hint of mint to make it that way. It's a light tea that is thirst quenching, unlike many drinks.If you enjoy a clean, light tea and if you like mint, you'll probably delight in this tea.The price here on Amazon is a bit high. I bought the tea at my local grocers for $1.50 a bottle. That may have been a sale price, however. And this brand isn't at every store. So ordering online may be the best option.Highly recommended.- Susanna K. Hutcheson

I really like Ito En, products it tastes like tea (what a concept) and this one tastes like green tea with mint leaves. (Most tea drinks taste like sugar water these days)If you are expecting a "peppermint patty" you may not think that this tastes like mint but indeed it does. Very refreshing sometimes I add a few drops of Blue agave sweetener.I just wish the price was not so high. Also the taste of their products has changed slightly since the product is now made in Thailand as opposed to Japan.

I have been getting into the Ito En green teas and have primarily been drinking the traditional green, jasmine and dark green.  I wanted to try some new flavors and bought a bottle of this at my local Whole Foods to try first.  Man, this is really good!  The mint is very subtle but refreshing!  It lends itself to a sweet finish that I really enjoy...I am motivated to buy a case because it livens up the regular green tea I have been drinking so much of.  I wish I had tried it sooner!
This is more of a bolder taste than mint. A little funky tasting. I got a little used to it. An acquired taste.
I like other Teas' Tea varieties, but this particular flavor is the worst by far. Wouldn't recommend or order again. Go with the other options first.
If you like mint, and you like tea, this stuff is awesome.  I love mint.

i have tried a few of the teas tea(jasmine, hoji, rose) and its good quality tea. they do not use gmos, no tea powders, just naturally brewed tea, most flavored w natural herbs.  that said, mint unsweetened is an acquired taste. i will just stick w the hoji(roasted green tea,excellent lots of flavor) from here out.

column9: What is wrong with this product?
column10: I bought the 12 pack box of these muffins. Made one bag & my goodness they were terrible. I handed out the remainder to friends to get their take on the muffins. I will be back...

I bought this muffin mix and followed the directions exactly.  These muffins were far more dry than anything I've ever experienced in one of the Marie Callender Restaurants.  There are much better muffin mixes out there than this one.  Buy one of those others please...
Makes great tasting muffins and very easy to prepare. Nice blue package and it's very easy to open. List of ingredients seems to be accurate.
I got mine today and made them in the microwave and they are delicious-really light and fluffy.I just ordered another box of 12 for the winter

My Australian Cattle Dog loves this food, and it is much healthier than grocery-store dog food.  I have recently learned that dogs cannot digest grains, especially corn, and dog food that contains these ingredients just makes their stomachs upset, and their poop bigger and stinkier!  It's a little pricey, but if you buy in bulk and wait for the sales, it's quite manageable.

column9: Great dog food in theory, but....
column10: I've been struggling to find the right dog food for my Giant Schnauzer Stella who suffers from digestive issues.  I was told that grain-free food was the way to go since the grain was probably causing her allergic reactions.  I bought Artemis and after going through three large bags of this formula, her digestive issues have only gotten worse. She has very loose stools and passes the most awful gas.  Even her body odor has gotten worse, and she requires baths every other week.  Her energy level also decreased significantly.  I was at my witt's end after going through various types of premium dog food including Artemis most recently.  Bottom line is, I dropped they dry kibble and I've been feeding her homemade chicken, rice and veggies with a multivitamin powder mixed in for extra nutrition, and her symptoms have all disappeared.  I don't care what anyone says, dogs do need carbohydrates (grains)!  Stella has regained her energy, her coat is shiny, her eyes are bright and her issues with the loose stools and gas have disappeared completely.  I know, this seems like a tremendous chore, but it's easier and cheaper than you think.  It's a lot better than having to clean after her loose stools...lol..I make her meals in bulk and I freeze the food into separate portions for the week. For variety I feed her chicken liver or the beef special of the week.  No matter how "premium" a dog food is, it will never compare to real, whole proteins, veggies and starches. There are tons of easy dog food recipes on the internet. If you are struggling with the same issues and you only want the best for your baby, please at least try it for a few weeks. He/she will love you for it!!!

I love hot sauce, specifically the Louisiana cayenne type. The smaller bottles I can go through in a week, without really trying. Most things I eat are not ready for enjoying until the sauce is ka-chunked on, two or three glops or more. So, needless to say, I really appreciate the larger refill containers of hot sauce. I had recently been using the Red Devil brand, since they had the larger re-fill bottles, an item that was no longer easily obtainable for me. At such times of need, I tend to look on amazon.com for replacements. When I found the Franks Red Hot (a brand I have used before) in a 1 gallon size, I thought I'd died and went to hot sauce heaven, or else Nawlins. This should easily last me three or four months!
I couldn't believe how much it here.  You can find it much cheaper else where. Take a few minutes to do a search.

This is one of the best hot sauces out there, it simply goes so well with everything, soups, pasta, chicken, snack dips, sandwiches.  The flavor is great, and it only has like 3 ingredients, which makes it nice and simple for those who avoid the list of 20 unpronounceable preservatives.  And one more plus: it's MADE IN USA, support the local delicacies!
This hot sauce is my family's favorite because of the flavor it adds to any meal. I have to have it all the time regardless of the meal and it's good every time.

column9: a pleasant heat with a kick
column10: Eight Ingredients in large mixing bowl2/3 cup of Frank's Red Hot, one stick of melted butter, three dashes of Worcestershire sauce,1/4 tsp. of garlic powder, 1/2 tsp. of Cheyenne pepper, pinch of salt, two tablespoons of white vinegar,seven dashes of Tabasco.Best wing sauce I have ever had. This batch will coat a lot of cooked chicken wings.You can easily cut this recipe in half for feeding three adults. Can be used as a marinade in refrigerator. Just reheat wings in microwave oven after a few hours.Thanks to Jekyll Island Georgia Rah Bar on the Wharf for the Frank's Red Hot, buckets of beer, and the 37 dozen cooked Georgia shrimp we ate that July afternoon!This stuff is good! you'll hate to see it gone.

column9: Months and months of buffalo wings
column10: I love Frank's. It's used in most buffalo wing recipes.It's just vinegar and aged pepper juice. No bs extra flavors so it's great as a base ingredient or just topped on anything you want to have a kick.You can't beat buying in bulk. I like amazon but hold no loyalty, if you can find this at sams/costco, it's $5 cheaper but rarely in stock.Free shipping and it beating any bottles you can buy at walmart, it's a steal online.

column9: An entire gallon of Frank's? Sign me up.
column10: When I discovered that I could obtain an entire gallon of Frank's Red Hot, the best mass-market hot sauce available, AND that it was available via Prime, I nearly pooped my pants in excitement. Whenever I feel a little blue, I just remember that somewhere out there, there exists an Amazon warehouse full of these things. Truly, there is a God.

column9: Not the best once you've tried the rest...
column10: Better than Tabasco for sure but nothing special. Fairly mild for those who don't like heat (I'd give it a 3 out of 10) and decent flavor just nothing great. This is a good basic hot sauce that you'll find in a lot of colleges or diners but definitely not the best. If you want a great hot sauce I recommend Tapatio, it has a better flavor with about the same level of heat.

I love this sauce, I have been marinating boneless skinless chicken breasts in it.  For that I was using alot of the larger bottles available at Wal-Mart and the cost added up quickly.  This is alot less expensive.  Plus when you have a gallon you can put it on everything, and i mean everything.  Try this stuff on things you wouldn't think of and it makes it amazing.  Red Hot vanilla ice cream, I'm just sayin.....

I like to buy all sorts of Hot sauces for all sorts of food. But no other hot sauce gets chosen more than Frank's. I use it for pizza, chicken, all mexican and even breakfast foods! I do not know of a hot sauce that tastes better, everything is blended very well. Not too hot, just a touch of vineger and a nice cayenne pepper taste.Best of all, add Frank's and some butter on the stove, let it sizzle for 2 minutes and you have great tasting wing sauce!The only bad thing I can report on this sauce is if you find a very old bottle still on the shelves. There could be a small chance of some clumping and flavor issues.

Blanxart has been my favorite ever since I first bought it, pretty much on a whim, at a cheese shop in Vermont a couple of years ago. I was really excited to find I could buy it on Amazon, but, living in Texas, I'm limited on when I can buy it, as it just can't survive the heat. But, about the chocolate, the flavor and texture are great! I like that old-world, kind of gritty texture, so different from the smooth, overly sugary, mass-produced "chocolates" people buy every day. You must try Blanxart!
I followed the instructions and it never popped. Nothing. Not a peep.My microwave is fine.I am returning the product to the grocery store.

column9: Healthy Alternative to Kibble, Canned or Raw Diets
column10: Actually, Sojo's strongly recommends that the meat you add to their mixes be raw, but it an be cooked as I choose to do.  My dog arrived with coccidia and giardia as a puppy.  Through veterinary mismanagement, he was never completely healthy for the first 2 1/2 years of his life.  After watching him get sicker on an aggressive course of antibiotics and prednisone for his Inflammatory Bowel Disease, I took him to a holistic veterinarian.  Part of his treatment has been a homemade diet of Sojo's and meat plus no medications.  I'm extremely pleased to report he has had no GI episodes in over 6 months and has reached a point where I consider him healthy.  His coat is glossy and much fluffier than before he's finally at a good weight.  I have before and after photos that show a dramatic improvement,much of which I credit to Sojo's.It does take some extra time to prepare as opposed to kibble, but I make 4 days worth at a time. This takes me about 30 - 40 minutes total which includes down time while the meat is cooking and cleaning up after.  To be completely honest, I'm not thrilled about cooking for my dog but I am thrilled with the results.  If I was able to feed him raw (perhaps down the road, when our vet gives the ok), preparation time would  be almost nothing.
Sojos foods have been tested for nutritional content and they are all formulated to have a calcium to phosphorus ratio of 1.4:1. You do not need to add calcium or phosphorus.

I feed my dogs Sojos as part of a mixed bowl of quality kibble and quality canned food.  I recommend Sojos.But I had a problem with the Amazon purchase.  Amazon stored the Sojos bag in the original mailing box Sojos sent them.  My order was picked from the shelf and the box containing the Sojos was placed in another box and mailed to me.  The bag of Sojos was almost one year old and there was no way Amazon kept track of that.  I got a refund from Amazon with no question and very quickly, but Amazon needs to keep control of the "use-by" dates of food they offer on their site.

I have three Newfoundlands so we go through a lot of food!  One of the dogs has had severe health issues and since we've switched from commercial kibble to home made food, he's thrived!  He gets regular blood tests to monitor the drugs he's on and they have been perfect since we started on Sojos!  It will not cure his issues, but he has more energy and he can't wait for meal time!  The other two are glowing with health as well!  All three dogs coats are shiny and they have tons of energy (for a Newf!)

column9: Great product if you are willing to do the work
column10: I think this is a great product but my picky dog gets tired of it after a week.
My small mixed breed is a picky eater but he seems to like solos so long as I mix it with some good people food. He hasnt had problems digesting it  Delivery was prompt as expected.

I have a now 8 month old male Shih Tzu.  When I brought him home from the breeder, I kept him on the 'Pro Plan Puppy' tiny dry kibble until the bag was almost finished.  There was about 2 cups left in the bag and he began walking away from his bowl as soon as I put it down.  As a test, I rolled a few morsels across the tile floor in the kitchen to see what would happen...he'd eat about 10 pieces and go bring me one of his squeaker toys to play with. (Which I was happy with, as I don't want to 'play' with his food as a game to get him to eat).  I went and got him Blue Buffalo dry puppy food (lamb and oatmeal formula), which had bigger size kibbles.  It seemed that he liked the bigger sized items to chew on and the harder antioxidant bits, since he was teething and chewing on his dentabones, venison antler, lamb lung chips for comfort.  Again when I got down to about a quarter of food left in the bag, he would walk away from the bowl---this went on for almost 3 days.  He was still having small bowel movements, urinating, drinking water and playing, running and continuing his successful training exercises; called the vet and they wanted to give me wet venison formula by Science Diet/Veterinarian's Diet after the exam, which showed nothing physically wrong.  The one vet tech said that Shih Tzu's tend to be picky eaters.  I didn't pick up the food at their check out counter, left and began some of my own research into the breed itself and a more natural diet.  I know from some of our outdoor excursions that he's attracted to road kill (he'll sniff the air, and want to lunge for it and would probably eat it if left to his own devices...but I won't allow it).  I remember being a kid in the late 60's early 70's and all my friends who had dogs fed them 1 of 2 choices available back then: Gravy Train or Alpo and they mixed meat or the drippings from the meat; they ate bones, etc and all lived into their late teens.  One of my friends small mutt lived to be 24 years old!!!  I never saw these dogs itching or digging at themselves other than the usual ears or if their was a flea problem, since I grew up in a rural area and most often that was a common occurrance.  Well, I read up on the more natural diets and decided to get the Sojos and ground beef and some boneless chicken thighs/breasts.  My Weston isn't a big fan of totally raw meat, but when browned (I put it in the toaster oven and add 1/4 tsp of 'Missing Link' to the meat portion) with the soaked Sojos Original, he eats with gusto!!!  From his early days, I would play with and take his food away, so he's not food aggressive.  He eats the recommended portion for his size and walks away when done.  Weston then wants to play hard, train hard, take a nice walk and nap.  His coat is soft and easy to keep brushed and groomed.  The droppings are nice sized and easy to clean up.  I just had him neutered 2 days ago and he ate this Sojos mix with the same gusto (even with the e-collar to challenge him).  So I am a fan and we are finished with the second 2.5 lb bag and I just ordered another one.  Hope this helps someone with a picky eater; I know another reviewer mentioned their Shih Tzu not liking it, but this shows you that dogs have certain tastes different from each other, much like us humans.
I didn't mean to order a 40-pound bag. But I did. Wow. That's a lot of food. Be sure to mix it with protein or else you dog will suffer a bit of internal distress.
Sojo's diet lacks calcium, and if fed as directed will cause severe metabolic bone disease in your dog.  This diet requires supplementation with a balanced calcium/phosphorous additive to be safe.

Got these on a hunch and it payed off.  These are delicious to snack on alone or to sprinkle over salads to give a little extra kick.  The warmth is just right with the spiciness.  I will be getting more when these run out.

I have tried a few of their other varieties, and this one is delicious too.The seeds have a nice crunch, are spiced just right, and being sprouted is a big plus.I have to force myself to put the bag away....Another point - I am a little sensitive to nuts and seeds in large quantities, but have NO problem digesting these.Buy them.....support people who care about the products they make!
I bought these for a healthy snack and ended up buying more to share with my classmates. Good tasting I like to add them to a quinoa/brown rice for added chrunch.

A look at the seasoning ingredients and I thought I would love this mix-organic jalapeno, organic cilantro, organic lime juice, organic spices- it's full of things I love. However, when I received the mix and tasted it I was overwhelmed. I thought maybe it was just too concentrated so I also purchased a bag of the go raw naked seed mix and mixed them half and half. column9: Unmarked, no weight/measure, name, seal, nothing...?
column10: Item is being returned.  Nuts arrived in a clear plastic bag with tie-wrap type closure.  There is no label, no country of origin, no weight/measure data, no nutrition information, no warning that it contains nuts, etc.  Literally, someone scooped the nuts out of a bulk bin somewhere, put them in a bag, tied it off and put the bag in a US Postal envelope and shipped it. When Trident dropped their cinnamon flavor (Robt Redford's favorite and mine), I went into sense-mourning.  After a year of pretending not to care and chewing peppermint flavored gum as a poor second choice, the 5-Flare pricey but good substitute came on the market.  YAY!  Then, gone, nada, nothing, nowhere in the San Francisco Bay Area could I find it.  I tried contacting whoever makes Trident and didn't get a response.  Researched the internet and found that cinnamon trees have a disease from time to time and it becomes rare, and thus difficult to produce.  To top it off, I read the flavor of cinnamon was a favorite of oldsters.  Hm, I'm over 65 and therefore potentially in a dwindling market (all our false teeth and arthritic jaws?).  However, I fell upon the Flare gum in a Pennsylvania store off the beaten track so I knew it continued to exist.  Now I'm on the internet and buying it through Amazon.  Bless you kiddos.P.S.  Two months after the above review....I think I cried "huzzah" too soon.  Almost every box I opened from this shipment from this purveyor (and I bought several multi-packs at one time), from the beginning of their tenure in my cool storage closet, had at least four sticks stuck together (each individually wrapped, yet still stuck to each other).  I checked, and Wrigley's is still making this flavor, so I don't know why they were glued together, making them unusable.I was told that the perfume sold in perfume "stores" in shopping malls are made up of mostly old product (thus the scent won't be "true").  I'm wondering if the same thing is happening with these wholesale online sellers.  They buy old, degenerating product from Wrigley's and pass them onto us? For my next order, I won't go with this particular seller.
Product arrived very quickly.  Nice job.  this is the BEST cinnamon gum on the market!! I cannot find it in my local stores so decided to buy some on line.

This product is not available in very many stores and my fiance won't chew anything else. This was a great price and it was delivered really fast. I would suggest anyone who loves this gum to get it here.

I was looking for a replacement for Altoid's cinnamon gum which they no longer make. It had a great strong flavor.  The flare is not as strong but makes up for it in having a long lasting flavor.  It has good cinnamon flavor and is a satisfying substitute.
This is soooo delicious.  I like it on cool fall mornings with pumpkin flavored pancakes, agave syrup, and scrambled eggs---YUM!!

I always look forward to the Thanksgiving and Xmas holidays for all the wonderful things you can have with pumpkin in them, pies, shakes, ice creams, puddings and candies. looking for a last minute gift that rocks give this gift basket grandparents loved this basket for sure
