For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  There are some great suggestions mentioned by other reviewers, like mint for example.
this is a great product,it helps to relieve my bloating.I will order it again.Thank you.its better then anything else i have tryed

I was actually looking for a prosciutto knife made by the same people but it was out of stock, so I opted for this. It's an excellent knife, does a great job even on prosciutto. As soon as the other one becomes available I'll buy it too. Haven't used it on salmon yet, but that will come and it will be fine.

Total bummer.  My little pup doesn't like these 'Lamb and Sweet Potato' tidbits at-all.  And I have no idea why.I bought this recipe at the grocery store and everything on the package looked good.  There's 9% protein, a reasonable 4% fat, with 11% moisture and 4% crude fiber.  The approximately 1x1 inch tidbits (about 1/4 inch thick) are made with barley, lamb, sweet potatoes, with organic molasses (yum) and few other good things, and yet, I couldn't interest Ms. Charlene (Charlie) in playing with one, much less eating one.She's a puppy -- Russell/Beagle mix -- so maybe she's picky or maybe she prefers something with more fat content, or with more smell-appeal.  Again I don't know, but I did want to write a review to warn you that you might want to buy a single bag versus a box full.Two Stars for excellent organic ingredients.  No additional stars because my young pup wouldn't eat more than one tiny corner of one. [The neighbors Australian cattledog is in for a treat]Pam T~mom/#kidlit blogger

My two Mini Schnauzer's are very treat picky. They like all of the Newman's Own treats, but these are their favorites. I wish they were a little smaller so I could give them multiple times a day or use them for training. They get one after breakfast and remind me if I forget.

Dukie arrived from San Diego Lab Rescuers with a great appetite.  He really loves his meals and treats. This one is especially enjoyed and he jumps around waiting for me to get the package open!  It is by far his very favorite and I have tried many treats since he has some special health needs and cannot have citric acid or high phosphorus foods.  Sweet potato and lamb are great, even though the barley is on the high side.  I think large breeds will go for this treat since even when divided in half it is still a hefty biscuit.

Watson, the pug, always gives Paul Newman's food and treats a gold metal.  He does not tolerate wheat or corn products very well, allergies, and it is harderto find tasty treats which meet this qualification.  Newman's is perfect.  Thanks

My German Shepherd loves these treats.  He has skin allergies so I'm trying to avoid feeding him wheat, chicken and beef products.  The price through Amazon is less than the grocery store and the package arrived quickly. I'm also glad that the expiration date is over a year.

column9: My dog loves this and it good for him too
column10: He loved this cookie as a treat. Not sure if this is available in a smaller size of cookie, but the bars seem larger than the heart shaped chicken cookie treats I have been buying. The lamb one does not upset my older English Cocker Spaniel who has a sensitive tummy, and isn't any more fattening either than the other cookie, but I do break each bar into two or three pieces to feed it to him. He can actually deal with the size just fine, tho this particular style is more appropriate for a large dog vs a middling size dog like him, but he counts the number of treats we give him and isn't happy until he gets three pieces :-) I feed him one bar broken into three pieces, while I feed him two to three of the little heart shape cookies(depends on how much food he's cadged from my toddlers that day) I totally trust the Newman's brand of dog food and have been happy with my baby's silky and healthy coat and no tummy upsets on the Newmans food or cookies.  I wrote this review for a sample from the vine program, but this seems to be the exact same cookie, so I am repeating the review here.

I have been a long time devotee of White Truffle oils, but somehow I had been out of the gourmet loop, unaware of the growing popularity of Black Truffle Sea Salt.  My curiosity was piqued, when I saw an Iron Chef using it on the Food Network, and, then by the outstanding reviews on Amazon.Well, thanks to ALL, unknowingly complicit in leading me astray, I now have an expensive habit; but don't we all deserve to indulge ourselves, once in a while?  Since this is my first purchase, I can't make comparisons, but I can say this, the fragrance and taste are moderately strong for BT infusion, when you consider the contrast in pricing for this product, over others.  It's a great entry point for those without much experience with Truffles, white, or black, to give it a try. Be careful though, you'll likely be hooked, too.Since it takes such a small amount of product to enhance flavor, the 5.5 oz supply should last a fairly long time. The container is nice enough to leave on display. It has a pop-up, sprinkle lid, for convenience. The container does not offer a percentage, nor does the website, so I'm not sure if this Fusion brand is 10%, or not, as some other brands' advertise. So on my next purchase, I will opt for one that designates such, just for comparison.I consider flavor enhancers, such as Truffles, to be a diet aide, when watching calories. If you feel you are having something delectable, it heightens the sense of satisfaction---that somehow your sacrifices are lessened.  For example, I was blown away by the taste of a simple boiled egg, with a dusting of BTSS---and, vegetables reach new heights, as well. And, don't get me started on, plain pasta, with only a little Truffle oil, and sprinkle of BTSS; it's decadent. Actually, I think I could take a chunk of Iceberg lettuce, give it a sprinkle, and feel I was having a treat.If you've not yet ventured into BTSS, give it a whirl. I doubt you will be disappointed.

According to a certificate of authenticity at saltworks.com that I googled, this stuff is 6% truffles.I'm not an employee, subemployee, contractor, agent, or relative in any dimension of a salt or spice dealer. But I can be kinda spicy.

column9: Could be stronger, but price is right
column10: Fusion Black Truffle Sea Salt has a definite black truffle flavor, that unlike truffle oils, actually comes from real black truffles.  Almost all truffle oils are made with a synthetic chemical that closely resembles the taste of truffles.  For those who want the real thing, this truffle salt is the cheapest way to get your truffle fix.The 5.5 ounce jar will last you a long time, even if you are a heavy seasoner.  I would have preferred a stronger concentration of truffle flavor in exchange for a smaller quantity of salt.  I spent twice as much for 1.5 oz of white truffle salt at a spice market, which i would purchase again over this.  With the fusion black truffle salt, I end up oversalting my food to get the amount of black truffle flavor I desire.The packaging is excellent, allowing for easy dispensing and storage.  Although i prefer white truffles, the taste from the black truffles is excellent.  I actually prefer it to some slices of black truffle I've had from michelin starred restaurants.  You may also want to check out truffle butters, which aren't as economical, but are a little better in practice.

column9: Bargain Truffle Salt? I have to see this...
column10: Ok, so I've been a fan of salts lately. Citrus infused sea salts, Chardonnay Oak Smoked Sea Salt, Alele Hawaiian Sea Salt, etc. But I have to say, my favorite of them all is the truffle salt. I was skeptical of the 'fusion brand' sea salt. It looked mass produced and cheap. I was expecting an inferior reproduction of the specialty boutique brands that specialize in making it the old fashioned way...but I was very surprised with what I found. Rich, Flavorful, and at a bargin.To get to the point, fusion sea salt has great truffle flavor at half the price of the other brands. It is great for anyone who is new to truffles, and doesn't want to spend $30 for something they may OR may not like...but I'm pretty sure you'll be back, and you may even find yourself spending that little extra, for a little more of that special ingredient.

We bought a jar of this and use it nearly everyday. At first we were enthralled with the flavor, and I would have given it a five star review, but now, about 9 months later, it barely has any flavor or scent at all. We kept the lid closed between uses, but I don't think the lid keeps a good seal, and perhaps that's why there's no flavor left. Our first time buying truffle salt, we got a little jar at Pikes Place Market, and its potency lasted well over a year until it ran out. If you buy this, maybe put half in a well sealed glass jar to store. We have a tiny bottle of truffle oil we picked up in Italy a year ago, and that's still very potent, not sure why this product loses it so quickly.

because this was so divine over slightly melted idiazabal cheese and eggs, I bought at a very expensive cookware store, this past weekend the variety with white truffle at slightly more $.  Both are exceptional and worth the indulgence  One word of advice: shake the dispenser before using, to disperse the truffle pieces.  Lift off the lid and that alone gives you quite a truffle hit!
This is the best truffle salt ever.  We take it everywhere.  Try it on freshly made french fries you will never eat fries by themselves again.

i love truffle oil. on pasta, potatoes, mmmmmthis is priced very well. It should last for months, you dont need much when you use it.I recommend taking it out of the plastic container, and into a glass one that seals. This will help in shelf life and the stench of truffles in your cabinet/pantry.enjoy

I was shocked by the strong smell when I opened it up. I found more and more that I craved it, and now rice noodles with butter, shaved parm and truffle salt is one of my favorite foods. It's a unique and very interesting aroma.

column9: Fantastic salt and such great flavor
column10: This salt is just wonderful.  It has such a great truffle flavor and a higher truffle content than most salts.  I love adding this to some angel hair pasta tosses with Roland truffle oil and parmesan.  Pure bliss! This salt is amazing on just about anything except most cooked tomato dishes, the tomatoes have a tendency to cancel out truffle flavor.  Steaks, pasta, onions, butter, subs, cream sauces... the list goes on and on.For the 2 star review, I can't imagine this salt sitting around for 9 months (not even two moths and I have more on the way) but due to the nature of flavoring with oils for this salt that is to be expected if it sits for the better part of a year, especially if in direct sunlight or heat.

This product is moderately expensive (for salt) but I got a jar and it has lasted for several months. Just a little goes a long way. I love the truffle flavor. While it's not as good as truffle oil, it's an economical purchase and there is enough truffle for flavor and aroma. I would buy this product again. Also, it's cheaper on Amazon than at Whole Foods.

This truffle sea salt is excellent! For me, more flavor is released if the truffle salt is adding during cooking. The dried truffle needs the heat to reach it's full potential. Added to warm EVOO or butter, the flavor can be easily infused throughout a dish.

I'm a huge fan of truffle infused french fries and had to have a way to have them at home.  Enter Fusion Black Truffle Sea Salt.  I have made my own truffle fries several times using this salt. A little bit of product goes a long way.  I mix the truffle salt with rosemary and sprinkle on freshly deep fried, hand-cut french fries.  The results are fantastic and truffle fries are a great extravagance to look forward to after a long work week.This salt has two ingredients -- sea salt and black truffle.  It is incredibly fragrant -- even when the jar is closed.  After using the salt, I tightly closed the jar but my pantry smells like truffles a week after I initially opened the container.I love this salt and can't wait to try it with other recipes.This is a product of Italy.
It is full of delicious flavor! So many truffle salts are flat and boring, not this one. The price is great, especially for this quality. I use it in my restaurant and at home. Try it on popcorn!
Fusion Black Truffle Sea Salt is good.  My wife uses it and likes it.  She wishes it would be a more concentrate truffle flavor so she would use less salt.
Was impressed with the flavor this salt imparts. Will now be a permanent flavoring in my pizza sauce and other dishes.
To be used at the table for personal seasoning of salt and hint of truffle.  It should last a long time.  Tasty on popcorn with a drizzle of flavorful olive oil.  I would recommend.

column9: good price for truffle salt and quick delivery
column10: This is the first time I've bought Truffle Salt, so I don't have another brand to compare it to.  I bought this brand because of the price, about $10 cheaper than Wiliams Sonoma.  It has more salt flavor than I thought it would, but overall I like it.  It arrive within a few days of ordering it, without paying for expedited delivery.

column9: Good truffle salt for somethings, not the best I have had.
column10: I have to start by saying this truffle salt is a fantastic deal. It is really wonderful on some things. Stuff like popcorn, eggs, and butter it works perfectly on. A few other things like potatoes and more heavily flavored things, the truffle does not really come out. There is not enough truffle in this salt to truly flavor some foods without making them too salty.Also get a different container to pour this salt into, because once you open it, your whole cabinet will smell of truffles. The container it comes in is not very airtight.I recommend getting this salt for simple things, but getting another more 'truffly' (and pricier) salt for more heavy foods.

column9: What do you put in on? Everything!
column10: I've new to the truffle game, having tried truffle oil and now this truffle salt. I have to say, the salt is an easier way for a novice like me to get more truffle in my life. Works on whatever you might put salt on normally...but mac & cheese with a little truffle salt will blow your mind. A little goes a long way so the price isn't much of a factor as this will last a long time.

I love this Black Truffle sea salt!  I purchased it to turn up the flavor on my homemade duck fat fries.  They are now in the realm of supernatural for flavor!  I can see how this stuff can go pretty quick.  Just a little dash will do as it is potent stuff, but you will want to put it on everything.
This is reasonably priced and has very nice flavor. Nice when paired with some cheddar cheese & some red wine.

This salt is, in my opinion, fabulous. For the price, you really get a lot of truffle flavor. I LOVE putting it on homemade stove-top popcorn or mac and cheese. I really don't think anyone could be disappointed in this product.

I've tried several truffle salt products and like Fusion's the best so far.  Some folks obviously don't like truffle fragrance but I enjoy it almost as much as the taste.  Fusion also utilizes packaging that doubles as a shaker.  As for service, Fusion delivered my package before some Amazon companies even acknowledge my order.
If your looking to kick up your hard boiled eggs (4hb style) or just wanting to find out what all the fuss is about, this is the place to start. Great product.

This was my first foray into truffles and I must say I am much impressed. I bought this based on the low price and good reviews and I am satisfied. I would recommend to anyone that wants to add a little something extra to otherwise bland foods like potatoes and eggs.

This truffle salt has added a new dimension to our kitchen.  Love it, so far used it in salad dressing, soup, on popcorn, etc. Will be buying more in the future.  Only problem so far is that our entire pantry smells like it. We will have to put it in another container.

column9: not a bad way to get some truffle in your life but get ready to wrap it up
column10: This stuff is great way to get some truffle taste without overpowering your dish.I just wish it were in a much better sealed container.I have the thing inside 2 ziploc bags and it still stinks up my spice cabinet.I like the smell of truffles but it got on my fiancee's nerves after a few weeks.One of these days I'm going to get around putting it into a little airtight storage container.
This salt was just as I expected! I add it to fries and then some fresh Parmesan for a treat!
But if it came in a glass jar rather than plastic shaker type container, it might be better able to contain the scent while stored in spice cabin.

column9: Very Potent Authentic Truffle Taste, Great stuff!
column10: This truffle salt is terrific! A little bit has a lot of flavor, and the flavor is blissful. Fusion makes a premium product!

My salt came very fast and so far I love it!!  My 14 year old son loves it also.  It does smell but it is a truffle.  I can't wait to invite my grown kids over this weekend and cook steaks and use my truffle salt.  It takes very little salt so it should last a long time!!

I've wanted to try truffles for quite a while, but haven't found anything in my budget until now.  I'm already a big fan of this company, and their other salts, so knew I was off to a good start when I found this.  It is VERY good.  The truffle flavor is there (sort of an 'umami' quality), but not overbearing.  I can use the right amount of salt for my taste, and get "enough" truffle flavor to notice it.  I had also ordered a white truffle oil (not the same company), and it's "ok"....but this black truffle salt is REALLY good- already have 2 more in my cart !!
I heard about this salt from a friend.  It's worth every penny!!!  You can put it on anything from popcorn to meats.

now this is a review im more than glad to rate highly! if you like the taste of Truffles like i do then this salt is for you! it has a strong aroma and taste just as i like, and was surprised how strong its aroma actually is! as soon as you unscrew the lid it will scent the whole room with a wonderful Truffle smell. ive made this product one that i dont want to run out of.

column9: Taste as you add, youcan always add more
column10: I don't know how it compares to all but one similar item.  I used as muchas I did on another product that cost much more and it was too salty.  The price may be directly related to how much truffle is in it.  Product was delivered quickly.

I bought this for my husband as a gift and he loves it. We literally put it on everything - chicken, rice, potatoes, popcorn - and it makes everything so flavorful. You don't have to use a lot so the container will last!! A great gift for any foodie.
I had several people try this salt on some fries I made the reviews were mixed, but overall it was way too pungent of a flavor. It could proabaly be cut with 2/3 table salt.
This is a nice grind of salt with a strong truffle smell/taste -- it is on a par with the truffle butter I buy at Dean & Deluca.  Would buy again.

I'm really sad about this. I was so excited to get this particular brand since it was so well received by everyone else. I went w/salt instead of oil so it would keep better and the whole bit about truffle oil not even containing real truffles. I was going to savor every last black bit of ambrosia in this little container. Alas, it was not to be. The aroma is definitely there, but after I put it on steaks, chicken, fries, burgers, pastas, etc, the truffle didn't come through. To get enough truffle flavor, I basically had to oversalt my food with this.Maybe I just got a bad batch. Maybe the seal went awry and the heat during shipping caused an irreversible chemical process whereby the truffle aromatic ringed compounds left my jar. I'm not sure. I'm just sad. And without truffle goodness.
This salt tasted very good the first time I tried it. Over successive uses, though, I became enured to the taste. Now it's indistinguishable from normal salt.

column9: Not enough truffle for the salt
column10: I was disappointed in this product. I had enjoyed truffle salt from another manufacturer, which had so much truffle that whenever I opened the lid, the delightful aroma filled the room. But it is no longer available, so I was hoping to find a similar product on Amazon. This ain't it; the truffle is barely detectible when sniffing the open bottle and not detectible on food at all. I'm debating whether to just throw it out so I can re-use the bottle to try a different brand. (The bottle is reusable, which is why I rated it more than one star.)
I love truffles, black or white, but this salt doesn't do them justice. It's too overpowering for a finishing salt.

This salt was a gift, I opened and it smells so bad, I think I need to place in garage or add 1 letter "b" and it might work out better for my family.. (GARBAGE) Smells like a nursing home.. Bad Jar?? Who knows.. Dont know what to say..The packaging was nice, just dont crack the seal... Sorry, being honest...
The flavor is ok, but if you try the same flavor in Da Vinci, I like it more.But it is only my opinion.

I love Torani sugar free syrups, but I did not like this flavor at all!  It tasted like someone poured a bottle of perfume into my coffee -- way too overpowering.  It didn't really taste too much like gingerbread to me, either.  I much prefer the pumpkin pie or coconut sugar free flavors to this one!
WOW, if you are looking for an authentic gingerbread flavor, then this is the one.  Great full flavor and best of all, the user can control the amount used!  Love it and will reorder!

After trying this brand's pumpkin pie sugar free syrup, I was amped to try this one! (Especially since that certain chain of coffee places that I am addicted to took their sugar free gingerbread latte off the holiday menu 2 years back)  Anyways after making my latte and being all hyped for the first drink... I was left feel a lil like ehhhhh.  I mean it's not terrible, but it's not what I expected it to be.

Maybe I have gotten accusttomed to a very low salt diet, but this product made breaded chicken (and later catfish) that was far too salty for me to eat. I diluted the flour with 50% corn flour for the catfish (Swai) and still couldn't enjoy it. Normally I give unsuccessful experiments to the dogs (they seem to love whatever I cook), but I didn't think this much salt was good for them either (they would have loved it anyway).I question if the 'salty' flavor is really salt or some other seasoning that tastes salty. Regardless, I probably will toss out the unused product. Maybe I have gotten too accustomed to low salt diets?Domata's other products have been terrific!!

I am a big fan of star anise.  I use it mostly in sauces and gravies, and I have always loved the flavor it brings.  Normally I buy it in an "upscale" grocery store across town, since the standard grocery stores near me do not carry it.  I have always been happy with the product I have been using, but I figured I'd poke around online to see what I could find.  Normally, it costs me $4.99 for a 0.60 ounce jar.  The Frontier Star Anise cost me less than $14.00 for a 16 ounce bag, so I figured I'd give it a try.  I didn't realize how much 16 ounces of star anise would be!  There really is a bunch of stars in this bag, and most of them are whole stars.  The truly surprising part about it for me was the quality.  Each star is easily twice the size of the stars I have been using, and now I realize my normal stock is actually shriveled up.  These are huge and very fragrant...I actually need to change my recipes to use less or else they will be overpowering.  Now, I don't know for sure if I'll be able to use all 16 ounces of them before they need to be replaced, but for the price (at this price, I would only get 1.8 ounces of shriveled up stars from my normal supplier) and the difference in quality, I would definitely recommend these and I will most certainly purhcase them again.

column9: Product and quality varies with the seller
column10: I've ordered this twice, once when fulfilled by Amazon, and the other by a private seller, "Smart Styles".  Depending on who fulfills the order, you will get variations in product quality. While I am very happy with the product I received from Amazon, I have some reservations about the product I received from Smart Styles.  To keep things simple, safe, and timely, I recommend only ordering this when fulfilled by Amazon.When fulfilled by Amazon, you will receive a sealed, branded bag of Chinese origin, distributed through a California based food distributor and shipped same or next day from Amazon's warehouse.  It has nutritional information and all of the other tidbits of information that one would expect from a product that goes through some sort of quality control procedure.  The majority of the star anise fruits were whole stars, as advertised, albeit most of the fruits were not seed bearing.  Very good quality star anise.On the other hand, when fulfilled by Smart Styles, you will be in for a wait and a shock.  I placed my order on December 13th, when it was advertised as being "In Stock", and then I got an Estimated Ship Date of January 6th - February 2nd after they charged my order and claimed it was "Shipped".  Advertising something as "In Stock" but then not having it arrive until nearly a month later is misleading.  I only received my order on January 9th.  It came as a parcel, shipped from India, poorly packaged and not sealed from the elements.  While they shipped more than 16oz, it was in a taped bag (not even a Ziploc type), surrounded by bubble wrap, and then shipped in a cardboard envelope.  It was very beat up when I received it.  The majority of the stars were broken and there was a lot of detritus (stems, dried leaves) included in the package. It's almost as if it was scooped right out of an open air market stall!  This might be very off putting for a lot of people, and leave them with dirt/bug anxiety.  Luckily though, the Indian star anise I received was actually fresher than the Chinese star anise that was fulfilled by Amazon.I have uploaded pictures as a comparison.In use, both of the star anise shipments I received provided the robust flavorings I was looking for.  I've used it for pho, bread, meat seasoning, and tea so far.  Star anise is an under-appreciated spice in the US, but can be used for so many things.  It's a blessing to be able to buy so much of it on Amazon, for such a low price.  Buying this spice from a grocer is very expensive, and while 16oz is quite a bit, once you understand the flavors this spice can impart, you'll find many uses for it.  I actually keep a spare pepper grinder on hand to pulverize raw spices like this, as it can make it very convenient for seasoning meats (star anise can really boost pork/carnitas!).  For larger volumes of pulverized star anise, I would recommend a coffee grinder.  To store and maintain maximum freshness, I recommend keeping these in vacuum sealed 1/2 gallon Ball jars, as the 16oz of star anise fills it perfectly.

column10: They are in perfect shape with 8 Angles. So hard to find good ones like this.The aroma from this spice was so good and strong. They are 200% better than those cheapherbs from China town.Will definitely buy from this company again!

I am happy to say it is "illicium verum" or Chinese Star anise.Please note that Japanese star anise (shikimi/I. anisatum) and (Florida anise/I. floridanum) are known toxic.I gave this product four stars because so many of the pods do not contain seeds. I still throw them in my tea & they give a nice flavor, but my guess is that the flavor would be stronger if the pods still contained the seeds. Still, I am quite happy with this purchase.
I was disappointed when I received them.  It was a big package but about 80% were NOT whole.  I was not happy about it.

I use these a lot. I use the whole pod to make baked bears, and apples, or just grind them for a biscotti recipe with chocolate dipped ends. Lovely aroma, and fragrant. column9: STAR  ANISE - just what I wanted!

Star anise imparts food with a flavor that speaks of barbecue shops in Chinatown everywhere.  Here is a nice recipe for Soy Sauce Chicken.Ingredients:1 whole chicken 3-3 1/2 lbs, rinse and remove fat from cavity - never frozen, all natural is best.  If you go over 3+ lbs it gets harder to judge the cooking time; discard giblets or reserve for other use2 cups water1/2 cup sugar1/2 cup 'black' soy sauce - this is an item you need to find in an Asian specialty shop2 tbs 'thin' soy sauce - same as above; you can use regular soy sauce from a grocery store in a pinch, but it won't be as good1piece star anise1.tsp peppercorns (Szechuan is best but black is OK)1 cinnamon stick (Chinese is best but generic is OK)2-3 stalks green onion1.  Take small cooking pot large enough to hold the chicken.  Put in chicken.  Add water, both soy sauces, sugar and green onion.2.  In a tea ball place star anise, cinnamon and peppercorns.  You can also improvise a spice bag with cheese cloth.  I also sometimes just dump them in without a bag.  Add to pot.3.  Cover pot.4.  Put on stove burner and medium to medium low heat.  Bring to a light simmer (check this often;at a vigorous boil the chicken will be over cooked.5.  Simmer 20 min, flip chicken and simmer 20 more minutes; essentially you are poaching the chicken.6.  Chicken is done when juices from between thigh and body run clear when pierced with a chop stick.7.  Cut chicken into pieces and serve with steamed rice.The cooking sauce can be served with the chicken for the rice, or reserved and used to cook up to 2 more chickens.

This is the best price I have seen for Selina Naturally Celtic Sea Salt. One taste of this salt and you will never buy the over-processed, chemically-tasting table salt again. It brings out the natural flavor of foods without tasting "salty". I love that it provides trace minerals missing from our modern, "civilized" diets. I go to a lot of trouble providing wholesome, fresh, healthy meals for my family. I'd hate to ruin them with inferior ingredients like grocery store, iodized salt. I did a lot of research on different types of salt and was torn between the pink Himalayan salt and the gray Celtic Sea salt. I think either would probably be ok but felt this salt held a slight edge as it tends to be less expensive.Helpful Notes: This salt arrives in a large, sealed plastic bag. It is rather moist, but that is no problem. I prefer to buy the coarse ground purely because of the price. I use this salt in three ways: in a sea salt grinder for the table, finer ground for baking, and naturally coarse for cooking. For the grinder, I highly recommend the Kyocera Ceramic Fine Mill, White Top, which I also purchased from Amazon. It handles this moist, course salt beautifully and never clogs or rusts, even in the humid South. No need for drying, just fill up the grinder with salt straight from the bag. For baking, I lay out some salt on a baking sheet to dry a bit, then grind it in a spice grinder. I then store it in a small glass jar. For general cooking, I like to use a salt cellar that I keep next to the stove. I just grab a pinch or spoonful as I need it. It dries out naturally a bit as it sits. I store the remaining salt in a large glass jar and take out what I need when I need it. I bought a 5 lb bag 4 months ago and at that time I filled the salt mill for the table, the salt cellar, and the jar for baking. I still have not yet refilled any of these containers, and we are a family of four with two teenage boys. This salt will last us a long time!I think a bag of this salt with the Kyocera salt mill would make a lovely wedding gift!
The product was packaged well and instructions on keeping it fresh were very clear. It has a wonderful flavor.

As far as I can tell, this is a pretty good price it is being offered at here.

Celtic Sea Salt is great. It's not refined or processed or bleached so it retains all the healthy trace minerals nature provides, and it's an excellent source of iodine. Great for use in cooking. For table use,you'll need a salt grinder.

Also...celtic sea salt has the highest essential minerals of any salt out there...so I drink 1 to 2 tsps of the salt in water everyday.  Not the same as our bleached out salt in the grocery stores.  This one is actually very good for you.

Such a wonderful alternative to regular salt. My family will never go back to it. This tastes so much better and I don't get that bloated, puffy feeling after using even heavier amounts. This is by far the best value for the volume of Celtic Sea salt.  I use it frequently.  Plus the seller is prompt and efficient with shipping, which is always a plus.Luanne

Let me first say that this is the best tasting salt I've ever had. My girls and I decided to do a side by side comparison with the other salts I had in the cupboard. We did kosher, name brand processed sea salt, and regular iodized salt against the Celtic Sea Salt. The winner without a doubt was the Celtic Sea Salt. It's not as salty, and has no weird sea smell like other semi damp salts I've dried. It has a clean flavor, without the burning "salt" taste. The 5lb. bag course is a lot cheaper than the ground version. I just bought a mortar and pestle and decided to just grind it myself. I can't wait to cook with it, especially for baking bread. My youngest daughter always wants salt and the salt aficionados say it's because her body is looking for the trace minerals that are found in the natural sea salt. I would highly recommend this to any who want to get away from the worthless, non nutritional stuff. As for it being wet, it's supposed to be like that. I just put it in my RSVP salt server, and wrap the rest of the bag up in a gallon zipper bag, and store in a cool dry place.

This salt is only $22.95 from the manufacturer's website, celticseasalt . c o m , further more this website and this manufacturer is highly deceptive, and it is obvious by the comments on this website. all modern sea salt has significantly less trace minerals than ancient himalayan sea salt. the manufacturer provides a graph that seems to indicate this salt has more than 3 times the trace minerals, when all they are really comparing is the moisture content. you are paying for about 12% water when you buy this product by weight, which is about 3 times the amount of water in himalayan salt. himalayan salt forms an alkaline solution in water, due to its higher trace mineral content, while all modern sea salt forms acidic solutions. this salt does have a decent flavor, which i find goes well with fish, but for all other cooking, himalayan salt is both tastier and healthier. a lot of reviewers have been duped by the spurious and misleading information on the manufacturers website. this salt has a significantly lower ratio of trace minerals to sodium  than himalayan salt.

column9: Selina Celtic Grey Salt - Fixed My Kidney Pain
column10: This salt tastes delicious, as everyone else has said.  And no, it isn't cheap.However, for me at least, it's been so very helpful.  I've been on a low-carb diet for 5.5 years and after about 2 years I began experiencing pain in my right kidney.  I went to doctors multiple times and they all said my kidney function was completely normal.  This salt quite literally cured this painful condition for me.I don't know if it's specifically caused by the low-carb diet or more likely a combination of the low-carb diet (which may eliminate minerals we would typically get in processed foods), a lot of tea drinking, and the fact that at work I only have access to reverse osmosis water (which has the minerals removed).  Whatever may have caused it - the DAY AFTER I started using this type of salt my kidney pain was gone completely.  I was not expecting it to cure this, I started using the salt because of the minerals in it but had no clue that was what was causing my kidney pain.  In the several months since then the only time my kidney pain recurs I can always look back at the previous couple of days and see that I have not had my usual amount of this salt.If you have troublesome kidney pain that seems to have no other cause I would definitely try using a grey salt like this one.On a side note, I've had low blood-pressure for years and I've added about 1.5 teaspoons of this salt to my diet per day (besides what I was already ingesting in food). I experienced a VERY slight increase in my blood pressure, most likely "caused" by the salt.  By slight I mean a couple of points.  For me this has also been a blessing as I no longer feel faint upon standing (or at least on very rare occasions).

There were a few complaints about excessive water content in this salt.  I dry my salt using a clay bar pan in my oven using just the light.  We have high humidity here in central Illinois.  After a day or two in the oven with periodic stirring it is dry enough to put in my grinder and I store the rest in a canister with a loose lid.  Curious about how much weight was water I weighed the salt before and after drying one time and did not see a signifcant difference.  My scale is not the most accurate but close enough to tell the water weight isn't that much of a consideration.  What with the price difference between the already dried and finely ground salt I'll stick with this one.  We have been using this salt for probably eight years and love it. Our chiropractor recommended it and we have never gone back.  The taste difference is really distinct.

Why can't the manufacturer remove moisture prior to bagging?  I don't want to pay extra to ship a cup of water along with my salt, nor do I want to dry it.  Otherwise, like the salt, but a hassle to get it dry enough to grind.

Flavorful and has added nutrition!  You use less than regular salt.  It brings out flavor of food.  In salads, I just use some Celtic salt and let it sit for a little while and it brings out the juices from contents.

We really enjoy this celtic sea salt. The coarse crystals are less expensive and I just put them in my salt grinder which works great!  With the celtic sea salt , I don't swell up, but when we eat out , the salt they use makes me swollen.  Guess it's all those good minerals in it.

This is an amazing salt. Slightly moist, which can be air dried, ground up in a coffee grinder and put in a salt shaker. Does not burn the tongue like table salt. Tastes fresh as the sea. I enjoy liberally, it helps prevent muscle cramps and charlie horses.

Being a  teacher, public speaker and singer, I have found that these drops are helpful in keeping the mouth moist.  However, I love candy and I am happy to add these honey drops to my collection. I grew up in Hudsonville, Michigan, about 20 minutes from Holland, Michigan, where there was a very large Dutch community. When I moved out to Oregon, I could not find these mints anywhere and I wanted them so I was very glad when I could finally find them on Amazon.They are more of a mild type of mint, especially compared to the peppermints that Lifesavers puts out. column9: More mints than I will ever need!
column10: I wish these mints came in smaller packaging. These mints are a favorite of my boss--he will get a package every year until he retires.  I hope they keep! I am glad amazon carries them--else I would have to go to Europe to buy them.

These mints are very different to your typical American breath mints - larger size, different texture, and milder taste.  Somehow they're pepperminty without being Menthol-y, and they have a slightly sweet aftertaste - with perhaps a hint of vanilla?  They're perfect for an after-dinner treat that freshens your breath without burning your tongue or totally shocking your taste buds...  Anyway, I hadn't had any in years and was delighted to find them on Amazon.  I bought some for my boyfriend to try, and he quickly became addicted to the "Christmas mints" and always keeps a baggie on hand!

I don't care for peppermints, but my Dutch girlfriend grew up eating Wilhelmina peppermints and had been talking a lot about how she missed them, so I decided to find her some online! Since Amazon offers free shipping on this item (it was around $30 when I bought it) and any other website I found had such expensive shipping, it cost around $10 anywhere else to get 3.5 ounces of these things! Amazon offered 24x the amount of mints for only 3x the price so I decided to just go for it and buy the whole 12 pack. I didn't realize until it arrived its more than 5 pounds of mints! I am very pleased with the amount for the cost on Amazon.About the actual mints- The size surprised me- they were around the size of a quarter and fairly thick. For the taste- I don't like mints, so I'll give my girlfriend's opinion here. She says they are the best mints she's ever tried! I read the ingredients and the flavoring comes from pure peppermint oil- no artificial flavors, and the list of ingredients is short (generally the shorter the list the healthier and less processed stuff goes in it), so if you like mints these would be great to try. From my online research I have to say the smaller containers of mints generally have much cuter packaging(some are in a nice roll that looks sort of like a pack of rollos, and some are in tins with blue and white pictures of stereotypical dutch things like windmills-- these mints are just loose in bags). My girlfriend said the mints she's had in the past had the design imprinted in the center of the circle like a coin, but these were just plain round circles with the queen's head on it. These may not have the best packaging or the coolest design, but if you primarily care about the taste of the mints, these are by far the greatest deal!
If you like mints you will really like these. I don't like mints very much but I really enjoy these. I have to hide them from my husband and kids because they love them and cannot get enough of them.

I'm a part-time martial arts/fitness instructor w/ an atrociously busy schedule that's got me practically 'fighting' for blocks of time to sleep. Although I enjoy what I do, I admit that I get bogged down from constantly going from one program to another. Just yesterday a student of mine gave me a can of XS and since I'm not a huge proponent of energy drinks, I just placed it in my bag and told her that I'll try it at a later time. I usually find that I don't get the effects that most of the popular ones promise to give. And to add, I'm not a huge fan of the 'seltzer-like' taste of many of them. This morning I got up and had one of many grueling workouts, showered, ate and came to work at my full time job when 'low and behold' I started to get a case of drowsiness just sitting at my desk checking my daily emails. I figured I'll just chug the XS and 'when it doesn't work' I'll go get a cup of java....NOT!!!! Not only was I pleasantly surprised by the taste, I got an instant "jolt" from just taking one sip. I'm almost reluctant to finish the can because it might have me bouncing off the walls. I immediately called my student to let her know that this is the real deal and she informed me that's what XS is supposed to do as it's loaded w/ B vitamins! Needless to say I placed an order for a case. I just hope all the flavors are as good as the Electric Lemon Blast! LOL

My wife was addicted to the sugary version of these and she has always hated the taste/aftertaste of any artificial sweeteners. Now that she has tried this sugar free version she is just as addicted but taking in less calories. I can't explain the reviewer who developed illness and thinks the candies are the cause. My wife has the most sensitive stomach and digestive tract and these do not bother her at all. In fact the reason she has always eaten the Star Brite or Starlight mints is that they help settle her stomach. She suffers from diverticulitis and is prone to attacks of diarrhea so she doesn't go anywhere without these mints. The sugar free version is very difficult to find locally so I'm thrilled to buy them buy the case on Amazon.

column9: Best sugar-free peppermint to be found
column10: As a former sugar addict, I've spent a lot of time and money looking for sugar free substitutes for when I need a little something sweet.  There are several SF mints out there but the Brach's Star Brites are the best, in my opinion. Because they can be hard to find in stores, I order them in large quantities online so that I always have them on hand. I keep a bowl of them at work on my desk and my colleagues appreciate them.

I thought I was going to die. Cramping, bloating, severe diarrhea, rectal bleeding and total exhaustion. It took me a few days to realize I didn't have the plague but the new Brachs star brite candies I bought from Amazon were killing me. It says it is made with Splenda on the front of the package so I figured it would be a good sugar free candy. Guess again, the main ingredient on the label is Isomalt. Some kind of synthetic sugar substitute. It even says on the rear cover that excessive consumption can cause a laxative effect. A serving size is 3 candies. I should have just ate poison. This is not food.

column9: Healthy treats. Made in the USA with all organic chicken, and doggie loves them. Very happy repeat customer
column10: I am the proud mom of a 16-year-old rescued Border Collie/Lab mix who just happens to be one of the sweetest beings that has ever lived. :) Well, I want her to live a very long, healthy, and happy life, so I only feed her things that I believe will help achieve that end. These treats have all organic chicken, no meat bi-products, pro-biotics, and lots of other great ingredients.I purchased our first bag of Plato Farmers Market Chicken & Vegetables Treats for Dogs over a year ago, and she absolutely loved them. Many bags later, she still wags happily for them.I also give her the Plato Sweet Potato Treats. She loves to chew the sweet potatoes, and they are easier on her teeth than chewing bones. Plato, thank you for making such great products. You have two very grateful customers.INGREDIENTS: Chicken, carrot, celery, beet, parsley, lettuce, watercress, spinach, green pea, sweet potato, tomato, parsley, salt, zinc propionate, vitamin E supplement, coated ascorbic acid (source of vitamin C), bacillus subtilis.NUTRITIONAL BENEFITS:- Grain-free -no corn, wheat, soy, grain fractions or fillers- Natural ingredients, fortified with antioxidant vitamins, zinc propionate- Contains a source of live (viable) naturally occurring microorganisms- No artificial colors, flavors, synthetic preservatives, GMO's (genetically modified organisms), meat by-products or meals.- Naturally preserved.

Our two dogs love these treats.  They are great to train a puppy because you can hold the treat and the dogs can have a nibble instead of giving them the whole treat. Both of our dogs love the treat and we feel that this is the healthiest product for our dogs.  You can see some of the vegetables and blueberries that are in this treat.  When I reach for the bag of treats both dogs go crazy.

Farmers Chicken and Vegetable is a great healthy treat for your dogs.  Best of all, it is grain free.  We have two standard poodles, one that cannot eat grain, and a mini pincer this is their favorite treat. We have many visitors who bring their dogs and all of them love this treat.  We order the treats from Amazon.com as they have the best price.
All 3 of my dogs absolutely LOVE these treats!! I love that they are made in the USA. No weird bowel movements either, 2 of my pups have really sensitive stomachs.
It is difficult to find a grainfree treat for your dogs, but these treats we're a great find! My dogs love them , they are the right consistency not too hard or too soft.  My pups love them!

I buy treats for my dogs in bulk to have them on hand. I opened this package 2 months after purchase, which meant it is too late to return, and found the product to be moldy. This is even though the expiration date hasn't been reached yet. Also, the sweet potatoes are soft, as if they are not fully dehydrated. I've bought this product at local stores and haven't had a problem. This must be part of a bad batch. I won't be buying this product or other dog treats from Amazon again, as now I am out of the money I paid.

One of my dogs has inflammatory bowel disease. This is one of the few products I can give her for a treat that she can eat because it's low in protein and in fat. It doesn't upset her stomach. It's also grown here in the USA which makes me feel safer after the recent scare we pet owners had not too long ago. All my dogs LOVE them!

My dogs love these sweet potato treats.  I feed my dogs grain-free diets and other high-end supplements, so of course I wanted a treat that followed our feeding ethic. This is low in protein and fat, so it is gentle on the stomach of puppies and sick dogs alike. My dogs go crazy over these. They love the taste and since these are a little tough, it takes them a bit longer to finish them, which is great because dogs usually swallow treats whole. They are not extremely tough though. Puppies can eat them. Even though the bag does not have an indication to refrigerate after opening, please do so. They will last longer and remain fresher. Plus, you could prevent mold growth. Amazon sells these by far at the most affordable price. Specialty stores sell these treats up to twice as much as Amazon does, so I suggest you buy them from Amazon. If you want a healthy treat, this is the way to go. :)

My dog refuses all vegetables, but he likes these treats.  Because the vegetables have been cooked and are dehydrated he should be able to get some nutrients out of them.  Dogs lack the enzymes to break down plants cell walls normally.  At first he hesitated to eat one, but I broke off a bit,and he decided they were good.  I also crumble two into his food each meal.  His fussy, meat-loving poodle pal also enjoys them--and no stomach upset.  Nice product.

My dog is allergic to almost every edible food, including treats. I was looking for something that could be a treat that wasn't manufactured and it wouldn't affect him, so I bought them. These sweet potatoes treats are all natural, he loves them and the best thing is that he is not allergic to them.  This is a perfect solution for those owners who want a different kind of treat for their dogs or for those dogs that are allergic to manufactured treats. I will be buying more.

column9: My Dogs Love Sweet Potatoes, But.....
column10: they did not like these! I cut them in half thinking that they could smell that it was sweet potato but that did not help.

column9: Sweet Potato Treats had mold on them
column10: I have stocked our dogs' treat pantry with Plato's Farmers Market products for about a year. My dogs love their Salmon and Salmon with Vegetable treats. I recently purchased their Sweet Potato treats, which have a "Best by" date of 9-22-10. Shortly after opening the bag we saw that treats were covered in white & blue mold. Unacceptable & disgusting. The bag's sticker has "X00133D6P" on it. I have bought Plato products many times previously and have been pleased, however, these are supposed to be safe and quality treats. I absolve the seller, The Whole Healthy Pet, of responsibility of this issue as they have taken swift steps to rectify the issue. However, I do firmly assert that Plato should have done a much better job of notifying customers of a bad batches of Sweet Potato treats.

column9: Good product but a tad crumbly
column10: My two dogs love these.  I bought them along with the regular Plato chicken treats when I saw they were USA made.  The only reason I gave these four stars instead of five is that they are somewhat crumbly when you get them out of the bag. I assume it's due to the vegetable content so I'm not really complaining. It's great to find products that are not only good tasting, but good for them as well.

column9: why would you put EGGS in sweet potatoes???
column10: Just make plain Sweet potatoes. I can;t buy these because my dog is highly allergic to Chicken, eggs and everything dairy.
Nice treats. Not messy, great for inside feeding. All my dogs enjoy them. Perfect size too...not too big or small for large breeds.

My Boston Terrier Max loves the Plato Organic Chicken treats, his favorite actually. When I first gave him one of the Sweet Potato treats he wasn't sure what to think. He was thrown off by the texture I think and was having trouble chewing it. After he finally ate the first one he was sniffing around the garbage where we had put one he had left on the floor. He was trying to get the treat that was in there. Now everytime we break them out that's all he wants. Along with the Organic Chicken treats. He's hooked.

Our doggies love Plato's Salmon treats the most, but the chicken ones come a close second.  The treats are friable, so pretty easy to either split into 1/4s or crumble into their regular kibble.  The resealable bags are also nice to have.  The "and Vegetable" part does not seem to diminish their appetite for these treats!

column9: Our Dogs Chew On Them, But Don't Finish
column10: I have two Doodles, a brother and a sister, and the male eats just about everything you put in front of him and many things you don't!  He seemed very interested in these and even the female took them into her jaws and scurried off.  Alas, we found most of them later secreted in different parts of the living room.Other Plato treats have been enthusiastically recieved, so I have a good opinion of the company.  Worth a shot, but not to the beasties' tastes!

These treats are fantastic. Made in the USA, grain free, wonderful ingredients. My dogs absolutely adore these treats,  and all Plato treats I've bought for them. They are worth the extra money to ensure I'm feeding my dogs healthy, SAFE, nutritious treats.

They're different looking from the other's I've seen. They're smaller and darker in color then other Chicken Strips. They look more like beef Jerky.Nonetheless, our doggies like them, and that's what counts for us.
There was white, hairy mold on the treats in the middle of the bag.  Unfortunately, I'd already given my pups a couple of them before I found the mold, just an hour or so later. :(

My dog loves this salmon treats, he is allergic to wheat and some protein products but since this treat is Made from salmon and veggies there is no allergic reaction at all. Great for training or I give it every time I'll leave the house and my dog doesn't even look for me!

column9: Not for dogs with food allergies
column10: I have a dog with all kinds of allergies. She loves sweet potato treats and I love giving them to her because they're so healthy (the more I read about all the dangers of processed treats found in pet stores, the more resolute I am in my decision to never, ever feed her that garbage).The only problem I have with these treats is that they contain eggs and salt in addition to the natural sweet potato and probiotics. Eggs are a big no-no for any dog with food allergies, and salt is just something you shouldn't really be feeding your dog anyway. At least not in excessive quantities. These treats are a thousand times better than regular dog treats, but they didn't work for my dog.I've decided to stick to Snook's sweet potato treats. They're 100% dried sweet potato and nothing else - also made in the USA and my dog absolutely loves them.

column9: Dog Loves Them, We Love Them - Made in the USA
column10: My dog loves sweet potato treats, but after discovering a lot of additives in her previous treats, as well as the fact that they were made in China, we started searching for a new treat. She loves them, they are pricier, but that's basically what it comes down to if you want a low number of ingredients and products made in the USA.
Excellent quality dog treat for training.  Most dogs will view as a "high value" reward.This is the best salmon treat I have tried! My dog loves both the Salmon Strips andthe Farmer's Market Strips.

I have two dogs....one picky and the other not.  They both ate this and the picky one got tired of it after give it for the 4th / 5th time.  I really like it because of it being a healthy treat option.
My dog loves them, loves them, loves them. The probiotics are a great addition, my big boy has a sensitive system and he can be a bit gassy. A couple of these treats a day and he has been less gassy.
It is priced the best and my Gertie loves it, plus it is good for her!

column9: Natural Treats made in the USA
column10: I will no longer buy anything made in China for my dogs. I searched for a treat for them and even the ones in places like Petco were made in China. I finally found a link to Plato's Farmer's Market and then to them being sold on Amazon. They are made here in the USA and all natural. My vet told me to feed my dogs sweet potatoes or pumpkin and these treats fit the bill. So I ordered them through Amazon. My dogs beg for these. I have now ordered them three times and will continue to do so.
My 3 toy dogs like just about every treat put before them except these and the other Plato Organic Chicken treats.
WHEN I OPENED THE BAG, I COULDNOT EVEN GET MY DOG TO COME OVER. THEN I TRIED MANUALLY PUT IT IN HER MOUTH AND SHE SPIT IT OUT AS FAST AS SHE COULD...NEVER AGAIN!!!

As someone who only has coffee every once in a while, I love my flavia for ease of use and its single-serving mentality.The French Roast flavor is a solid go-to coffee. Not overly sweet like many of their flavors, but can taste a little burnt. It reminds me of basic Starbucks coffee, so if that's something you really enjoy, you'll probably like this too.
Better than Starbucks at a great price! I run the packet twice to get a bigger cup of coffee. The coffee has a rich flavor without the bitterness.

I like the French Roast coffee.  It is fairly strong and has a nice earthy flavor.  This listing gives you 100 packets - so about fifty cents a cup.The case was unopened and seems to be fairly recently manufactured.  It is not old expired stock.If you like french roast, this is a reasonable value.  I don't see it elsewhere for less.

I have been using this Flavia machine of mine for 3+ years in my office and have had loads of compliments about the individually brewed packets.  I will say that I have found some coffees are better than others.  My husband prefers the French Roast while I personally enjoy the House Blend.  I also enjoy the Morning Roast.  I didn't like the new packages because of course new packages mean more cost....that wasn't surprising but still disappointing.  As far as taste, I find their coffees to be pleasant.  Overall very happy with the machine and products offered.

I ordered the Flavia Alterra "Morning Roast" coffee packs.  This is a $ 50 purchase.  I brewed one cup and practically spit it out.  The flavor was horrible.I will never again buy food products of any kind on Amazon, because no matter what, they will not do a return on it.  And try getting Flavia to help you..... good luck with that.The short sightedness of these 2 companies' return policy is that by refusing to make an Amazon/Flavia customer happy & do a $50 return, they now lose potentialy thousands$$$ of sales because of a negative review.  Bummer, that.

I was first turned on to these wonderful candies when I found them on clearance in a supermarket. After trying them and finding out just how wonderful they are, I went back and bought all the rest. With a 66% fruit content and everything else being acceptable i deemed them my new source of snacking sugars. (i have quite a sweet tooth) They aren't too chewy where they stick in your teeth and they are dry enough on the outside (the flavorless Carnauba wax coating) where they don't get messy to handle, even on hot humid days.  So if you are reading this to see if it's something you would like to try..add them to your Cart. They are Delish!  ...before i buy them all up.
My son had tasted these snacks at school and asked me to buy them for him.  I was appalled to see that they are MADE IN CHINA!  Very deceptive marketing in my opinion.

I bought these for my childrens lunches but hubby and I got hooked on them as well. They are a great snack and I love to keep some in the car, just in case. They are great when you are PMSing and want something sweet and sour and low calorie!

column9: Kids Love Them, Parents Do To...
column10: We bought these originally for the kids' lunches, and they have become a family lunchbag favorite.  They're tasty and reasonably healthy.Others love them too.  The kids often share them at lunch time, and we've had at least ten other parents ask where to get them.  We can't find them in the stores anymore, so Amazon is our exclusive source.  [And props to Amazon - I love the subscribe and save for convenience...]
Florida's Natural Nuggets are the best snack ever!! Fruity, chewy, and easy to eat, plus, not too sweet and sugary. I take them wherever I go for a quick energy snack.

column9: Love, love, love these little snacks
column10: I keep these in my desk at work. They are great when I don't really need much to eat, but want a snack.  Because this isn't an item that disappears in three bites, it helps satisfy cravings.

I tell every Mom I know about Florida's Natural Sour String, Fruit Stiks (yes that is how they are spelled) and Fruit Nuggets. These are indeed an awesome alternative to the junk out there for kids to snack on and they taste yummy too! No, they aren't actually fruit but they are definitely a healthier choice than other on-the-go snack choices.  Our favorite is Strawberry. Unfortunately these are really hard to find locally so when I do find them, I stock up!  If you aren't sure that you want to buy a 12 pack to start, check out their website for local retailers and buy a pack to try.  You'll be back here to place your order for all the varieties!

My kids and even my Mom loved these snakcs.  They are not "fruit snacks".  They are small and look like chiclets, but the taste is good.  The texture is closer to dried fruit than traditional fruit snacks.  I also like the small serving size.

column9: Made in CHINA...Deceptive Packaging! Do Not Buy.
column10: We were looking for a healthy snack for our three children and purchased a case of these. On the front of the package in large letters is ..."Made from American Grown Fruits" but on the back in small letters is..."Made in China". I feel this is very deceptive on the part of this company. I wish we could return these, but they are not returnable to Amazon. Our children will not be eating these.

My kids and I love these. They are sweetened mostly with fruit puree and don't contain high fructose corn syrup or chemical dyes unlike most "fruit snacks."  These are very small pieces, about the size of a square pea and texture is like a firm gum drop, not chewy like gummy candy like a lot of fruit snacks.  Kids tend to choke on fruit snacks, and I find that this has not happened with these probably due to the smaller size and less slippery texture.  The little half once bags are a perfect little treat size that won't spoil their appetite.

I first bought these in my local grocery store and absolutely fell in love with them... right size,right amount of sweetness.P.S. If you love sour candy but don't want to gain 20 more pounds... try the SOUR version THEY ARE INCREDIBLE!

These are not like the standard cartoon-character-shaped fruit snacks.  They are small and pebble-like, as another reviewer said, and the texture is not gelatin-based like "regular" fruit snacks.  Every kid is different, but my daughter doesn't choke on these like she did with the regular fruit snacks.  She prefers the taste of these, and we've found that these don't upset her stomach like the "regular" fruit snacks do.While not as good as say, a banana, these seem better than a candy bar or cookie for a treat.  Each pouch is pretty small, but is more than enough for a toddler.

column9: My kids love these fruit snacks
column10: Everyone in our family likes these fruit snacks. I found them in Target once and then couldn't find them again in any stores.

column9: Real fruit, yes  -  but real sweet, too.  No, I mean REAL sweet
column10: The biggest selling point for Florida's Natural Fruit Nuggets is that they actually contain fruit.  Faint praise?  Not for me; that "66% fruit" blurb looks mighty inviting after I bought a competing product and then discovered it consisted almost solely of corn syrup and sugar.Fruit content isn't the only point where Fruit Nuggets differ from their competition, though.  They're not the big soft shapes one usually associates with fruit snacks; instead, they're like a little packet of pills or pellets.  (A full pack measures surfacewise about half the size of a cell phone.)  The nuggets don't have the gummy texture associated with fruit snacks; as others have noted, they're a grainy half-gel.  It's a change for the less-fun, but I could adjust.The problem: they're VERY sweet.  Not tart, just super-sweet  -  this is one big dose of fructose.  (Odd, isn't it; usually, the natural products err in being too staid and not sweet enough.)  The other problem is that pear puree is used as a base for all four flavors, and so the pear taste does somewhat overpower the strawberry, orange, etc.  I applaud the effort to use, you know, *actual fruit* in these snacks, but I hope that Florida's Natural tweaks the recipe so that the taste is as good as the quality of the ingredients.

I was looking for a healthy option to fruit chews. This is just candy. I bought a whole case of this on here, waste of my money. My son who loves candy won't even eat these. My girls and I don't like them either, they are just WAY TO SWEET! Disappointed.

The disturbing thing is that they are made in China.  Nowhere on the product description does it state that fact.  Florida's Natural - you would just assume they were made in Florida or someplace close.  I tossed the whole box out because I will not let my family ingest anything made in China.  I do not trust their production values.

Small, firm and pebble like, these are not the soft gummy type snacks that some may be more familiar with.  They are chewy with a slight grainy texture.  Although the ingredient list isn't great, it is nice that it doesn't have the artificial colors and high fructose corn syrup as others have mentioned.However, the taste leaves much to be desired.  The initial taste reminded me of Flintstones chewable vitamins and the aftertaste certainly reinforced the chewable vitamin resemblance.  The box I bought had three flavors - orange, blueberry, and strawberry.  While all three flavors initially taste different from one another, they all fade into the same "vitaminy" realm of flavor.I love natural snacks such as dried fruit (contrary to another reviewer, these don't remind me at all of dried fruit) and the more 'natural' brands of goodies.  I also indulge in mainstream candy junk food occasionally.  These are fairly gross, though, and I won't purchase them again.

I was trying a chicken recipe that called for this vinegar...didn't really see that it would make much difference. So I made it 1st with rice vinegar, then with champagne vinegar. This product made a far more yummy entre. Thank you.
Great condiment for my latin american dishes.  Unable to find it lately in the supermarkets.  Miami?  Atlanta?

I live in Texas so there is not much, actually no, Greek cheese available here to make Saganaki.  This cheese was absolutely delicious!!!  Just as good as in a restaurant in Canada.  I'm a so happy to have found a source for this cheese.  It did arrive with the ice packets completely melted but it was 100 degrees or more that day.  It didn't seem to affect the quality at all.

column9: Great taste at a nice price
column10: Full black peppercorn flavor without the hype and expense of "gourmet" brands.This is the top-rated "supermarket" brand of peppercorns by non-profit Cook's Illustrated / America's Test Kitchen.This is the only non-Tellicherry pepper to make it to their final lineup.If you use freshly ground black pepper as much as I do, this is a fine purchase for everyday use.
I bought these for relatives who have everything.  They all told me it was great and the perfect gift that they can use year round and the soups were great.

It's a cool little basket, and the stuff inside looks great. The only problem I have is that I'm going to have to take it out of the wrap and make it look pretty. No biggie, really, but you should know that the stuff is crammed into the basket, and really doesn't look that great (presentation wise) I can't wait to give it as a gift though.

column9: Wine Country Gift Baskets Are Awesome!
column10: We are very impressed with Wine Country Gift Baskets.  We ordered the soup basket for our elderly relative, but unfortunately there was too much sodium for her to enjoy the soup.  She called Wine Country Gift Baskets to explain her dilemma, and they very graciously sent her another basket absolutely complimentary.  They did all this before Christmas so she could enjoy her new holiday gift basket.  We certainly appreciate their efforts because they helped make a holiday brighter for someone else at their own expense.  We give them a big THANK YOU !!!!!!!!

I gave this to two aunts (85 and 95 years old). I always ask them to be honest when I send things like this in the mail ( I think most poeple are not honest when they receive something as a gift). Anyway, thier comments were: "the soup was OK, just powder, nothing special". For the money this item cost with shipping you would be much beter off purchasing gourmet soup mixes at specialty stores and making your own gift basket.

I sent these to several relatives at Christmas and got rave reviews!  My 97-year-old grandpa, who lives in the Midwest, just called me yesterday (it's now Valentine's Day week!) to tell me again how much he loves the soup.  He also said he really liked the bowl that came with it and uses it all the time!  So if you're looking for something *different* that will create a warm feeling in the heart of someone you love - this is it!
When a family member endet up sick, we did send him this gift.And it was the right choice.I'm a loyal customer since years and never could complain.Always on time, great service and great product!
THIS PERSON THAT I BOUGHT THIS FOR, ENJOYED RECEIVING IT AND SAID THE SOUPS WERE GREAT.VERNA GREEN
Sent this basket to my son, who's a freshman in college.  He loved it... and, oddly, he finds the basket itself "highly useful."
This was a gift for my Mother and she loved it.  The soups and cornbread were delicious and filling. This was a great gift for someone who doesn't have the room for knickknacks.

I ordered this as a gift for my grandma and she loves it!!  She said they are delicious and very easy to make.  She likes them so much she had my mom ask me where I got them so she could order more.  Great product!!
Gave as an xmas gift to a friend that always orders soup at restaurants.  She just loved it!  It was perfect.  She said the broccli one was amazing.

I purchased 5 of these gift baskets because I wanted something different from the usual candy or cookie type basket.  I was very pleased with the baskets and each of my friends who received the soup basket seemed to be delighted it.

Soup's OnI sent this to my 90 year old mother, who is in an assisted living facility. They feed her well, but sometimes she doesn't like any of the selections or she is under the weather, and would prefer to eat in her room. She loved the soups and the corn bread, and thought it was a different idea....instead of flowers and candy. so I was a big hit!!
I gave this to my boyfriend's boss for Christmas and assumed that he liked it.  The wooden crate the soup fixin's come in is attractive.
An adorable array of items - mine was set nicely in the basket. I was happy to give this as a gift.
The basket arrived quickly and in great shape.  It looked very nice and of good quality.

We purchased this Soup Basket for some friends that are always on the go, and find hard to leave work for lunch. They truly enjoy the soup, and she loves the design on the soup cups.Thank you,Happy in Northern California

column9: Not at all what I expected
column10: For one thing, this was about a month late.  It was a shipping issue so I won't count that against the product.  The soups that come in the basket, there are 4 of them, are just enough to make 1 cup each!  What a rip-off!  The presentation is not that great either.

column9: Presentation is less impressive than I imagined...
column10: I was hoping that this would be an impressive gift to give my boyfriend's mother, so I was counting on looks since when she receives the gift it will be all about the first impression of the package. Personally, I wasn't impressed with how it looks, but I'm hoping that the the quality of the food will make up for it.
Sent this gift as a surprise to my brother, who didn't like the Christmas gift I gave him. So I came home found this and sent it to him. Made him think twice about being rude.

column9: Tried a different KOA coffee - tastes burnt
column10: In desperation & frustration from buying (and throwing out) pound after pound of bitter & burnt coffee beans of various brands and types for several years now, I ordered some expensive KOA Kona coffee beans in the 4-pack of half-lb. bags. Alas, after trying the first bag, KOA Kona Estate, I'm very sorely disappointed, and could cry at having thrown away more money for yet another bag of burnt tasting & smelling coffee.I grew up drinking great coffees that were quite affordable, but in recent years it is nearly impossible to find real, GOOD coffee that isn't bitter and burnt no matter how much you pay for it. After doing some research on why today's coffees smell & taste so terrible, I've decided to buy green coffee beans and roast my own. Coffee today is like most cheap merchandise made in China - made in huge quantities and processed with cheap methods, and no craftmanship or pride in the making of it.Most people I know today have never had truly good coffee, and they drink those ridiculous flavored versions with loads of sugar and artificial crap. Compare them to people who've only eaten cheap sliced white bread from grocery stores, with no idea of the fabulous aroma & flavor of home-baked breads made by hand - not machine bread made from a mix...Even the local coffee shops that once had excellent coffees have succumbed to mass production and inferior quality.If coffee were this terrible when I began drinking coffee decades ago, I would never have taken up the habit - I'd have spit out the first sip and said no thank you!

One of the best sugar-free syrups out there.  It is quite sweet, and has a thick creamy consistency.  It is fairly high in calories, so be sure to measure out a serving if needed.  I like to add this to my coffee or protein shakes for extra flavor/sweetness.  Very nice in certain teas as well.
glad I went ahead and ordered. better than I expected. another plus, they sent the pump. will watch for any other sugar free products from this company. this company is on my favorites list now.

I 'discovered' Torani sugar free Peach about 10 years ago.  I've been hooked on it ever since, buying sometimes a case at a time from the only retail outlet in the areas where I've lived.  I've had to drive as far as 50 miles to get it.  I use this in my own home made iced tea for that wonderful 'peach tea' us southerners are known for.  Use a Torani pump, 4 squirts in a 24 oz glass with tea and 1 tsp of additional splenda, and you've got a taste you won't forget!  I was extremely happy to find the larger bottles here and under the subscription service, I get a product I really like for less without even leaving home.

Peach is one of my favorite flavors in life, so when they came up with Sugar-Free peach, I bought some right away.  Nice addition to white soda, breakfast smoothies and even white wine.  Amazon's service can't be beat anywhere, so it's great all around.

The Dr. Started me on a new medication That Will Turn your tastse buds off of carbonated water. Including all Sodas!!  This was all I drank so I had to find something else fast. I started off with the flavored teas- but you have to be careful even some of these have carbonation in them!  I really preferred the peach tea, but with each different place you had no idea what you were getting!  So I decided that sense i couldn't drink soda I should leave the sugar alone as well.  So I got on amazon and found that they had sugar free peach syrup!  I was in business.  I make my own tea every morning and it goes everywhere I go. No more need for sonics or quick stops for a drink.  I am not getting all the preservatives that goes along with the other drinks as well.  I really recommend this syrup and i can't wait for winter to see what kind of coffee concoctions I can come up with.ALL SERIOUSNESS aside This is really good stuff, I just signed up for them to mail me more onced a month.
We use Torani flavorings over our yogurt and this sugar-free peach flavor is great.  I wish there were more inexpensive sugar-free flavors like this one as we would like them also for our yogurt.

column9: Great Value, Great Taste, Great Sevice
column10: This product was all that was promised and more.  Great taste and a nice touch in your coffee or iced tes. Service was great. The product arrived quickly and in perfect condition.  I have paid as much as $8.99 for a single bottle in a smaller size and finding the SF peach on the store shelves is nearly impossible!
