column9: Sugar free Peach Torani Syrup.....gotta love it
column10: this Torani Syrup, (sugar free peach) awesome.  I use it in my cold ice tea.  Mild flavor but you can really taste the peach.  I plan to get more once I finish the bottles I bought.
Best Sugar free syrup I have tried.  Tastes as good as those with sugar in them.  So far all of the Torani syrups taste great.  No after taste in the flavors.

I use this in my hot tea and it is just amazing.  I have a vitamix and so make all my own drinks at home.  This is the perfect flavoring to add to all types of drinks.  Sugar free Peach is my favorite of all of the Torani Syrups.
Product was just okay. Flavor was just not intense. I will of course  use more to get the flavor i want but will probably not order again.
This is great tasting sugar free syrup.  I use it to make peach dacquiris, and they turn out yummy!  Highly recommend!

Health Extension is a high quality food that both of our dogs relish. It's a smallish kibble designed for teacup, toy and miniature dogs. The pieces are so small that they are actually tinier than the puppy food we still give Gabby. I like that the first ingredient listed is organic chicken and the second is chicken meal.In this product negatives are positives:no byproductsno rendered animal fatsno wheat, corn or soyno artificial preservativesno BHT or ethoxyquinno added sugarno artificial flavors, colors or dyesHealth Extension foods like this one are an oasis in a desert of lesser foods. Quality like this is worth the extra money.

column9: Nice & crunchy mixed with canned food
column10: My dog has been eating this b4 I bought her from breeder, so I'm keeping her on it. I mix it with a good canned food & she loves it. There are days she doesn't eat much at all, but then she makes up for it when she probably gets hungry!!  As she gets older I can reduce the canned food & add more of the health extensions.If your dog doesn't eat it - don't worry.  Take the dish away after 30 min. & give it again @ night. Take it away after 30 min.  Eventually your dog will get the idea & eat it because it's hungry...but don't give your pet table food bcause it will think it's always going to get it & it will never eat it's own food.

I have a 13 week old, 21 oz. tiny maltipoo. This food has been a lifesaver.  I tried about 6 others (top quality, expensive kibble) but he would only eat 3 or 4 pieces. This kibble size is perfect for his tiny mouth.  I have been softening it with water and adding tiny pieces of cooked chicken.  I can get him to eat about a tablespoon of this mixture, 5 times a day.  No more hypo attacks!

I got this food when i first got my dog, a mix (yorkie/maltese), and unfortunately he hasn't been eating it, so i don't really know how to rate this product. The ingredients definitely are very good, there are no by products..etcEdit: he has been eating Innova ever since.

I was excited to order these frozen lobsters.  They are one of my favorite foods.  They came quickly and were cold packed.  I assumed they would taste like maine lobsters , but they are laganstino type lobster which is like comparing filet mignon to hamburger.  I will still eat them, but wouldn't recommend them to anyone that likes maine lobster.  I was wondering how they got them out of the shell and the type of lobster they used has a thin one.  It's like a big shrimp or cray fish.

I have been pleased with these. It is good to have them easily available and the flavor is very good, usually better than grocery store tank lobsters. I use them for salads and bouillabaisse primarily. The delivery was very fast. They are small, maybe a 1 pound lobster without the shell.
I really love the Vitavigor breadsticks! They are the perfect substitute for pretzels. They are great to have at dinners and barbecues.

column9: Best Blue Cheese in the United States
column10: I get this blue cheese on my hamburgers, my steaks, I love it in my salads.Simply put, unless you are importing European blue cheeses nothing produced in the U.S. competes with the quality of Maytag blue cheese.
We sent this to my wife's cousin & she was absolutely delighted!  She had just finished the last pound we sent her.  Thank you.

Yamazaki is a well balanced single malt whiskey, for a fair price. Goes down smooth and finishes with a light smokiness. It's not too peaty, which is something I prefer in whiskey, but it comes down to your personal preference. Usually, Macallen 12yr is my go to, but Yamazaki is a nice switch every now and again. I definitely recommend. CHEERS!

Yamazaki 12 used to be a bargain when it was at the $28 price per bottle. Somewhere along the way, they got too big for their britches, and have been demanding more for their product.While a decent Scotch-like whisky, they're too expensive when you can get similar for less - that is, you can buy a REAL scotch. For less.For about the same price, a Dalwhinnie 15 is superior.And the 18year Suntory selling for $109 to $140? Laughable when you can buy a Glenlivet Archive 21 year for the same price.In conclusion, this was once a good alternative to scotch when they were cheaper. At their current prices, this does not compete well with all the great Speyside or Highland whiskys to be had for much cheaper.

We have been using this rice for years, but are unable to find it near us.  The closest place we can buy it is Fort Bragg, a long drive each way.  If you have never tried CALROSE this is a real treat!  The flavor and texture are so different than any rice normally available it is worth the effort to try it.  This is NOT a Instant Rice - you have to actually cook it.  Microwave works great.  1 Cup Rice & 2 Cups of water in a 5 to 10 qt covered MW safe Casserole works fine (1/2 tsp salt or butter flavored salt optional).  Cook 10 min on high, Stir, 10 min on Med.  (Settings vary)  Serve with Butter and Soy Sauce (Kikkoman of course).
This is the best tasting rice for making sushi.  I like to eat it for just about any time I want white rice.  I enjoy the sticky consistency and full flavor.
A bit calorie dense but delicious!I cook 1/2 a cup of this rice with 1 cup of water in my rice cooker and it makes quite a delicious snack. Cleanup is also a breeze as well.
Hard to review as it is just simple medium grain rice. Much better than generic brands but not the best I have tried. Still good enough to be worth 5/5.

I love this rice.  It works very well in a Rice Cooker. I use to buy this rice all the time. Lately,  I have not been able to find it in the local stores.  I am glad I can purchase it through Amazon.  I would definitely recommend this rice.
This rice is tasty. It tastes kind of like the white rice in Japanese restaurants but not quite the same unfortunately. Still, a good buy.

I learned to eat this rice when I was stationed in Hawaii.  The kind of long grain rice you buy in the grocery pales in comparison.  This is plump tasty rice.  Not always available near me. Thank heavens for Amazon.

I was looking for "sticky rice" and couldn't find it locally, so I turned to Amazon. This is good short grain / sticky / calrose rice (depending on what you call it). The bigger bags from other sellers are a better value, but I have gotten this one a few times as it is easier to store.
This is the best rice I've ever bought, as far as flavor and texture go.  We really like this kind and prefer it to the rice at the grocery, like Minute Rice.

column4: Marshall B. Kerr "Taking rinky dink to levels...
column9: Surprisingly good rice for my preferences.
column10: Very good rice with the sticky texture I enjoy a lot. Very reasonably priced. I'm very glad that I found it and selected it out of curiosity.Note: I own and adore a Zojirushi NS-LAC05 Micom 3-Cup Rice Cooker. A good 'fuzzy logic' rice cooker will turn home cooked rice into something very special. Different rice types will show why they are considered different from each other. The cooker is very convenient to use and with only moderate familiarity will turn anyone into an expert rice chef. A Zojirushi 'fuzzy logic' cooker will absolutely make you enjoy your home cooked rice MUCH more. Do yourself a favor. Make the most out of your rice. Invest in a 'fuzzy logic' cooker. A good cooker can bring out the best that any rice has to offer. It's your call, but having the right tools can make a massive difference for you. Don't cheat yourself with an inexpensive rice boiler. You will understand after you develop a relationship with a fuzzy logic rice cooking system. Doing the job right is not hard, and the rewards are immense.

I really like this tea and have been using it for awhile. Have used nearly a whole bag of 100 tea bags. The taste is wonderful and since I'm allergic to molds, the green instead of the red works best for me. I wanted to order more but it's not available now. Hope I can get more soon.

When I first went to order these I thought they were way too pricey, but I really wanted a healthy protein snack option, so I decided to give them a try.They arrive today and and I am so pleasantly surprised.  They are so good.  They are not greasy.  The most exciting revelation?  They are over a foot long!  The picture looked to me like they were about 4".I think they are worth every penny, and will be purchasing more.Thanks!

I've tried the sweet and the mild and I highly recommend. These are a bit pricey at $50 per box of 20, but you get what you pay for. Perhaps if enough people start purchasing these, the price will come down a bit. The grass fed beef does not taste gamey either. I do wish they were certified organic though. My guess is that they are from organic cows on small farms but these farms don't want to pay for organic certification due to price.

This jerky is the best out there due to the thin cut, slice size, and extreme heat. There is almost no gross fat and the texture is very edible. Ive tried lots of jerky and was hooked on Chernobyl until I discovered this product. I only eat the hottest kind but there are milder flavors to suit everyone.Try it you will like it!
Best value for the price.  Excellent flavor and aromatic seasoning for southwestern style cooking or as a rub for seered tuna.

These are wonderful.  I'm a salt monster, so the things that will bump me off a diet are generally crunchy snacks.  You can have *eight* of these (about the size of a standard rice cake) for only 1 WW Point. I rarely eat more than two at a time, because they are pretty filling, and I add a bit of extra salt, but that's just me.I just wish Amazon had these on subscribe and save -- as it is, we run out much too soon.

I bought this because I wanted an instant cappuccino mix free of transfats. It's fairly tasty, but it doesn't compare well to my favorite transfat brand in terms of mouth feel. If you're accustomed to a thick, creamy powdered cappuccino mix like Land o' Lakes, you're in for disappointment. The Victorian Inn mix is thin and watery by comparison, even if you double the amount of powder used, saturating the hot water (and yet, the Victorian Inn mix packs more calories into a single serving). On the other hand, if you're accustomed to the International Coffee tins of cappuccino powder, you'll feel right at home with the Victorian Inn powder and can switch without reservation.

I have an addiction to 7-11's Cappuccino, and buying one of those everyday adds up quickly. I have been looking for a replacement to 7-11's for sometime and have not found one until now. I decided to purchase this item and try it and do not regret it in the least. This is even better than 7-11's and a lot cheaper. If you like French Vanilla Cappuccino you should definitely try this, I do not think you will be disappointed.I purchased the 6 pack from Amazon, not the 3 pack.

I like to drink coffee and prefer mixing the coffee with a creamer.  Several years ago I started mixing in 2-3 teaspoons of Victorian Inn Cappuccino with each cup.  It has become my favorite receipe for a relaxing cup of coffee each day after work. I buy mine at a local Fleet Farm for about 7 bucks a tin, so this price for three is quite reasonable.  The instructions state to mix 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.  This produces a good tasting cappuccino.  It is not as rich as some cappuccinos, but for the price per serving, it has become my economy cappuccino.  There are 100 calories per cup.  There are 43 servings per container. The mainingredient (of course!) is sugar.  Add a teaspoon of your favorite instant coffee for more rich coffee taste.  Compared to other store brands, this product gives you more cappuccino for the money.konedog

We have used this product for years as a creamer for our morning coffee.  One rounded teaspoon in a large cup of black coffee gives it a smooth, slightly sweet taste.  Occasionally, I follow the directions for a cup of evening dessert cappuccino.

Love it...fantastitic Cappuccino at home on the cheap!This Cappuccino IS NOT General Foods International French Vanilla Coffee Beverage. If you can get past that you'll really enjoy this product very much.  If you already took the plunge and are dissatisfied just add milk and sugar to your cup with this mix. Sometimes my son puts powdered non-fat milk in his to boost the protein without extra fat, but he's at that age when exercising and getting rippled ABS is important...to each their own. Good value when less than 20 bucks.
Creamy, rich flavor.  The best I've tasted.  You've GOT to try this!

column9: I honestly didn't care for it.

I was really disappointed after reading such great reviews about this product.. Even more so becaue I ordered 6 tins of it!!! But it was a learning experience... won't buy it again, for sure!

You have to try this product to believe how delicious it is.  I like to put about 4 miniature marshmallows on top of a cup of this mixture - then just enjoy life!!

Excellent taste were able to give a can away to one of my co-worker and kept two for myself(that is how good it is.  The next best thing.  Price was very good for the three cans and the size.
If you want a good cup of cappuccino made at home you have to try this product.  This is quick and tastes GREAT!!!

She is happy and my life is much easier!! If you want a cappuccino that is NOT chocolaty then this is the one for you!!
I have been using Victorian Inn products for years. This is the best Cappachino mix I have ever found. They asked me not to bring it to work because it smelled too good!
Very tasty and the best price anywhere. Amazon has a great program saving you from driving, shopping dealing with others in the store.

The price, shipping and selection are superior, and I can order whenever I run out, and have it delivered to my door within days.  We use the Vanilla Cappuccino for both hot and frozen drinks and it is SO MUCH BETTER than the offerings at the local coffees stores.  Also lower in calories!  One container makes 3 weeks worth of drinks for less than 10 dollars?  How much would all those drinks cost at S***** or D** D**?  We won't accept any substitutes and we won't stop ordering from Amazon.  :)

I absolutly love the flavor of this cappuccino.  I use a teaspoon or more in a cup of coffee and it makes my morning.  I was disappointed in the way it was packaged.  Two of the cans were broke open and some of it spilled into the box it was delivered in.  They must be more careful about that.  Otherwise I was very happy that I was able to get a good price and hope I can get that again soon.

I have purchased this product for me and also for a friend.  She directed me to this as one of the best tasting cappuccinoes out there.  She was right!!!!!!  This happens to be the second time we have purchased this.  We get a quantity of 6 each time so we never run out!  You won't be disappointed!

I was severely disappointed to learn that this product does actually contain Trans Fats. The ingredients on the can do not match the ingredients posted on the website... I do realize they made a disclaimer saying that it might not be exact, but I assumed since they were advertising NO TRANS FATS that the product that reached my door would be free of hydrogenated oils.Beware the false advertising.

column9: The best cappuccino I've ever found.
column10: As many cappuccino mixes I have bought over the years, this one is the best. It's not to sweet like all the others, it just right.

I searched the web looking for a product that tasted like my local 7-11 French Vanilla Cappuccino. A lot of snow this winter was making the convenience store trek a bit inconvenient.  Of all the recipes and reviews I read, Victorian Inn Instant seemed to be what everyone else was raving about.  The problem?  I couldn't find it in any store to taste it.  Finally I just put my faith in the online reviewers, and ordered the 3 containers from Amazon.  That was in late December.  It is now late April, and I am about to put in my third order! I am quite happy with this.  I have only tasted the French Vanilla,MAYBE if Amazon sold a three pack of mixed flavors, I would try the others too.

We used to buy this at Sam's Club but they stopped carrying it. We tried other brands but never liked anything else as well.  Then we found out you could order direct from the company and we did that for a while but it was expensive.  Now I found it on Amazon at a much better price than buying it direct from the company so we are happy!

I have used Victorian Inn Cappuccino for a while.  My husband used to tease me about drinking this item, however now he is now hooked.  Every night we have one together while watching TV.  I am greatful that Amazon. com has this item.  GaGal.

column9: this is our favorite cappucino mix
column10: I used to buy this at a warehouse club but they stopped carrying it. It's my husband's favorite cappucino mix. It's very good. I received the correct 3, 32oz containers. We like to use a bit more mix than the directions call for and it tastes a little sweeter.

Love this stuff!!!!! Use to get it from SAMs club then they discontinued it. Then I found it at bj's now they discontinued it too!!!!!! Now I found it at Amazon!! Yeah now I hope they don't discontinue  it too!  :-)
I consider this the best Cappuccino product available and I was most impressed with the price I found for this order!

What I like most:The taste:  Just right.  Not too sweet, but just sweet enough.The convenience:  In my hectic crazy life, stopping at Tim Horton's before my 7 a.m. work day start, is just not an option.  I leave a canister at the office.  And who want's to leave the house first thing in the morning on weekends either?The savings:  If the first two aren't enough of a reason for you to try it, using my attempt of an apples to apples cost comparison, it was going to save me > $200/year as compared to buying it at Tim Hortons.

I use to get this at the BJ'S wholesale store but they must have stopped carrying it as I have looked for the last several months to no avail.  Was delighted to find that I could order it online.  Have been using it for about 10 years now.  Tried all the store brands and big company versions and never liked any of them.  What can I say, I am hooked!

My family and I love this cappuccino mix and use it just about every day, especially when it's chilly outside.  It mixes well and has a really great flavor.  I mix it with regular coffee and it tastes better than the expensive stuff with the mermaid logo.  Enjoy!!

column9: Best homemade cappuccino on the market.
column10: I got hooked on this when Sam's Club used to carry it. It has great flavor and is highly recommended.

We used to get this in Sam's Club, but they quit selling it. I love buying from Amazon and this is a wonderful drink, and was so glad to find it available here.  We are all hooked on one cup a day for a treat.  I read one review where they received the 16 oz cans, but that had to be a mistake in shipping, because I have bought these from Amazon for years and once they did send me the 16 oz. in error, I called and they corrected it immediately.  They always ship 32 oz except for that one time.  No complaints here!  Put it with something else and you get free shipping, easy to do.
This is a wonderful product.  It is not to sweat but still maintains a rich flavor.  I would recommend this item to all those vanilla coffee drinkers.  It's good to have for those cold fall days.

I think this has a great flavor to it. It's got a little more of a coffee flavor than the cappuccino that I usually purchase but still tastes very good. It mixes easily and doesn't seem to leave a film on my cup like some mixes have.
GREAT SERVICE - GOOD PRICE AND THE COFFEE IS THE VERY BEST - I"M ADDICTED TO IT AND IT IS HARD TO FIND...THANK YOU - THANK YOU.LEGGENBER
This is pictured and advertised as three 32 oz containers. What they delivered was three 16 oz containers.
This is the best veggie juice available on the market.  Highest fiber content and an excellent sodium to potassium ratio.  Plus, it's organic and delicious!

Instead of loading this juice up with salt Lakewood Organic added flavor. (some lemon and a hint of Jalapeno and Cayenne pepper, garlic. It is low sodium, good source of fiber and most important it tastes great. I'll never drink a V8 again.

This is probably the very finest bottled vegetable juice I've ever tried. And although it's available locally, the six-pack sold through Amazon seems to offer about the best available price.As my review title suggests, you get not eight, not ten, not twelve, but _fourteen_ kinds of veggie juice in this mix. And you can taste pretty much all of them. Just chill a bottle of it in your fridge, pour a glass, toss it at your tonsils, and wait; aha, there's the tomato, and there's the carrot, and there's the broccoli . . .What I usually do with bottled/canned vegetable juice is to modify it myself with a dash (or six) of hot pepper sauce, some lemon juice, a bit of salt, and a healthy dollop of Worcestershire sauce. Well, I tried that with this juice and found that I liked it _better_ without my own modifications. This is a nice, flavorful, carefully balanced mix, and my tinkering didn't improve it.[*]Which is good for another reason: this stuff is pretty low in salt, and it relies on pepper and garlic to give it a little bite. So if you're watching your sodium, you'll be glad to know that one 8-oz. glass includes just 4% of your RDA and doesn't require supplementation in order to taste good.Good juice.(The product image shown on this page at the time I'm writing is a little weird-looking; it makes the juice look orange, which it isn't. The predominant ingredient is tomato juice, and that's what this stuff looks like.)----[*] However, I've discovered since writing this review that I do like to add a splash of Lakewood Organic PURE Lemon Juice, 12.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12) or Lakewood Organic PURE Lime Juice, 12.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12). Also, even though it contains celery juice, it's good with a dash of Simply Organic Celery Salt Certified Organic, 5.54-Ounce Containers  (Pack of 3) as well.

column9: A Little Lime, Ground Pepper, and Celery Seed
column10: Our first taste of Super Veggie made my wife and I reminiscent of a Bloody Mary. So much so, that we squeezed some lime in along with black pepper, a dash of celery seed and tabasco. No alcohol though, so I guess it would be considered a Virgin Mary! It was delicious and now we have one each evening.I have been drinking V8 Lower Sodium for quite a few years and have recently switched to Super Veggie for the additional health qualities. When compared to V8, it seems to be superior in every aspect. Super Veggie has a lot less sodium, higher fiber, less tomato and more of the other juices. I feel that it is more comparable to an actual serving of vegetables than V8. I'm very happy with this product.I gave Super Veggie 4 stars because it is 3 times as expensive as V8. I have calculated that I pay about 15 cents an ounce for Super Veggie, and a little less than 5 cents an ounce for V8. Don't get me wrong, Super Veggie is worth it. I think the health benefits make this product a dietary necessity. I just wish it was a little more affordable.

This is the best vegetable juice I've ever tasted. It is good chilled, but also good room temperature. There are so many flavors I find myself sipping, and savoring, it a little at a time. I disagree with other reviewers about adding salt. I do not detect a strong tomato flavor, and added salt would just mask the layers of flavor.

I'm a long time aficionado of vegetable juice, especially tomato juice based products. I like the taste of V8 and similar products, but stopped drinking them a long time ago due to the additives, GMO ingredients, and their use of reconstituted juices. I had high hopes for this product, but honestly you can barely tell there's tomato in it, it tastes strongly of broccoli and kale instead, which are not my favorite veggies. It's back to mixing organic tomato juice with bits of other organic juices (and a little soy or vegan worcestershire) sauce for me.

Vegetable juice may sound a little intimidating or unappetizing, but this stuff is very good compared to other alternatives.  I have absolutely no problem drinking bottle after bottle of this stuff.  It's healthy, and actually tastes good.  Reminds me of a bloody mary without the alcohol.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: As others have said, the BEST veggie juice you can buy!
column10: Drink your veggies! Don't hesitate to try this veggie juice! It is awesome good, but you wanna serve it chilled. Also, we add salt to taste to bring out the flavors. Excellent! We use this juice daily for taking RIBOSE (the miracle energy boost/heart aid) which Amazon also sells: D-Ribose Powder 8 oz.

This stuff is so good, and with a little lemon squeeze, it's over the top.Want a fast delicious lunch or snack?Try boiling up a handful of fine egg noodles, drain, return to pot and add a serving of this juice (dried parsley and seasoning optional) like soup...heat up (don't leave boiling). (1/2 tsp."Mrs.Dash" (onion and herb) is a good seasoning for this)While your noodles are cooking (only takes 4 minutes)...cut yourself a thick slice of Mozzerella and put itin a soup bowl. Microwave for about 30 seconds to melt cheese.When your juice and noodles are heated, pour in bowl over melted cheese. Mmmm. In five minutes you're got a healthy, hot, economic meal.Variation: Can use leftover rice instead of noodles, add fresh baby spinach, fresh cooked zucchini, etc.Thumbs up to this awesome product. column9: Delicious taste, but you pay a premium to substitute fructose for sucrose
column10: I eat this jam occasionally with peanut butter on crackers, and it is quite tasty. While it is less unhealthy than other sugary jams, I don't deceive myself that it won't raise blood sugar, because it is essentially 100% fructose, which is just as capable of raising blood sugar as sucrose (white/table sugar)--more on this below.Most people buy this product as a presumed health food due to it being lower in sugar than other jams. It's ingredients are: "Juice concentrate (pear, grape), strawberries, maltodextrin (dietary fiber), fruit pectin, citric acid, natural flavor." This product contains no artificial sweeteners, which are associated with various health hazards.This product's primary claim to fame is that it is, as the label states, "sweetened only with fruit juice." Any jam will have its sweetener listed first, meaning that is its primary ingredient. If you are on a low-carb diet or diabetic, you might want to know that this jam basically substitutes fructose for sucrose. Since fructose is twice as sweet as sucrose, the producers only need to use half as much as they would have of sucrose, so it has about half the calories of regular jam. (On the other hand, many cheap jams contain high-fructose corn syrup--but that's another health issue entirely.) The problem for many people is that they are used to the taste of sucrose, and 100% fructose tastes very different from a combination of fructose and sucrose which is the case with regular jam made with white sugar. To my own taste, since I'm eating a fruit spread, it tastes quite sweet enough to me.The fruit pectin in this product is a standard thickener in jellies and jams and its own natural form of fiber, so I am not sure why the company decided to add in  maltodextrin and call that "fiber" too. Anyone with a gluten intolerance should be wary of this product because of the maltodextrin since some people with gluten intolerance are getting sick from the maltodextrin in this jam. The producers claim on the label it is "gluten-free," but maltodextrin can be made from either wheat or corn, and apparently this company is not being careful enough about contamination with gluten.Another ingredient that is problematic as to how healthy this product can be is the "natural flavor." It is possible that the producers add a strawberry extract so they can get away with using less real strawberries, which are more expensive than a flavoring. The definition of natural flavor under the Code of Federal Regulations is: "The essential oil, oleoresin, essence or extractive, protein hydrolysate, distillate, or any product of roasting, heating or enzymolysis, which contains the flavoring constituents derived from a spice, fruit or fruit juice, vegetable or vegetable juice, edible yeast, herb, bark, bud, root, leaf or similar plant material, meat, seafood, poultry, eggs, dairy products, or fermentation products thereof, whose significant function in food is flavoring rather than nutritional" (21CFR101.22). That essentially means that natural flavor is derived from a real food, but the process by which it is derived is unexplained and there is no way to know how safe or healthy a natural flavoring is.

By now, most everyone has heard of the health benefits of eating broccoli sprouts.  The demand has driven the cost up to $3.80 for a 2-ounce carton at the few grocery stores that carry them.  Countless sprouters hawk their wares on the Internet selling both seeds and all sorts of fancy sprouting devices at a premium.  Add shipping to that.  Many growers make their own sprouters - and there are as many different designs as there are growers. Many websites show good pictures of these setups.  Most use glass jars with screen wire replacing the lid. After reading every bit of information I could find on growing broccoli sprouts, I ordered my first batch of seeds.  First off, at $20.00 a pound on Amazon.Com, these seeds  are $5.00/lb. cheaper than the competition plus Amazon offers free shipping.I opted for a clear plastic jar in stead of glass for a sprouter. Glass and cats do NOT mix. I had to order three types of stainless steel wire before I got the size that was perfect.  Here's what works best for me. Stainless Steel Type 304 Mesh #16 X 16 .018" Wire Diameter 12" x 12" available at Amazon for $8.62 with free shipping. #16 means the number of openings per lineal inch. Most craft stores sell scissors to cut wire mesh.  Fiskars makes a good pair.  Cut a circle 1mm larger in diameter than the mouth of your growing jar.  I use Folgers 12oz. coffee jars(38oz.liquid capacity) and cut out the lid with a Dremmel leaving only the rim with a 1mm ridge to the inside.  Insert the wire mesh circle into the top of the remaining lid. It should slightly bow outward but not so much that you can't rest the jar upside down with the lid on.(see attached photo image) Draining after washing is the part that gets tricky.  I read one website that said beat, slam, shake or do whatever necessary to thoroughly drain the sprouts after washing. So, I killed my first two jars of baby sprouts by blunt force tramma. They turned to mush.  Here's a secret I learned the hard way.  Wash the seeds/sprouts by swirling them in cold water for about 20 seconds.  Then, instead of violent slamming, simply place the growing jar upside down on a fluffed white paper towel.  After a minute, squeeze out the towel, refluff it and place it back under the lid.  No beating.  No knocking.  No shaking.  After ten minutes, your sprouts are well drained, still fluffed and happy.  The paper towel soaks the excess moisture through the screen better than any other method I've found.  Next, place the jar on its side in indirect sunlight between 66 and 70 degrees. I like a window sill behind a thin curtain.  Wash and drain twice a day.  For me, they grow much better when not compressed.  Two or three times a day, I'll rotate the jar about 90 degrees to allow them to gently tumble and bring submerged sprouts to the light. Another thing that seems to help is a very gentle air circulation flowing across the screen.  I have a small air cleaner/filter set on low about six feet away from the containers. From the first step of soaking the seeds to harvest, it takes me between 8 and 12 days. I understand that different varieties of seeds sprout differently and there are many variables to consider.  I wait until my jar becomes full of sprouts. Even the few seeds that don't sprout and the hulls are edible.  Some people remove these. During the final draining, most of the husks will float away and stick to the inside of the sprouter making them easy to remove. On average, 3 tablespoons of seeds yields 6.4oz of drained sprouts per jar. Based on the weights I'm getting on a postage scale, $20.00 in seeds yields about $90.00 in sprouts.  They are greener than the pale sprouts from the grocery store and taste much better, too.  This is a fun and productive hobby for the Winter months.  I have yet to come up with a cool growing idea for the Summer.  I'm thinking of a very small, shelf-type refrigerator set at 68 degrees and rigging it where the light will stay on inside.  Another bright idea that might burn out.

column10: This  product is so weak one might think they have tea instead of coffee the pods are a quick way to add regular roast to a cloth pod and cash into the pod industry. I have always used Senseco but then Amazon and others are not having much luck with availability or reasonable cost to purchaser, gave this company a try at best it takes two pods and then not a full 8.0z cup only half to get this product to taste like a good strong cup of coffee. Title name is misgiving BLAST to me meant rich aroma strong blast of a bold coffee.  Very disappointed it is not  worth the cost even being prime and free shipping will never use again and if you love a strong flavorful coffee this is not the one.. Ripped off and not liking the taste at all.

column9: I'm not a rocket scientist, but making coffee should be easier than this.
column10: Initial Review: One StarPros: Amazon's delivery. I ordered this yesterday, and (with my Prime Membership), OnTrac delivery placed it on my doorstep today, Saturday!  Thank you Amazon.Cons:  Either this coffee is bad, or I just can't make it work.  I've tried 4 approaches on my Senseo machine.It is almost the weight of two Senseo pods (unfortunately no longer sold on Amazon...why??), so I used the two pod holder (wouldn't fit in one pod holder).  Coffee appeared to brew, i.e., the water ran through the machine fine.  The result was not even close to passable.Here are the ways that I tried it, and the result (Senseo users will understand these terms):Right Brew Button, Two Bar Level:  Far too weakRight Brew Button, One Bar Level:  WeakLeft Brew Button, One Bar Level:  Strong, quite bitterLeft Brew Button, Two Bar Level:  Weak, bitter.So the moral of the story is: Don't order pods unless they are specifically designed for your machine.  Since Amazon won't accept returns of any food product, I'm out the $23.  At least let my loss stand as a lesson for others:  avoid these if you have a Senseo. And if you do have the machine they fit, I suspect the coffee isn't that good.Message to Amazon:  You sold me the coffee machine, why don't you sell Senseo brand pods anymore -- or something that specifically fits (7g pods).Update/Revision, One Day Later:  Okay, since I'm stuck with these things, figured I wouldn't give up so easily.  So I went back to the Senseo with these Pods. And I managed to make reasonably good (3 Star) coffee. Lesson Learned. Important Note for Senseo users vis a vis this (and I assume other) 12g pods:1. Make sure that you have the pod oriented with the correct side up/down.2. Use the Right Brew Button @ the One Bar Level. This will yield a tasty cup of coffee, but certainly not two-cup yield.I don't know if the cost/benefit vs. using 7 gram pods is reality, but bottom line: (revised)3 Stars.Moral of the story:  Don't give up

What a great Product Description!  V8 Spicy Hot has half the crabs!  I love crabs, especially when they're floating in a delicious stew of V8 spicy hot.  Nom nom nom!No but really, this stuff is amazing.  I've been opposed to anything drinkable-tomato-flavored my entire life.  Once I tried this stuff I was hooked.Crabs.

I love V8 "Spicy Hot" and have had problems finding the individual cans at local groceries.  I think the taste is awesome and the benefits are great.  If you are tracking your sodium closely, be careful to look at the content in these cans.  Otherwise, I coudln't be happier to have these on auto-delivery and never have to worry about finding them at the store or going to a different store just to pick these up.  I love it!!

My mother and I are both always looking for drinks that taste good but don't contain a lot of calories or sugar.  And we love spicy anything.  These spicy V8 drinks are great.  Heat it up and sprinkle cheese on top, add a couple of whole wheat crackers and you have a great light snack or lunch.  The 5.5 ounce size makes them quite totable.  I carry one in my purse rather than spend money while on the road.  There is just enough kick to make them tasty.  We keep these in the refrigerator all the time as well so they are handy when we are looking for a quick snack.  Great product.

I've tried other flavors of Arctic Zero and liked them all, but this is my absolute favorite!! I hope it will be available year round. I highly recommend this to anyone who likes any kind of pumpkin dessert.
Needs a stronger flavor of pumpkin. Also, the texture is not enough for me to purchase again. Sorry.
I love this new flavor. I am not really a pumpkin fan, but this ice cream is delish! The spice is just right! I love the pumpkin flavoring. This simply melts in my mouth!

I will say I have never had Pumpkin ice cream. I really loved this flavor of Artic Zero. Not sure why they are charging more for it here at Amazon, maybe because it is a seasonal flavor, but doesn't seem right. Here is the thing with Arctic Ice, it is made from Whey Protein, so some flavors do have more of the Whey Protein taste, like the Vanilla Maple (okay for me) and the Strawberry (the flavor I really did not like) also the Coffee (okay for me) and I don't mind the taste of Whey protein. I do prefer my ice cream NOT to taste like Whey Protein, so my favorites that to me don't taste like whey protein are: 1st Chocolate, 2nd Pumpkin, and 3rd Mint Chocolate Cookie(I don't like regular mint ice cream at all, but like this very much). Putting them in the microwave just to slightly defrost, they all are creamy in texture. If you don't like Whey protein, try one that doesn't have such a strong whey protein taste.
This is a good alternative to calorie laden pumpkin pie. Not exactly the same of course, but it has a good spicy flavor with just enough sweetness.

column9: Not as good as I had hoped
column10: I was really looking forward to trying the pumpkin flavor - I was a little disappointed in the flavor and not as creamy as the other flavors I have tried.

column9: Great taste and GOOD for you as well!  Bring us more!
column10: One of the best things to come along since...well...ice cream.  If you set it on the counter for a few minutes before eating, it will soften up and be just like ice cream.  So far, all the flavors are good except Strawberry.  I lOVE IT!!!
I love this flavor so much, I'm ordering 12 more pints so that I can have them before they disappear!  Thank you, Amazon, for carrying this great product!!!

I'm excited to see that Artic Zero is experimenting with new flavors!  (How about throwing a chocolate mint at us!!)  However, I wasn't a big fan of this new flavor.  I have tried them all, and love to eat an entire pint of the chocolate at a time.  The other flavors I will use in a smoothie, but not on their own.  I had high hopes for the pumpkin, but it fell into the "will eat it if I'm desperate for an ice cream and don't want to blow my diet" line.EDIT (10/5/10): They did create a Mint Chocolate Cookie flavor, and it's fantastic!
Enjoy the pumpkin spice, but it needs a little bit of cool whip to sweeten it up!  Would order again.

column9: Paige's Pumpkin Pie is Pure Heaven in the Sky!!!!!!
column10: Garrett,Greg,and Gary have done it again.Developing another flavorful and delectable guiltlfree dessert. I always "liked" pumpkin pie but I LOVE the intense spice of this frozen treat much better than any homemade,bakery, or frozen pumpkin pie I have ever eaten. I enjoy it with crumbled graham crackers or Golden Grahams Cereal.  For Thanksgiving,I'm planning on putting it on individual graham cracker tarts with fat free topping.I definitely will order it again!!!!!Michelle in Florida

column9: Needs some help from your spice rack.
column10: I agree with the reviewer that stated the flavor isn't strong enough, a problem with all of the of the Artic Ice flavors, not just the pumpkin. However, I still give the product four stars because it's easy to address the problem by adding spices such as nutmeg, cinnamon, pumpkin pie spices, or allspice.  I just recently purchased granulated lemon peel (it's a spice) and tried that to the chocolate flavor, it was excellent!  I'm also thinking of using the ice cream with non-fat milk and extracts, such as rum, vanilla, almond, etc. for milk shakes.  The pumpkin flavor could be used with real pumpkin, and coco powder to make a shake/smoothie that would still be low calorie.  To be honest, I wouldn't go through all of these extra steps to make the ice cream work for me if I didn't have an issue with gluten.  The low calorie count is an added bonus too.

This remind me of "soy delicious" a non dairy ice cream substitute sweetened with fruit juice.  I didn't like the after taste and found the product not worth the low calories and high price.  Yeah, you can have a pint at a time, but i'd stop at a spoonful.

My local grocery store finally began carrying the Arctic Zero products (I had been dying to try them for ages), and I've tried chocolate peanut butter (love it) and mint chocolate cookie (pretty great as well, especially for the amount of calories)...was not a huge fan of the maple vanilla and hated the cookies and cream...but I'd searched far and low and could NOT find the pumpkin spice in stores anywhere. Curiosity finally got the better of me and I ordered it off Amazon to try -- SO GLAD THAT I DID! I am going to petition my supermarket to begin carrying this flavor, because it is unbelievably good! Tastes like a delicious pumpkin pie in frozen form - you would NEVER expect the entire pint to have only 150 calories. It is seriously just so, so delicious. I'll definitely be ordering more (as a special treat) if I can't find it in stores sometime soon. MUST TRY!

Is it like creamy, sugary, rich ice cream? No. This is a diet product that is only 150 calories, 0 grams of fat, and 20 grams of sugar in an entire pint (to compare, a pint of Ben and Jerry's is 920 calories, 48 grams of fat, 82 grams of sugar). Knowing that, I wasn't expecting much in terms of flavor. I have to say, the taste has really exceeded my expectations. I really enjoyed the light pumpkin flavor. As a guy who likes to work out and build muscle, I also love the benefit of the whey protein in this product. One pint contains 14 grams of protein (for comparison, that's as much as a McChicken sandwich) and 8 grams of fiber. I have a new guilt-free late night snack.

I am a Lifetime Weight Watchers Lifetime member, and this is one of my favorite ice cream substitutes! It is rather expensive, but it is an indulgence that helps me stay on track. Of course it is not as creamy as a fat-laden ice cream would be, but it is a very fine sub! This and the Cookies and Cream are my favorite flavors.

I have tried all of the flavors & this one is without a doubt, my favorite.  I wish they made it all year round.  It tastes amazing & only 150 calories for the entire pint. You can really taste the pumpkin & all the spices that bring out the pumpkin pie flavor in it. YUMMY!!
Is this product gourmet ice cream? No. But if you just enjoy a cool, refreshing, guilt-free treat that you can enjoy on a daily basis, this is the product for you!
great product - absolutely delicious- tastes so much like desert but mostly protein! how great is that!
I usually like the vanilla but this was awful and it was thrown away...Money wasted as I could not send it back...

First, the chocolates themselves: Smooth caramel, sweet chocolate, and nice crunchy bits of salt. A wonderful sweet tooth experience. Nicely wrapped too, so they made a very good gift too! As for the service, care was taken to make sure they arrived safely. The box was well packaged and with ice so they would not melt along the way. Thank you very much!
This spice was pungent, spicy, and flavorful. You'll be able to taste that fruity and sweet habanero flavor along with that top-tier spicy kick. Use with care.
I broke a tooth on this item but, my dog loved them. 13 14 15 16 17 18 19 20

We first discovered these at Whole Foods market and liked them immediately.  There are quite a few varieties that Freeland makes, but this one is our family's favorite, mostly because of the sprouted buckwheat groats.  They are high in protein (8 grams!) and very tasty.  Perfect for me while I was pregnant and still great now that I am a nursing mom.  Buying them from Amazon garners a big savings as these are pricey for a granola bar.

I think perhaps that some of the previous reviewers are missing the point. These bars are "live" food as they are sprouted and not cooked. Hence they are easier to digest, contain all the natural enzymes that nature intended, and a are naturally wholesome! No they are not super sweet but they taste great nevertheless. In my opinion, it's the best bar out there. I can't stand all the other processed bars. They use lots of sugar to cover the dead and processed taste. And I absolutely love the fact that these bars are free from all the common food allergens!

We were expecting these to be a bit different than what we got.  They are drier and not sweet. (I actually tend to like things not sweet). I am sure they are probably good for you & they are not the worst bars we have tried. I think for the cost, I wish I enjoyed them more. You get enough bars to last a long time. They'll probably expire before we use them all, though.

Love this bar. It is not sweet like other bars that claim to be healthy for you. When I eat this bar I feel like I am eating healthy. The few raisins, and dates add just a little sweetness to the taste. Perfect for on the go! Wheat free-Nut free-Gluten free-no Cholesterol-no Trans fats

We really do like this fruit mixture and I highly recommend you try it. The fruit is high quality, delcious, firm in texture, yet easy to eat. Not mushy like some in a can are. The cups are just enough for one serving and handy to have on hand for a snack or to bring to work or school or even a picnic.

This is the first store-bought tomato sauce I've ever had that was honestly delicious. The texture was nice and thick, very chunky. No chemical aftertastes or anything unpleasant. I was very pleasantly surprised by this.
I've stopped trying to make my own sauce, no need when there's Pomi!  This sauce is amazing, we're more than happy to buy it by the case.  The sauce has a nice, short list of all natural ingredients.

This is the only prepared marinara sauce I've ever had that approaches that I make at home. There are discernable chunks of tomato, carrot etc. in the sauce - so if you are one of those people who prefer a completely smooth sauce, it's not for you. Also if you are used to a very sweet sauce, this is not for you. But if you like real authentic marinara, absolutely this is the right product. The spices are balanced and the tomatoes have the right mix of acid, sweetness and tomato flavor. Look at the ingredient list - everything is natural, no weird chemicals or preservatives. Plus the aseptic cartons will keep almost forever. One carton is more than enough for two adults and one child who loves pasta, for one meal. So one case is going to keep us in spaghetti, lasagna, manicotti, stuffed shells, etc. for a long time and the cost point was great, taking into account the free shipping. This is just a fantastic food product and I wish I'd tried it sooner.

Just received it today and am very pleased.  Had it on pasta for dinner.While enjoying it at dinner, I realized that it tastes just like the mild sauce at my favorite mexican restaurant... a rich garlic and tomato flavor.  So I tried it refrigerated as a dip for corn chips.  It was really, really good.I have 12 cartons of it and suspect that at least half will be eaten with corn chips.  Add a few peppers and you would have a great spicy sauce, but I don't want anything to detract from the garlic and tomatoes.

This is by far the best pasta / pizza sauce I have ever bought.  Delicious.  Big chunks of tomato, fresh garlic flavor, and nice herbs.  This is so fresh tasting, it tastes like it was JUST made.  This is actually better than anything i could make from scratch.  It's amazing in lasagna too!!!There are however no carrots, as another poster mentioned.  The ingredients are: crushed tomatoes, tomato puree, onions, olive oil, salt, garlic, sugar, parsley, oregano, natural flavour, pepper.
Hands down this is the best marinara I have ever had in a "can" and may be better than most "homemade". absolutely awesome.
we love this sauce and turned to amazon when our local store stopped carrying it. bought a case with free super saver shipping and now we have enough in the cupboard for earthquake supplies too.

I used the Pomi marinara about a year ago and was very impressed with the flavor.  I usually put together my own sauce but occasionally, it is nice to have something tasty that can be used to pull a meal together quickly.  The drawback with the case of this product was not in the product itself but rather the fact the the entire case has an out date in five months. With just my husband and I at home, it is doubtful that I would use it all that quickly. I guess that is the problem with ordering food on-line--you are unable to inspect the out dates on the box. Five months is fine for a couple boxes but not for a case.

I never buy commercially made tomatoe sauce, but this product is almost as good as I could make from scratch.  It is good on pasta and even better on pizza.  It is the only sauce I would ever stock in my pantry.  I also love the box.

There is a list of 18 items in the description of this basket. I only received 16 and a couple of them were duplicates. There are also things that weren't on the list at all. I figure there's 5-6 items in the description that weren't included, and one of those items (the licorice candy) was one of the reasons I chose this package (one of my coworkers loves licorice).I understand it's probably a busy time of year for them but I'm still disappointed. I would return it but it's getting too late to order something else.EDIT: I wrote Amazon customer services and told them I was disappointed with the item but wasn't going to return it because we'd went ahead and started eating it and it was getting too late to get something else. They wrote back within an hour and said they were crediting me for the basket. So five stars to Amazon for customer service! That's impressive and they have a loyal customer in me now. This is the first problem I've ever had with an Amazon order, and now I see how they handle things. :)

This is an excellent gift basket. I gave it to my mother. She loved it, and could not be happier. This is a very good deal and make sure to get the extra gift wrap at the amazon check out. It could not look more beautiful. Wonderful product it really shows that a persons cares by sending this gift.
oh my gosh this item was super, my friend loved it, there was over 20 items in this basket, very tasty, of coarse i had to taste. great buy, worth the price, AAAA++++++

I sent this to my mother as a thank you for all she's done for my family, she LOVED it, especially the basket! Silly I know, but she was so happy and told me she loved me, I'm so glad I could make her happy.

Purchased this item for my parents' 24th wedding anniversary.  It's a beautiful gift with lots of choice foods inside.  I would recommend this as a gift for any occasion suitable for anyone - every foods inside will be greatly enjoyed by the recipient!  Can't say enough about the seller (Art of Appreciation) - BEST GIFT SELLER EVER!!!!  Accomodated my request to ship out asap.  THANK YOU!!

I am incredibly embarrassed about this basket. Here I thought I was sending something of substance- based on the seller's description and the picture and the cost. My sister in law, who suffered an incredibly life threatening illness received this basket from my out of town family, thinking it was something for her to use to offer guests and local relatives a snack with tea when they visited. NO CHEESE IN THIS BASKET AND NOTHING EXPENSIVE. There were crackers and a school lunch size packet of chocolate chip cookies. I am so embarrassed. Many other companies offer less expensive baskets with greater goods. Don't order this basket. Barb DV.

My mother had a major surgery and since my sisters and I live out of state we wanted to give her something extra special to help cheer her up.  I ordered this basket, being the largest one, paid a hefty price and even paid the extra money to have it overnighted.  She received it the next afternoon at 2:30, which is rather late for the extra $30 I was charged.  Though the basket was pretty the yummies were described by my sister staying with her as, dry and tasteless.  That made me really sad because I really wanted something extra special

I got this for my dads birthday present and I wished I could have gotten him something better. It was delivered quickly and was beautifully decorated, but the candies and snacks I could have gotten at wal-mart. Do NOT BUY!

column9: Probably Will Be Enjoyed by the Family Who Receives This
column10: The family which received this gift basket from me told me that there were many great items in this gift basket.  This family is one of the families in my neighborhood, and I do not talk with them very frequently, but it definitely sounded like they enjoyed this item.  Like with most gift items such as this, I did not have the opportunity to see it or sample it myself, so I only was able to go by their response during their phone call.  Since it seemed like a happy and authentic thank you to me, this is what I wanted to pass to others to help them in making their decision.

column9: Good for gifting to someone special
column10: If you are looking to gift someone with gourmet food gift basket, I guess these would be good choice. The number of items are large, and they all seem to be quality items.
My beagle enjoyed this chew and it lasted several weeks until she left it outside and then it began to break up when she chewed on it.  Probably won't order another

is effing amazing. DO IT JUST DO IT. I've tried a wide variety of the Starport sauces and I LOVE them. They are delicious and save tons of time since all I have to do is add them to meat/veggies/noodles or a combo of any of them. Sweet and sour is by far my fav! So perfect if you want gourmet Asian food without having to deal with all the crazy ingredients or take the time!

I purchased this at a New Hampshire state store on the way to Maine for my Mom who loves all things chocolate.  Everyone who tasted it LOVED it.  Found out it is made locally in Maine and bought several more bottles as did everyone who tried it.  I am not a choc lover so added a little fat free 1/2 and 1/2.  I am craving it as I write this.  Rich thick chocolate and a fine red wine as the label says.
Love this gum. Awesome initial flavor with just a hint of melon(think honeydew), and a long lasting mint flavor. Great stuff.

I love Barilla Thick Spaghetti. My favorite food has always been spaghetti. Yet, I've never had a preference for a brand or type of spaghetti noodle until I tried this. Now I don't want to use any other. The closest store in my area that sells this is 45 minutes away but I will gladly drive there or order it online just to have this particular noodle.
If I was to be really picky I would say this mix makes a loaf that is not authentic.  It is much better!  The texture is fine and the flavor is what I remember as a child.

I was recommended this brand by my vet and my dogs love it. It is made in the USA and is all natural. It is probably cheaper to get at the pet store, but I am on vacation and just needed a little bit.

Since my move away from anywhere with an, "Old Spaghetti Factory," I have been craving spaghetti with browned butter and Myzithra cheese.  I could not locate a local source for the cheese.  I was pleased to find it available through Amazon.  I found a recipe for the dish online and ordered the cheese.  The cheese was very fresh and arrived in good condition.  I made the dish and it turned out well. I will be ordering it again!

Like a previous reviewer, I ordered this in an attempt to replicate the Spaghetti Factory's browned butter with myzithra cheese dish.  We live too far from any of Spaghetti Factories to enjoy it there.  This cheese tastes exactly like the myzithra served at their restaurants, maybe even a little better:  salty, strong, dry.  A little goes a long way.Also, the order from Parthenon came quickly and well-packed.  Very happy overall.
The product came extremely fast and was exactly what I ordered. Was packedvery well!!

This is the third time I ordered cheese from this company. It came extremely fast when ordered thru Amazon however you'll receive a 10% off discount card and be urged to order direct from the company in your box. When you do however it will take much longer to receive that shipment.The cheese that I received today and used in my recipe tasted like nothing...powder. It's tasteless almost like they forgot to add something.I'll be throwing the remainder of the cheese away. It'll be a crapshoot whether you'll get something like I got this time or maybe if you're lucky you'll get a good one. I wouldn't waste another dime with them.

We live in a small town in Tennessee and searched everywhere in a 150-mile radius for Myzithra with no luck.  Rather than traveling hundreds of miles to the nearest Old Spaghetti Factory we finally decided it was cheaper to buy it on Amazon and pay the shipping costs.  We were pleasantly surprised by this company's efficient service and the quality of the product is 5-star.  Like another reviewer said, it is strong and salty, and a little goes a long way.  Parthenon Foods is great, they even included a coupon for 10% off our next purchase!

These gumballs say "Dubble Bubble" on each one.  I specifically chose this item because it very clearly states that the gumballs are solid color with NO printing on them.  It is false.  They do have printing on them.

i used my crab base for the first time 3 days ago, in a seafood gumbo and the flavor was awesome! very rich crab flavor. I highly recommend it. IT IS A MUST IN EVERY KITCHEN. It didnt require much and was not overpowering. but season to taste. also try minors seafood base. EXCELLENT!Minor's Seafood Base - 16 oz.

Minor's Crab Base - 16 oz.Having purchased Minor's Crab Base to add to a cheese dip recipe, I was pleasantly surprised when the seller also sent a recipe book with the product.  The first recipe I made from the book was "Oregon Shrimp Salad" and brought it to a party where it received rave reviews.  A small amount added to any recipe revs up the flavors.  I definitely plan to keep this in my refrigerator to add to sauces, dips, and salads.

column9: You cannot buy a better pasta from a better company!
column10: I have dealt with the owner Amit for 2 years. Great servive, great price, highest quality product.! Recommend X 10!If you loved high quality Italian, imports, you will not fine better!

column9: SIMPLY THE BEST PASTA!  THE BEST!
column10: The Spinosi pasta comes from a part of Italy that is known for it's fine eggs, "Campofilone is the egg pasta capital of the world."  Reading that is one thing, tasting is another.  Having been a food buyer, with a test kitchen and tastings, I can't rate this pasta any higher.  Perhaps if I am in Italy in some romantic spot might be an exception.  But this pasta has a great taste because it is made from eggs, and not grain.  It has a great texture, where the pasta doesn't slide off your fork, but sits in a heap on top of your fork,holding the sauce very well.  No slipping and sliding off the fork, with that bland taste that is so prevalent.  Frankly, it was hard to believe that a boxed dry pasta could taste so delicious, and so fresh.  I wouldn't have thought it possible.  The Spinosi Fettucine is our favorite type.  Each type has it's own use, as pasta lovers know.  For a basic basil, olive oil, and parmesan cheese, it is just perfect.  The width is just right.  We have tried about all of the types available, which is limited, considering the number of types available, but we always seem to go back to this type of pasta, the fettucine.  I am sure that some persons have some particular dishes that would call for a different type of pasta, and they would probably buy a wide selection of types, but if you are just going to buy one type, I would suggest the Fettucine.  I find myself being amazed sometimes as I eat the pasta at how well it stands on your fork, and has such a wonderful taste.  I do recall better pastas in Italian restaurants, but it was probably not just home made, but had those special Italian sauces that are so astounding.  If you go to Italy, northern Italy is known for having the best pasta, in the Emilia Reggiano area, not too far from Parma.

This is an excellent product. I signed up for the subscription, we like it so much. However, with my first shipment, every single can arrived dented. The problem was not in the outside packaging - that was fine. But the cans, inside the shrink-wrapped case, were dented - on the inside surfaces of the cans! You couldn't see the dents until the cans were unwrapped. So the problem wasn't in the shipping, at least to me, but in shrink wrapping already damaged cans. Will be cancelling my subscription if my next shipment also arrives dented.

With being alergic to chocolate this is the only version of Betty Crocker Delights I can enjoy.  Warm, moist, cake-perfect snack before bed or for breakfast.  This won't stay around the house long with its great tast.

We love Warm Delights, almost all the flavors. They are individual desserts but we usually split one between us. It makes just enough to eat and since none is left over, no over indulging. Even if you do eat a whole one, it's better than being able to help yourself to seconds. They are easy and quick to make and taste great. Yes they cost more than buying a cake mix and making a whole cake but they take less time, no added ingredients other than water, and again, no left overs. I have been buying them since they came on the market and will continue as long as they make them. The variety makes it nice too because you can have a different every day.

This was amazing for adding only water! I am going to try this with applesauce when I get to the store. The item arrived fast and safe. The cake baked up in 75 seconds and then I squeezed on the icing. A great buy with subscribe and save and the promotion that they had. The expiration date is early next year and I don't believe they will be around that long. This will make an excellent breakfast cake with the applesauce added. I will be trying another flavor soon!
The coffee is smooth and has a wonderful coconut flavor.  I'm a coffee connoisseur and this is definitely good stuff.

column9: Yummy -- like what I remembered 35 years ago
column10: When I was at school in Idaho 35 years ago, this was my favorite candy of all time.  Unfortunately, I've never seen them offered for sell in any store since then.  Imagine my pleasant surprise when I saw these at Amazon -- at a great price and delivered to my door in Texas.  I lost no time in ordering a box.  They're basically chunky chocolate on the outside that surrounds a cherry concoction that surrounds a whole cherry.  Very tasty and just like I remembered.  If you love cherry chocolate candy, you won't go wrong with these yummy treats.  I think I'll have one right now....

My all time favorite!  Very difficult to find in stores.  Great that Amazon has it available.  Outside is chocolate with nut chunks, inside is a creamy cherry filling with a whole cherry in the middle. You have to try this.

column4: S. Kelley "Oblate spheroid-shaped head and torso"
column10: Quite tasty confection. Be aware there is a similar confection labeled "Cherry Mash" that does NOT have an entire cherry within but does have a chocolate nutty surround with a cherry tasting nougat within.Both are good but be aware that the difference exists.
This was a gift for my Mother who remembers this candy from her childhood. It's not found in the east, so it was great to be able to order if from Amazon. Great tasting.

Another chocolate-peanut coated candy with a whole cherry in the middle is the "Cherry Cocktail" from the Idaho Candy Company. Another bar similar to "Cherry Mash" is the "Twin Bing." With "Big Cherry," there are actually four regional candy bars with their own variations of chocolate and peanuts over a cherry filling.

Yesterday, I went in for a supplies  restocking at a nearby Costco and picked up a few very interesting products. One was a 32-ounce jar of Mezzetta Napa Valley Bistro Italian Olive Antipasto marinated with fresh garlic, herbs and Nappa Valley chardonnay. It appears to be exactly the same product as listed here but my jar appears to be larger. In any case, this product is just excellent! The taste is sensational! Thank goodness it's a low calorie dish! It's a mixture of olives, green peppers, onions, chunks of fresh garlic and it's all marinated in wonderful herbs, sea salt, canola oil, distilled vinegar and Napa Valley Chardonnay. The marination sauce is so good I plan to save it, filter out the herbs and drink the remaining juice. It has good electrolites, plus a wonderful taste. Mmmmm. This stuff is wonderful!Gary Peterson
This is a great tasting and handy product for those who must follow a gluten free diet. Requires no refrigeration so easy to pack, etc.
I have an addiction to these things! I was worried that I might get a box of stale candies, but let me tell you, these were the freshest that I have ever had! Super good and super fresh!

At first when I started using chia seeds regularly, people said to me "chia seeds are chia seeds.....why do you need to buy a brand?"  I did buy bulk seeds in my health food store....I did buy bags at Trader Joe's...and I still went back to my organicSalba Seeds and find they work the best for me.  Here's what I do with them.  I take 1 cup of almond milk (or soy, rice or plain old milk if you wish) and add a few soaked dates (which I left in a pot of water which had boiled but turned flame off).  PItted thedates, threw them (about 4 large ones) into my Vitamix (you can use a blender) and let them blend until totally mixed.  While blender is running, add 1/2 cup of chia seeds (My organic Salba seeds) and a few tsp of cocoa powder and instant coffee (if you likethat flavor).  Let the blender or Vitamix run until everything has thickened.  That's it.  Pour into a container.  Refrigerate.  What have you made?  Chia seed pudding.  Sugar free, lots of fiber, a perfect breakfast.  Some people use a banana instead of dates,others leave off the cocoa and coffee powder.  IT's a mater of taste and any sweet fruit works as a substitute sweetener. If you eat super low carb, even an artificial sweetener will work instead of fruit....with or without cocoa/coffee.SO why Salba seeds and not just any chia seeds?  Because this recipe I'm sharing, which I've tried with other chia seeds doesn't seem to work as well or taste as well.  Perhaps it's my imagination, but these seeds seem to be consistently clean, fresh and a blenderor mixer like a Vitamix will pulverize them into a pudding perfectly in less than a minute.Just a big fan of this product.  I keep buying many jars at a time. I like that it's organic.  And I think any company that focuses on putting their seeds in a jar and branding them probably has higher standards than chia seeds sold in bulk in bins...where I'mafraid bugs and dirt might have collected.... I always have my high fiber chia seed pudding ready for breakfast and even when I use the last of my pudding up, it's only minutes to make another batch.
I ordered this brand recently and found it has 25 percent less Omega3's per tablespoon than competing brands. beware. Look for 3600 units of Omega 3's per tablespoon min.

This is a great product for anyone needing more fiber in their diet. Added to Greek yogurt, mixed in peanut butter, etc. it provides all the benefits you need and you can adjust the quantity to suit your dietary needs.

Great stuff! Just be sure not to take too much if you are susceptible to blood clots. I think I read somewhere it thickens the blood, then I had a problem with that. I stopped for awhile, but feel SO much better when I'm on it, that I've started again, just in small doses, every other day. I have so much energy and feel so much better when I take it. Put it in morning health smoothie.
Product got to me super fast and it is terrific!  High quality chia seeds and a great price as well!

column9: Put Pasta Back in Your Diet
column10: Okay, I first came across the "Fiber Gourmet" brand from a vague Google search for "low calorie pasta". I'd previously bought into the shirataki noodle craze and while I admit--calorically speaking--shirataki have EVERYTHING else on the planet beat hands down, I quickly tired of the stuff mainly because I knew I would have to chew the heck out of it before swallowing, lest It Come Out Looking the Same Way It Went In ('nuff said there) and for the cost of each bag (the store brand I found in the tofu aisle was roughly $2.50 ea and the Miracle Noodle brand from online is essentially the same for 8-9 oz bag) my diet was getting pretty expensive eating 2bags a day 4 days a week. I ate shirataki by the bag, after all...So when I happened across the Fiber Gourmet website, I simply bookmarked it and went along my way. Finally, after a couple more weeks of laboriously chewing shirataki, I decided to give it a whirl and ordered from the official website. I have to admit, the first time I tried the Light Spaghetti pasta I wasn't exactly bowled over and that was because I was actually mixing the Fiber Gourmet noodles with another, lower sodium (but still 210cal/srvg) noodle brand and honestly wasn't seeing much of a difference--on the scale or satiety-wise. However, in the past couple weeks I went back to my case of 6 boxes and tried them again, this time wondering why in the world I didn't like them first time! I stopped mixing them with the other noodle and most times have either exactly the 56g serving size or 84g (1.5 srvg) and mix it with veggies, spices and low-sodium/calorie glazes (Captain Rodney's Sweet & Spicy Pepper Glaze being my fav). For a treat I'll throw in a couple ounces of Morning Star Farms fake chik'n strips.The best part about the Light Spaghetti is how absolutely filling they are. I've taken to having the above-described dish for lunch and honestly I don't feel hungry again until several hours later. 18g of fiber is just ridiculous (per serving) but I'm so glad it's there because you really don't need much of the noodles to get satisfied. That's one thing these have over the shirataki. Another is the whole "chewing element"; I found I don't have to count 32 chews (literally; I actually did this w/ the shirataki) before swallowing. Fiber Gourmet also cooks dang close to legit pasta. I found that really leaving them on the stove boiling for a while (over 20mins) is best and you can tell from sight when they're ready. I haven't managed to overcook this pasta yet.But above all the pros, I have to say that the fact they fill you up is the best. I'm on a low calorie diet so having that extra 70 cals/serving these spare you really helps. My faux-lo mein:) meal described above is around 250-395 cals depending on whether I add any meat to the pasta. Since I don't need an afternoon snack on the days I eat Fiber Gourmet for lunch, I can save another 100-150 there for dinner.I wouldn't recommend having these more than once a day or having more than twice the serving size on account of how much fiber is in a serving but so far I've had no intestinal issues whatsoever (TMI?). Oh! And even though I bought my first case from the Fiber Gourmet website I'd highly recommend buying them here from Amazon--when I saw the case for $16.92 WITH PRIME S/H I was sold and ordered immediately so I won't have to go even a day w/o these. I paid about $20 for the case from FG's site and then about $7-10s/h on top of that so the deal is DEFINITELY here. Since I've incorporated the FG pasta into my diet I've dropped almost 3lbs in 10 days whereas shirataki 4 days a week had me at a statistical standstill. I highly recommend FG's pasta if you want to taste noodles almost exactly like the real thing and can't stand the thought of life w/o a past dish like I can't:)

Yes, I needed to lose weight, and yes, I did try the noodles. Some of the noodles are semi OK with spaghetti sauce. I needed real pasta. I was pleased with the FiberGourmet Light Spaghetti and the Fettuccine, Short-Cut. I didn't care as much for the long Fettuccine. Elbows will be next on my list.I warm up the Morningstar Crumbles and spaghetti sauce in the microwave, while the Fettuccine or Spaghetti is boiling. When the Spaghetti is done, I drain it and add it to the crumbles and sauce. It is a quick low cal meal. Great for a family or group.I also slice chicken breasts (1 per each serving) in a skillet with olive oil and cook it for 10 minutes while turning it often. I then add diced onions and green peppers and cook that for 10 more minutes. I add a can of diced tomatoes (including the juice) and cooked Spaghetti or the Fettuccine, Short-Cut. Then stir it around for 4 or 5 minutes and add some grated pizza cheese. I serve it once the cheese has melted. This serves two people with some left over for lunch.Pasta at 140 calories (not 210) that tastes like pasta and cooks like real pasta, and eats like real pasta. It has my vote. One box is four or five servings. We cook two boxes at a time and put the rest in freezer bags and put it in the freezer. Cooking the pasta is the part that takes the longest time, so we grab a bag from the freezer and nuke it and put it into our low cal Italian dishes.

I never eat regular pasta at home. This is the only stuff I eat. My kids eat it as well. I love the penne and other varieties. I'm a big eater so I get to eat an extra serving since the calories are so low. This stuff should be offered at restaurants.

Amazing pasta!  Can't tell the difference between this and regular pasta.  Only thing to be aware of is the longer cooking time, but totally worth it for the cut in calories and fiber, which keeps you full so much longer than normal pasta ever would.

This is great tasting pasta, perfect for dieters and non-dieters alike.  Why would anyone eat regular pasta with 200+ calories a serving when you can eat fiber gourmet for 130 calories per serving?  I highly recommend this brand of pasta!

I love pasta, but it does not love me.  I just don't seem to be able to digest it.  But this pasta, not only tastes great, it is so easy to digest.  And, as an added bonus, it is healthy & low in calories.  I have now tried every version of this pasta & they are all amazing.  Some reviewers complained that the pasta is too firm, but that is not the case.  You simply need to cook it a bit longer than regular pasta & then it is light as a feather. Because of how wonderful it tastes & because it is so light, you would think that you were eating homemade pasta.  Almost hard to believe, that this pasta comes out of a box! :-)
This is much improved over the earlier product, which was acceptable/fine.  They claim it is improved, and both my wife and I noticed the difference in taste.

I have tried Fiber Gourmet in the past I find that I have to cook it longer then what the box states, but I love this pasta and I also have purchased the Lasagna noodles and love them as well. Great Product!

column9: Great Pasta, but check out their Web Site for a cheaper price
column10: Like other reviewers have said, a great tasting pasta, sometimes better then "regular" pastas. Plus you need LESS then normal because it is so filling, a double blessing (less calories anyway,  plus less needed). The fiber content is outstanding, FAR exceeded the so called "Fiber" pasta in sttores at the same price. I used to get it automatically shipped by Amazon at a good price, but as usual with my fav foods, they stopped. Now I use Fiber Gourmets web site, at about the same price, and a better selection, MUCH less then these sellers (at this time..of course that changes). Fiber Gourmet sells many different types not shown here. This is greatly recommended, and I make my own version of Mac and Cheese using the Kraft powdered Cheese.

Like so many, I am fighting to control my weight and pasta used to be a big downfall for me.  No more!  FiberGourmet pastas taste so close to regular pasta that most people will not notice the difference.  And, those that do will not be bothered by it.  My entire family likes this pasta.  It has far fewer calories per 2 ounce serving: 130 vs 210 for Smart Taste pasta.  Since we don't like our pasta al dente, this does have to be cooked a little longer than usual.  I have tried this with traditional red sauce, in lo mein, and just buttered, and it's perfect every time.  Plus, it is so filling!  Each box has 4 servings, and I feed three people easily with one box (each person, including my husband, satisfied with just over a serving).Yes, this pasta is expensive.  FiberGourmet Spaghetti only has 8 ounces per box whereas regular pasta has 12 (or even 16 for some brands).  And, it can be a challenge to find.  None of the grocery stores in my area sell this; I can only get it online and Amazon too often goes out of stock.  That said, most low calorie or healthy-option alternatives cost more, regardless of what the product is.  For me, this product is well worth the cost.  It tastes great, is very filling, and lets me fill that pasta craving without the guilt (or the extra pounds).  I also recommend their other pasta shapes, rotini, penne and the lasagna.  I have tried and enjoyed them all.  Now, if only they would offer plain elbows outside of their Mac & Cheese...
