My two senior dogs absolutely love this food.  They were in good condition before, but are now in excellent condition.  My 15 year old mini poodle had a "gas" problem, but that was all.  His blood work showed an elevated liver count.My 9 year old standard poodle had soft stool, was lethargic and was generally just off.  The vet could find nothing wrong.  She recommended a food change to a "senior" food.We have completed our first full 30 lb bag and what a difference.  No more gas in Gizmo and the Standard Poodle, Clio, is acting very active and young again.  Her stool is also firm again.I am now going to be a regular customer as my vet likes the results also.

I ordered from this seller for the 1st time and I was definitely disappointed.  The dog food bag was very shabby looking and it only had 4 months before it expired.  That concerned me.  I contacted the seller and he replaced it with another, but the expiration date was exactly the same on the second bag.  I returned the second bag and I'm waiting for a credit on my account.  I would not order this item from this seller again. This item was ordered from Wag.com, not Amazon.

column9: Good, but chocolate is slightly gritty
column10: These were not as good as I had hoped -- the espresso-flavored chocolate is gritty and there's a bit too much of it.  Would like more caramel, less chocolate, and smoother feel.

I bought these when they were half price & sold by Amazon-so that gave an extra half star. These are some of the best "normal" priced chocolates I have ever tried-much better chocolate taste than any other American chocolate brand typically sold at your local grocer, Target, Wal-Mart, etc. Tastes like real chocolate. Lovely expresso flavor with a very rich caramel center.

Not sure what KIND of bug, but a whole mess of 'em HATCHED and left their skins behind....so GROSS!!!Am still in the process of sending it back, getting my money back - yuck.I don't even want it in my house, much less to make tea with.
Pretty good, only 90 calories, a little too sweet for my tastes. I like their green tea flavor better. This one comes in second. I still recommend it.

I love Arizona iced tea and this raspberry flavored version is quite tasty.  I don't like it as well as some of the other varieties.  I personally prefer the lemon-flavored version to the raspberry.This review is specific to the product, not the price or merchant.

column9: Dole Mixed Fruit in Black Cherry Gel
column10: Quick delivery. Item well-packaged and secured for mailing. I love this fruit cup in Black Cherry Gel. Very refreshing ang filling. A bit pricey at $1.48 per cup. I love the free shipping. Thank you. Will surely re-order, hopefully there will be a sale.

I eat popcorn most nights.  I use an air popper and a little melted butter (not marjarine or spread).  I've tried every thing available in the stores and many gourmet popcorns looking for the perfect one -- and organic.  I found it here.  This popcorn has a mild corn taste and pops up big and fluffy.  I've read more than once that if you are going to buy anything organic, make it popcorn.  Pesticides are found on popcorn.  You wash some of that stuff off of your veggies, but popcorn is never washed -- just sifted before packaging.  You won't be disappointed with this popcorn.

We microwave our popcorn in plain paper bags with no oil.  We've tried many brands, but this is the best, by far.  It always tastes fresh, never stale, or soggy.  It holds up well to a bit of olive oil, and the flavor is great.  It also comes in vacuum sealed bags, that can be resealed.  I ordered 12, as the bags are small, which is a plus for freshness as well.  Also, being organic is important to us, as it's my understanding that popcorn which is not organic, provides some of the highest levels of toxins from pesticides.  Buy organic, buy this popcorn.  You won't be disappointed.

We love "real" popcorn popped in a pot.  With most of the corn crop in the US GMO this is the only popcorn I feel good about.  Purchased in bulk at Amazon it's cheaper than most brands at the grocery store.  It pops up light and fluffy.  Pop in orgainc oil with organic butter and sea salt and it's the best popcorn you'll ever have!

Pops completely into large pieces, and seems very fresh. Excellent product equivalent to Orville but this is organic. Love it popped in my cast iron sauce pan with the organic coconut oil sold at Amazon.
We only eat non-GMO foods and this product is way better than the Arrowhead Mills popcorn.  Bigger kernals and not stale like the Arrowhead. Good stuff!

I seldom write reviews, but this popcorn is so delicious I HAD TO! We pop it in the Presto Hot Air popper - it pops up huge, fresh and NO unpopped kernals. We melt some coconut oil and drizzle a small amount on popcorn, add sea salt - and the whole family raves it's the BEST POPCORN EVER! We'll never go back to non-organic after reading the concerns about toxins/chemicals on popcorn. And this it the best ever! We will go through the bags quickly as popcorn is now our new favorite nightly snack.

I had been looking for a decent priced popcorn that was organic free of GMO's.  I also wanted it to be light and fluffy.  And I didn't want a bunch of kernels and popcorn that didn't fully pop like some other organic brands I have tried.Well this popcorn fits all my criteria!  It is the best and as soon as I run out of my 12 bag stash I will be ordering more.

I received a mini version popcorn machine of what you would find in the theater for Christmas.  I have been trying to go "green" or organic as much as possible in my life.  I was very surprised by this popcorn.  Its very fluffy and light and has the perfect amount of crunch for me.  The amount you get from amazon is a very good deal price wise.  I would highly recommend.

column9: Similar to Jolly Time Organic but more expensive
column10: This popcorn is very good, but pops up very similar to Jolly Time Organic which I can get locally for cheaper. Both taste great with very few unpopped kernels. Excellent popped in coconut oil!

column9: It's organic. It pops big and fluffy. YUM!
column10: I had been using the Nordic Ware Microwave Popcorn popper with one of the Fireworks popcorn varieties that was supposed to be best popped in the microwave. I wasn't happy with all the old maids that were left in the bottom of the bowl. I used the reviews and found this organic popcorn, and I'm so glad I did. I like that this popcorn is organic, and comes in 20 oz resealable bags which keeps it nice and fresh, and easy to transport (beach trip). The most important things that I like about this popcorn is that it pops huge, fluffy, and flavorful. I had been able to use a half cup of the Fireworks popcorn without it ever nearing the top of the popper bowl. The first time I popped the Eden Organic Yellow popcorn with a half cup portion it literally popped the top off of the popper. Eden's Organic Yellow popcorn pops much bigger, and had very few old maids left in the bowl. I'm able to use a quarter of a cup of popcorn to get a full bowl. One other benefit to the Eden Organic Yellow popcorn over the Fireworks brand I was using is that the popcorn isn't as hard on the teeth. You still get a crunch just not a hard crunch, and less hulls between the teeth. Try the Eden's Organic Yellow popcorn with confidence. I think you'll be happy with the results. To get a great bowl of popcorn I use the Nutiva Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil with some Jolly Time Buttery seasoning...yum, yum, yum!

8 quart stock pot. Little above medium high on the electric stove. Cover the bottom with Olive Oil. Add overflowing full cup of corn. Cover till half full of popped corn. Pour out popped corn when full. Put back on stove 'cause it is still popping. Share with family. Repeat every Fri. night. It sounds like this when it pops...."PoP, Pop, poP, Pop, pop, POP," Scratch HERE to smell fresh popped corn. have a nice day.

I wanted organic popcorn (had been buying it in bulk at a local upscale grocer which was inconvenient). I checked Amazon and decided to give this a try given the reviews and the sourcing. The popcorn arrived on the day when I was about at the end of my current supply. The difference between what I had been using and this popcorn was dramatic. Huge puffs and no grubby hulls in the pot to be wiped out before making the next batch. While I normally don't like individual packaging, in this instance it may be worth it to keep the kernels fresh and ready to go.

column9: Tender & delicious organic, and super fast shipping!!! Great for Air-Poppers!
column10: Great for air-popping machines! Popcorn kernels pop into tender pieces. This is my third time ordering!  Speediest shipping all 3 times, and I only selected "Free Super-Saver Shipping".

column9: So happy to find delicious non-GMO popcorn!
column10: Our family loves popcorn, but now that most corn grown in the US is genetically modified, I was concerned we were going to have to give up our favorite snack.  I was so happy to find a safe and tasty alternative to the conventional popcorn we previously enjoyed.  This popcorn is flavorful, crisp, almost all kernels pop, and it's a great value.  No "Frankenfoods" for us!  Highly recommended!

Love this stuff! Popcorn contains lots of great antioxidents when it's not made from GMO Frankencorn, so I was thrilled to find organic! Most of the antioxidents are actually in the hulls, and many bagged pre-popped brands take the hulls out! This was a great find, and and LOVE that it comes in sealable bags. I use organic butter with it and sea salt. I do find it slightly chewier than major brands, but that doesn't bother me. It's a tasty treat that's actually good for me! Bonus! Great buy!
i am thoroughly enjoying eden organic popcorn. only a few kernels unpopped. better than any i have previously purchased. hope it is just as good when i get to the end of the 12 pack.

column9: Review from a Daily Popcorn Eater
column10: This is the first time I bought this brand of popcorn. My 14 year old son eats popcorn every day & I wanted to buy organic popcorn for him. He enjoys this new brand. He sprinkles sea salt on it & wants me to continue to buy this brand for him.

This is the first time I purchased an Amazon product in bulk without trying it out first.  I am so relieved to like this product so much. I love popcorn popped on the stovetop and this corn is great! It is my healthy snack (well...sometimes I do put some butter in just before it pops for extra yumminess).  The bags that it comes in have a zipping seal. I have not noticed any difference in the size of the popped corn when compared to a national non-organic brand as other reviews of organic popcorn have noted. This is good simple real food without preservatives and pesticides.  Worth the extra money for an extra healthy low-calorie (if I can bring myself to skip the butter) snack.
We use the Orville Redenbacker Microwave Popper with this Eden Organic Popcorn and peanut oil. It is the best popcorn ever! We have tried many brands of popcorn. This is the best!

column9: thought I was eating chewy puffed rice!
column10: I've always gotten another popcorn, Orville's - and love it, but I was happy to see an organic brand. Made it for the first time tonight and blech. Perhaps it's an old bag, but it really needs some flavoring on it because it tastes like nothing. I actually at one point forgot I was eating popcorn and thought - wow, this puffed rice is getting stuck in my teeth.

I have been looking for tender, crispy popcorn for some time.  I decided to try this popcorn since it was organic.  It's not what I'm looking for.  It is a little chewy, even though I've made several batches with a few changes, trying to see if I could make it crispy.  Nothing worked.  Perhaps it is old, & maybe it was crispier when it was fresher.

I bought this after deciding to get rid of all processed and GMO products in our home.  They pop great!  It takes slightly longer for the popping to start, and they pop slower than regular Orville brand popcorn, but the taste is the same if not better and the idea of no GMOs in the product makes it worth the extra minute of popping time.  I'd definitely recommend this product. They come in several individually sealed packages, so it keeps the kernels fresher.  Very impressed.
I just purchased this on 08-07-12 for  $37.44, I just can not believe how much this went up in price.  I was just going to re-order but now I will look else where,just insane...
This popcorn tastes great and pops really nice.  I like how fresh it is and knowing we aren't getting GM corn is worth the extra money.

The best popcorn!!!  I cook this up in an old, heavy, lidded, stainless steel pan (about 3 qt, I think) using organic coconut oil.  Tossed with a generous touch of melted butter and a sprinkling of RealSalt sea salt...you'll never go back to unnatural types of popcorn again after trying this brand.  Pops up fluffy and tasty every time.

I am very happy with this popcorn!  The kernels are smaller than regular popcorn but they pop up nice and fluffy and just as big as the regular, so it actually goes farther and you can use less.  Plus it's great to know that it's organic and not genetically modified!

This popcorn pops up so wonderfully that the fact it is organic is an extra bonus.  My family loves this popcorn so much that outside family members have been asking me for bags of it.  Good choice and I will reorder when we eat through 12 bags!  The bags are resealable which helps keep the popcorn fresh as well.  Great product.

I ordered a lot of this popcorn because it is organic.  I make it just as the direction state on the bag except I substitute the Soybean Oil with Organic Nutiva Extra Virgin Coconut oil.  It gives it a creamy flavor with a slight coconut flavor and it's delicious!I usually get all the kernels to pop because the coconut oil has a high heat tolerance.  My grand kids love it also.
I love this popcprn, and am very happy to be able to buy organic.  It pops up great in my air popper, and we have never used any other for the last 1.5 years!
Using a Presto Hot Air popper, this popcorn works exactly as promised.  Almost every kernel pops quickly and the popcorn turns out light and fluffy.

I LOVE popcorn, and this is delicious stuff. It pops fluffy and nicely and it is very tasty. It easily compares well with Orville's GMO stuff, this one is better for you and for the environment! If I have a treat, I want it to be a good one, and this is.
I don't ask for much from popcorn, pop well in terms of few unpopped kernels, and taste good when mixed with other varieties.  Eden delivers and it is cheaper than other gourmet brands.

The popcorn eaters at home have given it the thumbs up. Of course, it "tastes different". But after explaining to the testers that the lack of artificial flavor, pesticides, and chemicals would affect the taste, they reacted with a "yuck!", and promptly requested to keep this healthy brand.Update: they love it. Only 2-3 kernels per batch end up un-popped. Fantastic.

I want reasonbly priced organic popcorn that tastes good and pops well. This is it. I by 12 bags and when I get down to two, I buy some more. This is my popcorn and I have found no reason to switch...and shipping is free!

column9: not quite what I would consider really fresh
column10: This one is all righ but still not really fresh.I tried this one because some of the reviews mentioned that is was excellent and fresh. I just can't seem to find really nice fresh organic popcorn.
There are plenty of sweets in this container it was enough to last me and my family for at least two months.Next time holloween comes around this will be a cheeper way to hand out candy.
Diet coke tasted like carbonation only. Was not able to get a refund from vendor. Diet coke tasted like carbonation only. Was not able to get a refund from vendor.
Love Chipotle and its hard to find it in stores, powdered, I mean. Love the quality of the product as well. Super fine powder..

As a previous reviewer stated - I used to buy this product and it was very good - very spicy.  I have purchased several jars over the last several months, at different locations, and this product no longer is any good - at all.  The jar I just opened was supposed to be good until 2011 - it was totally bland, and looked old.  I don't know what Thai Kitchen is doing - but - their curry pastes are bland.  It seems like the curry is very old.  Or, the jars are not sealed properly.  I have even sent emails to Thai Kitchen about this.  This vendor has a problem.  Go to an Asian market and get a real curry paste.  It makes a WORLD of difference.  (I'm sorry Thai Kitchen - but you need to get it together !!)

We bought this stuff on occasion (loved it) for quite some time, but now it has changed.  Bought some recently and found it to be very mild and tasteless.  Used almost the whole jar!  Still no flavor.  Thought something was wrong and bought a jar a few months later, someplace else.  Same result.  Won't buy again, have tried another brand (A Taste of Thai brand Curry Paste, available in 4 different flavors), will stick with that.  Liked that this came in a nice sized jar, versus a packet, but without flavor, what's the point?  Hope this is helpful...

column9: I agree - this curry paste has changed
column10: This was a staple for me - loved it - but the prior reviewer is right - it is sour now and not spicy - just bad!  I should have googled this a while back, thinking maybe I just wasn't remembering correctly, but felt much better after I read that I'm not the only one who has noticed the change.  I won't buy it again.
I was really disappointed with this curry paste.  I used twice what the recipe called for and ended up with an exceptionally bland shrimp curry.  Such a waste.  :(

Used almost the entire jar and absolutely zero heat. I added some cayenne pepper to spice it up. I usually buy the real Thai stuff, which this is supposed to be according to the label, but got this instead. With the real stuff, 3 tablespoons along with 2 cans of coconut milk and your mouth is on fire. Not this. I am on vacation and made curry for my family. They loved my red curry chicken but to me it was only so so.

I once used Thai Kitchen Brand Red Curry as a substitute for Patak's and I basically ended up with 4 lbs of bland and over-salty shrimp.  I highly recommend Patak's Curry Paste.  Patak's is the best red curry paste I have ever used.I have cooked red curry chicken and red curry shrimp and Patak's made my entrees delicious.  I simmered the paste with meat and vegetables and then added some lite coconut milk to create a rich and flavorful curry sauce.  Yum!A word of advice.. Don't waste your money on Thai Kitchen brand.Feel free to send me a message if you want to talk about Thai and Indian recipes.Greg

I used to buy this and the green curry paste and loved it. The last batch I purchased is very bland - I used more than half a jar for a two-person serving, and it wasn't very spicy at all. I am sorry that I bought four jars of each flavor - now I'll have to find someone who doesn't know what Thai food is supposed to taste like and give it to them.

column9: Same as others, totally weak now
column10: Most of their products have been ruined by their parent company, the ever-present and ever-bland McCormick's. Go with Mae Ploy curry paste, Tirapos fish oil, and other truly authentic ingredients.

column9: The paste has ruined every single dish I've made with it!
column10: This curry paste is horrible. The green, red, whatever color, it doesn't matter. They are all bad. Totally flavorless and bland, and when you open the jar, it seems as if it hasn't even been sealed correctly and is old. I was confused for months now, thinking that all these good recipes were crap, and almost threw out my Thai cookbook. Finally after trying some other highly rated online recipes only to find the same problem, I narrowed it down to this jar of crap! Don't buy it. Save your money and your time and look elsewhere for good curry paste....
I had to add about half the jar just to taste anything. Don't buy this unless you like exceptionally bland curry.

First time making curry, and this is what they had in my local grocery store.  No taste at all...and the time and expense that have gone into this meal completely wasted.  Wish I had searched the reviews before I bought it...

I used to use this brand all the time and loved it, but they've changed their formula.  The latest is marked "gluten free" and has virtually no heat and little taste.  Now I'm searching for a new brand.
Taste of Thai is better, but the price of these case pack jars of curry paste will give you a comparable product at a decent price compared to store purchases.

column9: Used it once, but never again
column10: Bought this paste in my local grocery store because it was the only thing they had, plus I didn't know any better.  Was making curried butternut squash bisque for the first time.  The bisque was good, but little did I know, it could have been much better.Because this product was so expensive -- it took a whole jar to give my bisque a mild curry flavor -- I looked to Amazon for an alternative.  Found Mae Ploy Thai Red Curry Paste - 14 ounce per jar and gave it a try.  Prepared the same butternut squash bisque and Oh. My. Goodness!  What a difference!!Try the Mae Ploy ... you will get a HUGE container for a fraction of the cost, and the taste will be better than you ever knew was possible.  Kept in the fridge, it keeps for a good long while.  But, when you taste the wonderful flavor, you'll be looking for recipes calling for curry paste.  Try the yellow and the green curry too.  Totally different tastes.

column9: Kindergarten paste has more heat than this junk
column10: One jar of Thai Kitchen Red Curry Paste used to last me for years.  It was so powerful that a half-teaspoon could season a quart of curry.  Finally ran out of the old stuff (purchased c. 2005) and bought a new bottle.  I added the usual amount and tasted the curry.  Nothing!  Added a tablespoon--then two.  STILL nothing.  Finally I tried some right out of the jar.  The only flavor in it was salt!  Message to serious heat-seekers: Don't waste your money on this garbage.  It has the kick of a ninety-year-old mule.
This 12 pack is a great deal.They were delivered pretty quickly, and taste delicious.
All I can say is that this curry allows me to best reproduce my favorite local Thai restaurant's gang gai.  I love good thai food and this gets pretty close.
This is the only red curry paste that my wife and I have found that is suitably flavorful and spicy. Highly recommended.
Love the curry and use it in thai dishes.  Give it 5 stars.  I accidently put 2 stars.

column9: The ultimate "go to" item for great, quick meals !!
column10: Buy this product now, before it sells out, it is the ultimate go to for quick and delicious meals.  Combine with coconut milk, a protein, some veggies and serve with rice for a quick delicious meal.
Was looking for green mangoes in the local stores and came up empty. Was happy to find it online but a little pricey.
Rich, round and smooth with low acidic after-bite. Rare to find a full bodied de-caf ---this is a winner!

Nothing beats coming in from a long day, firing up the keurig, and having a cup of decaf. Newman's own decaf is a medium roast, perfect for that cup of coffee with a late night snack, to warm up a winter night, or just when I've so much caffeinated coffee my heart is jumping out of my chest and jitterbugging across the room, but I still want a cup of coffee.  I drink mine black, no sweetener, flavors, or milk to hide the taste, so for me to like a cup of coffee it has to be good. Newman's own decaf is a lovely mellow cup of coffee with no bitter aftertaste.

Most Newman's products are fabulous for many reasons, but especially their coffees - they are quite good. This particular decaf coffee is among our favorites and we have found it to be of very consistent quality and flavor without being too strong. it's really a great cup of coffee in the evening.

I enjoy the taste of coffee, not just the pick-me-up effect. So, when the latter isn't necessary, I prefer to drink decaf. Unfortunately, good-tasting decaf is hard to find. Until now.This Newman's Own Special Blend Decaf is outstanding. Full-bodied and flavorful, but no bitterness or burnt taste. It's not quite as good as the regular version of Newman's Special Blend. But, it's surprisingly close.If you have been searching for a decent decaf for your Keurig, look no further.
If you have a Keurig Single Cup coffee maker and prefer decaf coffee then give this one a try.  A well balanced medium roast coffee with no harshness.
This coffee has great flavor in both decaf and regular. If I had to chose one coffee to drink this would be it.
Great coffee, nice to find it here at semi-reasonable prices.Newman's Own Organic Special Blend Decaf K-cup for Keurig Brewers, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
I usually buy Timothy's decafinated k-cups, but bought Newman's Ownwhen they were out of stock and what a pleasant surprise! This isvery good coffee. Very smooth and not bitter at all.
A little expensive, but very good. Doesn't stick together,large fluffy grains. Easy to cook.
I love this rice.  It is a good measured size for my family and I like the way it turns out.  Most local stores have stopped carrying this so it is fast and easy to get it here on Amazon!

This is by far my favorite rice. It is so delicious even without anything on it! It can be hard to find at the store, so I hope Amazon keeps stocking it. It's very easy to cook perfectly and is delicious even if you overcook it a bit.

column9: Perfect Tea for a Wedding Reception
column10: We had a smallish wedding reception at our house for 60 peopleand just served this tea cold and everyone was raving about it.It needs no sugar and is mild, yet extreme tasty.I am not a tea lover - but this is great.Non-tea lovers will like it -not like the black teas on the market -or the overly bold fruit teas.we had guests from China, Japan and Thailand wanting to buy this tea.a perfect team.

Had this tea at our local tea/coffee shop.  Luckily, I was able to purchase it there (last one).  Being a comparative shopper I found it cheaper at Amazon.com.  This is the one of the shops biggest seller.
This by far is the best tea and i will tell you there's not a  tea from Octavia that taste bad. They are simply amazing!!!!

This is a fantastic tea.  Very easy to drink and I find that this company pays a lot of attention to quality. Someone told me about this particular tea after it was highly voted at the World Tea Expo show.  I would recommend this for anyone that likes a great flavored tea.

I don't quite understand why this tea contains 'natural peach flavor' rather than simply 'peach'.  It doesn't seem like actual peach would be too much to ask.  The 'natural flavor' gives the tea an off taste, in my opinion.  It also has a smell that can only be described as artificial.  Sorry, this is not a winner in my book.
This tea is just wonderful. The flavor is very nice and subtle. Very soothing both to begin and end your day with! Definitely recommend this tea.

I was watching an old movie from the 40's when I saw an actor use a product that I have not seen since the 50's. The product was SEN SEN  a confectionary breath freshner. I put the name in on the amazon search list and in less then 5 seconds there it was. I thought why not??? give it a try. I ordered the product from amazon and within 2 weeks received the product. The first time I opened the packet sent me back to the early 50's and was totally blowen away. Excellent  service and satisfaction thankyou Amazon.  rp

If you like black licorice, this is the treat for you.  SenSen is a super alternative to chewing gum and mints.  I like the ease of a small package and small mouth refresher.  This is it.  Buying in a larger quantity make is easy to offer a package to someone.  Watch the smile on their face.

This is a great idea for the mom who has everyhing but loves to bake. It is a great value and was pleasantly surprised when I got the packages. They look great in a gift basket and am told are super yummy!!
Exactly what I was looking for in a recipe that I had been about ready to give up on & a recipe site said to go here & order it.

column9: They have a new Pomegranate flavor!
column10: Can't go wrong with a good old Tootsie Pop but leave it to the people at Tootsie Roll to improve upon an already good thing.  They have added a Pomegranate flavor!  While not really my cup of tea, a lot of people (I bought this for the office) were excited to see this addition.  Very good and EXCELLENT price!
The pops are less expensive at my local Wally World.  Additionally I could not help but think that the products are factory seconds. Too many ill formed pops.  They taste the same though.

column9: Banana? Really? Yuck!  I rather the older flavors
column10: This box had very few chocolate pops in it but had plenty of the yucky and odd banana flavors.  The grape and cherry are the same, as well as raspberry, they do have orange, which I'm not a fan of but all acceptable flavors.  They can eliminate the banana or change it to lemon (which I thought it was! HUGE disappointment!) Other than that, I love Tootsie Roll Pops!
Great price and product.  It is hard to find a good deal in my area and with Prime, this will be a repeatable purchase!
Note that the shipping charge for this product is $14.75.  You can buy Tootsie Roll Pops individually in stores a lot cheaper than this.

column9: Great for Relaxing while Reading or Before Bed
column10: While my favorite relaxing tea is called Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime this tea is a close second. This is made with just chamomile flowers for maximum effect. This means that you get a full flavor of chamomile which is delicious with honey. To vary the flavors all you have to do is change the honey flavor. column9: Bigelow brand chamomile tea is the best chamomile tea out on the market today
column10: i drink exclusively chamomile tea (the italian panacea) and have been every day for the past seven years. i have tasted every brand of chamomile tea out on the market and i have found that Bigelow's chamomile tea is the best chamomile tea out on the market today. the chamomile flowers taste like aromatic golden deliciousness. you can taste the inherent sweetness of the chamomile flower in every cup. i feel that bigelow uses the highest grade chamomile flowers in their chamomile tea. it is simply delicious and i recommend this brand whole-heartedly. have a cup of bigelow chamomile tea, relax and enjoy!
I am not a tea expert but I sure can tell a good one from bad.  This is one of the best chamomile teas I've ever had.
As a very picky person. I prefer this blend of Bigelow's to all others. Celestial Seasons Herb Tea is my second favorite. The only two I buy.

This tea is a staple in our house.  We have a cup almost every night.  Bigelow has a great line of different teas for different uses.  I like the Chamomile because it relaxes and calms me.  It's great for an upset stomach, or for getting ready for bed.
I love this tea. I prefer to drink it at nights prior to bedtime as I find the aroma relaxing and gentle. Nice tea!

I drink this every night after dinner and before bed. I've tried lots of other brands of chamomile but this one tastes the best and I love how each one is wrapped sealing in the freshness. I find other brands really bland, I mean this is a bland tea in itself but this brand has a great taste and seems somewhat stronger than the rest. Mixed with fresh REAL local honey, it's really relaxing!!!
I love this kind of tea - not too strong flavor, and with "a purpose". Any time I cannot sleep, or I am stressed, I drink it.
The tea tastes very well; it is very calming and it helps my stomach. I also like the subscribe and save option.

My local store had these for a while and my dogs loved them. It was great to find some more using Amazon. I'm not sure if the company is still making these because they seem to be getting harder to find. They're good and crunchy (is there a happier sound on earth?)

column10: What a big mistake this was buying these.  They are the size of a quarter each!! Very bland and disappointing. I have had these type of cookies before. I would expect to pay less then a dollar for the whole package at a store. Don't waist your money!
These cookies were a huge disappointment!  Each cookie was the size of a quarter and if memory serves me correctly I believe it only had 8 or10 in the box...way too little for such a big cost!

column10: gummy-bitter chocolate and mostly melted by arrival time. Not good enough for this florentine gourmet cookie lover  to serve. needed to cool before we could peel off the plastic trays. They are thin withut the nut taste that makes a good florentine.
I love the flower lollipops so cute and priced great as well! Not a single one was broken, very good packaging.
arrived in very good packaging.  super cute colors and actually taste good too.  my daughter loved them when i used them as decoration on her 2nd birthday cake!

the product is listed as a 150g 6-pack.Traditionally, when US companies do a bundle-pack they list the size of the individuals...so a 6 pack of canned soda would be a 12oz 6-pack, we would never see that listed as a 72oz 6-packI foolishly assumed I was getting a real bargain, 6 150g bags, for about $8!Oh so wrong. It's a 6-pack of 25g bags, 150g TOTALSo you're getting about the equivalent of one bag of chips for your money. Still, not a terrible deal for something a little exotic.The chips themselves were good, though! I only took stars off for the somewhat deceptive descriotion and the fact it took a couple of weeks for them to arrive.

These are amazing chips but they just cost too much for the little amount that you get. They come from England so I suppose they have a way to travel. Hey just bring them to the states and I would be most happy!

column9: Makes me drool just thinking of them
column10: The Brit's have out done us. The flavor is supreme,they satisfy my hunger for steak and onions...Get them while you can...  Their other flavors are great tooo

column4: d wilson "Visitor from a Perpendicular Universe"
column10: I had a bag of these during a trip to London. I was looking for Walker's Frazzles but this was the only bacon-flavored chips I could find at the Tesco. The taste is very similar to Frazzles if not better. It tastes just like bacon! Even suitable for vegetarians.

This chips kind of reminded me of bacon bits. The six small bags were the perfect size and there's no MSG. They were a little expensive, but considering they came from the UK it's understandable. Half the price was in the shipping. They are well worth the indulgence once in awhile.
If you like salt and vinegar crisps (chips), but would prefer the vinegar to lighter, you should love these.  Salty and slightly tangy and yummy!

This could possibly be the best tasting chip I have ever eaten. It has a nice smokey bacon flavor. I would make sure this item was always stocked in my pantry if the price was not so high for the amount you get, or if they would sell this "AMAZING" chip here in the states. I would highly recomend someone paying the price one time just to try this.
I loved the chips they were AWESOME!!! but that's just me. It arrived Earlyer than expected in the mail so that was even better, no crushed chips yay!
The crisps are awesome. Give me English crisps over american chips any day! I recommend them to everyone. The smoky bacon are my favorite but the cheddar bacon are almost as good.
Item came promptly however the crisps were 3 months past their freshness date. Was told I would get replacements.  Still waiting.
Bought these the other day while I was in Canada, they are delish! If they were available here in the states I would buy them.

I had these wonderful chips in Ireland a few years ago on vacation and was sad that I could not find them in America.  Now that I have I will be in so much trouble ordering them all the time.  I love these chips!!!

I ordered this product on Amazon to get some of the flavors we can't get in the US, namely, bacon, worcestershire, and prawn cocktail.  The photo of the product was so small and the description was so vague that I didn't realize until it came that what I was getting were actually 3 flavors of crisps that I can get down the street from my house:  cheddar cheese and onion, salt and vinegar, and regular flavor.  I was VERY disappointed.  Instead of trying again to order online, I will ask friends in the UK to shop and mail them for me.

I am not one for flavored chips. Anytime I buy chips with any type of flavor (sour cream & onion, cheese, etc) They are usually DRENCHED in some strange and super salty powder. They always end up being too overwhelming for my palate. So I usually buy natural chips with only salt or I will buy unsalted. I saw these on sale and thought maybe I would try them. I've tried unsalted and regular Boulder Canyon and thought they were good enough. I hesitated at first. I added and removed these from my cart 3 times because I thought maybe Parmesan & Garlic would be too much for me. However something finally made me just take the risk and hope for the best. I was highly surprised at their flavor. They were NOT drenched in powdery stuff. YaY! The amount of flavor is just right for these chips. They are super crispy and taste fresh. column9: Try these you won't be sorry. GREAT!
column10: Well packed, fresh, all sealed and double boxed, this brand is fabulous. The Parmesan Garlic is my husbands other favorite besides the Jalapeno Hot chips. While the two are different he just loves the incredible garlic flavor in these chips and the potato is cooked to perfection.

column9: Okay but learning that I'm just not into "flavored" chips

If you are crazy about parm and garlic, try them but be sure you have lots of friends to help share them!  Bags were decent size, bigger than I had imagined for only 5 oz.

I have been a hardcore fan of Kettle Fully Loaded Baked Potato chips for the last three years. My regular order wasn't available in my subscribe and save account, so I ordered these after reading the reviews. These are delicious! The flavoring is not heavy, just enough to know what you are eating and certainly not too salty. They are gluten-free and I hope that will make a difference in my diet.  They make a nice break from my other fave and from popcorn. I thought I was ordering smaller sized bags and I passed a few around the office. I will definitely be ordering these again!

column9: These are now our favorite potato chips!
column10: Our friends and family love these chips.  The problem is that I have to keep myself from eating half the bag in one sitting!
Great chips!  These are really delicious and hard to find in the stores.  We hope Amazon keeps carrying them, and they're such a good deal!!!!

Bought a couple of boxes of Boulder Canyon chips [Hickory BBQ and this one] for the family gathering over the holidays, and every one of us is delighted with them. We're about halfway thru both boxes and all bags have been first-class flavor and texture. There's an extra 'something' to the Boulder Canyon chips--a tang or zing--which you don't get in other cheap chips.Mind you, I'm not a chip afficianado or anything, most times I don't notice them, just munch a few. I noticed these ones enough to write this review.

column9: A nutritious snack that isn't too sweet!
column10: I have bought both the Cran-blueberry crunch and the Pom-Raspberry crunch from Mrs. Mays.  Both are a small bite-size block of mixed dry fruits and nuts. Both are "constructed" in a similar way but I like the Cran-blueberry one better. This is primarily because Cran-Blueberry crunch uses almond, cashew, and sesame, which give it a little more variety and texture in the taste.  Pom-Rasberry crunch only has cashew (I think. Thought it also tastes very good.) The snack has a natural light sweet taste from the suger in the fruity ingredients so I don't feel bad about intaking extra sugar from eating it.  I always keep a bag in the office for the mid morning/afternoon snack.I also like how much the company has done to assure its customers that their food products are manufactured in a safe manner and they have been pretty transparent about their selection of ingredients. (Please see my review on Pom-Raspberry pack of 12 for more details on that.)I will definitely recommend it for anyone who wants a healthy snack.

You know how limited your food choices can be when your plane is delayed and the airport is pretty much closing down for the night? Well, that's how I found Mrs. Mays Cran-Blueberry Crunch.  The candy and gum kiosk at LaGuardia carries them, and I was not going to make it tbrough a 2 hour delay on a Snickers.  The Cran-Blueberry Crunch was wonderful.  Hit the spot and carried through with no sugar crash.  They're delicious without being overly sweet and the fruit is real fruit, not dried fruit with yucky preservatives.  When I got hom, I couldn't find it locally, so I ordered a case from Amazon, and I keep a bag in my desk drawer (for that late afternoon snack attack).  I've shared with my friends, and everyone loves it.  Enjoy!!
Good product, but very disappointed to find out it is made in China.  Why can't a product like this be made in the USA?

I really love this as a simple, quick snack! It is very flavorful and best of all, it is good for you! No nasty, overprocessed chemicals, fillers and sugars. The little bite size clusters are fantastic! Love It!!

I love this product and was happy to find it on Amazon for a low price. With a min purchase, Amazon ships it at no cost. I'm extremely happy with the service, and I can't say enough how much I love this natural, healthly snack.

I just love these!!  They are a great snack, and easy to keep in your car, or backpack or anywhere you go.  They have just the right combination of sweet and salty, crunchy and chewy.  My boyfriend keeps them in his golf bag and snacks on them while he's golfing.

I had bought these for my husband at Christmas & he didn't want them.  So I tried them 0 they are wonderful.  The puches look small - but they are filling and the scrucnch along with the nut flavors and sweetness from the dried fruits - totally worth the price.  Wish it was sold in stores by me !
The product was fresh,healthy and delicious.Highly recommended as a replacement for unhealthy snacks.

I made this tonight for my husband and I. I'm glad I didn't make this for a party or something. I followed directions exactly. The filling/pudding part came out very soupy, even after being in the refrigerator for 1-1/2 hours as directed. The "meringue" is not enough to cover the whole pie. Not nearly as much as it shows on the box, and my pie plate is small. So I ended up putting it in the freezer and it set well and was really tasty. If I made this for friends & family I would definately have to tweak it a bit.

column9: Yummy !!! Taste just like Lemon pie!!
column10: I made this tonight, I had no problems with it setting ,we cut it in squares to eat it :) And the taste is very good ,I was impressed.The lemon is a bit tangy , that's what I like, it has a nice feel when eating it smooth cool and a but tangy like a lemon filling in a donut to compare it.The crust is a common graham cracker crust.The fluff on top is very good also it's fluffy and tastes alot like cool whip but not as sweet.The desert is not rich or sweet, it's tangy with a tad bit of sweet taste.That's what I like about it.If you love lemon pie ,it's a must to try.I will be buying it again.

I would have to disagree with the previous review.  I followed the directions exactly and it came out perfectly.  I beat the filling for the full 3 minutes as stated in the instructions and it wasn't soupy at all (even before I put it in the fridge).  I had plenty of whipped "meringue" topping, just like the picture.It's not the best lemon meringue pie I've ever had, but it's pretty good for instant.  I would definitely bring it to a party or something if I was short on time/too lazy to make it from scratch.  It was fast, easy, and delicious!

Being French I grew up knowing how important it was to use a good unrefined salt. The one from Brittany being the very best. No! It's not foolish to spent money on a  basic spice. It has a very delicate flavor (almost floral) and you don't need a lot. Will taste great on salads. A clear healthy winner.

Not really sure if I can describe this salt properly. Yes, it has a wonderful flavor without too much of a salty flavor. It's very clean tasting. Mostly, though, I think it seems "creamy". Yea, I know that sounds weird, but the moisture with the salt gives it a creamy-salty embodiment. I use this for special dishes to add a delectable flavor to a dish...also knowing that I'm serving food with a healthy salt with tons of minerals.
This is good, briny large crystal grey sea salt, which for most uses I prefer to the more expensive white.

1 Pound - French Gray Sea Salt - Light Grey (Coarse) - Bag -"Sel Gris De Guérande" French Sea Salt  Don't know why, but when using this - there is a something special flavor added.  Never used anything but regular table salt.  But I am hooked!!!
This wonderful sea salt is both beautiful and healthy for you. It takes less to season. Anyone who is concerned abot salt and diet will love this product
Man, this salt is really good!  Love the flavor, and that it's a much better/wiser choice vs regular table salt.  Good Stuff!

column9: Great stuff,and a must to have
column10: I got into salts, the more I learned to cook.  Firstly all salt is salt,  but different textures appeal differently on your palate.  They seem so anyway.  Now the darker shades of salt do have different minerals, depending where they're from.  You need to be careful though , remember these gourmet salts do not have iodine, so make sure you continue to use table salt, though it is hard to do so.  Love this salt on salads and steak,  trust me.

Got this stuff and it looked like they just swept it off the beach . I think its still wet actually. We got the course and we grind it ourselves. We love it. We even took a taste test, first this French gray , then Mortons salt. Hands down we could taste the difference and we could taste how much better the French Gray was. I would get the fine salt next time. I wanted that but must have hit the course by accident. We still like it! You will too. Worth every dollar. And now im spoiled.
Love this salt.  It has a really nice flavor, not too salty, has a mineral taste that is very good.

I never realized this, but the salt and mineral concentration of seawater is different in each part of the world, and therefore the taste of sea salt varies based on where it comes from.To me, "French gray" sea salt is delicious - the flavor is more gentile than regular salt and has a slightly tangy taste with just a hint of minerals.  The price may seem high compared to table salt, but Amazon's price is low compared to other places I've bought it. Definitely worth it, in my opinion.One thing to note is that this sea salt is very moist, so it doesn't work well in a grinder or shaker.  Sometimes I'll serve it in a salt cellar, but generally I just keep it in a glass jar by the stove for cooking and use regular salt at the table.
great product.  actually we've used it all now.  great to scatter on veggies, as well as cooking in meals. highly recommends.

the salt is wet and i dont like that. it's not dripping or anything, but it's moist and it is clumping. i had to put it in the oven and as i type it's baking to get the moisture out.i did not know that it would be damp.it has a nice flavor, quite salty. if it was not damp/wet, i'd buy it again.
Yeah, I know that salt is salt, but I like the taste of this salt. It wasn't as costly as many of the gourmet salts, so I use it to make my own seasoned salts for myself and for gifts.
Arrived in excellent shape with no breakage.  Were very well made and strong enough to handle my various fillings.  Would definitely buy again.

You could also pull out whatever toppings you like to put on a baked potato and put those on top. Altogether, it's still a great meal and a must buy for quick and hot meal.

my family really enjoys this hamburger helper.to us it has an excellent taste.the cheese flavor is great.to us the"baked" potato part has the baked potato taste."note" it does take a little longer for the potato part to cook to be tender,HOWEVER its well worth the wait.we will buy again.
Thank you for carrying this product.  I moved from PA to FL and there is no retail store down here that carries this particular flavor of hamburger helper.  So a big huge kudos to Amazon!!!

I look forward to cooking in the microwave...means no spattered stove to clean! BIG SURPRISE - no microwave directions. Well this will be a noble experiment because it will be microwaved! Called Miss Betty Crocker @ General Mills and they don't supply microwaved directions either. So wish me luck as I experiment!UPDATE: Found Microwave directions on web BUT you still have to experiment :(MICROWAVE DIRECTIONS1. Crumble 1 lb lean ground beef into 3-qt microwavable casserole or bowl. Microwave uncovered on High 3 to 5 minutes, breaking up beef after 3 minutes, until brown; drain.2. Stir in sauce mix, 2-2/3 cups boiling water, 1 cup milk and uncooked potatoes.3. Microwave uncovered on High 14 to 21 minutes, stirring every 7 minutes, until potatoes are tender (sauce will thicken as it stands). Dish will be hot. Meanwhile, stir 1/4 cup milk and toping mix in bowl 30 seconds; set aside.4. Pour topping over beef mixture. (If topping is too thick to pour, stir in an additional 1/2 to 1 tsp milk.)***High altitude microwave (3500-6500 ft): increase boiling water to 3 cups and last microwave time to 18-25 min.
This stuff is great, just like Charleston, SC Shrimp and Grits!  Very easy too!  Just throw in shrimp, sausage, scallops.. whatever you like.  Makes 2 large helpings or 4 small helpings.

After ordering these, I was shocked that I had paid so much for so few servings (about $2.33 per bowl).  Once I got these, again, I had to shake my head at my own indulgence.  Then I tasted them!  OH... MY... GOSH!!!!  These were, without a doubt, the BEST oriental noodles I've ever tasted.  To say that they didn't skimp on the mushrooms is an understatement!  There were mushrooms in every bite.  And not just little bits of mushrooms.  They were whole, and the texture and taste was wonderful.  Another wonderful surprise was that the noodles never got mushy or stuck together -- even when I forgot I had them soaking, and left them for more than 20 minutes.  Another nice surprise was learning that these wonderful noodles have four grams of fiber in each bowl.  Even though these are very filling (probably because of the fiber), they only contain 190 calories, and 1 gram of fat.  One bowl is perfect for any entire meal.  And the flavor is perfect...  not too spicy, not too bland, but just right.Added to all the above is that they're incredibly easy to prepare.  Open the flavor/mushroom/egg pack, put it atop noodles, pour boiling water over everything, replace cover and wait three minutes.  There are two things I do different when preparing these (but just because of my preferences, not because the instructions are faulty -- they're not).  I add less water than the instructions suggest -- I prefer these more noodle-y and less soup-ey, and 1-1/2 cups of boiling water is the perfect amount for my preference.  I also let it set for five minutes, giving the noodles a chance to soak up more of the water.Are these mushrooms pricey?  Yes, they are.  Are they overpriced?  Not at all!  I will definitely buy these tasty and nutritious noodles again!

column9: GREAT, if you can afford them!
column10: These have to be my favorite noodle bowls EVER.  I originally purchased them at Big Lots for 60 cents per bowl.  I wasn't sure if I would like them, so only purchased a few bowls.  Big mistake!  I fell in love with them.  However, when I went back, they didn't have any more!  They did have the vegetable bowls, so bought some of them.  They are also tasty, but not as good as the mushroom.  I would love to buy more, but can't afford the asking price at Amazon.  If you can afford these, try them. They're great!

column9: Great taste, filling but SUPER high in sodium
column10: These soups extreme sodium content makes me pause each time I order them.  I like having an easy snack on hand for the kids as these taste great, are fun with the various different mushrooms and are filling and easy to make.  The sodium just makes me cringe but this particular flavor almost redeems itself with the very low fat content. :)

This is a quality product, the soup base and veggies come in a freeze dried brick that you place on top of the noodles before adding about a cup of boiling water.  Its delightful to see this dry little brick burst into green onions, mushrooms and soup base.  It fills the top of the cup with lots of great stuff.  The flavor was delicate and nice.  Now the part that is a deal breaker for me is the noodles..  They are flavorless, colorless strings that clump together and are not so easy to swallow.  I found myself trying to really chew these because I didnt like the feeling of the long strands of noodles half in my mouth and hanging down my throat.  It was odd..  If you like Mai-fun (cellophane) noodles or you are wanting to try them this is for you..  I prefer wheat/flour based noodles..  But you may love this, and like I said its a quality item.

This is some of the tastiest soup, ever.  The mushroom pieces are generous & identifiable & the noodles & broth make for a satisfying meal. I know the package says it's 2 servings, but I doubt you'll leave any to share!

The noodles are a fine hair like bean noodle which I do not prefer. The soup smells great while it steeps but has a almost fishy flavor. The mushroom season package is full of mushroom variety as promised. This maybe more authenic Chinese noodle soup.

column9: With the recent changes, Cost outweighs, Disappointed!
column10: I found it least expensive from Amazon at about $8.50 for a box of 6 bowls via subscribe and save.  That may sound expensive (compared to 25 cent ramens and 50 cent cup noodles) but that is because crystal noodle uses a freeze dried process that I feel preserves much of the flavor of the flavor packet of mushrooms.  The noodles are also very thin with a silky smooth texture and easy to consume while absorbing the flavor of the soup.  The sodium level is high (due to MSG probably) so that is a plus for those who enjoy sodium (funny thing I love sodium but despise sweets).  Is this healthy for you?  I don't know about that.  But without regards to whether it is healthy, I deeply enjoy having this for lunch at work.  Easy to make, easy to eat, and simply delicious.  If you do not have access to boiling water, use hot enough water and let it cook for longer (i.e.instead of 3 minutes, let it cook for 7-8 minutes).  P.S. Do not forget to finish drinking the soup!  That is the best part!!NOV03,2011I just purchased another box.  The new cup shows NO MSG.  Also new cup is 1.90oz rather than the 1.98oz they advertise (it was 1.98oz previously and damn tasty but now not so much).  The flavor freeze dried packet is also smaller.  I am going to have to decrease this to 2 stars.  This is more in the I am disappointed lines (instead of increasing costs, they are just going to decrease content...call me a pessimist but I think the decrease in content is not to promote healthy eating but rather to boost bottom line).  Flavor is more bland now, just like any other instant noodle out there...nothing special anymore.

best instant soup I ever had, and very easy to make because you don't microwave it, just pour boiling water over and wait.  nice spicy flavor, big pieces of mushroom.  I would pick this over most canned soups, as well.
Got these to suppliment the diet availble in McMurdo, nice and light but filling, great taste - not salty, they could have used a few more mushrooms but for the price I can not complain.

I bought these noodles at an overstock store once, and had I known at the time how good they were going to be I would have stocked up. As it stands, unless you live near an asian market or similar store you'll have a difficult time getting these locally. Fortunately, Amazon provides. All of the varieties are very good, this one brings out the savory flavor of the mushrooms and the texture of the bean thread noodles is satisfying. It prepares quick and easy, and only requires boiling water like a typical self contained ramen bowl. Great for work, and quite filling for the size and price.

At first I was a bit nervous to try this. I've always loved mushrooms, but a lot of these types are not available where I am from so it was my first time trying Shitake and the others. I have to say I was very impressed. A bit on the spicy side though, but it was tasty. I just wasn't expecting it to be spicy though.Also it's listed as 6 types of mushrooms even on the front of the package but if you look at the ingredients on the back there are seven types of mushrooms listed. Bonus...yay.

column9: You are going to love it.
column10: If you are a mushroom lover you are in for a treat. For a dry soup that comes in a cardboard bowl all I can say is "Wow". Just chucked full of mushrooms and clear noodles with a full rich flavor. I'll reorder again for sure.Crystal Noodle 6 Kinds of Mushrooms, 1.90 Ounce Cardboard Cup (Pack of 6)

Considering the cup of noodles are 50 cents a cup and about the same size, these clear noodles are rather pricey. The taste is good enough and I like that the cups aren't styrofoam but the portion is rather small (I'll need 2 cups to get full on this). It's more a snack or appetizer than a meal. 5 star for taste but minus 1 star for price...

column9: Good taste, lower in carbs and sodium than most noodle cups
column10: Good taste, lower in carbs and sodium than most noodle cups. Said to contain 2 servings; really only one. Noodles are made from bean & potato starch and are crystal clear. I add sliced scallions, raw spinach, raw arugala and/or sesame oil to create some variety and a real treat. Very hard to find in super markets; bought originally at Costco where they had for only a very short time. Amazon has good price and delivery.

column9: Great for people on the go
column10: I first ate Long Kow Crystal Noodle after finding it at a local Kroger store on clearance. I love ramen noodle soup and thought this might be a little different. It is definitely different than regular ramen noodle by virtue of the noodles themselves. If you like mai-fun, bean threads or rice noodles, you will love this noodle soup. The mushrooms are great and there are just enough to make the soup tasty. If you like this kind, try the egg and vegetable type, too. I love them both. I had to buy from Amazon as the store quit carrying it - I guess it was not a popular item. To me, it is worth what you pay for it. It's a great, quick snack for between meals and people on the go. You won't be disappointed in this product if you like oriental style, instant noodle soups.

column9: WE REALLY LIKE THESE FLAVORFUL NOODLES
column10: I first had these kinds of noodles in Guam and Okinawa. I loved them but  I could not find them locally for years. I had them with strips of lean meat and chicken back then. I think i have had them with Sukiyaki too. So different than other noodles. I They are clear but absorb flavors and colors of whatever is mixed with them.  I  ordered  the 6 mushroom kind. There were plenty of mushrooms. If you love mushrooms, you will probably love these too.  I don't know, I found them needing meat or chicken I guess, so am going to order the other flavors to try or maybe add my own to these. There are  a lot of noodles here and the flavor is wonderful. It is an excellent quality product, in my opinion.  My son likes them as well. He lets all his noodles set for an hour to fully absorb flavors and become more pliable. These noodles are particularly firm. He loves noodles and since we have discovered the better ones on Amazon, he will not eat the cheaper ones anymore that he use to love. They are different than egg or other types of  noodles but seem to soak up the flavors better. Very filling. I think they would also make a great side dish with other foods. Probably worth the additional cost.I am going to order the other flavors of crystal noodles to try.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: EXTRA LOW FAT LUXURY Mushroom noodle soup - $2 each!
column10: Full of exotic and delicious mushrooms, this instant soup rocks!! It is so fresh, so tasty, and such high quality, that if you like mushrooms, you MUST try it! The delicate glass noodles put it over the top! In about 6 minutes you have a tasty, hot meal! Product of China. Per container: 200 calories, 42 grams carbs, 2 grams protein and 1 gram fat (only 5% of calories from fat!) and 1000 mg sodium. Different than "Ramen" style because the noodles are not fried. Do not microwave, just add 2 or 3 cups BOILING water. COVER tightly, and (as others have said) let sit 6 to 8 minutes before you eat it. We find it best to put the dry soup block UNDER the noodles, then add the water. Otherwise the block of "soup" sits on top of the noodles as they swell and may not dissolve properly. Recommended!
I did not check the ingredients and did not notice that the product CONTAINS MSG, unfortunately for me, grocery items are not returnable.
I like it and gonna order more.(better adding more water and maple syrup because it s high in sodium)

See's chocolates are quite simply the best I've tasted. It isn't just the chocolate itself, which is excellent; it's the way all of the flavors come together. When I put a See's candy into my mouth, it grabs a hold of my attention and focuses it on my taste buds. It says, "Hey, this isn't just a piece of candy, this is something special, something apart." It's as though I can taste each individual flavor note separately, like chocolate, walnut, butter, sugar, a hint of salt...while simultaneously tasting the gestalt of all those flavors blended. Eating a piece of See's is an event.

UPDATE 1/19/2012: Sees took care of replacing the product and was beyond courteous. I will be back. Thanks.Box arrived a day late despite expensive "two day shipping". Most of the clusters were peanuts and not almonds or walnuts. The rest was good but only tasted semi fresh and cheap shot with so many peanuts. I recall when Sees never sold peanut clusters.

I never used to like nuts and chews before I tried Sees; now they are my favorite.  You really get a mouthful with Sees, and  there's nothing particularly "fine" about them, just good dark chocolate (the "American" version) in this particular mix.  In another review for Sees I mentioned that the first time I ever had a See's chocolate I exclaimed "This is like eating FOOD".  What I meant was, you get something substantial to chew on, not just a mouthful of sweetness and goo.  They are hefty, beefy, and not treacly.  I consider them the very high end of your basic all-around chocolate assortment.I have also special-ordered customized assortments from their website, and I can attest to their really good shipping and delivery methods.  No melting, and every perfect little gem in its place - until I can get my hands on 'em.

I spent a lot of time looking through gift baskets to send my kids a nice gift basket..$40.00 later they get a pretty small basket with very little product. Now I would probably pay $20.00 for this basket but not a penny more. First time I have ever been disappointed with anything I have purchased from Amazon.com And I have never written a review on anything. Just thought it was my duty:(((((

I ordered this for my husband (which means I ate some too) and we both are big fans. It came arrived very well packaged and appeared just like it did in the photo. Everything was fresh and very delicious. The popcorn and pretzels were our favorites. I would definitely order this again.

The product presentation and shipping packaging were outstanding.  The product itself was of great quality and was a very good Mother's Day present.  It was delivered in a very timely manner (shipped the same day) and I received it on the expected delivery date.  The only negative remark I can think of, which has nothing to do with the actual product, is that with our hot Florida spring weather the product did melt a little. This was a gift basket which was happily received by relatives.  They enjoyed the variety and said that the foods were good and fresh.

We purchased a few of these as Christmas gifts in 2010 and everyone loved them so we sent out the California Gourmet Baskets to everyone on our list. It is so easy to send with Amazon. I Just order and they mail it for me. Everyone we sent one to loved it. We even ordered on for us this year and it was gone in a very short time. We will be back to order more. Thank you so much for you yummy and fun filled baskets!

This stuff is so worth it, and when you do the math, it's actually a bargain.  More on that later....Some background:  My dog is an 80 pound American Pit Bull Terrier.  He is the love of my life (ok, he's a tie with my husband).  He has horrible allergies, both environmental and food.  Because of this, his doggie dermatologist (yep, there's dermatologists out there just for animals!) has him on an elimination diet of just venison.  Being that I completely spoil my dog I've been looking for high quality venison treats to feed him when I stumbled upon the ZiwiPeak venison on Amazon.  I'd not heard of ZiwiPeak, but when I looked at how few ingredients were in there and did a little research, I decided it sounded about as close to bambi in a bag as I could get (sorry, I know that's a sad visual...).  So, I ordered a few bags of the ZiwiPeak Venison treats.  Titan went mad for them.  It was as if I was sprinkling him with magical venison fairy dust and he would do anything so long as I would continue to shower him with those heavenly venison squares.  You see, it's raw air dried venison, and it comes in these little compact squares about the size of a dime of venison jerky.  But it's still soft, almost velvety, as it is still raw.Titan suffers from a tiny case of separation anxiety, so recently when I had to leave him alone for a while and I was fresh out of bambi bones, I put a handful on top of his food and tip toed towards the door.  He barely lifted his head from the bowl.  For insurance, I threw a half empty bag of the ZiwiPeak Venison treats on the floor just as I slipped out the door...he noticed the bag, but kept eating from his bowl, pushing it around and digging through the kibble with his nose to sniff out the ZiwiPeak squares as if a pig searching for truffles in the south of France.  When I returned a couple of hours later, I searched the house for evidence that he wasn't pleased with my departure.  Apart from the garbage being knocked over (my fault for leaving it full, bad mom!) the place was fine.Later when I went to put down his dinner, Titan sat at the entrance of the kitchen and stared at the cabinet where the venison treats were kept.  When I told him to go and eat, he stayed put, staring at the cabinet.  I added a little canned venison to entice him.  No go.  Finally I poured a little bit of the ZiwiPeak Venison on top and he ran to his bowl and started eating.  Now, he will not go near the bowl unless there is a hefty portion of ZP in there.  Figuring I could save some money, I moved up from the treats to the 2.2 pound bag.  Once I went through that in a week, I moved on to the 11 pound bag.  I haven't made the complete transition to just ZP in his bowl, as I'm still mixing it in with his old stuff, but it's just a matter of time.  The vet has had Titan on one of those vet prescribed diets, which, when I looked at the ingredients on that bag, not only could I not pronounce most of them, but the list was HUGE and the first ingredient was POTATO!But back to my point:  I've bought venison treats for Titan that were anywhere from $10 for 5 or 6 ounces, (which translates to $30 per pound) to $44 per pound for venison jerky (and I paid it!!).  So, at $9 a pound, the ZiwiPeak Venison is actually a bargain.  And, it is high quality.  Not to mention, you know how sometimes your dog eats a bowl of food and then throws up and the vomit looks like a mixture of spongy kibble and foam?  Titan's never had that with this stuff.  I think it's because the ZP is so close to the natural thing that there isn't anything in there to cause it to expand which then causes him to throw up.So yes, overall, I'm very happy with the product line.  I think it's a pretty cool thing that I can use his food as treats and he still goes mad for it (much like a toddler with cheerios!).  I'll be experimenting with some of the other varieties once I'm allowed to introduce other foods per the doggie dermatologist; and I will be trying out the ZP canned as well.

column9: Amazing For Finicky Eaters and Stomach Issues
column10: If you have a dog that turns his or her nose up to all dry and wet foods from premium names such as Wellness CORE, Merrick, Blue Buffalo, Evo, Stella and Chewy's Freeze Dried Patties, Dr. Harvey's etc. then you have to give this a try. My dog is a 40lb Sheltie/Collie mix so having a large highly active dog that wouldn't eat was very stressful I hear many people with toy breeds having the problem but I never thought I would happen with a high energy dog. I was shocked that she hated all other dog food and would only eat a little if I wet the dry food and hand fed her she would really try and starve herself any other way and she was not holding out for human food because I do not give her any knowing the problem would of got worse, if that was possible. I found this food by searching online for food for picky eaters and this came up. I was not hopeful because a lot of the brands I previously tried had similar reviews of picky eaters liking it and my my dog not. When I read that it was jerky like pieces it sparked an interest because she loves those types of treats. The company sent me a Venison trial bag and I purchased the Lamb 2.2lb bag and she lovesssss it. She wakes me up now at 8am whimpering by the bag because she wants it soooo much. The smell and texture is incredible I never saw her eat so fast and she is so much more energetic and happy this food is amazing and not that expensive considering the smaller portion. I could not be more happy this product has everything I need.

column4: D. Mantelli "I am part of the Amazon Tribe kn...
column10: This is not your typical dry dog food, where meat is ground up with all kind of fillers. It is air dried and just look at the ingredients:Venison - Meat (min. 50%), Liver, Tripe, Heart and Kidney (min. 19.5%), Fish (min. 15%), Chicory Inulin, Green-lipped Mussel (min. 4%), Fish Oil, Lecithin, Kelp, Vitamins and Minerals, Parsley, Naturally preserved with mixed tocopherols, Additives: Vit. D3 592 IU/kg, Vit. E 7.4mg/kg, Copper (copper proteinate) 9.8mg/kg. Calories 1778 KJ/100g.The food gets 5 stars from the Dog Food Advisor and contains all the essential vitamins and minerals for your dog.

column9: My shih tzu's LOVE their Ziwi!!
column10: I have two VERY picky shih tzu's that have NEVER turned away from the Venison flavored ZiwiPeak. They eat it daily and are happy doggies! I recommend this product to anyone who has a picky pooch!

column9: One of the best dog food out there.
column10: I have a very picky puppy that would often rather starve himself, than to eat something he doesn't like. Because of that, he was becoming underweight and I decided to switch him away from dry kibble to have him gain some weight first before worrying bout his picky taste.However when I give him ziwipeak, he would finish it up right away!This brand is expensive, but based upon the amounts you feed, it isn't really that much expensive if you have a small dog. I have a 2 pound puppy that is expected to mature at about 4-5 pounds, and the costs is about 25cents extra a day. If you have a big dog that's gonna gobble up 1/3 of a bag or more a day, then that will be a lot more expensive for you.But......The quality of food and the fact that it is in a jerky meat form makes it a lot better than eating hard dry kibble all day long.Anyone would be bored of eating biscuits everyday for his entire life :/The quality of this food is unsurpassed.There have been no problems at all with this food at all as well either. No recalls, all made in New Zealand as well.Something that I tell a lot of people.Spend more on food daily, and not risk the possibility of having a sick dog due to some pet food recall. Vet bills are going to cost you a few thousand dollars.Expensive dog food will probably add up to the same cost as most over the duration of your dog's life, unless you have a really big dog.So instead of having to go through the grief of having a puppy in pain, and you undergoing mental and emotional stress, why not just give it a food that is good and safe and something that the dog enjoys, and spare yourself from all that unnecessary trouble?Yes times are hard and most people are having difficulty putting dinner on the table for themselves or their kids. So there are situations where foods like this are just too much to afford.So unless if your budget really is a problem, I would recommend this food to anyone!
